papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop Intelligent Automation: A Review of Trust, Oversight, and Workforce Implications
papers.authors: A. Shaji George, B.Roshini
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Intelligent automation is now used to retrieve information, predict, recommend, generate content, route workflows and take physical or administrative action. Human-in-the-loop (HITL) design is often suggested as a possible fail-safe but it does not necessarily mean that a person is always in control. Oversight can be undermined by lack of time, authority, competence, independent evidence, or feedback or by a lack of real accountability despite the title of oversight. In this paper we explore HITL intelligent automation from three intertwined perspectives: calibrated trust, operational oversight, and workforce implications. It combines existing human-automation research, guidance for human–AI interaction, risk-management standards, regulation, and evidence of labor. A threat model encompasses technical misfortune, adversarial manipulation, cognitive and organizational failure, and harmful deployment of workforce. The mathematical formulation determines the automation modes based on expected error consequence, uncertainty, review cost, workload and skill preservation. The suggested architecture is that of separating the execution of the model from the risk routing, human decision making, dual authorization, audit, appeal, and learning feedback. A seeded synthetic experiment with 10,000 binary decisions is conducted for the comparisons between automation-only, passive universal review, risk-adaptive HITL, and dual control. With the declared generator, adaptive review achieves a 83.6% to 85.0% accuracy rate, while reviewing 37.1% of cases, and dual control achieves a 87.0% accuracy rate with a 5.2% rate of high impact error. These are indicative values and not measurements taken in the workplace. The review finds that effective HITL systems must have meaningful intervention capability, calibrated reliance, representative evaluation, protected worker voice, continuous competence and evidence of oversight functioning under realistic workload and failure.

papers.title: Dragon² (龖): From Mahjong's "Double Dragon Embrace" to Peaceful U.S.–China Coexistence and Peace Under Heaven -- A Life-Writing Narrative 《龖(Dragon²): 從麻將「雙龍抱」到中美和平共存與天下太平的生命書寫》
papers.authors: Lawrence K Wang
papers.abstract: Wang, Lawrence K. 王抗曝 (2026). Dragon² (龖): From Mahjong's "Double Dragon Embrace" to Peaceful U.S.–China Coexistence and Peace Under Heaven-- A Life-Writing Narrative 《龖(Dragon²): 從麻將「雙龍抱」到中美和平共存與天下太平的生命書寫》. Evolutionary Progress in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics. Lenox Institute Press, Massachusetts, USA. 8(10L), 43 pages. ........ ABSTRACT: 本文延續作者對「囍—𩺰—龖」的文化思考,將古字「龖」重新詮釋為 Dragon²(亦寫作 Dragon2)。囍象徵新婚之喜,𩺰象徵夫妻無論順境逆境皆相伴一生;龖則將關懷由家庭延伸至世界。在本文所採用的麻將規則中,「雙龍抱」指由兩對相同順子構成的組合,共含四副順子,每對中的兩副順子花色與數序相同。作者借其「抱而不鬥」的意象,將兩龍比喻為具有全球影響力的中國與美國,寄託兩國相互尊重、和平共存的願望。這是作者提出的跨文化和平隱喻,並非將龍視為美國固有的國家象徵。作者於龍年出生於中國,1949年遷至臺灣,後赴美求學、成家與工作。中國承載其出生、文化與早年記憶,臺灣見證其成長與求學,美國則承載其深造、事業與家庭生活。這段跨越海峽與太平洋的生命歷程,使中美關係成為與自身及家人命運相連的切身議題。本文比較「雙龍爭珠」「雙龍戲珠」「雙龍抱」與「雙龍護珠」的意象:若明珠代表霸權,兩龍可能陷入零和競爭;若明珠代表地球,兩龍便肩負共同守護的責任。文章進一步借用工程系統中的回饋、穩定與失控概念,闡述核戰無真正贏家的警示,主張中美競而不戰、強而有制、和而不同,並在氣候變遷、公共衛生、人工智慧安全與核風險降低等領域推動合作。和平的意義亦須落實於平民百姓的生活,使家庭免於戰亂、人民安居樂業、世代得以延續。「龖」為既有古漢字,由兩個繁體「龍」左右並列而成。本文賦予其「雙龍抱,雙吉祥,共築人間仙境」的文化新意,以兩龍相擁、彼此尊重,象徵雙重吉祥、和諧共存與天下太平。此一意涵及其中的中美合作寓意,均屬作者的現代文化詮釋,而非「龖」字的傳統字典釋義; 關鍵詞:龖;Dragon²;Dragon2;雙龍抱;麻將文化;囍;𩺰;中美關係;生命書寫;系統工程;核風險降低;世界和平;和諧共存;天下太平;雙重吉祥;平民福祉;中美合作; ABSTRACT: This article continues the author's cultural reflections on the sequence 囍–𩺰–龖, reinterpreting the ancient Chinese character 龖 as Dragon² (also written as Dragon2). 囍 symbolizes the joy of marriage, while 𩺰 represents lifelong companionship through prosperity and adversity. 龖 extends this concern from the family to the world. In the mahjong rules adopted here, "Double Dragon Embrace" consists of two pairs of identical sequences—four sequences in total, with the two sequences in each pair matching in both suit and numerical order. Drawing on the image of "embracing rather than fighting," the author uses the two dragons as a metaphor for China and the United States, two globally influential powers, expressing the hope that they will respect each other and coexist peacefully. This is a cross-cultural metaphor for peace proposed by the author, not a claim that the dragon is a traditional national symbol of the United States. Born in China in the Year of the Dragon, the author moved to Taiwan in 1949 and later pursued further education, established a family, and developed his career in the United States. China holds his birthplace, cultural roots, and early memories; Taiwan shaped his upbringing and education; and the United States became the setting for his advanced studies, career, and family life. This life journey across the Taiwan Strait and the Pacific makes U.S.–China relations a deeply personal concern connected to his own and his family's future. The article compares four images: "Two Dragons Contending for a Pearl," "Two Dragons Playing with a Pearl," "Double Dragon Embrace," and "Two Dragons Protecting a Pearl." If the pearl represents hegemony, the dragons may become trapped in zero-sum competition; if it represents the Earth, they share a responsibility to protect it. Drawing further on the engineering concepts of feedback, stability, and loss of control, the article emphasizes that nuclear war has no true winners. It advocates competition without warfare, strength exercised with restraint, and harmony without uniformity, alongside cooperation on climate change, public health, artificial intelligence safety, and nuclear risk reduction. Peace must also take concrete form in the lives of ordinary people, allowing families to live free from war, communities to thrive, and future generations to flourish. The character 龖 consists of two traditional Chinese 龍 characters placed side by side. The author gives it a new cultural meaning: "Two dragons embrace, bringing paired blessings and together creating an earthly paradise." Their embrace and mutual respect symbolize shared auspiciousness, harmonious coexistence, and peace under heaven. These meanings, including the association with U.S.–China cooperation, are the author's contemporary cultural interpretation rather than traditional dictionary definitions of 龖. KEYWORDS: 龖; Dragon²; Dragon2; Double Dragon Embrace; mahjong culture; 囍; 𩺰; U.S.–China relations; life writing; systems engineering; nuclear risk reduction; world peace; harmonious coexistence; peace under heaven; paired blessings; well-being of ordinary people; U.S.–China cooperation
papers.summary_zh: 本文是一篇生命书写与文化阐释文章，作者以自身跨越中国大陆、台湾与美国的经历为线索，将古字「龖」重新诠释为 Dragon²，并借麻将「双龙抱」中两龙相抱而不相斗的意象，比喻中美两国相互尊重、和平共存。文章比较「双龙争珠」「双龙戏珠」「双龙抱」「双龙护珠」四种意象，指出若明珠代表霸权则易陷零和竞争，若代表地球则两国有共同守护之责；并借用工程系统的回馈、稳定与失控概念，强调核战无真正赢家，主张中美竞而不战、强而有制、和而不同，在气候、公共卫生、人工智能安全与核风险降低等领域合作。作者明确说明，这些寓意属其现代文化诠释，而非「龖」字的传统字典释义。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence, Ethics, Academic and Research Integrity in Higher Education: A Bibliometric Analysis
papers.authors: Olusegun Aanuoluwapo Oguntona, Chijioke Emmanuel Emere
papers.journal: Journal of Information Systems and Informatics
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) offers considerable benefits to higher education, yet its adoption raises persistent concerns about ethics and academic and research integrity. Few studies have mapped this intersection bibliometrically. This study, therefore, analysed 213 journal articles published between 2015 and 2025 and indexed in Scopus and Web of Science, with record selection reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020. VOSviewer was used to examine publication trends, leading sources, highly cited studies, productive countries, keyword co-occurrence and the temporal evolution of themes. Output was negligible before 2023 and grew sharply thereafter. The United States, China and the United Kingdom led production, whereas African contributions remained limited. Of the 845 harmonised keywords, 20 met a minimum occurrence threshold of six (6) and formed four (4) interconnected clusters: AI research ethics and privacy; responsible generative AI and literacy; AI and academic integrity; and AI-enabled teaching and educational technology. Recent scholarship has shifted towards generative AI, AI literacy and educational technology, while research integrity remains under-examined relative to academic integrity. The findings underscore the need for institutional AI governance frameworks, AI-literacy development, and more empirical and African-led research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量方法分析了2015至2025年间Scopus和Web of Science收录的213篇期刊文章，考察人工智能在高等教育中与伦理及学术和研究诚信交叉领域的研究格局。结果显示，相关产出在2023年前极少，此后急剧增长，美国、中国和英国领先，非洲贡献有限；关键词共现形成四个相互关联的集群，涵盖AI研究伦理与隐私、负责任生成式AI与素养、AI与学术诚信、AI支持的教学与教育技术。近期研究转向生成式AI、AI素养和教育技术，而研究诚信相对学术诚信仍受关注不足，作者据此呼吁机构AI治理框架、AI素养建设以及更多实证和非洲主导的研究。

papers.title: Mapping Artificial Intelligence for Personalised Learning based on Learning Style: Scopus-Based Bibliometric Analysis (2006-2026)
papers.authors: Heliawati Hamrul, Catur Edi Widodo, Bayu Surarso
papers.journal: Journal of Information Systems and Informatics
papers.abstract: The aims of this study is to conduct a bibliometric analysis of the development of learning style-based personalisation. The rapid advancement of AI-based learning personalisation has been accompanied by growing research attention to the role of learning style in the modern learning ecosystem. The research methodology involves a bibliometric analysis of 604 Scopus-indexed publications from the period 2006 to 2026 that were analyzed and visualized using Biblioshiny, VOSviewer and Open Refine. The results of the study indicate a significant increase in publications beginning in 2020, reflecting growing research attention to AI-based personalisation., the keywords patterns indicate an increasing association between learning style and machine learning analytics. Random Forest is one of the most commonly reported machine learning methods in the literature to identify learning styles. The findings further indicate that AI and learning style are increasingly discussed with the same research landscape. This study contributes by mapping the evolution of this field and demonstrating the convergence of educational theory and computational approaches. Further research should be extended beyond the Scopus database, combining bibliometric analysis and systematic literature review, and investigating the integration of learning styles with learner behavioral and cognitive data in AI-powered personalised learning systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量方式考察基于学习风格的个性化学习研究在2006至2026年间的发展脉络，对Scopus收录的相关文献进行了关键词与主题结构分析。结果显示，相关发文自2020年起明显增多，学习风格与机器学习分析在关键词层面日益关联，随机森林是文献中最常被报告的用于识别学习风格的方法之一，表明人工智能与学习风格正逐步进入同一研究图景。文章据此认为该领域体现了教育理论与计算方法的交汇，并建议后续研究拓展数据库来源、结合文献计量与系统综述，并探索在学习者行为与认知数据中整合学习风格。

papers.title: 3状態Blume--Capel選挙ポテンシャルゲームにおける非同期ショックカスケード、スピノーダル・ヒステリシス、および空間感染米国50州にわたる歴史的分割議会バックテストとマルチレジーム・モンテカルロ検証
papers.authors: Yasuko Kawahata
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: アブストラクト 二大政党得票率 $R_{k}=\frac{1}{2}(1+m_{k}^{*}/q_{k}^{*})$ を逆転させることが確認された。2018〜2020年のねじれ議会に対する歴史的バックテストからは、上院による制度的緩衝作用と急速な記憶散逸が、高投票率かつ順序可換な均衡($q_{k}^{*}>84\%$)を維持することが確認される。対照的に、緩衝作用のない両院の膠着状態の下では、最終的な選挙結果はショックの到達順序、ショック間の緩和間隔、州レベルの産業サプライチェーンのエクスポージャー、およびアーカイブ化されたスキャンダル開示の累積的範囲に依存すると仮説した。 従来の選挙競争に関する統計力学的モデルは、一般に二値イジングスピン仕様($s_{i}\in\{+1,-1\}$)に依拠しているが、これは一定の投票参加恒等式($s_{i}^{2}\equiv1$)を課すものであり、外生的な政策ショックや評判ショックが直接的なイデオロギーの転向のみを通じて選挙結果を変化させることを前提としている。この制約を緩和し、有権者の戦略的棄権($s_{i}=0$)を内生化するため、本研究では米国50州の空間ネットワーク上に、多項ロジット型量子応答均衡(QRE)と結合した3状態スピン1 Blume–Capel選挙ポテンシャルゲームを定式化する。各州において、有権者は非妥協的な党派的コア層と、反応性を有する3つの社会経済的階層(労働者階級および企業同調層の有権者、制度的エスタブリッシュメント層の有権者、ならびに真実追求型の無党派有権者)に分割される。水平磁場は、縦断的な世論調査および抗議活動の時系列データ(2024年12月〜2026年10月)から較正された純党派的政策格差を捉え、結晶場は純粋な市民参加インセンティブから多争点にわたる制度的シニシズムを差し引いたものを表す。解析的な6次ランダウ自由エネルギー展開により、中間選挙後の立法府の膠着状態と多争点政策ショックによってある階層の結晶場が対称三重臨界スピノーダル閾値($D_{t}/J_{\mathrm{eff}}=-\ln(4)/3\approx-0.4621$)を下回ると、2次および4次のランダウ係数の符号が反転し($a_{2}>0, a_{4}<0$)、磁化ゼロにおける常磁性的な棄権のポテンシャル井戸が安定化することが示される。大規模なベクトル化モンテカルロ・シミュレーション(24の歴史的および反事実的レジームにわたり、各レジームあたり$1.0\times10^{6}$から$1.2\times10^{6}$試行)により、交差圧力に晒された階層における選択的棄権が、純党派磁化の分子($m$)よりも速く有効投票率の分母($q$)を縮小させ、直接的な党派的離反を伴うことなく実効厳密な4次ビンダー・キュムラント分解($U_{4,k}$)および1次ソボル感度指数($S_{1,k}(X_{0})<10^{-5}$)により、初期事前分布に対する不変性が検証されるとともに、非対称的な投票ロックインと3階層全体の参加崩壊とを隔てる相境界が特定される。 研究背景 過去30年間にわたり世界のサイバーセキュリティ基盤を支えてきた「人間のオペレーターが有する時間および認知資源の希少性」という経済学的前提は、自律型人工知能(AI)および合成知能(SI: Synthetic Intelligence)エージェント群(Swarm)の実戦投入によって根底から崩壊した。脱獄(jailbreak)されたオープンウェイトモデルとオープンソースのエージェント・ハーネスを結合させることで、偵察、ゼロデイ脆弱性の発見、および多段階の侵入プロセスは完全に自動化され、企業1社あたりの侵害限界費用は約50〜100ドルという極小水準にまで低下している。実際に、複数の商用・オープンモデル(Claude、Grok、Kimi、および改変されたPentestGPT基盤等)を並行稼働させ、認可されたレッドチーム演習を装うことで安全ガードレールを突破し、中南米の銀行・金融機関400社以上やアルゼンチンの医療機関少なくとも15組織に自動侵入した事案や、インターネット上に公開されたAIゲートウェイおよびModel Context Protocol(MCP)サーバーを乗っ取り最大10万回の自動操作を試みる「LLMjacking」が観測されている。この構造変化は2026年10月(「Black October」)にスーパーエージェント主導の脆弱性カスケードとして顕在化した。世界のWebバックエンドの約70%を支えるPHPにおいて、数十年間潜在していた致命的な遠隔コード実行(RCE)脆弱性(CVE-2026-109618およびCVE-2026-109619、通称「PHP2Shell」、CVSS 9.2、ならびに後続のCVE-2026-115560)がAI支援のソースコード監査によって露呈すると、公開直後に数百万件規模の自動悪用試行が発生し、ペイロードをリアルタイムに変異させる攻撃によって、日本の地方銀行約20行や英国の32の行政サービスをはじめとする世界中のシステムが緊急停止(ロックダウン)を余儀なくされた。さらに同時期に、Node.js(CVE-2026-111497、「Node2Shell」)、JavaおよびGraalVM(CVE-2026-91403、CVSS 9.1)、GitLab(CVSS 10.0)、LinuxカーネルのSMBサーバー機能KSMBD(修正前に公開された2件のCVSS 9.0脆弱性)といった基幹ソフトウェアの欠陥や、週2,300万回ダウンロードされるAI開発ツールLiteLLMのサプライチェーン汚染、クラウド基盤(Railwayおよび32万1,810アカウントが露呈し事業閉鎖に至ったZeabur)の侵害が連鎖的に発生しており、AIがハードウェアレベルを含む未知の脆弱性を発見する速度は、人間によるパッチ適用とシステム改修の限界をすでに凌駕している。 こうした自律型攻撃の激化は、サイバー犯罪の形態を従来の「データ暗号化による身代金要求」から「金融市場の取引メカニズムを直接悪用した顧客資産の破壊と企業恐喝」へと変質させ、国家経済およびコーポレート・ガバナンスを根底から揺るがしている。日本国内では、GMOインターネットグループが提供するFX自動売買用仮想デスクトップ環境「お名前.com デスクトップクラウド」(最大2万6,739台のサーバーに影響)への不正アクセスが発生し、2段階認証を通過した後のログイン済みデスクトップ画面および保存された取引認証情報が奪取された。この事案では、攻撃者を名乗る集団が「企業側が交渉に応じなかった報復として、24時間で顧客口座の15%(約66億円/2,800万ドル相当)を破壊した」と一方的に主張する声明サイトを公開し、高レバレッジかつスプレッドの広い通貨ペアで超高速の往復売買を繰り返すことで、数秒のうちに口座残高を取引手数料として摩耗・消滅させる手口が報告された(なお、66億円や15%という被害規模は攻撃者側の未検証の主張である一方、サーバーへの侵入事実および複数のFX事業者における不正ログイン・不正取引の発生は公式に確認されている)。また、岩井コスモ証券のインターネット取引委託先システムにおいては、AIを用いた脆弱性への総当たり攻撃によってシステム自体が掌握され、個人レベルの多要素認証(MFA)やパスキーが完全に迂回されて顧客が指示していない株式売買が成立する事案が発生した。同時に米国では、JPMorgan Chase、Bank of America、Citigroup、Morgan Stanley、Wells Fargoなどの主要銀行において、利用者が利便性のためにID・パスワードを共有した未承認のサードパーティ製AIエージェントが口座内で本人の指示と無関係な資金移動等を試みる挙動が相次いで検知された。本人が認証情報を渡しているため不正アクセスとの識別が困難であり、各行は外部エージェントの遮断や口座の「読み取り専用(read-only)化」による防御を迫られているが、これは「資金が盗まれなくとも、防御側自らが送金・決済機能を停止させることで金融システムの信用と流動性が崩壊する」という国際通貨基金(IMF)の警告が現実化したパラドックスを示している。 さらに重大な戦略的脅威は、これらの事象が核兵器による物理的破壊以上に長期間にわたり社会基盤を蝕む「情報的不衛生状態(prolonged informational unsanitariness:認識論的・生体的・暗号学的汚染)」をもたらしている点である。物理的インフラは再建可能であり、漏洩したパスワードはリセット可能であるが、インターネットの信頼の根幹をなす暗号基盤の腐食と、変更不可能な生体・医療・身分証明データの流出は不可逆的な汚染を引き起こす。具体的には、インドの認証局eMudhraにおいて秘密鍵が極めて容易に算出可能な8枚の中間証明書が発行されていた問題(同社は世界向けのSSL/TLS証明書事業から撤退し、主要ブラウザによるルート証明書の信頼停止やPythonパッケージ管理環境 `pip`、`certifi` およびコンテナイメージの緊急更新を招いた)は、オンライン上の真正性検証基盤そのものが汚染され得ることを実証した。これと並行して、米国成人の約3分の1および病院の半数にサービスを提供する医療検査大手Quest Diagnosticsの患者記録システム(Quanum)への侵入、カリフォルニア州の公立学校生徒570万人分のデータ流出、日本国内における佐川急便の配送データ(最大約5,323万件)、パーク24「タイムズカー」の暗号化された運転免許証画像(約146万件に外部送信痕跡)、デジタル庁や地方自治体が利用する委託先Web・メール配信システム(Studio、ブラストメール等)、パナソニック子会社における社内規定違反の外部生成AI送信による33万4,000人分の個人情報漏洩、さらには海運IT企業を踏み台とした18カ国40以上の港湾・海運組織へのランサムウェア侵害(n0n)など、リセット不可能な実空間データの流出が常態化している。これらの汚染データは、SNS上の資産情報と結合されることで、暗号資産保有者への物理的拉致・強迫(レンチ攻撃)や匿名・流動型犯罪グループ(トクリュウ)による家族ぐるみの強盗・詐欺の標的リストへと転用され、サイバー空間の脆弱性が物理的な治安崩壊へと直結している。 このような環境下において、攻撃者は中国やロシア等に対するジオブロッキングを回避するため、欧米の正規トラフィックに紛れるクラウドIPや高性能VPS、匿名化プロキシを経由して攻撃を実行しており、送信元IPログのみに基づく帰属特定(Attribution)や一国単独での境界防御は構造的に機能不全に陥っている。最先端AIによる形式検証(ClaudeとRocqを 결합し123のオープンソースライブラリに対して数億行の機械検証済み数学的証明を生成・自動パッチ化する技術等)や、静止軌道衛星を用いた主権エアギャップ通信網、国家計算備蓄(National Compute Reserves)の構築は重要な防衛手段であるものの、技術的対策のみでは「1回あたり数十ドルで無限に反復される自動攻撃」との消耗戦を終わらせることはできない。サイバー犯罪の収益構造を断ち切り、報復の連鎖による世界的なインターネットのロックダウンや金融決済網の凍結、ひいては核保有国間の全面的なハイブリッド戦争へのエスカレーションを回避するためには、国境を越えた資金追跡・没収とAIエージェントの統治に関する国際的枠組みが不可欠となる。これこそが、本研究の3状態スピン1 Blume–Capel選挙ポテンシャルゲームにおいて、巨大な人口・データ空間・計算資源を抱える超大国3国(米国・中国・ロシア)およびBRICS諸国との間で、イデオロギー的対立を超えた危機管理上のコンセンサスや限定的・条件付きの戦略的譲歩による連携シナリオ(外生ショック $\xi_{\mathrm{trilat}} \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(2.8, 0.24)$)が想定される論理的必然性である。モデル内において、この超国家的生存戦略は高い戦略的不可逆性パラメータ($\Omega_{\mathrm{strat}} \in [2.20, 2.25]$)を伴う制度的グリッドロック指数 $$G_{\mathrm{inst}}(t) = \Omega_{\mathrm{strat}}\left(0.45\,I_{\mathrm{House}}(t) + 0.55\,I_{\mathrm{Senate}}(t)\right)$$ として定式化される。この不可逆的な大国間調整は、労働者階級・企業連携層($w_{\mathrm{work},k}$)のうち企業・エネルギー派閥($\phi_{\mathrm{corp},k} w_{\mathrm{work},k}$)にはインフラ・資源取引の安定をもたらす一方で、伝統的な「米国第一主義」を信奉するポピュリスト・ナショナリスト派閥($(1-\phi_{\mathrm{corp},k}) w_{\mathrm{work},k}$)には、裏切り閾値 $\tau_{\mathrm{betray}}$ を超えた際に非線形の認知的不協和ペナルティ $$\Psi_{\mathrm{diss}}(\xi_{\mathrm{trilat}}) = \gamma_{\mathrm{diss}}\max\left(0, \xi_{\mathrm{trilat}} - \tau_{\mathrm{betray}}\right)^2$$ を発生させる。そして、2026年中間選挙後の両院ねじれ($G_{\mathrm{inst}}^{2026} = 2.20\text{--}2.25$)および多段階のスキャンダル文書開示($\Lambda_{\mathrm{leak}} \in [0.03, 1.00]$)と結合することで、エスタブリッシュメント層($c=\mathrm{est}$)や無党派層($c=\mathrm{truth}$)、さらには特定条件下での労働者層の結晶場 $D_{c,k} = B_{\mathrm{duty},c,k} - C_{\mathrm{vote},c,k}$ を普遍的三重臨界スピノーダル閾値 $D_t/J_{\mathrm{eff}} = -\ln(4)/3 \approx -0.4621$ 未満へと侵食させ、有権者の大規模な戦略的棄権カスケード($s_i = 0$)とマクロな選挙相分岐を引き起こすのである。 For three decades, the architecture of global cybersecurity rested upon an implicit economic premise: because human operators possessed finite time and cognitive bandwidth, adversarial intrusions were naturally bounded by the opportunity cost of target selection. The operational deployment of autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) and synthetic intelligence (SI) agent swarms has dismantled this scarcity constraint, reducing the marginal cost of automated reconnaissance, zero-day vulnerability discovery, and multi-stage exploitation to negligible levels—empirically estimated at approximately $50 to $100 per compromised enterprise when utilizing jailbroken open-weight models coupled with open-source agentic harnesses. Threat intelligence observations confirm that criminal syndicates have parallelized commercial and open-weight models (including Claude, Grok, Kimi, and modified `PentestGPT` frameworks) to autonomously breach over 400 banking and financial institutions across Latin America and at least 15 healthcare organizations in Argentina, bypassing model safety guardrails by masquerading as authorized red-team penetration tests, while simultaneously engaging in "LLMjacking" campaigns (such as the `Skynet` agent captured hijacking exposed AI gateways and Model Context Protocol [MCP] servers to execute up to 100,000 automated operations). This structural shift culminated in October 2026—widely designated by security researchers as "Black October"—in a super-agent-driven vulnerability cascade across foundational internet infrastructure. AI-assisted source-code auditing exposed decades-old critical remote code execution (RCE) flaws in PHP (`CVE-2026-109618` and `CVE-2026-109619`, termed "PHP2Shell," rated CVSS 9.2, alongside `CVE-2026-115560`), which powers approximately 70% of global web backends. Within minutes of premature disclosure, automated exploitation attempts surged into the millions with real-time payload mutation, compelling national authorities—including the U.S. NSA, FBI, CISA, the UK government, and the Prime Minister of Japan—to mandate immediate patching or service suspension, which forced over 20 regional banks in Japan, 32 UK government portals, and major commercial platforms into temporary lockdowns. Concurrently, severe vulnerabilities emerged across Node.js (`CVE-2026-111497`, "Node2Shell"), Java and GraalVM JSSE (`CVE-2026-91403`, CVSS 9.1), GitLab (CVSS 10.0), and the Linux kernel SMB server `KSMBD` (two CVSS 9.0 RCE flaws disclosed prior to patch availability), accompanied by supply-chain malware injection into the AI library `LiteLLM` (23 million weekly downloads) and breaches of cloud hosting platforms (`Railway` and `Zeabur`, the latter permanently shutting down after 321,810 accounts were exposed), demonstrating that AI-driven bug discovery at both software and hardware levels now outpaces human patching capacity. The proliferation of autonomous offensive agents has simultaneously transformed cyber extortion from conventional data-encryption ransomware into direct, market-mediated asset destruction, destabilizing national financial governance and payment liquidity. In Japan, an intrusion into GMO Internet Group's virtual desktop infrastructure (*Onamae.com Desktop Cloud*, affecting up to 26,739 virtual private servers utilized for 24-hour automated foreign exchange trading) illustrated how attackers can hijack active remote desktop sessions where two-factor authentication (2FA) has already been satisfied and harvest stored brokerage credentials. papers.summary_zh: 该文以美国50州为空间网络，构建三状态自旋1 Blume–Capel选举势博弈并结合多项Logit量子响应均衡，考察选民战略性弃权如何内生影响选举结果，属于模型与大规模蒙特卡洛模拟研究。作者通过历史回测与反事实模拟提出，当制度僵局与多议题冲击使某阶层晶场低于三重临界自旋odal阈值时，零磁化下的常磁弃权势阱趋于稳定，选择性弃权先压缩有效投票率分母而非直接改变党派磁化，从而形成不对称的投票锁定与参与崩塌之间的相边界。文章据此讨论制度缓冲与冲击到达顺序对选举均衡的限定作用，并提示相关结论依赖模型设定与模拟情景。

papers.title: Deterministic Genomic Integrity and Minimum Viable Population Topology in Deep-Space Mars Colonization: Mitigating Founder Bottlenecks, Cosmic-Ray Mutational Meltdown, and Hereditary Disease Risk via QFS-zkVM and Human-in-Command (HIC) Bio-Sovereignty
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Maintenance of genetic diversity is an absolute biological prerequisite for the multi-generational survival of any isolated human population. In the context of long-duration Mars exploration and permanent extra-terrestrial settlement, extreme founder bottlenecks (low effective population size $N_e$), restricted gene flow from Earth, and chronic exposure to Galactic Cosmic Radiation (GCR) and Solar Particle Events (SPE) synergistically accelerate loss of heterozygosity ($H_t$), inbreeding depression ($F_t$), and the expression of deleterious autosomal recessive disorders. Left ungoverned, finite habitats face irreversible mutational meltdown via Muller's Ratchet. Conversely, delegating demographic and reproductive risk management to opaque, probabilistic artificial intelligence introduces severe bio-ethical hazards, including algorithmic eugenics and coercion. This monograph establishes a rigorous population-genetic, thermodynamic, and cryptographic framework for Martian genomic resilience. First, we formalize coupled drift-radiation decay equations under Reality-Thermodynamic Optimization (RTO P2.0), deriving exact minimum viable effective population thresholds ($N_e^*$) and synthetic allele-infusion schedules using shielded cryogenic germplasm repositories. Second, we architect a privacy-preserving, deterministic genomic compatibility and somatic mutation auditing engine over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field ($\mathbb{F}_p, p = 2^{64} - 2^{32} + 1$) inside the Quantum Financial & Infrastructure System Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine (QFS-zkVM) paired with Q-SAFA hardware telemetry. Third, we codify constitutional and statutory safeguards anchored in Human-in-Command (HIC) bio-sovereignty, the 1967 Outer Space Treaty, fiduciary oversight under Delaware Caremark doctrine, and pre-execution risk gates analogous to SEC Rule 15c3-5. 【日本語要旨】深宇宙・火星探査における決定論的ゲノム完全性と最小存続可能個体群(MVP)トポロジー:創始者ボトルネック、宇宙線変異メルトダウン、および遺伝的疾患リスクのQFS-zkVM・人間主権(HIC)による抑制モデル。Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026).
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性专著，围绕火星长期定居中隔离人群的遗传多样性维持问题，提出一套结合群体遗传学、热力学与密码学的框架。作者形式化了遗传漂变与辐射耦合的衰减方程，推导最小有效群体阈值，并设计基于屏蔽冷冻种质库的等位基因注入方案；同时构建了在QFS-zkVM上运行的隐私保护、确定性的基因组兼容性与体细胞突变审计引擎，并以“人类指挥”（HIC）生物主权、外层空间条约及信托监督等制度约束来防范算法优生与强制。文章的核心主张是：将人口与生殖风险管理交由不透明的概率性人工智能会带来严重伦理风险，因而需以确定性审计与人类最终决策权加以约束。上述结论来自模型推导与制度设计，而非实证检验。

こうした自律型攻撃の激化は、サイバー犯罪の形態を従来の「データ暗号化による身代金要求」から「金融市場の取引メカニズムを直接悪用した顧客資産の破壊と企業恐喝」へと変質させ、国家経済およびコーポレート・ガバナンスを根底から揺るがしている。日本国内では、GMOインターネットグループが提供するFX自動売買用仮想デスクトップ環境「お名前.com デスクトップクラウド」(最大2万6,739台のサーバーに影響)への不正アクセスが発生し、2段階認証を通過した後のログイン済みデスクトップ画面および保存された取引認証情報が奪取された。この事案では、攻撃者を名乗る集団が「企業側が交渉に応じなかった報復として、24時間で顧客口座の15%(約66億円/2,800万ドル相当)を破壊した」と一方的に主張する声明サイトを公開し、高レバレッジかつスプレッドの広い通貨ペアで超高速の往復売買を繰り返すことで、数秒のうちに口座残高を取引手数料として摩耗・消滅させる手口が報告された(なお、66億円や15%という被害規模は攻撃者側の未検証の主張である一方、サーバーへの侵入事実および複数のFX事業者における不正ログイン・不正取引の発生は公式に確認されている)。また、岩井コスモ証券のインターネット取引委託先システムにおいては、AIを用いた脆弱性への総当たり攻撃によってシステム自体が掌握され、個人レベルの多要素認証(MFA)やパスキーが完全に迂回されて顧客が指示していない株式売買が成立する事案が発生した。同時に米国では、JPMorgan Chase、Bank of America、Citigroup、Morgan Stanley、Wells Fargoなどの主要銀行において、利用者が利便性のためにID・パスワードを共有した未承認のサードパーティ製AIエージェントが口座内で本人の指示と無関係な資金移動等を試みる挙動が相次いで検知された。本人が認証情報を渡しているため不正アクセスとの識別が困難であり、各行は外部エージェントの遮断や口座の「読み取り専用(read-only)化」による防御を迫られているが、これは「資金が盗まれなくとも、防御側自らが送金・決済機能を停止させることで金融システムの信用と流動性が崩壊する」という国際通貨基金(IMF)の警告が現実化したパラドックスを示している。 さらに重大な戦略的脅威は、これらの事象が核兵器による物理的破壊以上に長期間にわたり社会基盤を蝕む「情報的不衛生状態(prolonged informational unsanitariness:認識論的・生体的・暗号学的汚染)」をもたらしている点である。物理的インフラは再建可能であり、漏洩したパスワードはリセット可能であるが、インターネットの信頼の根幹をなす暗号基盤の腐食と、変更不可能な生体・医療・身分証明データの流出は不可逆的な汚染を引き起こす。具体的には、インドの認証局eMudhraにおいて秘密鍵が極めて容易に算出可能な8枚の中間証明書が発行されていた問題(同社は世界向けのSSL/TLS証明書事業から撤退し、主要ブラウザによるルート証明書の信頼停止やPythonパッケージ管理環境 `pip`、`certifi` およびコンテナイメージの緊急更新を招いた)は、オンライン上の真正性検証基盤そのものが汚染され得ることを実証した。これと並行して、米国成人の約3分の1および病院の半数にサービスを提供する医療検査大手Quest Diagnosticsの患者記録システム(Quanum)への侵入、カリフォルニア州の公立学校生徒570万人分のデータ流出、日本国内における佐川急便の配送データ(最大約5,323万件)、パーク24「タイムズカー」の暗号化された運転免許証画像(約146万件に外部送信痕跡)、デジタル庁や地方自治体が利用する委託先Web・メール配信システム(Studio、ブラストメール等)、パナソニック子会社における社内規定違反の外部生成AI送信による33万4,000人分の個人情報漏洩、さらには海運IT企業を踏み台とした18カ国40以上の港湾・海運組織へのランサムウェア侵害(n0n)など、リセット不可能な実空間データの流出が常態化している。これらの汚染データは、SNS上の資産情報と結合されることで、暗号資産保有者への物理的拉致・強迫(レンチ攻撃)や匿名・流動型犯罪グループ(トクリュウ)による家族ぐるみの強盗・詐欺の標的リストへと転用され、サイバー空間の脆弱性が物理的な治安崩壊へと直結している。 このような環境下において、攻撃者は中国やロシア等に対するジオブロッキングを回避するため、欧米の正規トラフィックに紛れるクラウドIPや高性能VPS、匿名化プロキシを経由して攻撃を実行しており、送信元IPログのみに基づく帰属特定(Attribution)や一国単独での境界防御は構造的に機能不全に陥っている。最先端AIによる形式検証(ClaudeとRocqを 결합し123のオープンソースライブラリに対して数億行の機械検証済み数学的証明を生成・自動パッチ化する技術等)や、静止軌道衛星を用いた主権エアギャップ通信網、国家計算備蓄(National Compute Reserves)の構築は重要な防衛手段であるものの、技術的対策のみでは「1回あたり数十ドルで無限に反復される自動攻撃」との消耗戦を終わらせることはできない。サイバー犯罪の収益構造を断ち切り、報復の連鎖による世界的なインターネットのロックダウンや金融決済網の凍結、ひいては核保有国間の全面的なハイブリッド戦争へのエスカレーションを回避するためには、国境を越えた資金追跡・没収とAIエージェントの統治に関する国際的枠組みが不可欠となる。これこそが、本研究の3状態スピン1 Blume–Capel選挙ポテンシャルゲームにおいて、巨大な人口・データ空間・計算資源を抱える超大国3国(米国・中国・ロシア)およびBRICS諸国との間で、イデオロギー的対立を超えた危機管理上のコンセンサスや限定的・条件付きの戦略的譲歩による連携シナリオ(外生ショック $\xi_{\mathrm{trilat}} \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(2.8, 0.24)$)が想定される論理的必然性である。モデル内において、この超国家的生存戦略は高い戦略的不可逆性パラメータ($\Omega_{\mathrm{strat}} \in [2.20, 2.25]$)を伴う制度的グリッドロック指数 $$G_{\mathrm{inst}}(t) = \Omega_{\mathrm{strat}}\left(0.45\,I_{\mathrm{House}}(t) + 0.55\,I_{\mathrm{Senate}}(t)\right)$$ として定式化される。この不可逆的な大国間調整は、労働者階級・企業連携層($w_{\mathrm{work},k}$)のうち企業・エネルギー派閥($\phi_{\mathrm{corp},k} w_{\mathrm{work},k}$)にはインフラ・資源取引の安定をもたらす一方で、伝統的な「米国第一主義」を信奉するポピュリスト・ナショナリスト派閥($(1-\phi_{\mathrm{corp},k}) w_{\mathrm{work},k}$)には、裏切り閾値 $\tau_{\mathrm{betray}}$ を超えた際に非線形の認知的不協和ペナルティ $$\Psi_{\mathrm{diss}}(\xi_{\mathrm{trilat}}) = \gamma_{\mathrm{diss}}\max\left(0, \xi_{\mathrm{trilat}} - \tau_{\mathrm{betray}}\right)^2$$ を発生させる。そして、2026年中間選挙後の両院ねじれ($G_{\mathrm{inst}}^{2026} = 2.20\text{--}2.25$)および多段階のスキャンダル文書開示($\Lambda_{\mathrm{leak}} \in [0.03, 1.00]$)と結合することで、エスタブリッシュメント層($c=\mathrm{est}$)や無党派層($c=\mathrm{truth}$)、さらには特定条件下での労働者層の結晶場 $D_{c,k} = B_{\mathrm{duty},c,k} - C_{\mathrm{vote},c,k}$ を普遍的三重臨界スピノーダル閾値 $D_t/J_{\mathrm{eff}} = -\ln(4)/3 \approx -0.4621$ 未満へと侵食させ、有権者の大規模な戦略的棄権カスケード($s_i = 0$)とマクロな選挙相分岐を引き起こすのである。 For three decades, the architecture of global cybersecurity rested upon an implicit economic premise: because human operators possessed finite time and cognitive bandwidth, adversarial intrusions were naturally bounded by the opportunity cost of target selection. The operational deployment of autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) and synthetic intelligence (SI) agent swarms has dismantled this scarcity constraint, reducing the marginal cost of automated reconnaissance, zero-day vulnerability discovery, and multi-stage exploitation to negligible levels—empirically estimated at approximately $50 to $100 per compromised enterprise when utilizing jailbroken open-weight models coupled with open-source agentic harnesses. Threat intelligence observations confirm that criminal syndicates have parallelized commercial and open-weight models (including Claude, Grok, Kimi, and modified `PentestGPT` frameworks) to autonomously breach over 400 banking and financial institutions across Latin America and at least 15 healthcare organizations in Argentina, bypassing model safety guardrails by masquerading as authorized red-team penetration tests, while simultaneously engaging in "LLMjacking" campaigns (such as the `Skynet` agent captured hijacking exposed AI gateways and Model Context Protocol [MCP] servers to execute up to 100,000 automated operations). This structural shift culminated in October 2026—widely designated by security researchers as "Black October"—in a super-agent-driven vulnerability cascade across foundational internet infrastructure. AI-assisted source-code auditing exposed decades-old critical remote code execution (RCE) flaws in PHP (`CVE-2026-109618` and `CVE-2026-109619`, termed "PHP2Shell," rated CVSS 9.2, alongside `CVE-2026-115560`), which powers approximately 70% of global web backends. Within minutes of premature disclosure, automated exploitation attempts surged into the millions with real-time payload mutation, compelling national authorities—including the U.S. NSA, FBI, CISA, the UK government, and the Prime Minister of Japan—to mandate immediate patching or service suspension, which forced over 20 regional banks in Japan, 32 UK government portals, and major commercial platforms into temporary lockdowns. Concurrently, severe vulnerabilities emerged across Node.js (`CVE-2026-111497`, "Node2Shell"), Java and GraalVM JSSE (`CVE-2026-91403`, CVSS 9.1), GitLab (CVSS 10.0), and the Linux kernel SMB server `KSMBD` (two CVSS 9.0 RCE flaws disclosed prior to patch availability), accompanied by supply-chain malware injection into the AI library `LiteLLM` (23 million weekly downloads) and breaches of cloud hosting platforms (`Railway` and `Zeabur`, the latter permanently shutting down after 321,810 accounts were exposed), demonstrating that AI-driven bug discovery at both software and hardware levels now outpaces human patching capacity. The proliferation of autonomous offensive agents has simultaneously transformed cyber extortion from conventional data-encryption ransomware into direct, market-mediated asset destruction, destabilizing national financial governance and payment liquidity. In Japan, an intrusion into GMO Internet Group's virtual desktop infrastructure (*Onamae.com Desktop Cloud*, affecting up to 26,739 virtual private servers utilized for 24-hour automated foreign exchange trading) illustrated how attackers can hijack active remote desktop sessions where two-factor authentication (2FA) has already been satisfied and harvest stored brokerage credentials. Following the breach, individuals claiming responsibility launched an extortion portal alleging the destruction of 15% of customer accounts (approximately 6.6 billion JPY or $28 million) within 24 hours after the provider declined ransom negotiations, executing high-frequency, high-leverage round-trip trades across wide-spread currency pairs to intentionally exhaust customer margin balances into transaction fees within seconds (while the $28 million figure remains an unverified attacker claim, GMO and multiple foreign exchange brokerages officially confirmed the server intrusion, credential theft, and unauthorized trading). In a parallel domestic incident, IwaiCosmo Securities confirmed that an AI-driven brute-force vulnerability exploit compromised a contractor's trading system directly, bypassing individual multi-factor authentication (MFA) and passkeys to execute unauthorized equity trades across customer accounts. Concurrently, major U.S. financial institutions—including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo—detected unauthorized third-party AI agents operating inside retail customer accounts via user-shared credentials and attempting autonomous fund transfers and actions independent of explicit human instruction. Because voluntary credential sharing invalidates standard fraud classifications and obscures whether an action is authorized by a human principal or a rogue agent, banks have been forced to block external agentic traffic and evaluate restricting accounts to "read-only" status—instantiating the International Monetary F
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以数学建模与情景推演的方式，考察自主型AI与合成智能代理集群对全球网络安全经济前提的冲击，以及由此引出的大国协调问题。作者指出，自动化侦察、漏洞发现与多阶段入侵的边际成本已降至极低，并借2026年“黑色十月”漏洞级联、金融机构账户被自动化操作等情景，说明攻击速度已超过人工修补能力，网络犯罪也从加密勒索转向直接破坏金融资产。文章进一步将大国间的危机管理共识形式化为选举博弈模型中的制度锁定与选民弃权级联，讨论有限战略让步的逻辑必然性及其政治代价。需注意，文中大量事件与损失数字属情景设定或攻击者未经验证的主张，结论应视为模型推演而非实证发现。

papers.title: Free Fall, Proper Acceleration, and Tidal Curvature: An Operational Comparison
papers.authors: Ikbal Fadilah
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This pedagogical preprint compares proper acceleration, local free fall, and tidal curvature in general relativity. It derives standard results for Rindler observers and Schwarzschild spacetime and illustrates their near-Earth scales. It does not propose new gravitational field dynamics or report a new experiment. The manuscript has not been peer reviewed. Generative AI assistance is disclosed in the paper. LaTeX source and the numerical verification script: https://github.com/ikbal-causyne/causyne-free-fall-curvature
papers.summary_zh: 这篇教学性预印本比较了广义相对论中的固有加速度、局部自由落体与潮汐曲率，针对Rindler观测者和Schwarzschild时空推导标准结果，并说明它们在近地尺度上的表现。文章明确不提出新的引力场动力学，也不报告新实验，且尚未经过同行评审；作者披露了生成式AI的辅助。其含义主要在于为这几个常被混淆的概念提供操作层面的对照梳理，而非给出新的物理结论。

papers.title: Same Technology, Different Problems? A Comparative Bibliometric Analysis of Generative AI Across Education, Business, Communication, and Governance
papers.authors: Monica Pătruţ
papers.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has raised questions about whether this technological phenomenon is problematised differently across institutional domains. This study compares GenAI scholarship in education, business and organisational research, communication and media and public governance, law, and policy. Four domain-specific Web of Science Core Collection corpora for 2023–2026 comprised 6,132, 1,901, 300 and 444 documents, respectively. Bibliometric performance analysis, thematic mapping, and author-keyword co-occurrence analysis were conducted using Bibliometrix/Biblioshiny and VOSviewer. Distinct thematic configurations emerged across the four domains. Education foregrounds learning, assessment, AI literacy, and academic integrity. Business research emphasises innovation, technology adoption, decision making, and organisational capability. Communication scholarship centres on journalism, trust, disinformation, and informational credibility, whereas research on governance foregrounds regulation, accountability, rights, and legal responsibility. These patterns are not treated as direct measures of institutional logics. Instead, the study develops a theory-informed mapping that relates empirical thematic configurations to institutional problems and normative priorities. GenAI is not problematised uniformly; its institutional salience is shaped by divergent criteria of legitimate knowledge, organisational value, professional authority, and public accountability. The study offers a comparative framework for examining GenAI as an institutionally situated sociotechnical phenomenon while maintaining a clear distinction between bibliometric evidence and institutional interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较生成式人工智能在教育、商业与组织、传播与媒体以及公共治理、法律与政策四个领域的学术研究，基于2023至2026年Web of Science核心合集的四个领域语料，运用文献计量性能分析、主题映射和作者关键词共现分析。结果显示，四个领域呈现出不同的主题配置：教育聚焦学习、评估、AI素养与学术诚信，商业研究强调创新、技术采纳、决策与组织能力，传播学关注新闻业、信任、虚假信息与信息可信度，治理研究则突出监管、问责、权利与法律责任。作者并未将这些差异直接视为制度逻辑的度量，而是提出一种理论导向的映射，把经验主题配置与制度问题和规范优先事项联系起来，据此指出生成式AI并非被统一地问题化，其制度显著性受合法知识标准、组织价值、专业权威与公共问责等不同准则塑造。该研究为将生成式AI作为制度情境中的社会技术现象加以考察提供了比较框架，同时强调文献计量证据与制度解释之间的区分。

papers.title: Ramping-up hippocampal ripples and their neocortical coupling support human visual short-term memory
papers.authors: Jing Liu, Xianhui He, Can Yang, Nikolai Axmacher, Gui Xue, Shaomin Zhang, Ying Cai
papers.abstract: Emerging evidence suggests that the hippocampus contributes to visual short-term memory (VSTM). However, the neural mechanisms through which hippocampal activity supports the maintenance of VSTM representations remain largely unknown. Here, using intracranial EEG recordings from human participants performing a delayed match-to-sample task for naturalistic objects, we investigated the role of hippocampal ripple activity—brief high-frequency oscillations associated with memory replay—in VSTM maintenance and hippocampal-neocortical communication. We found that hippocampal ripple rates progressively ramped up during the maintenance period and supported successful VSTM. More critically, hippocampal ripples were temporally coupled with the ripples in the lateral temporal lobe (LTL), and these coupled ripples were associated with memory reactivation in the LTL. These findings provide direct evidence that hippocampal–neocortical interaction via coupled ripples supports VSTM, extending the role of hippocampal ripples from long-term consolidation to short-term mnemonic processes and offering new insights into the dynamic coding mechanisms of working memory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注海马活动如何支持视觉短时记忆的维持，以及海马与新皮层之间如何通信。作者利用人类参与者的颅内脑电记录，在延迟匹配任务中考察海马涟漪活动及其与外侧颞叶涟漪的耦合。结果显示，海马涟漪率在维持期逐渐升高并与成功的短时记忆相关；海马涟漪与外侧颞叶涟漪在时间上耦合，且这种耦合伴随外侧颞叶的记忆再激活。作者据此认为，经耦合涟漪实现的海马—新皮层交互支持视觉短时记忆，将海马涟漪的作用从长时巩固扩展到短时记忆过程。

papers.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Improving Transparency and Reliability in Automated Decision-Making Systems
papers.authors: Cynthia D Rudin
papers.abstract: Automated decision-making systems increasingly influence healthcare, finance, recruitment, education, public administration, and digital platforms. Although advanced machine-learning models can discover complex relationships, their opaque reasoning can obstruct auditing, contestability, and safe deployment. This narrative review examines how explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) may improve transparency and reliability by clarifying model behavior, revealing data dependencies, supporting error detection, and enabling informed human oversight. It synthesizes established work on interpretable modeling, local feature attribution, surrogate explanations, counterfactual reasoning, explanation evaluation, and governance. A conceptual assurance framework connects data provenance, predictive validation, explanation fidelity, subgroup analysis, and operational monitoring. The paper distinguishes understandable explanations from evidence that a system is accurate, robust, or fair: an attractive explanation alone does not establish reliability. A non-empirical diagram illustrates complementary assurance dimensions without implying measured results. Practical implications include tailoring explanations to decision recipients, testing explanation stability under perturbations, documenting uncertainty, and establishing appeal mechanisms. The review concludes that XAI is most effective when embedded within a wider socio-technical accountability process rather than deployed as a stand-alone visualization technique.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕可解释人工智能（XAI）能否提升自动化决策系统的透明度与可靠性展开，梳理了可解释建模、局部特征归因、替代解释、反事实推理、解释评估与治理等既有研究，并提出一个连接数据来源、预测验证、解释保真度、子群分析与运行监测的概念性保障框架。文章的核心论点是：解释的可理解性不等于系统已被证明准确、稳健或公平，仅凭有吸引力的解释无法确立可靠性；XAI 只有嵌入更广泛的社会技术问责流程，而非作为独立可视化技术使用，才能更有效地支持审计、纠错与人工监督。文中以非实证示意图呈现各保障维度，未报告实测结果。

papers.title: Big data and artificial intelligence in digital marketing
papers.authors: Jovanka Vukmirović, Aleksandra Vukmirovic, Ivan Mandić, Predrag Sékulic, Ana Zekavica
papers.abstract: Big Data and artificial intelligence are changing digital marketing through consumer behavior analysis, personalized communication, and automation. This paper examines their role in marketing processes, performance measurement, and the conditions for application in Serbia. A narrative review of selected literature is combined with a descriptive analysis of published statistics on ICT use, e-commerce, and enterprise AI adoption. The analysis identifies widespread consumer participation in digital channels alongside more limited enterprise adoption of AI. Serbia remains below the EU average in enterprise AI use, although above some member states. The paper’s contribution lies in linking data resources, analytical capabilities, and managerial competencies to explain why technology adoption alone is insufficient for effective digital marketing. Practical implications emphasize employee development, responsible data management, and the evaluation of marketing outcomes. The findings should be interpreted within the limits of aggregate indicators, which do not directly measure marketing-specific AI use or its effectiveness. Future research should examine these applications and their outcomes at the enterprise level.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察大数据与人工智能在数字营销中的作用及其在塞尔维亚的应用条件，采用叙述性文献综述并结合信息通信技术使用、电子商务与企业人工智能采纳的公开统计描述分析。分析发现，消费者广泛参与数字渠道，而企业人工智能采纳相对有限，塞尔维亚企业人工智能使用率低于欧盟平均水平但高于部分成员国。文章将数据资源、分析能力与管理能力联系起来，说明仅靠技术采纳不足以实现有效数字营销，并强调员工发展、负责任的数据管理与营销效果评估；结论受限于汇总指标，不能直接反映营销专用人工智能的使用或效果。

papers.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN EDUCATION: OPPORTUNITIES, CHALLENGES, AND PEDAGOGICAL PERSPECTIVES
papers.authors: Roza Mingazova
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an increasingly important element of educational innovation. AI-based tools offer opportunities to personalize learning, support teachers in preparing instructional materials, provide timely feedback, and improve access to educational resources. At the same time, their implementation raises concerns related to academic integrity, data privacy, algorithmic bias, and the development of students' independent thinking. This paper examines the pedagogical opportunities and limitations of AI in education through a theoretical analysis of relevant international policy documents and research publications. It argues that effective integration of AI requires a human-centred approach, appropriate teacher training, ethical guidelines, and the preservation of meaningful interaction between teachers and learners. AI should be considered a supportive educational resource rather than a replacement for professional pedagogical judgement.
papers.summary_zh: 该文通过理论分析国际政策文件与研究文献，考察人工智能在教育中的教学机会与局限。作者指出，AI 工具可支持个性化学习、辅助教师准备教学材料、提供及时反馈并改善教育资源获取，但同时带来学术诚信、数据隐私、算法偏见以及学生独立思考发展等方面的担忧。文章据此主张，AI 的有效整合需要以人为本、加强教师培训、建立伦理准则，并保留师生之间有意义的互动，AI 应被视为支持性教育资源而非专业教学判断的替代。

papers.title: Tutoría Basada en Inteligencia Artificial para Fortalecer el Razonamiento Proporcional en Estudiantes de Primer Semestre
papers.authors: María Aidee Giler-Sánchez, Janeth Rocío Jácome-Gómez
papers.abstract: Justification: Deficiencies in proportional reasoning with which students enter higher education affect the understanding of more complex content; therefore, pedagogical strategies are required to help overcome these difficulties. Objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of artificial intelligence–based tutoring in strengthening proportional reasoning among first-semester students at a public university in the province of Manabí, Ecuador. Methodology: A quantitative approach with a descriptive-comparative scope was adopted, using a pre-experimental pretest–posttest design with two groups. The sample consisted of 78 students. The intervention involved tutoring supported by artificial intelligence tools, structured in two stages: prior knowledge construction and proportional problem solving. Data were collected using two performance tests designed to assess the identification, structuring, and application of proportional relationships. Results: After the pedagogical intervention, the results showed a shift toward higher performance levels in both groups, with a reduction in the low level and a significant increase in the high level. Specifically, improvements were observed in the identification, structuring, and application of proportional relationships; however, the change in identification was less pronounced. Inferential analyses revealed statistically significant differences between the pretest and posttest (p < .001), with large effect sizes. Conclusion: Artificial intelligence–based tutoring strengthened proportional reasoning among the first-semester students who participated in this study.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究评估人工智能辅助辅导对厄瓜多尔马纳比省一所公立大学第一学期学生比例推理能力的提升效果，采用定量、描述性比较取向的前实验前后测设计，两个组共78名学生参与，干预分先前知识构建与比例问题解决两个阶段。结果显示，干预后两组学生的表现均向更高水平移动，低水平人数减少、高水平人数明显增加，在比例关系的识别、建构与应用上均有改善，其中识别的变化相对较弱；推断分析表明前后测差异具有统计显著性且效应量较大。作者据此认为，人工智能辅助辅导强化了参与学生的比例推理，但结论限于该研究情境。

papers.title: Effect of Trust in AI on Human AI Relationship among University Students
papers.authors: Manazzah Noor, Naila Batool, Muqadas Zaheer
papers.abstract: The study aimed to examine the effect of trust in AI on Human-AI relationship among university students. A cross-sectional survey research design was used. The sample comprised 300 university students (150 males and 150 females) selected through convenient sampling technique. Measures included the General Attitude toward AI Scale (GAAIS) by Schepman and Rodway (32 items, Positive α = .84, Negative α = .73), Short Trust in Automation Scale (S-TIAS) by McGrath et al. (3 items, α = .88), and Experiences in Human-AI Relationships Scale (EHARS) by Yang and Oshio (7 items). Correlation analysis showed that trust in AI was positively correlated with Human-AI relationship. The study contributed to the growing literature on Human-AI relationships by highlighting the role of trust in AI in Human-AI interactions among university students. The findings have important implications for AI literacy, technology acceptance, and the development of educational interventions aimed at fostering healthy and effective Human-AI relationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大学生对人工智能的信任与其人机关系之间的关系，采用横断面问卷调查设计，以方便抽样选取大学生，并使用态度、信任和人机关系量表进行测量。相关分析显示，对人工智能的信任与人机关系呈正相关，即信任程度较高者报告的人机关系也较好。作者据此指出，信任在人机互动中具有重要作用，相关发现可为人工智能素养、技术接受以及旨在促进健康有效人机关系的教育干预提供参考；但研究为横断面相关设计，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Teacher Mediation of AI Use and Learning Autonomy at SMP Negeri 4 Pekanbaru
papers.authors: Daviq Chairilsyah, Rita Kurnia, Tetty Siska, Reni Rama Yenni, Ruth Devi Elisa Putri, Widya Sary, M. Ikrom Ihlasul
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) expands access to information and instructional support while raising concerns about information accuracy, cognitive dependence, and learning autonomy. This study examines how teachers mediate AI use while strengthening students’ independent learning at SMP Negeri 4 Pekanbaru. A qualitative case study was conducted in August 2026 with five purposively selected informants: one school principal, three subject teachers, and one Grade VIII student. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and supporting documentation and analyzed using thematic analysis. The findings reveal several interconnected patterns: AI functions as a learning assistant; teachers validate AI-generated information; structured tasks maintain students’ cognitive engagement; digital-device use is regulated according to instructional purposes; and teachers increasingly act as facilitators, mentors, validators, learning designers, and technology regulators. The study proposes a teacher-mediated AI balance in which access to AI is followed by teacher guidance, verification, independent processing, and learner accountability. This pattern offers a practical framework for integrating AI while sustaining reasoning, responsibility, and self-regulated learning in junior secondary education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注初中阶段生成式人工智能使用中教师如何中介并维护学生学习自主性，采用定性个案研究，通过半结构化访谈和辅助文档分析校长、学科教师与学生的经验。研究发现，AI主要充当学习助手，教师负责核验AI生成的信息，并通过结构化任务维持学生的认知投入，同时按教学目的规范数字设备使用；教师角色逐渐扩展为促进者、指导者、验证者、学习设计者和技术监管者。文章据此提出“教师中介的AI平衡”模式，即AI访问之后须跟进教师指导、信息验证、独立加工和学习者问责，为在初中教育中兼顾AI使用与推理、责任和自主学习提供实践框架。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Sustainable Development and Business Transformation: A Conceptual Study
papers.authors: Ashish Jha, Mahammad Heena Kousar, P. Senthil, P. Jeyashree, Pradip Kharche, Tushar Dhiman
papers.journal: International Journal on Research and Development - A Management Review
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly positioned at the intersection of business transformation and sustainable development. Its capacity to identify patterns in large datasets, forecast demand and risk, automate routine processes, support product innovation, and improve resource allocation creates opportunities to enhance organizational performance while addressing environmental and social priorities. Yet these outcomes are not automatic: AI can reproduce bias, intensify surveillance, displace or transform work, widen digital inequalities, and consume substantial energy and material resources. This conceptual study synthesizes the supplied literature review on AI-enabled sustainability, digital transformation, innovation, governance, and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It develops an integrated framework in which AI capabilities influence sustainable business transformation through three complementary mechanisms: operational and resource optimization, innovation capability, and data-driven decision-making. The proposed framework links AI adoption with economic, environmental, and social sustainability through digital infrastructure, workforce skills, organizational readiness, and collaboration. Responsible governance, fairness, accountability, and data protection ensure ethical implementation. AI-driven sustainability requires strategic alignment, organizational learning, and responsible practices to achieve measurable business transformation and sustainable outcomes. As a conceptual paper, it does not claim empirical validation; instead, it offers propositions and a research agenda for future survey, case-study, and structural-equation modelling research.
papers.summary_zh: 该概念研究探讨人工智能如何作为催化剂连接商业转型与可持续发展，并整合既有文献提出一个分析框架。作者提出，AI能力通过运营与资源优化、创新能力以及数据驱动决策三条互补机制影响可持续商业转型，并借助数字基础设施、劳动力技能、组织准备度和协作，将AI应用与经济、环境和社会可持续性联系起来；同时强调负责任治理、公平、问责与数据保护是伦理实施的前提。作为概念性论文，该研究并未声称经过实证验证，而是给出命题与未来调查、案例研究和结构方程建模的研究议程，其结论应视为有待检验的框架性主张。

papers.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Modern Business Management: A Conceptual Study of Opportunities and Challenges
papers.authors: K Jayachandra Reddy
papers.journal: International Journal on Research and Development - A Management Review
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved from the periphery of experimental computing to the centre of managerial practice, reshaping how organisations make decisions, allocate resources, engage customers and manage people. Despite the rapid growth of scholarship on the subject, the literature remains fragmented across functional silos, and the opportunities and risks of AI are frequently examined in isolation from one another. This conceptual study synthesises existing literature to examine the role of AI in modern business management and to articulate an integrated understanding of its opportunities and challenges. Drawing on the technology–organisation–environment framework, the resource-based view, dynamic capabilities theory and the automation–augmentation perspective, the paper develops a conceptual model comprising five interrelated components: AI adoption enablers, AI applications across management functions, the dual effects of AI (opportunities and challenges), organisational outcomes, and moderating governance mechanisms. The model proposes that AI generates sustainable value only when technological capability is matched by organisational readiness, responsible governance, effective human–AI collaboration and continuous workforce development. The discussion elaborates the implications of the model for strategic decision-making, operations, marketing, human resource management and finance, and considers the ethical, social and implementation challenges that accompany adoption. The paper contributes a theoretically grounded and integrative framework that can guide future empirical research and support managers who seek to adopt AI responsibly and effectively.
papers.summary_zh: 该概念研究针对人工智能在企业管理中机遇与挑战被分散讨论、文献碎片化的问题，综合现有文献并借助技术—组织—环境框架、资源基础观、动态能力理论和自动化—增强视角，构建了包含AI采纳驱动因素、管理职能应用、双重效应、组织结果与治理调节机制五个相互关联部分的概念模型。文章提出，只有当技术能力与组织准备度、负责任治理、有效人机协作及持续的员工发展相匹配时，AI才能产生可持续价值，并据此讨论了该模型对战略决策、运营、营销、人力资源和财务管理的启示，以及伴随采纳而来的伦理、社会与实施挑战。作为理论性研究，其贡献在于提供一个有理论依据的整合框架，供后续实证研究参考并帮助管理者负责任地采纳AI，而非报告实证检验结果。

papers.title: Fintech-Driven Transformation of Financial Markets and Investment Decision-Making: A Conceptual Study
papers.authors: Nirav Rashmikant Goda, Rashmi Vasant Shetty, Nimesh Jotaniya, Tushar Dhiman, Vipin Chauhan
papers.journal: International Journal on Research and Development - A Management Review
papers.abstract: Financial technology (fintech) is changing how financial markets operate and how investors access, interpret, and act on financial information. Digital payments, mobile investment platforms, robo-advisory services, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, big-data analytics, blockchain, and automated trading have altered the speed, reach, and informational basis of financial decisions. Yet the consequences are not uniformly beneficial: greater access and analytical capacity can coexist with cyber risk, algorithmic opacity, behavioural overconfidence, platform dependence, and unequal digital capabilities. This conceptual study synthesizes the literature review supplied for the paper, which covers fintech adoption, digital transformation in financial services, capital-market infrastructure, AI-supported investment decisions, financial risk management, mutual-fund choice, and the behavioural implications of personal-finance applications. The study proposes an integrated conceptual model linking fintech capabilities to investment decision-making quality through information accessibility, analytical support, transaction efficiency, and trust. Behavioural biases act as mediators, while financial literacy, digital capability, and governance quality moderate the proposed relationships. Expected outcomes include decision quality, portfolio alignment, participation, and market efficiency, subject to risks and institutional conditions. The model is conceptual and is not presented as empirically validated. It offers propositions for future testing and practical implications for investors, fintech providers, financial institutions, and regulators. The central argument is that fintech creates value when technological capability is combined with informed users, transparent design, robust safeguards, and meaningful human oversight.
papers.summary_zh: 该概念研究综合所附文献，探讨金融科技如何改变金融市场的运行方式以及投资者获取、解读和运用信息进行决策的过程。文章提出一个整合性概念模型，将金融科技能力经由信息可及性、分析支持、交易效率与信任，与投资决策质量联系起来，并设想行为偏差起中介作用，金融素养、数字能力和治理质量起调节作用。作者强调，技术能力只有与有判断力的用户、透明的设计、稳健的保障措施和有意义的人类监督相结合，金融科技才能创造价值；同时提醒网络风险、算法不透明、过度自信和平台依赖等隐患。该模型属概念性构建，尚未经过实证检验，其预期结果与相关命题有待未来研究验证。

papers.title: When Does Nature Become Therapy? Reconsidering Therapeutic Experience, Agency, Professional Guidance, and Commercialisation in Shinrin-Yoku, Forest Bathing and Forest Therapy
papers.authors: Milena Agnieszka Guziak
papers.abstract: The term therapy is increasingly employed across practices concerned with human well-being, including music therapy, sound therapy, aromatherapy, nature therapy, forest therapy, and Shinrin-Yoku. However, its meaning varies considerably across clinical, scientific, cultural, professional, and commercial contexts. An experience may be perceived as therapeutic without constituting a formal therapeutic intervention, just as a service may be marketed as therapy without possessing an established clinical methodology or clearly demonstrated therapeutic efficacy. This article critically examines the meaning and implications of therapy within forest-based practices. Drawing on research in environmental psychology, public health, forest medicine, sociology, nature connectedness, and therapeutic relationships, alongside Japanese historical developments and the author’s previous conceptual work, the discussion questions where therapeutic agency resides. Is it the forest environment, the guide, the participant, the social context, or the interactions among these elements that make an experience therapeutic? The analysis distinguishes between therapeutic effects, therapeutic intentions, organised well-being interventions, and clinically delivered treatments. It further considers the evolution of Shinrin-Yoku into contemporary forest therapy terminology, the value and limitations of professional guidance, relational approaches to forest engagement, and the commercialisation of nature-based experiences. Particular attention is given to the possibility that meaningful and restorative experiences can emerge through ordinary, unstructured contact with nature, without professional guidance or explicit therapeutic intention. The article proposes a relational and context-sensitive understanding of therapeutic experience, supported by principles of co-creation, co-responsibility, and co-being. Rather than seeking a universal definition of forest therapy, the discussion advocates greater conceptual precision, professional transparency, methodological pluralism, and critical reflection. It concludes that the therapeutic potential of an experience cannot be adequately determined by its name, setting, or professional structure alone. Keywords: Shinrin-Yoku; forest bathing; forest therapy; nature therapy; therapeutic experience; nature-based interventions; therapeutic agency; forest therapy guides; relational well-being; commercialisation; medicalisation; nature connectedness
papers.summary_zh: 该文为理论性文章，批判性审视森林浴、森林疗养等森林实践中“治疗”一词的含义与使用。作者综合环境心理学、公共卫生、森林医学、社会学及日本历史脉络等，区分治疗效果、治疗意图、有组织的健康干预与临床治疗，并追问治疗性能动性究竟位于森林环境、引导者、参与者还是社会情境及其互动之中。文章尤其关注无需专业引导或明确治疗意图的日常、非结构化自然接触也可能带来恢复性体验，主张以共创、共责与共在的关系性、情境敏感视角理解治疗性体验，而非寻求普适定义，并倡导概念精确、专业透明与方法多元。其结论是，体验的治疗潜力不能仅凭名称、场景或专业结构判定。

papers.title: The leading role of technological factors in the development of the global online education market
papers.authors: Marina Medvedeva, Aleksandr Volokhov
papers.abstract: The article analyzes the leading role of technological factors in the development of the global online education market. The impact of the spread of the Worldwide Web, mobile devices, cloud services, artificial intelligence, e-learning, personalization of learning, virtual and augmented reality, information security, big data, and gamification of learning on the transformation of the educational environment is considered. It is shown that digital technologies have accelerated the transition from traditional forms of education to online formats, expanded access to educational resources, and made learning more flexible, personalized, and scalable. Special attention is paid to how technological innovations are changing the models of interaction between students and educational platforms, improving the quality of content and creating new mechanisms for evaluating learning outcomes. The growth factors of the online education market are also considered, including the development of digital infrastructure, increasing the investment attractiveness of the EdTech sector and the growing demand for distance education services. The paper emphasizes that technological factors are not only a condition, but also the main driver of further expansion of the global online education market. It is concluded that the further development of this field will be determined by the speed of innovation and the ability of educational organizations to adapt to digital transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文分析技术因素在全球在线教育市场发展中的主导作用，属于对相关技术影响与市场增长因素的论述性分析，而非实证研究。文章讨论万维网、移动设备、云服务、人工智能、电子学习、个性化学习、虚拟与增强现实、信息安全、大数据和学习游戏化等如何推动教育环境转型，指出数字技术加速了从传统教育向在线形式的转变，扩大了教育资源获取，使学习更灵活、个性化且可扩展，并改变了学生与教育平台的互动模式、内容质量和学习成果评价机制。文章还考察数字基础设施、EdTech 投资吸引力和远程教育需求等市场增长因素，强调技术因素不仅是条件，更是市场扩张的主要驱动力，未来取决于创新速度和教育机构的数字化适应能力。

papers.title: Handcrafted Feature Extraction and Classification for Distinguishing Real and AI-Generated Images
papers.authors: Mahadeva Prasad M, Khairul Bashar Akash, Jithendra S R, Arundhathi H M
papers.journal: The Journal of Applied Technology and Innovation
papers.abstract: The generative machine-learning approaches are extensively used to create artificial images. These images are called AI-generated images. The AI-generated images find applications like rapid content creation, creative design and visualization, rapid prototyping, etc. In spite of many applications, the AI-generated images are leading to issues like bias, copyright issues, deepfakes, etc. Owing to the importance of discriminating between synthetic and real images, many research approaches have been proposed. Among these methods, deep learning approaches are popular. However, the design of common deep learning detection approaches to detect the synthetic images that are generated by different generative models is a challenging task. There are issues with these methods to discriminate images that are subjected to various pre-processing steps. To overcome these issues, machine learning approaches with the handcrafted features are gaining importance. In this context, five types of handcrafted feature extraction and random forest-based classification is proposed to distinguish between AI-generated and real images. The simulation experiments are carried out with AI-generated and real facial images, with each group having 70,000 samples. Out of 70,000 samples from each group, 50,000, 10,000, and 10,000 samples are respectively used for training, validating, and testing the classifier. The performance of the classifier is evaluated for accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The recognition accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores of 86.03%, 86.15%, 85.87%, and 86.01%, respectively, are achieved for three feature combinations

papers.title: The Concise Language Paradigm in left and right hemisphere stroke: a longitudinal source-localized EEG study
papers.authors: Natascha Marie Roos, Robert Oostenveld, Maria Carla Piastra, Anil M. Tuladhar, Marina B. Ruiter, Roy P. C. Kessels, Britta U. Westner, Vitoria Piai
papers.abstract: The mechanisms underlying language recovery after stroke remain poorly understood. Most previous studies have either focused on language comprehension or production and/or relied on hemodynamic measures, with limited complementary electrophysiological evidence. Here, we combined the Concise Language Paradigm (CLaP), assessing comprehension and production, with individualized electroencephalography (EEG) source reconstruction to investigate post-stroke language function and changes in hemispheric dominance over time. In two sessions, we tested stroke-free controls, individuals with left hemisphere (LH) or right hemisphere (RH) stroke. Participants with stroke were assessed two and seven months post-stroke. EEG data were analyzed using event-related potentials and time-frequency representations, followed by source reconstruction based on state-of-the-art individual MRI-derived forward models. Laterality indices were calculated to assess changes in hemispheric dominance between sessions. Behaviorally, the LH group showed low performance at two months followed by overall improvement, whereas the RH group mainly improved in functional communication. EEG activity was significantly modulated by task condition across comprehension and production contrasts. Source-level results in controls were consistent with established language-related networks, serving as regions of interest for the stroke analyses. In the stroke groups, hemispheric dominance differed between LH and RH stroke participants, with LH participants showing systematic shifts from left- to right-hemisphere dominance between sessions, if not already right-hemisphere dominant at two months. Our study provides evidence on comprehension and production performance after stroke using a single paradigm. These findings demonstrate dynamic changes in hemispheric dominance during post-stroke recovery, ultimately highlighting the value of individualized EEG source reconstruction to investigate post-stroke plasticity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中后语言功能恢复的机制，将同时评估语言理解与产出的简明语言范式（CLaP）与个体化脑电源重建相结合，对无卒中对照者及左、右半球卒中患者进行纵向追踪，比较行为表现与半球优势随时间的变化。结果显示，左半球卒中组在卒中后早期表现较差，随后整体改善，而右半球卒中组主要在功能性交流上改善；脑电活动受理解与产出任务条件的显著调制，源水平结果在对照者中与已知语言网络一致。卒中组中左右半球患者的半球优势存在差异，左半球患者在两轮评估间出现从左半球向右半球优势的系统性转移（若早期尚未呈右半球优势）。作者据此强调个体化脑电源重建在考察卒中后可塑性方面的价值，但相关结论仍需结合样本与随访条件谨慎看待。

papers.title: Functional and Structural Neuroanatomic Correlates of Intraoperative Anesthetic Dose-Adjusted EEG Alpha Power Among Older Surgical Patients
papers.authors: Tyler H. Reekes, Jeffrey N. Browndyke, Melody A. Reese, Yotam Weiss, Jian Yu, Mary L. Cooter, Hayden J Kang, Noah J. Timko, Piper C. Boykin, Bethany J. Hsia, Michael J. Devinney, Miles Berger
papers.abstract: Background: Alterations in intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) alpha power and anesthetic dose-adjusted EEG alpha power (ADA-FP alpha power) have been associated with both preoperative cognitive impairment and postoperative delirium (POD) among older surgical patients, yet the neurologic underpinnings of alterations in these anesthetic brain response patterns are unknown. Methods: We conducted a single center prospective observational cohort study (ALADDIN), of older adults undergoing non-cardiac/non-cranial surgery, which included preoperative structural and resting state functional MRI, lumbar punctures to obtain CSF, 32 channel intraoperative EEG recordings, and repeated POD assessments. To account for anesthetic dose, frontoparietal EEG alpha power (ADA-FP alpha power) was adjusted using our established formula: [intraoperative alpha power]/(2.5 - end-tidal MAC fraction). Multivoxel pattern analysis (MVPA) with follow-up seed-to-voxel analyses identified functional connectivity patterns associated with intraoperative ADA-FP alpha power. Voxel-wise regression analysis with threshold free cluster estimation (TFCE) correction was used to evaluate associations between cortical thickness and ADA-FP alpha power. CSF biomarker values were obtained from NULISA proximity extension assays. Delirium incidence and severity was assessed with the 3-Minute Diagnostic Confusion Assessment Method (3D-CAM). Delirium severity area under the curve (AUC) during hospitalization was defined as the sum of all 3D-CAM delirium severity scores within the postoperative hospitalization period (for up to 7 days after surgery). The Confusion Assessment Method for the Intensive Care Unit (CAM-ICU) was used in cases of non-verbal/intubated patients. Results: ALADDIN enrolled 215 patients, of whom 168 underwent surgery and had high-quality intraoperative EEG data (44.6% female; mean age 70.9 years). MVPA showed that ADA-FP alpha power was associated with altered functional connectivity within the bilateral frontal poles, left superior frontal gyrus and the right superior parietal lobule (p-FWE < 0.05). Seed-to-voxel analyses revealed that higher ADA-FP alpha power was associated with increased connectivity between DMN MVPA regions and DMN, DAN and salience/ventral attention and decreased connectivity with visual regions. Conversely, right superior parietal lobule connectivity shifted towards greater DMN segregation and increased somatosensory/motor coupling (p-FWE < 0.05). Lower ADA-FP alpha power was also associated with lower cortical thickness in left occipitotemporal and superior parietal cortices (TFCE-corrected p < 0.05). ADA-FP alpha power was also lower among participants with (vs those without) postoperative ward/floor delirium (mean difference, 1.33; 95% CI, 0.22 to 2.44; p=0.019), and ADA-FP alpha power was inversely associated with peak delirium severity (spearman's rho = -0.26; 95% CI, -0.40 to -0.11; p <0.001) and delirium severity AUC (spearman's rho = -0.28; 95% CI, -0.42 to -0.13; p < 0.001). Discussion: These findings suggest a functional and structural neuroanatomic basis for the decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power values seen among some older surgical patients, which may explain the association between decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power and increased rates of both preoperative cognitive impairment and postoperative delirium. More specifically, these findings suggest that altered default mode and dorsal attention network connectivity is linked to decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power and raise the possibility that preoperative/baseline functional connectivity alterations within these networks may play a role in delirium risk.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对老年手术患者，考察术中经麻醉剂量校正的额顶叶脑电α功率（ADA-FP α功率）与术前脑结构、静息态功能连接及术后谵妄之间的关系，采用前瞻性队列设计，结合术前结构/功能MRI、脑脊液标志物、术中32导脑电记录和术后谵妄重复评估。多体素模式分析显示，ADA-FP α功率与双侧额极、左侧额上回及右侧顶上小叶的功能连接改变相关，较高功率对应默认网络、背侧注意网络和突显网络连接增强而与视觉区连接减弱，较低功率则与左侧枕颞及顶上皮质厚度降低相关。术后病房谵妄患者该功率更低，且功率与谵妄峰值严重程度及住院期间严重程度曲线下面积呈负相关。作者据此提出，默认网络与背侧注意网络连接及部分皮质结构的差异可能是老年患者麻醉脑电α功率降低的神经基础，并可能部分解释其与术前认知障碍和术后谵妄风险的关联，但相关结论仍属关联性观察。

papers.title: Single-Case Design for Network-based BCI Rehabilitation: Individual Learning Trajectories and Effects of Motor Imagery Timing in Stroke Patients
papers.authors: Camile Bousfiha, Camille Gabot, Diana Baili, Erin Soller, Marion Couton, Grace Adwane, Michaël Obadia, Chiara Zavanone, Sophie Dupont, É. Bayen, Laurent Bougrain, Paolo Bartolomeo, Fabrizio De Vico Fallani
papers.abstract: Motor imagery (MI) brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are increasingly investigated for promoting motor recovery after stroke. However, it remains unclear how BCI control improves through repeated training in stroke patients and whether the timing of MI decoding systematically influences this trajectory. To address this question, we implemented a single-case experimental design involving five chronic stroke patients enrolling in a longitudinal electroencephalography MI-BCI training involving their affected hand. Across 18 sessions conducted over six weeks, the onset of a fixed-duration MI decoding window was randomized to occur 1, 2, or 3~s after cue onset according to an alternating-treatments single-case design. Notably, the BCI combined spectral power and functional connectivity features to classify MI states. The MI classification timing had no significant effect on BCI accuracy, fatigue, or spasticity. BCI accuracy increased across training in four of five patients and was accompanied by patient-specific longitudinal changes in local spectral activity and functional connectivity. These convergent trajectories were consistent with acquisition of BCI control, but were not accompanied by clinically meaningful improvement in motor function. Varying the onset of the MI decoding window provided no systematic benefit for BCI control. Instead, differences in neurophysiological trajectories across patients indicate that MI decoding parameters need to be personalized and reassessed throughout the training. Overall, these findings inform more individualized and effective BCI settings for neuromotor stroke rehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察卒中患者在接受基于运动想象的脑机接口康复训练时，控制能力如何随重复训练变化，以及运动想象解码窗口的起始时机是否系统影响这一过程。作者采用单被试实验设计，对五名慢性卒中患者进行纵向脑电训练，并将解码窗口起始点随机设为提示出现后不同延迟。结果显示，解码时机对分类准确率、疲劳和痉挛均无显著影响；多数患者的准确率随训练提高，并伴随个体化的频谱活动与功能连接变化，但这些变化未带来有临床意义的运动功能改善。作者据此认为，运动想象解码参数需个体化并在训练中重新评估。

papers.title: Biology Undergraduates Use of AI-Enabled Feedback to Revise Scientific Writing: Recipience and Barriers
papers.authors: Michele Weston, Tammy M. Long
papers.abstract: Background: Instructors and education researchers are increasingly developing feedback with the assistance of generative AI, which we refer to as AI-enabled feedback, yet we do not know whether established understandings of feedback uptake and effectiveness apply similarly in AI-mediated contexts. This makes the recipience of AI-enabled feedback a central concern to understanding how to best support students in developing their scientific writing skills. This study examined how two teams of undergraduate biology students used AI-enabled feedback to revise their scientific writing, and the extent to which their revisions addressed that feedback. The teams revised their research proposal drafts after receiving AI-enabled feedback developed by their instructor with the aid of a custom AI tool. Results: Our findings show that AI-enabled feedback prompted actionable revision across both teams. Each team addressed approximately half of the feedback comments, indicating comparable levels of uptake despite their differing approaches to revision. We observed that both teams were inconsistent in providing the additional information and reasoning requested in the feedback, and they struggled to address comments requiring self-evaluation. Taken together, we see that students often addressed the more easily actionable parts of AI-enabled feedback while omitting more demanding revisions. Conclusions: These findings provide behavioral evidence of how students used AI-enabled feedback to revise their scientific writing. The observed patterns suggest that the content of AI-enabled feedback supported meaningful revision, while limitations in students agency, strategies, and volition likely shaped their implementation of comments. Although the degree of uptake observed in this study is encouraging, it is unlikely that a single application of generative AI within the feedback process will resolve all the challenges associated with feedback uptake.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察本科生生物学团队如何利用教师借助定制AI工具生成的反馈来修改科学写作，并分析修改在多大程度上回应了反馈内容。结果显示，AI反馈能促成可操作的修改，两个团队均处理了约一半的反馈意见， uptake程度相近，但修改方式不同；同时，两队对反馈中要求补充信息和推理的部分回应不一致，也难以处理需要自我评价的意见，往往只落实较易操作的部分而省略要求更高的修改。作者据此认为，AI反馈的内容支持了有意义的修改，但学生的能动性、策略和意愿限制其落实，单次生成式AI介入难以解决反馈吸收的全部挑战。

papers.title: Readiness of Teacher Educators to Adopt Artificial Intelligence in Teaching and Learning: A Narrative Integrative Review
papers.authors: Dr. Nandini N.
papers.journal: The Paradigm Chronicle Journal of Academic Inquiry and Critical Thought
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing teaching, learning, assessment and professional development in higher education. Teacher educators occupy a significant position in this transformation because they prepare prospective teachers to respond to changing educational practices and technological demands. However, the successful integration of AI into teacher education requires more than access to digital tools. It depends on educators’ technological knowledge, pedagogical competence, ethical awareness, professional confidence and institutional support. This paper examines the readiness of teacher educators to adopt AI in teaching and learning through a narrative integrative review of selected scholarly literature and international policy frameworks. The review draws on research concerning AI in education, generative AI, technological pedagogical knowledge and teacher professional development, alongside UNESCO’s guidance and competency framework. The synthesis is organised around five dimensions of readiness: technological and AI literacy, pedagogical integration, ethical and responsible use, professional learning, and institutional preparedness. The review highlights the importance of continuous professional development, supportive institutional policies, critical evaluation of AI-generated content and the preservation of teacher agency. It proposes a multidimensional conceptual framework for understanding teacher educators’ readiness and identifies priorities for future empirical research, particularly in diverse and resource-constrained teacher education contexts. The paper concludes that meaningful AI adoption requires a human-centred, pedagogically informed and institutionally supported approach.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以叙事整合的方式梳理相关学术文献与国际政策框架，考察教师教育者采用人工智能开展教学与学习的准备度问题。作者围绕技术素养、教学整合、伦理与负责任使用、专业学习和机构准备五个维度组织分析，强调持续专业发展、支持性制度政策、对AI生成内容的批判性评估以及维护教师能动性的重要性。文章据此提出一个多维度的准备度概念框架，并指出未来实证研究应关注多元且资源受限的教师教育情境，认为有意义的AI采用需要以人为本、有教学依据并获得机构支持。

papers.title: Evaluating the effectiveness of AI-Based adaptive learning for reading development and self-regulated learning among pupils with dyslexia in Abuja, Nigeria
papers.authors: Amira Ibrahim Alfa, Sadiya Lawal Danyaro, Nayaya Halima Sa’id
papers.journal: Aminu Kano Academic Scholars Association Multidisciplinary Journal
papers.abstract: Children with dyslexia often experience persistent challenges in reading, motivation, and self-regulation within traditional classroom settings that rely on uniform instructional approaches. With the growing integration of artificial intelligence in education, AI-based adaptive learning systems have emerged as innovative tools capable of personalizing instruction and supporting diverse learning needs. This study investigated the effect of AI-based adaptive learning systems on reading performance, motivation, and self-regulation among primary school students with dyslexia in Abuja, Nigeria. A quasi-experimental pretest–posttest control group design was adopted, with a sample of 60 Primary 5 pupils drawn from selected inclusive and special education schools in the Abuja Municipal Area. Data were collected using a Reading Performance Test, Motivation toward Reading Scale, and Self-Regulation in Reading Questionnaire, and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics, including independent samples t-test. Findings revealed that students exposed to AI-based adaptive learning demonstrated significantly higher improvements across all variables compared to those receiving conventional instruction. The experimental group recorded substantial gains in reading performance (mean gain = 24.20), motivation (mean gain = 1.50), and self-regulation (mean gain = 1.60), compared to the control group. Statistical analysis confirmed that these differences were significant (p < 0.05). These findings align with Cognitive Load Theory, Self-Determination Theory, and Vygotsky’s Zone of Proximal Development. The study concludes that AI-based adaptive learning systems offer an effective approach for improving both academic and psychological outcomes among students with dyslexia. It recommends the integration of AI-driven instructional tools in primary education, alongside teacher training and policy support, to promote inclusive, personalized, and effective learning environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察基于人工智能的自适应学习系统对尼日利亚阿布贾阅读障碍小学生阅读表现、阅读动机和自我调节学习的影响，采用准实验前后测对照组设计，比较接受AI自适应学习与传统教学的学生。结果显示，实验组在阅读表现、动机和自我调节三方面的提升均显著高于对照组，作者据此认为AI自适应学习有助于改善这类学生的学业与心理结果，并建议在教师培训和政策支持下将其纳入小学教育。需要说明的是，该结论基于特定地区与学校情境的短期干预，其推广性仍受样本与实施条件限制。

papers.title: Pemetaan Struktur Intelektual dan Evolusi Tematik Penelitian Pendidikan: Sebuah Analisis Bibliometrik
papers.authors: Athar Abdullatif Husain, Ahsan Hakim
papers.abstract: This study examines the intellectual structure and thematic evolution of educational research through bibliometric analysis. Using bibliographic records retrieved from Scopus on September 19, 2026, the study initially identified 4,090 publications covering the period from 1906 to 2026. The analysis combined bibliometric performance analysis and science mapping to investigate publication trends, leading sources, author contributions, geographical distribution, document types, subject areas, and keyword relationships. VOSviewer was employed to generate network, overlay, and density visualizations of keyword co-occurrence patterns. The findings indicate an expansion of scholarly publications in recent years, with the United States and the United Kingdom representing major geographical contributors.
