Social Sciences and Arts and Humanities constitute prominent subject areas, reflecting the interdisciplinary character of educational research. Keyword mapping identifies education, teaching, learning, curriculum, and educational theory as central concepts connected to specialized themes, including educational technology, artificial intelligence, critical pedagogy, social justice, and professional education. By integrating publication indicators with thematic mapping, this study provides an overview of the knowledge organization and thematic diversity represented in the retrieved literature. The findings offer a reference for identifying established research areas, exploring interdisciplinary connections, and formulating future research directions. However, the results should be interpreted in light of the search strategy, metadata availability, and incomplete publication year of 2026
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量分析考察教育研究的知识结构与主题演变，基于Scopus书目记录结合绩效分析与科学图谱，用VOSviewer生成关键词共现网络、叠加和密度可视化。结果显示近年学术发表呈扩张态势，美国与英国是主要地理贡献者，社会科学与艺术人文学科构成突出学科领域，体现教育研究的跨学科特征；关键词映射将教育、教学、学习、课程与教育理论识别为连接教育技术、人工智能、批判教育学、社会正义和专业教育等专门主题的核心概念。作者据此勾勒所检索文献的知识组织与主题多样性，为识别成熟领域、探索跨学科联系和规划未来方向提供参考，同时提示结果受检索策略、元数据可得性及2026年出版年份不完整的影响。

papers.title: A Survey-Based Study on the Adoption of Generative AI in Software Development: Opportunities, Challenges, and User Perspectives
papers.authors: Rutuja Rajendra Yadav, Rushikesh Ganesh Yadav, Pratiksha Kamble
papers.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly used in software development for coding, debugging, documentation, and learning. This study examines its adoption, benefits, challenges, security concerns, dependence, learning support, and future impact. Survey responses from 21 programming students and professionals were analyzed using frequencies, percentages, and average ratings. Of the respondents, 95.2% reported daily or frequent use and 95.2% used ChatGPT. Debugging and error fixing was the most common task (71.4%). Respondents reported benefits such as better problem-solving and faster development, but also identified bugs, security issues, architectural complexity, and privacy concerns. Overall, GenAI is viewed as a useful assistant, but human review, testing, and responsible use remain essential. The findings are exploratory due to the small sample size.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过问卷调查考察了生成式人工智能在软件开发中的采用情况、收益与挑战，对象为编程学生和从业者，采用频次、百分比与平均评分进行描述性分析。结果显示，受访者普遍频繁使用这类工具且以ChatGPT为主，调试与错误修复是最常见的用途；他们认可其在问题解决和开发速度上的帮助，但也指出缺陷、安全问题、架构复杂性和隐私顾虑。总体而言，生成式人工智能被视为有用的助手，但人工审查、测试和负责任使用仍不可少；由于样本量小，结论属于探索性。

papers.title: Transforming Global Early Childhood Education Through Artificial Intelligence: Addressing Teacher Shortages, Inequality, and Quality Gaps in Early Learning Systems
papers.authors: Saba Munawar
papers.abstract: This study examines the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to support early childhood education (ECE) in addressing workforce pressures, inequality, and quality-related challenges, while identifying the organisational, pedagogical, and ethical conditions required for responsible AI use. An interpretivist qualitative design was used with 22 participants (8 head teachers and 14 early childhood teachers) from ECE institutions in Sydney, Australia, who took part in semi-structured face-to-face interviews. Six interconnected themes emerged from inductive thematic analysis: workforce and operational challenges; AI awareness and readiness; AI as teacher support, not replacement; AI and equity; AI and learning quality; and responsible AI adoption. Participants considered how AI could support planning, documentation, translation, administration, and personalised learning, freeing up time for meaningful teacher–child interaction. They stressed, however, that AI cannot address structural workforce shortages and cannot take the place of teachers’ relational, professional, and safeguarding roles. The study’s contribution lies in bringing together workforce, equity, learn-ing quality, and responsible AI adoption within a single ECE-focused empirical framework, and in highlighting the necessity of human-centred implementation. Longitudinal and mixed-methods studies in various settings are needed to inves-tigate the impact of AI on teacher workload, child outcomes, equity, and policy implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对悉尼幼儿教育机构负责人和教师的半结构化访谈，考察人工智能在支持幼儿教育应对人力压力、不平等和质量问题方面的潜力，以及负责任使用AI所需的组织、教学与伦理条件。归纳分析显示，参与者认为AI可辅助规划、文档、翻译、行政和个性化学习，从而腾出时间用于有意义的师幼互动，但强调AI无法解决结构性人力短缺，也不能取代教师在关系、专业和儿童保护方面的角色。研究将人力、公平、学习质量与负责任采用纳入同一幼儿教育实证框架，并指出以人为本的实施必要性；其结论受限于特定情境，后续需开展纵向和混合方法研究。

papers.title: Teachers’ experiences with generative AI for lesson planning: A qualitative study in Sindh, Pakistan
papers.authors: Jaffar Ali, Aqsa Shoaib, Bilal Hajano
papers.abstract: This Qualitative descriptive study explored how 15 in service Junior Elementary School teachers (JESTs) at Government Higher Secondary School Dad Laghari, Sindh, Pakistan, described their familiarity and use of artificial intelligence (GenAI) for lesson planning, perceived benefits and challenges, and professional learning and support needs. Participants provided written English responses to five open ended questions and profile information. Responses were analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis and participant characteristics were summarized descriptively. From the study five themes were identified like Familiarity with GenAI and reported planning uses; perceived efficiency and expanded planning options; verification of generated materials for accuracy and classroom fit; integration of AI fluency with subject and pedagogical knowledge ; and collegial and institutional support. Teachers reported using GenAI to draft lesson notes, questions, activities, examples, and explanations. Thirteen reported frequent use, while two reported occasional use. Participants showed concerns about accuracy, curriculum and learner suitability, privacy and internet access and identified need for practical training, peer exchange, digital resources and school guidance. The findings highlights self reported perspective from one school; lesson plan, classroom practice and student outcomes were not assessed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以巴基斯坦信德省一所公立高中的15名在职小学教师为对象，通过开放式问卷和反思性主题分析，考察他们对生成式人工智能辅助备课的熟悉程度、使用体验、 perceived benefits 与挑战以及专业学习需求。教师主要用生成式人工智能起草教案要点、问题、活动和讲解，多数人报告使用频繁；他们同时关注生成内容的准确性、课程与学习者适配性、隐私和网络接入问题，并希望获得实操培训、同伴交流、数字资源和学校指导。研究强调这些只是单一学校教师的自述视角，未评估教案质量、课堂实践或学生结果。

papers.title: Overview of the Current State and Prospects of Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Oleg Namicheishvili, Guram Javakhadze, Vera Prangishvili
papers.journal: Journal of Research in Engineering and Computer Sciences
papers.abstract: Between 2023 and 2026, artificial intelligence (AI) reached a decisive stage of development. From language models capable of logical reasoning to autonomous agents able to carry out complex tasks, AI is redefining the boundaries of productivity, creativity, and employment. This review provides a broad overview of AI in 2026, covering its core technologies, major market participants, practical impacts, and ethical challenges, while examining the current state of the field and its likely future direction.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2023至2026年间人工智能的发展状况，指出这一阶段AI从具备逻辑推理能力的语言模型扩展到可执行复杂任务的自主智能体，正在重新界定生产力、创造力与就业的边界。文章围绕核心技术、主要市场参与者、实际影响与伦理挑战展开概述，并在此基础上讨论该领域的当前格局与可能的未来走向。作为综述，其结论是对整体态势的归纳与展望，而非基于特定实验或数据的因果验证。

papers.title: La “creatività” dell’IA e le sue proprietà: definizioni e criticità nell’era dei LLM
papers.authors: FRANCESCO SACCA'
papers.journal: AI-Linguistica Linguistic Studies on AI-Generated Texts and Discourses
papers.abstract: Il concetto di “creatività”, virtù spesso attribuita all’intelletto o alla fantasia dell’essere umano, è di recente divenuto oggetto di trattazione all’interno di testi scientifici sull’IA. Per tale motivo, diversi ambiti di ricerca si preoccupano di definire una nuova ontologia della creatività che prenda in considerazione la continua evoluzione di sistemi artificiali come i LLM. In linea con tali sviluppi, la presente ricerca propone una definizione critica della creatività nell’ambito dell’IA, basata sui cinque elementi fondamentali della creatività: agente (actor), processo (process), prodotto (outcome), dominio (domain) e spazio (space). Una successiva analisi quantitativo-qualitativa basata su corpus riflette poi sugli usi linguistici dell’aggettivo creative in testi di computer science ad alto rigore scientifico e sulla sua co-occorrenza in relazione a termini riguardanti i cinque elementi fondamentali, classificati secondo la ricerca di Wingström et al. (2022).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大语言模型时代人工智能“创造力”概念界定不清的问题，提出一个基于行动者、过程、成果、领域与空间五个基本要素的批判性定义框架。作者随后以高科学严谨性的计算机科学文本为语料，对“creative”一词的用法及其与上述五要素相关术语的共现情况进行了定量与定性分析。文章由此反思人工智能创造力讨论中的语言使用与概念边界，为厘清该概念提供依据，而非检验某种系统的创造力表现。

papers.title: AI-DRIVEN, EVIDENCE-BASED GENERATIVE DESIGN: A TEACHING FRAMEWORK FOR LANDSCAPE ARCHITECTONICS INTEGRATING RESEARCH FINDINGS, DESIGN PRECEDENTS, AND INTELLIGENT RECOGNITION AND JUDGMENT
papers.authors: LiHao Yao, 张睿, Zixin Liang
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has entered design courses, but its use often stops at tool operation. Taking Landscape Architectonics, an undergraduate course in landscape architecture programs, as the vehicle, this paper builds a teaching framework for generative design that integrates four elements: research findings, design precedents, AI-based recognition and judgment, and AI generation. The core claim is simple. Teaching students to “use AI” means teaching them to run an evidence-constrained generative design chain. “AI-driven” therefore carries two meanings: at the tool level, AI executes generation; at the teaching level, evidence steers generation, and the work of teaching lies in leading students from the former toward the latter. Among the four elements, research findings and design precedents are static knowledge that travels across sites. Research findings supply criteria for what counts as good. Design precedents supply examples of what to do, distilled from 13 street design guidelines into 114 retrievable situation packages. AI-based recognition and AI generation produce dynamic outputs anchored to a specific site. Students mobilize these elements through three stages—reading the site, grounding the context, and giving form—and a chain of evidence disciplines each stage. The framework follows three design principles: complementary elements, partial embedding, and explicit judgment. Three classroom examples show how the framework operates. This paper focuses on framework construction and does not report learning-outcome data.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以风景园林本科课程“景观建构”为载体，提出一个整合研究成果、设计先例、AI识别判断与AI生成的生成式设计教学框架。其核心主张是：教学生“使用AI”应引导他们运行受证据约束的生成链，使AI在工具层面执行生成、在教學层面由证据引导生成。研究将研究成果与设计先例视为可跨场地迁移的静态知识，并把13份街道设计指南提炼为114个可检索的情境包；AI识别与生成则产出锚定具体场地的动态结果。学生通过读场地、锚定语境、赋形三阶段调动这些要素，框架遵循要素互补、部分嵌入与判断显性化三项原则。文章以三个课堂示例说明框架运作，但明确不报告学习成效数据。

papers.title: Automated Language Sample Analysis for Argentine Spanish-Speaking Children: Evaluating ASR and NLP Pipelines Against Expert Transcriptions
papers.authors: Analí Taboh, Franco Setti, Julián Blanco, Martina Sacks, Vanesa Nancy Seno, Carolina Gattei, Agustı́n Gravano
papers.abstract: AbstractPurpose: Narrative production tasks offer a rich context for assessing children's oral language development, but manual language sample analysis remains time-intensive. This study evaluates the accuracy of automated speech recognition (ASR) and natural language processing (NLP) pipelines for recovering 16 linguistic metrics from narrative productions of Argentine Spanish-speaking children.Method: The corpus comprised 54 recordings from 16 children aged 4–8 years. Following manual audio preprocessing, measures were computed from manual or Whisper Turbo transcripts using automated word-class annotation. For utterance-level measures, local and cloud-based large language models (LLMs) segmented communication units (C-units), with punctuation-based segmentation serving as a baseline. Performance was assessed using Pearson correlations and median absolute relative errors.Results: Despite a mean ASR word error rate of 29.3%, broad lexical and content-word measures showed strong correlations with expert values (r = .988–.999) and median errors of 1.1%–8.0% on ASR transcripts of child narratives. Some grammatical-category diversity measures showed larger relative errors. Cloud-based LLM segmentation of ASR transcripts reduced median errors for C-unit counts and longest-utterance measures compared with punctuation-based segmentation. Mean length of utterance in words showed inconsistent and less reliable performance, including weak correlations on ASR transcripts.Conclusions: Selected linguistic metrics can be recovered from children's Argentine Spanish spontaneous narratives despite transcription errors. LLM-based C-unit segmentation is a promising approach for languages and populations underrepresented in ASR training data, but it is still metric-dependent. Practical recommendations for low-cost implementation in educational and clinical settings are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察自动语音识别（ASR）与自然语言处理流程能否从阿根廷西班牙语儿童叙事中可靠恢复语言指标，以替代耗时的人工语言样本分析。作者对儿童叙事录音分别使用人工转写和 Whisper Turbo 转写，并用自动词类标注及本地/云端大语言模型进行语句单元切分，再与专家转写结果比对。结果显示，尽管 ASR 词错误率较高，词汇与实词类指标仍与专家值高度一致，部分语法类别多样性指标误差较大；云端大模型切分相比标点切分降低了语句单元计数和最长语句指标的误差，但平均语句长度指标表现不稳定。作者据此认为部分指标可在转写误差下恢复，并指出基于大模型的切分对训练数据不足的语言和人群有潜力，但结论仍取决于具体指标。

papers.title: Exploratory data analysis and machine learning-based assessment of social media addiction and its impact on academic performance and mental health among students
papers.authors: Nitin Kisan Ahire
papers.abstract: This study investigates social media addiction among students. It includes definitions, ways to measure it, how common it is, and its effects on mental health and academic performance. A focused review of literature from 2018 to 2025 gathers systematic reviews, meta-analyses, psychometric studies, and research that connects problematic social media use to issues like mental health problems, sleep disruptions, and academic results. The article also provides a method for analyzing student-level social media addiction data. It discusses common findings in datasets and offers recommendations for educators and policymakers based on evidence. Using data from 705 participants across 110 countries, this study combines a thorough literature review, dataset-driven exploratory data analysis (EDA), and correlational modeling. The results show strong connections between social media addiction, academic success, sleep, and mental health. The EDA reveals gender differences in usage, regional differences in platform preferences, and clear links between addiction and poorer sleep quality and mental health. These findings align with global research and suggest the potential value of targeted digital well-being interventions among students.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注学生社交媒体成瘾的界定、测量与流行程度，以及其对心理健康和学业表现的影响，结合2018至2025年文献综述与705名参与者数据的探索性分析和相关性建模。结果显示，社交媒体成瘾与学业表现、睡眠和心理健康之间存在较强关联，探索性分析还发现使用行为存在性别差异、平台偏好存在地区差异，且成瘾与较差的睡眠质量和心理健康状况相关。作者据此讨论了面向学生开展针对性数字健康干预的潜在价值，但相关结论属于关联性证据，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Transformative learning in farmer research networks: insights from Eastern and Southern Africa
papers.authors: Evelyne Kiptot, Romina De Angelis, Mirriam Matita, Shiphar Mulumba, Carolyn Phiri, Mary Richardson, Frank Tchuwa, Kate Wellard, Richard Coe
papers.abstract: Farmer research networks are collaborative platforms where farmers, researchers, extension workers, and NGOs co-create knowledge, experiment with innovations, and tackle local challenges through joint learning and action. Although interest in these networks is growing, there remains a limited understanding of how learning occurs within them. This study draws on qualitative data from nine networks active between 2015 and 2024 in Kenya, Malawi and Uganda. It reveals that these networks foster individual and collective transformation. The process is dynamic, multi-dimensional, technical, relational, and emotional, shaped by diverse knowledge systems and social interactions. Emotional engagement , enhanced motivation, deepened reflection, and prompted identity shifts. Networks function not only as sites of knowledge co-creation and learning but also as cultural and emotional spaces where agricultural visions and identities are negotiated and reshaped. Farmers assumed roles as researchers and educators, adapting agroecological innovations and experimenting with solutions to ecological and livelihood challenges. The key enabling factors were trust among members, inclusive facilitation, institutional memory, and strong local leadership. Progress was constrained by entrenched gender norms, hierarchical extension practices, and rigid social structures. Sustaining transformative learning calls for continued investment in facilitation capacity, inclusive leadership and institutional structures that embed networks within broader innovation systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注农民研究网络中的学习如何发生，基于肯尼亚、马拉维和乌干达九个网络多年间的定性资料进行分析。研究发现，这类网络推动个体与集体的转化性学习，过程兼具技术、关系与情感维度：情感投入、动机增强和反思深化促成了身份转变，农民也承担起研究者和教育者的角色，调适并试验生态农业创新。信任、包容性引导、机构记忆和本地领导力是主要促成因素，而性别规范、等级化的推广实践和僵化的社会结构构成限制。作者据此主张持续投入引导能力与包容性制度建设，将网络嵌入更广泛的创新体系。

papers.title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
papers.authors: Daniel Beránek
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization guardrail for persistent identity-changing mutations in Agentic Entity Resolution (ER).Agentic ER systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, update hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may therefore condition subsequent evidence acquisition and produce observations that appear to confirm the original error. The paper does not claim to eliminate this feedback mechanism. Instead, it distinguishes evidence available to an agent for reasoning from evidence eligible to authorize a persistent change to an entity’s identity.The proposed architecture connects selected DIO/ODI reconstruction-failure distinctions—referential, semantic, temporal, and contextual—to domain-configured identity-preserving constraints. A diagnostic-to-constraint mapping specifies which identity or continuity propositions a mutation must establish, which relations are insufficient to establish them, and when temporal applicability, contextual requirements, or unresolved conflicts call for deferral.An abstract two-phase Minimum Viable Digital Identity Optimization (MVDIO) Supervisor Layer separates evidence admission, claim-specific promotion, and protected graph commitment. Admission as UNVERIFIED permits exploratory reasoning but does not confer authorization eligibility. Evidence becomes eligible only for the proposition, evidentiary role, and applicability established under the declared policy. A persistent mutation may be committed only when the candidate graph satisfies the applicable constraints, each required proposition has appropriate claim-specific support, no unresolved material conflict blocks authorization, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and the relevant state and policy versions remain valid at commit time.The paper develops this contract through a lifecycle-to-boundary analysis, a stylized model of apparent verification, an authorization invariant with explicit assumptions, abstract interface algorithms, and hypothetical corporate entity-resolution cases. A prospective evaluation protocol distinguishes the proposed DIO/ODI-informed mapping from conventional identifier rules, conservative abstention, and a generic authorization boundary configured from the same domain facts.The contribution is an explicit specification of commit-boundary obligations, not a new matching algorithm, a stand-alone theorem of semantic correctness, or an implemented and empirically validated system. Its property remains conditional on domain-policy adequacy, claim-specific evidence promotion, recorded-provenance integrity, and enforcement of the protected boundary. The incremental value of the DIO/ODI diagnostic organization remains an open empirical question. Broader dependency-aware control of hypothesis-conditioned evidence acquisition and feedback is identified as a separate research direction. Canonical archival version: The canonical archival version of this preprint is deposited in Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23580733. AI disclosure: This paper was developed through a human-led, model-assisted process of conceptual exploration, source-oriented research, architectural formulation, drafting, formalization, and adversarial review. GPT-based systems, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Qwen, and Kimi contributed in different roles during development. Model outputs were treated as fallible proposals and critiques, not as independent peer review or evidence of system performance. The author selected, rejected, and revised suggestions and retains responsibility for the framing, design decisions, interpretations, claims, references, and final text. A detailed methodological disclosure is included in the manuscript.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对智能体实体解析中错误身份假设可能自我强化的问题，提出一种基于数字身份优化（DIO）与数字身份本体（ODI）的授权护栏，将证据推理与持久身份变更的授权资格区分开。作者通过生命周期到边界的分析、风格化的“表面验证”模型、带明确假设的授权不变量、抽象接口算法和假设性企业案例来展开这一契约，并给出前瞻性评估方案。其贡献在于明确提交边界的义务规范，而非新的匹配算法或已实现并实证验证的系统；该性质仍依赖领域政策充分性、证据提升与溯源完整性，DIO/ODI 诊断组织的增量价值尚待实证检验。

papers.title: Pemanfaatan Artificial Intelligence untuk Penguatan Branding Digital UMKM dalam Meningkatkan Daya Saing Produk Lokal
papers.authors: Agus Syukur, Fajar Sarasati, Femmy Femmy
papers.journal: Journal of Community Service and Society Empowerment
papers.abstract: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) are the main pillars of the Indonesian economy, but most micro-scale business actors face limited resources in managing their businesses. The main problem faced by the service partners, namely Sahabat Genggam Teman Indonesia (GTI), which facilitates MSME administrators in Bekasi City, is low literacy. Branding is digital, with less-than-optimal brand identity elements, minimal use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and limited resources to obtain professional assistance. This Community Service (PKM) activity aims to improve partners' literacy and skills in using AI technology, particularly ChatGPT as an AI branding assistant, to independently design brand names, slogans, brand positioning, product descriptions, and social media copy. The activity will be carried out independently in a hybrid format at the Grand Metropolitan Bekasi Ballroom and via Zoom Meeting on October 13, 2026. The implementation method includes surveys and problem identification, material/module preparation, educational training with lectures and interactive discussions, and evaluation. The outcome of this activity is increased knowledge and skills among partners, in this case MSMEs, enabling them to operate and use ChatGPT as an AI branding assistant to design brand names, slogans, brand positioning, product descriptions, and copywriting independently for social media. This activity helps MSMEs streamline their operations and product marketing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注印尼微型中小企业在数字品牌建设中的资源与素养限制，以社区服务形式面向贝克西市的创业辅导伙伴开展混合式培训，内容涉及使用ChatGPT辅助设计品牌名称、口号、品牌定位、产品描述和社交媒体文案。活动按需求调查、材料准备、讲授与互动讨论、评估的流程推进，目标是提升参与者独立运用AI工具开展品牌传播的知识与技能。摘要将成效表述为参与者相关能力的提升，并认为这有助于简化经营与产品营销，但未报告具体评估数据或对照结果，因此结论主要属于活动层面的经验总结。

papers.title: On Multilingual Text Summarization: A Review of Model Architectures, Techniques, and Research Gaps
papers.authors: Munyao Muia, Aaron Mogeni Oirere, Stephen Kahara Wanjau
papers.journal: International Journal of Data Informatics and Intelligent Computing
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of multilingual digital content has intensified demand for automated text summarization systems that can operate across diverse languages. Yet the architectural and methodological foundations of this domain remain dispersed across individual studies. This paper presents a systematic literature review of multilingual text summarization research in Natural Language Processing, with particular attention to model architectures, multilingual enabling techniques, and existing research gaps. Following a PRISMA-guided review protocol, 47 studies published between 2017 and 2026 were identified, screened, and synthesized from major scholarly databases using predefined eligibility and quality assessment criteria. The analysis shows that the literature is dominated by four dominant architectural paradigms: multilingual sequence-to-sequence models, large language models, adapter-based models, and hybrid architectures, with a recent shift toward large language model-based approaches. Across these studies, multilingual capability is primarily achieved through pre-training and transfer learning, with support from parameter-efficient adaptation and data augmentation. The review further identified four persistent limitation categories: low-resource language underrepresentation; dataset and benchmark constraints; evaluation limitations dominated by ROUGE overreliance; and generalization and scalability challenges, manifested as the curse of multilinguality. These findings indicate that current progress in the field is largely driven by scaling existing models rather than resolving structural multilingual limitations, particularly those related to data availability and model architecture. This paper provides a consolidated view of architectural and methodological trends and offers a structured, informed basis for future research on equitable multilingual summarization, particularly for low-resource languages.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了多语言文本摘要研究中的模型架构、多语言实现技术与研究空白，按PRISMA流程从主要数据库中筛选并综合了2017至2026年间的47项研究。分析发现，相关文献集中于多语言序列到序列模型、大语言模型、适配器模型和混合架构四类范式，且近期出现向大语言模型方法转移的趋势；多语言能力主要通过预训练与迁移学习实现，并辅以参数高效适配和数据增强。综述进一步归纳出低资源语言代表性不足、数据集与基准受限、评估过度依赖ROUGE以及多语言诅咒带来的泛化与扩展难题等持续存在的局限，指出当前进展更多来自模型规模扩展，而非解决数据可得性与模型架构层面的结构性多语言限制。

papers.title: EXPERIENTIAL AND EMBODIED LEARNING IN SPECIAL EDUCATION UNDER NEP 2020: CONFERENCE PROCEEDINGS
papers.authors: Deepak Kumar, Shri Bhagwan, Tarak Halder
papers.journal: mLAC Journal for Arts Commerce and Sciences (m-JACS)
papers.abstract: These proceedings bring together 51 conference abstracts presented in connection with the Two-Day Symposium on “Experiential and Embodied Learning in Special Education under NEP 2020: Conference Proceedings,” scheduled for 22–23 October 2026 at the Regional Institute of Education (NCERT), Mysuru. The collection explores inclusive education and experiential learning through themes including theatre and art-based pedagogy, yogic and embodied learning, inclusive science and mathematics education, teacher education, multilingual learning, digital technologies, artificial intelligence, accessibility, and learner well-being. In the context of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, the proceedings provide a forum for academic exchange on approaches intended to make teaching and learning more participatory, accessible, and responsive to diverse learners, including learners with disabilities. The contributions reflect a range of topics and proposed approaches; the present abstract summarises the scope of the collection and does not claim that the proceedings establish a single set of empirical findings.
papers.summary_zh: 该会议论文集汇集了在NEP 2020框架下探讨特殊教育中体验式与具身学习的51篇会议摘要，主题涵盖戏剧与艺术教学法、瑜伽与具身学习、融合科学和数学教育、教师教育、多语言学习、数字技术与人工智能、无障碍及学习者福祉等。作为学术交流平台，这些摘要呈现了使教学更具参与性、可及性并回应包括残障学习者在内的多元学习者需求的各种思路与拟议方法。摘要明确说明，本文仅概括文集范围，并不主张论文集确立了统一的实证发现。

papers.title: Problem analysis of curriculum development for application-oriented undergraduate art and design programs in Chinese-foreign cooperative education: a case study
papers.authors: Zhiyong Wang, Wei Wang
papers.abstract: Based on the OBE (Outcome-Based Education) philosophy, this study examines the construction of curriculum systems for application-oriented undergraduate art and design programs in Chinese-foreign cooperative education, taking the Modern International Art & Design Academy of Chongqing Technology and Business University as a case study. The research identifies four core challenges in practice at present: a gap between application-oriented talent cultivation goals and OBE principles; an incomplete curriculum system that integrates local needs with an international perspective; a dual-standard issue in assessment and evaluation systems oriented toward students’ long-term career development; and the absence of an effective collaborative mechanism between Chinese and foreign faculty despite their physical co-presence. These problems essentially reflect the structural tension between internationalization and localization. The study proposes that the solution lies in constructing a new educational logic of integrated co-creation, applying an outcome-oriented approach throughout the entire process of goal setting, curriculum reconstruction, evaluation reform, and faculty development. This approach would promote the organic integration of international design education resources with local industry-education collaboration, and establish a career competency tracking and support system that runs through the entire cultivation process. This study also provides a problem definition and analytical framework for similar institutions seeking to advance high-quality development in Chinese-foreign cooperative education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以重庆工商大学现代国际艺术与设计学院为案例，基于OBE理念考察中外合作办学中应用型本科艺术设计专业的课程体系建设问题。研究指出当前实践存在四方面核心挑战：应用型人才培养目标与OBE原则之间存在落差，课程体系尚未完整融合本土需求与国际视野，面向学生长期职业发展的考核评价存在双重标准，中外师资虽同处一地却缺乏有效的协作机制；这些问题本质上反映了国际化与本土化之间的结构性张力。研究据此提出以融合共创的教育逻辑加以应对，将成果导向贯穿目标设定、课程重构、评价改革与师资发展全过程，并建立贯穿培养全程的职业能力跟踪与支持体系，为同类院校提供问题界定与分析框架。

papers.title: Teachers’ Moral Resilience in the Digital Era: Internalizing Professional Codes and Islamic Moral Values
papers.authors: Muhamad Rizza, Muhammad Zidan Aulawy, Maslinah, Muhammad Zakariyya
papers.abstract: Digital education presents ethical challenges requiring teachers to exercise moral judgment, maintain integrity, and demonstrate professional accountability. Discussions of professional codes often emphasize regulation, giving insufficient attention to their internalization as foundations for moral resilience and professional identity. This study examines how professional codes, moral principles, Islamic ethical values, and personal values can be conceptually integrated to strengthen teachers’ ethical responsibilities in the digital era. A qualitative literature review synthesized academic books, scholarly articles, and relevant educational policy documents through descriptive analysis, thematic classification, and conceptual interpretation. The synthesis distinguishes four interconnected dimensions: ethics grounds rational moral judgment; morality articulates socially recognized standards of conduct; akhlak emphasizes spiritual integrity and exemplary behavior; and internalized values support consistency in professional decisions. Their integration provides a conceptual account of moral resilience that connects professional obligations with ethical reasoning and personal commitment. Digital privacy, artificial intelligence, institutional pressures, and the commercialization of education emerge as important contexts for applying this perspective. The study contributes an integrative understanding of professional codes as resources for moral responsibility, ethical reasoning, and professional identity formation. It recommends incorporating reflective ethical case studies, professional mentoring, and ethical training responsive to educational contexts into teacher preparation and continuing professional development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注数字教育中教师面临伦理挑战时，专业规范如何内化为道德韧性基础，并尝试将专业规范、道德原则、伊斯兰伦理价值与个人价值进行概念整合。作者采用定性文献综述，梳理学术著作、论文与教育政策文件，区分出伦理、道德、akhlak（德性）与内化价值四个相互关联的维度，并据此提出一个连接职业义务、伦理推理与个人承诺的道德韧性概念框架。文章指出数字隐私、人工智能、机构压力与教育商业化是应用该视角的重要情境，并建议在教师培养与持续专业发展中纳入反思性伦理案例、专业辅导和情境化伦理培训。需注意，该文属概念性综述，未开展实证检验。

papers.title: BLOCKCHAIN-DRIVEN VERIFICATION OF AI-GENERATED DIGITAL CONTENT
papers.journal: International Journal of Progressive Research in Engineering Management and Science
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of generative artificial intelligence has altered how digital content is created.Images, videos, audio, documents, and text can now be produced or modified with relatively minimal technical knowledge.These advances benefit areas such as education, communication, entertainment, business, and research, but they also introduce a practical issue: it is increasingly difficult to determine where a digital file originated and whether it was modified later.Existing ai detectors are able to identify some synthetic or manipulated content; however, their ability to do so may vary depending on the emergence of new generation models or when a file undergoes size alteration, compression, editing, or sharing across different platforms.This paper introduces a blockchain-driven framework that enables verification of the provenance and integrity of ai-generated digital content.The proposed framework integrates several key components including ai-based content analysis, cryptographic hashing, perceptual fingerprinting, digital signatures, decentralized identity, smart contracts, and blockchain-based provenance records.Instead of storing entire media files onto the blockchain, the system stores compact verification metadata on-chain and stores the actual content in an appropriate off-chain storage.When verifying a submitted file, the file is hashed and compared to the registered record.In addition, ai analysis is utilized as an additional form of evidence regarding potential synthetic generation or manipulation.This paper describes the architecture, verification process, security considerations, advantages, limitations, possible methods of evaluation, and future directions for the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式人工智能使数字内容来源与后续修改难以判断的问题，提出一套基于区块链的内容溯源与完整性验证框架。作者将AI内容分析、密码学哈希、感知指纹、数字签名、去中心化身份、智能合约与链上溯源记录整合起来，仅把紧凑的验证元数据上链，实际内容存于链下；验证时对提交文件做哈希并与登记记录比对，AI分析则作为判断内容是否可能由AI生成或被篡改的补充证据。文章属于系统/框架设计类工作，主要阐述架构、验证流程、安全考量、优势与局限，并讨论可能的评估方法和未来方向，未报告实证验证结果。

papers.title: ChatGPT-assisted mathematics learning in the era of generative AI: A bibliometric analysis of research trends, collaboration networks, and emerging pedagogical themes
papers.authors: Supriadi Supriadi, Dadang Juandi, Hidayani Hidayani
papers.journal: International Journal of Mathematics and Mathematics Education
papers.abstract: Purpose – This study aims to map the development of research on ChatGPT-assisted mathematics learning during the 2023–2025 period. Methodology – This study uses bibliometric analysis to examine the intellectual, social, and conceptual structures of research on ChatGPT-assisted mathematics learning. Data were obtained from the Scopus database and analyzed using Bibliometrix Biblioshiny. Document selection followed the PRISMA 2020 reporting guidelines as a checklist for the identification, screening, eligibility, and inclusion stages. Of the 1,227 documents identified, 143 met the inclusion criteria and were analyzed further. Findings – The number of publications increased from 12 in 2023 to 36 in 2024 and 95 in 2025, indicating an annual growth rate of 181.37% and an average of 18.63 citations per document. International co-authorship accounted for only 16.78% of these documents, indicating limited cross-national collaboration. ChatGPT, mathematics education, and artificial intelligence were the most dominant keywords, while geometry, prospective mathematics teachers, and personalized learning were relatively underrepresented. Novelty – Unlike previous studies that generally treat ChatGPT as part of generative artificial intelligence, this research analytically positions ChatGPT-assisted mathematics learning as a separate bibliometric unit and proposes AI-mediated mathematics learning as a conceptual proposition that emphasizes critical validation of AI-generated results. Significance – These findings provide an evidence-based research agenda to strengthen international collaboration and develop mathematics instruction that emphasizes reasoning, justification, and critical evaluation of AI-generated solutions, while identifying priorities for future empirical research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量分析梳理2023至2025年ChatGPT辅助数学学习的研究格局，数据来自Scopus并按PRISMA流程筛选出143篇文献，考察其知识、社会与合作结构。结果显示发文量逐年上升，但国际合著比例偏低，跨国协作有限；关键词集中于ChatGPT、数学教育与人工智能，几何、职前数学教师和个性化学习相对薄弱。作者据此将ChatGPT辅助数学学习作为独立分析单元，提出强调批判性验证AI生成结果的AI中介数学学习概念，并建议加强国际协作、重视推理与论证的教学取向。

papers.title: Proceedings of NORA's Annual Meeting 2026
papers.authors: Geir Halnes
papers.abstract: NORA - The Norwegian Artificial Intelligence Research Consortium - works to strengthen Norwegian research, education and innovation within the fields of AI, machine learning and robotics. NORA is a collaboration between 9 universities, 4 university colleges and 4 research institutes. The current article provides a summary of NORA’s annual conference 2026.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是对 NORA 2026 年年会的会议纪要，并非实证研究或综述。NORA 是挪威人工智能研究联盟，由多所高校与科研机构合作组成，致力于推动挪威在人工智能、机器学习与机器人领域的研究、教育和创新。文章概述了本次年会的整体情况，但摘要未给出具体议题、报告内容或参会规模等信息，因此无法进一步概括会议的核心发现或结论。

papers.title: BEYOND TECHNOSTRESS AI Fatigue as a Cumulative Adaptation Burden in Education and Work
papers.authors: Wael Badawy
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has become a persistent layer of work and learning rather than an occasional tool. Users must repeatedly decide when to delegate, how to prompt, whether to trust, how to verify, and how responsibility should be distributed. This integrative review defines AI fatigue as a cumulative reduction in the cognitive, affective, or motivational capacity for adaptive AI engagement when interaction, evaluation, correction, learning, and role-adjustment demands accumulate faster than recovery and support. The review connects technostress, automation vigilance, cognitive load and offloading, trust calibration, digital fatigue, and the Job Demands–Resources perspective. It introduces an Exposure–Adaptation–Depletion–Response framework, a five-domain taxonomy, and an AI Fatigue Load model that separates use volume from uncertainty, task stakes, correction burden, interruption, role disruption, and imposed adoption velocity. The analysis is updated to incorporate a 2026 validated 15-item AI Fatigue Scale; the proposed load model complements that psychophysiological outcome measure by specifying socio-technical antecedents and exposure conditions. Educational and organizational applications show why AI may simultaneously improve output and worsen human sustainability. The article identifies recurring inferential errors, presents a measurement and longitudinal research agenda, and proposes an intervention hierarchy spanning interface design, workflow, curriculum, organizational policy, and governance. AI fatigue is positioned neither as generic screen tiredness nor as a synonym for burnout, but as an adaptation problem located in the coupled human–AI–institution system.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述提出“AI疲劳”概念，将其界定为在人与AI持续互动中，当交互、评估、纠错、学习与角色调整等需求累积速度超过恢复与支持时，个体在认知、情感或动机上出现的适应性参与能力累积性下降。文章整合技术压力、自动化警觉、认知负荷与卸载、信任校准及工作需求—资源等视角，构建暴露—适应—耗竭—反应框架、五域分类和AI疲劳负荷模型，将使用量与不确定性、任务风险、纠错负担、中断、角色扰动及强制采纳速度区分开来，并纳入2026年经验证的15项量表作为补充。作者据此讨论教育和工作场景中AI可能同时提升产出与损害人类可持续性的机制，提出测量与纵向研究议程及跨界面、工作流程、课程、组织政策和治理的干预层级，强调AI疲劳是位于人—AI—制度耦合系统中的适应问题，而非泛化的屏幕疲劳或倦怠的同义词。

papers.title: Student Perceptions of Artificial Intelligence and Metaverse-Enabled Remote Learning in New Zealand Tertiary Education
papers.authors: Gamage Sharmila Iroshi Perera, Premalatha Sampath, Kumar Laxman
papers.abstract: The increasing development of emerging digital technologies is creating new possibilities for remote tertiary education. Artificial Intelligence and Metaverse technologies offer potential for personalised learning, intelligent support, immersive interaction, and collaboration; however, their educational value depends partly on how students perceive their usefulness, accessibility, supporting conditions, and motivational potential. This study examined New Zealand tertiary students’ perceptions of prospective Artificial Intelligence- and Metaverse-enabled remote learning environments and investigated whether selected technology-acceptance and motivational factors were associated with perceived learning engagement. A mono-method quantitative, cross-sectional survey design was adopted. Data were collected through an online questionnaire comprising 20 Likert-scale items representing six constructs: performance expectancy, facilitating conditions, motivation, perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, and perceived learning engagement. A total of 356 responses were retained for analysis. Descriptive statistics, reliability analysis, Pearson correlation, exploratory chi-square analysis, and multiple linear regression were conducted. The regression model was statistically significant and explained 33.8% of the variance in perceived learning engagement (R² = .338; adjusted R² = .329; F = 35.773, p < .001). Perceived usefulness (β = .279, p < .001), motivation (β = .218, p < .001), and facilitating conditions (β = .179, p < .001) were statistically significant predictors of perceived learning engagement. Performance expectancy (β = .065, p = .223) and perceived ease of use (β = .089, p = .058) were not statistically significant predictors. An exploratory chi-square analysis also identified a statistically significant association between age and perceptions of virtual teamwork (p = .001). The findings provide preliminary evidence that perceived usefulness, motivation, and facilitating conditions are important considerations in understanding student engagement with prospective advanced remote learning environments. Given the cross-sectional design and purposive non-probability sampling, the findings indicate statistical associations rather than causal effects and should be interpreted within the study sample.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察新西兰高等教育学生对人工智能与元宇宙支持的远程学习环境的感知，并分析技术接受与动机因素是否与感知学习投入相关。研究采用横断面问卷调查，以六个构念的量表题项收集数据，通过回归分析发现，感知有用性、动机和促进条件与感知学习投入呈显著正相关，而绩效期望和感知易用性则无显著预测作用。文章据此指出，这些因素对理解学生投入未来高级远程学习环境具有初步参考价值，但受横断面设计与非概率抽样限制，结果仅反映样本内的统计关联，不能推断因果关系。

papers.title: ЛАКУНАРНОСТЬ В ХУДОЖЕСТВЕННОМ ТЕКСТЕ: ЭКСПЛИЦИТНЫЕ И ИМПЛИЦИТНЫЕ АСПЕКТЫ
papers.authors: Д.А. МАРТИРОСЯН
papers.journal: Вестник Адыгейского государственного университета серия «Филология и искусствоведение»
papers.abstract: В статье рассматривается феномен лакунарности как фундаментального принципа организации художественного текста, обеспечивающего его смысловую глубину и эстетическую ценность. Анализируются два взаимосвязанных аспекта лакунарности: эксплицитный, связанный со структурными пропусками в повествовании (композиционные разрывы, диалогические паузы, темпоральные скачки, синтаксические эллипсисы), и имплицитный, отвечающий за генерацию скрытых смыслов (психологический, идейно-философский и культурно-аксиологический подтекст). На материале романа У. Теккерея «Ярмарка тщеславия» демонстрируется, что взаимодействие выраженного и невыраженного активизирует читательское восприятие, превращая чтение в процесс сотворчества. Доказывается, что лакунарность является не случайным элементом, а строго организованной системой, повышающей интерпретационный потенциал текста и обеспечивающей его многозначность. The article examines the phenomenon of lacunarity as a fundamental principle of the organization of a literary text, ensuring its semantic depth and aesthetic value. Two interrelated aspects of lacunarity are analyzed: the explicit one, associated with structural gaps in the narrative (compositional breaks, dialogical pauses, temporal jumps, syntactic ellipses), and the implicit one, responsible for generating hidden meanings (psychological, ideological, philosophical, and cultural-axiological overtones). Based on the novel by U. Thackeray «Vanity Fair» it demonstrates that the interaction of the expressed and the unexpressed activates the reader's perception, turning reading into a process of co-creation. It is proved that lacunarity is not an accidental element, but a strictly organized system that increases the interpretative potential of the text and ensures its ambiguity.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察文学文本中的“空白性”作为组织原则如何支撑文本的意义深度与审美价值，区分了显性层面（叙事中的结构断裂、对话停顿、时间跳跃、句法省略）与隐性层面（心理、思想哲学及文化价值层面的潜台词）。作者以萨克雷《名利场》为分析对象，论证显性空白与隐性空白的相互作用激活读者感知，使阅读成为共同创作的过程，并据此提出空白性并非偶然成分，而是一套严格组织的系统，能提升文本的解释潜力并造就其多义性。

papers.authors: Louis Morissette

FRANÇAIS COS45 — Démonstration de faisabilité mathématique et numérique Toute mesure a son silence. Avant de dire ce qu'un instrument détecte, il faut savoir ce qu'il mesure lorsque rien ne change volontairement. Ce silence expérimental permet d'estimer le bruit et de fixer un seuil de détection. Mais certaines transformations restent invisibles à une représentation, même en l'absence de bruit. COS45 propose une construction mathématique explicite : séries temporelles, fenêtres, matrices de Hankel, décomposition spectrale, projecteurs et trajectoires sur une grassmannienne. Trois niveaux de résultats sont présentés : 1. Démonstrations mathématiques Les travaux COS45 comprennent une borne sur le rang différentiel : rank DΨ ≤ min{n − 1, r(a − r), 3a − 5} Cette borne est publiée dans le dépôt DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23398912. Un résultat d'atteinte au rang trois est présenté dans le dépôt DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23540021. Ces travaux demeurent ouverts à la vérification indépendante. 2. Observations descriptives sur les batteries NASA L'analyse porte sur quatre batteries lithium-ion : B0005, B0006, B0007 et B0018, soit 636 décharges et 1 908 fenêtres. Les distances géométriques maximales à la référence sont respectivement : B0005 : 0,1452 B0006 : 0,1424 B0007 : 0,1155 B0018 : 0,1190 Les changements sont particulièrement visibles dans la fenêtre de fin de décharge. Les coefficients R² de 0,922 à 0,991 proviennent d'une régression quadratique descriptive de la distance géométrique sur la capacité, calculée dans l'échantillon. Ils ne démontrent aucun gain prédictif. 3. Expérience synthétique contrôlée Un modèle numérique fait varier la position, la largeur et les pentes du genou de fin de décharge. Ces transformations reproduisent qualitativement le motif observé sur les batteries NASA : déplacement important de la troisième fenêtre et déplacements plus faibles des deux premières. Cette expérience fournit une explication concurrente possible, sans identifier le mécanisme physique réel. Portée et limites L'ensemble constitue une démonstration de faisabilité mathématique et numérique de COS45 comme instrument de représentation des changements temporels. Il ne démontre pas encore une anticipation de défaillance, une supériorité prédictive ou une efficacité opérationnelle. Un protocole de confrontation avec les indicateurs classiques de tension, pente, courbure, amplitude et capacité est fourni, mais n'a pas encore été exécuté sur les batteries réelles. Les résultats descriptifs sont reproductibles à partir des tableaux dérivés archivés. Leur reproduction complète depuis les fichiers NASA bruts reste à effectuer. J'offre COS45 et mon temps aux équipes universitaires souhaitant vérifier, réfuter ou prolonger ce travail. ENGLISH COS45 — Mathematical and Numerical Feasibility Demonstration Every measurement has its silence. Before claiming that an instrument detects change, we must understand what it measures when nothing is deliberately changed. This experimental silence helps estimate noise and establish detection thresholds. Yet some transformations remain invisible to a representation even in the absence of noise. COS45 provides an explicit mathematical construction based on time series, sliding windows, Hankel matrices, spectral decomposition, projectors, and trajectories on a Grassmannian. Three levels of results are presented: 1. Mathematical demonstrations COS45 includes an analytical differential-rank bound: rank DΨ ≤ min{n − 1, r(a − r), 3a − 5} The bound is published under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23398912. A rank-three attainment result is presented under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23540021. These results remain open to independent verification. 2. Descriptive observations on NASA batteries The analysis covers four lithium-ion cells: B0005, B0006, B0007 and B0018, representing 636 discharges and 1,908 windows. The maximum geometric distances from the reference are: B0005: 0.1452 B0006: 0.1424 B0007: 0.1155 B0018: 0.1190 The largest changes occur in the end-of-discharge window. The R² values ranging from 0.922 to 0.991 are descriptive, in-sample coefficients from quadratic regressions of geometric distance on measured capacity. They do not demonstrate predictive improvement. 3. Controlled synthetic experiment A numerical voltage-curve model varies the position, width and slopes of the end-of-discharge knee. These transformations qualitatively reproduce the NASA pattern: substantial displacement in the third window and smaller displacements in the first two. This provides a possible competing explanation without identifying the actual physical mechanism. Scope and limitations Together, these results constitute a mathematical and numerical feasibility demonstration of COS45 as an instrument for representing temporal change. They do not yet establish early failure prediction, predictive superiority or operational effectiveness. A confrontation protocol against conventional voltage, slope, curvature, amplitude and capacity indicators is included but has not yet been executed on real battery data. The descriptive results can be reproduced from the archived derived tables. Full reproduction from the original NASA raw files remains outstanding. I offer COS45 and my time to university teams interested in independently verifying, refuting or extending this work. NASA source data remain subject to their applicable terms.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一份数学与数值可行性演示报告，提出以时间序列、Hankel 矩阵、谱分解和 Grassmann 流形轨迹构建的 COS45 表示框架，并给出差分秩上界等数学结果。作者将该框架用于四块 NASA 锂离子电池的放电数据，描述了几何距离在放电末窗变化最明显，但摘要明确指出这些样本内回归系数不构成预测增益。合成实验仅定性复现了观察到的模式，作者强调尚未证明早期故障预测、预测优越性或实际运行效果，与常规指标的对照方案也尚未在真实数据上执行。
