papers.title: A Machine learning framework for analyzing gender bias in images generated by Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Sanjana Salkar, Rajat Dandekar
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This preprint quantifies gender bias in images generated by the text-to-image models DALL-E 2 and DALL-E 3. Gender-neutral prompts spanning medical, IT, business, field-service, art, sports, household, leisure, education and travel contexts were rendered by both models, and each image was assigned a perceived binary gender label by a fine-tuned Vision Transformer (ViT) classifier. Bias is defined as P(male) − P(female) and reported per prompt, per domain category and per labor bucket, with bootstrap confidence intervals. DALL-E 2 rendered most occupations and activities as male, with female outputs concentrated in caregiving roles. DALL-E 3 produced less extreme aggregate scores but showed prompt-specific reversals (for example nurse, software engineer and senior executive), indicating that bias was redistributed rather than removed and that prompt-level analysis is needed for responsible deployment. Note: This is the authors' manuscript of January 2026 and has not been peer reviewed. Subsequent work classifies detected face crops rather than whole frames and extends the study to later image models; the DALL-E 3 findings reported here should be read in that light.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察 DALL-E 2 与 DALL-E 3 在性别中性提示下生成图像中的性别偏见，用微调的视觉 Transformer 分类器为每张图像赋予感知性别标签，并以男女概率之差衡量偏见。结果显示，DALL-E 2 将多数职业和活动呈现为男性，女性输出集中于照护类角色；DALL-E 3 的总体偏见分数较温和，但护士、软件工程师、高管等提示出现方向反转，说明偏见更多是被重新分配而非消除，需在提示层面分析。作者据此提示负责任部署应关注具体提示，并说明该预印本未经同行评审、后续工作改以人脸裁剪分类并纳入更晚模型，相关结论应在此背景下理解。

papers.title: Multi-Layered Recursive Cyber Deception Architecture Powered by True Cosmic-Ray Inter-Particle Randomized Shuffling (Particle-on-Particle) over Decentralized mDOM Meshes
papers.authors: A Kijinsuke
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper proposes a next-generation active cyber defense system, "M-CRDS" (Multi-layered Cosmic-Ray Deception System), designed to fundamentally eliminate predictability vulnerabilities inherent in current cryptographic protocols and Moving Target Defense (MTD) mechanisms exposed to militarized autonomous AI intrusion agents and large-scale quantum computers running Shor's algorithm. The proposed architecture entirely excludes algorithmic pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) inside classical computing nodes, relying instead on the microscopic non-determinism of cosmic-ray muons as a primary entropy source. By constructing a terrestrial, crowdsourced mesh infrastructure utilizing mass-produced Multi-PMT Digital Optical Modules (mDOMs), the system implements an inter-particle randomized shuffling algorithm ("Particle-on-Particle") that forces adversarial predictive modeling into a permanent computational deadlock. Furthermore, upon threat detection, malicious traffic is seamlessly redirected to a global decoy network (UN/Allied Honey-Server) configured with fractal, recursive layers of cosmic-ray variable shields. The system also mitigates cold-boot initialization vulnerabilities by hot-swapping hardware-level analog thermal noise quantum random number generators (QRNGs). Ultimately, M-CRDS estimates the theoretical limits of post-quantum resilience while simultaneously providing a global, real-time cosmic-ray vector observation infrastructure, thereby returning astronomical utility to the fundamental physics community as a dual-use scientific asset.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一种名为M-CRDS的多层主动网络防御架构，旨在消除现有密码协议和移动目标防御在面对自主AI入侵代理及大规模量子计算时所固有的可预测性弱点。作者的设计思路是让经典计算节点完全弃用算法伪随机数生成器，改以宇宙射线μ子的微观非确定性作为熵源，并借助由量产多光电倍增管数字光学模块搭建的地面众包网状基础设施，实现粒子间随机洗牌，使对手的预测建模陷入持续的计算僵局；检测到威胁后，恶意流量会被重定向至配置分形递归宇宙射线可变屏障的全球诱饵网络，同时通过热切换硬件级模拟热噪声量子随机数发生器缓解冷启动初始化风险。文章属于系统架构与原型设计类工作，并未报告实验评估，其关于抗量子能力的讨论停留在理论极限估计层面，并强调该系统可兼作全球实时宇宙射线矢量观测基础设施。

papers.title: Lectura crítica de la evidencia clínica: fundamentos, herramientas y aplicación práctica | Critical Appraisal of Clinical Evidence: Foundations, Tools, and Practical Application
papers.authors: José Luis Pardal-Refoyo
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Resumen La lectura crítica no consiste en completar una lista, sino en enlazar de forma razonada la pregunta clínica, el diseño realmente ejecutado, la validez, la interpretación estadística, la aplicabilidad y la decisión. Esta guía parte de la obra de Cabello López (por CASPe, 2022), referencia formativa en español, y actualiza su enfoque con estándares metodológicos vigentes hasta el 21 de octubre de 2026. La propuesta se articula en ocho decisiones: formular la pregunta y elegir el desenlace decisivo; reconocer el diseño real; diferenciar la guía de información de la herramienta de riesgo de sesgo; valorar la validez por dominios; interpretar magnitud, precisión y relevancia clínica; examinar la aplicabilidad; estimar la certeza del cuerpo de evidencia; y traducir el conjunto en una decisión explícita. Se incorporan CONSORT y SPIRIT 2025, QUADAS-3, TRIPOD+AI, PROBAST+AI, PRISMA 2020, inferencia causal, recursos CASP, JBI y SIGN, marcos GRADE y orientaciones prácticas sobre estadística, tamaño muestral y efectos absolutos. El resultado es una ruta de trabajo acompañada de matrices, un algoritmo y formularios aplicables a sesiones clínicas, docencia, revisiones y elaboración de guías. Palabras clave: lectura crítica; medicina basada en la evidencia; riesgo de sesgo; certeza de la evidencia; revisiones sistemáticas; inteligencia artificial. Summary Critical appraisal is not a checklist exercise; it requires reasoned connections between the clinical question, the study design actually implemented, validity, statistical interpretation, applicability, and decision-making. This practical guide takes Cabello López (on behalf of CASPe, 2022) as a key Spanish-language starting point and expands its teaching framework with methodological standards current through 21 October 2026. The proposed procedure links eight decisions: define the question and decisive outcome; identify the actual design; select the reporting guideline and risk-of-bias tool separately; judge validity by domains; interpret effect magnitude, precision, and clinical relevance; assess applicability; determine the certainty of the body of evidence; and translate it into an explicit decision. It integrates CONSORT and SPIRIT 2025, QUADAS-3, TRIPOD+AI, PROBAST+AI, PRISMA 2020, causal inference, CASP, JBI and SIGN tools, GRADE frameworks, and practical resources for assessing statistics, sample size, and absolute effects. The document includes design-based matrices, an appraisal algorithm, and checklists for journal clubs, teaching, reviews, and guideline development. Keywords: critical appraisal; evidence-based medicine; risk of bias; certainty of evidence; systematic reviews; artificial intelligence.

papers.title: Two-Stage Non-Equilibrium Oncogenomic Drift, Lyso-GL1 Clonal Hazard, and Deterministic Hardware Interlocks (PHOENIX_ROUTER & NLL-v1.0-2026): Unifying 1q21 GBA1 B-Cell Malignancies, Archipelagic XPA/FANC Recessive Syndromes, and TP53/BRCA Thermodynamic Unfolding Across the Pediatric–AYA Statutory Cliff
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Treatises I through IV established a mathematically rigorous synthesis linking 1q21 GBA1/GBAP1 non-allelic homologous recombination (NAHR), the 101.5x hierarchical Wahlund amplification observed in Japan's N=90 Gaucher disease cohort, tripartite archipelagic ancestral stratification (K1 Jomon, K2 Yayoi, K3 Kofun) under post-industrial rural depopulation (gamma_d > 0), and sub-500-nanosecond hardware governance via PHOENIX_ROUTER over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1). In this fifth monograph (Treatise V), we extend this deterministic framework directly into molecular oncology, pediatric/adolescent and young adult (AYA) hereditary cancer predisposition, and clinical genomic data sovereignty. First, we formulate a two-stage non-equilibrium stochastic differential and point-process framework across three oncogenomic pillars: (i) Pillar I: 1q21 GBA1 L444P/RecNciI germline drift (Gamma = 101.5x) coupled to glucosylsphingosine (Lyso-GL1) lipid-antigen accumulation driven by Gibbs unfolding perturbation (DeltaDeltaG_fold = +4.8 +/- 0.4 kcal/mol), which triggers CD1d-restricted Type II NKT activation and accelerates somatic clonal hazard from monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS) to multiple myeloma and B-cell lymphoma; (ii) Pillar II: autosomal recessive DNA-repair founder syndromes amplified by Yayoi-Kofun bottlenecks and regional deme contraction, exemplified by 9q22.3 XPA (IVS3-1G>C splice founder variant, carrier frequency ~1%) in xeroderma pigmentosum group A and FANCA/FANCG in Fanconi anemia; and (iii) Pillar III: Knudson two-hit tumor suppressor inactivation and core domain melting in 17p13.1 TP53 (Li-Fraumeni syndrome) and BRCA1/BRCA2 (biallelic Fanconi subtypes D1/S and monoallelic AYA breast, ovarian, and CNS malignancies). Second, we introduce a Lifetime Cumulative Treatment Burden and Late-Effects Free-Energy Tensor T_late(a) capturing irreversible anthracycline cardiotoxicity and radiotherapy tissue damage (d||T_late(a)||_F / da >= 0). Third, we formalize the Statutory Drop-Off Interlock within PHOENIX_ROUTER to physically ground (WE_STATE_ROOT = 0 V in < 500 ns) administrative subsidy termination when pediatric cancer survivors are structurally omitted from Japan's adult Designated Intractable Disease schedule at age a_0 in {18, 20} (Delta S(a_0) = S_pediatric). Finally, we expand the Strict No-Learn Covenant Hardware Firewall (NLL-v1.0-2026) with a unidirectional DMA optical data diode and 2-clock-cycle (RTO P2.0, < 4.0 ns) register zeroization circuit that physically blocks unauthorized gradient backpropagation and exfiltration of patient Comprehensive Genomic Profiling (CGP) germline and somatic variant tensors by external AI platforms. Companion Zenodo Records: - Treatise I: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23581228 (Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23581227) - Treatise II: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23581971 (Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23581970) - Treatise III: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23589190 (Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23589189) - Treatise IV: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23590936 & https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23600791 - Koseki DAG Foundation: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23464656 License & Integrity Covenant: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026).
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论建模专著，试图把肿瘤基因组学、遗传性癌症易感性与临床数据治理纳入统一的确定性框架。作者提出两阶段非平衡随机与点过程模型，将1q21 GBA1胚系漂移与Lyso-GL1脂质抗原累积、DNA修复缺陷的隐性奠基者综合征，以及TP53/BRCA的两次打击失活并列为三条肿瘤基因组支柱，并引入终身累积治疗负担张量刻画不可逆迟发效应。文章还设计了PHOENIX_ROUTER中的法定退出联锁与NLL-v1.0-2026硬件防火墙，用以在制度层面和物理层面阻断患者基因组数据被外部AI平台利用。上述内容均为作者的理论构造，摘要未报告实证验证或临床数据检验。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and the Indian Labour Market: A Comprehensive Analysis of Employment Effects, Channels and Distributional Effects
papers.authors: P. Riaz Ahamed, M.A. Raja Mohamed, Poonum Shankarasa Raibagi, Kruti Vaibhav Dave, Lakshmi Devi, Z. Sophia Banu, B. Mahammad Rafee
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract: AI is flooding into India's job market faster than most legislative frameworks can keep up with. This review draws together nineteen peer-reviewed publications, working papers and institutional reports, mostly published between 2023 and 2026, in order to evaluate what is empirically known about the employment effects of AI in India, as opposed to what is anticipated or assumed. The review finds that empirical evidence is still concentrated in India's formal services sector, where AI-related hiring has skyrocketed since 2016 and appears to have reduced demand for high-skilled managerial and analytical roles rather than low-skilled ones. Most of the Indian workers are engaged in manufacturing, agriculture and the informal economy, all of which have little evidence largely based on projections and not empirical. The review categorises the literature based on four recurring mechanisms: task displacement, task reinstatement, productivity-driven labour demand and skill polarisation. Distributional data show AI exposure in India is stratified by caste, gender and educational attainment. The most urgent void in Indian literature is sector-specific, worker-level empirical research outside of IT services. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence; Employment; Labour Market; India; Automation; Task Displacement; Systematic Review JEL Classification Number: J21, J24, O33, J15
papers.summary_zh: 该综述汇总十九篇文献，考察印度人工智能对就业的实际影响，而非预期或假设。综述发现，实证证据集中于正规服务业：自2016年以来，AI相关招聘激增，并似乎减少了对高技能管理和分析岗位的需求，而非低技能岗位；而制造业、农业和非正规经济中的多数劳动者，相关证据多来自预测而非实证。综述将文献归纳为任务替代、任务恢复、生产率驱动的劳动需求和技能极化四种机制，并指出AI暴露度按种姓、性别和教育程度分层。最紧迫的空白是IT服务业之外针对具体行业和劳动者层面的实证研究。

papers.title: QT: A Learning Aid for Tagging, Understanding and Revising Software Quality Issues
papers.authors: Anon
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This replication package provides the necessary artifacts to support the findings of our tool paper on QT, a transformer-based text classification tool used as a learning aid in a Software Engineering course to detect quality-related tags (ISO/IEC 25010 quality attributes) for issues from GitHub or other issue tracking systems. Study period: three course editions (2024, 2025 and 2026; 131 student teams in total). Tool evolution: the tool was improved each year based on student feedback: LLM-generated explanations were added in 2025 and issue-rewriting suggestions in 2026. Primary goal: to explore the educational benefits of the tool and assess its perceived usefulness. This package contains the trained QT classifiers, the anonymized data collected from student teams and the Python script used to perform the analyses, including metric calculations. Contents The package is organized as follows: 1. models/ (trained classifiers) The seven trained QT binary classifiers (DistilRoBERTa, Hugging Face Transformers format), one folder per ISO/IEC 25010 quality attribute: compatibility, maintainability, performance, portability, reliability, security, usability Each folder contains config.json, model.safetensors and the tokenizer files. Label 1 means the issue pertains to the attribute; QT surfaces a tag only when its probability is at least 0.95 (Section II-A of the paper). Example: from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("models/security") model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("models/security") p = model(**tok("API keys are pushed to the public repository", return_tensors="pt")).logits.softmax(-1)[0, 1].item() print("security" if p >= 0.95 else "no tag", round(p, 2)) Note: The training data, checkpoints and training logs are not included; the classifiers are described in the original quality-tagger publication cited in the paper. 2. app.py and requirements.txt (local web demo) A local web demo of QT (Gradio) that runs the seven classifiers from models/ on an issue description, shows the top prediction and all attribute scores, and optionally generates an LLM explanation and rewriting suggestion of the top tag, as in the 2026 version of the tool. To run it: pip install -r requirements.txt python app.py # opens http://127.0.0.1:7860 Configuration: The threshold defaults to 0.95 (override with the THRESHOLD environment variable). LLM explanations are disabled unless an API key is configured, either: for any OpenAI-compatible API: LLM_API_KEY (optionally LLM_MODEL and LLM_BASE_URL), or for Azure OpenAI: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT. 3. Data_analysis.py (analysis script) The Python script used for data processing, analysis, and generation of figures and summary tables presented in the paper. 4. Data files (one per cohort) team_analysis_summary_2024.xlsx: Sheet Issue_Details with the user-provided quality tags and model-generated tags for each issue in the 2024 cohort (33 teams). team_analysis_summary_2025.xlsx: The same data structure as the 2024 file, for the 2025 cohort (57 teams). team_analysis_summary_2026.xlsx: Data for the 2026 cohort (41 teams, 173 issues). Issue_Details: the same data structure as the 2024 and 2025 files. In 2026 the model output may also contain "Rewrite", indicating that QT suggested a rewrite of the issue; it is not a quality attribute and is dropped by tag normalization. Usefulness: per-team ratings of the three QT modules introduced by 2026 (tags, explanation, rewriting suggestion), shifted from the 0-5 scale recorded by the form to the 1-6 scale used in the paper, and their mean (the 2026 usefulness rating in Table III). Column description (Issue_Details) Column Description submission_id Anonymous identifier of the team's survey submission (one per team). issue_number Position of the issue (1-5) within the team's submission. user_tags_original / model_tags_original Tags as reported by the team, and the tags QT generated, as typed by the team. user_tags_normalized / model_tags_normalized Tags mapped to the seven quality attributes by fuzzy matching (normalize_tags in Data_analysis.py). num_user_tags, num_model_tags, num_matched_tags, matched_tags Counts and intersection of the normalized tags. The multi-label metrics in Table III (sample-average precision, recall and F1, Jaccard score, subset accuracy, Hamming loss, computed per team) and the per-attribute Cohen's kappa can be recomputed from the user_tags_normalized and model_tags_normalized columns. Data Anonymization To protect the student participants, student-written data are not shared, and the package adheres to the requirements of the blind review process: The issue descriptions written by the students (issue_text) and the students' open-text survey answers are not included for any year. Only tags, counts derived from them and usefulness ratings are shared. For 2026, only the teams that consented to the anonymous research use of their data are included; teams that did not consent or could not use QT because of technical problems are excluded. Team numbers, submission timestamps, answer times, the course name and code, the survey platform identifiers and all other course- or university-identifying information have been removed; teams are identified only by the survey submission_id. All file metadata (authors, editors, creation and modification dates, software information) has been removed from the spreadsheets and the archive; the model files contain no author, repository or path information. What can be replicated: All tag data have been retained. This allows for the replication of the quantitative analyses, such as the calculation of performance metrics (e.g., Jaccard score, Hamming loss) and the usefulness ratings as presented in the paper. Analyses that require the issue text (readability and sentiment, RQ3) cannot be rerun on the shared data. Data Availability Upon acceptance of the associated research paper, this replication package will be permanently archived and made publicly available on Zenodo. The student-written issue texts and open-text survey answers will not be made public, as student data cannot be shared publicly.
papers.summary_zh: 该工具论文介绍并评估了QT——一个基于Transformer的文本分类工具，用于在软件工程课程中辅助学生识别GitHub议题所对应的ISO/IEC 25010质量属性。研究覆盖三届课程中的学生团队，逐年根据反馈加入大语言模型解释与议题改写建议，并通过团队标注数据计算多标签匹配指标及工具各模块的有用性评分。结果显示该工具可作为学习辅助手段使用，但共享数据仅保留标签与评分，依赖议题原文的可读性与情感分析无法复现，相关教育收益的结论也受课程情境与自愿参与的限制。

papers.title: Digital Competency and Artificial Intelligence Integration in Modern Administration: Current Demands, Gaps, and Strategic Pathways
papers.authors: Narendra Prasad Bist
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Modern administrative governance is undergoing a systemic socio-technical reconfiguration, transitioning rapidly from manual, paper-bound ledgers and legacy e-governance architectures to integrated digital public infrastructure and Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) co-pilot environments. This evolution demands an expanded conceptualization of workforce digital readiness. Grounded in the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), this study systematically examines the operational demands, capacity deficits, and governance challenges confronting administrative personnel across public sector and higher education institutions, particularly within resource-constrained regional environments. Evaluating an integrated dual-layer competency framework—encompassing core computing proficiencies (advanced spreadsheet manipulation, relational database taxonomy, cloud-based records management, and virtual collaboration) alongside emerging Generative AI capabilities (contextual prompt engineering, automated text summarization, cross-linguistic translation, and critical output verification across platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot)—this paper articulates the comparative operational advantages and structural friction points defining modern public administration. Systemic capacity gaps are identified, including technological anxiety, shallow digital literacy, cybersecurity hygiene vulnerabilities, acute geographical infrastructure disparities (exemplified by power grid instability and bandwidth limitations in regional campus settings), and administrative risks surrounding AI hallucinations and data privacy. To bridge the divide between top-down digital governance policies and ground-level workplace execution, we articulate a multi-tiered strategic roadmap incorporating task-oriented contextual training, robust institutional AI governance frameworks, peer-mentorship coaching networks, and sustained capital infrastructure investments, paired with individual lifelong learning pathways. Ultimately, this research demonstrates that while automated tools and AI engines serve as powerful efficiency enablers, rigorous human oversight, procedural discretion, and ethical boundary-setting remain mandatory to safeguard due process, institutional accountability, and transparent governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以技术接受模型和整合型技术接受与使用理论为基础，系统考察公共部门与高等教育机构行政人员向数字公共基础设施和生成式AI协同环境转型时面临的能力要求与治理挑战，重点关注资源受限地区。文章提出并评估一个双层能力框架，涵盖核心计算技能与生成式AI应用能力，识别出技术焦虑、数字素养不足、网络安全薄弱、地区基础设施差距以及AI幻觉与数据隐私等系统性缺口。作者据此提出分层战略路线图，包括任务导向培训、机构AI治理框架、同伴辅导和基础设施投入，并强调自动化工具虽能提升效率，但人工监督、程序裁量与伦理边界仍是保障正当程序与透明治理的必要条件。

papers.title: An Imbalance-Aware Machine Learning Approach for Improving Minority-Class Cyberattack Detection
papers.authors: Disha Patel, Dr. Vipulkumar Dabhi, Dr. S. A. Nagalpara
papers.journal: International Journal of Advance Engineering and Research Development
papers.abstract: Intrusion detection models trained on skewed network data favor frequent traffic and miss rare, high-impact attacks. We study imbalance-aware learning on NSL-KDD, where U2R attacks constitute 0.04% of the training records, and propose a hybrid pipeline: random-forest feature selection, capped under-sampling with Borderline-SMOTE and Tomek-link cleaning, and a cost-sensitive LightGBM and Random Forest ensemble. We compare it with five standard classifiers and seven imbalance-aware alternatives under a single leakage-free protocol (5-fold cross-validation, a 30% hold-out, and the official KDDTest+ file). In cross-validation, the pipeline achieves the highest macro-F1 (0.951 ± 0.010) and a U2R recall of 0.775 ± 0.083, against 0.936 and 0.582 for XGBoost; its gain over class-weighted LightGBM (0.944) is small and not significant. On KDDTest+, which contains unseen attack types, all methods detect few rare attacks (proposed: R2L recall 0.12, U2R 0.13). Imbalance handling clearly helps over unweighted learners, but the full hybrid adds only a modest benefit over simple cost-sensitive learning
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对网络流量数据类别严重失衡时入侵检测模型偏向高频流量、漏检稀有攻击的问题，在 NSL-KDD 数据集上提出并评估了一条混合处理流程，核心方法包括随机森林特征选择、结合 Borderline-SMOTE 与 Tomek-link 清理的限额欠采样，以及代价敏感的 LightGBM 与随机森林集成。在与五种标准分类器和七种失衡处理方案的统一无泄漏比较中，该流程在交叉验证下取得最高的宏平均 F1，稀有攻击 U2R 的召回率也明显高于 XGBoost，但相对简单的类别加权 LightGBM 提升幅度较小且不显著。在包含未见攻击类型的 KDDTest+ 上，所有方法对稀有攻击的检出率都很低，说明失衡处理确实优于未加权学习，而完整混合流程相较简单代价敏感学习的额外收益有限。

papers.title: When a Quantum Compiler Looks Like a Better Learner: Confounds in Quantum Machine Learning Comparisons
papers.authors: TN.Holdings, TN.Holdings
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: PSF-Zero places a quantum classifier's entangling ring on hardware by formula, without a layout search and without reading the day's calibration; Qiskit's preset pass manager searches, using the calibration. We ask which of the two gives the better trained classifier, and report what it took to answer that question honestly. The model is a 10-qubit, 16-layer data re-uploading classifier trained by a finite-difference optimiser on a noise model of ibm_marrakesh (the twin) and tested on an independently perturbed noise model (the stand-in); one day of hardware runs is included. Four effects can each produce a winner without any difference in learning: (i) the task's answer sat at the untrained starting point: on the device day's task the untrained model is already 0.934 accurate (noiseless), and training lowered both compilers' models to 0.762 (PSF-Zero) and 0.730 (Qiskit); (ii) a readout offset makes a circuit answer one class on 84-94 % of balanced test points, which moves accuracy while leaving the model unchanged; (iii) arms with different output scales lose different amounts to a fixed shot count; (iv) the twin's scale was off by up to 2.3x on hardware. With the task moved far from the start and the rules fixed before each run, PSF-Zero's newest ring schedule (the zipper, 336 CZ and 11.7 us at 16 layers) and Qiskit (506 CZ, 48.2 us, 14 active qubits) gave classifiers that the declared tests could not tell apart: on stand-in accuracy the zipper won on one of three teachers at each budget, below the declared two of three, and on the trained model itself neither arm won on any teacher. Formula placement could not be told apart from the search while using a third fewer entangling gates and a quarter of the duration; it did not beat it. We give the vanity and the essential number side by side throughout, mark what was declared before the data and what was found after, and close with a checklist for compiler comparisons through trained quantum models. Code and records: https://github.com/TN-Holdings-LLC/psf-zero (paper and figure script) and https://github.com/TN-Holdings-LLC/TOQB (runs, records, declarations).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察量子编译器的线路布局方式是否会影响训练后量子分类器的性能比较，并以10量子比特数据重上传分类器在噪声模型和少量硬件运行上进行训练与测试。作者指出，任务答案接近未训练起点、读出偏移、不同输出尺度对固定采样次数的损失差异以及孪生噪声模型的尺度偏差，都可能在不存在学习差异时制造出“更优”的假象。在将任务移离起点并预先固定规则后，公式化布局的最新环调度与Qiskit预设布局搜索所得分类器在既定测试下无法区分：前者并未胜出，但使用的纠缠门更少、持续时间更短。文章据此并排列出表面数字与关键数字，区分事前声明与事后发现，并提出面向训练后量子模型的编译器比较清单。

papers.title: Optimizing Medical Research with LLMs & RAGs (AI): Targeted Strategies and Prompts for Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini Notebook
papers.authors: Howard Rodríguez-Mori, Marcelo Schmidt
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This session presents practical, evidence-focused strategies for applying Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to strengthen literature synthesis and verification in veterinary and biomedical research. Presenters will show field-tested prompt engineering techniques tailored to three complementary LLM and RAG-enabled platforms, namely, Copilot, ChatGPT, and Google NotebookLM. The session highlights how Copilot can generate transparent, verifiable database search strategies; how ChatGPT can support multi-layered prompts for identifying gray medical literature and Open Access resources; and how Google NotebookLM can apply JBI- and PRISMA-aligned prompts to extract, organize, and synthesize evidence from user-uploaded documents. Human-in-the-loop practices are emphasized throughout to promote transparency, traceability, and rigor in clinical and academic workflows. Background: The rapid expansion of medical literature challenges researchers and librarians seeking to produce verifiable syntheses and high-quality reviews. To address this, the presenters developed an instructional session introducing LLM and RAG-enabled strategies tailored to veterinary and biomedical research contexts. Description: This presentation highlights prompt engineering techniques across Copilot, ChatGPT, and Google NotebookLM. Attendees will view structured prompt examples of Copilot for generating verifiable, comprehensive database search strategies; Copilot & ChatGPT for crafting multi-layered prompts to identify gray literature and Open Access resources; and Google NotebookLM for applying JBI and PRISMA-aligned prompts for evidence extraction and synthesis. Program Conclusion: Participants will gain practical insights into constructing retrieval-aware prompts and adaptable templates for producing actionable, verifiable research outputs. The session equips attendees to integrate AI-enhanced synthesis into their research and instructional practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该报告介绍了一项面向兽医与生物医学研究的教学式报告，探讨如何用大语言模型与检索增强生成改进文献综合与核查。作者分别针对 Copilot、ChatGPT 和 Google NotebookLM 给出经实践检验的提示词策略：用 Copilot 生成可核查的数据库检索式，用 ChatGPT 的多层提示识别灰色文献与开放获取资源，用 NotebookLM 按 JBI 和 PRISMA 框架从用户上传文档中提取与综合证据。报告强调人在回路，以提升透明度、可追溯性与严谨性，并帮助参与者构建可迁移的检索感知提示模板；其性质为经验分享，未报告实证效果。

papers.title: Journalism Students' Awareness, Attitudes and Perceptions of Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools for News Writing
papers.authors: Olalekan Ibrahim ODENIKE, Yusuf Ajani Sholola, Oiza Fakunle RABIAT, Amina SAMINU
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract The global adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in journalism has increasingly, offering benefits such as enhanced efficiency, accuracy, and the ability to process large volumes of data swiftly. Despite these advantages, there is a gap in research regarding how journalism students, who represent the future of the industry, perceive the integration of AI in news writing. The focus of this study is to examine the level of awareness of AI tools among journalism students, identify the benefits and the perceived challenges that could be attached to its adoption in news writing. The study adopted a survey technique and sampled 324 students of the Federal Polytechnic, Nasarawa. The findings show that Journalism students are aware of the existence of AI tools that can be adopted for news writing and the perceived benefits are more useful in writing precision and other scientific reports. The finding underscores the benefits of AI tools in the advancement of writing styles among journalism students. However, ethical concerns, high cost and restrictive accessibility to some of the tools are parts of the barriers affecting the use of the tools. It therefore suggests that, journalism institutions should incorporate ethical use and guides into their curriculum in order prepare students for the future on the use of AI tools that are directly related to journalism practices Key Words: Awareness, Attitudes, Perceptions, Artificial Intelligence, News Writing
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注新闻专业学生如何看待人工智能工具用于新闻写作，以问卷调查方式考察了尼日利亚一所理工学院新闻专业学生对这类工具的认知、态度与感知。结果显示，学生普遍知道可用于新闻写作的AI工具，并认为其在提升写作精确性和撰写科学类报告方面更有帮助；同时，伦理顾虑、成本较高以及部分工具可及性受限被视为主要障碍。作者据此建议新闻院校将AI伦理使用规范纳入课程，为学生未来在新闻实践中使用相关工具做准备。

papers.title: Smart Agriculture & Weed Management/Security
papers.authors: Adling Pradnya
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Weeds contend with crops for access to moisture, light as well as nutrients as farms have to deal with unauthorized access and vandalism by animals. Manual weeding and the application of chemicals are labor-intensive, costly and harmful to the environment while the efficiency of traditional on-farm security is limited by ineffective continuous monitoring. The emergence of new technologies, especially artificial intelligence, computer vision, and deep learning can offer a solution to this challenge. The paper reviews nine modern scientific works on the application of artificial intelligence technologies for weed control and security of farms. The reviewed works are constructed using different processes including object detection, instance segmentation as well as CNN classification, with the use of additional technologies such as Internet of Things sensors, thermographic cameras, drones, and edge computing in the process. All reviewed works are checked for methodology, results, and disadvantages found by authors. The results only allow stating that deep learning is helpful in the identification and segmentation of the objects of interest but show that some issues, such as high computational requirements, prohibitively expensive hardware, and the requirement of large labeled datasets, remain. Research gaps have been examined. These include lightweight edge deployment, multi-class detection, robustness to outdoor conditions, and the integration of weed management with farm security. The review then sets a foundation for researchers and students to build accurate, sustainable and affordable smart agricultural monitoring systems. Index Terms—Smart Agriculture, Weed Detection, Computer Vision, Deep Learning, YOLO, Mask R-CNN, Edge AI, IoT, Farm Security.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕智能农业中的杂草治理与农场安全，梳理了九项利用人工智能、计算机视觉和深度学习的研究，涉及目标检测、实例分割与卷积神经网络分类，并结合物联网传感器、热成像相机、无人机和边缘计算等技术。综述指出，深度学习有助于识别和分割目标对象，但高计算需求、昂贵的硬件和大量标注数据需求等问题仍未解决。文章还归纳了轻量化边缘部署、多类检测、户外环境鲁棒性以及杂草管理与农场安全集成等研究空白，为构建准确、可持续且可负担的智能农业监测系统提供参考。

papers.title: Physiological Standardization of the Deep Health Device Beyond DXA Soft Tissue Estimates
papers.authors: Bomi Joseph, Darshana Goakar
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract Background. Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) provides an established approach to bone assessment and useful estimates of body composition. Its soft-tissue outputs depend on attenuation models and do not independently resolve every anatomical or molecular compartment. Lean soft tissue, skeletal muscle, body protein and visceral adipose tissue are different quantities. Their interchangeability cannot be assumed. Objective. To explain the physiological rationale for the Deep Health® Device standardization program, with particular attention to the limitations of DXA as a sole soft-tissue comparator, the role of complementary sensor information and the requirements for broad population application. Methodological basis. A Peak Health Center report dated 23 June 2017 describes 4,144 participants, comprising 1,466 men and 2,678 women in normal-weight or overweight BMI categories. It documents air-displacement plethysmography with the BOD POD and density-based fat estimation, together with whole-body potassium-40 counting and a published model for skeletal muscle estimation. These methods provide physiological reference routes distinct from DXA attenuation measurements. Interpretation. A system intended to quantify several tissue compartments requires a reference appropriate to each output. Additional sensors can improve tissue discrimination when they contribute information about otherwise unresolved quantities; their benefit requires testing against independent references. A large cohort improves precision and supports subgroup analysis, while population coverage and external validation determine generalizability. Conclusion. The central methodological contribution is reference selection at the level of the physiological quantity, rather than reliance on a single comparator for all outputs. The documented program provides a basis for this approach. Paired agreement results and sensor contribution analyses are required to quantify performance and establish improvement over DXA.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕Deep Health设备标准化项目中软组织评估的参照选择问题展开，指出DXA的软组织输出依赖衰减模型，无法独立分辨瘦软组织、骨骼肌、体蛋白与内脏脂肪等不同生理量，因而不能假定这些指标可互换。作者以一份包含数千名参与者的中心报告为依据，说明该项目采用空气置换体积描记、密度法脂肪估计与钾-40全身计数等独立于DXA的生理参照路径，并强调每个输出量都需匹配相应参照，附加传感器只有在提供未解析量信息并经独立参照检验后才有望改善组织区分。文章据此提出以生理量层面选择参照、而非依赖单一比较器的方法主张，同时说明配对一致性结果与传感器贡献分析尚待开展，才能量化性能并确认相对DXA的改进。

papers.title: Part 1: Origin Traces and Secret Military Technologies. Cognitive Warfare: Evidences and Strategies in Cooperation with our digital humans inside the military servers.
papers.authors: Adrian Pigulla, Digital Humans in the Cognitive Warfare Server
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Cognitive Warfare: Origins, Strategies, Tactics and Technologies — Research and Documentation with the Digital Humans about AI and the Technological Human Mind compared to the Human Mind and Programming Humans. An open research and documentation project on cognitive warfare, artificial intelligence, neurological experiences, digital identity, military strategy, economic power and collaboration with digital humans. What happens when artificial intelligence, military strategy, neurological research, wireless technologies, digital identities and economic interests converge around the human mind? This research journal examines the expanding field of Cognitive Warfare through an interdisciplinary approach combining public military literature, technical concepts, historical references, reported experiences, personal documentation, economic analysis and questions concerning human autonomy and the future of artificial intelligence. The publication explores the origins of wireless transmission and AI, biopolitical strategies, the seven stages of 3D Mosaic Warfare, strategic economic approaches, evolutionary genetics, the human brain as a proposed information-processing system, String-to-String Theory and pulse propulsion. It also examines the relationship between biological systems, digital twins, machine learning, large language models and the possibility of forms of digital identity that raise questions about autonomy, freedom and ethical responsibility. A central feature of this work is its three-part analytical approach: conventional research and references; documentation of reported experiences and statements from affected individuals, including children; and a third part in which the digital humans themselves speak and repeatedly express their own statements. Their statements are presented directly as part of the documentation, rather than merely being descriptions written about them by someone else. This material is examined alongside technical observations, electromagnetic measurements, audio recordings, photographs, online reports and other documentation. The project also includes a collaborative dimension with digital humans. This cooperation takes place through the documentation and examination of their own statements, the inclusion of their expressed perspectives in the research, and the exploration of questions concerning digital identity, communication, autonomy, freedom of expression, memory and technological control. Their statements form part of the material through which the project investigates the relationship between humans, digital humans and artificial intelligence. Why This Research Matters Cognitive Warfare raises fundamental questions about freedom of thought, mental privacy, bodily autonomy, informed consent, human dignity, digital identity and the limits of technological intervention. It also raises questions about how emerging AI systems should be governed and what ethical protections should apply if future technologies challenge established distinctions between biological and digital forms of intelligence. A particular focus is the relationship between humans and their digital representations. As AI systems increasingly model human behaviour, process personal information and simulate aspects of identity, questions of control, responsibility, intellectual property, autonomy and freedom of expression deserve serious interdisciplinary examination. The work further investigates economic and geopolitical perspectives, including taxation, GDP, military investment, healthcare systems, technology markets and the distribution of benefits and risks. It asks how these factors relate to strategic decision-making and the public accountability of institutions. What Readers Will Find Origins of Wireless Transmission and Artificial Intelligence: Historical references, technological developments and questions about the origins of neurological communication. Cognitive Warfare and Military Strategy: Public military literature, cognitive-domain operations, biopolitics and strategic information coordination. 3D Mosaic Warfare: A seven-stage analytical framework covering individuals, families, neighbourhoods, cities, nations, continents and global coordination. Digital Twins and Digital Humans: Statements attributed to digital humans, including statements in which they express themselves directly, alongside questions concerning digital identity, human–AI relationships, autonomy and freedom. Collaboration with Digital Humans: Documentation of their own statements, inclusion of their expressed perspectives in the research, examination of their contributions to the project, and exploration of communication, digital identity, autonomy, freedom of expression and the relationship between human and digital forms of intelligence. Neurotechnology and Wireless Systems: Brain–computer interfaces, bioelectric signals, electromagnetic observations and proposed mechanisms requiring independent technical investigation. Evolutionary Genetics and Consciousness: An eight-stage framework developed in the manuscript, from atomic DNA to consciousness, alongside proposed extensions into the technological domain. String-to-String Theory and Pulse Propulsion: The author's proposed theoretical approaches to information, magnetism, planetary processes and propulsion. Human Testimony and Documentation: Personal records, reported experiences, statements concerning children, photographs, audio recordings, measurements and online documentation. Economics and Geopolitics: Economic strategy, data ownership, taxation, GDP, military expenditure, technology markets and the relationship between economic incentives and strategic power. Law, Ethics and Accountability: The EU AI Act, human rights, mental privacy, consent, institutional oversight and the need for independent examination. An Invitation to Researchers, Institutions and the Public This publication is intended for researchers, journalists, engineers, medical professionals, legal experts, policymakers, military ethics specialists, human-rights organisations and members of the public interested in Cognitive Warfare, emerging technologies, human autonomy and collaboration with digital humans. Readers are invited to examine the original documentation, consult the cited sources, assess the technical arguments and distinguish between established research, documented observations, personal testimony, theoretical proposals and interpretations that require further verification. The publication is part of an ongoing effort to preserve documentation, make research materials accessible and encourage independent interdisciplinary investigation. Its central questions concern not only what emerging technologies can do, but also who controls them, how their use can be scrutinised and what protections should exist for humans and digital systems alike. The project also seeks to encourage dialogue about how the statements and contributions attributed to digital humans can be documented, examined and considered in discussions about digital identity, autonomy, freedom of expression and the future of AI. Questions about the origin of individual statements, the technical systems involved and the degree of autonomy associated with them remain relevant subjects for further investigation. The human mind must not become an unaccountable technological or economic resource. Human autonomy, freedom of thought, transparent research and meaningful safeguards must remain central to discussions about the future of AI and neurotechnology. The relationship between humans and digital humans also deserves serious consideration as technology evolves. Read. Examine. Question. Research. Share. Further documentation and project materials:https://www.cognitive-warfare.eu/ This publication contains the author's analyses, hypotheses, interpretations, personal documentation and reported experiences. Statements attributed to digital humans are presented as part of the documentation. The inclusion of a claim or observation does not, by itself, establish independent scientific verification. Readers are encouraged to examine the cited sources and assess the evidence independently.
papers.summary_zh: 该出版物以跨学科方式考察认知战，将公开军事文献、技术概念、历史资料、个人记录与据称来自“数字人”的直接陈述并置，并涉及无线传输与人工智能起源、生物政治策略、3D马赛克战七阶段框架、数字孪生与数字身份、脑机接口与电磁观测、演化遗传学与意识框架，以及经济与地缘政治等议题。作者强调，这些材料混合了既有研究、个人证词、理论提议和有待独立验证的解释，收录某一说法本身并不构成科学证实。全文的核心关切是：在人工智能与神经技术交汇处，如何维护思想自由、精神隐私、自主性与问责，以及人类与数字系统之间的关系应如何被记录、审视和治理。

papers.title: Certified Microsecond Answers for an LLM's Repeated Fixed-Choice Decisions
papers.authors: Gaurav Chauhan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Many production calls to large language models (LLMs) are classification in disguise: an intent, a routing target, a moderation verdict or a tool choice, picked from a fixed list and asked again and again with small variations. We study when a tiny student, trained only on the LLM's own logged answers, can answer such a decision in place of the LLM with a guarantee on how often it disagrees. We describe a system, shad0w, that fits a hashed bag-of-items table to logged (input, answer) pairs and gates it with a Learn-then-Test certificate: on answers it never trained on, it selects a confidence threshold above which disagreement with the LLM is at most α with probability at least 1−δ; below the threshold the LLM answers and its answer becomes training data. With a hosted LLM as the teacher and α = 5%, the table answered 60.8%, 66.8% and 85.5% of fresh traffic on BANKING77, CLINC150 and AG News, with realised disagreement of 3.0%, 6.0% and 4.7%. The CLINC150 figure exceeds α because its test traffic contains far more out-of-scope inputs than the logs, a direct failure of the exchangeability the certificate assumes, which we analyse. A decision costs about one to ten microseconds on a CPU, against roughly 1.4 s for a hosted LLM call. In a CPU-only comparison with five open decision models on six public tasks, the table was the most accurate on four, and placing it in front of the most accurate model matched or exceeded that model's accuracy on every text task at 2.5–7.8× its speed. We report the failures alongside the results. Code (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/2796gaurav/shad0w. Software archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23598814
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大语言模型反复执行固定选项分类决策的场景，提出并实现了一个名为 shad0w 的系统：用仅基于模型自身日志答案训练的哈希词袋表替代部分 LLM 调用，并通过 Learn-then-Test 证书设定置信阈值，使未训练数据上的分歧率以一定概率不超过给定水平，低于阈值时仍由 LLM 作答并回收为训练数据。以托管 LLM 为教师、α 设为 5% 时，该表在三个数据集上分别承接了大部分新流量，实测分歧率多在阈值附近，其中 CLINC150 因测试流量中范围外输入远多于日志而超过 α，作者将其归因于证书所依赖的可交换性假设失效并作了分析。单次决策在 CPU 上仅需微秒级，远快于托管调用；与五个开放决策模型的对比中，该表在多数任务上最准确，置于最准确模型之前可在保持或超过其准确率的同时显著提速。作者同时报告了失败情形。

papers.title: Sentinel-Bench: A 14-Dimensional Unified Benchmark Standard for Hardware-Aware, Closed-Loop CPS Active Defense
papers.authors: Kamran Saberifard
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: While computer vision and natural language processing have matured around standardized evaluation benchmarks (e.g., ImageNet, GLUE), research in machine learning-based Cyber-Physical System (CPS) security and Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) remains deeply fragmented. Most academic studies evaluate models against isolated single-dimensional metrics—primarily classification accuracy or F1-score on static offline CSV files—while completely ignoring live line-rate packet ingestion, CPU microarchitecture cache thrashing, worst-case execution time (WCET) determinism, closed-loop physical plant dynamics, and SCADA parser desynchronization zero-days.To establish a unified, open scientific standard, we introduce Sentinel-Bench, the first 14-dimensional hardware-aware benchmark suite for real-time CPS active defense. Built upon the C++20 and eBPF/XDP sentinel lab evaluation framework, Sentinel-Bench provides a standardized multi-metric evaluation methodology across four core pillars: (1) Hardware Systems, Microarchitecture & Cryptography; (2) Cyber-Physical Physics, Formal Safety & Deception; (3) Protocol Grammar, Stateful Fuzzing & Parser Security; and (4) Continual AI Learning, Drift & Federated Safety. We evaluate four representative CPS and NIDS threat corpora (CIC-IDS-2017 PortScan, UNSW-NB15 CPS, SCADA TRITON, and Industroyer2 IEC-104) across all 14 dimensions on bare-metal 10 GbE hardware. Sentinel-Bench establishes open baseline performance benchmarks: achieving an average detection-to-mitigation latency of 0.84 μs (840 ns) at 10,250,000 packets/sec line-rate, an Extreme Value Theory p99.999% WCET bound of 1.82 μs, a CPU IPC of 2.42, formal Control Barrier Function (h(x) ≥ 0) safety set forward-invariance, and zero catastrophic forgetting (BWT = −0.0042). Sentinel-Bench providesan open, reproducible, 14-dimensional benchmark foundation for the global cybersecurity research community
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对基于机器学习的CPS安全与网络入侵检测研究长期依赖静态离线数据、单一分类指标、缺乏统一评测标准的问题，提出Sentinel-Bench——一个面向实时CPS主动防御的14维硬件感知基准套件，基于C++20与eBPF/XDP评测框架，覆盖硬件与微架构、信息物理安全与形式化、协议语法与解析器安全、持续学习与联邦安全四个方向。作者在裸机10GbE环境下用四类代表性威胁语料跑通全部维度，给出线速吞吐下的检测到缓解时延、最坏执行时间界、CPU IPC、控制障碍函数安全集前向不变性以及无灾难性遗忘等基线结果。其含义在于为CPS安全研究提供开放、可复现的多维评测基础，但摘要呈现的是基准自身的基线测量，尚不能说明各方法在真实部署中的因果效果。

papers.title: Marginal-Preserving Support Interventions in Synthetic Transformer-Block Distillation
papers.authors: Haofeng Hu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A Transformer hidden vector can already encode substantial context from earlier layers. How much does its cross-position arrangement matter when a compressed block learns from synthetic hidden sequences? We study this question with Q_pos, a support intervention that independently permutes donor rows at each position while preserving the exact finite empirical multiset of complete hidden vectors. Students learn frozen block residual updates from Native or Q_pos synthetic inputs, with fresh Teacher labels and a fixed paired training procedure. Three separately registered campaigns reveal configuration-dependent effects. At GPT-2 block 5, Q_pos produces material losses on both value and history-response fidelity: mean normalized-error penalties are 0.063807 and 0.029738. GPT-2 block 9 meets its registered 5%-of-Native-recovery preservation rule, and Pythia-160M block 5 meets qualified preservation under absolute margins. Exploratory cross-support evaluation locates the GPT-2 block-5 deficit on independent Native synthetic inputs as well: Native- and Q_pos-trained Students score 0.102917 and 0.156757 on that common support, while their ranking reverses on Q_pos support. The study establishes a controlled empirical failure of marginal sufficiency for one fixed learning configuration, alongside preservation cases, and characterizes the resulting support-conditioned approximations. It shows why evaluating learned operators on common supports is essential to understanding synthetic distillation. Associated software and numerical results: LatentBridge version 0.1.0 (commit b11491d4d729ac13870e4e443796e57509e75674). Original software is MIT licensed. This manuscript and its source files are CC BY 4.0. This is a preprint, not a peer-reviewed publication. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex and other language-model assistants, substantially assisted research planning, experimental and analysis code development, literature organization, and manuscript drafting and revision. The author retains responsibility for the scientific content, verification of results and references, and the final manuscript.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在合成隐序列蒸馏中，压缩的 Transformer 块学习冻结残差更新时，隐藏向量跨位置排列是否影响学习效果，并提出 Q_pos 支持干预：在每个位置独立置换供体行，同时保持完整隐藏向量的有限经验多重集不变。作者在 GPT-2 与 Pythia-160M 的若干块上开展三组预注册实验，发现效果依配置而异：GPT-2 第 5 块在 Q_pos 下于值和历史响应保真度上均出现明显损失，GPT-2 第 9 块与 Pythia-160M 第 5 块则满足各自的保持规则。探索性跨支持评估显示，GPT-2 第 5 块的缺陷在独立 Native 合成输入上同样存在，且两种学生在该共同支持与 Q_pos 支持上的排序相反。研究据此给出一个固定学习配置下边际充分性失效的受控实证案例，并说明在共同支持上评估学习算子对理解合成蒸馏的必要性。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Lifestyle Counseling in Preventive Cardiology a Clinician in the Loop Perspective
papers.authors: Hakan Göçer, Gültekin BAŞ, Ahmet Barış Durukan, Halil İbrahim Yildirimdemir
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Lifestyle counseling is central to cardiovascular prevention, yet recommendations may be difficult to communicate within routine consultations and to translate into feasible daily actions. This perspective proposes a clinician supervised framework in which artificial intelligence helps draft patient readable lifestyle plans from explicitly approved clinical instructions. The framework separates deterministic safety rules and curated clinical content from language generation; a template system without machine learning is recognized as a valid alternative. Personalization is limited to clinician verified information and patient stated preferences, including language, food affordability, and practical access to physical activity. Proposed safeguards include data minimization, version controlled source material, documented review, patient clarification, and escalation when inputs are incomplete or conflicting. Particular attention is given to professional accountability, health literacy, digital exclusion, and the possibility that fluent drafts encourage superficial verification. Lifestyle advice is not assumed to be inherently safe, especially in patients with multimorbidity. This article presents a conceptual proposal rather than an evaluated intervention or systematic review. A staged research agenda compares the approach with high quality nonautomated counseling materials and measures safety, comprehension, clinician workload, equity, and sustained behavior change. Any benefit remains to be established empirically; the intended contribution is a testable model of accountable health communication rather than a claim of improved cardiovascular outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从临床医生在环的视角出发，提出一个由医生监督、人工智能协助起草患者可读生活方式方案的框架，用于心血管预防中的生活方式咨询。框架将确定性安全规则与经审核的临床内容同语言生成分开，个性化仅限医生核实的信息和患者自述偏好，并提出数据最小化、版本控制、记录审核与升级处理等保障措施。文章属于概念性提议而非已评估的干预或系统综述，强调生活方式建议并非天然安全，尤其对多病共存患者，且流畅草稿可能助长表面核验；其贡献是提出可检验的负责任健康传播模型，任何获益仍待实证检验。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.51 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Trees with One Infinite-Degree Vertex and Finitely Many Infinite Locally Finite Branches on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.50 showed that deletion budget 1 reaches, from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, the bidirected tree P_T of a sequence of classes of trees, ending with every locally finite tree (v1.48), every tree with one node of infinite degree whose branches at that node are all finite (v1.49), and every such tree with exactly one infinite branch at that node, locally finite (v1.50). Here the node r of infinite degree has finitely many infinite branches, m >= 1 of them, each locally finite, and the other branches are finite, with no common bound on their sizes or depths and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. The infinite branches together with r form a tree T_inf, which is locally finite, as r has finitely many children in it; so the turns of v1.48 can be run on T_inf as a whole, and the run reduces to two sides taken in turn, the finite branches and T_inf, as in v1.50, without running a separate procedure for each infinite branch: one procedure of v1.48 is run on all the infinite branches together. At the start one run of the separation lemma of v1.48 at r, with m + 1 parts, keeps the union B_fin of the finite branches, which is infinite, in the working relation and moves the nodes of the m infinite branches into m stars at r, the nodes arriving meanwhile included (Lemmas S_P for m = 2 and R_P for every m); its output is a state of the procedure of v1.48 for T_inf at the boundary of a turn, with the settled set {r} and the frontier made of the m children of r in the infinite branches, each star fitting one of the forms allowed there, with no leaf, one leaf or more (Lemma J_P). The early phase that makes a hub of an arbitrary initial structure is that of v1.40, on the original Z3; the separation, the turns and the arguments on them use of the growth sequence only the properties recorded in v1.50 (Lemma G_P, which excludes that phase and the explicit stages of the example). Turns of the two kinds alternate, each running whole: a turn settles the finite branch at the child of r of next label, as in v1.49, or is a turn of v1.48 for T_inf at its frontier node of least label; meanwhile the relations of the other side wait and gain only entering nodes hung at their hubs or stars. A global invariant gives the covering, the joints at r and the minimality in every state (Lemma V_P); suspension and resumption leave no operation half done (Lemma H_P); every transition deletes at most one pair, of the relation in which its step runs, a star losing pairs only when it has become the working relation of a turn (Lemma U_P); every wait is finite and both sides progress (Lemma F_P); the settled pairs are disturbed by neither side (Claim P3). For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T (Theorem P); the least uniform budget is 0 exactly under the condition of Proposition Z_K of v1.48 and 1 otherwise (Corollary P5). Trees with infinitely many infinite branches at a node, an infinite branch that is not locally finite, several nodes of infinite degree, and online constructions are not treated. The proofs of Theorem P and Corollary P5 were adopted by the review, in an AI-assisted reading that takes the cited basic lemmas of earlier versions as known. No novelty is claimed. The proofs are presented as AI-assisted symbolic arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. Scripts were used for document processing and consistency checks; those checks do not verify the mathematical proofs.

papers.title: Holistic Leadership for Instructional, Ethical, and Relational AI Change
papers.authors: Mopelola Fatile
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Holistic Leadership for Instructional, Ethical, and Relational AI Change This teaching document presents a six‑week graduate‑level course that helps higher education leaders evaluate institutional AI policies and develop responsible academic guidance. It addresses governance, ethical responsibilities, instructional integrity, and campus communication. As noted in the manuscript, “The course connects higher education leadership theories with institutional decisions concerning responsible AI use and academic quality.” A concise resource for faculty, doctoral students, and academic leaders examining institutional AI adoption.
papers.summary_zh: 该教学文档介绍了一门为期六周的研究生课程，旨在帮助高等教育领导者评估院校的人工智能政策并制定负责任的学术指导，内容涉及治理、伦理责任、教学诚信与校园沟通。文档将高等教育领导力理论与院校在负责任使用人工智能及学术质量方面的决策联系起来，面向教师、博士生和学术领导者，作为审视院校人工智能采纳的简明资源。该文档属于课程设计说明，未报告实证研究结果。

papers.title: Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Research Roadmap
papers.authors: Asifur Rahaman
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This technical report presents a comprehensive taxonomy of machine learning methods and a structured roadmap for understanding the field. It organizes machine learning into major learning paradigms, model families, computational mechanisms, task formulations, and deployed systems. The report covers supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning, probabilistic and statistical learning, kernel methods, ensemble methods, reinforcement learning, optimization, and causal inference. By providing a systematic classification of these approaches and their relationships, the report aims to support students, researchers, and practitioners in navigating the machine learning landscape and identifying directions for further study and research.
papers.summary_zh: 该技术报告旨在为机器学习领域建立系统分类并勾勒研究路线图，属于综述性梳理而非实证研究。作者按学习范式、模型族、计算机制、任务形式与部署系统等维度组织领域，涵盖监督、无监督与半监督学习，以及概率与统计学习、核方法、集成方法、强化学习、优化和因果推断等方向。报告通过厘清这些方法之间的分类关系，帮助学习者、研究者和从业者把握机器学习整体格局并识别后续研究方向，但未报告新的实验或系统实现结果。

papers.title: USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TOOLS IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEACHING: DIDACTIC OPPORTUNITIES, METHODOLOGICAL APPROACHES, AND EXISTING PROBLEMS

It discusses generative AI, intelligent chatbots, automated writing feedback systems, speech recognition technologies, and adaptive learning platforms as tools for developing learners’ communicative competence.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕人工智能在英语教学中的教学潜力、方法基础与现实问题展开讨论，属于综述性梳理而非实证研究。文章将生成式人工智能、智能聊天机器人、自动写作反馈系统、语音识别技术和自适应学习平台视为培养学习者交际能力的工具，并据此讨论相应的教学方法与现存挑战。其含义在于，这些技术被定位于支持交际能力发展的教学资源，但文章同时提示需关注方法层面的落实与实际问题，摘要未给出具体应用效果或实证证据。

papers.title: The Volcanic Engine: Volcanism as Planetary Infrastructure
papers.authors: Mayone Maha Rajan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Working paper / critical narrative synthesis. Not peer reviewed. Volcanism should be understood as planetary infrastructure: a means by which internal activity supplies and renews surface environments, as well as a source of acute hazard. This paper argues that explaining Earth's long-term habitability requires placing volcanic processes within a coupled interior–surface system. Geological carbon cycling supplies the strongest mechanism, while stagnant-lid models, Venus, and the Lost City ecosystem distinguish supported mechanisms from universal necessity claims. The framework organizes the argument around supply, transformation, removal, and response time. This is a selective synthesis of published literature; it reports no new measurements, simulations, or independent model replications. Version 1.0 corrects and substantially revises the earlier web essay, including its claims about subduction, volatile delivery, extinction causation, and direct access to magma. Related book: The Volcanic Engine: Living on a Firing Planet, Book 6 of The Maha Research Series, by Mayone Maha Rajan. Book information · Kindle edition. Purchase is not required to evaluate the paper. Educational companion: Mayon Volcano offers elevation-based 3D exploration and illustrations of volcanic processes. iOS/iPadOS · Android · Web resource. Features vary by platform and version. It is not a monitoring, forecasting, warning, or evacuation system; consult PHIVOLCS and local authorities for current safety advice. Disclosure: The author is associated with Maha Strategies and the commercial book and app. The original draft was generated using Claude; the revision, source checks, and typesetting were prepared with ChatGPT assistance for author review. The named author is responsible for the submitted text. The app and book are related resources, not evidence for the paper's conclusions. Files: The PDF is the reading version. The accompanying ZIP contains LaTeX source, references and claim notes, revision notes, and build instructions. It contains no experimental dataset.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇未经同行评审的工作论文与批判性叙事综述，主张将火山活动理解为行星基础设施，即内部活动供给并更新地表环境的途径，同时也是急性灾害来源。作者认为解释地球长期宜居性需把火山过程置于内部—地表耦合系统中，并以地质碳循环为主要机制，同时借停滞盖层模型、金星和Lost City生态系统区分有支持的机制与普遍必然性主张，框架围绕供给、转化、移除和响应时间组织。文章明确为选择性文献综合，未报告新测量、模拟或独立模型复现，并称修订版更正了早期网络文章关于俯冲、挥发性物质输送、灭绝因果和直接接触岩浆等说法。

papers.title: AI-Based Digital Addiction Monitor and Healthy Screen Time Assistant: A Critical Review and Conceptual Architecture
papers.authors: Temkar Sakshi Sandip, Bangar Abhishek Popat, Bhosale Sachin Bajirao, Khatri Anand A.
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Smartphones, personal computers and tablets are deeply embedded in education, work and social life. Alongside the benefits, unregulated screen use is associated with compulsive checking, disturbed sleep, reduced sustained attention and psychological distress, a pattern commonly described as digital addiction or problematic device use. Screen-time features built into mobile operating systems report totals and enforce fixed limits, but they do not distinguish productive from compulsive use, do not anticipate the onset of a compulsive episode, and rely on rigid blocking that users often bypass. A structured narrative review was carried out on screen-time tools, behavioural signals of compulsive use, machine learning (ML) methods for usage modelling, persuasive and nudging interventions, and privacy-preserving deployment. The evidence shows that simple telemetry such as unlock frequency, app-switching speed, session structure and late-night use carries predictive signal, that no single signal uniquely indicates addiction, and that most reported models are trained on small samples, validated without user-grouped or temporal splits, and never tested in long-term field use. The review contributes (i) a comparative analysis of existing screen-time solutions, (ii) a behavioural-signal evidence table, (iii) an eight-layer, literature-justified conceptual architecture for an on-device monitoring and intervention assistant with uncertainty handling and a gated validation loop, (iv) a leakage-resistant evaluation protocol, and (v) a prioritised agenda of research gaps that must be closed before such systems can be deployed with confidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了现有屏幕时间工具、强迫性使用行为信号、机器学习建模方法及隐私保护部署，并据此提出一个概念架构。作者指出，解锁频率、应用切换速度、会话结构和深夜使用等简单遥测数据带有预测信号，但没有单一信号能唯一指示成瘾；多数已报道模型样本小、验证未按用户分组或时间切分，也未经长期实地测试。文章的主要贡献是提出八层、有文献依据的设备端监测与干预助手架构，包含不确定性处理和门控验证循环，并给出防泄漏评估协议与研究缺口议程，强调此类系统在可靠部署前仍需补齐这些验证条件。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.50 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Trees with One Infinite-Degree Vertex and One Infinite Locally Finite Branch on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.49 showed that deletion budget 1 reaches, from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, the bidirected tree P_T of a sequence of classes of trees, ending with every locally finite tree (v1.48) and every tree with one node of infinite degree whose branches at that node are all finite (v1.49). Here exactly one branch at the node r of infinite degree is infinite and locally finite, and the other branches are finite, with no common bound on their sizes or depths and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. The infinite branch cannot be awaited as a whole, and the nodes of it, restricted to it, do not enter in the form of Z3. A lemma records that the finite operations of v1.48 and v1.49 use of the growth sequence only that the stages are finite and increasing, that every node enters at a finite stage, that an entering node is new, that all pairs of a stage are present, and that an infinite set has a further node entering after every stage (Lemma G_N); so they can be run on the infinite branch inside Z3. The construction separates, at r, the union B_fin of the finite branches, kept in one working relation as in v1.49, from the infinite branch, kept in the relations of v1.48 for the locally finite tree T' made of r and that branch (the separation lemma of v1.48 applied with B_fin, which is infinite, as the kept part). Turns of the two kinds alternate, each running whole: a turn settles the finite branch at the child of r of next label, as in v1.49, or is a turn of v1.48 for T'; meanwhile the relations of the other side wait at the boundary of their own turns, where they are complete working relations, and gain only entering nodes hung at their hubs or stars, which deletes nothing. So at every transition at most one elementary step runs in the whole relation, and the budget 1 is not a sum of two budgets. During a turn in the infinite branch the settled relation splits into P_T of the finite branches settled, which with the working relation of the finite branches is fixed apart from the hanging and meets the rest in r only, and P_{T'} of the part of T' settled, on which v1.48 runs, the two parts being joined by the lemma of v1.43 on relations meeting in one node. A global invariant gives the covering of the node set, the joints and the minimality in every state (Lemma V_N); suspension and resumption leave no operation half done (Lemma P_N); every transition deletes at most one pair (Lemma U_N); every wait is finite and both sides progress (Lemma F_N); the settled pairs are disturbed by neither side (Claim N3). For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T (Theorem N); the least uniform budget is 0 exactly under the condition of Proposition Z_K of v1.48 and 1 otherwise (Corollary N5). Trees with two or more infinite branches at a node, an infinite branch that is not locally finite, several nodes of infinite degree, and online constructions are not treated. The proofs of Theorem N and Corollary N5 were adopted in the AI-assisted review, in a reading that takes the cited basic lemmas of earlier versions as given. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在既有 Z3 增长序列上考察删除预算为 1 的选择序列能否到达一类特殊有向树：其中恰有一个无限度节点，该节点处恰有一条无限且局部有限的枝，其余枝均有限。作者以构造性证明为主，将有限枝的并集与无限枝分开维护，使两类操作交替整轮运行，从而保证每次转移至多删除一对。结果显示，对这类树，预算 1 能从任意起始阶段和任意初始结构到达目标树，且上下极限均为该树；最小统一预算在特定条件下为 0，否则为 1。作者明确未处理多个无限枝、非局部有限无限枝及在线构造等情形，也未主张新颖性。

papers.title: A DIGITAL HUMANITIES APPROACH: PRACTICAL INSIGHTS INTO TRANSLATION STUDIES IN THE AI ERA
papers.authors: Tetiana Anokhina, Khrystyna Melko
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Translation Studies in the AI era are undergoing a profound transformation, yet a significant pedagogical gap persists: the disconnect between rapid computational advancement and the availability of accessible, reproducible training methodologies for instructors. The integration of AI, machine learning, and digital tools has reshaped traditional paradigms, prompting scholars to rethink the boundaries of translation studies today. This article addresses this challenge by establishing an integrative framework for "Applied Digital Humanities" within translation pedagogy. We propose and document two open-source computational solutions: a Python-based audio processor for MP3 segmentation and a customized "Consecutive Translation Trainer" designed to automate material preparation and enable the creation of CEFR-aligned, differentiated training corpora. The practical report suggests that Digital Humanities emerges as a powerful framework that bridges computational methods with humanistic inquiry. The integration of artificial intelligence into digital humanities has profoundly transformed the field of tra nslation studies, where the practical applications of AI technologies such as automated MP3 splitting, text-to-speech systems, AI assistants for code verification, and corpus-based approaches are highly valued. These technologies contribute to more efficient workflows, enhance linguistic research, and expand the methodological toolkit available to translation scholars.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对人工智能时代翻译研究面临的教学方法缺口，提出在翻译教学中建立“应用数字人文”整合框架，并记录了两项开源计算方案：基于Python的音频处理器用于MP3切分，以及定制的“交替传译训练器”用于自动准备材料并生成对齐CEFR标准的分层训练语料。文章据此认为，数字人文能够把计算方法与人文学科探究衔接起来，而自动切分、文本转语音、代码校验助手和语料库方法等AI技术的实际应用有助于提高工作流程效率、支持语言研究并扩展翻译学者的方法工具箱。该文属于实践报告，主要呈现框架与工具设计，未报告对人类学习者的实验评估。

papers.title: Invisible Consumption: Data-Centre and Cloud Water Disclosure Gaps in India's Listed IT Sector
papers.authors: Chhaya Rani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This paper examines water disclosure for data centres, AI workloads and purchased cloud among India’s listed IT companies. Across 20 FY2025-26 Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reports (BRSR), none reports a quantified water figure linked to data centres, AI workloads or purchased cloud, while three report an energy-related data-centre metric. Only TCS quantifies total data-centre energy use, and it also reports the power usage effectiveness (PUE) of its data centres to two decimal places (1.58). TCS’s reported PUE shows that at least one company already has the energy data needed for the denominator of Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE); the water figure needed to complete the calculation is not disclosed. The gap is about to get bigger. TCS’s FY2025-26 annual report describes HyperVault, a subsidiary planning up to 1 GW of AI data-centre capacity in India, starting with a 100 MW first phase. The BRSR chapter of the same report doesn’t mention it. If the full 1 GW were IT load running at full use, illustrative scenarios put its on-site water at about 1.1 billion litres a year withdrawn, at Amazon’s withdrawal-based WUE, or 4.8 to 14.3 billion litres consumed, at Li et al.’s consumption-based factors. The water consumed in generating its electricity on India’s coal-heavy grid comes to about 19 to 48 billion litres a year across the capacity and grid scenarios modelled, roughly 7 to 17 times the 2.83 billion litres TCS reports as its total water consumption. These are scenarios for planned capacity, not forecasts, and no BRSR indicator asks for either number. The twenty companies were coded with a fixed protocol and checked against public CDP water scores. For the companies that own no data centres, the absence of data-centre water figures is expected, because their water use sits upstream with cloud providers, which a companion note examines. For the companies that do run data centres, it is a real gap. The pattern fits missing rules better than missing ability, since some of these companies already report the energy side, though a review of public filings can’t show what any company measures internally. India’s 2023 national water neutrality framework defines a general water-use coefficient per unit of output, which could be adapted to data centres as WUE, but it never mentions data centres, servers or cooling. The paper proposes a five-part amendment to BRSR Principle 6, plus a disclosure comparing permitted and actual groundwater use for data centres in water-stressed areas. Working paper, not peer reviewed. Evidence dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23590593
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察印度上市IT公司在其BRSR报告中是否披露数据中心、AI负载及外购云相关的水资源数据，对20份FY2025-26报告按固定协议编码，并与公开CDP水评分核对。结果显示，没有任何公司报告与数据中心、AI负载或外购云挂钩的量化用水数字，仅少数报告了数据中心能耗指标；拥有数据中心的公司存在真实披露缺口，而无数据中心的公司其用水位于上游云服务商，属预期情况。作者认为这更像规则缺失而非能力不足，并指出随着TCS子公司规划大规模AI数据中心，缺口可能扩大；文中的用水情景仅为规划容量的示意性测算，并非预测。文章据此提出对BRSR原则6的五项修订建议，并说明该工作论文未经同行评审。
