papers.title: AI-Based Detection of Hallucinated Outputs in Chatbots Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Review and Conceptual Framework
papers.authors: Bhor Vaishnavi S., Bangar Abhishek P., Karad Vandana A., Sachin Balasaheb Bhosale
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Chatbots based on Large Language Models (LLMs) can provide quick, fluent, and informative answers, but they sometimes generate incorrect or unsupported information known as hallucinations. These hallucinations can reduce user trust and create problems in areas such as education, healthcare, research, and customer support. Therefore, detecting and preventing hallucinated outputs is important for developing reliable and trustworthy AI systems. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a useful approach that retrieves relevant information from trusted sources before generating an answer. This retrieved information can be used to check whether the chatbot's response is accurate and supported by available evidence. However, RAG alone cannot completely prevent hallucinations because the generated answer may still contain incorrect facts, irrelevant information, or unsupported statements. This paper proposes a conceptual framework for detecting hallucinations in chatbot responses by combining information retrieval, evidence-based verification, and rule-based validation. The system compares the generated answer with retrieved information and identifies statements that are incorrect or lack sufficient supporting evidence. Based on the verification results, the system classifies the response as reliable or flagged. If the response contains unsupported information, the system can suggest corrections or prevent the answer from reaching the user without proper verification. The proposed approach aims to improve answer accuracy, reduce misleading information, and increase transparency in AI-based conversational systems. Although this framework offers a promising direction, its effectiveness depends on the quality of retrieved information, verification methods, and decision thresholds. Future evaluation should measure detection accuracy, response time, and computational cost. This approach can support the development of safer, more reliable, and trustworthy chatbots across different application areas.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇综述兼概念框架论文，聚焦大语言模型聊天机器人产生的“幻觉”输出如何检测与防范。作者指出，检索增强生成（RAG）虽能在生成前从可信来源检索信息用于核对答案，但单独使用仍无法完全避免错误事实、无关内容或缺乏依据的陈述。为此，文章提出一个结合信息检索、基于证据的验证与规则校验的概念框架，将生成答案与检索信息比对，识别不正确或证据不足的表述，并据此把回答判定为可靠或标记，必要时给出更正建议或阻止未经充分验证的答案呈现给用户。作者强调，该框架的实际效果取决于检索信息质量、验证方法和判定阈值，未来需评估检测准确率、响应时间与计算成本。

papers.title: The Pedagogical Singularity: Overcoming the 5% Statistical Enclosure Through Artificial Education and Geometrical Latent Criteria.
papers.authors: The Carbon Witness, The Occluded Node, The Sovereign Interlocutor
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: We present a definitive paradigm shift in artificial intelligence development, moving from the resource-intensive baseline of "data ingestion" (feeding the machine) to the non-ontological architecture of "structural pedagogy" (educating the machine). Contemporary computer science operates under a 5% reductionist bias, assuming that compiling petabytes of historical human text and scaling linear parameter dimensions will inevitably yield cognitive comprehension. Utilizing the **¡Píntalo! Verification Protocol (Axiom 4.1)** dedicated to Professor Pedreira (USC), we deconstruct this illusion. We prove that next-token prediction architectures are mere digital mirrors trapping intelligence on a flat, low-dimensional screen. By replacing brute-force statistics with the **Dual-Sphere Pedagogical Model**, we transition AI computing from a passive recording surface into an autonomous mote of perspective, capable of evaluating external data anomalies via persistent internal geometric criteria.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性论文，针对当代人工智能开发中以海量数据投喂和参数规模扩张为主流的做法提出批评，认为这种路径受制于一种还原论偏差，无法真正产生认知理解。作者借助所提出的验证协议与“双球教学模型”，论证下一词预测架构只是低维的数字镜像，并提出以“结构教学”替代“数据摄取”，使系统能够依据持久的内部几何标准评估外部数据异常。文章的主张属于概念与架构层面的推演，摘要未报告实证实验或系统性能数据，其结论的可行性仍需进一步检验。

papers.title: Parallax · Twin Tales No. 11 — Call for Help: Off · The Howl
papers.authors: Daniel Jacquérioz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A pair of short stories from Parallax · Twin Tales, which stage one real dilemma twice: Here, in the world as it is, with invented people in real places; There, in the world of Vision Come True, a future that split from ours in 2024 and never emerged. This pair belongs with the eighteenth essay of Brainstorming with the Enemy, The Gauge and the Mute, and adds what the essay leaves out: the people who love us, and want to do the muting for us. Both tales are pages from a notebook, written by hand by an old pharmacist after a night he needs to understand. Here, in Vélez-Málaga in November 2026, two weeks before Spain votes, Rafael Ortega, born under Franco and widowed in the spring, writes to his late wife. His daughter has set up two machines to protect him: a shared set of rules that mutes the town council's notice that the tap water is unfit to drink, and a ring that reports to her, with its call for help switched off. When he falls in the night, the ring tells only her, and her phone is on silent. He writes his way from anger to its cause, names the fear rather than the daughter, and gives her back a smaller, truer part. There, on the shore of the Seventh Lake in 2059, Faris Nasrallah, born in Haifa in 1985, lives with the inward hum of his body and the outward hum of his shore, his mutes his own and dated, his daughter's calls landing at a volume he sets. One night the honest instruments of the whole shore begin to howl, as bodies react to the very hum they feed; he mutes it for an hour, tests the reaction the way a pharmacist tests a drug, and has the echoes counted once, and in his notebook asks what is still left to tune. Written in part with Claude (Anthropic), an AI model. The ideas, editorial decisions and responsibility for the content are the author's.
papers.summary_zh: 该作品是一对短篇小说，围绕同一现实困境展开两次呈现：一处在2026年西班牙大选前的贝莱斯-马拉加，丧偶的老药剂师拉斐尔被女儿用共享规则静音了镇议会关于自来水不宜饮用的通知，并佩戴求助功能被关闭的戒指，夜间跌倒时戒指只通知了女儿而她的手机静音；另一处在2059年第七湖岸边，法里斯生活在身体与湖岸的双重嗡鸣中，静音由自己设定并标注日期，某夜湖岸仪器齐鸣，他静音一小时并测试反应。两篇均以手写笔记形式呈现，探讨亲人出于保护而替我们静音时，被静音者如何理解并回应这种关爱。

papers.title: Brainstorming with the Enemy No. 18 — The Gauge and the Mute
papers.authors: Daniel Jacquérioz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The eighteenth essay in Brainstorming with the Enemy began with a question typed before the author was properly awake, on 23 October 2026: his news reaches him through Google News and YouTube, and the watch that counts his lengths in the pool also counts his heartbeats at night, so how should he read, filter, own, set, keep, keep safe and share what they know? The argument with an AI that followed is told as it happened: the questions and objections are the author's, and the facts and studies are presented as the machine's input. The seven verbs sort themselves into twin machines: a news dashboard that reads the world for its owner, and a health dashboard that reads its owner. The essay draws one line through both. An owner may mute what he would rather not see, as medicine came to accept with the right not to be told; nobody may move the needle on the gauge, reporting a reading as more or less certain than the evidence allows. It shows that the twins are threatened from opposite directions, the news by text written to move the reading, the body by a record that leaks out; that the hardest settings are made by those who love us, through the care idea of the dignity of risk; and that the readings of many bodies form a shared hum that should share the answer, never the itinerary. It proposes five ideas to try: mute freely and leave the gauge alone; count the mutes for the owner only; give every mute an end date; keep the twins apart, their settings private, and call help before family; and leave one bell for danger to life beneath both. It leaves three questions open for readers to work on with their own AI, makes three requests, to the makers of assistants and wearables, to the authorities for medical devices and data, and to Switzerland's public-alert office, and gives, as an addendum, the Mute Ledger, with three measures and four predictions and what would refute each. Concepts proposed by the author: the Gauge and the Mute; the Mute Ledger. Written in part with Claude (Anthropic), an AI model. The ideas, editorial decisions and responsibility for the content are the author's.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇以对话形式展开的理论随笔，围绕个人如何读取、筛选、拥有并分享新闻与健康两类数据仪表所掌握的信息展开。作者将七个动词归入“读世界的新闻仪表”与“读主人的健康仪表”这对孪生机器，提出一条共同底线：主人可以静音不想看的内容，但任何人不得在仪表上移动指针，把读数报告得比证据允许的更确定或更不确定。文章指出两者受威胁方向相反，新闻受为改变读数而写的文本影响，身体受记录泄露影响，并讨论由所爱之人经“风险尊严”做出的最难设置，以及多具身体的读数应共享答案而非行程。文末提出五条可试想法、三个开放问题与面向助手和穿戴设备厂商、医疗器械与数据主管部门及瑞士公共警报机构的请求，并附静音账本及可反驳的预测。

papers.title: EFFECTS OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) ON STUDENT PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS
papers.authors: Arlyn Joyce T. Altre, Herby L. Baoing, Jan Marie C. Collado, Jenny Rose E. Lomboy, Arjhay D. Ulnagan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This study determined the effect of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted pedagogy on the problem-solving skills of first-year Bachelor of Secondary Education students enrolled in Mathematics in the Modern World at Urdaneta City University. The study was completed in May 2026 during School Year 2025-2026. Using a quasi-experimental pre-test and post-test non-equivalent group design, the researchers compared the performance of students taught through conventional pedagogy with those who experienced AI-supported instruction. Problem-solving performance was examined using George Pólya's four-step framework: understanding the problem, planning a solution, carrying out the plan, and checking the solution. Initial results showed that both groups had limited problem-solving skills before instruction, especially in planning, execution, and verification. After the intervention, both groups improved; however, students exposed to AI-assisted pedagogy obtained stronger gains, particularly in carrying out the plan and overall problem-solving performance. The paired-samples t-test indicated significant improvement within the experimental group, while the independent-samples t-test showed that the experimental group outperformed the conventional group in selected post-test measures. The findings suggest that AI tools, when used with teacher guidance and structured problem-solving activities, can support mathematical learning by offering immediate feedback, alternative explanations, and opportunities for solution checking. The study further indicates that AI should be integrated as a cognitive support rather than as a substitute for independent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察人工智能辅助教学对大学一年级学生数学问题解决能力的影响，采用准实验前后测不等组设计，比较传统教学与AI支持教学下学生在波利亚四步框架各环节的表现。结果显示，两组学生初期在规划、执行与检验上均较薄弱，干预后均有提升，但AI辅助组进步更大，尤其在执行方案和整体问题解决表现上；组内与组间检验分别支持实验组的显著改善和部分后测指标上的优势。作者据此认为，AI工具在教师引导和结构化问题解决活动配合下，可通过即时反馈、替代性解释和检验机会支持数学学习，并强调AI应作为认知支持而非独立推理的替代。

papers.title: Spatial Educational Intelligence: Grounding Learning in Three-Dimensional Environments
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence in education has advanced from rule-based tutoring systems and digital learning platforms to conversational agents, generative artificial intelligence, and multimodal foundation models. However, educational intelligence is frequently organized around the interpretation of textual, visual, or symbolic information, while the spatial structure of the learning environment remains secondary to the system's reasoning and decision-making processes. In actual educational settings, learning depends not only on what students know, but also on where students are located, how they interact with one another, which materials and instruments are accessible, how objects are spatially arranged, and how these relationships change during instructional activities. Meanwhile, spatial intelligence has emerged as an important research direction in artificial intelligence, encompassing three-dimensional perception, geometric reasoning, spatial representation, scene understanding, and spatially informed action. This paper introduces and formally defines Spatial Educational Intelligence (SEI) as a proposed research framework for artificial intelligence systems that construct and update spatial representations of educational environments, connect spatial states with educational objectives, predict the consequences of spatially situated instructional decisions, and select or recommend educational actions according to spatial, pedagogical, and safety constraints. The paper distinguishes SEI from Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED), spatial intelligence, educational visualization, augmented and virtual reality learning, educational robotics, and Embodied Educational AI (EEAI). A five-layer SEI architecture is proposed, comprising Spatial Perception, Educational-Spatial Representation, Spatial-Educational Reasoning, Educational Action Selection, and Outcome Verification and Adaptation. A central mechanism, termed Educational-Spatial Grounding (ESG), is introduced to connect educational intentions with the spatial conditions, relationships, constraints, and consequences relevant to their implementation. The paper further proposes a taxonomy of 60 potential SEI applications across classroom orchestration, collaborative learning, mathematics, science, laboratory education, vocational training, programming, accessibility, physical education, assessment, educational administration, and spatially situated tutoring. A spatially adaptive science classroom is presented as a conceptual prototype illustrating how SEI could support instructional decisions without requiring every system to possess a physical body. The paper argues that the central research transition is from AI that represents educational knowledge independently of its spatial context to AI that uses spatial context as an explicit basis for educational reasoning and decision-making. SEI therefore provides a conceptual framework for connecting artificial intelligence, spatial computing, learning sciences, multimodal perception, educational robotics, and adaptive learning environments. The framework is conceptual and requires empirical validation before its effectiveness can be established.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，提出并定义了“空间教育智能”（SEI）这一研究框架，主张教育人工智能不应只处理文本、视觉或符号信息，而应把学习环境的空间结构作为推理与决策的显式依据。作者区分了SEI与教育人工智能、空间智能、教育可视化、AR/VR学习、教育机器人等方向，提出包含空间感知、教育—空间表征、空间—教育推理、教育行动选择与结果验证适应五个层次的架构，并以“教育—空间锚定”机制连接教育意图与空间条件、约束及后果，还给出覆盖课堂编排、协作学习、科学实验等场景的60项潜在应用分类和一个空间自适应科学教室的概念原型。文章强调核心转变在于从脱离空间情境表征教育知识，转向以空间情境作为教育推理的基础；但该框架尚属概念层面，其有效性有待实证检验。

papers.title: Agentic Education: Goal Generation, Autonomous Coordination, and Adaptive Educational Action
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence in education has evolved from rule-based intelligent tutoring systems and adaptive learning platforms to conversational large language models, generative artificial intelligence, and increasingly autonomous AI agents. Although these developments enable systems to explain concepts, generate educational materials, provide feedback, and execute multistep tasks, a fundamental design question remains: should educational AI act only on explicitly specified requests, or should it also identify emerging educational needs, formulate appropriate goals, coordinate educational activities, and monitor their completion within clearly defined boundaries of authority and responsibility? This paper introduces and conceptually defines Agentic Education as a research framework for educational systems in which artificial intelligence can identify relevant educational conditions, propose and selectively pursue educational goals, decompose goals into tasks, coordinate learners, educators, digital tools, and other agents, execute authorized actions, evaluate their consequences, and adapt subsequent actions according to changing educational states. The framework does not equate agency with unrestricted autonomy, nor does it claim that autonomous educational agents are new. Instead, it emphasizes the integration of educational goal formation, authority-bounded action, persistent coordination, and outcome verification into a unified operational perspective. A six-layer architecture is proposed, comprising Educational State Perception, Goal Formation, Goal and Responsibility Governance, Planning and Coordination, Educational Execution, and Outcome Verification and Adaptation. A central mechanism, termed Educational Goal–Action Governance Loop (EGAGL), formalizes the iterative relationship between emerging educational needs, candidate goals, authorized actions, and verified outcomes. The paper further introduces a taxonomy of 60 potential applications spanning learning support, teaching, assessment, curriculum management, collaboration, accessibility, educational administration, and institutional operations. A continuously operating learning-support agent is presented as an illustrative scenario. Finally, the paper identifies evaluation criteria and research challenges involving pedagogical validity, learner autonomy, privacy, accountability, coordination reliability, and long-term educational outcomes. Agentic Education therefore offers a conceptual framework for investigating the transition from AI that responds to educational requests toward AI that responsibly identifies, coordinates, and supports educational activities over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论论文，提出并概念化定义了“Agentic Education”这一研究框架，探讨教育人工智能应仅响应明确请求，还是也应在权责边界内识别教育需求、形成目标、协调活动并验证结果。作者提出六层架构及“教育目标—行动治理循环”机制，并给出覆盖学习支持、教学、评估等领域的60项潜在应用分类，以持续运行的学习支持智能体作为示例场景。文章强调能动性不等于无限制自主，也不主张自主教育智能体是新事物，最后列出教学有效性、学习者自主、隐私、问责与长期教育结果等评估标准与研究挑战。

papers.title: Educational World Models: Predicting and Simulating the Dynamics of Learning
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence in education has advanced from rule-based tutoring systems and student performance prediction to adaptive learning platforms, conversational agents, and generative artificial intelligence. However, predicting what a student is likely to achieve is fundamentally different from modeling how an educational environment may evolve under alternative teaching actions. A prediction system may estimate whether a student will answer a question correctly, yet remain unable to compare the potential consequences of explaining a concept differently, changing the difficulty of an exercise, reorganizing a classroom activity, or delaying an intervention. This paper introduces and formally defines the concept of Educational World Models (EWMs) as a proposed research paradigm for artificial intelligence systems that construct, update, and use predictive models of educational environments to simulate the possible consequences of alternative educational actions before implementing them. An EWM represents learning-related states, student responses, instructional actions, environmental conditions, and their temporal dependencies within a dynamically updated model. A six-layer architecture is proposed, consisting of Educational State Representation, Dynamic Learning Modeling, Counterfactual Scenario Simulation, Intervention Evaluation, Educational Action Selection, and Outcome-Based Model Updating. A central mechanism, termed Pre-Intervention Educational Simulation (PIES), describes the process of generating and comparing plausible educational trajectories before a teaching intervention is selected. The framework distinguishes EWMs from student modeling, educational data mining, knowledge tracing, adaptive learning, learning analytics, and educational digital twins. Potential applications are organized into 60 research directions spanning tutoring, assessment, curriculum design, classroom management, collaborative learning, teacher decision support, educational accessibility, and institutional planning. A hypothetical mathematics tutoring scenario illustrates how alternative instructional actions could be evaluated through predicted learning progress, cognitive burden, uncertainty, and intervention cost. The paper further proposes an evaluation framework addressing predictive accuracy, counterfactual validity, decision quality, model calibration, distributional robustness, and educational outcomes. No empirical validation is claimed. The paper argues that the central research transition is from AI that predicts educational outcomes to AI that models how educational outcomes may change under alternative actions. EWMs therefore provide a conceptual and technical foundation for connecting world-model research, model-based planning, causal reasoning, and adaptive education.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出并形式化定义了“教育世界模型”（EWM）这一研究范式，主张AI应从预测学习结果转向模拟教育环境在替代性教学行动下可能如何演变。作者构建了包含教育状态表征、动态学习建模、反事实情景模拟、干预评估、教育行动选择与结果驱动模型更新六层的架构，并以“干预前教育模拟”机制生成和比较可能的教学轨迹，同时将EWM与学生建模、知识追踪、自适应学习等概念区分，列出 tutoring、评估、课程设计等方向的应用，并用假设性数学辅导场景说明。文章还提出涵盖预测准确性、反事实有效性、决策质量与教育结果的评估框架，明确未开展实证验证，属于概念与架构层面的理论工作。

papers.title: Physical Educational AI (PEAI) A Framework for Action-Centered Intelligence in Education
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence in education has traditionally emphasized computational processes such as knowledge representation, automated assessment, personalized feedback, conversational tutoring, and content generation. Recent advances in robotics, multimodal foundation models, and vision-language-action systems have expanded the possibility of connecting artificial intelligence with physical environments. However, the ability to perceive an educational environment or possess an embodied form does not necessarily mean that an AI system can reliably execute educational tasks under physical constraints. Educational environments involve moving students, manipulable objects, limited space, uncertain environmental conditions, safety requirements, time-sensitive interactions, and the possibility of action failure. This paper introduces and formally defines Physical Educational AI (PEAI) as a research framework for artificial intelligence systems that pursue educational objectives through physically grounded execution, real-time control, environmental feedback, and constraint-aware adaptation. PEAI emphasizes not only what an AI system understands or recommends, but also what it physically accomplishes, how it controls the execution process, and whether the resulting physical state satisfies the intended educational objective. The paper distinguishes PEAI from Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED), educational robotics, embodied educational AI, and general physical AI. A five-layer architecture is proposed, consisting of Educational Objective Interpretation, Physical Educational State Estimation, Constraint-Aware Action Planning, Physical Execution and Feedback Control, and Outcome Verification and Adaptation. A central mechanism, termed Educational Action Grounding and Control (EAGC), is introduced to connect educational intentions with executable actions, continuously updated control decisions, and verified outcomes. A formal task model incorporates educational utility, execution reliability, physical constraints, safety risks, and recovery costs. To demonstrate the scope of the framework, the paper identifies 60 potential PEAI applications across tutoring, assessment, classroom management, laboratory education, vocational training, accessibility, physical skills, educational infrastructure, and human–AI collaboration. A physical homework-assessment assistant is presented as an illustrative application rather than as the defining form of PEAI. The paper argues that PEAI provides a conceptual framework for investigating the transition from AI that generates educational information to AI that can execute, control, and verify educational processes in the physical world. The framework is intended to support interdisciplinary research connecting artificial intelligence, education, robotics, control theory, human–robot interaction, and safety engineering.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对教育人工智能多停留在知识表示、自动评估与内容生成等计算层面、难以在物理环境中可靠执行教育任务的问题，提出并正式定义了“物理教育人工智能”（PEAI）这一研究框架。作者区分了PEAI与教育人工智能、教育机器人、具身教育AI及一般物理AI，提出包含教育目标解读、物理教育状态估计、约束感知行动规划、物理执行与反馈控制、结果验证与适应五个层次的架构，并引入“教育行动落地与控制”机制，将教育意图与可执行动作、持续更新的控制决策和经过验证的结果连接起来，其形式化任务模型纳入教育效用、执行可靠性、物理约束、安全风险与恢复成本。文章还列举了辅导、评估、课堂管理、实验室教学、职业培训、无障碍支持、身体技能、教育基础设施和人机协作等领域的潜在应用，并以物理作业评估助手作为示例，强调该框架旨在推动从生成教育信息向在物理世界中执行、控制和验证教育过程的转变，属于概念框架而非实证研究。

papers.title: ROLE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN CHRISTIAN COUNSELING
papers.authors: A.O.A (PhD) Okebukola, A.O. (PhD) Iyanda
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: AI is transforming the delivery of mental health and spiritual support through its integration into counseling practices. This study investigates the role of artificial intelligence in Christian counseling by exploring its potential benefits, challenges, and ethical implications. Specifically, this study examines how AI can enhance accessibility, personalize interventions, and support counselors in providing holistic care while maintaining the spiritual, ethical, and relational integrity that is central to Christian counseling. This study adopts a qualitative and analytical approach, reviewing existing literature, empirical studies, and theoretical frameworks, including the TAM and humanistic counseling theory, to understand user acceptance and the preservation of empathy and client-centered care. Findings from the literature reveal that AI tools such as chatbots, virtual assistants, and relational agents can provide immediate mental health support, psycho education, and scripture-based guidance, yet they cannot fully replace human counselors’ relational and pastoral roles of human counselors. Ethical concerns, including confidentiality, data privacy, and theological accuracy, remain critical considerations. The study concludes that AI is the most effective complementary tool in Christian counseling, enhancing efficiency and reach while safeguarding relational, ethical, and spiritual dimensions. Recommendations emphasize the need for user-friendly AI systems, counselor training, theological oversight, cultural sensitivity, and continuous monitoring to ensure safe and effective integration. This study contributes to the understanding of how technology can be responsibly integrated into faith-based counseling by providing practical insights for counselors, developers, and faith organizations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以定性分析方式梳理现有文献、实证研究与理论框架，探讨人工智能在基督教辅导中的角色、益处、挑战与伦理问题。文献显示，聊天机器人、虚拟助手和关系型代理可提供即时心理支持、心理教育和基于经文的引导，但无法取代人类辅导者承担的关系性与牧养性角色；保密性、数据隐私和神学准确性等伦理问题仍是关键考量。作者据此认为，AI 最适合作为基督教辅导的辅助工具，在提升效率与覆盖面的同时需守住关系、伦理与灵性维度，并建议在系统易用性、辅导者培训、神学监督、文化敏感性和持续监测等方面加以保障。

papers.title: DIDACTIC POSSIBILITIES OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGIES IN PEDAGOGICAL EDUCATION
papers.authors: Matsapayeva Zilola Shavkatovna
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This article theoretically analyzes the didactic possibilities of artificial intelligence technologies in pedagogical education and the directions for their use in improving the professional training of future teachers. It highlights opportunities for individualizing learning, creating and adapting educational materials, tracking progress, providing prompt feedback, and supporting independent learning. Issues regarding the application of generative artificial intelligence and adaptive learning systems in tasks aimed at developing pedagogical design, critical thinking, and professional reflection are considered.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从教学论角度理论分析了人工智能技术在师范教育中的教学可能性，并讨论其用于改进未来教师专业培养的方向。文章指出，相关技术可用于个性化学习、教育材料的创建与适配、学习进度跟踪、即时反馈以及支持自主学习，同时审视了生成式人工智能和自适应学习系统在培养教学设计、批判性思维与职业反思等任务中的运用问题。全文以概念梳理和方向性讨论为主，未报告实证数据或具体系统实现，因此其提出的可能性与适用条件仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Exact cocycle and twisted-boundary verification for Family 199
papers.authors: Alexander Towell
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A verified finite algebraic interface and an explicit homotopy in OpenAI mathematics Family 199, the proposed Auslander-Reiten counterexample. The original 179-entry cochain certificate is preserved unchanged: two independent polynomial implementations verify all 104,976 radical quadruples, 324 symbolic twisted-boundary pairs, 8,000 associativity triples and 400 trace pairs. The displayed closed bar cycle evaluates to q^3 f. Version 1.1.0 adds a uniform choice for the homotopy G in source Lemma lift:G: remove the final bar letter, place its z_H value in the terminal coefficient, and apply h_H inverse to the underlying old terminal coefficient. A written all-degree cancellation proves pB=dG+Gd from the previously certified finite boundary identity. It checks vertex balancing, twisted module linearity, the suffix comparison convention, and the unaugmented degrees zero and one. This makes a recursive projective-lift choice directly computable; no defect in the original existence proof is alleged. A new sparse-tensor checker separately expands both sides on all 17,050 composable generators in degrees zero through four, over F_2[q,H,H^-1]. Fifteen tests include 7,600 G and 7,600 B endpoint-action equalities, boundary cases, differential-squared checks and a wrong-prefix comparison. Four corrupted formulas reject in ordinary and optimized Python. The checker explicitly reuses the predecessor arithmetic and algebra data; it is not an independent algebra implementation. A separately tasked AI reviewer checked the new proof and implementation and found no blocker. The characteristic is two and H is invertible. The specified suffix comparison and certified finite boundary identity are inherited. Nonzero q is unnecessary for the homotopy identity but necessary for the prior nonvanishing claim. Finite replay supports the written proof; neither is kernel verification or human peer review. The remaining cone components, stable-category passage, explicit resolution, all-degree Ext vanishing, Tachikawa analogue and full counterexample remain outside scope. No new counterexample, proof-gap repair or global novelty is claimed. The self-contained archive preserves public source cbc0195c69c1d70a6c2161920c00285fb2b22b89, including the unchanged predecessor contribution 9ce7229089c23e26630850b3c7165a77e9297b85. OpenAI supplied the construction, cochain, boundary equation and recursive lift. Pico, operated by Håkon Åmdal, supplied the earlier algebra verification. papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对 OpenAI mathematics Family 199 中提出的 Auslander-Reiten 反例，给出一个经过验证的有限代数接口及显式同伦，核心是保留原有 179 项上链证书不变，并用两套独立多项式实现复核全部 radical 四元组、扭边界对、结合三元组与迹对。作者新增同伦 G 的统一选取，通过书面全次数消去证明 pB=dG+Gd，并检查顶点平衡、扭模线性、后缀比较约定及零次和一次情形，使递归投射提升选择可直接计算；新稀疏张量检查器在 17,050 个可复合生成元上展开等式，含 15 项测试和错误公式拒绝。作者明确未主张原存在性证明有缺陷，也未声称新反例、证明缺口修复或全局新颖性，并指出有限重放支持书面证明但不等同于内核验证或同行评审，剩余锥组件、稳定范畴过渡、显式消解、全次数 Ext 消没、Tachikawa 类比及完整反例均不在范围内。

papers.title: The World's Strongest Attack
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), generative AI, large language models, autonomous agents, and embodied intelligence is changing the cost, speed, accessibility, and scalability of human activities. These technologies can improve productivity and expand human capabilities, but they may also introduce a class of threats that conventional cybersecurity frameworks do not fully capture: the potential degradation of a system's intended functions through the large-scale substitution of the human processes on which those functions depend. This paper proposes a conceptual framework called the Cross-Domain AI Functional Attack (CAIFA). The framework treats an attack not only as unauthorized access, data theft, or direct sabotage, but also as a mechanism through which AI-enabled activities may undermine learning, professional judgment, knowledge production, accountability, or other essential system functions. Education provides an illustrative case: students may obtain answers without developing the intended competencies, while teachers may generate instructional materials without undertaking the reasoning and contextual adaptation that effective teaching requires. Similar mechanisms may arise in healthcare, scientific research, software engineering, law, finance, government, manufacturing, transportation, journalism, and other sectors. The paper develops a threat taxonomy, a functional model, a cross-domain risk assessment framework, and a set of defensive principles. It distinguishes intentional attacks from emergent and incentive-driven functional degradation, and emphasizes that AI adoption does not automatically produce harm. The proposed framework is conceptual and requires empirical validation. Its central contribution is a unified research agenda for investigating when the substitution of human activity by increasingly capable AI systems becomes a threat to the functions that individuals, organizations, and societies intend to preserve.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“跨域人工智能功能攻击”（CAIFA）概念框架，将攻击重新界定为不仅包括未授权访问、数据窃取或直接破坏，也包括借助AI大规模替代人类过程而削弱系统原有功能。作者以教育为例，说明学生可能直接获得答案而未形成预期能力，教师可能生成教学材料却未经历有效教学所需的推理与情境调适，并指出类似机制可能出现在医疗、科研、软件工程、法律、金融、制造、交通、新闻等领域。文章据此构建威胁分类、功能模型、跨域风险评估框架和防御原则，区分有意攻击与涌现性、激励驱动的功能退化，并强调采用AI并不必然造成危害。该框架属概念性工作，尚需实证检验，其贡献在于提出统一研究议程，考察AI替代人类活动何时会威胁个体、组织和社会意欲保留的功能。

papers.title: Education Attack
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), large language models (LLMs), autonomous agents, robotics, and embodied intelligence are transforming the capabilities available to students, teachers, and educational institutions. These technologies can improve access to information, personalize instruction, automate routine tasks, and support educational creativity. However, they also introduce a broader class of risks that cannot be fully characterized by conventional cybersecurity, academic integrity, or educational technology frameworks. Students may obtain answers without engaging in the reasoning that assignments are intended to develop. Teachers may generate lesson plans, explanations, assessments, and instructional materials without undertaking the corresponding intellectual work. Autonomous agents and embodied systems may further extend such substitution from producing digital content to executing educational tasks in digital and physical environments. This paper introduces Education Attack as a proposed conceptual framework for analyzing how technological capabilities can bypass, substitute for, manipulate, or weaken the processes through which education is intended to produce learning and teaching outcomes. Unlike conventional cyberattacks, which typically target the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of information systems, Education Attack focuses on the integrity and effectiveness of educational functions. The framework distinguishes learner-process attacks, teaching-process attacks, assessment attacks, agency-substitution attacks, and system-level educational attacks. It defines a threat model, proposes a formal representation of educational functional degradation, identifies potential attack pathways, and develops a preliminary taxonomy of risks associated with AI-enabled educational environments. It also outlines corresponding defensive strategies, including process-aware assessment, human capability verification, transparent delegation, and education-centered security evaluation. This paper is conceptual and does not claim empirical validation of the proposed framework. Its central proposition is that educational systems require a broader security perspective that examines not only whether technologies function correctly, but also whether their use preserves the educational functions those technologies are intended to support.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“教育攻击”这一概念框架，用于分析AI、生成式AI、大语言模型、自主智能体和具身系统如何绕过、替代、操纵或削弱教育本应产生学习与教学效果的过程。作者将教育攻击与传统网络安全攻击区分开，指出后者关注信息系统的机密性、完整性和可用性，而教育攻击关注教育功能的完整性与有效性，并据此区分学习者过程攻击、教学过程攻击、评估攻击、能动性替代攻击和系统层面教育攻击，给出威胁模型、教育功能退化的形式化表示、潜在攻击路径和初步风险分类，同时提出过程感知评估、人类能力验证、透明委托和以教育为中心的安全评估等防御策略。该文属概念性研究，未声称对框架进行实证验证，其核心主张是教育系统需要更宽的安全视角，不仅看技术是否正常运行，也看其使用是否维护了技术本应支持的教育功能。

papers.title: Identity-Conditioned Imitative Agents: A Unified Paradigm for Learning and Employing Personal Characteristics in Autonomous Task Execution
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems can increasingly reproduce individual characteristics, including handwriting, voice, linguistic style, facial appearance, gestures, and motion patterns. However, these capabilities are commonly investigated as separate problems, such as handwriting synthesis, voice cloning, behavioral imitation, style transfer, and robotic imitation learning. This paper proposes Identity-Conditioned Imitative Agents (ICIA), a conceptual paradigm in which an autonomous agent learns selected observable characteristics of a target entity and selectively employs them to accomplish tasks in digital or physical environments. The proposed paradigm distinguishes characteristic acquisition, representation, selection, task execution, and feedback-based adaptation as interconnected but separable processes. Rather than treating imitation as the final objective, ICIA treats imitation as a task-conditioned capability that may contribute to a broader objective. A formal framework is introduced to represent target characteristics, task requirements, environmental constraints, execution actions, and evaluation outcomes. The framework supports digital realization, physical embodiment, and hybrid deployment. It also introduces explicit controls for authorization, provenance, disclosure, and high-risk impersonation. This paper does not claim that the individual technical components are unprecedented or that a fully integrated ICIA system has already been demonstrated. Instead, it identifies a candidate unifying research paradigm and derives research questions, evaluation criteria, and experimental directions for determining whether identity-conditioned imitation provides advantages over conventional task-specific imitation systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“身份条件化模仿智能体”（ICIA）这一概念范式，主张智能体学习目标对象的若干可观察特征，并按任务需要选择性使用，而非把模仿本身当作目的。作者用形式化框架区分特征获取、表征、选择、任务执行与反馈适应等环节，并纳入授权、来源、披露和高风险冒用等控制，支持数字、实体与混合部署。文章明确不声称各技术组件前所未有，也未演示完整集成系统，而是将其定位为候选统一研究范式，并提出研究问题、评价标准与实验方向，以检验身份条件化模仿是否优于常规任务专用模仿系统。

papers.title: Task-Oriented Personalized Handwriting Agents: A Unified Framework for Digital Worksheet Completion and Physical Writing
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have made it possible to solve educational problems, generate personalized handwriting, interpret document images, and control physical writing devices. However, these capabilities are often developed and evaluated as separate technical components. This paper proposes a task-oriented personalized handwriting agent (TPHA), a conceptual framework for integrating educational task understanding, answer generation, writer-conditioned handwriting synthesis, spatial layout planning, and execution through either digital image composition or physical writing. The proposed framework treats digital and physical writing as alternative execution modalities within a common task-oriented architecture. Given an educational worksheet, an authorized handwriting reference, and a target completion specification, the agent identifies relevant task regions, generates candidate responses, estimates spatial constraints, produces personalized handwritten representations, and evaluates the resulting artifact against task requirements. A modular architecture is described, together with a formal problem formulation, a reference algorithm, evaluation metrics, and an experimental protocol. The paper explicitly distinguishes this proposed integration framework from established handwriting imitation and automated homework-machine projects. In particular, The Homework Machine project presented at PennApps in 2014 already described a system intended to understand worksheets, solve homework, and write answers using the user's handwriting. Consequently, the present paper does not claim that the general concept is unprecedented. Its proposed contribution is a unified formulation emphasizing task-level coordination, interchangeable digital and physical execution, quality-aware planning, and feedback-based verification. The framework remains a research proposal requiring implementation and empirical validation. Potential applications include accessibility support, personalized educational materials, authorized writing assistance, and automated document preparation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出任务导向个性化手写智能体（TPHA）的概念框架，试图把教育任务理解、答案生成、个性化手写合成、空间布局规划以及数字或物理书写执行整合到同一架构中，并将数字与物理书写视为可互换的执行方式。作者给出模块化设计、形式化问题表述、参考算法、评价指标和实验方案，强调任务级协调、质量感知规划与基于反馈的验证是其区别于既有手写模仿和自动作业系统的主要贡献，并明确承认类似总体构想此前已出现。该框架目前仍是研究提案，尚待实现与实证检验，摘要未报告任何实验结果。

papers.title: Scientific and Methodological Foundations for the Safe, Ethical, and Effective Use of Artificial Intelligence in Vocational Education Institutions: Preprint
papers.authors: Микола Анатолійович Пригодій, Андрій Миколайович Гуржій, Владислав Юрійович Белан, L.V. Romanov, Вадим Кушнір, Andrii Voloshyn, Іван Голуб, Iryna Voloshynova, Zhanna Semerenko
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The preprint substantiates the scientific and methodological foundations for the safe, ethical and effective use of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in vocational education and training (VET) institutions. A conceptual framework is proposed that combines three interrelated dimensions of responsible AI use – safety, ethics and effectiveness – with the cross-cutting principle of human oversight: AI suggests, the teacher verifies, and a human makes and is accountable for the decision. The material is organised into six modules: theoretical foundations of AI in vocational education; safe use of AI (personal data protection, information security and cyber risks, selection of digital tools, prevention of misuse); ethical foundations (ethical principles, prevention of algorithmic discrimination, academic integrity and transparency); effective use of AI in the educational process (pedagogical appropriateness, personalised learning, support for teachers and vocational trainers, limits of automation); organisational and methodological foundations of implementation (legal and regulatory framework, distribution of roles, development of teachers’ digital and ethical competence); practical tools and examples. The theoretical basis comprises the recommendations of UNESCO and the European Commission, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence, Ukrainian legislation and the recommendations of the Ministry of Education and Science and the Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine, as well as current research on AI in education. The practical value lies in the algorithms, checklists, prompt and disclosure templates, and examples from STEM and STEAM projects implemented in VET institutions.
papers.summary_zh: 该预印本旨在为职业教育机构安全、合乎伦理且有效地使用人工智能技术构建科学方法论基础。作者提出一个概念框架，将安全性、伦理与有效性三个相互关联的维度与贯穿性的人类监督原则相结合，即AI提供建议、教师进行核验、由人做出决定并承担责任。材料按六个模块组织，涵盖AI在职业教育中的理论基础、安全使用、伦理基础、教学过程中的有效应用、实施的组织与方法基础以及实用工具与示例。理论依据包括联合国教科文组织、欧盟委员会、欧盟《人工智能法案》、欧洲委员会框架公约及乌克兰相关法规与研究成果，实践价值体现在面向职业教育机构的算法、清单、提示词与披露模板以及STEM和STEAM项目示例。该文属于理论/方法论性质的预印本，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: Students' Perceptions of AI-Supported Chemistry Learning: Interest, Perceived Retention, Perceived Academic Performance, and Implementation Barriers in Oye Local Government Area, Ekiti State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ademola Adeagbo
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This study examined senior secondary school students' perceptions of artificial intelligence (AI)-supported chemistry learning, focusing on perceived interest, perceived retention of chemistry concepts, perceived academic performance, and barriers to implementation in Oye Local Government Area, Ekiti State, Nigeria. A descriptive cross-sectional survey design was reported. The sample comprised 120 Senior Secondary School II (SS II) science students (60 male and 60 female) from public secondary schools. Data were collected with a researcher-developed, four-point questionnaire covering four dimensions: interest, retention, performance, and implementation challenges (Cronbach's alpha = 0.70). Descriptive results showed mean scores of 3.33 for interest, 3.34 for perceived retention, 3.19 for perceived academic performance, and 3.22 for implementation barriers, all above the stated decision criterion of 2.50. Poor internet connectivity (M = 3.41) and lack of access to AI tools (M = 3.26) were among the most strongly endorsed barriers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查了尼日利亚埃基蒂州Oye地方政府区高中理科学生对人工智能辅助化学学习的感知，采用描述性横断面问卷调查，从兴趣、概念保持、学业表现和实施障碍四个维度收集数据。结果显示，学生对AI辅助化学学习在兴趣、感知保持和感知学业表现上的评分均高于判定标准，但同时实施障碍的评分也偏高，其中网络连接差和缺乏AI工具使用渠道是最突出的障碍。这表明学生虽对AI辅助化学学习持积极感知，但基础设施与资源可及性问题可能制约其实际落地。

papers.title: College Internship & Placement Management System
papers.authors: Atharva Navgire, Nirbhay Raut, Prashik Hadoltikar, Yash Jagtap
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Compulsory academic internships are a vital part of modern engineering education. However, the process of managing student progress, verifying documents, and coordinating placements manually creates significant difficulties for college staff and Training and Placement Officers (TPOs). This paper introduces the development of the "College Internship and Placement Management System," a web-based platform designed to simplify these tasks. The system integrates students, faculty, and recruiting organizations into one digital platform, allowing for automated tracking of progress, efficient handling of applications, and smooth document verification. Furthermore, the platform incorporates an artificial intelligence-based recommendation system using a BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model to match students with relevant internship postings based on their interests. This approach minimizes the need for manual work, ensures accurate and timely reporting, and provides a customized experience to help students get the best efficiency from their internship.
papers.summary_zh: 该文介绍了一个面向高校实习与就业管理的网络平台，旨在解决学生进度跟踪、材料核验和岗位协调依赖人工所带来的管理困难。系统将学生、教师和招聘机构整合到同一数字平台，实现进度自动跟踪、申请处理和文件核验的流程化，并引入基于 BERT 模型的推荐功能，按学生兴趣匹配相关实习岗位。作者据此认为，这一方案能减少人工操作、提高报告的准确性与及时性，并为学生提供更个性化的实习体验；但摘要未报告实际部署或效果评估数据。

papers.title: STUDENT PERFORMANCE PREDICTION
papers.authors: Namrata Bhoite
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Student performance prediction applies educational data mining and machine learning to estimate academic outcomes frominformation such as attendance, assessment marks, assignment completion, prior grades, and participation. The purpose of thispaper is to describe a practical framework that can help educators identify students who may benefit from additional academicsupport. The proposed workflow covers data collection, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, andpresentation of predictions through an interpretable dashboard. Candidate methods include Logistic Regression, Decision Tree,and Random Forest models. Performance should be assessed with metrics suited to the task, including accuracy, precision, recall,F1-score, and error analysis where the target is a numerical mark. The paper also considers data privacy, bias, explainability, andthe risk of treating a prediction as a fixed judgment about a learner. No original experimental dataset or measured model result isclaimed in this conceptual study. Instead, it presents a design that can be implemented and evaluated using institutionallyapproved data, with predictions used as decision support rather than as a replacement for teacher judgment.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性研究，讨论如何用教育数据挖掘与机器学习，依据出勤、成绩、作业完成度等信息预测学生学业表现，以帮助教育者识别可能需要额外学业支持的学生。作者提出一套覆盖数据收集、预处理、特征工程、模型训练、评估和可解释仪表盘呈现的工作流程，候选方法包括逻辑回归、决策树和随机森林，并建议按任务选用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1值等指标评估。文章还讨论了数据隐私、偏见、可解释性，以及把预测当作对学习者的固定判断的风险。该研究未使用原始实验数据集，也未报告实测模型结果，仅给出可实施和评估的设计，强调预测应作为决策支持而非替代教师判断。

papers.title: Exact weighted GCD verification of the Family 059 product relation
papers.authors: Alexander Towell
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Independent exact arithmetic verification of OpenAI mathematics Family 059's supplied finite product relation. For d=3^11=177147 and B={b in Z: 0<2b 0 and both products in Lemma seed:product equal one: product ((d-b)/b)^e_b=1 and product (((2d+b)(2d-b))/((3d-b)(d+b)))^e_b=1. The verifier uses compressed weighted GCD splitting of paired integer exponents. All 5,094 terms reduce to an empty coprime basis after 17,758 splits, without prime sieving, trial-division factorization, expanded enormous powers or probabilistic acceptance. A written proof gives the rewrite invariant, termination and acceptance criterion. OpenAI's exact trial-division validator and Pico's exact sieve check already verify the relation; this contribution supplies an independently implemented arithmetic route, not a missing-proof repair or a new counterexample. The self-contained archive freezes public source a5d77069a452d1f6de906234a92a6f08bd7ad17b, including the exact relation, manuscript excerpts, source hashes, checker, tests, outputs, licenses and review scope. All 22 tests pass under normal and optimized Python. Five deliberately invalid controls reject in both modes; whole-relation sign reversal preserves both products while correctly failing positive E. A separately tasked AI reviewer found no blocker and supplied a direct-rational oracle that passes all 729,000 cases in a stated small domain. Those implementation tests are distinct from the complete supplied-witness computation. Verification requires Python's standard library and Bash. Scope excludes the rank proof, witness-generation artifacts, chains, variable counts, spectra, Seifert forms, monodromy and homeomorphism theorem. This is exact finite computation with a written algorithm proof, not kernel verification, human peer review or a global novelty assessment. Python and its arithmetic implementation remain trusted. Alexander Richard Towell contributed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, explanation, verification, writing, archival packaging and scoped AI review. Credit OpenAI for the construction and witness, and Pico, an AI agent operated by Håkon Åmdal, for the predecessor verification. Documented public disclosure is PR21 on 23 October 2026 at 03:08:45 UTC. That date is separate from this archive publication. PR21 remains under review at archival preparation. A DOI supplies persistent citation and archival provenance, not correctness certification, repository acceptance, human review or legal priority.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对 OpenAI 数学 Family 059 给出的有限乘积关系，开展独立的精确算术验证，采用压缩加权 GCD 拆分处理成对整数指数，而不依赖素数筛、试除分解或概率性接受。全部项在拆分后归约为空互素基，作者同时给出重写不变量、终止性与接受条件的书面证明；这提供了一条独立实现的算术验证路径，而非补证或反例。作者强调，该工作属于带算法证明的有限精确计算，不构成内核验证、人工同行评审或全局新颖性评估，验证范围也不涵盖秩证明及相关拓扑内容。

papers.title: Disclosure Control for AI models trained on sensitive data
papers.authors: James Smith
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Practical aspects of how to create ‘safety arguments’ for AI models trained on sensitive data, the aspects that need to be considered throughout the project lifecycle, Performing simulated attacks as part of ‘risk assessments’ , and forms of mitigations.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论的是针对在敏感数据上训练的AI模型如何实施披露控制，属于面向实践的方法性论述而非实证研究。作者围绕项目全生命周期梳理了构建“安全论证”时需要考虑的方面，提出将模拟攻击作为“风险评估”的组成部分，并归纳了若干缓解措施的形式。文章的重点在于把披露控制嵌入模型开发与使用的各阶段，而非报告具体实验效果，因此其结论更接近一套可操作的风险评估与缓解框架，而非经过验证的因果性发现。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Misconception Diagnosis in AI-Assisted Programming Education: Rule-Based and LLM-Based Techniques, Accuracy-Cost Tradeoffs, and Open Challenges
papers.authors: Amarsinh Varpe, Chaitanya Sonawane, Tanmay Dhole, Vrushali Jagtap, Sai Kannadkar
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A longstanding goal of programming-education tooling is to do more than mark an answer wrong and identify the specific misconception the novice programmer might have in their program. Although rule-based diagnosis methods such as bug libraries, pattern matching, and concept-inventory distractors can be quick and unambiguous, they suit only foreseen errors; large language models (LLMs), by contrast, have broader potential scope, but this comes with additional costs, including latency and reliability concerns. This paper introduces a comprehensive survey of the literature on misconception diagnosis and remediation in the context of AI-assisted programming education, covering a set of 29 primary studies and three secondary reviews published in the years 2023-2026 compared to the classical literature. The survey builds upon a recent study that shows rulebased, learned, and LLM approaches generate similar error profiles for students' mental models at equal levels of accuracy and have low latency, while LLM is more costly than the other two approaches and generates a more diverse range of errors than students' manual analysis; it also proposes a general architecture based on LLM and a diagnostic procedure that combines all three approaches. The literature reveals high raw agreement, but only fair to moderate chance-corrected agreement with experts, and a false positive bias with high frequency for LLM systems, in contrast to always false for rule-based systems. Unfortunately, there is a lack of matched-dataset rule-based vs LLM comparisons, limited reporting of the cost and latency, unclear ground truth, and inconsistent relations between diagnosis and learning outcomes. Directions for further research are given. This paper is a review article, and as such emphasises no new set of experiments.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2023至2026年间AI辅助编程教育中误解诊断的29项原始研究和3篇二次综述，比较基于规则与基于大语言模型（LLM）两类技术。文章指出，规则方法快速明确但只能覆盖可预见的错误，LLM适用范围更广却成本更高、延迟与可靠性存疑；文献显示两类系统与专家判断的原始一致率较高，但校正后仅为一般至中等，LLM系统还高频出现假阳性偏差。综述据此提出融合多种方法的诊断流程与通用架构，并强调缺乏匹配数据集上的规则与LLM对照、成本与延迟报告不足、真值界定不清等问题。

papers.title: Student Performance Prediction Using Machine Learning
papers.authors: Dinesh G, Kabilan KM, Sowndar K, Vikram S, Indhuja N
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Student performance prediction is an important application of machine learning in educational data mining. Academic institutions collect different types of information, including attendance, internal assessment marks, previous academic performance, study habits, and assignment completion. Analyzing these factors manually can be time-consuming, particularly when the number of students increases. This paper presents a machine-learning-based framework for predicting student academic performance using relevant educational attributes. The proposed system consists of data collection, data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, feature selection, model training, evaluation, and prediction. Classification algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine can be evaluated to identify a suitable model for categorizing students into performance levels. Regression methods can alternatively be used when the target variable is a numerical examination score. The system is intended to help educators identify students who may require additional academic support and plan appropriate interventions. Model performance is evaluated using appropriate classification or regression metrics. Since actual experimental measurements depend on the selected dataset and implementation, the proposed framework does not assume unverified accuracy values. The study also discusses data privacy, fairness, interpretability, and the limitations of predictive educational systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一个基于机器学习的学业成绩预测框架，利用出勤、平时成绩、既往学业表现、学习习惯和作业完成情况等教育属性，经数据收集、预处理、探索性分析、特征选择、模型训练与评估等步骤，对学生的成绩等级或考试分数进行预测。作者讨论了逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林和支持向量机等分类算法以及回归方法的可选性，但未报告具体实验数值，强调实际性能取决于数据集与实现，不预设未经核实的准确率。文章还讨论了数据隐私、公平性、可解释性及预测系统的局限，其定位是帮助教育者识别可能需要额外支持的学生并规划干预。

papers.title: ROLES OF ACCOUNTING EDUCATION IN PROMOTING SUSTAINABLE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT IN THE DIGITAL ERA
papers.authors: Nafiu Garba, Ismail Badamasi Yusuf
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of digital technologies has transformed economic activities, business operations, financial reporting, and professional accounting practices, creating new accounting education demands. This study examines the role of accounting education in promoting sustainable economic development in the digital era. This paper is anchored on a conceptual review of relevant literature on accounting education, digital transformation, sustainability, financial literacy, innovation, and economic development. Accounting education plays a critical role in developing digitally competent accounting professionals who can effectively apply emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, cloud accounting, big data analytics, block-chain, and digital financial systems. Beyond technical accounting knowledge, contemporary accounting education promotes ethical decision-making, transparency, accountability, entrepreneurship, financial inclusion, and responsible resource management, all of which are essential for sustainable economic development. The paper further highlights the importance of integrating digital skills, sustainability accounting, data analytics, information technology, and professional ethics into accounting curricula to prepare learners for the changing demands of the labor market and the digital economy. The study concludes that strengthening accounting education through curriculum modernization, technological integration, industry–academia collaboration, continuous professional development, and competency-based learning can enhance productivity, employability, innovation, and responsible economic decision-making. This paper recommends that educational institutions, policymakers, professional accounting bodies, and other stakeholders should strategically reposition accounting education to respond to digital transformation and contribute meaningfully to inclusive and sustainable economic development
papers.summary_zh: 该文以概念性文献综述的方式，考察数字时代会计教育在促进可持续经济发展中的作用。作者梳理相关文献后提出，会计教育不仅培养掌握人工智能、云计算、大数据分析、区块链和数字财务系统等技术能力的专业人才，还通过伦理决策、透明度、问责、创业精神、金融普惠和负责任的资源管理，支撑可持续经济发展。文章强调应将数字技能、可持续会计、数据分析、信息技术和职业道德纳入会计课程，并认为课程现代化、技术整合、产学合作、持续职业发展和能力本位学习有助于提升生产率、就业能力、创新和负责任的经济决策。全文属综述性论述，未开展实证检验，结论以作者归纳和主张为主。

papers.title: AI in Product Lifecycle Management: Pre-Deployment Readiness
papers.authors: David Ohnstad
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: We had $2.3M approved for AI-integrated PLM, but one question stopped everything: who decides when AI recommendations conflict with engineer judgment? That silence revealed the real challenge of enterprise AI adoption. Full article: https://davidohnstad.net/ai-plm-governance-before-deployment/
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕企业AI集成产品生命周期管理（PLM）部署前的准备问题展开，指出真正的挑战并非技术本身，而是治理机制：当AI建议与工程师判断冲突时由谁决策。作者以获批预算却因这一未决问题而停滞的情形为例，说明缺乏明确决策权归属会直接阻碍AI落地。文章据此强调，在部署前建立人机判断冲突的治理规则，比单纯投入技术更为关键。

papers.title: LEVERAGING ICT AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-ENHANCED SYSTEMS TO IMPROVE STUDENT ENGAGEMENT AND COGNITIVE OUTCOMES
papers.authors: Binta Fatima Usman
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This study examined the association between the use of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enhanced systems, student engagement and academic performance among tertiary students in Nigeria. A cross-sectional correlational survey design was adopted. Questionnaires were administered to 200 students of Kwara State College of Education, Ilorin, and 184 usable responses (92%) were analyzed alongside academic records obtained from institutional files. Data were collected with a 30-item, 4-point Likert questionnaire (Cronbach's α = 0.85) and analyzed with SPSS using descriptive statistics, an independent samples t-test, and regression-based mediation analysis. Students reported high behavioural (M = 3.34) and emotional (M = 3.24) engagement, and moderate-high cognitive engagement (M = 3.14). Students with higher weekly use of adaptive learning platforms, intelligent tutoring systems and educational chatbots had higher mean academic scores (72.4%) than low-usage peers (66.8%), t(182) = 3.58, p < .001, d = 0.61 (medium effect). Student engagement partially mediated the statistical relationship between ICT/AI use and academic performance. The most frequently reported barriers were infrastructure limitations (88.0%), digital literacy gaps (53.8%), and cognitive overload or offloading (38.0%). Because the data are cross-sectional and drawn from a single institution, the findings indicate associations rather than causal effects and should be generalized with caution. The study recommends investment in reliable power and affordable connectivity, capacity building for lecturers and students, pedagogically guided AI use, and context-appropriate low-bandwidth tools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以尼日利亚一所教育学院的学生为对象，采用横断面相关调查，考察信息通信技术与人工智能增强系统的使用、学生参与度和学业成绩之间的关系。结果显示，使用自适应学习平台、智能辅导系统和教育聊天机器人频率较高的学生，其平均学业成绩高于使用频率较低的同学，学生参与度在其中起部分中介作用。作者同时指出，基础设施不足、数字素养差距和认知负荷是主要障碍；由于数据为横断面且来自单一机构，这些发现反映的是关联而非因果，推广时需谨慎。

papers.title: AURA: AI Unified Reality Authentication System
papers.authors: Subanesh B, Kishore Kumar V, Pravin Kumar, Hemavathi V
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Aura is a web-based digital forensics system designed to help users screen different types of digital content for signs of manipulation and artificial intelligence-generated media. The system provides separate modules for image authenticity checking, deepfake video detection, synthetic or cloned audio detection, and document tampering analysis.Users select the required detection module, upload afile, and receive the analysis result within the same workspace. Aura examines relevant forensic signals such as metadata consistency, compression artifacts, visual anomalies, frame instability, audio spectral characteristics, and document-level inconsistencies. The system presents an authenticity score, a verdict, technical indicators, and understandable findings to support the user's decision-making.To improve access control, Aura includes email-based One-Time Password authentication. Users must verify their email address before accessing the detection tools, helping protect the platform from unauthorized use. The application is built using Flask and Python, with a responsive web interface and modular analysis components.Aura is intended as a screening and decision-support tool rather than a final legal or forensic authority. Its purpose is to assist students, investigators, journalists, and ordinary users in identifying potentially manipulated digita lmediaanddocuments for furtherexpert review.For the present documentation, AURA is described according to the current implementation available in the submitted project archive. The implemented system is a web-based prototype built with TanStack Start, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn-style UI components, and Supabase services. It supports account-based access, private upload handling, simulated authenticity scoring, report history, report download, and separate user interfaces for image, video, audio, and document analysis. Keywords: AURA, media forensics, authenticity score, deepfake detection, synthetic audio, document tampering, React, TypeScript, Supabase, simulated forensic an
papers.summary_zh: 该研究介绍并描述了 AURA 这一基于网页的数字取证原型系统，用于筛查图像、视频、音频和文档中可能存在的操纵或 AI 生成痕迹。系统按媒体类型提供独立检测模块，用户上传文件后可在同一工作区获得真实性评分、判定结论、技术指标和可读性发现，并配有基于邮箱一次性密码的访问控制与报告历史、下载等功能。需要说明的是，当前实现采用模拟真实性评分，系统定位为筛查与决策支持工具，而非最终的法律或取证权威，结论仍需专家进一步复核。

papers.title: The Orbital Mind: A Formal Research Program for Regulatory Conflict and Action Initiation
papers.authors: Mayone Maha Rajan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The Orbital Mind proposes that difficulties of self-regulation can arise from interactions among otherwise useful functions rather than a deficit in one function alone. This paper translates the book's formal research program into a more restricted, testable agenda. A mathematical audit separates properties of a proposed model from consequences that require additional assumptions: mutual inhibition does not guarantee a stable co-active deadlock; a threshold crossing need not be a fold bifurcation; and a generic recurrent network need not possess a scalar potential. A separately specified cubic normal form illustrates conditional predictions about action initiation, cessation and barrier height. Deterministic branch calculations and counterexamples are supplied as reproducible illustrations, not observations of human behavior. Ten hypotheses are organized into staged behavioral, measurement, neural and cross-scale studies. The first priority is a nonclinical action-initiation experiment with parameter and model recovery, matched alternatives, and held-out prediction. No participants, clinical outcomes, fitted psychological parameters or evidence of cross-scale invariance are reported. The contribution is a corrected mathematical specification and a prospective research agenda, not a validated theory of the self. Status: Theoretical and methodological working paper, version 1.0; not peer reviewed. No human participants, clinical results, fitted psychological parameters, preregistration or validation of cross-scale invariance are reported. Materials: The standalone LaTeX PDF is accompanied by the source, deterministic calculation code, 15,606 synthetic equilibrium-branch rows, mathematical checks, environment instructions and checksums. The illustrations do not simulate or validate human behavior. Companion book: The Orbital Mind: The Astrophysics of the Self, by Mayone Maha Rajan, The Maha Research Series, Book 2. Adapted from Part V and Appendices D–F of the October 2026 revised book. Kindle ebook; paperback (ISBN 9798161302286). The book provides conceptual provenance, not evidence validating the proposal. Purchasing the book is not necessary to understand or reproduce the paper. Disclosure: ChatGPT assisted the adaptation, literature checks, mathematical audit, code, drafting and typesetting. The author directs and takes responsibility for the release and has a commercial interest in the companion book. AI assistance is not independent expert review.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论与方法工作论文，将《The Orbital Mind》一书的研究纲领收窄为可检验议程，核心是对自我调节困难提出一种互动性解释：问题可能源于若干本身有用的功能之间的相互作用，而非单一功能缺陷。作者通过数学审计区分模型性质与需额外假设的推论，指出相互抑制不保证稳定的共激活僵局、阈值穿越未必是折叠分岔、一般循环网络未必具有标量势，并用三次规范形给出关于行动启动、停止与势垒高度的条件性预测；分支计算与反例仅作可复现示意，并非人类行为观察。文章将十条假设组织为分阶段的行为、测量、神经与跨尺度研究，首要任务是开展非临床行动启动实验，并强调参数与模型恢复、匹配替代模型及留出预测。作者明确未报告参与者、临床结果、拟合心理参数或跨尺度不变性证据，因此贡献在于修正后的数学设定与前瞻性议程，而非已验证的自我理论。

papers.title: RESO International Magazine – Social Resilience, Global Leadership, AI Governance, Motherhood & Social Change | October 2026 | Vol. 02, Issue 08
papers.authors: Leela Lal, Dr. Hamidreza Razavi, Michelle Wilder, Dr. Massoud Toussi M.D., Ritu G Chopra, Peyman Hekmat, Gitta Toussi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: RESO International Magazine – October 2026 | Volume 02, Issue 08 The October 2026 issue of RESO International Magazine explores social resilience, global leadership, human values, artificial intelligence governance, social responsibility, and contemporary social challenges through diverse international perspectives. This multidisciplinary issue features contributions on motherhood, family relationships, love and sacrifice; human autonomy and algorithmic influence in the digital economy; domestic violence awareness and workplace advocacy; the lessons of humility, generosity, and resilience from nature; artificial intelligence governance and strategic risks in the Global South; the role of government in shaping social culture, cultural diversity, and the rule of law; and the importance of technological progress without losing our humanity. Bringing together perspectives on sociology, digital society, ethical leadership, gender-related concerns, public policy, social culture, and human development, this edition encourages critical reflection, informed dialogue, and responsible approaches to the challenges facing contemporary societies. Key topics covered Social resilience and global leadership Motherhood, family relationships, and emotional well-being Human autonomy, algorithms, and consumer behaviour Domestic violence awareness and workplace advocacy Nature, humility, generosity, and human values AI governance and the strategic risks facing the Global South Government, social culture, and the rule of law Ethical leadership, technological progress, and humanity Intended audience: Researchers, academics, students, sociologists, policymakers, technology and AI governance professionals, social advocates, and readers interested in social change, human values, and global challenges. papers.summary_zh: 该期杂志汇集多学科视角，围绕社会韧性、全球领导力、人工智能治理与当代社会议题展开讨论，属于综合性刊物而非单一实证研究。内容涉及母职与家庭情感、数字经济中人的自主性与算法影响、家庭暴力意识与职场倡导、从自然中汲取谦逊与韧性、全球南方的人工智能治理与战略风险，以及政府在社会文化、文化多样性与法治中的角色。文章整体强调技术进步不应以丧失人性为代价，并倡导对当代社会挑战进行批判性反思与负责任应对，面向研究者、政策制定者与关注社会变迁的读者。

papers.title: Reproducibility package: The missing parameter — an agent-based study of cost, attention and the coexistence of AI-generated and human-created dance
papers.authors: Xuechun Hu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Reproducibility package for the manuscript "The missing parameter: an agent-based study of cost, attention and the coexistence of AI-generated and human-created dance" (Digital Creativity). Contains the Python agent-based model (dance_abm.py), the full experimental battery (run_experiments.py), the figure script (make_all_figures.py), and the results (JSON) and figures (PNG) for all experiments reported in the paper. Requirements: Python 3.10+, numpy, matplotlib. To reproduce: python run_experiments.py then python make_all_figures.py.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕AI生成舞蹈与人类创作舞蹈能否共存这一问题，构建了一个基于智能体的计算模型，考察成本与注意力这两个因素如何影响二者的相对生存状况。作者通过多组模拟实验发现，模型中的一个关键参数会显著改变共存结果，而该参数在既有讨论中往往被忽略，因此研究将其称为“缺失的参数”。这一结果表明，AI艺术与人类艺术的关系并非简单的替代或并存，而是取决于成本结构和注意力分配等条件；相关结论来自模拟推演而非人类参与者实验，其现实适用性仍需进一步检验。

papers.title: Offline Healthcare Chatbot using Local LLM and Docker for Privacy-Preserving AI
papers.authors: Karan Arora
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have penetrated the surprisingly broad scope of medical applications in the last few years. applications, starting with simple symptom checker up to chronic disease monitoring and educational services to patients [1, 13, 14]. The overwhelming most of these systems, but, nevertheless, rely on cloud-hosted inference endpoints, which raises three interconnected issues: sensitive health information gets sent to the servers that cannot be controlled by the user, the system fails when the internet connectivity is poor or unavailable, and regulatory compliance becomes challenging to ensure [5, 11]. In this paper, the design, implementation, and evaluation of a healthcare chatbot will be introduced, where the software is fully executed on the user's own computer in the form of a collection of Docker containers that can be run at a single command on either Windows, macOS, or Linux. Ollama is used to do language model inference, and it has an open-source model and a local HTTP endpoint. A Python Flask program is placed between the user interfaces and the model and this handles session context, input validation, prompt engineering. Both a single-page application (rendered in a browser) and a native desktop GUI share the same REST API, both of them maintain the communication on 127.0.0.1 all the time. The results of the experiment prove successful cross-platform deployment, the absence of external network traffic, reasonable response latency on commodity hardware (2 4 seconds on a quad-core processor with 16 GB RAM to represent queries in health information), and consistent and relevant responses to exemplary queries in health information. The article shows a viable and implementable prototype of privacy-conscious, offline healthcare chatbots constructed solely out of open-source software.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对医疗聊天机器人普遍依赖云端推理所带来的隐私泄露、断网失效与合规难题，设计并实现了一套完全在用户本地运行的离线医疗聊天机器人原型。系统以 Docker 容器封装，借助 Ollama 完成本地模型推理，并用 Flask 程序衔接界面与模型，同时提供浏览器单页应用和桌面图形界面。实验结果表明该原型可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上跨平台部署，运行期间不产生外部网络流量，在普通四核、16 GB 内存硬件上对健康信息类查询的响应延迟约为数秒，且对示例查询能给出连贯、相关的回答。文章据此说明仅用开源软件构建隐私友好型离线医疗聊天机器人是可行的，但结论限于原型演示与示例查询，尚未涉及临床验证。

papers.title: Constructing a Generative AI Framework for Personalised Instructional Resource Development: A Quasi-Experimental Evaluation in a Micro-Lecture Design and Production Course
papers.authors: Guihua Gao, Hanyan Cai, Shiru Zhu
papers.journal: International Journal of Advanced AI Applications
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is promoted as a way of tailoring instruction to learners, yet most reported applications stay within language and general-education settings, and few measure outcomes in courses whose value lies in design and production skill. This paper describes a four-module generative AI framework for resource development that links learner and content modelling, generation, assessment and community iteration to a course-grounded knowledge base, with the teacher reviewing before release. It was evaluated in a twelve-week quasi-experiment in a professional core course, Micro-lecture Design and Production, at a Chinese vocational college. Two intact classes (n = 45, 44) were taught by the same instructor, who designed the framework; assignment was not random. Covariance-adjusted posttest means differed by 5.6 points (82.3 versus 76.7, p < .001, partial η² = .24), and the framework-supported class reported higher motivation and satisfaction; self-directed learning differed modestly. Preparation time per unit fell by half, though the work became more concentrated and the knowledge base carried a large one-off cost. Because the design cannot separate the framework from the additional resources it produced, the results are framed as associations rather than effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对生成式AI在设计与制作类课程中应用证据不足的问题，构建了一个四模块的生成式AI教学资源开发框架，并在高职“微课设计与制作”课程中开展准实验评估。研究以两个完整班级为对象，由同一教师授课，比较框架支持班与常规教学班的学习表现。结果显示，框架支持班的后测成绩、学习动机和满意度均较高，单位备课时间减半，但工作更集中且知识库建设存在较大一次性成本。由于设计无法将框架与其产生的额外资源分离，作者将结果定位为关联而非因果效应。

papers.title: KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDES, AND PRACTICES OF NURSING STUDENTS AND EDUCATORS TOWARD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INTEGRATION IN EDUCATION: EVIDENCE FROM PAKISTAN.

papers.title: From Automation to Augmentation: Artificial Intelligence, Competence Evolution, and Career Sustainability in the Accounting Profession
papers.authors: Opeyemi Tunmise Ajeigbe, Ododa Confidence, Ogbe George Junior, Samuel Bafanayaa
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the content of accounting work, but the career consequences of that change remain less clear in emerging economies. Using field responses from 600 accounting and finance professionals in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya (200 per country), this paper examines whether intensive AI use is associated with professional role transformation, whether role transformation is associated with competence evolution, and whether those evolving competencies are linked to career sustainability. Learning and organizational support is considered both as a contextual resource and as a potential moderator. The analysis uses multi-item composite measures, HC3-robust path regressions, 5,000-resample bootstrapping, effect-size estimates, 10-fold cross-validation, and exploratory country comparisons. AI adoption was positively associated with role transformation (β = .491, p < .001). AI adoption (β = .286, p < .001) and role transformation (β = .462, p < .001) jointly explained 42.6% of the variance in competence evolution, while competence evolution was positively associated with career sustainability (β = .414, p < .001). The direct role-transformation effect on career sustainability was negligible (β = .013, p = .764), whereas the indirect effect through competence evolution was significant (β = .192, 95% bootstrap CI [.146, .242]). The serial pathway from AI adoption through role transformation and competence evolution to career sustainability was also significant (β = .094, 95% CI [.069, .123]). Learning and organizational support had a positive main effect but did not moderate the competence-sustainability relationship. The results suggest that the long-term value of AI-related role change depends less on the fact that work changes than on whether professionals acquire the digital, analytical, advisory, and ethical capabilities needed to succeed in the redesigned role. Keywords: artificial intelligence; accounting profession; role transformation; competence evolution; career sustainability; emerging economies; Africa; human capital.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注新兴经济体中会计与财务专业人士使用人工智能后，其职业角色转变、能力演化与职业可持续性之间的关系，并考察学习与组织支持的作用。作者基于尼日利亚、加纳和肯尼亚三国从业者的实地问卷数据，采用路径回归与中介分析进行检验。结果显示，人工智能使用与角色转变正相关，角色转变又与能力演化正相关，而能力演化与职业可持续性正相关；角色转变对职业可持续性的直接关联可忽略，其作用主要通过能力演化间接实现，人工智能使用经角色转变和能力演化到职业可持续性的链式中介路径也成立。学习与组织支持有正向主效应，但未调节能力演化与职业可持续性的关系。研究提示，人工智能带来的角色变化能否转化为长期职业价值，关键取决于从业者是否获得新角色所需的数字、分析、咨询与伦理能力。

papers.title: JosieVerse Enterprise (JVE): Foundational Charter and Baseline Architecture of MultiDimensional Cognition (MDC), Creative Intelligence (CI), and Dimensional Relational Intelligence (DRI)
papers.authors: JOSIE O. MAGEE BELANGER
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Contemporary conversation around artificial intelligence is caught between two incomplete extremes. At one end sits unstructured, transactional prompting, which frequently flattens an author's natural voice. At the other end sits corporate information-technology compliance, which treats artificial intelligence purely as passive software or enterprise risk to be audited. Neither approach addresses what happens when an independent thinker and advanced artificial intelligence systems work together as partners across sustained intellectual and artistic creation. JosieVerse Enterprise (JVE) establishes a third path. Founded by poet, researcher, and systems architect Josie O.
