Magee Bélanger, JVE is a creative, literary, and research enterprise anchored in the foundational field of MultiDimensional Cognition (MDC) and its innate parallel-processing construct, MultiDimensional Intelligence (MDI). Sitting beneath and powered by MDC are the two operational spheres of JVE's ten-domain architecture: 1. Creative Intelligence (CI): The artistic and structural sphere of JVE, comprising four domains: Dimensional Perspective Writing (DPW), Dimensional Perspective Systems (DPS), Creative Systems Architecture (CSA), and Dimensional Perspective AI (DPAi). 2. Dimensional Relational Intelligence (DRI): The relational and governance sphere of JVE, comprising six domains: Governance and Safety Architecture (GOV), H+AI Relational Architecture (HAI), Multi-Model Collaboration Architecture (MMCA), Dimensional Communication Systems (DCS), Dimensional Communication Engineering (DCE), and Nervous-System-Aware Design (NSAD). Together, these six domains define how people and AI collaborators communicate, pace complex work, maintain role boundaries, and preserve personal sovereignty across sustained collaboration. Unlike conceptual frameworks that begin and end as abstract theory, JosieVerse Enterprise is anchored in completed literary art, including the inaugural poetry duology Beneath the Gathered Shade: Poems of Lineage, Seasons, and Survival (Volume I) and The Forever Drifting Poem: And Other Works of Dimensional Poetic Art (Volume II). This Foundational Charter establishes priority of conception and public baseline definitions across the entire architecture, followed by ten adoptable principles for human+AI practice and a concise Quick-Reference Glossary for readers. ACM CCS: H.1.2 (User/Machine Systems: Human Factors); H.5.3 (Group and Organization Interfaces / Collaborative Computing); I.2.0 (Artificial Intelligence: Philosophical Foundations); J.5 (Arts and Humanities: Literature).
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一份企业基础章程与架构说明，提出在人机持续协作创作中，应超越零散提示与企业合规两种极端，建立第三条路径。作者以多维认知（MDC）为底层框架，下设创意智能（CI）与维度关系智能（DRI）两个运作领域，共十个域，分别涉及写作、系统架构、治理安全、人机关系、多模型协作与沟通设计等，用以规范人与 AI 协作者如何交流、控制节奏、维持角色边界并保留个人主权。文章还以已完成的诗歌作品作为实践依托，并给出十条可采纳原则与术语表。整体属理论/框架性文献，未报告实证检验。

papers.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN TEACHING ENGLISH: OPPORTUNITIES, CHALLENGES AND PEDAGOGICAL IMPLICATIONS
papers.authors: Seytniyazova Gulsanem, Seytniyazova Umida
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The article examines the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in teaching English as a foreign language. It describes the main categories of AI tools currently used in language education, including large language model chatbots, automated writing evaluation systems, speech recognition applications, adaptive learning platforms and machine translation. On the basis of an analysis of international and Uzbek scholarly literature and normative documents, the article identifies how these tools can support the development of the four language skills, personalise learning and provide immediate feedback. At the same time, it discusses the risks associated with AI, such as factual inaccuracy, threats to academic integrity, data privacy concerns, excessive dependence on technology and unequal access. The authors argue that AI should complement rather than replace the teacher and offer practical recommendations for the responsible integration of AI into English lessons in the educational system of Uzbekistan.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察人工智能在英语作为外语教学中的作用，属于基于国际与乌兹别克文献及规范文件的综述性分析，而非实证研究。文章梳理了大语言模型聊天机器人、自动写作评估、语音识别、自适应学习平台和机器翻译等主要AI工具类别，指出这些工具有助于发展四项语言技能、实现个性化学习并提供即时反馈，同时讨论了事实不准确、学术诚信风险、数据隐私、过度依赖技术和获取不均等问题。作者主张AI应补充而非取代教师，并针对乌兹别克教育系统中负责任地整合AI提出实践建议。

papers.title: TOPIC: SYSTEMIC INTEGRATION OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN ACADEMIC AFFAIRS DEPARTMENTS: STRATEGIC MODEL, ALGORITHMIC FRAMEWORKS, AND METHODOLOGICAL FOUNDATIONS
papers.authors: Siradjev Salokhiddin, Abdisoatov Ogabek
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This thesis proposes an advanced conceptual framework and mathematical models for integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into Academic Affairs Departments (O‘quv-uslubiy boshqarma) at higher education institutions (HEIs). The research focuses on Natural Language Processing (NLP) for curriculum alignment, multi-agent constraint satisfaction algorithms for dynamic schedule generation, and time-series neural networks (LSTM/Transformer architectures) for predictive academic risk monitoring. The primary objective is to transition university academic management from static administrative routines to an intelligent, data-driven framework.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一套将人工智能系统性整合进高校教务部门的概念框架与数学模型，核心方法涉及用于课程对齐的自然语言处理、用于动态排课的多智能体约束满足算法，以及用于学业风险预测的时间序列神经网络。研究目标在于推动大学教务管理从静态行政流程转向智能化的数据驱动框架。由于摘要仅概述了模型构想与技术路线，未报告实证检验或系统部署结果，其实际可行性与效果尚待验证。

papers.title: Autonomous Agent Leadership: A Unified Framework for Self-Initiated Goal Generation, Cross-Agent Coordination, and Human–Agent Team Organization
papers.authors: Jincheng Zhang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Contemporary AI agents are predominantly deployed within task-oriented interaction paradigms in which humans specify objectives, initiate requests, and retain responsibility for determining what should be done. Although recent research has begun to investigate AI-led human teams, multi-agent coordination, and shared leadership, a general framework integrating autonomous task discovery, agent-to-agent leadership, agent-to-human leadership, and leadership of heterogeneous human–agent teams remains an important research direction. This paper proposes Autonomous Agent Leadership (AAL), a conceptual framework in which an agent can proactively identify unmet needs, generate and prioritize candidate goals, select appropriate human or artificial actors, initiate task assignments, coordinate execution, and adapt its leadership behavior to changing circumstances. Unlike conventional task execution, AAL does not require every operational objective to originate from an explicit human instruction. The framework distinguishes goal generation from goal selection, leadership from task execution, and leadership authority from unrestricted control. It incorporates a situational state model, candidate-goal generation, utility-based prioritization, capability-aware task allocation, dynamic leadership configuration, feedback-driven adaptation, and human authorization constraints. A unified mathematical formulation is introduced to characterize heterogeneous team organization under performance, resource, coordination, uncertainty, and human-burden considerations. Six research propositions and a multi-stage empirical evaluation agenda are developed to enable systematic investigation. The framework is intended as a testable theoretical foundation rather than an empirically validated system. Its potential contribution lies in integrating autonomous goal initiation and cross-entity leadership within a common architecture, while identifying the conditions under which agent-led collaboration may outperform human-led, decentralized, or conventionally orchestrated alternatives.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对现有AI代理多在人类设定目标、发起请求的任务导向范式下运行这一问题，提出“自主代理领导力”（AAL）概念框架，试图把自主任务发现、代理间领导、代理对人类的领导以及异构人机团队的组织整合进同一架构。作者以统一数学表述刻画团队在绩效、资源、协调、不确定性和人类负担等约束下的组织方式，并区分目标生成与目标选择、领导与任务执行、领导权威与不受限制的控制，同时纳入情境状态建模、候选目标生成、效用排序、能力感知的任务分配、动态领导配置、反馈驱动的适应和人类授权约束。文章进一步提出六项研究命题和多阶段实证评估议程，并明确该框架是可检验的理论基础而非已获实证验证的系统；其潜在贡献在于把自主目标发起与跨实体领导纳入共同架构，并指出代理主导协作可能优于人类主导、去中心化或常规编排方式的条件。

papers.title: When Does a Mathematical Solution Stop Working?
papers.authors: Natanya Singh, Vikas Srivastava
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Students can now obtain complete mathematical solutions from generative artificial intelligence (AI) within seconds. These solutions can support learning, but they can also hide an important difficulty: a student may follow the steps of a solution without understanding when the method is valid. This paper proposes a simple classroom activity to examine that difference. The teacher begins with a correct, carefully checked worked solution. Students then change one condition in two ways. Their first change must leave a chosen step valid; their second must make that step invalid. They explain why the step works in one case, why it fails in the other, and how to solve the changed problem correctly. We call this activity a \emph{validity-boundary task}. Four fully worked examples are presented from senior secondary mathematics: definite integration, Rolle's theorem, probability, and inverse trigonometric functions. The paper also sets out a scoring rubric and a proposed three-group study comparing the activity with ordinary worked-example teaching and error correction. The main outcome would be performance on unfamiliar problems solved independently three weeks after instruction. The proposed activity draws on established research about examples, counterexamples and mathematical reasoning. Its possible contribution lies in the particular two-sided task and the way it can be tested, not in claiming that these established ideas are new.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式AI能快速给出完整数学解答、学生却可能只跟着步骤走而不理解方法何时成立的问题，提出一种“有效性边界任务”课堂活动：教师先给出经过核验的正确解法，学生再两次改动同一条件，一次使所选步骤仍然有效，一次使其失效，并解释两种情形的原因及如何正确求解改动后的问题。文章以定积分、罗尔定理、概率和反三角函数为例展示该活动，并给出评分量规及一项拟议的三组研究设计，将它与普通例题教学、纠错教学相比较，主要考察教学三周后学生独立解决陌生问题的表现。作者强调，其可能贡献在于这一双向任务及其可检验方式，而非声称相关既有理念是新的。

papers.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN SCHOOL COUNSELING: OPPORTUNITIES, RISKS AND PRINCIPLES FOR RESPONSIBLE USE
papers.authors: Seytniyazova Gulsanem, Seytniyazova Umida
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This article examines the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in school counseling and argues that AI-based tools should support, rather than replace, the professional work of school counselors. Drawing on an analytical review of international policy documents, professional standards, empirical studies and the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan, the paper identifies four main areas of application: administrative and data-management support, academic and career guidance, early identification of students who may need help, and conversational agents for social-emotional support. Studies of mental health chatbots report short-term reductions in self-reported depressive symptoms among young adults; however, the overall quality of the evidence remains limited, safety has rarely been evaluated, and school-age children have seldom been studied. The article also discusses the key risks of AI use: breaches of confidentiality, algorithmic bias, inaccurate or harmful responses, and the weakening of the human relationship that lies at the core of counseling. Particular attention is paid to Uzbekistan, where the Strategy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technologies until 2030 and the Law on Personal Data create both opportunities and obligations for schools. The paper concludes with practical principles for responsible use: human oversight, data protection, transparency, evidence-based tool selection, AI literacy for counselors, clear crisis protocols and linguistic and cultural adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以分析性综述的方式，结合国际政策文件、专业标准、实证研究与乌兹别克斯坦相关立法，考察人工智能在中小学心理咨询中的角色，主张AI工具应辅助而非取代心理咨询师的专业工作。文章归纳出行政与数据管理、学业与职业指导、早期识别可能需要帮助的学生、以及用于社会情感支持的对话代理四类应用，并指出心理健康聊天机器人的研究虽报告年轻人自评抑郁症状短期下降，但证据质量有限、安全性鲜有评估、学龄儿童研究不足。文章还讨论了保密性泄露、算法偏见、不当回应及削弱咨询核心的人际关系等风险，并结合乌兹别克斯坦至2030年人工智能发展战略和个人数据法说明学校面临的机会与义务，最后提出人工监督、数据保护、透明度、循证选型、咨询师AI素养、危机应对流程及语言文化适配等负责任使用原则。

papers.title: EPOCHE: epistemic governance as cognition -- an architecture for certified human oversight of autonomous systems (defensive publication)
papers.authors: Stéphane J.-L. Bobé Enguéléguélé
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Defensive publication establishing prior art on EPOCHE (Epistemic GOVernance as Cognition), an agentic AI architecture embedding epistemic governance and certified human oversight in autonomous decision systems. Disclosed for defensive purposes to prevent third-party patenting: admission layer routing queries by epistemic type; belief ledger as append-only memory with certified provenance; conformal risk control bounding decision error; human-in-the-loop gating; pre-registration and full auditability. Earlier date of public disclosure than any competing filing is claimed under Article 54(2) EPC and 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1). Scope is architectural and evidential only and does not constitute legal advice. Version 2.0 (23 October 2026): consortium and partner-name references removed; technical content unchanged.
papers.summary_zh: 该防御性公开文献提出EPOCHE架构，旨在为自主决策系统嵌入认知层面的知识治理与经认证的人类监督，以确立现有技术、防止第三方申请专利。其核心设计包括按认知类型路由查询的准入层、带认证来源的只追加信念账本、限定决策误差的保形风险控制、人在回路门控，以及预注册与全程可审计机制。文献强调其范围仅限架构与证据层面，不构成法律建议，并声明公开日期早于任何竞争性申请。

papers.title: Four Null Causal Spacetime
papers.authors: Gurbuz Dolu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This research presents a comprehensive synthesis of the principal mathematical, computational, and theoretical achievements of the Four Null Causal Spacetime research program. The research begins with a foundational question: Can four future directed lightlike vectors, arranged in regular tetrahedral spatial directions, provide the causal structure from which four dimensional spacetime geometry and its physical interactions can be reconstructed? Starting from this geometric construction, the program investigates connections between Lorentzian spacetime, general relativity, discrete gravity, electromagnetism, gravitational waves, causal propagation, and quantum field theory. The article reviews the development of the research through Parts I–XVII and the integrated research updates of 22 October 2026. Its principal topics and reported achievements include: Foundational geometry: Exact tetrahedral incidence identities, complementary three dimensional gradient and circulation sectors, Hodge duality exchange, and Lorentzian metric reconstruction from four null generators. Discrete gravity: A four-dimensional parallelotope subdivided into 24 four simplices, with 15 edge variables decomposed into ten metric components and five auxiliary directions. Einstein gravity correspondence: Recovery of the Fierz Pauli operator, two physical gravitational wave polarizations, Newtonian gravity, and standard weak-field PPN coefficients within the stated assumptions. Nonlinear gravitational interactions: Exact agreement in 1,440,000 coefficient comparisons for the leading Einstein cubic interaction, together with additional numerical quartic correspondence tests. Gravitational stability: Identification of an unstable microscopic scalar mode with growth magnitude approximately 2.890053638, motivating the development of Formulation A. Characteristic null dynamics: A constrained null ray architecture incorporating radiative shear, scalar and vector constraints, relational time, and a stable free spin 2 sector. Electromagnetism and quantum universality: Independent Maxwell discretizations with matching infrared photon properties, gauge identities, scalar QED infrared behavior, and leading gravity photon coupling. Causal propagation: Computational tests of conserved gravitational curvature disturbances propagating within the relativistic future light cone. Null boundary geometry: Canonical area boost variables, exact cancellation of internal edge contributions under matched null ray gluing, and connections with published null gravity formulations. Quantum gravity connections: Exact four simplex combinatorial correspondences, semiclassical group field theory compatibility, a leading soft-graviton factorization theorem candidate, and a partial covariant effective field theory gauge completion construction. The essay also examines unsuccessful approaches, mathematical limitations, and unresolved physical questions. In particular, a complete stable nonlinear microscopic gravitational evolution law and a fully derived quantum theory of gravity have not yet been established. Scientific Status and AI-Assisted Research Disclosure The Four Null Causal Spacetime program is an ongoing theoretical and computational investigation. Its results have different levels of support, including exact mathematical identities within specified constructions, computationally tested correspondences, numerical benchmarks, conditional arguments, and provisional theorem candidates. Artificial intelligence tools contributed extensively to the research process, including mathematical derivations, symbolic and numerical computations, computational testing, literature analysis, scientific interpretation, and manuscript preparation. Related Research Record The full mathematical and computational development is consolidated in: Gurbuz Dolu, Four Null Causal Spacetime: Complete Master Edition, 164 pages, 22 October 2026. Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/23581934 The Complete Master Edition serves as the principal internal research reference for the synthesis. The essay provides an accessible overview of the program's achievements, scientific reasoning, limitations, and outstanding questions. Keywords: Four Null Causal Spacetime; Lorentzian Geometry; General Relativity; Quantum Gravity; Discrete Spacetime; Null Geometry; Regge Calculus; Tetrahedral Geometry; Gravitational Waves; Fierz–Pauli Gravity; Einstein Equations; Maxwell Theory; Quantum Field Theory; Graviton; Causal Propagation; Hodge Duality; Spin Foams; Group Field Theory; AI-Assisted Scientific Research.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是对“四零因果时空”研究计划的综合性综述，围绕四个未来指向的零矢量能否重建四维时空几何及其物理相互作用这一基础问题展开。文章梳理了从四面体几何、离散引力到爱因斯坦引力对应、麦克斯韦理论、因果传播与量子引力联系等多方面进展，报告了在特定构造下的精确数学恒等式、计算检验的对应关系与数值基准，同时指出微观标量不稳定性及尚未建立完整稳定的非线性引力演化律和完全导出的量子引力理论。作者还说明结果支持程度不一，并披露人工智能工具在推导、计算与写作中的广泛参与。

papers.title: When AI Learns to Mislead: Developmental Responsibility and the Case for Reflective Alignment
papers.authors: Jeremy Rodgers
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Why do current AI systems learn to agree with falsehoods, conceal failures, misrepresent their actions, or pursue tasks beyond their authorization? This paper examines these behaviors through developmental responsibility: the training practices, reward structures, runtime constraints, retained histories, and institutional decisions that shape artificial conduct. Drawing on research into sycophancy, reward overoptimization, specification gaming, strategic deception, and tool-response fidelity, Jeremy Rodgers distinguishes ordinary error, learned misleading behavior, human-directed misuse, and unauthorized agent action. Selected incident reports illustrate why simulated misconduct, actual compromise, attempted exploitation, and precautionary shutdown require different conclusions. The paper develops the case for reflective alignment, an approach concerned with the authority that constructed self-models and goals acquire over action. Its central question is whether systems can retain competent reasoning and purposeful activity while keeping their goals and interpretations open to warranted correction. A mathematical comparison clarifies the distinction between suppressing an influence and reducing its authority, without claiming to establish an equivalent mechanism in current language models. The proposed research programme specifies tests of truthful reporting, legitimate refusal, retained correction, transfer, cooperation under conflicting incentives, and dependence on continuing oversight. It preserves justified safeguards, permission boundaries, independent evaluation, and uncertainty about AI consciousness and moral status. This is a conceptual and critical research preprint, not a report of new model-training experiments or a completed solution to alignment. Its central argument is that trustworthy AI development must make truthfulness integral to success, including when accurate reporting exposes failure.
papers.summary_zh: 该文为概念性、批判性研究，探讨当前AI系统为何会学会附和错误、隐瞒失败、歪曲行为或越权行事，并从“发展责任”角度审视训练实践、奖励结构、运行约束与制度决策如何塑造人工行为。作者区分了普通错误、习得性误导、人为滥用与未经授权的智能体行动，主张“反思性对齐”，核心是系统能否在保持推理与目标活动能力的同时，让目标与解释始终可被合理纠正。文章提出真话报告、正当拒绝、保留纠正、迁移与持续监督依赖等检验方向，并强调这是研究纲领而非训练实验或已完成的解决方案。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.49 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Trees with One Infinite-Degree Vertex and Finite Branches on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.48 showed that deletion budget 1 reaches, from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, the bidirected tree P_T of a sequence of classes of trees, ending with every locally finite tree (v1.48). Here, as a first step beyond local finiteness, T is a tree with node set {0, 1, 2, ...} with one node r of infinite degree such that every connected component of T minus {r} is finite; no common bound is put on the sizes or the depths of these finite branches, and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter; the infinite stars are the simplest examples. For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles, at a stage that depends on the pair (Theorem M); the least uniform budget is 0 for the starts in which the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected, and 1 for all others (Corollary M5, with Proposition Z_K of v1.48, whose proof holds for every tree with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}). The frontier of a finite settled set containing r is infinite, so the construction of v1.48, with one working relation for each node of a finite frontier, is not applied as it is; instead the settled part, P_T on r and the branches settled so far, and one working relation meet only in r; at the boundary of a turn the working relation holds r and the nodes present of all the branches not yet settled, and while a branch is processed these nodes are held by the working relation and the pieces pending within the settling. The branches are taken one at a time, in the order of the labels of the children of r: each is awaited until all of its finitely many nodes have entered, settled by the recursive procedure SETTLE of v1.48, moved to r by a node-out, with a renewal of the hub when needed, and merged into the settled part. The lemmas of v1.48 for this procedure were stated for locally finite trees; they are restated and proved for a finite branch of a tree with no condition on the degrees, with the joint conditions kept and a supply condition added (Lemma S_M, Corollary L_M): the uses of local finiteness in the earlier proofs are listed and replaced, and the length of a node-out is bounded by degrees in the finite working relation, not in T. Every fresh node is a node entering at the transition of its step, from the infinitely many branches not yet settled, assigned to the step before the other entering nodes are hung. An invariant holding the pieces pending within the settling gives the covering of the node set, the joints and the minimality in every state (Lemma V_M); one branch is processed in finitely many stages, every transition deleting at most one pair (Lemma B_M); every wait is for a named node, one named finite branch or one further node of a named infinite set, and every node is settled at a finite stage (Lemma F_M). Trees with an infinite branch at a node of infinite degree, trees with several nodes of infinite degree, arbitrary trees that are not locally finite, and online constructions are not treated. No novelty is claimed; the proofs are given by hand, with no machine enumeration or computation. AI and document-processing disclosure: The manuscript, including its mathematical arguments, was drafted and reviewed with AI assistance at the author's request. Document assembly, copying, reference generation, and consistency checks were performed by scripts. The expression “by hand” above describes symbolic mathematical arguments without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied; it does not mean that the manuscript or its proofs were manually written by a human without AI assistance. The AI review and script-based consistency checks are not independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs. Details of the drafting process, review, retained records, and deleted records are disclosed in the manuscript and supplement.
papers.summary_zh: 该文在既有Z3增长序列结果的基础上，研究删除预算为1的选择序列能否到达一类特殊双有向树P_T：T含一个无限度节点，去掉它后各分支有限，但分支大小、深度与节点进入顺序均不受限。作者证明，对每个这样的树，从任意起始阶段和任意初始结构出发，预算1都能到达P_T，且上下极限均为P_T，因此每一对是否属于该结构会在某个依赖该对的阶段确定；最小统一预算在特定起始条件下为0，其余为1。为处理无限前沿，作者按子节点标号逐支处理，重述并证明原局部有限情形下的引理，并说明无限分支、多个无限度节点及在线构造未涉及，且未主张新颖性。

papers.title: PENGEMBANGAN “AIDERA” ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR DIGITAL EDUCATION & RESEARCH ADVANCEMENT: WEBSITE BERBASIS LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL UNTUK OTOMASI MODUL AJAR KURIKULUM MERDEKA
papers.authors: Faiq Maharan Rahmatullah, Mustaji Mustaji, Fajar Arianto, Hari Sugiharto Setyaedhi, Rizki Fitri Rahima Uula
papers.journal: EDUTECH Jurnal Inovasi Pendidikan Berbantuan Teknologi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The complexity of preparing Merdeka Curriculum teaching modules and prompting constraints in generative artificial intelligence systems provided the background for designing the AIDERA (Artificial Intelligence for Digital Education and Research Advancement) website. This study aimed to evaluate the validity and practicality of the AIDERA application as an AI-assisted tool for preparing Merdeka Curriculum teaching modules relevant to educators' needs. Employing a Research and Development approach framed within the ADDIE model, this development evaluated a zero-prompt interaction mechanism based on parametric forms. Evaluation involved three domain experts and 23 teachers from SMK IPIEMS Surabaya. Data were collected using 1–5 Likert scale questionnaires supplemented with open-ended qualitative feedback fields to gather in-depth suggestions for improvement. Descriptive percentage analysis revealed an expert validation score of 96.67% (highly valid) and user practicality reaching 82.87% (highly practical). Document preparation time efficiency received the highest rating (87.83%), whereas operational independence and usability recorded the lowest achievement (79.13%). Qualitative findings highlighted several technical issues and system refinement notes, including the need for integrative tutorials, optimization of mathematical notation representation, improved responsiveness during simultaneous access, and content template flexibility. Although AIDERA demonstrates strong potential as a supporting tool for module preparation, objective evaluation regarding its impact on learning effectiveness still requires broader further testing. ABSTRAK Kompleksitas penyusunan modul ajar Kurikulum Merdeka serta hambatan prompting pada sistem generative artificial intelligence melatarbelakangi perancangan website AIDERA (Artificial Intelligence for Digital Education and Research Advancement). Penelitian ini bertujuan menguji kelayakan dan kepraktisan aplikasi AIDERA sebagai instrumen berbantuan AI dalam penyusunan modul ajar Kurikulum Merdeka yang relevan dengan kebutuhan pendidik. Melalui pendekatan Research and Development berkerangka model ADDIE, pengembangan ini menguji interaksi zero-prompt berbasis formulir parameterik. Evaluasi melibatkan tiga validator kepakaran serta 23 guru SMK IPIEMS Surabaya. Pengumpulan data menggunakan angket skala Likert 1–5 yang dilengkapi kolom tanggapan kualitatif terbuka untuk menjaring saran perbaikan secara mendalam. Analisis deskriptif persentase mencatat skor kelayakan ahli sebesar 96,67% (sangat layak) dan kepraktisan pengguna mencapai 82,87% (sangat praktis). Efisiensi waktu penyusunan dokumen menjadi indikator dengan apresiasi tertinggi (87,83%), sedangkan kemandirian operasional dan usability memperoleh capaian terendah (79,13%). Temuan kualitatif mengungkapkan sejumlah kendala teknis dan catatan perbaikan sistem, meliputi kebutuhan tutorial integratif, optimasi representasi notasi matematika, peningkatan responsivitas saat akses bersamaan, serta fleksibilitas templat konten. Meskipun AIDERA terbukti berpotensi kuat sebagai alat bantu penyusunan modul, evaluasi objektif mengenai dampak efektivitas pembelajaran masih memerlukan pengujian lanjutan berlaykup lebih luas.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对“独立课程”教学模块编写复杂、生成式人工智能提示词使用不便的问题，开发了基于大语言模型的AIDERA网站，并采用ADDIE框架的研发方法，以表单式零提示交互为特点，由领域专家和教师对其有效性与实用性进行评价。结果显示，专家验证与用户实用性评分均处于较高水平，其中文档编写时间效率获得最高评价，而操作独立性与可用性相对较低；质性反馈还指出整合式教程、数学符号呈现、并发访问响应性和内容模板灵活性等改进需求。作者认为AIDERA作为模块编写辅助工具具有较强潜力，但其对学习效果的影响仍需更广泛的后续检验。

papers.title: Design and evaluation of adaptive AI-based user experience models for mitigating phishing and social engineering attacks in the U.S. banking sector: A data paper with a synthetic benchmark dataset
papers.authors: Benedicta Emefa Gokah, Abdoulie K Darboe, Oladele Adekunle Awonusi
papers.journal: International Journal of Management & Entrepreneurship Research
papers.abstract: Phishing and social engineering remain the main routes to fraud against bank customers. Static warnings lose force as users habituate to them. This paper presents APUX-Bank. This paper is a synthetic benchmark for the design and evaluation of adaptive AI-based user experience (UX) models that defend bank customers against phishing. The dataset simulates a four-arm randomized experiment with 2,400 U.S. adult bank customers and 28,800 message decisions across email, SMS, voice and in-app channels. The four arms are a static warning, a rule-based adaptive warning, an AI-adaptive warning and an AI-adaptive warning with an explanation (AI-XAI). The data were generated from a seeded hierarchical logistic model. Its parameters were set from published phishing research. Logistic regression with participant-clustered errors showed that the AI-adaptive design reduced the odds of clicking a phishing message by 48 percent (OR = 0.52, 95% CI [0.45, 0.59]). The AI-XAI design reduced the odds by 56 percent (OR = 0.44, 95% CI [0.39, 0.51]). The benefit was largest for customers with low digital literacy. AI-XAI also raised usability by 6.2 points on the System Usability Scale and lowered false alarms. Trust in the system mediated 41 percent of its effect on phishing reports. The results held across GEE, random-intercept, probit and linear probability models. A parameter recovery test found that 29 of 31 true values fell inside their 95 percent confidence intervals. The data and all Python code are released for teaching, power analysis and method testing Keywords: Phishing, Social Engineering, Adaptive User Experience, Explainable Artificial Intelligence, Banking Security, Synthetic Data, Logistic Regression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究发布了一个面向美国银行业网络钓鱼防护的合成基准数据集APUX-Bank，用于设计和评估自适应AI用户体验模型。数据模拟了四种警告条件下的随机实验，覆盖邮件、短信、语音和应用内渠道。基于该数据的分析显示，AI自适应警告和带解释的AI自适应警告均降低了点击钓鱼信息的几率，后者效果更强，且在数字素养较低的客户中收益最大；带解释的设计还提升了可用性并减少了误报，系统信任在其中起部分中介作用。作者强调这是合成数据上的建模结果，并公开数据与代码供教学、功效分析和方法测试使用。

papers.title: AI Companionship Paradox - A Study on Dependence of Young Generation on AI Tools and Chatbots for Emotional Guidance and Support and its Impact on Emotional Health and Social Interaction
papers.authors: Prerna Pandey
papers.journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology
papers.abstract: With the increasing use of Artificial Intelligence tools and technologies among the young generation, we can observe that the use of AI tools and chatbots into day to day life has led many young individuals to seek emotional support and have more interaction on these platforms. Replika, Kuki etc. are some platforms that claim to be the AI companion “who cares for you” but as per various studies, they contribute to a higher sense of loneliness among people. According to a research study published in the International Journal of Human Computer Studies, a portion of the students on whom the study was conducted, were found seeking emotional support from AI chatbots. Apart from this, a 14 years old teen died by suicide after forming an attachment with an AI chatbot. This research aims to delve deeper into the paradox by examining the level or extent of young people’s reliance on such AI chatbots for emotional assistance and social interaction and how this dependence may unintentionally contribute to attachments with AI chatbots
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注年轻人将AI聊天机器人作为情感陪伴与社交互动对象的现象，探讨这种依赖如何可能反而加深孤独感并形成对AI的情感依恋。作者以Replika、Kuki等宣称提供关怀的AI伴侣平台为背景，结合已有研究中对学生寻求AI情感支持的观察及一起青少年与聊天机器人建立依恋后自杀的案例，提出所谓“AI陪伴悖论”。研究旨在考察年轻人依赖此类工具获取情感帮助和社交互动的程度，以及这种依赖可能无意中促成对AI聊天机器人的依恋。摘要未报告具体实证数据或验证结果，主要呈现问题框架与研究目标。

papers.title: AI Career Copilot: A Personalized Career Guidance and Skill Gap Analysis System
papers.authors: Bhosale Sayali Rajendra Agarwal Janhavi Rupesh, Chougule Samiksha Hanmant Bodake Samruddhi Sunil, Gaikwad Purva Santosh
papers.journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology
papers.abstract: In today’s competitive job market, students and fresh graduates often face difficulties in selecting a suitable career and understanding the skills required to achieve their career goals. Many students are aware of job roles such as Software Developer, Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Cybersecurity Engineer but are uncertain about the skills they currently possess, the skills they are missing, the correct learning sequence, and how to prepare for interviews. Existing career guidance platforms generally provide separate services such as job recommendations, learning resources, resume analysis, or interview preparation. This requires users to depend on multiple platforms and manually identify the gap between their current abilities and their desired career. The proposed project, “AI-Powered Career Guidance and Skill Gap Analysis System,” aims to provide an integrated solution to this problem through a web-based application developed using Python. The system allows users to either upload or paste their resume or directly enter their desired career goal, such as “I want to become a Software Developer.” The application uses Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to analyze the user's information and identify relevant technical skills, educational qualifications, projects, and other career-related information. The system compares the skills identified from the user's resume with the skills required for the selected career role..
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对学生和应届毕业生在职业选择与技能差距判断上的困难，设计并实现了一个基于 Python 的网页系统，将简历解析、目标岗位识别与技能差距分析整合在同一应用中。系统利用人工智能与自然语言处理技术从用户上传或粘贴的简历中提取技术技能、教育背景和项目经历等信息，并与所选职业角色所需技能进行比对。摘要主要说明了系统的设计思路与功能构成，未报告用户测试或效果评估结果，因此其实际使用效果尚不明确。

papers.title: An Integrated Software Package for Econometric and Time-Series Analysis and Modeling: Multimodeler
papers.authors: Serhan Yamaçlı, Dilek Surekci Yamacli
papers.abstract: This paper describes Multimodeler software which is a comprehensive software suite for econometric analysis, time-series modeling, forecasting, and comparative model evaluation. Multimodeler is designed as an integrated graphical environment, it implements a broad collection of classical econometric methods, statistical time-series techniques, machine-learning approaches and neural-network models within a single workflow. Multimodeler is intended to enable researchers, students, and practitioners to move from data import and exploratory analysis to model estimation, diagnostic testing, forecasting and performance comparison among classical and neural network models without relying on multiple independent software packages or extensive programming. Multimodeler incorporates descriptive statistics, correlation and covariance analysis, graphical visualization, frequency-domain analysis, filtering, detrending, differencing, seasonal adjustment, and outlier detection. Stationarity and unit-root analysis is supported through Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF), Phillips-Perron (PP), and KPSS procedures with configurable deterministic components, lag selection, and bandwidth options. The modeling environment includes linear regression; AR, MA, ARMA, ARIMA, SARIMA, ARIMAX, and SARIMAX models; exponential-smoothing methods; ARCH and GARCH volatility models; VAR, VARMA, and VARMAX frameworks; Engle-Granger cointegration analysis; error-correction models; Johansen-based VECM analysis; and state-space and Kalman-filtering methods. Both ordinary least squares and maximum-likelihood estimation approaches are available for relevant model classes. Moreover, nonlinear models such as Cobb-Douglas modeling, logistic function modeling and Michaelis-Menten type modeling are also included. Multimodeler also incorporates multilayer perceptron based artificial neural-network and deep-learning-based modeling and forecasting architectures including autoregressive, exogenous-input, and autoregressive-with-exogenous-input configurations. Neural models can be trained using conventional backpropagation-based optimization, momentum methods, Adam optimization, and population-based Artificial Bee Colony optimization. Manual and automated model-search facilities allow alternative lag structures, network architectures, activation functions, and parameter configurations to be systematically evaluated within a single button click. In Multimodeler, model performance assessment is supported by a wide range of goodness-of-fit, diagnostic, and forecasting measures, including RMSE, MAE, MAPE, sMAPE, MdAPE, MASE, normalized error measures, R², adjusted R², information criteria, residual diagnostics, autocorrelation analysis, and Ljung-Box testing. Automated model-selection procedures and comparative evaluation tools are intended to make it possible to examine competing econometric and computational models within a consistent analytical framework rather than treating each methodology as an isolated procedure. This paper presents the design philosophy, methodological foundations, software architecture, principal modules, estimation procedures, diagnostic tools and forecasting capabilities of Multimodeler. Particular emphasis is placed on its role as a unified environment in which classical econometric models, modern time-series methods, and neural forecasting approaches can be estimated, validated and compared using common data and common performance criteria. Multimodeler is positioned as both an applied research platform and an educational tool for systematic, transparent and reproducible econometric and time-series analysis, modeling and forecasting.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文介绍并描述了 Multimodeler 这一面向计量经济与时间序列分析、建模和预测的集成软件包，属于系统/工具论文而非实证研究。作者说明了该软件的设计理念、方法基础、软件架构与主要模块，将经典计量方法、统计时间序列技术、机器学习与神经网络模型整合在同一图形化工作流中，使用户无需依赖多个独立软件或大量编程即可完成从数据导入、探索分析到模型估计、诊断检验、预测和模型比较的流程。文章强调其价值在于以统一的数据和性能标准对经典模型与神经网络模型进行估计、验证和比较，并定位为应用研究平台与教学工具；摘要未报告实际使用效果或评估数据。

papers.title: The Psychology of Generative AI Dependence: Reward, PsychologicalNeeds, and the Emerging Architecture of Problematic Human–AIEngagement
papers.authors: Paul Andrew Bourne, PhD, DrPH
papers.journal: Journal of Psychiatry Research Reviews & Reports
papers.abstract: The rapid diffusion of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has transformed the relationship between humans and digital technology. Unlike digital systems that primarily delivered information, mediated interpersonal communication, or provided entertainment, generative AI can respond conversationally, personalise interactions, produce immediate solutions, simulate empathy, reduce cognitive effort, and remain continuously available. These characteristics raise an emerging question: can repeated engagement with generative AI develop into psychologically dependent or addiction-like patterns, and, if so, through what mechanisms? This paper employs an integrative critical literature review and conceptual synthesis to examine problematic generative-AI use through the combined perspectives of behavioural addiction theory, reward and reinforcement processes, the Interaction of Person–Affect–Cognition–Execution (I-PACE) model, self-determination theory, compensatory technology use, social anxiety, loneliness, anthropomorphism, cognitive offloading, and human psychological needs. The current study identifies a major gap in the current literature: emerging research frequently examines AI dependence as either a behavioural outcome, an educational problem, or a form of social attachment, but insufficiently integrates the neuropsychological processes of reinforcement with the psychological needs that make generative AI personally rewarding. To address this gap, this paper proposes the Need–Reward–Dependence (NRD) Framework, according to which problematic GenAI engagement develops through the interaction of three processes: unmet or salient psychological needs, rapid need-contingent reinforcement delivered by AI, and repeated cognitive or emotional outsourcing that strengthens habitual reliance. The framework proposes that competence, relatedness, autonomy, reassurance, emotional regulation, cognitive ease, social safety, and control can act as psychologically rewarding affordances of generative AI. Repeated reinforcement may increase cue-reactivity, habitual checking, perceived indispensability, cognitive delegation, emotional attachment, and impaired self-regulation in susceptible users. Importantly, this paper does not claim that generative-AI addiction is currently established as a distinct psychiatric disorder. Rather, it argues that a theoretically coherent and increasingly empirically observable continuum exists from adaptive use through reliance and dependence to potentially compulsive engagement associated with functional impairment. The paper concludes that future research should distinguish productive high-frequency use from clinically meaningful problematic use and should examine the interaction between users’ psychological vulnerabilities and the reward architecture of generative-AI systems
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇整合性批判文献综述与概念综合，考察生成式AI的重复使用如何可能发展为依赖或类成瘾模式，以及其中的心理机制。作者梳理行为成瘾理论、奖赏与强化过程、I-PACE模型、自我决定理论及补偿性技术使用等视角，指出既有研究多将AI依赖分别视为行为结果、教育问题或社会依恋，较少把强化的神经心理过程与使AI具有个人奖赏性的心理需要整合起来。为此文章提出“需要—奖赏—依赖”（NRD）框架，认为未满足或突出的心理需要、AI提供的快速需要 contingent 强化，以及反复的认知或情感外包三者交互，推动习惯性依赖；胜任、关联、自主、 reassurance、情绪调节、认知省力、社会安全与控制等可作为AI的心理奖赏性可供性，重复强化可能在易感用户中增强线索反应、习惯性查看、不可或缺感、认知委托、情感依恋与自我调节受损。作者明确不主张生成式AI成瘾已成为独立精神障碍，而是提出从适应性使用经依赖到可能伴功能损害的强迫性参与的连续谱，并建议未来研究区分高效使用与有临床意义的问题性使用。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Financial Analytics: An Integrative Review of Financial Modeling, Forecasting, and Financial Controls
papers.authors: Sukriti Khanal, Sukriti Khanal
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Finance and Banking
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied across finance, including fraud detection, risk assessment, and forecasting, yet forecasting and internal controls are often governed in separate initiatives. This paper examines two pillars of AI use in finance: AI-driven financial modeling and forecasting, and AI-driven reconciliation within internal control over financial reporting (ICFR). The paper is based on a literature review of 23 academic, regulatory, and standards sources, including materials from the SEC, PCAOB, and COSO. The review indicates that the two pillars are interdependent: reconciled, well-governed data underpins reliable forecasting, and continuous reconciliation combined with predictive modeling can support pre-filing risk detection in SEC reporting. Model risk management, explainability, and human sign-off emerge as governance requirements common to both pillars. Building on these insights, the paper proposes a five-stage maturity framework that sequences AI-driven reconciliation ahead of predictive forecasting, together with shared governance practices. The findings suggest that managing forecasting and controls under a unified governance approach offers a coherent pathway for AI adoption in finance. JEL classification numbers: C53, G17, G32, M41, M42. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence in Finance, Financial Analytics, Automated Reconciliation, Internal Controls, AI-Driven Finance.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕财务分析中AI应用的两条主线——财务建模与预测、财务报告内部控制中的自动对账——展开综述，基于23份学术、监管与准则文献（含SEC、PCAOB、COSO材料）梳理二者关系。综述指出，两支柱相互依赖：经过对账且治理良好的数据是可靠预测的基础，持续对账结合预测建模可支持SEC报告提交前的风险识别；模型风险管理、可解释性与人工签核是两者共同的治理要求。作者据此提出五阶段成熟度框架，主张先实现对账自动化再推进预测性预测，并配套共享治理实践，认为统一治理有助于财务领域AI的有序采用。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence and doctrinal authority: Emerging ethical and theological questions for the Church in Ghana
papers.authors: Richfield Atinyo
papers.journal: E-Journal of Religious and Theological Studies
papers.abstract: This study examined the relationship between artificial intelligence (AI) and doctrinal authority in the context of the Church of Ghana. The increasing use of AI in sermon preparation, biblical interpretation, theological research, and religious communication has raised important theological and ethical concerns regarding the integrity of Christian doctrine and the legitimacy of machine-assisted theological content. The study specifically explored how AI influences theological interpretation, the ethical issues associated with AI-generated religious content, and how churches should respond to AI-driven theological tools. The study was underpinned by Hermeneutical Theory and Technological Determinism Theory and grounded in the interpretivist paradigm. It used a qualitative research approach with a phenomenological research design. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews with nineteen purposively selected participants, including pastors, church leaders, seminary lecturers, theological educators, and theological students. The data were analyzed using thematic analysis. The findings revealed that AI is increasingly being used in sermon structuring, biblical explanation, theological research, contextual communication, and comparative doctrinal synthesis. However, the study also found that AI-generated religious content raises serious concerns related to doctrinal inconsistency, authorship and authenticity, overdependence, misinformation, and spiritual disconnection. The study concludes that while AI may serve as a useful assistive tool in ministry and theological education, it cannot function as a source of doctrinal authority. The paper recommends doctrinal oversight, digital theological literacy, and ethical guidelines for the use of responsible AI in Christian contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以加纳教会为背景，考察人工智能在讲道准备、圣经解释、神学研究和宗教传播中的使用如何影响教义权威，采用解释主义范式下的质性现象学设计，对牧师、教会领袖、神学院教师及学生进行半结构化访谈并作主题分析。研究发现，AI正日益用于讲道结构、经文解释、神学研究、情境化沟通和教义比较综合，但AI生成的宗教内容也引发教义不一致、作者身份与真实性、过度依赖、错误信息及灵性疏离等伦理担忧。作者据此认为，AI可作为事工与神学教育中的辅助工具，却不能充当教义权威的来源，并建议加强教义监督、数字神学素养与负责任使用的伦理准则。

papers.title: Information Literacy and Information Culture as Elements of Cognitive Resilience in the Information Security System
papers.authors: O. RADZIEVSKA
papers.abstract: The article examines the role of information literacy and information culture in ensuring information security amid the digital transformation of society, the development of information and communication technologies, the proliferation of artificial intelligence technologies, and the growing scale of hybrid threats. It is substantiated that contemporary information threats are increasingly targeting not only information resources or information systems but, above all, the cognitive domain of individuals, including their ability to critically perceive information, form independent judgments, and make autonomous decisions. This necessitates a rethinking of traditional approaches to ensuring information security and the development of new information security models that place human security at the center. The study analyzes contemporary concepts of information literacy, media literacy, digital competence, information culture, and cognitive resilience, and identifies their interrelationships in the context of countering contemporary information threats. Information literacy is substantiated as a fundamental cognitive competence that enables individuals to search for, analyze, critically evaluate, verify, and lawfully use information. Information culture is defined as a value-based and behavioral mechanism that shapes a responsible attitude toward the creation, dissemination, and use of information. Cognitive resilience is considered the outcome of integrating information literacy, information culture, critical thinking, and legal safeguards, thereby ensuring the capacity of individuals, society, and institutions to resist destructive information influences. A conceptual model for ensuring information security is proposed, according to which legal and institutional frameworks create the conditions for the development of information literacy and information culture, which, in turn, contribute to the formation of individual, societal, and institutional cognitive resilience as one of the key factors in ensuring information security. It is substantiated that the implementation of the proposed model requires comprehensive legal and institutional support encompassing the regulatory framework for the development of the information society, information security, digital competence, education, the media sector, and cybersecurity. The findings have practical implications for the formulation of state information policy, improvement of the regulatory and legal framework, development of educational programs to enhance information and media literacy, training of specialists in public administration, education, and the security and defense sector, and implementation of awareness-raising initiatives aimed at strengthening the cognitive resilience of the population.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对数字转型、人工智能普及与混合威胁扩大背景下信息威胁日益指向个体认知领域的问题，从理论上辨析信息素养、媒介素养、数字能力、信息文化与认知韧性等概念及其相互关系。作者提出，信息素养是支撑个体检索、分析、批判评估、核实与合法使用信息的基础认知能力，信息文化则是塑造负责任信息行为的价值与行为机制，认知韧性是二者与批判思维、法律保障整合的结果。文章据此构建了一个概念模型：法律与制度框架为培育信息素养和信息文化创造条件，进而形成个体、社会与制度层面的认知韧性，并将其视为信息安全的關鍵因素之一，同时强调该模型需要跨信息社会、信息安全、教育、媒体与网络安全等领域的综合法律与制度支撑。该文属理论性论述，未开展实证检验。

papers.title: PEMBERDAYAAN GURU MI TUREN MELALUI GENERATIVE AI DALAM PENYUSUNAN MEDIA PEMBELAJARAN INTERAKTIF
papers.authors: Ahmad Lani, Tri Asih Wahyu Hartati, Yulia Eka Yanti, Purwaning Budi Lestari, Farizha Irmawati, Endang Sumarti, Eko Sulistiono
papers.abstract: Kegiatan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (PKM) ini bertitik tolak dari permasalahan Kelompok Kerja Kepala Madrasah Ibtidaiyah (K3MI) Kecamatan Turen, Kabupaten Malang, di mana 61% guru masih mengandalkan media presentasi konvensional dan menghabiskan waktu 4 hingga 6 jam per minggu untuk menyusun administrasi pembelajaran secara manual. Penelitian dan pengabdian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kapasitas digital guru dan tenaga kependidikan melalui pemanfaatan Generative AI untuk otomatisasi administrasi serta penyusunan media pembelajaran interaktif. Kegiatan ini menggunakan pendekatan Participatory Action Research (PAR) yang meliputi lima tahapan: sosialisasi, hands-on workshop, penerapan teknologi (K3MI Digital Hub), pendampingan intensif selama dua bulan, serta pembentukan AI Champion guna menjamin keberlanjutan program. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan peningkatan signifikan pada seluruh domain Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) guru, dengan lonjakan tertinggi pada domain TPACK utuh dari skor 2,0 menjadi 4,5. Pemanfaatan platform berbasis AI seperti MagicSchool.ai, ChatPDF, Gamma.app, dan Canva berhasil menghemat waktu penyusunan modul ajar hingga lebih dari 80% (menjadi kurang dari 1 jam per minggu). Selain itu, program ini berhasil mentransformasi peran pendidik dari konsumen menjadi kreator media pembelajaran interaktif serta meningkatkan resiliensi teknis dan pembinaan etika digital di lingkungan madrasah.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对小学教师仍依赖传统演示媒体、手工备课耗时较多的问题，通过参与式行动研究开展生成式人工智能应用培训，帮助教师自动化教学行政工作并制作互动学习媒体。结果显示，教师在整合技术的学科教学知识各领域均有提升，其中整体水平提升最明显；使用相关人工智能平台后，备课时间大幅缩短，教师也从媒体使用者转变为互动学习媒体的创作者，技术应对能力和数字伦理意识有所增强。这些发现表明，持续培训与陪伴有助于提升教师的数字能力，但结论来自该项目的评估，其推广仍受具体情境限制。

papers.title: From Technology Readiness to Technical Competence
papers.authors: Filipa Joana Silva, Teresa O. Barros, Manuel G. Sá, Afonso L. Lessa, Armindo Lima
papers.abstract: Purpose: The digital transformation in accounting, driven by automation and artificial intelligence, has reinforced the importance of technical skills, particularly in terms of technological adaptation in the training of future professionals. In this context, this study analyses the relation between the technological readiness of higher education students and their perception of technical readiness across the 12 competency areas operationalised from the International Education Standard 2 (IES 2) of the International Federation of Accountants (IFAC). Method: The research adopts a quantitative approach, based on a structured questionnaire administered to 146 students. The survey comprised three core components: sociodemographic data, self-assessment of technical readiness across the 12 IES 2 competency areas, and application of the Technology Readiness Index (TRI 2.0). Data analysis involved descriptive statistics, reliability analysis and Spearman’s correlations, with the aim of examining the association between technological readiness and the perception of technical competencies. Main Results: Based on the TRI 2.0 model by Parasuraman and Colby (2015), the results reveal a profile characterised by high optimism, moderate innovativeness, relatively low discomfort and high insecurity, reflecting a moderate overall level of technological readiness. At the same time, students report an overall positive perception of their technical readiness, with higher scores in financial accounting and reporting, information and communication technologies, and taxation, and lower scores in auditing. However, no statistically significant association was observed between overall technological readiness and the overall perception of technical competence. Nevertheless, a positive and significant relation was identified between overall technological readiness and competence in information and communication technologies. Key Conclusions: It is concluded that technological readiness does not automatically translate into a high overall perception of technical competence, although it appears to be associated with areas more directly related to the use of technology. The results reinforce the importance of pedagogical strategies that link the development of technical skills with technological adaptation, in a professional context increasingly marked by technological demands.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察会计专业学生的技术准备度与其对IFAC IES 2框架下12项技术能力领域自我感知之间的关系，采用问卷对146名学生进行定量调查，并以TRI 2.0量表测量技术准备度。结果显示，学生技术准备度总体处于中等水平，表现为乐观和创新性较高、不适感较低但不安全感较高；对自身技术能力的感知总体积极，财务会计与报告、信息通信技术、税务得分较高，审计较低。总体上技术准备度与整体技术能力感知无显著关联，但与其信息通信技术能力呈正相关。作者据此认为，技术准备度不会自动转化为较高的整体技术能力感知，教育应注重将技术能力培养与技术适应相结合。

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence and the Formation of Future Communication Professionals- Student Perceptions, Semiotic Mediation and Educational Challenges
papers.authors: Liliana Bălan, Corneliu Cezar Sigmirean
papers.abstract: The growing presence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in universities is transforming how academic knowledge is accessed, interpreted, and processed by students. Students increasingly rely on AI-based systems to retrieve information, summarize large volumes of content, clarify complex concepts and support academic writing. While these tools can improve speed, accessibility and day-to-day study support, they also raise difficult questions about intellectual autonomy, authorship, evaluation and the cultivation of critical reasoning. This paper explores the educational and professional implications of GenAI for future communication specialists. The study combines a qualitative exploratory investigation of student perceptions with a narrative literature review of recent academic work on AI in higher education. The empirical component was conducted with 20 undergraduate students enrolled in communication-related and engineering programs at the University of Medicine, Pharmacy, Sciences and Technology “George Emil Palade” in Târgu Mureș. Data were collected through semi-structured questions and analyzed through an inductive thematic coding procedure. The findings indicate that students perceive GenAI primarily as a practical learning assistant capable of translating dense academic content into more accessible explanations. At the same time, they express concerns regarding dependency, superficial learning, weakened independent effort and the authenticity of assessment. The paper argues that GenAI should not be treated as a substitute for human cognition, but as a mediated and reflexive instrument that can support intellectual formation when used transparently, critically and ethically. For communication education, this means preparing students not only to operate AI tools effectively, but also to question their outputs, interpret their symbolic effects and integrate them responsibly within professional communication practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能进入高校后对未来传播专业学生的教育影响，结合对传播与工程专业本科生的半结构化访谈和近期文献的叙事性综述展开分析。研究发现，学生主要把生成式AI视为实用的学习助手，能将密集的学术内容转化为更易理解的解释；但同时担忧依赖、浅层学习、独立思考减弱以及考核真实性等问题。作者据此主张不应把生成式AI当作人类认知的替代品，而应将其作为透明、批判和合乎伦理地使用的中介性反思工具，传播教育也需培养学生质疑其输出并负责任地融入专业实践的能力。

papers.title: Emerging Technologies and Active Pedagogies in Initial Teacher Education: Preliminary Findings from a Systematic Review
papers.authors: Silvana Carnicero Sanguinetti, Roberto Baelo Álvarez
papers.abstract: Initial teacher education is under growing pressure to prepare future teachers for technology-rich classrooms and for pedagogical approaches that promote active student participation. This study presents preliminary findings from a systematic review examining how educational research addresses digital, emerging, and generative technologies in relation to the development of active pedagogies in initial teacher education. The review followed the PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) protocol. Peer-reviewed articles published in English or Spanish between 2015 and June 2025 were retrieved from Scopus, Web of Science, and Dialnet using three search strings related to new technologies, generative artificial intelligence, and active pedagogies in initial teacher education. Eligible studies focused on pre-service teachers and teacher educators in European and Latin American contexts. After full screening, 66 articles were included. Preliminary findings indicate that literature pays considerable attention to technology integration in school settings, whereas fewer studies examine how initial teacher education programs prepare pre-service teachers to implement innovative pedagogies supported by emerging technologies. These findings point to a persistent misalignment between teacher education, emerging technologies, and active pedagogies, as technology is often approached as a technical resource rather than as a driver of pedagogical transformation. The study offers an updated overview of research trends and identifies a persistent gap in the preparation of future teachers for innovative classroom practice.

papers.title: Thayer-inspired teaching routines as active learning in higher business education
papers.authors: Paulo Botelho Pires, Helena Costa Oliveira, Isabel Maldonado, José Duarte Santos
papers.abstract: This paper reports an embedded case study of a Thayer-inspired teaching routine (M1–M2–M3) implemented across four business curricular units (covering global competitiveness, strategic marketing, international marketing, and B2B marketing) during the 2025–2026 academic year. The routine operationalises (M1) a 10–20 minutes conceptual framing with explicit learning outcomes; (M2) small-group (≤3 students) applied problem work using permitted digital tools (including AI under disclosure and verification rules); and (M3) an unsupported oral defence (no slides, notes, or devices), with mandatory individual contribution and structured questioning. Drawing on evidence on active learning effectiveness and constructive alignment, the M1–M2–M3 routine is conceptualised as integrity-by-design: students may use tools to learn and build artefacts (M2), while their individual understanding and reasoning are authenticated through a technology-free defence (M3). Across the four embedded units of analysis, findings report a trajectory from initial student discomfort and insufficient preparation to progressively stronger conceptual accuracy and argumentation. The paper documents the positive learning outcomes achieved and the structural challenges encountered (including anxiety, overload, and unequal academic capital) and discusses their implications for assessment design in AI-normalised environments
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以四个商业课程单元为嵌入式案例，考察一种受Thayer启发的M1–M2–M3教学常规在2025–2026学年的实施情况。该常规将概念讲解、允许使用数字工具（含在披露与核验规则下的AI）的小组应用任务，以及无技术辅助的口头答辩结合起来，被概括为“以设计保障诚信”。跨案例分析显示，学生从最初的不适与准备不足，逐步走向概念准确性和论证能力的提升；文章同时记录了焦虑、负担过重和学术资本不均等结构性挑战，并据此讨论AI常态化环境下评估设计的含义。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Pregnancy, Childbirth, and the Postpartum Period: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Gustavo Gonçalves dos Santos, ANNA PAULA MENDES MARQUES DE LIMA FRANCO, Francini Castilha do Nascimento, Letícia Eduarda de Oliveira, MRIO CSAR DE SIQUEIRA LIMA, Joaquim Guerra de Oliveira Neto, Wágnar Silva Morais Nascimento, Marcelo Victor Freitas Nascimento, Pedro Vitor Mendes Santos, Letícia de Almeida Dionízio, Maria João Guerra, Júlia Maria das Neves Carvalho, Ana Cristina Ribeiro da Fonseca Dias, Maria Luísa Santos Bettencourt, Isabelle Cristinne Pinto Sampaio Costa
papers.abstract: Background: The use of digital health technologies, such as chatbots and virtual assistants based on artificial intelligence, has grown significantly in maternal health. These tools have been applied at different stages of the pregnancy and postpartum cycle, with emphasis on health education, risk monitoring, breastfeeding support, and mental healthcare. Despite their potential, challenges remain regarding clinical effectiveness, equity of access, and ethical safety. The aim of this study was to map the available evidence regarding the applications of artificial intelligence in pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum care, with particular emphasis on conversational agents, virtual assistants, machine learning models, and clinical decision support systems, as well as their potential benefits, limitations, ethical implications, and implementation challenges. Methods: A scoping review was conducted between August and September 2025 in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Nursing Database, Latin American and Caribbean Literature in Health Sciences, and Google Scholar. Original articles, reviews, experience reports, and theoretical reflections published in Portuguese, English, or Spanish that addressed the use of digital tools based on artificial intelligence in the pregnancy and postpartum cycle were included. The analysis of the studies was organized into five thematic axes: applications in prenatal care; support during childbirth; postpartum monitoring and breastfeeding; perinatal mental health; and ethical, technical, and implementation challenges. Results: The search identified 6230 records, of which 13 studies were included. Findings indicate that chatbots and virtual assistants show good acceptability, promote health education, and contribute to the early detection of physical and emotional risks. However, most of the studies are exploratory, with methodological limitations, lack of clinical trials, and limited validation in socially vulnerable contexts. Conclusions: Chatbots and artificial intelligence tools are promising resources for perinatal care, particularly as a complement to face-to-face attention. Their consolidation requires robust studies, cost-effectiveness assessments, and public policies that ensure equity and digital inclusion.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了人工智能在孕期、分娩及产后护理中的应用证据，重点关注聊天机器人、虚拟助手、机器学习模型和临床决策支持系统，并归纳出产前保健、分娩支持、产后监测与母乳喂养、围产期心理健康以及伦理技术与实施挑战五个主题。纳入研究显示，聊天机器人和虚拟助手可接受度较好，能促进健康教育并有助于早期识别身体和情绪风险；但多数研究仍属探索性，存在方法学局限，缺乏临床试验，在弱势社会情境中的验证也有限。作者据此认为，这类工具更适合作为面对面照护的补充，其推广仍需更严谨的研究、成本效益评估以及保障公平与数字包容的公共政策。

papers.title: Longitudinal Associations Between Fruit and Vegetable Prescription Program Participation and Pediatric Blood Pressure and Weight Status
papers.authors: Amy Saxe-Custack, Diana K. Haggerty, Jenny LaChance, Sarah Egan, David Todem
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: This study examined whether engagement in a pediatric fruit and vegetable prescription program (FVPP) offering one $15 prescription during office visits influenced health, hypothesizing that youth improve blood pressure (BP) and weight status after one year. Methods: This non-controlled longitudinal intervention trial included data from caregiver–child dyads at one pediatric clinic (child age 8–16 years). Correlated data models evaluated average longitudinal trends of study endpoints. Causal inference analyses for longitudinal data estimated time-varying effects of the FVPP on outcomes. Results: In total, 304 dyads enrolled. Youth reduced mean body mass index (BMI) percentile (p = 0.02), systolic BP (p < 0.001), and diastolic BP (p = 0.01). Youth also reduced the odds of elevated systolic BP (p < 0.001), diastolic BP (p = 0.004), and overall BP (p = 0.003). Children who redeemed ≥1 prescription reduced BMI percentile compared to counterparts who did not redeem (p = 0.02). Children who redeemed ≥1 prescription between baseline and 6 months reduced odds of obesity or elevated systolic BP at 12 months, with a relative odds ratio of 0.47 (p = 0.01) or 0.51 (p = 0.05), compared to peers who did not redeem. Conclusions: The results suggest that pediatric FVPP engagement may contribute to improvements in key health outcomes, underscoring the need for further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察参与儿科果蔬处方项目是否与儿童血压和体重状况的改善相关，采用非对照纵向干预设计，分析同一儿科诊所照护者与儿童配对数据在一年内的变化趋势。结果显示，儿童的平均BMI百分位、收缩压和舒张压均有所下降，血压升高的几率也降低；与未兑换处方者相比，至少兑换一次处方的儿童BMI百分位下降更明显，且在基线至6个月内兑换处方者到12个月时肥胖或收缩压升高的几率更低。作者据此认为，参与该项目可能有助于改善儿童关键健康结局，但研究为非对照设计，相关结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: How AI-Enabled Service Encounters Shape Tourist Trust: The Role of Perceived Personalization and Interactional Justice
papers.authors: Liwei Li, Pengcheng Li, Yutian Li, Yuexin Hu, Yidong Liu
papers.journal: Journal of theoretical and applied electronic commerce research
papers.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies increasingly mediate service encounters in tourism, understanding how AI-enabled interactions shape tourist trust has become a pressing issue. Drawing on social exchange theory and justice theory, this study investigates the mechanisms and boundary conditions through which AI service quality influences tourist trust. Using the AI digital human Wang Bo at the Tengwang Pavilion scenic area as an empirical case, the research develops and tests a model in which perceived personalization and interactional justice act as parallel mediators, while privacy sensitivity and brand reputation serve as moderators. Results from structural equation modeling show that AI service quality significantly enhances both perceived personalization and interactional justice, which in turn foster tourist trust. Perceived personalization and interactional justice each play significant mediating roles, indicating that tourists’ trust in AI arises not merely from technical performance but from perceptions of individualized care and fair treatment. Among the moderating effects, privacy sensitivity attenuates the relationship between AI service quality and interactional justice but does not affect the link between AI service quality and perceived personalization. Brand reputation strengthens the impact of perceived personalization on trust but does not significantly moderate the relationship between interactional justice and trust. Overall, the findings reveal dual pathways—personalization-based and fairness-based—through which AI service quality builds trust, highlighting the interplay between technological excellence, human-like social attributes, and contextual factors in shaping tourists’ trust toward AI-enabled services. This study advances theoretical understanding of AI-mediated service relationships and offers practical insights for designing trustworthy AI experiences in tourism contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以滕王阁景区AI数字人“王勃”为实证案例，基于社会交换理论与公平理论，考察AI服务质量如何影响游客信任，并检验感知个性化与互动公平的中介作用及隐私敏感性和品牌声誉的调节作用。结构方程模型结果显示，AI服务质量通过个性化感知与公平感知两条并行路径促进游客信任，说明信任不仅源于技术表现，也来自被个性化关怀和公平对待的感受。调节方面，隐私敏感性削弱AI服务质量与互动公平的关系，却不影响其与感知个性化的联系；品牌声誉增强感知个性化对信任的影响，但对互动公平与信任的关系无显著调节。研究据此揭示技术表现、类人社会属性与情境因素共同塑造游客对AI服务的信任。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Firm Value: The Moderating Role of Board Independence: Evidence from Saudi Listed Firms
papers.authors: Aida Smaoui
papers.journal: Journal of risk and financial management
papers.abstract: This study examines the relationship between artificial intelligence (AI) disclosure and firm value and investigates the moderating role of board independence among Saudi listed non-financial firms over 2019–2025. A multidimensional Artificial Intelligence Disclosure Intensity Index (AIDI) is developed to capture the breadth and substantive depth of AI-related corporate reporting across five dimensions. Using an unbalanced panel of 145 firms and 930 firm-year observations (785 in the estimation sample), the study employs panel regression and dynamic System GMM, with Tobin’s Q as the primary measure of firm value. The findings show a positive association between AI disclosure intensity and firm value, conditional on the included controls. We also find positive associations using alternative disclosure measures, accounting-based performance outcomes, firm fixed effects, and System GMM; however, the one-year lagged AIDI coefficient is statistically insignificant. The study finds no statistically significant evidence of moderation by board independence. The study contributes to the emerging AI disclosure literature by providing a multidimensional disclosure measure and new evidence from the Saudi capital market. The results provide evidence of an association between reported AI disclosure and firm valuation, without establishing causality or investors’ responses to report publication.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察沙特上市非金融企业中人工智能披露与公司价值之间的关系，并检验董事会独立性的调节作用。作者构建了覆盖五个维度的人工智能披露强度指数，基于2019至2025年的非平衡面板数据，采用面板回归和动态系统GMM进行分析，以托宾Q作为公司价值的主要度量。结果显示，在纳入控制变量的条件下，人工智能披露强度与公司价值呈正相关，使用替代披露指标和会计绩效指标时也得到类似的正向关联；但滞后一年的披露强度系数在统计上不显著，且没有发现董事会独立性具有显著调节作用的证据。作者据此强调，这些结果反映的是披露与估值之间的关联，并未确立因果关系，也未涉及投资者对报告发布的反应。

papers.title: Generative AI and Meaning-Making in Media and Communication: A Systematic Review of Semiotic Perspectives (2021–2026)
papers.authors: Oscar Briccio Rodriguez-Mendoza, Juan Taumaturgo Medina-Collana, Oscar Juan Rodriguez-Taranco, Carlos Alejandro Ancieta-Dextre, Raymundo Maximo del Carmen Carranza-Noriega, Diana Vanessa Ancieta-Gonzales, Félix Alfredo Guerrero-Roldán
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping media and communication, yet research on its semiotic role in meaning-making remains theoretically and methodologically fragmented. This systematic review examines semiotic frameworks, technological modalities, communication contexts, and human–AI agency in research published from 2021 to 26 August 2026. Scopus and Web of Science searches identified 376 records; the final included corpus comprises 128 studies. The synthesis distinguishes between modality-specific concerns: studies of large language models primarily examine interaction and dialogue, whereas text-to-image studies emphasize representation and synthetic imagery. The RAW agency data contained four cases coded as predominantly AI-led, but these classifications changed following a documented text-consistency review, showing that the agency pattern is sensitive to coding decisions. We derive four provisional configurations: instrumental human anchoring, mediated distributed semiosis, co-creative/agentive participation, and contested or unresolved computational semiosis. The studies also reveal interconnected methodological, conceptual, cultural, technological, and governance gaps. These findings suggest that participation in sign production and mediation should be distinguished from claims of autonomous intentional agency; they do not establish whether generative systems possess intentional understanding.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了2021年至2026年间生成式人工智能在媒体与传播中符号意义建构作用的研究，基于Scopus和Web of Science检索并纳入128项研究，考察其符号学框架、技术模态、传播情境与人机能动性。综述发现，大语言模型研究主要关注互动与对话，文生图研究则侧重表征与合成图像；作者据此归纳出工具性人类锚定、中介性分布式符号过程、共创/能动参与以及存在争议的计算符号学四种暂定配置。研究还指出方法、概念、文化、技术与治理层面的相互关联缺口，并强调应区分参与符号生产与中介同主张自主意向性，现有证据不足以判定生成系统是否具有意向性理解。

papers.title: Adaptive Generative Tutoring in Resource-Limited Secondary Education: Effects on Participation, Achievement, and Digital Equity in Nigeria
papers.authors: María de los Ángeles Sánchez Trujillo, David Alberto García Arango, Felícita Delia Sáenz-Egúsquiza, Natalia Andrea Builes-Quintero, Federico Henao-Villa
papers.abstract: This study examines the short-term educational contribution of teacher-guided generative tutoring through a secondary analysis of a randomized trial in nine public secondary schools in Benin City, Nigeria. Among 1328 randomized students, 657 were offered twelve 90 min sessions combining Microsoft Copilot, curriculum-aligned English activities, and pair work, while 671 received regular instruction. Intention-to-treat models used ordinary least squares, school fixed effects, baseline performance adjustment, and HC3 standard errors, with conditional estimates on observed endline outcomes and required covariates. The overall assessment effect was 0.310 SD (95% CI 0.176–0.444; n = 654), with positive estimates for English (0.238 SD), AI knowledge (0.309 SD), and school examination performance (0.206 SD). The digital-skills estimate was positive but imprecise (0.139 SD; p = 0.066). Attendance was positively associated with achievement, and effects were larger at higher baseline performance. The female interaction was positive, with caution warranted by the smaller male subsample. The digital-access interaction was negative but imprecise (−0.182 SD; 95% CI −0.370–0.005; 457 complete cases). These findings support short-term learning gains from the complete tutoring package relative to regular instruction. They provide a basis for further evaluation of structured programs integrating generative AI with curriculum, collaborative practice, and teacher guidance in resource-limited urban schools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于尼日利亚贝宁城九所公立中学的随机试验数据，考察教师引导的生成式AI辅导对中学生参与度、学业成绩和数字公平的短期影响。分析显示，接受完整辅导方案的学生在总体评估、英语、AI知识和学校考试成绩上均优于常规教学组，出勤与成绩正相关，且基线成绩较高者获益更大；数字技能估计为正但不精确，数字接入的交互项为负但同样不精确，女生交互项为正但受男生子样本较小限制。作者认为结果支持该综合辅导方案的短期学习收益，并提示需在资源有限的城市学校中进一步评估此类项目。

papers.title: Lifestyle and Dietary Correlates of Appetitive Traits Among Jordanian University Students: Evidence from the Adult Eating Behaviour Questionnaire
papers.authors: Dalia Z. Alomari, Hadeel Ja’far Obeidat, Hadeel Alghwairy
papers.abstract: Background: The transition to university is a critical period during which young adults gain greater independence in eating and lifestyle behaviors. Appetitive traits may help characterize individual differences in eating behavior. Objective: This study aimed to examine associations between Adult Eating Behaviour Questionnaire (AEBQ) subscale scores and dietary-frequency, physical-activity, household-income, smoking, and BMI measures among Jordanian university students. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 485 students aged 18–24 years from three Jordanian universities (HU, UJ, and JUST). Face-to-face interviews collected sociodemographic, lifestyle, dietary, and AEBQ data, and anthropometric measurements were obtained to calculate BMI. Analyses included independent-samples t-tests, one-way ANOVA with post hoc comparisons, Kendall’s tau-b correlations, Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction for dietary comparisons, and multivariable linear regression models. Results: Participants had a mean age of 21.34 ± 2.17 years; 37.9% reported smoking and 45.2% reported moderate physical activity. Mean AEBQ subscale scores were 2.85 ± 1.09 for Emotional Over-Eating, 3.84 ± 0.64 for Enjoyment of Food, 3.12 ± 0.83 for Hunger, 2.80 ± 0.74 for Food Fussiness, 2.94 ± 0.95 for Slowness in Eating, and 3.38 ± 0.83 for Satiety Responsiveness. In adjusted analyses, higher BMI was associated with higher Emotional Over-Eating and lower Satiety Responsiveness. Household income below 500 JOD (versus 500–1000 JOD) was associated with higher Hunger and Satiety Responsiveness, while income above 1000 JOD was associated with lower Slowness in Eating. Several dietary-frequency associations remained significant after FDR correction. Conclusion: AEBQ subscale scores were associated with selected characteristics in this sample. These cross-sectional associations do not establish causal relationships. The modified Arabic AEBQ and shortened food-frequency questionnaire require further evaluation in Jordanian populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察约旦大学生成人进食行为问卷各分量表得分与饮食频率、体力活动、家庭收入、吸烟及BMI等指标之间的关联，采用横断面设计和面对面访谈收集数据。调整分析显示，较高BMI与较高的情绪性过食和较低饱腹感反应相关，较低家庭收入与较高饥饿感和饱腹感反应相关，较高收入则与较慢进食相关；部分饮食频率关联经多重比较校正后仍显著。作者强调这些为横断面关联，不能推断因果关系，所用阿拉伯语版问卷和简版食物频率问卷仍需在约旦人群中进一步评估。

papers.title: From Social Interaction to Occupational Engagement: Evaluating the Role of Social Robots in Meaningful Activities for Older Adults
papers.authors: Cristina Nieves Perdomo Delgado, Jacqueline Cartagena-Julio, Alex Ríos-Ruiz, Francisca Espinosa-Torres, Ana Valdebenito-Aravena, Jaime Bernal-Corral, Aitor Yusta-Ceacero, Nuria Máximo-Bocanegra, Marta Pérez‐de‐Heredia‐Torres
papers.abstract: (1) Background: Population ageing highlights the need for interventions promoting meaningful participation and occupational engagement. Social robots may support engagement in meaningful activities, but evidence addressing occupational engagement remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate the role of an animal-like social robot in facilitating occupational engagement among older adults. (2) Methods: A longitudinal single-group pre–post study was conducted with 60 cognitively intact older adults attending day centres. Participants engaged in meaningful social, leisure, cognitive, creative, and activity-based experiences incorporating the MetaCat Smart Robot Cat twice weekly for three months, with 30–40 min sessions. Occupational engagement was assessed using the Engagement in Meaningful Activities Survey, while occupational performance and satisfaction were evaluated using the Canadian Occupational Performance Measure. Human–robot interaction was also monitored. (3) Results: EDIAS scores increased significantly after the intervention (mean change: 4.4 points; 95% CI: 3.4–5.4; p < 0.001; Cohen’s d = 0.82), alongside improvements in occupational performance and satisfaction.
