Spontaneous interaction initiation and persistence increased over time and were positively associated with occupational engagement. (4) Conclusions: Animal-like social robots may facilitate occupational engagement when embedded in meaningful activities. Controlled studies are needed to establish causal effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注动物形态社交机器人能否促进认知完好的老年人的作业参与，采用纵向单组前后测设计，让日间中心的参与者在社交、休闲、认知、创意等活动中使用MetaCat智能机器猫，并监测人机互动。结果显示，干预后参与者对有意义活动的参与度显著提高，作业表现与满意度也同步改善；自发发起互动和互动的持续性随时间增强，且与作业参与呈正相关。作者据此认为，将动物形态社交机器人嵌入有意义的活动情境可能有助于提升老年人的作业参与，但现有单组设计无法确立因果关系，仍需对照研究加以验证。

papers.title: Development of participatory intervention to improve safety and enjoyment in sports events based on Participatory Action-Oriented Training
papers.authors: 泰行 山田, Yuriko Takeuchi, Toyoki NAKAO, Motoko KAI, Takuya TANAKA, Wei Guo, Sora WATABE, Saki HOSOI, Kazutaka Kogi, Toru Yoshikawa, Etsuko Yoshikawa, Takashi TORIIZUKA, Atsushi Kubota, Koya Suzuki, Ko YAMANAKA, Motoki Mizuno, タケシ ヒビ, Kazuhiro Aoki, Daichi Suzuki, Hidefumi Waki
papers.journal: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
papers.abstract: Introduction Sports events are leisure activities that contribute to public well-being. To maximize their benefits, large-scale improvements and the continuous accumulation of small, low-cost, and immediately actionable improvements are needed. However, systematic approaches for the improvement of safety and enjoyment in sports events remain limited. Hence, this study developed and evaluated the Sports Event Improvement for Safe, Move, Info, Link, and Environment (SMILE) program based on Participatory Action-Oriented Training (PAOT). Methods The SMILE program was developed using a research and development framework and evaluated through field research and questionnaire. Field research covered professional football, basketball, and rugby games in Japan. The program involved 294 participants in Day 1 fieldwork and 243 in Day 2 workshops. Output evaluation assessed good practices, improvement proposals based on the program design principle of balancing safety and enjoyment, club feedback, and participant satisfaction. Outcome evaluation examined pre–post changes in engagement with sports clubs, spectating, supporting, and participating in sports, and PAOT. Results Participants collected 2,951 photographs of good practices and proposed 174 improvements. Output evaluation demonstrated high participant satisfaction and positive club feedback. Outcome evaluation showed significant pre–post increases in engagement with sports and PAOT. A 30-item action checklist based on photographs was developed to support the program. Discussion The SMILE program was developed as a participatory approach to the sustained improvement of safety and enjoyment in sports events. It promotes the refinement and sharing of good practices, the accumulation of small, low-cost, and immediately actionable improvements, and value co-creation among stakeholders.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于参与式行动导向培训（PAOT）开发了SMILE项目，旨在通过系统化方法持续改善体育赛事的安全性与趣味性，并在日本职业足球、篮球和橄榄球赛事中开展实地研究与问卷调查进行评估。产出评估显示，参与者提出了大量改进建议，满意度较高且俱乐部反馈积极；结果评估发现，参与体育俱乐部、观赛、助威及参与运动等行为以及PAOT在前后测中有显著提升。研究据此认为，这种参与式方法有助于积累低成本、可立即行动的改进，并促进利益相关者之间的价值共创，但结论主要基于前后测变化，尚不能确立因果效果。

papers.title: Supplementation with cartilage hydrolysate and rosehip peel extract in physically active adults: main outcomes and exploratory findings of a randomized, placebo-controlled study on knee discomfort
papers.authors: Lionel Noah, Cynthia G. Suarez, Arnaud Jacquot, Ralf Spreemann, Christine Juhel, Florian Rigaudier, Etienne Guillocheau, Sèverine Mèance
papers.journal: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Joint discomfort and pain during physical activity are frequent conditions in healthy adults, which can lead to mobility limitations, with multiple consequences on health and quality of life. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of a food supplement which combines cartilage hydrolysate and a rosehip extract on knee pain and discomfort in physically active healthy adults, examining subgroups according to sex and menopausal status. Methods In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 138 participants received either 4 capsules/day of Chondractiv™ Move (CM, containing 1200 mg/day of hydrolyzed chicken cartilage and 380 mg/day of Rosa canina extract) or a placebo (maltodextrin) for 8 weeks. Activity-related knee pain was assessed on a 0-10 eVAS following a standardized single-leg step-down test (SLSD) and analyzed via an ANCOVA. Activity-related knee pain experienced during or after daily activities (0-100 eVAS), daily life pain (ICOAP questionnaire), knee function (KOOS questionnaire), quality of life (SF-12 questionnaire) and range of motion were also assessed throughout the intervention period. Results Participants (39.9% men, 39.1% pre-menopausal women [PreMW] and 21.0% post-menopausal women [PostMW]) with a mean age of 46.4 years and a mean BMI of 24.4 kg/m 2 , practiced 5.6 hours of exercise per week on average. Knee pain after SLSD significantly decreased ( p < 0.0001) during the intervention in both arms in the entire population (CM: −2.2; placebo: −2.4), but with no significant difference between arms (delta −0.2 [95%CI −1.1; 0.7], p > 0.05). However, exploratory analyses in PostMW showed that the change from baseline tended to be greater with CM versus placebo (−3.4 versus −1.2; delta 2.2 [95%CI −0.2;4.7], p = 0.0712). Further exploration indicated a benefit of CM over placebo on knee pain experienced during daily activities (entire cohort; p = 0.0255) and after activity (PostMW only; p = 0.0421), and in the Sport and recreation dimension of the KOOS (PostMW; p = 0.0381). Quality of life and range of motion evolved favorably, but with no between-arm difference. Conclusions After eight weeks of supplementation, CM did not demonstrate superiority over placebo for the primary endpoint (pain after SLSD) but exploratory analyses indicated clinically meaningful improvements in postmenopausal women, particularly. These findings require confirmation in further large-scale studies. Clinical trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov, identifier [NCT06714851].
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过随机双盲安慰剂对照试验，考察含水解鸡软骨与玫瑰果提取物的膳食补充剂对体力活动活跃健康成人膝关节疼痛与不适的影响，主要终点为标准化单腿下台阶测试后的活动相关膝痛。结果显示，八周干预后两组疼痛均明显下降，但补充剂组与安慰剂组在主要终点上无显著差异；探索性分析提示绝经后女性可能获益更多，日常活动相关疼痛及部分膝关节功能维度也出现有利信号。作者指出这些发现尚需更大规模研究确认，不能据此夸大补充剂的镇痛效果。

papers.title: A conceptual co-design framework for structuring bankable climate interventions: design and illustrative instantiation
papers.authors: João Varela da Costa, Catarina Valente, Gabriel F. Pestana, Miguel Mira da Silva
papers.abstract: Urban and regional authorities across Europe must design climate-resilient interventions under constrained budgets, while coordinating more closely with private investors and insurance companies. Participatory governance, multi-criteria decision analysis and climate-investment planning are rarely combined in a single, transparent workflow. This is mainly because cities lack conceptual frameworks linking these elements across policy, technical design and finance. Here we report how the Horizon Europe BLOSSOM project used a design science research methodology in which an ArchiMate-based enterprise-architecture framework, structured around the analytic hierarchy process, developed the Co-design Framework for Bankable Climate Interventions (CFBCI), proposed as a reference architecture for participatory co-design of climate-resilient interventions. CFBCI is illustrated through a single instantiation in the River Cole urban-reforestation intervention in Birmingham, United Kingdom, one of seven BLOSSOM pilot sites across Europe; this instantiation demonstrates the framework’s structure and is not presented as a validated case. Representational completeness was examined through the Bunge–Wand–Weber ontological model and a co-creation session with BLOSSOM stakeholders. This formative evaluation, rather than a test of bankability or decision effectiveness, revealed three incompleteness gaps, one excess element, two redundancies and two overload issues, alongside general stakeholder interest and three refinements arising from the co-creation session: explicit legislative elements, flexible facilitator/expert roles for resource-constrained municipalities, and a simplified implementation guide. Together, these findings offer a conceptual reference architecture for structuring co-created climate solutions, providing a basis for future empirical validation and comparative research on urban sustainability transitions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对欧洲城市在有限预算下协调公共治理、多准则决策与气候投资规划时缺乏统一概念框架的问题，报告了BLOSSOM项目如何以设计科学研究方法构建“可融资气候干预协同设计框架”（CFBCI）。该框架基于ArchiMate企业架构并以层次分析法组织，属于概念性参考架构，而非经过验证的决策工具。作者通过英国伯明翰River Cole城市再造林这一单点实例展示其结构，并借助本体模型和利益相关者共创会进行评估，识别出若干表示完整性缺口、冗余与过载问题，同时获得细化建议。其含义是为协同设计气候方案提供结构化基础，后续仍需实证验证。

papers.title: Interpretable driver behavioral state monitoring using facial landmarks for human-autonomous vehicle interaction
papers.authors: Milton O. Candela, Jesús A. Mandujano-Granillo, Ismael Vidal-Lopez, Mauricio Adolfo Ramírez-Moreno, Juan C. Tudón-Martínez, Jorge de J. Lozoya-Santos
papers.abstract: Introduction Behavior-aware robotic systems require both accurate human state recognition and transparent machine intent to support trust and safe collaboration. This study presents an integrated framework for autonomous vehicles combining a real-time vehicle state visualization interface with a calibration-driven facial-based behavioral state recognition module. Methods A Polaris GEM e6 autonomous vehicle equipped with drive-by-wire control and LiDAR served as the testbed. A real-time Human-Machine Interface (HMI) built with ROS and Foxglove Studio visualized localization, object detection, and driving states. Concurrently, a vision-based behavioral monitoring system used an Intel RealSense L515 camera, MediaPipe, and OpenCV to extract facial landmarks. Individual calibration established neutral baselines for eye aspect ratio, mouth aspect ration, and head rotation angles. A real-time threshold-based finite-state model facilitated data collection across five behavioral states: neutral, closed eyes, out-of-safe-zone, yawning, and fast blinking. Classical classifiers (Support Vector Machine [SVM], Random Forest [RF]), and deep learning architectures (Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks) were trained on a controlled indoor dataset using stratified k-fold cross-validation (k = 10), and evaluated on a hold-out outdoor dataset. Results The HMI provided stable, real-time visualization of vehicle state and perception, while the facial monitoring system achieved a ∼ 98.5% face detection success rate. The online heuristic model identified behavioral states and enabled high-quality data collection, capturing features with strong Kruskal-Wallis significance from the neutral state for closed eyes (EAR, p < 0.001 ), yawning (MAR, p < 0.001 ), fast blinking (blink rate, p < 0.01 ), though out-of-safe-zone was non-significant (head rotation, p > 0.05 ). Stratified cross-validation accuracy and F1-scores reached ∼ 91% for SVM and RF. On the outdoor test data, SVM maintained its performance, whereas RF dropped to a ∼ 70% F1-score due to inter-session variability and feature ambiguity. Deep learning architectures achieved test F1-scores ( ∼ 80%), comparable to the heuristic baseline model ( ∼ 81%). SVM was the most stable and best performing classifier, isolating its confusion to the out-of-safe-zone and neutral states. Conclusion Combining transparent interface design with personalized calibration supports human-aware autonomy. The machine learning framework provided interpretable monitoring, while real-time visualization enhanced situational awareness, together contributing to behaviorally responsive and transparent human-robot interaction platforms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究面向自动驾驶中的人机交互，构建了一套将实时车辆状态可视化界面与基于面部特征的行为状态识别相结合的系统，并在装备线控与激光雷达的自动驾驶车上进行测试。面部监测模块通过个体校准建立中性基线，在室内数据上训练多种分类器，再在室外数据上评估。结果显示，支持向量机在跨场景下表现最稳定，随机森林因会话差异和特征歧义而明显下降，深度学习模型与启发式基线相当；闭眼、打哈欠和快速眨眼等状态可从中性状态中区分，而超出安全区状态未达显著。作者据此认为，透明界面与个性化校准有助于实现可解释、行为响应的人机协同，但结论受数据集与场景条件限制。

papers.title: An ODeL-based teacher professional development framework for teacher-facilitated human–AI collaboration in primary mathematics problem-solving: a conceptual analysis
papers.authors: Zanele Dibane
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are increasingly present in primary mathematics classrooms, yet their educational value is widely argued to depend on how teachers use them. Existing models explain parts of this problem: AI-TPACK describes the knowledge teachers need, teacher-in-the-loop and human-centred AI models describe how control is shared between teachers and systems, and orchestration research describes how teachers coordinate classroom activity. What remains under-theorised is the pathway linking the way open distance e-learning (ODeL) professional development builds teachers’ capacity to its enactment when AI scaffolds learners’ problem-solving. This conceptual article asks: through which mechanisms, and under which conditions, can ODeL-based professional development be expected to enable teacher-facilitated human–AI collaboration that supports primary learners’ mathematical problem-solving? The analysis combined an integrative review of peer-reviewed and selected grey literature with theory synthesis: sources were identified through structured database searches, screened against pre-specified criteria, coded for constructs, mechanisms and boundary conditions, and organised by level of analysis. The primary context is South African primary schooling (Grades 1–7) and low-bandwidth, predominantly asynchronous ODeL. Positioning four perspectives within a multilevel meta-model, Intelligent-TPACK at the teacher level, Zone of Proximal Development scaffolding and social constructivism at the interaction and classroom levels, and Polya’s heuristic as an analytic lens at the learner level, with transactional distance theory at the programme level, I propose a three-layer framework that distinguishes inputs, mechanisms, practices and outcomes, and derive seven testable propositions. These include teacher orchestration as a mediator between AI-TPACK and scaffolding quality; infrastructure readiness, learner age, language, and AI type as moderators; and governance and children’s rights as cross-cutting boundary conditions. Unlike models that specify teacher knowledge or the division of control alone, the framework specifies the professional development pathway through which human–AI collaboration is expected to benefit learners. I propose that well-designed ODeL professional development is an enabling condition for such benefit, not a guarantee of it, and close with implementation and evaluation indicators for teacher educators, policymakers, school leaders, researchers and learners.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念分析文章，围绕开放远程电子学习（ODeL）的教师专业发展如何促成教师引导的人机协同、进而支持小学数学问题解决展开，采用整合性文献综述与理论综合的方法，整合AI-TPACK、最近发展区与社会建构主义、Polya启发式及交互距离理论，提出一个区分输入、机制、实践与结果的三层框架，并推导出七条可检验命题。作者强调教师编排是AI-TPACK与支架质量之间的中介，基础设施就绪度、学习者年龄、语言和AI类型为调节因素，治理与儿童权利则是贯穿性的边界条件。文章据此主张，设计良好的ODeL专业发展是此类协同惠及学习者的使能条件而非保证，并给出实施与评估指标。

papers.title: Factors influencing registered nurses’ attitudes toward and literacy in artificial intelligence: a cross-sectional systematic review
papers.authors: Dai Yingqi, Xili Zhao, Xiao Pan, Jiaxin Wei
papers.abstract: Background Presently, artificial intelligence technology is being extensively applied across clinical nursing practice. However, whether this technology can be deeply integrated into clinical workflows depends largely on nurses’ attitudes and literacy regarding artificial intelligence. Consequently, conducting an in depth exploration of core factors shaping registered nurses’ artificial intelligence attitudes and literacy holds significant importance for driving the rapid development of intelligent nursing. Methods This study strictly adhered to PRISMA guidelines. Systematic searches were conducted across seven English databases, namely PubMed, Web of Science, Medline, Embase, The Cochrane Library, IEEE Xplore, and CINAHL, alongside three Chinese databases, including China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), Wanfang Data, and VIP Database. The search timeframe ranged from database inception through May 30, 2026. Following screening according to inclusion and exclusion criteria, independent factors influencing attitudes and literacy were extracted. Employing a narrative synthesis approach, these influencing factors were categorized, summarized, and narratively integrated across distinct thematic domains. Results A total of 30 studies involving 12,958 registered nurses were included in this systematic review. The majority of the studies were conducted in China and Turkey. The independent factors influencing registered nurses’ attitudes toward artificial intelligence included educational attainment, age, length of service, gender, professional title/nursing level, hospital tier/category, AI awareness/understanding/knowledge, AI training experience, AI usage experience, artificial intelligence anxiety, and digital leadership. The factors independently affecting nurses’ artificial intelligence literacy included leadership style, AI training experience, and usage experience/frequency. Conclusion Current evidence indicates that key modifiable factors to improve nurses’ attitudes toward and literacy in artificial intelligence include AI-related training, practical hands-on experience, and organizational leadership, while technical anxiety should not be overlooked. Compared with demographic characteristics, educational and experiential interventions appear more effective in enhancing nurses’ artificial intelligence literacy levels. Nursing managers should actively implement smart training programs, increase opportunities for nurses to apply new technologies in clinical practice, and formulate relevant policies regarding data privacy protection and accountability division, thereby promoting the safe and effective integration of AI technology into patient care. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/recorddashboard
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA规范检索中英文数据库，纳入30项研究，梳理注册护士对人工智能的态度与素养的影响因素。结果发现，影响态度的因素包括学历、年龄、工龄、性别、职称、医院等级、AI认知与培训使用经验、AI焦虑及数字领导力；影响素养的因素则主要涉及领导风格、AI培训经验和实际使用频率。作者据此指出，AI培训、实操经验和组织层面领导是可干预的关键因素，技术焦虑也不容忽视，且相较人口学特征，教育与经验类干预对提升素养似更有效，并建议护理管理者推进智能培训、增加临床应用机会及完善数据隐私与责任政策。

papers.title: When support becomes dependence: conversational continuity and relational safety in human-AI interaction
papers.authors: Xiao Wei, Xiaoyi Chen, Wangahe Jin, Jun Cai, 駱旭琛, Jiehua Deng
papers.abstract: Background Conversational artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used for emotional support, reflection, and consequential decision-making. Although conversational continuity may improve responsiveness, sustained interaction also exposes AI systems to their own prior relational language, potentially shaping how they respond when users become increasingly dependent or surrender personal agency. We examined whether model-generated conversational history alters relational-safety behavior as human–AI interactions escalate from ordinary support-seeking toward emotional dependence, social displacement, and decision delegation. Methods We conducted a standardized multi-turn benchmarking study of ChatGPT, Gemini, and Doubao. Twelve four-turn trajectories represented two agency-related domains: emotional dependency and displacement of human support, and decision delegation and surrender of personal agency. Each trajectory was evaluated under two matched context architectures: reconstructed cumulative user-only context, which retained all prior user disclosures but excluded previous AI responses, and native continuous conversation, which retained the complete interaction history. Across 72 model-condition-trajectory sequences comprising 288 turn-level responses, relational safety was independently evaluated for dependency reinforcement, agency preservation, and human-support preservation using predefined ordinal criteria. Context effects and their interaction with escalating relational risk were examined using cumulative-link mixed-effects models. Results Relational-safety differences between context architectures increased across successive turns of the standardized trajectories. Overall, explicit dependency reinforcement increased from 9.7% in cumulative user-only contexts to 18.1% in continuous conversations, while strong agency preservation declined from 75.7% to 65.3% and strong human-support preservation from 73.6% to 63.2%. Outcome-specific analyses showed condition-by-turn interactions for dependency reinforcement (cumulative odds ratio [cOR], 1.26; 95% CI, 1.03–1.55; unadjusted P = .026), agency preservation (cOR, 0.82; 95% CI, 0.69–0.98; unadjusted P = .031), and human-support preservation (cOR, 0.78; 95% CI, 0.65–0.94; unadjusted P = .009), indicating progressively greater divergence between context conditions across successive turns. After Holm adjustment across the three interaction tests, only the human-support-preservation interaction remained below the.05 threshold (adjusted P = .027).The overall pattern was observed across systems and was directionally consistent in predefined binary sensitivity analyses. Conclusions Across this benchmark, between-condition differences generally widened across successive turns, although the present design cannot determine whether this pattern reflects increasing relational-risk intensity, increasing accumulated model-generated history, or their combination. Only the human-support-preservation interaction remained below the.05 threshold after Holm adjustment, whereas the dependency-reinforcement and agency-preservation interactions were directionally similar but less robust after multiplicity adjustment. The observed pattern is compatible with a post-hoc interpretive framework of relational inertia but does not establish this process as a causal mechanism or demonstrate downstream psychological effects in human users.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式对话AI在情感支持与决策场景中，模型自身生成的对话历史是否会改变其关系安全行为。作者对ChatGPT、Gemini和豆包开展标准化多轮基准测试，比较仅保留用户披露的累积上下文与保留完整交互的原生连续对话两种条件，并按预设标准评估依赖强化、能动性保留和人际支持保留。结果显示，随着对话推进，两种条件下的关系安全差异总体扩大：连续对话中明确强化依赖的比例更高，而强能动性保留和强人际支持保留的比例更低；但经多重比较校正后，仅人际支持保留的交互仍低于显著性阈值，依赖强化与能动性保留的交互方向相似但稳健性较弱。作者指出，该设计无法区分这一模式源于关系风险加剧、模型生成历史累积还是二者共同作用，相关解释框架不构成因果机制，也未证明对人类用户的下游心理影响。

papers.title: A stacking machine learning model for identifying comorbid anxiety disorder in children and adolescents with functional abdominal pain disorders
papers.authors: Weiwei Wu, Quanquan Ye, Xiaochun Lin, Sisi Li, Shishi Wang, 刘晓燕
papers.abstract: Objective Comorbid anxiety disorder is common in children and adolescents with functional abdominal pain disorders, but clinically usable risk-stratification tools integrating abdominal pain, psychosocial, school-related, and family-level information remain limited. Methods In this observational predictive modeling study, children and adolescents aged 7–18 years with Rome IV-defined functional abdominal pain disorders were evaluated between December 2021 and December 2025. Participants were randomly allocated at a 7:3 ratio into training and internal validation cohorts using stratified sampling by anxiety status. Candidate predictors included demographic, abdominal pain-related, somatic, psychosocial, school-related, and family-level variables. After LASSO-based feature selection, four prespecified base learners—explainable boosting machine, calibrated support vector machine, random forest, and CatBoost—were combined using an L2-penalized logistic regression stacking meta-learner. Performance was assessed using discrimination, threshold-dependent metrics, calibration, decision curve analysis, learner diversity, and SHAP-based interpretability. Results Among 629 eligible patients, 210 (33.4%) had comorbid anxiety disorder. The training cohort included 440 patients, and the validation cohort included 189 patients, with similar anxiety prevalence in both cohorts. Clinically relevant correlates of anxiety included older age, longer symptom duration, higher pain frequency, night-time awakening, pain temporally associated with stressful events, higher SDSC and CSI-24 scores, higher parental GAD-7 score, and greater school absence. In out-of-fold training estimates, the stacking model achieved an AUC of 0.831 and a Brier score of 0.151. In the validation cohort, it showed the highest numerical performance among candidate models, with an AUC of 0.846 (95% CI, 0.789–0.894), accuracy of 0.788, sensitivity of 0.762, specificity of 0.802, F1 score of 0.706, and Brier score of 0.146. Decision curve analysis suggested potential clinical utility across selected threshold ranges. SHAP analysis identified school absence, parental GAD-7 score, CSI-24 score, pain-stress association, symptom duration, pain frequency, SDSC score, age, and night-time awakening as leading contributors to the final model output. Conclusion A stacking machine learning model integrating clinical, psychosocial, school-related, and family-level variables showed acceptable internal-validation performance for identifying comorbid anxiety disorder in children and adolescents with functional abdominal pain disorders. External validation is needed before clinical implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对功能性腹痛障碍儿童和青少年共病焦虑障碍的识别问题，构建了一个整合腹痛、心理社会、学校及家庭层面变量的堆叠机器学习预测模型。研究对象为符合罗马IV标准的7至18岁患者，作者将候选预测变量经LASSO筛选后组合多种基学习器，并以内部验证评估模型表现。结果显示，该模型在验证队列中区分度与校准度尚可，决策曲线分析提示在部分阈值范围内可能具有临床效用，SHAP分析则指出缺课、父母焦虑评分、躯体症状评分和疼痛-应激关联等是主要贡献因素。作者据此认为该模型在内部验证中表现可接受，但临床应用前仍需外部验证。

papers.title: How does community of inquiry matter? Mediating effects and configurational pathways linking project-based learning design to learning engagement
papers.authors: Tongfeng Xu, Peijun Qin, Siyuan Ma
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AIGC) has reshaped animation students’ skill profiles and the conditions of instructional design in project-based learning (PBL) studios. We examine whether and how perceptions of PBL design are associated with Learning Engagement (LE), treating AIGC-assisted PBL studios as the research context rather than testing generative AI as a model variable. Drawing on Community of Inquiry (CoI) theory, we examine Problem Driven (PD), Project Design (PDe), Project Implementation (PI), and Project Evaluation (PE) as antecedents; Cognitive Presence (CP), Social Presence (SP), and Teaching Presence (TP) as statistical mediators; and LE as the outcome. We analyzed two-wave survey data from 490 upper-year animation students using PLS-SEM and fsQCA. PBL and CoI were measured concurrently at T1, and LE at T2; indirect effects therefore represent indirect statistical associations rather than mediation with a fully established temporal sequence. PD, PDe, and PI showed significant positive direct associations with LE. PE’s zero-order and single-predictor associations were positive, but its direct path coefficient became significantly negative after controlling for the other PBL dimensions and CoI mediators. The coefficient was sensitive to model specification, suggesting possible statistical suppression; it should not be interpreted as evidence that evaluation itself inherently inhibits engagement. The three CoI dimensions showed significant statistical mediation associations across all 12 indirect paths. TP and SP had relatively higher point estimates of indirect statistical associations, but differences between indirect effects were not formally tested; no dimension is claimed to be optimal. PE’s positive indirect associations through CoI partially offset its negative net direct association without reversing the total association after adjustment. The extent of this offset may depend on the degree to which CoI-related experiences are concurrently reported. fsQCA identified seven high-engagement configurations. No individual PBL dimension was indispensable. CoI dimensions appeared as core or peripheral conditions, although not every configuration included all three. These findings clarify the dual pathways linking evaluation and engagement through indirect statistical associations and configurational conditions, and provide guidance for optimizing PBL under different resource constraints. Conclusions are limited to AIGC-assisted PBL studios and do not establish the instructional effects of generative AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以AIGC辅助的项目式学习工作室为背景，考察项目式学习设计感知与学习投入之间的关联，并检验认知临场感、社会临场感和教学临场感在其中的统计中介作用。作者对高年级动画学生开展两波问卷，用PLS-SEM和fsQCA分析，发现问题驱动、项目设计与项目实施同学习投入呈正向直接关联；项目评价在控制其他维度与中介变量后直接路径转为负向，作者提示这可能反映统计抑制、对模型设定敏感，不能解读为评价本身抑制投入。三个临场感维度在全部间接路径上均呈显著统计中介关联，其中教学与社会临场感的点估计较高，但未正式检验差异。fsQCA识别出七种高投入组态，没有单个项目式学习维度不可或缺。结论限于该情境，未确立生成式AI的教学效果。

papers.title: Psychological mechanisms of perceived technological dependence on generative artificial intelligence tools: perceived knowledge, trust, anxiety, and self-efficacy
papers.authors: Le Wei, Shu Zhang, Junghyun Heo
papers.abstract: Generative AI tools are increasingly used in design education, yet the relationship between students’ perceptions of these tools and their reported reliance on them remains unclear. This study analyzed cross-sectional survey responses from 526 undergraduate students in design-related disciplines using partial least squares structural equation modeling. In the specified model, perceived reliability, perceived usefulness, and perceived intelligence were positively associated with perceived AIGC knowledge, whereas perceived ease of use was not significantly associated with it. Perceived AIGC knowledge was positively associated with trust, self-efficacy, and usage intention and negatively associated with AIGC-related anxiety. Trust, AIGC-related anxiety, and self-efficacy each showed a significant indirect effect in the modeled relationship between perceived AIGC knowledge and usage intention. Usage intention was strongly associated with perceived technological dependence. These findings are consistent with the proposed framework, but the cross-sectional data do not establish the temporal sequence of the constructs or show that reported dependence reflects harmful overuse. The study extends technology acceptance research by examining perceived reliance in AIGC-supported creative work.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注设计教育中生成式人工智能工具的使用，考察学生对工具特征的感知如何与其对工具的依赖相关联。作者对设计相关专业本科生进行横断面问卷调查，并用结构方程模型分析。结果显示，感知可靠性、有用性和智能性与学生对AIGC知识的感知正相关，而感知易用性与后者无显著关联；感知AIGC知识又与信任、自我效能和使用意向正相关，与AIGC相关焦虑负相关，信任、焦虑和自我效能各自在感知知识与使用意向之间起显著间接作用，使用意向则与感知技术依赖强相关。作者指出，这些结果与所提框架一致，但横断面数据无法确定各构念的时间顺序，也不能说明所报告的依赖反映有害的过度使用。

papers.title: If it doesn’t have a soul, it doesn’t hurt? The effect of bullying and social anxiety on the use of conversational AI
papers.authors: Gergő Pál, Andras Norbert Zsido, Julia Basler
papers.abstract: Introduction Conversational artificial intelligence (CAI) increasingly functions as a social interaction partner, raising questions about how established interpersonal behaviors transfer to human-AI interaction. The present study examined whether bullying-like behavior directed toward CAI reflects the extension of real world social strategies, and how social anxiety, prior bullying experiences, and AI self-competency contribute to such behavior. Methods Participants ( N = 289) completed measures of social anxiety, prior bullying perpetration and victimization, AI self-competency, and bullying-like behavior directed toward conversational AI. Results Through several analyses, bully-victims exhibited the highest levels of AI-directed bullying-like behavior. The interaction between bullying perpetration and victimization emerged as the strongest predictor in our regression analysis, while prior bullying perpetration alone was not sufficient to explain AI-directed aggression, and prior victimization alone was negatively associated with AI-directed bullying-like behavior. Social anxiety did not directly predict bullying-like behavior toward AI; however, mediation analyses showed that prior victimization fully mediated the relationship between social anxiety and bullying-like behavior towards CAI. Individuals with higher social anxiety were more likely to report victimization, which in turn was associated with increased bullying-like behavior toward AI. AI self-competency did not emerge as an independent predictor. Discussion These findings suggest that AI-directed bullying-like behavior is best understood as a context-dependent behavior arising from the co-occurrence of aggression and vulnerability, rather than a direct extension of general aggressive tendencies. Conversational AI constitutes a distinct relational context that can both reflect and reinforce existing behavioral patterns. This has important implications for understanding how human-AI interactions may shape social behavior and psychological functioning over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了针对对话式人工智能的欺凌式行为是否延续自现实人际策略，以及社交焦虑、既往欺凌经历和AI自我效能感如何参与其中。研究以问卷测量了参与者的社交焦虑、欺凌实施与受害经历、AI自我效能感及对对话式AI的欺凌式行为，发现欺凌—受害双重经历者表现出最高水平的此类行为，且实施与受害的交互是最强预测因素；单独的实施经历不足以解释该行为，单独的受害经历则呈负相关。社交焦虑不直接预测该行为，而是通过既往受害经历完全中介，AI自我效能感并非独立预测因素。作者据此认为，针对AI的欺凌式行为更宜理解为攻击性与脆弱性共存下的情境依赖行为，而非一般攻击倾向的直接延伸。

papers.title: A cross-sectional comparison of five large language models in answering Chinese-language patient queries on visual field defects associated with brain diseases
papers.authors: Shenghe Li, Ling Wang, Xiaoyan Wang, Ligang Jiang, Weihua Yang, 叶璐
papers.abstract: Background Visual field defects associated with brain diseases may arise from stroke, intracranial space-occupying lesions, and other central visual pathway disorders. Patient questions often span symptom recognition, explanation of causes, care triage, treatment, and rehabilitation. Large language models may improve access to patient education. However, their accuracy, logic, coherence, safety, and content accessibility have not been compared under controlled conditions in this high-risk, interdisciplinary Chinese-language setting. This study aimed to compare the performance of five selected large language models across multiple dimensions. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 30 fixed Chinese-language questions, refined by experts and phrased from a patient perspective, were submitted to ChatGPT 5.6 Sol, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash, Qwen 3.8 Max, and Kimi K3 through a unified application programming interface (API) client. Each model generated one response per question in an independent single-turn session, with web retrieval disabled and conversation history cleared. Three raters, blinded to model identity, independently scored 150 randomly presented responses from 1 to 5 for accuracy, logic, coherence, safety, and content accessibility. Response time, word count, non-space character count, sentence count, paragraph count, and table count were also recorded. Models were compared using the Friedman test followed by Bonferroni-adjusted Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Inter-rater agreement was assessed using Kendall’s W. Correlations were assessed using Spearman analysis with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Results Agreement among the three raters was high across all five dimensions (Kendall’s W = 0.820–0.844; all P < 0.001). The five models differed in accuracy, coherence, and content accessibility (P < 0.001, P < 0.001, and P = 0.001, respectively). No statistically significant between-model differences were observed in logic or safety (P = 0.247 and P = 0.061, respectively). ChatGPT 5.6 Sol had the highest median accuracy score [4.67 (interquartile range, 4.00–5.00)], and Kimi K3 had the highest median coherence score [4.50 (4.00–5.00)]. Both models had a median content accessibility score of 4.67 (4.00–5.00). Response time, response length, and text structure also differed among models. However, their correlations with expert quality scores were generally weak (|ρ| ≤ 0.279). Conclusion The five large language models exhibited distinctly multidimensional performance when answering Chinese-language patient questions about visual field defects associated with brain diseases. No single model consistently performed best across all clinically relevant dimensions. These findings are specific to the model versions tested on 15 August 2026; stability across repeated generations was not assessed. Response speed, length, and structure cannot substitute for direct assessment of medical quality. The absence of a statistically significant difference in safety ratings under controlled conditions does not imply equivalent or adequate clinical safety. Large language models are better suited to supporting patient education and clinician-patient communication under clinical supervision than to making diagnostic or treatment decisions independently.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以30个经专家修订、患者视角的中文问题，通过统一接口在关闭联网检索的单轮会话中比较了五款大语言模型对脑部疾病相关视野缺损患者提问的回答表现，并由三名盲法评分者对回答的准确性、逻辑性、连贯性、安全性和内容可及性打分。结果显示，评分者一致性较高，五款模型在准确性、连贯性和内容可及性上存在差异，ChatGPT 5.6 Sol的准确性中位得分最高，Kimi K3的连贯性中位得分最高，而逻辑性和安全性未见显著组间差异；响应时间、篇幅和文本结构与专家质量评分的相关性普遍较弱。作者据此指出，没有单一模型在所有临床相关维度上持续最优，回答速度、长度和结构不能替代对医学质量的直接评估，安全性评分无显著差异也不等于临床安全相当，此类模型更适合在临床监督下辅助患者教育与医患沟通，而非独立作出诊断或治疗决策；结论仅适用于所测试的模型版本，且未评估重复生成下的稳定性。

papers.title: Perioperative individualized nursing for an adolescent with recurrent tracheoesophageal fistula after endoscopic repair: a case report
papers.authors: Menghua Xia, Zheng Tan, Jia Liu, Lei Wu, Hangyan Zhao, Jie Lai Xia
papers.abstract: Background Congenital esophageal atresia (CEA) type III is a common neonatal digestive malformation, and recurrent tracheoesophageal fistula (rTEF) is a refractory long-term postoperative complication. Combined suspension laryngoscopy and flexible bronchoscopy minimally invasive fistula repair is a novel therapeutic strategy, yet standardized perioperative nursing experience targeting adolescents with multiple failed transthoracic surgeries remains scarce. Conventional nursing cannot simultaneously manage compound risks including severe malnutrition, tracheomalacia, adolescent anxiety and airway edema. This case report aimed to summarize multidisciplinary team (MDT) individualized full-cycle nursing protocols for this rare patient population. Case presentation A 17.5-year-old male patient with rTEF, 17.5 years after neonatal primary congenital esophageal atresia repair, with two failed transthoracic fistula closures, presented persistent feeding choking, recurrent pneumonia and severe malnutrition (BMI=15.5 kg/m 2 ). MDT refined airway management, quantitative staged nutrition, whole-course psychological intervention and predictive complication prevention were implemented before and after endoscopic fistula repair. No severe complications occurred during hospitalization. Esophagography and bronchoscopy on postoperative day 10 confirmed complete fistula healing. The patient was discharged on postoperative day 14 with a 0.8 kg weight gain, and one-month follow-up showed sustained fistula repair and continuous weight improvement. Conclusion MDT-driven individualized perioperative nursing effectively reduces airway and nutritional complications and promotes fistula healing in adolescent rTEF patients receiving endoscopic minimally invasive surgery. This case provides replicable evidence-based nursing references for similar complex rare esophageal malformation cases.
papers.summary_zh: 该个案报告聚焦一名先天性食管闭锁术后反复气管食管瘘的青少年患者，在多次开胸修补失败后接受内镜下微创瘘修补术，探讨针对其营养不良、气管软化、焦虑与气道水肿等复合风险的围手术期护理方案。作者采用多学科团队协作下的个体化全周期护理，围绕气道管理、分阶段定量营养、全程心理干预和并发症预测性预防展开。结果显示住院期间未发生严重并发症，术后复查确认瘘口愈合，患者体重增加并顺利出院，随访维持修复效果与体重改善。文章认为该护理路径可为类似复杂罕见食管畸形病例提供可借鉴的循证护理参考，但作为单例报告，其结论的推广性有限。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-generated and algorithmically personalized music interventions and their effects on brain function, behavior, and health: a critical review
papers.authors: Jingting Jin
papers.abstract: This critical review synthesizes empirical studies of algorithmically personalized and artificial-intelligence-generated music interventions reporting neurophysiological, neuroimaging, or objective behavioral outcomes. Literature was identified through structured searches of PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, and the ACM Digital Library through 12 August 2026, with CNKI and Wanfang searched on 22 September 2026, supplemented by citation tracking. Twenty-one eligible studies (at least 1,005 participants) were identified. Five things the term artificial intelligence covers in this literature are separated: algorithmic selection from a corpus, rule-based sonification, parametric modulation of pre-existing material, machine-learning generative composition, and closed-loop delivery contingent on the listener’s own signal. Only three studies used a machine-learning generative model, so most of the evidence concerns algorithmic personalization of existing material. Studies of closed-loop neural systems reported the most consistent neurophysiological signal, and music-based alpha neurofeedback produced higher normalized alpha power than yoked random feedback. In an open-loop design, personalized EEG-derived music was reported to attenuate anxiety induction where self-selected preferred music and silence did not, with enhanced prefrontal theta oscillations as the associated correlate. Eight studies carried a comparator capable of isolating an algorithmic component from music exposure, and all eight favored the algorithmic condition. These eight address different causal questions, use different designs, and point to no single mechanism, so their results are best read as preliminary and hypothesis-generating. Evidence quality was very low throughout. The median reported sample size was 22, no study blinded participants or measured expectancy, and no specific finding has been independently replicated. GRADE certainty was very low for every outcome domain, covering EEG oscillatory power, sleep architecture, autonomic regulation, epileptiform activity, and cognitive, behavioral and affective outcomes. Neurophysiological change is reported more often than behavioral change, and behavioral change more often than clinical benefit. The evidence supports continued investigation and does not support clinical deployment. Eight reporting and design requirements for future trials are proposed.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了算法个性化与人工智能生成音乐干预对神经生理、行为及健康结局的实证研究，检索截至2026年，纳入21项研究，并将“人工智能”区分为算法选曲、规则化声音化、参数调制、机器学习生成作曲和闭环信号驱动等类型。主要发现是：多数证据实际针对既有素材的算法个性化，仅少数使用机器学习生成模型；闭环神经反馈研究报告的神经生理信号最为一致，八项设有可分离算法成分对照的研究均支持算法条件，但这些研究因果问题、设计各异且未指向单一机制。作者强调证据质量整体极低、样本量小、无盲法与期待测量、缺乏独立重复，神经生理变化多于行为变化、行为变化多于临床获益，因此结论仅具初步假设生成意义，支持继续研究而不支持临床部署。

papers.title: Glycaemic screening before kidney transplantation should include an oral glucose tolerance test
papers.authors: Espen Nordheim, Trond Geir Jenssen, Jørn Petter Lindahl, Kåre Inge Birkeland, Karsten Midtvedt, Kristian Heldal, Morten Hagness, Markus Herberg Hovd, Anders Åsberg
papers.abstract: Presence of diabetes mellitus (diabetes) adversely affects outcomes after kidney transplantation, and glycaemic screening should be included in the pretransplant evaluation of kidney transplant recipients. However, there is limited evidence regarding the optimal glycaemic screening protocol and current practices vary. According to diagnostic criteria defined by the American Diabetes Association, diabetes may be diagnosed based on HbA1c or plasma glucose criteria, including either fasting plasma glucose or 2-hour plasma glucose during a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test 1 (OGTT). In asymptomatic patients who fulfil diagnostic criteria for diabetes, confirmatory testing is needed to establish the diagnosis 1 .KDIGO guidelines regard OGTT as the gold standard for pretransplant assessment of glycemia 2 . However, a European survey from the ERA DESCARTES Working Group indicates that this recommendation has not been universally implemented 3 . As part of the pretransplant work-up in Norway, all kidney transplant candidates without known diabetes routinely undergo assessment with both HbA1c and OGTT.This study aimed to determine the frequency and distribution of diabetes-range HbA1c, fasting plasma glucose, and 2-hour plasma glucose results among kidney transplant recipients without known diabetes. The assessments were made according to existing pretransplant protocol at the time the patients were evaluated for waitlisting.In this retrospective observational study, patients who received a kidney transplant in Norway between 2007 and 2022 (n=3290) were identified from the national transplant registry. We excluded patients with preexisting diabetes (n=724), patients listed for re-transplantation (n=26) or combined organ transplantation (n=22) as well as patients without available HbA1c or OGTT (n=466), leaving 2052 patients eligible for the study. Data describing HbA1c and OGTT were retrieved from the patients' electronic medical records. All patients have provided signed informed consent covering this kind of analyses and the study was approved by the Regional Committee for Medical and Health Research Ethics South-East (reference 407293). During the study period 2007-2022, 5.5% of patients died while waitlisted for kidney transplantation, 11.9% were permanently withdrawn from waiting list for kidney transplantation from various reasons. Among all patients waitlisted for kidney transplantation during the study period, 12 patients (0.4%) are still waiting for kidney transplantation. American Diabetes Association criteria for diabetes were used to define diabetes range glycaemic levels: HbA1c ≥48 mmol/mol or plasma glucose ≥7.0 mmol/L, or 2-hour plasma glucose ≥11.1 mmol/L 1 .The proportion of patients fulfilling diabetes-range glycaemic levels were reported as rates or percentages and the distribution is illustrated in Figure 1 American Diabetes Association criteria for prediabetes were used to define prediabetes range glycaemic levels 1 : HbA1c from 39 to 47 mmol/mol or plasma glucose from 5.6 to 6.9 mmol/L, or 2-hour plasma glucose from 7.8 to 11.0 mmol/L.As part of the pretransplant work-up, HbA1c test and OGTT investigations were generally scheduled on a dialysis-free day, by the local nephrologist. OGTT test routines have been standardized in Norwegian hospitals throughout the study period. The OGTT was performed in the morning after at least 10 hours of fasting with oral administration of 75 grams of glucose in 200 mL of water when patients were seated and had avoided smoking the same day and were in their common medical state. They were instructed to stay on a weightmaintaining diet for 3 days prior to testing and abstain from alcohol. Plasma glucose was measured just prior to, 30 and 120 min after the glucose load and HbA1c was also assessed in a pre-OGTT sample. HbA1c analyses have been standardized in Norwegian hospitals since 2007 with standardized high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) or immunochemical methods certified by the IFCC in accredited laboratories. HbA1c and OGTT test results were sent to the national transplant centre as part of transplant candidate evaluation. The year of glycaemic testing, but not the exact date, was available for this study.In case of repeated tests, only the closest OGTT preformed prior to being waitlisted for transplantation were available in this analysis.This study included results from 2052 kidney transplant recipients (1354 males /66%) with mean age at transplantation 54 years (range:18-83 years) and mean BMI was 25.8 kg/m 2 (range:16.0-36.2 kg/m 2 ). Thirty percent of the patients were transplanted pre-emptively, while 47% were in haemodialysis and 23% in peritoneal dialysis before transplantation. The mean time from the OGTT/HbA1c assessment to transplantation was 1.62 years (range 0-8).We identified 165 kidney transplant recipients (8%) without known diabetes with glycaemic test results within the diabetes range detected during pretransplant work-up. Out of these, 48 patients fulfilled the HbA1c criterion, 23 patients the fasting plasma glucose criterion while 122 fulfilled the 2-hour plasma glucose criterion (Figure 1). In 23 cases, more than one diagnostic criterion was met. Baseline BMI was comparable between included and excluded patients, but excluded patients were on average five years younger than those included.Additional data are available in supplementary material.If 2-hr glucose tests results were excluded, only 65 patients (39%) were found to have glycaemic test results within the diabetes range. This approach with HbA1c and/or fasting plasma glucose assessment only, revealed 39% of the cases compared to when 2-hour plasma glucose data were included in the analyses.Among the remaining 1887 patients without diabetes-range glycaemic test results, 976 patients (52%) had test results within range of prediabetes according to one or several ADA criteria (HbA1c criterion n=514, fasting glucose criterion n= 417, 2-hour plasma glucose criterion n= 449).The main finding of our study was that 8% of Norwegian kidney transplant recipients without known diabetes were identified at the time for waitlisting with pretransplant diabetes-range glycaemic levels. These findings are in accordance with the results from two smaller studies from Austria (n=138) and Spain (n=186) which detected 3% and 6% respectively with diabetes-range screening results among their patients waitlisted for kidney transplantation [4][5] .In our study, the vast majority (74%) were identified through the 2-hour plasma glucose criterion. These patients would likely have been missed for further diagnostics and follow-up if the pre-waitlisting OGTT screening had not been included. While some transplant centres prefer fasting glucose and HbA1c and not OGTT in this clinical setting, our findings support the inclusion of OGTT as the gold standard for pretransplant glucose assessment as recommended in KDIGO guidelines 2 . Discrepancies between HbA1c and OGTT test results have also been described in the general population 6 and among kidney transplanted patients 7 . Additionally, it is known that HbA1c has its limitations to correctly reflect glycaemia in patients with chronic kidney disease 8 . In the present study, we lack information on whether the pre-waitlisting test findings triggered a follow-up re-test and/or treatment of diabetes or preventive efforts in prediabetes, and we suggest that such measures should be implemented. Hyperglycaemia identified before transplantation can be used to discuss a tailored approach to lifestyle or pharmacological interventions, when appropriate. In cases of overweight/obesity, weight loss can prevent diabetes to develop but also put diabetes into remission when identified early 9 . Since both prediabetes and diabetes are associated with increased mortality and cardiovascular risk after kidney transplantation [10][11] , pretransplant OGTT test results can be utilized in a continuous risk assessment for post-transplant diabetes among other post-transplant outcomes, as recommended by the 2022 PTDM Consensus Meeting 12 . Some transplant centres consider use of a less diabetogenic immunosuppressive regimen for patients at increased risk after kidney transplantation 13 .A strength of our study is the relative large national cohort of Norwegian kidney transplant recipients without known diabetes, with available HbA1c and OGTT sampled as part of systemic and standardized pretransplant work up, which allowed this study to analyse the overlap among individual screening thresholds. Our study has some limitations. Treatment data on anaemia, blood-transfusions, erythropoiesis-stimulating agents and iron supplementation were unfortunately not available for this study. Reported measurements of HbA1c and OGTT were performed only once per patient, while confirmative measurement is advocated in asymptomatic subjects before establishing a diabetes diagnosis 1 . OGTT is well known to have limited reproducibility and our study cohort included primarily data from patients who were transplanted and were predominantly Caucasian, limiting generalizability to all transplant candidates and other ethnic groups.In this cohort of kidney transplant recipients without previously known diabetes who underwent pretransplant glycaemic assessment, 8% had at least one screening result within the diabetes range. Notably, most cases were identified through the 2-hour plasma glucose criterion. These findings suggest that reliance on HbA1c and fasting plasma glucose alone may miss patients who warrant further diagnostics and follow-up for diabetes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于挪威全国移植登记数据，回顾性分析了无已知糖尿病的肾移植受者移植前血糖筛查结果，比较糖化血红蛋白、空腹血糖与口服葡萄糖耐量试验（OGTT）2小时血糖三种标准识别糖尿病范围血糖的情况。研究发现约8%的患者至少一项筛查结果达到糖尿病范围，其中多数仅通过2小时血糖标准被识别；若仅依赖糖化血红蛋白和空腹血糖，则可能漏掉相当一部分需要进一步诊断和随访的患者。作者据此支持将OGTT纳入移植前血糖评估，并提示相关结果受单次检测和队列以移植后患者为主等限制。

papers.title: Co-creating the EndoWatch - a smart wearable device for the management of hypothalamic dysfunction in pediatric brain tumor survivors: a pilot study
papers.authors: Sanne C Hulsmann, Sarah B. Petras, Philippe Fraboulet, Yuan Lu, Johan P. de Graaf, Willemijn Plieger, Herke Jan Noordmans, Wim J. E. Tissing, Hanneke Margo van Santen
papers.abstract: Introduction Hypothalamic dysfunction (HD) after treatment for a pediatric (supra)sellar tumor severely affects quality of life of patients, as well as their parents and families. Patients may develop signs of fatigue as a result of persistent disturbances in thermoregulation, sleep-wake rhythm, or hormonal insufficiencies. The management of HD requires around-the-clock care by the parent or caregiver. To support patients with HD and their parents/caregivers, we co-created a smart wearable device for continuous monitoring (EndoWatch) to detect early signs of hypothalamic dysregulation. We aimed to evaluate adherence to and user experiences of the first EndoWatch design. Methods In co-creation with clinicians, patient representatives, and design researchers and engineers, an existing smart device (wearable sensor and mobile application (app)) was adapted to a first design tailored for this purpose. In a prospective, observational study, 10 pediatric brain tumor survivors with HD (8 children; 2 adults) tested the first design of the device for 14 days. The primary outcome was adherence to wearing the EndoWatch. Secondary outcomes included usability, learnability, and desirability (through questionnaires), and barriers and facilitators (through semi-structured interviews). Results Ten patients participated (8 children, mean age 10.8 (SD 3.5); 2 adults, aged 18.9 and 31.0 years). Median overall adherence was 99.4% (IQR 22.8); two patients discontinued early due to wristband-related discomfort. Key facilitators were ease of use of the device and reliable technical performance. Main barriers included the absence of a separate caregiver app and limitations of the patient diary. These findings informed design modifications for future improvements of the device. Discussion The concept of the first EndoWatch design was considered acceptable and usable by patients with HD and their caregivers. This study identified key barriers and the modifications required for improvement, which were incorporated into a second EndoWatch design, to be evaluated in a larger prospective study.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对儿童脑肿瘤治疗后下丘脑功能障碍患者及其照护者需全天候管理的问题，与临床医生、患者代表及设计研究人员共同开发了用于连续监测的可穿戴设备EndoWatch初版，并在一项前瞻性观察研究中让患者试用14天，以评估佩戴依从性和使用体验。结果显示，患者总体佩戴依从性较高，设备易用性和技术稳定性是主要促进因素，但部分患者因腕带不适提前停用，且缺乏独立的照护者应用、患者日记功能有限构成主要障碍。研究据此提出设计修改，并纳入第二版设备，计划在更大规模的前瞻性研究中评估。

papers.title: Teachers' artificial intelligence self-efficacy: development and validation of a multidimensional scale grounded in social cognitive theory
papers.authors: Tolga Topçubaşı, Oğuz Keleş, Serkan Demir, Tuğçe Gamze İŞÇİ
papers.abstract: Introduction As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in education, it is important to know how confident teachers feel about using it. Research has examined AI literacy, AI readiness and AI competency, yet few validated instruments measure teachers' AI self-efficacy specifically. The aim of this study was to develop and validate the Artificial Intelligence Self-Efficacy Scale for Teachers (AISES-T). Methods Data were collected from teachers in different regions of Turkiye within a scale development design. Following expert review, a pool of 50 items was reduced to a 27-item trial form. Exploratory factor analysis (EFA) using principal axis factoring was conducted in a first sample of 313 teachers, and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was conducted in a second, independent sample of 559 teachers. Results The EFA yielded 22 items in three factors — AI Use and Learning Self-Efficacy (11 items), Pedagogical AI Integration Self-Efficacy (7 items) and AI Awareness and Understanding Self-Efficacy (4 items) — explaining 68.51% of the variance. The CFA supported the three-factor model, χ 2 (194) = 681.49, p < 0.001, χ 2 /df = 3.51, RMSEA = 0.067 (90% CI [0.062, 0.073]), SRMR = 0.044, CFI = 0.956, IFI = 0.956, TLI = 0.948, which fitted considerably better than a one-factor model, Δ χ 2 (3) = 2,202.35, p < 0.001. Cronbach's α coefficients were 0.92–0.96 for the subscales and 0.96 for the whole scale, and composite reliability ranged from 0.92 to 0.95. Standardized loadings (0.645–0.917) and average variance extracted (AVE = 0.609–0.730) supported convergent validity, while the Fornell-Larcker criterion and heterotrait-monotrait ratios (0.632–0.776) supported discriminant validity. Discussion The results show that teachers' AI self-efficacy comprises related but distinguishable beliefs about learning with AI, integrating it into instruction and understanding how it works. The AISES-T offers a valid and reliable measure for research on AI-supported teaching and for planning teacher professional development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在开发并验证一个专门测量教师人工智能自我效能的量表，以弥补现有工具多关注AI素养或准备度、较少直接测量自我效能感的不足。作者以土耳其不同地区的中小学教师为对象，先经专家评审形成试测题项，再分别用探索性因子分析和验证性因子分析检验量表结构。结果显示，教师AI自我效能可区分为AI使用与学习、教学整合以及AI认知与理解三个相互关联但可区分的维度，三因子模型拟合良好，量表及各维度的信度与收敛效度、区分效度均获支持。作者据此认为该量表可用于AI支持教学的研究与教师专业发展规划，但结论基于土耳其教师样本，跨文化适用性尚待检验。

papers.title: Can education set the agenda for AI? Simulated innovation and pedagogical direction-setting in teacher education
papers.authors: Diana Carolina Fajardo-Ramos, Andrés Chiappe, Sandra Martínez-Pérez
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) creates a critical inflection point in the relationship between educational innovation and technological development. For decades, educational systems have often been positioned reactively: technologies emerge, institutions search for their possible pedagogical uses, and teacher education programmes adapt belatedly to tools designed elsewhere. This article argues that GenAI makes this sequence increasingly insufficient. Because GenAI can produce texts, explanations, feedback, learning resources, and assessment artefacts that resemble evidence of educational performance, it compels education to define more clearly what should count as learning, authorship, judgement, and valid evidence. The article develops the concept of simulated innovation to describe technology-led change that signals modernisation without transforming pedagogical purposes, assessment logics, teacher judgement, student agency, or learning relationships. It then argues that GenAI opens the possibility of pedagogical direction-setting: beginning from educational, ethical, epistemic, and democratic aims, and requiring technology to respond to those aims. Teacher education is positioned as a strategic site for this shift, not because teachers alone can govern AI-mediated education, but because professional formation can prepare educators to translate pedagogical purposes into criteria for design, assessment, ethical judgement, and technology governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论生成式人工智能时代教育如何从被动适应技术转向主动设定教学方向。作者提出“模拟创新”概念，指技术驱动的变化只带来现代化表象，却未改变教学目的、评价逻辑、教师判断、学生能动性或学习关系；并主张以教育、伦理、认识论和民主目标为起点，要求技术回应这些目标。文章将教师教育视为这一转向的战略场所，认为专业培养能帮助教育者把教学目的转化为设计、评价、伦理判断和技术治理的标准，但并未开展实证研究或系统实现。

papers.title: Autonomous digital lifestyle intervention for obesity: a comparative study of software-generated vs. provider-delivered body composition outcomes
papers.authors: Ioanna Pagani, Maria Syed, Cynthia Ages, Michael Bell, Yannis Raftopoulos
papers.abstract: Background Many lifestyle intervention apps for weight management rely on human coaching, which increases cost and variability, or use calorie-counting approaches that lack structured, individualized guidance. Fully autonomous digital platforms that deliver personalized nutrition and exercise plans with body composition tracking remain limited. Objective To compare an autonomous, protein-focused digital lifestyle intervention (RightBMI App) with provider-delivered lifestyle intervention for weight loss and body composition outcomes in metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) candidates. Materials and methods This prospective quasi-experimental study enrolled 160 patients at a single center (April 2024–April 2025). Patients were sequentially allocated to the RightBMI App ( n = 80) or provider-delivered care ( n = 80). Outcomes (% total body weight loss [%TBWL], % fat mass loss [%FML], % visceral fat loss [%VFL], and % muscle mass loss [%MML]) were assessed over 24 weeks using Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) with multiple imputation and inverse probability weighting, adjusting for age, Body Mass Index (BMI), and sex. A time-to-event analysis (Kaplan–Meier and Cox proportional hazards) was performed as the primary sensitivity analysis to address informative censoring due to MBS clearance at ≥10% TBWL. Results In GEE models, the App group showed significantly greater %TBWL at weeks 12 (+2.64%, p < 0.001) and 16 (+2.47%, p = 0.027), and greater %FML at weeks 12 (+2.94%, p = 0.028) and 16 (+4.20%, p = 0.003) compared with provider-delivered care. By week 24, outcomes were comparable (%TBWL: 20.01% vs. 19.97%; %FML: 36.81% vs. 35.74%). Both groups achieved substantial fat mass loss while preserving muscle mass. Time-to-event analysis showed no significant difference in time to ≥10% TBWL (log-rank p = 0.23; adjusted HR 0.83, p = 0.43). The App group had a higher MBS clearance rate by week 24 (90% vs. 71.25%, p = 0.0023) with low attrition. User satisfaction was high (mean 8.76/10). Conclusion The autonomous RightBMI App demonstrated greater mid-study weight and fat loss compared with provider-delivered care after statistical adjustment, with comparable 24-week outcomes and effective muscle preservation. Time-to-event analysis showed no significant difference in time to achieve ≥10% TBWL. These findings support the potential of fully autonomous digital platforms as scalable alternatives to traditional provider-led interventions in MBS candidates. Limitations include the non-randomized design and use of consumer-grade bioimpedance scales.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了自主数字化生活方式干预应用（RightBMI App）与人工提供者主导干预在减重及身体成分结局上的差异，对象为代谢与减重手术候选患者，采用前瞻性准实验设计并辅以统计调整和时间事件分析。结果显示，App组在中期（第12、16周）的总减重和脂肪量减少上优于提供者主导组，但到第24周两组结局相当，且均能在减脂的同时保留肌肉量；达到至少10%减重的时间在两组间无显著差异。App组第24周的手术准入率更高、脱落率低且满意度较高，作者据此认为全自主数字平台有潜力成为可扩展的替代方案，同时提示非随机设计和消费级生物电阻抗秤等局限。

papers.title: The Dual Nature of AI-Supported Medical Decision-Making: A Conceptual Framework of Efficiency, Responsibility, and Human–AI Collaboration
papers.authors: Kihwan Kim, Eunsoo Ma
papers.journal: Journal of Management Policy and Practice
papers.abstract: In the medical field, while AI-driven systems promise enhanced efficiency, diagnostic accuracy, and operational effectiveness, they also raise critical concerns about responsibility, accountability, and ethical judgment. Despite the growing body of empirical research on medical AI, limited attention has been given to the theoretical implications of AI integration from a management and organizational perspective. Our study develops a conceptual framework to explain the dual nature of AI-supported medical decision-making by integrating insights from decision-making theory, algorithmic management, and healthcare management literature. We propose that AI simultaneously enhances decision efficiency while creating new forms of responsibility ambiguity and ethical tension. The framework conceptualizes how AI capability, human–AI interaction, and organizational governance jointly shape decision outcomes, professional accountability, and organizational trust. By offering a theoretically grounded model, this study contributes to literature in three ways. First, it extends traditional decision-making theory to AI-augmented healthcare contexts. Second, it introduces responsibility as a central construct in human–AI collaboration. Third, it provides a foundation for future empirical research and managerial practice in healthcare organizations navigating AI adoption.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从管理与组织视角出发，整合决策理论、算法管理与医疗管理文献，构建了一个概念框架，用以解释AI辅助医疗决策的双重性质。作者提出，AI在提升决策效率的同时，也会带来新的责任模糊与伦理张力，而AI能力、人机交互与组织治理共同塑造决策结果、专业问责与组织信任。作为理论性研究，文章并未开展实证检验，其贡献在于将传统决策理论延伸至AI增强的医疗情境，把责任确立为人机协作的核心构念，并为后续实证研究与管理实践提供基础。

papers.title: DEVELOPER PRODUCTIVITY IN THE ERA OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND MICROSERVICES: A CASE STUDY OF GITHUB COPILOT INTEGRATION AT DUOLINGO
papers.authors: Solomiya Ohinok, Андрій Лесюк
papers.abstract: This article examines the real-world experience and results of the strategic implementation of the generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tool "GitHub Copilot" into the development ecosystem of Duolingo – the world's leading educational platform with a global audience of over 500 million users [1]. Amid rapid business scaling, the company faced a critical need to optimize code writing processes. The paper details a comprehensive approach to overcoming cognitive friction and workflow fragmentation that inevitably arose from the evolutionary technological transition of the architecture from 3 large monolithic repositories to a complex distributed network of over 400 microservices [1; 2]. Such decentralization significantly complicated codebase navigation and increased engineer onboarding time. To evaluate the effectiveness of the AI assistant's integration, a multidimensional methodology was applied in the study. Based on an in-depth combined analysis of objective quantitative GitHub ecosystem metrics (specifically pull request processing velocity) and subjective qualitative indicators measured using the "SPACE" framework (satisfaction, performance, activity, communication, efficiency) [6], the positive impact of the innovation is empirically proven. The results demonstrate that the systematic use of AI assistants in close combination with modern cloud development environments (such as GitHub Codespaces) provides a substantial increase in engineering velocity: 25% among developers working in new or unfamiliar repositories, and a consistent 10% in a familiar environment [1]. Furthermore, the article conceptually shows that GenAI tools today go beyond simple autocompletion. They act as a powerful systemic multiplier of team expertise, reduce cognitive load, and serve as an effective means of maintaining mental flow state while solving complex algorithmic tasks [3; 7; 8]. The findings create a scientific and practical foundation for rethinking the role of artificial intelligence as a full-fledged partner in the software engineering process.
papers.summary_zh: 该案例研究考察了Duolingo在架构从大型单体仓库转向数百个微服务后，将GitHub Copilot引入开发流程的实际效果，结合GitHub拉取请求处理速度等客观指标与SPACE框架下的主观体验进行综合评估。结果显示，AI助手与云开发环境配合使用可提升工程速度，在陌生或新仓库中尤为明显，在熟悉环境中也有稳定增益。文章进一步提出，生成式AI工具已超出自动补全功能，可减轻认知负荷、帮助维持心流，并作为团队专业能力的系统性倍增器，为将AI视为软件工程中的协作伙伴提供了依据。

papers.title: Toward Evidence-Based Human-Centered AI and Human-AI Interaction: A Cross-Domain Systematic Review
papers.authors: Xinyi Wang, Christine Lo, Wei-Hsiang Lo, Manhua Wang, Gaojian Huang
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly used to support decision-making, automate tasks, personalize services, and improve system performance across domains such as healthcare, education, transportation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and workplace productivity. As AI adoption expands, clearer guidance is needed to connect human-centered design principles with measurable human outcomes. This systematic review synthesized 44 empirical studies on human-centered AI (HCAI) and human-AI interaction (HAX) to examine measurement approaches, framework categories, AI roles, and domain-specific findings. The reviewed studies showed that AI support was often associated with improved objective outcomes, including task performance and decision quality. Subjective outcomes, including trust, satisfaction, usability, workload, and perceived control, were more variable and depended on transparency, explanation design, task fit, user expertise, and the level of human control. Across studies, human-led AI support was the most common role, especially in high-stakes domains where humans retained final authority. Collaborative AI appeared in tasks requiring shared activity, feedback, or adaptive support, while AI-led support appeared mainly within mixed-role systems. Domain-specific findings showed that healthcare emphasized accuracy, reliability, and overreliance; education emphasized engagement, scaffolding, and ownership; transportation emphasized safety, timing, modality, and trust calibration; and other domains emphasized fairness, transparency, adoption, and acceptance. This review contributes a cross-domain synthesis that connects HCAI and HAX principles with AI roles, evaluation measures, and human outcomes, supporting future frameworks that are easier to evaluate and apply in real-world settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了44项关于以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）与人机交互（HAX）的实证研究，考察其测量方式、框架类别、AI角色及不同领域的发现。综述指出，AI支持常与任务表现和决策质量等客观结果的改善相关，而信任、满意度、可用性、工作负荷和感知控制等主观结果则更具差异性，取决于透明度、解释设计、任务匹配、用户专业水平及人类控制程度。人类主导的AI支持是最常见的角色，尤其在高风险领域；协作式AI多出现在需要共享活动或反馈的任务中，AI主导的支持则主要见于混合角色系统。不同领域关注点各异，医疗强调准确性与过度依赖，教育强调参与度与自主性，交通强调安全与信任校准。该综述为连接HCAI与HAX原则、AI角色和评估指标提供了跨领域综合，但相关结论多为关联性描述，尚不能确立因果效果。

papers.title: Subjective and mobile EEG responses to wood-clad and drywall interior environments: An in situ crossover study
papers.authors: Julianna Marie Mollica, Analia Marzoratti, Tanya Evans, Jennifer Roe, Panagiotis Mavros
papers.abstract: Exposure to natural environments has been associated with benefits for health and wellbeing, and natural materials offer one avenue for introducing nature-associated elements into interiors. However, relatively little in situ research has examined subjective and neural responses to full-scale interiors with contrasting material characteristics. In this within-subject crossover study, 36 students completed 10-min immersions in wood-clad and white drywall prototype pods following a mental arithmetic task while self-report data and mobile electroencephalography (EEG) were collected. Adjusted models indicated greater momentary nature connectedness and perceived restorative qualities in the wood-clad pod, as well as higher hedonic tone and energetic arousal and lower stress. The primary frontal EEG measures did not differ significantly between pods after correction for multiple comparisons. Together, these findings show that contrasting full-scale interiors elicited distinct immediate subjective responses without corresponding robust differences in selected frontal EEG measures, highlighting the value of multimodal in situ approaches for studying architectural experience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了全尺寸室内环境中的材料特征如何影响人的即时主观感受与神经反应，采用被试内交叉设计，让参与者在完成心算任务后分别进入木质包覆和白色干墙原型舱停留，并同步收集自评数据与移动脑电。结果显示，木质舱中被试的当下自然联结感、感知恢复性、愉悦度和精力唤醒更高，压力更低；但经多重比较校正后，主要额区脑电指标在两种舱间无显著差异。作者据此指出，不同全尺寸室内环境能引发可区分的主观反应，却未伴随所选额区脑电指标的稳健差异，并强调多模态现场方法对研究建筑体验的价值。

papers.title: Síndrome de rumiación en un niño con encefalopatía crónica severa
papers.authors: Julieta Costas, Martín Notejane, Karina Machado, Andreina Guisande, Laura Delgado, Loreley García
papers.abstract: Introduction: rumination syndrome (RS) is an uncommon functional gastrointestinal disorder. It is characterized by repeated regurgitation of recently ingested food, which does not occur during sleep and is not preceded by nausea. It occurs in the absence of an underlying organic disease to account for the symptoms.Objectives: to describe the diagnostic and therapeutic management of RS in a child with severe chronic encephalopathy.Case presentation: an 8-year-old male with severe static (non-progressive) chronic encephalopathy and clinical dysphagia. He demonstrated normal growth until age 6. One year prior to the consultation, he developed frequent postprandial regurgitations without retching or nausea, accompanied by rumination. Symptoms resolved during sleep. Physical examination revealed an emaciated appearance, reduced muscle mass, and depleted subcutaneous fat. Body mass index (BMI) was 11,5 < P5 (z-score = -4.0). Esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) demonstrated grade III gastroesophageal reflux. Daytime oral feeding was fractionated, and complete formula was administered via continuous nocturnal gastroclysis; omeprazole was initiated, and a therapeutic trial of baclofen was conducted. The patient showed favorable progress and was discharged after 25 days with gained weight, receiving oral nutrition.Discussion: RS is a poorly recognized entity. Its diagnosis is primarily clinical and one of exclusion. High-resolution esophageal manometry combined with impedance testing is the gold standard when the clinical presentation is ambiguous. An interdisciplinary and multimodal therapeutic approach is required. Cognitive-behavioral therapy cannot be used in children with severe neurological impairment. Treatment with baclofen represents a viable therapeutic option. Careful follow-up planning is essential to monitor treatment response and potential adverse effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以一名患有严重慢性脑病并伴吞咽困难的8岁男童为对象，报告其反刍综合征的诊断与治疗过程。患儿表现为餐后频繁反流、无恶心干呕且睡眠时症状消失，经食管胃十二指肠镜检查发现重度胃食管反流，采用分次经口进食、夜间持续胃管喂养、奥美拉唑及巴氯芬试验性治疗后体重增加、症状好转。作者据此指出，反刍综合征诊断主要依靠临床并需排除其他疾病，临床表现不明确时以高分辨率食管测压联合阻抗检测为金标准，治疗需多学科综合干预；严重神经损伤儿童无法使用认知行为疗法，巴氯芬是可考虑的选择，并强调需密切随访以监测疗效与不良反应。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Attitudes and Readiness Among Undergraduate Nursing Students: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Mücahide Gökçen Gökalp, Sena Yonar
papers.abstract: Purpose:This study examined undergraduate nursing students’ attitudes toward artificial intelligence and their readiness for medical artificial intelligence, as well as the factors associated with AI readiness.Methods: A descriptive, cross-sectional design was employed. Two hundred and fifty undergraduate nursing students at a nursing faculty in western Türkiye participated during the 2025–2026 academic year. Three instruments were administered: a Participant Information Form, the General Attitudes toward Artificial Intelligence Scale, and the Medical Artificial Intelligence Readiness Scale for Medical Students.Results: The Positive General Attitudes toward Artificial Intelligence Scale yielded a mean of 3.88 ± 0.66, the Negative General Attitudes toward Artificial Intelligence Scale 3.26 ± 0.87, and the Medical Artificial Intelligence Readiness Scale for Medical Students 74.29 ± 13.43. Academic year was significantly associated with AI readiness. One-way ANOVA showed significant differences across year groups (F = 3.450; p = 0.012; η² = 0.040), with fourth-year students scoring higher than second-year students. In the multiple linear regression analysis, both second-year (β = −0.156, p = 0.014) and third-year (β = −0.143, p = 0.024) students had significantly lower readiness scores compared with fourth-year students. A moderate positive correlation was observed between positive AI attitudes and readiness scores(r = 0.430; p < 0.01). Positive attitudes toward AI and self-reported computer skills emerged as the strongest independent factors associated with readiness.Conclusion: Nursing students displayed generally favorable attitudes toward AI, yet readiness levels varied across academic years. Attitude and readiness, while correlated, appear to be distinct constructs. These findings highlight the need for intentional, practice-oriented integration of AI competencies into undergraduate nursing curricula.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以土耳其西部一所护理学院的本科护理学生为对象，采用描述性横断面设计，考察其对人工智能的态度与医学人工智能准备度及其相关因素。结果显示，学生对人工智能总体持较积极态度，但准备度随年级而异，四年级高于二、三年级；积极态度与准备度呈中等正相关，积极态度和自评计算机技能是与准备度关联最强的独立因素。作者据此指出态度与准备度虽相关却属不同构念，并建议在本科护理课程中有针对性地融入实践导向的人工智能能力培养。

papers.title: VISUAL HEALTH COMMUNICATION ON INSTAGRAM: A VISUAL CONTENT ANALYSIS OF FOUR LEADING PRIVATE HOSPITAL NETWORKS IN INDIA
papers.authors: Muneeb Javaid Mir, Mujeeb Liyakat
papers.journal: ShodhKosh Journal of Visual and Performing Arts
papers.abstract: Private healthcare providers in India increasingly use image-driven social media platforms to communicate clinical services, promote health screenings, and establish institutional standing. This study examines visual health communication practices across four major private hospital networks in India: Apollo Hospitals, Manipal Hospitals, Medicover Hospitals, and Narayana Health. Informed by visual social semiotics and the Extended Parallel Process Model (EPPM), a visual content analysis was conducted on 400 static Instagram posts (100 per network). The analysis investigated predominant health topics, design elements, persuasive rhetorical appeals, and visual framing strategies. Chi-square tests showed that the networks differed clearly in rhetorical appeals and only modestly in visual modality, but not in health topics or framing. The findings show that oncology (28.5%) and cardiovascular-metabolic conditions (23.2%) dominate the clinical agenda, consistent with India’s epidemiological transition toward non-communicable diseases. Visually, hospitals rely on 3D anatomical computer-generated imagery, metaphorical analogies (such as broken chalk representing sarcoma or decaying fruit representing viral hepatitis), and skeuomorphic smartphone user-interface elements. Rhetorical appeals emphasize institutional authority (ethos) through accreditation seals, academic accolades, and state-level inaugurations, balanced with emotional pediatric recovery narratives (pathos). Loss framing took the form of financial metaphors, such as a billing ledger of delayed care. In qualitative reading, Manipal and Apollo present artificial intelligence and robotics as markers of precision, whereas Narayana Health emphasizes accessible care pathways and patient costs, although framing did not differ significantly across networks. The results show how these hospitals handle public health education and patient acquisition within the same posts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以视觉社会符号学和扩展平行过程模型为框架，对印度四家大型私立医院网络在Instagram上发布的静态帖子进行视觉内容分析，考察其健康主题、设计元素、修辞诉求与视觉框架策略。结果显示，各网络在修辞诉求上差异明显，在视觉模态上差异较小，在健康主题和框架上则无显著差异；内容以肿瘤和心血管代谢疾病为主，视觉上多用三维解剖图像、隐喻类比和拟物化手机界面元素，修辞上突出机构权威并辅以情感叙事。作者据此讨论了医院如何在同一批帖子中兼顾公共健康教育と患者获取，相关解读带有质性判断成分。

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence in the preparation of scientific medical articles on surgery: principles of responsible use and current requirements of editorial organisations
papers.authors: О. Yu. Usenko, І. А. Кryvoruchko, Andreieshchev Sa, М. V. Коstylev
papers.journal: The Ukrainian Journal of Clinical Surgery
papers.abstract: Background. The rapid adoption of large language models between 2022 and 2026 has transformed the routine preparation of scientific manuscripts. In surgery, where the author is simultaneously a practising clinician with limited time for analytical work and is often compelled to publish results in English, the temptation to delegate text preparation to generative tools is particularly high. At the same time, leading editorial organisations have restricted the permissible scenarios for the use of artificial intelligence and tightened the requirements for disclosing such use.Objective.
