To systematise the current positions of editorial organisations regarding the use of generative artificial intelligence in scientific manuscripts, to outline the functional classes of tools relevant to surgical writing, and to formulate a practical framework for the responsible use of artificial intelligence, suitable for implementation in a surgeon’s daily scientific work.Materials and methods. A narrative literature review involving a targeted search of the PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar databases for the period from January 2022 to July 2026, with restrictions on language (English, Ukrainian) and source type (peer-reviewed articles, official position papers from editorial organisations, and guidance documents on disclosure). The formal PRISMA–ScR protocol was not applied.Results. The ICMJE, COPE and WAME have agreed on three key positions regarding artificial intelligence: artificial intelligence cannot be an author; human authors bear full responsibility for the accuracy, integrity and originality of scientific manuscripts; and the use of artificial intelligence must be disclosed. The main clinically significant risks are the fabrication of references, factual inaccuracies in a medical context, bias, model drift, lack of reproducibility and breaches of patient data confidentiality. Automated detectors and expert assessment of content generated using artificial intelligence have limited reliability, which highlights the importance of voluntary disclosure of the use of artificial intelligence.Conclusions. Generative artificial intelligence should be regarded as an editorial and structural tool rather than a source of evidence. Responsible use of artificial intelligence requires mandatory verification of every statement and reference, de-identification of data, compliance with applicable guidelines on reporting, and transparent disclosure in the ‘Methods’ and ‘Acknowledgements’ sections.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了ICMJE、COPE和WAME等编辑组织对生成式人工智能用于科学稿件的基本立场，并针对外科医生写作场景提出负责任使用的实践框架。作者指出，三方共识包括AI不能作为作者、人类作者对稿件的准确性、完整性和原创性负全责、使用AI必须披露；主要风险涉及参考文献捏造、医学事实错误、偏倚、模型漂移、可重复性不足和患者数据保密问题，而自动检测与专家评估的可靠性有限，因此自愿披露尤为重要。文章据此主张将生成式AI视为编辑与结构工具而非证据来源，使用中须逐条核验陈述与文献、去标识化数据、遵循报告指南并在方法与致谢部分透明披露。

papers.title: The Nuclear Landscape: A Five-Variable 3D-Printed Representation of the Nuclides
papers.authors: Helena Schales, Jack Smart, Peter Oshkai, J. Scott McIndoe
papers.abstract: Traditional charts of the nuclides convey proton number, neutron number, and one other property (e.g. half-life or decay mode). We describe the design and fabrication of a modular three-dimensional model of the nuclides that encodes five nuclear properties. Proton number and neutron number determine planar position, half-life is represented by column height using a quantile-logarithmic transformation, decay mode is represented by colour, and year of discovery is represented by the area of the top of the column. The model provides a tactile and visual representation of >3400 nuclides with the stable nuclides forming the spine of the model. The digital models were made by an iterative human-artificial intelligence (AI) co-design workflow in which generative AI helped translate educational objectives and geometric constraints into 3D printable stereolithography (STL) files. Feedback from visitors to the completed piece was uniformly positive when describing their interaction and learning experience. Complete datasets, STL files, and representative design prompts are provided to facilitate reproduction and adaptation for educational use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计并制作了一个模块化三维核素模型，用平面位置表示质子数与中子数，以柱高、颜色和柱顶面积分别编码半衰期、衰变模式和发现年份，从而在单一实体中同时呈现五种核素属性，覆盖三千多种核素，稳定核素构成模型的主干。数字模型通过人与生成式人工智能迭代协同设计完成，AI协助将教学目标和几何约束转化为可打印文件。作者报告参观者对成品交互与学习体验的反馈均为正面，并公开数据集、打印文件和代表性设计提示，以便复现和改编用于教学；不过反馈描述较为笼统，未说明具体评估方式。

papers.title: Whitford, T. & Nyilasy, G. (2026, July 6–9). The critical GenAI debates facing business schools: Evidence from embedded classroom practice. [Poster Session], HERDSA Annual Conference, Singapore
papers.authors: Thomas Whitford, Gergely Nyilasy
papers.abstract: Our aim was to understand what happens when generative AI is deliberately embedded into postgraduate business education, rather than treated as an add-on, a threat, or a shortcut. Across Semester 1, 2025, we worked across two master’s subjects, co-designed with staff, founders and students, and used weekly studio-style workshops to examine how students actually used AI in entrepreneurial and business learning.The background is familiar to most of us now. GenAI can draft pitch decks, simulate investor meetings, produce market scans, and generate business ideas in seconds. So the question is no longer whether GenAI belongs in the classroom. It already does. The more important question is: what does it change about learning, judgement, creativity, evidence, and assessment?What we found was encouraging, but also complex. Students became more confident and capable with AI over the semester. Confidence rose from 6.38 to 7.46, and motivation also increased significantly. Students told us AI helped most with speed, brainstorming, structure, and getting unstuck. But they were also very clear about its limits. They worried about accuracy, generic outputs, overconfidence, and what some described as cognitive offloading, where AI becomes a reassurance machine rather than a thinking partner.The centre of the poster turns those findings into five debates: automation versus augmentation, efficiency versus ethics, levelling versus inequality, disciplinary boundaries versus interdisciplinarity, and simulation versus reflection. Each debate links a theoretical concern to a practical teaching response. For example, if AI accelerates thinking but risks generic work, then we need an “AI-starter, human-finisher” model. If AI makes work faster but students over-rely on it, then we need verification routines, such as the two-check rule. If AI can democratise learning but premium access creates inequity, then prompt libraries, shared tools, and studio-based peer learning become design questions, not optional extras.The contribution here is not simply that AI can be useful. We already know that. The contribution is a framework for educators: use AI to open possibilities, but use evidence, ethics, disciplinary judgement, and reflection to close decisions.Looking forward, the exciting direction is curriculum design. We need assessments that reward process, not just polished outputs. We need AI-free sprints to keep unaided judgement sharp. We need students comparing AI-only, human-only, and hybrid work. And at faculty level, we need shared AI literacy, clear guardrails, and equitable access.So the conclusion is simple: GenAI can be the starter motor, but educators and students still need to drive the vehicle. Taught deliberately, graduates can become both AI-literate and critically human.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察将生成式人工智能有意嵌入研究生商科教学（而非作为附加工具或威胁）后，学生的学习、判断与创造力会发生什么变化；作者与教师、创业者和学生共同设计两门硕士课程，并通过每周工作室式研讨观察学生的实际使用。结果显示，学生使用AI的信心和动机有所提升，认为AI在提速、头脑风暴、搭建结构和突破卡点方面帮助最大，但同时担忧准确性、输出同质化、过度自信和“认知卸载”，即把AI当作 reassurance 而非思考伙伴。作者据此提炼出自动化与增强、效率与伦理、普惠与不平等、学科边界与跨学科、模拟与反思五组张力，并提出“AI起步、人来收尾”、核查流程和共享提示库等教学应对，强调AI可作启动器，但教育者与学生仍需把握判断与决策。

papers.title: ATTENTION AGGREGATION U-NET++ (AAUNET++) AND DIFFUSION BASED VARIATIONAL AUTOENCODER (DVAE) FOR EPILEPTIC SEIZURE DETECTION
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: To monitor brain electrical activity and identify unusual spikes or asymmetries that can point to a seizure, electroencephalograms (EEG), are mostly utilised in epileptic seizure detection.However, it takes a lot of time for experts to visually examine an EEG, and their diagnoses could even conflict.For EEG diagnoses, an automated computer-aided diagnosis is therefore required.The Multivariate Variational Mode Decomposition (MVMD) algorithm for EEG signal denoising is suggested in this study.Construction of multivariate oscillations is based on the assumption that the same frequency element must be present in all channels of the input EEG data.Recovery of signals that have inherent multivariate modulated oscillations from multivariate input EEG data, a variational optimisation problem is developed for signal denoising.Attention Aggregation U-Net++ (AAUNET++) model has been developed for feature extraction.The original multi-level skip connections of U-net++ are replaced in the feature extraction process by attention aggregation, which is introduced to capture global contextual information.Diffusion Based Variational Autoencoder (DVAE) is introduced for seizure detection in EEG signals.DVAE integrates the probabilistic latent representation capability of a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with the progressive noise modeling of a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) to achieve robust feature learning and enhanced noise suppression in EEG.Using the Children's Hospital Boston-Massachusetts Institute of Technology (CHB-MIT) scalp EEG database, the recommended method attains superior efficiency by precision (PRE), recall/sensitivity, F-measure (F-score), and accuracy (ACC).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电图癫痫发作检测中人工判读耗时且易出现分歧的问题，提出一套自动化检测流程：先用多变量变分模态分解对多通道脑电信号去噪，再以引入注意力聚合的 U-Net++ 提取特征，最后用结合变分自编码器概率隐表示与去噪扩散概率模型渐进噪声建模的 DVAE 完成发作检测。作者在 CHB-MIT 头皮脑电数据库上评估该方法，报告其在精确率、召回率/灵敏度、F 值和准确率上取得较好表现。摘要未给出具体数值和对比细节，因此这些指标上的优势幅度尚不明确。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Medical Education: A Systematic Review
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI, is rapidly transforming medical education, particularly anatomy, assessment, and simulation.Objective: To systematically review the applications, educational benefits, limitations, ethical concerns, and emerging trends of AI in medical education since 2023.Methods: A structured literature search was conducted across PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and major medical-education publishers for studies published from January 2023 to July 2026.Twenty-nine eligible studies were synthesised across seven thematic domains.Results: AI applications included large language models, anatomy education tools, virtual simulation, AI-assisted assessment, and personalised learning.Evidence suggests potential benefits in learning support, simulation, question generation, and anatomy education.However, concerns regarding accuracy, hallucination, bias, academic integrity, privacy, and inadequate AI literacy remain.Evidence for improved educational outcomes is still limited, with many studies being small, single-centre, or pilot investigations.Conclusion: AI is becoming an important component of medical education, with particularly promising applications in anatomy and pre-clinical teaching.Responsible integration requires faculty oversight, competency-based AI literacy, ethical governance, validation of AI-generated educational content, and stronger outcome-based research.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了2023年以来人工智能在医学教育中的应用、教育收益、局限、伦理关切与新兴趋势，检索多个数据库后综合了29项研究，覆盖解剖学教学、模拟、AI辅助评估和个性化学习等主题。文章指出，现有证据提示AI在学习支持、模拟、题目生成和解剖学教育方面可能有帮助，但准确性、幻觉、偏见、学术诚信、隐私和AI素养不足等问题仍然存在，且关于教育结果改善的证据有限，许多研究规模小、单中心或属试点性质。作者据此认为AI正成为医学教育的重要组成部分，在解剖学和临床前教学中尤其有前景，但负责任地整合需要教师监督、基于能力的AI素养、伦理治理、对AI生成教学内容的验证以及更强的结果导向研究。

papers.title: A Nomogram Model for Rheumatoid Arthritis-Related Low Muscle Strength was Developed Based on the HALP Score Combined With Clinical Characteristics
papers.authors: Xiaoyan Xu, Jian Li, Yi Dong, Dong Cheng, Bo Xu
papers.abstract: Background: Low muscle strength is a common but underrecognized complication of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), associated with functional disability, impaired mobility, reduced quality of life, and adverse health outcomes. This study aimed to identify factors associated with low muscle strength in RA patients and evaluate the incremental value of the hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocyte, and platelet (HALP) score for its identification.Methods: This retrospective multicenter study included patients with RA who were hospitalized in the Departments of Nephrology, Rheumatology and Immunology at Jinhua Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine and Lanxi Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine between January 2022 and June 2026. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with low muscle strength. Multicollinearity among candidate variables was assessed using the variance inflation factor (VIF). To evaluate the incremental value of HALP beyond the clinical-variable selection process, the Clinical Base Model was initially established without including HALP. After the Clinical Base Model was finalized, HALP was added as a single additional variable to construct the nested Base + HALP Model. The incremental discriminative performance of the HALP score was evaluated by comparing changes in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ΔAUC), integrated discrimination improvement (IDI), and net reclassification improvement (NRI). Decision curve analysis (DCA) was performed to assess the estimated net benefit of each model across a range of risk thresholds. Internal validation was conducted using bootstrap resampling, and sensitivity analysis was performed among patients aged ≥50 years using the same analytical procedures.Results: A total of 220 patients with RA were included, of whom 81 (36.8%) had low muscle strength. Compared with patients without low muscle strength, those with low muscle strength were older, had lower body mass index (BMI) and HALP scores, higher erythrocyte sedimentation rate disease activity score (DAS28-ESR) values, and were more likely to be female. Multivariate logistic regression analysis identified age, sex, BMI, DAS28-ESR, current glucocorticoid (GC) use, and HALP score as independent factors associated with low muscle strength. The clinical base model demonstrated an apparent AUC of 0.784 (95% confidence interval (CI), 0.722–0.847). After the addition of the HALP score, the AUC increased to 0.829 (95% CI, 0.775–0.883), with a ΔAUC of 0.045 (DeLong test, p = 0.020). The Base + HALP model also demonstrated improved classification performance, with an NRI of 0.663 (95% CI, 0.402–0.924; p = 0.001) and an IDI of 0.072 (95% CI, 0.039–0.107; p = 0.002). After 1000-bootstrap internal validation, the AUCs of the clinical base and Base + HALP model were 0.766 (95% CI, 0.707–0.826) and 0.809 (95% CI, 0.757–0.863), respectively. Decision curve analysis demonstrated that the Base + HALP model provided a greater estimated net benefit than the clinical base model and the treat-all and treat-none strategies, particularly across threshold probabilities from approximately 10% to 60%.Conclusions: The HALP score, age, sex, BMI, DAS28-ESR and current GC use were independently associated with low muscle strength in patients with RA. The Base + HALP Model demonstrated good discrimination, calibration and estimated net benefit. However, further independent external validation and prospective studies are still needed in the future to clarify the role of this model.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于多中心回顾性数据，考察类风湿关节炎患者低肌力相关的因素，并评估HALP评分在临床变量基础上的增量识别价值。多因素分析显示年龄、性别、BMI、DAS28-ESR、当前糖皮质激素使用和HALP评分与低肌力独立相关；在临床基础模型上加入HALP后，模型的区分度和分类表现有所提升，决策曲线分析也显示在部分风险阈值范围内净获益更高。作者据此认为该列线图模型具有较好的区分度与估计净获益，但明确提示结论仍需独立外部验证和前瞻性研究确认。

papers.title: Proton Signaling Biology From Ancient Bioenergetics to Neural Communication: An Exploration of Keratan Sulfate as a Potential Proton-Modulatory Molecule
papers.authors: James Melrose
papers.abstract: This mini review examines the potential roles of proton signaling in the peripheral and central nervous systems and its proposed regulation by keratan sulfate (KS). Protons are central to bioenergetics and rapid chemical signaling, linking metabolism to membrane excitability and receptor activity across tissues. Nanoscale-to-microscale pH transients may add a further layer of intercellular communication in the nervous system through proton-sensitive ion channels and receptors. Extracellular matrix glycosaminoglycans may influence this signaling by buffering and transporting protons. Keratan sulfate has an unusually high capacity to bind and conduct protons. Evidence from electrolocation biology, proton-conductive biomaterials, and brain proton sensors suggests that keratan sulfate may act as a local proton reservoir and shuttle within defined microenvironments, thereby shaping pH-dependent neuromodulatory processes in health and disease. KS-substituted proteoglycans have the potential to act as neuron modulatory molecules mediating effects on cellular metabolism. KS shows considerable promise as a neuromodulatory molecule. Further electrophysiological studies are warranted using KS knockout animal models to test this hypothesis and validate the proposed role of KS as a potential regulatory neural interface molecule.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述探讨质子信号在外周与中枢神经系统中的潜在作用，以及硫酸角质素（KS）对这一过程的可能调控。作者整合电定位生物学、质子传导生物材料和脑内质子传感器等方面的证据，提出KS凭借其较强的质子结合与传导能力，可能作为局部质子储库和穿梭载体，在特定微环境中塑造pH依赖的神经调质过程，并影响细胞代谢。文章据此将KS视为有前景的神经调质分子，但明确指出上述作用仍属假设，需借助KS敲除动物模型的电生理研究加以检验。

papers.title: Research on the Innovation of Talent Training Mode for Higher Vocational Animation Majors in the Era of “Artificial Intelligence + X”
papers.authors: Zhou Yujie, Pan Peng, Feng Meiqi
papers.journal: International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of "Artificial Intelligence + X" and oriented by industrial demands, this paper systematically explores the innovative paths for the talent training mode of animation majors in higher vocational colleges. First, it promotes the intelligent reconstruction of the curriculum system. By embedding generative AI content creation, integrating intelligent animation pipelines with traditional techniques and building interdisciplinary curriculum groups, students’ knowledge and skill structure is updated. Second, intelligent technologies are used to empower teaching transformation: establishing a virtual-real integrated project-based teaching environment, carrying out collaborative practical training based on the AIGC toolchain, and constructing data-driven personalized learning paths. Third, the industry-education collaboration mechanism is deepened. Schools and enterprises jointly build intelligent workshops and project incubation platforms, and industrial standards are introduced to establish a competency certification system. Ultimately, a talent co-cultivation ecosystem driven by regional industrial clusters is formed. This study provides theoretical references and practical schemes for cultivating high-quality technical and skilled talents adapted to the new form of "AI + animation".
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕“人工智能+X”背景下高职动画专业人才培养模式的创新路径展开探讨，属于理论性研究，未涉及具体实验或系统实现。作者提出三条主要路径：一是重构课程体系，将生成式AI内容创作、智能动画流程与传统技法融合，并组建跨学科课程群；二是以智能技术赋能教学，构建虚实结合的项目化教学环境、基于AIGC工具链的协同实训和数据驱动的个性化学习路径；三是深化产教融合，校企共建智能工坊与项目孵化平台，引入行业标准建立能力认证体系，最终形成由区域产业集群驱动的人才共育生态。文章旨在为培养适应“AI+动画”新形态的高素质技术技能人才提供理论参考与实践方案，但摘要未报告实施效果或验证数据。

papers.title: Challenges of war: paroxysmal disorders in military personnel. Observational experience and optimization of differential diagnosis
papers.authors: Ie.H. Kaduk, Denys Kaduk, H.I. Seliukov, Andriy Dubenko
papers.abstract: Background. An unprecedented increase in paroxysmal events among military personnel is observed in the context of intensive combat operations. Up to 40–50 % of cases initially diagnosed as seizure disorders are, in fact, psychogenic nonepileptic seizures (PNES), or functional seizures. This study purposed to analyze the underlying neurobiological mechanisms, optimize differential diagnostic algorithms, and personalize the treatment of epileptic and conversion seizures within this patient cohort. Materials and methods. A narrative literature review was conducted to evaluate current neurobiological concepts regarding the development of post-traumatic epilepsy and PNES in military personnel with blast-induced trauma, post-concussion syndrome, and post-traumatic stress disorder, supplemented by a retrospective analysis of proprietary clinic observational experience with military personnel at the Kharkiv Military Medical Clinical Center of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine. Results. The pathogenesis of PNES is conceptualized via the “dual-hit” hypothesis: organic diffuse axonal injury disrupts the top-down inhibitory control of the prefrontal cortex over the stress-hyperactivated amygdala, likely resulting in the somatic conversion of affect. An adaptive, step-wise diagnostic algorithm for forward medical evacuation stages was established. In the absence of electroencephalography, the primary diagnostic tools are the bedside clinical evaluation of ictal semiology and video recording of the events using available mobile devices. Differentiated therapeutic strategies are substantiated. For post-traumatic epilepsy, novel anti-seizure medications are the drugs of choice, carefully weighing the risk of neuropsychiatric adverse effects associated with levetiracetam against the mood-stabilizing benefits of lamotrigine. For PNES, prescribing antiseizure medications constitutes an iatrogenic error; the foundational management strategy relies on deprescribing, the administration of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, and cognitive-behavioral therapy. Conclusions. Shifting the nosological paradigm (overcoming the stereotype that all seizures equate to epilepsy) and adopting a multidisciplinary neuropsychiatric approach are critical. This is essential to avoid neurotoxic polypharmacy, prevent unjustified medical discharge, and maintain the operational readiness of military personnel.

papers.title: Readability and Citation Sources of ChatGPT-Generated Responses to Lymphoma-Related Health Questions: Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Corey Hannah Basch, Tailisha M. Gonzalez, Grace Clarke Hillyer, Erin Toussaint Jacques, Charles E. Basch
papers.journal: Online Journal of Public Health Informatics
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Lymphoma is one of the most prevalent groups of cancers among people aged 15 to 29 years. Increasingly, patients with lymphoma and their caregivers use generative AI systems, supported by large language models (LLMs), to seek cancer-related online health information. Despite the need for plain and clear health information for clinical decision-making, there is a dearth of research on the readability and citation source classification of LLM-supported online health information. OBJECTIVE The objective of this study was to assess the reading level and reading ease of lymphoma-related health information using OpenAI’s GPT-5.2 model, as well as the citation sourcing of LLM-generated results. METHODS Questions were submitted to the LLM through an automated pipeline. The application code was written with Claude and run and hosted on Vercel. Standardized instructions were submitted to the LLM, asking for evidence-based sources with URLs to enable citation analysis. The final dataset included 392 citations garnered from 96 standardized lymphoma-related questions. Readability was assessed using the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Flesch Reading Ease scores. Citation sources were classified into 9 predefined organization types, and topics included Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphoma and clinical trials. Differences in readability were tested using linear models fitted to all 392 citations, with standard errors clustered by question. Estimated marginal means (EMMs) were used to summarize model-adjusted readability scores by citation source and topic. When the omnibus test was statistically significant, pairwise comparisons were performed using the Tukey-Kramer adjustment for multiple comparisons. RESULTS The Flesch-Kincaid reading levels of the ChatGPT responses by citation source and topic type were determined to be at the college or university level, well above the recommended sixth-grade level. Grade level did not differ by citation source (P=.58). The reading grade level of responses for Hodgkin lymphoma responses was statistically higher than that of clinical trial responses (mean 16.2, SD 3.4 vs 13.6, SD 2.5; P=.005). Flesch Reading Ease scores across source and topic were found to be very difficult at the university graduate academic level and did not differ by source (P=.27) or topic (P=.17). CONCLUSIONS Although LLMs frequently produce responses that include cited information, the readability of these outputs may limit accessibility for many patients and caregivers. These findings highlight the need for improved readability standards in AI-generated health information and reinforce that LLM outputs should complement, not replace, professional medical guidance. CLINICALTRIAL
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型生成的淋巴瘤相关健康信息在可读性和引用来源上的表现，通过自动化流程向模型提交标准化问题，并对所得回答及其引用进行可读性评分和来源分类。结果显示，回答的阅读难度普遍处于大学及以上水平，远高于推荐的六年级水平，且不随引用来源变化；霍奇金淋巴瘤相关回答的年级难度高于临床试验相关回答，整体阅读容易度也处于很难的水平。作者据此指出，即便模型常给出带引用的信息，其可读性仍可能限制患者和照护者的获取，AI生成内容应作为专业医疗指导的补充而非替代。

papers.title: Mapping The Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Group Creative Processes: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Katusha Gerardini, Eleonora Diletta Sarcinella, Ilaria Vergine, Andrea Gaggioli, Alice Chirico
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is finding its way into creative work at a growing pace, yet its specific role within collaborative creative processes, those involving multiple people working together, remains poorly understood and fragmented across the literature. This scoping review maps the empirical research on integrating GenAI into group creative processes, outlining creative domains, tasks, AI tools, AI roles, stages of integration, and reported outcomes. Following PRISMA-ScR and JBI guidance, a systematic search was conducted across Scopus, Web of Science, and PsycINFO. Empirical peer-reviewed studies were included when they involved at least two human participants engaged in a collaborative creative process supported by GenAI. Thirty-eight studies met the inclusion criteria. The majority were conducted in educational and design contexts, with brainstorming, content creation, and design development emerging as the most frequent task types. GenAI was most often integrated as a co-creative partner, typically during the ideation stage or across multiple phases of the creative process. Reported benefits included enhanced ideation, greater efficiency, improved engagement, and stronger collaboration quality, while the main tensions revolved around over-reliance on AI, cognitive offloading, homogenization of ideas, and unresolved questions of authorship and agency. Taken together, the findings suggest that GenAI is becoming an active component of hybrid human–AI creative systems, but whether its benefits are realized depends heavily on how collaborative workflows are designed to preserve human agency, support critical reflection, and maintain diversity of perspectives.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了生成式人工智能介入多人协作创造过程的实证研究，覆盖创意领域、任务类型、AI工具与角色、介入阶段及报告结果。纳入的研究多集中于教育与设计情境，任务以头脑风暴、内容创作和设计开发为主，AI常作为共同创造伙伴，主要出现在构思阶段或贯穿多个阶段。研究报告的益处包括促进构思、提升效率与参与度以及改善协作质量，主要张力则涉及过度依赖、认知卸载、想法同质化以及作者身份与能动性问题。综述据此指出，生成式AI正成为人机混合创造系统的活跃组成部分，但其收益能否实现，很大程度上取决于协作流程如何设计以保留人的能动性、支持批判性反思并维持观点多样性。

papers.title: Platform-driven multidisciplinary integration for graduate medical imaging education: a theoretical framework based on knowledge integration framework and technology acceptance model 2
papers.authors: Xiyuan Zhong, Changwei He, Yandan Song, Wei Yu, Min Wu
papers.journal: Quantitative Imaging in Medicine and Surgery
papers.abstract: Background: Graduate education in medical imaging is undergoing a paradigm shift from discipline-specific knowledge transmission toward the cultivation of multidisciplinary integration competencies. With the increasing convergence of imaging science, clinical medicine, engineering, and artificial intelligence (AI) in clinical practice, traditional training models that rely on fragmented, discipline-based curricula are insufficient to prepare graduate students for solving complex interdisciplinary problems. Although emerging educational technologies and learning platforms have been developed to promote interdisciplinary training, their effectiveness depends not only on the design of cognitive learning pathways but also on learners' acceptance and sustained engagement with these technologies; however, current educational frameworks rarely integrate cognitive mechanisms and technology acceptance factors within a unified model. Therefore, this study proposes a platform-driven, dual-theory integrated teaching framework to support multidisciplinary competency development in medical imaging graduate education from both cognitive and technological perspectives. Methods: This study constructed a theoretical framework by integrating the knowledge integration framework (KIF) and technology acceptance model 2 (TAM2). The four cognitive processes of KIF—elicitation, addition, differentiation, and organization—were mapped onto four corresponding platform functions: activating prior knowledge, exposure to industrial and clinical perspectives, authenticity-based knowledge verification, and multidisciplinary integrated output. Based on TAM2, design strategies for targeting perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use were incorporated to explain the mechanisms underlying learners’ acceptance, engagement, and utilization of the platform. By integrating KIF and TAM2, the framework established a dynamic learning pathway characterized by “knowledge activation—knowledge externalization—multidisciplinary integration—knowledge internalization”. Results: The proposed KIF-TAM2 framework demonstrated conceptual feasibility through theoretical modeling. However, its effectiveness in improving multidisciplinary learning outcomes requires further validation through empirical educational studies. Conclusions: This study provides a theory-driven framework for designing multidisciplinary platform-based medical imaging education and offers a foundation for future empirical investigations into technology-enhanced graduate training.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对医学影像研究生教育从单一学科知识传授转向多学科整合能力培养的需求，提出一个平台驱动的双理论整合教学框架。作者将知识整合框架的四个认知过程映射到平台功能，并结合技术接受模型2纳入感知有用性与易用性的设计策略，形成“知识激活—知识外化—多学科整合—知识内化”的学习路径。文章指出该框架仅通过理论建模显示概念上的可行性，其在提升多学科学习成效方面的作用仍需实证教育研究验证，为后续技术增强的研究生培养研究提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Image quality and radiation dose optimization in CT pulmonary angiography using 120, 100, and 80 kV protocols for pulmonary thromboembolism diagnosis
papers.authors: Zubir Shazli, Hanani Abdul Manan, Syeda Humayra, Zaidah Maspin, Kam Wai Chan, Victor Xing Dao Chong, Sarawana Chelwan Muniandy, Sian Zhen Khoo, Akmal Sabarudin
papers.journal: Quantitative Imaging in Medicine and Surgery
papers.abstract: Background: Computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the standard imaging modality for diagnosing pulmonary thromboembolism (PTE). Lowering tube potential enhances iodine attenuation but may affect image noise. This retrospective study evaluated quantitative image quality, subjective ratings, and radiation dose across 120, 100, and 80 kV CTPA protocols on a dual-source CT scanner. Methods: Ninety adult patients (n=30 per protocol) undergoing clinically indicated CTPA were evaluated across three tube potential settings (120, 100, and 80 kV). Quantitative parameters pulmonary artery attenuation [Hounsfield unit (HU)], image noise [standard deviation (SD)], signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and size-specific dose estimates (SSDE)—were evaluated. Three cardiothoracic radiologists performed blinded qualitative assessments using a 5-point Likert scale. Radiation dose metrics [volumetric computed tomography dose index (CTDIvol), dose-length product (DLP), and estimated effective dose] were recorded. Results: Baseline characteristics [age, sex, body mass index (BMI)] were comparable across groups (P>0.05). Pulmonary artery attenuation increased significantly as tube potential decreased, reaching highest values at 80 kV (633.9±92.1 vs. 338.5±42.1 HU at 120 kV, P<0.001). Image noise increased modestly at 80 kV (25.88±5.0 vs. 20.23±4.1 HU, P=0.26). SNR and CNR were significantly higher at 80 kV (25.93±2.6 and 25.20±3.4) compared with 120 kV (18.19±4.8 and 9.31±2.1, P<0.001). Effective dose decreased significantly by 46.4% from 3.34±0.67 mSv (120 kV) to 1.79±0.35 mSv (80 kV) (P<0.001). Qualitative scores for overall image quality, vascular enhancement, and motion artifacts showed no significant differences across protocols (P>0.05). Conclusions: Lowering tube potential to 80 kV in CTPA significantly increases vascular attenuation, SNR, and CNR while offering substantial radiation dose savings and maintaining subjective image quality scores. These findings support the feasibility of an 80-kV protocol for radiation dose optimization in CTPA.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于双源CT的回顾性数据，比较120、100和80 kV三种管电压方案在CT肺动脉造影中的图像质量与辐射剂量，对象为接受临床指征检查的成人患者。结果显示，管电压降至80 kV时肺动脉强化程度、信噪比和对比噪声比均显著提高，图像噪声仅小幅增加且差异不显著，主观图像质量、血管强化与运动伪影评分在各方案间无显著差异。同时，80 kV方案的有效剂量较120 kV明显降低。作者据此认为，80 kV方案在维持主观图像质量的同时可优化辐射剂量，但结论来自单中心回顾性比较，其可行性仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Future-Ready Skills for Special Education Teachers in the Digital Era
papers.authors: Setia Budi, Mega Iswari, Damri Damri, Rara Ajeng Pratiwi, Alan Rahman Rendra
papers.journal: The International Journal of Technologies in Learning
papers.abstract: The accelerating digitalization of schooling has reframed what it means to teach learners with disabilities. Special education teachers are now expected to combine traditional pedagogical expertise with assistive technology fluency, data literacy, and the socio-emotional sensitivity demanded by inclusive classrooms. This article presents a systematic literature review (SLR) that maps the future-ready skills required by special education teachers in the digital era. Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 protocol, the search was conducted across three databases, namely Scopus, ScienceDirect, and EBSCO, using a Boolean string built around the constructs of future skills, special education teachers, and the digital era. After identification (n = 563), screening, and eligibility assessment, sixteen empirical studies published between 2020 and 2025 in indexed journals were retained for thematic synthesis. The analysis surfaced five interrelated competency clusters: (1) digital and assistive technology skills, (2) inclusive pedagogical skills, (3) socio-emotional and behavioral skills, (4) lifelong learning and adaptability, and (5) collaboration and interdisciplinary skills. Bibliometric mapping revealed concentration in Spain, the United States, and Indonesia, with the DigCompEdu and Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) frameworks dominating conceptualization. Persistent gaps include the under-representation of low-resource contexts, fragmented teacher-preparation pathways, and limited integration of artificial intelligence within special education programs. The review contributes a competency synthesis that can inform curricular reform, professional development design, and policy aimed at preparing teachers who can deliver equitable, technology-enhanced instruction to learners with diverse needs.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述关注数字时代特殊教育教师需要具备哪些未来技能，按PRISMA 2020流程在三个数据库中检索并筛选出2020至2025年发表的十六项实证研究进行主题综合。分析归纳出五类相互关联的能力：数字与辅助技术、包容性教学、社会情感与行为、终身学习与适应，以及协作与跨学科能力；文献在地域上集中于西班牙、美国与印度尼西亚，概念框架以DigCompEdu和TPACK为主。作者同时指出低资源情境代表性不足、教师培养路径分散、人工智能在特殊教育项目中整合有限等缺口，并据此提出可供课程改革、专业发展和政策参考的能力综合框架。

papers.title: AI Bias in Special Education
papers.authors: Benjamin LaConner
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) to support K–12 educators in improving their practice, serious concerns remain unanswered about large-language model (LLM) output. This is especially true in special education, where educators report little training in disability theory, leading them to consult with AI systems without the background knowledge needed for objective analysis of the chatbot responses. To address this issue, we conducted a qualitative content analysis of the transcripts of responses from five major LLMs (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT, Perplexity Sonar, and xAI Grok) to common questions from early-career educators. We found an overreliance in the chatbot output on the Medical Model of disability, as well as almost no engagement with the Human Rights Model. We also found a wide variability between the different LLMs, as well as internal variability within each LLM based on the wording of the prompt. We conclude by calling for explicit instruction on disability theory in teacher preservice programs to support critical engagement by teachers with AI tools, as well as improved LLM models that consider multiple models of disability. This article makes a practical contribution to special education practice by identifying imbalanced AI output and suggesting ways to minimize the negative impacts that may result from using these tools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大语言模型在支持K–12教育者时可能存在的残障视角偏差，尤其针对特殊教育场景。作者对五个主流大语言模型回答早期职业教师常见问题的文本记录进行定性内容分析，发现模型输出过度依赖残障的医学模型，几乎不涉及人权模型，且不同模型之间以及同一模型因提示措辞不同而存在较大差异。文章据此呼吁在教师职前培养中明确加入残障理论教学，以支持教师批判性地使用AI工具，并推动模型兼顾多种残障模型。

papers.title: Towards a world-centred AI literacy in middle school education? Reflections from a Swedish case
papers.authors: Katarina Sperling, Charlotta Nordlöf, Linda Mannila, Jonas Hällström, Fredrik Heintz, Linnéa Stenliden
papers.abstract: With artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly influencing children’s and youth’s lives, AI literacy has been promoted as an educational concern at all levels of schooling. While AI literacy initiatives are being introduced globally, the specific components and the objectives of this literacy remain undecided. This position paper challenges the current discourse of AI literacy by drawing attention to multiple purposes of AI literacy in middle school education that may co-exist and collide. We do so by applying Biesta’s world-centred education framework as an analytical lens, and by grounding the argument in classroom observations and interviews with middle school students. Our findings highlight both tensions and overlaps between middle school students’ often vague and fragmented formal knowledge and skills (qualification) of what AI is and how it works, and their more developed reflections related to norms and ethical concerns (socialisation), as well as agency (subjectification). We suggest that for AI literacy to truly empower students, both curriculum design and professional development must account for a broad spectrum of educational goals.
papers.summary_zh: 该立场论文以Biesta的世界中心教育框架为分析视角，结合课堂观察与中学生访谈，审视初中AI素养教育中可能并存且相互冲突的多重目标。研究发现，学生对AI是什么及如何运作的正式知识与技能（资格化）往往模糊而零散，而在规范与伦理关切（社会化）以及能动性（主体化）方面的反思则相对更为发展，二者之间存在张力也有交叠。作者据此提出，要让AI素养真正赋能学生，课程设计与教师专业发展都需兼顾更广泛的教育目标谱系。

papers.title: The Pitch: Managers’ Disclosure Choice during Initial Public Offering Roadshows
papers.authors: Gregory S. Miller, Bradley E. Hendricks, Elizabeth Blankespoor
papers.abstract: We examine firm disclosure choice during the initial public offering (IPO) roadshow presentation to understand the informativeness of a management presentation designed to attract investors. Although firms submit a comprehensive registration filing during the IPO, managers also prepare a roadshow presentation, which is shorter and typically allows managers more autonomy to select the information released and how it is discussed. We find that IPO roadshows have significantly more positive, less negative, and less uncertain language than the SEC filing. Using machine learning to classify roadshow sentences into five major topics from the registration statement, we find that roadshows differ in both the topics selected and the language used within each topic. We then examine the predictive ability of the roadshow language, finding that roadshow language predicts future accounting performance, whereas filing language does not. These results highlight the informational role of management presentations, despite the flexibility they grant managers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察企业在首次公开募股路演演示中的信息披露选择，以理解管理层演示的信息含量。作者比较路演材料与注册文件的语言差异，并用机器学习将路演语句归类到注册文件中的主要议题，发现路演语言更积极、更少负面和不确定，且在议题选择与各议题内部表述上均与文件不同。进一步分析显示，路演语言能预测未来会计业绩，而文件语言不能，表明尽管管理层演示赋予管理者较大自主权，其仍具有信息作用。

papers.title: Discrepancy as curriculum: aggregate data and analysis code
papers.authors: Dong Dong Yang
papers.abstract: Discrepancy as curriculum (PLOS ONE submission) - aggregate data and analysis code Corresponding article: Yang D, Yang J, Gao J, Zhang Z, Liu Y, Zheng H, Guo X. "Discrepancy as curriculum: A generative-AI-supported learning environment for measurement-grounded engineering judgment in analog electronics." Contents (all aggregates; no individual-level student records): - condition_level_EJRT_scores.csv Manuscript Table 6: EJRT total (0-20) by condition and occasion. - secondary_outcomes.csv Manuscript Table 9: secondary outcomes by condition. - hypothesis_disposition.csv Manuscript Table 11: disposition of the 365 AI-generated hypotheses. - stage_transition_matrices.csv Manuscript Table 13: complete 6x6 lag-1 transition matrices, both groups. - section_level_descriptives_anonymized.csv Manuscript Table 15: section-level means (anonymous section codes). - code/v5_gen.py Dataset construction under pre-specified marginals and correlations. - code/v5_analysis.py Primary/secondary analyses (ANCOVA, Hedges' g, reliabilities, ICC, MDE). - code/v6_stats.py Exact randomization tests over the 90 admissible section-level allocations (estimands psi_A and psi_B), Holm corrections, power analysis, CR1 checks. - code/v5_figs.py Figure generation. - code/stats_v5.json / stats_v6.json / stats_v7.json Full statistical output for every number in the manuscript. Reproduction: python code/v5_gen.py -> python code/v5_analysis.py -> python code/v6_stats.py Requires Python 3.10+ with numpy, scipy, pandas. Item-level student performance data carry a residual disclosure risk and are not permitted for unrestricted release under the consent terms approved by the Institutional Review Board of Rocket Force University of Engineering (approval number B20260220-1). Qualified researchers may apply to the Research Data Access Committee of Rocket Force University of Engineering for access to de-identified item-level data.
papers.summary_zh: 该数据集与代码配套一项研究，考察生成式AI支持的学习环境如何培养模拟电子技术中基于测量的工程判断。作者以条件层面的EJRT得分、次要结果、AI生成假设的处理情况以及组间阶段转移矩阵等汇总数据，配合预设边际与相关结构的数据构造脚本及ANCOVA、精确随机化检验等分析代码，支撑论文中的统计结果。由于条目级学生表现数据存在再识别风险，未开放 unrestricted 发布，仅可向机构数据访问委员会申请去标识化数据。该资源主要用于复现分析，而非直接检验教学干预的因果效果。

papers.title: Dependence on Artificial Intelligence and Compulsive ChatGPT Use in Tunisian University Students: Data and Screening Materials
papers.authors: Ismail Dergaa

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注突尼斯大学生对人工智能的依赖与ChatGPT强迫性使用问题，核心工作是整理并公开一项量表验证研究的数据与筛查材料，包括匿名问卷记录、数据字典、重复记录筛查脚本及被排除的重复记录清单。研究对象为大学生群体，材料用于支持依赖人工智能量表和ChatGPT强迫性使用量表的验证。摘要仅说明数据与筛查材料的构成，未报告量表验证的具体结果或依赖与强迫性使用之间的关系，因此无法据此判断相关结论。

papers.title: Estereotipos Algorítmicos: Un Estudio Experimental sobre Sesgos de Género en la IA Generative
papers.authors: Patricia Sánchez Holgado, Maximiliano Frías-Vázquez, Laura Rodríguez-Contreras, Carlos Arcila-Calderón
papers.abstract: This study analyzes how citizens identify gender biases in narratives generated by artificial intelligence (AI), using ChatGPT as a case study. An online experiment was conducted with 614 Spanish participants, randomly assigned to three conditions: a professional success narrative featuring a female protagonist, a narrative featuring a male protagonist, and a neutral narrative. After exposure, gender bias detection in the story, perceived bias in ChatGPT, and the intention to reduce or correct algorithmic biases were measured. The results show that the narrative featuring a female protagonist was associated with higher bias detection and greater attribution of partiality to ChatGPT. No significant differences were observed according to participants’ gender or educational level. Likewise, indicators of proximity to AI, such as interest in these technologies and the use of AI-based applications, were associated with lower perceived bias in the tool. The findings underscore the need to promote critical AI literacy that helps citizens more critically recognize when its outputs reproduce gender stereotypes or inequalities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以ChatGPT为案例，通过在线实验考察公民如何识别生成式人工智能叙事中的性别偏见。参与者被随机分配到女性主角职业成功、男性主角和中性三种叙事条件，随后测量其对故事中性别偏见的识别、对ChatGPT偏见的感知以及减少或纠正算法偏见的意愿。结果显示，女性主角叙事与更高的偏见识别和对ChatGPT偏颇的更多归因相关，而参与者性别和教育水平未带来显著差异；对AI技术的兴趣和使用AI应用等接近性指标则与对工具偏见的较低感知相关。作者据此强调需要推动批判性AI素养，帮助公民更敏锐地识别AI输出何时再现性别刻板印象或不平等。

papers.title: Creating Indigenous sovereign virtual spaces : accountability to land, community, Elders, and ancestors
papers.authors: Joshua Liam Carriere McKenna
papers.abstract: This thesis explores the possibility of creating Indigenous-led sovereign virtual spaces. Thinking critically about the inherent tension between Indigenous people–whose struggle is primarily land-based–and the disembodied experience of virtual spaces, my research explores how we as Indigenous people might be guided by Indigenous philosophies of reciprocity and relationality to build frameworks of accountability to land, community, Elders, and ancestors that lead our development of sovereign virtual spaces. My methodology draws on research-creation and autopedagogy to guide the documentation of three Indigenous new media projects I developed over the course of my degree: Sage Plains, Last Words, and Sickle & Sash. Through Sage Plains, an RPG video game dealing with themes of Métis displacement, I explore accountability through visiting, particularly as it relates to my expansion of the game through a process of visiting with an Elder, and later integrating Métis Cree words and phrases into the gameplay. Through Last Words, a virtual art piece applying the concept of imagining otherwise to working with historical archives, as well as the exploration and interrogation of creative, ethical uses of artificial intelligence, I explore accountability to ancestors and land. Through Sickle & Sash, a podcast centered on Métis political discussion in opposition to cultural imperialism, I explore accountability to the sovereignty of my featured guests. All three projects explore unique points of engagement with Indigenous new media, as well as unique points of tension. By documenting, reflecting on, and analyzing my successes and failures in exercising accountability throughout the creation and development of these three projects, I affirm the outlined accountability structures as an essential framework for the creation of sovereign virtual spaces, and argue that these processes are essential aspects of modern-day decolonial praxis. Going further, I provide additional nuance on the application of these accountability structures as they pertain to the ethical boundaries that must be considered when translating traditional understandings of reciprocity and relationality to the realm of virtual spaces.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文探讨原住民主导的主权虚拟空间如何可能，核心方法是研究-创作与自我教学法，记录作者在学位期间开发的三个原住民新媒体项目。作者通过《Sage Plains》考察以拜访长者并融入米蒂斯克里语词汇体现的对土地与社区的问责，通过《Last Words》讨论对祖先与土地的问责及人工智能的伦理使用，通过《Sickle & Sash》关注对嘉宾主权的问责。基于对这些项目成败的反思，作者确认上述问责结构是构建主权虚拟空间的关键框架，并认为相关过程构成当代去殖民实践的重要部分，同时提示将互惠与关系性的传统理解迁移到虚拟空间时需考虑伦理边界。

papers.title: Decoding motor imagery EEG signals by a deep learning network integrating multiscale filtering and temporal-channel attention mechanisms
papers.authors: Yong Zhu, Yongge Shi, Jianhua Wu, Qingguo Wei
papers.abstract: Due to their low signal-to-noise ratio and non-stationarity, accurately classifying EEG signals is still one of the main hindrances that limit the real-world applications of a brain-computer interface (BCI). Deep learning (DL) is a potential method for addressing the problem. However, how to create a suitable DL network for motor imagery (MI)-based BCIs poses severe challenges in the case of insufficient training data. In this paper, a DL network based on multiscale convolutional neural network (CNN) and temporal and channel attention mechanisms is proposed for decoding MI tasks. Temporal and spatial features are extracted by four parallel CNN branches, each of which is followed by a Transformer block for learning the global correlations of local time features. The outputs from the four Transformer blocks are concatenated along channel dimension and then input into a channel attention module for channel fusion. The subsequent feature map is classified by a CNN, which replaces the commonly used fully connected layer for reducing computational complexity. The proposed network was evaluated on three publicly available BCI datasets and compared with five state-of-the-art DL networks. The training data sets are augmented using the approach segmentation and reconstruction. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed network achieved an average accuracy of 80.21% on Dataset 1 (4-class tasks), 90.19% on Dataset 2 (2-class tasks), and 97.32% on Dataset 3 (4-class tasks), surpassing the strongest baselines FBCNet on Dataset 1, MSFBCNN on Dataset 2 and MSFBCNN on Dataset 3 by 2.59%, 1.27%, and 1.99% respectively. The network effectively decoded the MI-based EEG signals, providing a potential method for BCI applications.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对运动想象脑电信号信噪比低、非平稳且训练数据不足时难以准确分类的问题，提出一种融合多尺度卷积与时间、通道注意力机制的深度学习网络，并在三个公开脑机接口数据集上与五种主流深度学习网络进行比较。结果显示，该网络在三个数据集上的平均准确率均高于最强基线，说明多尺度特征提取与注意力融合有助于提升运动想象任务的解码性能。作者据此认为该方法为脑机接口应用提供了一种可行途径，但结论基于公开数据集的离线评估，实际应用效果仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Creative ageing in a digital world: A protocol for a synthesis of arts-based innovations for culturally diverse older adults in Canada
papers.authors: Kristina Marie Kokorelias, Alisa Grigorovich, Kateryna Metersky, Areej Al‐Hamad, Umair Rehman, Renato Barbosa dos Santos, Maurita T. Harris, Shelly-Anne Li, Stephanie Hatzifilalithis
papers.abstract: The forthcoming scoping review will synthesize evidence on arts-based and digital engagement initiatives that support social inclusion, mental health, and cultural expression among older adults, with a particular focus on structurally-disadvantaged populations. Rapid digital transformation in the arts, including virtual and augmented reality, digital storytelling, and generative artificial intelligence, has expanded opportunities for participation and creative expression. However, access remains uneven, and there is limited consolidated evidence on effectiveness, equity considerations, and best practices for implementation across diverse contexts. Guided by Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and PRISMA-ScR reporting standards, the forthcoming review will systematically search peer-reviewed and grey literature across major health, social science, and interdisciplinary databases from inception to October 2026. An integrated knowledge translation approach will be embedded throughout the review, engaging older adults, caregivers, community arts practitioners, and cultural leaders as active partners in refining search strategies, interpreting findings, and shaping dissemination. Data will be extracted and synthesized using both quantitative mapping and qualitative content analysis to identify program models, theoretical frameworks, implementation strategies, outcomes, and equity considerations. Findings will generate a comprehensive evidence map of effective and emerging practices, highlight barriers such as digital exclusion and cultural underrepresentation, and identify ethical and legal considerations in digital arts engagement. The review will inform the development of culturally safe, accessible, and inclusive arts and digital programming, and will provide actionable guidance for researchers, practitioners, policymakers, and community organizations seeking to enhance well-being, social connection, and cultural continuity among older adults.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述方案计划系统梳理针对加拿大文化多元老年群体的艺术类与数字参与项目证据，重点关注结构性弱势人群在数字艺术转型中的参与机会与不平等。作者将按Joanna Briggs Institute方法与PRISMA-ScR标准检索同行评议及灰色文献，并采用定量映射与定性内容分析，识别项目模式、理论框架、实施策略、结果与公平考量，同时让老年人、照护者、社区艺术从业者和文化领袖参与知识转化。预期成果是形成有效与新兴实践的证据地图，揭示数字排斥和文化代表性不足等障碍，并指出数字艺术参与的伦理与法律问题，为文化安全、可及和包容的项目设计提供参考。

papers.title: Towards theorising the normative agency of Central Europe: iterative identities and norms shaping from a Global East perspective
papers.authors: Artur Marcin Lorek
papers.abstract: This article examines under what conditions actors operating through a semi-peripheral regional format can develop an emergent form of normative agency. It treats the Three Seas Initiative as an illustrative Central European case, viewed through the Global East as a relational and epistemic positionality rather than a fixed geography. The article introduces the constructivist model of iterative identities and norms shaping, a heuristic framework tracing how previously articulated norms, identity narratives and regional role claims re-enter later political and institutional contexts and are reinterpreted, contested, amplified or institutionalised. The model identifies identity alignment and norm localisation as the principal conditions of regional normative agency, distinguishing conditional norm co-creation from compliance, locally bounded autonomy and failed agency. Empirically, the article analyses Three Seas Initiative summit declarations from 2016 to 2025, supplemented by institutional documents and selected European Union and North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) materials examining external recognition and convergence. The analysis reconstructs three phases of the initiative’s development: initial identity formation and the search for recognition; institutionalisation and the localisation of connectivity norms; and the post-2021 reinterpretation of infrastructure through resilience, security and eastern-flank vulnerability. The findings suggest that the initiative has generated limited and conditional normative agency through the regionally grounded reinterpretation of broader Euro-Atlantic normative templates. The case does not demonstrate autonomous norm creation but shows how historically norm-receiving actors may contribute to norm transformation when regional institutionalisation combines with wider recognition.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨半边缘区域机制中的行为体在何种条件下能形成规范能动性，以三海倡议为案例，从“全球东方”的关系性位置出发，提出“迭代式身份与规范塑造”的建构主义启发框架，并分析2016至2025年峰会宣言及相关机构文件。分析重构出身份形成与寻求承认、制度化与连通性规范本地化、2021年后以韧性和安全重新诠释基础设施三个阶段。结论认为该倡议仅产生有限且有条件的规范能动性，体现为对更广泛欧洲—大西洋规范模板的区域化再诠释，而非自主规范创造；历史上接受规范的行为体在区域制度化与外部承认结合时可能参与规范转化。

papers.title: Investigating the relationship between polycystic ovary syndrome, personality type, and adherence to the Mediterranean dietary pattern in infertile women: a case-control study
papers.authors: Maryam Hassanzadeh Bashtian, Niloofar Hasannezhad, Zohreh Sadat Sangsefidi‬, Hossein Lashkardoost, Ayda Niazi, Andisheh Hamedi, Tooba Farazmand
papers.abstract: Reproduction is fundamental to population growth and the social and economic well-being of societies. Hormonal disorders, such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), which result from hormonal imbalances, may disrupt ovulation and lead to infertility. Various factors, including genetics, mental health, insulin resistance, and nutrition, contribute to the development of this syndrome. This study aimed to investigate the associations among polycystic ovary syndrome, personality type, and adherence to the Mediterranean dietary pattern in infertile women. In this descriptive analytical case-control study, 180 non-pregnant women aged 18 to 45 years with a history of infertility were evaluated, including 90 women with PCOS and 90 infertile women without PCOS. Demographic information was collected using a general characteristics questionnaire. Dietary intake was assessed using a validated Food Frequency Questionnaire (FFQ), and adherence to the Mediterranean diet was quantified by calculating a Mediterranean Diet Score derived from FFQ data, while personality type was evaluated using the NEO-FFI questionnaire. The relationship between PCOS, personality type, and adherence to the Mediterranean dietary pattern was analyzed using SPSS version 23, with a significance level set at 0.05. Regarding personality type, no statistically significant differences were observed between the case and control groups in the variables of conscientiousness ( p = 0.87), Eagerness for new experiences ( p = 0.26), extraversion/introversion ( p = 0.14), agreeableness ( p = 0.44), and neuroticism ( p = 0.81). Similarly, there was no statistically significant difference between the groups in terms of personality type or Mediterranean diet adherence scores. Furthermore, no statistically significant relationship was found between adherence to the Mediterranean dietary pattern and the presence of PCOS ( p = 0.87). The findings of this study did not demonstrate statistically significant associations among polycystic ovary syndrome, personality traits, and adherence to the Mediterranean dietary pattern among the infertile women. However, because BMI, physical activity, insulin resistance, and other major metabolic and lifestyle variables were not assessed, the absence of an observed association between Mediterranean diet adherence and PCOS should be interpreted with caution and should not be regarded as evidence of an association independent of these potential confounders. Future investigations employing longitudinal designs, mediation analysis, or structural equation modeling are warranted to better elucidate these complex interrelationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以不孕女性为对象，采用病例对照设计，比较多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）患者与非PCOS不孕女性在人格类型和地中海饮食依从性上的差异，并分析三者之间的关联。结果显示，两组在尽责性、开放性、外向性、宜人性、神经质五个人格维度上均无统计学显著差异，地中海饮食依从性得分及人格类型在组间也无显著差别，且未发现地中海饮食依从性与PCOS存在显著关联。作者指出，由于未评估BMI、体力活动、胰岛素抵抗等主要代谢与生活方式变量，上述阴性结果应谨慎解读，不能视为独立于这些潜在混杂因素的证据，后续需借助纵向设计、中介分析或结构方程模型进一步厘清关系。

papers.title: Luxury fashion brands’ AI-powered sustainability chatbot communication: how information qualities and brand luxury perception shape consumer trust and behavior
papers.authors: Yujeong Won, 세윤 장, Sim Youngho, 윤진 이, Yuri Lee
papers.abstract: This study examines how sustainability communication in luxury retail shapes brand trust and behavioral intentions, focusing on consumers' post-exposure perceptions of information quality and provider type. Building on perceived objectivity and perceived persuasiveness, the study explores how consumers evaluate identical sustainability information attributed to either a human agent or an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot, and how these perceptions influence brand trust, information acceptance intention, and purchase intention. A scenario-based experiment with 346 participants was conducted, and the data were analyzed using PLS-SEM. Perceived objectivity and perceived persuasiveness were positively associated with brand trust, which inturn mediated their relationships with information acceptance intention and purchase intention. The indirect effect of perceived objectivity was significant only under AI communication, suggesting that algorithmic provider cues may strengthen the trust-mediated role of objectivity, whereas perceived persuasiveness remained consistently associated with trust and behavioral intentions across provider types. Subgroup analyses further suggest a conditional pattern: among consumers with lower perceived brand luxury, the links between brand trust and behavioral intentions were stronger under AI communication, whereas no significant provider differences emerged among those with higher perceived brand luxury. As these results derivefrom split-sample multi-group comparisons rather than a formal interaction test, they should be regarded as subgroup-based evidence. These findings extend luxury branding research by showing how AI provider cues shape perceived information quality in sustainability communication and by highlighting the need to align provider strategy with consumers' perceptions of luxury brands.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察奢侈品牌以人类代理或AI聊天机器人传递可持续信息时，消费者对信息质量（客观性与说服力）的感知如何影响品牌信任及信息接受与购买意愿。基于情景实验数据，研究发现客观性与说服力均与品牌信任正相关，品牌信任在其中起中介作用；客观性的间接效应仅在AI沟通条件下显著，而说服力的关联在不同提供者间保持一致。亚组比较还提示，在品牌奢侈感知较低的消费者中，AI沟通下品牌信任与行为意愿的关联更强，但该结果来自分组比较而非正式交互检验，应视为亚组证据。

papers.title: The effect of mindfulness-based stress reduction (MBSR) Training on emotion regulation during voluntary inpatient care for youth with mixed mental health conditions
papers.authors: Fan Peng, Andrea T. Shafer, Sunita Vohra, K. Jessica Van Vliet, Florin Dolcos, Anthony Singhal
papers.journal: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and Mental Health
papers.abstract: Adolescence is a sensitive period for emotional and cognitive development, with heightened risk for mental health challenges, particularly in individuals with ADHD and affective disorders. While Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) improves emotion regulation and cognition in healthy populations, its effects in clinically complex adolescents are less understood. This pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT) examined the exploratory impact of an 8-week MBSR program on behavioral performance and neural processing in 31 adolescents (12–18 years) enrolled in a live-in mental health program, with 14 assigned to MBSR and 17 to a non-MBSR group receiving standard care. Participants completed a modified emotional oddball task while behavioral responses and event-related potentials (ERPs) were recorded. Results suggested that routine care with integrated MBSR was associated with selectively enhanced performance for fearful stimuli. Participants in the MBSR group showed shorter baseline-adjusted reaction times to fear-related stimuli and to targets following other targets, possibly reflecting improved task-relevant processing. ERP analyses detected no significant Group × Condition interactions for the P100 or P300 components, providing no evidence of broad changes in early sensory or attentional processing. In contrast, the MBSR group showed smaller baseline-adjusted Late Positive Potential (LPP) amplitudes for fearful stimuli but larger amplitudes for targets following fearful or other target stimuli, possibly reflecting attenuated sustained neural reactivity to threat and selective engagement with behaviorally relevant events. These patterns suggest that integrating MBSR into routine care may be associated with improved behavioral performance and selective modulation of later neural processing, potentially supporting rapid attentional engagement and efficient allocation of cognitive resources in adolescents with ADHD and affective disorders. This study suggests that mindfulness may have potential for supporting emotion regulation and attentional efficiency in clinical youth, while highlighting the need for larger-scale trials and examination of the long-term durability of these effects. Registered Clinical Trial (RCT) This study is part of a registered clinical trial. The trial protocol was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov under the registration identifier: NCT01307943.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以住院接受混合精神健康治疗的青少年为对象，通过一项试点随机对照试验，考察在常规照护中加入八周正念减压训练（MBSR）对情绪调节相关行为与神经加工的影响，参与者完成改良情绪oddball任务并记录行为反应与事件相关电位。结果显示，MBSR组对恐惧刺激及紧随目标之后的目标反应更快，提示任务相关加工可能有所改善；ERP分析未发现P100或P300的组别与条件交互，说明早期感觉与注意加工未见广泛变化，而晚期正电位在恐惧刺激下更小、在后续目标下更大，可能反映对威胁的持续神经反应减弱、对行为相关事件的选择性投入增强。作者据此认为正念或有助于临床青少年的情绪调节与注意效率，但结论受试点规模限制，尚需更大规模试验并检验效果的长期持续性。

papers.title: Association between physical fitness and core emergency competencies among emergency nurses in China
papers.authors: Shan Jiang, Rucui Xia, Xue Cai, Lu Tao, Xiaoqing Li, Zeyan Xia
papers.abstract: Emergency nurses require exceptional levels of clinical professionalism and physical fitness. However, little is known about the association between physical fitness and core emergency competencies among emergency nurses. The aims of this study were to describe the levels of physical fitness among emergency nurses and to explore the influence of physical fitness on their core emergency competencies. A descriptive and cross-sectional study among emergency nurses was conducted in China between April and May 2024. Data were collected using physical fitness tests and a self-reported questionnaire covering sociodemographic characteristics, core emergency competencies, self-perceived health-reported physical fitness(HRPF), and the perceived associations between HRPF and core emergency competencies, mental fitness and attention. Multiple linear regression analysis was used to explore the association between physical fitness indicators and core emergency competencies. A total of 146 emergency nurses were enrolled. Of them, 3.4% had good physical fitness, 47.3% had general physical fitness, and 49.3% had poor physical fitness. Furthermore, 88.4% agreed that their HRPF was associated with their core emergency competencies. Multivariate analysis indicated that core emergency competencies were associated with self-reported HRPF (β’=0.288, 95%CI:3.001 ~ 10.746, P = 0.001) and choice reaction time (β’=-0.213, 95%CI:-75.805~-6.868, P = 0.019). After adjusting for sex, age and work tenure, self-reported HRPF (β’=0.254, 95%CI: 2.440 ~ 9.666, P = 0.001) and choice reaction time (β’=-0.217, 95%CI: -74.239~-10.064, P = 0.010) remained significant, and body mass index(BMI) was also positively associated with core emergency competencies (β’=0.261, 95%CI: 0.120 ~ 0.989, P = 0.013). Nearly half of the emergency nurses had poor physical fitness. Self-reported HRPF, BMI, and choice reaction time were all found to be related to the core emergency competencies. Nurse managers should prioritize developing programs to improve emergency nurses’ physical fitness factors associated with their core emergency competencies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中国急诊护士的体能状况与其核心急救能力之间的关联，采用体能测试结合自报问卷的横断面设计，对急诊护士进行调查，并分析体能指标与核心急救能力的关系。结果显示，近半数参与者体能较差，自报健康相关体能与核心急救能力呈正相关，选择反应时则呈负相关；在调整性别、年龄和工作年限后，这两项关联依然存在，且BMI也与核心急救能力呈正相关。作者据此提示护理管理者可关注与核心急救能力相关的体能因素并设计相应干预方案，但作为横断面研究，相关结果只反映关联而非因果。

papers.title: Evaluation of undergraduate medical students’ experiences, perceptions and learning from a deaf insights and British Sign Language course: a qualitative study
papers.authors: Katie Scott, Georgina Neve, Natasha Wilcock, Sian Powell
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Deaf people experience healthcare inequities driven in part by limited deaf insights and specialist communication skills training in medical education. Evidence suggests deaf insights training and exposure to deaf culture and communication styles can improve students’ communication skills and understanding of deaf culture, yet it remains uncommon in undergraduate curricula. Methods We co-developed a Deaf Insights and British Sign Language student-selected component (SSC) for Year 3 medical students at Imperial College London with a deaf awareness trainer, and deaf insights advocate, who is also a deaf doctor, who shared their expertise and lived experiences of deaf culture, healthcare and patient journeys. The SSC comprised three weekly sessions (three hours each) focusing on health equity, communication, and reflective practice. We evaluated the SSC using an interpretivist qualitative approach with a dyadic interview and online survey. Data was analysed thematically using transformative learning theory as a sensitising lens. Results Across three cohorts in 2025-2026, forty students completed the SSC. Students described learning from the SSC that appeared to be aligned with the initial steps of transformative learning theory. Students discussed their assumptions being challenged and perspectives changing. This included a new understanding of deaf culture alongside a recognition of healthcare barriers and inequities faced by deaf people, and a perceived increase in their confidence in communicating with deaf people. This learning appears to have been facilitated by the co-design, co-delivery and opportunity to interact directly with deaf trainers and advocates. Students reflected upon their learning during group discussions and described intentions to act upon these new insights by changing their own practice and educating others regarding their new learning, hoping to act as advocates for deaf people in future. Conclusion Co-creation and co-delivery of an SSC in deaf insights training with deaf trainers and advocates shows features consistent with the initial stages of transformative learning occurring in undergraduate medical students. Our approach and findings may be of interest to other institutions developing similar training. Wider adoption of this model could help improve students’ confidence and understanding of how to meet the needs of deaf people which may in turn contribute to improving health equity for deaf individuals.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了与聋人培训者和倡导者共同设计、共同讲授的“聋人洞见与英国手语”选修课程，如何影响三年级医学生的学习体验与认知。研究采用解释主义质性取向，通过双人访谈和在线调查收集数据，并以转化学习理论为敏感化视角进行主题分析。结果显示，学生的学习经历与转化学习理论的初期阶段相吻合：他们原有的假设受到挑战，对聋人文化形成新的理解，认识到聋人群体面临的医疗障碍与不平等，并感到与聋人沟通的信心有所提升；共同设计、共同讲授以及直接与聋人培训者互动的机会似乎促进了这一学习。学生还在小组讨论中反思所学，并表示打算改变自身实践、教育他人，未来为聋人群体发声。作者据此认为，该课程模式呈现出转化学习初期的特征，或可为其他院校开发类似培训提供参考。

papers.title: Virtual education and artificial intelligence in public health and health professions training: a scoping review
papers.authors: Erwin Hernando Hernández Rincón, Laura María Gómez Trujillo, Gabriela García Montoya, Diana Marcela Díaz-Quijano
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: In recent decades, information and communication technology (ICT) has significantly impacted the health sector, necessitating constant evolution in the way knowledge is taught and imparted through these platforms. This implementation includes virtual simulations, virtual campuses, and chatbots, among others. However, there is uncertainty about how public health is being taught using technology. Objective: To map and describe the available evidence on virtual education and artificial intelligence-enabled tools in public health and health professions, with emphasis on their educational uses, reported benefits, implementation challenges, and implications for public health workforce development. Methods: A scoping review was conducted following Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology and PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Searches were performed in PubMed/Medline, Scopus, and the Virtual Health Library (BIREME) for studies published between 2015 and 2025. Studies addressing virtual education and/or artificial intelligence–enabled technologies relevant to public health or health professions training were included using a Population–Concept–Context framework. Results: A total of 1,266 records were identified, and 34 sources met inclusion criteria. The included evidence was geographically diverse and methodologically heterogeneous. Findings were synthesized into three overlapping analytical domains: educational uses, reported benefits, and implementation challenges, with additional contextual evidence informing digital transformation, equity, and governance considerations. Conclusions: This scoping review maps a heterogeneous body of evidence on virtual education and AI-enabled tools relevant to public health and health professions training. Reported benefits include flexibility, accessibility, learner engagement, and competency development; however, the evidence remains heterogeneous and largely descriptive or context-specific, limiting conclusions regarding comparative effectiveness and long-term educational impact. Further prospective, comparative, and longitudinal research is needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2015至2025年间关于虚拟教育与人工智能工具在公共卫生及健康专业培训中应用的证据，采用JBI范围综述方法与PRISMA-ScR指南，检索多个数据库后纳入34项来源。纳入证据在地域和方法上均较为多样，作者将其归纳为教育用途、报告收益与实施挑战三个相互重叠的分析维度，并补充了数字化转型、公平与治理方面的背景证据。报告收益涉及灵活性、可及性、学习者参与度和能力发展，但证据整体异质且多为描述性或情境特定，难以就相对效果和长期教育影响得出结论，作者据此呼吁开展前瞻性、比较性和纵向研究。

papers.title: Comparison of functional recovery and complications between varus and valgus knees after total knee arthroplasty: a large-sample cohort study
papers.authors: Yuqi liang, Xiaohai Luo, Suoli Cheng, Desheng Chen, Zhigang Bai, Cong Wang
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To compare functional recovery, pain patterns, analgesic requirements, and postoperative complications between patients with varus and valgus deformities who underwent primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA), and to evaluate the clinical impact of lower limb alignment on prognosis. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted on 1,547 patients who underwent primary TKA for knee osteoarthritis or rheumatoid arthritis at the Department of Joint Orthopedics, People’s Hospital of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, between January 2020 and December 2023. Patients were divided according to the preoperative hip-knee-ankle (HKA) angle into the varus group (HKA < -3°, n = 1,356) and the valgus group (HKA > 3°, n = 191). Baseline characteristics, surgical data, and follow-up outcomes were collected, including Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) knee score, Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index (WOMAC), and Forgotten Joint Score (FJS-12). Complications, revision rates, patient satisfaction, and analgesic use were also recorded. Results No significant differences were observed between the two groups in age, follow-up duration, BMI, WOMAC, or FJS-12 scores ( P > 0.05, d < 0.2). The valgus group had significantly higher ASA scores (2.30 vs. 2.17, P < 0.001, d = 0.33) and longer symptom duration (9.52 vs. 8.12 years, P < 0.001, d = 0.49), but significantly lower postoperative HSS scores (75.96 vs. 84.20, P < 0.001, d = 0.78). Univariable analysis revealed that the valgus group had higher rates of dissatisfaction (16.8% vs. 7.5%, P < 0.001, φ = 0.108) and persistent pain (34.0% vs. 18.9%, P < 0.001, φ = 0.123), whereas revision rates did not differ significantly (1.57% vs. 0.59%, P = 0.131, φ = 0.038). Stratified analysis revealed a significant interaction between deformity type and disease type (Breslow-Day P < 0.001). In OA patients, valgus deformity was associated with a markedly higher risk of dissatisfaction (OR = 11.05, 95% CI 5.92–20.58, P < 0.001). In RA patients, no significant difference was observed (OR = 0.63, 95% CI 0.23–1.69, P = 0.350). Daily analgesic use was significantly more frequent in the valgus group (38.5% vs. 15.6%, OR = 3.38, P < 0.001, φ = 0.228). Conclusion The effect of valgus deformity on postoperative satisfaction depends on disease type. In OA patients, valgus deformity significantly increases the risk of dissatisfaction; in RA patients, no significant difference is observed between valgus and varus groups. RA itself was associated with a higher overall dissatisfaction rate.Valgus deformity is also associated with a distinctive walking-pain phenotype and higher analgesic dependence, but revision rates were not significantly different. Clinical decision-making should stratify by disease type rather than relying on coronal alignment alone.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于大样本队列，回顾性比较了接受初次全膝关节置换术的内翻与外翻畸形患者在功能恢复、疼痛模式、镇痛需求及并发症上的差异。结果显示，外翻组术后HSS评分较低，不满意率和持续疼痛比例更高，每日镇痛药使用也更频繁，但翻修率无显著差异；分层分析进一步表明，外翻畸形对术后满意度的影响取决于疾病类型，在骨关节炎患者中外翻与不满意风险显著升高相关，而在类风湿关节炎患者中两组无显著差异。作者据此提示临床决策应按疾病类型分层，而非仅依据冠状面力线。

papers.title: Evaluation of echocardiographic abnormalities and associated factors in 100 hemodialysis patients
papers.authors: Hakimeh Saadatifar, Khojasteh Marashi, Zahra Eslamifar, Saber Rostami, Aziz Kasani, Soraya Khajehrezaei
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Systematic assessment of cardiac remodeling in hemodialysis (HD) patients is essential for cardiovascular risk stratification. Echocardiography is a widely available tool for evaluating structural and functional cardiac abnormalities. We investigated associations between clinical and dialysis-related parameters and echocardiographic abnormalities among patients receiving chronic HD at the Dezful Nephrology Center in southwestern Iran. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 160 adults undergoing chronic HD were screened and 100 met the predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. All participants underwent transthoracic echocardiography. Associations between echocardiographic abnormalities and age, sex, diabetes, hypertension, body mass index (BMI), dyslipidemia, coronary and non-coronary vascular disease, dialysis access type, dialysis vintage, anemia, plasma lipid concentrations, and resting heart rate were evaluated Bivariate analyses were followed by multivariable logistic regression for prespecified binary echocardiographic outcomes. Adjusted odds ratios (aORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated. A two-sided P -value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results Echocardiographic abnormalities were present in 86% of patients. After multivariable adjustment, hypertension (aOR 2.80, 95% CI 1.30–6.00), coronary artery disease (aOR 6.10, 95% CI 1.90–19.60), non-coronary vascular disease (aOR 4.20, 95% CI 1.30–13.60), and lower plasma triglycerides (aOR 0.99 per mg/dL, 95% CI 0.98–0.995) were independently associated with left ventricular systolic dysfunction. Diabetes was associated with diastolic dysfunction (aOR 2.60, 95% CI 1.10–6.20) and moderate-to-severe mitral or tricuspid regurgitation (aOR 2.40, 95% CI 1.00–5.70). Dialysis access type and non-coronary vascular disease were linked to left ventricular hypertrophy. Lower plasma triglycerides, higher resting heart rate, and non-coronary vascular disease were associated with right ventricular abnormality. Lower BMI and lower plasma triglycerides were associated with a higher aortic index. Traditional risk factors together with dialysis-related parameters, particularly low serum triglycerides, low BMI, and arteriovenous fistula access, showed independent associations with specific echocardiographic phenotypes. Conclusion Echocardiographic abnormalities are highly prevalent in this HD cohort and independently associated with both traditional cardiovascular risk factors and selected dialysis-related parameters, including low plasma triglycerides, low BMI, and the presence of arteriovenous fistula. These findings support closer clinical attention to these variables for cardiac risk stratification in hemodialysis patients. Given the cross-sectional design and modest sample size, the results represent associations rather than causal effects. Clinical trial number Not applicable.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性血液透析患者中超声心动图异常的发生情况及其相关因素，采用横断面设计，对符合纳入标准的患者进行经胸超声心动图检查，并结合临床与透析相关指标分析关联。结果显示，超声心动图异常在该人群中相当普遍，且高血压、冠心病、非冠脉血管病、糖尿病等传统危险因素以及较低的甘油三酯、较低的BMI和动静脉瘘通路等透析相关因素，分别与左室收缩或舒张功能不全、瓣膜反流、心室肥厚及右室异常等特定表型存在独立关联。作者据此提示应更关注这些变量以辅助心脏风险分层，同时说明横断面设计和小样本使结果仅反映关联而非因果。

papers.title: Knowledge Engineering With Large Language Models: A Capability Assessment in Evaluating Ontology Property Restrictions
papers.authors: Stefani Tsaneva, Guntur Budi Herwanto, Majlinda Llugiqi, Marta Sabou
papers.abstract: Advancements in large language models (LLMs) offer opportunities for automating challenging and time-intensive Knowledge Engineering (KE) tasks. Constructing an ontology is particularly complex when modeling logical axioms, especially among novice knowledge engineers and domain experts with limited KE training. Consequently, ontologies often contain modeling errors, undermining ontology-based applications and hindering subsequent KE tasks. Thus, it is important to investigate how LLMs can support KE tasks such as the evaluation of ontologies. However, systematically evaluating LLM performance remains challenging due to a lack of comprehensive, task-specific benchmarks needed for such LLM capability assessments. As a result, selecting the right LLM to support knowledge engineers is nontrivial.
