This study investigates how LLMs can support four concrete ontology evaluation subtasks: detection, classification, explanation, and possible correction of modeling issues, focusing on the use of existential, universal, and cardinality property restrictions. We construct a benchmark of student-built ontologies and assess the performance of four LLMs—GPT-4o, ClaudeSonnet, DeepSeekV3, and Llama3.3—on these KE subtasks. Additionally, we exemplify an annotation framework for qualitatively evaluating LLM outputs and analyse the capabilities of each model. Our findings reveal differences in model behavior and task-specific strengths, underscoring the importance of selecting an appropriate model for each KE task.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大语言模型能否支持本体工程中的本体评估任务，具体聚焦存在、全称和基数属性限制的建模问题。作者构建了基于学生所建本体的基准，考察四个模型在检测、分类、解释和可能修正建模问题这四项子任务上的表现，并辅以定性标注框架分析输出。结果显示各模型的行为存在差异，且在不同子任务上各有优势，说明需要按具体知识工程任务选择合适的模型；摘要未报告具体性能数值或因果性结论。

papers.title: Effects of paradoxical mindset on tourists’ eWOM and revisit intentions
papers.authors: Zhuoma Yan, Stephanie Hui‐Wen Chuah, Lei Chen
papers.abstract: Drawing on the value–attitude–behavior (VAB) model, the current study aims to identify the determinants that inspire customers’ electronic word-of-mouth (eWOM) and revisit intention in unmanned smart hotels in addition to the moderating influence of perceived risks. Furthermore, a multigroup analysis was conducted to investigate the differences between business and leisure tourists. This study adopts a quantitative approach where data is gathered from 396 unmanned smart hotel customers from China. Structural equation modeling was employed to test the proposed relationships. The results indicate that experience co-creation, memorable smart hotel experience, hedonic value, and utilitarian value significantly and positively influence the eWOM and revisit intention of unmanned smart hotels. For moderating relationship, privacy risk serves as a full moderator in the relationship between hedonic value, utilitarian value and attitude as well as eWOM and revisit intention. However, performance risk is found to be a partial moderator since it only moderates between perceived values and attitude but not between perceived values and related behavioral intentions. Meanwhile, results reveal the differences in moderating effects between business and leisure travelers. These findings provide important insights into whether, how, and for whom perceived values yield positive marketing outcomes, and offer practical guidance for smart hotel managers and smart devices manufacturers on how to provide better experiences for their customers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于价值—态度—行为模型，考察无人智慧酒店中体验共创、难忘体验、享乐价值与功利价值如何影响顾客的电子口碑和重访意愿，并检验感知风险的调节作用及商务与休闲游客的差异。对396名中国顾客的结构方程模型分析显示，上述因素均显著正向影响电子口碑与重访意愿；隐私风险对价值与态度及行为意愿之间的关系起完全调节作用，绩效风险则仅调节价值与态度之间的关系。研究据此讨论了感知价值产生正向营销结果的条件与对象差异，并为智慧酒店管理者和设备制造商提供实践参考。

papers.title: EXPRESS: Participation Governance in Consumer and AI Co-creation: Whether to Intervene and How to Design It
papers.authors: Mengxia Zhang, Brian Rongqing Han, Tianshu Sun, Lan Luo, Joseph M. Golden
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence reshapes digital mass customization by altering the structure of consumer co-creation. When consumers start from a draft generated by artificial intelligence rather than a blank canvas, outcomes are jointly determined by two stages: whether consumers initiate co-creation and, conditional on participation, how much refinement effort they exert. This separation makes participation a governable design margin—an issue that is largely muted in traditional blank-canvas customization, where participation and effort are tightly bundled. Partnering with a leading United States online retailer of personalized photo products, we study whether and how firm interventions at the participation stage shape downstream purchase outcomes. We develop a two-stage model in which, relative to a baseline with organic participation, a nudge lowers start-up frictions and expands voluntary entry, whereas a mandate serves as a strong boundary-case intervention that guarantees entry but can weaken how participation translates into purchase, generating a reach–efficiency trade-off. We examine these predictions in two randomized experiments. In Study 1, a light-touch nudge increases participation by 5.98 percentage points and raises revenue and order frequency. The evidence is consistent with gains arising primarily through expanded entry into consumer co-creation with artificial intelligence. In Study 2, mandates increase participation relative to nudges, but we find no clear evidence of additional gains in purchase or revisit intentions. Instead, mandates increase low-value participation, in which consumers exert minimal effort and report low purchase intention. Together, these findings show that in mass customization enabled by artificial intelligence, participation governance is a consequential design choice: firms must consider not only how many consumers initiate co-creation, but also whether the participation they induce creates downstream value.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在人工智能辅助的大规模定制中，企业是否以及如何对消费者参与共创进行干预，并与美国一家个性化照片产品在线零售商合作开展了两项随机实验。研究把参与决策与后续投入努力区分为两个阶段，发现轻量助推能提高参与率并带来收入和订单频率的增长，而强制要求虽能进一步扩大参与，却未带来购买或回访意愿的明显提升，反而增加了低投入、低购买意愿的参与。文章据此指出，参与治理是有后果的设计选择，企业不仅要关注有多少消费者开始共创，也要关注所诱导的参与是否产生下游价值。

papers.title: Digital Competence and Organizational Support as Determinants of Artificial Intelligence Technology Adoption Among High School Teachers
papers.authors: Sarah Az Zahra, Kiki Sudiana
papers.abstract: This study examines the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in secondary education by focusing on high school teachers in Depok City, Indonesia. Although AI technologies are increasingly promoted to enhance instructional effectiveness, many educators continue to face challenges related to digital competence and organizational support. This study aims to analyze the extent to which teachers’ digital competence and perceived organizational support influence AI technology adoption in daily teaching practices. A quantitative research design was employed using a structured questionnaire distributed to 343 high school teachers in Depok City, selected through purposive sampling based on predefined criteria related to digital technology usage and institutional exposure. The research instruments were validated through expert judgment and pilot testing, and data were analyzed using multiple linear regression at a significance level of ? = 0.05. The findings indicate that both digital competence and organizational support have significant and positive effects on AI adoption, with organizational support emerging as the stronger predictor. The regression model explains approximately 75.1% of the variance in AI technology adoption. These results suggest that effective AI integration in schools depends not only on individual teacher readiness but also on robust institutional systems that provide resources, professional development, and recognition. This study provides empirical evidence to support the implementation and evaluation of digital education policies in Indonesia, particularly within the Merdeka Belajar and Digitalisasi Sekolah frameworks.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以印度尼西亚德波市的高中教师为对象，采用问卷调查与多元线性回归，考察数字能力与组织支持对人工智能技术采纳的影响。结果显示，两者均有显著正向作用，其中组织支持是更强的预测因素，模型可解释约四分之三的采纳差异。作者据此指出，学校中的有效人工智能整合不仅取决于教师个人准备程度，也依赖提供资源、专业发展和认可的机构体系，并为相关数字教育政策的实施与评估提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Twenty-Five Years, Five Projects, and Five Reflections on Accessible Computing
papers.authors: Jacob Otto Wobbrock
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: I began working on accessible computing in 2001 at the start of my doctoral program by developing word prediction software for Palm PDA devices [4]. Today, 25 years later, accessibility has remained a core focus of my work and the work of my students in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI). In this keynote, I will share five projects that have significantly shaped my work, along with five reflections that continue to inform my perspective. My goal is to convey ideas from which I would have benefitted 25 years ago as a junior researcher starting in accessible computing. My five projects are EdgeWrite [9], Slide Rule [3], enhanced area cursors [1] and, in particular, the Pointing Magnifier [2], ability-based design [7,8], and the epidemiological model of mobile app accessibility [5,6]. My five reflections concern prioritizing depth, the power of participant-driven prototyping, the opportunities and obligations of field deployments, the importance of conceptual contributions, and the value of cross-disciplinary deep-dives. I conclude by addressing some of the promises and pitfalls of artificial intelligence for accessibility, drawing on these reflections to light our way.
papers.summary_zh: 该主旨演讲以作者25年来在无障碍计算领域的研究经历为线索，回顾了从早期为Palm PDA开发词预测软件到EdgeWrite、Slide Rule、增强区域光标与Pointing Magnifier、基于能力的设计以及移动应用无障碍流行病学模型等项目，并总结了重视研究深度、参与者驱动的原型设计、实地部署的机会与责任、概念性贡献的重要性以及跨学科深入探索等五点反思。作者据此讨论人工智能对无障碍研究的机遇与风险，属于经验回顾与观点性演讲，而非实证研究。

papers.title: Zeno: Improving the Fidelity and Pedagogical Value of LLM-Generated Alt Text with BLV-Informed Guidelines and Iterative Prompting
papers.authors: Shuyuan Liu, Jiaming Zhang, Mohamed Essam Moustafa Kamel Fayed, Yuhui Zhao, Prithiv Premkumar, Alexander Travis Adams, Thad E. Starner
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generating pedagogically useful alternative text (alt text) for advanced computer science course materials requires more than describing visual appearance: blind and low-vision learners often need descriptions that support tracing, comparison, equation reading, and task completion. This work-in-progress study examines how blind-learner-informed guidance can improve LLM-generated alt text for an online AI course. Inspired by a blind student’s longitudinal course experience, we introduce Delta, a CS-specific guideline for task-operable alt text, and Zeno, an iterative LLM workflow that generates, critiques, and revises alt text against the source material. In a formative evaluation with two sighted reviewers and one blind reviewer, Delta-informed prompting and Zeno substantially outperformed a WCAG-only baseline in sighted fidelity, pass rate, and diagnostic error patterns. These findings suggest that blind-learner-informed guidance can improve the pedagogical usefulness of LLM-generated alt text for technical course materials.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何让大语言模型为高级计算机科学课程材料生成更具教学价值的替代文本，而不仅是描述视觉外观。作者基于一名盲人学生的长期课程体验提出面向计算机科学的替代文本指南Delta，并构建了对照源材料进行生成、批评与修订的迭代流程Zeno。由两名视力正常评审者和一名盲人评审者参与的形成性评估显示，融入Delta的提示与Zeno在保真度、通过率和诊断性错误模式上明显优于仅依据WCAG的基线。研究提示，融入盲人学习者经验的指导有助于提升大语言模型生成的技术课程替代文本的教学可用性，但结论来自小规模形成性评估，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Reflections and Recommendations on AI Adoption Practice from a Mixed-Ability Research Group
papers.authors: Shalini Madan, Sreelakshmi Surabiyil Bindu, Veronica Pimenova, Ellie Seehorn, Venkatesh Potluri
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generative AI tools have recently been rapidly adopted by academics in mixed-ability research teams for both personal and professional tasks. While previous work on adoption of AI-based workflows has focused on collaboration and productivity, the perceptions of AI use within research teams remains divided. Through qualitative analysis of interviews of the five members of our mixed-ability research team, we discuss the motivations, challenges, and practices surrounding the use of generative AI in our lab. We reflect on experiences that shaped recommendations for balanced AI use that enable mixed-ability team workflows: (1) managing disability tax & crip time, (2) homogenizing identity, (3) risk disclosure of private information, (4) self-experimentation and miscellaneous tasks, and (5) information seeking. We build upon these themes to present AI practice recommendations we established for our lab to promote AI workflow adoption while preserving agency and disability identity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI在混合能力研究团队中的实际采用情况，通过对团队五名成员的访谈进行定性分析，探讨其使用动机、挑战与做法。作者归纳出管理残障税与“crip时间”、身份同质化、私人信息风险披露、自我实验与杂项任务、信息搜寻等主题，并据此提出实验室层面的AI使用建议，旨在促进AI工作流采用的同时维护成员能动性与残障身份。文章属于基于团队自身经验的反思性定性研究，结论来自小规模访谈，未涉及效果验证。

papers.title: Learning Python as a Blind Programmer in an AI-Mediated Environment: An Autoethnographic Study
papers.authors: Weijun Zhang, JooYoung Seo
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Programming education is increasingly mediated by AI tools, yet little is known about how blind learners—particularly non-native English speakers—integrate these tools into learning, or where AI fails to address accessibility barriers. This paper presents an eight-week autoethnographic study of a blind, Chinese-speaking doctoral student learning introductory Python through Khan Academy’s curriculum with screen readers, a Braille display, and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini). Drawing on detailed learning diaries and human–AI interaction logs analyzed via reflexive thematic analysis, we examine how AI mediates accessibility, cognition, and language during programming learning. Findings show that AI simultaneously functions as an accessibility interpreter, cognitive scaffold, and linguistic mediator, yet also introduces epistemic uncertainty, accessibility hallucinations, inconsistent cross-lingual terminology, and clear limits with non-textual cues. We argue that AI reconfigures rather than solves accessibility, and derive design implications for AI-assisted programming tools prioritizing explicit code structure, screen-reader integration, calibrated trust, and terminology-aware multilingual support.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一位盲人中文母语博士生为对象，通过八周自我民族志，结合学习日记与人机交互日志，考察其在AI辅助下学习Python入门课程的经历。研究发现，AI同时充当无障碍解释者、认知支架和语言中介，但也带来认识论上的不确定性、无障碍相关的幻觉、跨语言术语不一致，以及在处理非文本线索上的明显局限。作者据此指出，AI重新配置而非解决了无障碍问题，并提出应优先考虑显式代码结构、屏幕阅读器集成、校准信任和术语敏感的多语言支持等设计方向。

papers.title: "Catching lightning in a bottle": How Blind or Low Vision Creators Navigate Ideation Across Creative Domains
papers.authors: Mingyi Li, Yutian Shi, Cynthia L. Bennett, Maitraye Das
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Ideation, i.e., generating, capturing, organizing, and evaluating ideas, is foundational to creative practices; yet little is known about how blind and low vision (BLV) creators engage in ideation. We conducted interviews with 20 BLV creators working in different domains including poetry, music production, tactile graphics, digital drawing, and mixed-media arts. Our findings reveal how participants established accessible creative workflows under social and institutional constraints, drew inspiration from diverse physical and digital sources, captured and organized ideas across text, audio, visual, and physical modalities, and evaluated their work through human and AI feedback. We discuss how ableist norms and accessibility breakdowns cascade across ideation pathways, progressively narrowing BLV individuals’ creative possibilities. Finally, we offer design considerations for building accessible ideation support tools that amplify BLV creators’ distinctive practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过访谈不同创作领域的盲人与低视力创作者，考察其在创意构思各环节中的实际做法。研究发现，参与者会在社会与制度限制下建立可访问的创作流程，从多种物理和数字来源获取灵感，以文本、音频、视觉和实体等多种模态记录与整理想法，并借助人类和AI反馈评估作品。作者进一步指出，健全主义规范与可访问性障碍会在构思路径上层层累积，逐步收窄盲人与低视力个体的创作可能性，并据此提出面向可访问构思支持工具的设计考量。

papers.title: Synthesizing and Evaluating a Visual Feedback Framework for Accessible Content Creation
papers.authors: Lotus Zhang, Anh Hua, Leah Findlater
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Many blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals are interested in visual content creation, yet creative tools provide limited feedback for visual outputs during authoring. We synthesized and evaluated a visual feedback framework for creative tasks—we first conducted a purpose-specific literature review of 54 accessibility papers on BLV creators’ feedback needs and then refined the resulting framework through expert review interviews with nine BLV creators. We identify key feedback components for creative work, including object and people information, spatial layout, intent-based checking and suggestions, version differences, and visual aesthetics. We also outline delivery guidelines emphasizing hierarchical control, multimodal interaction, real-time verification, non-visual language, and transparency about AI accuracy. Our findings show that creative authoring requires more detailed and intent-driven feedback than passive consumption, particularly to support iterative decision-making and diverse creative goals. Rather than a prescriptive checklist, this framework offers a practical foundation for researchers and practitioners when designing and evaluating accessible creative tools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对盲人和低视力（BLV）群体在视觉内容创作中缺乏反馈的问题，综合并评估了一个面向创作任务的视觉反馈框架。作者先通过针对性的文献综述梳理BLV创作者的反馈需求，再经专家评审访谈细化框架，归纳出对象与人物信息、空间布局、基于意图的检查与建议、版本差异和视觉美学等关键反馈要素，并提出层级控制、多模态交互、实时验证、非视觉语言及AI准确性透明等交付准则。研究指出，创作型任务比被动消费需要更细致、意图驱动的反馈，以支持迭代决策和多样创作目标；该框架并非规定性清单，而是为无障碍创作工具的设计与评估提供实用基础。

papers.title: Balancing Safety and Autonomy: Accessibility-Oriented Interventions in Generative AI for Cognitive Impairment
papers.authors: Yibo Meng, Jingruo Chen, Lyumanshan Ye, Bingyi Liu, Zhicong Lu
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly used by older adults with cognitive impairment for everyday tasks such as information seeking, health management, and communication. While these systems provide flexible, language-based support, their open-ended outputs introduce risks of over-reliance, misinterpretation, and inappropriate decision-making. Prior work has focused on usability and adoption, with limited attention to how system design shapes users’ participation in decision-making and the distribution of agency in care contexts. We present a qualitative study of 45 individuals with cognitive impairment and their caregivers. We identify five accessibility-oriented mechanisms: AI Capability Constraint, Human Oversight Embedding, Cognitive Engagement Maintenance, Human–AI Relationship Regulation, and Risk Transparency and Control, through which systems structure interaction. These mechanisms both support and constrain users by redistributing decision-making across users and caregivers. We show that their effects vary by impairment level: while protective mechanisms support users with severe impairment, they can restrict autonomy for those with mild impairment. As impairment progresses, tensions become less visible as user participation diminishes. Our findings highlight the need for dynamic designs that balance safety and autonomy in AI-supported care.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI在认知障碍老年人日常使用中的设计问题，通过对45名认知障碍者及其照护者的定性研究，识别出AI能力约束、人类监督嵌入、认知参与维持、人机关系调节以及风险透明与控制这五类可及性导向机制。研究发现，这些机制在用户与照护者之间重新分配决策权，其效果随障碍程度而异：保护性机制对重度障碍者形成支持，却可能限制轻度障碍者的自主性；随着障碍进展，用户参与减少，相关张力也更不易察觉。文章据此提出，AI支持的照护需要能动态平衡安全与自主的设计。

papers.title: Towards Accessible AI Literacy: Investigating How Teachers of Blind and Low-Vision Students Integrate Generative AI in Pedagogical Practices
papers.authors: Rudaiba Adnin, Abir Saha, Maitraye Das
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools are reshaping the educational landscape; yet, how teachers working with blind and low vision (BLV) students integrate these tools into their pedagogical practices remains underexplored. To address this gap, we interviewed 17 teachers of BLV students to investigate how they leverage GenAI to fulfill their teaching responsibilities and educate BLV students about these tools. We found that teachers incorporated GenAI for personalized lesson planning and tasks specific to BLV education, while counteracting biases favoring sighted teaching methods. They addressed BLV students’ curiosity and concerns about GenAI and taught them prompt formulation strategies that support their access needs in academic and daily tasks, although occasionally perpetuating their own misconceptions about GenAI to students. They expressed concerns about students’ overreliance on GenAI lowering foundational accessibility-related skills. We discuss ways to promote accessible AI literacy and outline design considerations for incorporating GenAI to support teachers’ BLV-specific instructional responsibilities and for integrating GenAI responsibly in BLV education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注盲人与低视力学生的教师如何将生成式人工智能融入教学实践，通过对17名教师进行访谈来考察其使用方式与相关看法。研究发现，教师利用生成式人工智能进行个性化备课和处理盲人与低视力教育特有的任务，同时试图抵消偏向明眼人教学方法的偏见；他们还回应学生对生成式人工智能的好奇与担忧，教授有助于满足无障碍需求的提示词构建策略，但偶尔也会把自身对生成式人工智能的误解传递给学生。教师担心学生过度依赖生成式人工智能会削弱与无障碍相关的基础技能。文章据此讨论了促进无障碍人工智能素养的途径，并提出将生成式人工智能纳入盲人与低视力教育的设计考量。

papers.title: A Recipe for Access: Visually Oriented Recipe Instructions as an Accessibility Barrier for Blind and Low-Vision Cooks
papers.authors: Nathan Aileo, Syed Masum Billah
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: For people who are blind or have low vision (BLV), barriers to independent cooking are associated with reduced dietary quality and elevated health risks. One such barrier is embedded in recipe language itself: phrases such as “cook until golden brown” or “sauté until translucent” require visual monitoring. That such phrases exist is not new; what has been missing is evidence of their scale and an account of what BLV cooks do in their place. We use the term Visually Oriented Instructional Descriptor (VizOID) for this kind of recipe language. Across 573,986 recipes and 3.85 million instruction sentences, VizOIDs appeared in every corpus we examined, including 6.7% of instruction sentences and 35.9% of recipes overall, and 55.5% of recipes in the professionally written Food Network corpus. In a hand-labeled subset, independent human coders reached substantial agreement (κ = 0.730), and an LLM reached near-perfect post-adjudication agreement with human coding (κ = 0.961), showing that the phenomenon is detectable at scale. We then report semi-structured interviews with 12 BLV individuals to examine how they work through these instructions. Participants described a shared repertoire of non-visual cooking knowledge: timing as a proxy, smell, sound, touch, temperature, and familiar utensils used to infer food state. Framed through the social model of disability, our findings show that many recipes are inaccessible because recipe language fails to encode the non-visual knowledge BLV cooks already use. Our findings can inform vision rehabilitation therapists and AI accessibility researchers designing low-cost, language-level interventions that rewrite recipe text at the point of acquisition, grounded in BLV cooks’ lived expertise.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注盲人和低视力者在独立烹饪时面临的食谱语言障碍，提出“视觉导向指令描述语”这一概念，用以指称“煮至金黄”“炒至透明”等依赖视觉判断的表述。作者对大规模食谱语料进行标注分析，发现这类表述普遍存在于各类语料中，并借助人工编码与大语言模型验证其可规模化识别；随后通过半结构化访谈考察盲人和低视力者的应对方式，发现他们依靠时间、气味、声音、触觉和温度等非视觉经验推断食物状态。文章以社会模型残障视角指出，食谱不可及源于语言未能编码这些已有知识，可为低成本的语言层面改写干预提供依据。

papers.title: Prompting Change in the Welfare State: Co-designing an LLM-Assisted Toolkit of Welfare Stories and Tips with Aphasia Communities
papers.authors: Humphrey Curtis, Timothy Neate, Alistair Gentry, Sioban Zacharek, Sally Jane McVicker, Filip Birčanin
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: People with aphasia face substantial barriers when navigating digital welfare systems—including communication impairments, literacy demands and the cognitive burden of bureaucratic processes shaped by decades of austerity. We present Advokit, a multimodal AI toolkit co-designed with people with aphasia to support welfare navigation, application drafting and self-advocacy. Developed through a five-stage participatory design process, Advokit integrates accessible benefit information, a comparative benefits table, lived-experience stories and Benefit Buddy, an LLM-assisted drafting chatbot. Across a three-month real-world deployment, the toolkit recorded 800 visitors and 2,849 page views; users engaged most with the benefits table, benefits list and stories pages—reflecting demand for both structured guidance and peer-grounded narratives. Survey responses (n = 11) were broadly positive, particularly for information access, though Benefit Buddy onboarding scored lower. Analysis of 14 chatbot sessions showed the system excelled at translating established lived experience into application-ready language, but struggled when users first needed orientation before engaging with the drafting workflow. We frame Advokit as counter-infrastructure: a community-built response to the hostile design of the welfare system. Our findings also surface limitations of conversational AI interfaces as access mechanisms: as chatbots are increasingly deployed to mediate access to vital public services. We contribute an open-source co-designed welfare toolkit, empirical findings from its community deployment and design implications for accessible AI-supported public services.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对失语症人群在数字福利系统中面临沟通、读写与认知障碍的问题，与失语症社群共同设计了多模态AI工具包Advokit，整合福利信息、比较表格、生活经验故事和LLM辅助起草聊天机器人Benefit Buddy。三个月真实部署中，用户最常使用福利表格、福利列表和故事页面，反映出对结构化指引与同伴叙事的双重需求；问卷反馈总体积极，但聊天机器人引导环节评分较低。对聊天会话的分析显示，系统擅长将已有生活经验转化为申请语言，却在用户需要先获得方向指引时表现不佳。作者据此将Advokit定位为社区自建的“反基础设施”，并指出对话式AI作为公共服务访问中介的局限。

papers.title: Supporting Allyship in Virtual Collaboration with Artificial Intelligence: A Scenario-Based Study
papers.authors: Crescentia Jung, Ricardo E. Gonzalez Penuela, Prashita Biswas, Seungyoon Kwon, Shiri Azenkot
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Recent research has revealed that accessibility in virtual collaboration is not only a technical problem but also depends on allyship: the informal, interpersonal practices through which people support others’ accessibility needs. Yet little research has examined how artificial intelligence (AI) might support allyship in collaborative accessibility contexts. To address this gap, we conducted a study where 18 participants (10 disabled, 8 non-disabled) reflected on four allyship scenarios with novel AI tools. Participants valued AI designs that they anticipated could help teammates express, interpret, and coordinate around access needs by reducing repeated disclosure and making allyship more actionable. At the same time, participants raised concerns when AI acted without consent, misrepresented users’ intentions, or displaced the interpersonal work of allyship. Based on our findings, we introduce allyship-support tools as a class of accessibility technologies, offer design guidelines, and discuss AI in particular as a means of supporting allyship.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工智能如何支持虚拟协作中的无障碍盟友行为，即人们以非正式的人际实践相互支持无障碍需求。作者通过情景研究，让残障与非残障参与者围绕四种盟友情景反思新型AI工具。参与者认可AI能帮助队友表达、解读和协调无障碍需求，减少反复披露并使支持更可操作；但也担忧AI未经同意行动、曲解用户意图或取代人际支持工作。研究据此提出盟友支持工具这一无障碍技术类别及设计准则，并讨论AI作为支持盟友行为手段的定位。

papers.title: Gradient-interlayer–based flexible pressure sensors for high-performance robotic perception
papers.authors: Mingyuan Sun, G L, Shuai Dong, Erlong Wang, Shi‐Yang Tang, Xuanhan Chen, Yipu Guo, Xiaoqin Sun, Xiangpeng Li, Weihua Li, Shiwu Zhang
papers.abstract: Tactile perception systems based on flexible pressure sensors are indispensable for humanoid robots to perform dexterous manipulation, compliant interaction, and operation in visually challenging environments. Although strategies relying on surface or spatial microstructure engineering have improved sensor performance, the long-standing trade-off among sensitivity, sensing range, and linearity continues to hinder their practical deployment. Inspired by the gradient distribution of mechanoreceptors in human fingertip skin, we report a gradient-interlayer–based flexible iontronic pressure sensor (GriFIPS) in which a single direct-ink-written elastomeric mesh-like interlayer, with a centrifugal increase in aperture size, is placed between the soft electrode and an ionic hydrogel layer. Operating upstream of the functional layer, the mesh enables progressive, stage-wise contact under increasing load and decouples macroscopic contact-area evolution from the microscopic interfacial response. The sensor simultaneously achieves a sensitivity of 175.9 kPa −1 , a linear sensing range up to 360 kPa with a coefficient of determination of 0.997, a low detection limit of about 2.1 Pa, and a response time of about 25 ms, while remaining stable over 6000 loading cycles and 2000 cycles of 50% tensile strain. Building on this single-channel device, we further extend the architecture into a 3-axis gradient-interlayer–based flexible iontronic force sensor (3-axis GriFIFS) capable of resolving triaxial forces and surface textures. When integrated onto a dexterous robotic hand and combined with a temporal convolutional network, the sensors support tactile object recognition, fabric texture discrimination, human–robot interaction, and tactile-guided assembly, offering a generalizable route to tactile sensing for embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对柔性压力传感器在灵敏度、传感范围与线性度之间难以兼顾的问题，受人类指尖机械感受器梯度分布启发，设计了一种在软电极与离子水凝胶层之间加入单一直写弹性网状夹层的离子电子压力传感器，并进一步扩展为可解析三轴力与表面纹理的三轴版本。单通道器件在保持较低检测限与较快响应的同时，实现了较宽线性范围内的较高灵敏度，并表现出良好的循环与拉伸稳定性。作者将传感器集成于灵巧机械手并结合时序卷积网络，展示了触觉物体识别、织物纹理区分、人机交互与触觉引导装配等任务，为具身智能的触觉感知提供了一条可推广的技术路径。

papers.title: Spider-inspired bidirectional robotic joints driven by electrohydraulic multiaxial strain
papers.authors: Zean Yuan, Shuhong Huang, Luna Zhou, Xinyu Zhu, Jun Luo, Guo Zhan Lum, Rui Chen
papers.abstract: Compared with conventional motors and servos, soft-actuated angular-motion devices are superior in environmental adaptability and human-robot interaction, yet they can only achieve active bidirectional angular motion by integrating antagonistic actuators or restriction modules. The integration of such components introduces deformation antagonism, compromises structural simplicity, and increases control complexity. Herein, we propose a spider-inspired centimeter-scale soft bidirectional robotic joint driven by a pair of synchronously controlled electrohydraulic actuators (EHAs). Specifically, the EHAs generate multiaxial strain, enabling the joint to bidirectionally rotate depending on its physical state, without introducing additional functional components or asynchronous controllers. Furthermore, the joint demonstrates (i) high-speed (forward: 2851° per second, reverse: 1934° per second) and wide-stroke (up to 156.8°) rotational performance, (ii) multimodal motion (e.g., self-unfolding, self-folding, and reciprocating swinging), (iii) continuous response (up to 40 hertz), and (iv) payload-bearing capability. Last, three joint-integrated devices validate its feasibility as a multifunctional, high-dynamic, and single-channel-controlled actuation component in diverse robotic applications. This work establishes a viable design framework for minimalist yet versatile bioinspired robots.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对软驱动角运动装置通常需集成对抗执行器或限制模块才能实现主动双向转动、由此带来形变对抗和结构复杂的问题，提出一种受蜘蛛启发的厘米级软体双向机器人关节，由一对同步控制的电液执行器驱动，利用其多轴应变使关节依物理状态双向旋转，无需额外功能部件或异步控制器。该关节实现了高速、大行程转动、多模态运动、连续响应和承载能力，并通过三个集成该关节的装置验证了其作为多功能、高动态、单通道控制驱动组件的可行性，为极简而多功能的仿生机器人提供了设计框架。

papers.title: Biophysically constrained learning from healthy neural priors improves motor decoding in pathological cortical networks
papers.authors: Yihan Wu, Tao Chang, Siliang Chen, Yuxin Quan, Qiang Sun, Marc M. Van Hulle, Yan‐Hui Liu, Ning Jiang, Dario Farina, Yuan Yang, Qing Mao, Jiayuan He
papers.abstract: High-performance brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) rely on stable neural representations, yet brain functional impairments inherently disrupt canonical encoding, creating a fundamental decoding paradox. Conventional data-driven approaches struggle to bridge this gap because of pathological data scarcity and heterogeneity. Here, we propose to leverage healthy neural priors and introduce Pathology-Aware Consensus Training (PACT), a paradigm embedding biophysical constraints into healthy neural recordings to guide neural decoding. In a gesture classification task using high-density electrocorticography from patients with gliomas infiltrating the motor cortex, PACT improved the accuracy by more than 10%, effectively restoring the distorted semantic geometry of motor commands and realigning them with healthy canonical representations (correlation increase: r = 0.66 to r = 0.94). Mechanistically, PACT induced an emergent “inverse weighting” strategy: The model autonomously suppresses high-power pathological noise while reanchoring spatial attention to functional compensatory regions. This study provides a proof of concept for improving decoding in compromised networks by harnessing healthy neural dynamics, laying the theoretical foundation for future BCI deployments in clinical populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对病理皮层网络中神经解码因功能损伤而失稳的问题，提出病理感知共识训练（PACT），将生物物理约束嵌入健康神经记录以引导解码。在胶质瘤浸润运动皮层患者的高密度皮层脑电手势分类任务中，该方法将准确率提升逾10%，并使运动指令的语义几何与健康典型表征的相关性从r=0.66升至0.94。机制上，模型自发形成“反向加权”策略，抑制高功率病理噪声并将空间注意重新锚定到功能代偿区域。这为利用健康神经动力学改善受损网络的解码提供了概念验证，但结论仍属初步，其临床部署价值尚待进一步检验。

papers.title: The Trojan horse in the courtroom: The impact of flawed AI advice on legal discretionary decision‐making
papers.authors: Yaohua Jin, Yanling Sun, Hongyang Leon Zhang
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose AI‐assisted adjudication is increasingly embedded in judicial decision‐making, yet whether legal professionals and laypersons can independently guard against overreliance remains contested. This study examines how people with varying legal expertise respond to demonstrably flawed AI recommendations and whether reliance differs across legal‐error types. Methods Legal professionals, law students and laypersons each adjudicated one criminal and one civil case after random assignment to correct or incorrect AI‐generated recommendations. Incorrect advice involved two error types: misapplication of statutory provisions and erroneous citation of judicial precedents. Responses were coded using two independent adoption indicators. Explicit adoption captured direct incorporation of the AI‐provided legal basis; implicit adoption captured a final decision materially aligned with the AI recommendation without requiring explicit incorporation of that basis. Results Explicit adoption showed a floor effect: participants rarely reproduced, cited or endorsed the AI‐provided legal basis, regardless of advice accuracy or legal expertise. Implicit adoption was significantly less frequent for erroneous than correct advice. Legal expertise showed neither a significant main effect nor an interaction with advice condition, and no detectable expertise differences emerged in either adoption outcome. Subjective trust similarly declined significantly in response to AI errors, with no detectable main effect of legal expertise or interaction with advice condition. Conclusions These findings are consistent with selective adoption under the tested conditions: across expertise levels, participants aligned less often with erroneous than with correct AI recommendations. Nevertheless, further scrutiny is needed of how AI systems influence legal reasoning in practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察法律专业人士、法学生与普通人在面对明显有误的AI建议时是否会过度依赖，以及这种依赖是否因法律错误类型而异。参与者被随机分配接受正确或错误的AI建议（错误涉及法条误用与判例误引），并对刑事和民事案件作出裁判，采用显性与隐性两种采纳指标进行编码。结果显示，显性采纳出现地板效应，无论建议准确性与法律专长如何，参与者都很少直接复述或援引AI提供的法律依据；隐性采纳在错误建议下显著少于正确建议，且法律专长既无显著主效应也无与建议条件的交互，主观信任同样随AI错误而下降。作者据此认为结果与选择性采纳一致，但AI系统在实践中如何影响法律推理仍需进一步审视。

papers.title: The Influence of Facial Attractiveness on Empathy: A Systematic Review
papers.authors: Natalia Kopiś-Posiej, Andrzej Cudo
papers.abstract: Abstract This systematic review examines the impact of facial attractiveness on empathic responses. By synthesizing findings from behavioral studies, EEG, fMRI, EMG, and fNIRS research, it examines whether and how attractiveness modulates empathy at cognitive and emotional levels. The results indicate that attractive faces often trigger stronger automatic empathic reactions, likely driven by emotional contagion and positive beauty stereotypes. Conversely, in conscious empathic tasks or those requiring cognitive effort, greater empathy tends to be shown towards less attractive individuals. Significant differences related to gender, moral context, and participant experience reveal the relationship between physical attractiveness and empathy. Overall, facial attractiveness has a significant impact on empathy; however, its influence varies depending on the type of empathic process and the experimental conditions. This review offers new insights into distinguishing the affective and cognitive components of empathy and suggests ways to manipulate empathic responses through physical appearance cues.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合行为学与脑电、功能磁共振、肌电及近红外光谱等多模态研究，考察面孔吸引力是否以及如何在认知与情感层面调节共情反应。结果显示，吸引力较高的面孔常引发更强的自动化共情反应，可能与情绪感染和积极外貌刻板印象有关；而在需要意识参与或认知努力的共情任务中，人们反而对吸引力较低者表现出更多共情。性别、道德情境与参与者经验等因素也带来差异。作者据此强调，面孔吸引力对共情的影响显著但随共情加工类型和实验条件而变化，并为区分共情的情感与认知成分及通过外貌线索调节共情提供了思路。

papers.title: Exploring Mongolian Trilingual Students’ Perceptions About Academic and Affective Impacts of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technologies: A Descriptive Qualitative Study
papers.authors: Yaochen Deng, Lei Yang
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into education has received increasing attention over the past couple of years. However, the perceived impacts of such technologies by trilingual learners have remained unaddressed by scholars. Compared with conventional second or foreign language learners, trilingual learners may need to coordinate languages with different levels of proficiency and functions while also coping with unequal AI support across languages. To fill the gap, this descriptive qualitative study drew on technology acceptance model (TAM) and control‐value theory (CVT) to examine Mongolian trilingual learners’ perceptions about the academic and affective impacts of AI tools. A sample of 40 Mongolian trilingual students in Inner Mongolia, China were asked to complete an open‐ended questionnaire and attend an interview. The results of thematic analysis demonstrated that AI technologies had imposed several positive and negative academic and affective impacts on trilingual students. Particularly, it was found that AI adoption could improve learning efficiency, autonomy, and agency, but over‐reliance on AI tools might lead to dependency, plagiarism acts, surface learning, and reduced critical thinking. Regarding affective consequences, the students found AI adoption exciting, motivating, and emotionally safe, while they endorsed the possibility of anxiety, stress, fear, emotional tension, and emotional detachment. The study discusses the findings and provides practical implications for trilingual teachers, students, and policymakers by enhancing their AI and emotional literacy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注三语学习者对人工智能技术学术与情感影响的感知，以蒙古族三语学生为对象，通过开放式问卷和访谈收集资料并进行主题分析。结果显示，AI使用可提升学习效率、自主性和能动性，但过度依赖可能导致依赖、抄袭、浅层学习和批判性思维下降；情感上学生感到兴奋、有动力和情感安全，同时也可能产生焦虑、压力、恐惧和情感疏离。文章据此讨论了对三语教师、学生和政策制定者的实践启示。

papers.title: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit: unraveling the evolving role of customers’ emotional intelligence and perspective taking in promoting value co-creation behavior
papers.authors: David Amani
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aims to develop a conceptual model which aims to test the contribution of emotional intelligence in strengthening value co-creation behavior, with perspective taking included as a mediator. Design/methodology/approach The model was tested using cross-sectional data, which were collected from a sample of 338 customers selected using a convenience sampling technique in selected restaurants within the restaurant industry in Dodoma region. Findings The analyses using covariance-based structural equation modeling indicate that all hypotheses were supported, suggesting that emotional intelligence drives customers toward demonstrating value co-creation behavior through perspective taking. Practical implications Thus, service organizations should encourage customers to demonstrate positive emotions during the service encounters as strategic resources to ensure effective participation in value co-creation. Originality/value This study is one of among the few studies that have recently examined competencies of customers as a driver of value co-creation behavior. The study advances insights and fuel debates regarding the equal importance of considering both the competence of frontline employees and customers as co-actors in value co-creation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究构建了一个概念模型，考察顾客情绪智力如何通过观点采择的中介作用促进价值共创行为，并以餐饮业顾客的横截面数据为对象，采用协方差结构方程模型进行检验。结果显示，情绪智力会推动顾客表现出价值共创行为，观点采择在其中起中介作用，所有假设均得到支持。作者据此建议服务组织在服务接触中引导顾客表达积极情绪，将其作为保障有效参与价值共创的策略资源，并强调应同等重视一线员工与顾客作为共创主体的能力。

papers.title: Governing artificial intelligence for educational justice: developing a framework for inclusive and ethical digital learning
papers.authors: Thomas Sheku Marah
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aims to examine how artificial intelligence (AI) can be governed to advance educational justice, inclusion and ethical digital learning. It addresses incomplete integration across AI-in-education, AI-governance and educational-justice scholarship by developing a justice-oriented governance framework. Design/methodology/approach The study uses conceptual theory-building through an integrative synthesis of 186 sources identified through database searching and citation tracking for 2015–2025, with 2026 literature used only as contextual updates. The synthesis compares concepts, governance functions and theoretical relationships across domains. Findings The synthesis conceptualizes the AI–Justice Paradox as the possibility that expanded AI-enabled educational opportunity may coexist with or intensify injustice. It develops the educational justice governance framework (EJGF), comprising equitable access, capability development, algorithmic fairness, participatory governance and accountability and rights protection. These dimensions are theorized as conditionally interdependent and partially non-substitutable. Originality/value The contribution is integrative and relational: the EJGF complements established cross-sector AI-governance approaches by specifying educational justice as the substantive criterion linking governance safeguards within educational institutions. The framework is conceptually derived and requires empirical validation across contexts, institutions and AI applications. It also generates testable propositions concerning configurational relationships and boundary conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人工智能在教育中的应用、AI治理与教育公平研究之间整合不足的问题，通过整合性文献综合开展概念性理论建构，提出一个面向正义的治理框架。作者将“AI—正义悖论”概念化，即AI扩大教育机会的同时可能并存甚至加剧不公，并据此构建教育正义治理框架，涵盖公平可及、能力发展、算法公平、参与式治理以及问责与权利保护五个维度，且这些维度被理论化为有条件相互依赖、部分不可替代。文章强调该框架以教育正义作为连接校内治理保障的实质标准，属于概念推导，尚需在不同情境、机构和AI应用中接受实证检验。

papers.title: From typology to governance architecture: interdependent AI roles in open government data ecosystems
papers.authors: Martin Lněnička, Anastasija Nikiforova, Anthony Simonofski, Dimitrios Symeonidis
papers.abstract: Purpose While Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in Open Government Data (OGD) ecosystems, the mechanisms through which it restructures information practices and governance remain insufficiently theorized. This study empirically evaluates and refines an AI–OGD typology, explaining how AI roles are structured, sequenced and shaped by contextual conditions. Design/methodology/approach A mixed-methods expert panel evaluation (N = 9) was conducted with specialists in information systems and public administration. Five structured tasks were used to assess the conceptual clarity, role distinctiveness, sequencing and strategic positioning of the proposed AI roles, combining qualitative assessment with quantitative measures of expert agreement and perceived influence and impact. Findings Results support the typology while extending its theoretical interpretation. Rather than a flat classification, AI roles are perceived as forming a hierarchical and interdependent system, progressing from foundational portal-oriented functions to high-impact ecosystem-level roles. The findings further reveal low classification accuracy as an indicator of functional overlap, suggesting that AI roles operate along a continuum rather than as discrete categories. In addition, implementation patterns are shown to be cyclical and contingent on socio-technical factors such as organizational readiness, data infrastructure maturity and governance capacity. Practical implications The study provides a structured roadmap for policymakers and public managers to sequence AI adoption, balancing foundational data capabilities with ecosystem-level value creation. Originality/value This study contributes beyond validation by reconceptualizing AI roles in OGD ecosystems as a dynamic governance architecture. It advances research by integrating empirical validation with explanatory insight, offering a more practice-sensitive and theoretically grounded understanding of AI-enabled public data ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人工智能嵌入开放政府数据生态后如何重构信息实践与治理这一问题，对既有AI角色类型学进行实证评估与修正，采用混合方法专家小组评估，通过结构化任务考察概念清晰度、角色区分度、排序与战略定位。结果显示，专家认可该类型学，但将其理解为由基础门户功能向高影响生态层角色递进的分层且相互依赖的系统，而非扁平分类；分类准确率偏低被视为功能重叠的信号，说明AI角色沿连续谱分布而非离散类别，实施模式呈循环性并受组织准备度、数据基础设施成熟度和治理能力等社会技术条件制约。文章据此将AI角色重新概念化为动态治理架构，并为政策制定者和管理者分阶段推进AI应用提供参考。

papers.title: “Through the looking glass: envisioning new library technologies” artificial intelligence, patron privacy and passkeys
papers.authors: Peter Fernández
papers.abstract: Purpose This column aims to examine how developments in artificial intelligence (AI) impact the need for patron education. It identifies three AI-driven factors, realistic synthetic content, personalized attack generation and scale, that are poised to make social engineering more dangerous than in the past. It explores passkeys as one potential solution. Design/methodology/approach This is a viewpoint column that synthesizes recent research and reporting. It was copy-edited with Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, ChatGPT Sol 5.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemma 4. Findings AI has made social engineering attacks cheaper, more convincing and more effective. Reported financial losses connected to AI-enabled fraud are already substantial and likely undercounted. Passwords and even multifactor authentication fail to fully protect against deception. Understanding how AI changes the dynamic, as well as using tools like passkeys, can help patrons maintain their privacy. Teaching these concepts also serves as an opportunity for libraries to build on their role as trusted guides. Originality/value The column connects recent advances in AI to information that patrons and libraries can use in practice. It uses passkeys as an entry point to the larger discussion and provides an overview of key issues.
papers.summary_zh: 该观点专栏综合近期研究与报道，讨论人工智能发展如何影响读者隐私教育需求。作者指出，逼真的合成内容、个性化攻击生成和规模化是使社会工程攻击比以往更危险的三类AI驱动因素，AI已让此类攻击更廉价、更具说服力且更有效，相关经济损失已相当可观且可能被低估；密码乃至多因素认证都无法完全防范欺骗。文章以通行密钥为切入点，认为理解AI如何改变这一态势并采用此类工具，有助于读者维护隐私，同时为图书馆依托其可信引导者角色开展相关教育提供了机会。

papers.title: Designing phygital tourism experiencescapes for tourist well-being: a transformative service framework
papers.authors: Hasan Erdoğan
papers.abstract: Purpose This paper aims to develop a Transformative Service Research (TSR)-informed framework explaining how phygital tourism experiencescapes can be designed to foster tourist well-being. It addresses limited understanding of how hybrid physical–digital service environments can operate as well-being-oriented transformative systems beyond technological enhancement and engagement. Design/methodology/approach The study adopts an integrative conceptual approach because phygital transformative tourism experiencescapes constitute an emergent, multidisciplinary and theoretically fragmented domain. It synthesizes customer experience, tourist well-being and service research through thematic clustering to clarify relationships among service environments, tourists’ interpretive processes and well-being-oriented transformation. This synthesis generates six framework elements: experiencescape stimuli, decoding mechanisms, experience types, transformative mechanisms, well-being outcomes and experiential marketing as a design layer. Findings The paper proposes a Stimulus–Experience–Well-being framework. Phygital experiencescape stimuli are interpreted through sensoriality, cognition, affectivity, sociability, conativity, pragmatism and lifestyle alignment mechanisms, producing experience types such as immersion, refreshment, reflection, volunteering, challenge, education, entertainment, socialization and sensory experience. These experiences activate transformative mechanisms that shape hedonic, eudaimonic, collective and occupational well-being, while poorly configured technologies may generate overload, technostress or negative transformation. Practical implications The framework guides managers to align experiential marketing practices – multisensory design, customization, co-creation, gamification and theming – with intended experience pathways, well-being outcomes and phygital tools. Social implications The study highlights how phygital tourism can support participation, cultural awareness, empathy and responsible behavior. Originality/value The study extends TSR into phygital tourism, refines stimulus–organism–response logic by specifying two mediating layers, and integrates experiential marketing as a service-system design lever for transforming hybrid experiences into well-being outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对实体与数字融合的旅游体验场景如何被设计为促进游客福祉的转化性系统这一问题，采用整合性概念研究路径，综合顾客体验、游客福祉与服务研究文献，提出一个“刺激—体验—福祉”框架。框架指出，融合场景的刺激经由感官、认知、情感、社交、意动、实用与生活方式契合等解读机制，生成沉浸、放松、反思、志愿服务、挑战、教育、娱乐、社交与感官等体验类型，进而激活转化机制，影响享乐型、实现型、集体型与职业型福祉；同时提醒技术配置不当可能带来过载、技术压力或负面转化。文章据此将体验营销（多感官设计、定制、共创、游戏化与主题化）定位为服务系统设计杠杆，并讨论了该框架对管理实践与社会参与、文化意识等方面的启示。

papers.title: Phygital customer experience and the adoption of immersive technologies in hospitality: an exploratory study with a value co-creation perspective
papers.authors: Taewon Suh, Luigi Nasta, Luca Pirolo, Barbara Sveva Magnanelli
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aims to explore immersive-technology adoption in hospitality through the Phygital Customer Experience (PH-CX) framework. PH-CX extends existing technology acceptance, service-dominant logic, omnichannel and customer-journey perspectives by emphasizing embodied, co-created and human-centered experience across physical, digital and artificial intelligence (AI)-mediated interactions. Design/methodology/approach Using Bayesian Networks, the study examines probabilistic dependencies among perceived usefulness, collaborative value, responsive co-creation attitudes and intention to use immersive technologies. Data was collected from 208 participants exposed to an AI-supported immersive hotel journey scenario. The analysis is exploratory and identifies conditional associations rather than causal effects or latent-variable relationships. Findings Adoption intention was conditionally associated with perceived usefulness, collaborative value and responsiveness to service innovation. The findings suggest that immersive-hospitality engagement involves functional, relational and participatory conditions beyond usefulness alone. However, the item-level results are hypothesis-generating and do not demonstrate PH-CX’s incremental predictive superiority over technology acceptance model (TAM) or service-dominant logic. Research limitations/implications The scenario-based, cross-sectional bayesian network (BN) design cannot model latent constructs, measurement error, mediation or causal effects. Future studies should validate PH-CX dimensions and compare TAM, TAM-plus-service-dominant logic (SDL) and PH-CX models using structural equation modeling, longitudinal designs and holdout-sample prediction. Practical implications Hotels can implement PH-CX through phased AI concierge pilots, cross-platform data integration and guest co-creation mechanisms. Relevant metrics include booking conversion, AI resolution rates, cross-channel engagement, co-creation participation and net promoter score (NPS). Ethical implementation requires transparency, opt-in participation, privacy safeguards, accessibility and human escalation options. Social implications Human-centered phygital hospitality requires safeguards against digital exclusion, surveillance and loss of human warmth. Transparency, agency, equity, privacy and non-digital alternatives are essential for inclusive and trustworthy service innovation. Originality/value The study advances PH-CX as a theory-extending framework linking usefulness, co-creation, embodied experience and ethical safeguards in immersive hospitality. It also proposes experience-design orientation as a future research profile and offers a phased implementation framework for responsible phygital service design.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以酒店业沉浸式技术采纳为问题，基于物理—数字—人工智能交互的Phygital Customer Experience（PH-CX）框架，用贝叶斯网络分析208名参与者在AI支持的沉浸式酒店旅程情境中的条件关联。结果显示，采纳意愿与感知有用性、协作价值及对服务创新的响应性存在条件性关联，提示沉浸式酒店参与涉及功能、关系与参与性条件，而非仅由有用性决定；但条目层面结果仅具假设生成性质，并未证明PH-CX相对技术接受模型或服务主导逻辑具有增量预测优势。作者据此提出分阶段AI礼宾试点、跨平台数据整合与宾客共创等实践方向，并强调透明度、隐私保护与人工升级选项等伦理保障。

papers.title: Understanding student satisfaction with generative AI learning tools in Vietnamese business education: a TAM- and SDT-informed framework
papers.authors: Hung Manh Pham, Thu Thi Hoai Nguyen, Giang  Thi Huong Nguyen, Nham Linh Vuong, Quy Huu Vuong Nguyen
papers.journal: Journal of International Education in Business
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aims to examine the determinants of student satisfaction with their experience of using artificial intelligence (AI) tools for learning-related activities in Vietnamese higher education, addressing a gap in research that has focused primarily on AI adoption and usage, with limited evidence on students’ post-use satisfaction in an emerging-market higher education context. Design/methodology/approach A construct-level framework informed by selected insights from the technology acceptance model (TAM) and self-determination theory (SDT) was used to organise perceived credibility, content quality, perceived utility, cognitive absorption and emotional wellbeing within one explanatory model. Survey data from 380 undergraduate business students were analysed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM). Findings All five factors were positively associated with satisfaction. The findings indicate that students’ satisfaction depends not only on the functional value of generative AI tools but also on the credibility of their outputs and the cognitive and emotional quality of the learning experience. Originality/value This study shifts attention from AI adoption to satisfaction as a post-use evaluative outcome. Rather than testing TAM or SDT in their entirety, it uses selected insights from both theories to organise complementary technology-related and experiential determinants within a single construct-level framework.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注越南商科本科生在使用生成式AI学习工具后的满意度，以技术接受模型与自我决定理论的若干要点构建解释框架，并通过问卷调查与结构方程模型分析数据。结果显示，感知可信度、内容质量、感知效用、认知沉浸和情绪幸福感五项因素均与满意度呈正相关。作者据此指出，学生的满意度不仅取决于工具的功能价值，也取决于其输出是否可信以及学习体验在认知与情感层面的质量，并将研究视角从AI采纳转向使用后的评价性结果。

papers.title: The REAL framework: evaluating the cognitive and formative impact of generative AI
papers.authors: Martin R. Jones
papers.journal: Journal of Ethics in Entrepreneurship and Technology
papers.abstract: Purpose This paper aims to address a gap in contemporary scholarship on generative artificial intelligence (AI) by shifting attention from the functional evaluation of AI systems to the formative impact of repeated AI use on the human user. It introduces formative evaluation as a complementary approach concerned with how sustained AI use may shape cognitive skills, habits, reasoning, judgment and agency over time. To address this concern, the paper proposes the REAL Framework (Retained, Eroded, Atrophied, Leveraged) as a practical means of evaluating and intentionally shaping patterns of AI use. Design/methodology/approach This conceptual paper develops the REAL Framework through interdisciplinary synthesis and theoretical analysis. It integrates scholarship on human agency and principal-agent relationships with research on cognitive offloading, cognitive reserve, desirable difficulty, automation bias and human–AI collaboration. Emerging empirical research on the cognitive effects of generative AI is used to contextualize and support the framework. The resulting four-dimensional framework is then illustrated through its application to professional practice and considered in relation to potential objections, limitations and directions for future empirical research. Findings The analysis identifies formative evaluation as a distinct and underdeveloped dimension of AI evaluation. While emerging research increasingly documents potential cognitive effects of generative AI use, practical means of evaluating and responding to those effects remain limited. The REAL Framework addresses this gap through four dimensions: Retained, Eroded, Atrophied and Leveraged. Together, these dimensions distinguish between AI use that preserves human agency and cognitive engagement, use that risks over-delegation and capability loss, and use that intentionally leverages AI to enhance human thinking and judgment. Research limitations/implications The REAL Framework is a conceptual and reflective framework that has not yet been empirically validated or operationalized as a measurement instrument. Longitudinal research is needed to examine the formative effects of sustained generative AI use and determine whether structured application of the framework influences patterns of AI delegation or preserves cognitive engagement and capability. Future research should develop and test measures associated with the framework’s four dimensions and examine their applicability across educational, professional and organizational contexts. Practical implications The REAL Framework provides individuals and institutions with a practical means of evaluating how generative AI is being incorporated into learning and professional practice. Its four reflective dimensions can help users identify inappropriate over-delegation, preserve important cognitive and professional capabilities, and redesign AI use to support rather than replace human reasoning and judgment. The framework may also inform institutional guidance, professional development and AI literacy initiatives by shifting attention from whether AI should be used toward how it can be used while preserving meaningful human agency and engagement. Social implications As generative AI becomes increasingly embedded in education, work and everyday decision-making, its societal effects will depend not only on the capabilities of AI systems but also on how their use shapes human capabilities over time. The REAL Framework highlights the importance of preserving human agency, reasoning, judgment and cognitive engagement while benefiting from technological advancement. It encourages a broader societal conversation about which human capacities should remain meaningfully exercised and which may appropriately be delegated to increasingly capable AI systems. Originality/value This paper introduces formative evaluation as a distinct conceptual approach to understanding generative AI use, complementing prevailing functional approaches concerned primarily with AI systems, governance and responsible use. It advances the REAL Framework as a structured means of translating emerging concerns about AI’s cognitive and formative effects into reflective practice. By connecting human agency and delegation with cognitive development, the framework shifts attention from evaluating what AI can do to evaluating what repeated AI use may be doing to the human user.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，针对现有研究多关注生成式AI系统功能评估、较少考察长期使用对人自身影响的不足，提出以“形成性评估”作为补充视角，关注持续使用AI如何塑造认知技能、习惯、判断与能动性。作者通过跨学科理论综合，提出REAL框架，从保留、侵蚀、萎缩、杠杆化四个维度区分维护人类能动性与认知投入的使用、过度委托导致能力流失的使用，以及有意借助AI增强思考与判断的使用，并结合专业实践加以说明。文章强调该框架尚属概念性、未经实证验证，需纵向研究检验其是否影响委托模式并保持认知投入，其意义在于把评估重点从AI能做什么转向反复使用AI可能对人产生什么影响。

papers.title: CSR communication on social media: the impact of message source and co-creation cues on credibility, engagement, and e-WOM
papers.authors: Monica Sareen, Ritika Mahajan
papers.abstract: Purpose Amid stakeholder skepticism and organizations' reliance on static, informational posts, this study aims to assess which configurations of message source (corporate vs. non-governmental organization (NGO)) and co-creation cues (high vs. low) stimulate source credibility, consumer engagement, and electronic word of mouth (e-WOM) in corporate social responsibility communication (CSR-C) on social media (SM), grounded in stakeholder theory. Design/methodology/approach A 2 × 2 between-subjects factorial experiment was conducted with 406 active Facebook users in India. Data were analyzed using two-way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and partial least squares structural equation modeling multigroup analysis. Findings High co-creation cues significantly increased source credibility, consumer engagement, and e-WOM, diminishing the independent effect of message source. NGO-attributed posts produced higher e-WOM than corporate posts, but only under high co-creation. Consumer engagement partially mediated the effect of source credibility on e-WOM. Practical implications Practitioners should prioritize participatory message design (high co-creation cues) over source attribution, and treat NGO partnerships as effective for e-WOM only when posts invite participation. Originality/value This is among the first studies to assess which message source and co-creation cues jointly shape CSR-C outcomes on SM. It shows that co-creation cues, not source identity, are the primary driver, identifies consumer engagement as the mechanism linking credibility to e-WOM, and locates these effects in the under-examined Indian mandated-CSR context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于利益相关者理论，通过一项2×2组间实验考察社交媒体企业社会责任传播中信息发布者（企业或非政府组织）与共创线索（高或低）如何共同影响来源可信度、消费者参与和电子口碑。研究发现，高共创线索显著提升来源可信度、消费者参与和电子口碑，并削弱发布者身份的独立作用；非政府组织发布的帖子仅在共创线索较高时比企业帖子带来更强的电子口碑，消费者参与部分中介了来源可信度对电子口碑的影响。作者据此建议实践者优先设计参与式信息，并将非政府组织合作视为在帖子邀请参与时才有效的电子口碑策略。

papers.title: Beyond Human–AI interaction: exploring the influence of AI anthropomorphism on work engagement
papers.authors: Bin Ling, Yuting Xia, Yujie Cai
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines how anthropomorphic cues that make AI agency socially salient influence employee work engagement in mandatory, performance-oriented human–AI collaboration. It distinguishes AI agency from AI anthropomorphism, tests affective and evaluative motivational mechanisms and identifies perceived AI threat as a boundary condition grounded in the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) model. Design/methodology/approach Across two pilot studies and two main experiments (total N = 501), we used immersive workplace role-playing scenarios to test a dual-pathway model. Integrating social response theory with the JD-R model, this research tests a dual-pathway model in which anthropomorphic design influences work engagement through emotional bonding and acquisitive impression management motive (IMM), whereas perceived artificial intelligence threat operates as a hindrance demand that weakens these resource pathways. Findings Anthropomorphic AI enhanced work engagement through two motivational routes: an affective route via emotional bonding and an evaluative route via IMM. However, perceived AI threat significantly attenuated these benefits. When threat was high, the positive effects of anthropomorphism on emotional bonding, IMM and work engagement became non-significant, suggesting that replacement-related threat drains the psychological capacity needed for anthropomorphic cues to function as job resources. Originality/value This research contributes to workplace AI and information systems (IS) scholarship by clarifying how anthropomorphic cues make AI agency socially salient without equating anthropomorphism with agency. It extends prior work on anthropomorphic AI and engagement by identifying an evaluative pathway – performing for AI – alongside the affective pathway of bonding with AI. It also offers a contingency-based explanation for the anthropomorphism paradox by showing that the benefits of humanlike design depend on the surrounding AI-threat climate.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在强制且以绩效为导向的人机协作中，拟人化线索如何通过让AI能动性具有社会显著性来影响员工工作投入，并区分AI能动性与拟人化。作者通过角色扮演情境开展实验，检验情感联结与获取性印象管理动机两条动机路径，以及感知AI威胁的边界作用。结果显示，拟人化AI经情感联结和印象管理动机提升工作投入，但感知AI威胁显著削弱这些益处；当威胁较高时，拟人化对情感联结、印象管理动机和工作投入的正向效应不再显著。文章据此提示，拟人化设计的效果取决于周围的AI威胁氛围。

papers.title: Does transparency matter when interacting with social bots? An experiment on user engagement behaviors in Chinese social media
papers.authors: Hao Xu, Shaobo Liang, Qingxuan Cheng
papers.abstract: Purpose While transparency is widely promoted as a principle of responsible AI design, its behavioral consequences remain contested, particularly in Chinese social media contexts. This study examines whether different levels of social bot transparency reduce or facilitate user engagement, and whether these effects depend on users' prior knowledge of social bots. Design/methodology/approach An online experiment was conducted in a simulated Weibo environment. A total of 731 participants were randomly assigned to one of three transparency conditions: low, medium, or high transparency. User engagement behaviors were measured through participants' behavioral choices, including reading, liking/sharing, replying, and combined engagement actions. Multinomial logistic regression and subgroup analyses were used to examine the effects of transparency and the moderating role of prior knowledge. Findings Social bot transparency significantly reduces active user engagement. Compared with high transparency, low transparency increases the likelihood of liking/sharing, replying, and combined reply-based engagement rather than merely reading. Medium transparency produces engagement patterns similar to high transparency, suggesting that even ambiguous bot identity cues may activate non-human attribution and suppress active engagement. Prior knowledge moderates this relationship: users with limited prior knowledge are more sensitive to transparency cues, whereas those with higher prior knowledge show more stable engagement across transparency conditions. Originality/value This study extends social bot transparency research beyond binary disclosure by identifying a categorical identity-attribution mechanism. It also clarifies prior knowledge as a boundary condition of algorithm aversion in human-AI interaction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在模拟微博环境中通过在线实验考察社交机器人透明度如何影响用户参与行为，并检验用户先前知识是否起调节作用。结果显示，透明度显著降低主动参与：相比高透明度，低透明度条件下用户更可能点赞/分享、回复或采取组合性回复行为，而非仅阅读；中等透明度与高透明度效果相近，提示即便模糊的机器人身份线索也可能触发非人归因并抑制主动参与。先前知识具有调节作用，知识较少的用户对透明度线索更敏感，知识较多的用户在不同透明度条件下参与行为更稳定。研究据此将透明度效应理解为分类式身份归因机制，并把先前知识界定为人机交互中算法厌恶的边界条件。

papers.title: Negotiating professional identity in the creative industries: the REC framework for Human–AI creative work
papers.authors: Giuseppe Ceci, Matteo Daminato, Michela Iannotta
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines how artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes professional identity in the creative industries. Although prior research has largely emphasized the technological capabilities and industry-level implications of AI, limited attention has been devoted to how creative professionals themselves interpret and negotiate its consequences for creativity, authorship, and career development. Design/methodology/approach An inductive qualitative design is conducted based on 40 semi-structured interviews with professionals from the Italian audiovisual industry, including actors, directors, screenwriters, technicians, and AI experts. Data were analyzed using the Gioia methodology. Findings Findings show that AI does not simply support creative work but disrupts established understandings of what it means to be a creative professional. Three interconnected forms of identity work emerge: resisting, extending, and crafting (REC). While some participants defend the human and symbolic foundations of creativity, others embrace AI as a source of experimentation and new skill formation. More critically, AI also generates identity ambiguity and fragmentation, blurring boundaries between human originality, technological assistance, and professional legitimacy. Originality/value This work addresses an important gap in AI and creative work research by shifting attention from technological adoption to the identity-level consequences of AI. Through a unique and heterogeneous dataset spanning multiple creative occupations, the study introduces the REC framework and conceptualizes AI as a disruptive identity force that simultaneously enables, threatens, and redefines career sustainability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工智能如何重塑创意产业从业者的职业身份，通过对意大利视听行业演员、导演、编剧、技术人员和AI专家进行半结构化访谈，并采用Gioia方法分析资料。研究发现，AI并非只是辅助创作，而是动摇了人们对“创意专业人士”的既有理解，并呈现出抵抗、拓展与塑造三种相互关联的身份工作形式：部分受访者维护人类创造力的象征基础，另一些人则把AI视为实验和新技能形成的来源。更重要的是，AI还带来身份模糊与碎片化，使人际原创性、技术辅助与职业合法性之间的边界变得不清。文章据此提出REC框架，将AI理解为一种同时赋能、威胁并重新定义职业可持续性的身份扰动力量。

papers.title: Enhancing Empathy in Nursing Students Through a Multimodal Artificial Intelligence-Supported Simulation: A Mixed-Methods Study
papers.authors: Sang-Hee Kim
papers.abstract: Background: Empathic communication is a core competency in nursing practice, yet providing nursing students with realistic opportunities to develop this competency remains challenging. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled the integration of behavioral and physiological data into simulation-based education. Objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of a multimodal AI-supported simulation in improving empathy, communication self-efficacy, and learning engagement among undergraduate nursing students. Methods: A quasi-experimental pretest-posttest study was conducted with 134 undergraduate nursing students (68 experimental and 66 control). The experimental group received multimodal AI-supported simulation integrating conversational AI, facial emotion recognition, speech analysis, and physiological monitoring, whereas the control group received conventional role-play–based simulation with faculty-led debriefing. Results: After adjustment for baseline scores, the experimental group showed significantly greater improvements in empathy, communication self-efficacy, and emotional, behavioral, and cognitive engagement than the control group (all P < .001). Heart rate variability and galvanic skin response showed significant group-by-time differences, indicating differential physiological responses during the simulation. Qualitative findings indicated enhanced empathy awareness, communication confidence, and reflective learning. Conclusions: Multimodal AI-supported simulation improved empathy, communication self-efficacy, and learning engagement by providing integrated behavioral and physiological feedback. This approach may serve as a complementary educational strategy to support empathic communication training in undergraduate nursing education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察多模态人工智能支持的模拟训练能否提升本科护理学生的共情与沟通能力，采用准实验前后测混合方法，将学生分为接受该模拟的实验组和接受传统角色扮演模拟的对照组。调整基线后，实验组在共情、沟通自我效能及情感、行为、认知投入上的改善均显著大于对照组，心率变异性与皮肤电反应也呈现组别与时间的不同变化，提示模拟过程中生理反应存在差异。质性结果进一步显示学生的共情意识、沟通信心和反思性学习有所增强。作者据此认为，整合行为与生理反馈的多模态AI模拟可作为护理共情沟通训练的补充策略，但结论基于准实验设计，仍需谨慎推广。

papers.title: Applications of Generative Artificial Intelligence Teaching in Nursing Education: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.authors: Qing Wan, Xisha Long, Tao Lin, Zheng Zhang, Yichen Meng
papers.abstract: Background: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in nursing education. Its educational effects in nursing remain uncertain. Purpose: To evaluate the effects of using GenAI in teaching nursing. Methods: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to July 2026. Standardized mean differences and 95% confidence intervals (95% CI) were pooled using random-effects models. Heterogeneity, sensitivity analyses, meta-regression, and small-study effects were explored. Results: Seventeen studies involving 1456 participants were included. GenAI-integrated teaching was associated with higher knowledge scores (standardized mean differences 0.53, 95% CI 0.03-1.04), practice-related scores (SMD 1.25, 95% CI 0.23-2.28), and teaching satisfaction (SMD 0.58, 95% CI 0.02-1.13). Attitudes, competency, and self-efficacy did not differ significantly. Meta-regression findings were exploratory. Conclusions: GenAI-integrated teaching may improve knowledge, practice-related performance, and satisfaction in nursing education. However, extreme heterogeneity and sensitivity to individual studies limit confidence in the magnitude and reproducibility of these effects. GenAI should be used as a supervised pedagogical adjunct pending high-quality trials.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与荟萃分析考察生成式人工智能用于护理教学的效果，检索多个数据库后纳入17项随机对照试验，合并分析显示GenAI整合教学与知识得分、实践相关得分和教学满意度较高相关，但在态度、胜任力和自我效能上未见显著差异。作者强调异质性极大且结果对单项研究敏感，因此对这些效应的大小和可重复性应保持谨慎，建议在高质量试验出现前将GenAI作为有监督的教学辅助手段。

papers.title: Dynamics of collective creativity in AI art competitions
papers.authors: Mason Youngblood, Jeff Nusz, Joel Simon
papers.abstract: Abstract Creativity is a fundamental part of cultural evolution, but the mechanisms by which groups produce novelty are notoriously difficult to infer from the historical record. Iterated learning experiments have shown that cultural transmission reliably distorts artifacts toward the inductive biases of learners, but most of this work uses linear chains of human participants, and it is unclear how these dynamics play out in the networked, human-AI systems that increasingly shape cultural production. In this study, we analyze one such system: Artbreeder, which hosts daily “remix parties” in which users iteratively build on each other's work from a single seed image, producing branching lineages of images co-created by humans and generative AI. Using 130,882 images from 368 remix parties over 13 months, we find that images become less novel over the course of a party and that each remix step moves less far from its parents, consistent with the stabilization seen in iterated learning experiments, and that late-stage images drift toward the platform's dominant portrait style. More novel “parent” images produce more novel and more complex “children.” More novel children attract more likes but are not remixed more, whereas more complex children are remixed less. Finally, larger remix parties produce images that are more novel but less complex.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人机协同创作中集体创造力如何演变，以Artbreeder平台的“混音派对”为对象，分析用户基于同一初始图像迭代再创作所形成的分支谱系。结果显示，派对进程中图像新颖性逐步下降，每次再创作偏离母本的程度递减，后期图像向平台主流肖像风格漂移；母本越新颖，子代越新颖且越复杂，子代新颖性带来更多点赞却未带来更多再创作，复杂度反而降低再创作可能，规模更大的派对产出更新颖但复杂度更低的图像。这些发现表明，人机协同的迭代创作可能像人类链式传递一样趋于稳定，且社会反馈与创作选择并不一致。

papers.title: Trace-Distance Binary Tree AdaBoost for Trainable Quantum Multi-Class Classification
papers.authors: Xin Wang, Yabo Wang, Rebing Wu
papers.abstract: Abstract We propose a Trace-distance binary Tree AdaBoost (TTA) multi-class quantum classifier, a practical pipeline for quantum multi-class classification that combines quantum-aware reductions with ensemble learning to improve trainability and resource efficiency. TTA builds a hierarchical binary tree by choosing, at each internal node, the bipartition that {heuristically} maximizes the trace distance between average quantum states; each node trains a binary AdaBoost ensemble of shallow variational quantum base learners. By confining intrinsically hard, small trace distance distinctions to small node-specific datasets and combining weak shallow learners via AdaBoost, TTA distributes capacity across many small submodels rather than one deep circuit, mitigating barren-plateau and optimization failures without sacrificing generalization. Empirically TTA achieves top test accuracy ($\approx $100\%) among quantum and classical baselines, is robust to common quantum errors, and realizes aggregate systems with almost 10,000 cumulative layers and 0.2M parameters, implemented as many shallow circuits. Our results are empirical and implementable on near-term platforms, providing a resource-efficient route to scalable multi-class quantum machine learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种面向量子多类分类的迹距离二叉树AdaBoost（TTA）分类器，将量子感知的类别归约与集成学习结合，以提升可训练性和资源效率。方法上，TTA按内部节点平均量子态间迹距离最大的二划分构建层次二叉树，每个节点训练由浅层变分量子基学习器组成的二分类AdaBoost集成，把困难的小迹距离区分限制在节点级小数据集上，并以多个小子模型分散容量而非依赖单一深电路。实验显示，TTA在量子与经典基线中取得最高测试准确率，对常见量子误差较稳健，并以大量浅层电路实现累计近万层、约0.2M参数的系统；这些为实证结果，作者据此提出一条面向近期平台的可扩展多类量子机器学习路径。

papers.title: Exploratory data analysis and machine learning-based assessment of social media addiction and its impact on academic performance and mental health among students
papers.authors: Nitin Kisan Ahire

papers.title: From print to algorithm: teaching Indonesian postcolonial fiction with critical algorithmic literacy
papers.authors: Dewi Candraningrum, Mauly Halwat Hikmat, Muhammad Akram Sabir
papers.journal: Innovation in Language Learning and Teaching
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines how Indonesian postcolonial fiction – principally Pramoedya Ananta Toer's Bumi Manusia [This Earth of Mankind] and Laksmi Pamuntjak's Amba – was taught across print, digitised and algorithmically mediated environments in two undergraduate English Language Teaching (ELT) literature courses in Surakarta and Yogyakarta, Indonesia, and what teaching critical algorithmic literacy looks like in such courses.Design/methodology/approach A qualitative multiple-case study drew on Indonesian postcolonial criticism, cultural memory studies and work on algorithmic and AI literacy, distinguishing three layers of mediation: digitised reading, algorithmic curation and generative AI. Data comprised classroom observation, instructor interviews, student focus groups and interviews, reflective journals and student-produced ‘feed audits’, analysed through reflexive thematic analysis by an author team that includes the courses’ own teacher.Findings Print-first close reading supported textual warranting and cultural-memory work; students perceived recommendation panels as foregrounding Anglophone titles over Indonesian ones; instructor-designed counter-searches and feed audits made algorithmic curation an object of critique; digital tools supported translanguaging across Bahasa Indonesia, Javanese and English when paired with evaluation criteria; and hybrid sequencing was valued but labour-intensive.Originality/value The study's innovation is pedagogical rather than technological: a resource-aware, print-first sequence of feed audits, Indonesian-language counter-searches, checklists for generative AI output and evidence ladders that turns algorithms into objects of literary inquiry. It brings Indonesian literary criticism and language politics into dialogue with algorithmic literacy and identifies the conditions under which such teaching may be sustainable in Indonesian higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察印尼后殖民小说在纸质、数字化与算法中介环境中如何被教授，以及批判性算法素养教学在此类课程中的形态。作者采用定性多案例研究，综合课堂观察、访谈、焦点小组、反思日志与学生“信息流审计”等材料进行分析。研究发现，以纸质为先的细读有助于文本论证与文化记忆工作；学生认为推荐面板更突出英语作品而非印尼作品，而教师设计的反向检索与信息流审计使算法策展成为批判对象；数字工具在配合评价标准时可支持多语转换，混合式教学序列虽受认可但耗费人力。文章据此提出以资源为条件、纸质为先的教学序列，将算法转化为文学探究对象。
