papers.title: A bibliometric analysis of combat stress during 1990–2024 from Web of Science database
papers.authors: Lele Xu, Wantong Xie, Hong Chang, Mingyue Gao, 毓薇 杨, Lin Zhang, Leijing Shan, Shufang Qiao, Peng Zhang
papers.abstract: The aims of this study were to explore the research hotspots and trends in combat stress worldwide. Using the Web of Science (WoS) as the literature source, we searched for papers published between 1990 and 2024 using combat stress-related terms combined with veteran-related terms. VOSviewer 1.6.17 and CiteSpace 6.2R6 software were employed to analyze the data. A bibliometric analysis was applied to assess the publications related to combat stress. In total, 5840 publications were retrieved. Analysis of the keywords indicated that memory, moral injury, military personnel, prazosin, secondary traumatization, traumatic brain injury, cardiovascular disease, high-density EEG, traumatic stress disorder, and milieu therapy were the main research hotspots in the field of combat stress. The burst detection indicated that the psychological coping mechanism of combat stress, particularly resilience, is a future research trend. These results can provide insight into the research progress regarding combat stress.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以 Web of Science 为文献来源，对 1990 至 2024 年间发表的战斗应激相关论文进行文献计量分析，并借助 VOSviewer 与 CiteSpace 考察研究热点与趋势。关键词分析显示，记忆、道德伤害、军人群体、哌唑嗪、继发性创伤、创伤性脑损伤、心血管疾病、高密度脑电、创伤性应激障碍及环境治疗等构成该领域的主要热点；突现检测则提示，战斗应激的心理应对机制尤其是心理韧性，是未来的研究方向。这些结果可为把握战斗应激研究的进展提供参考。

papers.title: Transformative learning in farmer research networks: insights from Eastern and Southern Africa
papers.authors: Evelyne Kiptot, Romina De Angelis, Mirriam Matita, Shiphar Mulumba, Carolyne Phiri, Mary Richardson, Frank Tchuwa, Kate Wellard, Richard Coe
papers.abstract: Farmer research networks are collaborative platforms where farmers, researchers, extension workers, and NGOs co-create knowledge, experiment with innovations, and tackle local challenges through joint learning and action. Although interest in these networks is growing, there remains a limited understanding of how learning occurs within them. This study draws on qualitative data from nine networks active between 2015 and 2024 in Kenya, Malawi and Uganda. It reveals that these networks foster individual and collective transformation. The process is dynamic, multi-dimensional, technical, relational, and emotional, shaped by diverse knowledge systems and social interactions. Emotional engagement , enhanced motivation, deepened reflection, and prompted identity shifts. Networks function not only as sites of knowledge co-creation and learning but also as cultural and emotional spaces where agricultural visions and identities are negotiated and reshaped. Farmers assumed roles as researchers and educators, adapting agroecological innovations and experimenting with solutions to ecological and livelihood challenges. The key enabling factors were trust among members, inclusive facilitation, institutional memory, and strong local leadership. Progress was constrained by entrenched gender norms, hierarchical extension practices, and rigid social structures. Sustaining transformative learning calls for continued investment in facilitation capacity, inclusive leadership and institutional structures that embed networks within broader innovation systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注农民研究网络中的学习如何发生，基于肯尼亚、马拉维和乌干达九个网络多年间的定性资料进行分析。研究发现，这类网络能推动个体与集体的转化性学习，过程兼具技术、关系与情感维度：情感投入、动机增强、反思加深促使参与者身份发生转变，农民也承担起研究者和教育者的角色，试验并调适生态农业创新。信任、包容性引导、机构记忆和本地领导力是主要促进因素，而性别规范、等级化的推广方式和僵化的社会结构则构成限制。文章据此指出，维持这种学习需要持续投入引导能力建设与包容性制度安排。

papers.title: Nudging citizens to use chatbots: an information and default option approach
papers.authors: Haoting Chang, Lei Tao
papers.abstract: Governments are increasingly adopting chatbots to reduce administrative burdens and improve service quality, yet citizens’ willingness to use them remains limited. Drawing on nudge theory, this study examines how information framing and default options influence citizens’ willingness to use chatbots in public services. Using a survey experiment in China, the results show that participants exposed to a loss frame were more willing to use chatbots than those exposed to a gain frame. The default option alone did not significantly affect willingness. However, the interaction between information framing and default settings was significant. Specifically, the positive effect of loss-framed information on citizens’ willingness to use chatbots was stronger when a default option was presented, suggesting that defaults amplify the effect of loss framing. Overall, the study offers practical insights into designing strategies to promote chatbot adoption in public services.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于助推理论，通过一项调查实验考察信息框架与默认选项如何影响公众在公共服务中使用聊天机器人的意愿。结果显示，损失框架比收益框架更能提升使用意愿，而单独设置默认选项并无显著作用；但两者存在交互效应，即在呈现默认选项时，损失框架的正向作用更强，表明默认设置会放大损失框架的效果。研究据此为促进公共服务中聊天机器人的采纳提供了设计层面的启示。

papers.title: How postgraduate learning engagement in generative AI-assisted contexts supports critical thinking: A grounded theory study
papers.authors: Changhong Teng, Chunmei Yang, Qiushi Liu
papers.journal: Innovations in Education and Teaching International
papers.abstract: Despite growing interest in generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in higher education, limited attention has been paid to how learning engagement is reconfigured in GenAI-assisted contexts and how it supports critical thinking. This study adopts a grounded theory approach to examine the dimensions of postgraduate learning engagement and its underlying mechanisms. Based on semi-structured interviews with 32 postgraduates, four dimensions are identified: cognitive, emotional, human-AI interaction, and agentic engagement. Extending existing frameworks, the findings show that engagement promotes critical thinking through both direct and indirect pathways. Learning self-efficacy and lower-order cognitive offloading act as key mediators, while GenAI trust serves as a contextual moderator. A process-oriented model is proposed to explain how GenAI reshapes engagement and fosters higher-order thinking.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能辅助情境下研究生学习投入如何被重新配置并支持批判性思维，采用扎根理论方法，基于对研究生的半结构化访谈进行分析。研究发现学习投入包含认知、情感、人机交互和能动性四个维度，并进一步提出，学习投入既直接也间接地促进批判性思维，其中学习自我效能感和低阶认知卸载起中介作用，而对生成式人工智能的信任则作为情境调节因素。作者据此构建了一个过程导向模型，用以解释生成式人工智能如何重塑学习投入并促进高阶思维，但相关机制仍属基于访谈的理论建构，尚需进一步检验。

papers.title: Design literacy as an mediator: An empirical study on AIGC-assisted intangible cultural heritage design
papers.authors: Wangming Hu, Gulong Wang, Tao Peng
papers.abstract: Although AI-generated content (AIGC) is increasingly integrated into cultural heritage design, few empirical studies have examined how users’ design literacy and educational backgrounds shape their engagement with AIGC in culturally embedded design tasks. This paper uses mixed methods to investigate AIGC in Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) design, using Quanzhou Festival Lanterns as a case study. A 17-week teaching experiment involving 105 undergraduates was conducted to develop a structured evaluation framework for AIGC-assisted ICH design. The findings indicate that AIGC significantly enhances creative expression, particularly when supported by strong design literacy. Comparative analysis demonstrates that design literacy may play a significant explanatory role in the process of AIGC-assisted culture creativity: design majors tend to use AIGC for cultural semantic organization and design iteration, whereas non-design majors focus more on the novelty of visual forms, resulting in works that are relatively limited in terms of the depth of cultural expression.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以泉州花灯为案例，采用混合方法考察在非物质文化遗产设计任务中，使用者的设计素养与教育背景如何影响其使用AIGC的方式。为期17周的教学实验显示，AIGC能显著增强创意表达，但这种作用在参与者的设计素养较强时更为明显。比较分析表明，设计素养对AIGC辅助的文化创意过程具有重要解释作用：设计专业者倾向于用AIGC进行文化语义组织与设计迭代，非设计专业者则更关注视觉形式的新颖性，作品在文化表达深度上相对有限。

papers.title: Organizing Creative Labor in the Age of AI: Institutional Differences and Transnational Connections Across the US and EU
papers.authors: Matina Magkou
papers.journal: The Journal of Arts Management Law and Society
papers.abstract: This paper examines how cultural and creative workers (CCW) in the United States and European Union have organized in response to the rise of artificial intelligence in cultural and creative industries since 2023. Drawing on documentary analysis and interviews that contextualize and interpret the secondary material, it examines parallel developments in the two contexts to explore how different institutional settings shape CCWs’ collective responses to AI. The analysis highlights distinct institutional pathways and mobilization repertoires, yet increasingly shared concerns around authorship, consent, transparency, and remuneration, pointing toward increasingly interconnected CCW ecosystems across geographical boundaries. The paper thus argues that AI-related mobilization is shaped both by institutional contexts and emerging transnational connections, contributing to broader debates on creative labor, collective organization, and the governance of emerging technologies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察2023年以来人工智能在美国和欧盟文化创意产业中的兴起如何促使文化创意工作者组织起来，采用文献分析与访谈相结合的方式，对两地平行发展进行情境化解读。研究发现，不同的制度环境塑造了各自的组织路径和动员方式，但围绕作者身份、知情同意、透明度和报酬等议题，两地工作者的关切日益趋同，显示出跨越地理边界的创意工作者生态正变得相互关联。文章据此提出，与人工智能相关的动员既受制度情境影响，也受新兴跨国联系塑造，为创意劳动、集体组织与新兴技术治理的讨论提供了参考。

papers.title: Human or Algorithmic Managers in Expert Knowledge Work? The Interplay of Management Style and Managerial Function
papers.authors: Janne Kauttonen, Aarni Tuomi, Johanna Vuori, Pirjo Saaranen, Anna Lahtinen
papers.abstract: Algorithmic management is entering expert knowledge work, but when workers accept algorithmic rather than human managers remains unclear. We surveyed Finnish expert knowledge workers (N = 1,156) using a factorial scenario experiment varying manager type (human/algorithmic), management style (controlling/balanced /flexible), and six managerial functions and measured leader–member exchange (LMX), organizational trust, AI familiarity and work complexity. Findings cover five functions; rewarding was excluded due to insufficient model fit. Management style was the strongest predictor: flexible styles were rated highest and controlling lowest, regardless of manager type. Human managers were preferred for goal setting, performance evaluation, and supportive leadership; algorithms only for scheduling under controlling conditions. Monitoring showed no consistent difference. High-quality LMX buffered reactions to controlling styles, and in performance evaluation and supportive leadership its association with acceptability was stronger for algorithmic managers, narrowing the human advantage. Organizational trust and LMX were more consistently implicated than AI familiarity, qualifying algorithm-aversion accounts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注专家知识工作者在何种情况下接受算法管理者而非人类管理者，采用情景实验调查了芬兰专家知识工作者，并操纵管理者类型、管理风格与六项管理职能。结果显示，管理风格是最强预测因素：无论管理者是人类还是算法，灵活风格评价最高、控制型最低；人类管理者在目标设定、绩效评估和支持性领导上更受偏好，算法仅在控制型条件下负责排程时占优，监控职能则无一致差异。高质量的领导—成员交换能缓冲对控制型风格的反应，且在绩效评估与支持性领导中，这种交换与可接受性的关联对算法管理者更强，从而缩小了人类管理者的优势；组织信任比AI熟悉度更稳定地相关，对算法厌恶的解释构成限定。

papers.title: Bounded Delegation: How Student Design Teams Keep Strategic Control over Generative AI
papers.authors: Bize Wei, Yu Qiao

papers.title: Generalizable neural decoding for clinically scalable brain-computer interfaces
papers.authors: Yuanjie Gu, Haotian Yin, Yiqun Wang, Yan-Qi-Vivian Woon, Yujie Wang, Mengge Teng, Chengze Lu, Zhi Lü, Jie Chen
papers.abstract: Brain–computer interfaces promise restored communication and movement, yet accuracy achieved under development rarely survives new sessions, users, tasks, or hardware. Generalization, not peak performance, determines clinical scalability. Here we examine generalizable neural decoding from development to deployment, organized by the domain held out at evaluation, target-data access, adaptation strategy, and the clinical conditions under which performance persists, identifying benchmarking standards, prospective validation, and hardware-algorithm co-design as prerequisites for durable benefit.
papers.summary_zh: 该文关注脑机接口从开发走向临床部署时的泛化问题，指出开发阶段达到的准确率往往难以在新会话、新用户、新任务或新硬件上保持，真正决定临床可扩展性的是泛化能力而非峰值性能。文章按评估时留出的领域、目标数据可及性、适应策略以及性能得以维持的临床条件来组织讨论，并将基准测试标准、前瞻性验证和硬件—算法协同设计列为实现持久获益的前提。全文属于框架性论述，未报告具体实验或系统实现。

papers.title: Knowledge and attitudes of Egyptian medical students towards artificial intelligence application in medical practice: a multicenter cross‑sectional study
papers.authors: Mohamed El-Helaly, Abdelaziz M. Hussein, Amira Ibrahim Taman, Nesrine Saad Farrag, Asmaa Ali Elfeky, Ahmed Mohamed Elhelaly, Noha Essam
papers.abstract: Abstract The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly impacted various fields, including medicine. As AI integration in medicine expands, medical students and professionals need to develop a comprehensive understanding of its applications. This study aimed to explore the self-reported knowledge and attitudes of undergraduate Egyptian medical students regarding artificial intelligence application in medical practice. A multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted between June and August 2025 among undergraduate medical students from seven Egyptian medical schools. Participants were recruited using convenience sampling. Data were collected via a validated structured web-based questionnaire distributed through social media to assess students’ demographics, knowledge, and attitudes toward AI applications in medical practice. This study included 1438 medical students with a mean age of 20.3 years ± 1.9 years. Overall, 55.3% demonstrated good knowledge and 66.8% showed a positive attitude toward AI applications in medical practice. Good knowledge was significantly higher among students in higher academic years (3rd year AOR = 1.88, P = 0.006; 4th year AOR = 2.02, P = 0.007; 5th year AOR = 1.86, P = 0.034) and among those reporting peers and mentors (AOR = 1.35, P = 0.017), scientific papers and books (AOR = 1.71, P < 0.001), training courses (AOR = 1.43, P = 0.004), and mass media (AOR = 1.32, P = 0.036) as their main sources of AI information. A positive attitude toward AI was significantly more common among male students (AOR = 1.50, P = 0.001), 4th-year students (AOR = 1.97, P = 0.014), and those willing to enroll in an AI course (AOR = 1.30, P = 0.039). YouTube was perceived as the most valuable social media source for AI-related information (90.4%), followed by Telegram (86.6%) and WhatsApp (65.2%). Although the Egyptian medical students who participated in this study demonstrated generally positive attitudes toward AI and a willingness to learn, they may be navigating this transition with limited institutional guidance. These findings suggest that medical schools should consider integrating AI-related technical literacy and ethical reasoning into the core curriculum.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查了埃及医学生对人工智能在医疗实践中应用的自我报告知识与态度，采用多中心横断面设计和结构化网络问卷，对象为七所医学院的本科生。结果显示，约半数学生具备较好的AI知识，多数持积极态度；较高年级以及通过同伴导师、论文书籍、培训课程和大众媒体获取信息的学生，知识水平更高，男生、四年级学生和愿意选修AI课程者态度更积极。作者据此指出，学生虽总体积极且愿意学习，但可能缺乏机构层面的引导，建议医学院将AI技术素养与伦理推理纳入核心课程。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-coupled paper-based detection of H2O2: an experiment customized from lab-on-paper sensing to image analysis to machine learning
papers.authors: Haider A. J. Al Lawati, Maryam Mousavizadegan, Fakhr Eldin O. Suliman, Syeda N. F. Ali, Asil Al Subaihi, Zakiya Al Hashmi, Abrar Al Abri, El-Said I. El-Shafey
papers.abstract: Abstract Despite the vast growth of artificial intelligence (AI) in chemical research, educational programs have struggled to keep pace in familiarizing and preparing students for its implementation. In response to this gap, we have developed an interdisciplinary experiment for senior undergraduate and postgraduate students to discuss the implementations of AI in analytical chemistry with a focus on sensing. For this, an example paper-based fluorescent sensor was employed for the detection of H2O2 using image-based signal readout and machine learning-based concentration quantification. The Horseradish Peroxidase (HRP)-catalyzed yellow fluorescence emission resulting from the interaction of ortho-phenylenediamine (OPD) with H2O2 was recorded using smartphone cameras. Various features were extracted from the images and used to develop machine learning models for quantifying H2O2 concentration. Through this experiment, an introduction to sensing and paper-based sensor development, as well as the implementation of AI in sensor data analysis, was presented. During the lab experiment, students successfully developed Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models, validated them, and optimized them to improve performance. The feedback showed that students had become familiar with AI and machine learning and had increased interest in using AI in their future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对化学教育中人工智能教学滞后的问题，为高年级本科生和研究生设计了一项跨学科实验，将纸基荧光传感、智能手机图像读取与机器学习浓度定量相结合，用于检测过氧化氢。学生在实验中提取图像特征并构建、验证和优化人工神经网络模型，完成了从传感原理到AI数据分析的完整实践。反馈显示，学生借此熟悉了人工智能与机器学习，并提高了在未来研究中应用AI的兴趣。文章属于教学实验设计，主要报告的是课程实施与学生反馈，而非AI方法本身的性能比较。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Audio-Visual Stimuli based Brain-Machine Interface with Safe Model Predictive Control for Robotic Arm Trajectory Tracking in Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.authors: Aditi Pandey, Abhra Roy Chowdhury
papers.abstract: Abstract Achieving effective Brain–Machine Interface (BMI) control of robotic manipulators remains challenging, particularly when integrating low-bandwidth neural commands with safety-constrained robot execution. This paper presents a pilot proof-of-concept framework for BMI-driven control of a UR5 robotic arm using a switchable audio–visual EEG paradigm combined with nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC). Steady-State Visual Evoked Potentials (SSVEP) and Auditory Steady-State Responses (ASSR) are employed as mutually exclusive BMI channels for discrete task selection, while Error-Related Potentials (ErrP) provide supervisory feedback for safety intervention. Three stimulation frequencies are mapped to predefined manipulation tasks executed along offline, pre-computed trajectories. Robot execution is evaluated under open-loop control, a nonlinear PID controller as a reference baseline, and a safe NMPC scheme. In the proposed implementation, ErrP detection triggers suppression of robot velocity within the NMPC framework, acting as a real-time safety stop. Pilot human–robot interaction experiments demonstrate the feasibility of decoding-to-execution integration and consistent trajectory execution under NMPC. The NMPC scheme achieved tracking errors in the range of 0.043–0.137 m and task completion times of 7.3 s –7.5 s while enforcing a velocity limit of 0.25 m/s. The FBCCA method yielded average classification accuracies of 93.5% (SSVEP) and 87.5% (ASSR), averaged across two participants. These findings provide preliminary evidence of system-level feasibility, rather than population-level statistical validation, and motivate future studies with larger cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究面向脑机接口控制机械臂这一难题，提出并初步验证了一个将视听脑电范式与安全非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）相结合的原型框架，用SSVEP和ASSR作为可切换的离散任务选择通道，并以ErrP作为监督反馈触发实时减速。作者在少量人类参与者上开展人机交互试验，结果显示解码到执行的整合可行，NMPC下轨迹跟踪误差约为0.043至0.137米，任务完成时间约7.3至7.5秒，同时维持速度上限；SSVEP与ASSR的平均分类准确率分别约为93.5%和87.5%。作者强调这仅为系统层面的初步可行性证据，而非群体统计验证，后续需扩大被试规模。

papers.title: Large language models combined with open-source algorithms for identifying prior art for obviousness analysis
papers.authors: Joshua M. Pearce
papers.abstract: The literature shows that patents often slow innovation, and patent parasites that patent commons innovation threaten the growth of entire industries, including additive manufacturing (AM) or 3D printing. AM has expanded through open-source hardware, software and shared material recipes, yet this cumulative innovation ecosystem is increasingly exposed to broad patents on AM materials. This article examines how obviousness doctrine should respond to algorithmic and large language model (LLM)-assisted prior-art generation in cumulative-innovation fields. Twenty-five U.S. AM materials patents and applications from 2016 to 2026 are mapped against an open-source algorithm for identifying obvious AM material prior art. The results suggest that many claims can be characterized as known printable material classes, predictable combinations of known feedstocks, routine additive use, or ordinary processing adaptations. The article argues that LLMs substantially reduces the difficulty of locating, parsing and applying prior art, providing a clear path for challenging obvious claims. A hybrid strategy is proposed as the strongest defense: deterministic, open-source databases for legally robust disclosure, combined with LLM-assisted claim parsing, semantic search and prioritization. Such systems could help patent examiners, researchers and open-source communities distinguish genuine inventions from predictable formulation work and preserve open access to the commons in many fields.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论在增材制造这类累积性创新领域，专利显而易见性判断应如何回应算法与大语言模型辅助的现有技术检索。作者将一批美国增材制造材料专利与申请同开源算法识别出的现有技术进行对照，发现许多权利要求可被归为已知可打印材料类别、已知原料的可预测组合、常规添加使用或普通工艺调整。文章据此认为大语言模型显著降低了定位、解析和运用现有技术的难度，并提出以确定性开源数据库保障法律上稳健的披露、再结合大语言模型辅助的权利要求解析与语义检索的混合策略，帮助审查员、研究者和开源社区区分真正发明与可预测的配方工作。

papers.title: An artificial intelligence meta-skills framework for undergraduate research
papers.authors: Ángel Deroncele-Acosta, Sergio Tobón, Roger Pedro Norabuena-Figueroa, Emerson Norabuena-Figueroa
papers.abstract: Undergraduate research faces unprecedented challenges in the digital era, as exponentially growing data increasingly shapes the university ecosystem. However, artificial intelligence, particularly tools such as ChatGPT, offers significant opportunities to address this transformation. Effective use requires advanced competencies in generating, acquiring, storing, and analyzing data. In response, this study developed and validated a new Big Data Socio-Technical Competence Scale to assess undergraduate students’ competencies in research contexts. This study examined the relationship between Big Data socio-technical competencies and undergraduate students' academic use of ChatGPT, as well as the underlying meta-skills for using AI in research. A sequential explanatory mixed-methods design (QUAN → qual) was adopted, involving 418 undergraduate students. We used two measurement instruments: the newly developed and validated Big Data Socio-Technical Competence Scale and a scale measuring the academic use of ChatGPT; both showed high internal consistency, along with a semi-structured interview protocol. The findings show that Big Data competencies were generally low, whereas the academic use of ChatGPT for research was predominantly medium to high. Structural equation modeling revealed that socio-technical competencies in Big Data positively and significantly predict the academic use of ChatGPT (β = 0.269, p < .001). The qualitative phase identified nine Artificial Intelligence Meta-Skills for Undergraduate Research: (1) Critical Data Literacy, (2) Critical Thinking, (3) Epistemic Data Management, (4) Evidence-Based Decision-Making, (5) Critical Data Communication, (6) Metacognitive Regulation, (7) Emotional Self-Regulation, (8) Responsible Human–AI Agency, and (9) Ethical Reasoning. The study discusses educational implications and practical applications.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注本科生在科研中使用ChatGPT所需的能力基础，开发并验证了大数据社会技术能力量表，采用顺序解释性混合方法，结合问卷调查与半结构化访谈考察大数据能力、ChatGPT学术使用及AI元技能之间的关系。结果显示，学生的大数据能力总体偏低，而ChatGPT用于科研的学术使用多处于中高水平；结构方程模型表明大数据社会技术能力对ChatGPT学术使用具有正向预测作用。质性分析进一步归纳出九项本科生科研AI元技能，涵盖批判性数据素养、批判性思维、证据本位决策、元认知与情绪调节、负责任的人机能动性及伦理推理等，文章据此讨论了相应的教育启示。

papers.title: How does generative AI shape doctoral students’ critical reading in academic contexts? A mixed-methods investigation
papers.authors: Lihong Ma, Maomao Cao, Guoping Sun
papers.journal: Journal of English for Academic Purposes

papers.title: Lighting design for enclosed environments: A multimodal predictive framework for human alertness and emotional responses
papers.authors: Jing Chen, Muyao Shen, Yujia Liu, Xiaoya Liang, Gongbing Shan, Mingjiu Yu
papers.abstract: Lighting in enclosed, daylight-isolated environments must simultaneously sustain alertness and emotional stability, yet current standards provide limited guidance for achieving both outcomes. This study presents a multimodal predictive framework for preventive lighting design based on emotion–alertness integration. Twenty combinations of illuminance and correlated color temperature were evaluated in a windowless control-room mock-up using EEG, behavioral tasks, and valence–arousal self-reports. Results revealed two distinct functional regions: higher illuminance with mid-to-high correlated color temperature enhanced alertness and performance, whereas lower illuminance with warmer color temperature promoted calmer and more positive affect. A back-propagation neural network predicted subjective alertness and valence from selected EEG and behavioral response features recorded under each lighting condition, and the resulting response patterns were used to map design-relevant lighting regions. The framework provides a direct pathway from multimodal evidence to parameterized lighting decisions, supporting preventive, health-oriented design in enclosed habitats.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对无窗封闭环境中照明需同时维持警觉性与情绪稳定、而现行标准指导有限的问题，提出一个基于情绪—警觉性整合的多模态预测框架。作者在无窗控制室模拟环境中评估了照度与相关色温的多种组合，结合脑电、行为任务和效价—唤醒自评，发现高照度配中高色温更利于警觉性与任务表现，低照度配暖色温则带来更平静积极的情感。随后用反向传播神经网络从脑电与行为特征预测主观警觉性和效价，并据此映射出设计相关的照明区域。该框架为从多模态证据走向参数化照明决策提供了路径，但其预测与设计映射基于特定模拟环境，实际应用仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Beyond question and answer: Practical applications of multimodal and multifunctional large language models in ophthalmology with a scoping review and future directions
papers.authors: Hye Won Jun, Dongjin Nam, Joon Yul Choi, Tae Keun Yoo
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) connect language understanding with image-based reasoning and are increasingly explored as artificial intelligence systems for ophthalmic image analysis, workflow support, research prototyping, and education. This scoping review synthesizes 21 peer-reviewed studies that moved beyond text-only question answering to evaluate visual question answering (VQA), domain-adapted or fine-tuned ophthalmic models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and low- or no-code tools for analytics and prototype development. Across studies, the evidence suggests early feasibility for image-conditioned explanations, triage support, documentation assistance, structured data extraction, and rapid tool creation. However, the evidence base remains heterogeneous and preliminary, with mixed diagnostic performance, variable prompts and model versions, limited external validation, and persistent risks including reasoning errors, hallucinations, session variability, privacy concerns, and security threats. To illustrate potential workflows not yet fully covered by the literature, we also provide clearly labeled author-built demonstrations, which are non-evidentiary, for fundus and optical coherence tomography (OCT)-based VQA, optical character recognition (OCR) tabulation, code-free analytics, automated software programming, and web-based risk calculators. Future priorities include extending image-conditioned reasoning to additional ophthalmic modalities, strengthening RAG with curated corpora and provenance, evaluating few-shot and in-context learning for rare conditions, and using controlled generative imaging for education and data augmentation. Overall, MLLMs may support supervised ophthalmic artificial intelligence applications in selected clinical, research, and educational workflows. Clinical deployment will require external validation, prospective human-in-the-loop evaluation, standards-based workflow integration, privacy-preserving infrastructure, audit logging, cybersecurity, and post-deployment monitoring.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了21项同行评审研究，考察多模态大语言模型在眼科中超越纯文本问答的实际应用，涵盖视觉问答、领域适配或微调模型、检索增强生成以及低代码或无代码工具。证据显示，这类系统在图像条件下的解释、分诊支持、文书辅助、结构化数据提取和快速工具构建方面已显现早期可行性，但整体证据基础异质且初步，诊断表现不一，提示词与模型版本各异，外部验证有限，并存在推理错误、幻觉、会话波动、隐私与安全等风险。作者另附明确标注为非证据性的自建演示，用以说明文献尚未充分覆盖的工作流，并提出拓展图像条件推理、强化检索增强生成、评估少样本学习及受控生成图像等未来方向。总体而言，多模态大语言模型可能支持受监督的眼科人工智能应用，但临床部署仍需外部验证、前瞻性人在回路评估、标准化工作流整合、隐私保护基础设施与部署后监测。

papers.title: A fashion specific framework for artificial intelligence literacy in higher education
papers.authors: Srikant Manchiraju
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming every dimension of the fashion industry—from creative ideation and pattern generation to supply chain optimization, trend forecasting, and personalized retail. Yet the higher education institutions charged with preparing tomorrow’s fashion professionals remain structurally, pedagogically, and conceptually unprepared for this transformation. This paper argues that the challenge is not simply one of adding AI tools to existing curricula; it is, more fundamentally, a question of literacy. Drawing on a critical integrative review of interdisciplinary scholarship across AI education, digital literacy theory, fashion pedagogy, and industry workforce analysis, this paper examines three interlocking questions: What is AI literacy, and how has its conceptualization evolved? What theoretical and conceptual frameworks currently govern AI literacy discourse, and how might they be adapted for the creative disciplines? And, critically, do fashion higher education students require a form of AI literacy that is fashion-specific—and if so, what form should it take? The paper proposes a novel conceptual framework, the Fashion AI Literacy Framework ( FALF ) and outlines concrete curricular pathways for implementation. The framework is presented as a conceptual proposition that requires empirical validation. The argument advanced here is both urgent and structural: generic AI literacy, however well-designed, may not fully equip fashion students to navigate the creative, ethical, commercial, and cultural terrain that defines their discipline. On the evidence reviewed here, a domain-specific approach is better understood as needed rather than optional.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对时尚产业快速智能化而高等时尚教育在结构、教学与概念上准备不足的问题，追问时尚专业学生是否需要一种领域专属的AI素养。作者通过跨AI教育、数字素养理论、时尚教学法与行业劳动力分析的批判性整合综述，梳理AI素养概念的演变及现有框架，并提出“时尚AI素养框架”（FALF）及相应的课程实施路径。文章强调该框架目前只是有待实证检验的概念性主张，其核心判断是：通用AI素养即便设计良好，也未必能让学生应对本学科特有的创意、伦理、商业与文化情境，因此领域专属路径应被视为必要而非可选。

papers.title: Development and exploratory validation of the student susceptibility to artificial intelligence (SAI) index among higher education students in Ghana
papers.authors: Simon Sanche, Emmanuel Udochukwu Osisiogu, Frederick Allou, Raphael Eyram Amemo
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Generative AI is now routine in student work, yet instruments measuring the risks attached to that use—over-reliance, misuse, and the reflective practices that guard against them—remain scarce in African higher education. This study reports the initial development and exploratory evaluation of a 23-item Student Susceptibility to AI (SAI) item pool. Methods A cross-sectional survey of 408 students, recruited by convenience sampling at six purposively selected Ghanaian institutions, was analysed using a reverse-coding audit, Principal Axis Factoring with Promax rotation, parallel analysis, false-discovery-rate-corrected comparisons and multivariable regression. No pilot preceded the survey, and one sample informed item evaluation and extraction. Results Two-thirds of participants (65.7%) reported daily AI use; only 2.0% none. Parallel analysis supported three factors, the fourth eigenvalue falling below the random threshold; both solutions are reported. Internal consistency was acceptable for Over-Reliance, Cognitive Vulnerability and Resilience & Reflection (α = 0.807–0.824) but inadequate for Misuse/Academic Integrity (α = 0.535), and a total composite was unsupported (ECV = 0.373). Use frequency produced the largest group differences of any variable examined, though adjusted predictors explained only 2.7–7.9% of variance. Conclusion AI use is already near-universal here, so the question is not whether students use these tools but how. Reflective verification practices proved largely independent of the risk dimensions, indicating that susceptibility is not simply a function of use intensity: interventions should target how students interrogate AI output, not how often they consult it. The item pool remains promising but unstable, requiring revision and independent confirmation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在加纳高校学生中开发并初步检验“学生人工智能易感性（SAI）”题项池，通过横断面问卷调查，考察生成式AI使用中的过度依赖、误用及反思性防护等风险维度。因子分析支持过度依赖、认知脆弱性与韧性反思三个内部一致性可接受的维度，而误用/学术诚信维度信度不足，总体合成分未获支持；使用频率带来的组间差异最大，但校正后预测变量解释的方差很有限。作者据此指出，当地AI使用已近普遍，关键不在使用频率，而在于学生如何核查AI输出，反思性验证实践与风险维度基本独立，因此干预应针对质疑与验证AI结果的方式；题项池仍有潜力但不稳定，需修订和独立验证。

papers.title: Application of dynamic symbolic execution and test coverage enhancement combined with artificial intelligence in large-scale web software systems
papers.authors: Ran Li
papers.abstract: Aiming at the bottleneck problems of path explosion and low efficiency of constraint solving faced by dynamic symbolic execution (DSE) in large-scale Web software systems, this paper applies a DSE and test coverage enhancement method combined with artificial intelligence (AI). Firstly, an Actor-Critic dual network model is constructed based on the PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) algorithm. The Actor network outputs the probability distribution of path selection, and the Critic network evaluates the value of path state. Secondly, the path priority sorting strategy is updated through the generalized advantage estimation and pruning mechanism, and the path depth threshold is gradually increased by combining curriculum learning. The key branch priority solving strategy is applied to optimize the efficiency of constraint solving. Finally, after each round of symbolic execution, the coverage increment is used as a reward signal to update the model parameters online and dynamically optimize the path exploration strategy. Experimental results show that this method significantly improves the efficiency of path exploration (the number of paths reaches 225 and 216, respectively) and test coverage (74.9% and 73.4%) on large-scale Web systems, with an average solution success rate of 79.8% and an average vulnerability detection rate of 88%. It has good vulnerability detection capabilities and resource adaptability, and provides an efficient and scalable new paradigm for automated testing of complex systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大规模Web软件系统中动态符号执行面临的路径爆炸与约束求解效率低的问题，提出一种结合人工智能的符号执行与测试覆盖增强方法，核心是构建基于PPO算法的Actor-Critic双网络模型，并配合路径优先级排序、课程学习与关键分支优先求解策略。实验结果显示，该方法在路径探索效率与测试覆盖率上均有明显提升，平均求解成功率与漏洞检测率也达到较高水平，表现出较好的漏洞检测能力与资源适应性。文章据此认为，该方案为复杂系统的自动化测试提供了一种高效且可扩展的新思路，但结论主要基于所报告的实验结果，其适用范围仍需结合具体系统条件看待。

papers.title: Research on student academic-psychological joint early warning model under multi-task deep learning framework
papers.authors: Chengli Song
papers.abstract: Early identification of students at risk is critical for modern educational management. However, existing systems often treat academic performance and psychological well-being as independent domains, neglecting their complex interdependencies and shared behavioral markers. This paper proposes a novel multi-task learning (MTL) framework designed for joint academic and psychological early warning. By integrating multi-source heterogeneous data—ranging from temporal behavioral logs, such as attendance and campus consumption, to unstructured counseling records processed via BERT-based semantic embeddings—the framework captures a holistic view of student dynamics. To address the "seesaw effect" inherent in MTL, we employ a Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) architecture that effectively decouples task-specific features while maintaining a shared knowledge base. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive gradient normalization (GradNorm) mechanism to dynamically balance the loss weights between the academic GPA regression task and the psychological crisis classification task. This prevents gradient dominance from denser data sources and ensures stable convergence across disparate objectives. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves significant performance gains, particularly in the recall of psychological crisis detection, outperforming several state-of-the-art baselines. The proposed framework advances artificial intelligence in education by integrating multimodal student data with multi-task deep learning for joint academic prediction and psychological-risk early warning. Its interpretable and fairness-aware design demonstrates practical AI applications supporting timely, data-driven educational decision-making. The framework is deployed through a real-time inference pipeline powered by Apache Flink to ensure campus-wide scalability and low-latency response. Finally, the integration of SHAP values enhances model transparency, providing educators with actionable insights and interpretable evidence for targeted interventions. This research offers a robust, scalable, and interpretable solution for proactive student support in large-scale academic environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对学业表现与心理状况常被分开建模、忽视二者关联的问题，提出一个多任务深度学习框架，用多源异构数据（行为日志与咨询记录文本）对学生进行学业与心理的联合预警。作者采用多门混合专家架构解耦任务特征，并用自适应梯度归一化平衡学业回归与心理危机分类的损失，实验显示该方法在心理危机识别的召回率上优于多个基线。文章据此讨论了该框架在可解释性与公平性设计上的考虑，以及通过实时推理流程支持校园规模部署的潜力，为数据驱动的学生支持提供参考。

papers.title: Predicting English learning performance in vocational colleges using explainable large language models
papers.authors: Lili Ju
papers.abstract: English proficiency prediction is an important task in vocational education because it is helpful in support teaching evaluation, personalized learning and early academic intervention. Traditional methods for predicting student performance mainly use structured educational properties such as test scores, classroom participation and attendance records. Although these methods can achieve certain prediction results, they often pay no attention to the semantic relationships contained in the students’ overall learning portfolios and have limited interpretability. To address this problem, this study proposes an interpretable large language model-based framework to predict English proficiency. Firstly, student learning records are transformed into natural language prompts, and semantic embeddings are learned using large language models. At the same time, structured educational features are standardized and encoded to build a structured representation. Then, a gated multimodal fusion module is designed to adaptively fuse semantic information and structured information. Finally, residual attention multi-layer perceptrons are used to classify the fused features to predict the students’ English proficiency. The experiment was carried out on a dataset of 200 student records from a vocational college for English learning. The results showed that the proposed model achieved an accuracy rate of 92.5% and a weighted F1 score of 91.3%, which is better than several traditional machine learning baseline models. Further analysis showed that the gated fusion mechanism could integrate semantic information and structured information. Feature importance analysis and case studies also shown that the proposed framework could provide interpretable prediction results and personalized learning recommendations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对职业院校英语能力预测中传统方法忽视学习档案语义信息、可解释性有限的问题，提出一种基于大语言模型的可解释预测框架。作者将学生学习记录转为自然语言提示并用大语言模型学习语义嵌入，同时编码结构化教育特征，再通过门控多模态融合模块自适应整合两类信息，最后用残差注意力多层感知机分类预测英语水平。在职业院校学生记录数据集上的实验显示，该模型预测表现优于若干传统机器学习基线，门控融合机制能够整合语义与结构化信息，特征重要性分析和案例研究也表明框架可提供可解释的预测结果与个性化学习建议。

papers.title: Decolonising Generative AI in South African Teacher Education: Wayfinding for Multilingual, Indigenous, and Publicly Accountable Futures
papers.authors: Benjamin Seleke
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Educational Studies
papers.abstract: Abstract This viewpoint article argues that South African teacher education requires a distinctly decolonial agenda for generative artificial intelligence (AI), developed in critical dialogue with scholarship from Aotearoa New Zealand and wider international contexts. AI is not a neutral efficiency tool: its infrastructures, training data, evaluation standards, and platform logics can intensify linguistic hierarchy, data extraction, epistemic marginalisation, and pedagogical standardisation. Drawing on epistemic justice, decoloniality, settler-colonial analysis, and wayfinding, the article synthesises policy and scholarship to develop a framework for multilingual, Indigenous, and publicly accountable AI in teacher education. The comparison is deliberately relational rather than transfer-oriented. South Africa and Aotearoa have distinct colonial histories, constitutional arrangements, and Indigenous political formations; nevertheless, Te Tiriti o Waitangi-informed educational thinking, Māori data and algorithmic sovereignty, and Pacific-led teacher education provide productive tests of whether AI governance redistributes authority or merely adds cultural content to externally controlled systems. The article advances six interdependent propositions: language justice by design; Indigenous Knowledge Systems stewardship; critical AI literacy for teacher agency; assessment redesign around process and judgment; public-interest data governance; and infrastructure-aware inclusion. Decolonising AI, it concludes, is not metaphorical branding or the insertion of local examples into imported systems. It requires material changes to curriculum purposes, decision rights, data relations, evaluation criteria, and institutional accountability so that AI strengthens multilingual participation, community authority, teacher judgment, and public benefit.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇观点文章，主张南非教师教育需要一套去殖民化的生成式人工智能议程，并与新西兰及更广国际背景下的研究展开批判性对话。文章综合政策与学术文献，提出语言正义、原住民知识体系守护、教师能动性的批判性AI素养、围绕过程与判断的评估重构、公共利益数据治理以及基础设施敏感的包容等六项相互关联的主张。其核心论点是，去殖民化AI并非隐喻式标签或向外部系统插入本地案例，而需要对课程目的、决策权、数据关系、评价标准和机构问责制作实质性改变，从而使AI强化多语言参与、社区权威、教师判断与公共利益。

papers.title: Perceived Discrimination, Preparation for Bias, and Associations with Physical and Mental Health of Racially/Ethnically Marginalized Children
papers.authors: Kamar S. Abdullahi, Angela R. Fertig, Jerica M. Berge, Alicia Kunin‐Batson
papers.journal: Journal of Racial and Ethnic Health Disparities
papers.abstract: Abstract Prior studies suggest that perceived discrimination and preparation for bias are associated with children’s mental health, yet few studies have examined relationships with children’s physical health. The current study expands on prior literature by examining associations between perceived discrimination and preparation for bias parenting practices on the physical and mental health of racially/ethnically marginalized children. Children ( n = 227, ages 7–13 years, 58% female; 28% Non-Hispanic Black, 26% Hispanic, 15% Hmong, 15% Native American, 10% multiracial/ethnic with White and 6% multiracial/ethnic without White) completed an in-clinic assessment of cardiometabolic health and self-reported perceived discrimination. Parents completed survey measures of their child’s mental health (self-efficacy, inhibitory control, depression) and their use of preparation for bias parenting practices. Physical health measures (BMI, waist circumference, blood pressure, pulse rate, hair cortisol) were taken at a lab visit. In adjusted regression analyses, children who self-reported any experiences of perceived discrimination had significantly lower levels of self-efficacy ( p < 0.05) and inhibitory control ( p < 0.05) than those who did not report experiences of discrimination. Preparation for bias parenting practices differed significantly by race/ethnicity and higher levels were associated with higher hair cortisol concentrations in children, reflecting elevated activity of the hypothalamic-pituitary adrenal (HPA) axis ( p < 0.05). There were otherwise no statistically significant differences in children’s mental or physical health outcomes as a function of perceived discrimination or preparation for bias parenting practices. Our findings highlight the potential importance of interventions that reduce interpersonal discrimination and the need for further research on parenting practices that may influence children’s health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了种族/族裔边缘化儿童中感知歧视与父母偏见准备教养实践同身心健康指标的关联，儿童完成临床心血管代谢评估并自报歧视经历，父母报告儿童心理健康及自身教养实践。调整回归分析显示，自报任何歧视经历的儿童自我效能感和抑制控制显著更低；偏见准备水平因种族/族裔而异，且较高水平与儿童头发皮质醇浓度升高相关，提示HPA轴活动增强。除此之外，感知歧视和偏见准备与其余心理及身体健康结果无显著差异。作者据此强调减少人际歧视干预的潜在重要性，并呼吁进一步研究可能影响儿童健康的教养实践。

papers.title: The rebirth of the author: writing critical social theory in the time of generative AI
papers.authors: Isabelle Higgins, Shannon Philip, Ella McPherson, Patrick Baert
papers.abstract: Abstract Sociologists face the pressing question of how large language model-based technologies can contribute to social theorising. Several social scientists have called for a greater integration of generative AI tools in the social sciences and humanities to speed and scale up the production of social theory. In this article, we adopt a more cautious approach, reflecting on how the adoption of generative AI raises foundational questions about the construction, refinement and evaluation of critical social theory. To make this argument, we create and critically analyse a speculative piece of dystopian sociological fiction. This enables us to explore the values and practices of critical social theory authorship. We argue that authorship must be ‘recentred’, particularly with regard to four key values of authorial practice: (1) standpoint, (2) creativity, (3) pluralism and (4) accountability. In the present moment, the use of generative AI as substitution for authorial practices redefines and potentially threatens authorship in ways that problematises its particular use in generating critical social theory. With regards to standpoint, generative AI technologies run the risk of reproducing an ‘abstract masculinity’ that feminist scholars have long written against. The relational wonder at the heart of social theory creativity is undermined by generative AI use, as is the pluralism of creativity. Generative AI also flattens and overlooks pluralism of voice, as well as dilutes authorial accountability. We sociologists need to defend and rearticulate what we contribute to social theory and its concomitant politics, both in the theories themselves and in the project of social theorising. It is with this in mind that we call for the ‘rebirth’ - that is, the recentralisation - of the human author in critical social theory creation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式AI能否以及如何参与社会理论生产这一问题，采取审慎立场，通过创作并批判分析一则推测性的反乌托邦社会学小说，探讨批判性社会理论作者身份的价值与实践。作者提出应将作者身份“重新中心化”，具体涉及立场、创造力、多元性和问责四个核心价值，并论证以生成式AI替代作者实践可能复制“抽象男性气质”、削弱社会理论创造中的关系性惊奇与创造力多元性、抹平声音多元性并稀释作者问责。文章据此呼吁在批判性社会理论创作中“重生”即重新中心化人类作者，以捍卫社会学对理论及其政治性的贡献。

papers.title: Building sustainable futures: Responsible development of AI-enabled open educational resources as digital public goods
papers.authors: Javiera Atenas, Robert Farrow, Nicholas H. M. Caldwell, Éamonn Costello, Leo Havemann
papers.abstract: Abstract This article explores the transformative potential of open educational resources (OER) as digital public goods (DPG) to foster the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence (AI). Guided by the United Nations’ Common Agenda, Global Digital Compact and agenda for open solutions, along with the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization’s Recommendation on OER, the ROAM-X framework and the FAIR principles for open science, this article promotes the importance of inclusivity, equity and global collaboration in tackling both local and global challenges. It also advocates for non-commercial, shared infrastructures that democratise knowledge and technology, ensuring they are secure, ethical and accessible to all communities. Current OER infrastructures and policy ecosystems remain fragmented and face significant challenges, as they are distributed across disconnected repositories and lack consistent metadata, limiting their reusability and accessibility. These barriers are exacerbated by inequities in internet access, and limited collaboration between institutions and nations, resulting in an uneven global OER landscape. To address these issues, the authors propose the creation of integrated and open platforms that position OER as global public goods, grounded in open principles and standards. This approach will foster resilient, collaborative, responsible and inclusive infrastructures that prioritise gender, linguistic and cultural diversity, and empower communities worldwide, thus democratising access to knowledge and enabling a more equitable technological future.
papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨如何以开放教育资源（OER）作为数字公共产品，推动人工智能负责任地开发与使用。作者指出，当前OER基础设施与政策生态分散在互不连通的存储库中，缺乏一致的元数据，加之互联网接入不均、机构与国家间协作有限，全球OER格局发展不均衡，可复用性和可及性受限。为此，文章提出建设一体化开放平台，以开放原则和标准为基础，将OER定位为全球公共产品，从而支持有韧性、协作、负责任且包容的基础设施，兼顾性别、语言与文化多样性。文章属于立场与政策倡导性论述，主要依据联合国相关议程、教科文组织建议书及ROAM-X、FAIR等框架展开，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: When disclosure rules are not enough: authorial warrant and judgment in ai-supported scholarship
papers.authors: Marcin Mirończuk
papers.abstract: Abstract Editorial policies increasingly require authors to disclose substantive uses of generative AI, but such requirements commonly focus on whether, where, and how a model was used. Even function-specific disclosure may locate a model in the research or writing process without showing how its outputs entered scholarly judgment, how they were evaluated, or whether contributors can reconstruct the relevant reasoning and defend resulting claims without treating those outputs as sufficient justification. Drawing on research ethics, AI disclosure policy, human–model interaction, and researcher formation, this article argues that disclosure documents model use, whereas responsible use requires claim-level authorial warrant: a contributor’s capacity to understand, justify, and defend claims within their contribution. The article distinguishes cognitive delegation, in which model outputs shape substantive choices, interpretations, or justifications, from routine delegation, which does not ordinarily bear on the substance of judgment. Its conceptual contribution is to link the epistemic role of outputs that shape judgment to the function-appropriate evaluation required to justify decisions and retain warrant for resulting claims. It then repurposes disclosure categories as a claim-sensitive ex ante heuristic, mapping six recurrent research functions to risks, forms of oversight, and formative questions for recognising cognitive delegation and selecting function-appropriate evaluation. The article contributes to the ethics of information technology by clarifying when AI-supported scholarship remains under responsible human judgment and when cognitive delegation threatens the epistemic basis of authorship.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式AI披露政策只说明模型是否、何处、如何被使用，却无法体现其输出如何进入学术判断这一问题，提出负责任使用需要“主张层面的作者授权”，即贡献者能够理解、证成并辩护自己贡献中的各项主张。作者区分了会实质影响选择、解释或论证的“认知委托”与通常不触及判断实质的“常规委托”，并将披露类别改造为一种对主张敏感的事前启发式，把六类常见研究功能对应到风险、监督方式和形成性问题，以帮助识别认知委托并选择与功能相匹配的评估。文章属于概念性论证，未开展实证研究，其贡献在于厘清AI辅助学术工作在何种条件下仍处于负责任的人类判断之下。

papers.title: Usage and Perceptions of Generative AI in Learning Among University Students in Bangladesh
papers.authors: K. M. Tahsin Kabir, Koushik Biswas Arko, Arizit Chaki Artha, Md. Fahim Kabir Chowdhury, Md. Mortuza Ahmmed, Md. Ashraful Babu, M. Mostafizur Rahman
papers.journal: Communications in computer and information science

papers.title: Generative AI in Second Language Video Composing: Investigating Students' Critical Digital Literacies and Multimodal Redesign
papers.authors: Jialei Jiang
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in digital multimodal composing (DMC) presents both opportunities and challenges for second language (L2) research and pedagogy. While GenAI tools provide linguistic and multimodal support, they also raise concerns about biased information, culturally generic outputs, and technological overreliance. This qualitative study investigates L2 students' enactment of critical digital literacies (CDL) during GenAI‐assisted video composing. Drawing on CDL as a theoretical orientation and the analytical heuristic of critical awareness, critical identities, critical relationships, and critical actions, the study examines how students negotiated and revised AI‐generated video representations. Using multimodal critical discourse analysis of screen recordings, final video artifacts, focus group interviews, and reflective essays from 20 L2 students, the findings reveal four interrelated forms of CDL enactment. Students demonstrated critical awareness of GenAI's culturally limited outputs, authored critical identities through multimodal redesign, negotiated critical relationships with peers and GenAI, and engaged in localized critical action against cultural erasure. However, students' varied responses also highlight the uneven opportunities for CDL enactment across student groups. These findings offer theoretical and pedagogical implications for supporting L2 learners' critical engagement with algorithmic assumptions, cultural biases, and multimodal representations in GenAI‐assisted DMC.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察二语学生在生成式人工智能辅助的视频多模态创作中如何实践批判性数字素养。作者对20名学生的屏幕录像、最终视频作品、焦点小组访谈和反思短文进行多模态批判话语分析，发现学生表现出四种相互关联的素养实践：察觉生成内容的文化局限、通过多模态重构塑造批判性身份、与同伴和AI协商关系，以及针对文化抹除采取本地化行动。研究同时指出，不同学生群体实践这些素养的机会并不均衡，并据此讨论如何支持学习者批判性地审视算法预设与文化偏见。

papers.title: Integrating AI Interactional Competence Into Models of Communicative Competence: Human–Machine Collaborative Communication
papers.authors: Rasoul Mohammad Hosseinpur
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The advent of sophisticated LLMs and their integration into daily communicative practices represents a significant contextual development for the field of TEFL and Applied Linguistics. As a conceptual contribution, this paper argues that existing models of communicative competence, most notably Canale and Swain's foundational framework, require expansion to adequately describe the realities of language use in AI‐saturated environments. When learners employ AI for translation, drafting, and polishing, their communicative competence is no longer a purely human‐to‐human construct but can become a collaborative human–AI endeavor. This paper proposes an additional and context‐dependent dimension that complements traditional models: AI Interactional Competence (AIIC), which denotes the competencies required for direct human–AI collaboration and co‐construction of meaning. The paper deconstructs AIIC into three constituents: Prompt Crafting Literacy, AI Output Evaluation Literacy, and Ethical and Strategic Mediation Literacy. Drawing on the historical evolution of communicative competence models, digital literacies, human‐computer interaction, critical pedagogy, and posthumanist applied linguistics, this article provides a theoretical update for reshaping pedagogy, assessment, and research in the age of AI. It is acknowledged that this model is provisional and supplementary competence relevant primarily in AI‐integrated educational and communicative contexts and requires empirical validation across diverse sociocultural and educational contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，针对大语言模型进入日常交际实践后，现有交际能力模型（尤其是Canale与Swain的经典框架）难以描述人机协作语言使用的问题，主张对模型加以扩展。作者提出一个情境依赖的补充维度“AI互动能力”，并将其拆解为提示设计素养、AI输出评估素养以及伦理与策略性中介素养三部分，用以刻画学习者借助AI翻译、起草和润色时所需的能力。文章据此讨论该框架对教学、评估与研究的理论启示，同时明确该模型是暂定且补充性的，主要适用于AI整合的教育与交际情境，尚需在不同社会文化与教育环境中接受实证检验。

papers.title: Explainable AI in Neural Poetry Generation: Beyond Attention
papers.authors: Abinet Bizuayehu Desta, Million Meshesha, Agegnehu Tesfa Tesema, Worku Abebe Degife, Moges Alebachew Mekonen
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is increasingly important for ensuring transparency and trust in neural systems; however, its applicability to creative text generation remains limited. Neural poetry generation models produce linguistically coherent and stylistically rich outputs, yet explaining decisions such as metaphor construction, emotional tone, and thematic development remains unresolved. This systematic literature review synthesizes 26 peer‐reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2026, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines and a predefined protocol across four major digital libraries. The analysis identifies a fundamental mismatch between existing XAI paradigms and the properties of generative modeling. We propose a taxonomy distinguishing classification‐native methods from generation‐compatible approaches, highlighting their differing assumptions. Based on established criteria of contrastivity, selectivity, and faithfulness, we show that attention mechanisms lack causal validity as explanatory tools. To consolidate these findings, we introduce a unified failure framework comprising five interacting structural limitations: token–semantic mismatch, attention non‐causality, classification–generation incompatibility, evaluation collapse, and human–model ontological misalignment. These limitations collectively constrain the effectiveness of current XAI methods in creative contexts. Our findings indicate that advancing explainability in neural poetry generation requires a shift toward semantic‐level representations, causal intervention‐based approaches, and human‐centered evaluation frameworks that incorporate aesthetic and interpretive dimensions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA 2020指南，系统梳理了2015至2026年间26项关于神经诗歌生成可解释性的同行评审研究，考察现有XAI范式能否解释隐喻构建、情感基调与主题发展等创作决策。分析发现，现有XAI范式与生成模型的性质存在根本错配：注意力机制缺乏因果效度，不能作为可靠解释工具。作者据此提出区分分类原生方法与生成兼容方法的分类体系，并归纳出五个相互作用的失败框架，包括词元与语义错配、注意力非因果性、分类与生成不兼容、评估失效及人机本体错位。文章认为，推进该领域的可解释性需转向语义层面表征、基于因果干预的方法以及纳入审美与解释维度的人本评估框架。

papers.title: How Large Language Models Weight Narrative Cues When Detecting Deception in Oral Accounts: A Multi‐Model Comparison
papers.authors: Meng‐Chen He, Wei Ji, Jing‐Xuan Ran, Jiaxin Cui, Wen‐Jing Yan, Jing Liang
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Lie detection research has increasingly turned to artificial intelligence, yet the application of large language models (LLMs) remains underexplored for transcribed oral narratives. We compared five LLMs (Gemini‐3‐flash, Gemini‐3‐pro, Deepseek‐v4‐flash, GPT‐5.6‐luna, and Grok‐4) in classifying truthful and deceptive statements from interview transcripts of oral travel narratives collected from 95 Chinese‐speaking participants. Guided by Criteria‐Based Content Analysis (CBCA), Reality Monitoring (RM), and the Verifiability Approach (VA), theory‐driven prompts instructed models to score five narrative cues before making binary veracity judgments. Gemini‐3‐flash achieved the highest accuracy (74.74%, AUC = 0.76) with 81.63% sensitivity and 67.39% specificity, and stable repeated‐run performance. For this optimal model, unusual/superfluous details served as the sole significant predictor of objective veracity even after controlling for text length. LLMs can detect deception above chance but show large performance heterogeneity. Independent human coding, cross‐cultural replications, and adversarial robustness testing are needed before real‐world deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较五种大语言模型在口头叙述转录文本中判别真实与欺骗陈述的表现，以95名中文使用者的旅行叙述访谈为材料，并依据基于标准的内容分析、现实监控和可验证性方法设计理论驱动的提示，让模型先对叙事线索评分再作真假判断。结果显示模型整体能高于随机水平识别欺骗，但不同模型差异明显，其中Gemini‐3‐flash准确率最高且重复运行较稳定；在该模型下，异常或多余细节是客观真实性唯一显著的预测因素，控制文本长度后依然成立。作者据此指出大语言模型用于测谎仍有明显局限，实际部署前需开展独立人工编码、跨文化重复验证和对抗稳健性测试。

papers.title: Prospects for the Digitalization of Administrative Court Proceedings
papers.authors: Sarvarbek Rakhmonov
papers.abstract: This article examines the theoretical foundations and practical prospects for digitalizing administrative court proceedings in the Republic of Uzbekistan within the framework of the “Digital Uzbekistan — 2030” strategy and the “SMART SUD” concept. Drawing on the concept of e-government, the study identifies transparency, accessibility, efficiency and security as the core principles on which a digital judicial system should rest. A comparative legal analysis of the experience of Estonia, Germany, the United States (PACER and CM/ECF) and China’s “smart courts” initiative highlights best practices in electronic case management, blockchain-based evidence storage and the use of artificial intelligence in the judiciary. The article reveals the main problems of current practice in Uzbekistan, including the predominance of paper-based case management, the absence of a unified digital platform for inter-agency data exchange and an insufficient level of digital literacy among judges and court staff. The advantages and risks of applying artificial intelligence and the “robot judge” in administrative proceedings are critically analysed, with particular attention to issues of responsibility, cybersecurity and public trust. Based on the analysis, the author proposes to develop a concept of digital justice that enshrines the principle of “digital inclusion” in the judicial reform concept and to create a unified digital platform for administrative courts. It is also recommended to install interactive information terminals in court buildings in order to make judicial protection more accessible to citizens.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以乌兹别克斯坦“数字乌兹别克斯坦—2030”战略和“SMART SUD”构想为背景，考察行政诉讼数字化的理论基础与现实前景。作者通过比较爱沙尼亚、德国、美国和中国智慧法院的实践，归纳出电子案件管理、区块链证据存储和司法人工智能应用等方面的经验，并指出乌兹别克斯坦当前仍以纸质案件管理为主、缺乏统一的跨机构数据交换平台、法官和法院人员数字素养不足。文章还批判性分析了人工智能与“机器人法官”在行政诉讼中的优势与风险，重点关注责任归属、网络安全和公众信任问题，并据此建议在司法改革中确立“数字包容”原则、建设统一的行政法院数字平台，以及在法院场所设置交互式信息终端。

papers.title: LEGAL APPRAISAL OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN JUDICIAL DECISIONMAKING: BALANCING INNOVATION AND THE RULE OF LAW IN NIGERIA
papers.authors: Itiekemieba B. Fyneface, Dr. Aladokiye E. Gabriel-Whyte
papers.journal: Journal of Jurisprudence, International Law and Contemporary Legal Issues
papers.abstract: Decision-making is the core function of the judiciary in the Nigerian legal system, and it must be grounded in law, evidence and the principles of fair hearing. The growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in Nigerian courts, including AI-assisted legal research platforms, case management systems and judgment drafting tools, is reshaping how that function is performed. This paper examined the legal implications of AI deployment in judicial decision-making in Nigeria. Its aim is to determine whether the existing legal framework is adequate to govern AI use in adjudication and to identify the reforms needed to align AI adoption with constitutional requirements. The paper adopted a doctrinal methodology, analysing the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 (as amended), the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, the Cybercrimes Act 2015 (as amended) and relevant judicial decisions, supplemented by comparative analysis of regulatory models in the United Kingdom and Canada. The paper found that the current framework is inadequate. AI tools in Nigerian courts operate without mandatory disclosure obligations, audit requirements or vendor accountability mechanisms, creating serious risks to fair hearing, judicial independence and the integrity of the court record. The paper therefore concluded that an Artificial Intelligence and Judicial Integrity Bill is necessary and made recommendations to the National Assembly, the National Judicial Council and relevant regulatory agencies to give effect to that submission.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以尼日利亚司法决策中的人工智能应用为对象，采用法理分析方法，考察宪法、数据保护法、网络犯罪法及相关判例，并比较英国与加拿大的监管模式，追问现有法律框架是否足以规范AI辅助审判。文章发现现行框架不足：法院使用AI工具缺乏强制披露、审计要求和供应商问责机制，对公平听审、司法独立和法庭记录完整性构成风险。作者据此主张制定《人工智能与司法诚信法案》，并向国民议会、国家司法委员会及监管机构提出相应建议。

papers.title: DEEPFAKES AND CRIMINAL LIABILITY IN NIGERIA: EMERGING CHALLENGES FOR THE CRIMINAL JUSTICE SYSTEM
papers.authors: Florence Anelechi Ph. D CHINDA, Tombari, PhD, Alawa Stephen
papers.journal: Journal of Jurisprudence, International Law and Contemporary Legal Issues
papers.abstract: Deepfake technology has transformed the production and circulation of audio-visual material by enabling artificial intelligence systems to create highly realistic synthetic representations of persons, voices, events and statements. Although the technology has legitimate applications in entertainment, education, accessibility and creative production, its malicious deployment presents serious challenges for criminal law and the administration of criminal justice. Deepfakes can facilitate impersonation, fraud, extortion, identity theft, non-consensual sexual imagery, reputational attacks, election manipulation, cyberbullying and the fabrication or alteration of digital evidence. Nigeria presently has no specific legal framework on deepfake creation or distribution. Nevertheless, conduct involving malicious deepfakes may fall within existing offences under the Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) Act 2015 (as amended in 2024), the Criminal Code Act, the Penal Code, the Administration of Criminal Justice Act 2015, the Evidence Act 2011 (as amended in 2023), the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 and other relevant laws. This article examined the extent to which those provisions can respond to deepfake-enabled criminality. It suggested that the present framework is fragmented and often dependent upon the purpose, manner and consequences of the deepfake rather than the synthetic manipulation itself. The article also examined attribution, mens rea, jurisdiction, authentication, evidential reliability and the difficulties created by anonymous and cross-border perpetrators. Drawing from comparative approaches in the United Kingdom and Kenya, the article proposed a Nigerian Deepfake and Synthetic Media framework as well as institutional checks, while ensuring safeguards for journalism, sattire, research and artistic expressions.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察尼日利亚现行法律框架能否应对深度伪造技术带来的刑事风险。作者梳理相关制定法后指出，现有规范较为分散，多依赖深度伪造的用途、方式与后果而非合成操纵本身，并在归因、犯意、管辖、证据认证与可靠性等方面存在困难，匿名与跨境实施者更增加追责难度。文章借鉴英国与肯尼亚的做法，建议建立尼日利亚深度伪造与合成媒体专门框架及机构性制衡，同时为新闻、讽刺、研究和艺术表达保留保障。

papers.title: Influence of Formative Assessment Guidelines on Students’ Academic Achievement: Evidence from Public Secondary Schools in Kigoma Municipality, Tanzania
papers.authors: Barakuba N.M Dobeye, Eugenia Lucas Wandela, Daniel J. Mkude
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Education and Social Studies
papers.abstract: Formative assessment is widely regarded as a cornerstone of students’ academic achievement, but its implementation at the classroom level is jeopardised by inconsistent guidelines. This study examined the influence of formative assessment guidelines on students’ academic achievement in public secondary schools in Kigoma Municipality, Tanzania. The study employed a convergent research design under a mixed-methods approach to collect data from 169 respondents. A total of 156 students were selected using simple random sampling, six teachers experienced in using formative assessments, six academic masters/mistresses, and one education officer. Data were collected using questionnaires for students and interviews for educators. The quantitative data were analysed using descriptive statistics (frequencies, percentages, and means) using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 20 with a tested reliability coefficient of 0.713, while qualitative data were analysed using a deductive content analysis approach. The findings indicate that students valued weekly tests and clear teacher instructions as motivating and fair mechanisms that enhanced students’ academic achievement. Teachers also reported that classroom assessment guidelines are useful, but the guidelines lack competence-based clarity. Further, students prioritise formative assessments over national examinations, while socioeconomic limitations undermine the effectiveness of take-home assignments. The study concludes that the use of formative assessment guidelines improves academic achievement, but challenges in teacher preparation and policy-practice alignment persist. The use of technology in formative assessment is limited by infrastructure and connectivity; additionally, the study concludes that increased use of artificial intelligence and the internet is not a feasible option for public secondary schools in Kigoma Municipality. Therefore, policymakers should emphasise capacity-building initiatives for teachers and administrators in competence-based curriculum assessment methods. The shift from traditional teaching and learning approaches to competence-based models is often hindered by resource constraints or shortages. Emphasis on critical thinking should begin at the classroom level and support students’ academic achievement rather than merely high grades in final assessments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察坦桑尼亚基戈马市公立中学形成性评价指南对学生学业成绩的影响，采用混合方法汇聚设计，通过学生问卷和教育者访谈收集数据。研究发现，学生认为周测和教师明确指导具有激励和公平作用，有助于提升学业成绩；教师认可课堂评价指南的用处，但指出其缺乏能力本位清晰度。学生更重视形成性评价而非国家考试，社会经济限制削弱了家庭作业效果，技术与人工智能应用受基础设施和网络条件制约。研究据此认为形成性评价指南能改善学业成绩，但教师准备和政策与实践衔接仍存挑战，建议加强教师和管理者能力建设。

papers.title: Alfabetización mediática e informacional en la Universidad de Valladolid
papers.authors: Pablo Berdón Prieto, Itziar Reguero Sanz, Ruth Pinedo González, Susana Álvarez Álvarez
papers.abstract: This study assesses the level of Media and Information Literacy (MIL) across the main groups within the university community —students, Teaching and Research Staff (TRS), and Technical, Management, and Administrative Staff (TMAS)—and identifies patterns and strategic areas for improvement in the context of contemporary informational challenges. A quantitative, cross-sectional design was adopted, based on the administration of three structured questionnaires tailored to each group and aligned with the UNESCO conceptual framework for Media and Information Literacy. The study sample comprised 1,915 participants (1,181 students, 415 TRS, and 319 TMAS), with a confidence level of 95%. The instrument design incorporated specific strategies to minimize social desirability bias, supported by the use of artificial intelligence during the validation and refinement of the questionnaire items. The findings indicate a medium–high level of MIL across the university community, with statistically significant differences between groups. Teaching and Research Staff achieved the highest scores, followed by students, while Technical, Management, and Administrative Staff obtained the lowest scores. The dimensional analysis reveals clear strengths in critical evaluation and ethical use of information, alongside structural weaknesses in access to information. Prior training in MIL emerges as the most consistent explanatory factor across all groups. Media and Information Literacy is configured as a multidimensional competence that is unevenly distributed within the university. The results highlight the need to explicitly incorporate MIL into lifelong learning strategies, with differentiated interventions tailored to the specific characteristics of each group.

papers.title: USING GENERATIVE AI TO CREATE LANGUAGE GAMES IN THE ENGLISH CLASSROOM
papers.authors: Shirinmoh Abdullayeva
papers.abstract: The paper examines how generative AI tools such as ChatGPT can be used to create language games for English lessons. It describes the main types of AI-generated games (interactive stories, vocabulary riddles, quizzes and role-plays), shows how they are produced with simple prompts, and discusses their effect on learner motivation and teacher workload. Generative AI is presented not as a replacement for the teacher but as a creative assistant that makes gamified lessons quick to prepare and easy to personalise.
papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨如何利用ChatGPT等生成式AI工具为英语课堂创编语言游戏，属于实践性论述而非实证研究。文章描述了AI生成的互动故事、词汇谜语、测验和角色扮演等主要游戏类型，说明可通过简单提示词制作，并讨论了这些游戏对学习者动机和教师工作量的影响。作者将生成式AI定位为教师的创意助手而非替代者，认为它能使游戏化课程备课快捷且易于个性化，但未报告具体效果数据。

papers.title: SUN’IY INTELLEKT VOSITALARI DAVRIDA TALABANING AKADEMIK HALOLLIGI: PEDAGOGIK JAVOB CHORALARI
papers.authors: Dilafro'z Samatova
papers.abstract: Purpose – to substantiate, on the basis of international experience, the pedagogical mechanisms for safeguarding academic integrity under generative artificial intelligence and to adapt them to higher education in Uzbekistan. Methods: a systematic review of 2023–2026 studies indexed in Scopus and Web of Science and of policy documents issued by international organisations; existing responses were compared by point of impact and implementation cost; modelling was then applied. Results: the limits of the detection-and-sanction approach are demonstrated – AI-text detectors show high error rates and a systematic bias against non-native English writers. A three-level model of pedagogical responses is proposed – institutional, course and task level – together with a five-step scale of permitted AI use and a set of cheating-resistant task types. Conclusion: the most effective and least costly measure is assessment redesign combined with transparent declaration of AI use; a detector result cannot serve as evidence in a disciplinary decision.
papers.summary_zh: 该文基于国际经验，系统梳理了生成式人工智能背景下保障学术诚信的教学机制，并尝试将其适配到乌兹别克斯坦高等教育。作者通过系统综述与政策文件比较及建模，指出以检测和处罚为主的路径存在明显局限：AI文本检测工具错误率高，且对非英语母语写作者存在系统性偏差。文章据此提出机构、课程与任务三个层面的教学回应模型，以及允许使用AI的五级量表和一组合规且抗作弊的任务类型。结论认为，重新设计评估并透明声明AI使用是成本较低且更有效的措施，检测结果不能作为纪律处分的证据。

papers.title: ARIFICIAL INTELLEGENCE AND ENGLISH READING MOTIVATION INFLUENCING COMMUNICATION SKILLS AMONG PAKISTANI UNDERGRADUATE COLLEGE STUDENTS
papers.authors: Tahir Jahan Khan, Nabeeha Anees, Zain Ul Hassan Anjum
papers.journal: Insights (Bhalwal) International Journal of Humanities Management and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: The fast incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) into higher education has changed how university students’ access, evaluate, produce, and communicate scientific information. At the same time, English reading motivation remains significant for Pakistani college undergraduate students because English is extensively used in academic, educational, lingua franca and scientific contexts. English language is also enjoying prestigious status in Pakistan. This study examines AI literacy and English reading motivation as predictors of science communication skills among Pakistani students. AI literacy is theorized as students’ ability to understand, use, evaluate, and ethically engage with AI technologies, while English reading motivation refers to students’ interest in reading for educational, academic and other purposes. Science communication skills include the skill to explain scientific concepts accurately, clearly, ethically, and appropriately to in this context with multi socio-economic and culture backgrounds of Pakistan. Existing literature suggests that AI literacy involves more than technological usage and includes critical evaluation and ethical awareness. Likewise, research on English-medium instruction indicates that language competence can influence students’ participation and learning experiences. This study has used a quantitative, correlational-predictive design involving collegiate students from Pakistani higher education institutions. Data have been collected from N=250 college students through standardized questionnaires and a science communication performance task. Descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, and multiple regression analysis have been completed. The study shows that there are evidences for assimilating AI literacy, English proficiency, and science communication into college programs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察巴基斯坦本科生的AI素养与英语阅读动机能否预测其科学传播能力，采用定量相关-预测设计，通过标准化问卷和科学传播表现任务收集数据，并做描述统计、相关与多元回归分析。结果显示，AI素养和英语阅读动机与科学传播技能存在预测关系，作者据此认为有证据支持将AI素养、英语水平与科学传播训练整合进大学课程。需要说明的是，摘要未报告具体效应大小与显著性，结论应理解为预测性关联而非因果效果。

papers.title: Manajemen Kesehatan Masyarakat pada Penanganan Kusta Multibasiler dengan Komorbid Stroke dan Risiko Paparan Tuberkulosis Kontak Serumah di Pedesaan Aceh Utara
papers.authors: Osama Al-Farauq, Cut Khairunnisa
papers.abstract: Kusta multibasiler (MB) merupakan penyakit infeksi kronis yang penanganannya tidak hanya bertumpu pada terapi medis, tetapi juga penyelesaian tantangan determinan sosial, status gizi, keterbatasan fisik, dan stigma masyarakat. Laporan kasus ini bertujuan menganalisis manajemen penanganan kusta MB berbasis pendekatan kedokteran keluarga dan kesehatan masyarakat pada seorang pasien perempuan berusia 38 tahun di Gampong Awe, Kecamatan Kuta Makmur, Aceh Utara. Pasien mengeluhkan bercak mati rasa yang meluas sejak 3 tahun lalu dan saat ini sedang menjalani terapi Multidrug Therapy (MDT) bulan ke-3. Pasien memiliki komorbid stroke non-hemoragik 10 tahun lalu yang menyisakan kelemahan ekstremitas kiri, serta mengalami gizi buruk (underweight, IMT 15,1 kg/m²). Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui home visit, wawancara, pemeriksaan fisik, serta analisis faktor lingkungan dan perilaku keluarga. Hasil evaluasi menggunakan diagram fishbone mengidentifikasi 6 masalah utama: kepatuhan MDT, status gizi buruk, risiko penularan kontak serumah, stigma sosial, dampak stroke pasca-akut, dan ketergantungan ekonomi. Intervensi komprehensif dilakukan secara terintegrasi mencakup promotif, preventif (pemeriksaan kontak serumah dan perawatan kulit mandiri), kuratif (MDT-MB), dan rehabilitatif. Keberhasilan eliminasi kusta membutuhkan kolaborasi lintas sektor dan pemberdayaan keluarga guna memutus rantai penularan serta meningkatkan kualitas hidup penderita.Kata kunci: Kusta Multibasiler, Kesehatan Masyarakat, Kedokteran Keluarga, Stigma, Aceh Utara.AbstractMultibacillary (MB) leprosy is a chronic infectious disease whose management relies not only on medical therapy but also on addressing social determinants, nutritional status, physical limitations, and social stigma. This case report aims to analyze the management of MB leprosy using a family medicine and public health approach in a 38-year-old female patient in Gampong Awe, Kuta Makmur District, North Aceh. The patient reported spreading numb patches over the past 3 years and is currently undergoing month 3 of Multidrug Therapy (MDT). She presents with a comorbid history of non-hemorrhagic stroke 10 years ago resulting in left-sided weakness, alongside severe malnutrition (underweight, BMI 15.1 kg/m²). Data were collected via home visits, interviews, physical examinations, and environmental/behavioral assessments. Fishbone analysis identified six key problems: MDT adherence, malnutrition, contact transmission risk, social stigma, post-stroke motor impairment, and economic dependency. Comprehensive interventions were implemented across health promotion, prevention (contact screening and skin care), curative treatment (MDT-MB), and rehabilitation. Successful leprosy elimination requires cross-sectoral collaboration and family empowerment to interrupt transmission chains and improve quality of life.Keywords: Multibacillary Leprosy, Public Health, Family Medicine, Stigma, North Aceh.
papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告以家庭医学与公共卫生相结合的视角，分析亚齐北部农村一名同时患有多种基础疾病的女性多菌型麻风患者的管理。作者通过家访、访谈、体格检查及环境行为评估收集资料，并用鱼骨图归纳出服药依从性、营养不良、家庭接触传播风险、社会污名、卒中后遗症和经济依赖等问题。干预覆盖健康促进、预防、治疗与康复多个层面，报告据此强调跨部门协作与家庭赋权对阻断传播和改善患者生活质量的重要性；作为单例报告，其结论属于经验性描述，未提供干预效果的因果证据。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Integration and Its Effectiveness on Higher Vocational Education Management and School–Enterprise Talent Training
papers.authors: Jianfeng Zhang
papers.journal: QualiSearch Journal of Educational Research and Practice
papers.abstract: This study examined artificial intelligence (AI) integration, management effectiveness, and school–enterprise collaborative talent training at Guangzhou Huali Vocational College of Science and Technology, China. A descriptive-correlational quantitative design involved 159 students and 101 teachers during the second semester of academic year 2025–2026. Students were included through total enumeration and teachers through purposive sampling. A researcher-developed questionnaire was validated by five experts and pilot-tested with 30 individuals; Cronbach’s alpha was 0.96.
