Analysis used frequencies, percentages, weighted means, t tests, one-way analysis of variance, and Pearson correlations. Both groups rated AI integration as high, management effectiveness to a high extent, and training success to a high degree. Students’ assessments differed significantly by enterprise exposure across all three constructs; teachers’ AI integration assessments differed by position. AI integration correlated positively with management effectiveness for students (r = 0.8839) and teachers (r = 0.9225). Management effectiveness correlated positively with training success for students (r = 0.9399) and teachers (r = 0.9586). The findings support coordinated curriculum, assessment, supervision, faculty development, and workplace learning. A Comprehensive AI Integration Framework was proposed to strengthen institutional practices and collaborative training. The relationships indicate association rather than causation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以广州华立科技职业学院的学生和教师为对象，采用描述性相关量化设计，考察人工智能整合、管理效能与校企协同人才培养之间的关系。结果显示，两组对AI整合程度、管理效能和培养成效的评价均较高；学生的评价在企业实践经历上存在显著差异，教师的AI整合评价因职位不同而不同。AI整合与管理效能、管理效能与培养成效之间均呈正相关，但作者明确指出这些关系只是关联而非因果。研究据此提出一个综合AI整合框架，建议在课程、评估、督导、师资发展和职场学习等方面加强协同。

papers.title: Negotiating English Language Teaching in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: A Constructivist Grounded Theory of Secondary School Teachers’ Pedagogical Adaptation in Philippine Public Schools
papers.authors: Clarice Daryll Silang
papers.journal: QualiSearch Journal of Educational Research and Practice
papers.abstract: This qualitative study examined how secondary school English teachers in Philippine public schools negotiate and reconstruct pedagogy in response to artificial intelligence (AI). Using Constructivist Grounded Theory, the study drew on intensive semi-structured interviews with seven English teachers from selected public secondary schools under the Schools Division Office of Batangas City. Initial and focused coding, constant comparison, memo writing, and theoretical integration generated seven interrelated categories: continually recalibrating pedagogical practice; protecting the learning work from technological substitution; reconstructing assessment to make learning and authorship visible; negotiating ethical boundaries through contextual professional judgment; building adaptive capacity through collegial and institutional support; cultivating critical AI literacy while preserving human voice and communication; and mediating AI access to preserve equity and inclusive participation. Findings indicate that responsible adaptation involves recursive, context-sensitive professional judgment. Teachers evaluated whether AI supported intended competencies, preserved valid assessment and authorship, maintained ethical safeguards, and enabled equitable participation. The categories informed the emergent AI-Responsive English Pedagogy Framework. The study concludes that responsible integration requires bounded technological augmentation, professional learning, flexible institutional guidance, assessment redesign, and protection of authentic language learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察菲律宾公立中学英语教师如何应对人工智能并重构教学实践，采用建构主义扎根理论，对七名教师进行深度半结构化访谈。分析生成七个相互关联的类别，涵盖持续调整教学、保护学习免受技术替代、重构评估以显现学习与作者身份、依据情境作伦理判断、借助同事与制度支持建设适应能力、培养批判性AI素养并维护人的声音，以及调节AI可及性以保障公平参与。研究发现，负责任的适应是递归且情境敏感的专业判断：教师会评估AI是否支持目标能力、是否维护评估效度与作者身份、是否守住伦理边界并促进公平参与。这些类别构成AI回应性英语教学框架，作者据此提出有限度的技术增强、专业学习、灵活制度指引、评估重构与保护真实语言学习等条件。

papers.title: FinAI: Bridging the Gap Between Financial Awareness and Practical Budgeting Through Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Nikhil V Jain, Romil N Shah, Pratiek Vyas, Sara Mishra, Nandini Mittal, Neha Singh
papers.journal: DMPedia Lecture Notes in Computer Science & Engineering
papers.abstract: Let’s be honest: being a college student usually means dealing with some pretty messy money situations. We’re all trying to watch our spending and stick to a budget, but those last-minute splurges always seem to find us. This paper dives into those everyday struggles and suggests FinAI as a simple solution. The idea is to use AI and machine learning to automatically log expenses and give us financial tips that actually make sense for our lives. Basically, if we pair basic money smarts with this kind of tech, we can stop stressing about our bank accounts and start making choices that set us up for the future.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对大学生日常消费难以跟踪、预算常被临时冲动打乱的问题，提出FinAI这一借助人工智能与机器学习自动记录支出并给出贴合个人生活的理财建议的方案。作者的核心主张是，将基本理财意识与这类技术结合，可减少学生对账户状况的焦虑，并帮助其做出更有利于长远的选择。文章属于系统构想型论述，摘要未报告实际实现细节或用户测试结果，因此其效果仍属待验证的设想。

papers.title: Comparative Performance Evaluation of Generative AI-Assisted Acoustic Tiles from Recycled Educational Waste
papers.authors: Nada Ahmed Talaat, Ahmed Mahmoud Elfakarany, Nihal Atif Salim
papers.abstract: Noise pollution is increasingly recognized as a critical environmental challenge with direct implications on public health and well-being. In Egypt, data from the Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA, 2019) identify noise as the second most reported environmental concern, affecting both indoor and outdoor spaces. At the same time, the growing volume of waste generated on university campuses represents an underexploited resource for sustainable design. This study addresses these challenges by investigating how generative AI can serve as a design collaborator in suggesting high-performance acoustic tiles from recycled campus waste. Two AI-driven prototypes were developed through prompts emphasizing acoustic absorption, aesthetic versatility, environmental impact, and ease of installation. Each design was standardized in thickness and fabricated using discarded materials such as foam, egg cartons, cardboard, and cotton. The prototypes were then physically tested within a controlled micro-environment to evaluate their acoustic performance. Results show that both designs significantly reduced sound reverberation, with Prototype B achieving better performance—cutting reverberation time by 57.7%. Beyond performance, both prototypes demonstrated low embodied energy and high adaptability, though material sourcing posed practical challenges. By combining generative AI with recycled resources, this research presents a scalable approach to tackling noise pollution while advancing circular economy practices. This approach underscores the role of AI as a conceptual co-design partner in sustainable material exploration, while simultaneously serving as a catalyst for eco-driven innovation within educational settings. The findings support the integration of AI-assisted co-design into building material research, offering new pathways for sustainability in architectural interiors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式人工智能能否作为设计协作者，利用校园回收废弃物提出高性能吸声瓷砖方案。作者通过强调吸声、美观、环境影响和安装便利的提示词生成两款AI辅助原型，统一厚度后用泡沫、蛋托、纸板和棉花等废弃材料制作，并在受控微环境中实测其声学表现。结果显示两款设计均明显降低混响，其中原型B将混响时间缩短约57.7%，表现更优；两者还呈现较低隐含能耗和较高适应性，但材料来源构成实际困难。文章据此将AI定位为可持续材料探索中的概念协同设计伙伴，并讨论了其在建筑室内可持续设计与教育场景中的潜在价值。

papers.title: Current Attitudes and Use Patterns of Large Language Models in Clinical Practice and Medical Education Among Trauma Providers
papers.authors: Brendon Frankel, Chavi Rehani, Elizabeth Anne Clark, Susan L. Evans, Vicki L. Moran, Hannah K. Galvin, Lizette Villarreal, Andrea Nevedal, Mohamed Tawfig Albirair, Ashley N Moreno, Lacey Nicole LaGrone, The 2026 Design for Implementation (DFI) Authorship Group
papers.abstract: Introduction: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in clinical practice and medical education, yet uncertainty remains regarding appropriate use, oversight, and potential effects on clinical reasoning and patient safety. This study examined current LLM use patterns, attitudes, perceived risks, and priorities for responsible integration among individuals engaged in trauma care, clinical guidance development, and medical education. Methods: Participants attending the third Design for Implementation: The Future of Trauma Clinical Guidance and Research Conference (DFI) completed surveys examining LLM use, attitudes, perceived inhibitors to personal use, and clinical applications. During facilitated sessions, participants used open-ended note-taking guides to document their perspectives regarding LLM use in clinical practice, education, and guidance development. Survey data were analyzed descriptively, and qualitative responses were analyzed using rapid qualitative content analysis. Results: 77 participants completed the pre-conference survey; 62 clinicians provided data regarding clinical LLM use and attitudes. Among clinicians, 15% reported daily LLM use, whereas 26% reported never using LLMs. Respondents expressed strongest agreement with the need for regular quality auditing of LLM-supported clinical decisions. Among 52 post-conference survey respondents, 96% somewhat or strongly agreed that clinical training curricula should include education on LLM use. Barriers to LLM use included time required to verify accuracy, concern about patient harm, and insufficient training in appropriate prompting. Qualitative data came from 23 note-taking documents administered during the conference. Both positive and negative perspectives arose regarding AI use, centering on topics including efficiency gains, deskilling and never-skilling, governance and oversight, accuracy and hallucination, patient safety, and education. Discussion: DFI participants recognized efficiency and informational benefits of LLMs while identifying important concerns related to accuracy, patient safety, skill development, and governance. Findings support a need for institutional guidance, education in responsible LLM use, and evaluation of the incorporation of these technologies into clinical practice and health professions education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查了创伤照护、临床指南制定与医学教育相关从业者对大型语言模型的使用模式、态度与风险认知，通过会前会后问卷和会议记录进行描述性统计与快速定性内容分析。结果显示，临床医生中日常使用与从不使用并存，受访者最强烈认同对模型支持的临床决策进行定期质量审计，绝大多数会后受访者认为临床培训课程应纳入相关教育；主要障碍包括核实准确性耗时、担心患者伤害和提示技能培训不足。定性资料呈现效率收益与去技能化、治理监督、准确性与幻觉、患者安全及教育等正反观点，作者据此强调机构指导、负责任使用教育和实践评估的必要性。

papers.title: Localising the Seizure Onset Zone from Routine Interictal and Ictal Scalp EEG Via a Factorised Spatiotemporal Ensemble Deep Learning Framework
papers.authors: Songyuan Shi
papers.abstract: Background: Drug-resistant focal epilepsy requires precise localisation of the epileptogenic zone (EZ) for surgical resection. Current practice depends on invasive recordings or spontaneous seizure capture, a costly and risky bottleneck. Interictal scalp EEG can exhibit localising features like spikes, but scalp EEG suffers from volume conduction (the smearing of brain signals across multiple electrodes) and low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which obscure subtle spatial dynamics. Neurophysiologist review of long, often multi-day recordings is time-consuming and expertise-dependent, and while computational methods exist, they tend to rely heavily on human-designed features. Deep learning for EEG localisation could therefore help to improve clinical efficiency and sensitivity. Objectives: To develop and validate a non-invasive deep learning approach for lobar-level localisation of the seizure onset zone (SOZ), the primary electrophysiological proxy for the epileptogenic zone (EZ), using interictal and ictal segments from routine scalp EEG. The model is trained on expert-annotated clinical labels and is intended to augment, not supplant, clinical judgement in EZ delineation. Methods: We curated 262 sessions (6,000+ hours) from 100 patients with unilateral focal epilepsy, tested with an extra 28-patient internal and a 9-patient external dataset. The framework integrates: (1) an online augmentation pipeline (Gaussian noise, amplitude scaling, temporal cropping, and hemispheric channel swap) to mitigate overfitting. (2) a multi-scale temporal block for 20-200 ms discharge morphologies; (3) a factorised spatiotemporal Transformer decoupling temporal and spatial attention to counter volume conduction; and (4) a hemispheric mutual exclusivity penalty encoding unilateral priors. A five-model heterogeneous ensemble, fused via model soup, was evaluated on held-out, seizure-free, and cross-institutional cohorts. Results: The ensemble achieved 88.46% session-level exact match on internal test data, outperforming EEGNet (50.00%). Performance generalised to the seizure-free holdout set (82.76%) and to cross-institutional data (84.62%). Rare occipital class (RO) recall rose from 0.500 to 1.000, with zero false positives on healthy controls (n=108). On unlabelled random segments, accuracy was 66.67% (vs. 14% chance). A full 24-hour recording was processed in 4.26 minutes, with inference under 8 seconds, highlighting localising windows for targeted expert clinical review Conclusion: Clinically actionable SOZ spatial information is encoded in routine interictal scalp EEG. Our factorised ensemble provides a safe, interpretable, and efficient tool to expedite presurgical evaluation, potentially reducing reliance on prolonged monitoring and invasive implantation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对耐药性局灶性癫痫术前定位依赖侵入性记录或长程监测的问题，开发并验证了一种基于常规头皮脑电的非侵入式深度学习框架，用于在脑叶层面定位发作起始区。该框架整合多尺度时间模块、解耦时空注意力的Transformer及半球互斥惩罚，并以五模型异构集成在内部、无发作及跨机构队列上评估。结果显示，该集成在内部测试的会话级精确匹配上明显优于EEGNet，并能泛化到无发作留出集和跨机构数据，对稀有枕叶类别的召回提升且对健康对照无误报；处理长程记录的速度也支持快速筛出可供专家复核的定位窗口。作者据此认为常规发作间期头皮脑电已编码具有临床可操作性的空间信息，该工具可辅助而非替代临床判断，以加快术前评估。

papers.title: Contribution of the Late Positive Potential to Emotional Memory: A Joint Neuro-Cognitive Approach to Memory Prediction
papers.authors: Robin Hellerstedt, Jordan Gunn, Deborah Talmi
papers.abstract: Emotional events are better remembered than neutral events. The emotional Context Maintenance and Retrieval model (eCMR) explains this effect by simulating preferential encoding of emotional items, implemented by a free parameter that scales the learning rate. Incorporating a neural signal measured during encoding could make the model's account more specific, permitting a prediction not only of average increased recall but also which emotional items are likely to be recalled. We investigated whether the late positive potential (LPP) event-related potential (ERP) effect could provide this item-specific information in a secondary analysis of EEG recorded while 38 participants encoded negative and neutral pictures for an immediate free recall test (Zarubin et al. 2020). First, we established that the LPP effect was modulated by emotion in an early (400-1000 ms) and a late (1000-2000 ms) time window and this modulation was reliable in 73.7% and 50% of the participants respectively. Second, we investigated at what level the LPP was related to subsequent memory. Emotion-enhanced LPP did not covary with emotion-enhanced memory between participants or across lists within participants, but the early LPP specifically predicted memory for emotional items on a single-trial level. Third, we compared eCMR variants to test whether trial-level early LPP should scale learning for both categories or only for emotional items, and whether it could replace or complement a common learning-rate increase for all emotional items. The best-fitting model combined emotion-specific LPP scaling with the common learning-rate increase. The finding that early LPP predicted enhanced recall only for emotional items is difficult to reconcile with accounts on which the LPP reflects attention or stimulus significance more generally, which predict a relationship to memory for neutral items as well. These results pave the way to quantitative prediction of internal recall trajectories by individual participants without requiring behavioural output.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于已有脑电数据，考察晚期正电位（LPP）能否为情绪记忆提供项目层面的预测信息。作者让参与者编码负性与中性图片并进行即时自由回忆，发现LPP的情绪调制在早期和晚期时间窗内均可观察到，但只有早期LPP在单试次水平上特异性地预测了情绪项目的记忆，而未预测中性项目的记忆。将这一神经信号纳入eCMR模型后，最佳拟合模型同时包含情绪特异的LPP学习率缩放与所有情绪项目共有的学习率提升。作者指出，早期LPP仅预测情绪项目回忆这一结果，难以用LPP反映一般性注意或刺激显著性的解释来调和，并为无需行为输出即可定量预测个体回忆轨迹提供了可能。

papers.title: The Impact of Contextual Prompting on LLM Translation Accuracy in Educational Sciences: An Exploratory Case Study of ChatGPT Pro
papers.authors: Mayssaa MOUKATIB, Rajae Khaloufi
papers.abstract: Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into specialized translation workflows introduces nuanced lexical and register-related challenges. This exploratory case study investigates how progressively constrained prompt engineering influences the translation of domain-specific pedagogical terminology from English into Arabic. Using ChatGPT Pro (GPT-4), an 84-word source excerpt containing four key Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT) pedagogical terms was translated under three prompting conditions: zero-shot baseline, role-prompting (expert persona), and context-rich prompting (localized to Moroccan secondary education). The resulting Arabic outputs were evaluated against recognized Moroccan pedagogical frameworks and specialized Arabic educational lexicons using an explicit three-tier adequacy rubric. Descriptive analysis revealed marked lexical variations: zero-shot prompting yielded literal semantic calques, whereas context-rich prompting aligned closely with localized curricular terminology. While these exploratory findings demonstrate that contextual constraints assist the model in selecting domain-appropriate registers, the results highlight the necessity of continued human expertise and institutional oversight in specialized machine translation post-editing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以ChatGPT Pro为对象，考察在英译阿过程中逐步收紧的提示设计如何影响教育学术语翻译的准确性，属于探索性案例研究。作者将一段含四个任务型语言教学关键术语的英文原文分别置于零样本、角色提示和情境丰富提示三种条件下翻译，并用三级充分性量表对照摩洛哥教学框架与专业词汇表评估输出。结果显示，零样本提示产生字面语义直译，而情境丰富提示更贴近本地化课程术语，说明情境约束有助于模型选择领域适配的语域；但作者同时强调，专业机器翻译的译后编辑仍需人的专业判断与机构监督。

papers.title: Integration Pathways of AI-Generated Tools and Cultivation of Instructional Innovation Competencies in Pre-Service Teacher Preparation: A Literature Review and Practical Implications
papers.authors: Cai Jun, Qhamariah Binti Samu
papers.abstract: With the rapid iteration of generative artificial intelligence technology, AI-generated tools have become a core variable reshaping the education ecosystem and have also placed new demands on the competency structure of pre-service teachers. This study, based on domestic and international literature on the application of AI-generated tools in pre-service teacher education, employs an integrative literature review approach to examine existing research findings from four aspects: the connotation of core concepts, the current state of cognitive application, curriculum integration paths, and competency development dimensions. Given the rapidly evolving nature of the topic and the limited pool of empirical studies available, an integrative review design was chosen over a full systematic review to allow for critical synthesis of both empirical and conceptual works.The study finds that the academic community has formed a hierarchical conceptual system of AI literacy and AI competency, constructing three typical integration paths: curriculum embedding, workshop intervention, and practical penetration. However, pre-service teachers generally suffer from low levels of AI application, a disconnect between theoretical understanding and teaching practice, and insufficient ethical critical thinking. Based on these findings, this paper proposes practical strategies such as a hierarchical and progressive competency development system and a closed-loop “theory-practice-reflection” training model.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以整合性文献回顾方式，梳理了生成式人工智能工具在职前教师教育中的应用研究，围绕核心概念内涵、认知应用现状、课程整合路径与能力发展维度展开分析。作者指出，学界已形成分层的AI素养与AI能力概念体系，并归纳出课程嵌入、工作坊干预和实践渗透三条典型整合路径；但职前教师的AI应用水平普遍偏低，理论理解与教学实践相脱节，伦理批判性思维也不足。文章据此提出分层递进的能力培养体系和“理论—实践—反思”闭环培训模式等策略，属于基于文献综合的实践建议，而非实证检验。

papers.title: Development and Validation of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-Generated Visual Clinic for Supplementing Clinical Teaching in Resource-Limited Settings: A Proof of Concept Study
papers.authors: Auwal Abdullahi
papers.abstract: Background: Clinical teaching integrates theoretical knowledge with direct patient contact. However, in resource-limited settings, adequate patient contact is often compromised by inadequate clinical facilities, perennial industrial actions by healthcare workers, and limited access to rare or under-referred cases. The aim of this study was to develop an AI-generated visual clinic (a curated catalogue of videos) depicting motor rehabilitation in patients with stroke to help supplement real-world clinical teaching. Methods: An AI platform, Topmediai (https://www.topmediai.com/app/text-to-video/) was used to generate videos on constraint-induced movement therapy (CIMT), motor imagery, sit-to-stand, over-ground gait training and treadmill gait training. The videos were edited and combined into an AI-generated visual clinic using CapCut (https://www.capcut.com/). Students and teachers were asked to rate the AI-generated visual clinic for: 1) Anatomical plausibility, 2) Procedural fidelity, 3) Rehabilitation accuracy, 4) Pedagogical clarity, and 5) Risk of learner misconception on a-5-point Likert scale, where, 1=low, 2= fair, 3=moderate, 4=high, and 5=very high. Results: A complete visual clinic demonstrating CIMT, motor imagery, sit-to-stand, over-ground gait training and treadmill gait training was produced. In addition, majority of the participants (both teachers and students), rated anatomical plausibility, procedural fidelity, rehabilitation accuracy and pedagogical clarity of the AI-generated visual clinic as high or very high; and risk of learner misconception as low or fair. Conclusion: It seems possible to generate clinically relevant videos of disease management using current AI text-to-video tools that can be catalogued into a “visual clinic” and used to support traditional clinical teaching.
papers.summary_zh: 该概念验证研究针对资源有限环境下临床教学患者接触不足的问题，利用AI文本生成视频工具制作了涵盖约束诱导运动疗法、运动想象、坐站转移及步行训练等内容的卒中康复视频，并汇编成“视觉诊所”。教师与学生从解剖合理性、操作保真度、康复准确性、教学清晰度和学习者误解风险五方面进行评分，多数人认为前四项达到高或很高水平，误解风险为低或一般。结果表明，现有AI视频生成工具有望产出与临床相关的疾病管理教学素材，作为传统临床教学的补充，但研究仅为概念验证，实际教学效果尚待进一步检验。

papers.title: From AI Adoption to Institutional Preparedness: Governing Enterprises for AGI
papers.authors: Fang Sun
papers.abstract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) is increasingly discussed not merely as a technical frontier but as a social and institutional challenge. Drawing on current generative and agentic AI as diagnostic evidence, this paper examines enterprise institutional preparedness for increasingly general and autonomous AI systems through three interrelated dimensions: organizational resilience, employee protection, and social responsibility. Using conceptual and normative analysis, the paper synthesizes AI governance, organizational resilience, labor studies, corporate social responsibility, and policy frameworks to develop a forward-looking governance architecture. The framework links three levels of institutional exposure: continuity of organizational functions, preservation of worker agency, and external social legitimacy. It identifies seven preparedness components: strategic foresight, governance architecture, risk and impact assessment, human oversight, employee protection, social responsibility, and continuous learning. The analysis further distinguishes scalable risks already visible in current AI from potentially discontinuous risks associated with greater autonomy and cross-domain integration. The study shifts the unit of analysis from tool-level AI risk management to enterprise-level institutional capacity to preserve organizational continuity, worker agency, and external social legitimacy.
papers.summary_zh: 该文将通用人工智能（AGI）视为社会与制度层面的挑战，而非单纯的技术前沿，并以当前生成式与智能体式AI为诊断依据，从组织韧性、员工保护和社会责任三个维度考察企业的制度准备程度。作者采用概念性与规范性分析，综合AI治理、组织韧性、劳动研究、企业社会责任和政策框架，提出一个前瞻性治理架构，将制度暴露分为组织功能连续性、员工能动性维护和外部社会合法性三个层次，并归纳出战略预见、治理架构、风险与影响评估、人类监督、员工保护、社会责任和持续学习七项准备要素。文章还区分了当前AI中已显现的可扩展风险与更高自主性和跨域整合可能带来的非连续性风险，主张把分析单位从工具层面的AI风险管理转向企业层面的制度能力建设。需注意，该文属概念与规范分析，未开展实证检验，所提框架的有效性尚待经验研究验证。

papers.title: Integration of artificial intelligence in quality improvement projects for undergraduate nursing students: Enhancing nursing education through innovative applications
papers.authors: D’Ana Brooks, Elizabeth Mayerson
papers.journal: Journal of Nursing Education and Practice
papers.abstract: Background and objective: Nursing faculty have been hesitant to incorporate artificial intelligence into coursework due to various reasons, including the risk of affecting academic integrity and the potential for receiving inaccurate information. As nursing cohorts continue to grow, innovative approaches are needed to meet learning objectives; such as artificial intelligence. Incorporating artificial intelligence into group projects may increase responsible, ethical, and critical use of artificial intelligence and support programs in managing larger cohorts. The purpose of this initiative was to integrate artificial intelligence into the literature review process for a quality improvement group project to develop students’ ability to use artificial intelligence responsibly, ethically, and critically. This approach included validating the accuracy of artificial intelligence generated information. Methods: This initiative was offered as an honors conversion opportunity within the Clinical Science II course to undergraduate nursing students. Six students opted to participate and were divided into two groups of three. Groups selected a topic related to the course content and aligned it with one of the Joint Commission national patient safety goals. Groups developed a clinical question, search strategy, conducted a literature review, and used artificial intelligence to identify evidence. Results: Benefits of using artificial intelligence included the generation of creative ideas, provision of workflow steps, and a broad range of solutions. Challenges included a lack of concrete examples and a tendency for artificial intelligence generated information to be more practical than theoretical. Groups found artificial intelligence generated findings aligned with most articles from their literature reviews. Conclusions: Incorporating the utilization of artificial intelligence into nursing curriculums can help programs monitor usage while managing growing cohorts. Allowing students to engage with artificial intelligence under guided instruction enhances understanding of its practical applications in clinical settings. This will better prepare students for real-world practice while ensuring academic integrity is maintained.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何在本科护理课程的质量改进小组项目中融入人工智能，以培养学生负责任、合乎伦理且批判性地使用人工智能的能力，并应对学生规模扩大带来的教学管理压力。作者以荣誉课程转换的形式，让参与学生在完成文献综述任务时借助人工智能查找证据，并核验其生成信息的准确性。结果显示，人工智能有助于产生创意、提供工作流程步骤和多种解决方案，但也存在缺少具体实例、生成内容偏实践而少理论的问题；小组核查后发现人工智能给出的结果与综述中多数文献基本一致。文章据此认为，在教师指导下让学生接触人工智能，有助于其理解临床应用并兼顾学术诚信。

papers.title: Generative AI and Copyrightability in the United States: Human Authorship, Creative Control, and AI-Assisted Works
papers.authors: Chinmay Rathee
papers.journal: International Journal of Law Management & Humanities
papers.abstract: The U.S. Copyright Office has released its report Copyright and Artificial Intelligence, Part 2: Copyrightability. This paper explores the copyrightability of AI-generated and AI-assisted works in the United States, focusing on that report and on the jurisprudence of human authorship. It examines the constitutional and statutory bases of human authorship, the importance of Burrow-Giles, Feist, Community for Creative Non-Violence v. Reid and Thaler v. Perlmutter, and how the Copyright Office has dealt with prompting, human-authored inputs, selection, arrangement, modification and the assistive use of AI. The paper shows that the United States has adopted a case-by-case approach: the use of AI as a tool does not defeat protection, but copyright extends only to expression created by a human author and not to material generated by AI itself. Under current technology, prompts alone do not generally provide sufficient control, but human expression that is perceptible in the output, creative selection and arrangement, and meaningful modification can be protected. The paper sets out the strengths and weaknesses of this approach and suggests more explicit registration, evidentiary and guidance practices, while maintaining the human-authorship requirement.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕美国版权局《版权与人工智能》第二部分报告及相关判例，讨论AI生成与AI辅助作品的可版权性问题，梳理了人类作者身份在宪法与制定法上的依据及若干关键判例。文章指出，美国采取逐案判断的路径：将AI作为工具使用并不当然排除保护，但版权只及于人类作者创作的表达，不及于AI自身生成的材料；在现有技术下，仅凭提示词通常不足以构成充分控制，而输出中可感知的人类表达、创造性的选择与编排以及有意义的修改可以获得保护。文章评估了这一路径的优劣，并在坚持人类作者身份要求的前提下，建议改进登记、证据与指导实践。

papers.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND ROBOTIC SURGERY
papers.authors: Usva Siddique, Jahanzaib Tufail, Hamad Rasul, Muhammad Naeem, Abdul Waheed, Zia Ashraf
papers.journal: Review journal of neurological & medical sciences review.
papers.abstract: The synergy of smart AI with robotic surgery is one of the greatest achievements to emerge within biomedical science and clinical practice. Within less than a decade the integration of AI in robotic surgery has progressed from simple tele-manipulation machines to rapidly advancing, ‘smart’, precise, and intelligent robots capable of instant image interpretation, predictive deduction, automatic suturing, and real-time surgical navigation. Forty-five papers from scientific journals (2015-2025) were systematically gathered, read, and summarized, based upon the progression of development time, technological approach, multidisciplinary and applied nature, reported outcomes and results, surgical training and education, peer reviews and appraisals, and predictions concerning the future ethical implications of intelligent robotic surgery. Results indicated that, of those that were analysed, the integrated intelligent AI robotic surgery reported up to a 25-40% greater degree of accuracy, 25-30% fewer complications during surgery, and 15-20% more rapid post-operative recuperation in patients compared with the group undergoing standard surgery. The current market share held by popular robotic surgical systems including da Vinci, MAKO, Versius and Hugo RAS are reviewed, however cost, algorithmic racial and gender bias, government regulations and liabilities, and the digital gap continue to present major obstacles. In conclusion, although robotic surgery is advancing beyond human hand-eye coordination more rapidly than previously assumed, and an impending array of new and innovative benefits that will enable more secure and readily available operations, are indisputably en route.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了2015至2025年间45篇文献，考察人工智能与机器人手术从远程操作向智能精准系统演进的过程及其应用表现。分析显示，集成智能AI的机器人手术在准确性、并发症控制和术后恢复方面优于标准手术，但成本、算法中的种族与性别偏见、监管责任及数字鸿沟仍是主要障碍。文章据此讨论了智能机器人手术在训练教育与伦理层面的 implications，并提示其进一步发展仍受上述条件制约。

papers.title: KEAMANAN SIBER DI ERA DIGITAL: TINJAUAN PENERAPAN DATA MINING UNTUK DETEKSI ANCAMAN PADA PELAKU USAHA KECIL
papers.authors: Faizah Amirah Harahap, Taufiq Taufiq, Yanita Yanita
papers.journal: SULIWA Jurnal Multidisiplin Teknik Sains Pendidikan dan Teknologi
papers.abstract: The rapid digital transformation of Indonesian MSMEs has increased exposure to cyber threats such as phishing, malware, ransomware, and DDoS. This study aims to review the application of data mining and machine learning for cyber threat detection, especially in the context of small businesses. A systematic literature review (SLR) with the PRISMA approach was used. Articles were collected from Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar (2018–2026), screened using inclusion and exclusion criteria, and analyzed descriptively. From 19 collected articles, 11 were reviewed: seven on data mining/machine learning for cyber threat detection and four on MSME cybersecurity. The results show that Random Forest, C4.5/J48, SVM/SMO, Naive Bayes, and K-Means are commonly used. Feature selection (Information Gain, PCA) and class balancing (SMOTE) improve accuracy and training efficiency, with reported accuracy generally above 90%. However, most studies use public datasets such as KDD Cup’99, AWID, CICIDS2017, and CIC-MalMem-2022, not data from MSME environments. Key challenges include class imbalance, false positives, limited resources, data quality, scalability, and low digital literacy. Non-technical factors—management commitment, governance, training, and cost—are also critical. Data mining has potential for MSME threat detection, but implementation requires lightweight, context-specific models and organizational readiness.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以PRISMA方法系统梳理了数据挖掘与机器学习在网络威胁检测中的应用，并特别关注小型企业情境。纳入的文献显示，随机森林、C4.5/J48、SVM/SMO、朴素贝叶斯和K-Means是常用算法，特征选择与类别平衡处理有助于提升准确率和训练效率，但多数研究报告的高准确率基于公开数据集而非小微企业实际环境。文章指出，类别不平衡、误报、资源有限、数据质量、可扩展性和数字素养不足是主要挑战，管理承诺、治理、培训与成本等非技术因素同样关键；数据挖掘在该场景具有潜力，但落地需要轻量化、贴合情境的模型和组织准备。

papers.title: El modelo pedagógico de innovación crítica: metodología para el fortalecimiento del conocimiento y el aprendizaje en los estudiantes de pregrado
papers.authors: Blanca Mery Rolón Rodríguez, Orlando Antonio Mejía Quintero
papers.abstract: Background. Pedagogical innovation is one of the main challenges facing higher education in the twenty-first century, as digital transformation now shapes every mode of instruction and calls into question the way students build knowledge. Objective. To develop an emerging pedagogical model that strengthens knowledge and learning among undergraduate students, drawing on the experiences of students, faculty, and administrators across different educational modes. Methods. A qualitative study was conducted under the interpretive-critical paradigm using a grounded theory design. A total of 221 participants from three Colombian institutions representing on-campus, military on-campus, and online modes were selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, supported by document analysis of reports issued by the Colombian Ministry of National Education and by observational research. The analysis involved open, axial, and selective coding, source triangulation, and categorical convergence analysis. Results. Eight emerging categories were identified: pedagogical innovation as the organizing axis, participation and dialogue, reflective assessment, critical thinking, faculty development, educational equity, meaningful learning, and the pedagogical use of artificial intelligence and ICT. The three groups agreed that changing educational practice depends not on adopting technology or making isolated methodological changes, but on aligning pedagogy, didactics, teaching strategies, and the instructional context. Conclusions. The convergence of these categories gives rise to the Pedagogical Model of Critical Innovation, an emerging theoretical construct that offers a conceptual reference for updating institutional education projects, pedagogical models, and curriculum designs across the different modes of higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在构建一个强化本科生知识与学习的教学模型，采用解释批判范式下的扎根理论设计，通过半结构化访谈、文件分析和观察，收集了来自哥伦比亚三所院校不同教育模式的学生、教师和管理人员的经验。分析识别出八个新兴类别，涵盖教学创新、参与对话、反思性评价、批判性思维、教师发展、教育公平、有意义学习以及人工智能与信息通信技术的教学运用。三组参与者一致认为，改变教育实践的关键不在于采用技术或孤立的方法调整，而在于使教学法、教学策略与教学情境相互对齐。这些类别的汇聚形成了“批判创新教学模型”这一新兴理论构念，可为不同高等教育模式下更新院校教育项目、教学模型和课程设计提供概念参考。

papers.title: A Review on Analysis of K-Means Clustering Machine Learning Algorithm based on Unsupervised Learning
papers.authors: Zahraa Radhi Waad
papers.journal: Review of Multidisciplinary Academic and Practice Studies
papers.abstract: Purpose: This study revisits the K-means clustering algorithm as a core technique of unsupervised machine learning and explains, in plain terms, how it groups unlabeled data into meaningful clusters.Methodology: The paper combines a narrative review of studies published mostly between 2021 and 2026 with a manual, step-by-step computation of K-means on a small one-dimensional dataset of nine values, using Euclidean distance and K=2. The final partition is then checked with the within-cluster sum of squares and the silhouette coefficient for K values from one to four.Results: The algorithm stabilized after three reassignment rounds and produced the clusters {2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12} and {20, 25, 30}, with centroids of 7 and 25. The within-cluster sum of squares fell from 348.00 to 150.00, and the mean silhouette coefficient reached 0.660, although K=3 gave a higher value of 0.711.Conclusions: K-means is simple, fast, and easy to interpret, yet its output depends strongly on the chosen number of clusters and on the starting centroids.Limitations: The worked example relies on a small one-dimensional dataset and does not test high-dimensional, noisy, or streaming data.Contributions: The paper offers a transparent teaching case that links the classic procedure to current validation practice and to recent applied studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以综述结合手工演算的方式重新梳理无监督学习中的K-means聚类算法，用一组一维小数据按欧氏距离和K=2逐步演示聚类过程，并借助簇内平方和与轮廓系数检验划分质量。结果显示算法经三轮重新分配后稳定，得到两个簇及相应质心，簇内平方和明显下降，平均轮廓系数处于中等水平，但K=3时轮廓系数更高。作者据此指出K-means简单快速且易解释，但其结果高度依赖簇数和初始质心，且该示例仅限小规模一维数据，未涉及高维、含噪或流式数据。

papers.title: Self-Reported Use, Attitudes, and Practices of Medical
papers.authors: Raouf Roshdy
papers.abstract: Background: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in healthcare, but evidence on physicians' selfreported use of, and attitudes toward, these tools remains limited in Egypt and the wider Arab region.Methods: A cross-sectional survey of 293 medical professionals in Egypt was conducted in May 2026 using a 47-item bilingual questionnaire covering demographics, AI use patterns, Likert-scale attitudes and concerns, and self-reported clinical impact. Convenience sampling used professional networks and social media; a single-submission link limited duplicate responses. Percentages are reported against each item's valid (non-missing) denominator, stated with each result.Results: Of 293 respondents, 239 (82.7% of valid responses) reported current AI use. ChatGPT was most used (87.4% of users), followed by Gemini (59.8%). Most respondents (88.9%) supported formal AI training, and 72.1% reported personally identifying inaccurate AI output. Mean trust in AI-generated information was 2.93/5 (median 3, IQR 2–4); mean rating for reviewing AI output before clinical use was 4.11/5. Absence of clear AI regulation received the highest mean concern rating (4.17/5). Only 29.4% reported using AI during direct patient interaction; 26.5% changed a treatment plan after AI consultation, and 34.7% reported AI contributing to a diagnosis not initially considered.Conclusion: Self-reported generative AI use is high in this convenience sample, but direct clinical integration remains limited and trust is modest relative to use. These findings describe the sampled respondents only and should not be extrapolated nationally. They support a role for structured education and verification practices rather than firm claims of demonstrated clinical benefit.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以埃及293名医疗专业人员为对象，通过横断面问卷调查考察其对生成式人工智能的自报使用情况、态度与临床实践。结果显示，自报使用AI者比例较高，ChatGPT最为常用，多数人支持正式培训，且不少人曾发现AI输出不准确；但信任度仅处中等水平，在直接患者互动中使用AI的比例较低，少数人曾因AI咨询改变治疗方案或获得此前未考虑的诊断。作者指出，该便利样本中AI使用虽普遍，临床整合仍有限，信任与使用并不匹配，结论仅适用于受访者，不宜外推，并提示应重视结构化教育与核验实践，而非断言临床获益。

papers.title: Extended data for: Artificial intelligence in cardiovascular diagnosis and care pathways: a SANRA-informed narrative review of multimodal imaging, physiological signals and clinical decision support
papers.authors: Andres F. Zuluaga, Germán Camilo Giraldo
papers.abstract: This file accompanies the article above, submitted to F1000Research. It contains Extended data 1 (SANRA coverage map) and Extended data 2 (search documentation and evidence verification). License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0).
papers.summary_zh: 该文件是上述论文的扩展数据，包含SANRA覆盖图（扩展数据1）以及检索文档与证据核验材料（扩展数据2），并非独立研究或综述正文。由于摘要未提供论文本身的研究问题、方法或结果，无法据此概括其主要发现；可确认的仅是这些扩展数据用于补充说明该叙述性综述的文献检索与证据核验过程。

papers.title: Contaminated by Collaboration: Shared Workspaces Can Fabricate Severe-Defect Recall in Multi-Agent Code Review
papers.authors: Jiahao Hu
papers.abstract: Multi-agent code review, in which one LLM writes code and another reviews it, is now standard practice, and its evaluation depends on an assumption rarely stated. The two reviewers are taken to be independent. We report a forensic reconstruction of an unintentional violation of that assumption, with a matched same-model comparison of two single runs. A first-round reviewer in a shared hidden workspace directory wrote a 4,746-byte assertion script reproducing the artifact's most severe defect, then a memory file recording its seven findings. A second reviewer, launched 52 seconds later in that directory, read that memory file eleven minutes into its own run and produced a report matching those seven findings in order, while citing a script it never opened. Re-running the same model on the same artifact in a fresh directory is consistent with the leak causing the difference, though run time and inference configuration varied too. Severe recall reads 100% under leakage and 0% under isolation, while aggregate F1 moves 3.5 pp (36.8% to 33.3%), a difference a practitioner would read as noise. Leakage also relocates coverage. The conditions detect different sets, and the isolated run finds the edit-dialog validation gap that the contaminated run never reported. The interaction is gated by what the reviewer brings. Contamination raised the weaker reviewer to the level the stronger reached unaided; whether the stronger is unaffected by leakage is untested. In that direction it can flatten a capability difference rather than merely inflate scores. We give a five-step post-hoc checklist requiring no model internals, an isolation protocol, and a metric recommendation. Reports should carry severity-stratified recall and detection sets, since aggregate F1 cannot see this failure.This preprint reports a forensic reconstruction of an unintentional answer leak between two LLM code reviewers sharing a hidden workspace directory, and a matched same-model comparison of the contaminated and isolated runs. All figures and tables are computed from the raw records described in Section 3. The artifact and its specification are included as supplementary files.AI use disclosure: The research question, experimental design, all condition runs in Sections 3 and 4, the frozen gold adjudication, and every interpretive claim are the author's, who takes full responsibility for the content. A large language model assistant (WorkBuddy) was used for prose editing, consistency checks, metadata verification and typesetting. The author verified every reported number against the underlying records. No reported result was produced by the model; every measurement was made by the author. The model is not an author, consistent with Research Square and COPE policy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过一次取证式重建，考察多智能体代码审查中两个大语言模型审查者共享隐藏工作区目录时可能出现的答案泄漏问题，并对同一模型在受污染与隔离条件下的单次运行进行匹配比较。结果显示，泄漏使严重缺陷召回率从隔离条件下的0%升至100%，但总体F1仅小幅变化，易被误读为噪声；泄漏还改变了检出集合，隔离运行发现了受污染运行未报告的校验缺口。作者据此指出，这种污染可能把较弱审查者提升至较强审查者独立达到的水平，从而压缩能力差异，并提出无需模型内部信息的核查清单、隔离协议和按严重程度分层的召回指标建议。

papers.title: From Content Transmission to Epistemic Construction: Redesigning University Education in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Rosario Dawson
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence challenges the university model centered on content transmission and subsequent testing. Large language models can retrieve, synthesize, and recombine information within seconds, but rapid access to information does not constitute reliable knowledge. This conceptual article argues that higher education should shift toward epistemic construction: the process of framing problems, integrating information, verifying sources, exposing assumptions, confronting counterarguments, revising provisional judgments, and defending conclusions. Drawing on Socratic inquiry, medieval disputatio, Popperian falsification, reflective learning, critical-thinking research, and scholarship on artificial intelligence in education, the study proposes the AI-Assisted Epistemic Construction Cycle. The framework positions generative AI not primarily as an answer-producing device, but as a scalable digital devil’s advocate that supports structured intellectual dissent. Implications are developed for faculty roles, student agency, assessment, institutional governance, academic integrity, and future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，针对生成式人工智能使大学以内容传授和测验为核心的模型难以为继的问题，提出高等教育应转向“认知建构”，即由学生完成问题界定、信息整合、来源核实、假设暴露、反驳应对、暂定判断修正与结论辩护等过程。作者借鉴苏格拉底式追问、中世纪辩论、波普尔证伪、反思性学习与批判性思维研究，提出“AI辅助认知建构循环”框架，将生成式AI主要定位为可规模化的数字“魔鬼代言人”，用以支持结构化的智识异议，而非答案生成器。文章据此讨论了教师角色、学生能动性、评价、机构治理、学术诚信及未来研究等方面的启示。需注意，该框架属概念主张，其有效性尚待实证检验。

papers.title: FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS AND ARCHITECTURE OF AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-BASED INFORMATION SYSTEM FOR STUDENT CAREER GUIDANCE
papers.authors: Islomxon Karamatov
papers.abstract: This thesis addresses the development of an artificial intelligence-based information system for student career guidance. Since existing tools do not sufficiently account for labor market dynamics, the creation of a new AI system is proposed. The paper describes the functional requirements of the system, its four-component architecture, and the machine learning methods (content-based filtering, clustering, and NLP) employed in the recommendation module.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文针对现有工具难以充分反映劳动力市场动态的问题，提出开发一个基于人工智能的学生职业指导信息系统。论文主要描述了该系统的功能需求、由四个组件构成的架构，以及推荐模块所采用的机器学习方法（包括基于内容的过滤、聚类和自然语言处理）。由于摘要仅停留在系统设计与方法说明层面，未报告系统实现后的评估结果或实际使用效果，因此无法判断其在职业指导中的实际表现。

papers.title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Physics into Islamic Education: Opportunities, Challenges, and a Framework for Future Learning
papers.authors: Mohammad Wali Khurami, Musawer Hakimi, Khoshal Rahman Rahmani
papers.abstract: Islamic educational institutions are increasingly drawn into a technological moment shaped by artificial intelligence and, more quietly, by quantum physics, yet little research asks how either can be woven into Islamic pedagogy without unsettling tawhid, the epistemological commitment underlying the tradition. This PRISMA-guided systematic review maps the opportunities, challenges, and design principles for integrating AI and quantum physics into Islamic education and proposes a working framework. Of 1,563 unique records retrieved from five databases (2016-2025), 57 studies were retained: 48 engaging directly with an Islamic-education context (Stream A), and 9 general quantum-physics-education studies included deliberately as a comparison corpus (Stream B), since none met a joint Islamic-context-and-quantum criterion. AI is used mainly for personalised Qur'anic and Arabic-language learning and administrative efficiency; quantum content remains almost entirely confined to secular STEM curricula. Data privacy, algorithmic bias, teacher readiness, and decontextualised content recur as concerns. The review proposes the AI-Quantum-Islamic Education Framework (AIQIEF), grounding adoption in tawhid-based epistemology rather than treating these technologies as neutral add-ons.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以PRISMA流程系统梳理了将人工智能与量子物理融入伊斯兰教育的机会、挑战与设计原则，并提出一个工作框架。纳入的文献显示，AI主要用于个性化《古兰经》与阿拉伯语学习及行政效率提升，而量子内容几乎仍局限于世俗STEM课程；数据隐私、算法偏见、教师准备不足和内容脱离语境是反复出现的关切。作者据此提出AI-量子-伊斯兰教育框架（AIQIEF），主张以认主独一的认识论为基础来接纳这些技术，而非将其视为中性的附加工具。

papers.title: Augmented Radiology: why map artificial intelligence in imaging from and for the Spanish-speaking world
papers.authors: F. M. Olivera Plata
papers.journal: Swiss Journal of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine
papers.abstract: Radiología Aumentada (Augmented Radiology) is an independent personal project documenting the adoption of artificial intelligence in diagnostic imaging in Argentina and the wider Spanish-speaking world. This invited contribution discusses gaps between the predominantly English-language evidence base and local clinical practice, and describes the project’s adoption map, vendor directory, educational resources, governance guidance and opinion articles. As of October 2026, the map records 36 institutions across 14 Argentine jurisdictions; the directory surveys 59 products, of which 18 show presence or signs of presence in Argentina. The project emphasises independence, source transparency and a radiologist’s perspective, and proposes institutional surveys and international comparisons to develop locally relevant evidence on AI adoption.

papers.title: RANANO-Recreating Nano Banana Using Diffusion Model
papers.authors: K R Manjushree, S Sakshi, Prakash Jadamali Sanjana, Udaya Vernekar Shreya, Guttal Vinuthana
papers.journal: Indian Journal of Computer Science and Technology
papers.abstract: RANANO is an integrated artificial intelligence-based multimedia creation platform developed to combine multiple creative functionalities within a single web-based interface. The system addresses the fragmented workflow involved in using separate applications for image generation, image enhancement, video creation, animated text generation, and user guidance. RANANO uses a trained diffusion model for text-to-image generation, where the trained model checkpoint is integrated into the application for inference. The platform also incorporates image enhancement using super-resolution, video generation from selected images, animated text generation, and a voice assistant for interactive guidance. The system follows a modular architecture in which the frontend communicates with backend services responsible for model inference, image processing, multimedia generation, and output management. The diffusion model is trained using a prepared dataset, while the trained checkpoint is subsequently loaded during application execution without repeated training. Functional testing was conducted across the major modules, including checkpoint loading, prompt processing, image generation, image enhancement, video generation, animated text, voice interaction, output display and storage, and frontend-backend integration. All twelve test cases documented in the project were successfully passed. The results demonstrate that RANANO provides a unified and modular approach for AI-assisted multimedia creation while reducing the need to switch between multiple tools. The system also provides scope for future improvements in computational efficiency, processing time, and multimedia generation capabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究介绍并实现了一个名为RANANO的网页端多媒体创作平台，旨在把文生图、图像增强、视频生成、动态文字和语音引导等功能整合到同一界面，以减少用户在多个工具间切换的碎片化流程。系统采用模块化架构，前端调用后端完成模型推理与多媒体处理，其中文生图使用训练好的扩散模型检查点，运行时直接加载而无需重复训练。作者对检查点加载、提示词处理、图像生成与增强、视频与动态文字生成、语音交互及前后端集成等模块进行了功能测试，摘要称记录的十二项测试用例全部通过。结果说明该平台能以统一、模块化的方式支持AI辅助多媒体创作，但摘要未报告用户研究或与独立工具的对比，计算效率、处理时间和生成能力仍被列为后续改进方向。

papers.title: SUSTAINOPRENEURSHIP: A THEORY OF ENTREPRENEURIAL APPROACH WITH SUSTAINABILITY
papers.authors: Muhammad Nawaz Iqbal, Muhammad Wamiq, Muhammad Ibrahim Shamsi, Muhammad Tasnim Khan, Malaika Asghar
papers.abstract: Sustainopreneurship is a theoretical approach that is a combination of entrepreneurial orientation and sustainability requirements to solve the complex socio-environmental problems. This paper proposes a theory of sustainopreneurship as a process of seeking opportunities in which entrepreneurs create innovative, scalable and economically viable solutions that not only create social equity but also regenerate the environment and create economic value in the long-term. Sustainopreneurship is based on the idea of a balanced triple-bottom-line logic, which is embedded into the opportunity recognition, the orchestration of the resources and the creation of value processes, unlike the traditional entrepreneurship, which is generally driven by a logic of profit, or the social entrepreneurship, which is generally driven by a logic of social impact. The theory is based on a synthesis of the fields of entrepreneurship, sustainability science, and strategic management and highlights six constructs: sustainability-oriented opportunity recognition, creation of triple-bottom-line value, orchestration of regenerative resources, stakeholder co-creation, impact scalability, and adaptive sustainability capability. The framework is comprised of a set of eight theoretical propositions: a vision of links between sustainability challenges and entrepreneurial outcomes within specific boundary conditions. Antecedents, core processes and long-term outcomes are also distinguished, to create an integrated conceptual model for the study. Sustainopreneurship contributes to the academic discourse by integrating the two literatures of entrepreneurship and sustainability, by adding a dimension of creating regenerative value as a key entrepreneurial process, and by introducing a dimension of process into the triple bottom line, as a goal, rather than only an outcome. It's a theoretical underpinning to guide practitioners, policymakers and educators on how to try to go about striking a balance between benefits and losses to the planet and its people, and profitability. Finally, Sustainopreneurship is seen as a paradigm for a resilient, inclusive and sustainable economic model amidst global uncertainties.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“可持续创业”理论，将创业导向与可持续性要求结合，以应对复杂的社会环境问题。作者通过整合创业学、可持续性科学与战略管理，构建了包含六个构念和八项命题的概念模型，区分前因、核心过程与长期结果。其核心主张是：可持续创业以平衡的三重底线逻辑贯穿机会识别、资源编排与价值创造，区别于利润驱动的传统创业和社会影响驱动的社会创业，并强调再生价值创造与将过程维度纳入三重底线。该理论为实践者、政策制定者和教育者平衡生态与社会损益及盈利提供概念指引，属理论建构而非实证检验。

papers.title: Relationship Between Chatgpt And Google Gemini Use And Mathematics Learning Interest Among Fifth-Grade Students At Sdn Kebalen 05
papers.authors: Yohamintin Yohamintin, Alya Quratul Aini, Dian Anggraeni Maharbid
papers.abstract: The objective of this study was to investigate the relationship between the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI), represented by ChatGPT and Google Gemini, and students’ interest in learning mathematics among fifth-grade students at SDN Kebalen 05. This study was motivated by the increasing use of generative AI as a learning tool and the low level of students’ interest in mathematics. A quantitative approach with a correlational survey design was employed. The population consisted of all fifth-grade students at SDN Kebalen 05, and a saturated sampling technique was used. Data were collected primarily through questionnaires, with observations, documentation, and interviews serving as supporting data. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and Pearson Product-Moment correlation analysis. The results showed a strong positive relationship between the use of generative AI, represented by ChatGPT and Google Gemini, and students’ interest in mathematics learning (r = 0.682, p < 0.001). This finding indicates that higher use of generative AI was associated with higher interest in mathematics learning among fifth-grade students. The findings suggest that the appropriate use of generative AI may provide teachers with complementary tools for creating more interactive mathematics learning experiences and may be considered in supporting students’ learning interest. The study provides practical implications for teachers in integrating AI-based learning tools appropriately as complementary resources in primary mathematics education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了五年级学生使用ChatGPT和Google Gemini等生成式人工智能与数学学习兴趣之间的关系，采用相关调查设计，以问卷为主、观察和访谈为辅收集数据。结果显示，生成式人工智能的使用与数学学习兴趣呈较强正相关，即使用越多，学习兴趣越高。作者据此认为，合理使用这类工具可为教师提供补充手段，帮助营造更具互动性的数学学习体验，但相关设计只能说明关联而非因果，结论受样本与情境限制。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence: Learning Flow in 30 Years
papers.authors: Otacílio Antunes Santana
papers.journal: AI Computer Science and Robotics Technology
papers.abstract: The rapid ubiquity of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has fundamentally disrupted traditional pedagogical frameworks in engineering education, necessitating a critical examination of its impact on cognitive development and knowledge retention. This longitudinal study spans 30 years (1996–2025) to analyse shifts in student learning curves within an AI curriculum, testing the hypothesis that reliance on automated tools exacerbates a ‘J-curve’ learning style, characterised by delayed engagement and terminal production spikes, at the expense of fundamental understanding. By comparing weekly topic acquisition and final assessment data across cohorts, the research reveals a distinct morphological transformation from the classic sigmoidal progression (‘S-curve’) of the baseline 1996 class to an exponential ‘J-curve’ in the 2025 cohort. While modern students demonstrate high procedural efficiency in project delivery, this shift correlates strongly with a significant decline in independent examination performance, where mean scores fell from 9.50 to 7.75. Although a gradual decline in performance was observed prior to 2020, the disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic and the subsequent ubiquity of generative AI tools may have intensified this trend (main finding). The data indicate that students utilise AI to bypass the cognitive friction necessary for deep learning, resulting in a failure to exit the assisted phase of skill acquisition. These findings suggest that current AI integration acts as a mechanism for cognitive offloading rather than scaffolding, creating a trade-off between immediate output and long-term declarative competence. The study concludes that engineering curricula must rigorously re-evaluate assessment strategies to ensure that the efficiency of automated generation does not erode the foundational logic required for sustainable innovation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于30年（1996—2025）的纵向课程数据，比较不同届学生在人工智能课程中的学习曲线与考核表现，以检验依赖自动化工具是否会加剧“J型”学习模式。结果显示，学习进程由早期届别的经典S型曲线转变为2025届的指数型J型曲线：学生在项目交付上表现出较高的程序性效率，但独立考试成绩明显下滑，且这一趋势在新冠疫情和生成式AI工具普及后可能进一步强化。作者据此认为，当前AI的融入更像认知卸载而非支架，使学生绕过深度学习所需的认知摩擦，形成即时产出与长期陈述性能力之间的权衡，并据此提出工程课程需重新评估考核方式。

papers.title: SAFE AND ETHICAL AI-BASED SELF-HEALING MENTORING FOR STUDENTS OF SMP NEGERI 30 MUARO JAMBI
papers.authors: Muhammad Alridho Lubis, Ninil Elfira, Utami Niki Kusaini, Desy Susanti, Dinny Rahmayanty, Nur Qomariah Panjaitan
papers.journal: PEMA (JURNAL PENDIDIKAN DAN PENGABDIAN KEPADA MASYARAKAT)
papers.abstract: The development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) provides opportunities for students to use technology as a tool to support self-reflection and emotional management. However, its use in the context of mental health requires an understanding of safety, ethics, privacy, and technological limitations. This community service program aimed to provide assistance to students in utilizing AI as a self-healing support tool in a safe, ethical, and responsible manner. The program was conducted at SMP Negeri 30 Muaro Jambi and involved 30 students and a school guidance and counseling teacher as a partner. The program employed a Participatory Action Research (PAR) approach through four stages: preparation, core implementation, evaluation, and sustainability. The activities included orientation and initial assessment, emotion and stress recognition, overthinking management, self-healing techniques, AI-assisted self-reflection, and education on the ethics and safety of AI use. Participant responses were evaluated among 24 students using a 1–4 scale instrument covering material comprehension, usefulness, delivery, media, comfort, application of knowledge, and interest in future activities. The evaluation results showed an overall mean score of 3.43 out of 4.00, equivalent to 85.74%, which was categorized as very good. The highest score was found in participants' interest in attending similar activities in the future (90.91%), while all evaluation indicators remained in the very good category. The program indicates that practice-based assistance can help students understand AI as a support tool for self-reflection while strengthening their awareness of privacy, safety, ethics, and the limitations of AI in the context of mental health. Program sustainability is directed toward integrating the materials into school guidance and counseling services and continuing support through the school guidance and counseling teacher.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何让初中生在心理健康场景中安全、合乎伦理地使用人工智能进行自我反思与情绪管理，并以某校30名学生和一名辅导教师为对象，采用参与式行动研究开展分阶段培训与陪伴。活动涵盖情绪与压力识别、过度思考管理、自我疗愈技巧、AI辅助自我反思以及AI使用伦理与安全教育。对24名学生的问卷评估显示，各指标总体均分处于“很好”水平，其中未来参加类似活动的兴趣得分最高。作者据此认为，基于实践的陪伴能帮助学生把AI理解为自我反思的辅助工具，同时增强其对隐私、安全、伦理及AI在心理健康领域局限性的意识，并建议将相关内容纳入学校辅导服务以延续支持。

papers.title: SHAPING SELF-REGULATED AND METACOGNITIVE LEARNING THROUGH ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND LEARNING ANALYTICS
papers.authors: Rhezwan Dhaifullah Romdhoni, Suprih Widodo, Ulva Elviani, Nuur Wachid Abdul Majid
papers.journal: PEMA (JURNAL PENDIDIKAN DAN PENGABDIAN KEPADA MASYARAKAT)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and learning analytics are increasingly embedded in educational systems, yet their implications for self-regulated learning (SRL) and metacognitive development remain only partially understood. This study conducts a systematic literature review of 34 empirical and review articles investigating AI-driven learning analytics in formal education settings, focusing on their impact on SRL, motivation, and academic performance. Following PRISMA-aligned procedures, the review identifies studies involving AI-based analytics tools, standardized SRL or metacognitive assessments, and empirical designs with pre–post or comparison data. The results indicate that AI-driven systems such as predictive models, adaptive platforms, chatbots, and generative AI can strengthen core SRL processes, increase motivation and engagement, and improve academic outcomes across diverse subjects and educational levels. However, the review also reveals persistent implementation challenges, including infrastructural limitations, teacher preparedness, privacy and ethical issues, and potential over-reliance on AI that may weaken independent strategic thinking. The article concludes that AI-driven learning analytics can meaningfully support SRL when embedded within coherent pedagogical frameworks and supported by institutional policies, and it outlines directions for future research on mechanisms, equity, and long-term effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了34项实证与综述文献，考察人工智能驱动的学习分析在正规教育中对自我调节学习、元认知发展与学业表现的影响。结果显示，预测模型、自适应平台、聊天机器人和生成式AI等系统能够强化自我调节学习的核心过程，提升动机与参与度，并在不同学科和教育阶段改善学业成绩；但实施中仍存在基础设施不足、教师准备不够、隐私伦理问题以及过度依赖AI可能削弱独立思考等挑战。作者据此指出，只有当AI学习分析嵌入连贯的教学框架并获得制度政策支持时，才能切实支持自我调节学习，并提出了关于作用机制、公平性和长期效果的研究方向。

papers.title: No single winner: Forecast combination versus neural and tree-based learners on short monthly time series
papers.authors: Heri Nurdiyanto, Abid Khan
papers.journal: Journal of Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning and Neural Network
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) methods are increasingly applied to business and environmental forecasting, yet many practical series are short and dominated by trend and seasonality, conditions under which classical statistical methods have performed strongly in large forecasting competitions. This study compares nine forecasting methods on six public monthly time series of 108–240 observations, covering airline traffic, retail sales, crime, climate and solar activity. The methods comprise naive and seasonal naive benchmarks, exponential smoothing (ETS), the Theta method, a seasonal ARIMA model, an equal-weight combination of the three statistical models (Comb), a multilayer perceptron (MLP), an MLP applied to seasonally adjusted data (MLP-DS) and gradient boosting (GB). Each method produced 12-month forecasts from 25 rolling origins per series, giving 1,350 multi-step forecasts evaluated with the mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and the symmetric mean absolute percentage error. The combination achieved the lowest average MASE (1.076), the best mean rank (3.75 of 9) and the smallest worst-case regret (1.42 times the best method on any series), and it improved on the seasonal naive benchmark at 74.7% of forecast origins. The ML methods were markedly heterogeneous: they were the most accurate family on the airline series (MLP-DS, MASE 0.562) and on the non-seasonal sunspot series (GB, 0.837), but among the least accurate on the car sales and robberies series, where their MASE exceeded that of the combination by 0.46–0.98. Seasonal adjustment improved the MLP on four of the six series. Differences between methods were not significant at the series level (Friedman p = 0.113), reflecting the small number of series. For short monthly series, a simple combination of statistical models is therefore the most reliable default, whereas ML methods should be adopted only after series-specific validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了统计模型、机器学习模型及其组合在短月度时间序列上的预测表现，使用六条公开序列进行滚动多步预测并以MASE等指标评估。结果显示，三种统计模型的等权组合平均误差最低、平均排名最好且最坏情况损失最小，并在多数预测起点上优于季节朴素基准；机器学习方法表现分化明显，在部分序列上最准确，在另一些序列上则明显不如组合。作者据此认为，对短月度序列而言简单统计组合是更可靠的默认选择，机器学习方法需经序列层面的验证后再采用，同时指出方法间差异在序列层面并不显著，且受序列数量较少的限制。

papers.title: Argument-First Versus Language-First Generative AI Feedback in Chinese EFL Argumentative Writing: A Randomized Study
papers.authors: Jianying Lyu
papers.abstract: This eight-week randomized study examined how the order of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) feedback shaped revision and near-term independent writing among 132 Chinese English-as-a-foreign-language (EFL) undergraduates. Students received argument-first (AF; n = 67) or language-first (LF; n = 65) feedback; 64 pairs underwent within-class, within-pair randomization, and four unmatched students were randomized within class. Both modules were independently generated from each initial draft (D0) and locked before release. Students completed two revisions (D1 and D2) across three tasks and a new-topic, AI-free transfer task. Adjusted AF–LF differences in D0–D2 change favored AF for overall quality (0.811 points, 95% CI [0.424, 1.198]) and argumentation (1.102 points, 95% CI [0.668, 1.536]), but not language quality (0.020 points, 95% CI [−0.381, 0.420]). Revision depth and implementation showed stage-specific crossovers. Language contrasts did not survive primary Holm adjustment, although complete-pair sensitivity analysis detected a crossover. Argumentation transfer favored AF (1.057 points, 95% CI [0.508, 1.606]); overall transfer was less consistent, with the complete-pair interval including zero (0.685 points, 95% CI [−0.111, 1.481]). Module type was structurally linked to release stage, so stage-specific contrasts describe sequence-by-stage configurations rather than isolated content or order effects. The findings support cautious use of staged feedback when argumentative development is the instructional priority.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式人工智能反馈的呈现顺序如何影响中国英语学习者的议论文修改与短期独立写作，采用为期八周的随机设计，比较“论证优先”与“语言优先”两种反馈安排。结果显示，论证优先反馈在整体质量和论证质量上带来更大的修改提升，但在语言质量上未见差异；在无AI辅助的新题目迁移任务中，论证表现同样偏向论证优先，整体迁移结果则较不一致。作者指出，反馈模块类型与释放阶段存在结构性关联，因此阶段差异应理解为顺序与阶段配置的组合效应，而非孤立的内容或顺序效应，并据此建议在以论证发展为教学重点时谨慎采用分阶段反馈。

papers.title: Causal Machine Learning to Estimate the Impact of Using Generative AI on Students' GPA And Skill Retention
papers.authors: Angelina Hadriani, Ade Sumaedi, Layli Ana, Sugiyanti Sugiyanti, Yuni Yulistiani
papers.journal: Al adzkiya International of Computer Science and Information Technology (AIoCSIT) Journal
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in higher education raises questions about its effects on academic performance and durable skills. This study evaluates the adjusted relationship between GenAI usage, GPA Change, and Skill Retention Score using 50,000 student records. Weekly GenAI Hours is treated as the exposure, while academic, behavioral, institutional, and psychological characteristics are included as adjustment covariates. A cross-fitted Double Machine Learning workflow is supported by overlap diagnostics, continuous-treatment sensitivity analysis, quartile comparison, and exploratory heterogeneous-effect analysis. High GenAI usage is associated with higher GPA Change (ATE = 0.0328; 95% CI: 0.0297–0.0358) and Skill Retention Score (ATE = 0.8098; 95% CI: 0.5733–1.0464). The quartile comparison shows the same direction. However, each additional weekly GenAI hour is associated with lower skill retention (ATE = −0.1096; 95% CI: −0.1298 to −0.0895). Thus, greater usage intensity does not necessarily indicate deeper learning. Because the data are observational, the estimates remain conditional on measured covariates. Universities should promote GenAI as a structured learning aid while preserving independent reasoning and sustained skill development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用五万条学生记录，采用交叉拟合的双重机器学习方法，在调整学业、行为、院校与心理特征后，考察生成式AI使用时长与GPA变化及技能保持之间的调整关联。结果显示，较高的生成式AI使用与GPA变化和技能保持得分呈正相关，分位数比较方向一致；但每增加一小时的周使用时长，技能保持反而下降。作者据此指出，使用强度更高并不必然意味着学习更深入，并建议高校将生成式AI作为有结构的学习辅助工具，同时维护学生的独立推理与持续技能发展。由于数据为观察性，相关估计仍以已测量的协变量为条件。

papers.title: Editors’ Words
papers.authors: Симеон Василев
papers.abstract: Issue No. 69 of Rhetoric and Communications continues the tradition of publishing research findings obtained through both traditional and contemporary methods, focusing on new and rapidly evolving fields of analysis, such as artificial intelligence, digitalization, the media ecosystem, and changes in education at the university and school levels. This issue brings together 12 scholarly articles in two sections. The first one is titled “Communication in Media and Society”, and two of the articles in this section are devoted to fact-checking, a topical issue in contemporary media and communication studies. In one article, researchers Milen Filipov and Nilufar Sulaimonova present findings related to an analysis of fact-checking activities in the media in Kazakhstan. In the second article, Tihomira Doncheva presents the results of a study on fact-checking and the use of artificial intelligence. The second area of research focuses on the media in Bulgaria. Aneta Milkova examines the legal framework, the limits of media regulation, and communication. Tanya Dimova discusses the functions of the Bulgarian National Radio, emphasizing the cultural role of the “Hristo Botev” program while taking into account changes in the digital media landscape. Alexander Blagoev presents the results of a study on social identity in communication through memes and participation in online challenges. Damyan Bumbalov clarifies, from a theoretical and methodological perspective, the scope and content of the concept of “monumental sculpture” and its communicative functions in public space. The second section includes interesting publications in which rhetoric and communication are studied in university and school settings. Faculty members from two universities in Ukraine – Mykola Chursin, Halyna Shevchenko, Tetiana Antonenko, and Tetiana Zinovieva – present the results of a timely and in-depth theoretical review related to changes in higher education resulting from technological transformations and the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into the educational process. The topic of artificial intelligence is also addressed in several other articles. Radeya Gesheva analyzes the transformations in the didactics of foreign-language literature in the era of artificial intelligence, focusing on Italian literature, for the teaching of which she provides many excellent practical examples in terms of methodology. Rhetoric is explored in new and interesting fields from a scholarly and methodological perspective: art, theater, education, and teaching in academic and school settings. Evgenia Roeva presents the findings of a study on the application of rhetoric and public speaking in education and its intersections with educational theater when working with elementary school students. Ralitsa Bezhan presents the results of a study on fundamental rhetorical canons from Aristotle to the era of artificial intelligence, contemporary theatrical performances and productions, and chatbots. Irena Shunina presents, in a captivating and compelling manner, the rhetoric of the heart and ethics in Shalva Amonashvili’s humanistic pedagogy. Boyan Zahariev highlights the specifics of pedagogical communication when using the LEGO® Serious Play® method: spatial projections and social identity as the result of field observation and a pedagogical experiment with Roma students from a neighborhood school
papers.summary_zh: 该文是《Rhetoric and Communications》第69期的编者按，概述了本期刊发的12篇学术文章，分属“媒体与社会中的传播”和“大学与学校场景中的修辞与传播”两个板块。前者涉及哈萨克斯坦媒体的事实核查、人工智能在事实核查中的使用、保加利亚媒体监管与广播文化功能、网络模因与在线挑战中的社会身份，以及公共空间中纪念性雕塑的传播功能；后者包括乌克兰高校学者关于技术变革与人工智能融入高等教育所致变化的理论综述，以及人工智能时代外语文学教学法、教育戏剧中的修辞应用、从亚里士多德到人工智能时代的修辞准则与聊天机器人、人文主义教学中的修辞伦理，还有LEGO® Serious Play®方法下的教学传播研究。编者按本身未报告独立实证结果，仅归纳各文主题。

papers.title: The “Breath” of Persuasion: Corporeality as the Missing Link between Classical Rhetoric and Discourse in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Ralitsa Kovacheva-Bezhan
papers.abstract: Abstract: The article examines the classical Aristotelian model of persuasion, based on the triad of ethos, pathos, and logos, but from a new and different perspective, namely, within the context of corporeality and embodied cognition (embodiment). According to this understanding, the mind, thought, and language do not exist independently of the body but are directly conditioned by our physical experience and senses. The hypothesis is that the deficit of artificial intelligence in comparison with the living orator is not merely moral or value-based – it is, above all, physical: generative models have no breath, weight, spontaneity, or presence here and now. This bodily absence underlies what classical rhetoric describes abstractly as the absence of ethos and pathos. The methodology is innovative and incorporates auto-cyberethnographic observation, as well as internal and external observation. The analysis is based on three stage experiments (Improbotics, Annie Dorsen, and Interrobang / Chatbot Challenge), in which the boundary between machine-generated and live performance is literally tested before an audience, complemented by the evocative power of the literary voice of Zdravka Evtimova. Three forms of art – literature, theatre, and oratory – are examined from a creative and a methodological perspective that has not been explored to date. The conclusions drawn from the analysis indicate that rhetorical education, which may form part of actors’ training during and beyond the third decade of the 21st century, at a time when artificial intelligence is developing and being increasingly utilized dynamically, requires a return to the body – to voice, breathing, and presence – as a primary rather than a secondary source of persuasiveness. Keywords: Artificial intelligence, rhetoric, corporeality, embodied cognition (embodiment), ethos, pathos, logos, performance, breath, presence.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从身体性与具身认知的角度重新审视亚里士多德以信誉、情感和逻辑为核心的古典说服模型，提出生成式人工智能与真人演说者的关键差距不只是道德或价值层面的，更是身体层面的：模型没有呼吸、重量、即兴性和此时此地的在场感，而这种身体缺席正是古典修辞所说的信誉与情感缺失的根源。作者采用自动网络民族志观察与内外观察相结合的方法，依据三场舞台实验并结合文学声音的表现力展开分析，涉及文学、戏剧与演说三种艺术形式。结论认为，在人工智能日益普及的背景下，修辞教育应把声音、呼吸与在场重新视为说服力的首要来源而非次要因素。

papers.title: Rethinking the Development Paradigm in Higher Education: Educational Communication in the Age of Technological Transformation
papers.authors: Mykola Chursin, Halyna Shevchenko, Тетяна Антоненко, Tetiana Zinovieva
papers.abstract: Abstract. This article critically re-examines the educational “development paradigm” as a foundational methodological assumption of higher education in the context of accelerating technological transformation and artificial intelligence. It is argued that the traditional understanding of development as an inherently positive educational objective requires critical reconsideration. It is demonstrated that human development, technological development, and educational development no longer represent convergent trajectories and therefore should be conceptualised as complementary yet analytically distinct dimensions. Based on theoretical analysis, comparative interpretation, and critical synthesis of interdisciplinary scholarship, the growing divergence between the exponential dynamics of technological innovation and the cognitive, ethical, and communicative capacities of human beings is examined. Particular attention is devoted to educational communication as the principal mechanism through which knowledge is co-constructed, meanings are negotiated, and human agency is sustained within technology-mediated learning environments. The concepts of sustainable development, limits to growth, limits of destruction, posthumanism, and technological singularity are analysed in relation to their implications for higher education. It is substantiated that technological innovation should be evaluated not solely in terms of efficiency and economic performance but also according to its contribution to human flourishing, ethical responsibility, and democratic participation. It is concluded that the educational “development paradigm” should be reconceptualised as a differentiated methodological framework integrating technological progress with human agency, communicative ecosystems, educational communication, and future-oriented education in an AI-mediated society. Keywords: higher education, educational “development paradigm”, pedagogical communication, AI-mediated communication, posthumanism, communicative ecosystems; future-oriented education.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一项理论分析，重新审视高等教育中以“发展”为内在积极目标的发展范式，并结合技术加速与人工智能背景，比较阐释跨学科研究。作者指出，人的发展、技术发展与教育发展已不再趋同，应被视为互补但分析上彼此区分的维度；技术创新呈指数式动态，而人的认知、伦理与沟通能力相对滞后，二者差距扩大。文章强调教育沟通是技术在媒介化学习环境中共同建构知识、协商意义并维系人的能动性的主要机制，并据此主张将发展范式重构为整合技术进步、人的能动性、沟通生态与未来导向教育的差异化方法论框架，且技术评价不应只看效率与经济表现。

papers.title: Transformations in the Didactics of Foreign-language Literature in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Radeya Gesheva
papers.abstract: Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into education is transforming how literary texts are read, interpreted, linguistically mediated, and assessed, as well as how the significance and cultural status of their authors are conceptualised. This article examines transformations in the didactics of foreign-language literature, with particular emphasis on Italian literature and the teaching of Italian as a foreign language. It explores the potential of generative AI for personalised learning, linguistic support, engagement with authentic literary texts, comparative analysis of human-generated and AI-generated interpretations, translation, the development of intercultural competence, and the cultivation of AI literacy. Particular attention is devoted to the methodological potential of the Italian literary tradition, extending from Dante and Petrarca to contemporary Italian literature with examples such as Pirandello and Calvino. The central hypothesis is that artificial intelligence should be regarded neither as a substitute for the professor or for the practice of literary reading, nor merely as a technical instrument or as a means of employing specialised software. The analysis suggests that a more appropriate framework for philological education is a human-centred pedagogical model for the teaching of literature and foreign languages at university level. Within such a model, technological tools, software applications, and algorithms function as instruments for fostering critical thinking and for integrating traditional and contemporary approaches into academic communication and university teaching. Artificial intelligence can be productively employed in the formulation of questions by both lecturers and students throughout the educational process; it can support interpretation and comparative analysis, facilitate the verification of claims and arguments, and, in certain contexts, encourage critical reflection on the reading process itself. In conclusion, the article proposes an expanded didactic model that integrates literary, linguistic, intercultural, digital, and AI literacy, thereby reconceptualising the teaching and learning of foreign-language literature in the context of contemporary higher education. Keywords: foreign-language literature, Italian literature, literary didactics, artificial intelligence, academic communication, philological education.
