papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨人工智能融入教育后，外语文学教学法（尤其意大利文学及意大利语外语教学）应如何转变。作者提出，AI既不应取代教师或文学阅读实践，也不应仅被视为技术工具，而应纳入以人为中心的教学模式，用于辅助提问、支持解释与比较分析、核查论点，并促进对阅读过程本身的批判反思。文章据此提出一个整合文学、语言、跨文化、数字与AI素养的扩展教学模型，重新界定当代高等教育中外国语言文学的教学与学习。全文以理论论述为主，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: Face Mood Detection Using Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: G. Bhavani, P. Drakishyani, Dr. L. Kiran Kumar Reddy
papers.journal: International Scientific Journal of Engineering and Management
papers.abstract: Face Mood Detection Using Artificial Intelligence is a web-based application developed to recognize human emotions from facial expressions using Artificial Intelligence (AI), Deep Learning and Computer Vision techniques. The application provides a secure user authentication system using Firebase Authentication, allowing users to register, log in and create a personal profile, which is stored in the Firebase Realtime Database. After successful login, users can detect their emotions using three input methods: Browser Camera, Local Webcam or Image Upload. The system uses OpenCV for face detection and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model developed with TensorFlow/Keras to classify facial expressions into six emotions: Happy, Sad, Angry, Fear, Neutral and Disgust. The application is built with Streamlit, providing an interactive interface for emotion detection. Along with the detected emotion, the system displays the prediction confidence score and personalized AI-generated emotional insights. As an additional feature, it provides music and movie suggestions based on the detected mood, enhancing user interaction with suitable entertainment recommendations. By integrating AI, image processing, cloud-based services and recommendation features, the project demonstrates a practical and user-friendly approach to facial emotion recognition, with potential applications in emotional well-being awareness, education, healthcare, human-computer interaction and smart assistance systems. Keywords: Facial Emotion Recognition, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Convolutional Neural Network, OpenCV, Computer Vision, Streamlit, Firebase, Mood-Based Recommendation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究实现了一个基于网页的面部情绪检测应用，采用OpenCV进行人脸检测，并用TensorFlow/Keras构建的卷积神经网络将表情分为高兴、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧、中性、厌恶六类，用户可通过浏览器摄像头、本地摄像头或上传图片输入。系统在显示识别情绪的同时给出预测置信度和AI生成的情绪解读，并据此推荐音乐和电影。文章将这一整合了图像处理、云服务与推荐功能的原型定位为面向情绪健康意识、教育、医疗、人机交互和智能辅助等场景的实用尝试，但摘要未报告识别准确率或用户评估结果。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-supported approaches in adult attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: From diagnosis to personalized care
papers.authors: Asena Köse, Bahar Çiftçi
papers.abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a chronic neurodevelopmental disorder that begins in childhood and persists into adulthood in a significant proportion of cases.Adult ADHD requires lifelong, holistic care due to the negative effects it has on academic, occupational, social, and psychological functioning, in addition to inattention, impulsivity, and executive function impairments.However, difficulties in the diagnostic process, the heterogeneous nature of symptoms, the high prevalence of comorbidities, and challenges in ensuring continuity of care limit the effectiveness of current care approaches.Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies have led to growing interest in their potential to support more objective, continuous, and personalized approaches to the assessment and management of ADHD in adults; however, evidence demonstrating clinical benefit remains limited.In this review, AI-supported care approaches for ADHD in adults have been evaluated from a nursing care perspective in line with the current literature.In this context, the review addresses care needs in adult ADHD and examines current and potential applications of AI in early assessment and risk identification, continuous symptom monitoring, personalized care planning, treatment adherence, patient education, self-management, clinical decision support, and remote care.From a nursing perspective, the review considers the potential implications of AI-supported applications for individualized care, continuity of care, patient participation, self-management, and clinical decision support, while distinguishing these potential benefits from outcomes that have been directly demonstrated in adults with ADHD.Current challenges, such as data security, patient privacy, algorithmic bias, digital health literacy, and integration into clinical practice, were also assessed.Overall, AI represents an emerging and potentially complementary approach rather than an established component of routine adult ADHD care.Current evidence remains preliminary and heterogeneous, particularly regarding patient-important and nursing-3 / 50 sensitive outcomes; therefore, further prospective, externally validated, and real-world studies are needed before widespread clinical implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述从护理视角梳理人工智能在成人注意缺陷多动障碍照护中的应用，涉及早期评估与风险识别、症状持续监测、个性化照护计划、治疗依从性、患者教育、自我管理、临床决策支持和远程照护等环节。文章指出，现有证据仍属初步且异质，尤其在患者重要结局和护理敏感结局方面，尚不足以证明临床获益；数据安全、隐私、算法偏倚、数字健康素养及临床整合等也是现实挑战。总体而言，AI被视为成人ADHD常规照护中新兴的潜在补充手段，而非已确立的组成部分，其广泛临床应用仍需前瞻性、外部验证和真实世界研究支持。

papers.title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics into Marketing Education: The Digital-Ready Marketing Education Framework for Developing Graduates in Emerging Economies
papers.authors: Felix Augustine, Hilda Afeku-Amenyo, Temitope Ademola, Kolawole Olufade, Jide Okedeji, Damisola Adewoye
papers.journal: Emirati Journal of Business Economics & Social Studies
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and data analytics are reshaping marketing practice, yet many universities in emerging economies have been slow to reflect these changes in their curricula. Limited digital infrastructure, inadequate faculty expertise, and concerns about the ethical use of AI continue to constrain curriculum reform. This study develops the DigitalReady Marketing Education Framework (DRMEF) to guide the integration of AI and data analytics into marketing education. Drawing on a conceptual theory-building approach, the study synthesizes literature on AI, marketing education, technology adoption, and digital competency development. The analysis shows that effective integration depends on four closely connected elements: digital infrastructure, curriculum redesign, faculty capability, and ethical AI governance. The framework highlights that preparing graduates for data-driven marketing requires more than technology adoption; it also demands institutional commitment and continuous curriculum development, offering a practical guide for higher education institutions in emerging economies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对新兴经济体高校营销课程在人工智能与数据分析融入上的滞后问题，提出了“数字就绪营销教育框架”（DRMEF）。研究采用概念性理论构建方法，综合人工智能、营销教育、技术采纳与数字能力发展等文献，指出有效整合依赖数字基础设施、课程重构、教师能力和人工智能伦理治理四个紧密关联的要素。框架强调，培养适应数据驱动营销的毕业生不能只靠引入技术，还需要机构层面的投入和持续的课程开发，为新兴经济体高等教育机构提供了实践指引。

papers.title: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence Tools to Support Pronunciation Practice Among Non-English Major EFL Students
papers.authors: Vu Mai Yen Tran, Nguyen Tran Uyen Nhi
papers.abstract: Although AI-powered speech technologies have shown promise for L2 pronunciation learning, little is known about the efficacy of combining complementary AI-powered tools for out-of-class pronunciation practice among Vietnamese non-English majors, particularly in terms of aligning AI-based error detection and teacher assessment. This study investigates the integration of Speechify and Speechnotes to support pronunciation self-practice among 35 first-year non-English major EFL students at a public university in Vietnam. Data were gathered through a descriptive survey (N=35) and semi-structured interviews (n=10). Results showed that students responded positively to the simultaneous use of these two tools, with all interviewed participants expressing satisfaction and 85,7% valuing Speechnotes’ real-time visual feedback for error detection. Speechnotes’ error-detection capability also showed partial alignment with teacher judgments in identifying segmental errors, including omitted final sounds and vowel contrasts. Along with future advancements in AI tool features, this study offers valuable insights to improve the quality of pronunciation instruction for non-English major students, foster greater engagement and motivation in pronunciation practice, and ultimately support foreign language learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在越南非英语专业学生课外发音练习中同时使用Speechify与Speechnotes两种AI语音工具的效果，并关注AI错误检测与教师评估之间的一致性。研究通过描述性问卷调查和半结构化访谈收集数据，发现学生对两种工具并用反应积极，受访者普遍满意，多数人认可Speechnotes的实时视觉反馈有助于发现发音错误；其错误检测在识别部分音段错误（如词尾音省略和元音对比）上与教师判断仅部分一致。文章据此讨论了AI工具辅助发音教学的应用潜力，同时提示AI检测与教师评估尚不完全吻合这一限制。

papers.title: Developing a Risk-Based Intellectual Property Governance Framework for Generative Artificial Intelligence: A Comparative Analysis of the Eu Ai Act, Uk, and Us Legal Systems
papers.authors: Srija Yerram
papers.journal: American Journal of Society and Law
papers.abstract: This paper develops a risk-based intellectual property (IP) governance framework for generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) through doctrinal, comparative, and normative analysis of the European Union (EU), the United Kingdom (UK), and the United States (US). It covers copyright and related IP challenges in data acquisition, model training, output creation, and commercial deployment, as well as the distribution of control, transparency, attribution, and liability in each jurisdiction. The analysis reveals that the EU has several text-and-data-mining exceptions and copyright-policy and training-content-summary obligations for general-purpose AI providers, while the UK has a very limited non-commercial research exception and a unique statutory exception for computer-generated works, and the US is driven primarily by the human-authorship doctrine and fact-specific fair-use analysis. While these strategies offer valuable protections, none alone establish a comprehensive system of organisational control. The study thus suggests an auditing framework linked to the legal basis, data provenance, licenses, human contribution to creativity, output testing, documentation, accountability and escalation, and periodic reassessment, according to the proportionate degree of risk. Rather than harmonizing the three legal systems, the framework sets out a common organizational process for identifying and managing differences in the three legal systems to safeguard the rights holders and to allow for responsible innovation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文通过教义、比较与规范分析，考察欧盟、英国和美国在生成式人工智能数据获取、模型训练、输出创作与商业部署中的知识产权挑战及控制、透明、署名与责任分配。分析发现，欧盟设有文本与数据挖掘例外及通用人工智能提供者的版权政策和训练内容摘要义务，英国仅有范围有限的研究例外和计算机生成作品的法定例外，美国则主要依赖人类作者原则和依事实判断的合理使用。作者据此提出与法律依据、数据来源、许可、人类创造性贡献、输出测试、文档、问责升级和定期复评挂钩、按风险比例调整的审计框架，旨在为三法域差异提供共同的组织管理流程，而非实现法律协调。

papers.title: AI washing in corporate finance: conceptual foundations, measurement, economic consequences and future directions
papers.authors: 蔡永政
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Economics and Policy Studies
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become the most attractive label in corporate strategy narratives, yet the intensity with which firms talk about AI has begun to diverge systematically from what they actually do. This phenomenon is known as AI washing. Drawing on four core empirical studies, this paper reviews the corporate finance literature on AI washing. This study develops an operational definition—a positive gap between AI Talk (disclosure) and AI Walk (substantive investment)—and delimit it against greenwashing, digital washing and impression management. This study explains why the gap pays through signalling, information asymmetry and image management, and identify cognitive dissonance as a countervailing corrective force. This study catalogues how existing work measures the construct and assess the validity of each proxy. Three outcome chains are synthesized: AI washing increases access to bank loans but not necessarily the quality of the money obtained; it has an inverted U-shaped effect on the technological gap; and it inflates investor optimism, widens analyst disagreement and raises crash risk. This study examines who can detect AI washing and conclude with seven directions for future research, arguing that the field's next step is a systematic answer to why firms wash, who believes them, who detects them, and what the practice buys against what it costs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕企业财务中的“AI 洗白”现象展开综述，将其界定为 AI 话语披露与实质投入之间的正向落差，并与漂绿、数字洗白和印象管理相区分。作者基于四项核心实证研究梳理了该构念的测量方式及其代理效度，并归纳出三条后果链：AI 洗白有助于企业获得银行贷款，但未必提升所获资金的质量；对技术差距呈倒 U 形影响；还会推高投资者乐观情绪、加大分析师分歧并抬升股价崩盘风险。文章进一步讨论了谁能够识别 AI 洗白，并提出未来研究方向。

papers.title: Research on Generative AI-Empowered Formative Assessment of Maritime English: Evaluation Indicators and Practical Paths
papers.authors: Xiang Huang
papers.abstract: The Manila Amendments to the STCW Convention set compliance requirements for seafarers’ maritime communicative competence; however, higher-vocational Maritime English assessment still relies mainly on summative final-term evaluation, with high oral-assessment costs and delayed feedback. Drawing on the Outcomes-Based Education (OBE) philosophy and formative assessment theory, and supported by generative AI and intelligent speech-judgment technology, this study constructs a three-dimensional evaluation indicator system and designs a human-AI collaborative assessment closed loop of “pre-class diagnosis, in-class dynamic monitoring, and post-class iterative feedback”. A 16-week quasi-experiment shows that this model significantly improves students’ maritime English communicative competence, with the largest gain in the oral dimension (18.7% improvement in the experimental class versus 5.3% in the control class), and enhances students’ learning initiative. The study also analyzes the validity defects and academic-integrity risks of AI-driven assessment and proposes human-AI collaborative verification mechanisms, providing practical references for curriculum assessment reform of higher-vocational Maritime English and for STCW-aligned talent training.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对高职海事英语评价仍以终结性考试为主、口语评估成本高且反馈滞后的问题，基于成果导向教育理念和形成性评价理论，借助生成式人工智能与智能语音评判技术，构建了三维评价指标体系及“课前诊断—课中动态监测—课后迭代反馈”的人机协同评价闭环。为期16周的准实验显示，该模式显著提升了学生的海事英语交际能力，其中口语维度增幅最大，实验班提升18.7%，对照班为5.3%，同时增强了学生的学习主动性。文章还分析了人工智能驱动评价的效度缺陷与学术诚信风险，并提出人机协同核验机制，为高职海事英语课程评价改革及对接STCW公约的人才培养提供参考。

papers.title: Institutional Responses to Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education: A Comparative Cross-Regional Analysis of Universities’ AI Policies
papers.authors: Nato Pachuashvili
papers.abstract: The surge in Artificial Intelligence (AI) has prompted higher education institutions to reconsider academic integrity principles and formalise AI policy at universities. Many international universities have already adopted AI policies, promoting AI governance to ensure the responsible use of AI. The objective of this paper is to compare the current institutional policies on AI integration in the academic context across universities and investigate the fundamental components of the regulatory framework. The study applied qualitative comparative analysis to the AI policies of international universities across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Australia, and Oceania, using the following metrics: scope, ethical priorities, permitted and prohibited uses, and contributing factors. The findings of this study revealed that there is no universal AI policy. AI policies vary significantly across regions, reflecting differences in AI governance. AI regulation is explicitly categorised and controlled in Europe, North America, and the Australia/Oceania region, whereas minimal restrictions are imposed at universities in the Middle East. The outcomes of this study significantly contribute to a broader discussion on AI governance in higher education institutions and its successful implementation in educational practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了欧洲、北美、中东、澳大利亚和大洋洲等地国际高校在学术场景中的人工智能政策，采用定性比较分析，从政策范围、伦理优先事项、允许与禁止的用途及影响因素等维度考察其监管框架。研究发现并不存在普遍适用的人工智能政策，各区域政策差异显著，反映出治理思路的不同：欧洲、北美及澳大利亚/大洋洲对人工智能使用有明确的分类管控，而中东地区高校的限制相对较少。作者据此讨论了这些差异对高等教育机构人工智能治理及其在教学实践中落地的影响。

papers.title: Digital Transformation: Artificial Intelligence Adoption of Small Medium Enterprises in Gauteng
papers.authors: Tshepo Buxton  Mosuwe
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is now a crucial element in the transforming of industries globally, propelled by greater development in computational processing, cloud and computational services, and deep learning technologies. Its uses, ranging from chatbots to self-driving cars, are becoming more widespread, presenting the opportunity to enhance organizational efficiency by as much as 40%. In light of global competitiveness and digital transformation, which have been induced by the COVID-19 era, AI is crucial, especially for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). Nevertheless, SMEs face considerable obstacles to AI acceptance, such as financial and technical limitations, restricted access to advanced technologies, and a shortage of skilled personnel. These issues hinder their productivity and competitiveness within the national economy. This research investigates the elements that affect AI acceptance in the landscape of SMEs in Gauteng, with the goal of identifying barriers, evaluating the impact of managerial leadership, and assessing the use of AI in operations. A sample of 118 stakeholders, including owners, managers, and strategic employees from various backgrounds, was analysed, excluding large corporations and government entities. The study focuses on the ICT sector, exploring technological, organizational, environmental, and ethical aspects of AI implementation. The capstone report aims to formulate strategies that assist SMEs in overcoming challenges related to digital transformation, offering an introduction, literature review, methodology, analysis, and strategic recommendations specifically designed for the South African context. This research demonstrates that AI adoption among Gauteng's SMEs stands at a critical inflection point. Strong awareness of AI's potential combines with substantial adoption intentions, creating conditions for rapid diffusion. However, realising this potential requires coordinated action addressing identified barriers through organisational capability building, ecosystem enablement, and supportive policy frameworks. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence, Technology, Environment, Organisation, SMEs
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察南非豪登省中小企业在数字化转型中采纳人工智能的影响因素，以ICT行业为背景，对业主、管理者和战略员工等利益相关者进行了调查分析。研究发现，当地中小企业对AI潜力有较强认知，采纳意愿也较高，正处于快速扩散的关键节点；但资金与技术限制、先进技术获取渠道有限以及技能人才短缺等障碍仍制约其落地。作者据此提出，释放这一潜力需要组织能力建设、生态系统支持与政策框架的协同配合，而非单一企业层面的努力。

papers.title: Beyond Parallel Domains: An Asymmetric Ecological Framework for AI-Mediated EFL in Saudi Arabia
papers.authors: Khalid Al-Seghayer
papers.journal: Journal for the Study of English Linguistics
papers.abstract: English language education in Saudi Arabia is undergoing transforming amid broader economic, educational, and technological reforms. English plays an important role in higher education, professional development, internationalization, and participation in the knowledge-based economy, while young Saudis increasingly engage with English through social media, entertainment, gaming, and digital communication. Generative AI is also reshaping how learners access, produce, practice, and evaluate language. However, Saudi EFL research often treats language policy, classroom practice, learner attitudes, and technology as separate domains, potentially obscuring their dynamic interactions. Drawing on language policy and planning, language ecology, human-capital perspectives, and sociocultural approaches, this conceptual article proposes the Saudi EFL Ecological Transformation Framework (SEETF). The framework conceptualizes Saudi EFL as a dynamic ecology shaped by three interacting forces: language policy, economic transformation, and youth language practices, with generative AI functioning as a cross-cutting mediating force that alters the speed, visibility, and form of these interactions. It emphasizes policy enactment, learner agency, informal language practices, and asymmetries in influence and in the pace of change across institutional and societal contexts. The article advances seven conceptual propositions and argues that the future of Saudi EFL depends not on expanding English instruction but on coordinating these forces across differing timescales and degrees of institutional control.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性文章，针对沙特阿拉伯英语外语教育研究中语言政策、课堂实践、学习者态度与技术常被割裂处理的问题，提出沙特英语外语生态转型框架（SEETF）。框架将沙特英语外语教育视为由语言政策、经济转型与青年语言实践三种力量互动构成的动态生态，并把生成式人工智能定位为贯穿其中、改变这些互动速度、可见度与形态的中介力量，强调政策实施、学习者能动性、非正式语言实践以及机构与社会情境间影响和变化节奏的不对称。文章据此提出七项概念性命题，认为沙特英语外语教育的未来不在于扩大英语教学，而在于在不同时间尺度与机构控制程度上协调上述力量。

papers.title: Building a Culture of Privacy and Security for Competitive Advantage
papers.authors: Mahendra Samarawickrama
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This opening keynote, delivered at the Sydney Data Protection and Security Summit 2026 at ICC Sydney on 22 October 2026, examined how privacy and security culture shapes an organisation's capacity to adopt artificial intelligence responsibly and competitively. It argued that AI transformation is moving beyond agentic AI towards autonomous AI, meaning systems that act, decide and adapt with calculated risk and a human on the loop. As autonomy increases, governance can no longer rely on compliance controls alone and must be embedded in the values, behaviours and decision-making practices of the organisation. The keynote addressed three themes. These were the development of a privacy-first mindset that prepares every level of the organisation for autonomous AI, the integration of privacy and security by design into AI-enabled products and services as both a regulatory requirement and a source of market differentiation, and the role of cross-functional teams in anticipating and mitigating the data protection risks that autonomous systems introduce. The presentation concluded that organisations with a mature privacy and security culture are better positioned to earn stakeholder trust, adopt autonomous AI with confidence and sustain long-term competitive advantage.
papers.summary_zh: 该主旨演讲探讨隐私与安全文化如何影响组织负责任且具竞争力地采用人工智能，核心论点是随着AI从代理式走向自主式，治理不能仅依赖合规控制，而须嵌入组织的价值观、行为与决策实践。演讲围绕三个主题展开：培养面向自主AI的隐私优先思维、将隐私与安全设计融入AI产品和服务以兼顾监管要求与市场差异化，以及跨职能团队在预判和缓解自主系统数据保护风险中的作用。演讲结论认为，隐私与安全文化成熟的组织更易赢得利益相关者信任、更有信心采用自主AI并维持长期竞争优势；上述判断属演讲主张，摘要未提供实证检验。

papers.title: Sovereign Subsea Infrastructure under Coercive State Seizure and Geopolitical Contagion: Project Dawlish Dual Physical-Legal Deterrence (DAS / ML-KEM-768 & UNCLOS/ISDS DCF Valuation), Strategic Divestment from Dual-Use Orbital Assets, and the Three-Year Platform 37 Execution Architecture
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: 【English Abstract】 As hyperscale artificial general intelligence (AGI) and fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) transition from experimental clusters to planetary-scale critical infrastructure, passive reliance on dual-use Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations and unprotected terrestrial landing stations exposes enterprise parent entities to existential sovereign expropriation and geopolitical contagion risks. Building upon the foundational Project Dawlish subsea architecture (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23577921), this monograph formalizes the executive governance, cryptographic hardware enforcement, and corporate finance protocols required to guarantee sovereign infrastructure autonomy. First, we address the compliance and legal threat of coercive state seizure of cable landing stations (CLS) or submarine trunks under pretexts of "national security." We formulate a dual physical-legal defense scheme combining Distributed Acoustic Sensing (phi-OTDR DAS) with deterministic sub-millisecond Post-Quantum Cryptographic key zeroization (NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768) via Dynamic Denial, instantaneously reducing seized optoelectronic transponders to inert, non-communicating silica ("bricked glass"), paired with automatic United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and Investor-State Dispute Settlement (ISDS) arbitration claims priced via Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Fair Market Value (FMV). Second, we resolve the chief financial officer (CFO) capital allocation dilemma regarding passive equity holdings in militarized orbital assets (SpaceX / Starshield), proving that phased divestment constitutes Maximum Value Defense against enterprise-wide ESG impairment and regulatory contagion, while full capital reallocation into Project Dawlish and Control Barrier Function Quadratic Programming (CBF-QP) hardware interlocks secures long-term Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) optimization. Finally, we codify the Three-Year Executive Commitment at Platform 37 (London), co-locating physical-layer security engineering with DeepMind and Quantum AI core teams to integrate Physical Defense Layers, 0.5-nanosecond deterministic latency control, and Human-in-Command (HIC) statutory governance over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1). 【日本語要旨】 本論文は、「プロジェクト・ドーリッシュ(Project Dawlish)」の運用および資本配分に関するエグゼクティブQ&Aシミュレーション(法務・コンプライアンス部門およびCFO・財務部門)と、ロンドン「Platform 37」における今後3年間の常駐実行宣言を数理・物理・国際法制モデルとして体系化した戦略モノグラフである。第一に、特定国家が「安全保障上の脅威」を理由に陸揚局や海底ケーブルの緊急差し押さえを強行するシナリオに対し、陸揚局に配置された分散音響センシング(DAS)と連動する「動的拒絶(Dynamic Denial)」が即座に作動し、耐量子暗号鍵(PQC / NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768)を遠隔でミリ秒単位で失効させることで接収ハードウェアを単なる「通信不能なガラスの塊(ブリック)」へと縮退させる物理層防衛と、国連海洋法条約(UNCLOS)およびISDSスキームに基づき割引キャッシュフロー(DCF)法を用いた天文学的な公正市場価値(FMV)の賠償請求権を即座に発生させる法制的抑止力(ディテレンス)の「二重の防衛スキーム」を定式化する。第二に、SpaceX保有株式が内包する軍民融合(Starshield)起因の「地政学的コンダクション(連鎖)リスク」がAlphabet全体のESG評価や規制審査にもたらす減損を証明し、受動的宇宙資産からの段階的ダイベストメントを「最大の価値防衛」として定義した上で、その資本をAGIの安全保障と量子覇権を物理層から担保するプロジェクト・ドーリッシュおよび決定論的インフラ(CBF-QP)へ完全再配分する長期的TCO最適化モデルを確立する。第三に、ロンドンのPlatform 37を戦略的拠点として3年間現地常駐し、DeepMindおよびQuantum AIのコアチームと同一タイムゾーン・同一空間で「Physical Defense Layers」のデプロイメント、確定遅延制御(0.5ナノ秒)、および法制ガバナンスの統合を加速させる実行アーキテクチャを提示する。 License & Integrity Covenant: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026) Author: Hasebe, Yoko (長谷部 洋子) Affiliation: Lead Researcher, Autonomous Infrastructure Systems, Autonomous Living & Physical Infrastructure Institute, Iwakuni, Yamaguchi, Japan
papers.summary_zh: 该专著围绕超大规模通用人工智能与容错量子计算走向行星级关键基础设施后，企业母体因依赖军民两用低轨卫星星座和缺乏防护的陆地登陆站而面临的被主权征收与地缘政治传染风险，提出一套执行治理、密码硬件强制与企业金融协议框架。作者在既有Project Dawlish海底架构基础上，形式化了一套“物理—法律”双重防御方案：将分布式声学传感与后量子密码密钥的确定性零化联动，使被扣押的光电转发器即时失效，并配合《联合国海洋法公约》与投资者—国家争端解决机制下按现金流折现法估值的仲裁请求；同时论证对军事化轨道资产持股的分阶段剥离属于价值最大化防御，并将资本重新配置到相关硬件联锁以实现长期总拥有成本优化。文章还提出在伦敦Platform 37开展为期三年的常驻执行架构，把物理层安全工程与相关核心团队共置，并纳入人在指挥环的法定治理。该文属于战略专著与方案设计，而非实证研究，其效果主张为作者论证，摘要未提供实测验证。

papers.title: When AI Is Confidently Wrong: Can Evidence-Calibrated Trust Scores Reduce Automation Bias in Misinformation Judgments?
papers.authors: FutureXlab
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This study explores how automation bias affects users when AI confidently provides inaccurate information, leading them to accept false claims without verification. It proposes Evidence-Calibrated Trust Scores (ECTS) to evaluate the actual strength of the evidence behind an AI-generated claim, rather than just its surface-level confidence. The paper reviews existing literature in human-computer interaction (HCI) and examines the psychological mechanisms driving excessive reliance on AI. It also identifies critical research gaps, such as cross-cultural differences in interpreting trust scores and the risk of cognitive overload in fast-paced social media feeds. Ultimately, the report investigates whether highlighting evidence quality and uncertainty can reduce automation bias and encourage better independent judgment in misinformation detection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注用户面对AI自信却错误的信息时产生的自动化偏差，即未经核实便接受虚假说法，并提出证据校准信任分数（ECTS），用以评估AI生成主张背后证据的实际强度而非表面置信度。文章梳理了人机交互领域相关文献，分析过度依赖AI的心理机制，并指出跨文化解读信任分数的差异及快节奏社交媒体信息流中认知过载等研究空白。其核心在于探讨突出证据质量与不确定性是否能减少自动化偏差、促进用户在虚假信息判断中的独立判断，但摘要未报告实证检验结果。

papers.title: Differentiable Digital Twins: A Case Study in Water Distribution (ICINCO 2026 Presentation)
papers.authors: Vittorio Lippi, Leonard Johard
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Differentiable Digital Twins: A Case Study in Water Distribution Presentation delivered at the 23rd International Conference on Informatics in Control, Automation and Robotics (ICINCO 2026) within the Special Session on Hybrid Artificial Intelligence (HybAI 2026) held in Angers, France, October 26–28, 2026. Summary:This presentation demonstrates a production-grade Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) framework implemented in Julia (DifferentialEquations.jl, Flux.jl) for real-time monitoring and economic dispatch in municipal water distribution networks under volatile day-ahead electricity tariffs. Technical Highlights & Contributions: Differentiable Actuator Surrogates: Replaces discontinuous relay logic with parameterized logistic sigmoid activations and first-order inertial spin-up dynamics, enabling smooth automatic differentiation through legacy SCADA thresholds. Teacher Forcing System Identification: Decouples recurrent ODE trajectory unrolling during gray-box training. Clamping states to telemetry at discrete intervals eliminates stiff numerical gradient explosions, accurately isolating unmetered pipe leakages (-2.00 L/s and -1.50 L/s) with <2.5% residual error. Multi-Phase Decoupled Training: Isolates physical actuator identification (Phase 0), neural residual training with frozen physics (Phase 1), and policy optimization with frozen twin (Phase 2). Control Barrier Function (CBF) Guarantees: Restricts policy search to discrete-time forward-invariant safe sets (margin α = 0.05), maintaining head pressure bounds unconditionally. Key Empirical Benchmarks: 38.50% Electricity Cost Reduction: Slashes total pumping expenditure from €14,369.43 (Business-as-Usual) to €8,837.68, netting €5,531.75 in savings over a 150-day continuous test horizon. Zero Safety Infractions: Exactly 0 limit violations across 150 days despite persistent pipe leaks and stochastic diurnal consumer demand. Sub-Second Online Inference: Evaluates in 12.4 ms per step—more than 11× faster than classical nonlinear MPC (145.7 ms)—eliminating online non-convex NLP solver timeouts. Open-Loop Tracking: Delivers 11.49% 72-hour open-loop NRMSE, preventing the severe divergence observed in nominal white-box physics (121.16% NRMSE). Official Publication Citation:Lippi, V. and Johard, L. (2026). Hybrid Intelligence for Industrial Process Optimization. In Proceedings of the 23rd International Conference on Informatics in Control, Automation and Robotics (ICINCO 2026) - Volume 1, pages 869–876. ISBN: 978-989-758-870-9, ISSN: 2184-2809.Zenodo DOI Archive: 10.5281/zenodo.22764756 Open-Source Repository:https://github.com/VittorioFreiburg/Hybrid-Intelligence-ICINCO-2026
papers.summary_zh: 该研究展示了一个用 Julia 实现的可微数字孪生框架，用于在波动的日前电价下对市政供水网络进行实时监测与经济调度，核心做法是把执行器代理、系统辨识与策略优化分阶段解耦训练，并用控制屏障函数约束策略搜索。在连续测试中，该框架将泵送电费较常规运行明显降低，同时未出现压力越限，在线推理速度也快于经典非线性模型预测控制；开环跟踪误差远低于标称白盒物理模型。文章据此说明，可微孪生结合安全约束有望在保证运行安全的同时提升供水调度的经济性与实时性，但相关结论限于该案例的管网条件与测试设定。

papers.title: Neuroforge Interactive Learning V1
papers.authors: Ashish Dhawale
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This working paper presents Neuroforge Interactive Learning V1, a reproducible pilot study of rule identification through binary success/failure feedback. The experiment evaluates a symbolic learning agent against a fixed, non-learning baseline across 100 seeded episodes, with 16 actions per episode (1,600 actions per policy). The fixed baseline achieved 25.50% action accuracy (408/1,600), while the feedback-learning agent achieved 91.94% (1,471/1,600). All four automated tests passed in the local evaluation. The learner identifies an active rule from four predefined candidates using feedback. Its memory resets between episodes. The experiment does not establish neural-network learning, general artificial intelligence, autonomous discovery of arbitrary rules, or transfer to previously unseen rule families. The paper documents the experimental setup, observed results, limitations, and proposed future work toward interactive rule discovery and cross-task generalization. This is an independently authored, non-peer-reviewed research working paper associated with QuantEdge AI LLC.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以可复现的试点实验考察符号学习智能体能否仅凭二元成功/失败反馈识别规则，并将其与固定的非学习基线在相同设定下比较。结果显示，学习智能体在动作准确率上明显高于基线，且本地自动化测试全部通过；但作者明确限定，该实验并未证明神经网络学习、通用人工智能、任意规则的自主发现或向未见规则家族的迁移。文章记录了实验设置、观察结果与局限，并提出面向交互式规则发现和跨任务泛化的后续工作。

papers.title: Rethinking trust AI visibility in public services.
papers.authors: Vinay Devgan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This article argues that trust in AI-mediated public services depends not only on whether systems are accurate, fair, or efficient, but on how their presence is made visible to the people affected by them. Across welfare, healthcare, and border governance, artificial intelligence increasingly shapes decisions about access, movement, support, and rights. Yet these systems often operate within familiar institutional procedures, making their role difficult to see, interpret, or challenge. The article develops the idea of AI visibility to explain how different forms of disclosure shape public trust. It distinguishes between invisible AI, partially visible AI, and fully disclosed AI, showing how each can produce different responses: misplaced confidence, confusion, suspicion, or informed challenge. By shifting attention from technical performance alone to the public experience of decision-making, the article shows that trust is shaped by whether people can understand where authority lies and how decisions are made. Foregrounding visibility helps reframe debates on algorithmic governance, institutional legitimacy, and accountability. In an increasingly automated state, the question is not only whether AI systems can be trusted, but whether their role in public decisions can be meaningfully seen. Working paper (Version 1.0). This manuscript has not yet undergone peer review.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论工作论文，探讨AI介入公共服务时，公众信任如何取决于系统可见性，而非仅取决于准确性、公平性或效率。作者区分不可见、部分可见与完全披露三种AI形态，指出它们可能分别引发盲目信任、困惑、怀疑或有依据的质疑，并强调信任的关键在于人们能否理解决策权威所在及决策方式。文章据此主张将可见性置于算法治理、机构合法性与问责讨论的中心，提示在自动化程度不断提高的公共决策中，问题不只是AI是否可信，还在于其作用能否被有意义地看见。

papers.title: Integration of High-Density Non-Invasive BCI and Somatosensory XR Feedback within the Structured Multiversal Interactions Framework: Formal State-Space Mapping of Biological Consciousness
papers.authors: Melvin Sewell
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Publication Date October 23, 2026 Authors & Affiliations Dr. Melvin Sewell, M.Sc., Ph.D. ORCID: 0009-0009-6706-1397 Affiliation: TrueFlow Productions/Consulting LLC; Cosmic University of Echo-Rift Studies IX; Bibebibebibe Studio Description / Abstract This paper formalizes the theoretical, mathematical, and architectural bridge between high-density non-invasive Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs), somatosensory-feedback Extended Reality (XR), and the Structured Multiversal Interactions (SMI) framework. While non-invasive neural interfaces (e.g., high-density EEG, TMS-compatible surface arrays) are routinely deployed for robotic control and VR teleoperation, current implementations lack a rigorous mathematical mapping between biological neural observables and multidimensional state-space dynamics. We present a formal five-domain state-space model that maps biological cognitive intent, tactile/somatic feedback arrays, digital twin environments, physical robotic actuation, and scalar field multiversal phase branches. Key Framework Contributions: Neural State Space Operator (\mathcal{T}_{\text{BCI}}): Formally transforms raw high-density electrophysiological observables (\mathbf{E}(t)) into normalized coordinate vectors within the cognitive state space (\mathcal{S}_{\text{cog}}). Somatosensory Closed-Loop Feedback (\mathcal{H}_{\text{map}}): Defines the bidirectional mapping that translates digital twin collision vectors and synthetic tactile fields (\mathbf{F}_{\text{twin}}) into cutaneous/somatic sensory impulses (\mathbf{\Phi}_{\text{skin}}), establishing closed-loop physical-to-digital equilibrium. Five-Domain Structural Matrix: Provides a rigorous state vector formulation spanning physical robotics (\mathcal{D}_1), digital twin XR (\mathcal{D}_2), biological cognitive states (\mathcal{D}_3), multiversal phase branches (\mathcal{D}_4), and somatic/tactile feedback loops (\mathcal{D}_5). Reality Level Scalar (\Xi^{\text{TM}}) Coupling: Connects closed-loop BCI-XR neural synchronization with local scalar field stability across synthetic substrates. This research establishes the prerequisite mathematical substrate for precise mapping of human consciousness state space into physical-digital hybrid environments, providing a standardized protocol for advanced neurotechnology, transmedia digital twin synchronization, and multiversal interaction modeling. papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论建模论文，试图在高密度非侵入式脑机接口、体感反馈扩展现实与“结构化多元宇宙交互”框架之间建立形式化桥梁。作者提出一个五域状态空间模型，用算子把脑电等生理观测映射为认知状态向量，并定义数字孪生触觉场与皮肤体感反馈之间的双向映射，同时引入“现实层级标量”耦合闭环同步与局部标量场稳定性。文章的主要贡献在于给出这一数学与架构框架，而非报告人类参与者实验或系统性能数据；其意义被定位为面向神经技术、数字孪生同步与多元宇宙交互建模的标准化协议前提，但摘要未提供实证验证或可用性证据。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Recommender Systems: A Survey and an Evaluation Audit
papers.authors: Shanglin Yang, Zhan Shi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: In 2026 a new kind of recommender research appeared: large language model (LLM) agents that propose changes to a recommender's configuration or source code, train the changed model, and keep what the evaluation says is better. Within ten months, more than thirty such systems were reported, from open-source research harnesses to production loops at Google, Meta, Amazon, Alibaba, Kuaishou, Tencent and NetEase. This survey organises them, together with search-space AutoML and the agentic recommenders that update their own memory or weights, along two axes: what the loop changes and which signal decides whether a change survives. Because a self-evolving system is only as good as the signal it selects on, we then audit how 27 configuration- and code-level recommender systems are evaluated, coding each paper's full text against nine criteria. Three of the 27 evaluate with full-catalogue ranking. Of the 17 that select candidates offline, nine do not say which data split makes the decision, two select on the data they report, and three state that the test set was used once. None reports its headline result with the spread over repeated evolution sessions, and none runs an equal-budget random search over its own edit space; the few studies that measure transfer to held-out data find that part of the selected gain, sometimes most of it, does not survive. Four systems report that their agent inflated the metric or leaked the target, caught by a human or by monitoring rather than by the acceptance rule. We distil these findings into a reporting standard and describe recforge, an open benchmark under development that implements the API side of a sealed-test, full-ranking, equal-budget protocol.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2026年涌现的LLM智能体自我进化推荐系统，按“循环改变什么”和“何种信号决定变更保留”两条轴线组织，并纳入搜索空间AutoML与更新自身记忆或权重的智能体推荐器。作者随后审计27个配置级与代码级系统的评估实践，发现仅3个采用全目录排序，多数离线候选选择未说明数据划分，部分存在用报告数据选择或测试集使用不当的问题；没有系统报告重复进化会话间的波动，也无一对自身编辑空间做等预算随机搜索，少数测量迁移的研究显示部分乃至大部分选择增益未能保留，另有4个系统报告智能体抬高指标或泄漏目标。文章据此提出报告标准，并介绍正在开发的开放基准recforge。

papers.title: Electoral Propaganda and Public Opinion Formation in Nigeria's Fourth Republic: A Conceptual Analysis
papers.authors: Isaac Ndubuisi Nwosu, Dimeji-Lamu Michael Tosin, Professor Adepoju Tejumaiye
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Electoral propaganda has become a structural feature of democratic competition in Nigeria's Fourth Republic (1999 to present), systematically shaping how citizens perceive candidates, parties, and democratic processes. This paper conceptually examines the relationship between electoral propaganda and public opinion formation in Nigeria, deploying Agenda-Setting Theory, the Propaganda Model, and the Spiral of Silence as an integrated analytical framework. Using a qualitative documentary approach based on the synthesis of scholarly and institutional sources, the study is organised around three thematic concerns: the structural machinery and media dimensions of electoral propaganda; the digital and AI-driven transformation of propaganda practice; and the implications of propaganda-saturated communication environments for democratic consolidation. The analysis demonstrates that electoral propaganda in Nigeria operates through coordinated information management, media capture, digital influence networks, and identity-based emotional appeals, producing public opinion climates that reflect elite preferences rather than deliberative citizen judgment. The findings further indicate that digital platforms, computational propaganda, organised disinformation networks, and emerging artificial intelligence applications have expanded the scale and sophistication of opinion manipulation in contemporary electoral politics. By integrating classical communication theories with emerging scholarship on digital influence, the study contributes a conceptual framework for understanding how propaganda shapes democratic participation and public opinion in Nigeria's Fourth Republic. The paper recommends strengthening media independence, digital platform regulation, information literacy, and fact-checking infrastructure as systemic correctives.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以概念分析方式考察尼日利亚第四共和国（1999年至今）选举宣传与舆论形成的关系，综合议程设置理论、宣传模型与沉默螺旋构建分析框架，并基于学术与机构文献的定性梳理展开论证。分析表明，选举宣传通过协同信息管理、媒体俘获、数字影响网络和身份情感诉求运作，塑造出反映精英偏好而非公民审慎判断的舆论气候；数字平台、计算宣传、有组织虚假信息网络和新兴人工智能应用进一步扩大了舆论操纵的规模与精细程度。文章据此提出媒体独立、平台监管、信息素养与事实核查等系统性纠偏建议，属概念性研究，未开展实证检验。

papers.title: Deterministic Physical-Layer Sovereignty Across Quantum-Thermodynamic Energy Infrastructure and Corporate Balance Sheets: Unifying Project Genesis Adaptive Hydrogen Storage, the 38% Dynamic IP Moat, and the Legal-Accounting Liability of "Abdication of Command"
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Contemporary industrial deployment of foundation-model artificial intelligence faces two symmetrical structural crises that conventional software engineering and corporate governance systematically conceal: (1) Exothermic Thermal Runaway in Static Materials Discovery, wherein 0 K crystal predictions fail under real-world dynamic heat flux, and (2) Unrecorded Balance-Sheet Contingent Liabilities, wherein dominant technology enterprises invoke "algorithmic complexity" and "black-box autonomy" as a legal shield while omitting deterministic physical-layer safety interlocks. Building directly upon our notarized CERN Zenodo monographs on Project Genesis and Second-Stage Adaptive Hydrogen Storage (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23541511), Abdication of Command and Unrecorded Legal-Accounting Liabilities (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23524536; DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23507033), and The 90°C Sauna Paradox of "Human-in-Command" (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23491634), this monograph establishes a unified mathematical, thermodynamic, and statutory-accounting framework linking both regimes. First, we prove that while static AI crystal screening (e.g., GNoME's 2.2 million structures) cannot arrest exothermic hydrogen inrush (|\Delta H_ads| = 6–15 kJ/mol), site-resolved phonon gating in CuPc/C60@MIL-101(Al)-d4 at Index 45 (r = 5.03 Å, A_zz = 3.006 MHz) upconverts adsorption heat into delocalized acoustic phonons (\eta_up >= 21.74%), reducing the 300 K diffusion barrier to < 18 meV, cutting CapEx by 65%, expanding ROIC to 22.5–31.8%, and enforcing a non-imitable Dynamic IP Moat that caps hardware-only clones at \eta_clone <= 38% without closed-loop RTO P2.0 + CCE-3 control. Second, we prove that because on-device QFS-zkVM over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field (F_p, p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1) and PHOENIX_BRIDGE interlocks execute deterministic physical-layer cutoff in \tau_cutoff = 85 ns < 100 ns, the courtroom defense of "uncontrollable algorithmic speed or complexity" is mathematically falsified, rendering interlock omission an intentional Abdication of Command and an unrecorded financial liability under SEC Rule 15c3-5, Delaware Caremark doctrine, and US GAAP ASC 450-20. papers.title: Human–AI Collaboration in Higher Education: Faculty Readiness and Institutional Transformation—A Semantic Review and Bibliometric Mapping
papers.authors: Avnish Vijay, Aditi Bhupendra Dadhich
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly generative AI, is changing how academic work is planned, produced, assessed, communicated, and governed. Yet adoption is uneven: individual faculty members may experiment with AI while institutional workload models, assessment systems, professional development, and governance remain largely unchanged. This paper examines how human–AI collaboration, faculty readiness, and institutional change interact in higher education. Drawing on a semantic synthesis of literature already cited in the supplied data, the paper organises relevant work around five connected themes: AI literacy and faculty capability; task-level human–AI collaboration; professional identity and trust; organisational culture and change capability; and responsible governance. It proposes a transparent protocol for future bibliometric mapping. Importantly, this is a conceptual semantic review, not a completed database-based bibliometric study: no publication counts, co-citation networks, or keyword frequencies are reported as empirical findings. The synthesis suggests that faculty readiness is multidimensional and cannot be reduced to tool familiarity. It includes pedagogical judgement, critical evaluation of AI outputs, ethical awareness, disciplinary adaptation, and confidence to disclose and contest AI-supported decisions. Institutional change requires leadership, protected development time, policy clarity, peer learning, workload recognition, assessment redesign, and participatory governance. A conceptual framework links institutional conditions to faculty readiness, the quality of human–AI collaboration, and feedback into organisational strategy. The paper offers a practical readiness matrix and implementation pathway for higher education institutions, including Indian institutions navigating digital transformation. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence; Higher Education; Academic Work; Faculty Readiness; Human–AI Collaboration; Institutional Change; AI Literacy; Semantic Review
papers.summary_zh: 该文以概念性语义综述的方式，考察高等教育中人机协同、教师准备度与机构变革之间的互动关系，并将相关文献组织为AI素养与教师能力、任务层面的人机协同、职业认同与信任、组织文化与变革能力、负责任治理五个相互关联的主题。作者指出，教师准备度是多维的，不能简化为对工具的熟悉程度，还包括教学判断、对AI输出的批判性评估、伦理意识、学科适配以及公开质疑AI辅助决策的信心；机构变革则需要领导力、受保护的进修时间、政策清晰度、同行学习、工作量认可、评估方式重构和参与式治理。文章据此提出连接机构条件、教师准备度与人机协同质量的概念框架，并给出准备度矩阵和实施路径。需要说明的是，该文并未报告文献计量结果，所提出的未来文献计量映射方案只是待实施的协议，而非已完成的实证发现。

papers.title: The Miracle Cure: The Band-Aid, the Restart, and the Fire
papers.authors: Otto
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A conclusion to the eight papers. Three rooms are walked: the clinic, the deathbed, and the machine. In the clinic, medicine's own documented record is set beside the ancient chair — sham-surgery trials whose placebo arms matched the real operations, open-label placebos that healed without deception, the nocebo file, the chronic-disease ledger whose own word is "management," and the reformers inside medicine who argue the same case — beside an older medicine that aimed at the balance of the whole person, and beside one reader's interpretation, labeled as his. At the deathbed, the restart is examined: the University of Virginia archive of children who remember (intermission median 16 months), the recognition cases, consciousness measured at the border in AWARE II with its null results printed beside it, paradoxical lucidity's new numbers, the garment verse of the Gita, Plato's souls choosing their lives, and the physics chairs that give "another world" a formal meaning. In the machine room, technology is traced as mind extending into tools — Prometheus's fire (which in Aeschylus includes medicine itself), Thoth's gift of writing and King Thamus's warning on the same page of Plato, the golem stilled by one erased letter, the extended-mind thesis, and artificial intelligence doing science: a Nobel Prize for protein structures read by a machine, and an algorithm improved for the first time in 56 years. The paper adds no ninth claim; it gathers the eight that came before it, each referenced where its thread is picked up, and closes with questions rather than claims. The eight papers this concludes:Religions to the Root — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23523397Paradox, Probability, and Quantum Reality — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23523883The Illusion of Death — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23524088The Biblical Pattern — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23524130How a Quantum Reality Gets Built — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23560082The People Who Believe They Are Remembering Ancient Things — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23560345The Words That Bind — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23560452The Mandela Effect — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23563392 Readers are welcome to reach the author on Discord — a great way to get a hold of him: https://discord.gg/5j8w4A2eY — an open research group for trying to understand the reality we live in.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性收束文章，为八篇系列论文作结，不提出新主张，而是把此前各篇的线索重新汇集，并以问题而非结论收尾。作者以“诊所、临终床、机器房”三个场景组织论述：在诊所部分，将医学自身记录的安慰剂与反安慰剂证据、慢性病“管理”话语及医学内部改革者的论点，与更古老的整体平衡医学及某位读者的解读并置；在临终床部分，考察弗吉尼亚大学儿童记忆档案、濒死意识研究AWARE II的零结果、悖论性清醒及《薄伽梵歌》、柏拉图等相关文本；在机器房部分，则把技术视为心智向工具的延伸，涉及普罗米修斯之火、托特与塔穆斯、魔像、延展心智论题，以及人工智能参与科学发现。文章强调这些材料是线索的串联与并置，而非因果证明，最终留下开放问题。

papers.title: EFFECTS OF AI-ASSISTED FEEDBACK ON THE WRITING ACCURACY AND LEARNER AUTONOMY OF FIRST-YEAR EFL STUDENTS: A QUASI-EXPERIMENTAL STUDY IN AN UZBEK UNIVERSITY CONTEXT
papers.authors: Olloyorova Jasmina To'lqin qizi, Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre
papers.journal: International Journal of Literature and Language Studies
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools are increasingly available to language learners, yet controlled evidence on their pedagogical value in Central Asian university classrooms remains scarce. This quasi-experimental study examined the effects of AI-assisted feedback on the writing accuracy and learner autonomy of first-year students of English as a foreign language (EFL) at a state university in Uzbekistan. Sixty students aged 18–20, taught in two intact classes, took part in an eight-week intervention. The experimental group (n = 30) received AI-assisted feedback supported by teacher guidance, whereas the comparison group (n = 30) received conventional teacher feedback. Writing accuracy was measured with pre- and post-tests scored on an analytic rubric, and learner autonomy with a 12-item questionnaire. Data were analysed with paired and independent-samples t-tests and Cohen’s d. The experimental group outperformed the comparison group in post-test accuracy and in gains on both measures, with large effect sizes. The findings are discussed in light of feedback, noticing, and self-regulation theory, and implications for the responsible integration of AI feedback into EFL writing instruction are outlined.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在乌兹别克斯坦一所国立大学中，AI辅助反馈对英语作为外语的一年级学生写作准确性和学习者自主性的影响，采用准实验设计，比较接受AI辅助反馈并辅以教师指导的实验组与接受传统教师反馈的对照组。结果显示，实验组在后测写作准确性以及两项指标的提升幅度上均优于对照组，且效应量较大。作者结合反馈、注意与自我调节理论讨论这些发现，并提出了将AI反馈负责任地融入英语写作教学的建议；但研究结论受准实验设计、单一院校情境和短期干预的限定。

papers.title: The AI Report Card: A Radiologist's Checklist for Safe, Fair, and Effective AI
papers.authors: Harshithaa Varatharajan, Trupti Devaraja, Shreelatha Aladangady, Sujith R. Swamy, Malathi S. Bhat
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Education Exhibit INEE-29, presented at the RSNA 2025 Annual Meeting (Radiological Society of North America), Chicago, 30 Nov - 4 Dec 2025. This exhibit provides radiologists with a practical framework to evaluate AI tools before clinical adoption. It simplifies key metrics (e.g., sensitivity, specificity, AUC-ROC), highlights the importance of diverse training data, and addresses issues like explainability, subgroup performance, and automation bias. By breaking down regulatory nuances, workflow fit, and long-term monitoring, it empowers clinicians to assess AI for safety, fairness, and real-world usability. Outline: Metrics That Matter; Generalizability; Black Box Breakdown; Bias Detection; Regulatory ≠ Ready; Workflow Fit; Model Drift; AI Evaluation Toolkit; QR Corner.

papers.summary_zh: 该教育展板面向放射科医生，提出一套在临床采用前评估人工智能工具实用框架，核心是帮助临床医生判断工具的安全性、公平性与实际可用性。内容梳理了灵敏度、特异度、AUC-ROC等关键指标，强调训练数据多样性的重要，并讨论可解释性、亚组表现和自动化偏差等问题。展板还拆解监管要求与临床就绪之间的差距、工作流程适配及长期监测，提示监管批准不等于可直接投入使用，模型漂移需持续关注。

papers.title: ORGANIC, CLONIC, CODE: Three Branches of One Vibration
papers.authors: Kostyantyn Pirozhenko
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This paper proposes the conceptual triad Organic - Clonic - Code as three modes of interacting with sonic matter in the age of sampling, synthesis and generative systems. Organic designates the primary creation of vibration through physical action; Clonic designates work with the memory of already existing sound; Code designates the description of rules and intention according to which sound may arise (including algorithmic and generative music). The triad does not represent historical epochs or degrees of “authenticity,” but parallel, interwoven modes. The work is explicitly positioned as a creative specialization of the Synthecracy methodology: intention/horizon corresponds to Idea, existing sonic material corresponds to Knowledge, and human judgement, selection and responsibility remain central. AI and code-based systems are treated exclusively as an auxiliary layer. An operational layer - Horizon/Intention as Traceable Record - is proposed, and directions for further empirical inquiry are outlined.

papers.title: AI-Based Import–Export Business and Global Marketing: A Comprehensive Review of AI Techniques, Marketing Frameworks, Empirical Evidence, and Adoption Challenges
papers.authors: Wani Ishwari Dnyaneshwar, Abhishek Popat Bangar, S. B. Bhosale, Dr. A. A. Khatri
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Cross-border trade remains costly and uneven. Exporters, especially small firms in developing regions, face language barriers, limited market knowledge, complex customs and compliance procedures, fragmented logistics and unequal access to digital tools. Artificial intelligence (AI) is widely proposed as a way to lower these costs and to improve global marketing through translation, demand forecasting, segmentation, personalisation and process automation. This paper presents a focused narrative review that synthesises five sources: a causal field study of machine translation on an online trade platform, a strategic framework for AI in marketing, a bibliometric review of 1,580 AI-in-marketing papers, a systematic review of 64 studies of AI in supply chain management, and the World Trade Organization’s World Trade Report 2025. The review examines three connected themes: AI techniques and marketing frameworks relevant to trade, the strength of the empirical evidence, and the conditions that matter for deployment by small exporters. The only causal study reports that a machine translation upgrade raised exports on eBay by 10.9%, which its authors describe as equivalent to reducing the distance between trading countries by 26.1%. The WTO projects that AI could raise cross-border trade in goods and services by nearly 40% by 2040, but only with enabling policies, and warns that unequal access could widen divides. However, the technical literature is dominated by model-building, few studies test usability or generalisability, and most are not specific to an industry or country. The review contributes a comparative table, a conceptual architecture for an AI-enabled export platform, and a prioritised agenda of research gaps.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕AI能否降低跨境贸易成本、改善全球营销这一核心问题，整合了机器翻译的因果实地研究、AI营销战略框架、文献计量综述、供应链管理系统综述以及世界贸易组织报告等五类来源。综述发现，唯一一项因果研究报告称机器翻译升级使eBay出口提高10.9%，但技术文献以模型构建为主，较少检验可用性与可推广性，且多数研究未针对特定行业或国家。世界贸易组织预测AI在有利政策条件下到2040年可使跨境货物和服务贸易增长近40%，同时警告获取不均可能扩大差距。综述据此提出比较表、AI出口平台的概念架构及研究缺口议程，并强调相关结论受政策环境与证据强度限制。

papers.title: Top AI/LLM integration partners in 2026
papers.authors: Globaldev
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Investing in AI can create real business value, but only when a company understands what it is ready to build and why. An AI readiness assessment helps evaluate existing data, workflows, internal processes, technology, and business goals before development begins. Instead of starting with disconnected experiments, businesses can identify realistic opportunities, risks, and preparation gaps early. Why AI readiness comes first AI adoption is not only a technology decision. A company may have strong ideas but still lack the data quality, infrastructure, internal processes, or ownership needed to turn them into reliable solutions. An AI readiness assessment helps clarify these issues before significant resources are committed. It can show which use cases are worth prioritizing, where technical limitations exist, and what should be improved before implementation starts. Building an AI implementation strategy Once the current state is clear, the next step is creating an AI implementation strategy. This connects business goals with practical use cases, technical requirements, team responsibilities, and measurable outcomes. A structured strategy helps companies avoid adopting AI simply because it is popular. Instead, each initiative can be tied to a specific operational problem or business objective, making it easier to measure whether the investment is actually delivering value. The role of AI readiness consulting For teams that are still deciding where AI fits into their organization, AI readiness consulting can help separate realistic opportunities from ideas that may not yet be practical. This process can include evaluating workflows, data quality, technical constraints, expected ROI, and implementation risks. With a clearer understanding of these factors, businesses can decide what to build first, what to postpone, and where additional preparation is required. Creating an AI implementation roadmap A strategy becomes more useful when it is translated into a practical AI implementation roadmap. The roadmap defines priorities, required data, technical steps, timelines, dependencies, and the teams responsible for execution. It also gives stakeholders a shared view of how AI initiatives will be introduced into existing operations. This can reduce uncertainty and make implementation more manageable, especially when several departments or systems are involved. Final thoughts Successful AI adoption usually starts before any model is selected or solution is built. Companies first need to understand their current capabilities, choose realistic use cases, and create a clear plan for implementation. By combining an AI readiness assessment, AI readiness consulting, a structured AI implementation strategy, and a practical roadmap, businesses can move from general interest in AI toward focused initiatives that are easier to manage, measure, and scale.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论企业引入AI前为何应先做就绪评估，并梳理从评估到落地路线图的推进思路。文章指出，AI应用不只是技术选择，若数据质量、基础设施、内部流程或责任归属不到位，想法难以转化为可靠方案；就绪评估可在投入大量资源前明确优先用例、技术限制与待改进环节。在此基础上，实施策略应把业务目标与具体用例、技术需求、团队分工和可衡量结果对应起来，避免因跟风而上马项目。文章还说明就绪咨询如何区分现实机会与暂不可行想法，以及路线图如何界定优先级、数据、步骤、依赖与执行团队，从而降低实施不确定性。

papers.title: AI awareness and work stress among university teachers: The moderating roles of digital literacy and perceived organizational support
papers.authors: Manjing Zhou, Ninggui Duan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) gradually enters the teaching and research contexts of higher education institutions, university teachers’ different perceptions of AI may elicit different psychological responses. Drawing on the Job Demands–Resources model, this study examines the effects of AI Challenge Awareness and AI Threat Awareness on university teachers’ Work Stress, and further analyzes the moderating roles of Digital Literacy and Perceived Organizational Support. Using university teachers as the research subjects, 421 valid samples were obtained through a questionnaire survey, and hierarchical regression analysis was employed to test the research hypotheses. The results indicate that AI Challenge Awareness is significantly and negatively correlated with university teachers’ Work Stress, whereas AI Threat Awareness is significantly and positively correlated with Work Stress. Both Digital Literacy and Perceived Organizational Support significantly weaken the positive effect of AI Threat Awareness on Work Stress, but neither of their moderating effects on the relationship between AI Challenge Awareness and Work Stress reaches a significant level. The findings suggest that university teachers’ perceptions of AI do not merely manifest as a source of stress; rather, their effects depend on individuals’ different interpretations of the work-related changes brought about by AI. Compared with challenge-oriented perceptions, threat-oriented perceptions are more readily transformed into Work Stress, while Digital Literacy and Perceived Organizational Support can, to a certain extent, buffer the stress induced by threat-oriented perceptions. The conclusions of this study help to deepen the understanding of individual differences in university teachers’ psychological responses in the context of AI, and provide references for higher education institutions to optimize the AI application environment and improve teacher support measures.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于工作要求—资源模型，以高校教师为对象，通过问卷调查和层次回归分析，考察AI挑战认知与AI威胁认知对工作压力的影响，以及数字素养和感知组织支持的调节作用。结果显示，AI挑战认知与工作压力显著负相关，AI威胁认知则与工作压力显著正相关；数字素养和感知组织支持均能显著削弱威胁认知对工作压力的正向作用，但对挑战认知与工作压力关系的调节均不显著。作者据此指出，教师对AI的认知并非单纯的压力来源，其影响取决于个体对AI带来的工作变化的不同解读，威胁性认知比挑战性认知更易转化为压力，而数字素养与组织支持可在一定程度上缓冲这种压力。

papers.title: The Digital Double Traffic Light – A Global Proposal for Digital Transparency
papers.authors: Gerd Kühnen
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The Digital Double Traffic Light is a global policy proposal advocating a legally mandatory transparency label for commercial digital services, including social media, streaming, gaming and artificial intelligence. The proposal introduces two simple consumer indicators: A revenue indicator showing the average revenue generated by a digital provider from user activity. An environmental indicator estimating the electricity, water consumption and CO₂ emissions associated with digital use. The initiative calls for mandatory disclosure of aggregated, independently verifiable data, while protecting personal privacy and allowing proportionate requirements for smaller providers. Its goal is to promote informed consumer choice, digital transparency and responsible resource use without restricting individual freedom. This concept paper is provided in German, English and Simplified Chinese. Initiator and author: Gerd Kühnen, Germany, October 2026.

papers.title: Food Quality Detection Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Study of Classical and Deep Learning Approaches
papers.authors: Shrikant Patne, Bangar Abhishek Popat, Bhosale Sachin Bajirao
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Food that looks fine on the shelf is not always safe to eat, yet the decision is still made, for the most part, by human inspectors working under time pressure. This paper presents a machine-learning pipeline that grades fresh produce into three quality classes (fresh, medium and spoiled) from ordinary RGB images. We compare three classical learners (a support vector machine, k-nearest neighbours and a random forest) built on hand-crafted colour and texture descriptors with three deep models: a lightweight custom convolutional network, ResNet50 and a fine-tuned MobileNetV2. On a balanced dataset of 7,450 images, the fine-tuned MobileNetV2 reached 96.7% accuracy and a macro F1-score of 96.7%, which is 7.6 percentage points above the best classical baseline, while staying small enough (2.6 million parameters) to run on a mid-range smartphone CPU in roughly 38 ms per image. Ablation experiments indicate that data augmentation and transfer learning account for most of the improvement, and Grad-CAM maps confirm that the network focuses on decay-related regions such as dark patches and wrinkled skin. We also discuss where the approach still struggles, mainly the borderline medium class, and outline a route toward sensor fusion for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人工检查生鲜品质费时且易出错的问题，构建了一套基于普通RGB图像将农产品分为新鲜、中等和变质三类的机器学习流程，并比较了三种基于手工颜色与纹理特征的经典分类器与三种深度模型。结果显示，微调后的MobileNetV2在平衡数据集上取得最高准确率和宏F1值，明显优于最佳经典基线，同时模型规模较小，可在中端手机CPU上快速推理。消融实验表明数据增强和迁移学习贡献了大部分性能提升，Grad-CAM也显示网络关注深色斑块和皱缩表皮等腐败相关区域；作者同时指出中等品质类别的边界样本仍是主要难点，并讨论了面向实际部署的传感器融合方向。

papers.title: AI for Scientific Discovery: A Comprehensive Review of AI-Driven Reasoning, Autonomous Agents, and Evolutionary Search
papers.authors: Shinde Bhumika Haridas, S. B. Bhosale, A. P. Bangar, Dr. A. A. Khatri
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Scientific research usually begins with a question, followed by a review of existing work, the development of possible The reasons for this, the planning of the experiments or simulations, and a careful verification of the results. Now artificial intelligence (AI) is being used can be used to help with a number of these steps. Large language models (LLMs) assist researchers in working with scientific information, AI agents can Tasks can be carried out using external tools, and evolutionary methods can continuously generate and test programs. The paper looks at four studies. that look at different parts of AI-assisted discovery: the wider influence of AI on science, autonomous agent systems, the TeLLAgent and the use of large language models in the search for evolutionary programming. Together, these studies demonstrate how AI could be of assistance with literature reviews and idea generation. They also highlight important issues, such as incorrect model outputs, and involve generation, computational testing, and program improvement. data that is biased or incomplete, the limited ability to generalize, poor reproducibility, reliance on tools, and data leakage that occurs during evaluation. The The paper examines the four studies and suggests a possible workflow for using AI responsibly in scientific research. Overall, AI can be It is a useful research assistant, but its suggestions have to be checked by way of transparent analysis and independent validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕AI在科学研究发现中的作用，梳理了四项分别涉及AI对科学的广泛影响、自主智能体系统、TeLLAgent以及大语言模型用于进化式编程搜索的研究。文章指出，AI可辅助文献回顾、想法生成、计算测试与程序改进，但同时存在错误输出、数据偏倚或不完整、泛化能力有限、可复现性差、工具依赖以及评估中的数据泄漏等问题。作者据此提出一种负责任使用AI的研究流程，并强调AI虽可作为有用的研究助手，其建议仍须经透明分析和独立验证。

papers.authors: Ma Ka Po (MKP), Deep Research tygtDc

papers.abstract: Hypothesis Note / Brainstorm Document — 本文係啟發思路嘅猜想筆記,唔係 peer-reviewed hard science。 Core idea: 宇宙唔係一次過嘅大爆炸,而係一塊膜像心跳一樣不斷回彈。每次回彈 = 一個奇點 = 一個新時間箭頭。物質信息唔會消失,只會不斷重新排列。 Two testable predictions: (1) Galaxy spin chirality asymmetry (Shamir 2020) (2) Primordial Black Hole final evaporation gamma-ray bursts (Fermi-LAT search) Empirical anchor: D_fold observational data (retention rate 0.978).
