papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.48 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Arbitrary Bidirected Locally Finite Trees on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.47 showed that deletion budget 1 reaches, from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, the bidirected tree P_T of a sequence of classes of trees, ending with every locally finite tree with finitely many ends (v1.47). Here the target is P_T for every locally finite tree T with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}, with no condition on the number of its ends, on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles, at a stage that depends on the pair (Theorem L); the least uniform budget is 0 for the starts in which the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected, and 1 for all others (Corollary L5, with Proposition Z_K, whose proof holds for every tree with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}). The construction chooses a root and keeps a finite settled set closed under the parent; at the boundary of a turn there is one working relation for each node of its frontier, while within a turn the relation in progress may also hold the nodes of directions not yet separated and pending pieces may be present. Its main tool is a separation lemma: one working relation holding a node f and the nodes of finitely many disjoint sets below it is split, by node-outs to f, into the relation of one infinite set and stars at f for the others, every stage minimal and every transition deleting at most one pair of the relation separated, the joints with the other relations kept (Lemma X_K). Each turn takes the node of least label of the frontier at its start and runs three parts: an advance into that node; the settling of its finite child subtrees, after each has entered completely, by a recursive procedure whose lemma needs no skeleton and no condition on the ends (Lemma S_L, with Corollaries L_L and B_L); and the separation into its infinite children. The states within a turn are kept apart from its boundary, at which the settled set is complete and every frontier node is infinite, and the covering of the node set, the joints and the minimality are shown in every state, the pieces pending within the settling included (Lemma V_L). Every transition keeps the invariant and deletes at most one pair (Lemmas I_L and T_L); every wait is for a named node, a named finite set or one further node of a named infinite set, every turn ends after finitely many stages, and every node is settled at a finite stage, although the frontier grows (Lemma F_L). The rooted binary tree is treated first in full (Theorem K and Corollary K5). Trees that are not locally finite and online constructions are not treated. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论论文，研究在 v1.36 例 Z3 这一特定增长序列上，删除预算为 1 的选择序列能否到达任意以 {0,1,2,…} 为节点集的局部有限树所对应的双有向树 P_T。作者证明对每个这样的树，从任意起始阶段和任意初始结构出发，预算 1 都能到达 P_T，且上下极限均为 P_T，因此每一对的出现与否会在依赖该对的某个阶段确定下来；并给出最小一致预算为 0 或 1 的区分条件。主要工具是一条分离引理，配合按轮次推进的构造，每步至多删除一对并保持不变量。结论限于该增长序列，未处理非局部有限树与在线构造，作者声明不主张新颖性，且文本与论证有 AI 协助。

papers.title: Architectural and Methodological Overview: Privacy-First, Client-Side Implementation of Open-Source Psychometric and Decision-Making Frameworks
papers.authors: Bingelis
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Digital self-assessment platforms addressing personality traits, career alignment, emotional intelligence, and cognitive decision-making frequently rely on extractive monetization models. Common industry practices include server-side harvesting of sensitive personal responses, mandatory email gating prior to result disclosure, and paywall dark patterns. This technical note outlines the architectural and methodological design of Tester.lt, an open-access web platform that executes psychometric scoring entirely client-side within the user's browser, paired with stateless, opt-in AI synthesis for multi-dimensional self-reflection. Live Implementation & Bilingual Accessibility The frameworks described in this technical note are maintained as a free public resource available in both English and Lithuanian: English Portal: https://www.tester.lt/en/ Lithuanian Portal: https://www.tester.lt/ Core Interactive Modules: Big Five (OCEAN) Assessment: https://www.tester.lt/en/tests/big-five/ Holland (RIASEC) Career Test: https://www.tester.lt/en/tests/career-holland/ Cartesian Decision Square: https://www.tester.lt/en/audits/descartes-square/ Life Balance Wheel Audit: https://www.tester.lt/en/audits/life-balance-wheel/ Emotional Intelligence (EQ) Test: https://www.tester.lt/en/tests/emotional-intelligence/ Impostor Syndrome Assessment: https://www.tester.lt/en/tests/imposter-syndrome/
papers.summary_zh: 该技术说明介绍了一个名为Tester.lt的开放访问网络平台，其核心设计是在用户浏览器内完成心理测量评分，并配合无状态、需用户主动选择的AI综合功能，用于多维度自我反思。平台涵盖大五人格、霍兰德职业测试、笛卡尔决策方格、生活平衡轮、情商及冒名顶替综合征等模块，并提供英语和立陶宛语双语访问。文章重点在于阐述这种客户端优先、不采集敏感作答的架构与方法设计，以回应现有数字自评平台在服务器端收集数据、强制邮箱门槛和付费墙等做法带来的隐私问题。作为技术说明，它未报告用户实验或效果评估，主要贡献是公开可用的系统实现与设计思路。

papers.title: Inheritance Architecture: Recursion, Cost, and the Safety of Development in Long-Horizon HAI
papers.authors: Jey Dry
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Long-horizon human–AI interaction (HAI) emerges when the outcomes of joint work retain functional force across changes in sessions, tasks, context windows, and technical conditions, and continue to participate in the production of subsequent actions. This preprint introduces inheritance architecture as a framework for analysing how consequences of prior interactions gain, retain, transform, or lose functional weight in a system’s subsequent trajectory. Long-horizon HAI is treated as a distributed recursive system. The framework distinguishes regulatory, trajectory-level, and organizational recursion; separates thresholds from developmental Gate events; and operationalizes inheritance through the unit “move — distinguishable consequence — carrier — next functionally comparable opportunity — altered choice,” an L0–L5 scale of inheritance depth, and a separate V axis for Gate events. Longitudinal observation of one long-horizon HAI is supplemented by pilot coding of 12 external reports of discontinuities following platform changes. The analysis distinguishes memory, local application, and trajectory-level inheritance; parasitic return cost from functional cost; and locally capable output from compatibility with an already developed human–AI system. It argues that the safety potential of recursion depends on the distributed architectures of attention, presence, and return, together with preserved model-side variability, human-side selection, consequence checking, and the ability to stop, refuse, and revise. The accompanying codebook and pilot coding matrix make the framework available for independent application and further validation. The deposit contains the English-language preprint, the authoritative Russian-language original, the Recursive Dynamics Codebook (Supplementary Material S1), and the pilot coding of external cases (Supplementary Material S2). In the event of interpretive divergence between the language versions, the Russian-language text is authoritative. Contact: emitter.resonance@gmail.com
papers.summary_zh: 该预印本提出“继承架构”框架，用于分析长时段人机交互中先前互动的后果如何获得、保留、转化或失去功能权重。作者将长时段人机交互视为分布式递归系统，区分调节性、轨迹层面和组织性递归，并借助“动作—可区分后果—载体—下一次功能可比机会—改变的选择”单元、继承深度量表及独立的Gate事件轴加以操作化。研究基于对一例长时段人机交互的纵向观察，并辅以对12份平台变更后不连续性的外部报告进行试点编码。分析区分了记忆、局部应用与轨迹层面继承，寄生性返回成本与功能性成本，以及局部有能力输出与已发展人机系统兼容性，并主张递归的安全潜力取决于注意、在场与返回的分布式架构，以及模型侧变异性、人类侧选择、后果核查和停止、拒绝与修订能力的保留。

papers.title: Limitations of Generative AI in Content Creation: A Review
papers.authors: Mayur Rajaram Chavan, Abhishek Popat Bangar, S. B. Bhosale, V. A. Karad
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools are now widely used to produce and support digital content such as stories, news items and social-media posts. Such tools can make a single piece of output look better, yet they also bring worries about originality, sameness across many outputs, bias, factual accuracy, creative control and ownership rights. This paper reviews five chosen scholarly works that look at creator responsibility, AI-supported story writing, prompting as a creative method, copyright, and bias in machine-written news. Read together, the studies indicate that a gain for one writer does not automatically become a gain for everyone: stories written with AI help may score higher while growing more alike. The remaining works point to the need for human fact-checking, the risk of skewed representation, the difficulty of turning unspoken creative know-how into written prompts, and unsettled questions about ownership and openness. We compare how the studies were carried out and what each contributes, draw out the shared challenges, and suggest where future work could head. Because only five hand-picked papers were examined and no exhaustive database search was run, this work is a focused narrative review rather than a systematic one.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇聚焦式叙述性综述，而非系统性综述，梳理了五项精选研究，考察生成式AI在故事、新闻和社交媒体内容创作中的局限。综合来看，这些研究提示个体写作者的收益未必转化为集体收益：AI辅助写出的故事评分可能更高，但彼此更趋同质；其余研究则指向人工事实核查的必要、代表性偏斜的风险、将难以言传的创作诀窍转化为提示词的困难，以及所有权与开放性问题上的未决争议。作者比较了各研究的做法与贡献，归纳共同挑战并提出未来方向，同时说明因仅选取五篇论文、未做穷尽式数据库检索，结论范围有限。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Study Notes Generation Using Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Comprehensive Review of Retrieval Methods, Prompting, Educational Evidence, and System Architecture
papers.authors: Korade Apeksha Maruti, Bangar Abhishek Popat, S. B. Bhosale
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Learners often spend a great deal of time condensing lecture slides, textbook chapters and research papers into brief revision notes. Large language models (LLMs) from the generative AI family can draft such notes within seconds, but a model that is not grounded in a source may write confident text that the material never states. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lowers this risk by supplying the model with passages fetched from the learner’s own documents. This paper offers a focused narrative review of verified literature on AI-driven study notes generation with generative AI and RAG. Three linked areas are covered: retrieval and RAG techniques (chunking, dense embeddings, retrievers and advanced pipelines); generative models and prompting (LLMs, structured prompt frameworks and hallucination); and empirical evidence on generative AI in engineering and computing courses. The reviewed work indicates that RAG was proposed to anchor generation in retrieved text, that dense retrieval outperformed a strong sparse baseline in open-domain question answering, and that in a quasi-experiment with 26 students, structured prompts produced fuller answers than free-style prompts. Even so, most educational studies capture student perceptions instead of learning outcomes, rely on small samples, and none of the reviewed studies directly measures note quality, faithfulness or retention. The paper contributes a comparison of representative studies, a conceptual seven-layer architecture that links ingestion, retrieval, grounded generation, verification and learner feedback, and a ranked list of research gaps.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了生成式人工智能与检索增强生成（RAG）用于学习笔记生成的研究，围绕检索与RAG技术、生成模型与提示设计、工程与计算课程中的实证证据三条线索展开。文中指出，RAG旨在将生成内容锚定在检索到的文本上，稠密检索在开放域问答中优于强稀疏基线，而一项准实验显示结构化提示比自由式提示产生更完整的回答。但多数教育研究关注学生感知而非学习结果，样本偏小，且所综述研究均未直接测量笔记质量、忠实度或记忆保持。文章据此提出连接内容摄取、检索、有依据生成、验证与学习者反馈的七层概念架构，并列出研究空白。

papers.title: Building Trust in AI: Explainable AI in Critical Decision-Making
papers.authors: Ingle Sakshi Atmaram, Bangar Abhishek Popat, Bhosale Sachin Bajirao, V. A. Karad
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to support decisions in healthcare, finance, recruitment, transportation, and public services. Although complex machine-learning models can produce accurate predictions, their reasoning is not always easy to understand. This creates practical questions: why did the system recommend a particular outcome, did it use appropriate information, and when should a person challenge its decision? Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) brings together techniques that help people understand a model’s behaviour or the factors behind a prediction. This review discusses interpretable models, feature-attribution methods such as LIME and SHAP, counterfactual explanations, and model-agnostic approaches. It compares their uses and limitations in high-impact settings. An understandable explanation, however, is not proof that a model is accurate, fair, dependable, or safe. The paper uses a narrative review of foundational work and selected research and survey publications on interpretability, responsible AI, and human-centred explanations. No new experiments, participant studies, or quantitative tests were performed. The literature points to unresolved issues involving explanation fidelity, stability, accessibility, privacy, bias, evaluation standards, and over-reliance on automated advice. Future research should use domain-specific evaluations, retain meaningful human oversight, communicate uncertainty clearly, assess fairness across groups, and report limitations transparently. XAI can support accountability and informed supervision, but it cannot guarantee trustworthiness on its own.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕可解释人工智能（XAI）在医疗、金融、招聘、交通和公共服务等高风险决策场景中的作用展开，梳理了解释性模型、LIME与SHAP等特征归因方法、反事实解释及模型无关方法，并比较了它们各自的用途与局限。文章强调，一个易于理解的解释并不等于模型准确、公平、可靠或安全，并指出解释保真度、稳定性、可及性、隐私、偏见、评估标准以及对自动化建议的过度依赖等问题仍待解决。作者据此建议未来研究开展领域特定的评估、保留有意义的人类监督、清晰传达不确定性、评估群体间公平性并透明报告局限，认为XAI有助于问责与知情监督，但本身无法保证可信。该文为叙述性综述，未开展新实验或参与者研究。

papers.title: SMART E-LEARNING PLATFORM USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
papers.authors: Pragati Vasekar
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Online learning platforms provide access to educational content, but many systems deliver the same material to every learner andoffer limited support for identifying individual learning needs. This paper proposes a Smart E-Learning Platform using ArtificialIntelligence (AI) that aims to personalize learning through learner profiles, progress tracking, recommendation methods,automated practice feedback, and a dashboard for learners and instructors. The proposed workflow collects learning activity andassessment results, processes relevant learning indicators, and recommends suitable resources or practice activities. Possible AImethods include rule-based recommendation as a baseline, content-based filtering, and supervised models when sufficientlabelled data is available. The platform is designed as an academic prototype and should be evaluated using measurableindicators such as recommendation relevance, task completion, learner satisfaction, and usability. No implementation results orimprovement percentages are claimed in this proposal. Privacy, transparency, accessibility, and instructor oversight areimportant requirements. The system is intended to support teaching and learning, not to replace teachers or make high-stakesdecisions about students
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一个基于人工智能的智能在线学习平台原型，试图解决传统平台对所有学习者提供相同内容、难以识别个体学习需求的问题。平台围绕学习者画像、进度追踪、推荐方法、自动练习反馈以及面向学习者和教师的面板来组织个性化学习流程，并设想以规则推荐为基线，结合基于内容的过滤和在标注数据充足时使用监督模型。文章明确这是学术原型方案，未报告实现结果或提升幅度，只提出应以推荐相关性、任务完成、学习者满意度和可用性等指标进行评估，同时强调隐私、透明、可访问性和教师监督，定位为辅助教学而非替代教师或做高风险决策。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.47 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Locally Finite Trees with Finitely Many Ends on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.46 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar, of the double ray along any bijection from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...}, of any two-ended caterpillar, of any two-ended tree with branches of depth at most two, and of any two-ended, one-ended or three-ended tree with finite branches. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of any locally finite tree T with node set {0, 1, 2, ...} and finitely many ends, with no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. The ends are taken by the standard definition, and for the rays of a tree being separated by no finite set of nodes is shown to be the same as having a common tail (Fact N_J). A tree with node set {0, 1, 2, ...} is locally finite with exactly k >= 1 ends iff it has a skeleton with a finite core and k rays all of whose branches are finite: a finite set C of nodes inducing a connected subtree, the core, and k one-way infinite paths, each beginning at a node of C, its base, and otherwise disjoint from C and from one another, the bases not necessarily distinct (Lemma D_J, with König's argument for the finiteness of the branches, Lemma K_J); a single centre may not suffice for four or more ends. Hence the classes of v1.45, v1.44 and v1.46 are exactly the locally finite trees with one, two and three ends, and the reachability theorems of those versions hold for all such trees (Corollary E_J). Budget 0 reaches P_T from a given start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected (Corollary Z_J, with a connectivity test for finite node sets, Lemma C_J, and a four-ended example with two branching nodes, Example J*). For every locally finite tree with finitely many ends, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles, at a stage that depends on the pair (Theorem J with Lemma D_J); the least uniform budget is therefore 0 for the starts that satisfy the condition of Corollary Z_J and 1 for all others (Corollary J5). The finite-branch lemmas of v1.46 are restated for several attachment points: a working relation may meet settled pieces in single nodes under the condition (H) of v1.43, and two relations of a list that share a node may be merged (Lemmas P_J and U_J); the procedure SETTLE with Lemma S_J and Corollaries L_J and B_J is given with statements and proofs in full under the relaxed hypothesis (S2*). The construction waits until the finite central part has entered, separates the directions 2, ..., k into stars at their bases while all the bases are still nodes of the one working relation, and then settles the central part from the core nodes farthest from the base of the direction 1 inwards, the stars staying attached at their bases; every stage of both phases is minimal and deletes at most one pair (Lemmas W_J and Q_J, with an invariant for every stage). The k directions then take turns in a fixed cyclic order, each turn waiting until the whole branch of the next skeleton node of its direction has entered, advancing that direction by one node and settling that branch, while the other working relations only grow. Every transition of the main phase preserves the invariant, the hanging of entering nodes in all the directions included (Lemma T_J); every turn ends after finitely many stages, the number of steps on a branch being shown finite apart from the waits for new nodes; every direction advances without bound and every node joins the settled part at a finite stage; from then on a pair with both nodes settled is selected iff it is in P_T, and no other pair with both nodes settled is introduced again. Trees with infinitely many ends and trees that are not locally finite are not treated. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在 v1.36 例 Z3 的增长序列上考察删除预算为 1 的选择序列能否到达任意有限端局部有限树的双向树。作者通过骨架分解与分阶段构造证明：对每个起始阶段和每个初始结构，预算 1 都能到达目标，且上下极限均为该目标，因此每对节点的归属会在有限阶段确定；预算 0 仅对满足特定连通条件的起始结构可达。由此，最小统一预算对满足该条件的起始为 0，其余为 1。研究还给出若干有限分支引理与 SETTLE 过程的完整论证，但明确不处理无限端或非局部有限树，也未主张新颖性。

papers.title: Campus Ai: A Chatbot Using Natural Language Processing for College Assistance
papers.authors: Athul Krishna S, Chandrika K, Sanjay G, Sanjay S
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Students and faculty at engineering colleges often search several portals, notices and documents to find routine academic information. This paper presents Campus AI, a web-based chatbot prototype that lets users ask college-related questions in natural language. The system is implemented as a Next.js and React application. A server-side chat endpoint applies per-IP sliding-window rate limiting and input sanitization, assembles a prompt from an institutional system prompt, the latest eight conversation messages and, when available, the authenticated student’s profile, and then queries the Llama 3.1 70B model hosted on the Groq platform in JSON mode. The reply is returned as a structured object containing the answer text, an optional generated visual and source labels, and is rendered in a conversational interface alongside role-specific dashboards for students, faculty and administrators. We describe the architecture, request workflow and implementation, and we separate the features that are implemented in the prototype from those that are only planned. Functional behaviour is demonstrated through screenshots of the working prototype. No quantitative evaluation of answer accuracy, response time or user satisfaction has been carried out; such an evaluation is identified as future work.
papers.summary_zh: 该文介绍了一个名为 Campus AI 的网页聊天机器人原型，旨在让工程学院师生用自然语言查询日常学术信息，系统基于 Next.js 和 React 实现，通过服务端接口调用托管在 Groq 平台上的 Llama 3.1 70B 模型生成回答。文章描述了系统架构、请求流程与实现方式，并明确区分了原型中已实现的功能与仅处于计划阶段的功能，功能表现以工作原型的截图展示。作者指出，目前尚未对回答准确性、响应时间或用户满意度开展定量评估，并将此类评估列为未来工作，因此该文属于系统/原型论文，其实际效果仍有待验证。

papers.title: APPLICATION OF PERSONALIZED AND ADAPTIVE LEARNING MODELS IN COMPUTER SCIENCE CLASSES
papers.authors: A.J. Ahmadova
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This research analyzes the application mechanisms, pedagogical significance, and upcoming challenges of personalized and adaptive learning models in computer science classes within the modern digital educational environment. Against the background of the inadequacy of traditional "one-size-fits-all" instructional methods for students with varying learning paces and prior knowledge, the role of adaptive technologies based on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and Learning Analytics is substantiated. The paper explores the positive impact of intelligent code editors, auto-graders, and dynamic adaptive testing on instructional quality, student motivation, and the development of algorithmic thinking. Simultaneously, strategic issues such as the digital divide, data privacy, and the necessity of implementing a blended learning framework are evaluated.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕计算机科学课堂中个性化与自适应学习模型的应用展开分析，讨论其在学生节奏与基础差异较大、传统统一教学难以适配的背景下如何发挥作用。文章指出，基于人工智能、机器学习和学习分析的智能代码编辑器、自动评分与动态自适应测试，有助于提升教学质量、学生动机和算法思维培养，同时评估了数字鸿沟、数据隐私及混合式教学框架实施等战略性问题。

papers.title: Microsoft Microsoft AI-500 PDF
papers.authors: Certification Exam
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The 'Microsoft AI-500 PDF' is a comprehensive guide designed to facilitate understanding and mastery of Microsoft's AI-500 certification exam. This document features detailed coverage of the topics essential for candidates preparing to validate their knowledge and skills in implementing Microsoft Azure AI solutions. It includes sections on AI concepts, integration of Azure services, and best practices for deploying AI models. With clear explanations, diagrams, and practical examples, this PDF serves as an invaluable resource for IT professionals and learners looking to enhance their capabilities in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. Additionally, the document may encompass sample questions and strategic insights to aid in exam preparation, making it a must-have for anyone pursuing certification in Microsoft AI technologies. Source: https://www.certification-exam.com/en/pdf/microsoft-pdf/ai-500-pdf/
papers.summary_zh: 该文档是一份面向 Microsoft AI-500 认证考试的备考指南，围绕 Azure AI 解决方案的实施知识组织内容。它涵盖 AI 概念、Azure 服务集成以及 AI 模型部署的最佳实践，并配有解释、示意图和示例，可能还包含样题与应试策略。需要说明的是，摘要未报告任何实证研究或系统评估，因此其实际备考效果无法从现有信息判断。

papers.title: Financial Risk Management in the Digital Era: Cybersecurity, FinTech Innovation, and Banking Sector Resilience
papers.authors: Md. Ruhul Amin
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The financial services landscape has witnessed rampant digital change, which has restructured financial risk management and made it a fundamentally new phenomenon. The use of financial technology (FinTech), artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, mobile banking, digital payments systems and data driven financial services brings benefits to financial institutions' operational efficiency and financial inclusion, and boosts their ability to develop and launch financial products. But these factors have also brought additional challenges, among them cyber-attacks, data breaches and digital fraud, reliance on third-party technologies, algorithmic bias, system disruption and vulnerabilities. Therefore, traditional risk management approaches are becoming less effective in tackling the interrelated risks of today's banking environment. Here, we review how cybersecurity, FinTech innovation and banking sector resilience are related in the digital era. The study is based on la COUNT qualitative second data analytical approach with englobing existing literature, regulatory frameworks and principles of institutional risk management. It delves into the evolving characteristics of credit, market, liquidity, operational and systemic risks in a digital world and assesses the significance of cybersecurity governance and regulatory compliance, technological innovation, and organisational resilience. Overall, the analysis suggests that technology-assisted financial transformation can enhance the stability of the financial system with strong governance, the use of effective cyber-risk management measures, responsible innovation and adequate regulatory oversight. The article suggests that integrated risk management frameworks, the monitoring of threats on an ongoing basis, scenario-based stress testing, the use of third-party risk assessment, employee education and cross-border regulatory co-operation should all be introduced. It concludes that this financial inclusion for sustainability in digital finance will need a balance of innovation, security, accountability, and resilience on the side of the financial institutions.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了数字时代网络安全、金融科技创新与银行业韧性之间的关系，基于现有文献、监管框架和机构风险管理原则进行定性二手资料分析。文章指出，金融科技、人工智能、云计算和数字支付等在提升运营效率与金融包容性的同时，也带来网络攻击、数据泄露、数字欺诈、第三方技术依赖和算法偏见等风险，使传统风险管理方法难以应对当前相互关联的风险格局。分析认为，在强治理、有效网络风险管理、负责任创新和充分监管下，技术驱动的金融转型可增强金融体系稳定性，并建议引入整合型风险管理框架、持续威胁监测、情景压力测试和跨境监管合作。

papers.title: CULTURAL IDENTITY AND LOCAL RECONSTRUCTION OF ITTEN'S SENSORY TRAINING IN CHINESE DESIGN EDUCATION
papers.authors: Wang Zhiwei
papers.journal: Ученые записки Крымского федерального университета имени В. И. Вернадского. Философия. Политология. Культурология
papers.abstract: The object of this study is the concept of sensory training developed by Johannes Itten, founder of the Bauhaus preliminary course. The relevance of the study stems from the need to return to ‘authentic perception’ and bodily experience in design education in the era of artificial intelligence so as to preserve the humanistic dimension and the creative foundation of the profession. The scientific novelty of the article lies in the first systematic application of the Delphi method to study the mechanisms of cultural identification and the pathways for the local reconstruction of Itten’s ideas in Chinese design education. The results of a two-stage survey of 15 experts in the field of design education indicate that experts generally recognize the deep connection of Itten’s ideas with traditional Chinese concepts of ‘the unity of nature and humanity’ and ‘the unity of heart and hand’, as well as their particular value in the AI era. At the same time, they unanimously point out the problems in current pedagogical practice, such as formalism, loss of the spiritual component, insufficient understanding of the concept by teachers, and the lack of an adequate assessment system. The findings confirm that direct simple borrowing of the Western model is largely ineffective; its reconstruction based on local cultural resources is necessary. The article proposes ways to integrate the material wisdom of traditional crafts, the methods of Chinese painting and calligraphy, and work with local natural materials into sensory training. This establishes a theoretical foundation and a practical direction for returning design education to ‘authentic perception’, realizing cross-cultural synthesis, and fostering local innovation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以包豪斯基础课程创始人伊顿的感官训练理念为对象，采用德尔菲法对中国设计教育领域的专家进行两阶段调查，探讨其文化认同机制与本土重构路径。结果显示，专家普遍认可伊顿理念与中国“天人合一”“心手合一”传统概念的深层关联，并肯定其在人工智能时代对保持设计教育人文维度的价值；但专家也一致指出当前教学实践存在形式化、精神内涵流失、教师理解不足和评价体系缺失等问题。研究据此认为直接照搬西方模式基本无效，需依托本土文化资源进行重构，并提出将传统工艺的材料智慧、中国书画方法及本地自然材料融入感官训练，为设计教育回归“本真感知”提供理论基础与实践方向。

papers.title: The Cost of Complexity: Thermodynamic Architecture and the Collapse of AI Adoption
papers.authors: E. Katz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This theoretical working paper examines the relationship between complexity, recursive planning, correction capacity, and the long-term viability of organizational and decision-making systems. It develops a conceptual account of how optimization and recursive validation may strengthen existing frameworks while simultaneously increasing the cost of revision and reducing the practical capacity to correct foundational assumptions.The paper proposes a recurring structural sequence in which accountability pressures encourage metric optimization; optimization reinforces established frameworks through recursive validation; accumulated commitments increase the cost of correction; and strong performance may obscure emerging constraints on revision. When subsequent demands exceed a system’s available correction capacity, the system may experience breakdown, forced restructuring, or the preservation of an increasingly untenable framework.Knowledge Thermodynamics and Recursive Planning Science (KT–RPS), presented here as a theoretical working architecture, provide the conceptual vocabulary for examining these relationships. Thermodynamic terminology is used to articulate structural constraints and the costs of maintaining and revising recursive meaning systems; it is not presented as evidence of a demonstrated physical law. The paper distinguishes its proposed mechanisms from empirically established causal relationships and treats threshold assessment as a problem requiring further operationalization and validation.The manuscript also develops an application protocol intended to support structured examination of correction capacity, commitment boundaries, threshold warning signs, and planning survivability. Its contribution is conceptual and diagnostic: it offers a framework for formulating questions about the sustainability of complex systems and for developing subsequent empirical tests. It does not establish universal collapse thresholds, predict specific collapse dates, or claim empirical validation of the proposed architecture. KeywordsKnowledge Thermodynamics; Recursive Planning Science; organizational complexity; correction capacity; recursive validation; commitment boundaries; system resilience; threshold risk; decision-making; governance; planning survivability; theoretical framework
papers.summary_zh: 这篇理论工作论文考察复杂性、递归规划、纠错能力与组织及决策系统长期存续之间的关系，提出一个概念性解释：问责压力推动指标优化，优化通过递归验证强化既有框架，累积的承诺抬高修正成本，而良好表现可能掩盖修正空间正在收窄。当后续需求超出系统可用的纠错能力时，系统可能崩溃、被迫重构，或继续维持日益难以为继的框架。作者以“知识热力学与递归规划科学”作为理论工作架构提供概念词汇，并明确热力学术语仅用于描述结构性约束与维护、修正递归意义系统的成本，并非已证实的物理定律；所提机制也区别于经验确立的因果关系，阈值判断仍需进一步操作化和验证。文章还提出一套应用协议，用于结构化审视纠错能力、承诺边界、阈值预警信号与规划可存续性，其贡献在于概念与诊断层面，不确立普遍崩溃阈值，也不预测具体崩溃时间。

papers.title: From Bot-Farm to For-You-Page Fork: Consuming The Whole Digital Animal
papers.authors: Jill R D MacKay, Louise Connelly
papers.abstract: In 2022, OpenAI launched the Large Language Model ChatGPT, and with it, the possibility of generative Artificial Intelligence (genAI) as a creative partner. Progress in the genAI arena has been rapid, with genAI created media going from uncanny horror show, to being able to create realistic media from a prompt. Social Media ‘for you page’ algorithms are now serving their users content created by genAI, including digital animals which may behave very unlike real animals do. The field of animal welfare science has utilised policy frameworks such as ‘Farm-to-Fork’ to conceptualise where harms and sustainability opportunities exist within the animal production system. In this work, we utilise three common ethical approaches to animal use, utilitarianism, deontological ethics, and the principle of telos, to explore the production and consumption of digital animals on social media. Using the example of an object animal (a toy), a digital animal (a genAI created cat), and an embodied animal (a real cat in a teaching programme), we explore the evidence for their effect on the human-animal relationship, and how various ethical frameworks would consider their consumption. We conclude with three recommendations for social media companies for incorporating digital animal media in their provisions. First, digital animal creation should be limited, with similar style guard-rails to creation of media containing humans. Second, digital animal media should be fully disclosed, to minimise risk of misinformation and norm creep. Third, as with content regarding ‘kid influencers’, ‘animal influencer’ content should be demonetised, to reduce the risk of exploitation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以社交媒体上由生成式人工智能创造的“数字动物”为对象，结合功利主义、义务论与目的论三种伦理路径，并借助玩具动物、AI生成的猫与教学项目中的真实猫三个例子，考察这类内容对人类与动物关系的影响及不同伦理框架如何评价其消费。作者据此提出三项建议：对数字动物内容的生成设置类似涉及人类内容的安全限制，对数字动物媒体进行充分披露以降低误导与规范漂移风险，并将“动物网红”内容去货币化以减少剥削风险。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.46 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Three-Ended Trees with Arbitrary Finite Branches on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.45 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar, of the double ray along any bijection from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...}, of any two-ended caterpillar, of any two-ended tree with branches of depth at most two, of any two-ended tree with finite branches and of any one-ended tree with finite branches. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of a three-ended tree T with finite branches with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}: a centre c and three one-way infinite paths from c that meet one another only at c, the skeleton, with a finite tree rooted at each skeleton node, with no common bound on the sizes or on the heights of these trees and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. Budget 0 reaches P_T from a given start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected (Corollary Z_I, with both directions written out); a nonempty finite node set induces a connected subtree iff its skeleton nodes form an interval of one direction or c with an initial part of each direction, and each of its other nodes has its parent in the set, or it has no skeleton node and lies in D(v_0), the set of one of its nodes v_0 and the descendants of v_0, each of its nodes other than v_0 having its parent in the set (Lemma C_I); a stage may hold no skeleton node, and a later one skeleton nodes of all three directions (Example I*). For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles, at a stage that depends on the pair (Theorem I); the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Corollary Z_I decides (Corollary I5). The finite-branch lemmas of v1.45 are restated for three-ended trees and proved in full; their proofs use of the tree only the parent relation, the sets D(v) and the finiteness of the branches, and they treat one branch inside one working relation, the other relations being further relations of a list meeting one node at a time. The construction settles the branch of the centre with one working relation, then separates the three directions: the nodes of two directions present at that moment, a finite set fixed then, are taken out one at a time by a node-out to c and joined to c in two stars, while every node that enters meanwhile is put at once into the relation of its direction; every stage of this separation is minimal and deletes at most one pair (Lemma W_I, with an invariant for every stage of it). The three directions then take turns in a fixed cyclic order, each turn waiting until the whole branch of the next skeleton node of its direction has entered, advancing that direction by one node and settling that branch, while the other two working relations only grow. Every transition of the main phase preserves the invariant, the hanging of entering nodes in all three directions included (Lemma T_I); every turn ends after finitely many stages, with no bound common to the turns, so every direction advances without bound and every node joins the settled part at a finite stage; from then on a pair with both nodes settled is selected iff it is in P_T, and no other pair with both nodes settled is introduced again. By the argument of König's infinity lemma, written out here, the one-ended trees with finite branches of v1.45 are exactly the locally finite one-ended trees, so that v1.45 Theorem H holds for every locally finite one-ended tree (Lemma E_I, Corollary O_I). Trees with an infinite branch and trees with four or more ends are not treated, and the equivalence of the three-ended class of §2 with the class of all locally finite trees with exactly three ends is not proved here. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文研究在 Z3 增长序列上，删除预算为 1 的选择序列能否到达任意有限分支三端树的双向树。作者以符号数学论证证明：对每个起始阶段和初始结构，预算 1 都能到达目标，且上下极限均为该树，因此每对节点是否属于目标会在有限阶段确定；预算 0 能否到达则由初始结构是否恰为目标限制及后续诱导子树连通性判定。文章还给出三端情形的有限分支引理及构造性证明，并据此把此前一端树结果推广到所有局部有限一端树；四端及以上和含无限分支的树未处理，作者声明不主张新颖性。

papers.title: From Early Warning to Effective Self-Correction: Novelty, Comparative Performance, Validation Design, and Epistemic Limits of the BenchEWS Research Programme
papers.authors: Bernd von Mallinckrodt
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: From Early Warning to Effective Self-Correction Scientific Perspective / Methodological Position Paper — Version 3.0 (October 2026) Author: Dipl.-Ing. Bernd von MallinckrodtIndependent Researcher, Wesel, GermanyORCID: 0009-0005-5279-6607Website: https://www.vonmallinckrodt.de Description Detecting an early-warning signal is not the same as determining whether a complex system can still correct itself. Conventional early-warning signals (EWS) identify statistical precursors of critical transitions, such as increasing variance and autocorrelation. However, these indicators alone do not establish whether corrective feedback has deteriorated, interventions have become ineffective, or a system has lost its capacity for recovery. The BenchEWS research programme addresses this fundamental distinction by separating five processes: Detection of statistical early-warning signals. Inference about changes in system resilience. Deterioration of corrective feedback mechanisms. Delay between detection and effective corrective intervention. Actual loss of corrective capacity. The proposed methodological contribution is an explicit architecture connecting reproducible EWS benchmarking, corrective-capacity assessment, evidence classification, and scientifically justified diagnostic abstention. Corrective capacity is operationalized using established control-theoretic concepts of fault recoverability and reachable sets, including safe-set retention and target-set reachability under specified time horizons, disturbances, and control-energy constraints. The paper critically examines the novelty and limitations of this approach and introduces a falsifiable validation framework with five principal hypotheses (H1–H5). The framework distinguishes observation-only comparisons (Class O) from model-informed comparisons (Class M), including two information-matched evaluation pathways for prospective corrective-delay measures (H2-O and H2-M). The proposed benchmark includes matched false-alarm calibration, positive and negative controls, statistical superiority and equivalence criteria, and independent replication requirements. Scientific evidence and limitations: The CRTI spectral-compression derivation has been externally peer-reviewed as a conditional mathematical result (AIP Advances, 2026, DOI: 10.1063/5.0337045). This does not constitute empirical validation of the broader BenchEWS diagnostic architecture. The proposed FCQ, SCD, Epistemic Silence, and active-interrogation components remain unvalidated as diagnostic instruments. No independent third-party replication is documented. The central scientific proposition is therefore not that BenchEWS has already demonstrated earlier detection or superior diagnostic performance, but that the transition from statistical warning to effective self-correction should be investigated as a distinct, operationally testable scientific problem. Publication disclosure: This manuscript incorporates an author-commissioned, AI-assisted scientific audit and is not an independent external peer review. The validation protocol described in the paper has not yet been executed. Keywords BenchEWS; Early-Warning Signals; Critical Transitions; Complex Adaptive Systems; Corrective Capacity; Self-Correction; Corrective Feedback; Fault Recoverability; Reachable Sets; Fault Detection and Isolation; Spectral Compression; CRTI; Selective Classification; Epistemic Abstention; System Resilience; Falsifiability; Reproducibility; Independent Validation. Von der Frühwarnung zur wirksamen Selbstkorrektur Wissenschaftliches Perspektiv- und Methodenpapier — Version 3.0 (Oktober 2026) Autor: Dipl.-Ing. Bernd von MallinckrodtUnabhängiger Forscher, Wesel, DeutschlandORCID: 0009-0005-5279-6607Website: https://www.vonmallinckrodt.com Beschreibung Ein Frühwarnsignal zu erkennen bedeutet noch nicht, zu wissen, ob ein komplexes System sich weiterhin selbst korrigieren kann. Klassische Frühwarnverfahren (Early-Warning Signals, EWS) untersuchen statistische Vorläufer kritischer Systemübergänge, beispielsweise zunehmende Varianz und Autokorrelation. Solche Signale belegen jedoch für sich genommen weder eine Verschlechterung korrigierender Rückkopplungsmechanismen noch den Verlust der Fähigkeit eines Systems, durch wirksame Eingriffe wieder einen stabilen oder sicheren Zustand zu erreichen. Das BenchEWS-Forschungsprogramm setzt an dieser grundlegenden Unterscheidung an und trennt fünf Prozesse: Erkennung statistischer Frühwarnsignale. Schlussfolgerungen über Veränderungen der Systemresilienz. Verschlechterung korrigierender Rückkopplungsmechanismen. Verzögerung zwischen Warnsignalerkennung und wirksamer Korrektur. Tatsächlicher Verlust korrigierender Kapazität. Der vorgeschlagene methodologische Beitrag liegt in einer ausdrücklich strukturierten Verbindung von reproduzierbaren EWS-Benchmarks, der Untersuchung korrektiver Kapazität, transparenter Evidenzklassifikation und wissenschaftlich begründeter diagnostischer Enthaltung. Korrektive Kapazität wird anhand etablierter Konzepte der Regelungs- und Steuerungstheorie operationalisiert. Dazu gehören die Aufrechterhaltung sicherer Zustandsbereiche und das Erreichen definierter Zielbereiche innerhalb festgelegter Zeitfenster, Störungsannahmen und begrenzter Steuerenergie. Das Papier untersucht kritisch den wissenschaftlichen Neuheitsgrad und die Grenzen dieses Ansatzes. Es entwickelt ein falsifizierbares Validierungskonzept mit fünf zentralen Hypothesen (H1–H5), zwei informationsgerecht getrennten Vergleichsklassen (O und M) und zwei prospektiven Auswertungspfaden für Korrekturverzögerungen (H2-O und H2-M). Der vorgeschlagene Benchmark umfasst einheitliche Fehlalarmkalibrierung, Positiv- und Negativkontrollen, statistische Überlegenheits- und Äquivalenzkriterien sowie Anforderungen an unabhängige Replikation. Wissenschaftliche Evidenz und Grenzen: Die mathematische CRTI-Herleitung zur spektralen Kompression wurde unter definierten Annahmen extern begutachtet (AIP Advances, 2026, DOI: 10.1063/5.0337045). Daraus folgt keine empirische Validierung der gesamten BenchEWS-Diagnosearchitektur. Die vorgeschlagenen Komponenten FCQ, SCD, Epistemic Silence und aktive Systembefragung sind als Diagnoseinstrumente bislang nicht validiert. Eine unabhängige Replikation durch Dritte ist nicht dokumentiert. Die zentrale wissenschaftliche These lautet daher nicht, dass BenchEWS bereits nachweislich früher oder zuverlässiger warnt, sondern dass der Übergang von statistischen Warnsignalen zur tatsächlichen Fähigkeit eines Systems zur Selbstkorrektur als eigenständiges, operational überprüfbares Forschungsproblem untersucht werden muss. Veröffentlichungshinweis: Das Manuskript enthält ein vom Autor beauftragtes, KI-gestütztes wissenschaftliches Audit. Es handelt sich nicht um ein unabhängiges externes Peer-Review. Das beschriebene Validierungsprotokoll wurde bislang nicht durchgeführt. Schlüsselwörter BenchEWS; Frühwarnsignale; Kritische Systemübergänge; Komplexe adaptive Systeme; Korrektive Kapazität; Selbstkorrektur; Korrigierende Rückkopplung; Fehler-Wiederherstellbarkeit; Erreichbare Zustandsmengen; Fehlererkennung und -isolation; Spektrale Kompression; CRTI; Selektive Klassifikation; Epistemische Enthaltung; Systemresilienz; Falsifizierbarkeit; Reproduzierbarkeit; Unabhängige Validierung.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇方法论立场论文，提出BenchEWS研究方案，主张把“检测到统计性早期预警信号”与“系统是否仍具备有效自我纠正能力”区分为两个独立问题，并将检测、韧性推断、纠正反馈退化、检测到干预的延迟以及纠正能力实际丧失拆分为五个过程分别考察。作者借用控制论中的故障可恢复性与可达集概念来操作化纠正能力，提出连接可复现基准、证据分级与诊断性弃权的架构，并给出含五条假设的可证伪验证框架，区分仅观测比较与模型知情比较。文章明确说明，除CRTI谱压缩推导经外部同行评审为条件性数学结果外，FCQ、SCD等组件作为诊断工具尚未验证，也无第三方独立复现，验证方案尚未执行，因此其核心主张是这一问题应被独立检验，而非BenchEWS已证明更早或更优的检测性能。
