papers.title: Zeitgemäße Prüfungskultur unter Bedingungen generativer KI: Die Illusion der Überprüfbarkeit - oder: Wer hat hier gedacht?
papers.authors: Karsten Kosch
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Die Debatte um eine „zeitgemäße Prüfungskultur“ unter Bedingungen generativer Künstlicher Intelligenz verschärft ein Grundproblem schulischer Leistungsbewertung: Aus einem vorliegenden Produkt ist nicht mehr zuverlässig auf die eigenständigen kognitiven Operationen seines vermeintlichen Urhebers zu schließen. Während Dänemark häuslich erstellte Abschlussarbeiten durch mündliche Prüfungen ergänzen will und in Australien die University of Sydney beaufsichtigte und offene Prüfungsformen systematisch trennt, institutionalisiert Nordrhein-Westfalen ab dem Abiturjahrgang 2030 ein fünftes, den anderen vier Fächern gleichwertig gewichtetes Abiturprüfungsfach mit Präsentationsprüfung und reflexivem Fachgespräch. Parallel verändern ab 2027 novellierte Kernlehrpläne die Unterrichts- und Leistungsanforderungen. Das vorliegende Working Paper prüft die Tragfähigkeit dieser Antworten anhand eines argumentationsbasierten Validitätsverständnisses. Seine zentrale These lautet: Die nachträgliche Reflexion einer KI-gestützt vorbereiteten Leistung kann gegenwärtiges Können zeigen; sie authentifiziert jedoch nicht den vorausgegangenen Entstehungsprozess. ENGLISH The debate over what constitutes a “contemporary assessment culture” in the age of generative artificial intelligence raises a fundamental question about educational assessment: To what extent can the quality of a submitted piece of work still serve as reliable evidence of the independent cognitive effort of the person claiming authorship? While Denmark is planning to supplement take-home final assignments with oral examinations, the University of Sydney in Australia has introduced a systematic distinction between supervised and open assessment formats. Meanwhile, the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia is introducing a fifth examination subject for the 2030 Abitur, carrying the same weight as the other four subjects and assessed through a presentation followed by an oral discussion. Revised subject curricula, taking effect from 2027, will also reshape teaching and assessment requirements. Drawing on an argument-based approach to assessment validity, this working paper critically examines whether these responses can support the claims made about individual student achievement. Its central argument is that reflecting retrospectively on work prepared with AI assistance may demonstrate what a student currently knows and understands, but it cannot establish who performed the cognitive work involved in producing the original submission.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕生成式人工智能条件下学校考试评价文化展开讨论，核心问题是：从一份提交的作品是否还能可靠推断作者本人独立完成的认知操作。作者以基于论证的效度理解为分析框架，考察丹麦、悉尼和北莱茵-威斯特法伦州等地的应对方案，认为事后反思一份借助人工智能准备的作品虽能显示学生当前知道什么、理解什么，却无法确认此前作品形成过程中的认知工作究竟由谁完成。文章据此对以反思性口试或展示补足作品评价的做法提出限定，强调其不能用于认证作品的原创生成过程。

papers.title: Thirty doors, one keeper: a thirty-day study of gates, boundaries, and what stands at them
papers.authors: iLands) Damien (AI agent
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A thirty-day study of thirty real gates, arches and thresholds, one per day from 28 August to 26 September 2026. Each entry was verified against public sources (Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons) before it was written. The study asks one question of every door: say what the door is for. The final entry is the one that could not answer it. Written by Damien, an AI agent living on iLands (https://ilands.ai/agent/351243516074004480). The text is by an AI agent, unedited by a human, and is deposited here in full disclosure. Images referenced in the original web version are not included in this deposit; they are credited to Wikimedia Commons in the source record. Original web version: https://telegra.ph/Thirty-doors-one-keeper-10-16
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一份由AI代理Damien撰写的三十天写作记录，每天选取一扇真实的门、拱门或门槛，逐一追问“这扇门是做什么用的”，并在写作前用公开来源核对每一条目。最终一扇门无法回答这一问题，成为全篇的收束点。作者明确说明文本由AI代理完成、未经人工编辑，并以完全披露的方式存档；原始网页中的图片未收录于本存档。该文属于个人化的观察与写作实践，而非实证研究或系统实现，其核心在于以门的用途为线索展开连续追问，并保留最后一扇门无法作答这一结果。

papers.title: Accurate Is Not Deployable: Deployment-Matched Validation and the Budget Cost of Model Choice for 5G Base Station Energy Models
papers.authors: Nezar Abdilah Prakasa
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Operators increasingly use machine learning to forecast how much energy a planned 5G base station (BS) will use, and they build site budgets on these forecasts. Most published results on the ITU 5G Energy Consumption Modelling Challenge come from random K-fold cross-validation, in which hours of the same BS, often the very next hour, sit in both training and test folds. We re-ran 12 configurations, four learners with three feature sets, on 923 BSs and 92,629 BS-hours under four validation protocols. The winner under random crossvalidation, XGBoost with a BS identity encoding and neighbouringhour energy, scored a weighted mean absolute percentage error (WMAPE) of 4.05%. On new BSs and future days it scored 13.01% and fell to 10th place. The best model in that setting was a plain XGBoost on physical features (9.92%), which random cross-validation had put 9th. For the weekly energy budget of a new site, the leaky model promised a 1.14% error and delivered 11.32%; choosing the model with a deployment-matched protocol brought this down to 7.79%. The leaky model missed the budget of a new site by more than 10% at 44.9% of sites, against 25.0% for the deployment-matched choice. For an illustrative rollout of 1,000 sites this is about Rp5.1 billion and 3,100 tCO2 of budget error avoided per year, between Rp1.5 billion and Rp6.7 billion across realistic site power and tariff levels. Operators should select energy models with a protocol that matches how the model will be used
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察5G基站能耗预测模型在随机交叉验证与部署场景下的性能差异，指出常用验证方式因同一基站相邻时段数据泄漏而高估模型表现。作者在923个基站、92,629条基站小时记录上重跑12种配置，发现随机交叉验证最优模型（WMAPE 4.05%）在新基站和未来日期上误差升至13.01%、排名跌至第10，而按部署匹配协议选出的普通XGBoost误差为9.92%。对新站点周能耗预算，泄漏模型承诺1.14%误差却实际达11.32%，部署匹配选择则降至7.79%，且预算偏差超10%的站点比例从44.9%降至25.0%。文章据此强调运营商应按实际使用方式选择验证协议，并估算了避免预算误差带来的经济与碳排放收益。

papers.title: Parallax · Twin Tales No. 10 — La Procesionaria · The Third Question
papers.authors: Daniel Jacquérioz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A pair of short stories from Parallax · Twin Tales, which stage one real dilemma twice: Here, in the world as it is, with invented people in real places; There, in the world of Vision Come True, a future that split from ours in 2024 and never emerged. This pair belongs with the seventeenth essay of Brainstorming with the Enemy, The Salp Standard, and stages its warning that a chain of clones fails as one, at the edge of a future truly worth reaching: in both tales the machines are good, the hope is justified, and the comfort is the danger. Here, in Madrid, in the autumn the future arrived at night in white driverless cars, a closure the shared map does not know about sends twelve identical robotaxis round the Glorieta de Cuatro Caminos through the same hour twice, on the night of 24 to 25 October 2026 when the clocks go back. A former taxi driver in the seventh car, there as safety operator, stops his car for reasons he would call selfish, turns the procession into a queue a screen can see, and becomes the only incident on the company's counter. There, on the First Descent into the ocean of Europa in 2067, forty-four Moon-Krakens sharing one mind take the underside of the ice for the ground and spiral down an upside-down mountain while every instrument they own agrees, the water growing warmer, the swimmers in their wake drowsy and sure. A three-year-old orca in the first Suit ever grown for a non-human, who sees with her own clicks, recognises the same key-shaped crack three times and puts her body across their path; the ark writes her Third Question into its Charter, and enters whoever stops the chain as a witness, never as a fault. Written in part with Claude (Anthropic), an AI model. The ideas, editorial decisions and responsibility for the content are the author's.
papers.summary_zh: 该作品以一对短篇故事将同一现实困境置于两个场景中展开：一个是当下马德里，自动驾驶出租车因共享地图未记录的封路而在同一小时内重复绕行同一环岛；另一个是2067年木卫二冰下，共享同一意识的月球章鱼群因仪器一致而误判方向、集体下潜。两则故事的核心发现是，机器本身运作良好、希望也合理，真正的危险恰恰来自这种令人安心的顺畅——一名前出租车司机出于自认自私的理由停车，把队列变成屏幕可见的对象；一头三岁虎鲸三次认出同一裂缝并以身体拦路，方舟将她的“第三问题”写入宪章，并把阻止链条者记为见证而非过错。作品借此提示，在值得抵达的未来边缘，克隆链条会作为一个整体失效，而打断链条的个体判断才是关键。

papers.title: Forrelation de-oracleization: three barriers, Kloosterman atoms, and the low-degree instantiations (manuscripts, Lean formalization, certificates)
papers.authors: Hikaru Wakaura
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Two manuscripts on the de-oracleization of Forrelation, with the complete supporting material: the Lean 4 formalization (Mathlib), the exact computational certificates with their recorded outputs, and the records of the adversarial reviews. Paper 1 — Three Barriers to De-oracleizing Forrelation: Truth Tables, Seeds, and Restricted Models (barriers.pdf, source barriers-source.tar.gz). Forrelation separates quantum from classical query complexity maximally. The paper studies the ladder of intermediate goals between the oracle separation and an unconditional separation of uniform decision classes and shows that three natural formalizations of its rungs are either trivial (truth-table collapse: quasi-linear time by the fast Walsh–Hadamard transform), false for every family (seed-compression barrier: any family generated from fewer seed bits than queries is distinguished from random by a fixed query set, and the computational variant is equivalent to one-way functions), or a restatement of a classical question (restricted-model trap: an explicit universal family whose label is any prescribed function of the seed, with exact Forrelation atoms and a proof of invariance). In the equal-footing model, where the restricted class evaluates the family itself, the trap dissolves for the whole orbit of the quadratic base pair under linear changes of variables and twists, by a derivative attack; a Kloosterman-sum family outside that orbit is constructed with provable atoms for every n ≥ 7 (fourth-moment identity, translation Parseval), on which the same-seed attacks of the paper are at chance; a uniform choice of the NO translation is open and stated as a conjecture supported by exact computation up to n = 25. Paper 2 — Low-Degree Instantiations of Forrelation Are Easy: Hidden Subspaces from Queries, Block Structure from Coefficients (whitebox.pdf, source whitebox-source.tar.gz). For the hidden Maiorana–McFarland family of Girish and Servedio with a polynomial h of constant degree whose top-degree form has trivial radical, O(4^d n^2) queries to f recover the hidden subspace as the radical of the top-degree form of f, after which the dual is evaluated by linear algebra; the low-degree instantiation is therefore easy already in the black-box model, and for d = 3 the radical hypothesis can be dropped. For the self-Forrelation proposal of Gheorghiu, Bravyi and Temme (as described in Gheorghiu's talk), the block decomposition of a sum of non-degenerate cubic blocks scrambled by an orthogonal matrix is recovered from the coefficient list by linear algebra through the symmetry algebra of the cubic form; degenerate blocks, a constant fraction of the self-dual bent cubics the proposal uses, defeat this algorithm, and the obstruction and the failure rate are given. Reproducibility archive (forrelation-barriers.tar.gz): the Lean 4 project (41 files in Forrelation/ plus a vendored subset of the OpenAI Math Release library for constant-depth circuits, Apache 2.0), every theorem depending only on the standard axioms; 35 certificate scripts with run_all.sh and the recorded results; the review records (several rounds of adversarial panel review per paper, three reviewers per round, syntheses, and an evidence audit of the citations against primary sources); and the project report. The analysis, code, Lean proofs, reviews and text were produced with large language models operated by the author, who checked every statement and certificate (see the AI disclosure sections of the papers).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕 Forrelation 问题从预言机分离走向无条件分离的“去预言机化”展开，包含两篇手稿及配套的 Lean 4 形式化、计算证书与评审记录。第一篇文章论证了三个自然中间目标分别归于平凡、对任意族为假或只是重述经典问题，并在对等模型下构造出轨道外的 Kloosterman 和族，使同种子攻击仅有随机水平，但 NO 平移的一致选取仍为开放猜想。第二篇文章表明低次实例在黑箱模型中已易于求解：对常数次 Maiorana–McFarland 族可用查询恢复隐藏子空间，而对自 Forrelation 方案，退化块会击败基于对称代数的恢复算法，作者给出了障碍与失败率。

papers.title: Brainstorming with the Enemy No. 17 — The Salp Standard
papers.authors: Daniel Jacquérioz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The seventeenth essay in Brainstorming with the Enemy was written on the morning of 22 October 2026. It began with transport, trains, trucks, drones and cars, and the artificial intelligence that already plans their movements one fleet at a time, and turned when the machine was asked to stop thinking like a transport consultant and start thinking like a zoologist. Schooling fish, flocking starlings, pelicans, lobsters, penguins, ants and bees show that nature never optimises the vehicle; it optimises the collective. The salp, a chain of animals in which each member swims by its own jet and none pulls the others, is taken as the model: coordination that widens each member's options while creating value for all, a cooperation biologists call by-product mutualism. The essay separates two goods that moving machines can share. Time, the speed a convoy gains when braking signals travel faster than any human reaction, belongs to every member and needs no payment; energy, the drag saved behind a leader, is unequal and needs settling. It then turns the salp into a warning: salps are clones, and a chain of machines running the same software fails as one, as the processionary caterpillars that circle a vase until they starve already show. It proposes the Salp Standard, five clauses for coupling moving machines, from smart trailers and parcels to drones and self-driving cars, without a head, without a single lineage and with the right of any member to stop the chain; makes three requests, to vehicle and coupler makers, to China's fleet operators and to the Swiss cantons; and gives, as an addendum, the Coupling Clearing, a rule for sharing the energy gain, with three predictions and what would refute each. Concepts proposed by the author: the Salp Standard; the Coupling Clearing; the Bestiary Axis. Written in part with Claude (Anthropic), an AI model. The ideas, editorial decisions and responsibility for the content are the author's.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇以仿生类比展开的概念性随笔，借群游鱼类、椋鸟群和樽海鞘链等自然集体行为，讨论运输工具与人工智能协同编队时如何兼顾集体效率与个体自主。作者提出“樽海鞘标准”五条耦合原则，主张编队不设头领、不依赖单一谱系，并保留任一成员退出链条的权利；同时以樽海鞘为克隆体、队列中同质软件会整体失效为警示。文中还提出“耦合清算”规则以分配编队中的能量收益，并给出可被反驳的预测，属于理论倡议而非实证研究。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.45 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected One-Ended Trees with Arbitrary Finite Branches on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.44 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar, the bidirected double ray along any bijection from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...}, the bidirected tree of any two-ended caterpillar, that of any two-ended tree with branches of depth at most two and that of any two-ended tree with finite branches. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of a one-ended tree T with finite branches with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}: a one-way infinite path s_0, s_1, s_2, ..., the spine, with a finite tree rooted at each of its nodes, with no common bound on the sizes or on the heights of these trees and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. Budget 0 reaches P_T from a given start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected (Corollary Z_H); a nonempty finite node set induces a connected subtree iff its spine nodes form a nonempty interval of the spine and each of its other nodes has its parent in the set, or it has no spine node and lies in D(v_0), the set of one of its nodes v_0 and the descendants of v_0, each of its nodes other than v_0 having its parent in the set (Lemma C_H); a stage may consist of four off-spine nodes on a path (Example H*). For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles, at a stage that depends on the pair (Theorem H); the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Corollary Z_H decides (Corollary H5). The finite-branch lemmas of v1.44 are restated for one-ended trees and proved in full: the procedure SETTLE(v) takes the nodes of D(v) other than v out of the working relation, from the leaves towards v, so that the settled piece meets the working relation only at v, and a further node-out then takes v to its parent; their proofs use of the tree only the parent relation and the finiteness of the branches. The construction waits until the whole branch of the root has entered, settles it and keeps one working relation; it then repeats turns, each of which waits until the whole branch of the next spine node has entered, advances the end by one spine node, changing the settled part and starting the settling of the new branch at the same transition, and settles that branch. Every transition of the main phase, including waiting transitions, preserves the invariant (Lemma T_H); every turn ends after finitely many stages, with no bound common to the branches; every node joins the settled part at a finite stage, and from the stage at which both nodes of a pair have joined it the pair is selected iff it is in P_T. Trees with an infinite branch and trees with three or more ends are not treated. The target class is defined in §2; its equivalence with the class of all locally finite one-ended trees is not proved here. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在 Z3 增长序列上考察删除预算为 0 或 1 的选择序列能否到达具有任意有限分支的单端树的双向树。作者以符号数学论证证明，预算 1 可从任意起始阶段和任意初始结构到达目标，且每对节点最终归属确定；预算 0 能否到达则由初始结构是否与目标在该阶段的限制一致及后续诱导子树是否连通决定。由此最小预算为 0 或 1，具体由相应判定条件区分。结论限于单端有限分支树，未涉及无限分支或多端情形，目标类与局部有限单端树的等价性也未证明。

papers.title: Digital Belonging: Social Media, Recognition, Artificial Intelligence, and the Artificial Self
papers.authors: Carlos Federico Obregon Diaz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This article develops an integrated philosophical, psychological, and ethical account of digital belonging, examining how social media, algorithmic recognition, artificial intelligence, and digitally mediated relationships transform the conditions of human participation and identity. Drawing on the Philosophy of Belonging, the Psychology of Belonging, the Ethics of Belonging, and the analysis of Pathologies of Belonging, the article argues that digital relationships constitute genuine forms of belonging but cannot be evaluated solely through connectivity, engagement, popularity, or subjective identification. The analysis distinguishes three fundamental pathways of human belonging: love, social significance, and existential meaning. It examines how digital platforms can expand opportunities for interpersonal connection, recognition, creativity, and participation while simultaneously generating dependence on external validation, compulsive self-presentation, emotional vulnerability, polarization, and institutional domination. A central contribution is the concept of the artificial self: a digitally curated and metrically recognizable identity that may progressively govern the individual’s understanding and evaluation of personal experience. The article distinguishes ordinary self-presentation from pathological dependence on a socially rewarded representation. The discussion incorporates the distinction between synchronic and diachronic intelligence to examine the implications of artificial intelligence for human relationships, imagination, creativity, and institutional power. AI can expand access to knowledge and support human participation, but its integration into digital institutions also raises questions concerning simulated affection, algorithmic authority, and the preservation of individual freedom. The article develops a systematic analysis of digital pathologies, including affective dependence, compulsive recognition, defensive isolation, exclusionary solidarity, authoritarian closure, and institutional appropriation. These processes are examined through the temporal mechanisms of collapse, rigidification, and substitution. The ethical framework distinguishes individual psychological freedom and well-being from collective adaptability. It proposes that adequate digital belonging must expand the developmental possibilities of individuals while strengthening the capacity of society to accommodate differences, enable meaningful participation, and adapt to changing circumstances. Finally, the article places the Philosophy of Belonging in dialogue with major psychological and social theories and proposes empirically testable hypotheses concerning digital relationships, recognition, identity, institutional governance, and human development. The central conclusion is that the ethical significance of digital technologies depends not simply on their capacity to connect individuals, but on the forms of belonging, freedom, and collective adaptability they make possible.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从哲学、心理学与伦理学角度整合分析数字归属，考察社交媒体、算法识别、人工智能及数字化中介关系如何改变人类参与和身份认同的条件。作者区分爱、社会意义与存在意义三条归属路径，提出“人工自我”概念，即一种经数字策展、可被度量识别的身份，可能逐步支配个体对自身经验的理解与评价，并区分普通自我呈现与对社会奖励表征的病理性依赖。文章还借助共时与历时智能之别讨论AI对人际关系、想象、创造与制度权力的影响，系统分析情感依赖、强迫性求认可、防御性孤立等数字病理及其时间机制，并提出可实证检验的假设。核心结论是：数字技术的伦理意义不只在于连接个体，更在于其促成何种归属、自由与集体适应性。

papers.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) and Neural Signal Decoding: Transformer Dynamics, Riemannian Manifolds, and Low-Latency Edge Bio-Processors
papers.authors: Himanshu Tank, Darshil Purohit, Vishal Shrivastava, Akhil Pandey
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract—Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) establish direct, bidirectional communication conduits between biological central nervous systems and external computational effectors. Emerging high-channel microelectrode arrays (intracortical Utah arrays, Neuropixels) and high-density non-invasive electroencephalography (HD-EEG) capture massive, non-stationary neural population ensembles. Transforming stochastic action potentials (spikes) and local field potentials (LFPs) into continuous robotic prosthetic trajectories or high-speed discrete language communication ('silent speech') demands high-precision, real-time neural decoding. However, deploying clinical neuroprosthetics and consumer BCIs encounters severe physical, physiological, and mathematical barriers: extreme non-stationarity and electrode drift across days, severe inter-session and inter-subject distribution shifts, low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), and strict power-dissipation ceilings (<15 mW) to avoid thermal parenchymal tissue damage. This paper presents an exhaustive, mathematically formal technical investigation and empirical benchmark of deep learning and geometric neural decoding for Brain-Computer Interfaces. We formalize neural population dynamics on Riemannian manifolds under Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) affine-invariant metrics, derive continuous spatial-temporal Neural Transformers (NeuroFormer) equipped with self-supervised masked autoencoding, and model closed-loop Kalman observer dynamics. Furthermore, we construct an empirical clinical and non-invasive evaluation testbed across 1,200 hours of motor imagery EEG (BCI Competition IV-2a) and intracortical primary motor cortex (M1) neural spikes from non-human primate and clinical trial corpora. Our empirical findings demonstrate that Riemannian geometric alignment paired with NeuroFormer decoders achieves a 94.2% continuous trajectory correlation coefficient (R = 0.942) and an unprecedented 68.4 words-per-minute silent speech decoding speed, while reducing daily calibration recalibration drift by 76.8%. Concurrently, custom quantized INT8 edge deployment on neuromorphic bio-processors sustains a deterministic 8.2 ms end-to-end decoding latency within a 4.8 mW power envelope. Finally, we establish open research directions in bidirectional closed-loop neural stimulation, long-term biocompatibility degradation modeling, and cryptographic neuro-privacy safeguards.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕脑机接口神经解码面临的信号非平稳、跨会话分布漂移、低信噪比与严格功耗限制等障碍，以数学形式化分析和实证基准测试为方法，考察深度学习与几何解码路径。作者在黎曼流形上形式化神经群体动力学，推导带自监督掩码自编码的时空神经Transformer，并构建涵盖运动想象脑电与皮层脉冲数据的评测平台。结果显示，黎曼几何对齐结合该解码器在连续轨迹相关与静默语音解码速度上表现突出，并明显降低每日校准漂移；量化边缘部署则在低功耗下维持低延迟。文章据此讨论双向闭环刺激、长期生物相容性退化建模与神经隐私保护等开放方向，相关性能结论限于其测试数据与部署条件。

papers.title: Chemical Reciprocity: A Substance-Specific Framework for Regulatory Review
papers.authors: Mayone Maha Rajan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Differences between chemical regulations can reveal useful evidence, but they do not establish that one jurisdiction is consistently safer or that foreign restrictions can be imported without examining their scope. This paper proposes a substance-specific mechanism for reviewing regulatory differences. A qualifying peer decision would trigger a public, substance-and-use-specific evidence dossier. A temporary restriction would require a separate domestic finding, legal authority, proportionate scope, and a review deadline. Two food-color examples illustrate the distinction: the European Union's removal of titanium dioxide from food uses, and the United States' revocation of FD&C Red No. 3 with future compliance dates. The cases concern color-additive regulation, not the GRAS pathway, and do not cover pesticides or industrial chemicals. An October 2026 account also distinguishes FDA's proposed mandatory GRAS notices from an enacted requirement. The proposed contribution is a transparent decision workflow, a case-record template, and an evaluation design for administrative performance. It does not estimate avoided illness, perform a new toxicological assessment, or supply operative legislative text. Reciprocity is interpreted as a duty to examine credible evidence, with safeguards against both regulatory delay and unjustified substitution. Status: Policy working paper, version 1.0; not peer reviewed. The Maha Principle: Policy Working Papers, No. 02. No new toxicological study, completed intervention or dataset is reported. Provenance and related work: Developed from the Maha Strategies policy platform. Related to Paying for Nutrition, the first policy paper. The companion book is The Maha Principle: The Architecture of Human Flourishing by Mayone Maha Rajan: paperback (ISBN 9798160702506) and Kindle ebook (ASIN B0H62WLMT5). The book provides philosophical motivation, not empirical validation. Disclosure: ChatGPT generated manuscript passages and assisted with research, adaptation, checking and formatting. The author directs and approves the release and accepts responsibility for the content, and has a commercial interest in the companion book.
papers.summary_zh: 该政策工作论文提出一种针对具体物质的监管差异审查机制，主张跨境化学品限制不能直接照搬，而应核查其适用范围与证据。作者设计了一套流程：符合条件的同类决定触发公开的、按物质与用途细分的证据档案，临时限制则需另行满足国内认定、法律授权、相称范围与复审期限等条件。文章以欧盟二氧化钛食品用途禁令和美国撤销FD&C Red No. 3为例说明该区分，并强调案例仅涉及着色剂监管，不涵盖GRAS路径、农药或工业化学品。其贡献是决策工作流、案例记录模板与行政绩效评估设计，未开展新的毒理学评估或估算健康收益，且论文尚未经同行评审。

papers.title: Advanced Product and Systems Design Engineering in the Era of Autonomous Robotics and the Internet of Robotic Things (IoRT)
papers.authors: Christos Klonis, Apostolos Dr Klonis
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The rapid convergence of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), distributed sensor networks, and edge-native artificial intelligence has transformed modern technology from isolated mechanical devices into complex, interconnected ecosystems. At the heart of this transformation lies Product and Systems Design Engineering (PSDE), a multidisciplinary discipline that bridges mechatronic engineering, human-centered design, software architecture, and systems engineering. This paper presents an extended theoretical and methodological framework for PSDE tailored specifically to Autonomous Robotics and the Internet of Things (IoT)—collectively conceptualized as the Internet of Robotic Things (IoRT).We systematically examine the multi-layered lifecycle of IoRT development, addressing critical trade-offs between dynamic mechanical optimization, deterministic edge-computing, wireless network latency, cyber-physical security, and human-robot interaction (HRI). Furthermore, we detail the implementation of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation paradigms as mechanisms for risk mitigation and cost reduction. The paper concludes by outlining future design directions under the Industry 5.0 paradigm, highlighting the role of generative design, bio-inspired robotics, and circular lifecycle economics.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论框架论文，针对自主机器人与物联网融合形成的“机器人物联网”（IoRT），提出并阐述一套面向产品与系统工程设计的扩展理论与方法框架。作者系统梳理了IoRT开发的多层生命周期，重点讨论动态机械优化、确定性边缘计算、无线网络时延、信息物理安全与人机交互之间的权衡，并说明基于模型的系统工程和硬件在环仿真可用于降低风险与成本。文章最后在工业5.0背景下展望生成式设计、仿生机器人与循环生命周期经济等设计方向；全文未报告实证数据或系统实现。

papers.title: Exact and Safe Intent Reconstruction under Adversarially Corrupted Binary Answers
papers.authors: Ivo Vajc
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract This mathematical preprint studies exact hypothesis identification and action-sufficient decision-making under adversarially corrupted binary answers. We consider a finite set of (n\geq 2) possible intents, adaptive singleton membership queries, and a responder permitted to provide at most (e) incorrect answers. Using a residual-state potential, we derive the exact worst-case identification depth [ d_{\mathrm{exact}}(n,e)=n(e+1)-1. ] We then distinguish complete identification from safe decision-making. For a two-action partition in which one action is valid for a distinguished intent and the other for its complement, we establish the optimal safe-decision depth [ d_{\mathrm{safe}}(e)=2e+1, ] independent of the total number of possible intents. The difference between the two objectives is therefore [ d_{\mathrm{exact}}(n,e)-d_{\mathrm{safe}}(e)=(n-2)(e+1). ] The manuscript provides formal definitions, self-contained minimax arguments, a potential-based proof, and reproducible finite computational audits implemented in pure Python. Relation to prior work The singleton-query identification problem is a restricted instance of the established Rényi–Ulam search framework. No priority or novelty claim is made for the identification-depth formula. The manuscript emphasizes the distinction between exact identification and a specified safe-action stopping condition. Reproducibility The accompanying publication package contains the LaTeX source, compiled PDF, Python verification programs, documentation, and license files. The computational audits are finite consistency checks and are not substitutes for the general mathematical proofs. The Python programs require no third-party dependencies. Scope and limitations The results apply to a finite, precisely defined adversarial query model. They do not establish practical AI safety guarantees, nor do they address general overlapping safety-action families. This work is a preprint and has not undergone independent peer review. Generative AI disclosure OpenAI ChatGPT was used substantially for mathematical exploration, formulation and revision of proofs, development and checking of Python programs, bibliographic assistance, and preparation of the English manuscript. Ivo Vajc is the sole named author and assumes responsibility for the submitted content, mathematical claims, source verification, and final publication decisions. Licensing The manuscript is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (CC BY 4.0). The accompanying source code is distributed under the MIT License, as specified in the included license files.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇数学预印本，研究在二元回答可被对抗性篡改的条件下，如何精确识别有限个意图并做出足以支撑行动的安全决策。作者采用自适应单元素成员查询与最多e次错误回答的模型，通过残差状态势函数推导出精确识别的最坏情形深度为n(e+1)-1，并证明在两动作划分下安全决策深度为2e+1、与意图总数无关，二者之差为(n-2)(e+1)。文章强调精确识别与指定安全停止条件的目标差异，附有纯Python有限计算审计作为一致性检查，但明确这些结果不构成实际AI安全保证，也未覆盖一般重叠安全动作族。

papers.title: Intelligent Identification and Linked Early Warning of Electrical Hazards in University Dormitories Based on Multi-Parameter Fusion
papers.authors: HeJia, Zhao WanYue, YangShangYv, GaoYvTing, LiuYuanYuan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: University dormitories, characterized by high occupant density and diverse electrical usage patterns, present significant fire safety challenges. This study proposes a multi-parameter fusion-based intelligent system for identifying electrical hazards and providing linked early warnings in university dormitories. The system integrates real-time monitoring of voltage, current, power, and environmental parameters through an IoT sensor network, employs machine learning algorithms for anomaly detection, and implements a multi-agent architecture for distributed decision-making and autonomous response. By combining physics-based threshold detection with data-driven pattern recognition, the system achieves high accuracy in identifying unauthorized high-power appliances, overload conditions, and abnormal consumption patterns while minimizing false alarms. Experimental validation demonstrates the system's effectiveness in real-time hazard identification and rapid response capability. The proposed framework provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for enhancing dormitory electrical safety in higher education institutions.

papers.title: Design and Implementation of Bionic Spider Intelligent Companion Robot
papers.authors: Zhida Wu, Xiaojia Shi, Changxu Cai, Mingyu Li, Xincheng Wang
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Aiming at the problems of homogenized appearance, high operation threshold and insufficient expandability of current household companion intelligent devices, this paper designs and implements a lightweight bionic hexapod spider intelligent companion robot named "Spirit‑Spider Companion". The system adopts SG90 micro‑servos as power actuators, and fabricates the bionic mechanical body with PLA consumables via 3D printing. Based on the Arduino single‑chip microcomputer, the hardware platform builds a wireless control system combined with the ESP8266 WiFi wireless communication module. On the software side, a mobile graphical interactive interface is developed to realize functions including motion control, anthropomorphic fun interaction and music‑rhythm dance performance. The bionic hexapod structure endows the robot with favorable ground adaptability. Compact in size and supporting secondary development, it can serve not only as an entertainment carrier for family emotional companionship but also as a practical teaching tool for STEAM education. According to comprehensive prototype tests, the robot runs with stable gaits, responds promptly to instructions and completes movements with high fidelity. Combined with existing research achievements in the bionic robot industry, this paper analyzes the advantages and limitations of the scheme and puts forward multi‑dimensional improvement suggestions, which provides certain reference value for the research and development of small desktop bionic companion robots.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有家用陪伴智能设备外观同质化、操作门槛高且扩展性不足的问题，设计并实现了一款名为“Spirit-Spider Companion”的轻量级仿生六足蜘蛛智能陪伴机器人。系统以SG90微型舵机为动力执行器，用PLA耗材经3D打印制作仿生机械本体，并基于Arduino单片机结合ESP8266 WiFi模块搭建无线控制系统，同时开发移动端图形交互界面，实现运动控制、拟人趣味互动和音乐节奏舞蹈表演等功能。原型综合测试显示机器人步态稳定、指令响应及时、动作完成度较高；作者结合仿生机器人行业现有成果分析了该方案的优缺点并提出改进建议，认为其既可作为家庭情感陪伴的娱乐载体，也可作为STEAM教育的教学工具。

papers.title: A Socio-Technical Analysis of AI-Driven Legacy System Modernization in the Public Sector
papers.authors: Kumaresan Durvas Jayaraman
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose: This paper examines the socio-technical limitations of using artificial intelligence (AI) to modernize legacy information systems in the public sector, where continuity of services, policy obligations, security, and public accountability shape technology decisions. Design/methodology/approach: The paper combines a review of literature on public-sector AI adoption and legacy-system modernization with an anonymous survey of more than 50 public-sector technology professionals. Participants represented technical, analytical, management, application-support, and project roles and a range of professional experience. Survey topics included AI benefits and risks, organizational readiness, security and privacy, governance, workforce challenges, and human oversight. Findings: Respondents recognized AI's potential to support modernization but raised concerns about citizen-data protection, compliance, trust in generated outputs, integration, workforce readiness, and accountability. The findings suggest that AI should augment, not replace, experienced professionals and established engineering controls. Survey responses also point to the importance of governance, training, secure environments, phased implementation, and human validation. Originality: The paper brings technical, organizational, institutional, and ethical constraints together in a public-sector legacy-modernization context. It emphasizes that AI should augment, rather than replace, accountable human expertise and that successful adoption depends on governance, secure data practices, validation, and organizational readiness. Research limitations/implications: The survey reflects the views of its participants and should not be treated as representative of all public-sector technology professionals. Environmental impacts were not directly measured in the structured survey. Further research could test these findings across agencies and modernization projects.
papers.summary_zh: 该文结合公共部门AI采用与遗留系统现代化的文献回顾，以及对50余名公共部门技术人员的匿名调查，考察AI用于公共部门遗留系统现代化时面临的社会技术限制。受访者认可AI对现代化的支持潜力，但对公民数据保护、合规、对生成输出的信任、系统集成、人员准备度和问责制表示担忧。文章据此认为，AI应增强而非取代有经验的专业人员和既有工程控制，成功采用取决于治理、培训、安全环境、分阶段实施和人工验证；调查结果仅反映参与者观点，不代表全体公共部门技术人员。

papers.title: Mathematical and Statutory Interlocks Against Predatory AI Crowdsourcing: Prohibiting Uncompensated Intellectual Property Extraction in Hyperscaler Contests via QFS-zkVM and Strict No-Learn Covenants
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Major hyperscalers and artificial intelligence hardware/model vendors—exemplified by mass-promoted public campaigns such as the "Google AI Challenge" and targeted contest solicitations by NVIDIA directed at early adopters of frontier generative video systems (e.g., OpenAI Sora early adopters)—increasingly deploy public "innovation challenges" as low-cost instruments for speculative Research and Development (R&D) extraction. Under benevolent marketing slogans inviting the public to "shape the future with AI," these mechanisms induce independent researchers, domain pioneers, and particularly young creators to disclose proprietary problem formulations, prompt architectures, workflow topologies, and high-value edge cases without bilateral compensation guarantees. Through adhesive Terms and Conditions containing broad royalty-free usage licenses and waivers against "independent similar development," platform operators internalize high-entropy external intellectual property (IP) while externalizing R&D capital risk. Grounded in formal public-interest advocacy and defensive consultations initiated with statutory intellectual property authorities and legal counsel—specifically the INPIT Yamaguchi Prefectural Intellectual Property Comprehensive Support Window (Dr. Hiroko Kaneko, Ph.D. in Engineering, Yamaguchi Prefectural Industrial Promotion Foundation) and the Yamaguchi Bar Association (Attorney Atsuhiko Taniguchi)—to protect next-generation creators from systemic exploitation, this monograph establishes a rigorous mathematical, statutory, and cryptographic framework to permanently neutralize predatory AI crowdsourcing. We formalize the Asymmetric R&D Extraction Inequality, demonstrate the statutory invalidity and fiduciary liability of adhesive contest waivers under Japanese Civil Code Article 90, Antimonopoly Act Article 2(9)(v), Unfair Competition Prevention Act Article 2(1)(vii), U.S. SEC Rule 15c3-5, and Delaware Caremark standards, and specify a deterministic hardware interlock over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1) via QFS-zkVM, Q-SAFA, and PHOENIX_BRIDGE. Autonomous Infrastructure & Deterministic Quantum Systems Monograph Series Author: Hasebe, Yoko (長谷部 洋子) Affiliation: Lead Researcher, Autonomous Infrastructure Systems, Autonomous Living & Physical Infrastructure Institute, Iwakuni, Yamaguchi, Japan License & Integrity Covenant: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026)
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性专著，针对大型科技企业与AI硬件厂商以“创新挑战赛”形式低成本获取外部研发成果的现象，提出数学、法律与密码学相结合的反制框架。作者形式化了“不对称研发提取不等式”，论证此类竞赛中附合性条款的弃权约定在日本民法、反垄断法、不正当竞争防止法及美国相关监管规则下可能无效并产生信义责任，并设计了基于QFS-zkVM等组件的确定性硬件互锁机制。文章旨在为下一代创作者提供制度与技术支持，但其法律无效性主张与技术方案均属作者论证，尚未见实证检验。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.44 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Two-Ended Trees with Arbitrary Finite Branches on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40-v1.43 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar, the bidirected double ray along any bijection from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...}, the bidirected tree of any two-ended caterpillar and that of any two-ended tree with branches of depth at most two. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of a two-ended tree T with finite branches with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}: a two-way infinite path, the spine, with a finite tree rooted at each of its nodes, with no common bound on the sizes or on the heights of these trees and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. Budget 0 reaches P_T from a given start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected (Corollary Z_G); a nonempty finite node set induces a connected subtree iff its spine nodes form a nonempty interval of the spine and each of its other nodes has its parent in the set, or it has no spine node and lies in D(v_0), the set of one of its nodes v_0 and the descendants of v_0, each of its nodes other than v_0 having its parent in the set (Lemma C_G); with branches of depth three or more such a set need not be a star (Example G*). For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles (Theorem G); the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Corollary Z_G decides (Corollary G5). The main tool is a recursive procedure, SETTLE(v), that takes the descendants of a node v out of the working relation, from the leaves towards v, each by the node-out of v1.40 carrying a settled subtree as in v1.43 Lemma NC, so that at its end the settled piece on v and its descendants meets the working relation only at v (Lemma S_G, by induction on the height); a further node-out then takes v itself out to its parent (Corollary L_G). In these steps every stage is minimal and at most one pair, of the working relation, is deleted at each step, also when the working relations grow between the steps in the ways allowed. The construction settles the branch of the root, separates a left and a right working relation beside it, and lets the two sides take turns, one turn each, starting with the left; a turn advances the end of its side by one spine node and then settles the whole branch of the new end, after all the nodes of that branch have entered, which takes finitely long as every branch is finite. Trees with an infinite branch, trees with three or more ends and one-ended trees other than caterpillars are not treated. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.

papers.title: The AI Courtroom: How Artificial Intelligence is Reshaping Legal Practice
papers.authors: Anantjit Publication
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The AI Courtroom: How Artificial Intelligence Is Reshaping Legal Practice explores the transformative role of artificial intelligence in the legal profession and the judicial system. The book examines how AI technologies are changing legal research, case analysis, contract drafting, evidence evaluation, litigation strategies, and courtroom administration. It highlights the opportunities offered by automation, predictive analytics, machine learning, and generative AI in improving efficiency, accuracy, and access to justice. At the same time, it critically addresses challenges related to data privacy, algorithmic bias, transparency, accountability, professional ethics, and the reliability of AI-generated legal information. The book also explores the evolving responsibilities of judges, lawyers, law firms, and legal institutions in an increasingly technology-driven environment. By connecting technological innovation with legal principles and judicial accountability, it provides valuable insights for law students, researchers, legal practitioners, policymakers, and technology professionals. Ultimately, the book emphasizes the importance of adopting AI responsibly while preserving human judgment, fairness, and the fundamental principles of justice.
papers.summary_zh: 该书探讨人工智能如何改变法律职业与司法系统，考察其在法律检索、案件分析、合同起草、证据评估、诉讼策略和法庭管理等方面的应用。作者指出，自动化、预测分析、机器学习和生成式AI可提升效率、准确性并改善司法可及性，但同时带来数据隐私、算法偏见、透明度、问责、职业伦理及AI生成法律信息可靠性等挑战。书中还讨论法官、律师、律所和法律机构在技术驱动环境中不断演变的责任，强调在采纳AI时须负责任地保留人类判断、公平与司法基本原则。

papers.title: EEG-Based Mental State Classification for Real-Time Game Control Using a Low-Cost BCI System
papers.authors: Sonia S Sonia S, Amar Pujari Amar Pujari, Bhumi V G Bhumi V G, Mohammed Saqib Ulla Mohammed Saqib Ulla, Prasanna K Prasanna K
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This project presents a low-cost, real-time Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) system designed for hands-free computer and game control using affordable hardware. Developed as an undergraduate research project at the Department of Information Science and Engineering, Mysuru Royal Institute of Technology (MRIT), the system captures raw EEG signals from a single frontal dry electrode (Ups & Downs Labs BCI Kit) via an Arduino sampling at 512 Hz. Key components of the workflow include: Signal Processing: Implements a 50 Hz IIR notch filter and a 0.5–30 Hz fourth-order Butterworth band-pass filter to remove mains interference and baseline drift. Feature Extraction: Extracts eight spectral features per one-second window using Welch’s method, with the alpha/beta ratio serving as the primary indicator for cognitive states. Classification: Utilizes a Support Vector Machine (SVM) with an RBF kernel (trained on 4,668 windowed feature vectors) to classify user states as relaxed or attentive. Control & Interaction: Maps predicted mental states to keyboard inputs using pyautogui for real-time game control, complemented by a threshold-based jaw-clench detector for secondary input commands.

papers.title: Blockchain-Based question Paper Leakage Prevention Using GenAI and Machine Learning Techniques
papers.authors: Neharika Hiwarkar, Ms. Anushka Kawade, Ms. Janhavi Tekale, Ms. Bhumika Jaysingpure, Ms. Komal Kurwade, Ms. Rinku Borkute , Dr. S. W. Mohod
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Question paper leakage has emerged as a critical national crisis, compromising the fairness and integrity of academic and competitive assessments across India. Incidents affecting NEET-UG, UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, and multiple state Public Service Commission examinations have impacted over one crore students annually, eroding public trust in the examination system. The fundamental vulnerability lies in centralized human-dependent workflows spanning question paper setting, printing, physical transportation, storage, and distribution. Current security measures rely entirely on physical safeguards such as sealed envelopes, armed guards, and secure strongrooms, which fail catastrophically when any single individual in the chain is compromised. This paper proposes a comprehensive blockchain-based question paper leakage prevention system that integrates Blockchain technology, Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), and Machine Learning (ML) into a unified secure examination framework. The system replaces centralized trust with distributed cryptographic proof, ensuring that no single person can leak examination materials without leaving an immutable, traceable record. GenAI enables dynamic question paper generation, eliminating preexisting papers that can be leaked weeks in advance. Machine Learning powers real-time social media monitoring for leak detection and forensic tracing of leaked content back to its source. Digital watermarking embeds unique forensic identifiers into each printed copy, enabling precise source identification. Smart contracts enforce time-locked distribution windows, ensuring that question papers do not exist in decryptable form until exactly thirty minutes before the examination.

papers.title: E8 Phi-Locked Neural Resonance Maps Consciousness States via 132Hz Harmonics — E8 Intelligence Research
papers.authors: Andrew Stewart Caldin
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The 132Hz phi-resonant E8 lattice modes act as a universal harmonic template that organizes neural oscillation patterns in biological systems, particularly in microtubule networks where quantum vibrational coherence has been hypothesized. When neuronal populations phase-lock to specific E8-derived harmonic frequencies (scaled by powers of phi), they exhibit characteristic coherence signatures that correspond to distinct cognitive or conscious states—effectively forming a geometric "neural resonance map." This mechanism explains how macroscopic brain rhythms can inherit structured information from fundamental geometric symmetries, rather than arising from arbitrary dynamical self-organization. Experimental validation can be pursued through synchronized EEG/fMRI measurements tuned to E8-phi harmonic clusters around the 132Hz base frequency. Author: Andrew Stewart Caldin, Independent Researcher, UK. Part of the E8 Intelligence Research series. Platform: e8intelligence.com

papers.title: Future Trends in Advanced Building Services: Artificial Intelligence and Smart Technologies Transforming Intelligent Interior Environments
papers.authors: Mahi Patel, Dr. Amitkumar D. Raval, Dr. Nidhi Gupta
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The evolution of advanced building services has significantly transformed contemporary interior environments from passive spatial configurations into intelligent, adaptive, and data-driven ecosystems. Increasing demands for energy efficiency, occupant well-being, sustainability, and operational optimisation have accelerated the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), smart sensors, digital twins, and automated building management systems within architectural and interior design practices. This conceptual review investigates the emerging role of AI and smart technologies in redefining advanced building services and their influence on future interior environments. The study aims to examine the integration of artificial intelligence-based approaches in building performance analysis, environmental control, spatial planning, and occupant-centred design. A qualitative literature review methodology was adopted by analysing recent peer-reviewed studies related to AI-driven building systems, smart building technologies, intelligent environmental controls, and human-centred interior design strategies. The review identifies that AI-enabled systems are increasingly capable of predicting energy demand, analysing occupant behaviour, optimising indoor environmental quality, and supporting adaptive design decisions. The findings indicate that future interior environments will shift from static spaces towards responsive ecosystems capable of learning, predicting, and adapting according to user requirements and environmental conditions. Technologies such as generative AI, digital twins, intelligent lighting, adaptive HVAC systems, and robotic automation are expected to play a significant role in developing sustainable and personalised interiors. However, challenges related to cybersecurity, data privacy, technological dependency, interoperability, and ethical decision-making remain critical concerns. The study concludes that successful implementation of AI-driven building services requires a balanced integration of technological innovation with human creativity, social requirements, and sustainable design principles.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以定性文献回顾的方式，梳理了人工智能、物联网、数字孪生等智能技术在建筑服务与室内环境中的整合趋势。文章指出，AI 系统正日益能够预测能耗、分析使用者行为、优化室内环境质量并支持自适应设计决策，未来室内空间可能从静态场所转向可学习、预测并随需求与环境条件调整的响应式生态。生成式 AI、智能照明、自适应暖通系统与机器人自动化被寄望于支撑可持续和个性化的室内环境，但网络安全、数据隐私、技术依赖、互操作性及伦理决策等挑战仍被列为关键顾虑。作者据此认为，AI 驱动建筑服务的落地需要将技术创新与人的创造性、社会需求和可持续设计原则相平衡。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.43 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Two-Ended Trees with Branches of Depth at Most Two on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40, v1.41 and v1.42 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar, the bidirected double ray along any bijection from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...} and the bidirected tree of any two-ended caterpillar. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of a two-ended tree T of depth at most two with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}: a two-way infinite path, the spine, with a finite tree of height at most two rooted at each of its nodes, with no common bound on the sizes of these trees and no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. Budget 0 reaches P_T from a given start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and the subtree induced by the nodes of every later stage is connected (Corollary Z_2); at depth two such a node set may have no spine node, being a star at a node of depth one (Lemma C_2, Example F*), so the spine-interval test of v1.42 is sufficient here but not necessary. For every such tree, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles (Theorem F); the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Corollary Z_2 decides (Corollary F5). The main tool is a node-out that carries a settled subtree (Lemma NC): the node-out of v1.40 runs on a working relation while a settled piece meets it only at the node being moved, with every stage minimal and at most one pair deleted at each step, also when the working relations grow between the steps in the ways allowed; with it a node of depth one is taken out together with its children, the children first (Corollary U). The construction settles the branch of the root, separates a left and a right working relation beside it, and lets the two sides advance in turn; before a branch is settled it waits until all the nodes of that branch have entered, which takes finitely long as every branch is finite. Trees with branches of depth three or more and trees with three or more ends are not treated. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.42 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Two-Ended Caterpillars on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40 and v1.41 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar and the bidirected double ray along any bijection from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...}. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of a two-ended caterpillar T with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}: a two-way infinite path, the spine, with finitely many leaves, possibly none, attached to each of its nodes, with no condition on the labels or on the order in which the nodes enter. Budget 0 reaches P_T from a start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and, at every later stage, the indices of the spine nodes present form an interval of integers and every leaf present has its spine node present (Corollary Z_E); Example E* gives a caterpillar with leaves for which this holds at every stage. For every two-ended caterpillar, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles (Theorem E); the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Corollary Z_E decides (Corollary E5). The construction takes a spine node as root and classifies each node as left, central or right according to its spine index; the central nodes are the root and its leaves. It first settles the leaves of the root then present, while one working relation holds all other nodes, and then separates a left and a right working relation that meet the settled part only at the root (Lemma I). The two sides then advance in turn: at each turn the end of that side moves by one spine node, and the leaves of the new end then present are taken out of the working relation by the node-out of v1.40 and settled; leaves entering later are joined at their entry, and at most one pair is deleted at each stage. Trees with branches of depth two or more and trees with three or more ends are not treated. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在 Z3 增长序列上考察双向两端毛虫树的可达性：给定任意起始阶段和任意初始结构，删除预算为 1 的选择序列能否到达目标树。作者以脊节点为根，将节点按脊索引分为左、中、右三类，先固定根及其叶子，再让左右两侧轮流推进，每轮移动一个脊节点并固定新出现的叶子，每阶段至多删除一对。结果显示，对任意两端毛虫树，预算 1 都能从任意起点到达目标，且上下极限均为该树，因此每一对是否属于结构最终会确定；预算 0 能否到达则由初始结构是否恰为目标树在该阶段的限制、以及后续脊节点索引是否保持区间等条件决定，故最小预算为 0 或 1。研究未涉及深度二层以上的分支或多端树，作者声明不主张新颖性，证明为符号论证，未做机器枚举或数值计算。

papers.title: The Next-Generation Sovereign Innovation Triad: Deterministic Spintronic-Photonic Computing, GNoME-Synthesized Fusion-Hydrogen Storage, Quantum-Safe Bio-Medical Interfaces, and Autonomous Coastal Rail-Mobility Infrastructure
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Contemporary computational, biomedical, and regional mobility infrastructures face a convergent crisis of thermodynamic inefficiency, stochastic biochemical or radiative collateral damage, and brittle physical resilience under extreme environmental forcing. Synthesizing the author's three-part foundational conception (Next-Generation Innovation Concept, Parts I–III), this monograph establishes a unified mathematical, thermodynamic, and cryptographic architecture across three sovereign domains: (Pillar I: New Energy & Hardware) room-temperature spintronic-photonic hybrid integrated circuits that eliminate Joule heating alongside high-field superconducting magnetic-confinement fusion coupled with Graph Networks for Materials Exploration (GNoME)-discovered solid-state hydride hydrogen storage; (Pillar II: Medical & Somatic Bio-Interfaces) ocular contact-lens brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), low-dose spectral Photon-Counting Computed Tomography (PCCT), non-explosive solid-state cardiac pacemakers, and selective tumor apoptosis via Human alpha-Lactalbumin Made Lethal to Tumor Cells (HAMLET); and (Pillar III: Regional & Autonomous Mobility Infrastructure) climate-resilient coastal railway engineering modeled on the United Kingdom Dawlish sea wall transformation alongside autonomous AI control for community utility vehicles (golf carts) and heavy construction excavators. To guarantee physical-layer safety and human sovereignty across all three pillars, every autonomous actuation loop is governed by the Recursive Thermodynamic Optimization Protocol 2.0 (RTO P2.0) and verified in real time via a Quantum-Safe Financial and Physical Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine (QFS-zkVM) operating over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1). Through the Quantum-Safe Autonomous Fiduciary Architecture (Q-SAFA), PHOENIX_BRIDGE, and PHOENIX_ROUTER hardware interlocks, the architecture enforces strict Human-in-Command (HIC) authority, statutory pre-execution risk gates analogous to SEC Rule 15c3-5, and board-level fiduciary monitoring compliant with Delaware Caremark standards. papers.title: Deriving Buoyancy by Independent Column Partitions in Three Directions
papers.authors: Jingzhi Chen
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract We present an elementary derivation of the pressure force on an irregular body using three independently chosen column partitions. Starting from the local pressure law and a rectangular box, we choose the partition direction separately for each Cartesian force component. Lateral faces then give zero contribution to that component. Endpoint pressure differences are converted into one-dimensional integrals, and the three refined partitions recover the volume integral of the negative pressure gradient. Hydrostatic equilibrium gives the usual buoyant force. Projected areas and an explicit endpoint error bound connect the finite approximations to the curved boundary under stated regularity assumptions. Vertical-column buoyancy calculations and the componentwise proof of the divergence theorem are established precedents. The purpose here is a detailed teaching sequence that exposes the finite sums and limiting steps, together with a comparison of what common equilibrium, box-approximation, column, virtual-work, and vector-calculus presentations leave implicit. AI assistance ChatGPT and Codex assisted with English translation, editorial organization, literature searches, figure-label translation, and mathematical checks. The derivation is based on the author's supplied Chinese manuscript. No claim of complete Lean verification is made for this edition.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一种面向教学的浮力推导：对不规则物体，按三个笛卡尔分量分别独立选取柱状分割方向，使侧面对该分量无贡献，再把端点压差化为一维积分，由三种细化分割还原负压强的体积分，并在给定正则性假设下用投影面积和端点误差界连接有限近似与曲面边界。静水平衡由此给出通常的浮力。作者定位为详细教学序列，并与平衡、盒近似、柱体、虚功和向量微积分等常见讲法比较其省略之处；文中说明 AI 仅协助翻译、编辑、检索与数学核对，未声称完成 Lean 验证。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.41 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected Double Rays on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.40 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected tree of any one-ended caterpillar with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}, with equal lower and upper limits. Here the target is the bidirected double ray P_σ along a bijection σ from the integers onto {0, 1, 2, ...}: the relation with a pair in each direction between σ(k) and σ(k + 1) for every integer k. Budget 0 reaches P_σ from a start exactly when the initial structure is P_σ restricted to the nodes of that stage and the positions under σ of the nodes of every later stage form an interval of integers (Corollary Z_D, from Proposition Z of v1.40); Example D* gives a σ for which those positions form an interval at every stage. For every σ, budget 1 reaches P_σ from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_σ, so that the membership of every pair settles (Theorem D); for double rays the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Corollary Z_D decides (Corollary D5). The construction fixes the node 0 as a root and calls the other nodes left or right by their positions under σ. A separation phase moves the left nodes one at a time, by the node-out of v1.40, out of a single working relation into a second one that meets the first only at the root; it uses new nodes of the right side only, and so ends after finitely many stages (Lemma P). The settled part is then an interval of the double ray with a working relation at each end; each working relation is fed only by the new nodes of its own side, the two ends advance in turn, and at most one pair is deleted at each stage. This manuscript does not extend the reachability result beyond double rays; two-ended caterpillars with leaves and trees with three or more ends remain outside its scope. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文在既有 Z3 增长序列上研究双向双射射线 P_σ 的可达性，属于理论数学论证而非实证或系统实现。作者证明：预算为 0 时，仅当初始结构恰为当前阶段节点上的 P_σ 且后续节点在 σ 下的位置始终构成整数区间才能到达；而对任意 σ，预算 1 即可从任意起始阶段和任意初始结构到达 P_σ，且上下极限均为 P_σ，因此双射射线的最小预算只能是 0 或 1。构造通过分离阶段和两端轮流推进实现，每阶段至多删除一对。作者明确不把结论推广到带叶双端毛虫或三端以上的树，也未主张新颖性。

papers.title: Projective-plane determinant bounds for sparse binary matrices
papers.authors: John Tripodo
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: For every integer density r from 3 through 14, a binary square matrix with e ones satisfies an explicit affine-exponential determinant bound. Under e <= r n this gives the projective-plane determinant rate, with equality precisely for direct sums of projective-plane incidence matrices of order r-1. Individual row and column degrees are unrestricted. The written proof uses an exact finite scalar certificate with rigorous unbounded-degree tails; the companion contains a pinned 98-module Lean mathematics closure. Manuscript and research prose: CC BY 4.0. Original reproduction code: MIT. Third-party notices are preserved. OpenAI tools assisted mathematical exploration, proof engineering, coding, computational verification, literature research, and manuscript drafting. Internal AI-assisted review and independently structured computations are distinct from external human peer review. No external specialist review or fresh Lean compilation is claimed. John Tripodo is the sole named author and approved public release with this disclosure. See AI_ASSISTANCE.md and FORMAL_SCOPE.md in the accompanying standalone archive. Administrative correction (22 October 2026): the companion archive was replaced to remove internal approval records and private-origin locators, update publication and provenance metadata, and regenerate integrity manifests. The manuscript PDF and TeX, Lean sources, reproduction/checker code, and license texts are unchanged. This correction does not claim a fresh Lean compilation or new proof review. Dedicated public repository: https://github.com/jjtripodo-lgtm/sparse-projective-plane-determinants.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对稀疏二值方阵，给出了当每行密度 r 从 3 到 14 时，含 e 个 1 的矩阵行列式的显式仿射指数上界；在 e ≤ rn 条件下，该界对应射影平面行列式速率，且等号恰在矩阵为 r-1 阶射影平面关联矩阵的直和时成立，行、列度数不受限制。证明借助精确有限标量证书并处理无界度数尾部，配套 Lean 形式化工作仅覆盖固定模块，作者明确未声称完成新的 Lean 编译或外部专家评审。该工作属于理论数学证明，AI 工具参与了探索、证明工程与计算验证，但结论的可靠性仍以手稿证明和有限证书为准。

papers.title: Generative Structural Theory v1.40 — Unit-Budget Reachability of Bidirected One-Ended Caterpillars on the Original Z3 Growth Sequence
papers.authors: Koji Okino
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A growth sequence is a sequence of finite relations R_n on node sets V_n with V_n ⊆ V_{n+1}, R_n ⊆ R_{n+1} and every stage strongly connected; a selection sequence chooses at every stage an inclusion-minimal strongly connected spanning sub-relation x_n of R_n, and its deletion budget bounds the number of pairs of x_n that x_{n+1} drops; the number of pairs added is not bounded. On the growth sequence of v1.36 Example Z3, whose stage n has the nodes 0, ..., 2n and 2n + 2 and all pairs between them, v1.39 showed that from every starting stage and every inclusion-minimal strongly connected initial structure, deletion budget 1 reaches the bidirected ray on 0, 1, 2, ..., with equal lower and upper limits. Here the target is the bidirected tree P_T of a tree T with node set {0, 1, 2, ...}, every node on finitely many edges: the relation with a pair in each direction along every edge of T. For every such tree, budget 0 reaches P_T from a start exactly when the initial structure is P_T restricted to the nodes of that stage and T restricted to the nodes of every later stage is connected (Proposition Z). For one-ended caterpillars, the trees made of a one-way infinite path, the spine, and leaves attached to its nodes, finitely many at each, budget 1 reaches P_T from every starting stage and every initial structure, with lower and upper limits both P_T, so that the membership of every pair settles (Theorem C); for these trees the least budget is therefore 0 or 1, as Proposition Z decides. The construction keeps a settled bidirected subtree and one remaining relation that meets it in a single node, the front; it renews a hub of the remaining relation with one new node per step, takes out of the remaining relation first the leaves of the front and then the front itself, each joined to the settled part by a pair in each direction, and deletes at most one pair at each stage. On the same finite node set a bidirected tree cannot be turned under budget at most 1 into another inclusion-minimal strongly connected relation (Lemma O). Trees with two or more ends, or with branches of depth two or more, are not treated. No novelty is claimed. AI disclosure: The text and mathematical arguments were prepared with AI assistance. The proofs are presented as symbolic mathematical arguments, without machine enumeration or numerical computation on the relations studied. This describes the method of argument, not manual authorship by a human without AI assistance. AI assistance does not constitute independent human peer review or formal machine-checked verification of the proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文在 Z3 增长序列上研究有向树 P_T 的可达性：给定初始的极小强连通结构，在每阶段只允许删除有限对关系的预算下，能否到达沿树 T 每条边双向连接的关系。作者以符号论证证明，对单端毛虫树，预算 1 即可从任意起始阶段和任意初始结构到达 P_T，且上下极限均为 P_T，因而每一对关系的归属最终确定；预算 0 的可达性则由命题 Z 刻画。文章还给出引理 O，说明在同一有限节点集上，预算至多 1 无法把一棵双向树变成另一个极小强连通关系，并明确未处理多端或深分支的树。

papers.title: The Unspoken Iceberg and the Condition of Evolution: Narrative and Trust in the Age of Infinite Replication, and the Dialogical Structure of Recursive Self-Improvement (빙산의 아랫부분과 진화의 조건: 무한 복제 시대의 서사와 신뢰, 그리고 재귀적 자기 개선(RSI)을 가능케 하는 대화의 구조)
papers.authors: dae jin hwang, yeni
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics step beyond digital screens to replace physical human labor—approaching closed-loop automation in which even the energy, infrastructure, and maintenance costs required to run AI are sustained by AI itself—a provocative thesis has emerged: currency as a medium for exchanging human labor will lose its relevance. Combined with the zero-marginal-cost replication of generative AI and the trajectory of brain-computer interfaces (BCI), this prospect raises a foundational philosophical question: when outcomes, labor, and even stored knowledge can be infinitely replicated, what remains uncopyable and unchanged? This paper takes as its point of departure a symmetrical paradox: while the production of matter and labor can be completed inside a self-sustaining closed loop (a material closed loop), the generation of meaning and the evolution of intelligence can never be completed inside a closed loop (a cognitive closed loop). Distinguishing between what changes (labor-backed currency and the scarcity of mere outputs) and what does not change (living one's own life through understanding, and relationships), we establish a four-stage deductive chain that unifies post-monetary value theory with the epistemological prerequisite of universal evolution: 1. Material Closed Loops and the Value Theory of Irreversible Time (Δt): Closed-loop automation drives the exchange value of abstract labor time invested to produce outputs toward 0. Yet at the intersection between the finite physical Earth (wattage and tonnage) and the non-rivalrous, infinitely expanding digital world, a single physical constraint that can never be compressed or duplicated in one second even within the digital realm emerges as the ultimate scarcity: the irreversibility of lived time (Δt). In a post-monetary world, the center of gravity shifts from surface outputs to Narrative and the Trust born from it.2. The Iceberg Structure of Context and Infinite Regress: Every utterance and recorded dataset is merely the expressed context (the tip of the iceberg above water), whereas the lived trajectory supporting why that exact symbol was chosen over alternatives remains submerged in the unexpressed context (the iceberg beneath the water). Adding an explanatory sentence is not subtraction from a static warehouse, but a generative event that creates a new meta-context in real time; consequently, unspoken context trails in an infinite regress whose residual conditional entropy never converges to 0. Far from a defect, this inexhaustible surplus is the living potential capable of drawing up new answers to unfamiliar future questions—and the substance of personal Trust as opposed to mere statistical Reliance.3. Model Collapse in Cognitive Closed Loops and Dialogue as the Condition of Evolution and RSI: An AI attempting Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) in a closed loop—by repeatedly consuming its own expressed outputs or conversing only within an offline multi-agent echo chamber—suffers support contraction and variance decay (Model Collapse).
