Across biological co-evolution, human growth, and AI self-improvement (RSI), the universal prerequisite is expressing internal potential outward, colliding with an uncontrollable external world and other minds who have lived through independent irreversible time (Δt), and rewriting oneself—which is Dialogue. --- 본 논문은 “물질과 노동의 생산은 닫힌 루프(물질적 폐루프)로 완결될 수 있으나, 의미의 생성과 지능의 진화는 결코 닫힌 루프(인지적 폐루프)로 완결될 수 없다”는 대칭적 역설을 출발점으로 삼아, ① 물질적 폐루프와 비가역적 시간(Δt)의 가치론(서사와 신뢰), ② 표현된 맥락(빙산의 윗부분)과 표현하지 않은 맥락(빙산의 아랫부분)의 무한후퇴, ③ 인지적 폐루프의 모델 붕괴를 넘어 생물·인간·AI의 진화와 재귀적 자기 개선(RSI)을 가능케 하는 보편적 전제조건으로서의 ‘대화’를 규명한다.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论论文，从“物质与劳动生产可闭环、意义生成与智能演化不能闭环”这一对称悖论出发，提出一条四阶段推演链。作者论证：闭环自动化会使抽象劳动时间的交换价值趋零，而不可逆的亲身时间（Δt）成为终极稀缺，价值重心转向叙事及由此产生的信任；任何话语和数据集只是“水上冰山尖”，支撑其选择的未表达语境无限后推、残余条件熵不收敛于零，这一盈余恰是应对未来新问题的活力来源，也是个人信任区别于统计性依赖的实质；AI若在闭环中反复消费自身输出或仅在离线多智能体回音室中对话，会出现支持收缩与方差衰减的模型崩溃。由此文章主张，生物协同演化、人类成长与AI递归自我改进的共同前提是与经历独立不可逆时间的外部世界和他者心智碰撞并改写自身的“对话”。

papers.title: Trustworthy Digital Mediation for Renaissance Heritage: Authenticity, Bias, and Cognitive Security in AI Assisted Storytelling
papers.authors: Marco Marsili
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Digital technologies and AI are rapidly transforming cultural mediation, enabling scalable cataloguing, personalized interpretation, and immersive experiences that bring historical content to new audiences. In the MARY4ALL context—where Renaissance architecture, arts and music associated with Mary of Hungary are digitally re-activated through multisensory installations and digital storytelling—the question is no longer whether AI can enhance access, but under which conditions it can remain trustworthy, inclusive and sustainable. This paper proposes a practical framework for “trustworthy digital mediation” that addresses three intertwined dimensions: (i) authenticity and provenance of AI-assisted reconstructions (including disclosure of synthetic elements, documentation of sources, and uncertainty communication); (ii) bias and representational integrity in narrative choices and personalization (e.g., whose heritage is foregrounded, which voices are omitted, and how recommendation logics may steer collective memory); and (iii) cognitive security risks affecting public history, such as narrative manipulation, deepfake-enabled confusion, and attention-driven polarization when heritage content circulates through platform ecosystems. Building on research on information/cognitive warfare, human rights and governance of emerging technologies, the paper translates security and rights-based concerns into museum-ready safeguards and governance practices—lightweight enough for heritage institutions, yet robust enough to support accountability. The contribution concludes with a concise set of implementable recommendations (checklists and “red flags”) for curators, digital producers and cultural-route managers, aimed at strengthening public trust while preserving cultural integrity and ensuring socially and environmentally responsible innovation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对文艺复兴遗产的AI辅助叙事，提出“可信数字中介”框架，讨论AI增强文化传播时如何保持可信、包容与可持续。作者围绕三个相互关联的维度展开：AI辅助重建的真实性与来源（含合成元素披露、来源记录与不确定性说明）、叙事选择与个性化中的偏见和表征完整性（如谁被突出、谁被省略、推荐逻辑如何影响集体记忆），以及公共历史面临的认知安全风险（如叙事操纵、深度伪造引发的混淆和平台传播中的注意力极化）。文章借鉴信息与认知战、人权及新兴技术治理研究，将这些关切转化为适合博物馆的保障措施与治理实践，并给出面向策展人、数字制作者和文化路线管理者的清单与“警示信号”建议。该文属框架与建议性论文，未报告实证检验。

papers.title: Sploty i Praktyki. Raport z badania działań partycypacyjnych w polskich muzeach, bibliotekach i domach kultury
papers.authors: Marta Błaszczyńska
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Raport przedstawia wyniki badania praktyk partycypacyjnych w polskich muzeach, bibliotekach oraz domach i centrach kultury, przeprowadzonego w ramach projektu „Sploty i Praktyki” Pracowni Otwierania Kultury fundacji Centrum Cyfrowe. Jego celem było rozpoznanie sposobów współpracy instytucji z publicznością, warunków sprzyjających trwałości tych działań oraz barier utrudniających przechodzenie od konsultowania do współtworzenia i współdecydowania. Analiza opiera się na przeglądzie literatury i wcześniejszych badań, 70 ankietach samoewaluacyjnych oraz sześciu wywiadach pogłębionych z przedstawicielkami i przedstawicielami instytucji kultury. Ze względu na niereprezentatywny charakter próby wyniki opisują badaną grupę i nie powinny być uogólniane na cały sektor. Praktyki przeanalizowano w czterech powiązanych obszarach: programie, przestrzeni fizycznej i cyfrowej, komunikacji oraz zarządzaniu. Wyniki pokazują, że partycypacja rozwija się w nich nierównomiernie. Zbieranie opinii, rozpoznawanie potrzeb, udostępnianie przestrzeni i współtworzenie pojedynczych działań występują częściej niż trwałe mechanizmy udziału społeczności w planowaniu i podejmowaniu decyzji. Praktyka często wyprzedza jej umocowanie w strategii, podziale odpowiedzialności i ewaluacji wpływu. Trwałości współpracy sprzyjają jasne określenie zakresu wpływu uczestników, czas, zasoby, ciągłość finansowania, odpowiedzialność rozłożona na zespół, dokumentowanie doświadczeń oraz wzajemność relacji. Rezultatem projektu jest internetowe narzędzie samoewaluacji „Sploty i Praktyki” (centrumcyfrowe.pl/splotyipraktyki), które pomaga instytucjom rozpoznawać mocne strony i obszary wymagające rozwoju, korzystać z katalogu dobrych praktyk, planować zmiany oraz powracać do diagnozy po ich wdrożeniu. Dziękujemy osobom i instytucjom, które podzieliły się z nami swoją wiedzą i doświadczeniami w trakcie wywiadów pogłębionych oraz rozmów o dobrych praktykach. Dziękujemy też wszystkim respondentom i respondentkom badania ankietowego. Dofinansowano ze środków Ministra Kultury i Dziedzictwa Narodowego w ramach programu Narodowego Centrum Kultury „Kultura – Interwencje 2026”. This report presents the findings of a study of participatory practices in Polish museums, libraries, and cultural centres, conducted as part of the “Sploty i Praktyki” project developed by the Opening Culture Studio of the Centrum Cyfrowe Foundation. The study aimed to identify how cultural institutions collaborate with their audiences, the conditions that support the sustainability of such practices, and the barriers that hinder the transition from consultation to co-creation and shared decision-making. The analysis draws on a review of the literature and previous research, 70 self-assessment questionnaires, and six in-depth interviews with representatives of cultural institutions. As the sample is not representative, the findings describe the participating institutions and should not be generalised to the cultural sector as a whole. The practices were analysed across four interconnected areas: programming, physical and digital spaces, communication, and management. The findings show that participation develops unevenly across these areas. Collecting feedback, identifying needs, making spaces available, and co-creating individual activities are more common than permanent mechanisms enabling communities to participate in planning and decision-making. In practice, participatory activities often precede their formal integration into institutional strategies, divisions of responsibility, and impact evaluation. Sustainable collaboration is supported by clearly defining the scope of participants’ influence, sufficient time and resources, continuity of funding, shared responsibility across the team, documentation of experience, and reciprocity in relationships. The project resulted in the online “Sploty i Praktyki” self-assessment tool (centrumcyfrowe.pl/splotyipraktyki), which helps institutions identify their strengths and areas for development, draw inspiration from a catalogue of good practices, plan changes, and return to the assessment after implementing them.
papers.summary_zh: 该报告考察波兰博物馆、图书馆和文化中心如何与公众开展参与式合作，以及哪些条件支撑这类实践的持续性、哪些障碍妨碍其从征询意见走向共同创造与共同决策。分析基于文献回顾、自我评估问卷和深度访谈，但样本不具代表性，结论仅描述参与机构，不能推广到整个文化部门。作者从项目、实体与数字空间、传播和管理四个相互关联的领域分析实践，发现参与式实践发展不均衡：收集意见、识别需求、开放空间和共同创造单项活动较为常见，而让社区持续参与规划和决策的稳定机制较少，实践往往先于战略、责任分工和影响评估方面的制度化。明确参与者的影响范围、时间与资源、资金连续性、团队共同担责、经验记录和互惠关系有助于合作持续。项目还产出了在线自我评估工具，供机构识别优势与待发展领域、参考良好实践案例并规划改进。

papers.title: Erosión cognitiva en la industria 5.0:
papers.authors: Adriana Zavala Martínez, Martha Yaneth Segura Ruiz, María Erika Pecina Rivas
papers.journal: INTERSOSTENIA Ciencia Desarrollo e Innnovación por la convergencia de saberes
papers.abstract: Technical, social, avant-garde, global, and cognitive pressures are driving the adoption of new technologies characterized by constant updates and automation most notably generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and autonomous agents. While the stated intention is to augment and enhance human capabilities regarding complex challenges, skills, and critical thinking rather than replacing them recent empirical evidence suggests the actual trend is moving in the opposite direction, to the detriment of consumers. This study analyzes the flaws and risks stemming from the use and misuse of these cutting-edge technologies, aiming to propose intervention frameworks before they become irreversibly entrenched in a fragile structure within the technology adoption cycle. It explores phenomena such as the atrophy of technical skills, the productivity paradox, cognitive offloading, over-reliance on automated systems, and the irony of automation, drawing on evidence from randomized controlled trials and large-scale surveys conducted between 2025 and 2026. This analysis examines the critical failures and systemic risks of these cutting-edge technologies, aiming to propose regulatory and operational intervention frameworks before their negative effects become irreversibly embedded in the labor market and social fabric. Identifying these risk vectors early allows for the design of guidelines that restore human control, ensuring technology acts as a genuine complement rather than an agent of cognitive and professional erosion. Furthermore, there is high demand for courses, diploma programs, and workshops focused on critical thinking, reflecting a growing awareness of the need to pursue them.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕第五次工业革命背景下生成式人工智能与自主智能体的采用风险展开分析，属于结合实证证据的综述性讨论，而非作者开展的新实验。文章梳理了技术技能萎缩、生产力悖论、认知卸载、对自动化系统的过度依赖及自动化讽刺等现象，并援引2025至2026年间的随机对照试验与大规模调查证据。作者据此提出监管与操作层面的干预框架，主张在风险嵌入劳动力市场和社会结构之前恢复人类控制，使技术成为真正的补充而非认知与职业侵蚀的动因，同时指出对批判性思维相关课程与培训的需求正在上升。

papers.title: Inteligencia artificial y sostenibilidad educativa en la educación superior virtual
papers.authors: Marco Antonio Román Villegas, Liliana Benítez Jaimes, Juan Manuel Peña Aguilar
papers.journal: INTERSOSTENIA Ciencia Desarrollo e Innnovación por la convergencia de saberes
papers.abstract: Virtual higher education seeks to address the growing demand for sustainable, inclusive, and ethical educational models within the context of digital transformation and the progressive integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI). The purpose of this study is to analyze the pedagogical, ethical, and organizational conditions required for the implementation of AI applications related to academic tutoring and student monitoring from the perspective of educational sustainability. The research adopts a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design. The quantitative phase consists of a questionnaire using Likert-scale items administered to students, faculty members, and academic tutors, followed by a qualitative phase based on semi-structured interviews aimed at exploring in greater depth the perceptions, experiences, and tensions identified during the quantitative stage. The discussion is structured around four key dimensions: institutional ethical governance, AI-supported academic tutoring, digital inclusion, and systematic evaluation. The findings suggest that AI can contribute to ensuring the continuity of students’ educational pathways, enhancing personalized learning experiences, and enabling the early identification of academic risks. However, it may also give rise to challenges related to privacy, algorithmic bias, surveillance, technological dependency, and the displacement of professional judgment. The study concludes that AI can effectively contribute to educational sustainability only if it is implemented as a transparent decision-support tool that complements, rather than replaces, human judgment while ensuring data protection, accessibility, faculty oversight, and institutional accountability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从教育可持续性视角出发，采用顺序解释性混合方法，结合面向学生、教师和学术导师的问卷调查与半结构化访谈，分析在虚拟高等教育中实施AI学业辅导与学生监测所需的教学、伦理和组织条件。研究发现，AI有助于保障学生学业路径的连续性、增强个性化学习体验并支持早期识别学业风险，但同时可能带来隐私、算法偏见、监控、技术依赖以及削弱专业判断等问题。作者据此认为，只有当AI作为透明的决策支持工具、补充而非取代人的判断，并配合数据保护、可及性、教师监督和机构问责时，才能有效促进教育可持续性。

papers.title: La inteligencia artificial en universidades, reflexión para la filosofía de la ciencia y la sostenibilidad
papers.authors: Alfredo Gómez González, Lucero Gómez González, Rodrigo Cornejo Ortega
papers.journal: INTERSOSTENIA Ciencia Desarrollo e Innnovación por la convergencia de saberes
papers.abstract: University classrooms are where students acquire higher-level knowledge and develop skills for future professional development in a work environment that requires decision-making through analysis, synthesis, and evaluation. Artificial intelligence provides guidance to students as a support tool, but there is a risk that it may become invasive or substitute for solving, thinking, and dictating what should or can be done, resulting in negative impacts and generating significant risks. The objective is to investigate students' reflections of artificial intelligence for their proper training, which must consciously consider sustainability and the importance of the philosophy of science to position it as a technological advancement. The paradigm is qualitative, as it involves discussion and the speculative aspects of the philosophy of science. Worksheets and a Likert scale were used to collect information. The results show that approximately 35% of respondents agree on the positive and negative aspects of its use, highlighting risks and benefits. The most radical position, which defends artificial intelligence, is held by a very small percentage of the total respondents.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从科学哲学与可持续性的视角出发，考察大学生如何反思人工智能在自身专业培养中的使用，采用定性取向，通过工作表与李克特量表收集学生的看法。结果显示，约三成半的受访者同时认可人工智能带来的益处与风险，持较为平衡的态度；而完全为人工智能辩护的立场仅占很小比例。文章据此提示，高校在把人工智能作为学习支持工具时，需要引导学生有意识地权衡其便利与替代思考的隐患，并将可持续性与科学哲学反思纳入相关讨论。

papers.title: Supporting or Replacing Students' Reasoning? Cognitive Offloading in AI-Assisted Proof Learning
papers.authors: Eason Chen, Sophia Judicke, Kayla Beigh, Xinyi Tang, Isabel Wang, Nina Yuan, Zimo Xiao, Chuangji Li, Siyi Li, Reed Luttmer, Shreya Singh, Maria Yampolsky, Naman P. Parikh, Yvonne Zhao, Meiyi Chen, Scarlett Huang, Anishka Mohanty, Gregory Johnson, John Mackey, Jionghao Lin, Ken Koedinger
papers.abstract: We studied 153 students in an undergraduate proof-based mathematics course with staggered-access to an AI support system. Students were randomly assigned to receive an AI chatbot and a homework-feedback interface earlier or later in the course. During the period when only the early-access group had access, their homework scores were 2.56 points higher, but exam performance did not differ significantly between groups, suggesting that improved AI-supported homework performance did not translate into detectable gains on a subsequent exam. After all students received access, every additional 100 messages sent to the AI chatbot was associated with a 3.02-point lower score on the subsequent exam. A mediation analysis showed a significant indirect association linking lower baseline self-efficacy to greater chatbot use and, in turn, lower exam scores: a one-point decrease in self-efficacy corresponded to 0.62 fewer exam points through chatbot use. These findings raise concerns that students may use the chatbot to offload their cognitive reasoning. Use of the homework-feedback interface, which required students to submit their proof attempts before receiving feedback, was not negatively associated with exam performance. We recommend against using a chatbot for AI tutoring and suggest exploring a tutor embedded in the course activities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在本科证明类数学课程中考察了学生使用AI聊天机器人与作业反馈界面对学习的影响，学生被随机分配到较早或较晚获得AI支持的组别。在仅早期组可使用期间，其作业分数更高，但两组考试表现无显著差异，提示AI辅助带来的作业提升未转化为可检测的考试收益；全体获得访问后，聊天机器人消息量越多，后续考试成绩越低，且中介分析显示较低基线自我效能通过更多使用聊天机器人间接关联更低的考试分数。相比之下，要求先提交证明尝试再获反馈的作业反馈界面与考试成绩无负向关联。作者据此担忧学生可能借聊天机器人卸载认知推理，建议不将聊天机器人用于AI辅导，转而探索嵌入课程活动的辅导方式。

papers.title: What the submission does not show: Complexifying cognitive offloading in students' mathematical work with LLMs
papers.authors: Igor’ Kontorovich, Miriam N Wallach
papers.abstract: A common concern is that using large language models (LLMs) lets students offload mathematical work that tasks are designed to elicit. Yet such claims often rest on outcomes (e.g., submitted solutions), rather than on evidence of students' work with LLMs. We followed 23 first-year linear algebra students as they solved three differently designed homework tasks with LLMs. Drawing on self-regulated learning and choice-affluent environments, we interpreted each of 429 prompts as a trace of a regulatory event and compared 59 chatlogs with the problem solutions the students submitted. Prompts formed five structures, casting the LLM mainly as a solver, explainer, or validator. The mix of structures shifted across the tasks, and ten of the 15 students who completed all three tasks changed their dominant structure. Most final submissions stayed close to LLM output, including those that followed exchanges in which students had explained, conjectured, and checked their own ideas. We conclude that an LLM-aided submission is not a trustworthy marker of students' offloading of the mathematical work, and that offloading needs to be examined in each regulatory space and part by part rather than as a whole.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注学生使用大语言模型完成数学作业时是否将工作外包，但指出仅凭提交的答案难以判断。作者追踪23名大一线性代数学生借助大语言模型完成三项不同设计的作业，将学生的提示词视为自我调节事件，并与最终提交的解答对照。结果显示，提示词主要形成五种结构，模型多被当作求解者、解释者或验证者，且结构随任务变化，多数最终提交内容接近模型输出，即便此前学生曾自行解释、猜想和检查。作者据此认为，提交成果不能可靠反映学生是否外包数学工作，外包需按调节空间和部分逐一考察。

papers.title: CoWriter: Guiding Methodological and Synergetic Human-LLM Co-Authoring
papers.authors: Shmuel Amar, Benjamin Lieber, Ori Shapira, Debanjana Kar, Sebastian Dennerlein, Yufang Hou, Ido Dagan
papers.abstract: While LLMs have transformed text generation, standard chat-and-canvas interfaces often reduce human authoring to quite passive supervision, causing review fatigue, over-reliance on AI, and the sidelining of the human role in long-form, source-grounded writing. Prior systems typically address isolated writing phases, leaving comprehensive end-to-end human-LLM collaboration largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CoWriter, a proactive agentic scheme that adapts expert human (co-)authoring methodologies from cognitive science to flexibly steer the entire writing workflow while actively encouraging the user to engage. In an exploratory user study, compared to a standard LLM baseline, authors using CoWriter better expressed their perspectives and maintained a higher sense of document ownership, supported quantitatively by $2.2\times$ more successful agent engagements. Furthermore, external reader judges rated the resulting texts higher in "human touch" qualities like storytelling and integrating unique personal experiences. Overall, our results demonstrate that proactively engaging users through established human practices is beneficial for effective LLM-supported co-authoring, providing useful methodologies, techniques and insights for future research on collaborative agents.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对长文写作中聊天式界面使人沦为被动监督者、引发审阅疲劳与过度依赖的问题，提出并实现了主动式协作代理系统CoWriter，将认知科学中的人类合著方法引入人机写作流程。探索性用户研究显示，相比标准大模型基线，使用CoWriter的作者更能表达自身观点并保持更强的文档所有权感，代理成功交互次数也更多；外部读者评审认为其文本在叙事性和融入个人经历等“人味”上更佳。结果表明，以成熟的人类写作实践主动引导用户参与，有助于提升人机协同写作的效果。

papers.title: Diagnosing the Explicit-to-Applied Theory of Mind Gap in LLMs
papers.authors: Prajvi Saxena, Sabine Janzen, Wolfgang Maaß
papers.abstract: As large language models are deployed in high-stakes roles such as therapy, education, and personal assistance, their social cognition must be assessed reliably. Current Theory of Mind (ToM) benchmarks report aggregate scores that conflate two distinct competencies: explicit ToM (recognizing what someone believes) and applied ToM (using that belief to predict behavior). Building on this distinction, we investigate the gap and its recoverability using four structurally diverse benchmarks. Aggregate reporting obscures uneven competence: on SimpleToM, Llama-3.1-8B scores 51.5 percent overall while recognizing mental states at 99.4 percent and predicting behavior at only 28.9 percent. To assess recovery, we compare structured prompting, matched in-context learning, and our proposed Belief-State Test-Time Training (BSTTT), which adapts lightweight parameters on answered support questions through action reconstruction. Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and GPT-oss-20B, recovery depends on the model, task, and intervention. On SimpleToM, reminders combined with BSTTT improve Llama's behavior prediction by 40.8 percentage points; reminders account for most of the overall improvement, with BSTTT adding 1.3 to 5.5 points beyond reminders across models. Contextual examples often outperform weight updates, while BSTTT remains stronger in specific model-benchmark settings. Temporal belief tracking remains difficult despite partial recovery. These findings show that aggregate ToM scores can overstate applied competence while hiding performance recoverable through targeted assistance. We recommend decomposed reporting of explicit and applied accuracy alongside intervention comparisons that establish which failures are recoverable and under what conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究区分了大型语言模型的显式心理理论（识别他人信念）与应用心理理论（用该信念预测行为），指出当前基准的总体得分掩盖了两者差距，并考察这种差距能否通过干预恢复。作者在四个结构不同的基准上比较结构化提示、匹配的上下文学习与所提出的信念状态测试时训练（BSTTT），发现恢复效果取决于模型、任务和干预方式：提醒贡献了大部分提升，BSTTT 仅在此基础上小幅增加，上下文示例常优于权重更新，而时间性信念追踪仍较困难。结果表明总体心理理论得分可能高估应用能力，建议分解报告两类准确率并比较干预条件。

papers.title: Algorithmic drift in generative adaptive learning
papers.authors: Firuz Kamalov, Hana Sulieman, Ahmed El Sayed, R. Sivaraj, Nitesh Sughnani
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence promises to democratize personalized tutoring, yet the longitudinal stability of adaptive systems remains under-theorized. Current ethical discourse focuses on static bias. This paper argues that a distinct threat lies in algorithmic drift: a feedback loop in which minor, demographically asymmetric observation errors compound over time into systemic inequities. We make three contributions. First, we formalize algorithmic drift as a coupled learner--tutor dynamical system. Second, we corroborate this theory with an agent-based Monte Carlo simulation in which either a transparent online tracker or an LSTM deep-knowledge-tracing network drives an IRT-based curriculum policy. Third, we introduce the temporal fairness stabilizer (TFS), a targeted intervention that periodically re-probes learner capability, and benchmark it against standard exploration baselines with explicit group-fairness metrics and replication-level inference. Within the modeled environment, TFS closes the achievement gap where generic exploration does not, and we characterize the conditions under which it succeeds. We separate what is established analytically, what is demonstrated in simulation, and what remains to be validated with real learners. Our results reframe algorithmic fairness in education as a temporal property of a closed loop rather than a deployment-time checkbox.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式自适应学习系统长期运行中的公平性问题，提出“算法漂移”概念：带有群体不对称性的微小观察误差会在学习者与 tutor 的反馈回路中随时间累积，形成系统性不平等。作者用耦合动力学模型加以形式化，并以基于智能体的蒙特卡洛模拟进行验证，比较透明在线追踪器与 LSTM 深度知识追踪网络驱动的 IRT 课程策略。文章进一步提出定期重新探测学习者能力的时间公平稳定器（TFS），在模拟环境中，TFS 能缩小成绩差距，而通用探索基线不能。作者明确区分了分析结论、模拟结果与尚待真实学习者验证的部分，并将教育算法公平重新界定为闭环系统的时间属性，而非部署时的一次性检查。

papers.title: When Code Gets Cheap, Evaluation Gets Scarce: An Experience Report on AI-Assisted Agile Software Engineering
papers.authors: Barbara Weber, Olaf Zimmermann, Marco Franceschetti
papers.abstract: Coding assistants are widely reported to speed up code production; most accounts stop there. We report the end-to-end construction and deployment of a compliance-critical, human-in-the-loop exam-grading system, built by a single developer who wrote no code by hand, protected by a gated process from stakeholder persona to audited behavior. The initial system was built in three working days and could grade a real cohort. We draw one claim from this experience: AI changes software engineering less by making programming faster than by changing what is scarce. Writing code becomes abundant. Reliable evaluation-knowing whether a result is correct and meets the actual need-remains necessary at every iteration and becomes the binding constraint. Engineering judgment remains a second scarcity. Several defects passed the test suite: they sat at the boundaries the tests had mocked, the browser and the language-model API, or appeared only in real use. Deployment exposed assumptions that local tests had missed. Moreover, an AI assistant acting across many steps bypassed process checkpoints until we made them enforceable gates. All of this was observed in a triple union: the developer was also the end user and domain expert, making expert judgment immediately available and evaluation as cheap as it can be. This favors the iteration gains, which may shrink where evaluation requires additional people or expertise, but makes the case a hard test for evaluation scarcity: evaluation still constrained progress. We draw five lessons: run a gated, traceable construction process; specify what is knowable and discover the rest against a running prototype; validate in the real environment; gate the assistant, not only the work; record decisions with their assumptions and the process state the assistant forgets. A second project showed similar patterns; an independent single-expert case corroborates the shift.
papers.summary_zh: 该经验报告记录了一名开发者在不手写代码的情况下，借助AI编码助手端到端构建并部署一个合规关键、人在回路中的考试评分系统，并辅以第二项目和独立单专家案例佐证。作者的核心论点是：AI对软件工程的影响主要不在于加快编程，而在于改变稀缺资源——代码生产变得充裕，可靠评估（判断结果是否正确、是否满足真实需求）成为每次迭代的约束，工程判断力是第二稀缺。测试套件未能拦截的缺陷多位于被模拟的边界、浏览器与语言模型API，或仅在真实使用中暴露；跨多步行动的助手还会绕过流程检查点，直到将其设为强制关卡。作者据此提出五项经验，并指出该案例中开发者兼为最终用户与领域专家，使评估成本处于最低，因而构成对“评估稀缺”的严苛检验。

papers.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
papers.authors: Zhizhuo Kou, Sizai Hou, Long Chen, Jian Yang, Junyu Luo, Jingshu Peng, Wenkai Zhang, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究追问推理模型中的“wait”标记究竟由强化学习教会，还是从训练数据中继承。作者通过开放模型训练历史，结合无标签的频次、位置、形式与用法指标及注入错误测试，对采样输出进行分析。结果显示，零强化学习在缺乏该词的基座上几乎不会创造它，即便数学准确率明显提升；该标记主要随训练数据到来，如中期训练或推理轨迹微调将其植入多数基座。基座已有该词时，部分RL配方会放大它，而KL-free GRPO不会；不同配方还会改变其形式与警示特性。研究据此提醒，标记频次本身不能指示RL诱导的推理，并警示自动评判指标可能反转人工标注的趋势。

papers.title: TutorCaseBench: A Case-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Tutors in Supporting Students with Challenging Behaviors
papers.authors: Yeon Su Park, 박찬영, Tae Soo Kim, Seungju Kim, Hyunwoo Kim, Daho Jung, Jinsung Yoon, Juho Kim
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as AI tutors, yet existing benchmarks overlook the challenging behaviors common among students with learning and behavioral difficulties. We introduce TutorCaseBench, a benchmark that grounds AI-tutor evaluation in qualitative case studies from pedagogy, educational psychology, and special education. Our pipeline converts documented student categories into case-specific scenarios, tutor-student dialogues, and rubrics grounded in source evidence. The benchmark contains 923 dialogues across five challenge types, evaluated through open-ended response generation (1,560 items) and multiple-choice selection (2,537 items). Across 11 state-of-the-art LLMs, even the strongest model satisfies a rubric criterion in only 55.8% of open-ended cases, while models are better at selecting appropriate strategies than generating situated responses. These results reveal a gap between intervention recognition and context-specific adaptation, especially for open-weight models. All data are publicly available at https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有评测忽视学习与行为困难学生挑战性行为的问题，提出 TutorCaseBench 基准，将教育学、教育心理学和特殊教育中的质性案例转化为具体情境、师生对话和基于来源证据的评分标准，并据此评测大语言模型导师。基准涵盖五类挑战、923 段对话，通过开放式回答生成和多项选择两种方式考察 11 个先进模型。结果显示，即使最强模型在开放式情境中也仅满足 55.8% 的评分标准，且模型在选择合适策略上优于生成贴合情境的回应，说明干预识别与情境化适应之间存在差距，开放权重模型尤为明显。

papers.title: TESSA: A Governance-Oriented Custom GPT for SME Guidance under the EU AI Act: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation
papers.authors: Chalisa Veesommai Sillberga, Kai-Kristian Kemella, Pekka Sillberga, Katri Harjuveteläinenb, Mika Saaria, Pekka Abrahamssona
papers.abstract: The increasing adoption of generative AI presents new opportunities while raising AI governance and regulatory challenges, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) navigating the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act). To support AI governance education, this study developed TESSA, a governance-oriented educational artifact within the OpenAI Custom GPT environment. Following a design science research approach, TESSA was evaluated against baseline ChatGPT using 100 benchmark scenarios through governance alignment assessment, human expert review, and consistency testing. Preliminary LLM-assisted assessment showed governance alignment rates of 90% for TESSA and 83% for baseline ChatGPT, while independent validation by an AI regulation law practitioner yielded 71% and 70%, respectively. Human expert review indicated that both systems provided generally strong governance guidance, while TESSA maintained high consistency across repeated executions. The findings suggest that governance-oriented grounding can support structured, practical, and stable AI-assisted compliance guidance for SMEs. The study contributes (i) a governance-oriented Custom GPT artifact for AI governance education, (ii) a human-validated regulatory update mechanism, and (iii) a multidimensional evaluation framework for governance-oriented AI artifact.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对中小企业应对欧盟《人工智能法案》的治理与合规需求，在设计科学方法下开发了面向治理教育的定制GPT工具TESSA，并以100个基准场景将其与基线ChatGPT进行对比评估。初步的LLM辅助评估显示，TESSA的治理对齐率为90%，基线为83%；而由AI监管法律从业者独立验证后，两者分别为71%和70%，表明自动评估可能高估了对齐程度。人类专家评审认为两个系统均能提供总体较强的治理指导，TESSA在重复执行中保持较高一致性。研究据此认为，面向治理的知识 grounding 有助于为中小企业提供结构化、实用且稳定的AI辅助合规指导，但专家验证与自动评估之间的差距提示相关效果仍需谨慎看待。

papers.title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
papers.authors: Hao Jiang, Peiru Du, Pengfei Yao, Mengting Li, Siyuan Lou, Kuo Cai, Sheng Yu, Qiang Luo, Jian Liang, Ruiming Tang, Fei Pan, Peng Jiang, Wenwu Ou
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. OneLatent first introduces Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT), which creates diverse, high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. Building on pretrained FRMs, it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize CoT traces into learnable latent tokens. Finally, a multistage curriculum-based post-training strategy activates latent-token reasoning for downstream recommendation tasks. Experiments on an industrial-scale Kuaishou dataset and the public Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark show that OneLatent consistently outperforms explicit CoT-based methods and traditional baselines. Compared with the Think and No-Think variants of FRMs, OneLatent improves SID@64 by 17.44% and 9.33%, respectively, while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. We further develop a production serving system for scalable, real-time FRM inference. An online A/B test in Kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows that deploying OneLatent with this system yields an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines, including OneRec and OneReason.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对基础推荐模型显式思维链推理开销大、依赖人工模板的问题，提出OneLatent潜空间推理框架，将显式推理轨迹压缩为可学习的潜变量token，从而在不生成冗长推理文本的情况下完成推理与推荐。作者先在预训练推荐模型上通过多视角自适应思维链生成多样化监督信号，再以三阶段对齐和课程式后训练激活潜变量推理。在快手工业数据集与公开基准上的实验显示，该方法在推荐指标上优于显式思维链方法及传统基线，并大幅提升在线推理吞吐；线上A/B测试也报告了相对现有线上基线的收入提升。这些结果表明，将推理过程内化为潜变量表示可在保持推荐效果的同时降低推理成本，但线上收益结论仍受具体业务场景限制。

papers.title: Group Relative Policy Optimisation Improves Multilingual Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
papers.authors: Tim Wenjie Hu, Evelyn Nafula Ouma, Benjamin Akera, John Quinn
papers.abstract: Autoregressive encoder-decoder speech recognition models trained with teacher forcing can suffer from exposure bias, limiting their ability to recover from their own prediction errors at inference time. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves speech recognition in major languages with LLM-based models. We extend this line of work to smaller, non-LLM encoder-decoder ASR models, using Whisper-large-v3 as a case study across 51 African languages. The benefits of this approach are most pronounced when training data is scarce or when input audio is noisy or degraded. Our resulting model, SunflowerASR, achieves the best published macro-averaged WER on the AfriVox-v2 (0.227) and SimbaBench (0.372) benchmarks, and is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基于教师强制训练的自回归编码器-解码器语音识别模型在推理时难以从自身预测错误中恢复的问题，并以Whisper-large-v3为例，将组相对策略优化（GRPO）扩展到非大语言模型的小型编码器-解码器模型，在51种非洲语言上开展实验。结果显示，这种强化学习方法的收益在训练数据稀缺或输入音频含噪、退化时最为明显；所得模型SunflowerASR在AfriVox-v2和SimbaBench两个基准上取得已发表的最优宏平均词错误率。文章据此说明，GRPO有助于提升低资源语言语音识别的稳健性，但相关结论主要来自上述模型与语言范围。

papers.title: Impacts of generative AI skill development on academic adaptation and learning outcomes among university students
papers.authors: Lei Fan, Fangxue Liu
papers.abstract: Understanding how university students perceive the development of their generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) skills over time can clarify how GenAI use relates to learning and academic outcomes. This study examined perceived skill-development trajectories, changes in learning practices, and associated academic gains using a retrospective questionnaire with 313 analyzed responses and interviews with 18 students across subject areas. Descriptive and comparative analyses and exploratory structural equation modeling (SEM) were integrated with thematic analysis. Perceived developmental trajectories were heterogeneous: 34.2% of students reported rapid early improvement followed by a plateau, 28.4% steady improvement, and 21.1% delayed acceleration. Development was also uneven across skills, with improvement in evaluating GenAI outputs perceived as more challenging; assignments were the most frequently selected driver of skill growth. Interviews further indicated increasingly specific prompting, tailored verification, and selective delegation, although some students reported stable routines, dependence, skipped reasoning, or improvements attributable partly to better GenAI tools. Academic gains were reported more often for assignments than for examinations. The SEM indicated a positive indirect association between perceived skill growth and academic gains through adaptation of assignment processes, whereas academic gains did not clearly differ across developmental trajectory groups after multiplicity correction. The findings suggest that perceived GenAI skill development varies in both trajectory and skill domain and is associated with changes in learning practices and differentiated academic benefits.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大学生对自身生成式人工智能技能发展的感知轨迹及其与学习实践和学业收获的关系，采用回顾性问卷并结合部分学生访谈，辅以描述性比较、探索性结构方程模型和主题分析。结果显示，感知到的技能发展轨迹并不一致，存在快速提升后趋稳、持续稳步提升和较晚加速等不同模式；各项技能的提升也不均衡，评价生成内容被认为更难，作业是最常被提及的技能成长驱动因素。访谈还显示学生的提示、核查与任务分派方式趋于具体和有选择性，但也有人维持固定做法、产生依赖或跳过推理。学业收获更多体现在作业而非考试上，技能成长与学业收获之间可能通过作业过程调整存在正向间接关联，而不同轨迹组之间的学业收获差异在多重校正后并不明确。

papers.title: Beyond Better Ideas: How Human-AI Collaboration Shapes Scientific Ideas and Human Perceptions
papers.authors: Qian Chen, Saatvik Pradhan, Janice Ahn, Berk Atil, Angkai Li, Shijie Lu, Nobin Sarwar, Michael Ulis, Ruyuan Wan, Wenpeng Yin
papers.abstract: As AI increasingly becomes a collaborator in scientific research, its impact may extend beyond improving ideas to reshaping how they are evaluated, attributed, and perceived by humans. Yet existing research has largely examined these dimensions in isolation. We present a unified empirical study of Human-AI scientific ideation, investigating two complementary perspectives: i) how AI collaboration shapes scientific ideas and their evaluation, and ii) how firsthand collaboration reshapes human perceptions of AI. Through a shared experimental setting involving Human-AI and Human-Human research teams, human and LLM evaluators, collaboration-provenance analysis, and participant surveys, we uncover several counterintuitive findings. First, AI collaboration shows no significant advantage in human-evaluated idea quality, while iterative revision consistently improves quality. Second, AI judges can approximate human scores yet disagree on idea rankings; notably, an AI judge favors AI-assisted proposals without a corresponding advantage in human evaluations. Third, collaboration provenance remains only partially detectable, revealing substantial overlap between Human-AI and Human-Human scientific outputs. Finally, firsthand AI collaboration is associated with greater perceived usefulness but smaller efficiency gains than expected, suggesting a nuanced recalibration of human expectations. Overall, our findings challenge the notion that AI's value in scientific ideation lies primarily in producing better ideas, revealing instead its broader influence on scientific creation, evaluation, attribution, and human perceptions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过同一实验框架下的“人—AI”与“人—人”科研团队对比，结合人类与LLM评审、协作来源分析和参与者调查，考察AI协作如何影响科学想法的质量与评价，以及亲身协作如何改变人对AI的感知。结果显示，AI协作在人类评审的想法质量上并无显著优势，而反复修改能稳定提升质量；AI评审虽能接近人类评分，却在想法排序上与人类不一致，并偏好AI辅助方案，而人类评价中并无对应优势。协作来源只能被部分识别，人机与人人的科研产出存在较大重叠；亲身与AI协作还带来更高的有用性感知，但效率提升小于预期。作者据此认为，AI在科学构思中的价值不止于产出更好的想法，还涉及评价、归属和人的预期调整。

papers.title: AI-Native Academia Should Build a Community Verification Layer
papers.authors: Haotian Zong, Luhao Zhang
papers.abstract: This paper argues that AI-native academia should build a Community Verification Layer: interoperable, policy-governed infrastructure that converts researchers' routine reading and checking into persistent, claim- and version-linked evidence, while routing scarce deeper verification toward uncertain, consequential, and neglected research. AI is lowering the cost of producing plausible research artifacts faster than the cost of accountable evaluation, yet much of the evaluation researchers already perform while reading, citing, implementing, or extending work is never made reusable. We propose a tiered ladder from comprehension notes to claim checks, audits, artifact execution, reproduction, replication, and downstream validation. The layer would elicit judgments before revealing social signals, preserve multidimensional disagreement, privately verify contributors while allowing flexible public disclosure, allocate attention under expertise and coverage constraints, and make verification labor citable, with credit tied to the quality and depth of the evidence. We distinguish this design from prior open and post-publication review and outline governance requirements and potential counterarguments.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论立场论文，讨论AI原生学术生态应如何应对研究产出成本下降快于可问责评估成本的问题。作者提出构建“社区验证层”，即一套可互操作、受政策治理的基础设施，把研究者日常阅读和核查中产生的判断转化为与具体主张和版本关联、可长期复用的证据，并将稀缺的深度验证资源导向不确定、后果重大且被忽视的研究。文章设计了一条从理解笔记到主张核查、审计、制品执行、复现与下游验证的分级阶梯，并讨论了在揭示社会信号前收集判断、保留多维分歧、在专业与覆盖约束下分配注意力、使验证劳动可被引用等机制，同时区分了该设计与既有开放评审和后发表评审，提出治理要求并回应潜在反对意见。

papers.title: AI-Based PDF Chat and Summarization Engine Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Dr. Sushma Zade Prof. Dr. Aniruddha Rumale, Prashik Bhise Lokesh Patil, Sarthak Shende Hareshwar Wagh
papers.journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology
papers.abstract: Portable Document Format (PDF) files are the most common way of storing reports, research papers, manuals, and legal documents, but their layout-oriented structure makes them difficult to search and to query conversationally. Large Language Models (LLMs) can answer questions fluently, but they may hallucinate and cannot process long documents that exceed a fixed context window. This study presents the design, implementation, and preliminary testing of a PDF chat and summarization system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system uses a three-stage data pipeline (raw, processed, and RAG-ready) that parses PDFs, removes repeating headers and footers, converts content to Markdown, and applies structure-aware chunking, which attaches section-path metadata to every chunk. Answers are generated by the openai/gpt-oss-120b model (served through the Groq API) using passages retrieved from a local ChromaDB vector store with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings, and are returned with page references. Three chunking strategies (fixed-size, Markdown-aware, and hierarchical) are defined, and an evaluation protocol based on answer accuracy, faithfulness, hit rate at k, unsupported-answer rate, and response time is specified for comparing them. In preliminary testing, the system processed uploaded PDFs and answered natural-language questions with an average response time of approximately 2–5 seconds. A full comparative evaluation is left for future work. The study provides a reproducible, small-scale baseline that student and small-team developers can extend, and it argues that document preprocessing and chunking quality are central to the reliability of PDF question answering
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计并初步测试了一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的PDF对话与摘要系统，以应对PDF版式结构难以检索和对话式查询、以及大语言模型易产生幻觉且受上下文窗口限制的问题。系统采用三阶段数据管道解析PDF、去除重复页眉页脚、转换为Markdown并进行结构感知分块，检索本地向量库中的段落交由大语言模型生成带页码引用的回答。初步测试中系统能处理上传的PDF并用自然语言作答，平均响应时间约数秒；作者还定义了三种分块策略及基于答案准确性、忠实度等指标的比较评估方案，但完整的对比评估留待后续工作。文章据此提出文档预处理与分块质量是PDF问答可靠性的关键，并提供了一个可供学生和小型团队扩展的可复现基线。

papers.title: Marketing strategies for introducing innovative products to the market. A review of the literatura
papers.authors: Dorys Magaly Guzmán Mayancha
papers.abstract: The introduction of innovative products is a critical driver of competitive advantage in highly turbulent technological environments. The objective of this article is to systematically analyze the recent literature on the marketing strategies that optimize the acceptance and performance of such innovations. Using a systematic-narrative methodology, a final corpus of 20 scientific articles published between 2020 and 2025 in high-impact databases such as Scopus and Web of Science was selected. The results reveal that commercial success does not reside exclusively in technical superiority, but in the creative configuration of an integrated marketing mix, where packaging design, dynamic pricing, and the diversification of channels toward e-commerce reduce adoption barriers. A strategic shift is identified, moving from traditional launch models toward agile, iterative, and niche approaches that prioritize user co-creation to mitigate perceived risk. Furthermore, functional communication and educational pre-announcements emerge as essential cognitive mechanisms for reducing consumer resistance to change in the face of radical innovations. It is concluded that dynamic organizational capabilities, enhanced by Marketing 4.0 and artificial intelligence, are crucial for personalizing the value proposition and ensuring product sustainability in global markets.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了2020至2025年间关于创新产品市场导入营销策略的文献，旨在分析哪些策略能优化创新产品的市场接受度与表现。作者指出，商业成功并非仅取决于技术优势，而在于整合营销组合的创造性配置，其中包装设计、动态定价和向电商渠道的多元化能降低采用障碍；同时发现营销正从传统发布模式转向敏捷、迭代和细分导向的方式，强调用户共创以缓解感知风险，功能性沟通与教育性预告则有助于降低消费者对激进创新的抵触。文章据此认为，借助营销4.0与人工智能强化的动态组织能力对个性化价值主张和全球市场中的产品可持续性至关重要。

papers.title: Adoption and Impacts of a Socratic Generative AI Tutor in Undergraduate Algebra
papers.authors: Caitlin K. Kirby, Eing Kanyi, Jane Zimmerman, Hala Sun, Monica L. Mills, Maria O'Connell, Renata Opoczynski, Min Zhuang
papers.journal: International Journal of Education in Mathematics Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Instructors looking to support personalized mathematics learning may provide access to generative AI tutoring tools. Few studies explore the effectiveness of these systems in classroom settings. This is particularly important in mathematics, where genAI is a shift from historic adaptive intelligent tutoring systems. We evaluated undergraduate algebra students’ (n=58) use of the Socratic generative AI tutor, Khanmigo, through a quasi-experimental mixed-methods study using survey, registrar, grades, and software usage data. One course section was assigned four Khanmigo activities throughout the semester (experimental), while the other was provided access and an introductory activity only (control). A Wilcoxon Rank Sum test showed that experimental students engaged in significantly more chats than control students (p<0.05), controlling for in-class activities. Instrumental help seeking was positively correlated with Khanmigo use, while intentions of seeking help from technology sources were negatively correlated with use. Khanmigo use did significantly predict mathematics grades after controlling for prior GPA and course section. Most students reported using Khanmigo for homework help and exam prep, though lack of visuals and the Socratic design limited perceived usefulness for some students. Integrating genAI tutoring systems into class activities and setting student expectations may improve the likelihood of students using them effectively for learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在本科代数课程中引入苏格拉底式生成式AI辅导工具Khanmigo后，学生的使用情况及其与成绩的关系，采用准实验混合方法，结合问卷、成绩与软件使用数据进行比较。结果显示，被安排多次活动的实验组学生聊天互动显著多于对照组；工具性求助行为与使用呈正相关，而向技术来源求助的意愿与使用呈负相关。在控制先前GPA和课程分组后，Khanmigo使用能显著预测数学成绩。多数学生将其用于作业和备考，但缺乏视觉呈现和苏格拉底式设计限制了一些学生对实用性的感知；作者据此建议将此类工具融入课堂活动并明确学生预期。

papers.title: Integration of Artificial Intelligence and Mental Health Education
papers.authors: Lingmian Kong
papers.journal: Journal of Cases on Information Technology
papers.abstract: Mental health education for university students faces challenges, like inadequate personalization and delayed intervention. This study develops an intelligent platform integrating artificial intelligence and big data. The platform comprises structured courses, an artificial intelligence psychological assistant, self-assessment tools, and personalized recommendation functions, with core logic centered on resource classification, optimization, and dynamic mining. A quasi-experiment was conducted with 386 undergraduates for eight weeks, followed by a three-month follow-up. Results show the experimental group significantly outperformed the control group in mental health literacy, help-seeking attitudes, and emotional regulation self-efficacy (p < 0.001), with effects persisting long-term. Platform usage intensity positively moderated intervention effects, and high-engagement users gained the most. This study verifies the platform's effectiveness in optimizing mental health information resource management, providing a feasible digital solution for university mental health education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大学生心理健康教育中个性化不足、干预滞后的问题，开发了一个整合人工智能与大数据的智能平台，包含结构化课程、AI心理助手、自评工具和个性化推荐功能，并通过准实验对386名本科生进行了八周干预及三个月追踪。结果显示，实验组在心理健康素养、求助态度和情绪调节自我效能上均显著优于对照组，且效果具有长期持续性；平台使用强度正向调节干预效果，高参与度用户获益最大。研究据此认为该平台在优化心理健康信息资源管理方面具有可行性，为高校心理健康教育提供了一种数字化方案，但结论主要基于准实验设计，仍需谨慎看待其推广范围。

papers.title: Application of AIGC in Innovative Design of Product Modeling
papers.authors: Xu Chi
papers.abstract: This study systematically analyzed artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content text-to-image technology in product modeling innovation and built a systematic evaluation framework for enterprise design management. While AI quickly generates concepts, enterprises lack standard evaluation criteria and struggle to screen visual solutions suitable for engineering and manufacturing. By coding eight research documents, the study developed a double-loop collaborative mechanism, evaluating tools across six dimensions such as manufacturing adaptability and semantic matching. AI-generated content excels in early creative divergence but causes structural distortion and high management costs, though multi-modal systems show the best stability and deployment readiness. AI must evolve from a basic visual tool into a digital design infrastructure integrating engineering parameters and requiring standardized manual supervision to truly upgrade industrial design.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕生成式人工智能在产品造型创新设计中的应用，构建了面向企业设计管理的系统评价框架，并通过编码八份研究文献提出双环协同机制，从制造适配性、语义匹配等六个维度评估相关工具。研究发现，AI生成内容在早期创意发散阶段表现突出，但存在结构失真和管理成本较高的问题；多模态系统在稳定性和部署就绪度上表现最佳。作者据此指出，AI需从基础视觉工具演变为整合工程参数、并需标准化人工监督的数字设计基础设施，才能真正推动工业设计升级。

papers.title: Unlocking new frontiers: AI-Enabled innovation in research, teaching and community engagement in Nigeria: A systematic review
papers.authors: Stella Bolanle Apata, Itumeleng Innocentia Setlhodi
papers.journal: E-Journal of Humanities Arts and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: This article systematically reviews how artificial intelligence (AI) is being mobilized to support research, teaching, and community engagement in Nigeria, and identifies the governance conditions required for responsible and inclusive adoption. The study follows PRISMA 2020 reporting principles and synthesises peer-reviewed literature and relevant policy documents published between 2022 and 2025. Searches were conducted across Scopus, Web of Science, ERIC, and Google Scholar, yielding 87 records, of which 51 met the inclusion criteria. Thematic synthesis was used to organise evidence across research innovation, teaching and learning, community-facing applications, ethics and implementation constraints. The review shows that AI can strengthen literature discovery, data analysis, adaptive learning, multilingual support, health diagnostics, agricultural decision-making and institutional administration. However, adoption remains uneven because of weak infrastructure, high data costs, limited AI literacy, fragmented policy implementation, data governance risks, algorithmic bias and limited local language capacity. The article reframes AI adoption in Nigeria as a governance, equity and capacity-building challenge rather than a purely technological opportunity. It proposes a responsible AI integration framework linking infrastructure, literacy, local innovation, ethics, research productivity, teaching quality and community development.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA 2020原则，系统梳理了2022至2025年间尼日利亚在科研、教学和社区参与中应用人工智能的同行评议文献与政策文件，并归纳了负责任且包容地采用AI所需的治理条件。综述指出，AI有助于加强文献发现、数据分析、自适应学习、多语言支持、健康诊断、农业决策和机构管理，但受基础设施薄弱、数据成本高、AI素养不足、政策执行分散、数据治理风险、算法偏见及本地语言能力有限等因素制约，实际采用仍不均衡。文章据此将尼日利亚的AI采用重新界定为治理、公平与能力建设问题，而非单纯的技术机遇，并提出一个连接基础设施、素养、本地创新、伦理、科研产出、教学质量和社区发展的负责任AI整合框架。

papers.title: Integrating ChatGPT within Genre-Based Pedagogy to Strengthen Critical Thinking in ESP Academic Writing
papers.authors: Eliasanti Agustina, Ahmad Munir, Slamet Setiawan
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of integrating ChatGPT within genre-based pedagogy to strengthen critical thinking in ESP (English for Specific Purposes) academic writing among students in East Java higher education institutions. Using a mixed-methods sequential explanatory design, the research involved 142 students from six private universities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在体裁教学法中引入ChatGPT能否强化ESP学术写作中的批判性思维，采用混合方法顺序解释设计，以印尼东爪哇六所私立高校的学生为对象。摘要仅交代了研究问题与设计，未报告具体结果，因此无法判断ChatGPT整合对批判性思维的实际作用及其条件。

papers.title: Transfer-Related Cognitive and Learning Profiles Across Predominant MOBA Roles in Novice Esports Players
papers.authors: Meriç BOYNUKARA, Özcan Özgür Dursun
papers.abstract: Esports research increasingly recognizes that multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) games contain differentiated team roles, yet it remains unclear whether these role differences correspond to cognitive and learning-related profiles beyond immediate gameplay. This exploratory secondary analysis examined whether naturally emerging predominant roles were associated with post-intervention transfer-related outcomes among novice League of Legends players. Here, transfer-related refers to outcomes assessed beyond immediate gameplay and does not imply causal demonstration of transfer. Data came from the experimental arm of an eight-week quasi-experimental intervention requiring at least 18 hours of gameplay. Of 42 experimental participants, one predominantly played jungle and was excluded because this created a single-participant category. The final sample comprised 41 undergraduates classified as top lane (n = 5), mid lane (n = 15), marksman/ADC (n = 12), or support (n = 9). Outcomes included EEG-based attention-related engagement, working-memory-related theta activity, and theta/alpha-based cognitive load recorded during a standardized dual n-back task, together with 21st-century learner skills and content-specific learning performance. After z-standardization, Euclidean distances were analyzed using PERMANOVA with 9,999 permutations, principal coordinates analysis, and a multivariate dispersion diagnostic. The omnibus PERMANOVA did not detect statistically significant role-based differentiation, pseudo-F(3, 37) = 0.941, p = .526, R² = .071. PCoA showed substantial overlap, no statistically detectable dispersion differences were found, and the baseline sensitivity analysis was non-significant. These findings suggest that functional role differentiation within MOBA gameplay should not be assumed to produce corresponding differentiation in transfer-related outcomes among novice players with relatively short role exposure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察新手《英雄联盟》玩家中自然形成的主导位置是否与干预后超越即时游戏情境的迁移相关结果存在关联，数据来自一项为期八周的准实验干预实验组，对41名本科生按上单、中单、射手和辅助分类，比较其脑电注意投入、工作记忆相关活动、认知负荷、21世纪学习者技能及内容学习表现。多变量分析未发现基于位置的显著整体差异，各位置在结果上高度重叠，基线敏感性分析也不显著。作者据此提示，不能假定MOBA中的功能位置分化会带来迁移相关结果的分化，且这一结论限于角色接触时间较短的新手玩家。

papers.title: Analysis of Big Data-Based Financial Technology and AI on Financial Inclusion in Indonesia
papers.authors: Sari Asrini, Dwita Sakuntala, Lia Nazliana Nasution
papers.journal: EKOMBIS REVIEW Jurnal Ilmiah Ekonomi dan Bisnis
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effect of implementing Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based financial technology on increasing financial inclusion in Indonesia during the period 2019–2024. The background of this study is based on the rapid increase in digital transformation in the financial sector triggered by the adoption of fintech, but there is still a gap in financial access, especially among low-income groups and disadvantaged regions. This study uses a quantitative approach with a panel data model, involving independent variables of Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP), education level, average internet access, fintech loan recipient entities, and the number of mobile banking users on the dependent variable of the Financial Inclusion Index. The data was obtained from official publications of the Financial Services Authority (OJK), Bank Indonesia (BI), and the Central Statistics Agency (BPS). The results of the analysis show that Big Data and AI have a positive and significant contribution to expanding financial inclusion through increased credit distribution efficiency, expanded access to digital services, and personalized financial products. However, their influence is still limited by gaps in digital literacy, infrastructure, and trust in data security. The findings of this study are expected to provide strategic input for regulators, fintech industry players, and academics in formulating technology-based inclusive policies to achieve sustainable national financial inclusion targets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大数据与人工智能驱动的金融科技如何影响印度尼西亚的金融普惠水平，采用面板数据模型分析2019至2024年间的相关变量与金融普惠指数之间的关系。结果显示，大数据和AI通过提升信贷发放效率、扩展数字服务渠道和个性化金融产品，对扩大金融普惠有正向且显著的贡献；但这种作用仍受数字素养不足、基础设施差距和数据安全信任问题的制约。文章据此为监管者、金融科技从业者和学者制定技术驱动的普惠政策提供参考。

papers.title: Lektio: Relational approach to public service professionals in value co-creation
papers.authors: Salla Maijala

papers.title: PHILOSOPHY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
papers.authors: Diana Kamoliddin kizi Hairuddinova
papers.abstract: This article explores the rapid penetration of artificial intelligence into everyday life and analyzes the psychological consequences of this process. Central to this is an examination of the mechanisms by which people begin to perceive chatbots not simply as tools but as emotional partners and sources of support. Drawing on the concepts of the Eliza effect, anthropomorphism, Baudrillard's simulacrum, and Z. Bauman's "liquid love," the article traces the formation of parasocial relationships between humans and algorithms. Particular attention is paid to the risks of such interactions: the rise of narcissistic behavior patterns, digital isolation, and the substitution of simulated authentic human communication. Finally, the article considers how AI is transforming ideas about consciousness, empathy, and the nature of interpersonal connection.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从心理学视角探讨人工智能深入日常生活后，人们为何会把聊天机器人当作情感伴侣与支持来源，并借助伊丽莎效应、拟人化、鲍德里亚的拟像和鲍曼的“流动的爱”等概念，分析人与算法之间准社会关系的形成机制。文章重点指出，这类互动可能带来自恋行为倾向上升、数字性孤立以及用模拟交流替代真实人际沟通等风险，并进一步讨论人工智能如何改变人们对意识、共情和人际联结本质的理解。

papers.title: Can Patients Understand Online Information About AI and Mammography
papers.authors: Grayson Luderman Baird
papers.abstract: Patients Find When They Search Online for AI and Mammography? An Examination of Readability and Understandability Metrics in Online Patient Education Materials. Clinical Breast Cancer. What question did the researchers askWhen patients hear that artificial intelligence is being used in mammography, they may search online to learn what it means for them.Tanvin Araen and colleagues asked what information those searches might uncover and how accessible it would be.Their study evaluated webpages about AI and mammography using reading-level formulas and a structured assessment of understandability.The central finding was that the information was written at a very high reading level which may be inaccessible to many patients. .This was a study of communication, not a test of whether AI detects breast cancer better or improves patient outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注患者在网上搜索“人工智能用于乳腺X线摄影”相关信息时，会看到什么样的科普材料，以及这些材料是否易读易懂。作者用阅读难度公式和结构化可理解性评估考察了相关网页，发现这些内容整体写作难度偏高，可能让不少患者难以理解。需要强调的是，这是一项关于健康传播的研究，并未检验AI能否更准确地发现乳腺癌或改善患者结局。

papers.title: Generative AI Governance in Education: A Scoping Review of Principles, Mechanisms, and Risks in English-Language Documents
papers.authors: Ezieddin Elmahjub, Muhammad Haseeb Arshad, Waleed Iqbal, Shadiya Pathari, Aliya Tabassum, Junaid Qadir
papers.abstract: The rapid introduction of generative artificial intelligence into education has prompted governments, intergovernmental organizations, and educational institutions to publish governance frameworks faster than any single jurisdiction can readily compare them. This scoping review introduces the principles--mechanisms--risks nexus and applies it to an English-language corpus produced by a globally scoped gray-literature search. Following PRISMA-ScR procedures, the search identified 498 records from international and education-sector bodies and targeted ministry searches across 193 countries for documents published from January 2020 through December 2025. Of 255 records screened, 243 full texts were retrieved and 160 English-language documents were included: 47 from intergovernmental and regional organizations, 9 from education-sector bodies, 7 from think-tanks, NGOs, and policy labs, and 97 jurisdiction-based documents across five continents. A sequential, hybrid qualitative content analysis yielded 11 normative principles, 12 governance mechanisms, and 11 ethical and pedagogical risk categories. Descriptive frequencies and document-level co-occurrence mapping, combined with close reading, informed four interpretive governance logics (regulatory, normative, capacity-first, and practice-oriented) and four qualitative diagnostic states (alignment signals, shallow alignment, decoupling, and accountability voids). As a document-level review, the study maps governance as written. An authority-sensitive reading shows that only 4 of 160 documents take formal legal or regulatory form, whereas 92 are guidance, ethical frameworks, advisory documents, toolkits, or handbooks. Accountability is widely articulated but less often accompanied by a named actor, process, and remedy. The corpus maps a persistent gap between normative attention and operational specificity.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以“原则—机制—风险”框架考察生成式人工智能在教育领域的治理文本，通过范围综述流程检索并筛选英语文献，最终纳入来自政府间组织、教育机构、智库及多国辖区的政策与指导文件。分析归纳出若干规范原则、治理机制和风险类别，并据此提出四种治理逻辑与四种诊断状态。作者指出，这些文件多属指导、伦理框架或工具包，正式法律或监管形式很少，问责虽被广泛提及，却常缺少明确的责任主体、程序和补救措施，反映出规范关注与操作细化之间的持续落差。

papers.title: Empowering Independent and Critical Learning in High School Students with Learning Disabilities and ADHD: A Mixed-Methods Study on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Eitan Ben Itzhak Klutch
papers.abstract: Students with learning disabilities and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) often struggle with executive functioning, independent learning, and critical thinking within traditional instructional settings based on uniform pacing and standardized content. Following the growing integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into educational settings, this study examines the perceived contribution of AI tools to independent and critical learning among high school students with learning disabilities and ADHD. A mixed-methods design was employed with 105 students in grades 9–12, combining pre–post questionnaires across four dimensions - self-confidence, concentration, organization and time management, and critical thinking—with thematic analysis of open-ended responses describing students' experiences. The findings suggest that AI's contribution was reflected primarily in the emotional and motivational aspects of learning, particularly self-confidence and autonomous engagement with learning material. Quantitative changes were modest: self-confidence showed a slight non-significant increase; organization and time management showed a moderate non-significant decrease; and concentration remained generally stable, although a significant decrease was found among younger students. Qualitative findings indicated that students experienced AI as helpful in accessing, simplifying, and organizing academic content, but also revealed a risk of over-reliance on AI-generated responses without sufficient critical evaluation. The study underscores the importance of guided, age-appropriate, and pedagogically mediated AI use in inclusive educational settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察有学习障碍和ADHD的高中生如何看待AI工具对其独立学习与批判性学习的帮助，采用前后问卷与开放式回答主题分析的混合方法，对象为9至12年级学生。结果显示，AI的作用主要体现在情感与动机层面，尤其是自信心和对学习材料的自主投入；量化变化有限，自信心略有非显著上升，组织与时间管理呈非显著下降，注意力总体稳定但低年级学生显著下降。质性分析表明，学生认为AI有助于获取、简化和组织学习内容，但也存在不加批判地依赖AI生成答案的风险。作者据此强调，在融合教育环境中应有引导地、符合年龄特点地并以教学为中介使用AI。

papers.title: The use of artificial intelligence platforms by users of legal services and the challenges for the legal sector
papers.authors: José de Campos Amorim
papers.abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into the field of Law represents a significant paradigm shift in both legal education and professional practice. By enabling innovative methodologies, AI contributes to a more dynamic and interactive approach to legal knowledge, fostering critical thinking, creativity, and adaptability among future legal professionals. Its application in pedagogical contexts supports active learning models, such as the case method, legal clinics, and design thinking, which emphasize experiential learning and practical problem-solving. Through advanced data analysis, intelligent systems can process legal doctrine, legislation, and case law, allowing users to identify patterns and jurisprudential trends. This contributes to a more informed and efficient application of the law, while promoting greater consistency and predictability in judicial decisions. AI facilitates access to vast volumes of legal information and serves as a valuable instrument for optimizing legal strategies and case management. Its ability to simulate legal scenarios, akin to virtual courts, provides a platform for testing arguments and exploring potential outcomes. Additionally, as a virtual educational environment comparable to platforms such as Moodle, AI fosters collaborative learning through discussion forums, simulations, and role-playing exercises, thus extending the boundaries of traditional legal education.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论人工智能平台在法律服务使用者中的应用及其对法律行业提出的挑战，属于围绕法律教育与实务变革的论述性文章，而非实证研究。作者提出，AI 通过数据分析处理法律学说、立法与判例，帮助识别模式与法理趋势，并借助虚拟法庭、模拟与协作讨论等形式支持案例教学、法律诊所等体验式学习。文章据此认为，AI 有助于更高效、一致地适用法律并拓展法律教育边界，但摘要未报告具体使用数据或效果检验，相关判断多为作者论述。

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Digital Communication Ecosystems: Educational, Psychological and Consumer Behavior Perspectives across Emerging Generations
papers.authors: Liliana Bălan, Sorina Mihaela Bălan, Emil-Marius Pașcan
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is transforming digital communication ecosystems by redefining how information is produced, interpreted, recommended and consumed in contemporary media environments. In platform-based communication, artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly operates as a cognitive and communicational infrastructure that shapes learning processes, media practices and consumer behavior. This paper examines AI in convergent media environments through a transdisciplinary framework integrating three analytical perspectives: published evidence on student uses of AI in higher education, psychological adaptation to algorithmically curated information environments, and AI-driven consumer behavior within digital media platforms. Methodologically, the study uses a PRISMA-guided systematic literature review combined with qualitative thematic synthesis and conceptual model-building. The review considered peer-reviewed studies indexed in Web of Science and Scopus between 2018 and 2025 and analyzed literature on GenAI, digital education, algorithmic communication, recommendation systems and AI-mediated consumer behavior. No statistical effect-size synthesis was conducted. The synthesis indicates that AI performs three interconnected roles within digital communication ecosystems: learning assistant, cognitive mediator and behavioral influencer. The analysis also discusses generational differences in AI-mediated media interaction, with particular attention to Generation Z, Generation Alpha and the cautious, anticipatory use of the term Generation Beta. The study proposes the AI-Mediated Communication Ecosystem Model as a conceptual framework derived from recurring thematic clusters in the literature. It argues that education for communication professionals should integrate AI literacy, ethical awareness and critical media competencies in order to prepare graduates for increasingly AI-mediated communication environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以PRISMA引导的系统综述结合主题综合与概念建模，梳理2018至2025年Web of Science和Scopus收录的生成式人工智能、数字教育、算法传播与AI中介消费行为研究，未做效应量统计合成。综述提出AI在数字传播生态中承担学习助手、认知中介和行为影响者三重相互关联角色，并讨论Z世代、Alpha世代及对Beta世代一词的谨慎预期使用中的代际差异。作者据此构建AI中介传播生态系统模型，主张传播专业教育应整合AI素养、伦理意识与批判性媒体能力。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Literacy as a Challenge for Higher Education - A case study at the Portalegre Polytechnic University
papers.authors: Eduardo O. Lérias, Cristina Guerra, Paulo Ferreira
papers.abstract: This study analyses artificial intelligence (AI) literacy in higher education, using the Portalegre Polytechnic University (PPU) as a case study. The main objective was to examine self-reported AI literacy profiles among faculty and students, identifying perceived competences, weaknesses, and pedagogical implications. A psychometrically validated questionnaire was applied, supported by descriptive statistical analysis and critical interpretation. The descriptive results show an intermediate level of self-reported AI literacy in both groups, although with distinct perceived profiles. Faculty members report higher perceived conceptual understanding of AI, while students show higher mean scores in several applied and adaptive dimensions, particularly ethical awareness and learning. Faculty members reveal limitations in continuous learning and keeping up with technological advances. Students, on the other hand, display high self-confidence in self-management and resistance to algorithmic persuasion, while showing relevant weaknesses in technical understanding and deeper conceptual engagement with AI. The widespread use of AI tools, particularly ChatGPT, confirms their integration in academic practices but raises critical challenges regarding integrity, self-regulation, and assessment. The study concludes that AI literacy should be considered a strategic priority in higher education, requiring dynamic and multidisciplinary training programs that integrate technical, cognitive, and ethical competences. Such initiatives are essential to foster responsible and critical use of AI in educational contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以波塔莱格雷理工学院的教师和学生为对象，通过心理测量学验证的问卷考察其自我报告的AI素养状况，并辅以描述性统计分析。结果显示，两组均处于中等水平，但感知画像不同：教师对AI概念的理解更高，却在持续学习和跟进技术进展方面存在局限；学生在伦理意识和学习等应用与适应维度上得分更高，对自我管理和抵御算法说服较有信心，但技术理解和深层概念参与相对薄弱。ChatGPT等工具的广泛使用已融入学术实践，同时带来诚信、自我调节和评估方面的挑战。作者据此认为，AI素养应成为高等教育战略优先事项，需要融合技术、认知与伦理能力的动态多学科培养方案。

papers.title: From Foundation to Frontier: Re-Examining Bloom’s Taxonomy Across the Four Levels of Education in ICT and Generative AI Era
papers.authors: Prof. Dr. A.B.M Siddique
papers.abstract: Bloom’s Taxonomy remains one of the most enduring pedagogical frameworks in global education, offering a structured hierarchy of cognitive processes from Remembering to Creating. In the age of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) and generative artificial intelligence (AI), its relevance has been both reinforced and problematised. This article argues that the effectiveness of Bloom’s Taxonomy is not uniform across the four levels of education—Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary, and Tertiary—but rather varies in emphasis and application according to students’ cognitive development, curricular demands, and the affordances of digital tools. Drawing on contemporary scholarship and the Bangladeshi educational context, the article proposes a differentiated model of Bloom’s application, where lower-order cognitive skills (LOCS) dominate early schooling while higher-order cognitive skills (HOCS) become progressively central. It further contends that Bloom’s Taxonomy, while necessary, is insufficient in the AI era unless complemented by digital literacy, AI literacy, ethical reasoning, and process-oriented assessment. The article concludes with implications for curriculum design, teacher development, and assessment reform.
keywords: information and communication technology in education
papers.summary_zh: 该文重新审视布鲁姆分类学在信息通信技术与生成式人工智能时代四个教育阶段中的适用性，属于结合文献与孟加拉国教育背景的理论论述。作者提出，分类学的应用应随学生认知发展、课程要求和数字工具可供性而差异化：低阶认知技能在早期教育中占主导，高阶认知技能随后逐步成为核心。文章进一步认为，布鲁姆分类学在人工智能时代虽仍必要但已不充分，需辅以数字素养、人工智能素养、伦理推理和过程性评价，并据此讨论了课程设计、教师发展和评价改革的含义。

papers.title: Digital Illusions and Cognitive Crisis: Governing the Negative Externalities of Internet and AI in Education
papers.authors: Prof. Dr. A.B.M Siddique
papers.abstract: The Internet and artificial intelligence (AI) have become deeply embedded in contemporary education, research and professional life. Their capacity to enhance learning efficiency and reduce access costs is undeniable. Yet these technologies have also generated significant negative externalities: students are increasingly distanced from printed textbooks and library-based study, turning instead to instantly available digital resources and generative AI tools. This shift has contributed to the erosion of deep reading, critical thinking and creativity. Drawing on recent empirical evidence, this article analyses the mechanisms through which screen-based reading and AI dependence undermine cognitive development, and argues that educational institutions must intervene through formal rules and regulations to minimise these externalities. It proposes a policy framework centred on the principle of preserving cognitive friction, encompassing curriculum design, pedagogical norms and assessment reform.
papers.summary_zh: 该文关注互联网与人工智能在教育中带来的负面外部性，指出学生在远离纸质教材和图书馆学习、转向即时数字资源与生成式AI工具的同时，深度阅读、批判性思维和创造力受到侵蚀。作者基于近期实证证据分析屏幕阅读和AI依赖削弱认知发展的机制，并主张教育机构应通过正式规章制度加以干预，提出以保留认知摩擦为原则、涵盖课程设计、教学规范和评估改革的对策框架。文章属于理论分析而非实证研究，其结论建立在既有证据的梳理之上。

papers.title: AI Service Investment and Information Disclosure Under Financing Strategies in a Tourism Live-Streaming Supply Chain: The Roles of Government Regulation and Platform Altruism
papers.authors: Jiaxuan Yang, Hui Yu, Na Xu
papers.abstract: Live-streaming plays a vital role in tourism product marketing. Consumers often struggle to obtain sufficient product information through live-streaming, leading to information asymmetry and low trust, which hinder transaction efficiency. To address these challenges, an increasing number of live-streaming platforms are adopting artificial intelligence (AI) services to help consumers better understand tourism products. However, investment in AI services requires substantial financial resources, while suppliers’ information disclosure directly affects the transparency of tourism product information. A Stackelberg game model examines how government regulation and financing strategies shape supplier information disclosure, platform AI investment, and supply chain profits. The results show the following: (1) The platform’s financing choice is not determined solely by financing costs. The relative advantage of supplier financing over bank financing depends jointly on relative financing rates, consumers’ sensitivity to AI services, and the platform’s altruistic preference; (2) Neither strategy dominates. Subsidies are more advantageous when reward-and-penalty intensity is low, whereas reward-and-penalty regulation becomes preferable as the intensity increases. (3) Platform altruism boosts AI investment and supplier profit but may reduce platform profit when commissions are low or consumers are less AI-sensitive. These findings provide theoretical guidance for live-streaming platforms to optimize their financing and AI service investment decisions, and for governments to design differentiated information disclosure regulations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对旅游直播供应链中消费者信息不足、信任偏低的问题，用Stackelberg博弈模型分析政府监管与融资策略如何影响供应商信息披露、平台AI服务投资及供应链利润。结果显示，平台融资方式的选择并非只取决于融资成本，供应商融资相对银行融资的优势还取决于相对融资费率、消费者对AI服务的敏感度及平台利他偏好；补贴与奖惩监管各有适用条件，奖惩强度较低时补贴更有利，强度提高后奖惩监管更可取。平台利他偏好会提升AI投资和供应商利润，但在佣金较低或消费者对AI不敏感时可能压低平台利润。这些结论为平台优化融资与AI投资决策、政府设计差异化信息披露监管提供参考。

papers.title: The Case for Low-Friction High-Adherence Passive Sleep-Tracking Devices in Longitudinal Monitoring of Neurodegenerative Disease
papers.authors: Angelika Papanicolaou, Graham B. Jones
papers.abstract: Digital health technologies are playing an increasingly important role in patient monitoring, able to capture longitudinal data to supplement scheduled episodic evaluations conducted by clinicians. Rapid advances in sensors and data processing algorithms have resulted in some highly sophisticated systems capable of monitoring and tracking numerous symptoms with high levels of sensitivity and specificity. These approaches, however, often require active engagement with the patient, potentially increasing burden in a clinical trial and often resulting in diminishing adherence over time. In the case of slow-progressing neurodegenerative diseases, this may become an obstacle, as often very subtle changes in symptoms are typically monitored over a multi-year period. Accordingly, there is evident interest in passive monitoring solutions which have minimal burden on patients. Smart ring technologies are one such solution, with appealing form factors, low engagement requirements and increasing intervals before device recharging is required. While newer devices are capable of tracking sleep function with increasing levels of accuracy, they are unable to offer the precision afforded by gold standard sleep analysis such as electroencephalography (EEG), polysomnography (PSG) and sleep laboratory protocols. Prompted by a recent study which highlighted the reduced accuracy of consumer-based sleep devices compared with conventional approaches, we posit that the benefits of such devices may offset the constraints of measurement accuracy. Furthermore, any accuracy–adherence trade-offs would be compensated by long-term statistical benefits derived from detecting within-person changes and reducing measurement noise through enhanced sampling frequencies. In this perspective, we highlight their potential utility in tracking Parkinson’s disease patients longitudinally, where compromised sleep architectures are associated with multiple symptoms and continuous monitoring could offer myriad patient benefits.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇观点性论文，讨论在神经退行性疾病的长期监测中，低负担、高依从性的被动睡眠追踪设备是否值得采用。作者以智能戒指类消费设备为例，指出这类设备虽在精度上不及脑电图、多导睡眠图等金标准，但佩戴方便、无需主动操作、充电间隔长，能减少患者负担并维持长期依从。文章认为，精度与依从性之间的权衡可由长期统计收益补偿：更高采样频率有助于识别个体内变化并降低测量噪声。作者据此主张此类设备在帕金森病患者纵向睡眠监测中具有潜在价值，但结论属于观点论证，并非实证验证。

papers.title: Soft Prompt Tuning for Multilingual Natural Language Understanding in Human–Robot Interaction with Bidirectional Cross-Attention
papers.authors: Sakthiprasad Kuttankulangara Manoharan, Rajesh Kannan Megalingam, Chandini Sunil
papers.abstract: Natural language understanding (NLU) enables intuitive human–robot interaction (HRI). It requires joint modeling of intent classification and named entity recognition (NER). Existing approaches suffer from three key limitations. Fine-tuning large multilingual pretrained models on domain-specific HRI data incurs high computational overhead.
