Intent classification and NER are typically treated as independent tasks, despite their semantic interdependence. Labeled HRI datasets for Indian languages are absent, to the best of our knowledge, limiting system accessibility for native-speaking communities. This paper proposes SoftPromptIndicBERTCRF, a parameter-efficient multilingual NLU architecture built on a frozen, 33.4 M-parameter IndicBERT backbone. The architecture prepends 50 learnable soft prompt tokens, initialized from task-specific HRI vocabulary, to the input sequence. A bidirectional cross-attention module, with 8 attention heads, models the mutual dependency between intent and NER. A Conditional Random Field (CRF) decoder enforces valid Begin–Inside–Outside (BIO) tag sequences during entity decoding. Custom HRI datasets were constructed for English, Hindi, and Malayalam, covering 13 intent classes and 7 entity types. The proposed framework provides 99.35% accuracy for intent detection and a 98.77% F1 score for NER in all three languages. The latency for end-to-end pipelining involving ASR transcriptions and NLU inferences is 0.78 to 0.92 s on average in all three languages, thereby validating its utility for real-time application in robots.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人机交互中的多语言自然语言理解，提出一种参数高效架构，在冻结的轻量多语言预训练模型上引入可学习软提示，并用双向交叉注意力建模意图分类与命名实体识别之间的相互依赖，以条件随机场约束实体标签序列。作者为英语、印地语和马拉雅拉姆语构建了领域数据集，报告三种语言下意图识别准确率和实体识别F1均较高，端到端流水线延迟处于亚秒级。结果表明该方案在保持较低计算开销的同时具备实时机器人应用潜力，但结论基于作者自建数据集与特定语言范围。

papers.title: Human Freedom as Participation in Divine Creativity: The Spiritual Intelligence AI Cannot Possess
papers.authors: Luca Colacino
papers.abstract: Contemporary debates on artificial intelligence increasingly raise questions not only about machine agency but also about the nature of human creativity and freedom. While much of the current discussion evaluates AI by comparing its observable behaviour with that of human beings, this article argues that the decisive question is metaphysical rather than functional. Drawing on insights into the nature of freedom from Augustine, Aquinas, and other medieval theologians, I argue that human freedom arises from the rational creature’s participation in an immaterial mode of being that grounds the free agentic self-movement. This participatory account of freedom provides a theological anthropology capable of distinguishing human creativity from increasingly sophisticated artificial systems without appealing merely to current technological limitations. After examining two recent attempts to attribute free agency to AI systems, including theories rooted in intentionality and computational sourcehood, I argue that these accounts fail to identify the metaphysical conditions required for genuinely free and creative agency. Human freedom is shown to be inseparable from the unity of the spiritual soul, whose intellect and will participate in divine wisdom and providence with a specific kind of secondary causality. Thus, I identify the distinctive feature of human agentic intelligence in its intrinsic transcendent teleology, a mark of participation in the divine. AI systems, even their most autonomous future versions, seem limited by an intrinsic immanent teleology to their algorithmic boundaries. Thus, if my distinction holds, I determine that AI systems may increasingly reproduce the external operations associated with human intelligence and free agency, but they cannot participate in the kind of creative self-movement that belongs to rational creatures created in the image of God. The article concludes that the chief challenge posed by AI is therefore not whether machines will become human, but whether technological culture will encourage humanity to reinterpret itself according to computational categories rather than its vocation to participate in divine creativity.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对人工智能是否具有自由与创造力这一问题，主张关键不在功能比较而在形而上学条件。作者借助奥古斯丁、阿奎那等中世纪神学家关于自由的论述，提出人的自由源于理性受造物对非质料存在方式的参与，并据此审视意向性和计算来源等两种赋予AI自由能动性的近期理论，认为它们未能满足真正自由创造所需的形而上学条件。文章由此区分人的超越目的论与AI受算法边界限制的内在目的论，结论是AI或可复制人类智能与自由能动性的外在表现，却无法参与理性受造物特有的创造性自我运动；作者进而提示，AI带来的主要挑战在于技术文化是否会让人按计算范畴而非参与神圣创造的使命来重新理解自身。

papers.title: Generative AI Adoption in Software Development Through an Extended UTAUT2 Framework with Evidence from Thailand
papers.authors: Tanatorn Tanantong, Charoen Kasetruengphol, Nittaya Chemkomnerd, Tanpat Kraiwanit
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) diffuses globally, understanding the adoption of AI-assisted software development tools is increasingly important, particularly in emerging digital economies. This study examines GenAI acceptance among individuals in Thailand with varying durations and contexts of software development experience acquired through professional work, education, internships, freelance assignments, independent activities, or personal projects. Anextended UTAUT2 framework was developed by adding perceived trust and perceived risk, with age, gender, and software development experience examined as potential moderators. Partial least squares structural equation modeling was applied to 404 valid responses collected through an online survey. The model explained 42.9% of behavioral intention and 44.8% of use behavior. Hedonic motivation, price value, habit, and perceived risk were significantly associated with behavioral intention, whereas behavioral intention and habit were significantly associated with use behavior. The remaining direct relationships and all moderating effects, including those involving software development experience, were nonsignificant. Contrary to the hypothesized direction, perceived risk showed a small positive association with behavioral intention, suggesting that stronger usage intentions and greater risk awareness may coexist within the present sample. These findings provide context-specific evidence of GenAI adoption in Thailand and offer practical insights for organizations and policymakers seeking to support responsible adoption in comparable settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以泰国具有不同软件开发经验背景的个体为对象，在UTAUT2框架中纳入感知信任与感知风险，用偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析问卷调查数据，考察生成式AI辅助开发工具的采纳机制。结果显示，享乐动机、价格价值、习惯和感知风险与使用意向显著相关，使用意向和习惯与使用行为显著相关，其余直接关系及包括开发经验在内的调节效应均不显著；感知风险与使用意向呈小幅正相关，与假设方向相反，提示较强使用意向与较高风险意识可能并存。研究据此为泰国及类似情境下支持负责任采纳提供参考。

papers.title: Factors Associated with Health-Related Quality of Life Among Greek Candidates for Bariatric Surgery: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Marianna S. Tsatali, Evangelos Ntouros, Myrto T. Samara, Paraskevas Panagiotis Sdralis, Fotios I. Economou, Elias Sdralis
papers.abstract: Background: This study examined demographic, anthropometric, and psychological factors associated with health-related quality of life (HRQoL) among Greek candidates for bariatric surgery. Methods: A total of 524 candidates for bariatric surgery (mean age = 41.49 years, SD = 11.18) were recruited from the Interbalkan Medical Centre of Thessaloniki between May 2019 and November 2024. Participants completed standardized measures assessing depressive symptoms, anxiety, disordered eating attitudes, psychological resilience, personality traits, and HRQoL. Eight theory-informed multiple linear regression models were fitted to examine cross-sectional associations with the SF-36 domains, adjusting simultaneously for 12 demographic, anthropometric, and psychological covariates. Heteroscedasticity-consistent (HC3) standard errors and false discovery rate (FDR) correction were applied. Results: Depressive symptoms were negatively associated with all eight SF-36 domains after multivariable adjustment and FDR correction. Higher BMI was associated with poorer scores across all four physical HRQoL domains, as well as Social Functioning and Vitality, while older age was negatively associated with all four physical domains. Anxiety symptoms were independently associated only with Mental Health. Psychological resilience was positively associated with General Health Perceptions and Vitality, whereas higher Neuroticism and Extraversion were associated with poorer and better mental and psychosocial HRQoL, respectively. Adjusted R2 values ranged from 0.245 to 0.548 across the eight SF-36 domains. Discussion: Depressive symptoms emerged as the most consistent correlate of HRQoL among Greek candidates for bariatric surgery, whereas BMI, age, resilience, anxiety, and personality traits demonstrated more domain-specific associations. These findings highlight the relevance of comprehensive preoperative assessment addressing both physical and psychological functioning. Conclusions: Longitudinal studies are needed to clarify temporal relationships and determine whether these characteristics are associated with postoperative HRQoL outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察希腊减重手术候选者中与健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）相关的 demographic、人体测量和心理因素，采用横断面设计，对候选者施测抑郁、焦虑、进食态度、心理韧性、人格特质及 SF-36 等标准化量表，并用多元线性回归分析各因素与 SF-36 各维度的关联。结果显示，抑郁症状在多重校正后与全部八个 SF-36 维度均呈负相关，是最一致的关联因素；较高 BMI 和年龄主要与身体相关维度得分较低相关，焦虑仅与心理健康维度独立相关，心理韧性与总体健康感知和活力正相关，神经质和外向性分别与较差和较好的心理社会 HRQoL 相关。作者据此强调术前评估应同时关注身体与心理功能，并指出需纵向研究厘清时间关系及这些特征与术后 HRQoL 的关联。

papers.title: From Nutrition Knowledge to Health-Related Behaviors in Undergraduate Nursing Education: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Carlos Enrique Adán-Failde, Ana Presa-Carrera, Eva Luyufeng Yáñez-Izquierdo, Juan Manuel Vázquez-Lago
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Nutrition knowledge is an important component of undergraduate nursing education, but greater knowledge does not necessarily translate into healthier personal behaviors. This study aimed to assess nutrition knowledge and health-related behaviors among undergraduate nursing students, compare these outcomes across academic years, and identify factors associated with both dimensions. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among students enrolled in the four-year nursing degree at the University of Santiago de Compostela, Spain, during the 2025/2026 academic year. Participants completed a study-specific ad hoc questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, nutrition knowledge, dietary and health-related behaviors, self-rated dietary quality, and body mass index (BMI) perception. Bivariate analyses, multiple linear regression, ordinal logistic regression, and weighted Cohen’s kappa were used. Results: A total of 297 students participated (50.9% response rate); 81.1% were women. Mean nutrition knowledge was 22.51 ± 4.01/36 and differed across academic years, ranging from 21.56 ± 3.74 among first-year students to 24.64 ± 3.87 among fourth-year students (p < 0.001). The mean health-related behaviors score was 76.26 ± 7.01/105 and did not differ across academic years (p = 0.103). Behavior score increased from 68.33 ± 7.78 among students rating their diet as poor to 84.81 ± 4.32 among those rating it as very good (p < 0.001); each 10-point increase was associated with higher odds of reporting a better dietary-quality category (adjusted OR = 7.78; 95% CI: 4.99–12.13). Exact agreement between calculated and self-perceived BMI categories was 82.7% (weighted κ = 0.593). Conclusions: Nutrition knowledge was higher among students in later academic years, whereas health-related behaviors did not show a similar academic pattern. These findings suggest that undergraduate nursing education should reinforce practical and behavior-oriented nutrition learning alongside theoretical knowledge.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察护理本科生营养知识与健康相关行为之间的关系，并比较不同学年的差异。研究采用横断面设计，让西班牙一所大学的护理本科生填写自编问卷，分析营养知识、饮食与健康行为、自评饮食质量及BMI感知。结果显示，营养知识随学年升高而增加，但健康相关行为得分并未呈现类似的学年差异；行为得分越高，学生自评饮食质量越好，自评BMI类别与计算类别的一致性也较高。作者据此认为，护理本科教育在传授营养理论的同时，应加强实践性和行为导向的学习。

papers.title: Food Label Reading and Cardiovascular Health Profiles Across Adulthood: Findings from the Look-Up 8+ Study
papers.authors: Anna Maria Martone, Elena Levati, Riccardo Calvani, Matteo Tosato, Vincenzo Galluzzo, Francesca Ciciarello, Sara Salini, Stefano Cacciatore, Emanuele Marzetti, Francesco Landi
papers.abstract: Background: Unhealthy dietary patterns are a major risk factor for death and functional disability. Food labeling provides key nutritional information and is associated with healthier dietary patterns. This study aims to investigate whether attention to food labels is associated with dietary patterns, BMI, and Cardiovascular 8 metrics scores. Methods: We analyzed data from the Look-Up 8+ project, including adults aged 18 years or older from several Italian regions. Participants underwent a comprehensive lifestyle assessment, including dietary habits, cholesterol and glucose measurements, and anthropometric evaluations. Descriptive, comparative, and inferential statistical analyses were used to investigate the association between attention to food labels and dietary patterns, BMI, and Cardiovascular Health scores. Results: Among 7401 participants (mean age 54.4 ± 15.0 years, with 55.5% women), those who reported reading food labels exhibited a higher prevalence of regular physical activity and adherence to a healthy diet. In contrast, participants who did not read food labels had a higher body mass index. Both men and women who reported greater attention to food composition had a higher Life’s Essential 8 score. Conclusions: These results suggest that attention to food labels is associated with more favorable lifestyle choices and improved cardiovascular health profiles.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于意大利Look-Up 8+项目的数据，考察成年人关注食品标签与膳食模式、BMI及心血管健康指标之间的关联。分析显示，报告阅读食品标签的参与者更可能保持规律运动和健康膳食，而不阅读标签者BMI更高；无论男女，对食品成分关注度较高者的Life's Essential 8得分也更高。作者据此认为，关注食品标签与更有利的生活方式选择和更好的心血管健康状况相关，但这是横断面关联，尚不能说明阅读标签本身带来这些健康收益。

papers.title: Cross-Dataset Generalisation of Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Three-Class Alzheimer’s Disease Staging: A Six-Model Benchmark Including a Bidirectional State-Space Model
papers.authors: Keenan Ramnarain, Rito Clifford Maswanganyi, Philani Khumalo
papers.abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common neurodegenerative disorder, and its pathology accumulates for years before symptoms appear, which places the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) stage at the centre of early detection. Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) applied to structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) report high classification accuracy, yet these figures are usually measured within a single cohort and are rarely tested for transfer to an independent cohort, so whether they translate into clinical usefulness remains unresolved. The objective of this study is to address that gap directly. Six classifiers, three classical learners (Extra Trees, LightGBM and CatBoost) and three deep networks (ConvNeXt, CoAtNet and an introduced bidirectional Vision Mamba model, MambAD) were trained and tested on identical hippocampal slices from three publicly available datasets, namely ADNI, OASIS and a public Kaggle collection, for the three-class staging of cognitively normal (CN), MCI and AD. Every model was evaluated within cohorts and, more importantly, across cohorts, with subject-level scoring on the two clinical datasets. Within the primary ADNI cohort, the introduced model reached the highest balanced accuracy (BAC) at 0.578, although this lead was not statistically significant; across the six models, none dominated on every task, and no pairwise difference between models reached significance. BAC fell from about 0.55 within-cohort to between 0.38 and 0.45 across cohorts for every model, and the deep models transferred better on the ranking metric than the classical learners. The results show that a lightweight state-space model can match far larger pretrained backbones under matched conditions, and they confirm that single cohort accuracy overstates readiness, with cross-dataset generalisation remaining the binding constraint on clinical use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对阿尔茨海默病三分类分期模型跨数据集泛化能力不足的问题，在ADNI、OASIS和Kaggle三个公开数据集上，用相同的海马切片训练并测试了三种经典机器学习模型与三种深度网络（含新提出的双向视觉Mamba模型MambAD），并在队列内和跨队列两种条件下评估。结果显示，各模型在队列内的平衡准确率约为0.55，跨队列时降至0.38至0.45；没有模型在所有任务上占优，模型间差异也未达显著，深度模型在排序指标上的迁移表现优于经典学习器。作者据此指出，轻量状态空间模型在同等条件下可与更大的预训练骨干网络相当，而单队列准确率会高估临床可用性，跨数据集泛化仍是临床落地的主要制约。

papers.title: VIG-Un: An Interactive Vision and Instruction Grasping for Unknown Objects
papers.authors: Qi Sun, Zuofan Chen, Lili He
papers.abstract: Despite the development of various dexterous grasping techniques, it remains challenging for robots to successfully pick unknown objects through an image or speech input provided by a human. The challenge lies in the absence of an effective mechanism to integrate visual information and instruction derived from human interaction, and to subsequently associate this integration with unknown objects captured by sensors in a real-world scenario. To address this challenge, this work proposes an interactive vision and instruction grasping method for unknown objects (VIG-Un). The proposed VIG-Un offers users three communication modes: visual interaction, instruction interaction, and vision–instruction combined interaction. In the vision-based mode, ARUCO marker boards serve as input samples for object detection, providing a reliable visual reference for accurate object localization. In the instruction mode, we introduce a Semantic-Aware Image Generation Branch (SAIGB), which generates relevant images based on textual instructions, enabling semantic understanding in grasping tasks. Then, VIG-Un leverages a Deep Siamese Network (DSN)-based few-shot object detection approach, reducing the reliance on visual fine-tuning and substantially enhancing the flexibility and adaptability of robotic manipulators during grasp operations. In experimental evaluations benchmarked against state-of-the-art methods, including YOLO-World and RT-1, the VIG-Un framework achieves higher object detection accuracy and grasping success rates than these competitors on object-grasping tasks in typical indoor environments, while maintaining acceptable execution efficiency, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对机器人难以根据人类提供的图像或语音输入抓取未知物体的问题，提出了交互式视觉与指令抓取方法 VIG-Un，将视觉信息与人类指令整合并关联到传感器捕获的未知物体。该方法提供视觉、指令及两者结合三种交互模式，并借助少样本目标检测降低对视觉微调的依赖。与 YOLO-World、RT-1 等方法的对比实验显示，VIG-Un 在典型室内场景的物体抓取任务中取得更高的检测准确率和抓取成功率，同时保持可接受的执行效率，表明其在未知物体抓取上具有一定有效性与稳健性。

papers.title: Reported Transparency Practices in AI Use Among Journalism Professionals in Ecuador: Ethics, Self-Regulation, and Professional Challenges
papers.authors: Cristhian Martin Reyes Hidalgo, Débora Judith Burgos Zambrano
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly incorporated into journalistic work, raising questions concerning transparency, authorship, editorial responsibility, human verification, and organizational governance. This study examines reported transparency practices and professional perceptions concerning AI use among journalism professionals linked to media organizations and news-production environments in Ecuador. A mixed-methods design combined a non-probability online survey of 53 eligible professionals with seven semi-structured interviews involving six journalism professionals and one communication academic with professional experience in journalism. The quantitative component was analyzed descriptively, while the qualitative component was examined through a deductive and interpretive analysis structured around four predefined thematic domains. AI use was reported by 48 of the 53 survey participants (90.6%), with both instrumental and generative applications identified. Among applicable responses, 39.5% reported the existence of a specific AI-related deontological code, 59.2% reported having received instructions from superiors, and 29.3% reported an obligation to disclose AI use to audiences. Human verification was the most frequently selected component of proposed internal AI rules (79.2%). The interviews showed uneven levels of organizational formalization, including verbal instructions, emerging guidelines, and differing thresholds for disclosure, while consistently emphasizing human editorial judgment and responsibility. The findings indicate that transparency in AI-assisted journalism is multidimensional and unevenly institutionalized across the professional environments represented in the study. These results provide sample-bound evidence from Ecuador and should not be interpreted as a national estimate of media transparency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察厄瓜多尔新闻从业者对人工智能使用透明度的报告实践与职业认知，采用混合方法，将面向相关从业者的在线问卷调查与半结构化访谈结合，分别作描述性统计和围绕预设主题的演绎阐释。结果显示，绝大多数受访者报告在工作中使用人工智能，用途兼有工具性与生成性；但相关规范建设并不均衡，仅部分受访者表示存在专门的人工智能伦理准则、收到上级指示或负有向受众披露使用的义务，访谈也呈现出口头指示、初步指南与披露门槛不一等差异。人工核验是被最频繁提及的内部规则要素，受访者始终强调人的编辑判断与责任。作者据此认为，人工智能辅助新闻的透明度是多维度的，且在所涉职业环境中制度化程度参差；结论仅基于该样本，不能视为厄瓜多尔媒体透明度的全国估计。

papers.title: “What Am I Really Doing with My Own Brain?”: College Students on Learning, Ownership, and AI
papers.authors: Tobin Ting, Elisa Liang, Maxwell Edward Tankersley, Timothy Lindgren, Noël Ingram, Colleen Dallavalle, Terese Lund, Belle Liang
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence gives college students new ways to support their learning, while also raising questions about what they still want to learn and do for themselves. This qualitative study draws on semi-structured interviews with 14 undergraduates at a Northeastern liberal arts college to examine how students distinguish between AI use that supports their own thinking and AI use that substitutes for it, what they believe is worth doing on their own, and whether and how purpose enters their reasoning about learning and AI use. Using the Framework Method with a cross-case matrix to compare patterns across participants and topics, we found that students repeatedly drew a line between using AI as a supportive tool and letting it take the place of their own thinking or authorship. Students most often talked about wanting to keep developing their own skills, thinking independently, and knowing what they could actually do without AI. They also wanted the work to still feel “like theirs,” citing ownership, pride, authenticity, and ethical concerns. Students also described pressures that made AI appealing, including heavy workloads, deadlines, grades, convenience, and concerns about falling behind their peers. Although few participants explicitly connected their AI choices to a stated purpose, many described concerns that may be relevant to purpose development, including developing valued skills and strengths, acting on personal values, and becoming the kind of person they hoped to be. We consider these concerns through a purpose-mindset framework while distinguishing our interpretation from participants’ own explanations of their AI choices. The findings suggest that understanding students’ AI use requires attention to what they believe they need to learn and do for themselves.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对美国东北部一所文理学院14名本科生的半结构化访谈，采用框架分析法与跨案例矩阵，考察学生如何区分支持自身思考的AI使用与替代自身思考的AI使用，以及他们如何看待学习的意义与目的。研究发现，学生反复在“AI作为辅助工具”与“让AI取代自己的思考或创作”之间划界，普遍希望保留自身技能发展、独立思考以及不依赖AI时实际能力的判断，并强调作品仍要“像自己的”，涉及归属感、自豪感、真实性与伦理顾虑；同时，课业负担、截止日期、成绩、便利和落后于同伴的担忧又使AI具有吸引力。尽管少数参与者明确将AI选择与人生目的联系起来，许多人表达的关切仍可能与目的发展相关。作者借助目的心态框架加以解读，并明确区分这一解读与学生自身的解释，指出理解学生的AI使用需关注他们认为自己需要亲自学习和完成的内容。

papers.title: Treg and Oxidative Stress Biomarker Profiles in Long COVID and Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
papers.authors: Yana Todorova, Radostina Dimitrova, Teodora Kalfova, С. В. Петров, Martina Bozhkova, Mariya Ivanovska, Dobrina Dudova, Marianna Murdjeva, Hristo B. Taskov, Michael H. J. Maes, Maria H. Nikolova
papers.abstract: Chronic immune dysregulation is the possible pathophysiological mechanism in myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) and long coronavirus infectious disease (long COVID, LC). However, a detailed characterization of regulatory and effector T-cell subsets in these conditions remains limited. To assess and compare T-cell subsets in relation to serum biomarkers of chronic activation and oxidative/nitrosative stress in an attempt to differentiate between LC and ME/CFS patients. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PMNC) from LC patients (n = 89), ME/CFS patients (n = 125), and healthy controls (HC, n = 80) were analyzed using multiparameter flow cytometry. The frequencies of naïve (CD45RA+), effector (CD45RA-), CD31+, CD39+, CD73+, GARP+, PI16+, CD15s/CD161+, and CD147+ Treg subsets were determined in relation to CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell differentiation, activation, and effector subsets. Catalase (CAT), superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1), glutathione peroxidase 1 (GPX1), malondialdehyde (MDA), nitric oxide synthase 1 and 3 (NOS1, NOS3), zonulin, lipopolysaccharide (LPS), immunoglobulin G (IgG) against lipopolysaccharide (IgG-LPS), Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO), and Dickkopf-related protein 1 (DKK1) were measured in serum by ELISA. Clinical symptom scores (HAMA, HAMD, FF, dePol) were additionally assessed. The immune-serum biomarkers distinguishing LC, ME/CFS, and HC comprised Th17, CD15s+CD161−eTreg, and CD161+ Treg. The five-marker signature retained significance after adjustment for age, BMI, and sex. Altered T-cell subsets were strongly associated with markers of oxidative (GPX1) and nitrosative (NOS3) stress but not directly with symptom severity. ME/CFS showed a strong separation from HC across Random Forest (AUC = 0.907) and logistic regression (AUC = 0.924). The modest distinction of LC from HC (AUC = 0.727 and 0.577 respectively) possibly reflected important endotypic diversity, though differences in disease duration, vaccination history, biomarker selection, and other cohort characteristics might add to it. MDA was an independent predictor for three-class classification, ME/CFS vs. HC, and LC vs. HC pairwise comparisons, while GPX1 discriminated between ME/CFS and LC. In spite of shared biomarkers of oxidative stress and T-cell response dysregulation, our results support the hypothesis that LC and ME/CFS differ in the extent of cellular damage and the exhaustion of compensatory mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较长新冠（LC）与肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征（ME/CFS）患者的T细胞亚群及血清氧化应激相关标志物，采用流式细胞术与ELISA检测，并结合临床症状评分。结果显示，区分LC、ME/CFS与健康对照的主要免疫标志物包括Th17、CD15s+CD161−eTreg和CD161+Treg，校正年龄、BMI和性别后仍具显著性；改变的T细胞亚群与氧化应激标志物GPX1和亚硝化应激标志物NOS3密切相关，但与症状严重程度无直接关联。ME/CFS与健康对照区分度较高，LC与健康对照区分度有限，提示LC存在较大的内型多样性；MDA可独立预测三组分类及两两比较，GPX1可区分ME/CFS与LC。作者认为，尽管两类疾病共享氧化应激和T细胞调节异常，但细胞损伤程度与代偿机制耗竭不同，支持二者存在差异的假设。

papers.title: SmartGate: A Prototype of AI–Blockchain-Enabled Academic Certificate Management System
papers.authors: Ibrahim Khormi, Priyadarsi Nanda, Mohammed Y. Aalsalem, Manoranjan Mohanty, Ibrahim Aqeel
papers.abstract: Technological innovations have exposed vulnerabilities in traditional certificate verification systems. Conventional methods of verification cannot handle complex, evolving fraud systems and are susceptible to manipulation and human error. They can verify the authenticity of validly signed certificates but fail to detect behavioral fraud throughout the certificate lifecycle. This paper presents SmartGate—a secure framework that combines AI and blockchain to detect behavioral fraud and protect the integrity of academic certificates. The framework uses AI and feature engineering to capture user behavioral patterns indicative of fraud. The proposed SmartGate is designed to screen a certificate’s behavioral context before allowing it to be stored on the blockchain. University student records data were used to evaluate the proposed SmartGate. Specifically, the normal academic records and certificate workflow are real, while the suspicious cases were synthetically generated via controlled fraud scenarios. A machine learning algorithm is used to model the relationship between user behavior and the legitimacy of certificates. The framework introduces an SHAP explainable AI approach to interpret the outcomes for transparency and trust. To provide a secure, tamper-proof system, blockchain is deployed to anchor the approved certificates. A prototype of the proposed SmartGate has been developed. As a proof-of-concept implementation, the XGBoost model was used to validate the certificate-screening stage of the proposed SmartGate system. Also, a local Ethereum environment was used to implement the blockchain anchoring stage. Experimental results demonstrate the technical feasibility of the proposed SmartGate framework, including its ability to provide feature-level model explainability, within a controlled environment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统证书验证系统难以识别证书全生命周期中行为欺诈的问题，提出并实现了一个结合人工智能与区块链的学术证书管理原型系统 SmartGate。系统利用特征工程和机器学习建模用户行为与证书合法性之间的关系，在证书上链前筛查其行为背景，并借助 SHAP 解释模型输出以增强透明度，再将通过的证书锚定到区块链上。作者用真实学术记录与受控场景合成的可疑案例进行概念验证，结果显示该框架在受控环境下具备技术可行性，并能提供特征层面的模型解释；但相关结论来自原型验证，尚不能说明其在真实部署中的效果。

papers.title: Human-Centered AI Translation Systems: An Evaluation and Validation Framework for Literary Translation
papers.authors: Jean S. Blancia, Mariane Grace F. Fajutina, Rhealyn F. Falcunit, Jenerose F. Gitubig, Mac Daryl G. Galicia, Menchie F. Gadon, Marwin Sarandin
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly being used for language processing and translation, providing computational capabilities for automated drafting, linguistic exploration, alternative expression generation, and interactive language assistance. However, literary translation presents a particularly demanding application context because translation quality depends on meaning, tone, imagery, emotion, cultural context, genre, and stylistic intent. This study develops and empirically grounds a human-centered AI translation system framework for the evaluation and validation of AI-assisted Filipino literary translation. An explanatory sequential mixed methods design was employed with 22 pre-service teachers who translated poetry and flash fiction from English into Filipino using limited AI assistance. Their translation outputs were evaluated by three inter-raters, while 15 purposively selected participants participated in semi-structured interviews. Quantitative data were analyzed using frequency and percentage, while qualitative data were examined through thematic analysis. ChatGPT-5.3 was the most frequently used AI platform, and most participants relied on a single AI system. Couplet, adaptation, lexical synonym, and addition or expansion were the most frequently identified translation techniques. The findings indicate that AI systems supported faster translation, vocabulary development, alternative phrasing, and meaning clarification, but also produced inaccurate or awkward translations and demonstrated limitations in preserving cultural, emotional, contextual, and literary meaning. Based on these findings, the study proposes a human-centered AI translation system framework integrating text familiarization, AI tool selection, AI-assisted drafting, human evaluation, student revision and justification, teacher-guided pedagogical control, final translation revision, and back translation. The framework positions AI as a computational support component within an iterative evaluation and validation process, while retaining human interpretation, cultural judgment, revision, and accountability as essential system functions. The proposed framework provides a structured basis for evaluating and responsibly integrating AI translation systems into literary translation instruction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对文学翻译对意义、语气、意象与文化语境的高要求，考察职前教师在使用有限AI辅助将诗歌与微小说从英语译为菲律宾语时的表现，并据此提出以人为中心的AI翻译系统评估与验证框架。研究采用解释性序列混合方法，对译文进行评分者评定并结合半结构化访谈分析。结果显示，AI能加快翻译速度、帮助词汇拓展与措辞选择，但也会产生不准确或生硬的译文，在保留文化、情感与文学意涵方面存在局限。作者据此提出涵盖文本熟悉、工具选择、AI辅助起草、人工评估、学生修改与论证、教师引导、终稿修订及回译的迭代框架，将AI定位为计算支持，而把解释、文化判断与责任保留给人类。

papers.title: A Human–AI Orchestration Framework for Mathematics Education
papers.authors: Gila Payevsky, Anita E. Stoyanova, Moshe Mellick, Nikolay Penev, Veneta Veselinova Tabakova-Komsalova, Iskra Nencheva, Stanimir Nedyalkov Stoyanov, Emil G. Delinov
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing personalized and adaptive education. Existing research has examined Human–AI hybrid adaptivity and coordination between human participants and AI systems, but clearer conceptualization is needed of the pedagogical coordination of functionally different forms of instructional support, particularly in highly abstract domains such as mathematics. This study proposes a Human–AI Orchestration Framework integrating Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs), Generative AI, and direct teacher support while retaining pedagogical orchestration and responsibility with the teacher. Drawing on Cognitive Load Theory, the Framework proposes Cognitive Load Redistribution as a theoretical proposition and introduces coordination mechanisms, including Handover Points and a Meta-Prompt. Its practical implementation was explored through an exploratory design pilot with 32 Grade 8 students in an authentic classroom, using observations and feedback to iteratively refine its configuration. The pilot informed several design refinements, including refinement of the Meta-Prompt, introduction of “Call the Teacher,” and adaptation of interaction formats. These formative observations provide preliminary indications of the practical feasibility of coordinating functionally different and potentially complementary forms of instructional support, while the Framework’s educational effectiveness and proposed conceptual mechanisms remain to be systematically evaluated in future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对数学教育中不同功能的教学支持如何协调的问题，提出了一个整合智能辅导系统、生成式AI与教师直接支持的人机协同编排框架，并强调教学编排与责任仍由教师承担。作者基于认知负荷理论提出认知负荷再分配的理论设想，并引入交接点与元提示等协调机制。通过一项有32名八年级学生参与的课堂探索性设计试点，研究借助观察与反馈迭代调整了框架配置，如改进元提示、增设“呼叫教师”功能并调整互动形式。这些形成性观察初步显示，协调功能不同且可能互补的教学支持在实践上具有可行性，但框架的教育效果及其理论机制仍有待后续系统评估。

papers.title: A Local Edge Companion Architecture for Human-Aware Communication and Service Augmentation in Cloud-Controlled Service Robots
papers.authors: Kazuma Ito, Tomihiro Utsumi, Tianjia Lan, Min Lu, Iori Sasaki, Ryo Sato, Masatoshi Arikawa
papers.abstract: Commercial cloud-controlled service robots are increasingly deployed in shared public facilities, yet many remain task-centric delivery platforms that cannot be easily extended with surrounding-people recognition, situated communication policy, or continuous access to internal middleware. This article proposes the Local Safety Companion Robot Extension (LSCRx), a non-invasive local edge companion architecture that augments such robots with human-aware communication while preserving manufacturer-controlled cloud operation and built-in safety functions. The central contribution is a communication-space design method that interprets robot–user distance, distance dynamics, body cues, field-of-view availability, and recognition confidence as service-level evidence. In the proposed conceptual policy, a gradual, confidence-supported decrease in distance would be treated as participation evidence, whereas separation, stopping outside the service zone, target loss, or unstable recognition would lead to waiting, distant greeting, information display, or other distance-preserving service actions. A prototype combines a commercial service robot with smartphone-class companion modules and a local edge server to demonstrate local body tracking, self-localization, data transmission, and cloud-API command preparation. Viewpoint-aware selection among registered spatial service waypoints (RSSWs) and anti-chasing rules are proposed as a conceptual model and were not implemented or evaluated in the present prototype. In the baseline route study, offline translational correction using known route-endpoint coordinates reduced the mean return-segment human-position error from 0.770 m to 0.476 m (approximately 38.2%) on the recorded data; this reduction was not independently validated. The evaluation was limited to one robot at a single university indoor location. Exploratory experiments involved seven participants, yielding six valid body-tracking datasets and seven questionnaire responses. These experiments and field observations suggest that contactless cues, camera placement, stop distance, and field of view jointly influence service usability under the tested conditions. The findings suggest a potential HRI design gap: the distance that is socially appropriate for a person may not coincide with the distance that is technically appropriate for reliable skeleton recognition. These preliminary findings further suggest that near-distance service interaction may benefit from both distance-aware robot policy and robust wide-field smartphone-based AR/body-tracking support that can preserve skeleton completeness and metric spatial stability. Further evaluation is needed to assess generalizability beyond this setting.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一种非侵入式本地边缘伴随架构LSCRx，在保留厂商云端控制与内置安全功能的前提下，为商用云控服务机器人增加人体感知与情境化沟通能力。其核心是沟通空间设计方法，将人机距离、距离动态、身体线索、视野可用性和识别置信度作为服务层证据，据此区分参与迹象与应保持距离的情形。原型结合商用机器人、手机级伴随模块与本地边缘服务器，演示了本地人体跟踪、自定位与云端指令准备；基于注册空间服务路点的视角感知选择和防追逐规则仅为概念模型，未实现或评估。基线路线离线校正使回程段人体位置平均误差由0.770米降至0.476米，但未独立验证，评估也限于单一室内地点的单台机器人。七名参与者的探索性实验提示，非接触线索、相机位置、停止距离与视野共同影响服务可用性，并揭示社交适宜距离可能与骨架识别可靠所需距离不一致，近距服务或需兼顾距离感知策略与稳健的广域手机AR/人体跟踪支持。

papers.title: Explainable Classification Models for Identifying Elevated Gastrointestinal Symptom Burden in Honduran Communities: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Ethel Flores, Diana Meza, Rene Gonzales, Carlos Agudelo-Santos, Lilian Sosa, Lupe Carolina Espinoza, Isaac Zablah
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Gastrointestinal symptoms are a common reason for primary-care consultation, yet specialist assessment is often inaccessible in rural Central America. We evaluated whether explainable models using inexpensive demographic and lifestyle data can identify community residents aged 12 to 49 years with concurrently elevated gastrointestinal symptom burden. Methods: This was a cross-sectional survey of 1838 residents from 85 communities in five Honduran departments. Elevated symptom burden was defined as at least two of four indicators: recent abdominal pain, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux, and post-prandial bloating. Model A used eight demographic and lifestyle predictors; Model B added self-reported previous digestive diagnosis. Logistic regression was compared with six machine-learning classifiers under repeated nested five-fold and ten-fold cross-validation and community-grouped cross-validation. Discrimination, calibration, paired differences, community-level uncertainty, decision curves, SHAP explainability and subgroup performance were assessed. Results: Elevated symptom burden affected 840/1838 participants (45.7%, 95% CI 43.4 to 48.0). Model A showed modest discrimination (AUROC 0.663, 95% CI 0.639 to 0.688), while Model B improved performance (AUROC 0.726, 95% CI 0.702 to 0.748) with good calibration (slope 0.955). No flexible learner outperformed logistic regression; the paired AUROC difference with gradient boosting was 0.001 (95% CI −0.008 to 0.010). Within strata of previous diagnosis, discrimination was only 0.621 to 0.643. Model B provided net benefit above screen-all and screen-none strategies at thresholds above approximately 0.25, but reaching 80% sensitivity required flagging 66% of participants. Conclusions: Low-cost information can identify concurrently elevated gastrointestinal symptom burden with moderate accuracy. A parsimonious, well-calibrated logistic regression model performed comparably to more complex methods and is a reasonable candidate for community-based identification of current burden, not for forecasting risk. Prospective external validation and age-specific thresholds are required before clinical implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于洪都拉斯五省85个社区1838名12至49岁居民的横断面调查数据，评估仅用低成本人口学与生活方式信息能否识别同时存在多种胃肠道症状负担的社区居民，并比较逻辑回归与六种机器学习分类器的表现。结果显示，约四成半参与者症状负担升高；加入既往消化道诊断后模型判别力提升且校准良好，但复杂模型并未优于逻辑回归，在既往诊断分层内判别力明显下降。作者据此认为，简约且校准良好的逻辑回归可作为识别当前症状负担的社区筛查候选工具，而非用于预测未来风险，临床使用前仍需前瞻性外部验证和年龄特异阈值。

papers.title: Generative AI in Higher Education Instructional Design: A Systematic Review of AI Roles, Educator Competences, and Professional Development Approaches
papers.authors: Natalia D. Spyropoulou, Achilles D. Kameas
papers.abstract: Higher education (HE) educators have rapidly adopted generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) for instructional design (ID), yet evidence on this educator-facing use remains scattered. This PRISMA-guided qualitative systematic review synthesises 78 studies (2022–2026) to examine how AI-supported ID activity is distributed across ADDIE phases, functional AI roles, and practitioner versus pre-service contexts; the competences and human-oversight practices it requires of educators; and the professional development (PD) approaches documented for building them. Documented activity concentrates in the Design phase (95% of studies), while Implementation and Evaluation remain largely unexamined. Most studies (76%) apply no named competence framework; seven competence clusters emerge, with ethical awareness and bias detection recurrent yet weakly operationalised, suggesting a possible perceptual rather than declarative deficit. Human oversight is an explicit commitment in 58% of studies but examined empirically in only 21 (27%); the review consolidates five core oversight mechanisms plus two emerging ones, for which quantified evidence remains sparse and uneven. The corpus identifies six PD approach families, with embedded ethics checkpoints and performance-based assessment as the best-supported design features. The synthesis grounds an account of AI-supported ID in which the educator’s design expertise, not the technology’s generative fluency, remains the organising centre.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以PRISMA流程系统梳理了78项研究，考察生成式人工智能在高等教育教学设计中的使用分布、对教育者能力的要求及相应专业发展路径。结果显示，相关活动高度集中于设计阶段，实施与评价阶段几乎未被探讨；多数研究未采用具名能力框架，伦理意识与偏见识别虽被反复提及却缺乏可操作化，人类监督多为原则性承诺而少有实证检验。综述据此归纳了监督机制与专业发展路径类型，并强调教育者的设计专业能力而非技术的生成流畅度仍是核心。

papers.title: Which Blood Pressure Measures Correlate with Nocturia Severity in Adolescents?
papers.authors: Tasmia Promi, Gulzhan Tologonova, Thomas F. Monaghan, Meseret Tena, Sarita Dhuper, Monique Hanono, Jeffrey P. Weiss, Louis F. Salciccioli, Jason Lazar
papers.abstract: Nocturia, defined as waking to void during sleep hours, is common in adolescents, causing sleep disruption and daytime fatigue. While numerous studies have found nocturia associated with systolic blood pressure (BP) hypertension in adults, diastolic (D) BP has greater relative importance in youth. Little is known about the hemodynamic profile of the hypertension–nocturia link in adolescents. Accordingly, we evaluated relationships between nocturia severity and brachial artery systolic and DBPs in each arm, as well as central aortic pressures using applanation tonometry. We studied 100 adolescents, 10–18 years, from pediatric clinics. Nocturnal urinary indices were obtained from voiding diaries. Results: In total, 45% reported nocturia. Nocturia severity was correlated with left and right arm brachial SBP, higher of two arms, and central SBP (r = 0.27, p = 0.007). Brachial SBP was also correlated with nocturnal urine volume (NUV) (r = 0.31, p = 0.001) and production rate (NUP) (r = 0.32, p = 0.001). DBP showed no significant correlations. After adjusting for BMI and sex, brachial SBP remained independently associated with nocturia severity. The median first uninterrupted sleep period was 171 min (25–75%ile; 94, 300). In adolescents, SBP is associated with nocturia severity, NUV, and NUP. Nocturia typically occurs during the first half of nighttime, suggesting an impact on deep sleep.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察青少年夜尿严重程度与血压指标之间的关系，对象为儿科门诊青少年，通过动态血压测量和排尿日记收集数据。结果显示，夜尿严重程度与双臂及中心动脉收缩压相关，收缩压也与夜间尿量和尿生成率相关，而舒张压未见显著关联；调整体重指数和性别后，收缩压仍与夜尿严重程度独立相关。夜尿多发生在夜间前半段，提示可能影响深睡眠。相关不等于因果，结论受横断面设计限制。

papers.title: Six-Minute Walk Performance, BMI and Estimated Cardiorespiratory Fitness Among Primary-School Boys: A Large-Scale Regional Study in Southern Italy
papers.authors: Domenico Monacis, Matteo Bibba, Dario Colella
papers.abstract: Background: This study examined whether measured walking performance, body mass index (BMI) and estimated cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) differ across the six provinces of Apulia (southern Italy), and whether physical fitness components and psychological variables (perceived self-efficacy [PSE] and enjoyment) are associated with these outcomes in primary-school boys. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 2700 boys. BMI, Standing Long Jump (SLJ), 4 × 10 m Shuttle Run (4 × 10 m SR), 6-Minute Walk Test and questionnaire data were collected, and VO2max was estimated with the Jalili equation, which combines 6-min walk distance (6MWD) and BMI and was developed in older boys without validation in children aged 8–10 years. Measured 6MWD was analyzed as the primary outcome and estimated VO2max as a complementary outcome, using linear models. Results: Measured 6MWD, SLJ, 4 × 10 m SR did not differ across provinces (all p > 0.50). Province was not associated with 6MWD (p = 0.331), which was positively associated with SLJ and inversely associated with 4 × 10 m SR (both p < 0.001). Estimated VO2max differed across provinces (p < 0.001), but this difference disappeared after accounting for BMI (p = 0.340) and was almost entirely attributable to the BMI term of the estimation equation. No clear independent association emerged for PSE and enjoyment (p = 0.119; p = 0.281). Conclusions: Provincial differences in equation-derived VO2max were almost entirely attributable to differences in BMI, entered through the estimation equation, and should not be interpreted as differences in aerobic capacity. Because the equation was developed in older boys and has not been validated in children aged 8–10 years, these values are indirect, group-level estimates rather than measurements of CRF.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于意大利南部普利亚大区小学男童的大规模横断面数据，考察六分钟步行距离、BMI 与估算心肺适能是否在不同省份间存在差异，以及体能表现和心理变量与这些结果的关系。结果显示，实测六分钟步行距离、立定跳远和折返跑在不同省份间没有差异，步行距离与立定跳远正相关、与折返跑负相关；由方程估算的 VO2max 虽在省份间呈现差异，但该差异在纳入 BMI 后消失，几乎完全来自估算公式中的 BMI 项，因此不应解读为有氧能力差异。作者同时指出，所用方程源自年龄较大的男童且未在 8–10 岁儿童中验证，估算值只是间接的群体层面估计而非实测心肺适能；感知自我效能与享受感也未显示清晰的独立关联。

papers.title: Temporal Dynamics of Moral Semantic Processing in Chinese: An ERP Study of Word Categorization
papers.authors: 辛增友, Xihang Wu, Fucai Liu, Xueyun Wang
papers.abstract: Morality serves as a universal code of behavior and a foundation for social value systems. To investigate the cognitive architecture of moral information processing, the present study adopted event-related potentials (ERPs). We used Chinese moral words as stimuli to characterize the temporal neural dynamics of moral processing. Fifty-four participants completed a one-way repeated-measures lexical categorization task with four conditions (moral, immoral, neutral, and pseudowords), including response mapping as a between-subjects factor. Behavioral responses and electroencephalography (EEG) activity were recorded simultaneously. Behavioral analyses yielded robust response latency disparities: participants categorized moral words most rapidly, followed by neutral words and immoral words; pseudowords elicited the slowest responses. ERP analyses revealed graded neural signatures across stimulus categories. During the P2 window (150–250 ms), immoral words elicited the largest amplitudes. At the N3 component (250–350 ms), real words showed attenuated negativity compared with pseudowords, and moral words also differed from neutral words, suggesting that N3 reflects lexical-semantic categorization with additional moral-relevance effects. At the LPP (400–800 ms), immoral words evoked the largest responses, significantly larger than those for neutral and pseudowords, whereas the moral–immoral contrast was not significant. Collectively, these results are consistent with an affective-moral salience account: moral words show a behavioral recognition advantage, and immoral words elicit heightened early and late neurocognitive sensitivity. The findings highlight the utility of ERP analysis for mapping moral semantic processing within the logographic Chinese writing system, and may inform future cross-cultural neurocognitive research and semantic decoding in brain–computer interface paradigms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以中文道德词为材料，用事件相关电位（ERP）考察道德语义加工的时间进程，54名参与者完成词汇分类任务，同时记录行为反应与脑电活动。行为结果显示道德词分类最快，中性词和 immoral 词次之，假词最慢；ERP上，不道德词在P2和LPP窗口诱发更大波幅，N3则反映词汇语义分类并受道德相关性影响。作者据此提出情感—道德凸显解释，认为道德词具有行为识别优势，而不道德词引发更强的早期和晚期神经敏感，并提示该范式可用于跨文化神经认知研究及脑机接口中的语义解码。

papers.title: EEG Emotion Recognition Based on Azimuthal Equidistant Projection and a Multiscale Residual Temporal Network
papers.authors: Xiaoqin Lian, Ran Liang, Chao Gao, Peiyi Wang, Wenyang Guan
papers.abstract: Background: In most existing EEG-based emotion recognition studies, the spatial configuration of electroencephalography (EEG) electrodes is not adequately preserved, and conventional single-scale convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have limited ability to capture both local and global spatial patterns. To address these limitations, an EEG emotion recognition framework integrating azimuthal equidistant projection (AEP) with a multiscale residual temporal network (MRTNet) is proposed. Methods: Differential entropy (DE) features are first extracted, and the three-dimensional electrode coordinates are projected onto a two-dimensional plane to construct AEP-based DE (AEP-DE) feature maps that preserve the spatial topology of the electrode layout. MRTNet then combines multiscale depthwise separable convolutions with a long short-term memory (LSTM) network to extract spatial features at multiple receptive-field scales and model temporal dependencies across EEG segments. Results: Experimental results show that MRTNet achieves average accuracies of 95.1% for four-class classification on the Database for Emotion Analysis using Physiological Signals (DEAP) and 93.1% for three-class classification on the SJTU Emotion EEG Dataset (SEED). Conclusions: Grad-CAM visualizations further indicate that the model responses are concentrated in spatially localized frontal and temporal regions, providing qualitative support for the spatial interpretability of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电情绪识别中电极空间构型保留不足、单尺度卷积难以兼顾局部与全局空间模式的问题，提出将方位等距投影与多尺度残差时序网络相结合的识别框架。作者先提取微分熵特征，把三维电极坐标投影到二维平面以构建保留电极布局空间拓扑的特征图，再由网络结合多尺度深度可分离卷积与长短期记忆网络提取多尺度空间特征并建模时序依赖。在DEAP和SEED数据集上的实验显示，该框架在四分类与三分类任务中取得较高平均准确率；Grad-CAM可视化表明模型响应集中于额区与颞区的局部空间范围，为方法的空间可解释性提供了定性支持。

papers.title: Associations Between Individual Differences in Cognitive Control Capacity and Multitasking Performance
papers.authors: Xiubo Song, Yuting Zhang, Haiyan Liu, Yuntao Gao, Yangyang Shen, Kaiwen Sun, Tingwei Feng, Mingxuan Zou, Weishan Fan, Lingwei Zeng, Hui Wang, Xiuchao Wang
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cognitive control capacity (CCC) describes the maximum volume of information an individual can reliably process per unit time, a key cognitive factor of multitasking performance. While sustained high-load multitasking is known to induce cumulative cognitive impairment, it remains untested whether CCC is associated with vulnerability to this decline across subjective, behavioral, and neural levels. This study systematically characterized how individual differences in CCC relate to multitasking processing ability and examined whether a higher CCC is associated with smaller cognitive fatigue during extended operations. Methods: CCC was assessed in 313 college students via the adaptive MFTA_A paradigm. Participants scoring in the upper and lower 27% of the CCC distribution formed the high-CCC group (n = 42, 3.65 ± 0.33 bps) and the low-CCC group (n = 41, 2.04 ± 0.28 bps). All participants completed a 1 h multitasking information-processing test comprising tracking, instrument monitoring, and listening subtasks. Alertness was measured with the Psychomotor Vigilance Task before and after the test, subjective workload was rated across four Visual Analogue Scale dimensions, and continuous task-state EEG was recorded to analyze spectral power and microstate dynamics. Results: Relative to low-CCC participants, the high-CCC group showed smaller post-test alertness declines, consistently higher multitasking scores across all blocks, and sustained higher theta/alpha ratios and parietal beta power throughout the task. High-CCC participants also exhibited descriptively stronger activation of microstate C and a late rebound pattern in microstate D transitions, while the low-CCC group showed early stabilization of D-state dynamics without compensatory adjustment. Subjective workload ratings rose equivalently across time in both groups, with no significant between-group differences. Conclusions: CCC is strongly associated with multitasking efficiency. Higher CCC is associated with larger information-processing capacity and better sustained performance during high-load work. This association may be supported by more efficient neural resource allocation and more robust cognitive control network engagement, with exploratory evidence of adaptive brain network reorganization under fatigue. CCC is associated with both immediate multitasking performance and alertness maintenance capacity during prolonged operations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察认知控制容量（CCC）的个体差异与多任务加工表现及长时间作业中警觉度维持之间的关系，以大学生为对象，按CCC高低分组完成一小时多任务信息处理测试，并结合警觉度任务、主观负荷评定和任务态脑电进行分析。结果显示，高CCC组在多任务成绩上持续更高，测试后警觉度下降更小，任务全程保持较高的theta/alpha比值与顶区beta功率；两组主观负荷随时间上升的幅度相当，组间无显著差异。作者据此认为，CCC与多任务效率和持续作业中的警觉度维持相关，这种关联可能由更有效的神经资源分配和更稳健的认知控制网络参与所支持，脑电微状态结果仅为探索性证据。

papers.title: Magnesium Intake, Sociodemographic Determinants, and Memory Performance in Older Adults: A Sex-Stratified Analysis in NHANES 2011–2014
papers.authors: Huma Shahzad, Mohammed Shawkat Razzaque, Juan Carlos López-Alvarenga
papers.abstract: Background: Magnesium intake (MgI) has been associated with cognitive health in older adults, but the influence of sex, socioeconomic factors, and overall dietary intake remains unclear. Methods: We analyzed adults aged ≥ 60 years from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2011–2014. Of 3079 participants eligible before missing data exclusions, 2397 (1153 men and 1244 women) then had complete information for the final structural equation model (SEM). Total magnesium intake included dietary and supplemental sources assessed using two 24-h dietary recalls. Memory performance was derived using principal-component factor analysis of CERAD word-recall and animal-fluency assessments. Survey-weighted, sex-specific SEMs evaluated associations among magnesium intake, memory performance, age, education, household income, and total energy intake. Results: Participants had a mean age of 70 ± 6.8 years, 52% were female, and mean BMI was 29 ± 6.4 kg/m2. Without energy adjustment, total magnesium intake showed a positive but nonsignificant association with memory in men (β = 0.043, p = 0.387) and women (β = 0.080, p = 0.105). After energy adjustment, the associations were attenuated in men (β = 0.030, p = 0.486) and women (β = 0.040, p = 0.532). Energy intake was strongly associated with magnesium intake but not with memory. Education was positively associated with memory, whereas age was negatively associated in both sexes. Conclusion: Total magnesium intake was not independently associated with memory performance after accounting for energy intake and sociodemographic factors. Education and age remained the most consistent predictors of memory. These findings highlight the importance of considering overall dietary intake when examining nutrient–cognition relationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于NHANES 2011–2014数据，考察老年人镁摄入量与记忆表现的关系，并按性别分别构建结构方程模型，纳入年龄、教育、家庭收入和总能量摄入等因素。结果显示，无论男女，总镁摄入与记忆表现的关联均不显著，调整能量摄入后进一步减弱；能量摄入与镁摄入相关，但与记忆无关。教育和年龄则是两性记忆表现最一致的预测因素。作者据此提示，在考察营养素与认知关系时需考虑整体膳食摄入，镁摄入对老年人记忆并无独立关联。

papers.title: From Human Empathy to AI-Generated Empathic Performance: Conceptual Boundaries and Ethical Risks for Human-Centered AI
papers.authors: Rabia Zamur Tuncer, Şafak Tanır Levendeli
papers.abstract: The increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into everyday communication has complicated the conceptual boundaries of empathy by enabling systems to generate responses that appear emotionally attentive, supportive, and context-sensitive. Through a concept-centered theoretical synthesis of scholarship on human empathy, artificial empathy, human–AI interaction, and AI ethics, this article distinguishes three analytically distinct phenomena: human empathy, AI-generated empathic performance, and perceived AI empathy. In the present framework, human empathy is organized around four dimensions—cognitive understanding, affective responsiveness, self–other differentiation, and communicative expression—which are used as analytical reference points for comparing the observable capacities and conceptual limits of AI-generated empathic performance. The analysis argues that AI systems can approximate communicative features associated with empathy through emotional and contextual inference, affect-sensitive expression, adaptive response generation, and conversational continuity, but such performance should not be treated as equivalent to the relational and experiential dimensions of human empathy. Perceived AI empathy is shaped by source attribution, interactional context, and user interpretation. The resulting ethical implications concern attributional and relational risks, vulnerability, data and fairness, transparency, accountability, and governance. Operationally, the framework supports separate evaluation of system performance and perceived empathy, disclosure of AI status and inferential limits, communication of uncertainty in emotion inference, calibration of anthropomorphic and relational cues, and pathways to human support in emotionally sensitive or high-stakes contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一项以概念辨析为中心的理论综合，梳理人类共情、人工共情与人机交互及AI伦理研究，区分人类共情、AI生成的共情表现与用户感知到的AI共情三种现象。作者以认知理解、情感回应、自我—他人区分和沟通表达四个维度为参照，指出AI可通过情绪与情境推断、情感敏感表达和对话连续性近似共情的沟通特征，但不应等同于人类共情的关系与体验层面；感知到的AI共情则受来源归因、互动情境和用户解读影响。文章据此讨论归因与关系、脆弱性、数据与公平、透明与问责等伦理风险，并主张分别评估系统表现与用户感知、披露AI身份与推断局限、说明情绪推断的不确定性，并在高情感风险情境中保留通向人类支持的路径。

papers.title: Does the rural digital economy enhance green total factor productivity of agriculture? An empirical approach using double machine learning
papers.authors: HUANG Mingyi, Mengshuai Zhu, Jijie Yu, Chen Shen, Dongyan Jin, WU Jianzhai
papers.abstract: Introduction In the context of the green transformation of agriculture, the digital economy offers a novel pathway to mitigate environmental externalities and operational inefficiencies. Recognizing that agricultural digitalisation relies heavily on the spillover of macro-level digital resources, this study constructs a multidimensional rural digital economy (RDE) framework. Methods Employing a double machine learning (DML) model on a panel dataset of 30 Chinese provinces from 2011 to 2022, we empirically investigate the impact of the RDE on agricultural green total factor productivity (GTFP). Results We find that: (1) The RDE exerts a positive effect on GTFP. Dimensional analysis strictly confirms that digital industry development and industrial digital transformation have positive linkages with this productivity growth, whereas basic infrastructure alone is insufficient. (2) Mechanism analyses demonstrate that the RDE empowers green agriculture by optimizing inter-sectoral factor allocation and significantly reducing agricultural polluting energy intensity; however, the mediating role of government digital policy attention is not statistically established. (3) To accurately capture asymmetric effects, group-based heterogeneity tests reveal that the empowerment effect of the RDE is significantly stronger in provinces with larger cultivated scales. Discussion These findings indicate that the RDE currently empowers green agriculture primarily through structural factor reallocation and precision energy management rather than immediate technological leaps. To overcome hardware-software structural lags and mitigate scale disadvantages faced by smallholders, policymakers should pivot toward enhancing farmers’ digital literacy, expanding shared digital socialized services, and implementing market-based environmental governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察农村数字经济能否提升农业绿色全要素生产率，基于中国省级面板数据构建多维农村数字经济框架，并采用双重机器学习模型进行实证估计。结果显示，农村数字经济总体对农业绿色全要素生产率具有正向作用，其中数字产业发展和产业数字化转型与生产率增长呈正向关联，而仅靠基础设施并不充分；机制上，农村数字经济主要通过优化跨部门要素配置和降低农业污染能源强度发挥作用，政府数字政策关注的中介作用未获统计支持。异质性分析还表明，这一赋能效应在耕地规模较大的省份更强。作者据此认为，当前农村数字经济更多依靠要素再配置和精准能源管理而非直接技术跃升来推动农业绿色转型，并提示需关注小农户的规模劣势与软硬件结构滞后。

papers.title: Assessing threats to freshwater ecosystems: implications for water security management in Spain
papers.authors: Ariadna Gabarda-Mallorquí, Àlex Gou-Villalobos, Ramón J. Batalla, Concha Durán, Celso García, Andreu Rico, Sergi Sabater
papers.abstract: Human threats to freshwater ecosystems overall compromise water security, and identifying these threats is essential to set up the required strategies in managing water resources. The article focuses on Spain as the region of study since this country maintains a long-lasting conflict between the use of water resources and the impacts on freshwater ecosystems. Spain has a double-sided water reality, both in spatial (dry Mediterranean versus humid Atlantic ecoregions) and in temporal terms (interannual climate variability). Up to 30 threats for freshwater ecosystems have been identified and prioritized after a deliberative process composed by three main methodological stages aimed at (I) documenting, (II) screening, and (III) assessing based on academics and water managers perspectives. Climate and land use change are the highest-ranked threats, while pollution is ranked lower. Overall, quantity issues lead to concern among both the experts and Júcar River Basin managers, whereas quality-centred threats displayed discrepancies between the two perspectives. These observed discrepancies between academic and managerial priorities underscore the challenges of operationalizing Integrated Water Resources Management (IWRM), highlighting the need for enhanced knowledge co-creation in water governance. Thus, this twofold assessment, as a co-creation and prioritization exercise, establishes a new knowledge co-creation approach and represents a potential framework in designing strategies for assuring freshwater ecosystem preservation as a foundation for water security.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以西班牙为案例，针对淡水资源利用与生态系统保护之间的长期矛盾，通过由文献梳理、筛选和评估三个环节组成的审议流程，结合学者与水资源管理者的视角识别并排序了淡水生态系统面临的威胁。结果显示，气候变化和土地利用变化被列为最高等级威胁，污染排名相对靠后；水量问题受到专家和管理者共同关注，而水质类威胁在两类视角间存在分歧。作者指出，学术优先事项与管理优先事项之间的差异反映了综合水资源管理落地实施的困难，并强调在水治理中加强知识共创的必要性，认为这种双重评估可作为保护淡水生态系统的策略设计框架。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) anxiety and nurses’ turnover intention during healthcare digital transformation: the mediating role of occupational fatigue
papers.authors: Lidan Zhu, Feng Zang, Guangxu Mao, Xiang Li, Xiaofang Shen
papers.abstract: Background The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into healthcare is associated with new psychological challenges. However, the extent of its impact on nursing workforce stability is unclear. Aim To explore the relationship between AI anxiety and turnover intention of clinical nurses, and the mediating effect of occupational fatigue and the moderating effect of emotional intelligence (EI). Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted from March to June 2026 among 404 clinical nurses from four hospitals in Jiangsu Province, China. Data were collected using the AI Anxiety Scale (AIAS), Health Workers’ Occupational Fatigue Scale (HWOFS), Turnover Intention Scale (TIS) and Wong and Law Emotional Intelligence Scale (WLEIS). Mediation was tested using structural equation modelling with bootstrap resampling, while moderation was tested using moderated regression analysis. Results Differences in baseline turnover intentions across age, department, and professional title level were statistically significant (all p < 0.001). Path analysis showed that AI anxiety was positively associated with occupational fatigue (β = 0.611, p < 0.001) and turnover intention (β = 0.530, p < 0.001). Occupational fatigue partially mediated the association between AI anxiety and turnover intention (indirect effect = 0.299, 95% CI: 0.129, 0.379). EI had a significant negative main effect on occupational fatigue (b = −0.257, p < 0.001), but it did not significantly moderate the association between AI anxiety and occupational fatigue. Conclusion AI anxiety is significantly correlated with the turnover intention of clinical nurses, and occupational fatigue may represent a potential pathway linking AI anxiety and turnover intention. Although EI is associated with lower levels of occupational fatigue, it fails to cushion the impact of AI anxiety, a specific stressor. Hospital administrators should focus on targeted AI literacy improvement plans and specific fatigue relief strategies to retain clinical nursing staff.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注医疗数字化转型中临床护士的AI焦虑与离职意向之间的关系，并考察职业疲劳的中介作用和情绪智力的调节作用，采用横断面问卷调查和结构方程模型进行分析。结果显示，AI焦虑与职业疲劳和离职意向均呈正相关，职业疲劳部分中介了AI焦虑与离职意向之间的关联，即AI焦虑可能通过加重职业疲劳进而增强离职意向。情绪智力与职业疲劳呈负相关，但并未显著调节AI焦虑与职业疲劳的关系，说明其难以缓冲这一特定压力源的影响。作者据此建议医院管理者通过针对性的AI素养培训和疲劳缓解措施来稳定护理队伍，但相关结论基于横断面关联，尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: Restorative streetscapes in high-density urban tourism: environmental archetypes, visual attention, and psychophysiological responses
papers.authors: Xinliang Wang, Yafei Zhao, Xiang Xu, Xiaoju Li, Jingyuan Cheng
papers.abstract: In high-density tourist districts, visitors are continuously exposed to the visual environments of surrounding streets, forecourts, and small public spaces before reaching an attraction, and these transitional spaces may influence short-term restorative states. Existing research has typically examined urban-scale streetscape characteristics and human responses under experimental conditions separately, with limited provision of a reproducible procedure for selecting experimental stimuli from large environmental samples. Taking the high-density urban core around Hong Kong’s Victoria Harbour as a case study, this study identified 66 tourism-related sites and acquired four fixed-direction streetscape images for each site, yielding 264 images in total. A 66 × 11 objective environmental matrix was constructed from five GIS-based environmental indicators and six streetscape-image proxy indicators. Principal component analysis (PCA) summarized the dominant environmental gradients, and k = 6 K-means was retained as a pragmatic six-group sampling solution aligned with the pre-specified six-scene experimental capacity rather than as a uniquely optimal or stable urban typology. Forty-six of 48 registered adults contributed 108 focal-scene exposures. After BH-FDR correction, significant differences among the six scenes were observed in perceived restorativeness, the proportion of fixations on natural areas of interest (AOIs), gaze entropy, changes in EEG alpha-minus-theta, mean EDA skin conductance level (SCL), and HRV RMSSD, whereas sustained-attention accuracy showed no significant scene effect. Oil Street Art Space exhibited the highest perceived restorativeness (5.69/7), the highest proportion of fixations on natural AOIs (51.4%), and the largest increases in EEG (+2.68) and HRV RMSSD (+11.37 ms), while Western Market showed the lowest restorativeness (4.17/7), the lowest natural-AOI fixation share (31.2%), and the smallest EEG increase (+1.93). Sensitivity analyses showed no evidence of scene-by-order interaction for perceived restorativeness, natural-AOI fixation, gaze entropy, or SART accuracy, but EEG, EDA, and HRV were more order-sensitive; the principal subjective, attentional, EEG, and HRV contrasts remained evident when analysis was restricted to each participant’s earliest focal-scene exposure. These findings therefore support scene-configuration contrasts under short-term static visual exposure. Building on the environmental structure of the 66 sites and the multimodal responses to the six experimental scenes, the study further proposes an archetype-calibrated framework for mapping restorative potential in high-density tourist streetscapes, providing a spatial basis for identifying restorative opportunity nodes and priority intervention areas.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注高密度旅游街区中过渡性街景的短期恢复潜力，以香港维多利亚港周边66个旅游相关地点为对象，从每个地点采集固定方向街景图像，结合GIS指标与图像代理指标构建环境矩阵，并通过聚类筛选出六类场景开展实验。46名参与者完成108次焦点场景观看，结果显示六类场景在感知恢复性、自然区域注视比例、注视熵、脑电alpha-minus-theta变化、皮肤电导水平和心率变异性RMSSD上存在显著差异，而持续注意准确率未见显著场景效应；其中油街艺术空间恢复性评分与自然注视比例最高，西港城最低。作者据此提出面向高密度旅游街景的恢复潜力映射框架，用于识别恢复机会节点与优先干预区域，但结论限于短期静态视觉暴露条件。

papers.title: Bridging joint degeneration and systemic skeletal fragility: knee osteoarthritis as an independent risk factor for osteoporosis
papers.authors: Weizheng Sun, Jianrong Ma, Juqin He, Yanxin Liu, Wei Zhang, Liang Zhang
papers.abstract: Background Whether localized joint failure in knee osteoarthritis (KOA) interacts with systemic pathways, including psychological distress and neuro-endocrine stress response, to precipitate systemic bone fragility remains an unresolved question. Capitalizing on the large-scale prospective design of the UK Biobank and translational clinical biomarker profiling, this investigation aims to clarify this association and delineate the long-term risk profile linking joint failure to systemic skeletal degradation. Methods This prospective analysis tracked 406,810 participants who were free of metabolic bone disease or confounding joint pathologies at baseline. Participants were stratified by ICD-10 defined KOA status, with incident OP serving as the primary longitudinal endpoint over a median 10-year follow-up. Survival profiles were contrasted via log-rank tests, and multivariable Cox proportional hazards formulations were constructed to yield rigorously adjusted hazard ratios (HR) controlling for socioeconomic deprivation, lifestyle habits, multi-systemic comorbidities, and history of malignancies. To validate these epidemiological findings in human biology, circulating bone resorption biomarkers (β-CTX and TRACP-5b) were further evaluated in an independent clinical validation cohort of 35 KOA patients and 30 matched controls. Results Long-term follow-up unveiled a clear divergence in bone health trajectories, with the KOA cohort experiencing a significantly elevated cumulative OP incidence of 5.2 vs. 3.9% in the unexposed reference group (log-rank p < 0.001). Fully adjusted multivariable modeling confirmed KOA as a robust, standalone predictor of systemic skeletal deterioration, conferring a 22% independent risk premium (HR = 1.22, 95% CI: 1.16–1.29). While vulnerability was compounded by current smoking, physical inactivity, high Townsend deprivation, and cardiometabolic clusters, enhanced physical and structural reserves (greater grip strength and higher BMI) exerted pronounced protective effects. In parallel, clinical serum profiling validated an upregulation of bone resorption activity in KOA patients, evidenced by elevated circulating levels of β-CTX and TRACP-5b compared with non-OA controls. Conclusion These findings provide prospective population-level evidence and biochemical validation that knee osteoarthritis is independently associated with an increased risk of osteoporosis. While pain-related physical unloading, low-grade systemic inflammation, and hypothesized neuro-endocrine pathways may underlie this systemic vulnerability, our results highlight the clinical need for comprehensive musculoskeletal monitoring and proactive bone health management in patients with knee osteoarthritis.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于英国生物银行的大规模前瞻性队列，并结合独立临床队列的血清标志物检测，考察膝骨关节炎是否独立关联系统性骨质疏松风险。随访发现，膝骨关节炎组的累积骨质疏松发病率高于对照组，多变量调整后其仍为独立预测因素，风险约高出两成；吸烟、缺乏运动、社会经济剥夺和心血管代谢共病会加重这一风险，而握力和体重指数较高则表现出保护作用。临床血清检测也显示膝骨关节炎患者骨吸收标志物水平升高，为上述关联提供了生化佐证。作者据此提示，膝骨关节炎患者需要更全面的骨骼健康监测，但相关机制仍属推测。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence literacy and innovative behavior among clinical nurses: the roles of AI self-efficacy and organizational innovation climate
papers.authors: Jiahang Li, Xianyong Liu, Yang Cao, Caiyan Tang, Jianwei Zhou
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate the current status and related factors of innovative behavior among clinical nurses in tertiary hospitals and explore the relationships and pathways among artificial intelligence literacy, AI self-efficacy, organizational innovation climate, and nurse innovative behavior, for providing a basis for targeted nursing management strategies. Methods This cross-sectional study was conducted on 850 nurses from six tertiary medical institutions using a stratified survey approach in Yueyang city, Hunan province, from June to July 2026, in the General Information Questionnaire, Artificial Intelligence Literacy Scale, Artificial Intelligence Self-Efficacy Scale, Organizational Innovation Climate Scale, and Nurse Innovative Behavior Scale were used. AMOS 24.0 was used to conduct confirmatory factor analysis to assess the model fit of the scales. SPSS 26.0 was used for descriptive statistics, univariate analysis, Pearson correlation analysis, and multiple linear regression. PROCESS macro version 4.2 Models 4 and 14 tested mediation and moderated mediation effects. Results A total of 850 valid questionnaires were obtained, with a valid questionnaire rate of 95.3%. The mean nurse innovative behavior score was 37.93±6.50. The measurement model for the four scales showed good fit, and the scales demonstrated good convergent validity and some evidence of discriminant validity. Artificial intelligence literacy, artificial intelligence self-efficacy, organizational innovation climate, and innovative behavior showed positive associations with one another (r = 0.609–0.797, P < 0.01). Educational level, professional title, participation in research or innovation activities, artificial intelligence literacy, artificial intelligence self-efficacy, and organizational innovation climate were factors associated with nurse innovative behavior and explained 60.9% of the total variance. Artificial intelligence self-efficacy partially mediated the relationship between artificial intelligence literacy and nurse innovative behavior. The indirect effect was 0.322, with a 95% CI of 0.243–0.403, accounting for 52.90% of the total effect. Organizational innovation climate moderated the relationship between artificial intelligence self-efficacy and nurse innovative behavior (b = 0.051, P < 0.01). The index of moderated mediation was 0.041, with a 95% CI of 0.009–0.078. Conclusion AI literacy was closely related to nurse innovative behavior, with AI self-efficacy as a partial mediator and organizational innovation climate as a moderator. Nursing management may focus on AI competencies, application confidence, and organizational support.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察临床护士的人工智能素养与创新行为之间的关系，并检验AI自我效能的中介作用和组织创新氛围的调节作用。研究采用横断面设计，对三级医院护士进行问卷调查，通过相关分析、回归及中介和调节中介模型检验变量间路径。结果显示，AI素养、AI自我效能、组织创新氛围与护士创新行为两两正相关；AI自我效能部分中介了AI素养与创新行为的关系，组织创新氛围则调节了AI自我效能与创新行为之间的关联。作者据此提示，护理管理可关注AI能力培养、应用信心和组织支持，但横断面设计使相关路径不宜作因果解读。

papers.title: Managing generative-AI health information resilience: human resource capabilities and multilevel public health governance
papers.authors: Abdelrehim Awad, M. A. El-Naggar, Dina Helmy Al Nashily, Hiyam Abdulrahim, Rohit 1982- Bansal, Adel Ghonim
papers.abstract: The use of Conversational Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is growing as a way to interact with health information, especially for the public. This theory-based conceptual synthesis suggests a multilevel governance approach to reducing the likelihood for generated information to become unsafe action – GenAI health information resilience (GenAI-HIR). Its contribution is immediately usable and practical — deploying organizations and public-health actors and public-health actors can use the consequence-based control tiers, actor-specific safeguards, and domain-level audit anchors, and the proposed competency configuration still needs to be validated and is a research agenda for the future. Five conceptually distinct functions at the individual and workforce levels describe at which point protection may contribute to the decision pathway, but are not necessarily assumed to be empirically separable: recognize, interrogate, verify, contextualize, and escalate. Organizational capacity is limited to controls particular to created health information such as authorized sources, attainable human routing, incident monitoring and corrective action. Platform and regulatory conditions are constraints, safety, access, calibrated trust, and equity, outcomes. The framework was created using an expert guided purposive synthesis of the 62 sources that were retained, not a systematic review process. It distinguishes between an explanatory risk model and a normative control architecture and categorizes outputs with respect to type of output, severity, urgency, reversibility, context dependence, mitigation feasibility, and remaining risk. Falsification criteria are now included in six propositions. The candidate self-report indicators are kept as material for the cognitive interviewing only and must be correlated with behavioral vignettes before use for psychometric purposes. GenAI-HIR is therefore not a validated scale, certification standard or replacement for accessible professional care; it is a model for competency that can be falsified in future research and a governance structure that can be audited for current implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性概念综合，提出用多层次治理框架降低生成式AI健康信息被误用为不安全行为的可能，即“GenAI健康信息韧性”。作者通过专家引导的目的性文献综合（非系统综述）构建框架，在个体与劳动力层面区分识别、追问、核实、情境化和升级五类功能，并将组织控制、平台与监管条件作为约束与结果。文章强调该能力配置尚待验证，候选自评指标仅用于认知访谈，须与行为情境题相关后才能作心理测量使用；该框架不是已验证量表、认证标准或专业照护替代品。

papers.title: Associations of BCW-informed early rehabilitation nursing with patient compliance and related outcomes in non-dialysis chronic kidney disease patients
papers.authors: Yingxing Zhou, Xiaodong Cao, Xiaomin Xu, Linjie Xu, Xiao Li, Qin Xu
papers.abstract: Objective To examine the association between a BCW-informed intensive nursing support package and patient compliance and related outcomes in non-dialysis patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD). Methods This retrospective, non-randomized observational study analyzed the clinical and nursing records of 57 non-dialysis CKD patients admitted to our hospital from June 2022 to June 2023. All patients met the predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. Patients were retrospectively classified according to the nursing intervention documented in their clinical records: 27 patients who received routine nursing were included in the control group, and 30 patients who received a BCW-informed intensive nursing support package were included in the observation group. Outcomes included nutrition-related indicators [albumin (ALB), prealbumin (PA), transferrin (TF), and body mass index (BMI)], renal function-related indicators [blood urea nitrogen (BUN), serum creatinine (Scr), and cystatin C (CysC)], self-reported dietary adherence assessed using an adapted Renal Adherence Behavior Questionnaire (RABQ), quality of life, and reported nursing satisfaction. Results Before the intervention, there were no significant differences between the two groups in nutrition-related indicators, renal function-related indicators, RABQ scores, or quality of life (all p > 0.05). After the intervention, the observation group showed significantly higher ALB, PA, and BMI levels than the control group ( p < 0.05), whereas the between-group difference in TF was not statistically significant ( p = 0.169). For renal function-related indicators, BUN was significantly higher and CysC was significantly lower in the observation group than in the control group ( p < 0.05), whereas Scr was numerically higher but the between-group difference did not reach statistical significance ( p = 0.054), indicating inconsistent changes among renal function-related markers. After the intervention, the observation group also had higher adapted RABQ scores, indicating higher self-reported dietary adherence on this instrument, and higher quality-of-life scores than the control group ( p < 0.05).
