The reported nursing satisfaction rate was 77.78% in the control group and 100.00% in the observation group. Conclusion In this retrospective, non-randomized study, the BCW-informed intensive nursing support package was associated with more favorable nutrition-related indicators, higher self-reported dietary adherence scores on the adapted RABQ, better quality-of-life scores, and higher reported nursing satisfaction. Renal function-related indicators were inconsistent, and because the observation group received greater nursing contact, the specific effect of BCW/COM-B cannot be distinguished from nonspecific attention or intervention-dose effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于行为改变轮（BCW）框架，考察强化护理支持方案与非透析慢性肾脏病患者的依从性及相关结局之间的关联。作者采用回顾性、非随机观察设计，比较接受常规护理与接受BCW强化护理支持的患者记录，发现强化护理组在营养相关指标、自报饮食依从性评分、生活质量评分及护理满意度上表现更好，但肾功能相关指标变化不一致。由于观察组接受的护理接触更多，作者指出无法将BCW/COM-B的特异性作用与非特异性关注或干预剂量效应区分开，相关结论需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Risk prediction models for fear of cancer recurrence in patients with cancer: a systematic review
papers.authors: Yifan Zhang, Dongmei Wu, Wendan Xiao, 罗懋, Lingyan Zhou, Yuanyuan Fan, Baolian Xu, Yanjun Li, Lihong Zhao
papers.abstract: Background The apprehension of cancer recurrence among cancer survivors strongly influences their quality of life. Predictive models can enable the timely recognition of this concern and the implementation of interventions. In recent years, a multitude of models have been constructed to predict the likelihood of disease recurrence in cancer patients. Nevertheless, the methodological strictness and clinical applicability of these models necessitate further elucidation. Objectives Systematic assessment of the existing predictive models for fear of cancer recurrence. Methods FOUR databases, including PubMed, the Cochrane Library, Embase, and Web of Science, were systematically searched to identify relevant studies published from the inception of the databases to December 31, 2025. Data extraction was independently performed by two reviewers on the basis of the critical evaluation and data extraction checklist of the systematic review predictive model study. The quality of the included models was assessed using the predictive model bias risk assessment tool. Results A total of 1,137 articles were retrieved, from which 15 models across 9 studies were ultimately selected for inclusion. Logistic Regression and machine learning were the most frequently employed methods for model development. The AUC values of the developed models ranged from 0.66 to 0.9786, whereas those reported in validation studies ranged from 0.83 to 0.949. None of the models underwent external validation. All risk prediction models exhibited high bias, primarily because of inappropriate data sources and methodological shortcomings. Social support, age, and education level were identified as common predictive factors. Conclusions Current predictive models for the risk of cancer recurrence exhibit good discriminative power. However, most of the included studies are single-center retrospective studies with small sample sizes and lack external validation; these studies exhibit significant methodological limitations that restrict their clinical applicability. Future researchers are encouraged to develop predictive models in accordance with the PROBAST guidelines, enhance methodological rigor, and conduct both internal and external validation. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/recorddashboard , identifier CRD420261288735.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统评估了癌症患者癌症复发恐惧风险预测模型的构建质量与临床适用性，检索多个数据库后纳入9项研究中的15个模型。模型多采用逻辑回归与机器学习方法，报告区分度较好，但所有模型均未进行外部验证，且普遍存在高偏倚风险，主要源于数据来源不当和方法学缺陷。社会支持、年龄和教育水平是较常见的预测因子。作者据此指出，现有研究多为单中心回顾性设计、样本量小，方法学局限制约了临床适用性，建议未来按PROBAST指南开发模型并开展内外部验证。

papers.title: When college students perceive GAI feedback as credible: the role of perceived GAI feedback credibility in promoting deep learning through cognitive engagement
papers.authors: Wen Guo, Xiaojian Ren
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has rapidly developed in higher education and has raised new questions from an educational psychology perspective. Why does GAI feedback promote meaningful learning for some college students but fail to produce similar learning benefits for others? To answer this question, this study develops a theoretical framework based on Information Processing Theory, Elaboration Likelihood Model, and Constructivist Learning Theory. This study examines how perceived GAI feedback credibility influences college students’ deep learning and explores the mediating role of cognitive engagement in this relationship. This study adopts a stratified simple sampling method and collects questionnaire data from 506 undergraduate students and uses structural equation modeling (SEM) to examine the proposed model. The results show that perceived GAI feedback credibility has positive relationships with both cognitive engagement and deep learning. In addition, cognitive engagement plays a significant mediating role between perceived GAI feedback credibility and deep learning, suggesting that credible GAI feedback may support deep learning by encouraging college students to engage in cognitive processing and reflective thinking. This study extends research on learning psychology in GAI-supported learning environments by explaining how college students evaluate and process GAI feedback. The findings indicate that the influence of GAI feedback on learning does not simply result from the technology itself. Instead, college students’ judgments of feedback credibility and their following cognitive engagement play important roles in shaping deep learning processes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注为何生成式人工智能反馈对部分大学生能促进深度学习、对另一些却收效有限，基于信息加工理论、精细加工可能性模型与建构主义学习理论构建框架，以问卷方式调查本科生并用结构方程模型检验。结果显示，感知到的GAI反馈可信度与认知投入、深度学习均呈正相关，认知投入在其中起显著中介作用，即可信的反馈可能通过促使学生进行认知加工和反思性思考来支持深度学习。作者据此指出，GAI反馈对学习的作用并非单纯来自技术本身，学生对反馈可信度的判断及其后续认知投入共同塑造了深度学习过程。

papers.title: Clinical characteristics, semiology, and comorbidity patterns in non-epileptic seizures (NES): a retrospective comparative study
papers.authors: Paola Caruso, Magda Quagliotto, Yvonne Radin, Stefania Pavan, Paolo Manganotti, Alberto Benussi
papers.abstract: Objectives Non-epileptic seizures (NES) are paroxysmal events resembling epileptic seizures but not explained by ictal activity. Differential diagnosis may be challenging, particularly because NES and epilepsy can coexist. We aimed to characterize the demographic, clinical, semiological, psychiatric, and instrumental profile of patients with NES, compare patients with NES only with patients with NES epilepsy-only, and assess the robustness of the main associations through sensitivity analyses. Methods We conducted a retrospective observational comparative study using a clinical database from our Neurology Unit (2022–2025) including 38 patients with NES and 23 patients with epilepsy without NES. A total of 18 NES patients had comorbid epilepsy; therefore, the primary comparison included mutually exclusive groups: NES-only ( n = 20) and epilepsy-only ( n = 23). All NES patients were retained for descriptive analyses. Between-group comparisons used exact or non-parametric tests with Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate (BH-FDR) correction. Sensitivity analyses restricted NES-only patients to those with database-recorded video-EEG confirmation and used Firth penalized logistic regression adjusted for age and sex. Results Among 38 patients with NES, 94.7% had documented psychological/psychiatric comorbidity, mainly anxiety (50.0%) and depression (28.9%). Positive motor phenomena were documented in 73.7%, neurological examination inconsistency/incongruity in 85.7% of evaluable patients, and video-EEG confirmation in 73.7%. Psychological/psychiatric comorbidity was significantly more frequent in NES-only than epilepsy-only patients (90.0% vs. 13.0%; exact OR 50.40, 95% CI 7.29–670.28; BH-FDR p < 0.001), as was anxiety (45.0% vs. 4.3%; BH-FDR p = 0.014). Broad seizure-semiology domains were not significantly different after multiplicity correction. Among imaged patients, abnormal MRI findings were more frequent in epilepsy-only patients (12/18 vs. 0/10; BH-FDR p = 0.006), although MRI ascertainment differed between groups. The psychiatric-comorbidity association persisted in sensitivity analyses. Conclusion NES showed substantial clinical heterogeneity and frequently coexisted with epilepsy. Psychological/psychiatric comorbidity was markedly more frequent in NES-only than epilepsy-only patients and remained robust in sensitivity analyses, although differential ascertainment limits interpretation. Broad seizure manifestations alone did not distinguish the groups after multiplicity correction. Instrumental findings should be considered descriptive rather than NES biomarkers. These findings support explicit stratification for comorbid epilepsy and standardized prospective assessment of psychiatric and semiological features.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于神经内科临床数据库的回顾性比较设计，考察非癫痫性发作（NES）患者的人口学、临床、发作症状学及精神共病特征，并比较单纯NES患者与单纯癫痫患者。结果显示，NES患者中心理或精神共病极为常见，且单纯NES组的心理精神共病和焦虑比例显著高于单纯癫痫组，这一关联在敏感性分析中保持稳健；校正多重比较后，两组在宽泛的发作症状学领域未见显著差异，影像学异常在癫痫组更常见但受检查方式差异限制。作者指出NES临床异质性明显、常与癫痫共存，症状表现本身不足以区分两组，相关器械发现应视为描述性而非生物标志物，并强调需按是否合并癫痫分层及开展标准化的前瞻性精神与症状学评估。

papers.title: AI literacy is directly associated with positive attitudes and indirectly associated with negative attitudes through AI anxiety: a cross-sectional study of preservice teachers
papers.authors: İsmail Satmaz, Mehmet Adıyaman
papers.abstract: Introduction Positive and negative attitudes toward artificial intelligence (AI) may have partly distinct psychological correlates. This cross-sectional study examined whether AI anxiety statistically accounted for associations between AI literacy and positive and negative attitudes toward AI among preservice teachers. Methods Participants were 335 preservice teachers enrolled in a faculty of education in Türkiye. Data were collected using the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Scale, Artificial Intelligence Anxiety Scale, Artificial Intelligence Attitude Scale, and a personal information form. Two indirect-effect models were estimated using PROCESS Model 4 with 5,000 bootstrap resamples, controlling for prior AI training. Results AI literacy was negatively associated with AI anxiety and positively associated with positive attitudes toward AI. AI anxiety was positively associated with negative attitudes but was not significantly associated with positive attitudes. The indirect association through AI anxiety was significant for negative attitudes but not for positive attitudes, and a direct bootstrap contrast confirmed that the two indirect effects differed significantly (B = −0.118, 95% CI [−0.201, −0.039]). Prior AI training was not significantly associated with either attitude dimension. A sensitivity analysis excluding the three reverse-worded AI literacy items reproduced this pattern. Discussion The findings indicate that positive and negative attitudes toward AI may have partly distinct psychological correlates: AI literacy is directly related to positive evaluations, whereas its association with negative evaluations is statistically linked to AI anxiety. Because the data are cross-sectional, the indirect effects should not be interpreted as evidence of causal mediation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以土耳其335名职前教师为对象，采用横断面设计和间接效应模型，考察AI素养是否通过AI焦虑与对AI的正负态度相关联。结果显示，AI素养与AI焦虑负相关、与积极态度正相关；AI焦虑与消极态度正相关，但与积极态度无显著关联。经由AI焦虑的间接关联仅对消极态度显著，且与积极态度对应的间接效应存在显著差异；此前的AI培训与两种态度均无显著关联。作者据此指出，正负态度的心理关联可能部分不同，但横断面数据不足以支持因果中介解释。

papers.title: Within-person reciprocal processes between AI feedback literacy and agentic engagement: a three-wave random-intercept cross-lagged panel study
papers.authors: Shuai Xu
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) feedback has become a pervasive feature of university learning, yet whether students’ capacity to engage productively with such feedback co-develops with their broader learner agency remains poorly understood. Drawing on student feedback literacy theory, self-determination theory as a supplementary motivational lens, and the mutualism principle, this study tested whether AI feedback literacy and agentic engagement reciprocally predict each other over time at the within-person level and exploratorily examined whether they share a stable trait-level association. A three-wave panel study of 480 Chinese undergraduates ( N = 399 with complete data across all waves), with measurements at six-week intervals across one semester, was analyzed using a random-intercept cross-lagged panel model (RI-CLPM). At the between-person level, students who scored systematically higher in AI feedback literacy across the semester also scored systematically higher in agentic engagement, with a moderate and statistically significant trait-level correlation between the two random intercepts ( r = 0.315, p < 0.001), supporting Hypothesis 1. At the within-person level, both cross-lagged pathways were positive and significant: deviations in AI feedback literacy predicted later deviations in agentic engagement ( β = 0.222, p < 0.001), and the reverse pathway was likewise significant ( β = 0.263, p < 0.001). A Wald test indicated that the two reciprocal pathways did not differ significantly in magnitude (Δ B = 0.002, p = 0.972), consistent with a symmetric mutualism. A model comparison confirmed that the RI-CLPM provided substantially better fit than a traditional cross-lagged panel model, with the RI-CLPM revealing substantially larger within-person reciprocal effects once stable trait-level covariation was properly isolated. The findings extend the mutualism principle from a coupling of person-internal constructs to a coupling between a person-internal competency and a person-environment behavioral interface. They also raise the possibility, in a Confucian Heritage Culture context where agentic engagement has historically been culturally muted, that AI feedback may offer a less culturally-loaded venue in which students can exercise agency. The study repositions AI feedback literacy from a static skill into a dynamic developmental resource that is constituted, in part, by the very engagement it enables.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大学生的AI反馈素养与能动性投入是否在个体内部随时间相互预测，并探索二者是否存在稳定的特质层面关联。作者对480名中国本科生进行了一个学期三次、间隔六周的追踪，采用随机截距交叉滞后面板模型分析。结果发现，在个体间层面，AI反馈素养较高者其能动性投入也较高，二者存在中等程度的稳定关联；在个体内部层面，AI反馈素养的偏离正向预测后续能动性投入的偏离，反向路径同样显著，且两条路径强度无显著差异，符合对称互惠模式。模型比较显示，在分离出稳定特质协变后，该模型揭示的个体内互惠效应明显大于传统交叉滞后模型。作者据此将AI反馈素养视为动态发展资源，并提示在儒家文化背景中AI反馈可能为学生提供较少文化负担的施展能动性的场域。

papers.title: Molecularly guided pharmacotherapy for obesity: emerging targets, clinical efficacy, and personalized therapeutic approaches
papers.authors: Jianchao Mao, Rong Hu
papers.abstract: Obesity is a complex, chronic disease whose aetiology is complex and highly variable, and is linked to a network of neural, endocrine, adipose, genetic, epigenetic and metabolic pathways. This molecular complexity also drives significant differences in the clinical course of disease, drug sensitivity and weight regain, thus making standardized treatment, which is largely based on BMI and clinical empiricism, challenging. This narrative review explores the molecular mechanisms involved in obesity and the potential to apply the knowledge of molecular mechanisms to develop more personalized treatment strategies using advances in pharmacology. It focuses on hypothalamic appetite-satiety pathways, gut–brain hormonal communication, inflammation and metabolic dysfunction in adipose tissue, and known and novel drug targets. The review focuses on the evidence available on GLP-1 receptor agonism, GIP–GLP-1 co-agonism, multi-agonism with glucagon, signaling of amylin, melanocortin pathways, and novel central and peripheral targets. Studies have shown that some dual- and triple-receptor drugs are more effective at causing weight loss, and practitioners should consider tolerability, sustainability, cardiometabolic effects, and response when choosing drugs or drug combinations for patients. Inter-individual variability may be further explained by genetic, epigenetic, metabolic, and tissue-specific factors, which may help identify mechanisms of resistance. In conclusion, Inter-individual variability may be attributed to genetic, epigenetic, metabolic, and tissue-specific factors, and most suggested molecular or biomarker predictors have not yet proven sufficiently valid or useful for routine drug selection. Receptor-targeted drugs, including GLP-1 receptor agonists and GIP–GLP-1 co-agonists, are currently clinically actionable for patients with common obesity and available to specific patients with obesity, genotype-directed molecular therapeutic drugs are clinically actionable only for selected genetically defined types of obesity. However, the use of pharmacogenomic, biomarker, and multi-omics methods to guide the choice of anti-obesity drugs are still in their early stages of clinical investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕肥胖的分子机制与个体差异，梳理了将分子知识用于个体化药物治疗的潜力，涉及下丘脑食欲—饱食通路、肠—脑激素通讯、脂肪组织炎症与代谢功能障碍，以及已知和新型药物靶点。文章指出，部分双受体和三受体药物减重效果更强，但选药时需权衡耐受性、可持续性、心血管代谢效应与个体反应；遗传、表观遗传、代谢及组织特异性因素可能解释个体间差异和耐药机制。总体而言，GLP-1受体激动剂和GIP–GLP-1共激动剂等受体靶向药物对常见肥胖已具临床可操作性，基因导向的分子治疗仅适用于特定遗传定义类型的肥胖，而药物基因组学、生物标志物和多组学指导选药仍处于早期临床研究阶段，多数预测指标尚未被证明足够有效。

papers.title: Overcoming subject variability in P300 decoding based on quantification by deep learning
papers.authors: Maohua Liu, Fred R. Beyette
papers.abstract: Binary P300 decoding is a cornerstone of P300-based brain-computer interfaces, enabling applications such as assistive communication, neurorehabilitation, and cognitive monitoring. However, substantial subject variability in EEG patterns poses a major challenge to the development of generalized P300 decoders. To address this problem, this study proposes SQ_EMoE, a subject-variability-aware enhanced Mixture-of-Experts framework that uses the confidence produced by a deep subject-identification network as a practical proxy for trial-level subject distinctiveness. High-confidence trials are routed to subject-specific experts, whereas uncertain trials are redirected to a pooled general expert, allowing the framework to dynamically balance subject-specific specialization and cross-subject generalization. Latent subject representations are further visualized to qualitatively examine subject separability and its relationship with routing behavior. Experiments on eight random subjects from each of two public P300 datasets yielded mean ROC–AUC values of approximately 0.86 on BNCI Horizon 2020 and 0.89 on P300-LINI, outperforming pooled EEGNet and architecture-matched pooled P300MCNN baselines. Ablation experiments further demonstrated the contribution of confidence-controlled fallback to the general expert. To evaluate scalability, the framework was additionally tested on all 22 subjects of P300-LINI. With the original subject-identification network, SQ_EMoE achieved a mean ROC–AUC of 0.8518; after strengthening the subject representation and identification network, performance increased to 0.8760, exceeding the pooled P300MCNN baseline (0.8482) and slightly surpassing the oracle routing or within-subject decoding (0.8744). Leave-one-subject-out experiments further showed that the under-realized SQ_EMoE conservatively redirects most completely unseen-subject trials to the general expert when reliable subject-specific routing is unavailable. These results demonstrate that effective modeling of subject variability, together with adaptive integration of shared and subject-specific representations, provides a promising alternative to conventional one-size-fits-all EEG decoding.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对P300脑机接口中脑电模式存在显著个体差异、难以构建通用解码器的问题，提出一种感知个体差异的增强型专家混合框架SQ_EMoE，以深度个体识别网络输出的置信度作为试次级个体区分度的代理指标，将高置信度试次路由至个体专属专家、不确定试次交由共享通用专家处理。在两个公开P300数据集各随机选取八名被试的实验显示，该框架的平均ROC–AUC分别约为0.86和0.89，优于池化的EEGNet与P300MCNN基线；消融实验表明置信度控制的回退机制对性能有贡献。在P300-LINI全部22名被试上的扩展测试中，强化个体表征与识别网络后平均ROC–AUC提升至0.8760，略高于被试内解码的0.8744；留一被试实验则显示，在缺乏可靠个体路由时框架会保守地将多数完全未见被试的试次转交通用专家。作者据此认为，对个体差异的有效建模与共享、个体表征的自适应整合，为替代传统一刀切式脑电解码提供了可行思路。

papers.title: Striatal and orbitofrontal grey matter volumes are associated with cognitive event related potentials during associative learning task performance in male and female children and adolescents
papers.authors: Kymbat Kassen, Rassul Shakhzadayev, Manzura  Zholdassova, Oxana Kabenova, Altyngul Kamzanova, Gaukhar Datkhabayeva, D. Abdilmanov, Jane B. Allendorfer, James Eliassen, Mikhail Ye. Melnikov, Almira Kustubayeva
papers.abstract: Introduction The individual differences in gray matter volumes and event-related potentials may underlie variability in associative learning. However, little is known about the sex differences in these structure–function relationships across development. Methods The current study investigates associations between local gray matter volumes and brain responses during associative learning task in children and adolescents aged 7–21 years. We hypothesized that gray matter volumes of the basal ganglia and prefrontal cortex would be associated with event-related potentials indices of associative learning, in a sex-dependent manner. Final analysis included 138 participants (68 females, 70 males). Participants completed an associative learning task with concurrent EEG event-related potentials recording. Gray matter volumes were analyzed within 5 a priori regions of interest, predominantly located in the basal ganglia vicinity and prefrontal cortex. Results In females, anterior N400 latency to Early-stage stimulus onsets was positively associated with gray matter volume in the left putamen/lentiform nucleus and to Late-stage stimulus onsets with gray matter volume in the subgenual anterior cingulate. Anterior P300 amplitude to Late-stage feedback presentation was positively associated with gray matter volume in the right nucleus accumbens/putamen and the right medial orbitofrontal cortex. Correlations involving the subgenual anterior cingulate and medial orbitofrontal cortex were significantly stronger in the female group relative to the male group. In males, anterior P300 amplitude to Early-stage feedback presentation was associated with gray matter volume in a left hippocampus/amygdala cluster, yet not significantly differently from females. In exploratory analysis, after accounting for total brain volumes, age was positively associated with the volumes of striatal and orbitofrontal regions in both sexes, with largely overlapping patterns. Discussion Therefore, findings support structure–function relationships linking gray matter volumes of striatum and orbitofrontal cortex to brain activity during reinforcement learning performance. Given that associative learning is an instance of reinforcement learning, its underlying neural processes are influenced by the structural development of striatal and orbitofrontal regions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察儿童青少年在联想学习任务中局部灰质体积与事件相关电位（ERP）指标之间的结构—功能关联，并检验这种关联是否存在性别差异。参与者完成联想学习任务并同步记录脑电，灰质体积在基底节附近和前额叶的预设感兴趣区内分析。结果显示，女性左侧壳核/豆状核及膝下前扣带灰质体积与早期刺激诱发的前部N400潜伏期相关，右侧伏隔核/壳核和右侧内侧眶额皮质体积与晚期反馈诱发的前部P300波幅相关，且膝下前扣带和内侧眶额皮质的相关在女性中显著强于男性；男性早期反馈诱发的前部P300波幅与左侧海马/杏仁核簇体积相关，但与女性差异不显著。作者据此认为，纹状体和眶额皮质的结构发育与强化学习过程中的神经活动存在联系，相关结论属关联性发现。

papers.title: CEP-MI: a novel cue-execution dual-stage motor imagery paradigm with PGCANet decoding architecture
papers.authors: Jianxiu Li, Pengda Yu, Huiyu Qiao, Zhiqiang Zheng, Changming Wang, Zhi Weng, Caili Gong
papers.abstract: Background Motor imagery-based brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) holds great potential in neurorehabilitation and motor assistance. Data quality and motor intention decoding effectiveness are closely associated with participants’ engagement. However, previous MI tasks ignored active engagement regulation, and neural mechanisms underlying the transition from motor imagery to execution remain unclear, with limited relevant research. Conventional separate-trial designs cannot capture continuous brain dynamics from imagery to execution and cannot objectively evaluate subject engagement, which hinders mechanism exploration and stable decoding. Methods To address these paradigm-related limitations, a novel cue-execution MI paradigm (CEP-MI) with countdown anchors was designed to quantify engagement. Motor execution sessions were added post-imagery to reveal neural differences during the transition and identify movement-related brain activities. Meanwhile, to boost MI-EEG decoding performance, a collaborative decoding architecture (PGCANet) integrating prior guidance and channel awareness was proposed, with dual branches and consistency constraint loss for decision fusion. Results CEP-MI effectively quantifies participant engagement, and PGCANet achieves superior decoding performance compared to traditional algorithms and advanced models, with the optimal average accuracy reaching 85.77% in binary classification and 82.47% in quadruple classification. Conclusion Targeting the above-mentioned research gaps, the CEP-MI paradigm provides valuable insights into the imagery-execution transition mechanism. PGCANet enhances MI decoding accuracy via multi-branch collaboration, laying a foundation for MI-BCI’s clinical application in neurorehabilitation. Significance This study introduces a novel paradigm and collaborative architecture that significantly advance MI-BCI decoding accuracy and engagement quantification, and helps to promote its clinical application in neurorehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统运动想象任务忽视参与者主动投入调节、且难以捕捉从想象到执行连续脑动态的问题，设计了带倒计时锚点的提示-执行双阶段运动想象范式（CEP-MI），并配套提出融合先验引导与通道感知的协同解码架构PGCANet。该范式在想象阶段后加入实际执行环节，用于量化参与者的投入程度并考察想象向执行过渡时的神经差异；PGCANet则通过双分支与一致性约束损失进行决策融合。结果显示，CEP-MI能够有效量化参与者的投入水平，PGCANet在二分类和四分类任务中的解码表现优于传统算法与先进模型。作者据此认为，该范式为理解想象-执行过渡机制提供了线索，而协同架构提升了运动想象解码精度，为脑机接口在神经康复中的临床应用打下基础。

papers.title: Intranasal CBT101 demonstrates favorable safety and neurophysiological evidence of central activity in healthy male volunteers
papers.authors: Henri Benech, Lila Krebs-Drouot, Geoffrey Viardot, Valérie Bertaina‐Anglade, Clara Lhotellier, Victoria Flament, Camille Roucairol, Aloïse Mabondzo, Jean‐Louis Pinquier, Thomas Joudinaud
papers.abstract: Objectives CBT101 is a creatine prodrug under development for disorders driven by impaired neuronal energy homeostasis, with initial development focused on creatine transporter deficiency and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. This first-in-human study aimed to assess the safety and tolerability of single and repeated ascending intranasal doses of CBT101 in healthy male volunteers and explored neurophysiological evidence of central pharmacodynamic activity using quantitative EEG (qEEG) and event-related potentials (ERPs). Methods This was a randomized, double-blind, single-center, placebo-controlled phase 1 trial including single ascending dose (SAD) and multiple ascending dose (MAD) parts. Forty-eight healthy male volunteers were randomized 3:1 to CBT101 or placebo. CBT101 was administered intranasally at 4.2, 8.4, or 12.6 mg in the SAD part and at 4.2, 8.4, or 12.6 mg/day for 14 days in the MAD part. The primary objective was safety and tolerability. Secondary analyses assessed quantitative EEG (qEEG) and event-related potentials (ERPs) as pharmacodynamic evaluations. Results No serious or severe treatment-emergent adverse events occurred, no dose-limiting toxicity was observed, and no clinically relevant safety findings were reported. As expected, plasma CBT101 concentrations were below the limit of quantification in all analyzed samples. qEEG analyses identified an acute post-dose increase in relative beta activity after single dosing. After repeated dosing, the qEEG profile evolved toward a more sustained pattern characterized by beta-1 modulation and early gamma-band changes. ERP/P300 analyses showed a transient decrease in P300 latency, with no statistically significant change in P300 amplitude. Conclusion Intranasal CBT101 was safe and well tolerated across the evaluated SAD and MAD dose ranges in healthy male volunteers. Convergent qEEG and ERP findings provided early neurophysiological evidence of central pharmacodynamic engagement. These findings support continued clinical development of CBT101 for disorders associated with impaired neuronal energy homeostasis. Clinical trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov , identifier: NCT07050316.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的首次人体试验，在健康男性志愿者中评估肌酸前药 CBT101 经鼻给药的安全性与中枢药效学证据，采用单次和多次递增剂量设计，并以定量脑电图和事件相关电位作为次要药效学指标。结果显示，未出现严重或重度治疗中出现的不良事件，也无剂量限制性毒性或临床相关安全性问题；单次给药后相对 beta 活动出现急性升高，重复给药后脑电模式转向更持续的 beta-1 调制和早期 gamma 波段变化，P300 潜伏期短暂缩短而波幅无显著变化。作者据此认为 CBT101 在所测剂量范围内安全且耐受良好，脑电与诱发电位的趋同结果提供了中枢药效学参与的早期神经生理学证据，支持其继续临床开发。

papers.title: Medical AI: are Osler's principles lost in translation?
papers.authors: Michel Goldman, Elie Cogan, Serge Goldman
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is poised to transform clinical practice, but its adoption coincides with a longstanding decline in bedside medicine. Herein, we argue that reintroducing Oslerian principles into medical training may be essential to ensure that technological progress does not come at the expense of the physician-patient relationship. Throughout, we use the term AI to refer to tools built on algorithms, from risk calculators and predictive models to large language models, that produce predictions, classifications or recommendations. These tools have no agency of their own: they operate only on the data supplied to them, and their implementation depends on how clinicians and institutions design and deploy them.William Osler never saw an algorithm. He died in 1919, a century before "artificial intelligence" entered the clinical vocabulary. And yet no figure in the history of medicine is better equipped to tell us what we are about to lose 1 . Osler's central achievement was a discipline of the mind: the conviction that the practice of medicine must rest on direct observation of the patient and on the relationship between patient and physician. We argue that this discipline is now under direct threat, and that AI tools, as currently deployed, tend to hasten its erosion rather than reverse it -unless we act deliberately to stop it. In fact, the physician-patient relationship has already been reshaped by decades of patient access to medical information through the internet and social media. This shift has been amplified by the development of health-related AI tools, which increase patients' knowledge but also expose them to misinformation and misinterpretation. Nowadays, patients often arrive at the clinical encounter having already formed their own interpretations about their disease, which directly impacts the dialogue with the physician from the very first minutes of the encounter -a dynamic Osler never had to confront. Oslerian principles must therefore be adapted to this new reality, in which both physician and patient increasingly approach the clinical encounter already shaped by algorithms.Clarifying what AI can do -and will not do in the foreseeable future AI tools can go extraordinarily far in the medical process -synthesizing literature at a scale no human can match, flagging patterns in imaging and pathology that trained eyes miss, drafting notes, triaging risk, generating differential diagnoses, and suggesting therapeutic options in seconds. None of this is in serious dispute anymore, and clinicians who dismiss it outright are being unrealistic.On the other hand, it is illusory to imagine that AI will, in the foreseeable future, replace clinical observation and the personal relationship between doctor and patient. This needs to be said plainly, not hedged. Diagnosis by patternmatching on data is not the same as sitting at the bedside of anxious patients, watching how they behave, picking up on what they leave unsaid, and actually building the trust that makes adherence possible. Whatever level of performance AI models will achieve in the future, they will remain trained on the past, and no model can substitute for what happens, uniquely, in the present, between two people.There is also a more technical reason why bedside medicine remains indispensable: AI can only reason about the reality that has been captured and digitized. An algorithm implicitly assumes that what is absent from the record does not exist. Because important information reaches the record only if a physician observes it, an algorithm working from an incomplete record can return a seemingly precise but inaccurate output, creating an illusion of certainty. Oslerian observation is therefore not a nostalgic complement to AI but a technical prerequisite for its validity: no AI tool can compensate for a hurried or incomplete examination. Far from making clinical skills obsolete, AI demands sharper skills in listening, observation and physical examination.Losing the lessons learned at the bedside is not a hypothetical risk, nor is it a new one. For decades, medical departments have been organized around organ systems and specialized technologies. This process of specialization and subspecialization -a transformation that long predates the current wave of AI adoption -has produced remarkable diagnostic and therapeutic advances, but it has also fragmented the physician's view of the patient as a whole and made a holistic approach harder to sustain. Another powerful driver of this change has been the growth of administrative and documentation burden: in ambulatory practice, a time-and-motion study found that physicians spend nearly two hours on electronic health records and desk work for every hour of direct clinical face time with patients 2 , and administrative burden has been associated with lower intrinsic motivation among physicians and poorer patient-reported experience of care 3 .Consistent with this, studies among internal medicine trainees have documented a clear decline in direct time with patients for well over a decade 4 , and the trend is still underway today in several disciplines. For example, in hematologic malignancies, where AI-based tools are being rapidly adopted to guide diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment decisions 5 , physicians increasingly spend more time in offices in front of computer screens -reviewing algorithmic outputs, multiomic profiles, and risk calculators -often making therapeutic decisions before they examine the patient, so that the consultation risks becoming a confirmation of a decision already made elsewhere, rather than the encounter from which the decision should emerge. Deployed carelessly, AI tools are likely to deepen this pattern rather than correct it. Many current incentives push in that direction: institutions will reward the efficiency of deciding early, physicians will gravitate toward the workflow that is faster and less cognitively taxing, and the tools themselves are easiest to deploy on data that are already structured and available before the visit. Left to market and workflow pressures alone, AI is unlikely to restore the clinical encounter and may further hollow it out. This is the central danger. However, AI can also work in the opposite direction. In a recent randomized trial, ambient AI scribes, which transcribe the consultation and draft the clinical note, were associated with reduced physician burnout, and doctors reported that the technology allowed them to engage better with their patients 6 . Such tools can return the physician's attention from the screen to the patientprovided that the time they free is deliberately protected for the clinical encounter.This is precisely why Osler's teaching should not be treated as an outdated precept, but as the specific countermeasure this moment requires. We argue that it should be urgently reintroduced as a structural component of clinical education, integrated into, not appended to, the technical curriculum. Three Oslerian principles should anchor that effort: "Listen to the patient; he is telling you the diagnosis." What the physician personally learns at the patient's bedside should always come first -a principle physicians in subspecialty training are especially at risk of losing, as AI output can easily become the main input they consult before reaching a conclusion. AI output should inform that conclusion but not replace it."Medicine is learned by the bedside and not in the classroom." Osler's most consequential reform was moving medical education out of the lecture hall and to the patient's side. A century later, the direction of travel has reversed: trainees now often learn to interpret data before they learn to examine a patient. That sequence needs to be corrected, with protected, unhurried bedside time built into training and explicitly shielded from the pressure to consult the algorithm first. "Imperturbability." In his famous 1889 address, Aequanimitas 7 , Osler used this word to describe the calm and steady judgment a physician needs when facing suffering, urgency and clinical uncertainty. Applied to the output of AI, the same discipline must hold: neither adopting it blindly, a failure known as automation bias 8 , nor dismissing it out of hand, but checking it as rigorously as any other clinical evidence, including against what the physician has personally observed.These principles cannot be reintroduced as a simple return to an earlier era; they must be adapted to a clinical environment now shaped not only by AI but also by electronic health records, an ever-expanding volume of diagnostic data, and patients arriving informed -and sometimes misinformed. The task for training programs is not to teach learners to resist these developments but to integrate them without displacing direct observation and reasoning. Concretely, this could include bedside practice that requires trainees to form their own clinical impression before consulting AI output, case studies comparing bedside findings with AI-generated information, exercises showing how omissions in the history or examination alter an algorithm's output, and communication exercises on discussing AI- derived information with patients. These skills should be embedded into formal assessment and not treated as incidental.Discussions on "AI and the future of medicine" too often lead to wishful thinking that is very unlikely to be implemented. Instead, they should lead to concrete proposals, such as treating the clinical encounter as a parameter to be measured in academic medical centers. Time at the bedside is a necessary but insufficient indicator, since more time does not automatically translate into better care. We therefore propose mixed metrics combining the time physicians actually spend with patients, the diagnostic accuracy of the physician working with AI compared with either alone, and patients' perceptions of empathy and trust assessed with validated instruments such as the Consultation and Relational Empathy (CARE) measure 9 .William Osler would have welcomed the advent of AI in medicine, but he would have insisted that every AI tool be held to a single non-negotiable question: does it bring the physician closer to the patient, or does it interpose itself between them? On present evidence, in disciplines already reorganized around screens and algorithms, many AI deployments are failing that test 10 . The remedy is not to slow the technology down. It is to speed up, urgently, the reintroduction of Osler's principles into the training of every physician who will use it.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇观点性论文，讨论AI进入临床实践之际，医学教育中 bedside 观察与医患关系传统（作者称为奥斯勒原则）可能被进一步削弱的问题。作者指出，AI工具本身没有能动性，只能基于已数字化的记录进行推理，记录中缺失的信息会被算法默认为不存在，因此床旁观察反而是AI输出可靠性的技术前提；同时，当前机构激励和工作流压力可能使医生更早依赖算法结论，而非纠正这一趋势。文章据此主张将奥斯勒原则结构化地重新纳入临床培训，并提出以床旁时间、人机协同诊断准确性和患者对共情的感知等混合指标来评估临床接触，但相关判断主要基于论证与既有研究引述，而非作者开展的新实证研究。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence use patterns, attitudes, and psychological distress among medical students: a cross-sectional survey
papers.authors: Mesut Sarı, Yasemin İmrek, Ali Evren Tufan
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are widely used by medical students, but associations of general use frequency and AI-related attitudes with psychological distress remain unclear. Methods All 1,275 active students at one Turkish medical faculty were invited to an anonymous online survey conducted from 1 April to 1 May 2026; 249 of 251 respondents consented. Measures included general AI use, an investigator-translated 13-item Artificial Intelligence Attitude Scale (ATAI), and the validated Turkish Depression Anxiety Stress Scales-21. A general-distress composite was the primary outcome, and hierarchical regression used HC3 robust standard errors. Results AI use was reported by 95.6% of participants, and 50.2% reported daily use. Mean doubled DASS-21 total was 56.97 (SD 31.55). The ATAI three-factor model showed mixed fit (CFI = .898, TLI = .872, RMSEA = .107, SRMR = .070). AI-frequency categories did not improve the adjusted model at the block level (change in R -squared = .016, p = .111; robust global p = .088). Adding exploratory ATAI factors increased R-squared by.052 ( p = .002; robust global p = .009); Benefit was inversely, and Risk and Use positively, associated with distress. Subscale sensitivity analyses preserved coefficient directions, but only the inverse Benefit-Anxiety association survived correction across 15 additional focal tests ( q = .032). Conclusion AI use was nearly universal and served both educational and personal/non-educational purposes, but this sample did not provide stable evidence of an overall association between general use frequency and distress. ATAI associations are exploratory and may reflect measurement or common-method processes. Longitudinal multicenter studies should use formally adapted measures and objective indicators of AI engagement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查了土耳其一所医学院学生的人工智能使用频率、对AI的态度与心理困扰之间的关系，采用匿名在线问卷调查，并以分层回归分析关联。结果显示，AI使用在该样本中几乎普及，但调整后的模型未提供一般使用频率与心理困扰存在稳定关联的证据；探索性分析中，对AI收益的态度与困扰呈负相关，而对风险和使用本身的态度呈正相关，不过这些关联多为探索性，仅收益与焦虑的负向关联在多重校正后仍保留。作者据此提示相关态度关联可能受测量方式或共同方法偏差影响，结论需通过纵向多中心研究并使用正式适配的量表加以验证。

papers.title: Case Report: From concept to care and knowledge translation: developing a community-oriented family health center in a resource-limited post-conflict setting in Sri Lanka
papers.authors: Antony Sheron Vethanayagam, Kumaran Subaschandren, Kaarunnya Parthipan, Sakana Kannathasan, Saman Pathirana
papers.abstract: Primary Health Care (PHC) oriented systems in resource-limited, post-conflict settings face compounded challenges arising from population ageing, rising non-communicable diseases, workforce constraints, and weakened community trust. In Sri Lanka's Northern Province, decades of conflict followed by economic instability and the COVID-19 pandemic further exposed limitations of fragmented, facility-centered Primary Care. This paper presents a concept-driven community case study describing the progressive development of a community-oriented Family Health Center (FHC) in Northern Sri Lanka, tracing its evolution from a small FHC to a nationally recognized and internationally connected Primary Care, education and research hub. The model integrates Family Medicine, Community-Oriented Primary Care (COPC) and Participatory Action Research (PAR) within a single operational framework. Family Medicine provides the clinical and ethical foundation, COPC introduces defined population responsibility with embedded Patient and Public Involvement and Engagement (PPIE) and Community Engagement and Involvement (CEI), while PAR functions as a system-learning engine enabling continuous adaptation and co-creation of knowledge. Locally recruited Community Health Workers (CHWs) operate these principles by linking households, services and research. The FHC delivers comprehensive Primary Care services and supports multilevel education, continuous professional development and capacity building, while functioning as a platform for global collaboration, including a 10,000-participant community cohort supported through digital health systems and international partnerships such as the NIHR DIGIPATHS program. This experience demonstrates how locally grounded PHC-oriented system components can be integrated into health systems and support the transformation in post-conflict settings can evolve into sustainable centers of excellence and trusted global implementation hubs, offering transferable lessons for strengthening PHC-oriented system in comparable contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以斯里兰卡北部省一个资源有限的冲突后地区为背景，采用概念驱动的社区案例研究，梳理一家社区导向家庭健康中心从规模较小的机构逐步发展为全国认可、国际连接的基础医疗、教育与研究枢纽的过程。作者将该模式概括为家庭医学、社区导向基础医疗与参与式行动研究三者的整合：家庭医学提供临床与伦理基础，社区导向基础医疗引入明确的人群责任及患者与公众参与，参与式行动研究则作为系统学习机制支持持续调整与知识共创，并由本地招聘的社区卫生工作者在家庭、服务与研究之间建立联系。文章认为，这种立足本地的初级卫生保健取向系统组件可融入卫生体系，在冲突后环境中演化为可持续的卓越中心与可信的全球实施枢纽，为类似情境提供可借鉴的经验。

papers.title: Rapidly progressive cognitive decline and drug-induced encephalopathy secondary to teprotumumab for thyroid eye disease: a case report and narrative literature review
papers.authors: Zhijuan Cheng, Shixian Zhou, Zi-Ying He, Ze-Fang Deng, Chuan Zeng, Weiping Chen, Jiang-Long Tu
papers.abstract: Background Teprotumumab, a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor (IGF-1R), is an approved targeted therapy for thyroid eye disease (TED). Teprotumumab-associated encephalopathy is an extremely rare but potentially severe central nervous system adverse event, with only three cases reported globally to date. We report the first Han-Chinese patient with Graves’ disease and associated TED complicated by teprotumumab-associated encephalopathy, together with a narrative review of all published cases, to raise clinicians’ awareness and improve early recognition and management of this rare complication. Case presentation A 56-year-old Chinese man with Graves’ disease and TED developed acute progressive apathy and encephalopathy characterised by multidomain cognitive and behavioral dysfunction 20 days after the third teprotumumab infusion, with an admission MMSE score of 15. Contrast-enhanced brain MRI, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) examination, and autoimmune encephalitis antibody screening were unremarkable. Prolonged video-electroencephalography(VEEG) demonstrated intermittent diffuse bilateral slow-wave activity, and widespread interictal epileptiform discharges without electrographic or clinical seizures. Systematic workup excluded infectious, autoimmune, metabolic, and psychiatric encephalopathy. Treatment-emergent hyperglycemia was confirmed as a secondary aggravating factor rather than the primary cause. The patient achieved prominent neurological recovery after individualized treapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) and symptomatic management, with a Naranjo score of 6 indicating probable drug-related encephalopathy. Narrative literature review Synthesis of all three previously published teprotumumab-associated encephalopathy cases demonstrates that neurological toxicity can develop as early as the third infusion cycle. These cases present consistent neuroimaging features with variable CSF profiles, and thyroid autoantibody elevation predominantly reflects pre-existing Graves’ disease-related autoimmune background instead of directly mediating neurotoxicity. TPE generally facilitates neurological recovery but may be complicated by procedural hypersensitivity and fluctuating therapeutic responses. Notably, interictal epileptiform discharges on VEEG represent a newly identified neurophysiological manifestation of this rare adverse event. A three-hit interacting pathogenic hypothesis is proposed: impaired IGF-1R-dependent neurotrophic signalling serves as the core injury mechanism, while underlying thyroid autoimmunity and treatment-related metabolic disturbance act as susceptibility-modifying factors. Discussion This case expands the ethnic and clinical spectrum of teprotumumab-related encephalopathy. Diffuse interictal epileptiform discharges without ictal changes reflect reactive cortical hyperexcitability secondary to acute encephalopathy. Metabolic disturbance merely exacerbated neurological impairment. Limitations include single-case constraints, simultaneous multi-intervention therapy, and lack of direct intracranial mechanistic evidence. Conclusion Teprotumumab-associated encephalopathy is a rare but serious adverse event. Close neurological surveillance and are essential during medication. Accumulated cases are needed to establish unified diagnostic and therapeutic criteria.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以一份病例报告结合叙述性文献综述，报告一例格雷夫斯病合并甲状腺眼病的汉族患者在接受替妥木单抗第三周期输注后出现急性进展性认知与行为障碍，并经系统检查排除感染、自身免疫、代谢及精神性病因，脑电图显示弥漫性慢波与发作间期癫痫样放电，停药并接受血浆置换后神经功能明显恢复。作者结合既往三例已发表病例提出，该药相关脑病可早至第三周期出现，甲状腺自身抗体升高多反映原有疾病背景而非直接致病，并据此提出以IGF-1R神经营养信号受损为核心、甲状腺自身免疫与代谢紊乱为易感调节因素的三重打击假说。文章提示用药期间需密切神经监测，但结论受单例报告、多干预同时进行及缺乏颅内直接机制证据的限制。

papers.title: Design and formative usability evaluation of a prototype integrated digital health platform for chronic care support
papers.authors: Kekayan Nanthakumar, Kunal Gupta, Alireza Farrokhi Nia, Sergio Dempsey, Nastaran Saffaryazdi, Alaeddin Nassani, Elizabeth Broadbent, Merryn Tawhai, Gonzalo Maso Talou
papers.abstract: Introduction Chronic care management platforms often support only one or two core pillars of care, such as patient monitoring, patient activation, and data-driven care coordination. This fragmentation can limit the continuity of support and reduce the usefulness of shared patient data among patients, coaches, and clinicians. Method This study describes the design, software architecture, and formative usability evaluation of the Digital Health Navigator (DiNa) platform, an integrated system designed to bring together the core pillars of chronic care management. DiNa combines wearable and self-reported monitoring, a large language model-powered embodied conversational agent, and a coordinator dashboard within a single modular ecosystem. DiNa was implemented as an Android application, a web-based coordinator dashboard, a microservices backend, and wearable integrations with a smartwatch and a continuous glucose monitor. The embodied conversational agent supports goal setting, logging, reminders, and knowledge-grounded education through coaching informed by motivational interviewing and cognitive behavioural therapy. We conducted moderated laboratory think-aloud usability sessions with 10 relatively young healthy volunteers familiar with digital health tracking. Participants explored the application and completed structured tasks, including setting goals, logging meals with an image, reviewing history, interacting with the coach, and viewing trends. Results Outcomes included task performance, the System Usability Scale (SUS), a brief NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX), three acceptability items, and a reflexive thematic analysis of interviews. Participants completed the core tasks in a facilitated session, and a small number of critical breakdowns were observed and quantified. Mean SUS was 76.1 (SD 15.0), indicating generally good usability. Overall, the NASA-TLX workload averaged 26.7, with mental demand and effort higher than the other subscales and the remaining subscales low. Acceptability ratings indicated moderate early acceptability, with perceived usefulness rated more positively than near-term use or recommendation. Qualitative analysis identified five themes, including burdensome and sometimes unclear logging workflows, uneven goal setting, a friendly but occasionally generic coach, interface elements that reduced confidence, and a strong interest in integration with existing devices and applications. Discussion These findings provide early evidence that an integrated platform combining continuous sensing, conversational coaching, and clinician-facing coordination is technically feasible and usable in a controlled setting with healthy volunteers, and they identify the workflow refinements needed before evaluation in clinically representative populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计并开发了整合可穿戴监测、大语言模型驱动的具身对话代理与协调员仪表盘的慢性病照护平台DiNa，并通过10名熟悉数字健康追踪的健康志愿者的实验室出声思维可用性测试进行形成性评估。参与者能在引导下完成设定目标、记录饮食、查看历史、与教练互动等核心任务，系统可用性量表均值为76.1，整体可用性较好，任务负荷总体偏低但心理需求与努力程度相对较高，早期可接受度为中等，感知有用性评价优于近期使用意愿或推荐意愿。质性分析归纳出记录流程负担重且有时不清晰、目标设定体验不均衡、教练友好但偶尔泛化、部分界面元素削弱信心、对与现有设备应用整合兴趣强烈等主题。作者据此认为该整合平台在受控环境下技术可行且可用，但需先优化工作流程，再在具有临床代表性的群体中评估。

papers.title: Enhancing Teachers’ Digital Media Competence through AI-Based Training to Support Environmental Projects and Learning
papers.authors: Febblina Daryanes, Zulfarina, Wan Syafii, Imam Mahadi, Irda Sayuti, Putri Junita Anipa
papers.abstract: Teachers' limited competence in utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based digital media has hindered the effective implementation of innovative teaching practices and environmental projects. This community service program aimed to enhance teachers' knowledge and skills in developing AI-based instructional media. The program was conducted at State Senior High School 1 Koto Kampar Hulu and involved 29 teachers through educational seminars, workshops, hands-on practice, and mentoring using Canva AI, Gemini AI, and NotebookLM. Program effectiveness was evaluated using pretest-posttest assessments, N-Gain analysis, instructional media product evaluation, and participant satisfaction questionnaires. The results showed that the participants' mean score increased from 47.0 to 78.9, with an N-Gain score of 0.6, indicating a moderate level of improvement. All participants (100%) demonstrated increased knowledge following the training. Furthermore, every participant successfully developed at least one AI-based instructional medium, such as a poster or infographic, that was ready for implementation in classroom instruction and environmental projects. These findings indicate that the training effectively enhanced teachers' digital competencies and their ability to integrate AI technologies into teaching and learning practices
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对教师运用人工智能数字媒体能力不足、影响教学创新与环境项目开展的问题，通过研讨会、工作坊、动手实践和辅导等形式，围绕Canva AI、Gemini AI和NotebookLM对29名高中教师开展培训。前后测与N-Gain分析显示，教师平均得分由47.0升至78.9，N-Gain为0.6，属中等程度提升，全部参与者知识水平均有提高；每位教师还至少完成了一件可用于课堂教学和环境项目的AI教学媒体作品。结果表明此类培训有助于提升教师的数字能力及其将AI技术融入教学实践的能力。

papers.title: An Interpretable Random Forest Model for Predicting Anosognosia in Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease: Findings from the A4 Study
papers.authors: İdris Demirsoy, Merve Ceren Akgör
papers.abstract: Anosognosia, reduced awareness of cognitive difficulties, is common across the Alzheimer's disease (AD) continuum yet remains difficult to detect before objective impairment appears; We developed an explainable machine learning model to predict a Cognitive Function Index (CFI) discrepancy–based operational indicator of anosognosia ΔCFI-defined reduced awareness) in amyloid-positive, cognitively unimpaired older adults from the A4 study. Anosognosia was defined as a negative discrepancy between participant- and study-partner-reported CFI scores (ΔCFI<0); the comparison group (ΔCFI>0) reflects hypernosognosia, over-reporting of difficulty relative to the study partner, rather than intact awareness. Participants with ΔCFI=0 or incomplete data were excluded, yielding a final sample of 1,058. A Random Forest classifier was trained on nine features with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values computed to quantify predictor contributions at the individual level. The model achieved 65.88% accuracy, 53.45% sensitivity, 70.59% specificity. Hippocampal volume (HV) was the highest predictor by permutation importance, followed by age and study-partner cohabitation status; FCSRT and PACC contributed meaningfully, while MMSE, GDS, and education showed near-zero importance. SHAP analyses confirmed that lower HV, older age, and lower cognitive scores jointly drove predictions of anosognosia, while misclassifications arose from competing demographic and neuroimaging signals. These findings demonstrate that an accessible combination of clinical and neuroimaging variables can identify meaningful predictors of anosognosia in preclinical AD. HV was the leading predictor, consistent with the established role of medial temporal lobe integrity in self-monitoring. The asymmetry among sensitivity, specificity, and positive predictive value underscores the need to incorporate additional biomarkers, particularly tau pathology, functional connectivity, and longitudinal data.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对临床前阿尔茨海默病中难以在客观损害出现前识别的病感失认，基于A4研究中淀粉样蛋白阳性且认知未受损的老年人数据，构建了可解释的随机森林模型，以参与者与知情者报告的认知功能指数差值定义病感失认。模型在区分病感失认与过度报告困难方面表现有限，敏感性偏低而特异性较高；海马体积是最重要的预测因素，年龄和与知情者同住情况次之，部分认知测验也有贡献，而简易精神状态检查等变量重要性接近零。SHAP分析显示，较小的海马体积、较大年龄和较低认知得分共同推动病感失认预测，误分类则源于人口学与神经影像信号的相互竞争。作者据此指出，临床与神经影像变量的组合可提供有意义的预测线索，但敏感性与特异性之间的不对称提示仍需纳入tau病理、功能连接和纵向数据等更多信息。

papers.title: Massive open online courses: Trends shaping online education
papers.authors: Marija Pokos Lukinec, Dragutin Kermek
papers.journal: International Journal of Education and Learning
papers.abstract: The development of digital technology has enabled the emergence and expansion of Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs), which are transforming education through global accessibility, flexibility, and interactivity. This paper analyzes several platforms, their structure, the role of mentors, and the application of learning analytics. By searching citation databases and using generative artificial intelligence tools, relevant studies in the field were identified as the foundation of the analysis. An analysis of the most prominent MOOC platforms was conducted, with a more detailed comparison between the international platforms Coursera, edX, Future Learn, and the Croatian national platforms Srce and CARNET. The research shows that platforms differ in their use of technology, target groups, and approaches to mentorship, but they share a common goal: to provide accessible and personalized education. Personalized education is maintained through the role of mentors, reflected in communication on forums, AI assistants, and peer interaction. Learning analytics also play an equally important role, enabling precise monitoring of progress and adapting content to the specific needs of individuals. Alongside many advantages, the paper also discusses challenges such as privacy protection and data accuracy, which influence the development of MOOCs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文通过检索文献数据库并借助生成式人工智能工具梳理相关研究，分析多个大规模开放在线课程平台的结构、导师角色与学习分析应用，并对Coursera、edX、Future Learn等国际平台与克罗地亚国家平台作了较详细的比较。分析显示，各平台在技术运用、目标群体和导师支持方式上存在差异，但都致力于提供可及且个性化的教育，个性化主要通过论坛交流、AI助手和同伴互动中的导师作用来维持，学习分析则用于监测学习进度并据此调整内容。文章同时指出隐私保护和数据准确性等挑战会影响这类课程的发展。

papers.title: The influence of institutional policies and ChatGPT usage levels on dependence through utilization in higher education
papers.authors: Darul Prayogo, Taruga Runadi, Aryanti Fitrianingsih, Moh. Aziz Rohman
papers.journal: International Journal of Education and Learning
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AI), particularly ChatGPT, has transformed learning practices in higher education while raising concerns about student dependency and academic integrity. Although previous studies have primarily examined the effects of AI usage intensity, limited attention has been given to how institutional policies shape AI utilization and subsequently influence dependency. This study addresses this gap by examining the effects of ChatGPT usage level and institutional policies on student dependency, with ChatGPT utilization as a mediating variable. A quantitative approach was employed involving 113 students from Politeknik Ilmu Pelayaran Semarang, Indonesia, selected through stratified random sampling. Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 3. The findings indicate that institutional policies significantly enhance ChatGPT utilization but do not directly affect dependency. In contrast, ChatGPT utilization has a significant negative effect on dependency, suggesting that higher-quality utilization reduces the likelihood of excessive reliance. The level of ChatGPT usage does not significantly influence either utilization or dependency. Furthermore, ChatGPT utilization fully mediates the relationship between institutional policies and dependency. These findings extend the literature on AI adoption and technology dependency by demonstrating that the quality of AI utilization, rather than usage intensity, is the primary mechanism through which institutional policies influence dependency. This study suggests a shift from frequency-based perspectives toward utilization-oriented approaches in understanding responsible AI adoption in higher education. Practically, higher education institutions should prioritize policies that promote AI literacy, establish clear ethical guidelines, integrate ChatGPT into learning activities with appropriate supervision, and encourage reflective rather than passive AI use to maximize educational benefits while minimizing dependency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察高校制度政策与ChatGPT使用水平如何通过实际使用方式影响学生的依赖程度，以印尼一所航海院校的学生为对象，采用问卷调查与结构方程模型进行分析。结果显示，制度政策能显著提升ChatGPT的使用质量，但并不直接降低依赖；使用质量越高，依赖反而越低，而单纯的使用频率对使用质量和依赖均无显著影响。使用质量在制度政策与依赖之间起完全中介作用。作者据此指出，影响依赖的关键在于使用的质量而非强度，建议高校通过AI素养教育、明确伦理规范和有监督的学习整合，引导学生反思性而非被动地使用生成式AI。

papers.title: Generative AI-supported problem-based learning for enhancing computational thinking and chemistry achievement in engineering chemistry
papers.authors: Widiyanti Widiyanti, Muhammad Idris Effendi, Roswina Dianawati, Fadliyanti Firdausia
papers.journal: International Journal of Education and Learning
papers.abstract: The increasing adoption of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in higher education has created new opportunities to enhance active learning; however, empirical evidence regarding its integration with Problem-Based Learning (PBL) in Engineering Chemistry remains limited, particularly for simultaneously fostering Computational Thinking (CT) and chemistry achievement. This study investigates the effectiveness of integrating GenAI with PBL in an undergraduate Engineering Chemistry course within a Mechanical Engineering Education program. In the intervention, GPT-4 was embedded as an AI learning scaffold that guided students through Socratic questioning, provided formative feedback, and supported problem decomposition and analysis during collaborative PBL activities rather than supplying direct answers. Employing a quasi-experimental pretest-posttest control group design, the study involved 68 undergraduate students (n = 34 experimental; n = 34 control) selected through cluster random sampling. Data were collected using three validated instruments: a Computational Thinking Test (CTT, 30 items, ? = .87), a Chemistry Achievement Test (CAT, 35 items, ? = .84), and a Learning Observation Sheet (LOS, 20 items, ICC = .91). Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Shapiro-Wilk normality tests, Levene's homogeneity tests, independent-samples t-tests, ANCOVA, and Cohen's d effect size analysis. The results revealed significant improvements in both CT skills (t(66) = 8.47, p .001) and chemistry achievement (t(66) = 9.12, p .001) in the experimental group compared with the control group. ANCOVA controlling for pretest scores confirmed significant treatment effects for CT (F(1,65) = 127.84, p .001) and chemistry achievement (F(1,65) = 109.07, p .001), with large practical effects (Cohen's d = 2.14 and 2.06, respectively). These findings provide empirical support for integrating AI-supported scaffolding within structured PBL environments to strengthen computational thinking and conceptual understanding in Engineering Chemistry, while extending the pedagogical application of AI-enhanced constructivist learning in engineering education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在工程化学课程中，将生成式人工智能（GPT-4）作为学习支架嵌入问题导向学习（PBL）后，能否同时提升学生的计算思维与化学学业成绩。研究采用准实验前后测对照组设计，实验组在协作PBL中由AI通过苏格拉底式提问、形成性反馈和问题分解引导学习，而非直接给出答案。结果显示，控制前测成绩后，实验组在计算思维和化学成绩上均显著优于对照组，且效应量较大；这为在结构化PBL环境中使用AI支架促进计算思维与概念理解提供了实证支持，但结论受准实验设计与特定课程情境的限制。

papers.title: Embracing artificial intelligence (AI) with the help of pharmacy students
papers.authors: Matthew Ryan Mink, Annette Kempston
papers.journal: Canadian Pharmacists Journal / Revue des Pharmaciens du Canada

papers.title: The CTF is dead, long live the CTF? Exploring perspectives on AI and the recognition of skill in capture-the-flag competitions
papers.authors: Susan J. Harrington, Mikael Asplund
papers.abstract: Capture-the-flag (CTF) competitions are used across the security community to recruit talent, build skills and sustain a competitive culture. As AI agents increasingly solve CTF challenges, three positions have emerged: that the format is obsolete, that it should become a benchmark for human-AI collaboration, and that headline claims overstate what the saturation of introductory benchmarks shows. This debate has been driven mainly by capability benchmarks, while the views of those who design, run and play CTFs remain largely unexamined. We report an exploratory qualitative study based on six interviews (seven participants) and eleven anonymous written responses from experienced CTF organisers and players. We interpret their accounts using Bourdieu's concepts of field and capital, and, for learning, the notion of threshold concepts. Participants did not offer a single verdict. Some were strongly critical of AI-assisted solving in competition; others wanted AI to be embraced and built into CTFs; still others took positions that depended on context. Strongly critical positions were voiced more often in anonymous written responses, a reminder that such positions are situated in the circumstances in which accounts are given. Participants involved in competition-focused CTFs described rankings that increasingly reflect access to AI models and money, and a loss of the satisfaction that made competing worthwhile. From an educational perspective, participants described students who solved challenges quickly but could not explain how they had done so. Participants disagreed about whether CTFs are preparation for real-world practice or a sport, and this seemed closely related to the stance they took. Many saw the enforcement of anti-AI measures as feasible only in on-site CTFs, and also largely dependent on trust. Several participants expressed doubt about CTF results still signalling individual skill levels to potential employers. We propose that this exploratory study into CTFs indicates a wider problem for the security workforce: when a measure of skill becomes cheap and easy to automate, a community must renegotiate what counts as legitimate performance. We also discuss implications for skills development, competition governance and hiring.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过访谈与匿名书面回应，考察CTF竞赛组织者和选手如何看待AI解题对技能认可的影响，并借助场域、资本与阈值概念进行解读。参与者并未形成统一判断：有人强烈批评AI辅助解题，有人主张将AI纳入竞赛，也有人持情境化立场，且批评态度在匿名回应中更常见。竞赛导向的参与者认为排名日益反映对AI模型和资金的获取，削弱了参赛的满足感；教育视角下则出现学生快速解题却无法解释过程的现象。参与者对CTF是实战准备还是竞技运动存在分歧，并多认为反AI措施仅在现场赛中可行且依赖信任，部分人怀疑CTF成绩还能否向雇主传递个人技能信号。作者据此提出，当技能衡量变得廉价且可自动化时，安全社区需重新协商何为正当表现。

papers.title: Bridging the “Black Box”: High School Computer Science Teachers’ Pedagogical Content Knowledge and Self-Efficacy in Foundational Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Jacqueline Corricelli
papers.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) expands to secondary computer science (CS), CS educators need to change our approach to CS pedagogy from deterministic, traceable algorithms toward understanding "black boxes" or probabilistic analysis. This requires that we modify CS curricula to refocus to include conceptual abstraction, data critique, and ethics. However, a disconnect currently exists between teachers' perceived requirements and the actual skills needed to effectively teach AI. To explore this gap, this study draws on survey data from high school CS educators (N = 55), investigating the relationships between Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK-A), Teacher Self-Efficacy (AI-TSE), and beliefs about rigor in AI instruction.Descriptive findings show variation in pedagogical content knowledge (67.3% to 98.2% accuracy), along with a ‘mathematical dishonesty’ paradox. While 69.1% (n = 38) of educators do not believe advanced math is required for students to understand AI, 41.8% (n = 23) report feeling 'dishonest as a teacher' when teaching algorithms without it. Exploratory regression modeling indicated that instructional confidence trended positively with PCK-A (B = 0.101, p = 0.080), while beliefs about math rigor showed no predictive association (p = 0.357; model R2 = 0.062, p = 0.189). Confidence is more related to that teacher’s strategies for abstraction, rather than mastery of advanced math. Educators reported their lowest confidence evaluating student projects based on model choice rather than code complexity (M = 2.75, SD = 1.31). Based on these findings, educators are categorized into a 2x2 Readiness Grid. This paper seeks to bridge the "black box" of AI education, suggesting a 4-pillar professional learning model. Moreover, a qualitative phase is currently underway to explore the lived experiences of CS educators as we navigate this pedagogical shift.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对高中计算机科学教师的调查，考察其在基础数据科学与人工智能教学中的教学内容知识（PCK-A）、教师自我效能感（AI-TSE）以及对AI教学严谨性的信念之间的关系。描述性结果显示教师的教学内容知识存在差异，并呈现出一种“数学不诚实”悖论：多数教师不认为学生理解AI需要高等数学，但相当一部分教师在不借助数学讲授算法时感到“作为教师不诚实”。探索性回归提示教学信心与PCK-A呈正向趋势，而对数学严谨性的信念没有预测关联，信心更多与教师的抽象化教学策略相关；教师对依据模型选择而非代码复杂度评价学生项目的信心最低。作者据此将教师归入一个2×2准备度网格，并提出一个四支柱专业学习模型，同时说明质性研究阶段仍在进行中。

papers.title: AI as Cultural Infrastructure: Cultural Sovereignty and Civilizational Pluralism beyond Algorithmic Homogenization
papers.authors: Himal Giri
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is often understood as a tool that can preserve, translate, promote, or hreaten culture. This article argues that AI does not merely circulate cultural content; it becomes he infrastructure through which cultures are made visible, authorized, translated, valued, and enabled-or prevented--from shaping the future. Through training data, model design recommendation systems, content moderation, and platform ownership, AI determines which languages, aesthetics, memories, and knowledge systems attain cultural authority. Cultural homogenization is therefore not simply the spread of similar content; it is the narrowing of the epistemic, linguistic, aesthetic, and institutional conditions through which different civilizations nake meaning and build futures. The article responds to four central questions: Can Al coexist with cultural plurality? Whose values should AI align with? Who controls cultural data anguages, and creative works? And why is cultural preservation alone insufficient? It argues that these questions require more than better representation or ethical guidelines; they require restructuring the data, value systems, ownership, and governance of Al itself. To address this, the article develops a theory of civilizational pluralist AÏ governance. It advances three concepts cultural data sovereignty, affirming community authority over cultural data, consent, provenance ınd benefit-sharing; pluralist value alignment, treating alignment as participatory and context- sensitive rather than the universalization of one moral framework; and polycentric cultura. accountability, requiring shared responsibility among communities, creators, states, platforms, and global institutions. Drawing on the Himalayan and Nepali context as a lived example of inguistic, religious, and cultural plurality, the article shows that small and plural societies car provide a normative imagination for AI governance beyond Western universalism. It concludes that the central question is no longer only "Who may speak?" but "Whose knowledge, language, memory, and creativity become the infrastructure of AI's future?" Civilizational pluralism requires moving beyond preservation toward cultural sovereignty, equitable cultural economies, participatory value alignment, and polycentric AI governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论人工智能如何不只是传播文化内容，而成为决定文化能否被看见、被授权、被翻译和被赋值的底层基础设施。作者提出，文化同质化的实质是知识、语言、审美与制度条件的收窄，并据此构建“文明多元主义AI治理”理论，包含文化数据主权、多元价值对齐与多中心文化问责三个概念。文章以喜马拉雅和尼泊尔语境为例，说明小型多元社会可为超越西方普遍主义的AI治理提供规范想象，结论强调问题已从“谁可以发声”转向“谁的知识、语言、记忆与创造力成为AI未来的基础设施”。

papers.title: The Deepfake Discount: Believing Erotic Images Are AI-Generated Reduces Affective Responses
papers.authors: Ana Briosa Neves, Marco Viola, Marco Sperduti, Guido B. Corradi, Antonio Olivera La Rosa, Alessandro Ansani, Marco Marini, Dominique Makowski
papers.abstract: The proliferation of AI-generated content raises the question of whether beliefs about a stimulus’s origin alter emotional responses to it. Across two studies, we conceptually replicated and extended Marini et al. (2024) by presenting heterosexual participants (Study 1: N = 705; Study 2: N = 261) with erotic (Studies 1 and 2) and non-erotic (Study 1) images from validated databases (NAPS and NAPS ERO). Unbeknownst to participants, all stimuli were real photographs, each randomly labelled as “Photograph” or “AI-generated”. Participants rated sexual arousal, enticement, and valence for each image, and later judged their agreement with the labels. Images labelled as AI-generated received lower affective ratings, but this effect was small and driven primarily by male participants. Gender differences were robust yet context dependent: males yielded more robust differences, partially driven by a higher baseline arousal response. However, image of couples (Study 2), that females rated as more arousing, narrowed the gender gap found in Study 1. Critically, the effect of the labels interacted with participant’s own beliefs: photograph-labelled images were rated more arousing than AI-labelled only when participants’ subsequent belief ratings were congruent with the label, and the difference between labels reversed when opposite beliefs were reported, suggesting a complex relationship between emotion and reality beliefs. Individual-level differences in AI attitudes, pornography consumption, and sexual activity showed no reliable modulation of the labels effect. These findings suggest that the anti-AI bias is best understood as a belief-sensitive authenticity effect rather than a uniform response to AI labels, with implications for research using synthetic stimuli and for policies mandating disclosure of AI-generated content.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过两项实验考察人们对图像来源的信念是否会改变其情感反应：参与者观看情色与非情色图片，这些图片实为真实照片，却被随机标注为“照片”或“AI生成”。结果显示，被标为AI生成的图片获得的情感评分略低，这一效应较小且主要由男性参与者驱动，性别差异还随图片情境而变化；更关键的是，标签效应与参与者事后对标签的相信程度交互，只有当其信念与标签一致时差异才出现，反之则反转。作者据此认为，这种反AI倾向更应理解为对真实性的信念敏感效应，而非对AI标签的普遍反应，并讨论了其对合成刺激研究与AI内容披露政策的含义。

papers.title: AI-Powered Prevention and Early Intervention for Stress, Depression, and Anxiety: A Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.authors: Julie Youko Anne Cachia, Xuan Zhao, Wenxi Pu, Chi Liao, Merel Keijsers, Julian De Freitas, Rebecca G. Fortgang
papers.abstract: Randomized evidence for purpose-built generative AI mental health support remains limited. In this preregistered trial, 1,137 unscreened university students were assigned to 6 weeks of a generative AI-powered mobile intervention (“Flourish”) or care as usual. Across the full sample, Flourish produced more favorable trajectories for perceived stress (β = −0.03, p = 0.010), depressive symptoms (β = −0.03, p = 0.006), and anxiety symptoms (β = −0.04, p = 0.001). Among participants with lower baseline symptoms, Flourish buffered deterioration; among those with elevated symptoms, improvements were larger with Flourish for depression (d = 1.03 vs 0.56) and anxiety (d = 0.91 vs 0.60), with meaningful improvement in 52.3% vs 31.7% and 50.6% vs 38.1%, respectively. Reduced perceived stress emerged as a potential pathway to symptom improvement. To our knowledge, this is the first trial supporting purpose-built, safety-first generative AI for mental health prevention and early intervention in an unscreened population.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过随机对照试验检验专门设计的生成式AI移动干预（Flourish）对大学生压力、抑郁和焦虑的预防与早期干预效果，比较其与常规照护的差异。结果显示，Flourish在整体样本中使压力、抑郁和焦虑症状呈现更有利的变化趋势；基线症状较低者获得恶化缓冲，基线症状较高者的抑郁和焦虑改善幅度更大，达到有意义改善的比例也更高，感知压力的降低可能是症状改善的潜在路径。作者据此认为，这是首个在未筛查人群中支持安全优先的专用生成式AI用于心理健康预防与早期干预的试验证据。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Associations in Creativity: Evaluating Word-Image Pairing in Humans and Large Language Models
papers.authors: Eva Illion, Linxuan Wang, Liane M. Gabora
papers.abstract: Given differences in the associative memory architectures of humans and AI, it is not clear whether AI generates and interprets visual-linguistic associations the way humans do. To investigate this, human participants and two large language models (LLMs), ChatGPT and Gemini, were asked to generate novel words and corresponding images that form meaningfully linked dyads. The LLMs and a second group of human participants were presented with shuffled sets of these words and images and asked to rematch them in ways they felt were most meaningful. Humans performed similarly regardless of whether the pairs were human or LLM-generated, while LLMs were better at matching LLM-generated pairs. Overall, LLMs outperformed humans at recovering the intended pairings. These findings suggest that despite architectural differences, the way in which AI generates and detects associations between language and visual stimuli is not only like that of humans, but they may be superior at recognizing cross-domain associations that humans find meaningful.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察人类与大语言模型在词语—图像跨模态联想生成与匹配上的差异，让人类参与者和ChatGPT、Gemini分别生成语义关联的词—图配对，再由另一组人类参与者和模型对打乱后的词图重新配对。结果显示，人类无论面对人类还是模型生成的配对，匹配表现相近；而模型更擅长匹配模型自己生成的配对，且总体上模型恢复原配对的成绩优于人类。作者据此认为，尽管人类与AI的联想记忆架构不同，AI生成和识别语言—视觉关联的方式与人类相似，甚至在识别人类认为有意义的跨域关联上可能更强。

papers.title: Induction and Overreach in the Science of Consciousness
papers.authors: Matthew P. Gunn, Christine C. Minton, Chienyem A. Nweke
papers.abstract: Induction shapes consciousness science as researchers infer experience, generalizing neural signatures, and project across contexts. While deduction sets ideals of certainty, induction guides experimentation and decision-making. This article provides a synoptic analysis of induction’s role in consciousness science by surveying its philosophical background, from Aristotle and Hume to Popper, Salmon, and Peirce, and its formalization in Bayesian and predictive-processing frameworks. This manuscript then examines how induction operates across neuroimaging, comparative cognition, and clinical contexts, highlighting successes (pattern detection, anesthesia monitoring, covert awareness detection) and structural risks (correlation–causation slippage, overgeneralization, anthropomorphism, and high-stakes misclassification). Recent sufficiency-oriented syntheses (e.g., Coppola, 2025; Mashour et al., 2020; Hohwy et al., 2020) exemplify both the power and the perils of inductive generalization, extending correlational findings into claims of ontological sufficiency. Building on recent critiques and adversarial comparisons of leading theories, this article argues for an explicitly deflationary program that keeps induction indispensable but bounded. The core tools are: (i) operational vocabularies distinguishing constructs (access, arousal, valuation, metacognition); (ii) transparent bridge principles linking observables to experiences; and (iii) prediction tables that register both positive predictions and falsifiers. This pragmatic framework does not solve Hume’s problem; it makes our inductive commitments tractable, testable, and ethically responsible. Consciousness science should remain inductive, just not inflationary. To demonstrate this framework’s tractability, the paper introduces examples of bridge principles and quantitative criteria for “bounded” inference, including Bayesian priors, model-comparison metrics, and causal graphs. Ethical and institutional dimensions are expanded to include AI, animal, and algorithmic induction. These additions link philosophical modesty with methodological implementation and moral accountability.
