papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论分析文章，考察归纳在意识科学中的作用及其越界风险。作者梳理从亚里士多德、休谟到波普尔、皮尔士的哲学背景及贝叶斯与预测加工框架下的形式化，并结合神经影像、比较认知与临床情境，指出归纳在模式检测、麻醉监测和隐蔽意识检测中的成效，也揭示相关与因果混淆、过度推广、拟人化及高风险误判等结构性风险。文章据此主张一种“有界归纳”的紧缩纲领，提出操作化词汇、透明的桥接原则和记录正反预测的预测表等工具，并强调该框架并未解决休谟问题，只是使归纳承诺更可检验、更负责任。

papers.title: Should AI Trust Its Gut? The Cost of Deliberative Moral Reasoning in Humans and AI
papers.authors: Simon Myers, Nick Chater A
papers.abstract: People prefer deliberation to intuition, when judging how others solve hard problems, and they extend this to artificial agents. Yet in the moral domain, the preference may reverse as intuitive moral responses appear to signal good character. One explanation is that fast, intuitive responses show real emotional engagement. Since machines are thought to lack emotion, it is unclear whether a preference for intuition in the moral domain extends to AI. Across three preregistered studies (N = 2,173), we find that it does, but that it appears to be driven by commitment to moral norms and precedents rather than emotion. In Study 1, participants preferred intuitive reasoning for moral decisions and systematic reasoning for non-moral decisions, for human and AI agents alike. Intuitive moral reasoning signalled better character but was not clearly expected to produce better outcomes. In Study 2, the character preference persisted when the AI was described as being incapable of emotion. In Study 3, we held the decision fixed and varied how firmly the agent held the relevant moral norm. An agent who would never reconsider applying a moral norm was rated above one who would reconsider given sufficiently high stakes; and both above one who weighed costs and benefits case by case. Commitment raised character ratings more than expected-outcome ratings. The character-based cost of moral deliberation appears to be a cost of treating a moral norm as negotiable, and we found strong evidence that people apply this inference to machines and people alike.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察人们对人类与AI在道德判断中采用直觉还是审慎推理的偏好差异。三项预注册研究显示，参与者对人和AI都更偏好道德决策中的直觉推理，且直觉道德推理被视为更能体现良好品格，但并未明显被认为带来更好结果；当AI被描述为无法拥有情感时，这种品格偏好依然存在。进一步操纵智能体对道德规范的坚持程度后发现，绝不重新考虑规范的智能体品格评分最高，会视代价重新考虑者次之，逐案权衡利弊者最低，且这种坚持对品格评价的提升大于对预期结果的提升。作者据此认为，道德审慎在品格层面的代价源于将道德规范视为可协商，而人们会把这一推断同样应用于机器和人。

papers.title: Does facial expression processing require attention? A multi-lab replication of Eimer et al. (2003)
papers.authors: Ziyi Wang, Alejandro J. Estudillo, Ala Yankouskaya, Nazanin S. Andalibi, Amy Rachel Bland, Chris Robert Harrison Brown, Elisabeth Fonteneau, Donovan G. Govan, Marine Granjon, Tijl Grootswagers, Jennifer N. Gutsell, José Antonio Hinojosa, Jing Ke, Yixuan Ku, Bryan Leong Qi Zheng, Claudia Poch, Ellen Seiss, Efe Soyman, Oscar Sun, Manuel Varlet, Nolhan Zermane, Faisal Mushtaq, Yuri G. Pavlov, Xun He
papers.abstract: How the brain processes facial expressions and whether this process requires focal attention have been central topics of neurophysiological research on face processing. In a seminal study, using scalp-recorded event-related potentials (ERPs), Eimer, Holmes, and McGlone (2003) found that emotional and neutral faces were differently processed in the brain as early as 160 ms after stimulus onset. Importantly, these ERP differences disappeared when attention was directed away from the face stimuli, suggesting the necessity of focal attention in facial expression processing. These results have greatly motivated further research in the field. Yet, subsequent research did not always agree with these findings, and the study was never directly replicated. Hence, this study has been selected by #EEGManyLabs, a global and multi-laboratory replication project, for a high-powered direct replication across multiple laboratories (N = 41 in each laboratory). We hypothesize the replication of the original positive findings, including the ERP effects differentiating emotional and neutral faces and their dependence on focal attention. To address the debate on facial expression processing and the role of N170, we will also take this opportunity to reassess key negative findings of the original study, namely no difference between emotional and neutral facial expressions in N170 and no ERP differences among the six facial expressions. Replication or revision of these findings will confirm the necessity of focal attention in emotional face processing and the postulated biomarkers of basic emotion processing. This study will provide a reproducible benchmark on face processing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对“面孔表情加工是否需要集中注意”这一神经生理学争议，由#EEGManyLabs组织多实验室对Eimer等（2003）的ERP研究进行高统计效力的直接重复。原研究发现情绪与中性面孔在刺激后约160毫秒即出现ERP差异，且当注意偏离面孔时该差异消失，但后续研究结论不一且原研究从未被直接重复。作者假设能重复原研究的阳性结果，即情绪与中性面孔的ERP差异及其对集中注意的依赖，同时重新检验原研究中N170无表情差异、六种表情间无ERP差异等关键阴性发现。重复或修正这些结果将检验集中注意在情绪面孔加工中的必要性及基本情绪加工的生物标记，并为面孔加工提供可重复的基准。

papers.title: Does Calling an AI Advisor "Agentic" Make People Trust It More? An Online Experiment on Trust and Financial Risk-Taking
papers.authors: Michele Lodetti
papers.abstract: AI financial advisors are increasingly presented as autonomous agents that reason and act on their own. Theory suggests that such agency cues should raise perceptions of an AI's ability and integrity, but not its benevolence, and that trust in its ability and integrity should increase willingness to take financial risks. I tested these predictions in a between-subjects experiment with 195 UK adults, with the hypotheses specified before data collection. Participants met an AI advisor framed either as a rule-based system or as an autonomous advisor, received the same final advice and allocated a hypothetical £1,000 between a low-risk and a high-risk investment. The framing increased perceived agency (Hedges' g = 0.46) but did not detectably change trust in the advisor's ability (g = 0.18, 95% CI [−0.11, 0.46]), integrity (g = −0.10) or benevolence (g = 0.00). Bayes factors favoured the null hypothesis for all three dimensions (BF01 = 3.2 to 6.4), and equivalence tests ruled out medium-sized effects on integrity and benevolence, though not on ability. Neither trust in ability nor trust in integrity was significantly related to risk-taking, and there was no evidence of mediation. Yet perceived agency correlated with every trust dimension (r = .35 to .50). Describing the advisor as agentic changed what people thought the system was but did not detectably change whether they trusted it. For human-machine communication research, the findings caution against reading correlations between perceived machine agency and trust as causal, and suggest that agency framing is a weak lever for trust in high-stakes advice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察将AI理财顾问描述为“自主智能体”是否会提高人们对其的信任并影响金融风险承担，采用预注册的组间在线实验，让英国成年参与者面对同一建议但不同框架的AI顾问，并在假设投资中分配资金。结果显示，自主性框架提升了参与者对系统自主性的感知，但未检测到对其能力、诚信或善意的信任产生变化，贝叶斯因子支持各信任维度无效应；能力信任与诚信信任也均与风险承担无显著关联，未见中介证据。然而，感知自主性与各信任维度存在相关。作者据此提醒，不应将机器自主性感知与信任之间的相关解读为因果，并认为在高风险建议场景中，自主性框架对信任的作用有限。

papers.title: Loneliness in the Brain: Distinguishing Between Hypersensitivity and Hyperalertness
papers.authors: Joe Bathelt, Corine Dijk, Marte Otten
papers.abstract: Introduction: Loneliness has emerged as a pressing public health issue, necessitating greater understanding of its mechanisms to devise effective treatments. While the link between loneliness and biased social cognition is a commonly proposed, the precise nature of this relationship remains unclear. This study aims to investigate the cognitive processes underlying loneliness, specifically distinguishing between hypersensitivity (heightened initial response) and hyperalertness (slow habituation) to social stimuli in lonely individuals.Methods: In Study 1, 36 participants were tested to identify the relevant EEG channels and time windows that show differential processing of angry vs happy faces and first vs later exposure in a roving oddball paradigm. Study 2 will compare these face processing effects in lonely and non-lonely participants. We aim to recruit a sample of 50 lonely and 50 non-lonely participants, who will be identified by their responses on a standardised loneliness questionnaire with population norms.Results: In Study 1, a greater response to angry compared to happy facial expressions was observed between 120-170ms over posterior and central channels, and between 360 and 470ms over right posterior channels. A greater response to the initial compared to the fifth presentation of an emotional face was found between 480 and 600ms over right posterior and central channels. These findings align with previous research on emotion and novelty processing in similar experiments.For Study 2, we anticipate observing higher response amplitudes when comparing angry expressions to happy expressions in lonely participants, indicating hypersensitivity. Furthermore, we expect to see greater amplitudes when comparing early presentations to late presentations of angry faces in lonely individuals, indicating increased alertness.Discussion: to be added at Stage 2
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注孤独感背后的社会认知机制，试图区分孤独个体对社交刺激是初始反应更强的“超敏感”，还是习惯化更慢的“超警觉”。研究一以脑电方法在情绪面孔的重复呈现范式中确定能区分愤怒与快乐面孔、以及首次与后续呈现的通道和时间窗，为后续比较提供指标；研究二计划据此对比孤独与非孤独参与者的面孔加工差异。作者预期孤独个体对愤怒面孔反应更强、且对重复呈现的愤怒面孔习惯化更慢，但研究二结果尚未报告，相关预期仍待检验。

papers.title: The Influence of AI-Powered Translation and Paraphrasing Tools on Academic Writing English Department: A Mixed-Methods Study
papers.authors: Isti Rahma Wijaya
papers.journal: Journal of English Language and Education
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-powered technologies are increasingly being employed to help EFL students with academic writing. However, research into the combined use of DeepL and QuillBot during the writing process is sparse. This study looks on students' use and perceptions of DeepL and QuillBot in academic writing. Using a mixed-methods design, quantitative data were gathered from 49 English Education students through a 35-item five-point Likert-scale questionnaire and analysed using descriptive statistics, while qualitative data were obtained through semi-structured interviews with nine participants and analysed thematically. The data revealed that both instruments were generally viewed positively. DeepL was mostly utilized for translation and phrase improvement during planning and drafting, while QuillBot helped with paraphrasing and editing. Students did not rely solely on AI results; rather, they critically analyzed and corrected generated texts. The study finds that DeepL and QuillBot serve as supportive tools that improve academic writing while allowing students to retain control over content and meaning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察英语教育专业学生在学术写作中使用DeepL与QuillBot的情况及看法，采用混合方法，以问卷和半结构化访谈收集数据。结果显示，学生对两款工具总体持正面评价：DeepL多用于构思与起草阶段的翻译和措辞改进，QuillBot则用于改写和编辑；学生并未完全依赖AI输出，而是会批判性地分析和修正生成文本。作者据此认为，这两款工具起辅助作用，在提升学术写作的同时让学生保留对内容与意义的控制。

papers.title: Między wsparciem a zagrożeniem: koncepcje potoczne osób studiujących pedagogikę wczesnoszkolną i przedszkolną wobec generatywnej sztucznej inteligencji w edukacji
papers.authors: Adam Mroczkowski
papers.abstract: The aim of the article is to reconstruct the lay conceptions held by students of early childhood and pre-primary education regarding generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and its potential role in education. The study is grounded in the constructivist-interpretive paradigm, adopting an understanding of learning as a process of active construction and negotiation of meanings. The empirical material was collected using a questionnaire consisting of open, exploratory questions. The participants were students who had already completed coursework related to didactics but had not yet taken courses on modern technologies. A non-probability purposive sampling strategy was applied. The collected data were analyzed using interpretative thematic analysis. The results reveal tension in students’ common understandings of GenAI. On the one hand, GenAI is perceived as a tool that increases teacher effectiveness and facilitates access to information. On the other hand, the same feature raises concerns about limiting students’ cognitive independence. The results further suggest that future teachers’ ways of thinking about GenAI may be closely related to their understanding of the nature of learning and educational culture. Therefore, the study highlights the need to incorporate reflection on GenAI into teacher education – not as a technical issue, but as a didactic one.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察早期儿童与学前教育专业学生对生成式人工智能及其在教育中潜在角色的日常概念，采用建构主义—解释取向，通过开放式探索性问题收集问卷资料，并用解释性主题分析处理。结果显示，学生对生成式AI的理解存在张力：一方面视其为提升教师效能、便利信息获取的工具，另一方面又担心同一特性会限制学生的认知独立性。研究进一步提示，未来教师对生成式AI的思考方式可能与其对学习本质和教育文化的理解密切相关，因此主张将生成式AI的反思纳入教师教育，且应作为教学法议题而非技术议题来处理。

papers.title: AI-driven design of a novel synthetic route to malaria drug ganaplacide
papers.authors: Fernando F. Huerta, Erik J. Leonhardt, Lianyan L. Xu, Trevor Laird, John Dillon, David M. Parry, Thomas Galeandro‐Diamant
papers.abstract: Malaria is a deadly infectious disease that disproportionately affects low- and middle-income countries. Ganaplacide is a drug candidate that is highly effective against malaria, and the ability to produce it at low cost is essential. Here we show how we used a combination of AI-driven design and expert chemistry knowledge to develop a novel synthetic route to ganaplacide. The AI retrosynthesis algorithm suggested a non-evident two-steps synthesis of the imidazolopiperazine core of the molecule from benzyl-protected dimethylpiperazinone through a strategic thioimidate intermediate. We also present the Synthetic Confidence Score, which assesses the level of risk associated with a given retrosynthetic disconnection and allows balancing creativity and reliability. The synergy between AI creativity, metrics such as the Synthetic Confidence Score and expert chemist knowledge has the potential to unlock non-evident efficient routes for important molecules, when expert chemists alone have explored mainstream chemistry unsuccessfully.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨如何结合AI驱动的设计与专家化学知识，为抗疟候选药物ganplacide开发新的合成路线。AI逆合成算法提出了一条非直观的两步路线，从苄基保护的二甲基哌嗪酮经硫代亚胺酸酯中间体构建咪唑并哌嗪核心；作者同时提出“合成置信度评分”，用于评估特定逆合成断键的风险，从而在创造力与可靠性之间取得平衡。文章认为，当仅靠专家化学家探索主流化学路线未获成功时，AI创造力、此类指标与专家知识的协同有望为重要分子找到非直观的高效路线。

papers.title: The flipped classroom model in medical education: A PRISMA-based systematic review
papers.authors: Shilpa Karkera, Ramesh Lolla, Maimuna HASSAN
papers.journal: Sri Ramachandra Journal of Health Sciences
papers.abstract: The flipped classroom (FC) model has obtained collective attention in medical education for its potential to enhance student engagement, active learning, and knowledge retention.This study systematically reviews the report on flipped classrooms in medical education using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta- Analyses (PRISMA) framework. Articles were retrieved from reputable databases, including PubMed, Medline, OVID, ACM, ScienceDirect, Taylor & Francis, MDPI, SAGE, SpringerLink, Wiley, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar.The 34 studies were identified exploring flipped classroom teaching approaches to enhance medical education. Review focuses on the tools and technologies employed such as video creation, learning management systems, podcasts, online assessments, and collaborative platforms as well as pedagogical strategies implemented across medical courses.This study focused on flipped learning in higher education. Future research should examine its application in other educational settings, including schools, vocational, technical, and professional training. Emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and augmented reality warrant investigation for their impact on student engagement and learning outcomes across disciplines. Further studies should also explore the influence of cultural and geographical factors on flipped classroom implementation and effectiveness. Additionally, research is needed to determine how flipped classroom activities can be tailored to specific learning objectives, student needs, and subject areas. Finally, longitudinal studies are recommended to assess the long- term effects of flipped learning on student achievement, retention, and academic success.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述基于PRISMA框架系统梳理了医学教育中翻转课堂的研究，检索多个数据库后纳入34项研究，重点关注视频制作、学习管理系统、播客、在线评估与协作平台等工具技术，以及各医学课程中实施的教学策略。文章指出，现有研究主要集中于高等教育情境，翻转课堂在提升学生参与、主动学习与知识保持方面的潜力受到关注，但向中小学、职业与技术培训等场景的推广尚待检验。作者据此提出未来应考察人工智能、增强现实等新兴技术对参与和学习结果的影响，并关注文化地理因素、教学活动的针对性设计以及长期效果。

papers.title: Federated, Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Heart Disease Prediction: A Literature Synthesis and a Proposed SHAP-Based Framework
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Heart disease is still the world's biggest killer, responsible for an estimated 19.8 million deaths in 2022 up from the 17.9 million figures for 2019 that gets cited so often in older papers.Machine learning models have gotten quite good at predicting cardiovascular risk, but two problems keep them out of the clinic: nobody can easily explain why a model flagged a given patient, and hospitals cannot legally pool their data to train better models in the first place.This paper looks at how federated learning (FL) and explainable AI (XAI) are being combined to deal with both problems at once, drawing on a review of twenty-eight peer-reviewed studies published between 2022 and 2026 that apply FL, ensemble learning, or XAI methods such as SHAP and LIME to cardiovascular data.Building on the gaps that review turns up, we propose FedX-Heart, a framework pairing a federated ensemble of Random Forest, XGBoost, and LSTM models with layered privacy protection (differential privacy, secure aggregation, k-anonymity) and dual SHAP/LIME explanations.The studies reviewed here report that federated training can match centralized accuracy (92.3% versus 90.1%), that stacking ensembles beat individual base learners (91-98% accuracy), that a transfer-learning ensemble reaches 98.2% accuracy with SHAP interpretability built in, and that adding k-anonymity costs only a few points of accuracy (83.21%).A synthesis of feature-importance findings across six SHAP-based studies turns up solid agreement on some predictors and real disagreement on others, and lining FedX-Heart up against its three closest predecessors shows that none of them covers federation, accuracy, privacy, and generalizability all at once.Taken together, it shows that relationship mastery and explanatory AI can blend out and deliver a lot of accuracy, though open questions remain around how privacy noise affects causes, how badly non-IID medical laboratory data hurts things in practice, and whether those protections penalize small patient subgroups.Even the FedX-Heart is a proposed design and not something we have tried, yet all need empirical validation before it should be clinically agreed upon.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕心脏病预测中机器学习模型难以解释、医院数据难以共享训练这两个临床落地障碍，综述了2022至2026年间28项将联邦学习与SHAP、LIME等可解释AI方法结合用于心血管数据的研究，并在此基础上提出FedX-Heart框架，把随机森林、XGBoost与LSTM的联邦集成同差分隐私、安全聚合、k-匿名等分层隐私保护及双重解释机制组合起来。综述中的研究报告联邦训练可达到与集中式训练相当的准确率，堆叠集成优于单一基学习器，加入k-匿名仅带来有限的准确率损失；六项基于SHAP的研究在部分预测因子上较为一致，在另一些因子上则存在分歧，且与三个最接近的已有框架相比，所提框架是唯一同时覆盖联邦、准确率、隐私与泛化性的设计。文章同时指出隐私噪声对因果解释的影响、非独立同分布医学检验数据的实际损害以及保护措施是否不利于小患者亚组仍待检验，且FedX-Heart本身只是提出方案，尚未经实证验证。

papers.title: Implementing AI-Assisted Diabetic Retinopathy Screening: A Qualitative Evidence Synthesis of Data Governance, Trust and Equity
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Diabetic retinopathy can be screened (assisted by artificial intelligence) in primary care and underserved contexts, and technical accuracy is irrelevant to whether patients and practitioners consider the service a legitimate offer.This secondary qualitative research study explored how trust, data ownership and equity are formed in empirical descriptions of AI-assisted retinal screening.A systematic search found 35 sources from 2016-2026.The findings were based on sixteen major articles published since 2021, whereas a different body informed the introduction, theoretical framework, research gap, methods and discussion of literature.This yielded three themes suggested by reflexive thematic synthesis: trust as a relational goal and not an assurance of accuracy alone; retinal data ownership is an open relationship of governance; equity is a dilemma of increased access and risk redistribution.Speed, convenience, and instant outcomes were well-regarded by patients, although this consideration faded as AI seemed to substitute clinical elucidation or reuse of data was opaque.Practitioners were open to AI when accountability, escalation channels, and training could be perceived, but raised anxieties over consent, accountability, information security, and skewed model performance.The greatest gains in access were most effective when AI was integrated within attainable care pathways, though inaccessible images, referral failure, digital savvy, and subgroup bias could recreate disparity.The paper finds that reliable AI eye screening entails human-controllable communication, purpose-driven data stewardship, and equity considerations throughout the screening process, not just at the algorithmic endpoint.The analytic focus is therefore multi-actor and system-level, integrating patient experience with practitioner readiness, institutional accountability, data governance and referral capacity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以二次定性研究综合的方式，考察在基层和资源不足场景中开展AI辅助视网膜筛查时，信任、数据所有权与公平如何形成。作者系统检索并综合相关实证文献，提炼出三条主题：信任是关系性目标而非仅靠准确率保证；视网膜数据所有权是开放的治理关系；公平则是在扩大可及性与风险再分配之间的两难。患者看重速度与即时结果，但当AI替代临床解释或数据再利用不透明时，这种认可会减弱；从业者在问责、转诊通道和培训可感知时更愿接受AI，但仍担忧知情同意、信息安全与模型偏差。文章据此指出，可靠的AI筛查需要贯穿全程的人可控沟通、目的明确的数据治理与公平考量，而不仅取决于算法端。该综述梳理的是已有实证描述，未开展新的实证实验。

papers.title: Educational Innovation In Health: Impact Of Digital Technologies On Clinical Training
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of digital technologies has transformed health sciences education, particularly in the field of clinical training.This systematic review aimed to analyze the impact of digital technologies on clinical training in health sciences education.The review was conducted following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines.A comprehensive literature search was performed in three major databases: Scopus, PubMed/MEDLINE, and Web of Science.The search initially identified 498 records.After removing duplicates and applying eligibility criteria, 18 studies were included in the qualitative synthesis.The included studies examined various digital technologies applied to clinical education, including simulation-based learning systems, artificial intelligence tools, digital learning platforms, and online educational resources.Overall, the findings indicate that digital technologies significantly enhance clinical training by improving procedural skills, clinical reasoning, and student engagement.Simulation environments and virtual learning systems provide safe and controlled settings where students can practice clinical procedures without compromising patient safety.Additionally, digital educational platforms facilitate flexible learning and promote the development of digital competencies among healthcare students and professionals.Despite these benefits, challenges such as technological infrastructure limitations and the need for faculty training remain important considerations.In conclusion, digital technologies represent a valuable strategy for strengthening clinical education and preparing healthcare professionals for increasingly technology-driven healthcare systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA 2020指南，在三个数据库中检索并筛选出18项研究，分析数字技术对健康科学临床教学的影响。所纳入研究涉及模拟学习系统、人工智能工具、数字学习平台和在线教育资源等。总体来看，这些技术有助于提升操作技能、临床推理和学生参与度，模拟与虚拟环境还能在不危及患者安全的前提下提供受控练习机会，数字平台则支持灵活学习并促进数字能力发展。文章同时指出技术基础设施限制和师资培训需求仍是重要制约，并据此认为数字技术可作为加强临床教育的策略。

papers.title: An Observational Study on the Effect of Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana in Lifestyle Disorders with Special Reference to Obesity
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Background: Obesity is a major lifestyle disorder and an emerging global public health concern associated with increased morbidity and reduced quality of life.In Ayurveda, obesity is described as Sthaulya, a SantarpanajanyaVyadhi resulting by improper or Faulty dietary habits, sedentary lifestyle and impaired metabolic functions.Among the dietary principles described in the classical texts, Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana provides comprehensive guidelines regarding the proper method of food consumption to maintain health and prevent disease.However, adherence to these dietary principles has declined considerably in modern society, contributing to the increasing burden of obesity.Aim: To evaluate the effect of Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana in lifestyle disorders with special reference to obesity.Materials and Methods: This observational study included 174 obese participants aged 20-40 years selected through stratified random sampling.Participants with a Body Mass Index (BMI) between >25 and <30 kg/m² were enrolled.Assessment was carried out using anthropometric parameters including BMI, waist circumference, waist-hip ratio, neck circumference, wrist circumference, body fat percentage, and lipid profile (HDL, LDL and triglycerides).Clinical evaluation was performed using the signs and symptoms of Sthaulya and adherence to the principles of Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana.The collected data were analyzed using appropriate descriptive and inferential statistical methods. Results:The study demonstrated a significant association between adherence to Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana and improved anthropometric and metabolic parameters.Participants following the recommended dietary principles exhibited better BMI, body fat percentage, waist circumference, and lipid profile compared with those showing poor adherence.Compliance with proper dietary practices was also associated with reduced severity of the clinical manifestations of Sthaulya.Conclusion: The findings suggest that Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana plays an important role in the prevention and management of obesity.Incorporating these classical Ayurvedic dietary guidelines into daily life may serve as an effective, economical, and sustainable lifestyle strategy for reducing obesity and improving metabolic health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以阿育吠陀经典中的饮食规范（Aahar-Vidhi-Vidhana）为切入点，采用观察性设计考察肥胖这一生活方式障碍，对象为肥胖人群，通过人体测量指标、血脂及Sthaulya症状与饮食规范依从性进行评估。结果显示，对该饮食原则的依从性与更好的BMI、体脂率、腰围及血脂状况相关，依从较好者的Sthaulya临床表现也相对较轻。作者据此认为，这些经典饮食指南可能对肥胖的预防与管理有作用，可作为日常生活中的生活方式策略；但作为观察性研究，其发现属于关联而非因果效果。

papers.title: THE EFFECTIVENESS OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN IMPROVING STUDENTS’ CRITICAL READING SKILLS AT EFL STUDENTS OF SULTAN AGENG TIRTAYASA UNIVERSITY
papers.authors: Yudi Juniardi, Tazkia Aghnia Aulia
papers.journal: Prosiding Konferensi Linguistik Tahunan Atma Jaya (KOLITA)
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in improving students’ critical reading skills in higher education. As digital technologies increasingly shape learning environments, AI offers potential to enhance higher-order thinking. This research employed a quantitative approach using a quasi-experimental one-group pretest–posttest design. The participants were 30 sixth-semester students enrolled in the Qualitative Research on ELT course at Universitas Sultan Ageng Tirtayasa, selected through purposive sampling. The instrument was a standardized critical reading test measuring students’ ability to identify main ideas, analyze arguments, evaluate evidence, detect bias, and draw conclusions. It included multiple-choice and short-response items to assess analytical comprehension. The treatment integrated AI-based tools for text analysis, summarization, argument mapping, and reflective questioning. Students also compared their interpretations with AI-generated feedback to enhance metacognitive awareness. The intervention was conducted over four meetings under guided supervision. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and a paired-sample t-test. The findings revealed a statistically significant improvement in students’ posttest scores compared to pretest results at the 0.05 level. These results indicate that AI can effectively support critical reading development and foster deeper engagement with academic texts in EFL contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察人工智能能否提升高校英语学习者的批判性阅读能力，采用单组前后测准实验设计，以批判性阅读测试为工具，在四次有指导的教学中让学生借助AI进行文本分析、摘要、论证梳理和反思性提问，并与AI反馈对照自己的理解。结果显示，学生后测成绩较前测有统计显著提高，表明AI辅助有助于批判性阅读发展和更深入的学术文本参与。不过，单组设计缺少对照组，提升是否由AI本身造成仍需谨慎判断。

papers.title: STUDENTS’ PERCEPTIONS ON AI TRANSLATION: A THEMATIC ANALYSIS
papers.authors: Clara Herlina Karjo
papers.journal: Prosiding Konferensi Linguistik Tahunan Atma Jaya (KOLITA)
papers.abstract: In addition to the availability of machine translation technologies such as Google Translate, people now have the option of employing Generative AI to carry out the translation tasks. GenAI is capable of producing translations in any language in a quick and efficient manner. Students in English department who might be interested in pursuing careers as language translators in the future, should have mastered artificial intelligence technologies in order to thrive in the world that is always changing. The purpose of this study is to investigate the students’ perceptions regarding the employment of artificial intelligence tools such as ChatGPT for translating texts. This study was presented with two research questions, which are as follows: To what extent do students position AI translation tools in relation to human translation? When it comes to the employment of artificial intelligence for translation, what benefits and concerns shapes students’ attitude toward AI translation use? In order to collect the necessary information for this study, interviews were conducted with twenty-two students from English department at Binus University who were enrolled in Translation course. The interview transcripts were used as the data for this study, and they were analysed qualitatively using thematic analysis framework developed by Braun and Clarke (2006). There are three fundamental steps involved in doing thematic analysis. Starting with initial open coding, which involves classifying data into codes. The second step is grouping the similar codes and finally, defining and naming the themes for each group. Results show that five themes appear in this analysis. These are: conditional acceptance of AI translation, perceived advantages of AI translation, concerns about overdependence, human superiority in meaning, and ethical and institutional boundaries. The findings suggest that even though artificial intelligence translation is effective, it is still a limited tool that must continue to be controlled by humans.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察英语系学生如何看待以ChatGPT为代表的生成式人工智能翻译工具，并将其与人工翻译相对照。作者对修读翻译课程的22名学生进行访谈，用主题分析法归纳出五个主题：对AI翻译的有条件接受、感知到的优势、对过度依赖的担忧、人类在意义理解上的优势，以及伦理与制度边界。结果显示，学生虽认可AI翻译高效，但普遍视其为仍需人类掌控的有限工具，而非可替代人工翻译的方案。

papers.title: DIRECTIVE SPEECH ACTS IN RESEARCHER–AI INTERACTION: A REFLEXIVE CASE STUDY OF ACADEMIC JOURNAL SUBMISSION
papers.authors: Agung Pramujiono, Tri Indrayanti
papers.journal: Prosiding Konferensi Linguistik Tahunan Atma Jaya (KOLITA)
papers.abstract: This study investigates the realisation and interactional functions of directive speech acts in researcher–AI communication through a reflexive case study of an academic journal submission. While directive speech acts have been extensively examined in human–human institutional interactions, limited empirical attention has been paid to how directives are constructed and deployed when the addressee is an artificial intelligence (AI) system operating within digitally mediated academic workflows. As AI systems increasingly assist scholars in writing and navigating editorial platforms, it is necessary to examine how action, authority, and epistemic responsibility are negotiated in human–AI interactions. This study addresses this gap by analysing a naturally occurring dialogue between a researcher and ChatGPT during the real-time submission of a manuscript to an international Q1 journal. The dataset comprised a complete 46-turn interaction sequence, from which 16 researcher-initiated directive moves were identified as primary units of analysis. Adopting a qualitative reflexive case study design, the analysis draws on speech act theory (Searle, 1976), interactional epistemics (Heritage, 2012), and relational work (Locher & Watts, 2008) to examine the linguistic realisation and functional deployment of directives across submission stages. The findings reveal that directives are predominantly realised through interrogative constructions rather than bald imperatives. WH-questions (e.g., “What should I do?”) and yes/no interrogatives pragmatically function as action-eliciting moves, particularly at moments of procedural uncertainty. These interrogatives enable the researcher to seek guidance while mitigating imposition, constructing AI as a procedural authority without an overt command. In addition to interrogatives, mitigated imperatives (e.g. “please explain”) and declarative problem reports (e.g., “I clicked OK, but there is no response”) operate as directive resources, demonstrating that directive force is interactionally achieved rather than strictly encoded in the grammatical mood. Functionally, four directive categories emerged: procedural guidance, explanatory mediation, confirmation for epistemic risk management, and evaluative positioning. Procedural guidance directives are clustered during technically opaque stages, such as PDF generation and final approval. Explanatory directives seek clarification of institutional prompts, positioning AI as an interpretive mediator. Confirmation directives appear before irreversible actions, reflecting heightened epistemic caution. A smaller subset of evaluative directives solicits normative stances regarding open-access decisions, extending human–AI interaction into moral reasoning. Directive density increases in phases characterised by institutional opacity, suggesting a correlation between procedural risks and directive production. Notably, directives are consistently mitigated through relational address terms and politeness markers despite the AI’s nonhuman status. This persistence of mitigation indicates that relational framing may function as a routinised communicative schema rather than solely as a face-protecting adjustment. Overall, this study argues that directives in researcher–AI interactions operate as mechanisms of institutional navigation and epistemic regulation rather than coercive command structures, contributing to empirical insights into the emerging field of human–AI pragmatics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一位研究者向国际期刊投稿期间与ChatGPT的完整对话为个案，考察研究者—AI互动中指令言语行为的实现方式与互动功能。分析发现，指令多通过疑问句而非直接祈使句表达，并辅以缓和性祈使句和陈述性问题报告，指令力度在互动中协商达成而非由语法语气直接编码。功能上可归纳为程序引导、解释中介、确认以管理认知风险以及评价性定位四类，且在机构流程不透明的阶段指令密度上升。作者据此认为，此类指令更多是机构导航与认知调节的手段，而非强制性命令结构，并提示缓和策略在人机互动中可能已例行化。

papers.title: Transformasi Pedagogis Guru Kelas V MI dalam Merespon Akselerasi Teknologi AI pada Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia
papers.authors: Aisya Amelia, Prissilia Prahesta Waningyun
papers.journal: Pedagogik Journal of Islamic Elementary School
papers.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis adaptasi guru kelas V di MI Kaliputih, MI Tirtomoyo, dan MI Pejagatan dalam menanggapi akselerasi teknologi Artificial Intelligence (AI) pada pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia. Menggunakan pendekatan studi kasus kualitatif, data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi terhadap tiga guru kelas V. Sumber data utama yakni, Ibu Eva Kholifah, S.Pd.I, Bapak Yatino, S.Pd.I, dan Ibu Khotimah, S.Pd. Analisis ini memuat tiga tahapan utama yang saling berkaitan, yakni reduksi data, penyajian data, hingga tahap akhir berupa penarikan Kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan guru mulai bertransformasi ke paradigma digital, meskipun taraf pengadopsiannya bervariasi. Pembelajarannya masih didominasi pendekatan teacher-centered melalui Canva dan media audiovisual, di MI Tirtomoyo yang menerapkan evaluasi interaktif Quizizz Barcode. Adanya teknologi AI memudahkan guru merancang modul ajar sekaligus mengoptimalkan proses evaluasi siswa agar lebih efektif dan efisien. Kendala yang dihadapi meliputi keterbatasan jaringan internet, akses platform berbayar, serta minimnya pelatihan formal. Solusi mandiri dicapai melalui persiapan materi offline , penggunaan fitur gratis, dan diskusi sejawat. Disimpulkan bahwa adaptasi AI memerlukan dukungan infrastruktur serta pelatihan literasi digital yang terstruktur bagi pendidik.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了印尼三所伊斯兰小学五年级教师在印尼语学习中如何应对人工智能技术的加速发展，采用定性案例研究，通过观察、访谈和文档分析三位教师的实践。研究发现，教师已开始向数字范式转变，但采纳程度不一，教学仍以教师为中心，借助Canva、视听媒体及Quizizz条码互动评价等工具；AI技术主要帮助教师设计教学模块并优化评价过程。教师面临网络受限、付费平台访问困难及正式培训不足等障碍，并通过离线准备、使用免费功能和同事讨论自行应对。文章据此认为，AI适应需要基础设施支持和结构化的数字素养培训。

papers.title: PENERAPAN GAMIFIKASI BERBASIS PROYEK UNTUK MENINGKATKAN MOTIVASI BELAJAR MURID SMP
papers.authors: Mohamad Saiful Anwar Sri Rumini, Aditya Hanif Nursolichin, Sukirman, Heru Hadiyono
papers.abstract: This study was initiated by the uneven learning motivation among junior high school students in Coding and Artificial Intelligence (CAI) subjects. The research aims to enhance students’ learning motivation through a project-based gamification strategy. The method employed was Classroom Action Research (CAR) based on the Kemmis and McTaggart model, conducted in two cycles with 31 students as subjects. The learning process implemented Project-Based Learning (PjBL) integrated with six gamification elements (clear goals, points, challenges, badges, feedback, and leaderboards) through a simple Scratch game development project. Data were collected using an adapted Motivated Strategies for Learning Questionnaire (MSLQ), observations, field notes, and documentation, and analyzed descriptively. The results showed an increase in students’ learning motivation, with the classical average rising from 3.06 (76.39%) in the pre-cycle to 3.24 (81.00%) in Cycle I and 3.38 (84.39%) in Cycle II, and all motivation aspects improving. Students reaching the minimum “High” criterion (score ≥ 3.00) increased from 51.61% (16 students) in the pre-cycle to 77.42% (24 students) in Cycle I, and reached the classical success target at 80.65% (25 students) in Cycle II. In Cycle II, a layered troubleshooting strategy using a Generative AI chatbot as a coding assistant, followed by peer feedback, appeared to support more persistent and independent problem-solving, although the gains were moderate and uneven across students, and self-regulation remained the lowest-scoring aspect (3.09). In conclusion, project-based gamification was accompanied by an increase in junior high school students’ learning motivation in CAI subjects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对初中编程与人工智能课程中学生学习动机不均的问题，采用基于Kemmis和McTaggart模型的课堂行动研究，在31名学生中实施整合六项游戏化要素的项目式学习，并以改编的学习动机策略问卷、观察和文档资料进行描述性分析。结果显示，学生动机的班级均值从实施前的3.06逐轮升至3.24和3.38，达到“高”标准的学生比例由51.61%增至77.42%，并在第二轮达到80.65%的班级成功目标，各动机维度均有改善。第二轮引入生成式AI聊天机器人作为编程助手并配合同伴反馈后，学生的问题解决表现出更强的持续性，但提升幅度中等且学生间不均衡，自我调节仍是得分最低的维度。研究据此认为，项目式游戏化伴随了学生动机的提高。

papers.title: Medical Staff Perceptions of Artificial Intelligence Integration in Clinical Practice in Kazakhstan: Mixed Methods Study (Preprint)
papers.authors: Zarina Zhumanova, Ainur Khassenova, Simeon Nanovsky, Bauyrzhan Sagimbekov
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly positioned as the next stage of healthcare digital transformation, and substantial public and institutional resources are being directed toward its implementation. The main risk to this investment is not the absence of technology but poor implementation: an AI system can be technically sound yet clinically unused if physicians do not trust it, cannot understand its outputs, or remain solely liable for the decisions it informs. This risk is especially salient in Kazakhstan, where earlier waves of healthcare digitalization did not automatically translate into easier clinical work. OBJECTIVE This study examined how medical staff at the University Medical Center (UMC) Corporate Fund in Astana perceive AI integration into clinical practice, which factors predict openness to adoption, and what conditions would need to be met for declared openness to become responsible everyday use. The aim was to build an evidence-based, phased implementation framework for AI adoption in Kazakhstan’s healthcare system. METHODS A mixed-methods design combined a cross-sectional survey of 66 UMC healthcare professionals (5-point Likert items measuring digital confidence, perceived usefulness, trust/ethics, organizational readiness, and openness to AI use, analyzed with robust ordinary least squares regression) with six scenario-based, in-depth interviews with practitioners selected through purposive expert sampling. Interview transcripts were coded thematically in NVivo using a deductive-inductive approach. Quantitative and qualitative findings were integrated during interpretation. RESULTS Medical staff showed generally positive attitudes toward AI: 76% were open to daily use, 75% were willing to undergo training, and 73% would join pilot projects. Safety and explainability were particularly important, with 92% requiring AI to pose no patient-safety risks and 87% requiring transparent, explainable decisions. Organizational readiness was weaker: only 41% reported sufficient IT infrastructure and 46% sufficient training. Openness was significantly associated with digital confidence (β=0.551, P<.001), perceived usefulness (β=0.365, P=.039), organizational readiness (β=0.202, P=.034), and prior exposure to incorrect AI output (β=0.142, P=.008), while trust/ethics was not significant in the adjusted model (P=.69). Interviews highlighted three themes: continued verification even when AI confirmed clinicians’ judgments, prioritization of clinical judgment over algorithmic probability in high-risk situations, and the view that responsibility for AI-assisted decisions ultimately remains with physicians. CONCLUSIONS UMC medical staff are not resistant to AI; acceptance is conditional on explainability, patient safety, legal clarity, and institutional support that lags behind individual willingness. AI implementation should be treated as a governed institutional change process rather than technology procurement. We propose a six-domain implementation architecture – shared-accountability rules, certified clinical protocols, controlled pilots, role-specific training, clinically interpretable outputs, and infrastructure investment with error-monitoring – as a preliminary framework transferable to health systems facing similar digitalization legacies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳一家大学医疗中心的医护人员为对象，采用横断面问卷与情景访谈相结合的混合方法，考察他们对人工智能融入临床实践的看法、接纳意愿的预测因素，以及从表态支持走向日常负责使用的条件。结果显示，医护人员总体态度积极，多数愿意日常使用、接受培训并参与试点，但普遍要求AI不带来患者安全风险且决策可解释；相比之下，组织层面的IT基础设施和培训支持明显不足。开放性主要与数字信心、感知有用性和组织准备度相关，访谈则强调即便AI与判断一致仍会持续核验、高风险情境下优先临床判断、最终责任仍归医生。作者据此提出分阶段的实施框架，主张把AI落地视为有治理的机构变革而非单纯技术采购。

papers.title: Future urgency: who brings politics to the practice of technology? Difficult realities emerging in the AI and technology space
papers.authors: Gabriella Razzano
papers.journal: London School of Economics and Political Science Research Online (London School of Economics and Political Science)
papers.abstract: This paper examines who might legitimately bring political considerations into technology development, particularly in contexts where traditional government political actors are absent. Drawing on two generative AI academic-practitioner collaborations in South Africa (a civic participation tool review and a chatbot construction for research content), I draw attention to how digital inequality, funding dynamics, and interpersonal tensions shape knowledge production and decision-making in technology partnerships. The cases demonstrate examples of how technologist knowledge can be undervalued, particularly when it comes to considering the political dimensions of technology deployment. I also consider how poor interpersonal dynamics, which stem from technophobia and discomfort with technical expertise, may have a detrimental impact. These organisational-level challenges have significant implications for emerging AI governance frameworks that rely on collaborative risk assessments and impact evaluations. The paper proposes empathetic collaboration strategies between partners in a technology development process, and strategies that include explicit acknowledgment of inequality in African technology environments, clear communications, skills transfer, and shared normative visions focused on human wellbeing - rather than mere efficiency gains. Such approaches can constitute a resistance to technocapitalist obfuscation and enable more equitable co-creation of responsible AI systems amongst different actors.
papers.summary_zh: 该文基于南非两项生成式人工智能的学术—实践者合作案例，探讨在传统政府政治主体缺位时，谁有正当性将政治考量带入技术开发。作者指出，数字不平等、资助动态和人际张力会塑造技术合作中的知识生产与决策，技术专家知识在涉及技术部署的政治维度时尤其容易被低估，而技术恐惧和对专业能力的不适所引发的不良人际互动也可能造成损害。文章认为这类组织层面的挑战对依赖协作式风险评估与影响评估的新兴AI治理框架有重要含义，并提出以共情协作、明确承认非洲技术环境中的不平等、清晰沟通、技能转移和以人类福祉为共同规范愿景的策略，来推动更公平的负责任AI共同创造。

papers.title: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in Learning Writing of the Indonesian and Philippine Students
papers.authors: Ma. Vivienne S. Salon, Umar Fauzan, Siti Rosdiana, Sitti Hadijah
papers.journal: Indonesian Journal of EFL and Linguistics
papers.abstract: The integration of technology, particularly artificial intelligence (AI), has transformed foreign and second language learning, including the teaching and learning of writing. AI-based tools can help students find references quickly, paraphrase sentences, translate texts, and check grammar and sentence structure. This study investigated the kinds of AI tools used by Indonesian English as a Foreign Language (EFL) students and Philippine English as a Second Language (ESL) students in learning writing, how they used these tools across the stages of the writing process, and the weaknesses and ethical issues they perceived. A descriptive qualitative design was employed. The participants were students of the English Education Department of Universitas Islam Negeri (UIN) Sultan Aji Muhammad Idris Samarinda, Indonesia, and seven students enrolled in English-related programs at Central Mindanao University, the Philippines. The data were collected through interviews, observation, and documentation, analyzed using the interactive model of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña, and validated through triangulation. The findings showed that the Indonesian students used a wide range of tools, namely QuillBot, Grammarly, ChatGPT, DeepL, Perplexity AI, and Essay Writer, whereas the Philippine students relied mainly on ChatGPT, followed by Grammarly and Gemini. In both contexts, AI was used throughout the writing process, most intensively at the drafting stage and, among the Philippine students, also at the editing stage. The students acknowledged that AI sometimes produced inaccurate or overly general information and expressed concerns about dependency, while most Philippine students did not disclose their use of AI to their lecturers. These findings suggest that the students used AI selectively, according to their needs and abilities, and that clear institutional guidance on the responsible use of AI in writing is needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察印度尼西亚与菲律宾英语学习者在外语或第二语言写作学习中使用人工智能工具的情况、使用阶段及其感知到的局限与伦理问题，采用描述性质性设计，通过访谈、观察和文档收集资料。研究发现，印尼学生使用的工具种类较多，菲律宾学生则主要依赖ChatGPT，辅以Grammarly和Gemini；两国学生均在写作全过程中使用AI，其中起草阶段最为集中，菲律宾学生还在编辑阶段使用。学生指出AI有时会生成不准确或过于笼统的信息，并对依赖问题表示担忧，多数菲律宾学生未向教师说明自己使用了AI。作者据此认为，学生会依据自身需求和能力有选择地使用AI，并呼吁院校就写作中负责任地使用AI给出明确指引。

papers.title: Gender and Academic Level Differences in Artificial Intelligence Usage for Academic Writing in Indonesian Higher Education
papers.authors: Rafidah Amat, Ariyanti Ariyanti, Sukaena Sukaena, Agnes Veronika
papers.journal: Indonesian Journal of EFL and Linguistics
papers.abstract: The rapid spread of AI chatbots has begun to reshape how university students plan, draft, revise, and evaluate academic writing. Although recent studies have examined students’ perceptions of generative AI in higher education, less is known about how students in regional Indonesian universities understand and use these tools, particularly when viewed across gender, age, and academic level. This study investigated the perceptions and reported use of AI chatbots among 267 students from four universities in East Kalimantan. A mixed-method survey design was used. Quantitative responses were analyzed through descriptive statistics and Spearman’s rho correlation, while open-ended responses were coded to identify the AI tools students reported using for academic writing. The results show that AI use was widespread, with 94.76% of respondents indicating that they had used AI in academic writing. Students generally held positive views of AI chatbots, especially for improving writing effectiveness, language quality, and the revision process. At the same time, their responses revealed continuing ethical and pedagogical uncertainty, particularly around learning, authorship, and the boundary between assistance and cheating. Correlation analysis showed weak relationships between students’ perceptions and gender, age, or semester, suggesting that AI chatbot use was broadly shared across demographic groups. The study offers regional evidence from Indonesian higher education and underscores the need for clearer AI literacy instruction, responsible-use guidelines, and process-based academic writing pedagogy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注印尼东加里曼丹地区大学生在学术写作中使用AI聊天机器人的情况，以及这种使用和看法在性别、年龄与学业阶段上的差异。作者采用混合方法调查，对四所高校学生的问卷作答进行描述统计与相关分析，并对开放题回答进行编码。结果显示AI使用相当普遍，绝大多数受访者已在学术写作中使用过AI，整体态度偏正面，尤其认可其在提升写作效果、语言质量和修改过程方面的作用；但学生同时表达出对学习、作者身份以及“辅助”与“作弊”边界的伦理和教学层面的不确定。相关分析显示学生看法与性别、年龄或学期之间仅存在弱关联，提示AI使用在不同人群中较为普遍。文章据此强调需要更清晰的AI素养教育、负责任使用指南和过程性学术写作教学。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition: An Empirical Assessment of Recruitment Outcomes and Responsible Use
papers.authors: Mohan Manjunath, Patcha Bhujanga Rao
papers.journal: International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to source applicants, display screening packages, match candidates, communicate with applicants, and analyse workforce data. Processing speed alone does not indicate whether it is AI-powered. Recruitment outcomes also include shortlist relevance, applicant delight, recruiter productivity, and high-quality decisions. This study examines the relationship between AI adoption and five perceived skill-acquisition outcomes, drawing on questionnaire responses from 70 individuals. The analysis uses descriptive statistics, Cronbach's alpha, Pearson correlation, and separate simple linear regression. AI adoption undoubtedly improves recruitment performance (β = 0.546, R2 = 0.282), recruitment effectiveness (β = 0.514, R2 = 0.295), perceived candidate experience (β = 0.569, R2 = 0.363), recruiter productivity (β = 0.498, R2 = 0.329) and overall performance of talent acquisition (β = 0.341, R2 = 0.120). All five regression relationships are statistically significant at the 5% level. Candidate experience has the highest R2 among the five factors, while specific skill acquisition performance has the lowest. Additionally, respondents who report greater AI adoption tend to report more favourable recruiting outcomes, but the study does not establish causality or confirm changes in overall objective hiring performance. The article discusses these findings in relation to fairness, transparency, confidentiality, and human oversight. It recommends that firms assess the use of multiple end-result markers in AI-enabled hiring and conduct meaningful human assessment of the resulting options.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于70名受访者的问卷，考察招聘中对人工智能的采用与五项感知技能获取结果之间的关系，采用描述统计、信度检验、相关分析和简单线性回归。结果显示，AI采用与招聘绩效、招聘有效性、候选人体验、招聘人员生产力及人才获取整体表现均呈正向关联，其中候选人体验的解释力最高，具体技能获取表现最低。作者强调这些关联不能确立因果关系，也未证实客观招聘绩效的变化，并据此讨论公平、透明、保密与人工监督，建议企业综合使用多种结果指标并对AI生成的选项进行有意义的人工评估。
