papers.title: PENGEMBANGAN CHATBOT WHATSAPP BERBASIS DECISION TREE UNTUK OTOMATISASI INFORMASI PENDAFTARAN SANTRI BARU DI PESANTREN
papers.authors: Syahrul Hidayat, Alexius Endy Budianto, Ainia Walidaroyani
papers.journal: BIMASAKTI Jurnal Riset Mahasiswa Bidang Teknologi Informasi
papers.abstract: Digital transformation int he Islamic boarding school environment has prompted the need for a system that can simplify the registration process for new students. This study aims to develop a WhatsApp-based chatbot using the Decision Tree (CART) algorithm as a solution for automating information services and registration forms at the Salafiyah Shirothul Fuqoha Islamic Boarding School Salafiyah Shirothul Fuqoha'. The development method used is a prototyping model with stages of needs analysis, interaction flow design, branching logic implementation, and testing. The chatbot is designed to guide prospective students in accessing information, filling in data, determining dormitoriesbased on program type, and calculating total costs by adjusting to the user's economic conditions. The system was evaluated using a confusion matrix for 25 menu interactions, resulting in an accuracy of 76%, precision of 89.47%, recall of 80.95%, and an F1-score of 85.05%. These results indicate that the Chatbot performs well in accurately responding to structured inputs and is suitable for use in supporting the efficiency of pesantren administration. However, further development is needed in terms of input validation and system scalability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了一个基于WhatsApp的聊天机器人，采用决策树（CART）算法，旨在自动化为伊斯兰寄宿学校新生提供报名信息与登记服务。开发采用原型模型，涵盖需求分析、交互流程设计、分支逻辑实现与测试，机器人可引导用户获取信息、填写数据、按项目类型确定宿舍并依据经济状况计算总费用。系统以混淆矩阵对25项菜单交互进行评估，准确率为76%、精确率89.47%、召回率80.95%、F1值为85.05%，表明其在响应结构化输入方面表现较好，可辅助提升行政效率；但作者也指出输入验证与系统可扩展性仍需改进。

papers.title: Machine Learning Meets Blockchain: A Domain-Oriented Review of Integration Mechanisms, Applications, and Open Challenges
papers.authors: Md Sultanul Arefin Afnan, Zhehuan Zhao, Chaimae Yzem
papers.abstract: Blockchain and machine learning (ML) are combined in systems that must learn from multi-party data and keep a verifiable record of what was used and decided. This scoping-style review of a ranked sample covers seven domains: healthcare, finance, supply chain, energy, smart contracts, transportation and education. We searched Scopus and IEEE Xplore on 15 October 2026, ranked 5,195 candidate records, read 345 abstracts in rank order, coded a core corpus of 192 studies and read 38 in full. Federated learning is the most common method (93 of 192 core studies name it), and detection of fraud, intrusions and vulnerabilities is the most common task among the 38. None of the 38 reports a deployment, 24 report a measured ledger figure and two measure ledger energy. Ten use more than one privacy mechanism, and only two report accuracy with and without it. Attack tests are small, and one study tests a Sybil attacker. Studies differ too much to compare, so we do not rank domains. A ledger shows that a record has not changed, not that it was correct when written. The main gaps are realistic evaluation, shared benchmarks and reporting standards, and tested explanations for decisions made inside contracts.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以范围性方式梳理了机器学习与区块链在医疗、金融、供应链、能源、智能合约、交通和教育七个领域的整合机制与应用现状，核心语料来自按排序抽取的192项研究。作者发现联邦学习是最常见的方法，欺诈、入侵和漏洞检测是最常见的任务，但纳入全文阅读的研究均未报告实际部署，且攻击测试规模小、隐私机制与准确率的对照报告很少。由于研究之间差异过大，作者未对领域进行排序，并指出主要缺口在于现实评估、共享基准和报告规范，同时强调账本只能证明记录未被改动，不能证明写入时正确。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Middle and Secondary Education: Instructional Opportunities, Limitations and Ethical Considerations
papers.authors: Adam Stefanile
papers.abstract: Middle and secondary school educators should utilize and implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a support tool for instruction, not a replacement for their pedagogy and lesson planning. Utilizing and implementing AI can assist with lesson planning, differentiation, feedback, and generating learning materials; and its uses should be guided by clear expectations, professional judgment, and school policy. Educators should also teach their students how to use AI ethically, verify outputs for accuracy and bias, and protect student privacy by avoiding sensitive data. Most importantly, assessments should be designed to show genuine student understanding, with AI used transparently and appropriately. The best available published advice concurs that the usage of AI within an educator’s pedagogy significantly enhances middle and secondary school students’ learning. This article offers practical guidance for educators who use or plan to use AI in the classroom, while also highlighting policy recommendations to support effective educational practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕中小学教育中如何定位和使用人工智能展开，属于面向教育者的实践指导而非实证研究。文章主张AI应作为教学的辅助工具，用于备课、差异化教学、反馈和学习材料生成，但不能取代教师的教学法与课程设计，其使用需受明确预期、专业判断和学校政策的约束。文章同时强调应教学生合乎伦理地使用AI、核查输出的准确性与偏见、避免输入敏感数据以保护隐私，并让评估能体现学生真实理解。作者指出，现有公开建议一致认为在教师教学法框架内使用AI能显著增强中小学生学习，并据此提出配套的政策建议。

papers.title: 4Cast Lab: Open-Source App for Machine Learning & Statistical Analysis
papers.authors: Periklis Gogas
papers.abstract: 4Cast Lab is a free, open-source application for machine learning, econometrics and statistical analysis that runs on the user's own computer, with no installation, no programming and no data leaving the machine. It was developed at the E|M|E|F Lab, Department of Economics, Democritus University of Thrace, for researchers, analysts, instructors and students in any field. Its Forecasting mode trains eight learning algorithms (with three kernels for SVM/SVR), implemented from scratch, under leakage-safe validation for time-ordered data; it selects models by cross-validation, compares the selected model with every alternative and with naive benchmarks through formal tests of predictive accuracy, and documents each run in a methods report and a Python script that the user can export. Its Estimation mode covers the core of applied econometrics, from OLS with robust inference to ARIMA, ARDL, VAR/VECM and GARCH. This paper describes the design, the interface and the workflow of version 4.6.2, reports a validation of 1,234 numerical results against statsmodels, linearmodels, arch, scikit-learn and NIST certified values, illustrates the workflow with three examples, and discusses current limitations.
papers.summary_zh: 该文介绍了一款名为4Cast Lab的免费开源桌面应用，用于机器学习、计量经济学与统计分析，用户无需安装、编程，数据也不离开本机。文章描述了4.6.2版的设计、界面与工作流程，并报告将1,234项数值结果与statsmodels、linearmodels、arch、scikit-learn及NIST认证值进行比对验证，还用三个示例展示使用流程。其预测模式在防泄漏验证下训练八种算法，通过交叉验证选模并与备选模型及朴素基准做正式预测精度检验，可导出方法报告和Python脚本；估计模式覆盖从OLS稳健推断到ARIMA、ARDL、VAR/VECM和GARCH等常用计量方法。文末还讨论了当前局限。

papers.title: An Old Answer to a New Problem: The Degree-Free Model for Higher Education in the Age of AI
papers.authors: Boris Gorelik
papers.abstract: Generative AI has not created the governance crisis in higher education credentialing; it has made it harder to ignore. The academic degree is higher education’s principal instrument for governing access to occupations. Its signaling value depends on assessed work reflecting individual competence. AI weakens that link: in blind marking, AI-written exam answers went largely undetected and, on average, outscored students, while detection tools trail each new model. Strengthening surveillance restores procedural control only at the cost of assessment validity. Drawing on credentialism and signaling theory, this paper argues that the response may need to include institutional redesign, not only pedagogical adjustment. It proposes a degree-free model, illustrated by the yeshiva: a centuries-old institution organized around formation, community, and recognized mastery rather than certification. Labor markets already partly follow this logic, as employers substitute direct observation of performance for the degree within three to five years of hire. Three recommendations follow. Outside safety-critical fields, institutions could stop issuing degrees while continuing to teach. Public investment should shift from surveillance-based assessment toward authentic evaluation. Reform should be differentiated by field, retaining mandatory credentialing in licensed and safety-critical professions. The model is offered as a proposition for debate, not a blueprint.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论生成式AI为何使高等教育学位认证的治理危机更难被忽视。作者援引文凭主义与信号理论指出，AI削弱了评估作业与个人能力之间的关联，而加强监控只能恢复程序性控制、却损害评估效度，因此回应可能需要制度重构而非仅教学调整。文章据此提出“无学位模式”，以长期围绕培养、社群与公认精通而非认证组织起来的机构为例，并建议非安全关键领域可停止授予学位但继续教学、公共投入转向真实性评估、改革按领域区分并保留持证与安全关键职业的强制认证；该模式是供讨论的提案而非蓝图。

papers.title: ALIGNING HIGHER EDUCATION WITH INDUSTRY NEEDS: EVALUATING A WORK-INTEGRATED COMPUTER SCIENCE PROGRAM
papers.authors: Harald Wah, A Mense
papers.abstract: The work-integrated Bachelor’s program in Computer Science at the UAS Technikum Wien combines academic education with professional practice to prepare graduates for the rapidly evolving information technology sector. To ensure that the program continues to achieve its educational objectives while responding to changing industry requirements, a comprehensive evaluation was conducted based on the institution’s seven quality objectives, including study feasibility, curriculum relevance, organizational effectiveness, learning support, teaching quality, international competencies, and the integration of research and development. The evaluation adopted a mixed-methods approach, combining qualitative and quantitative data collected through surveys of students, faculty, alumni, and industry partners, complemented by workshops that explored experiences with the integration of theory and practice, workload, communication, and curriculum organization. In addition, an occupational field analysis of more than 900 job advertisements identified current and emerging competence requirements, particularly in generative artificial intelligence, agile software development, and accessibility standards. Statistical indicators, including student performance, progression, dropout rates, and graduate employability, were also analyzed to provide a comprehensive assessment of program effectiveness. The findings demonstrate that the program’s strong practical orientation, close collaboration with industry, and successful integration of academic learning with workplace experience represent significant strengths that contribute to graduate employability. At the same time, opportunities for improvement were identified, including better alignment between courses, a more balanced workload distribution, enhanced communication structures, and curriculum updates. The proposed measures, including new courses on foundation models, revised career pathways, and the systematic integration of artificial intelligence and accessibility, are expected to strengthen curriculum relevance, improve the student learning experience, and ensure that graduates are well prepared for future challenges in the information technology profession.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究对维也纳应用技术大学（UAS Technikum Wien）的计算机科学工学结合本科项目进行了综合评估，依据院校七项质量目标，采用混合方法，收集学生、教师、校友和行业伙伴的问卷与工作坊数据，并分析900余份招聘广告及学业表现、升学、辍学和就业等统计指标。结果显示，项目实践导向强、与行业合作紧密、理论学习与职场经验融合较好，有助于提升毕业生就业能力；同时存在课程衔接、工作负荷分配、沟通结构和课程更新等方面的改进空间。作者据此提出开设基础模型课程、调整职业路径、系统融入人工智能与无障碍标准等措施，以增强课程相关性并改善学生学习体验。

papers.title: Dynamics of respiratory system functional status in female students of special medical group under the influence of a block-modular program implemented via the “SMG ACTIVE” chatbot
papers.authors: V. Z. Alieva, Бойко Наталия Александровна
papers.journal: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
papers.abstract: Importance . Female students in special medical groups (SMG) have reduced functional reserves, including those of the respiratory system. The integration of a digital tool into physical education may improve lung ventilation and hypoxia tolerance in SMG students. Aim of the study – to evaluate the dynamics of respiratory system functional status indicators in female SMG students under the influence of an academic year cycle of classes based on a block-modular program implemented via the “SMG ACTIVE” chatbot. Materials and Methods . The study involved 60 female SMG students (mean age 19.4 ± 0.7 years, height 166.6 ± 7.2 cm, weight 63.0 ± 15.2 kg, BMI 22.7 ± 5.8 kg/m²). Participants are divided into an experimental group (EG, n = 35) and a control group (CG, n = 25). The EG followed the author’s block-modular program, including an invariant (basic) and a variable (nosology-specialized) component, using the “SMG ACTIVE” chatbot for personalized exercise selection, self-monitoring, and feedback. The CG followed the traditional program (2 mandatory classes per week). At the beginning and end of the academic year, vital capacity (VC), Stange, Genchi, Serkin tests, and the Skibinskaya index are assessed. Results and Discussion. The EG showed significant improvements in VC/body weight (+9.8%, p < 0.05), Genchi test (+14.3%, p < 0.05) and Skibinskaya index (+26.7%, p < 0.05). No significant change is found for the Stange test. In the control group, only the Genchi test improved significantly (+5.7%, p < 0.05). 87.8% of EG students regularly used the chatbot; the number of independent sessions increased from 1.7 ± 0.6 to 5.3 ± 1.2 per week (p < 0.05). Conclusion . The nine-month academic year cycle of the block-modular program with the chatbot significantly improves several respiratory parameters in female SMG students, but the between-group difference for the Skibinskaya index did not reach statistical significance. The digital tool markedly enhances self-organization of physical activity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了通过“SMG ACTIVE”聊天机器人实施的模块化体育课程，对特殊医疗组女学生呼吸系统功能状态的影响。研究将参与者分为实验组和对照组，在学年前后评估肺活量、屏气测试及斯基宾斯卡娅指数等指标，发现实验组在肺活量/体重比、Genchi测试和斯基宾斯卡娅指数上有显著改善，而对照组仅Genchi测试有改善；但两组间斯基宾斯卡娅指数的差异未达统计显著。研究还显示多数实验组学生定期使用该聊天机器人，自主锻炼次数明显增加，提示该数字工具可能有助于提升身体活动的自我组织，但组间比较的局限需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Organizational and pedagogical conditions for training linguistics students to conduct formative assessment of written responses for the Unified State Examination using AI technologies
papers.authors: M. A. Ulshina
papers.journal: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
papers.abstract: Importance . The expanding linguistic and didactic potential of artificial intelligence technologies creates new opportunities for automated language processing, feedback provision, and assessment support, including in foreign language writing instruction. AI technologies are particularly significant in the implementation of formative assessment as a pedagogical technology, which requires a methodologically solid distribution of assessment functions between the teacher and artificial intelligence. This places specific demands on the training of linguistics students and the development of their analytical, assessment and reflection, and AI-related skills. At the same time, the organizational and pedagogical conditions for training linguistics students to conduct formative assessment of written responses for the Unified State Examination using AI technologies have not yet been specifically addressed in the research literature. Research Methods . Theoretical methods included analysis, comparison, synthesis, and systematization of scientific and methodological literature on formative assessment, future teachers’ readiness for professional activity, pedagogical design, staged learning, and professional reflection, as well as the analysis of regulatory and methodological documents defining the requirements for the language and professional training of linguistics students and secondary school graduates. Results and Discussion . The theoretical analysis identified and substantiated five organizational and pedagogical conditions for training linguistics students to conduct formative assessment of written responses for the Unified State Examination using AI technologies: B1–B2 proficiency in the foreign language, a professional and value-based attitude toward the use of AI, the development and integration of specialized methodological support, staged learning, and the organization of reflective assessment activities among linguistics students at all stages of training. The study determined the content of the specialized methodological support and the sequence of training stages, which involve a gradual reduction in teacher support and an increase in linguistics students’ learning autonomy. Conclusion . The implementation of the identified organizational and pedagogical conditions contributes to the targeted development of the analytical, assessment and reflection, and AI-related skills required for conducting formative assessment of written responses using AI technologies. In this context, AI serves as a tool for supporting assessment activities, while the responsibility for interpreting the results and making the final pedagogical decision remains with the future foreign language teacher.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦语言学专业学生使用人工智能技术对统一国家考试书面作答开展形成性评价的培养问题，指出相关组织与教学条件在既有文献中尚未得到专门讨论。作者采用理论分析方法，梳理形成性评价、教师专业准备、教学设计与阶段学习及反思等方面的文献，并结合规范与方法文件，提出五项组织与教学条件：外语达到B1—B2水平、形成对使用人工智能的专业价值态度、开发并整合专门的方法支持、实施阶段化学习，以及在培养各阶段组织反思性评价活动。研究还确定了方法支持的内容与训练阶段顺序，即逐步减少教师支持、提高学生的学习自主性。文章认为，落实这些条件有助于有针对性地发展学生开展此类评价所需的分析、评价与反思及人工智能相关能力，并强调人工智能只是评价活动的支持工具，结果解读与最终教学决策的责任仍由未来外语教师承担。

papers.title: Model for training law students in resolving international disputes in a foreign language using technological solutions based on artificial intelligence
papers.authors: Vadim Kharin
papers.journal: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
papers.abstract: Importance . Generative artificial intelligence technologies are rapidly penetrating all spheres of life, and education is no exception. The integration of neural networks into the educational process, which entails the transformation of traditional methodological approaches, opens up new opportunities for teachers to design lessons and monitor results, and provides students with additional tools for developing professional competencies. The growing importance of using AI technologies in the professional training of specialists creates a need for a systematic understanding of the principles of organizing the educational process and the creation of an appropriate methodological model. The aim of this study is to develop and describe a methodological model for teaching law students how to resolve international disputes in a foreign language using technological solutions based on artificial intelligence. Materials and Methods . The methodological basis of the study consisted of scientific literature analysis in the fields of pedagogy, psychology, and foreign language teaching methodology (including articles from Scopus and Web of Science databases, the list of the Higher Attestation Commission of the Russian Federation, and journals from the “White List”), as well as a method of observing the educational process of bachelor’s degree students in the field of study 40.03.01 “Jurisprudence,” within the framework of which an integrated course entitled “Foreign Language and Jurisprudence” is implemented. Results and Discussion . Within the framework of this study, a methodological model for teaching law students to resolve international disputes in a foreign language using AI-based technological solutions is developed, consisting of five blocks: prerequisites (requirements of the Federal State Educational Standard for Higher Education, contradictions, relevance), target (formation of law students’ competencies in the field of resolving international disputes in a foreign language using AI technology), theoretical (approaches: communicative-cognitive, integrated, the concept of informatization of education, the concept of integrating ICT and AI technologies into education; principles: functionality, novelty, situationality, speech orientation, continuity, dominance of problem-based professionally oriented tasks, compliance with information security rules, personalization, triad “student – artificial intelligence – teacher”), technological (content, means, methods, and forms of education), and evaluative. Conclusion . The developed model demonstrates a method for the systematic integration of artificial intelligence technologies into the educational process, ensuring the development of foreign-language communicative and professional competence among law students, and also contributing to their professional self-determination. The model’s testing during the training of bachelors in the field of study 40.03.01 “Jurisprudence” at Derzhavin Tambov State University confirms its practical effectiveness. The prospects for further research are related to refining the assessment criteria and expanding the AI tools used.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对法学专业学生用外语解决国际争端的教学需求，提出并描述了一套基于人工智能技术解决方案的方法论模型。作者以教育学、心理学与外语教学法文献分析为基础，结合对法学本科“外语与法学”综合课程教学过程的观察，构建了包含前提、目标、理论、技术与评价五个模块的模型，强调“学生—人工智能—教师”三方协同及信息安全教育等原则。文章称该模型在坦波夫国立大学法学本科教学中经过检验，确认了其实践有效性，并指出后续将细化评价标准、扩展所用AI工具。

papers.title: A comparative analysis of generative neural networks’ and AI correctors’ effectiveness in assessing written creative works in a foreign language
papers.authors: P. S. Zimin, Olga Evgenjevna Shults, Galina M. Pervova
papers.journal: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
papers.abstract: Importance . The active integration of artificial intelligence technologies into the pedagogical process and the continuous development of generative artificial intelligence and AI-based correctors make it possible to speed up and simplify the review of students’ written creative works for teachers. In addition, students’ extracurricular practice with AI, aimed at obtaining evaluative and corrective feedback, creates additional conditions for the development of writing skills. However, the question remains relevant: which of the generative AI tools is the most effective in assessing students’ written creative works and providing them with feedback. The aim of the study is to conduct a comparative analysis and determine which AI tool (generative neural networks DeepSeek, ChatGPT, and AI correction tools Grammarly, PaperRater) is the most effective in assessing students’ written creative works. Materials and Methods . For comparison, argumentative essays (N = 117) written by students majoring in “Pedagogical Education” at Derzhavin Tambov State University are used. The students’ level of English proficiency corresponded to level B1. The assessment is carried out using two generative AI systems (DeepSeek, ChatGPT) and two AI proofreaders (Grammarly, PaperRater). Generative neural networks evaluated the works based on five criteria (structure, grammar, vocabulary, logic, and argumentation) on a scale from 1 to 5, using a developed prompt, while AI proofreaders worked in the standard mode. Results and Discussion . The analysis revealed that generative neural networks (DeepSeek, ChatGPT) provide quantitative and qualitative assessment of written works based on such criteria as grammar, spelling, punctuation, structure, and text content. In accordance with the prompts, they are capable of providing the user with detailed and comprehensive feedback. AI proofreaders are capable of identifying grammatical, lexical, and punctuation errors in a text and providing recommendations on how to correct words or shorten sentences. However, their feedback regarding structure and content is generic and formal, which prevents them from being used for comprehensive text revision. Conclusion . The study showed that the choice of an AI tool for evaluating written creative work directly depends on the purpose of the assessment. Generative neural networks are useful for in-depth text analysis: they provide a detailed assessment of the structure, logic, and arguments, and offer comprehensive corrective feedback. AI proofreaders are well suited for quickly checking for errors: they help identify grammatical, lexical, and punctuation errors and can help restructure a sentence or find synonyms for repeated words.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了生成式神经网络（DeepSeek、ChatGPT）与AI校对工具（Grammarly、PaperRater）在评估学生外语创意写作时的效果，以B1水平学生的议论文为对象，由两类工具分别评分或纠错。结果显示，生成式神经网络能依据结构、语法、词汇、逻辑和论证等标准给出定量与定性评价，并按提示提供详细反馈；AI校对工具则擅长识别语法、词汇和标点错误并给出修改建议，但在结构与内容方面的反馈较为笼统和程式化。作者据此指出，工具选择取决于评估目的：前者适合深入分析文本，后者适合快速查错，这一区分对教学中的写作反馈实践具有参考意义。

papers.title: Corpus data in the age of generative artificial intelligence: continuity of digital methods in foreign language education
papers.authors: Качурин Иван Дмитриевич
papers.journal: Вестник Тамбовского университета. Серия: Гуманитарные науки
papers.abstract: Importance . Generative artificial intelligence in language education renews the question of sufficient grounds for language decisions because chat systems often do not disclose the origin of examples or the procedure behind conclusions. Research purpose – to test the hypothesis that corpus data retain methodological value by making language hypotheses open to observable and reproducible checks. Materials and Methods . A targeted integrative review covered 27 scholarly publications and policy documents: foundational and review studies of data-driven learning, research on generative artificial intelligence, Russian-language evidence, and early hybrid projects. Twenty-four sources were examined in full text; three were used at the abstract and metadata level. Results and Discussion. Corpus-based language pedagogy has a more mature evidence base for immediate vocabulary and lexicogrammar outcomes. Research on generative artificial intelligence remains limited by short interventions, university samples, writing tasks, and self-reports. The synthesis produced six stages: task definition, hypothesis generation, corpus search, interpretation, application, and transfer assessment. Conclusion . The hypothesis received partial support: the literature substantiates the checking function of corpora, but the proposed sequence has not been tested comparatively. The findings can inform the design and evaluation of foreign language courses that combine a generative system with corpus data.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以整合性综述方式考察生成式人工智能进入外语教育后，语料库数据是否仍具方法论价值，梳理了数据驱动学习、生成式人工智能研究及早期混合项目等文献。作者提出任务界定、假设生成、语料检索、解释、应用与迁移评估六阶段框架，认为语料库能为语言假设提供可观察、可复现的检验，但这一序列尚未经过对比检验；同时指出生成式人工智能研究多受短期干预、大学生样本、写作任务与自我报告限制。结论仅部分支持原假设，相关发现可用于设计兼顾生成系统与语料数据的外语课程。

papers.title: ChatGPT’s effect on EFL students’ simple past tense accuracy in narrative text writing
papers.authors: Made Restu Grianata, Eusabinus Bunau, Eka Fajar Rahmani
papers.journal: Journal of English Language Teaching and Learning (JETLE)
papers.abstract: Grammar errors are a common problem encountered by senior high school EFL students when writing narrative texts. This study aimed to examine changes in students' simple past tense accuracy following the use of ChatGPT feedback in narrative writing. A pre-experimental one-group pre-test and post-test design was employed with 21 students from Class XI at SMAN 1 Sungai Raya, Kubu Raya Regency, West Kalimantan, Indonesia. The intervention was conducted in one session, during which students used ChatGPT 3.5 through their personal smartphones to obtain feedback on their narrative writing. The feedback focused on simple past tense accuracy, and students used the suggestions to revise their texts. Data were collected through pre-test and post-test writing tasks and analyzed using a paired-samples t-test and effect size analysis. The results showed a statistically significant improvement in students' scores (p = 0.010), with an effect size of 0.62, indicating a medium effect according to Cohen's criteria. These findings suggest that ChatGPT feedback was associated with improved simple past tense accuracy in narrative writing. However, the absence of a comparison group limits conclusions about its causal effects. Therefore, it cannot be concluded that the improvement that students got is solely due to the use of ChatGPT
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察高中英语学习者在叙事写作中使用ChatGPT反馈后，一般过去时准确性的变化，采用单组前后测设计，让学生借助个人手机获取并应用反馈修改作文。结果显示，前后测成绩出现统计上显著的提升，效应量属中等水平，表明ChatGPT反馈与过去时准确性改善相关。但研究没有设置对照组，作者明确提醒不能将进步单独归因于ChatGPT，也无法据此得出因果结论。

papers.title: Effects of Digital Tools on Design Cognition in the Conceptual Phase
papers.authors: So Yeon Kim, Seung Jin Chung
papers.journal: The International Journal of Visual Design
papers.abstract: The rapid development of digital technology has significantly influenced the entire design process, particularly the conceptual phase, affecting designers’ cognition and creativity. This study systematically reviewed the literature to provide a comprehensive understanding of how digital tools support design cognition in the conceptual design phase and identify future research directions. The findings indicate that individual digital tools offer various advantages, such as providing broader perspectives, facilitating rapid idea development, and enhancing motivation. However, the strength and generalizability of the evidence were constrained by limitations in participant sampling and variation in reliability and validity procedures across studies. The review identified key areas for future research, including exploring the cognitive benefits of artificial intelligence (AI) design tools with designers, applying innovative methods and analyses to understand design cognition, examining the benefits of digital tools in simulated professional design environments, and exploring distributed collaborative design settings. The study highlighted the need for further research to deepen understanding of digital tools and their application in conceptual design.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了数字工具在概念设计阶段如何影响设计师的认知与创造力。研究发现，各类数字工具各有优势，如拓展视角、加快构思和提升动机，但证据强度与可推广性受参与者抽样局限及研究信效度程序差异的限制。文章据此提出未来研究方向，包括与设计师共同探讨AI设计工具的认知益处、采用创新方法分析设计认知、在模拟专业环境中检验工具效果，以及研究分布式协作设计情境。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in healthcare and human resource management: a review of the global divide, Pakistan's landscape and institutional innovations
papers.authors: Umair Maqbool, Lutaf Ali Mangrio, Mazhar Iqbal
papers.journal: International Journal of Advances in Medicine
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping healthcare and organizational management worldwide, yet its benefits remain unevenly distributed between high-income and low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). This review examines the structural drivers of this global AI divide, situates Pakistan's healthcare and digital infrastructure challenges within this context, and presents an institutional case study of four AI-enabled interventions implemented at the Sindh Integrated Emergency and Health Services (SIEHS), an emergency and health services organization under the Health Department, Government of Sindh, Pakistan: an AI-driven recruitment and candidate-job matching system (Talent Match Live), a facial-recognition and geolocation-based field monitoring application, an AI-assisted CCTV training-monitoring system, and an AI-augmented telemedicine triage service embedded within SIEHS's Teletabeeb telehealth department. Each intervention is evaluated against comparable systems documented in the international literature to assess feasibility, evidence of effectiveness, and associated ethical risks. A responsible-adoption framework is proposed to guide organizations in resource-constrained settings toward AI integration that is effective, equitable, and ethically governed. The review concludes that while AI offers meaningful efficiency and access gains for LMIC public-sector organizations such as SIEHS, sustainable adoption requires deliberate attention to data protection, algorithmic bias, workforce consent, and alignment with international ethical guidance.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察全球人工智能鸿沟的结构性成因，并将巴基斯坦的医疗与数字基础设施挑战置于这一背景下，进而以信德省综合应急与卫生服务组织（SIEHS）的四项AI干预为机构案例，逐项对照国际文献中的同类系统评估其可行性、有效性证据与伦理风险。文章指出，AI能为资源受限的公共部门组织带来效率与可及性收益，但可持续采用需关注数据保护、算法偏见、员工知情同意及与国际伦理准则的衔接，并据此提出负责任采用框架。作为综述与案例研究，其结论基于文献对照与机构经验，而非对照实验。

papers.title: The discrimination loop: The concerns of literary creatives around the socio-economic implications of GenAI on novelists and readers
papers.authors: Clementine Collett
papers.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is reshaping creative work, yet little empirical research has examined how novelists understand the socio-economic implications of GenAI for writers and readers. Drawing on focus group data and a survey with 384 literary creatives across the UK, including 258 published novelists, this article explores the concerns of creatives around the expanding production and consumption of AI-generated fiction. It argues that these concerns can be conceptualised under the umbrella of ‘the discrimination loop’, a process by which AI-generated fiction may intensify inequality in the creative writing economy and society. The loop has four interrelated dimensions. First, market saturation may make it harder for new or diverse voices to be discovered. Second, declining income from fiction and related freelance work may increase reliance on personal resources, privileging writers with more time, wealth, or an existing profile. Third, a two-tier market may emerge in which human-written fiction becomes a premium good, while cheaper AI-generated content becomes more widely and cheaply consumed. Fourth, AI-generated fiction may reproduce discriminatory, stereotyped or homogenised narratives, with consequences for the voices and experiences represented. By conceptualising the discrimination loop, this article contributes to critical data studies, science and technology studies, and sociology by offering a framework for future longitudinal research on GenAI, creative labour, and inequality.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于焦点小组数据和对英国384名文学创作者（含258名已出版小说家）的调查，考察小说家如何看待生成式AI对作者与读者的社会经济影响。作者提出“歧视循环”概念，认为AI生成小说可能通过四个相互关联的维度加剧创作经济与社会中的不平等：市场饱和使新声音或多元声音更难被发现；小说及相关自由职业收入下降，使创作者更依赖个人资源，从而有利于拥有更多时间、财富或既有知名度者；可能形成双层市场，人类写作成为高端商品，而更廉价的AI内容被更广泛、更低廉地消费；AI生成小说可能复制歧视性、刻板化或同质化叙事，影响被呈现的声音与经验。文章据此为后续关于生成式AI、创意劳动与不平等的纵向研究提供框架。

papers.title: Philosophical, Ethical, Pedagogical, and Methodological Implications of Artificial Intelligence in Qualitative Research
papers.authors: Lorien S. Jordan, April M. Jones, Stephanie Anne Shelton
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is an increasingly visible, pervasive, and contentious presence that is arguably embedded within everyday practices in qualitative inquiry. Even as some scholars reject AI usage as incongruent with axiologies and onto-epistemologies that inform qualitative research (Chatzichristos, 2025; Greenhalgh, 2026; Messner et al., 2025), standard tools, including video conferencing, word processing, and thematic analysis software have already incorporated AI-based elements as default features (IntuitionLabs, 2026; Paulus et al., 2026; Suduc & Bizoi, 2022). And while there are critically important concerns regarding the environmental impacts of AI usage and data centers, and the acceleration of inhuman(e) rates of scholarly “productivity” alongside institutions eagerly establishing schools and institutes focused on AI adoption (Bay, 2026), the field of qualitative inquiry has simultaneously (and perhaps unknowingly) created hierarchies regarding when AI usage is acceptable (e.g., using AI-generated transcriptions from Zoom, Teams, and Otter.ai) and alarming (e.g., unanonymized, sensitive data being fed into large language models [LLMs] for thematic analysis), thereby establishing some methodological practices as meaningful and others as menial.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性文章，讨论人工智能在质性研究中的哲学、伦理、教学与方法论意涵。作者指出，AI 已作为默认功能嵌入视频会议、文字处理和主题分析软件等日常工具，而学界对 AI 使用是否契合质性研究的价值论与本体认识论存在分歧。文章进一步提出，质性研究领域在无意间形成了关于 AI 使用何时可接受、何时令人警觉的等级划分，从而把某些方法实践建构为有意义、另一些则视为琐碎；同时提示 AI 的环境影响与学术“生产力”加速等问题。

papers.title: ORGANIC, CLONIC, CODE: Three Branches of One Vibration
papers.authors: Kostyantyn Pirozhenko
papers.abstract: This paper proposes the conceptual triad Organic - Clonic - Code as three modes of interacting with sonic matter in the age of sampling, synthesis and generative systems. Organic designates the primary creation of vibration through physical action; Clonic designates work with the memory of already existing sound; Code designates the description of rules and intention according to which sound may arise (including algorithmic and generative music). The triad does not represent historical epochs or degrees of “authenticity,” but parallel, interwoven modes. The work is explicitly positioned as a creative specialization of the Synthecracy methodology: intention/horizon corresponds to Idea, existing sonic material corresponds to Knowledge, and human judgement, selection and responsibility remain central. AI and code-based systems are treated exclusively as an auxiliary layer. An operational layer - Horizon/Intention as Traceable Record - is proposed, and directions for further empirical inquiry are outlined.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“有机—克隆—代码”三分框架，用以区分采样、合成与生成系统时代人与声音材料互动的三种并行且交织的方式：有机指通过身体动作直接创造振动，克隆指对既有声音记忆的处理，代码指对声音生成规则与意图的描述。作者明确反对将该三分视为历史阶段或“本真性”等级，并将其定位为Synthecracy方法论在创作层面的专门化，其中人的判断、选择与责任仍居核心，AI与代码系统仅作为辅助层。文章还提出“视域/意图作为可追溯记录”的操作层设想，并勾勒了后续实证研究的方向；整体属理论建构，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: Recovering expert-defined performance levels in breaking-bad-news simulations with a large language model: materials and data
papers.authors: Christina Aron Ciochina
papers.abstract: Materials and data for a pilot study testing whether a large language model can identify three expert-defined levels of performance (high, intermediate, low) in scripted, video-recorded simulations of the disclosure of a perioperative cardiac arrest to parents. Includes the 23-item assessment grid, the full prompt given to the AI, the annotated scripts, the unedited AI outputs and the evidence-check tables. Videos are not shared publicly.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一项初步试验，考察大型语言模型能否在脚本化、录像的围手术期心脏骤停向家长告知模拟中，识别专家定义的高、中、低三个表现水平。材料包含23项评估量表、完整提示词、标注脚本、未经编辑的模型输出及证据核对表，但视频未公开。摘要只说明材料与数据构成，未报告识别结果或准确率，因此模型能否可靠区分表现水平尚不明确。

papers.title: Effectiveness of AI-Based Therapeutic Conversational Agent Interventions for Depressive and Anxiety Symptoms Among University Students: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.authors: TAN CAI LIANG
papers.abstract: This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to evaluate the effectiveness of artificial intelligence-based therapeutic conversational agent interventions for depressive and anxiety symptoms among university students. The review focuses on parallel-group randomized controlled trials evaluating therapeutic conversational agents or chatbots designed to provide psychological treatment or therapeutic psychological support. The primary outcomes are depressive and anxiety symptoms measured using validated assessment instruments.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与元分析聚焦大学生群体，评估基于人工智能的治疗性对话代理干预对抑郁和焦虑症状的效果，纳入的是平行组随机对照试验，干预须为提供心理治疗或治疗性心理支持的对话代理或聊天机器人，主要结局为采用经验证工具测量的抑郁与焦虑症状。摘要仅交代了研究目的、纳入标准与结局指标，未报告检索范围、纳入试验数量、合并效应量或异质性等结果信息，因此无法判断干预是否有效及效果大小，相关结论有待原文结果部分补充。

papers.title: Tourists’ Perceptions of Algorithmic Transparency in Personalized Recommendation Systems: A Content Analysis in Smart Tourism Destinations
papers.authors: Yunyoung Kim Yunyoung Kim, Wooje Cho
papers.abstract: Purpose: This study examines how tourists perceive the transparency of personalized recommendation algorithms in smart tourism destinations. Methodology: Using a content analysis approach, this study analyzed 145 user-generated texts collected between 2022 and 2025 from Google Maps, TripAdvisor, social media platforms, and online communities to identify interpretive patterns in tourists’ responses to AI-based recommendation systems. Findings: Algorithmic recommendation systems shape user perceptions through multiple interrelated dimensions, encompassing transparency and explainability in how recommendations are generated, privacy vulnerability associated with data collection and perceived surveillance, system competence and usefulness reflected in accuracy and contextual relevance, and emotional-cognitive reactions such as trust, discomfort, and perceived loss of autonomy. Research limitations/implications: A limitation of this study is that it relies on user-generated text data, which constrains the examination of cognitive mechanisms and causal relationships underlying perceptions of algorithmic transparency. In addition, the temporal scope of the dataset, limited to the period from 2022 to 2025, may not fully capture rapid advancements in AI-driven recommendation systems and evolving regulatory environments. Moreover, the lack of differentiation across platform types, recommendation contexts, and cultural backgrounds restricts the generalizability of the findings. These limitations should be considered when interpreting the results and suggest opportunities for future research. Originality/value: The findings show that transparency is interpreted as an experiential concept shaped by system performance, data governance, and emotional comfort. These insights highlight the need for user-centered transparency strategies and ethical algorithmic practices in smart tourism. The study contributes to broader discussions on responsible AI by clarifying how tourists construct meaning around algorithmic processes in digital travel environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注智能旅游目的地中游客如何感知个性化推荐算法的透明度，采用内容分析法对2022至2025年间来自Google Maps、TripAdvisor、社交媒体和在线社区的145条用户生成文本进行解读。分析发现，算法推荐系统通过多个相互关联的维度塑造用户感知，包括推荐生成方式的透明度与可解释性、与数据收集和感知监控相关的隐私脆弱性、由准确性和情境相关性体现的系统能力与有用性，以及信任、不适和自主性丧失感等情感认知反应。文章据此指出，透明度是被系统性能、数据治理和情感舒适度共同塑造的体验性概念，并强调在智慧旅游中采取以用户为中心的透明度策略和合乎伦理的算法实践的必要性；同时说明，基于用户生成文本的数据限制了因果机制的考察，平台类型、推荐情境和文化背景未作区分也影响结论的推广。

papers.title: Pseudo-remission in childhood absence epilepsy. Objective assessment of seizure control and the role of ethosuximide
papers.authors: N. V. Chebanenko, Mikhail Borisovich Mironov, В. А. Егоров
papers.journal: S S Korsakov Journal of Neurology and Psychiatry
papers.abstract: Absence epilepsy is a common form of pseudo-remission, in which patients and observers may incorrectly believe seizures have ceased while paroxysms persist in subtle form. Three primary factors contribute to this phenomenon: the brief duration (typically less than 10 seconds) and indistinct semiology of typical absences; the limited reliability of parental observation (sensitivity up to 43%); and the occurrence of generalized spike-wave discharges without significant clinical manifestations, which are nonetheless associated with fluctuations in wakefulness. Verification of remission requires at least a properly conducted three-minute hyperventilation test with attentional load. Preferred methods for objective assessment include prolonged video-EEG monitoring that registers wakefulness, sleep, and arousal, and, when indicated, intermittent photic stimulation. However, no direct comparative studies have demonstrated superiority of these methods over short-term EEG with adequately performed hyperventilation. Extended EEG monitoring does not substitute for the induction of provoking factors, and functional testing does not obviate the need for sufficient recording duration. The absence of “peak-slow wave” discharges lasting three seconds or longer may serve as a practical operational criterion, as adopted from the CAE study protocol. Data are presented on the proportion of patients free from treatment failure with ethosuximide, valproic acid, and lamotrigine in patients with newly diagnosed childhood absence epilepsy at Week 16 (53%, 58%, and 29%, respectively) and at Month 12 (45%, 44%, and 21%, respectively). The review also describes the mechanism of action of ethosuximide, discrepancies between NICE recommendations and Russian clinical guidelines, dosing considerations, and the need for laboratory monitoring. The clinical benefit of adjusting therapy based on EEG findings in patients with apparent clinical well-being remains unproven.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕儿童失神癫痫的“假性缓解”问题展开，指出患者与观察者可能误以为发作已停止，而实际仍有细微的痫样放电持续存在。作者将这一现象归因于失神发作短暂且表现不典型、家长观察的敏感性有限，以及缺乏明显临床表现的广泛性棘慢波放电仍可能伴随觉醒波动。文章强调，缓解的确认需要规范的过度换气试验并配合注意负荷，客观评估可借助长程视频脑电图及必要时的间断闪光刺激，但现有研究尚未证明这些方法优于规范的短程脑电图加过度换气；延长监测不能替代诱发因素，功能测试也不能取代足够的记录时长。综述还汇总了乙琥胺、丙戊酸和拉莫三嗪在新诊断患儿中的治疗无失败比例，并讨论了乙琥胺的作用机制、指南差异、剂量与实验室监测，同时指出根据脑电图调整治疗在临床状况良好患者中的获益仍未被证实。

papers.title: Invisible patterns of motivation: AI-assisted qualitative analysis of cover letters of teacher-education applicants
papers.authors: Katalin Kanczné Nagy, Ferenc Ribní, Tünde Tóth, Rita Kattein-Pornói, Péter Szandi-Varga
papers.abstract: Abstract The aim of this study is to explore motivational patterns in teacher candidates' cover letters (CL) and to examine the methodological role of artificial intelligence (AI) in qualitative content analysis. The theoretical framework is provided by the literature on teacher career motivation, qualitative text analysis, and the latest approaches to AI-based content analysis. The empirical analysis is based on the CLs of teacher training applicants. The analysis uses deductive coding, employing both human coders and an AI-based analytical system. The aim of the text analysis is to identify the dominant motivational factors and construct a motivational factor structure. The qualitative results are supplemented at an early stage by quantitative analysis, which examines the relationships between the identified motivational factors and the selected background variables. The methodological contribution of the study lies in the use of AI-assisted pre-coding within a deductive qualitative framework combined with systematic human validation. The results show that the most dominant motivational factors for teacher candidates are 1. Love of teaching, 2. Internal interest, 3. Shaping the next generation, 4. Career adjustment. Automated screening indicated that, on average, approximately 20% of the analysed text was flagged as potentially AI-generated. Potential AI-assisted writing may affect the linguistic and stylistic characteristics of the letters.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以教师教育申请者的求职信为对象，结合人工编码与AI辅助预编码进行演绎式质性内容分析，旨在识别其职业动机的主要类型与结构，并考察AI在质性文本分析中的方法角色。结果显示，最突出的动机依次为热爱教学、内在兴趣、塑造下一代和职业调整；自动筛查还提示约两成文本可能由AI生成，可能影响信件的语言与文体特征。作者据此讨论了AI辅助预编码配合人工验证的分析路径，同时提醒AI参与写作可能给这类文本分析带来干扰。

papers.title: Aperiodic EEG activity is a domain-specific marker of attentional aging in neurotypical adults
papers.authors: Christian Cazares, Alison M. Rigby, Leena Kang, Stephan Getzmann, Stefan Arnau, Edmund Wascher, Bradley Voytek
papers.abstract: Aperiodic neural activity has been reliably shown to be reduced among older adults, and these reductions are associated with age-related cognitive decline. These results suggest that aperiodic activity, as measured by the spectral exponent, might be a viable electrophysiological biomarker for cognitive aging. However, this has not been tested longitudinally, within participants, during normal aging. Here, we used a longitudinal cohort of either sex to test whether changes in aperiodic activity between two sessions, approximately 5 years apart, track behavioral change across two domains: sustained attention (Psychomotor Vigilance Test) and executive function (modified Simon task). We found that aperiodic activity declined within individuals after the interval, independent of age at baseline. This within-person change tracked concurrent changes in reaction times during sustained attention but was not associated with changes in any Simon task measure. Within a resampling framework, the aperiodic-PVT association was stable across cohort resamples and independently fitted partitions, though it was not confirmed in a small, frozen held-out set. These findings suggest the longitudinal decline in aperiodic activity tracks attentional processing speed rather than executive function, supporting its potential as a domain-specific biomarker of attentional aging in neurotypical populations. Significance Statement Aperiodic (non-oscillatory) neural activity, indexed by the aperiodic exponent, is known to decline in older adults, but whether this happens within individuals over just a few years, and in step with cognitive change, remains unclear. Here we leveraged scalp EEG and cognitive-behavioral data from 276 neurotypical adults, tested twice approximately five years apart, and found that the aperiodic exponent declines within individuals over this interval, independent of age at baseline. This decline tracked concurrent slowing on a sustained attention task, but not change on an executive function task, and only in EEG recorded before, not after, cognitive testing. Based on this dissociation, we propose that aperiodic exponent decline indexes attentional processing speed rather than general cognitive decline in neurotypical aging.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察非周期性脑电活动能否作为正常认知老化的纵向生物标记，利用同一批神经典型成人相隔约五年的两次脑电与行为测量，检验其变化是否与持续注意和执行功能的变化同步。结果显示，个体内非周期性活动随时间下降，且这一下降与持续注意任务中反应时的变化相关，却与执行功能任务各项指标的变化无关；该关联在重采样中较稳定，但未在小型冻结留出集中得到确认。作者据此提出，非周期性活动的纵向下降更多反映注意加工速度而非一般认知衰退，可作为注意老化的领域特异性标记，同时提示结论受测量条件与验证范围的限制。

papers.title: ALGORITHMIC WILDERNESS: AI LITERACY, TECHNOLOGICAL MEDIATION, AND DECISION-MAKING AMONG GENERATION Z HIKERS
papers.authors: Maneenate Worrachananun
papers.abstract: This phenomenological study explores the lived experiences of Thai Generation Z hikers, thoroughly examining the critical intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) literacy and complex decision-making in wilderness environments. As young adventurers increasingly pursue nature-based eco-experientia for psychological restoration, AI has rapidly evolved into an active, front-facing backcountry companion. Using the Theory of Technological Mediation alongside robust methodological triangulation—including in-depth interviews, focus groups, and interactive discussions with university-aged hikers—this research examines how algorithmic tools profoundly reshape human-nature relationships. The empirical findings clearly show that AI is seamlessly integrated throughout the trekking lifecycle, functioning as a vital digital safety net that mitigates environmental uncertainty. However, this deep integration precipitates a highly complex socio-technical paradox. While participants consistently exhibit exceptional functional AI literacy, an emerging algorithmic dependency actively threatens to erode traditional, intuitive wilderness judgment. Ultimately, AI facilitates a hermeneutic relationship in which pristine nature is interpreted through curated data, fundamentally transforming raw exploration into a mediated digital reality that urgently requires careful preservation of human agency within adventure tourism.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以现象学取向考察泰国Z世代徒步者在荒野环境中的决策经验，结合深度访谈、焦点小组和互动讨论，探讨AI素养与技术中介如何重塑人与自然的互动。研究发现，AI已贯穿徒步全程，充当缓解环境不确定性的数字安全网；参与者虽具备较强的功能性AI素养，但逐渐显现的算法依赖可能侵蚀传统的直觉性荒野判断。作者据此指出，AI使自然体验越来越多地经由数据被解读，原始探索由此转为被中介的数字现实，因而在冒险旅游中维护人的能动性尤为必要。

papers.title: Predicting under-five child mortality in Zambia: Machine learning versus parametric survival models
papers.authors: Kassaye Getaneh Arge
papers.abstract: Background In sub-Saharan Africa, child mortality remains a critical public health challenge, with Zambia exhibiting some of the highest rates in the region. While survival analysis has identified key risk factors, these methods often fail to capture complex non-linear interactions and the dynamic, time-varying nature of longitudinal markers like birth intervals. This study aimed to develop and compare predictive survival models to improve risk stratification for under-five mortality using the 2024 Zambia Demographic and Health Survey (ZDHS). Methods A cohort of 35,610 live births was initially identified, with a final analytic sample of 9,362 singleton births and 1,236 mortality events (13.2%) after applying exclusion criteria for maternal age and data completeness. We compared four modeling frameworks for predictive comparison: Cox Proportional Hazards (Cox PH), Lasso Cox regression, Random Survival Forests (RSF), and Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), alongside a Bayesian Joint Model for inference on the birth interval and mortality association. The proportional hazards assumption was assessed using Schoenfeld residuals, and stratified Cox models were employed to address time-varying effects. Model performance was evaluated using nested cross-validation with mother-level outer folds and time-dependent Concordance Indices (C-index) and Area Under the Curve (AUC) metrics across a 48-month follow-up period. Results Under nested cross-validation, the four survival models demonstrated comparable predictive performance, with C-indices ranging from 0.745 (Cox PH) to 0.750 (Gradient Boosting Machine) and Integrated Brier Scores ranging from 0.095 to 0.096; pairwise comparisons across models were not statistically significant (DeLong’s test: all p > 0.05). The Bayesian Joint Model revealed a significant association between the longitudinal birth interval process and the hazard of death ( α = 0.035 , 95% CI: 0.023–0.048, p < 0.001), supporting the maternal depletion hypothesis. Variable importance analysis identified birth interval and maternal age as the most influential predictors of child survival, followed by previous child deaths. Stratified analysis of the Cox model revealed significant effects for maternal education (Secondary: HR = 0.426, 95% CI: 0.318–0.570) and previous child deaths (HR = 1.648, 95% CI: 1.529–1.777). Conclusion Advanced survival modeling using joint modeling techniques provides deeper biological insights into child mortality dynamics, and machine learning and traditional survival models offered equivalent predictive discrimination and calibration in this analysis. These findings support targeted public health interventions focusing on birth spacing, maternal age, and enhanced monitoring for high-risk families as critical strategies for reducing under-five mortality in Zambia.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用2024年赞比亚人口与健康调查数据，比较机器学习生存模型（随机生存森林、梯度提升机）与参数化生存模型（Cox比例风险、Lasso Cox）对五岁以下儿童死亡的预测表现，并借助贝叶斯联合模型考察生育间隔与死亡风险的关联。结果显示，四类模型在嵌套交叉验证下的预测区分度与校准度相近，差异不具统计显著性；联合模型则发现较长的生育间隔过程与死亡风险存在显著关联，变量重要性分析将生育间隔和母亲年龄列为最具影响力的预测因素。作者据此认为，机器学习并未在预测上优于传统生存模型，而联合建模能提供更多机制性信息，相关发现可支持聚焦生育间隔、母亲年龄及高风险家庭监测的公共卫生干预。

papers.title: A comparative analysis of machine learning, deep learning, and ensemble learning models for suicidal ideation detection on social media
papers.authors: Andualem Woldegiorgis, Mohammed Abebe Yimer, Durga Prasad Sharma, Worku Jimma
papers.abstract: Suicidal ideation is the consideration of self-inflicted death and has emerged as a serious and rising concern for worldwide public health systems, contributing to over 800,000 deaths annually worldwide. Individuals express intentions, distress, and thoughts of self-harm and death, thereby offering a crucial and unprecedented avenue for timely psychological intervention and surveillance. The core problem addressed by this research is the pronounced global insufficiency in detecting and mitigating suicidal ideation across linguistically diverse environments, specifically focusing on low-resource languages. Previous computational studies have primarily focused on English and other widely used languages, leaving a critical research gap for contexts such as Amharic. The main aim of this study was to investigate and to develop a robust and optimal deep learning model for identifying suicidal ideation in Amharic social media content. A total of 5,428 postings from social media such as Facebook and Telegram were carefully collected, manually annotated, and processed to provide the first publicly available dataset on Amharic suicidal ideation. After preprocessing, Word2Vec, GloVe, and FastText were among the word embedding techniques used for feature engineering. Five deep learning models and four machine learning models were then compared in this study. Based on the experimental results, ensemble learning models achieved slightly higher performance than the individual deep learning models in suicidal ideation detection. Specifically, hard voting ensemble learning models achieved the highest accuracy (83.3%) and precision (86.55%). CNN-BiLSTM achieved an accuracy of 81.45%, while the BiLSTM model achieved an accuracy of 81.4%, indicating that bidirectional sequence learning effectively captures contextual information in Amharic texts. Beyond its strong empirical performance, this study contributes a robust detection framework and introduces a public Amharic dataset, thereby establishing a foundational methodological resource for mental health research. Future studies should focus on developing scalable datasets and context-aware deep learning models that effectively handle multimodal data, multilingual transformer models, fusion-based features, and addressing bias in low-resource computational linguistics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对低资源语言阿姆哈拉语社交媒体中自杀意念检测的空白，构建了首个公开的阿姆哈拉语自杀意念数据集，并比较了多种机器学习与深度学习模型。结果显示，集成学习模型的表现略优于单个深度学习模型，其中硬投票集成取得最高准确率与精确率，而双向序列模型也能较好捕捉阿姆哈拉语文本的上下文信息。研究据此提供了一个检测框架和基础数据资源，并指出未来需发展可扩展数据集及能处理多模态、多语言与偏差问题的情境感知模型。

papers.title: Improving Patient-Reported Understanding of Radiographic Reports in Spine Surgery Through Implementation of Natural Language Processing: A Randomized Controlled Study
papers.authors: Shailen G. Sampath, Christopher Pawul, Alan X. Chen, Chiemela Izima, Anthony Tang, Christina M Bear, Alex Hernandez Manriquez, Nathan A. Shlobin, Phillip Chung, Miles L. Botkiss, Shaw Qin, Vivian P. Le, Dean Chou, Andrew K. Chan
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Many spinal imaging reports are written above recommended health literacy levels, limiting patient comprehension at a time when rapid electronic access to radiology results is increasing. We aim to evaluate whether supplemental natural language processing (NLP)–modified radiology reports—within the context of usual patient portal access to the original report—are associated with improved patient-reported perceived understandability compared with standard reports among patients undergoing spine imaging. METHODS: This is a prospective randomized controlled study with limited participant blinding, conducted with 2 spine surgeons affiliated with a single academic medical center in New York City. Participants (18 years or older) undergoing spine imaging at initial surgical consultation were enrolled and were randomized to receive either their original radiology report or a supplemental NLP–modified version. Radiology reports were rewritten using a standardized natural language processing prompt (ChatGPT 4.0) and reviewed for accuracy by study investigators. The primary outcome was survey-based patient-reported perceived understandability. Secondary outcomes included objective readability scores (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease, Simple Measure of Gobbledygook, Gunning-Fog Index). RESULTS: Fifty-two adults were enrolled; 42 (81%) completed the postintervention survey. Among 52 randomized participants (26 women [50%]), NLP–modified reports demonstrated significantly improved objective readability across all indices compared with original reports (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, 5.9 ± 1.1 vs 11.0 ± 1.7; Reading Ease, 71.0 ± 10.3 vs 28.2 ± 12.5; Simple Measure of Gobbledygook, 20.1 ± 12.7 vs 23.5 ± 15.7; Gunning-Fog Index, 8.2 ± 1.1 vs 14.3 ± 1.8; all P < .01). Of 42 survey respondents, those receiving supplemental NLP-modified reports reported greater ease of understanding the report language (4.2 ± 1.2 vs 2.6 ± 1.5, mean-difference 95% CI: 0.75-2.53, P < .01, Bonferroni-corrected- P = .02), and less difficulty with medical terms (2.0 ± 1.5 vs 3.6 ± 1.4, mean-difference 95% CI: −2.51 to −0.60, P < .01, Bonferroni-corrected- P = .04). CONCLUSION: Supplemental NLP-modified radiology reports were associated with improved objective readability and higher patient-reported perceived ease of understanding in a spine surgery initial consultation setting. These findings support further investigation of NLP-generated supplemental explanations within supervised clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在脊柱影像检查中，为患者额外提供经自然语言处理（NLP）改写过的放射学报告，能否改善患者自评的理解程度。作者开展了一项前瞻性随机对照试验，将接受脊柱影像检查的成年患者分为两组，分别获得原始报告或经NLP改写的补充版本，并以问卷自评理解度为主要结局，同时评估客观可读性指标。结果显示，NLP改写版报告在各项客观可读性指标上均优于原始报告；在完成问卷的受访者中，获得补充改写版本者报告更容易理解报告语言、对医学术语的困难感更低。作者据此认为，这类补充解释与更好的可读性和患者感知理解度相关，值得在受监督的临床流程中进一步研究，但结论仍属关联性证据。

papers.title: Effects of question-chain prompting on self-regulated learning, metacognition, and achievement in a generative AI environment
papers.authors: Xiuyu Lin, Shan Li, Yijing Zhu, Hang Ju, Guozhu Ding
papers.journal: International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) offers learners immediate and personalized support, yet unguided interaction may encourage passive use and weaken self-regulated learning (SRL). This study examined whether question-chain prompting can support SRL in human-AI interaction. A quasi-experiment was conducted with 83 undergraduates enrolled in a television program production course. A control group used free-form questioning, whereas two experimental groups used either a progressive or a divergent question-chain strategy. Data included GenAI interaction logs, post-task reflections, metacognitive awareness measures, and course grades. This study found that both question-chain groups demonstrated significantly more learning-strategy and learning-monitoring behaviors than the control group. Reflection data further indicated differences in students’ approaches to human-AI collaboration, although these differences should be interpreted cautiously because the reflection prompts differed by condition. Moreover, both experimental groups scored significantly higher than the control group on knowledge of cognition, regulation of cognition, and academic achievement. No significant differences were found between the progressive and divergent question-chain approaches. The findings suggest that question-chain prompting, implemented as an instructional package of specific, sequenced, and required questions, can promote more active engagement during human-AI interaction and support metacognitive development and learning performance. Question chains offer a practical approach for guiding students’ use of GenAI in educational settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在生成式人工智能学习环境中，问题链提示能否支持学生的自我调节学习。作者以修读电视节目制作课程的大学生为对象开展准实验，比较自由提问与两种问题链策略下的人机互动。结果显示，两种问题链组的学习策略与学习监控行为均显著多于对照组，其对认知知识和认知调节的测量得分及课程成绩也更高；渐进式与发散式问题链之间未见显著差异。反思数据提示学生的人机协作方式存在差异，但因反思提示随条件而异，这一结果需谨慎解读。研究认为，将问题链作为包含具体、有序且必答问题的教学方案，可促进人机互动中的主动参与，并支持元认知发展与学习表现。

papers.title: Temporal attentional bias to food stimuli in adolescent anorexia nervosa – an ERP study
papers.authors: Julia Nannt, Inés Wolz, Jan Vagedes, Jennifer Svaldi
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Anorexia nervosa (AN) is associated with substantial psychological and physical impairment and low recovery rates. A deeper understanding of its underlying mechanisms is therefore crucial. Cognitive models of eating disorders emphasize the role of attentional biases in the processing of food stimuli. However, only a few studies to date have examined the temporal dynamics of food-related attentional bias in adolescents with AN. Methods The present study combined the high temporal resolution of event-related potentials with the behavioral measure of the attentional blink in a rapid serial visual presentation task in order to disentangle the temporal processing stages that underlie food-related attentional biases in female adolescents with AN ( n = 33) compared to age-matched healthy controls ( n = 36). Results Behavioral results revealed an increased attentional engagement with food in AN, but no impairment in attentional disengagement . Additionally, high-calorie food distractors elicited reduced early electrocortical processing followed by enhanced later processing in AN. These AN-specific attentional biases were no longer evident for target processing. Conclusions The findings suggest that attention allocation to food in AN is a temporally dynamic process rather than a unitary mechanism. They further suggest that these biases are not entirely autonomous but rather depend on the availability of attentional resources.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年神经性厌食症患者对食物刺激的注意偏向在时间进程上如何表现，采用快速序列视觉呈现任务，结合事件相关电位与注意瞬脱行为指标，比较患者与健康对照。行为结果显示，患者对食物投入更多注意，但注意脱离未见受损；高热量食物干扰项在患者中先引发较早的皮层加工减弱，随后出现较晚的加工增强。这些偏向在目标加工阶段不再出现，提示患者的食物注意分配是随时间变化的动态过程，而非单一机制，且可能依赖可用注意资源。

papers.title: Ethics of AI chatbots in mental healthcare: insights from a multi-stakeholder focus group study
papers.authors: Mehrdad Rahsepar Meadi, Floriane Jaspers, Suzanne Metselaar, Neeltje M. Batelaan, Justin S. Bernstein
papers.abstract: Abstract Background AI chatbots are increasingly used as therapists for mental health problems. A potential benefit of this technology is that, unlike human practitioners, it is not affected by waiting times. However, its use also raises ethical challenges, and while ethical analyses are growing, perspectives from relevant stakeholders remain understudied. This qualitative study examines ethical questions surrounding the use of AI chatbots as therapists for people with mental health problems. Methods We conducted online 90-minute focus groups with mental healthcare practitioners (psychiatrists, psychologists, psychotherapists, physicians, psychiatric nurses), ethicists, AI experts, and legal professionals in the Netherlands. A topic list based on a previously published scoping review guided the discussions, and a vignette served as a prompt for ethical reflection. The discussions were analysed using thematic content analysis. As the study progressed, methods were refined to enhance validity and reliability, for example, by adjusting the topic list, vignette or group composition. Transcripts were reviewed, corrected and coded in MAXQDA. Results Participants across all stakeholder groups expressed caution or reluctance toward using AI chatbots in mental healthcare due to unresolved ethical and legal concerns. Key worries included potential harm to users, uncertainty about responsibility for adverse outcomes, and risks including harmful output or AI hallucinations, excessive screen time, and limited effectiveness. While most participants preferred human-to-human contact, they acknowledged that some patients might prefer chatbots and emphasised the importance of informed and autonomous choice. Privacy and confidentiality concerns were raised, particularly by legal professionals rather than by other groups. Conclusions We distinguished three types of ethical concerns about AI chatbots in mental healthcare: general AI issues, concerns specific to AI in mental health contexts, and concerns that also apply to human therapists. Distinguishing between these categories is useful because potential solutions may come from different domains. Participants weighed the second category—concerns specific to AI in mental health contexts—especially heavily. Yet, as people already turn to chatbots for mental health support, we suggest the question is not whether they should be used, but under what conditions and with what level of risk acceptance their use can be responsible and safe.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过焦点小组探讨心理健康护理中AI聊天机器人的伦理问题，参与者包括精神卫生从业者、伦理学家、AI专家和法律专业人士。结果显示，各利益相关群体普遍对将AI聊天机器人用作治疗师持谨慎或保留态度，主要担忧包括对用户的潜在伤害、不良后果责任归属不明，以及有害输出或AI幻觉、屏幕时间过长和效果有限等风险；多数人偏好人与人接触，但也承认部分患者可能更愿意使用聊天机器人，并强调知情与自主选择的重要性，隐私和保密问题则更多由法律专业人士提出。作者据此区分了三类伦理关切——通用AI问题、心理健康情境下AI特有的问题，以及同样适用于人类治疗师的问题，认为这一区分有助于从不同领域寻找解决方案，并提出在人们已开始借助聊天机器人获得心理支持的背景下，问题或许不在于是否使用，而在于在何种条件下、以何种风险接受程度负责任且安全地使用。

papers.title: Performance of latest-generation large language models on endodontic specialty examination questions: a comparative cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Hilal Erdoğan, Muhammet Cankar
papers.abstract: Abstract Background This study aimed to compare the performance of Gemini 3 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, ChatGPT 5.2, and DeepSeek V3.2 on the Endodontics section of the Turkish Dental Specialty Exam (DUS), with particular attention to question source, type, and endodontic subtopic. Methods The dataset comprised 187 endodontic questions from 2012–2025, stratified into internet-sourced from 2012–2021 ( n = 127) and textbook-sourced from 2022–2025 ( n = 60). Questions were further categorized by type as case analysis, literature knowledge, combination or visual analysis, and by 10 endodontic subtopics. Following a standardized zero-shot prompting protocol (public web interfaces, default settings, single run per item), two independent endodontic assessors scored responses on a blinded 0–3 rubric, and then the two evaluator scores were averaged for each response. Overall model performance was expressed as a percentage of the maximum possible rubric score (100%). Statistical analysis employed the Friedman test, Wilcoxon Signed-Rank tests with Bonferroni correction, Mann–Whitney U and Kruskal–Wallis tests. Results All reported percentages represent normalized rubric-based performance scores, evaluating both answer selection and reasoning quality, rather than simple correct/incorrect accuracy rates. High inter-rater agreement was achieved, with quadratic weighted kappa values ranging from 0.954 to 0.998. In overall performance, Gemini 3 Pro (90.37%) and Gemini 3 Flash (88.32%) significantly outperformed ChatGPT 5.2 (78.25%) and DeepSeek V3.2 (62.12%) (adjusted p ≤ 0.001; Kendall’s W = 0.214); corresponding answer accuracies were 94.1%, 93.0%, 86.6%, and 73.3%. No significant difference was found between the Gemini models (adjusted p = 1.000). No significant difference was observed between internet-sourced and textbook-sourced questions within any model. In literature knowledge questions, combination questions, and selected endodontic subtopics, the Gemini models generally showed higher rubric-based performance than the other models. Conclusions The findings indicate high rubric-based performance of the latest-generation LLMs, particularly the Gemini 3 series, on Turkish endodontics residency examination questions. No significant difference in performance was observed between internet-sourced and textbook-sourced questions; however, contamination of the data in both groups cannot be excluded. These models may serve as adjunctive tools in endodontic education; however, examination performance does not establish clinical diagnostic performance, and their outputs require expert validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了Gemini 3 Pro、Gemini 3 Flash、ChatGPT 5.2和DeepSeek V3.2在土耳其牙髓病专科考试题目上的作答表现，由两名评估者按评分量表对回答的选择与推理质量打分。结果显示，Gemini两款模型的总分明显高于ChatGPT 5.2和DeepSeek V3.2，而两款Gemini模型之间无显著差异；各模型在来源于网络与来源于教材的题目上表现均无显著差异，但作者提示两组数据均无法排除污染可能。文章据此认为这些模型可作为牙髓病教育的辅助工具，同时强调考试表现并不等同于临床诊断能力，其输出仍需专家核验。

papers.title: A mixed-methods evaluation of shipshape program at a large military treatment facility: outcomes and strategic insights
papers.authors: Nia N Maye, Dziyana A. Nazaruk, William A. Mase, Andrew R. Hansen, Cheryl R. James
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Obesity is a significant public health issue affecting two in five adults in the United States, with the US Navy experiencing higher rates of overweight and obesity among military branches. The Navy’s ShipShape program aims to assist participants in adopting healthier lifestyle behaviors to achieve weight loss. While previous studies have explored the characteristics of ShipShape participants and program enhancements, a mixed-methods program evaluation of effectiveness has been lacking. Aim A mixed-methods approach was utilized to evaluate the ShipShape program at a large Military Treatment Facility (MTF) in Portsmouth, Virginia. Methods Retrospective quantitative data were analyzed from participants who attended the program in either 2022 or 2023, including demographics, program completion status, and Body Mass Index (BMI) measurements before and after program participation. Qualitative data were obtained through semi-structured interviews with participants and facilitators, focusing on the Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats (SWOT) framework. Results The program evaluation included 67 participants, of whom 83.6% were active-duty military self-referrals. Among participants with complete BMI data, mean BMI decreased from 35.61 to 35.16 kg/m² ( p = 0.043). Qualitative analysis reveals four main themes: strengths in educational content, weaknesses in scheduling and communication, opportunities for increased accessibility, and threats from negative perceptions. Participants also suggested adding a virtual program option. Conclusion and recommendations The ShipShape program demonstrated a statistically significant but modest reduction in participant BMI. However, marketing efforts need to be enhanced to improve visibility and engagement. The program evaluation highlighted the importance of addressing negative perceptions and expanding program accessibility through virtual formats. Future studies should focus on broader program evaluations across multiple MTFs to generalize findings and assess long-term sustainability. Addressing identified limitations and incorporating a more comprehensive analysis will be essential for the continued success and effectiveness of the ShipShape program.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用混合方法评估美国海军ShipShape减重项目在一家大型军队医疗机构的实施效果，量化部分回顾分析参与者项目前后的体重指数变化，质性部分通过半结构化访谈梳理项目的优势、不足、机会与威胁。结果显示，完成数据记录的参与者体重指数出现统计学显著但幅度有限的下降；访谈则突出教育内容方面的优势，以及排期与沟通、可及性和负面认知等方面的短板，参与者还建议增设线上形式。作者据此提出应加强宣传、改善项目可见度与参与度，并通过虚拟形式扩大可及性，同时指出结论受单点评估和随访数据完整性的限制。

papers.title: Addressing diabetes distress in community health centers: protocol for the ARISE study, a pragmatic cluster randomized trial
papers.authors: D Hessler Jones, A. M. Durgan, E. M. Staab, A. Campbell, C. Schaefer, W. Wan, H. Wing, H. Zhu, C. Kasir, M. A. Mendoza, A. A. Baig
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Diabetes distress (DD), emotional burden of stress, fear, and guilt related to managing diabetes, is linked to poor glycemic control and disproportionately affects vulnerable populations. Although the American Diabetes Association and European Association for the Study of Diabetes recommend routine screening and intervention for DD, few health systems have implemented systematic screening and follow-up, and no studies have evaluated the impact of implementing DD screening and treatment workflows in real-world primary care. ARISE (Achieving Routine Intervention and Screening for Emotional health) is a training and technical assistance program designed to support multidisciplinary teams at community health centers (CHCs) in implementing DD screening and intervention for adults with type 2 diabetes (T2DM), based on the 7 A’s model (Aware, Ask, Assess, Advise, Assist, Assign, Arrange). Methods/Design This is a pragmatic, type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation cluster randomized trial in which 12 CHCs in the Midwest will be randomized 2:1 to ARISE (n=8) or Enhanced Usual Care (n=4). Eligible patients are aged ≥ 18 with T2DM and hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) >8% who speak English or Spanish and are not pregnant. ARISE clinics will participate in webinars on assessing DD using the Type 2 Diabetes Distress Assessment System (T2-DDAS) and strategies to address DD via the 7A's model and motivational interviewing, followed by monthly virtual learning community sessions for interactive training, implementation planning, and problem-solving. Enhanced Usual Care clinics will receive a webinar on DD. Data will be collected via pre- and post-training staff surveys, meeting notes, post-screening checklists, and staff and patient interviews from ARISE clinics; all clinics will contribute patient-level EHR data. The primary outcome is change in HbA1c at 12 months. Secondary outcomes include change in DD within the ARISE group and between-group differences in LDL, systolic blood pressure, and BMI. Implementation outcomes will be evaluated using the RE-AIM framework. Discussion This trial is the first to evaluate a program facilitating DD assessment and intervention for T2DM in real-world primary care. ARISE provides an opportunity to assist CHCs, which serve a disproportionate burden of individuals with diabetes and DD, in improving guideline-based care for underserved populations while informing the scalability of DD-focused care in safety-net primary care nationally. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06887049, registered 03/13/2025.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究方案针对社区健康中心中2型糖尿病患者的糖尿病痛苦（DD）筛查与干预落地难题，设计了一项实用性集群随机试验，将12家社区健康中心按2:1分配至ARISE培训与技术支持项目或增强常规照护，并通过员工调查、访谈及患者电子健康记录数据评估效果。主要结局是12个月时糖化血红蛋白的变化，次要结局包括ARISE组内DD变化及组间低密度脂蛋白、收缩压和体重的差异，实施结局则按RE-AIM框架评价。作者指出，这是首个在真实初级照护环境中评估DD评估与干预促进项目的研究，有望帮助主要服务弱势人群的社区健康中心改善基于指南的照护，并为此类照护模式的可扩展性提供参考。

papers.title: From Dentists to AI: Oral Health Information-seeking Behavior Among Pregnant Women in the Digital Era—A Cross-sectional Study
papers.authors: T. Shakina Madhuri, Banda Sri Deepti Sindhusha, Nijampatnam P.M. Pavani, Potluri Rajasekhar, Bhimana Srilekha, Mallidi Srujana
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Dentistry and Oral Sciences
papers.abstract: Introduction Pregnancy is a critical period during which optimal oral health is essential for maternal and fetal well-being. With increasing use of digital technologies, pregnant women obtain oral health information from various sources, including healthcare professionals, social media, and artificial intelligence (AI)-based platforms. This study assessed oral health information-seeking behavior among pregnant women and its association with oral health knowledge. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted among 150 pregnant women attending antenatal clinics in Vijayawada. Data were collected using a structured self-administered questionnaire. Descriptive statistics and Chi-square tests were used for analysis, with statistical significance set at p < .05. Results The mean age of participants was 28.42 ± 5.07 years. Although 96.7% had internet access, only 34.0% sought oral health information during pregnancy. Dentists were the most commonly used and trusted source (45.0%), followed by obstetricians (23.5%), while social media and AI chatbots were each used by 11.7%. Preferred information source was significantly associated with knowledge of gum disease ( p < .001), the safety of dental treatment ( p = .018), and the impact of maternal oral health on the baby’s health ( p = .040). Information-seeking behavior was also associated with better knowledge of gum disease ( p < .001) and the importance of regular dental check-ups during pregnancy ( p < .001). Conclusion Despite widespread internet access, oral health information-seeking during pregnancy was limited. Professional guidance, particularly from dentists, was associated with better oral health knowledge, emphasizing the need to strengthen evidence-based oral health education within antenatal care.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察孕妇在数字环境下获取口腔健康信息的来源及其与口腔健康知识水平的关联，采用横断面设计，对产前门诊孕妇进行结构化自填问卷调查。结果显示，尽管绝大多数孕妇能上网，但孕期主动寻求口腔健康信息者比例较低；牙医是最常用且最受信任的信息来源，其次为产科医生，社交媒体和AI聊天机器人的使用均较少。偏好信息来源与对牙龈疾病、牙科治疗安全性及母亲口腔健康对婴儿影响的认知相关，主动寻求信息也与更好的牙龈疾病知识和定期口腔检查意识相关。作者据此强调产前保健中应加强循证口腔健康教育，并提示这些关联不等同于因果。

papers.title: The role of libraries in integrating innovative technologies into the pedagogical education system
papers.authors: Кушчубек Кызы Ширин, Aigul K. Chaldanbaeva, Burul Kutueva, Dzh.O. Albanbayeva, Nurgul Chaldanbaeva
papers.abstract: The results of this study confirm the possibility of creating a model of transforming the libraries of Kyrgyzstan into innovative scientometric centres that will provide scientometric support for the educational process. For the research, theoretical and case study analysis of leading institutions in the country, such as Kyrgyz National University named after Jusup Balasagyn and Ishenaly Arabaev Kyrgyz State University, was performed. In addition, a review of regulatory and prognostic methods was carried out. The digital transformation of academic libraries is taking place, and the focus of library activities is shifting towards the development of 4C competencies: cooperation, coordination, communication, and creativity.
