The automated systems, cloud storage, and tools based on artificial intelligence allow the libraries to shift from being repositories of knowledge to relational service organizations, where the librarian becomes a media coach and information mentor. Projects such as the “Digital CASA-Kyrgyz Republic” project provide legitimacy to electronic resources within education. Access to international scientometric databases and scientific repositories, such as the UN, Medline, and Hinari, allows the scientific research of the country to be published on the international scientific and academic stage. The implementation of these technologies and the commitment to environmental responsibility in the “Green and Digital Universities” concept will become a vital condition for the development of the educational system of Kyrgyzstan sustainably. The conclusions of the study confirmed that the transformation of libraries into digital mediators of knowledge minimises the cognitive load on students and promotes the development of their digital literacy and academic integrity. The practical significance of the results lies in the possibility of their use by higher education institution administrations and library and information science specialists for developing strategies for the intellectualisation of services, optimising digital asset management, and creating programmes to enhance the digital qualifications of teachers and students.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨吉尔吉斯斯坦高校图书馆如何转型为创新型科学计量中心，以支持教育教学过程。作者通过理论分析与案例研究考察了比什凯克两所主要大学，并结合规范与预测方法进行梳理。研究发现，图书馆数字化正推动其从知识存储库转向关系型服务机构，馆员成为媒体教练和信息导师；自动化系统、云存储与人工智能工具的应用，以及国际科学计量数据库的接入，有助于提升学生数字素养、降低认知负荷并促进学术诚信。文章据此讨论了将图书馆作为知识数字中介的转型路径，并指出相关结论可为高校管理者和图书情报专家制定服务智能化策略提供参考。

papers.title: Dual effects of AI on academic work performance: A job demands-resources theory systematic review
papers.authors: Sheref Gogsido, Matewos Kebede Refera, Abdilkerim Asrar Seman, Baqer Khudair Al-Hadrawi
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping academic work, yet its occupational health implications for academicians remain under-examined. The Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) framework offers a dual lens for understanding AI as both a performance-enhancing resource and a source of job demands, but no systematic review has applied this framework across the full spectrum of academic roles. Objective This systematic review examines how AI impacts academicians’ performance across four core domains—teaching, research, community engagement, and professional development—using the JD-R framework to understand AI's dual nature as both a resource and a demand. Methods Following PRISMA guidelines and the five-stage framework of Khan et al., 1 we systematically searched Scopus and Web of Science databases for empirical studies published between 2021 and 2025. After screening 868 records, 30 peer-reviewed journal articles met the inclusion criteria. A two-phase coding approach (deductive and inductive) was employed, with intercoder reliability (Cohen's Kappa = 0.91) indicating strong agreement. Thematic analysis was guided by the JD-R framework. Results Teaching performance dominates the literature (70%), reflecting AI's immediate impact on instructional practices. AI functions as a job resource through enhanced personalized learning, assessment automation, and administrative efficiency when supported by self-efficacy, AI literacy, and institutional resources. However, AI creates significant job demands including academic integrity management, assessment redesign, continuous upskilling, and ethical dilemmas. Professional development (27%) exhibits the most severe demand-resource imbalance, with faculty experiencing skill obsolescence anxiety, technostress, and imposter syndrome. Research performance (20%) shows a relatively balanced profile, while community engagement (7%) remains critically understudied. Identity-threatening demands—academic integrity in teaching, authorship ambiguity in research, and skill obsolescence in professional development—generate disproportionate psychological strain requiring specialized buffers. Conclusions AI's impact on academic work is inherently dualistic, with outcomes determined by the balance between available resources and demand intensity. Psychological resources, particularly self-efficacy, emerge as the most powerful enablers mediating the effectiveness of institutional and knowledge resources. The review extends JD-R theory by identifying identity-threatening demands as a distinct demand category and proposing a Resource Cascade Model wherein distal organizational resources foster proximal psychological resources. Institutions must adopt systemic, autonomy-supportive interventions addressing the full spectrum of AI's impact on academic work.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以工作要求-资源（JD-R）框架为线索，系统梳理了2021至2025年间关于人工智能如何影响高校教师工作表现的实证研究，覆盖教学、科研、社区参与和专业发展四个领域。分析显示，AI在具备自我效能、AI素养和机构资源支持时可作为资源提升个性化教学、评估自动化与行政效率，但同时带来学术诚信管理、评估重构、持续技能更新和伦理困境等要求；专业发展领域的要求-资源失衡最突出，表现为技能过时焦虑、技术压力和冒名顶替感，科研领域相对均衡，社区参与则研究不足。作者据此将身份威胁性要求列为独立的要求类别，并提出资源 cascade 模型，强调心理资源在机构资源转化为成效中的中介作用，提示机构需采取支持自主性的系统性干预。

papers.title: Ensemble machine learning for multi-class anemia severity prediction and risk factor identification among Ethiopian adolescents
papers.authors: Misganaw Ketema Ayele, Eyob teshager enyew
papers.abstract: Background Anemia remains a major public health concern among adolescent girls in Ethiopia, adversely affecting physical growth, cognitive development, educational attainment, and future reproductive health. Accurate prediction of anemia severity and identification of key risk factors are essential for supporting targeted prevention and intervention strategies. Objective This study aimed to develop and compare tree-based ensemble machine learning models for multi-class prediction of anemia severity among Ethiopian adolescent girls using nationally representative survey data. Methods This study analyzed Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS) data from 2011 and 2016, including 15,952 adolescent females aged 15–19 years. Four tree-based ensemble machine learning algorithms (Random Forest, Extra Trees, CatBoost, and XGBoost) were developed and compared with a baseline Multinomial Logistic Regression model. Following TRIPOD-AI recommendations, data preprocessing included missing value imputation, categorical feature encoding, Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) for feature selection, and Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) to address class imbalance. To prevent data leakage, all preprocessing and SMOTE procedures were applied exclusively within the training folds. Models were trained using stratified 10-fold cross-validation on 70% of the data and evaluated on an independent 30% hold-out test set (n = 4786) using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and macro-average ROC-AUC. Model interpretability was assessed using global and local SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). Results Random Forest achieved the highest predictive performance, with an accuracy of 85.60% and a macro-average ROC-AUC of 94.84%, followed by Extra Trees (85.10% accuracy; 94.48% ROC-AUC) and CatBoost (83.80% accuracy; 93.08% ROC-AUC). The baseline Multinomial Logistic Regression model achieved 71.20% accuracy and an ROC-AUC of 81.50%. SHAP analysis consistently identified geographic region, altitude, educational level, household wealth index, and household size as the most influential predictors of anemia severity. Conclusion Tree-based ensemble machine learning models, particularly Random Forest and Extra Trees, substantially outperformed conventional multinomial logistic regression for multi-class prediction of anemia severity among Ethiopian adolescent girls. Their strong predictive performance and SHAP-based interpretability highlight their potential to support evidence-based screening, risk stratification, and targeted public health interventions in resource-limited settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用埃塞俄比亚人口与健康调查数据，比较随机森林、Extra Trees、CatBoost和XGBoost等树集成模型与多项逻辑回归在青少年女孩贫血严重程度多分类预测中的表现，并通过SHAP分析识别关键风险因素。结果显示，随机森林和Extra Trees的预测性能明显优于传统回归模型，地区、海拔、教育水平、家庭财富指数和家庭规模是最具影响力的预测因素。作者据此认为，这类模型结合可解释性分析，有望辅助资源有限地区的贫血筛查、风险分层和针对性公共卫生干预，但结论基于调查数据的预测表现，尚不能等同于实际干预效果。

papers.title: How to Institutionalize and Individualize Educational Programs to Prevent Violence
papers.authors: David Finkelhor B
papers.abstract: We need to build broader, comprehensive and well-established curricula incorporating violence prevention along with other life skills, prevention practices, health information, character building and decision-making. We might be able to take advantage of the curricular revolution that is likely to arrive soon. This revolution will be from the greater deployment of artificial intelligence to personalize the learning process. Strategies are needed to overcome the obstacles to the collaborations required to create these comprehensive curricula. Evaluations are needed of these comprehensive approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇立场性论述，主张把暴力预防与其他生活技能、健康信息、品格培养和决策能力整合进更全面、成熟且覆盖面更广的课程体系。作者认为，人工智能在学习过程中的更广泛部署有望推动个性化学习，从而为课程改革提供契机，但要让各方协作开发这类综合课程，还需专门策略来克服障碍。文章强调，对这些综合课程方案开展评估是必要环节，但摘要未报告任何实证数据或评估结果。

papers.title: The Student Success Bypass: How Generative AI Decouples Performance from Learning
papers.authors: Royel M. Johnson
papers.journal: Teachers College Record The Voice of Scholarship in Education
papers.abstract: The rapid development of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has fundamentally changed how college students produce their academic work. As a result, it has also unsettled long-standing assumptions about what constitutes student success. Yet, much of the discussion has focused on academic dishonesty and detection, leaving a more funadmental question largely unaddressed: What happens to student success when the thinking it is meant to represent can be offloaded to GenAI? Drawing on Perna and Thomas’s (2006) framework of student success, this essay distinguishes between traditional indicators of success, such as grades, persistence, and completion, and the developmental process those indictors are presumed to reflect. I introduce the concept of student success bypass to describe how GenAI enables students to achieve conventional benchmarks without necessrily engaging in the cognitive and relational work traditionally associated with them. This bypass can produce cognitive debt and contribute to what I call hollow persistence, in which students continue progressing toward a degree without meaningful learning. I close with recommendations for how institutions can move beyond conventional indicators of success to more direclty assess the development processes they are meant to represent.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论生成式人工智能介入大学生学业后，“学生成功”这一概念面临的挑战。作者借用Perna与Thomas的学生成功框架，区分成绩、坚持和完成等传统指标与这些指标本应反映的发展过程，并提出“学生成功绕道”概念，说明GenAI可让学生在不必然投入相应认知与人际工作的情况下达到常规标准，进而可能带来认知债务和“空心化坚持”，即学生持续向学位推进却缺乏有意义的学习。文章据此建议院校超越传统成功指标，更直接地评估其本应代表的发展过程。

papers.title: Designing a Unity-Integrated AI-Assisted Game Development Environment for Investigating Learner's Metacognitive Development in Game Programming Tasks
papers.authors: Dania Alsaid
papers.journal: ACM Annual Symposium on Computer-Human Interaction in Play (CHI PLAY)
papers.abstract: The emergence of AI-assisted coding tools has created urgent questions about how undergraduate computer science education must change. This study will investigate how structured AI-assisted game development, enacted through VibeLab, a Unity-integrated educational platform, will scaffold metacognitive awareness and computational thinking in undergraduate CS students. Grounded in Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development, Papert's constructionism, and Flavell's metacognitive regulation framework, the study will adopt a Participatory Action Research methodology across three iterative design cycles. Students will produce two game artifacts, one AI assisted and one traditionally coded, with prompt behaviour to be captured and analysed using RoBERTa-based metacognitive classifier. Creative output will be evaluated by industry judges using Amabile's Consensual Assessment Technique in an authentic Game Jam. The study will contribute a validated metacognitive prompt taxonomy, the VibeLab platform, and the pedagogical framework for integrating structured AI-assisted development into undergraduate CS curricula.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究计划考察结构化的人工智能辅助游戏开发如何支持本科计算机科学学生的元认知意识与计算思维，核心依托Unity集成的教育平台VibeLab，并采用参与式行动研究推进多轮迭代设计。学生将分别完成人工智能辅助与传统编码的游戏作品，其提示行为由基于RoBERTa的元认知分类器分析，创意产出则由行业评委在真实Game Jam情境中依据共识评估技术评价。研究预期形成经过验证的元认知提示分类体系、VibeLab平台及将结构化人工智能辅助开发纳入本科课程的教学框架；摘要呈现的是研究设计与预期贡献，尚未报告实际结果。

papers.title: Envisioning and Co-Creating Generative AI for Future Creative Workers in Gaming: A CHI PLAY 2026 Workshop
papers.authors: Guo Freeman, Carlos Toxtli, Ruchi Panchanadikar, Yang Hu, Julian Frommel, Regan Lee Mandryk, Christian Guckelsberger B, Alena Denisova
papers.journal: ACM Annual Symposium on Computer-Human Interaction in Play (CHI PLAY)

papers.title: Designing Attention-Driven Play: A Multi-Genre Suite of BCI Games
papers.authors: Marie Buhagiar, Daniel Calleja, Chris Porter, Tracey A. Camilleri, Kenneth P. Camilleri, Rosanne Zerafa, Stefanie Türk
papers.journal: ACM Annual Symposium on Computer-Human Interaction in Play (CHI PLAY)
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) gaming remains a niche field, within which the selection of playable games using steady-state visually evoked potentials (SSVEPs) is remarkably limited. The SSVEP paradigm relies on a neural response produced when a person focuses on a visual stimulus flickering at a specific frequency. This enables players to control in-game elements by attending to flickering targets, while the system detects the target frequency from electroencephalography (EEG) signals. Due to its high classification rate, reliability and minimal training requirements SSVEP represents a highly promising approach for interactive BCI games. The limited SSVEP games available in the literature are usually prototypes tied to a specific study, typically using lab-grade or emerging headsets, with the primary aim of validating technical EEG processing pipelines rather than to optimise the player's experience. This paper argues that the field of BCI-games needs a more purposefully designed collection of diverse, interoperable, experience-first SSVEP games that together demonstrate the breadth of attention-driven play – a paradigm where gameplay input is generated through selective attention to visual in-game stimuli, rather than through conventional motor input. To address this need, this paper presents NeuroTune, a multi-headset SSVEP suite that offers both a calibration process to optimise an individual's SSVEP response and a suite of HTML5 games, currently including MazeMind (a narrative puzzle), NeuroDash (an endless runner), and CogniConnect4 (an asymmetric multiplayer connect four). These games were designed from the ground up for this unified platform, which can be played using multiple consumer-grade EEG headsets and any Lab-Streaming Layer (LSL) compatible device, removing vendor lock-in. NeuroTune is a deliberate attempt to shift the focus from standalone BCI prototypes to integrated software suites, expanding the small, fragmented library of SSVEP games through a unified, accessible platform.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）脑机接口游戏数量少、多为验证技术流程的单一原型、且常绑定特定设备的问题，提出应转向以体验为先、多样且可互操作的游戏集合。作者据此设计并实现了 NeuroTune：一个支持多种消费级脑电头戴设备及任意兼容 LSL 设备的统一平台，包含个体 SSVEP 响应校准流程和三款从零为该平台开发的 HTML5 游戏（叙事解谜、无尽跑酷与非对称多人四子棋）。文章将这一工作定位为从孤立原型迈向集成软件套件的尝试，旨在以统一、易获取的平台拓展注意力驱动游戏的类型与可及性；摘要未报告玩家体验或分类性能的实证评估结果。

papers.title: Voice Over Persona: Dialogue Modality Drives Player Engagement and Immersion in LLM-Driven AI Agents in Games
papers.authors: Zhimo Li, Nandhini Giri
papers.journal: ACM Annual Symposium on Computer-Human Interaction in Play (CHI PLAY)
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled Non-Player Characters (NPCs) in video games to generate context-aware, real-time dialogue, opening new possibilities for designing richer and more immersive player experiences [14]. However, the effects of specific NPC design variables on player experience remain empirically underexplored. This paper presents a work-in-progress study examining how NPC persona (Empathic/Supportive vs. Low-Empathy/Task-focused) and dialogue modality (Text vs. Voice) influence player emotional response, engagement, and immersion in an AI-driven game environment. A Unity-based first-person detective game prototype was developed, in which an AI-driven NPC mentor guides players through a fictional investigation. Using a 2 × 2 within-subjects factorial design, 23 adult university students each completed four gameplay scenarios representing all combinations of persona and modality. Player experience was measured after each scenario using the Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM), the User Engagement Scale Short Form (UES-SF), and two subscales of the Immersive Experience Questionnaire (IEQ). Results indicated that dialogue modality had a consistent and significant effect on player experience, with voice-based interaction producing significantly higher scores on IEQ Emotional Involvement and UES Focused Attention compared to text-based interaction, and marginal trends in the same direction across all remaining measures. NPC persona did not produce significant differences in any measure; a result interpreted as reflecting the brief scenario duration and inherent variability of real-time LLM-generated dialogue rather than the absence of any persona effect. No significant interaction between persona and modality was found. These findings suggest that the modality through which players communicate with an AI-driven NPC is a more immediate impactful design decision, offering practical guidance for developers designing LLM-driven NPC systems in narrative games. Future work will include studies to investigate how specific NPC communication styles impact player experience in prolonged multiple round game levels.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注LLM驱动的游戏NPC设计中，人格设定（共情支持型与低共情任务导向型）和对话模态（文字与语音）如何影响玩家的情绪反应、参与度和沉浸感。作者开发了基于Unity的第一人称侦探游戏原型，采用2×2被试内设计，让参与者体验四种组合场景并用量表测量体验。结果显示，对话模态的影响一致且显著：语音交互在情感投入和专注注意力上明显高于文字交互，其余指标也呈同方向趋势；NPC人格未带来显著差异，作者认为这可能与场景时长较短及实时生成对话的波动性有关，而非人格本身无效，两者也无显著交互。研究据此提示，在叙事游戏中，玩家与AI驱动NPC的沟通模态是更直接见效的设计选择。

papers.title: Wonder Town: Integrating Generative AI into a Bloom-Aligned Physics Learning Game
papers.authors: 付良军, Aurora Constantin, Gennaro Imperatore, Kejia Zhang
papers.journal: ACM Annual Symposium on Computer-Human Interaction in Play (CHI PLAY)
papers.abstract: Physics education remains challenging for many secondary-school students because core concepts such as forces, motion, electricity, and magnetism are abstract, counterintuitive, and frequently associated with persistent misconceptions. Although educational games and generative AI have shown potential to support learning, most existing systems position AI in a single role—such as a chatbot tutor or narrative generator—rather than integrating it throughout the broader learning experience. As a result, opportunities for adaptive support, sustained engagement, and cognitively scaffolded learning within game-based environments remain limited. This paper presents Wonder Town, a web-based physics learning serious game that integrates generative AI across multiple stages of a learning process structured around Bloom’s Taxonomy, a framework that supports progression from lower-order to higher-order thinking skills. The system combines AI-generated narrative styles, a diegetic AI mascot named Jules, reflective conversational feedback, and five hand-coded interactive physics simulations covering topics including motion, forces, friction, electricity, and magnetism. Wonder Town was developed iteratively and evaluated with secondary-school students and physics teachers through a mixed-methods design process. The paper contributes a Bloom-aligned multi-touchpoint design pattern for integrating generative AI into educational games. It also provides early evidence that embedding AI within a narrative-driven and cognitively scaffolded learning experience can support engaging, personalised, and educationally meaningful gameplay.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对物理教育中抽象概念难学、现有教育游戏多将生成式AI局限于单一角色的问题，提出并实现了网页端物理学习严肃游戏Wonder Town。该系统按布鲁姆分类法组织学习进程，将AI生成叙事、吉祥物对话反馈与五个手工编写的物理交互模拟结合，并采用混合方法对中学生和物理教师进行迭代评估。文章据此提出一种与布鲁姆目标对齐的多触点生成式AI整合设计模式，并给出初步证据表明，将AI嵌入叙事驱动且具认知支架的游戏体验，有助于提升游戏的参与度、个性化与教育意义。

papers.title: TokenVerse: A Game-Based Learning Experience for Understanding Large Language Models and Human-AI Interaction Risks
papers.authors: Huijia Huang, Katelyn Gumagay, Yining Zhang, Jeremiah Timberlake, Cathy Lin, Vanshika Khatwani, Joseph Tabor, Tianjian Wei, Sijia She, Brian S. Magerko
papers.journal: ACM Annual Symposium on Computer-Human Interaction in Play (CHI PLAY)

papers.title: Learning about learning: A path from spin glasses to artificial intelligence
papers.authors: Denis D. Caprioti, Matheus Haas, Constantino Francisco Vasconcelos, Mauricio Girardi‐Schappo
papers.abstract: The Hopfield model, originally inspired by spin glasses, occupies a central place at the intersection of statistical mechanics, neural networks, and artificial intelligence. Despite its conceptual simplicity and broad applicability, it is rarely integrated into the undergraduate physics curriculum. We present the Hopfield model as a pedagogically rich framework that naturally unifies core topics from the undergraduate physics curriculum and that provides a concise introduction based on concepts such as a model's energy function, dynamics, and pattern stability. We discuss practical aspects of its simulation and provide simulation codes. We also propose problems designed to mirror research practice, which can be included in undergraduate classes.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇教学性论文，讨论如何把Hopfield模型引入本科物理课程，以串联统计力学、神经网络与人工智能的相关内容。作者以能量函数、动力学和模式稳定性等概念给出简明介绍，说明该模型能自然统一本科物理课程中的核心主题，并讨论了模拟的实践环节、提供了模拟代码。文章还设计了贴近科研实践的问题，供本科课堂使用；其重点在于教学框架与可操作材料，而非报告新的实证结果。

papers.title: Infra‐slow brain–heart–gut electrophysiological interactions reveal a co‐ordinated multisystem physiological network in humans
papers.authors: Giovanni Sitti, Laura Pitti, Diego Candia‐Rivera
papers.abstract: Abstract Growing evidence indicates that brain continuously interacts with other physiological systems through neural and non‐neural pathways. The brain–heart and brain–gut axes play a central role in homoeostasis, allostasis and behaviour, but also in cognitive aspects, including emotion and decision‐making. Disruptions in these axes have been linked to a wide range of cardiovascular, neurological and psychiatric disorders. Despite this evidence, triadic crosstalk between the brain, heart and gut remains largely unexplored. Brain activity, cardiac autonomic fluctuations and gastric rhythms all exhibit slow temporal components in resting state, suggesting that brain–heart–gut electrophysiological interactions may occur over time scales from the infra‐slow (0.01–0.1 Hz) physiological range. Using open‐access electrophysiological recordings from 28 healthy subjects at rest, we extracted time‐varying power dynamics describing the activity of the three organs: brain alpha power, cardiac sympathetic and parasympathetic indices, and the power of the gastric rhythm. Statistical associations among these organs were quantified using the maximal information coefficient across the extended temporal delay range. Physiological interactions were confirmed using surrogate‐based testing, which allowed us to construct the network topology of interactions between the three organs. Our findings show that triadic brain–heart–gut interactions form a multidirectional network primarily at infra‐slow time scales during resting state. This study offers one of the first insights into the physiology of brain–heart–gut interplay, providing a methodological baseline for the development of more comprehensive biomarkers based on network dynamics capable of linking pathological conditions to dysregulation across multiple organ systems. image Key points First in‐human, non‐invasive investigation of parallel brain–heart–gut electrophysiological interactions in awake, healthy subjects. We analysed simultaneous electroencephalographic (EEG), electrocardiographic (ECG) and electrogastrographic (EGG) recordings and quantified strength and temporal scale of the derived time series associations to construct a large‐scale network of interactions. We found that brain–heart–gut interactions extend into the infra‐slow range (0.01–0.1 Hz), indicating that spontaneous fluctuations in the electrophysiological activity of one organ at rest are typically followed by corresponding changes in the other two. We consistently found a robust brain–heart–gut network topology across subjects, with multidirectional interactions and bodily dynamics converging towards midline central‐posterior EEG regions. These findings provide one of the first endeavours in characterizing the physiology of brain–heart–gut interactions and a methodology with strong biomarker development potential.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察清醒健康人静息状态下脑、心、胃三系统电生理活动之间是否存在协同交互，利用公开的同步脑电、心电与胃电记录，提取各器官活动的时变功率动态，并在较宽的时间延迟范围内量化三者关联，再用替代数据检验确认交互并非偶然。结果显示，三系统交互主要出现在超慢（0.01–0.1 Hz）时间尺度上，形成多方向网络，且各受试者间网络拓扑较为一致，身体动态汇聚于中线中央-后部脑电区域。作者据此提出，这为理解脑-心-胃协同生理及开发基于网络动态的跨系统生物标志物提供了方法学基础，但结论限于静息状态与健康受试者。

papers.title: AI-Augmented Short-Form Video Journalism and Audience Trust on Platforms like YouTube Shorts
papers.authors: Khalilov Abdygany, Yihao Shen, Jiaxing Fei, Zelong Yu, Wenwen Miao
papers.abstract: With the rise of short-form video content creation on social media, along with the growing role of AI in online content creation, there is a need for validation of the use of AI in newsrooms and in social media journalistic communication. To study how AI implementation in short-form video journalism affects the audience's perception of trust, engagement, and authenticity, this study examines how AI technology is shaping media content and how this process influences audiences' perception. As AI becomes more and more popular as a tool for news production, there is an increasing need for research that will explore the perception of audiences in regard to AI-mediated content and how it affects credibility and interaction. The study used a mixed-methods design of surveying 300 participants and conducting focus groups with them. The quantitative data collected were analysed using descriptive statistics, correlation, and regression, while qualitative information was obtained using thematic analysis. The finding suggests that transparency can create a perception of deception among the audiences; authenticity is seen as performative, and engagement is somewhat habit-based. Additionally, AI journalism is not necessarily affecting trust in a negative way, but rather changing the way audiences perceive news.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察AI参与短视频新闻制作如何影响受众对信任、参与和真实性的感知，采用问卷调查与焦点小组相结合的混合方法，以300名参与者为对象。结果显示，透明度反而可能让受众产生被欺骗感，真实性被视为表演性的，参与则带有习惯性成分；AI新闻未必直接损害信任，而更多是改变受众理解新闻的方式。文章据此提示，在短视频新闻场景中，AI的使用效果取决于受众如何解读透明与真实，而非简单的技术接受问题。

papers.title: How Perceived University Support Shapes Marketing Students’ AI Self-Efficacy: A Multigroup Dual-Mediation TAM Analysis Across Three Chinese Universities
papers.authors: Yuanmei Wang, Min Huang, 李淑娟
papers.journal: Journal of Education and Training Studies
papers.abstract: The proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI) in marketing has prompted higher education institutions to invest substantially. However, a critical pedagogical question remains: whether and how these institutional investments translate into students’ psychological readiness to deploy AI tools effectively. Students’ AI self-efficacy constitutes a foundational prerequisite for technology adoption and career adaptability. A lack of such confidence can precipitate technology avoidance behaviors and diminish learning engagement. Drawing on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) as a cognitive-mediation framework, this study investigates how perceived university support (PUS) shapes marketing students'’ AI self-efficacy (AISE) through the dual mediating beliefs of perceived usefulness (PU) and perceived ease of use (PEOU),and whether this mechanism holds across institutionally heterogeneous settings. Using structural equation modeling with a sample of 538 marketing students from three Chinese universities, we find that PUS significantly enhanced both PU and PEOU in all samples,and that both beliefs carried the effect of support to self-efficacy.PU and PEOU mediated the PUS–AISE relationship: the indirect effect via PEOU was consistently stronger than that via PU,and the direct PUS–AISE path remained significant in two of the three institutions.This study bridges the gap between resource allocation and student psychological outcomes. The robust dual-mediation pathway offers actionable insights for universities: to build student confidence in AI, investments must be channeled not merely into infrastructure but also into pedagogical strategies that demonstrably reduce the perceived complexity of AI tools and illustrate the professional relevance of these tools.Limitations concerning the cross-sectional self-report design and the single-country sample are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于技术接受模型，考察高校感知支持如何通过感知有用性与感知易用性的双重中介影响市场营销专业学生的AI自我效能感，并检验这一机制在不同院校间是否一致。作者对三所中国高校的市场营销学生进行问卷调查，采用结构方程模型分析。结果显示，感知支持在全部样本中均提升了两类信念，二者共同中介了支持与自我效能感的关系，其中经由感知易用性的间接效应始终强于经由感知有用性的路径；支持对自我效能感的直接路径仅在部分院校显著。研究据此提示，高校若想增强学生的AI信心，除基础设施投入外，还需通过教学策略降低学生对AI工具复杂性的感知，并说明其职业相关性。结论受横断面自评设计和单一国家样本的限制。

papers.title: The lie in the eyes: Ocular indicators and machine‐learning models with a cognitive load paradigm to detect lying
papers.authors: Alice Naomi Preti, Giulia Melis, Barbara Barbieri, Giuseppe Sartori, F Crippa, Stefano Zago, Nadia Bolognini
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose Behavioural and ocular markers may provide reliable indicators of lying, although their combined use remains underexplored. This study examined whether eye‐tracking could contribute to the detection of lying using an Induced fake identity (IFI) paradigm, considering the association between pupillary dynamics, eye‐blinks and behavioural indices of lying. Machine learning was also used to assess the predictive value of these measures. Methods Fifty‐seven healthy adults underwent an IFI task, randomised to lying or truth‐telling conditions. Participants responded to Control, Expected and Unexpected questions while assuming either a fake identity or their true identity, while their ocular (pupil dilation and eye‐blinks) and behavioural (reaction times and errors) responses were recorded. Results Liars exhibited significantly longer reaction times than truth‐tellers, particularly in response to Unexpected questions, consistent with greater cognitive demands during deception. Similarly, baseline‐corrected pupil responses also differed between groups: whereas truth‐tellers showed reduced pupil dilation during Unexpected questions compared with Control and Expected questions, liars exhibited relatively stable pupil responses across question types. No group differences emerged in eye‐blink rate, nor in errors. Machine‐learning models achieved up to 84% accuracy and identified reaction times to Unexpected questions as the strongest predictor of deception, whereas ocular measures provided limited additional predictive value. Conclusions Lying is characterised by slower responses to identity‐related Unexpected questions and distinct patterns of pupillary modulation. Although reaction times were the strongest predictor of deception, pupillary responses may provide complementary information about the psychophysiological processes associated with deceptive responding.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察眼动指标能否辅助识别说谎，并检验瞳孔变化、眨眼与行为指标之间的关联。作者让健康成年参与者在虚假身份任务中分别说谎或说真话，同时记录眼动与行为反应，并用机器学习评估这些指标的预测价值。结果显示，说谎者在意外问题上反应更慢，瞳孔反应模式也与说真话者不同，而眨眼率和错误率未见组间差异；机器学习模型最高达到约84%的准确率，其中对意外问题的反应时是最强预测因子，眼动指标的额外预测价值有限。文章据此认为，说谎表现为对身份相关意外问题的迟缓反应和特定的瞳孔调节模式，瞳孔反应或可补充反映欺骗相关的心理生理过程。

papers.title: From Critical Thinking Disposition to Learning Engagement: The Roles of Motivation, Academic Buoyancy, and Grit in AI ‐Supported University Learning
papers.authors: Yiming Cai, Zhiteng Zhao, Meiqi Wang, 廖小玲, Xiaoxia Wei
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Artificial intelligence is changing university students' learning experiences, but how cognitive dispositions translate into sustained engagement in AI‐supported learning remains insufficiently understood. Guided by the Study Demands–Resources Model, this study examines the association between critical thinking disposition and learning engagement, with learning motivation, academic buoyancy, and grit as parallel indirect pathways. Using cross‐sectional data from 729 university students with experience using AI for learning, structural equation modelling tested the direct and indirect relationships among the variables, after which psychological network analysis identified central and bridge nodes within the learning psychological system. Critical thinking disposition was conceptualised as a cognitive personal resource, and learning motivation as a motivational resource. Academic buoyancy captured students' capacity to manage everyday academic setbacks, whereas grit represented perseverance in pursuing long‐term learning goals. The combination of variable‐centred and network‐based analyses provided complementary views of how these resources relate to university students' engagement in AI‐supported learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在人工智能支持的学习情境中，大学生的批判性思维倾向如何与学习投入相关联。作者基于学习要求—资源模型，以729名有AI学习经验的大学生为对象，采用横断面问卷和结构方程模型检验学习动机、学业浮力与坚毅的中介路径，并用心理网络分析识别学习心理系统中的核心与桥梁节点。结果显示，批判性思维倾向与学习投入存在关联，且可能通过上述资源性因素间接相连；但横断面设计只能提示关联而非因果，结论受样本与情境限制。

papers.title: Exploring Chinese Students' Perceived Strategies for Regulating AI Anxiety in Their Education: A Focus Group Inquiry
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Xing, Xiuwei Liang
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in education has been found to affect students' psycho‐emotional states. However, there is insufficient research on how learners can regulate their AI anxiety through emotion regulation strategies before and after its occurrence. To fill this gap, the present research adopted a qualitative design to unveil Chinese general education students' perceived regulation strategies used to manage their AI anxiety. A focus group interview was conducted online with 20 students, who were selected non‐randomly. The results of thematic analysis indicated eight preventive and responsive regulation techniques to cope with AI anxiety. Before the emergence of AI anxiety, the students suggested that by ‘developing AI literacy/competency’, ‘increasing self‐efficacy in using technology’, ‘seeing AI as an assistant rather than a danger’, and ‘discussing AI concerns with peers and teachers’ they can handle their anxiety in the class. To respond to AI anxiety after its occurrence, the participants recommended ‘cognitive reframing and reappraisal of threats’, ‘mindfulness and reflective practices’, ‘stress‐management exercises’, and ‘seeking external help’. The study highlights individual and collective practices to regulate AI anxiety. Implications for theory and practice of emotion regulation in the context of AI are provided.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中国通识教育学生在AI使用中如何调节AI焦虑，采用焦点小组访谈的质性设计，非随机选取20名学生进行在线访谈，并通过主题分析归纳其感知到的调节策略。结果区分出焦虑出现前的预防性策略与出现后的应对性策略，前者包括发展AI素养与能力、提升技术使用自我效能、将AI视为助手而非威胁、与同伴和教师讨论AI顾虑，后者包括认知重评、正念与反思练习、压力管理练习以及寻求外部帮助。研究据此强调个体与集体层面的焦虑调节实践，并为AI情境下情绪调节的理论与实践提供启示；结论基于学生的主观感知，属于质性探索。

papers.title: Education in the era of artificial intelligence from a cross-border perspective regarding student perceptions, meta-competences and institutional integration
papers.authors: Carmen Boghean, Daniela-Mihaela Neamţu, Lucia Moroșan-Dănilă, Florin Boghean, Claudia-Elena Grigoraș-Ichim
papers.abstract: Purpose The accelerated transformations of the digital economy require a profound rethinking of higher education, especially in terms of preparing human capital for a future shaped by artificial intelligence (AI). The use of AI is no longer a peripheral technological option. Still, it has become a central vector in defining the skills required in the labour market, streamlining educational processes, and reshaping the relationship between learning and performance. Design/methodology/approach This paper aims to analyse, from a cross-border perspective, how AI is integrated into higher education in Romania, the Republic of Moldova and Ukraine. The investigation examines the relationships among available educational resources, AI use, AI-related skills, meta-competencies, self-reported perceived academic performance and career intentions in an emerging digital context. Findings The study uses a convergent mixed-methods design, combining survey data from 678 students with 76 semi-structured interviews with university teachers. The findings show that AI adoption is shaped by the interaction between institutional resources, actual use, AI-related skills, meta-competencies and national context. Students from Romania and the Republic of Moldova reported more frequent and varied AI use than students from Ukraine, while the Ukrainian profile reflected a more cautious pattern shaped by risk perception and contextual constraints. The results also indicate that resources and institutional support matter mainly when they translate into concrete AI use and competence development. Originality/value The study contributes empirically and contextually to comparative research on educational technology adoption by showing that AI integration in higher education depends not only on technological acceptance, but also on institutional readiness, educational equity, digital access and responsible pedagogical governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从跨境比较视角考察罗马尼亚、摩尔多瓦和乌克兰三国高等教育中人工智能的整合情况，采用混合方法，将学生问卷调查与大学教师半结构化访谈相结合，分析教育资源、AI使用、相关技能、元能力、自评学业表现与职业意向之间的关系。研究发现，AI采用受制度资源、实际使用、技能、元能力与国家情境的共同作用影响：罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦学生使用AI更频繁多样，乌克兰学生则因风险感知和情境约束而更为谨慎；资源与制度支持只有在转化为具体使用和能力发展时才真正起作用。文章据此指出，高校AI整合不仅取决于技术接受度，也依赖制度准备、教育公平、数字可及性与负责任的教學治理。

papers.title: AI source disclosure in sustainable advertising: felt obligation, competence framing and decision-making orientation
papers.authors: Ying Yang, Di Wu
papers.journal: Journal of Research in Interactive Marketing
papers.abstract: Purpose This research examines when and why artificial intelligence (AI) source disclosure reduces participation in sustainable advertising. It proposes that AI source disclosure is associated with lower felt obligation toward the campaign organization and that this negative effect depends on appeal type and decision-making orientation. Design/methodology/approach Five experiments tested the proposed model. Study 1 used an interactive webpage and a consequential sharing task to examine actual participation. Study 2 examined felt obligation as the proposed mediator while testing perceived sincerity as an alternative explanation. Studies 3 and 4 tested the moderating role of warmth versus competence appeals in Chinese and US samples, respectively. Study 5 examined instrumental versus normative decision-making as an additional boundary condition. Findings Campaigns attributed to AI sources generated lower participation than campaigns attributed to human sources. This effect was associated with reduced felt obligation toward the organization, while sincerity and authenticity were not supported as mediators. The negative effect was stronger for warmth appeals and normative decision-making, but weaker for competence appeals and instrumental decision-making. Originality/value This research identifies felt obligation toward the campaign organization as a pathway associated with responses to AI source disclosure in sustainable advertising. It extends the stereotype content model by demonstrating that appeal type conditions the AI source-disclosure effect and contributes to stakeholder and AI decision-making research by identifying decision-making orientation as an additional boundary condition.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察可持续广告披露AI来源为何以及何时会降低公众参与，通过五项实验结合互动网页、实际分享任务与情境操纵，检验感知义务的中介作用及诉求类型和决策取向的调节。结果显示，标为AI来源的广告活动参与度低于标为人类来源者，这一关联与对活动组织的感知义务下降有关，而真诚性和真实性未获支持为中介。负面效应在温暖诉求和规范性决策下更强，在能力诉求和工具性决策下较弱。研究据此将感知义务识别为AI来源披露影响参与的一条路径，并提示诉求框架与决策取向是重要边界条件。

papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop AI for resilient supply chain operations: a framework for augmented decision-making and ethical deployment
papers.authors: Mehtab Alam, Chandra Kanta Samal, Shamsh Parveen, Ashraf M Ali, Abdullah Alourani
papers.abstract: Purpose This research examines how Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) artificial intelligence (AI) can support resilient decision-making, operational performance, transparency, trust and ethical accountability in operations and supply chain management (OSCM). Design/methodology/approach The research adopts a design science research approach combined with comparative case analysis. A HITL AI framework, termed the adaptive oversight architecture (AOA), was developed and evaluated in two contrasting OSCM contexts. System logs, operational observations, interviews and performance indicators were analysed to examine decision outcomes, human oversight, trust and accountability. Findings HITL integration was associated with improved exception-handling accuracy, reduced human override frequency, shorter task-completion times and higher user satisfaction across the two cases. Qualitative findings further indicate that trust calibration, training, interface design, workflow integration and organizational governance influence how effectively human oversight operates. The findings also identify risks of automation dependence, accountability diffusion and inappropriate reliance on algorithmic recommendations. Research limitations/implications The research is limited to two case firms, which constrains the generalizability of the findings. While the dual-case approach provides in-depth insights, broader studies involving larger datasets or cross-industry comparisons are needed to validate the proposed framework. Future research could extend the empirical base by employing longitudinal analysis, simulations or hybrid models that test HITL effectiveness under different operational conditions. These directions will allow for a more comprehensive understanding of the scalability, adaptability and long-term organizational impacts of HITL-enabled supply chains. Practical implications For practitioners, the research highlights how HITL can be implemented to strengthen supply chain decision-making while ensuring compliance with ethical and regulatory standards. It suggests that organizations should prioritize training programs, design user-friendly interfaces and establish override mechanisms to maximize HITL effectiveness. The findings emphasize the importance of aligning AI investments with human oversight structures, rather than pursuing automation in isolation. Managers can use the framework to evaluate readiness, map decision tasks suitable for HITL integration and design workflows that balance speed, transparency and accountability. Social implications By positioning humans as active collaborators, HITL contributes to responsible AI adoption that safeguards jobs, reinforces accountability and reduces risks of algorithmic bias in supply chain operations. The approach ensures that technology complements rather than replaces human expertise, fostering inclusive digital transformation. From a societal perspective, embedding ethical safeguards into AI decision-making promotes trust in enterprise systems and enhances their legitimacy. The findings encourage the development of AI solutions that not only drive operational efficiency but also align with broader social values of fairness, responsibility and human dignity. Originality/value This research conceptualizes HITL as a dynamic socio-technical arrangement rather than a static control mechanism. The proposed AOA explains how human authority, algorithmic decision-making and organizational governance interact through oversight, trust calibration and distributed accountability, providing a mechanism-based conceptualization of HITL for OSCM.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对运营与供应链管理中如何借助人在回路（HITL）人工智能实现韧性决策，采用设计科学研究结合对比案例分析，开发并评估了名为自适应监督架构（AOA）的框架。两个案例的日志、观察、访谈与绩效指标显示，HITL整合与异常处理准确性提升、人工接管频率下降、任务完成时间缩短和用户满意度提高相关；质性分析还表明，信任校准、培训、界面设计、流程整合与组织治理会影响人工监督的实际效果，同时存在自动化依赖、责任分散和不当依赖算法建议的风险。作者据此将HITL理解为动态的社会技术安排而非静态控制机制，并强调其结论受限于两个案例，推广需更多验证。

papers.title: Configurational pathways and spatio-temporal evolution of value co-creation in smart eldercare services: a regional innovation ecosystem perspective
papers.authors: Shaopeng Zhu, Fangkun Liu, Zhiping Hou
papers.abstract: Purpose This study investigates how configurations of regional innovation ecosystem conditions support value co-creation in smart eldercare services, examining both configurational patterns and their spatio-temporal evolution across diverse regional contexts. Design/methodology/approach Integrating Service-Dominant Logic (SDL) with innovation ecosystem theory, the research employs Panel Qualitative Comparative Analysis (Panel-QCA) on panel data from 30 Chinese provinces spanning 2013–2023. Findings Three configurational patterns achieve high-level value co-creation: an actor-environment-resource multi-driven pattern, an actor-resource dual-driven pattern under constrained market openness, and an environment-driven pattern enabled by industry-university-research collaboration. These patterns exhibit a gradient spatial evolution from eastern multi-driven models to central dual-driven models and western environment-driven models. Temporally, they transition from holistic factor accumulation during the formation stage to core condition differentiation with peripheral condition complementarity during the expansion stage. Practical implications It provides policy insights for regions with diverse resource endowments and developmental stages to formulate differentiated smart eldercare service strategies. Originality/value This study extends SDL and innovation ecosystem theory by operationalizing the distinction between micro-level co-creation processes and macro-level structural capacity, demonstrating that regional capacity to support value co-creation emerges from configurational synergies rather than isolated factors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从区域创新生态系统视角出发，考察区域创新生态条件的不同组合如何支撑智慧养老服务中的价值共创，并分析这些组合模式在空间与时间上的演变。作者整合服务主导逻辑与创新生态系统理论，对30个省份的面板数据做面板定性比较分析，识别出三条通向高水平价值共创的路径：主体—环境—资源多驱动、市场开放受限下的主体—资源双驱动，以及产学研协同支撑的环境驱动。这些路径呈现由东向西的梯度空间分布，并在时间上从形成阶段的要素整体积累转向扩展阶段的核心条件分化与外围条件互补。研究据此为不同资源禀赋和发展阶段的地区制定差异化智慧养老策略提供参考，并强调区域支撑价值共创的能力来自条件组合的协同而非单一因素。

papers.title: Encouraging disclosure: the role of personalization in pre-consultation chatbots
papers.authors: Jiamin Peng, Meiling Peng, Manqiong Shen, Xinyi Zhu
papers.journal: Asia Pacific Journal of Marketing and Logistics
papers.abstract: Purpose This study aims to explore how personalized services provided by pre-consultation chatbots influence patients' intentions to self-disclose and the boundary conditions of this effect. Drawing on the Communication Privacy Management Theory, it identifies AI interactive trust as a mediator and examines how disease sensitivity moderates this mechanism. Design/methodology/approach Three scenario experiments and a field survey were conducted to test hypotheses. Experiments 1 and 2 were between-subjects experiments that manipulated pre-consultation chatbot service personalization (low vs. high) in different disease contexts. Experiment 3 employed a 2 (service personalization: low vs. high) × 2 (disease type: low- vs. high-sensitivity) between-subjects design. Survey 4 reconfirmed all hypotheses. Findings Service personalization increased patients' willingness to self-disclose by enhancing AI interactive trust, but only for low-sensitivity diseases. For high-sensitivity conditions, this trust-based effect weakens or even disappears. Originality/value By uncovering the central role of relationship quality in human-AI interactions, this study delivers novel theoretical insights, distinct from prior benefit-risk frameworks, into the internal mechanisms by which AI service personalization shapes users' willingness to self-disclose, extending existing research on the mechanisms of personalized AI services.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于沟通隐私管理理论，考察预诊聊天机器人的个性化服务如何影响患者的自我披露意愿及其边界条件，通过三项情境实验和一项实地调查进行检验，并以AI互动信任作为中介变量。结果显示，服务个性化通过提升患者对AI的互动信任来增强其自我披露意愿，但这一效应仅出现在低敏感性疾病情境中；在高敏感性疾病条件下，这种基于信任的作用会减弱甚至消失。研究据此强调关系质量在人机交互中的核心作用，为理解AI服务个性化影响用户自我披露的内部机制提供了不同于既有收益—风险框架的解释。

papers.title: From chatbot to clinical copilot: the role of generative artificial intelligence in nuclear medicine reporting and data extraction
papers.authors: Pei Fan Shih
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming clinical documentation workflow. This scoping review evaluates the emerging role of LLMs in nuclear medicine and molecular imaging, as recent literature suggests increasing evaluation of newer LLM architectures alongside GPT-4. We conducted a scoping review following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Lens, and Google Scholar was performed from January 2023 to January 2026. Studies were included if they applied LLMs to nuclear medicine tasks (PET/computed tomography, single-photon emission computed tomography, and scintigraphy). General radiology studies were only included if separate nuclear medicine data were extractable. A total of 14 studies were included. While the GPT-4 family remains the most studied, recent literature includes increasing evaluation of non-GPT models, with several studies reporting comparable performance in specific tasks. In data extraction tasks, such as tumor–node–metastasis staging for breast cancer, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and DeepSeek have demonstrated performance comparable or superior to GPT-4o. The applications are primarily categorized into generative reporting (drafting impressions) and data extraction (structuring unstructured text). However, limitations persist: LLMs struggle with dynamic curve analysis (e.g. renal scintigraphy) and visual interpretation. Safety remains a concern, with one study reporting an 8% rate of potentially harmful responses in patient education scenarios. LLMs are evolving from experimental chatbots into capable ‘Clinical copilots’ that can significantly reduce administrative burden through automated reporting and data structuring. However, because of risks of hallucinations and domain-specific limitations in dynamic imaging, human oversight remains non-negotiable. Future research must focus on multimodal integration and multicenter prospective validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了生成式大语言模型在核医学与分子影像报告生成和数据提取中的应用现状，按范围综述流程纳入相关研究。结果显示，GPT-4系列仍是研究最多的模型，但非GPT模型在部分任务上表现相当，如Claude 3.5 Sonnet和DeepSeek在乳腺癌TNM分期等数据提取任务中不逊于甚至优于GPT-4o；应用主要集中在生成报告草稿和结构化非结构化文本。作者同时指出，模型在动态曲线分析和视觉判读上仍有困难，患者教育场景中还存在潜在有害回答，因此人工监督不可替代，未来需关注多模态整合与多中心前瞻性验证。

papers.title: High Prevalence of Pruritus, Fatigue, and Sleep Disorders in MASLD Negatively Affects Health-related Quality of Life and Work Productivity
papers.authors: Zobair M. Younossi, Yusuf Nadir Yilmaz, Ming-Lung Yu, Mohamed El-Kassas, Marlén Castellanos, Yuichiro Eguchi, George V. Papatheodoridis, Vincent Wai‐Sun Wong, Ajay Kumar. Duseja, Ashwani Kumar Singal, Saeed Sadiq Hamid, Elisabetta Bugianesi, Исаков Василий Андреевич, Manuel Romero Gómez, Wah‐Kheong Chan, Khalid Alswat, Jian-Gao Fan, Stuart C. Gordon, Stuart Keith Roberts, Jacob George, Nahúm Méndez‐Sánchez, Çağlayan Keklikkıran, Eugen Tcaciuc, Andrei Racila, Brian Lam, Linda L Henry, Andrei Racila, Maria Stepanova, Saleh A. Alqahtani
papers.abstract: Background: Metabolic dysfunction–associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is associated with health-related quality of life (HRQL) impairment, which can be exacerbated by pruritus, fatigue, and/or sleep disorders. We assessed the prevalence of significant pruritus, fatigue, and sleep disorders in patients with MASLD and evaluated their association with HRQL and work productivity loss. Methods: Patients with MASLD were prospectively enrolled into the Global NAFLD/MASLD Registry. Clinical and HRQL (per CLDQ-MASH and WPAI:SHP questionnaires) data were analyzed according to the presence of significant pruritus, significant fatigue, and sleep disorders. Results: A total of 8034 patients with MASLD from 39 countries (age 54±12 years, 46% male, 50% type 2 diabetes, 39% advanced fibrosis) were included. At baseline, 25% reported significant pruritus, 35% significant fatigue, and 34% sleep disorders, and 10% had all 3 symptoms. Patients with fatigue, pruritus, or sleep disorder were more likely to be female, have higher BMI, more metabolic comorbidities, and greater psychiatric burden. At 1-year follow-up, over half of the patients with baseline symptoms continued to experience them, and 14% to 18% developed de novo symptoms. Multivariate analyses showed that significant pruritus and sleep disorders each independently predicted fatigue [OR=9.51 (8.0-11.3)] when both conditions were present. Pruritus was a strong predictor of sleep disorders [OR=2.90 (2.6-3.3)]. All 3 conditions, especially fatigue, were independently associated with significantly impaired HRQL and work productivity loss. Conclusion: Clinically significant fatigue, pruritus, and sleep disorders are common in MASLD, having a negative impact on HRQL and a substantial economic burden.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于全球MASLD登记队列，考察瘙痒、疲劳和睡眠障碍在代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病患者中的患病情况及其与健康相关生活质量和工作效率损失的关联。研究发现这些症状相当常见，且常持续存在或新发，其中疲劳、瘙痒与睡眠障碍相互预测，并均独立关联于生活质量受损和工作效率下降，疲劳的影响尤为突出。文章提示这些常被忽视的症状构成显著疾病与经济负担，但结论基于观察性关联，不能据此推断因果。

papers.title: Development and Internal Validation of Machine-Learning Models for Individualized Prediction of Hearing Recovery in Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss
papers.authors: Yingqiang Li, Xun Cao, Dongzhou Deng, Xiang Lu, Dan Bing
papers.abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a pragmatic machine-learning model for predicting hearing recovery in sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) using routinely available baseline clinical variables and standard audiometry. Study design: Retrospective prognostic study. Setting: Tertiary teaching hospital in China. Patients: Adults with idiopathic SSNHL evaluated between January 1, 2017, and August 31, 2025, who had pretreatment and follow-up audiometry. The final cohort included 1097 patients contributing 1205 affected ears. Intervention(s): Routine clinical management, including systemic and/or intratympanic corticosteroid therapy according to contemporary clinical practice and physician judgment. Main outcome measure(s): Hearing recovery on follow-up audiogram classified by the 2015 Chinese guideline and Siegel criteria and dichotomized at clinically relevant thresholds. Primary model selection was based on overall performance across the 3 Chinese guideline-defined binary outcomes. Results: Six algorithms were compared using patient-level 5-fold cross-validation, within-fold imputation, calibration assessment, decision-curve analysis, and SHAP interpretation. Tree-based models outperformed logistic models overall. In the primary models excluding treatment variables, LightGBM showed consistent performance across Chinese guideline-defined outcomes. ROC AUCs were 0.873 for full recovery, 0.797 for important recovery and better, and 0.753 for minor recovery and better, with corresponding accuracies of 89.07%, 78.99%, and 69.87%. Under Siegel criteria, LightGBM achieved ROC AUCs of 0.889 for complete recovery, 0.807 for partial recovery and better, and 0.782 for slight improvement and better. Performance was similar in sensitivity models incorporating treatment variables. The most influential predictors were age, baseline hearing thresholds, audiogram configuration, and vertigo. Conclusions: A LightGBM model based on easily collected baseline clinical and audiometric variables showed useful internal performance for predicting hearing recovery in SSNHL and may support early, individualized prognostic assessment, pending external and prospective validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于常规基线临床变量与标准听力学检查，开发并内部验证用于预测突发性感音神经性聋患者听力恢复的机器学习模型，数据来自单中心回顾性队列。作者比较六种算法，发现树模型整体优于逻辑回归，其中LightGBM在多项恢复结局上表现较为一致，区分度随恢复阈值放宽而下降；年龄、基线听阈、听力图形态和眩晕是最主要的影响因素。作者据此认为该模型有望辅助早期个体化预后评估，但结论尚待外部与前瞻性验证。

papers.title: The Evolution of Brain-Computer Interfaces Towards Collaborative Intelligence
papers.authors: Yang Yu, Yingxin Liu, Zhipeng Fan, Zongtan Zhou, Ling‐Li Zeng, Dewen Hu
papers.abstract: Abstract Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are evolving from unidirectional control toward deeper integration of biological and machine intelligence. This transition is constrained by two complementary bottlenecks: Intent Mismatch, or Brain-to-Machine Underreach, in which user intentions cannot be sufficiently decoded, represented, or executed by the machine; and State Mismatch, or Machine-to-Brain Overload, in which system demands exceed the user’s current cognitive, affective, or neural resources. This review uses these two mismatches as an organizing framework for examining the evolution of BCIs toward brain-machine collaborative intelligence, while distinguishing non-invasive and invasive modalities according to their signal characteristics and translational constraints. We review neural decoding, generative artificial intelligence, and shared control as approaches for reducing Intent Mismatch, and passive BCIs, adaptive interaction, neurofeedback, and neuromodulation as approaches for reducing State Mismatch. By integrating these solution paths, this review outlines a pathway toward adaptive, bidirectional, and human-centered BCI systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以“意图失配”和“状态失配”两个互补瓶颈为组织框架，梳理脑机接口从单向控制走向脑机协同智能的演化路径，并区分非侵入与侵入两种模态在信号特征和转化约束上的差异。作者围绕神经解码、生成式人工智能与共享控制讨论如何缓解意图失配，围绕被动脑机接口、自适应交互、神经反馈与神经调控讨论如何缓解状态失配。文章据此提出通向自适应、双向且以人为中心的脑机接口系统的发展路径，属于框架性综述而非实证研究。

papers.title: AI lexicography and literary texts: applying Gricean maxims to evaluate ChatGPT’s performance on Shakespearean vocabulary
papers.authors: Amal BARIK, Rachid Ed-Dali
papers.abstract: Abstract This study evaluates the reliability of ChatGPT-3.5, accessed via its 2024 public web interface, in identifying and contextualizing Shakespearean lexical items within Elizabethan English. Using five lexical items (bread, blood, grace, honest, and wit) as test cases, ChatGPT’s outputs are systematically compared with established reference resources, including Shakespeare’s Words and the Shakespeare Complete Works. The analysis adopts Grice’s cooperative principle—Quality, Quantity, Relevance, and Manner—as an evaluative framework for assessing the accuracy, proportionality, relevance, and clarity of artificial intelligence (AI)-generated responses. A total of eighty responses were independently coded by six raters, yielding perfect inter-rater agreement (Fleiss’ κ = 1.00). Results show that violations of the maxim of Quality—particularly factual inaccuracies, misattribution, and fabricated citations—were dominant across all lexical items, despite variation in semantic domain. While ChatGPT demonstrates fluency and occasional contextual sensitivity, its outputs exhibit instability and limited reliability in historically grounded literary tasks. The findings, specific to ChatGPT-3.5, suggest that this model generation may function as a supplementary tool for exploratory or pedagogical purposes but cannot replace curated lexicographic resources in Shakespearean scholarship; whether these limitations persist in more recent model generations remains an open question for future comparative work.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以莎士比亚词汇为测试案例，考察ChatGPT-3.5在伊丽莎白时期英语词义识别与语境化方面的可靠性，并借助格莱斯合作原则对模型回答的质量、数量、相关性和方式加以评估。结果显示，模型回答的主要问题集中在质量准则的违反上，包括事实不准确、归属错误和虚构引用，尽管其表达流畅且偶有语境敏感性，整体输出仍不稳定，在历史语文学任务中可靠性有限。作者据此认为，该代模型或可作为探索性或教学辅助工具，但无法替代经过整理的词典资源，相关局限是否延续到更新模型仍有待比较研究。

papers.title: A plea to slow down (AI) and think
papers.authors: Estelle Derclaye
papers.journal: Journal of Intellectual Property Law & Practice
papers.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been with us in earnest for about four years now. As the technology has improved, it has infiltrated almost everywhere, often without users’ choice (most conspicuously at the top of search engines, PDF documents and in WhatsApp searches), and many are using it daily. It is easy to see why, as it helps in many ways: businesses can improve efficiency, and hospitals can treat more patients better. Schools and universities, so as not to leave students behind, feel compelled to let them use it, some are even embracing it, encouraging students to use it to improve their chances in the job market. However, scientific research has started to emerge showing that those who use it lose their cognitive skills. For instance, some recent studies show that doctors and software engineers performed less well once they got accustomed to using AI tools and when access to them was subsequently withdrawn.1 In addition, as AI use is spreading, people are starting to resist. They do not want data centres, not only because they suck up resources and create greenhouse gases but also because more data centres mean fewer jobs overall, since AI performs many human tasks. In the IP field, a few examples come to mind, such as the Make It FAIR Campaign2 by UK artists to ensure fair remuneration for AI model training on their works, and the Australian ban on songs that are totally or largely AI-generated in music charts.3 Early focus groups and interviews show artists are hesitant or reluctant to use AI or at best ambivalent about it.4 Ethical concerns (including the fear of being replaced and of being seen as a fraud when using AI) top the list of their reasons. Beyond the obvious dangers AI technology poses, including the risk of it annihilating the human race in a few years, its most imminent problematic aspects are the loss of our cognitive skills and of our jobs.5 In a recent essay,6 Bill Gates (himself recognizing he is obviously biased, as Microsoft runs its own Large Language Model (LLM) and has a share in OpenAI) worries about these two issues. He is calling for ‘human reserved areas’, similar to nature reserves, to keep some jobs for humans, mainly for economic reasons. What does not come from his analysis is that the two types of loss are linked. Having human reserved areas clearly has an educational, even physiological reason to preserve our human cognitive skills, in addition to the economic reason, ie, to (p)reserve some jobs, especially creative ones, for humans rather than machines. If we lose our cognitive skills, we will not be able to create, or will at least become less able to do so. For the first time in history, we will lose grey matter rather than increasing it. In short, we will be less human. So, what does all this mean for IP law? On the one hand, AI’s power can be harnessed to make new inventions such as new vaccines7 and these AI uses should arguably be fostered (notwithstanding the general controls that need to be put in place to curtail the dangers of AI). On the other hand, when it comes to copyright law, and even potentially patent law and other IP areas,8 it seems that the combined effects of the loss of cognitive skills by the user and the replacement of the creator by the machine point to regulation in the light of what Bill Gates suggests, ie, human-reserved areas. Hence, the copyright debate needs to shift from the idea of remunerating authors for having used their works to train AI models to the idea of keeping certain types of work, such as creative ones, only for humans. These human-reserved areas non-appropriable by machines could be likened to the public domain, which no one can appropriate. More than any type of human work, creative work, such as writing music or novels and drawing or painting, involves more than mechanical tasks, probability and logic, but emotion, lived experience, morality, cultural and social awareness, which AI does not and will never have, as it is not human. The problem is of course where to draw the line—if we accept that AI can still be used as a tool. What is the borderline between an AI-assisted (copyrightable) and an AI-generated piece (not copyrightable) of music or artwork, and how to detect it? Labelling and disclosure could help, but early evidence is not conclusive.9 One way to do it would be to prove authorship by asking authors to reveal the logs of the AI model(s) they used to create their works. This is what some academic misconduct officers are doing with students suspected of cheating. Such evidence could be brought in a copyright lawsuit too. In Europe at least, proof of originality is becoming more stringent since the Mio/konektra ruling.10 Whatever the solution, it is our job as IP lawyers and legislators to find it. AI enthusiasts will say creators will never be replaced by machines because the machine needs to be fed new human outputs, but this could change in the future with better technology. More importantly, do authors really want to be creating to feed machines and get peanuts in return? Is that what we want for creators’ new role in this AI-driven society? And will they even do that? And if they do, will they use AI to create and therefore lose cognitive skills in the process? So, for once, whatever their possible agenda is, maybe we should heed the advice of the tech giants, to slow down the machine, to use the machine less, before the ‘The machine stops’, like in E.M. Forster’s short story.11 If we do not act, it will not really be AI that annihilates us: it is us who will annihilate ourselves by decreasing our intelligence and letting the machines we created take over. While AI is here to stay, its use everywhere is not inevitable. It is not too late and this is a plea for academics in all disciplines to use their brains to gather evidence, reflect critically and for (IP) lawyers to slowly but surely craft laws that will harness the good of AI and keep it under control for creators’ and inventors’ sake and that of society.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性评论，围绕生成式人工智能在日常与专业场景中日益普遍的使用展开，讨论其可能带来的认知技能退化与工作被替代这两类相互关联的风险。作者援引已有研究提示，习惯使用AI工具者在工具被撤走后表现下降，并指出艺术家等群体对AI持犹豫或矛盾态度。文章据此主张借鉴“人类保留区”的思路，将创造性工作保留给人类，并认为知识产权法的讨论应从训练数据补偿转向限制机器对特定创作领域的占用，同时提出用披露AI使用日志等方式区分AI辅助与AI生成作品。作者也承认划界与检测仍存困难，相关证据尚不充分。

papers.title: Lingering Norfentanyl: Considerations for Prolonged Clearance in Pregnancy Given Potential Clinical and Legal Implications
papers.authors: Laura Smy, Stacy Boden, Erwin Cabacungan, Kelsey Ryan, Elizabeth Hovis
papers.journal: The Journal of Applied Laboratory Medicine
papers.abstract: How can elimination of fentanyl change during pregnancy? What are challenges clinicians face when interpreting drug testing results? When is it important for the clinical team to contact the laboratory toxicologist for consultation? The patient was a 33-year-old woman, Gravida 3 Para 2, established with an outpatient perinatal addiction program at 35 weeks’ gestation. Her history included tobacco use disorder, daily intravenous fentanyl use (last use 14 days prior to assessment), hepatitis C virus, and obesity (body mass index [BMI] 38.7 kg/m2 at 39 weeks’ gestation). She was initiated on buprenorphine and received regular urine toxicology testing. A series of urine drug tests were performed for this patient (Table 1). The initial urine drug screen (UDS) performed at an outside hospital 14 days after last reported fentanyl use was presumptive positive for buprenorphine, fentanyl, and opioids. Eleven days later, repeat testing using a point-of-care (POC) UDS cup was positive only for buprenorphine. No confirmatory testing was performed for either of those tests. On treatment day 13 (27 days since last reported fentanyl use), UDS remained fentanyl positive. Confirmatory liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) testing reported fentanyl as <1.0 ng/mL, which was interpreted as negative for fentanyl. The norfentanyl level was not reported due to an interfering substance. After consultation, the toxicologist determined the total combined concentration of norfentanyl and the interfering substance was ≤4.1 ng/mL suggesting that the concentration of norfentanyl was very low as it was no more than 4.1 ng/mL. The identity and concentration of the interfering substance alone could not be determined by the LC-MS/MS assay used. For comparison, mean urine concentrations of norfentanyl in people wearing fentanyl transdermal patches range from 175 to 373 ng/mL depending on the patch dose which may range from 25 µg/h to 100 µg/h (1). Longitudinal urine drug testing grouped by days since last fentanyl use. aPOCT, point of care testing. bUnable to report due to interference with methodology. On treatment day 28 (42 days since last reported fentanyl use)—the day of scheduled cesarean section (CS)—a UDS collected upon arrival for the procedure again screened positive for fentanyl. Confirmatory LC-MS/MS reported fentanyl as <1.0 ng/mL and norfentanyl as 2.3 ng/mL. The patient received intrathecal fentanyl for pain control after collection of this specimen. Umbilical cord toxicology was negative. The care team debated whether toxicology findings reflected ongoing use or delayed elimination. Social work considered a Child Protective Services (CPS) report based on positive maternal UDS. Mirroring the general population, opioid use disorder among pregnant and postpartum patients has increased dramatically (2). Perinatal drug testing has clinical, ethical, and legal implications. Clinically, birth parents and infants may experience withdrawal after birth (2). Legally, families may face criminal sequelae and family separation. In the United States, clinicians must comply with federal and state law, which may include reporting the infant and birth parent to CPS. In some states, perinatal substance use as evidenced by a positive toxicology test is grounds for child abuse charges (3). Informed consent should be obtained prior to drug testing birthing parents. Some jurisdictions may not require informed consent for newborn toxicology testing. The implications of a positive toxicology test result should be discussed with birth parents (2). Sample options for toxicology testing in perinatal patients include maternal urine, infant urine, meconium, or umbilical cord tissue. Screening typically begins with immunoassay (IA) and can be followed by confirmatory testing. The IAs have high clinical sensitivity and are prone to false-positive results. The rate of false positives can vary by the drug class and vendor. Detection of a drug may be impacted by using a POC vs main laboratory assay, the cross-reactivity of the IA with the parent drug, its metabolites, or related compounds, and drugs administered during labor and delivery. POC tests for fentanyl often detect fentanyl, which is at lower concentrations in urine than norfentanyl, whereas main lab IAs may target norfentanyl, fentanyl, or both. Clinicians should be aware of limitations of toxicology tests. IA results should be considered presumptive. Best practice dictates that any unexpected positive or negative IA result should be verified using a confirmatory assay, either qualitative or quantitative (4). Mass spectrometry-based methods are generally used for confirmation and considered a definitive test. Clinicians should have a low threshold for consultation with the laboratory’s toxicologist when results are inconsistent with the clinical picture or patient report (4). Accurate interpretation of perinatal UDS is critical yet poses challenges (4). Physiologic changes during pregnancy can cause false-positive and false-negative results. Physiologic changes progress over the course of pregnancy, peaking in the third trimester, and affect all aspects of drug pharmacokinetics (5). A case report regarding delayed norfentanyl elimination in a pregnant women with opioid use disorder describes prolonged norfentanyl detection for up to 70 days after last fentanyl use (6). In comparison, the typical urine detection window in people entering treatment for fentanyl use was 7 to 13 days and people with overweight or obesity had longer detection windows (7). Possible contributing factors considered for our patient’s lingering norfentanyl concentrations include changes in enzymes and transporters, decreased albumin, increased renal blood flow, and an increase in the fat compartment (5). Reports on the effects of pharmacogenetics on fentanyl metabolism are conflicting. Pregnancy accelerates fentanyl metabolism via cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) induction, which would hasten elimination, but the net effect on fentanyl exposure may be modulated by individual CYP3A4/3A5 and ABCB1 genotypes. Fentanyl is mainly metabolized by CYP3A enzymes. Polymorphisms in the related genes CYP3A4 (such as CYP3A4*22) and CYP3A5 (such as CYP3A5*3) can decrease the metabolic clearance of fentanyl (8). When this happens, fentanyl is metabolized more slowly, which may lead to prolonged or more intense drug effects. Additionally, the drug transporter p-glycoprotein, encoded by the ABCB1 gene, is a key efflux transporter at the blood–brain barrier and placenta, limiting the entry of fentanyl into the central nervous system and fetal circulation. The 3435C>T variant of the ABCB1 gene can lead to decreased ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 1 (ABCB1) expression, potentially resulting in higher fetal exposure to fentanyl (9). For our patient, changes in enzymes and transporters were considered unlikely given there was detectable norfentanyl and undetectable fentanyl, supporting adequate drug metabolism and elimination. Classic considerations for altered drug pharmacokinetics include protein binding and changes in renal function, both altered in pregnancy. About 88% of fentanyl is bound to protein, predominantly albumin (7). As albumin decreases during pregnancy, the amount of free drug increases, thus enabling increased metabolism of fentanyl to norfentanyl and excretion (10). Further, norfentanyl and fentanyl are predominantly eliminated by the kidneys. Therefore, in pregnancy, the lower albumin and increased renal blood flow would lean toward faster clearance of the drug, ruling these out as contributing factors for our patient’s lingering norfentanyl. Fentanyl is a small, highly lipophilic molecule, which increases its ability to cross plasma membranes and gives it a high volume of distribution (Vd) (7). Higher Vd is more pronounced in people with obesity and for drugs with higher lipophilicity (11). With chronic use, fentanyl moves out of the circulation into fat and muscle and accumulates in tissues (7). During pregnancy, the fat compartment increases, which will lead to a higher fentanyl Vd. This, paired with our patient’s gestational BMI and chronic fentanyl use, suggests she would have a higher fentanyl Vd. Chronic use of fat-soluble drugs can have delayed elimination over weeks; tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) metabolism is a well-known example of this (12). This mechanism likely contributed to our patient’s results. Secondary peaking is a phenomenon in drug elimination whereby sudden increases in drug concentration may occur during the elimination phase (7). Two mechanisms have been proposed: (a) enterogastric reabsorption, where the drug is held in the stomach by gastric cells and later reabsorbed in the intestine and (b) altered distribution pattern of the drug within the peripheral tissues (7). During pregnancy, gastrointestinal emptying is slower, which would theoretically reduce secondary peaking via the enterogastric reabsorption mechanism (7). For fentanyl distributed to fat and tissues, the release will occur due to changes in that compartment, which might be unpredictable. The most plausible explanation for our patient is delayed elimination due to prolonged release of fentanyl from the fat or other compartments. When monitoring drug use, urine toxicology is often used. Urine is prone to varying degrees of dilution. Different studies have evaluated normalizing the drug concentration to creatinine or specific gravity to manage dilution differences (4). There are limitations to normalization, but it may assist with following a patient’s trends. The specific gravity was available for our patient, though normalizing the norfentanyl concentrations to it did not provide additional information. For our patient, consultation with the laboratory toxicologist was essential to interpreting serial toxicology results. The patient’s care team concluded that prolonged clearance of norfentanyl was likely due to physiologic characteristics of pregnancy and obesity. This consensus was reached after a CPS report was made, though the interpretation of results was clarified with CPS. This family’s care could have been improved with awareness of nuances of perinatal toxicology interpretation. Screening immunoassays are presumptive results and should be confirmed using more specific methods before any punitive actions are taken. When available, ordering screening tests that reflex to confirmatory testing is recommended. Physiologic changes in pregnancy affect all aspects of drug pharmacokinetics and need to be considered for proper interpretation of screening and confirmatory drug results. There can be significant social or criminal implications associated with positive drug results surrounding pregnancy, even if mistakenly interpreted. Clinicians may have limited experience or expertise in interpreting drug results and a low threshold for consulting the laboratory toxicologist can be beneficial for patient care. Early collaboration amongst a multidisciplinary team could improve birth parent and baby patient outcomes when toxicology results are positive. Nonstandard Abbreviations: BMI, body mass index; UDS, urine drug screen; POC, point-of-care; CS, cesarean section; CPS, child protective services; IA, immunoassay; CYP3A4, cytochrome P450 3A4; ABCB1, ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 1; Vd, volume of distribution; THC, tetrahydrocannabinol. Human Genes: CYP3A4/3A5, cytochrome P450 family 3 subfamily A member 4 and 5; ABCB1, ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 1. Nobody who qualifies for authorship has been omitted from the list. Disclosures: L Smy has received consulting fees from Fluxergy and Navidx. K Ryan has received funding from the American Academy of Pediatrics for participation in the 2025 Safe Discharge Perinatal Quality Improvement Initiative, honoraria from the American Academy of Pediatrics and The Periscope Project, and serves as an editor for Elsevier for publications pertaining to newborn care and pediatrics.
