papers.title: Does adding high occupational workload to high impact sport relate to worse hip-related symptoms and MRI-defined early-stage hip osteoarthritis features in men?
papers.authors: Pim van Klij, Rintje Agricola, Johanna Luitjens, Felix Gassert, Matthew King, Peter R. Lawrenson, Mark James Scholes, Joanne L. Kemp, Thomas Link, Richard B. Souza, Michael Girdwood, Benjamin Mentiplay, Adam Semciw, Kay M. Crossley, Joshua Heerey
papers.abstract: This study explored the association of occupational workload with [1] severity of hip-related symptoms (illness) and [2] magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-defined early-stage osteoarthritis (OA) features (disease) in symptomatic young adult male sub-elite football (soccer/Australian football) players. A cross-sectional study used baseline data from the Femoroacetabular impingement and hip OsteoaRthritis Cohort study. One hundred forty‑four (228 hips) symptomatic (hip and/or groin pain >6/12 and positive flexion-adduction-internal-rotation test) players completed hip MRI. The Scoring Hip OA with MRI (SHOMRI) system was used to score early-stage hip OA features (cartilage defects and labral tears). Each participant completed the International Hip Outcome Tool-33 (iHOT-33). Participants specified their occupational physical requirements, classified as high or low . Study aims were assessed using regression models adjusted for age, BMI, cam morphology size and symptom duration. Results showed that football players with high occupational workload (n = 35, 24%) had lower (worse) iHOT‑33 total scores (adjusted mean difference (aMD): −10.3 95% CI [−16.9, -3.7]), -Symptoms (aMD: −7.5, 95% CI [−14.1, −0.8]), -Sport (aMD: −10.5, 95% CI [−19.0, −1.9]), -Job (aMD: −19.7, 95% CI [−28.2, −11.2]) and -Social (aMD: −11.7, 95% CI [−20.0, −3.5]) subscale scores compared with football players with low occupational workload (n = 109, 76 %). The prevalence and severity of cartilage defects and labral tears did not differ between football players with high and low occupational workload. High occupational workload was associated with worse hip-related symptoms. MRI-defined early-stage OA features did not differ between football players with high and low occupational workload.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于股骨髋臼撞击与髋骨关节炎队列的基线数据，采用横断面设计，考察有症状的年轻男性业余足球运动员中高职业体力负荷是否与更差的髋部症状及MRI定义的早期髋骨关节炎特征相关。结果显示，高职业负荷者的髋部相关生活质量总分及症状、运动、工作、社交各维度得分均较低负荷者更差，但两组在软骨缺损和盂唇撕裂的患病率与严重程度上未见差异。作者据此指出，高职业负荷与更差的髋部症状相关，而未观察到其与MRI早期结构病变的关联，提示症状与影像学表现可能并不同步。

papers.title: Is this candidate for real? AI authorship disclosure and candidate evaluations
papers.authors: Matthew Dempsey
papers.abstract: Many U.S. states now require political campaigns to label some AI-generated content, but thus far, there is little empirical evidence on how such labels influence voters. In a 2 × 2 between-subjects experiment, 457 college students saw a candidate’s fundraising e-mail or Twitter/X post labeled as written by either campaign staff or AI, while 106 participants saw a biographical control. The AI label was modeled after statutory language enacted in Michigan. Compared with the campaign staff label, the AI label lowered perceived authenticity, trust, vote likelihood, donation intent, and candidate feeling thermometer ratings (d = 0.20 to 0.39). Effects did not differ significantly between the e-mail and Twitter/X conditions. In the full sample, the AI label did not change how well written or persuasive participants found the otherwise identical message.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了政治竞选内容被标注为AI生成时如何影响选民的候选人评价，采用2×2组间实验，让大学生阅读标注为竞选团队或AI撰写的筹款邮件或推文，并设置传记信息对照组。结果显示，与竞选团队标签相比，AI标签降低了感知真实性、信任、投票可能性、捐款意愿和候选人好感度，但未显著改变对信息写作质量与说服力的评价，且邮件与推文两种形式间无显著差异。这表明AI来源披露主要损害候选人的可信与支持意愿，而非对信息本身质量的判断。

papers.title: The (in)congruence of speaking self-efficacy and anxiety in shaping L2 learners’ willingness to communicate within GenAI-enhanced learning environments: a response surface analysis
papers.authors: Dianyong Zhu, Ali Derakhshan, Mehdi Solhi
papers.journal: Innovation in Language Learning and Teaching
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examined how speaking self-efficacy and speaking anxiety relate to second or foreign language (L2) learners’ willingness to communicate (WTC) in a GenAI-enhanced learning environment. More specifically, the study focused on the joint associations of these psycho-emotional variables with WTC and examined whether their alignment or discrepancy was related to learners’ communication willingness.Methodology A sample of 280 L2 learners completed measures of speaking self-efficacy, speaking anxiety, and WTC within a generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-enhanced learning environment. Bivariate correlations were first examined to establish the associations among the variables. Response surface analysis (RSA) was then employed to examine the joint associations of speaking self-efficacy and speaking anxiety with WTC.Findings Speaking self-efficacy was positively associated with WTC, whereas speaking anxiety was negatively associated with WTC. The significant interaction between speaking self-efficacy and speaking anxiety indicated that their associations with WTC varied as a function of each other. The RSA showed that the direction of incongruence between speaking self-efficacy and speaking anxiety was systematically associated with WTC, with WTC higher when the discrepancy favored greater self-efficacy and lower anxiety. At the configuration level, the incongruent combination of high speaking self-efficacy and low speaking anxiety was associated with the highest WTC.Originality/value The study extends research on L2 learners’ WTC by moving beyond separate examinations of speaking self-efficacy and speaking anxiety and considering how these experiences operate in combination within a GenAI-enhanced instructional context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在生成式人工智能增强的学习环境中，二语学习者的口语自我效能感与口语焦虑如何共同关联其交际意愿，而不再将两者分开分析。280名学习者完成相关量表后，作者先用相关分析，再用响应面分析检验两者的联合模式。结果显示，自我效能感与交际意愿正相关，焦虑则与之负相关，且两者存在显著交互；二者不一致的方向与交际意愿系统相关，当差异偏向高效能、低焦虑时交际意愿更高，其中“高自我效能感配低焦虑”的不一致组合对应最高的交际意愿。研究提示，两种情感体验的组合形态比单一变量更能说明学习者的交际意愿。

papers.title: From Co-Creation to Compassion: Unveiling the Emotional Pathway to Sustainable Tourism Behavior
papers.authors: Tran Thi Tuyen
papers.journal: International Journal of Hospitality & Tourism Administration
papers.abstract: This study examines how co-created tourism experiences foster sustainable tourism behavior through emotional and well-being mechanisms. Drawing on the Stimulus-Organism-Response framework, broaden-and-build theory, and transformative tourism perspectives, the study proposes compassion for nature as a central emotional-moral mediator linking stage-specific co-creation to hedonic and eudaimonic well-being and, ultimately, sustainable behavior. Using PLS-SEM on survey data collected in Ho Chi Minh City, the results show that co-creation during and after the trip significantly enhances compassion for nature, whereas pre-trip co-creation does not. Sequential mediation analyses reveal a multi-step transformation pathway in which compassion stimulates hedonic well-being, facilitates eudaimonic well-being, and is associated with stronger future sustainability-oriented behavioral commitment. The findings advance emotion-centered and process-oriented explanations of sustainability in tourism.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察共同创造的旅游体验如何经由情感与幸福感机制促进可持续旅游行为，基于刺激—有机体—反应框架、拓展—建构理论和变革性旅游视角，提出对自然的同情是连接分阶段共同创造与享乐及实现型幸福感、并最终指向可持续行为的核心情感—道德中介。作者在胡志明市收集问卷数据并用偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析，发现旅行期间及旅行后的共同创造显著增强对自然的同情，而旅行前的共同创造则没有这种效果。序贯中介分析显示出一条多步骤转化路径：同情激发享乐型幸福感，进而促进实现型幸福感，并与更强的未来可持续行为承诺相关。这些发现推进了以情感为中心、以过程为导向的旅游可持续性解释。

papers.title: Ethics Before Deployment: Catholic Just War Theory and Doctrinal Development for Military AI
papers.authors: Sebastian Seidel
papers.abstract: On 25 May 2026, Pope Leo XIV's Magnifica Humanitas became the first papal encyclical on artificial intelligence, declaring that lethal decisions cannot be entrusted to artificial systems and calling for a shared international framework to govern military AI. It states these principles but does not operationalise them. This article develops that operational framework. Applying Catholic social doctrine (human dignity and agency, subsidiarity, prudence, intentionality, the common good, and the protection of noncombatants) to military AI, it translates the encyclical's commitments into concrete requirements for autonomous weapons, targeting systems, and alliance interoperability. It grounds the argument in the nuclear precedent, where Catholic ethics shaped doctrine as it formed, and more briefly in chemical and biological weapons prohibition. Engaging just war theory, NATO's Principles of Responsible Use, recent military wargaming, and a leading AI provider's treatment of a catastrophic strike as consistent with its self-declared “red lines,” it shows where Catholic ethics is more demanding than procedural compliance. It then proposes institutional mechanisms: a tiered deliberation framework, proportionality dossiers, ethics review boards, and NATO-level coordination. Building ethical architecture before deployment, the article argues, serves strategic as well as moral interests.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对教皇利奥十四世首份人工智能通谕虽提出致命决策不可交由人工系统、并呼吁国际共同治理军事AI，却未给出可操作方案的问题，尝试构建一套操作框架。作者将天主教社会教义（人的尊严与能动性、辅助性原则、审慎、意向性、共同善及对非战斗员的保护）应用于自主武器、目标选择系统和联盟互操作，并参照核武器先例及化生武器禁令，与正义战争理论、北约负责任使用原则、近期兵棋推演及某主要AI企业对灾难性打击的“红线”处理相对照，指出天主教伦理的要求高于程序性合规。文章进而提出分层审议框架、相称性档案、伦理审查委员会和北约层面协调等制度机制，主张在部署前先行建设伦理架构，兼顾战略与道德利益。

papers.title: Ethical perspectives on generative AI in English-medium instruction: the role of gender and academic discipline
papers.authors: Flor de Lis González-Mujico, Alberto Fernández-Costales, David Lasagabaster

papers.title: Associations of body composition and chronotype with social jet lag in Brazilian adults: A cross-sectional study
papers.authors: João Paulo Lima de Oliveira, Bianca Aparecida de Sousa, Maria Luíza Almeida Ferreira, Amanda C. Silva, Camila Maria de Melo
papers.abstract: Social jet lag (SJL) refers to the discrepancy between average sleep timing on workdays and free days and has been implicated in weight gain, changes in body composition, and chronotype. This study aimed to examine the association between SJL, body composition parameters, and chronotype. Participants wore an actigraph for 14 consecutive days and completed a socioeconomic questionnaire and the Morningness-Eveningness Questionnaire (MEQ). Body composition was assessed by bioelectrical impedance analysis. SJL was calculated as the absolute difference between the midpoint of sleep on weekends and weekdays |SJL = MSweekend - Msweekday|. Data normality was assessed using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, and appropriate parametric or nonparametric tests were applied. Adjusted binary logistic regression models were performed with SJL category (low versus moderate/high) as the dependent variable to investigate associations with body composition and chronotype, adjusting for age, sex, and paid employment. The sample comprised 97 individuals, predominantly female (71.1%). Most participants exhibited low SJL (58.8%) and a morning chronotype (57.3%). In the adjusted analyses, which included 91 participants for body composition variables and 96 for chronotype, participants classified as having increased metabolic risk according to waist-to-hip ratio showed higher odds of moderate/high SJL (OR = 5.86, 95% CI: 1.49-22.99). No clear associations were observed for fat mass, fat-free mass, body fat percentage, BMI, or chronotype. These findings indicate that SJL was associated with waist-to-hip ratio classification in this sample, whereas associations with other body composition parameters and chronotype were not evident.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察巴西成年人中社会时差与身体成分参数及昼夜节律类型之间的关联，采用横断面设计，让参与者连续佩戴活动记录仪并填写问卷，同时以生物电阻抗法评估身体成分。调整年龄、性别和有偿就业后，腰臀比所指示的代谢风险升高者出现中度或高度社会时差的比值更高，而脂肪量、去脂体重、体脂百分比、BMI及昼夜节律类型均未见明确关联。作者据此提示社会时差可能与腰臀比分类相关，但这一关联来自横断面观察，不能推断因果，其他身体成分指标与节律类型的关联在本样本中并不明显。

papers.title: Neuropharmacology of language: ERP evidence for catecholaminergic modulation of syntactic processing
papers.authors: Yingying Tan, Ashley Lewis, Iris C. Schmits, Robert Jan Verkes, Roshan Cools, Peter Hagoort A
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: A few studies have shown that brain catecholamines are implicated in language comprehension. However, the specific cognitive processes they modulate remain underexplored. We hypothesized that catecholamines enhance the unification of syntactic roles and word meanings into coherent multiword structures. This study combined electroencephalography and psychopharmacology to examine the effects of a catecholaminergic stimulant (methylphenidate) on processing sentences containing local syntactic ambiguities. Methylphenidate amplified the P600 event-related potential effect, which has been linked to the recruitment of cognitive resources for processing sentences with increased syntactic load. The drug’s impact on semantic processing was subtler, showing a suggestive attenuation of the N400 effect to ambiguous sentences. Furthermore, the increase in the P600 effect under methylphenidate was most pronounced in participants with lower working memory capacity. This study provides evidence for linking catecholamine activity to syntactic unification in healthy individuals. Elevated catecholamine levels appear to increase the cognitive effort invested in syntactic unification, and to support the dynamic prioritization of syntactic information when contextual demands require it.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合脑电记录与药物干预，考察儿茶酚胺类兴奋剂哌甲酯如何影响含局部句法歧义句子的加工，以检验儿茶酚胺是否增强句法角色与词义向多词结构的整合。结果显示，哌甲酯放大了与句法负载相关的P600效应，对语义加工的影响则较微弱，仅提示歧义句的N400效应有所减弱；且P600增幅在工作记忆容量较低的参与者中更明显。作者据此认为，儿茶酚胺水平升高可能增加句法整合投入的认知努力，并在语境需要时支持句法信息的动态优先处理，为健康个体中儿茶酚胺活动与句法整合的关联提供了证据。

papers.title: AI-generated content-plagiarism versus institutional silence: comparative insights on responses of higher education to rapid technological changes in China and Japan
papers.authors: Zhang Taolue, Chen Hunan
papers.abstract: This study seeks to elucidate how the higher education systems of China and Japan have addressed the issue of plagiarism exacerbated by generative artificial intelligence (AIGC-plagiarism) and the insights gained from these responses. As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated with higher education, the age-old problem of plagiarism has resurfaced with greater intensity and elusiveness, sweeping across universities worldwide. Although no definitive consensus exists regarding the precise definition of AIGC-plagiarism, this conceptual ambiguity does not preclude its broad recognition as prohibited academic conduct. The relationship between cutting-edge technologies and higher education appears to have reached an impasse, yet the majority of Chinese institutions have maintained a stance of silence, while the Chinese government has shown concern but refrained from taking formal action. This research comparatively examines the response strategies to AIGC-plagiarism by the Japanese government and 359 universities, which share similar systemic and institutional contexts with their Chinese counterparts, and reaches a conclusion that the practice of “No Copy + Exceptions” emerges as a particularly instructive approach. A micro-level comparative analysis reveals that this regulatory inertia is shaped by both technological and political factors, and represents a pragmatic strategy in the face of technological uncertainty. Regardless of the underlying rationale, such silence constitutes an unacceptable form of de facto endorsement or passive acquiescence. Higher education systems must develop more proactive, responsive, and agile mechanisms to cultivate morally anchored, innovation-capable students amidst technological and geopolitical turbulence. Key components of this mechanism include, but are not limited to a unified national benchmark and implementation rule, a dynamic AI impact assessment structure, autonomy of faculty and academic councils, and student participation with feedback channels.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较中国与日本高等教育体系对生成式人工智能加剧的抄袭问题（AIGC-plagiarism）的应对方式，以日本政府及359所高校的做法为对照，分析中国多数高校保持沉默、政府关注但未正式行动的监管停滞现象。微观比较显示，这种停滞受技术与政治因素共同塑造，是面对技术不确定性的务实策略，但作者明确指出沉默实质上构成不可接受的事实认可或被动默许。研究据此提炼出“不抄袭+例外”的实践作为有启发性的参照，并主张高教体系应建立更主动、敏捷的机制，包括统一的国家基准与实施细则、动态的AI影响评估、教师与学术委员会的自主权以及学生参与和反馈渠道。

papers.title: Human-AI collaboration in crisis response: understanding adoption barriers and enablers for generative AI in emergency decision-making
papers.authors: Liguo Fei, Jiayi Sun, Zongfeng Sun
papers.abstract: Abstract Human-AI collaboration in emergency management represents a critical socio-technical challenge that requires understanding both technological capabilities and human factors. This study examines the barriers and enablers influencing emergency decision-makers’ adoption of generative artificial intelligence, focusing on the complex interplay between individual, organizational, and technological factors in high-stakes crisis environments. Through expert interviews and intuitionistic fuzzy DEMATEL analysis involving Chinese emergency management practitioners, we identify five key dimensions affecting AI adoption: technology acceptance, decision-making processes, contextual factors, risk and trust, and individual factors. Our analysis within the Chinese emergency management context suggests that contextual factors and decision-making processes are perceived as primary drivers, while technology acceptance and individual factors serve as critical enablers shaped by organizational environments. The findings demonstrate that successful human-AI collaboration requires addressing social and technical dimensions simultaneously, with organizational support, trust-building, and individual self-efficacy emerging as fundamental requirements. These insights inform strategies for emergency management organizations to enhance human-AI integration through governance frameworks, transparency mechanisms, and targeted training programs, contributing empirical evidence to the growing literature on socio-technical aspects of AI adoption in critical decision-making contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注应急决策场景中生成式人工智能的采纳障碍与促进因素，通过专家访谈和直觉模糊DEMATEL分析，考察中国应急管理从业者眼中个体、组织与技术因素的交互作用。分析识别出技术接受、决策过程、情境因素、风险与信任、个体因素五个关键维度，其中情境因素和决策过程被视为主要驱动因素，技术接受与个体因素则是在组织环境影响下发挥作用的关键促成条件。研究据此指出，成功的人机协同需同时处理社会与技术两个层面，组织支持、信任建设和个体自我效能是基础性要求，并为应急管理组织通过治理框架、透明机制和针对性培训推进人机融合提供了参考。

papers.title: Neural sensitivity to peer rejection predicts depressive symptoms and daily mood in adolescents
papers.authors: Nayoung Kim, Isaac N. Treves, Lilian Yanqing Li, Sarah E. Sarkas, Katherine Durham, David Pagliaccio, Nicholas Brian Allen, Stewart A. Shankman, Randy Patrick Auerbach
papers.abstract: Abstract Understanding the role of peer feedback, particularly rejection, is critical for adolescent major depressive disorder (MDD). However, the neurophysiological markers core to peer feedback, especially those that may presage risk for depression, are unclear. Adolescents ( N = 179; ages 13–18; healthy controls n = 62, remitted MDD n = 80, current MDD n = 37) completed a baseline clinical assessment and a revised Chatroom Task during EEG recording, from which the P3 to peer acceptance and rejection feedback was quantified. Over 12 months, daily mood and keyboard inputs from adolescents’ smartphones were passively obtained. Linear models evaluated whether the P3 difference between rejection and acceptance (ΔP3) prospectively predicted depressive severity and average daily mood. Exploratory natural language processing examined whether friendship-focused social communication moderated the association between neural sensitivity to peer feedback and subsequent clinical outcomes. Group and feedback type interacted in predicting P3 amplitude (F(2176) = 4.84, p = 0.009): adolescents with current MDD showed larger P3 amplitudes to rejection than acceptance, whereas remitted MDD showed elevated amplitudes to both feedback types relative to controls. In a general linear model adjusting for age, sex, site, and baseline depression severity, the Grou p × ΔP3 interaction was significant in predicting severity at follow-up (b = 0.092, p = 0.045); higher ΔP3 predicted higher follow-up severity in current MDD, but not in remitted MDD or healthy controls. Across the full sample, larger ΔP3 was associated with lower average daily mood over 12 months (b = −1.673, p = 0.045). These findings suggest that enhanced neural sensitivity to peer rejection may be deeply engrained in adolescent depression, shaping both the longitudinal course of depressive symptoms and daily mood.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察青少年对同伴接纳与拒绝反馈的神经敏感性（以脑电P3波幅衡量）能否前瞻性预测抑郁严重程度和日常情绪，对象为健康对照组、缓解期和当前抑郁障碍青少年，结合基线脑电任务与随后12个月的手机被动情绪监测。结果显示，当前抑郁组对拒绝的P3波幅大于接纳，缓解组对两类反馈均高于对照组；在控制年龄、性别、站点和基线抑郁严重度后，拒绝与接纳的P3差值越大，当前抑郁组随访时抑郁越重，而缓解组和对照组无此关联。全样本中该差值越大，12个月平均每日情绪越低。作者据此提出，对同伴拒绝的神经敏感性增强可能深植于青少年抑郁，并关联症状的纵向进程与日常情绪。

papers.title: Association of chronic pain and BMI with frailty among individuals aged 60 years and older in Beijing: a cross-sectional study
papers.authors: 胡晏珍, Jinghua Xia, Dan Zhao, Ling Wang, Xuemei Lu
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the moderating role of body mass index (BMI) in the association between chronic pain and frailty among community-dwelling older adults in Beijing, China. This cross-sectional study included 629 community-dwelling adults aged ≥ 60 years from the Xinjiekou community in Beijing, China, who were able to attend the assessment site and complete the required measurements. Frailty was assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, adapted for the Chinese older adult population. Cognitive function was evaluated using the Chinese Mini-Mental State Examination. Chronic pain was defined as pain persisting or recurring for at least 3 months, and pain intensity was assessed using the Brief Pain Inventory–Short Form through face-to-face interviews. Multiple linear regression models with heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors were used to examine the associations of chronic pain, BMI, and their interaction with frailty. Frail participants had lower cognitive function and higher pain intensity than non-frail participants. In adjusted analyses, pain intensity was positively associated with frailty score, and the BMI × pain interaction was significant ( β = 0.030, P < 0.001), suggesting that the pain–frailty association was stronger at higher BMI levels. Chronic pain was associated with higher frailty scores among community-dwelling older adults in Beijing, China, and this association appeared stronger at higher BMI levels. These findings highlight the importance of considering both chronic pain and BMI in frailty assessment. Longitudinal studies are needed to clarify causal relationships and evaluate whether integrated pain and weight-related interventions can influence frailty progression.
papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察北京社区居住的60岁及以上老年人中，慢性疼痛与衰弱之间的关联是否受BMI调节。研究者通过面对面访谈评估疼痛强度与衰弱状况，并用回归模型分析二者的交互作用。结果显示，疼痛强度与衰弱评分呈正相关，且BMI与疼痛的交互项显著，提示在BMI较高者中疼痛与衰弱的关联更强。作者据此指出，衰弱评估应同时考虑慢性疼痛与体重状况，但因果方向尚需纵向研究澄清。

papers.title: A disentangled CNN–transformer framework for big data-driven intelligent brand visual generation
papers.authors: Yanan Jiang, Yongxiao Liu
papers.abstract: Big data has driven the rapid growth of brand visual design demand, yet existing intelligent generation methods suffer from detail distortion and poor cross-cultural adaptability. This study proposes a style-disentangled Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-Transformer framework for intelligent brand visual generation. A dual-branch architecture extracts local details via CNN and global style via Transformer, with an embedding mixer enabling balanced feature fusion. A regional gating and style calibration module further enhances structural fidelity. Evaluated on a self-constructed 10-brand multimodal dataset, the model outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) (0.186) and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) (0.924), with style consistency exceeding 85% across cross-cultural scenarios. Ablation studies have shown that, compared with the full model, only the CNN branch increases LPIPS by 54.3%, confirming the contribution of key modules. This work provides an effective solution for big data-driven intelligent brand design and extends computational creativity applications.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有品牌视觉智能生成方法在细节失真和跨文化适应性上的不足，提出一种风格解耦的CNN-Transformer框架，通过双分支结构分别提取局部细节与全局风格，并借助嵌入混合器与区域门控、风格校准模块增强结构保真度。在自建的多品牌多模态数据集上，该模型在感知相似度和结构相似度指标上优于现有方法，跨文化场景下的风格一致性超过85%；消融结果也显示关键模块对性能确有贡献。文章据此认为该框架为大数据驱动的品牌视觉设计提供了可行方案，并拓展了计算创造力的应用，但结论主要基于自建数据集上的指标表现。

papers.title: Integral resonant filter-based chattering reduction in switched human-robot interaction with hybrid admittance-adaptive impedance control
papers.authors: Ado Haruna, Auwalu Muhammad Abdullahi, Ronnapee Chaichaowarat
papers.abstract: Physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) is a type of interaction that implies that robots should demonstrate dynamic and compliant behavior that is dependent on the interaction environment. A prominent solution is compliant control, which includes either Admittance Control in the case of soft contact or Impedance Control for stiff contact. However, if the nature of the environment is unknown or dynamic, then a hybrid control scheme that switches between the admittance and impedance regimes is adopted. However, switching from admittance to impedance and vice versa results in discontinuity in the control signal. The discontinuity inherent in the abrupt switching mechanism causes high-frequency oscillations (chattering) in the control signal. The effect of this phenomenon is poor performance of the system, mechanical stress, and high energy consumption. To effectively attenuate this chattering and its negative effects, this work proposes an Integral Resonant Control (IRC) command filter, which is incorporated into the switching loop of the hybrid admittance and adaptive impedance control. The IRC filter, normally employed to damp structural vibrations, is designed here to act as a command filter for robust signal smoothing by damping the high-frequency components of the control signal introduced by the switching action. The proposed hybrid controller is compared to a standard hysteresis (dead-zone) chattering mitigation strategy. Comparative simulation results indicate that the proposed filtering technique can reduce the Chattering Index on average by over 76% for both joints of a planar rehabilitation robot while maintaining trajectory tracking accuracy. The results obtained indicate that the proposed switched hybrid control is Lyapunov stable and can be employed to achieve effective, energy-efficient, and compliant robotic rehabilitation in uncertain environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对机器人在柔顺与刚性接触环境间切换时，混合导纳—自适应阻抗控制因控制信号不连续而产生高频抖振的问题，提出将原本用于抑制结构振动的积分谐振控制（IRC）用作切换回路中的指令滤波器，以平滑切换引入的高频分量。作者在平面康复机器人上通过仿真将该方案与标准滞回（死区）抖振抑制策略进行对比，结果显示该方法在两个关节上平均降低抖振指数超过76%，同时保持轨迹跟踪精度，并报告所提切换混合控制满足Lyapunov稳定性。这些结果表明该滤波方案可在不确定环境下兼顾柔顺性与能效，但结论主要基于仿真对比，实际康复场景中的适用性尚待验证。

papers.title: Stability-aware hybrid optimisation-based feature selection and stacking classification for PCOS prediction
papers.authors: S. Reka, T. Suriya Praba, Prabu Selvam, B. Kiran Kumar, Nikola Ivković, Korhan Cengiz
papers.abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is one of the most common endocrine diseases in women of reproductive age all over the world. It is estimated that 6–13% of women are affected worldwide, and a significant percentage of them go undiagnosed because of their heterogeneity. The increased rate of PCOS is directly associated with lifestyle transition, metabolic stress, and hormonal imbalance. PCOS is linked to infertility, metabolism, and cardiovascular risks, which are long-term. Machine learning provides data-driven approaches for identifying patterns associated with PCOS from clinical and related patient characteristics. Such approaches may support predictive modelling by identifying informative features and combining them to distinguish between PCOS and non-PCOS cases. Feature selection is therefore used to identify a compact and stable subset of input variables, with the aim of improving predictive performance and model reliability. This study presents a hybrid optimisation approach for selecting a compact and stable subset of features for PCOS prediction. First, an ensemble wrapper-based approach is implemented, and then a combination of hybrid Optimisation strategies is examined with several combinations and ends with an ACOBO (Ant Colony Optimisation - Butterfly Optimisation) technique. Additionally, robustness of feature selection methods, a most common issue when algorithms run on the same dataset multiple times or with small modification has been checked with the help of rank-based Spearman and Kendall correlations, and distribution-based Jensen Shannon divergence using 10-fold cross-validation. Additionally, SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique) has been used to address the class imbalance issue. Finally, multiple stacking configurations were evaluated with SMOTE by varying the meta-classifier while using the remaining candidate classifiers as base learners. Among the evaluated configurations, the stacking model with AdaBoost as the meta-classifier achieved the highest accuracy of 95.64%.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）预测，提出一种基于混合优化的特征选择与堆叠分类方法，在临床及患者相关特征数据上筛选紧凑且稳定的特征子集。作者先采用集成包装式方法，再比较多种混合优化组合，最终以蚁群-蝴蝶优化（ACOBO）完成特征选择，并用基于秩的Spearman、Kendall相关和基于分布的Jensen-Shannon散度在交叉验证下检验特征选择的稳健性，同时用SMOTE处理类别不平衡。在多种堆叠配置中，以AdaBoost为元分类器的模型取得最高准确率95.64%。这些结果表明该流程在PCOS预测上具有较好的预测表现，但摘要未报告与基线方法的对比或独立外部验证，结论的泛化性仍待检验。

papers.title: Schizophrenia classification from multichannel EEG using EEGNet with SHAP and Grad-CAM
papers.authors: Manisha Pandey, Velmathi Guruviah
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia affects cognition, perception and neural information processing. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive and relatively low-cost way to study these changes. This study evaluates two deep learning models for separating paranoid schizophrenia patients from healthy controls using the public RepOD resting-state EEG dataset, which contains 14 patients and 14 healthy controls recorded from 19 electrodes at 250 Hz. To prevent participant level data leakage, all final testing kept participants separate using Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) and Stratified Group 5-Fold validation. The three-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) used Short-Time Fourier Transform representations (STFT), while EEGNet used the channel-time EEG epochs directly. At the reference settings used for the final controlled analysis, EEGNet gave an accuracy of 0.750, F1-score of 0.767, Cohen’s kappa of 0.497 and AUC of 0.797 under LOSO validation. Under Stratified Group 5-Fold validation, the corresponding values were 0.679, 0.695, 0.357 and 0.757. EEGNet showed stronger performance than the 3D-CNN, particularly under Stratified Group 5-Fold validation, where the 3D-CNN achieved a kappa of 0.011. Participant-based bootstrap confidence intervals quantified the uncertainty associated with the 28-participant cohort. Additional tests of learning rate (LR) and STFT resolution confirmed that the 3D-CNN was sensitive to model settings and fold composition. A separate ICA cleaning test showed that removing likely artifacts did not correct the weak 3D-CNN stratified result, while EEGNet performance improved after cleaning. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) were used to examine which EEG channels and signal regions influenced the model decisions. The XAI results were clearer for EEGNet, while SHAP and Grad-CAM assigned different rankings to individual electrodes. These findings provide a basis for further validation using larger and independent datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用公开静息态脑电数据集，比较EEGNet与三维卷积网络在精神分裂症患者与健康对照分类中的表现，并采用留一被试交叉验证和分层分组五折验证避免被试层面数据泄漏。结果显示EEGNet整体优于三维卷积网络，后者在分层分组验证中接近随机水平且对学习率、时频分辨率和折划分敏感；去除伪迹后EEGNet表现有所改善。作者还用SHAP与Grad-CAM考察影响模型判断的通道和信号区域，发现EEGNet的解释较清晰，但两种方法对电极重要性的排序并不一致，结论仍需更大独立数据集验证。

papers.title: Beyond good and bad: An in-depth study of student and teacher views on generative AI in high school.
papers.authors: Sarah Segall, Talia Waltzer, Gail D. Heyman
papers.abstract: Public and scholarly discussions of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education often emphasize sharp divides, portraying students as enthusiastic adopters unconcerned with learning and teachers as reluctant gatekeepers focused on control and assessment.However, little empirical work has examined how students' and teachers' attitudes toward AI are formed, expressed, and negotiated in everyday social contexts.We conducted in-depth interviews with 31 high school students and 29 high school teachers from five states in the United States to quantitatively examine how both groups reason about generative AI tools in education.Participants rarely expressed simple endorsement or rejection of AI; instead, they often articulated tensions between perceived benefits and risks.Students and teachers described AI as useful and engaging but also potentially undermining genuine learning and skill development.Participants also expressed uncertainty about appropriate use, the reliability of AI outputs, and the long-term implications of AI for education.Attitudes toward AI were shaped through ongoing peer interaction, with many participants describing how conversations and shared experiences influenced their views.Together, these findings suggest that attitudes toward generative AI in education are best understood as socially negotiated responses to a rapidly evolving technology rather than in terms of generational divides.More broadly, the findings highlight how integrating AI into education requires ongoing reflection about the role technology should play in learning and human development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过深度访谈，考察美国五州的高中师生如何看待生成式人工智能在教育中的作用，关注其态度如何在日常社交情境中形成与表达。研究发现，师生很少简单支持或反对AI，而是同时看到其有用、有吸引力与可能削弱真实学习和技能发展的两面性，并对使用边界、输出可靠性和长期影响存有不确定。态度还受同伴交流与共同经历影响。作者据此认为，师生对AI的态度应理解为对快速演变技术的社会协商反应，而非代际对立，AI进入教育也需持续反思技术在学习与人的发展中应扮演的角色。

papers.title: Beyond Chemistry Knowledge: Embedding Pedagogical Content Knowledge through an AI-Augmented Retrosynthesis Program for Chemistry Education
papers.authors: Zihan Wang, Changyu Hu, Junren Li, Yue Su, Mingyuan Lu, Hua Lu, Luhua Lai, Xiao Li
papers.abstract: Abstract Synthetic route planning is a core learning objective in university organic chemistry, yet a challenging one requiring the development of advanced problem-solving skills. Existing computational tools often propose routes beyond the intended curriculum, limiting their suitability as learning resources. In this work, we introduce Retro-Learn, an educational retrosynthesis platform that integrates a curriculum-aligned reaction template library with large language model interfaces. The platform incorporates selected aspects of pedagogical content knowledge by aligning available reactions with the scope and sequence of instruction. An agent skill and a web-based chatbot enable route generation and visualization through natural language interaction. Evaluation using cumulative chapter-specific template libraries showed how the addition of reaction knowledge enables new routes and shorter solutions. Blind assessments of undergraduate examination problems showed higher mean chemical correctness scores than those of database-derived routes and scores comparable to or higher than those of general-purpose language models. Student survey responses indicated a plurality preference for Retro-Learn over general-purpose tools as a synthesis-planning learning aid. These findings illustrate how curriculum-specific chemical informatics and language model interfaces can translate pedagogical considerations into computational support for organic chemistry learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对逆合成路线规划这一有机化学学习难点，开发了整合课程对齐反应模板库与大语言模型接口的教学平台Retro-Learn，并对其进行了评估。基于分章节累积模板库的测试显示，反应知识的加入能生成新路线并缩短求解路径；对本科考试题目的盲评表明，该平台给出的路线在化学正确性上优于数据库来源路线，与通用语言模型相当或更高。学生调查也显示，多数人更偏好将其作为合成规划学习工具。文章据此说明，课程特定的化学信息学与语言模型接口可将教学考量转化为对有机化学学习的计算支持。

papers.title: Retrofitters, pragmatists, and activists: public interest litigation for accountable automated decision-making
papers.authors: Henry Fraser, Zahra Stardust
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper examines the role of public interest litigation in promoting accountability for AI and automated decision-making (ADM) in Australia. Since ADM regulation faces political and geopolitical headwinds, effective governance will have to rely on the enforcement of existing laws. Drawing on interviews with Australian public interest litigators, technology policy activists, and technology law scholars, the paper positions public interest litigation as part of a larger ecosystem for transparency, accountability, and justice with respect to ADM. The paper explores the tactics and strategies of what one participant described as “retrofitting” old laws to ADM. These go beyond creative legal argumentation to encompass practices of community-building, collaboration on theories of change, canny selection of clients and causes of action, and careful alignment of the interests of stakeholders in litigation. Naturally, the paper also contends with the limits of these strategies, and of the Australian legal system. Where limits are, however, capable of being overcome, the paper presents findings on urgent needs: the enabling institutional arrangements without which effective litigation and accountability will falter. The paper is relevant to law and technology scholars; individuals and groups harmed by ADM; public interest litigators and technology lawyers; civil society and advocacy organizations; and policymakers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对澳大利亚公益诉讼律师、技术政策活动人士和技术法学者的访谈，考察公益诉讼在推动AI与自动化决策问责中的作用。作者将诉讼置于透明度与问责的更大生态中，梳理了“改造”旧法以适用于自动化决策的策略，包括社区建设、变革理论协作、审慎选择客户与诉因以及协调诉讼相关方利益，同时讨论了这些策略和澳大利亚法律体系本身的局限。文章还指出，在局限可被克服之处，有效的制度性安排是诉讼与问责得以持续的必要条件。

papers.title: AI washing in technology markets: The divergent roles of patient capital in innovation signaling distortion
papers.authors: Ziru Tang, Zenglian Zhang
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes a central driver of innovation and competitive advantage, firms increasingly rely on AI-related narratives to signal technological capabilities to external stakeholders. However, such signaling may deviate from actual technological activities, giving rise to AI washing (AIwash), which can distort the interpretation of firms' technological capabilities and undermine the credibility of AI-related signals in emerging technology markets. Drawing on a contract-based perspective, we examine how heterogeneous forms of patient capital are associated with AI signaling distortion. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2024, we find that equity-type patient capital (PCS) is negatively associated with AIwash, and this association is related to stronger governance and reputational discipline. In contrast, debt-type patient capital (PCD) is positively associated with AIwash, and this association is related to earnings management. The decomposition of disclosure–activities divergence indicates that PCS is primarily associated with lower levels of AI over-claiming, whereas PCD is associated with higher levels of over-claiming. Moreover, financing constraints positively moderates the relationship between PCD with AIwash. Heterogeneity analyses show that the negative association between PCS and AIwash is stronger in high-technology industries, star firms, and firms in mature and declining stages, whereas the positive association between PCD and AIwash is primarily concentrated in non-high-technology industries, non-star firms, and growth-stage firms. Overall, the findings contribute to the literature on innovation signaling and technology governance by showing that different financial contract structures are systematically associated with the credibility of AI-related technological signaling in emerging technology markets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注企业面向外部利益相关者的AI技术信号可能与实际技术活动脱节所形成的“AI洗白”现象，并考察不同形式的耐心资本与这种信号失真之间的关联。作者基于契约视角，以中国A股上市公司为研究对象进行实证分析，发现股权型耐心资本与AI洗白呈负相关，这一关联与更强的治理和声誉约束有关；债务型耐心资本则与AI洗白呈正相关，且与盈余管理相关。披露与活动偏离的分解显示，前者主要对应较少的AI过度宣称，后者对应较多的过度宣称，融资约束会正向调节债务型耐心资本与AI洗白的关系。异质性分析表明，上述负向关联在高科技行业、明星企业及成熟和衰退期企业中更强，正向关联则主要集中在非高科技行业、非明星企业和成长期企业。研究据此讨论了不同金融契约结构如何系统性地关联新兴技术市场中AI技术信号的可信度。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence, disclosure and consent: a comparative review of Australian and European Union legal frameworks for medical imaging
papers.authors: Minh Toan Chau, Marcus Smith

papers.title: Digital transformation in higher scientific education: The roles of virtual simulation, AI-assisted learning, and blended teaching
papers.authors: RuiQuan Long, 张雪辉, Zhao li
papers.journal: Journal of Radiation Research and Applied Sciences
papers.abstract: The accelerating digitisation of higher education has prompted urgent questions about which technology-mediated pedagogical interventions most effectively improve student learning outcomes in scientific disciplines. Drawing on a cross-institutional survey of 1500 undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in STEM and scientific programmes across five institution types, this study investigates the individual and joint effects of three canonical digital transformation mechanisms: virtual simulation laboratories (VSL), artificial intelligence-assisted learning (AIAAL), and blended teaching models (BTM). Employing a mixed-methods empirical framework that combines structural equation modelling (SEM), multi-level fixed-effects regression, and bootstrap mediation analysis, we estimate standardised direct effects of 0.264, 0.218, and 0.192 for VSL, AIAAL, and BTM on academic achievement, respectively. Mediation analysis reveals that self-regulated learning (SRL), collaborative knowledge construction, and cognitive engagement jointly channel 55.5% of the VSL effect and 54.7% of the AIAAL effect through indirect pathways, underscoring the primacy of process-level learning mechanisms. Moderation analysis demonstrates that institutional readiness amplifies all three technology effects by 42-68%, while disciplinary context generates the sharpest differential: VSL effects in STEM disciplines are 110% larger than in non-STEM contexts, whereas AIAAL effects remain comparably robust across disciplines. Robustness tests using instrumental variables, propensity score matching, and difference-in-differences quasi-experimental designs confirm that results are not artefacts of selection bias or omitted variable contamination. Policy scenario projections to 2030 suggest that full digital integration could reduce inter-institutional achievement gaps by 74% relative to business-as-usual. The findings contribute a theoretically grounded and empirically validated framework for evidence-based digital transformation in scientific higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注高等教育数字化中虚拟仿真实验室、AI辅助学习和混合教学三种技术手段如何影响理科学生的学习成效，基于跨院校问卷数据，结合结构方程模型、多层回归与中介分析进行估计。结果显示，三种手段均与学业成绩呈正相关，其中虚拟仿真实验室的关联最强；自我调节学习、协作知识建构和认知投入共同承载了相当比例的中介路径，说明过程性学习机制较为关键。院校准备度会放大这些技术的作用，学科背景的调节差异则主要体现在虚拟仿真上，而AI辅助学习在不同学科间表现相对稳定。作者据此讨论了数字化教学投入与院校条件、学科特点相匹配的问题。

papers.title: Service experiences with companion robots in older adult care: A social belonging perspective
papers.authors: Wenju Ma, Yushi Jiang, Muhammad Khayyam, Jiaji Zhu
papers.journal: Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services
papers.abstract: Advances in embodied robotics and large language models have facilitated the growing integration of companion robots into care settings for older adults, positioning them as a promising intelligent technology for supporting older adults' quality of life. Drawing on the cognitive–affective–conative (CAC) model, this study develops a theoretical framework to examine the relationships between older adults' perceptions of interactions with companion robots, social belonging, and adoption intention. Service experience data were collected through a field-based quantitative survey of older adult residents in senior care communities who had interacted with companion robots. Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) showed that four perceived characteristics of interactions with companion robots—anthropomorphism, respect, autonomy, and social support—were positively associated with older adults’ sense of social belonging. Higher levels of social belonging were, in turn, positively associated with intentions to adopt companion robots. Social belonging mediated the relationships between the four dimensions of companion robot service perception and adoption intention. In addition, artificial intelligence literacy positively moderated the relationship between social belonging and adoption intention. From the perspective of social belonging, this study clarifies the associations among companion robot service perceptions and the psychological and behavioral experiences of older adults in smart eldercare settings. The findings offer practical insights for senior care institutions seeking to improve service experiences and for companion robot developers seeking to optimize its anthropomorphic design and socially responsive interaction features.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于认知—情感—意动模型，考察养老社区老年人使用陪伴机器人时，对互动的感知、社会归属感与采纳意愿之间的关系，数据来自对已与陪伴机器人互动过的老年居民的实地问卷调查，并用偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析。结果显示，拟人化、尊重、自主性和社会支持这四项互动感知特征均与社会归属感正相关，社会归属感又与采纳意愿正相关，并在四项感知与采纳意愿之间起中介作用；人工智能素养正向调节社会归属感与采纳意愿的关系。研究据此从社会归属视角说明陪伴机器人服务感知与老年人心理和行为体验的关联，为养老机构改善服务体验、开发者优化拟人化设计提供参考。

papers.title: Comparing ChatGPT and teacher feedback for EFL writing development
papers.authors: Neda Naqdi Babaee
papers.abstract: This mixed-methods study compared ChatGPT-generated and teacher-written feedback conditions in university EFL writing and examined how learners perceived the revision value of each condition. A nonrandomized pretest-posttest design was combined with open-ended post-intervention responses. Participants were 46 upper-intermediate learners in a ChatGPT feedback condition ( n = 25) or a teacher-written feedback condition ( n = 21). Across four weeks, both conditions completed the same instructional sequence and two feedback-revision cycles. Writing was scored for task achievement, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource, grammatical accuracy, and an overall composite. Baseline-adjusted models showed a robust difference favoring the ChatGPT condition for overall writing, F(1, 43) = 16.86, p < .001, partial eta squared = 0.282. Unadjusted domain tests favored the ChatGPT condition for task achievement, coherence and cohesion, and lexical resource; after Holm adjustment across the four domains, only task achievement remained below 0.05. Grammatical accuracy did not differ between conditions. Learners described ChatGPT feedback as immediate and elaborated, particularly for content, organization, and vocabulary, while also reporting concerns about trust and contextual fit. Teacher-written feedback was perceived as selective, context-sensitive, and authoritative. The findings support a condition-level advantage in overall writing and suggest different perceived revision affordances, but they do not isolate feedback source from differences in feedback elaboration and immediacy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了ChatGPT生成反馈与教师书面反馈对大学英语学习者写作发展的影响，并考察学习者对两种反馈修订价值的感知。研究采用非随机前后测设计结合开放式反馈，让两组学习者在四周内完成相同的教学流程和两轮反馈修订。结果显示，在控制基线后，ChatGPT组在整体写作成绩上明显优于教师反馈组；分项上，未校正时任务完成、连贯衔接和词汇资源三项偏向ChatGPT组，经多重比较校正后仅任务完成仍显著，语法准确性两组无差异。学习者认为ChatGPT反馈即时且展开充分，尤其有助于内容、组织和词汇，但也对其可信度和情境适配性存有疑虑；教师反馈则被视为有选择性、贴合情境且具权威性。作者指出，这支持整体写作上的条件层面优势及不同的感知修订可供性，但无法将反馈来源与反馈展开程度和即时性的差异分开。

papers.title: A systematic literature review of generative AI support for pre-service teachers in designing computational thinking instruction
papers.authors: Hanifah Lutfia Farah, Cucuk Wawan Budiyanto
papers.abstract: Abstract Computational Thinking (CT) is increasingly expected across curricula, yet pre-service teachers often report limited preparation for translating CT concepts into instructional practice. This systematic literature review examines how Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) supports pre-service teachers’ instructional design and what the available evidence implies for CT-oriented teaching. Using the PRISMA approach, the review synthesised 26 empirical studies identified through Scopus and ScienceDirect under the original eligibility criteria. The evidence base was heterogeneous: only two studies were coded as explicitly addressing CT integration, fifteen as implicitly CT-aligned, and nine as having no identifiable CT integration. Accordingly, indirect studies are treated as contextual evidence rather than direct evidence of CT instructional design. Across the literature, GenAI was used for ideation, lesson planning, feedback, multimedia generation, and iterative refinement. Several studies reported gains or positive experiences in efficiency, confidence, engagement, creativity, or instructional design competence; however, these outcomes were study-specific and should not be generalised as improvements in CT competence. Several studies have linked more productive use of GenAI to human evaluation, AI literacy, pedagogical or subject-matter knowledge, and structured frameworks or training. Reported risks included inaccurate or inconsistent outputs, hallucinations, overreliance, metacognitive laziness, and ethical concerns. Because the search was limited to Scopus and ScienceDirect and applied an open-access criterion, the review may be affected by database and accessibility bias. Overall, direct evidence that GenAI improves CT-specific instructional design remains preliminary; the broader literature more strongly supports a conditional role for GenAI as a pedagogical scaffold in CT-relevant instructional design.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察生成式人工智能如何支持职前教师进行教学设计，以及现有证据对计算思维教学意味着什么。作者按PRISMA流程从Scopus和ScienceDirect筛选并综合了26项实证研究，但其中仅两项明确涉及计算思维整合，多数研究只是间接相关，因此被作为背景证据而非直接证据。文献中生成式AI主要用于构思、教案规划、反馈、多媒体生成和迭代修改，部分研究报告了效率、信心、参与度或教学设计能力方面的积极体验，但这些结果因研究而异，不能推广为计算思维能力的提升。更有效的使用与人工评估、AI素养、学科教学知识及结构化培训相关，同时存在输出不准确、过度依赖和伦理等风险；综述也指出数据库与开放获取限制可能带来偏差，生成式AI改善计算思维专项教学设计的直接证据仍属初步。

papers.title: Enhancing shear strength prediction in steel fiber reinforced concrete: a hybrid machine learning approach
papers.authors: Houshang Habibi, Yousef Zandi, Adel Ferdousi, Jamshid Sabouri
papers.journal: Multiscale and Multidisciplinary Modeling Experiments and Design
papers.abstract: It is complicated to comprehend the shear strength behavior of steel fiber-reinforced concrete (FRC) because of various parameters that are involved. The goal of this paper is to develop a framework for precise estimation of the shear strength of steel FRC beams using a novel hybrid machine learning technique. The adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) was chosen as a predictive model to address this problem, and a new metaheuristic algorithm based on the equilibrium optimizer (EO) was used, for optimal generalization and accurate prediction. In addition, the performance of the newly created predictive model was evaluated by using other popular metaheuristic algorithms, such as genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO). To create the EO-ANFIS model, 241 experimental data sets from the literature were utilized. The input variables consisted of the steel fiber ratio, the concrete design strength, the effective depth, the reinforcement ratio, and the span-to-depth ratio, while the output variable was the shear strength capacity. The accuracy of the ANFIS models based on metaheuristic algorithms was evaluated against four equations from other research and against modern ensemble learners using ten-fold cross-validation. The results indicated that the ANFIS models based on the proposed algorithms outperformed the previous equations, and the EO-ANFIS model had a better performance than the GA-ANFIS and PSO-ANFIS models while remaining competitive with the ensemble methods and offering an interpretable rule structure. The sensitivity analysis revealed that the most influential factors on shear strength are reinforcement ratio and steel fiber ratio.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对钢纤维混凝土梁抗剪强度受多参数影响、难以准确预测的问题，构建了以自适应神经模糊推理系统（ANFIS）为预测模型、以平衡优化器（EO）进行参数优化的混合机器学习框架，并利用文献中241组实验数据建模，输入涵盖钢纤维掺量、混凝土设计强度、有效深度、配筋率与跨高比。结果显示，基于元启发式算法的ANFIS模型整体优于既有经验公式，其中EO-ANFIS的表现优于GA-ANFIS和PSO-ANFIS，与集成学习方法相比具有竞争力，同时保留了可解释的规则结构；敏感性分析表明配筋率和钢纤维掺量是影响抗剪强度的最主要因素。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and ethics education
papers.authors: Henk ten Have (21006545)

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in religious education: teacher perspectives from a national professional development context
papers.authors: Ιωάννα Κομνηνού
papers.abstract: Abstract This study examines teachers’ perceptions of and orientations to Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the context of Religious Education (RE), drawing on survey data collected from 54 in-service RE teachers participating in the SUB8 professional development programme in Greece. Using a descriptive survey design grounded in the frameworks of Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK), Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK), AI literacy, and digital self-efficacy, the study maps teachers’ reported practices, competencies, and concerns across seven thematic dimensions. Findings indicate generally positive orientations towards AI-assisted instructional design within this cohort, alongside significant theological and pedagogical concerns regarding its use in spiritually sensitive contexts. Qualitative responses point to three recurring themes: the productive utility of AI for lesson preparation and differentiation; persistent concerns about accuracy, depth, and the reliability of AI-generated content; and a strong consensus that AI must function as a supplementary pedagogical tool, subordinate to the relational and experiential dimensions of RE. Because participants were self-selected members of an AI-focused training programme and were surveyed immediately upon its completion, these findings are interpreted as descriptive of this specific professional development context rather than of Greek RE teachers in general. The study complements recent comparative evidence from Germany and Poland by providing, to the author’s knowledge, the first empirical account of AI perceptions among RE teachers within an Orthodox national professional development context, and it foregrounds a theological and epistemological dimension still largely absent from AI-in-education research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察宗教教育教师对人工智能的看法与使用取向，基于希腊一项聚焦 AI 的专业发展项目中在职教师的调查数据，从教学内容知识、技术教学内容知识、AI 素养与数字自我效能等框架出发，梳理其自报实践、能力与关切。结果显示，这一群体对 AI 辅助教学设计总体持积极态度，但在精神性敏感的教学情境中仍有明显的神学与教学顾虑；定性回应反复提到 AI 在备课与差异化教学上的实用价值、对生成内容准确性深度与可靠性的持续担忧，以及 AI 应作为辅助工具、从属于宗教教育的关系性与体验性维度的共识。作者强调，参与者是自愿加入该培训项目且刚结业即接受调查，因此结论只描述这一特定专业发展情境，不能推广到希腊宗教教育教师整体。

papers.title: A discourse analysis of guidelines for artificial intelligence in education policy
papers.authors: Giulia Cancellaro
papers.abstract: Abstract This research note examines how international organisations and supranational entities are addressing the ethics of artificial intelligence (AI) in education, with a particular focus on the guidelines they have published. It seeks to identify common themes covered in these guidelines. Drawing on eight official documents published by international and regional organisations, the research note aims to map the international discourse on the topic up to 2024 and to demonstrate that, despite regional differences, there are shared approaches to framing the regulation of AI in education policy across regions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察国际组织与超国家机构如何在其发布的人工智能教育指南中处理伦理问题，并识别这些指南的共同主题。作者对八份官方文件进行话语分析，梳理截至2024年的国际讨论，发现尽管存在地区差异，各地区在构建人工智能教育政策监管框架上仍呈现共享路径。这一结果表明相关伦理议题在国际层面已形成一定共识，但结论基于有限文件，反映的是政策话语层面的趋同而非实际实施效果。

papers.title: Disentangling direct and weight-mediated effects of physical activity on health-related quality of life in a 12-month real-world digital lifestyle intervention
papers.authors: Isabel McCann, Anu Joki, Laura-Unnukka Suojanen, Mikko S. Venäläinen, Kirsi Hannele Pietiläinen, Aila J. Ahola
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose To examine whether participation in a 12-month digital lifestyle program was associated with increased physical activity and whether physical activity was associated with health-related quality of life (HRQoL) independently of weight loss. Methods Self-reported weight and height were used to calculate body mass index (BMI). Physical activity (metabolic equivalent of task hours, MET-h/day) was assessed using a web-based questionnaire at baseline, 3, 6, 9, and 12 months. HRQoL was measured with the RAND-36 at baseline, 6, and 12 months yielding eight domains and physical and mental component scores. Longitudinal mixed-effects models and mediation analyses were used to examine associations between physical activity, BMI, and HRQoL over time. Results In 1732 individuals (82.9% women, median age 52 years, BMI 39.0 kg/m 2 ), estimated marginal mean physical activity increased from 2.16 to 3.06 MET-h/day ( p < 0.001). Periods of higher-than-usual physical activity were associated with lower BMI within individuals (B = − 0.032, 95% CI − 0.053 to − 0.012). Higher physical activity was also associated with better scores in most HRQoL dimensions, including physical and mental component scores. Indirect associations via BMI were largely limited to physical domains, whereas direct associations predominated: 84.9% of the total association with physical functioning and 88.0% of that with bodily pain were attributable to the direct pathway. Conclusion Participation in a digital lifestyle program was associated with increased physical activity, and physical activity was associated with better HRQoL largely independently of weight change, although follow-up was incomplete and the magnitude of the individual associations was modest. Physical activity merits attention as a treatment goal alongside weight management. Trial registration The trial is registered at clinicaltrials.gov (Clinical Trials Identifier NCT04019249). Registration date 12 Jul 2019. Retrospectively registered.

papers.title: Spatio temporal graph attention transformer for EEG based emotion recognition using DEAP and SEED datasets
papers.authors: Sonu Kumar Jha, Indrajeet Kumar, Mandeep Kumar, Lokesh Kumar Sharma, Sanjay Kumar Kuanar
papers.abstract: Emotion recognition based on electroencephalography (EEG) has become an important frontier in affective computing and human–computer interaction (HCI). However, accurately modeling the complex spatial relationships among EEG electrodes, along with long-range temporal dependencies, remains a significant challenge. To address this issue, this paper proposes a Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Transformer (ST-GAT) framework that jointly learns spatial and temporal representations from multi-channel EEG signals. The proposed framework constructs a graph based on EEG electrode topology and correlation-aware connectivity to capture inter-channel relationships through a graph attention mechanism, while a transformer encoder models long-range temporal dependencies within EEG sequences. In addition, a multi-scale feature fusion strategy integrates raw EEG signals, power spectral density, and discrete wavelet transform features to obtain complementary representations for emotion classification. The proposed approach is evaluated on two publicly available benchmark datasets, DEAP and SEED, under a consistent evaluation protocol. Experiments on two benchmarks, DEAP and SEED, show that ST-GAT outperforms representative deep learning and transformer baselines, achieving accuracies of 85.9% and 91.3%, respectively. Visualization via attention heatmaps and feature-space analysis provides insights into the learned representations and improves the interpretability of the proposed framework. The results show that the proposed model provides an effective spatio-temporal learning framework for EEG-based emotion recognition across multiple benchmark datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电情绪识别中电极间空间关系与长程时间依赖难以同时建模的问题，提出时空图注意力Transformer框架，在DEAP和SEED两个公开数据集上开展分类实验。该框架结合电极拓扑与相关性构建图结构，用图注意力捕捉通道间关系，并以Transformer编码器建模时间依赖，同时融合原始信号、功率谱密度和小波特征。结果显示，该模型在两个基准上的准确率分别为85.9%和91.3%，优于代表性深度学习与Transformer基线；注意力热图和特征空间分析也为表征的可解释性提供了线索。

papers.title: SOFEx: A Self-Organized Feature Extraction Approach for Detecting Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer’s Disease using EEG Datasets
papers.authors: Burak Taşçı, Kübra Yıldırım, Prabal Datta Barua, Şengül Doğan, Massimo Salvi, Türker Tuncer, Ru-San Tan, Aruna Devi, Ravinesh Chand Deo, Yan Li, Hasan Mir, Filippo Molinari, U. R. Acharya

papers.title: Multimodal Transformer-Based Preoperative Risk Assessment of Lymph Node Metastasis in Early Gastric Cancer Using Whole Slide Images of Endoscopic Biopsies
papers.authors: Xinyuan Niu, Siyuan Wang, Jinhua Yu, Mengxin Tian, Zhaoqing Tang
papers.abstract: Accurate preoperative assessment of lymph node metastasis (LNM) in early gastric cancer (EGC) is critical for choosing endoscopic or surgical treatment. Most computational pathology studies rely on resection specimens obtained after curative gastrectomy, which inherently limits their preoperative relevance. Our study developed a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) framework to estimate LNM risk using preoperative whole slide images (WSIs) of endoscopic biopsies, aiming to assist clinicians in optimizing treatment strategies before the surgery and reducing unnecessary surgical risks for patients. We developed a multimodal transformer-based model with a clinical-guided co-attention mechanism to fuse pathological features and clinical variables. To overcome the information scarcity inherent in fragmented biopsy specimens, we extracted mucosa and submucosa regions from WSIs of surgical tissues to serve as pseudo-biopsies. A curriculum learning (CL) paradigm was further employed to transition the model from idealized pseudo-biopsies to real-world biopsy samples. Through the analysis of a dataset comprising 1,099 WSIs of surgical tissues and 189 WSIs of endoscopic biopsies, our framework achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.759 on WSIs of surgical tissues and an AUC of 0.727 on preoperative WSIs of endoscopic biopsies. Our findings demonstrate the feasibility of a multimodal AI framework tailored for endoscopic biopsy WSIs in preoperatively assessing LNM risk in T1 EGC. As an investigational clinical decision-support tool, this framework holds promising potential to assist clinicians in preoperative risk stratification, serving as a preliminary step toward optimizing prospective surgical management.

papers.title: Cybersickness, sensory feedback, and embodiment in XR–BMI systems
papers.authors: Diogo João Tomás, João J. Lopes, Carla Pais-Vieira, Miguel Pais-Vieira
papers.abstract: Abstract Embodiment is a core construct in immersive human–computer interaction, yet it is often assumed that increasing multisensory feedback linearly enhances embodied experience. Using an extended reality brain–machine interface (XR–BMI) task, we investigated whether sensory load modulates embodiment and whether affective, experiential, and dispositional factors provide a more informative psychological account of individual differences. Participants performed a BMI task under visual, audiovisual, and audiovisual-tactile conditions, while embodiment subcomponents (ownership, agency, self-location), cybersickness, anxiety, personality traits, and task performance were assessed. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, no statistically significant differences in global embodiment or its subcomponents were observed across sensory conditions. Complementary Bayesian analyses provided moderate evidence favoring models that excluded an effect of sensory condition on embodiment. Instead, cybersickness showed the most consistent negative association with reduced embodiment across conditions. This association remained significant in combined sensitivity analyses, although its independent contribution in adjusted models was attenuated. Mediation analyses identified an indirect statistical pathway consistent with the proposed model, whereby anxiety was associated with lower embodiment via increased cybersickness. Stable personality traits showed limited explanatory value beyond cybersickness. Global embodiment was not associated with BMI performance, although exploratory analyses suggested that spatial self-location may influence the relationship between cybersickness and task performance. Overall, these findings suggest that, under the present experimental conditions, cybersickness is a more consistent correlate of embodiment than increasing sensory load, although smaller effects of sensory enrichment cannot be ruled out. These findings highlight the importance of minimizing cybersickness and promoting sensorimotor coherence when designing immersive XR–BMI systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究借助扩展现实脑机接口任务，考察增加多感官反馈是否如常见假设那样线性提升具身感，并比较晕动症、焦虑、人格特质等因素对个体差异的解释力。参与者在视觉、视听和视听触条件下完成任务，结果显示各感官条件在整体具身感及其子成分上均无显著差异，贝叶斯分析也倾向于支持感官条件无效应的模型。相反，晕动症与较低的具身感在各条件下呈最一致的负相关，焦虑则可能通过增加晕动症间接关联较低的具身感；稳定人格特质的解释力有限，整体具身感与任务表现无关。作者据此提示，在现有实验条件下，减少晕动症、促进感觉运动一致性比单纯增加感官负荷更重要，但也不能排除感官丰富化存在较小效应的可能。
