papers.title: AI-Enabled School Management for Sustainable Education: A Systematic Review of Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Monireh Mokhtarzadeh
papers.abstract: This review examines the various ways artificial intelligence (AI) can influence school management and its potential to promote sustainable education. It brings together the findings from earlier studies to illustrate how schools are using AI to simplify administrative tasks, enrich learning experiences, and support sustainable education efforts. Key uses include AI tools for real-time data analysis, better resource management, and personalised learning paths that connect students with real-world environmental issues. By managing tasks such as data cleaning and report generation, AI enables educators and staff to dedicate more time to strategic initiatives like developing curricula and engaging the community in sustainability projects. The review also highlights major challenges and risks of using AI in education, such as concerns about data privacy, the need for reliable infrastructure, and ethical issues related to algorithmic bias. The findings show that although AI provides powerful tools for creating efficient and environmentally conscious schools, successful and fair implementation requires careful planning, targeted teacher training, and a focus on equal access. The article concludes by emphasising key areas for future research, underlining the need for robust frameworks to enable schools to use AI responsibly while promoting both academic excellence and a culture of sustainability and sustainable education.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了人工智能在学校管理中的应用及其对可持续教育的潜在作用，整合既有研究说明学校如何借助AI简化行政事务、丰富学习体验并支持可持续发展教育。主要用途包括实时数据分析、资源管理优化，以及将学生与真实环境议题相联系的个性化学习路径；通过承担数据清洗、报告生成等任务，AI使教职员工有更多时间投入课程开发和社区可持续发展项目。综述同时指出数据隐私、基础设施可靠性和算法偏见等伦理风险，认为AI虽能助力建设高效且具环保意识的学校，但公平有效的落地仍需周密规划、有针对性的教师培训和均等可及性，并强调未来需建立稳健框架以负责任地使用AI。

papers.title: A Methodological Systematic Review of Mixed‐Methods Research on AI and Teacher Cognition and Practice in Language Education (2015–2025)
papers.authors: Zia Tajeddin, Minoo Alemi, Neda Khanlarzadeh
papers.abstract: Abstract The rich insights afforded by integrating qualitative and quantitative methods in mixed‐methods research (MMR) have given it enormous cachet in teacher education. One expression of this interest is the growing scholarship on the intersection of teacher cognition and practice and artificial intelligence (AI) in language education. To provide a picture of the trajectory of this intersection, this methodological systematic review sought to analyze 36 empirical studies employing MMR published between 2015 and 2025, retrieved through a PRISMA‐informed procedure and a set of inclusion and exclusion criteria. Findings showed a sharp increase in the number of studies in 2023–2025, mostly conducted in East Asia and the Middle East. They also manifested that the majority of the studies were conducted on teacher cognition, mainly on in‐service teachers in university and school contexts, with scant research solely directed at teacher instructional practice. Findings about different aspects of mixed‐methods used in the studies revealed a preference for the explanatory quan‐qual sequencing, insufficient reporting of the sequencing of data analysis in many studies, and mostly separated rather than integrated presentation of the findings. This systematic review has implications for AI‐based teacher education, highlighting the importance of explicit report design typology, sequencing, priority of strands, and integration procedures in framing research on teacher cognition and practice regarding AI use.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述采用方法学系统综述方式，梳理了2015至2025年间语言教育领域探讨人工智能与教师认知及实践关系的36项混合方法实证研究，重点分析其方法学特征。结果显示，相关研究在2023至2025年明显增多，多集中于东亚和中东，且大多聚焦教师认知、以高校和中小学在职教师为对象，专门针对教师教学实践的研究较少。方法学上，研究偏好解释性量化—质性顺序设计，但不少研究对数据分析顺序报告不足，结果呈现多为分开而非整合。文章据此提示，AI相关教师教育研究应明确报告设计类型、顺序、各线索优先性与整合程序。

papers.title: Everything everywhere all‐at‐once? AI , expertise–output decoupling, and new entrepreneurial strategy trade‐offs in the age of abundance
papers.authors: Jen Gennai, Riitta Katila, Minu Kumar, Ian Sinapuelas
papers.abstract: Abstract Research Summary Generative AI democratizes entrepreneurship by lowering barriers to ideation, creating an environment of abundance. Yet while AI produces speed, scale, and local autonomy, these benefits may come at hidden costs to output quality. Using illustrative vignettes to ground and elaborate, we particularly identify explainability, traceability, and generalizability as costs of abundance. As AI separates observable output from the expertise traditionally required to produce it, the entrepreneur's attention to evaluation becomes the scarce resource. We identify three trade‐offs and their interdependencies for entrepreneurs: speed‐to‐understanding, scale‐to‐oversight, and local autonomy‐to‐system‐wide relevance. Implications for human accountability of AI systems and governance (organizational design) challenges for entrepreneurs are discussed. Managerial Summary AI allows entrepreneurial firms to produce ideas and other outputs faster and at greater scale than ever before. As AI separates output from the expertise traditionally gained while creating it, the scarce resource shifts from generation to evaluation. This creates new managerial tensions: speed versus understanding, scale versus oversight, and local autonomy versus system‐wide relevance. These tensions help explain concerns about AI “going rogue”: simply keeping a human in the loop is not enough if the human expertise no longer includes the ability to understand, trace, question, and override the system. Entrepreneurs are challenged to design organizations that preserve meaningful human expertise and accountability.
papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨生成式人工智能降低创业门槛、带来创意丰裕之后，创业者面临的新权衡。作者借助示例性情景说明，AI 虽带来速度、规模与局部自主性，却可能以可解释性、可追溯性和可推广性为代价；当产出与原本生产它所需的专业知识脱钩，创业者的注意力便从生成转向评估，成为稀缺资源。文章据此提出速度与理解、规模与监督、局部自主与系统相关性三组相互关联的权衡，并讨论其对 AI 系统的人类问责与组织设计治理的启示，指出仅保留人在回路中并不足够。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in agricultural education: Applications, challenges, and future directions with a focus on image recognition
papers.authors: Mingnan Qu, Jialin Yu
papers.abstract: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI)‐based image recognition technology is reshaping the digital transformation of agricultural education by enhancing practical teaching, intelligent assessment, and personalized learning. This review examines the educational applications of AI image recognition technologies in agricultural training environments, including virtual simulation systems, intelligent pest and disease diagnosis, adaptive learning platforms, and smart field teaching. The study further discusses the pedagogical value of AI‐supported agricultural education from the perspectives of experiential learning, digital competence development, and instructional innovation. Major challenges, including teacher digital literacy, infrastructure limitations, data privacy, and educational equity in rural areas, are also analyzed. Finally, future directions for AI‐enabled agricultural education are proposed, emphasizing interdisciplinary curriculum reform, intelligent learning ecosystems, and sustainable educational development. This review provides a theoretical and practical reference for promoting the intelligent transformation of agricultural education.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕人工智能图像识别技术在农业教育中的应用展开，梳理了虚拟仿真系统、病虫害智能诊断、自适应学习平台和智慧田间教学等场景，并从体验式学习、数字能力培养和教学创新角度讨论其教育价值。文章同时分析了教师数字素养、基础设施不足、数据隐私和农村教育公平等主要挑战，进而提出跨学科课程改革、智能学习生态与可持续教育发展等未来方向。作为综述，它未报告原始实证结果，而是为农业教育智能化转型提供理论与实践的参考框架。

papers.title: Understanding the CSR – AI Paradox: The Duality of Health Innovation and Environmental Responsibility in Consumer Perceptions
papers.authors: Yanqi Sun, Cheng Xu, Howard Davey, Weijie Tan
papers.journal: Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental Management
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in healthcare presents a paradox at the intersection of corporate social responsibility (CSR) and environmental sustainability. While AI‐driven health innovations promise life‐saving benefits and social good, their development often entails substantial carbon emissions that contradict environmental commitments. This study investigates the CSR–AI paradox by examining how consumers perceive and respond to the duality of health innovation and environmental responsibility in AI‐enabled healthcare products. Drawing on cognitive dissonance theory, moral licensing, and greenwashing frameworks, we conducted a scenario‐based experimental study to analyze consumer reactions to discrepancies between firms' environmental, social, and governance (ESG) claims and actual carbon footprints. We introduce and operationalize the concept of Carbon Accountability Elasticity (CAE) as a conceptual framework to quantify and guide analysis of trade‐offs between health utility and environmental accountability. The results reveal that greenwashing—particularly vague or unsubstantiated ESG claims—triggers significant consumer disappointment, reduces willingness to pay, and erodes trust, especially when high carbon footprints are disclosed post‐purchase. However, consumers demonstrate greater tolerance for environmental costs in the case of life‐critical innovations, such as AI‐powered cancer screening, highlighting a moral licensing effect. These findings underscore the importance of transparent ESG reporting and authentic sustainability practices in AI healthcare innovation. The study offers theoretical and managerial insights for advancing responsible innovation that aligns social benefit with environmental stewardship, supporting both sustainable development goals and stakeholder accountability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注AI医疗产品中健康创新与环境责任之间的“CSR–AI悖论”，即消费者如何感知并回应企业ESG宣称与实际碳足迹之间的落差。作者基于情景实验，结合认知失调、道德许可与漂绿框架，提出并操作化“碳问责弹性”概念以刻画健康效用与环境责任之间的权衡。结果显示，模糊或无依据的ESG宣称会引发失望、降低支付意愿并侵蚀信任，尤其在购买后披露高碳足迹时更为明显；但面对AI癌症筛查等生命攸关的创新，消费者对环境成本的容忍度更高，体现出道德许可效应。文章据此强调透明ESG报告与真实可持续实践的重要性，并提示相关结论受情景设定与创新类型的限制。

papers.title: Bi‐Model Deep Learning Architectures: A Systematic Review of Fusion Strategies and Design Taxonomies
papers.authors: Jasmin Z. K. Chu, Joel Chia Ming Than, Choon Lin Tan, Tan Ngoc Dinh
papers.journal: Concurrency and Computation Practice and Experience
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bi‐model deep learning, the coordinated use of two complementary models or modalities, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving predictive accuracy and robustness in complex real‐world applications. However, existing research remains scattered across domain‐specific studies, with no unified account of the architectural patterns, fusion strategies, and evaluation practices that distinguish bi‐model designs from broader multimodal learning. This systematic review addresses this gap by consolidating 136 publications into a unified taxonomy of parallel, stacked, and interactive bi‐model architectures, together with feature‐level, model‐level, decision‐level, and hybrid fusion strategies. Representative applications across insurance analytics, cybersecurity, medical imaging, emotion recognition, and brain‐computer interfaces are examined to demonstrate how bi‐model systems consistently outperform unimodal baselines when modalities carry complementary information. The review further identifies recurring challenges, including data heterogeneity, representation mismatch, sensitivity to missing modalities, interpretability limitations, and high computation overhead, and proposes future research directions such as adaptive quality‐aware fusion, resilient handling of incomplete modalities, lightweight dual‐encoder designs, and inherently interpretable multimodal reasoning. Beyond synthesizing existing evidence, this review contributes a unified conceptual taxonomy, a consolidated cross‐domain view of practical and real‐time applications, and a structured foundation of open challenges and future directions to guide the design of more accurate, efficient, transparent, and deployable bi‐model systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述针对双模型深度学习研究分散于各领域、缺乏统一架构与融合策略梳理的问题，将136篇文献整合为并行、堆叠和交互三类双模型架构，以及特征级、模型级、决策级和混合四类融合策略。文章结合保险分析、网络安全、医学影像、情绪识别和脑机接口等应用指出，当两种模态携带互补信息时，双模型系统通常优于单模态基线，同时归纳出数据异质性、表征不匹配、缺失模态敏感、可解释性不足和计算开销高等反复出现的挑战，并提出自适应质量感知融合、不完整模态的稳健处理、轻量双编码器设计和可解释多模态推理等方向。其贡献在于提供统一的概念分类与跨领域应用视图，为更准确、高效、透明且可部署的双模型系统设计奠定结构化基础。

papers.title: AI use creates artificial sense of confidence in campus legal matters
papers.authors: Michael Porter
papers.abstract: Consider the following scenarios: A student unhappy with a grade cites three federal regulations and a circuit court opinion in an email to a professor. An employee facing a corrective action plan submits a two‐page rebuttal organized by legal elements, complete with case citations. A community member follows up an open‐records request with a follow‐up letter quoting the statute's response deadline down to the business day. None of these individuals has ever consulted an attorney. All of them have an artificial intelligence partner open in another tab.
papers.summary_zh: 该文关注人工智能被用于校园法律事务时如何影响使用者的信心。摘要以学生就成绩向教授援引联邦法规和巡回法院判例、员工按法律要件撰写申辩书、社区成员引用法条回应期限等场景为例，指出这些人都未咨询过律师，却借助另一标签页中的人工智能伙伴完成类似法律行动。文章由此提出，AI 使用可能制造一种人为的法律信心感，提示在人机协同处理法律事务时需审视这种信心的来源与可靠性。摘要未报告实证数据或系统实现细节。

papers.title: Emotion-Focused Behavioral Weight Loss Treatment for Adolescents
papers.authors: Kerri N. Boutelle, Michael A. Manzano, Ellen K. Pasquale, David R. Strong, Rebecca S. Bernard, Kyung E. Rhee, Dawn M. Eichen, Alec L. Miller, Carol B. Peterson
papers.abstract: Importance Family-based behavioral treatment (FBT) efficacy decreases in adolescence, a developmental period of gradual maturation and increasing autonomy during which emotion regulation skills develop. Objective To evaluate the feasibility and efficacy of FBT alone compared with FBT plus emotion regulation across 6 months of treatment and 12 months of follow-up on adolescent weight change, emotion regulation, emotional eating, and parent weight change. Design, Setting, and Participants This parallel-group randomized clinical trial of adolescents 13 to 16 years of age with body mass index (BMI) in the 85th percentile or higher but less than the 99.9th percentile was conducted from August 29, 2019, to January 4, 2024, at 2 university clinics. Central randomization was completed by a statistician, and outcome assessors were blinded to treatment condition. The majority of treatments and assessments were delivered remotely via video conference due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Interventions FBT plus emotion regulation vs traditional FBT skills alone for weight loss. FBT included nutrition and physical activity education, behavior change strategies, and parenting skills. Both treatments had 6 months of adolescent and parent groups and behavior coaching sessions. The combined group included FBT skills and added dialectical behavior therapy and emotion-focused therapy. Main Outcomes and Measures The main outcomes were adolescent weight (body mass index [BMI] z score (BMIz) and BMI as a percentage of the 95th BMI percentile [%BMIp95]), emotion regulation skills (measured by Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale [DERS] scores), emotional eating behaviors (measured by Emotional Eating Scale [EES] scores), parent weight, and feasibility and acceptability of treatment. Primary outcome analyses used an intention-to-treat approach. Results A total of 166 (FBT plus emotion regulation = 84; FBT = 82) dyads (adolescents: mean [SD] age, 14.3 [1.2] years; 95 [57%] female; mean [SD] BMIz, 2.2 [0.6]; mean [SD] %BMIp95, 120.4 [21.4]; parents: mean [SD] age, 45.3 [6.5] years; 141 [85%] female; mean [SD] BMI, 32.6 [7.0]) were assessed at baseline, midtreatment, posttreatment, and 6- and 12-month follow-up visits. There were no statistically significant differences in posttreatment weight loss among adolescents receiving FBT plus emotion regulation compared with FBT (difference in BMIz, 0.03 [95% CI, −0.05 to 0.10]). However, adolescents in FBT plus emotion regulation did not regain as much weight at the 12-month follow-up (difference in BMIz, −0.09 [95% CI, −0.17 to −0.02]). At the 12-month follow-up, 4% (95% CI, 1%-12%) of adolescents in FBT and 22% (95% CI, 8%-48%) of adolescents in FBT plus emotion regulation lost a clinically significant amount of weight (≥0.20 BMIz). At 12 months’ follow-up, parent weight (difference in BMI, 0.51 [95% CI, −0.03 to 1.05]) and adolescent emotion regulation (difference in DERS scores, −0.06 [95% CI, −0.25 to 0.50]) did not differ by treatment. By contrast, the FBT plus emotion regulation group had lower scores than the FBT group on emotional eating (difference in EES scores, −0.39 [95% CI, −0.63 to −0.15]). Conclusions and Relevance In this randomized clinical trial of 166 parent-adolescent dyads, adding emotion regulation skills to FBT did not improve weight loss during treatment but was associated with less weight regain and lower emotional eating through the 12-month follow-up. These findings suggest that adding emotion regulation skills to an FBT program may attenuate weight regain and decrease emotional eating among adolescents. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT03674944
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对青少年家庭行为减重治疗（FBT）效果随年龄增长而下降的问题，比较了单独FBT与FBT联合情绪调节技能对青少年体重变化、情绪调节、情绪性进食及家长体重的影响，采用平行组随机临床试验设计，对象为超重青少年及其家长。结果显示，两种方案在治疗结束时减重差异不显著，但联合组在12个月随访时体重反弹更少，达到临床显著减重比例更高，情绪性进食得分也更低；家长体重和青少年情绪调节未见组间差异。作者据此认为，在FBT中加入情绪调节技能虽未改善治疗期减重，但可能有助于减缓随访期体重反弹并减少情绪性进食。

papers.title: ACADEMIC INTEGRITY AND GENERATIVE AI IN LANGUAGE ASSESSMENT: FORMULATING FAIR EVALUATION STRATEGIES FOR EFL CLASSROOMS
papers.authors: Kumush Obiddin qizi
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT can produce fluent English texts in seconds. This creates a serious challenge for language assessment, because teachers can no longer be sure that a student’s written work shows the student’s own ability. This article discusses academic integrity in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) classrooms in the age of generative AI and proposes fair evaluation strategies. It reviews research on AI and academic integrity, explains why AI-detection software is an unreliable and potentially unfair solution for EFL learners, and presents a practical framework based on clear AI-use rules, process-based assessment, oral verification and reflective tasks. The article argues that fair assessment does not depend on banning AI completely, but on redesigning tasks and being transparent about what is allowed.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论生成式人工智能给英语作为外语课堂评估带来的学术诚信难题：ChatGPT 等工具能快速生成流畅英文，教师难以判断学生写作是否反映其真实能力。文章梳理相关研究后指出，AI 检测软件对英语学习者并不可靠，也可能造成不公平，因此提出以明确 AI 使用规则、过程性评估、口头核验和反思任务为核心的评估框架。作者主张，公平评估的关键不在于全面禁止 AI，而在于重新设计任务并透明说明允许的使用范围。

papers.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Shaping Students' Sustainable Education and Career Development: An Extended Technology–Organization–Environment (TOE) Perspective
papers.authors: Preeti Kulkarni, Vaishnavi Kulkarni, Niraj Chaudhari, Gautami Upadhyay
papers.abstract: The central purpose of education is to ensure the holistic development of learners, and delivering quality teaching and effective learning practices enables Higher Educational Institutions (HEIs) to attain long-term, meaningful learning outcomes; in today's academic context, both Artificial Intelligence (AI) and outcome-based education are receiving considerable scholarly attention, and this study examines how students perceive AI and the extent to which it influences sustainable learning and future career advancement. The research framework is grounded in the Technology–Organization–Environment (TOE) model, extended to incorporate social, educational, and career-related dimensions relevant to student populations; data were collected from 239 higher education students across multiple academic programs using a structured questionnaire developed in consultation with specialists in AI and sustainable education, and the measurement and structural models were validated using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM) in SmartPLS, with descriptive analysis performed in IBM SPSS 23.0. The findings show that three core antecedents—social factors, technological factors, and organizational factors—significantly shape students' attitude toward AI, and attitude, in turn, positively influences students' perception of sustainable education and their career development, with all twelve hypothesized paths statistically supported (p < 0.05) and the model demonstrating acceptable reliability, validity, and predictive relevance (Q² > 0.35 across endogenous constructs). The study extends the classical TOE framework beyond its organizational-adoption origins into an individual-level, student-centred model of AI acceptance, linking technology adoption theory directly to sustainable-education and employability outcomes, and the findings offer empirically grounded guidance for HEIs seeking to integrate AI responsibly into curricula and student-support services.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于扩展的技术—组织—环境（TOE）框架，考察大学生对人工智能的感知如何影响其可持续学习与职业发展，通过对多专业高等教育学生进行问卷调查，并采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型检验测量与结构模型。结果显示，社会、技术与组织三类因素显著塑造学生对AI的态度，而这一态度又正向影响学生对可持续教育和职业发展的感知，研究假设的路径均获统计支持。作者据此将经典TOE框架从组织采纳层面延伸到以学生为中心的个人层面，把技术接受理论与可持续教育及就业能力结果联系起来，为高校负责任地将AI融入课程与学生支持服务提供了实证依据。

papers.title: ANÁLISE CIENTOMÉTRICA DA PRODUÇÃO CIENTÍFICA EM INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL NA EDUCAÇÃO, ÉTICA E INCLUSÃO: UMA INVESTIGAÇÃO COM O SOFTWARE VOSVIEWER
papers.authors: Wellington Cantanhede dos Santos, Dadson Luis Ferreira Leite, Edvan Moreira
papers.abstract: This study aimed to map evidence of the essential role of institutions in consolidating Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly in the fields of education, health, and language. A scientometric analysis was conducted based on indicators of productivity, publication volume, and scientific connection strength, considered as measures of impact and collaboration. The United States, China, England, and India lead in scientific output, with the United States standing out in productivity and England in international articulation. Institutions such as the Mayo Clinic, UCL, and Monash University demonstrate distinct profiles of influence. The terms “Artificial Intelligence” and “ChatGPT” occupy central positions within the networks, highlighting their multidisciplinary applications. The analysis underscores the importance of collaborative and interdisciplinary strategies for advancing AI research and shaping more effective scientific policies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以科学计量分析为方法，借助VOSviewer软件考察人工智能在教育、伦理与包容领域的研究产出格局，并关注机构在相关研究整合中的作用。分析显示，美国、中国、英国和印度在科学产出上居前，美国在生产力上突出，英国在国际合作联系上较为活跃；Mayo Clinic、UCL和Monash University等机构呈现不同的影响力特征。“Artificial Intelligence”和“ChatGPT”在网络中处于中心位置，反映其多学科应用。作者据此强调协作与跨学科策略对推进AI研究及制定更有效科学政策的重要性，但该分析基于文献计量指标，主要揭示产出与连接格局，而非因果效应。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Driver of Tourism Development in Uzbekistan
papers.authors: Rustamov Otabek Akbarovich
papers.journal: American Journal of Economics and Business Management
papers.abstract: Uzbekistan received 10.3 million foreign visitors in the first nine months of 2026, 20.4% more than a year earlier, and earned USD 5.3 billion from tourism service exports, up 51.2% on the comparable period of 2025. Growth of this speed is good news, but it is also a warning: the country's service infrastructure is being asked to absorb volumes it was never built for. This article asks a practical question — how should artificial intelligence (AI) be introduced into the tourism sector so that quality keeps pace with quantity? Drawing on the service quality literature and on recent work concerning AI acceptance in hospitality, we propose a four-stage adoption model: digitalisation, a data ecosystem with predictive analytics, intelligent customer engagement, and finally an autonomous city-level tourism ecosystem. We then show, using Samarkand as a case, how the classic SERVQUAL-AHP weighting scheme can be merged with AI-driven sentiment monitoring so that the Gap 1 misalignment between what managers believe customers want and what customers actually say is tracked daily rather than once a year. Benchmarking against Dubai, Singapore, and Spain suggests the model is realistic provided staff training begins before, not after, deployment. Under a conservative reading, properly phased AI adoption could lift service quality indicators by a quarter to a third and protect export growth as the market approaches saturation in proximate source countries.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以乌兹别克斯坦旅游业快速增长为背景，提出一个分四阶段引入人工智能的采纳模型，并以撒马尔罕为案例，将SERVQUAL-AHP权重方法与AI驱动的情感监测结合，用于持续追踪管理者认知与顾客实际反馈之间的错位。与迪拜、新加坡和西班牙的对照表明，该模型具有现实可行性，但前提是员工培训须先于部署。作者保守估计，分阶段推进AI采纳可使服务质量指标提升约四分之一至三分之一，并在近程客源市场趋于饱和时支撑出口增长。

papers.title: Measuring the Muscle of Change: How the Changemaker Index Helps People and Institutions Lead When the Ground Is Moving
papers.authors: Diana Wells, Laxmi Parthasarathy, Anjana Shekhar
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the skills work requires faster than most institutions can adapt. The capacities that matter most now (acting under uncertainty, working across shifting teams, taking initiative for the common good) have long been treated as too intangible to measure, so the gap between those who have them and those who don't has stayed largely invisible. Ashoka's Changemaker Index (CMI) is a validated psychometric assessment that makes these capacities measurable at the individual, team, and institutional level. Drawing on more than 16,000 completed assessments and partnerships with a global company, a University in Mexico, and a leadership academy in Mozambique, this article explains how the CMI works, how it differs from conventional leadership tools, and how mapping "changemaker density" could guide investment by funders, employers, and education systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕人工智能加速改变工作所需技能、而机构适应滞后的背景，讨论如何测量在不确定性中行动、跨团队协作和为公共利益主动担当等此前被视为难以量化的能力。作者介绍Ashoka的Changemaker Index这一经过验证的心理测量工具，说明其可在个人、团队和机构层面测量这些能力，并借助大量已完成评估及与企业、高校和领导力学院的合作，阐述其运作方式及与传统领导力工具的区别。文章进一步提出，绘制“变革者密度”可为资助方、雇主和教育系统的投入提供参考，但属于工具介绍与应用设想，并未报告因果效果。

papers.title: ECONOMIC NEGOTIATIONS IN THE DIGITAL ERA: DEVELOPING AN INTEGRATED DIGITAL ECONOMIC NEGOTIATION FRAMEWORK BASED ON EIGHT GOVERNING PRINCIPLES
papers.authors: Svetlana V. Rusu
papers.abstract: Digital transformation is reshaping economic negotiations by changing how information is generated, processed, and used in strategic decision-making. Traditional negotiation theories, focused mainly on bargaining power, information asymmetry, and interpersonal interaction, do not fully capture the complexity of technology-mediated economic exchanges. This paper develops the Integrated Digital Economic Negotiation Framework (IDENF), a conceptual model explaining how digital capabilities influence negotiation effectiveness in the global economy. Based on the literature on negotiation theory, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and information economics, the study proposes eight principles of economic negotiations in a digitalized world: data intelligence, AI-augmented decision-making, digital trust, technological adaptability, digital transparency, ethical digital governance, networked collaboration, and continuous digital learning. The framework contributes to the literature by reconceptualizing economic negotiations as hybrid socio-technological processes where human expertise and digital infrastructures jointly shape negotiation outcomes. Note: The article was elaborated within the framework of Subprogram 030101 „Strengthening the resilience, competitiveness, and sustainability of the economy of the Republic of Moldova in the context of the accession process to the European Union”, institutional funding.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对传统谈判理论难以充分解释技术中介下经济交换复杂性的问题，提出一个概念模型——整合数字经济学谈判框架（IDENF），用以说明数字能力如何影响全球经济中的谈判成效。作者基于谈判理论、数字化转型、人工智能与信息经济学文献，提出数据智能、AI增强决策、数字信任、技术适应性、数字透明度、伦理数字治理、网络化协作与持续数字学习八项原则。其核心含义在于将经济谈判重新概念化为人与数字基础设施共同塑造结果的社会—技术混合过程，而非单纯的人际博弈。

papers.title: A Machine Learning Approach using Low Burden Predictors from German PIRLS 2021
papers.authors: Julia Zeidler
papers.journal: Gothenburg University Publications Electronic Archive (Gothenburg University)
papers.abstract: Background: In the light of the declining reading literacy scores in Germany among fourth graders, there is a crucial need to efficient solutions. Early warning systems (EWS) form a first step by identifying students at risk for developing or already demonstrating reading difficulties. However, research lacks context sensitive (German) approaches that are neither time-consuming nor requiring a high response burden in their conduction. Aims: This study aims to develop an approach for a low-burden EWS that identifies fourth graders at risk of having reading difficulties using only easily accessible background data. The central goal is to maximize predictive performance while taking practical applicability into account. Theory: The study is grounded in Bronfenbrenner’s Bioecological Systems Theory. The theory guided the organization of the low-burden predictors and helped to interpret the findings in the context of the Process-Person-Context-Time (PPCT) model. Methods: Data from German fourth graders (N = 4552) of the Progress in International Reading Literacy Study (PIRLS) 2021 was used to employ a two-stage machine learning approach. First, a penalized logistic regression model (Elastic Net regularization) was conducted to predict the risk status of the fourth graders and to identify the most important low-burden predictors from a set of 91 variables. Second, the variable importance and the effect sizes of the predictors were validated through multilevel logistic regression to account for the nested structure of the data. Results: The final machine learning model achieves a high predictive performance with an AUC of .86. The most important predictors for being at risk of low reading performance are parental expectations of the students’ future education, the number of books at home, and reading practices at school. The findings demonstrate that a low-burden approach can reliably classify students as at risk and not at risk without the need for expensive or specialized testing, providing foundation for targeted interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于德国四年级学生PIRLS 2021数据，采用两阶段机器学习方法，尝试仅用易获取的背景信息构建低负担阅读困难早期预警系统。最终模型预测表现较高，最重要的预测因素包括家长期望、家庭藏书量和学校阅读实践。结果表明，无需昂贵或专门测试即可较可靠地区分风险学生，为后续针对性干预提供依据，但结论仍限于该德国样本与所用预测变量。

papers.title: O papel dos biomarcadores recentes no diagnóstico precoce da demência por corpos de Lewy
papers.authors: Rhafael Tobias Bastos, Iuri Cesar Lima Paiva, Eberson da Silva Rodrigues Nascimento
papers.abstract: Dementia with Lewy Bodies is one of the most challenging neurodegenerative conditions in older adults, frequently underdiagnosed due to its phenotypic overlap with Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. This study synthesizes the primary molecular, imaging, and neurophysiological biomarkers that enable the early detection and pathological differentiation of this condition during prodromal phases. Through a critical review of contemporary biological consensus criteria, the disruptive role of Alpha-Synuclein Seed Amplification Assays in cerebrospinal fluid and peripheral tissues is analyzed, showcasing high diagnostic specificity in vivo. Additionally, the contribution of iodine-123-metaiodobenzylguanidine. myocardial scintigraphy in identifying postganglionic sympathetic denervation and dopamine transporter imaging in evaluating striatal neuronal loss is examined. In the neurophysiological spectrum, the value of quantitative electroencephalography in identifying the slowing of posterior background activity is highlighted, correlating with characteristic cognitive fluctuations. It is established that transitioning from a purely clinical diagnostic model to an integrated bio-clinical approach is essential for identifying the disease in its earliest stages. This advancement facilitates the timely enrollment of patients in clinical trials for disease-modifying therapies and optimizes early, targeted therapeutic management.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕路易体痴呆早期诊断困难的问题，梳理了分子、影像与神经生理三类生物标志物在疾病前驱期识别及与阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病鉴别中的作用。文章重点分析了脑脊液和外周组织中α-突触核蛋白种子扩增检测在体内的高诊断特异性，并讨论了心肌闪烁显像与多巴胺转运体成像的价值，以及定量脑电图在识别后部背景活动减慢、对应认知波动方面的意义。作者据此提出，从纯临床诊断模式转向生物-临床整合路径，有助于在最早阶段识别疾病，为患者及时进入疾病修饰治疗临床试验和早期针对性管理创造条件。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Community Empowerment: Integrating Islamic Values and Digital Social Innovation
papers.authors: Azlina Bujang, Leviana Andrew, Izyan Farhana Zulkarnain, Sharin Sulaiman
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology with the potential to empower communities by enhancing access to education, healthcare, digital entrepreneurship, public service delivery, and social innovation. However, the development and deployment of AI must be guided by an ethical framework that ensures fairness, transparency, accountability, and societal well-being. In an Islamic context, these principles align with the values of Maqasid al-Shariah, which emphasize the preservation of religion, life, intellect, lineage, and property as the foundation for sustainable human and societal development. Consequently, this paper aims to explore the role of AI in community empowerment through the integration of Islamic values and digital social innovation. The study employs a conceptual approach, grounded in a literature review, to synthesise and analyse literature on AI, digital social innovation, community empowerment, and Islamic ethics. Furthermore, a conceptual framework is proposed to elucidate the relationship between AI, digital social innovation, and Islamic values in supporting inclusive and sustainable community development. The discussion also examines the potential applications of AI in education, healthcare, entrepreneurship, social welfare, and community development, while identifying challenges such as algorithmic bias, the digital divide, data privacy, and AI governance. This paper argues that integrating AI with Maqasid al-Shariah principles and digital social innovation can foster a technological ecosystem that is more ethical, human-centric, and beneficial to society. These conceptual findings are intended to serve as a reference for policymakers, educational institutions, researchers, and community organizations in developing AI solutions that are responsible, inclusive, and aligned with Islamic values.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以概念性文献综述的方式，探讨人工智能如何结合伊斯兰价值观与数字社会创新来赋能社区。作者梳理相关文献后提出一个概念框架，用以说明人工智能、数字社会创新与伊斯兰价值观在支持包容且可持续的社区发展中的关系，并讨论人工智能在教育、医疗、创业、社会福利和社区发展中的应用潜力，同时指出算法偏见、数字鸿沟、数据隐私和人工智能治理等挑战。文章主张，将人工智能与《伊斯兰教法宗旨》（Maqasid al-Shariah）原则及数字社会创新相结合，可促成更具伦理性和以人为本的技术生态；这些概念性结论旨在为政策制定者、教育机构、研究者和社区组织提供参考，而非实证检验的结果。

papers.title: Ecopoiesis y patrimonio: Redefiniendo la sostenibilidad de los espacios culturales
papers.authors: Leonardo Patricio Lavanderos Gallardo, Luis Fernando Valenzuela, Leonardo Patricio Lavanderos Gallardo, Luis Fernando Valenzuela
papers.abstract: This article explores the concept of ecopoiesis as a relational approach to heritage conservation, proposing that cultural spaces should not be regarded as static objects but as living systems shaped by dynamic relationships between community, history, and natural context. Drawing on the concepts of triference and relational surroundings, the article examines how relational sustainability can overcome traditional extractivist and aesthetic approaches, fostering co-creation of meaning and ethical livability. This paradigm highlights the urgent need to regenerate living relationships that position heritage as an active node within cultural and natural networks that sustain life. Ecopoiesis thus emerges as an essential theoretical and practical framework to ensure that heritage remains inclusive, relevant, and sustainable in a shared world.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从关系性视角探讨“生态创生”（ecopoiesis）概念，提出文化遗产空间不应被视为静态对象，而应理解为由社区、历史与自然语境之间动态关系塑造的活态系统。作者借助“三指涉”与“关系性环境”等概念进行理论论证，指出关系性可持续能够超越传统的榨取式与审美式路径，促进意义的共同创造与伦理上的可居性。文章据此强调，遗产应作为维系生命的文化与自然网络中的活跃节点，生态创生由此成为确保遗产在共享世界中保持包容、相关与可持续的理论与实践框架。

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence–Driven Virtual Patients for Communication Skills Training in Medical and Health Professions Education: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Yue Cai, Zheng Jinjin, Han Jiaxin, Shanshan Wei, Guo Gaosong, Chen Fang
papers.abstract: This completed scoping review mapped the available evidence on generative-AI-driven virtual patients for communication-skills training in medical and health professions education. It examined the forms and application contexts of virtual patients, instructional designs, feedback mechanisms, learner outcomes, and evidence gaps. Thirty-six studies were included in the review.
papers.summary_zh: 该范围综述梳理了生成式人工智能驱动的虚拟病人用于医学与健康职业教育沟通技能培训的现有证据，考察了虚拟病人的形态与应用情境、教学设计、反馈机制、学习者结果及证据缺口，共纳入36项研究。综述旨在厘清这一新兴应用的研究现状与空白，而非开展新的实证检验；摘要未报告具体效果结论，相关发现与证据强度有待原文进一步说明。

papers.title: Register Gated Evaluation: The Discursive Construction of Educational AI on Weibo (2023–2025)
papers.authors: Yutong Xia
papers.abstract: Social media are a key site where educational uses of artificial intelligence (AI) are made sense of, and computational studies often read problem-oriented talk about AI as criticism of it. This study asks when naming a problem evaluates the technology. A total of 9,766 verified clause-level units from 1,060 Weibo post clusters (2023–2025) were assigned to five thematic frames and annotated for institutional actors, modality, Appraisal, legitimation and temporal orientation. The 866 problem-naming units were coded by hand for what each problem is attributed to and what is evaluated, with independent double-coding (κ = .73 for both). Mentioning AI was not the same as blaming it: of 526 problem units that named a technology, 43% located the problem elsewhere. Where a problem was located in the technology, AI was evaluated in 24.7% of units, always negatively; where it was located in institutions, people or society, AI was evaluated in 4.0%, almost always as the remedy. Locating a problem in the technology raised the odds of evaluating AI nearly tenfold (OR = 9.69), and this effect did not differ between frames. The frames differed sharply in where they located problems, from 57.3% in technology discourse to 5.1% in higher-education discourse, but once attribution was held constant they no longer differed in how often AI was evaluated. Register thus shapes the evaluation of AI by shaping where problems are placed. Measures of public perception of AI should record what a problem is attributed to, not merely whether it is mentioned.

papers.title: Cognitive Task Substitution, Cognitive Offloading, and Behavioral Dependency on Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Technologies: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Amit Agrawal, Roshan Fakirchand Sutar, Vijender Singh
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and automated decision systems has resulted in a fundamental shift in human-technology interaction. This scoping review aims to map the breadth of empirical evidence and original conceptual models regarding human-artificial intelligence (AI) functional displacement. The objective is to synthesize findings across disparate fields into a unified framework of task substitution, cognitive offloading, and behavioral dependency. This review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidelines. Systematic searches were executed across PubMed, Scopus, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and ScienceDirect. The studies were screened for research addressing thinking substitution (e.g., reasoning, clinical diagnosis, and creative synthesis) over simple digital assistance. A total of 36 studies met the inclusion criteria. Neurophysiological data from functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) indicate that digital saving triggers cognitive offloading, characterized by significantly lower activation in the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). In academic settings, randomized controlled trial data showed that students using ChatGPT scored significantly lower on 45-day retention tests (57.5% correct) compared to traditional learners (68.5% correct, p = 0.002). Professional judgment is increasingly subject to biases; MRI interpretation exhibited substantial self-anchoring bias (score: 6.94), while the automation bias index was high for ECG tasks (0.30). Senior executives receiving AI recommendations acted more actively (M = 5.05) than human-led controls (M = 4.61; p = 0.020), and 89% of educators surveyed reported perceptions of quantifiable skill atrophy. Socially, AI usage and human interaction were moderately and negatively correlated (r = -0.443; p < 0.01), with participants delaying the revelation of intentions in parallel-play settings with digital agents. Task substitution may create a "sovereignty trap" where individuals cede intellectual judgment to automated systems, confusing operational fluency with epistemic mastery. This reliance carries the risk of bypassing the desirable difficulties essential for long-term knowledge retention and the development of professional expertise. As "quiet dependency" becomes an evolving reality of professional and academic life, institutional and design-level interventions must prioritize trust-enabling mechanisms and robust AI literacy to preserve human critical character and professional autonomy.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA-ScR指南系统检索多个数据库，纳入36项研究，梳理了人类将推理、诊断、创作等思维任务交由AI承担后的任务替代、认知卸载与行为依赖证据。综述指出，数字保存会引发认知卸载，使用ChatGPT的学生在延迟保持测验中表现低于传统学习者；专业判断中自锚定偏差与自动化偏差均较明显，高管在获得AI建议后行动更积极，多数教育者报告可感知的技能退化，AI使用与人类互动呈负相关。作者据此提出“主权陷阱”概念，认为任务替代可能让人把操作流畅误当作认知掌握，从而绕过长期知识保持与专业能力发展所需的“合意困难”，并强调需通过信任机制与AI素养干预维护人的批判性与专业自主。

papers.title: Assessment of Compliance With the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence Guidance in the Management of Patients Referred Following a First Suspected Seizure: A Retrospective Clinical Audit
papers.authors: Mohammed T Hazara, Zeenia Merali, Priya Sarasamma, Sinead Blake, Gibran Merali
papers.abstract: IntroductionA first suspected seizure requires timely specialist assessment and appropriate investigation to establish an accurate diagnosis, identify seizure mimics, assess the risk of recurrence, and provide appropriate safety advice.The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidance recommends urgent specialist assessment following a first suspected seizure, alongside appropriate electrocardiography, electroencephalography, neuroimaging, recurrence-risk assessment, and patient safety advice.This audit evaluated adherence to these standards within a first-seizure clinic. Materials and methodsA retrospective clinical audit was undertaken on patients referred to a first-seizure clinic from the Emergency Department and Acute Medicine Unit over a three-month period from January to March 2025.Data were obtained from electronic patient records, clinic correspondence, and discharge documentation.Compliance with predefined standards from NICE guidance was assessed.The primary outcome measures were timely specialist assessment, 12-lead electrocardiography, documentation of individualized seizure recurrence risk, timely electroencephalography where clinically indicated, timely neuroimaging where indicated, and documentation of safety-netting and driving advice. ResultsSixty-three patient records were initially identified.Ten patients did not attend or were lost to follow-up and were excluded from the final clinical analysis, leaving 53 patients.Five of 53 patients (9.4%) received specialist assessment within two weeks.A 12-lead ECG was documented in all 53 patients (100%), and an individualized seizure recurrence risk assessment was documented in all patients (100%).An electroencephalogram (EEG) was indicated in 17 patients, of whom one (5.9%)underwent EEG within 72 hours; 15 (88.2%) underwent EEG after 72 hours, and one patient did not attend.The mean time to EEG among those who eventually underwent the investigation was approximately 12.5 weeks.Neuroimaging was indicated in 41 patients, of whom 22 (53.7%)underwent imaging within six weeks and 19 (46.3%) underwent imaging after six weeks.Safety-netting, including documentation of driving/Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) advice, was documented in all 53 patients (100%). ConclusionThe audit demonstrated high compliance with core assessment and documentation standards but substantial delays in specialist review and time-critical investigations.The greatest gap was in timely EEG access, followed by delays in specialist assessment and neuroimaging.The findings support service-level interventions aimed at improving urgent access to first-seizure assessment and investigations.A repeat audit, following the implementation of targeted interventions, will be important to determine whether pathway changes improve compliance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以某首次疑似癫痫发作门诊转诊患者为对象，通过回顾性临床审计评估其对英国国家卫生与临床优化研究所（NICE）指南的依从情况，重点考察及时专科评估、心电图、脑电图、神经影像、复发风险评估及安全建议等指标。结果显示，心电图、个体化复发风险评估和安全网建议（含驾驶建议）的记录率均较高，但及时专科评估和限时检查存在明显延迟，其中脑电图及时性缺口最大，其次为专科评估和神经影像。作者据此指出，需从服务层面改善首次发作评估与检查的紧急可及性，并建议在针对性干预后重复审计以检验路径改进效果。

papers.title: Strong mnemonic prediction errors increase cognitive control, attention, and arousal
papers.authors: Alice M Xue, Jenna Jokhani, Anthony M. Norcia, Anthony D. Wagner
papers.abstract: Ongoing experience is continuously processed in the context of past events. Divergence between current experience and memory-based predictions (i.e., a mnemonic prediction error; MPE) is theorized to be a signal for the hippocampus that encoding, as opposed to retrieval, should be prioritized. We asked how MPEs place demands on cognitive and neural resources beyond the hippocampus, and whether these demands differ as a function of prediction strength. We investigated these questions across two experiments, wherein we recorded scalp electroencephalography and/or pupillometry as 101 young human adults performed an associative memory task. Strong MPEs, more so than weak MPEs, increased physiological indices of cognitive control (frontal theta), attention (posterior alpha and pupil size), and arousal (pupil size). Trial-level pupil-linked MPE responses scaled with the amount of attention (posterior alpha) allocated during prediction generation. Finally, greater cognitive control (frontal theta) during strong MPEs promoted better learning of prediction violating (i.e., unexpected) stimuli. Collectively, these findings reveal how the mind and brain respond adaptively to violations of strong mnemonic predictions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察记忆预测误差（当前体验与基于记忆的预测之间的偏离）如何调动海马以外的认知与神经资源，以及这种调动是否随预测强度不同而变化。作者通过两项实验，在年轻成人完成联想记忆任务时记录脑电和/或瞳孔数据，发现强预测误差比弱预测误差更明显地提高额叶theta（认知控制）、后部alpha与瞳孔（注意）及瞳孔（唤醒）等生理指标。试次层面的瞳孔相关预测误差反应与预测生成阶段分配的注意量相关，且强预测误差期间的认知控制增强与对违反预测刺激的更好学习相关。这些结果说明心智与大脑会对强记忆预测的违背作出适应性反应。

papers.title: Business Model Innovation and Sustainable Small and Medium Enterprises Performance in Developing Economies: A Systematic Review
papers.authors: Oluwakemi Onayemi, Adebola Amoo, Chinyere Adeniji, Adesanya Oluwatoyin, Rose Michael
papers.journal: Abuja Journal of Business and Management
papers.abstract: The pursuit of sustainable performance among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) has become increasingly important in developing economies that face persistent institutional constraints, yet existing evidence on the relationship between business model innovation (BMI) and sustainable performance remains fragmented and inconsistent. Drawing on Dynamic Capabilities Theory and Stakeholder Theory, this study synthesises the empirical literature to clarify how, and under what conditions, BMI contributes to the sustainable performance of SMEs. Adopting the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) framework, peer-reviewed articles published between 2014 and 2026 were identified from Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, yielding 37 empirical studies for thematic synthesis. The synthesis identified five dominant themes: BMI as a driver of sustainable performance; sustainable performance as a multidimensional construct; the mediating role of green and eco-innovation; digital transformation as a facilitator of BMI; and the transition toward integrated, sustainability-focused business models. Digital transformation and green innovation emerged as key mediating mechanisms, while access to finance, institutional support, and technological capability operated as significant contextual moderators. The findings indicate that BMI enhances financial, environmental, and social performance by reconfiguring value creation, delivery, and capture, but that this relationship is context-dependent and contingent on the alignment between internal dynamic capabilities and external stakeholder expectations. Because the reviewed evidence is geographically concentrated in Nigeria, generalisability remains limited. The review contributes an integrated, theory-grounded synthesis that maps context-specific pathways for sustainable BMI adoption, with practical implications for managers and policymakers in developing economies.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述关注发展中经济体的中小企业如何通过商业模式创新实现可持续绩效，基于动态能力理论与利益相关者理论，按PRISMA框架系统梳理了相关实证文献。综合结果显示，商业模式创新通过重构价值创造、传递与获取来改善财务、环境和社会绩效，绿色与生态创新的中介作用以及数字化转型的促进作用较为突出，融资可得性、制度支持和技术能力则构成重要的情境调节条件。作者强调这一关系依赖情境，取决于内部动态能力与外部利益相关者期望的匹配，且所综述证据在地理上集中于尼日利亚，结论的普适性有限。

papers.title: LEVERAGING MENTORSHIP TO FACILITATE AI-DRIVEN PRECISION AGRICULTURE AMONG AGRI-SMES IN BAMENDA, NORTH-WEST, CAMEROON
papers.authors: Dr. Eyong Ako
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the role of mentorship in facilitating the adoption of AI-driven precision agriculture among agri-SMEs in Bamenda, Cameroon. Primary data was collected through a structured questionnaire administered to 212 randomly selected agripreneurs. A quantitative research design was adopted, and hypotheses were tested using multiple regression analysis with Ordinary Least Squares estimation. The findings reveal that mentorship programs have a positive and statistically significant influence on the adoption of AI-driven precision agriculture (β = 0.387, p < 0.01), while structured coaching plans exhibit a positive but insignificant influence (β = 0.134, p = 0.081). The study concludes that mentorship serves as a critical catalyst for facilitating AI-driven precision agriculture adoption among agri-SMEs. The study recommends that agricultural organizations invest in structured mentorship programs integrating AI literacy and ensure coaching plans incorporate practical AI application training.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察导师指导在喀麦隆巴门达农业中小企业采用人工智能驱动精准农业过程中的作用，以问卷收集的农业创业者数据为基础，采用定量设计与多元回归分析检验相关假设。结果显示，导师计划对精准农业采用具有正向且统计显著的影响，而结构化辅导计划的影响为正但不显著。作者据此认为导师指导是推动此类技术采用的关键促进因素，并建议农业组织投入融合人工智能素养的结构化导师项目，同时让辅导计划纳入实际的人工智能应用培训。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Assets and Training Data under IFRS: Challenges and Application Prospects in Iraq
papers.authors: Sadiq Hadi Mohi Al-Mansouri, Farqad Mohammed Bakr, Ahmed Najah Hadi
papers.abstract: This research aims to address the accounting gap arising from the inadequacy of IFRS, particularly IAS 38, to accommodate the nature of artificial intelligence assets and training data, within the context of emerging economies with a specific application in Iraq. The study adopts a mixed-methods approach (quantitative and qualitative), including a survey of 178 accounting and auditing professionals, academics, and technical experts in Iraq, as well as a case study on the Bank of Baghdad. Results reveal a clear methodological gap in IAS 38 (mean perception 4.04/5), high practical challenges (4.29/5) – most notably the difficulty of distinguishing between research and development phases and allocating cloud costs. The proposed solutions (functional control, composite digital assets, hybrid measurement) received broad acceptance (4.31/5). The Bank of Baghdad case study confirms that applying the proposed model adds intangible assets worth IQD 3.67 billion and increases net income by approximately 3%, compared to the current treatment of writing off all costs. Main conclusions: a conceptual gap in current standards, an urgent need for an independent standard for digital assets or enhanced expanded disclosure as a transitional phase, and the current lack of readiness of the Iraq Stock Exchange. Recommendations: the Central Bank of Iraq and the Iraq Securities Commission should issue temporary local guidance, invest in specialized training programs, and conduct further large-sample studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注国际财务报告准则（尤其是IAS 38）难以适配人工智能资产与训练数据所导致的会计缺口，以伊拉克为新兴经济体背景，采用混合方法，结合对伊拉克会计、审计及技术专家的问卷调查与巴格达银行的案例研究。结果显示，受访者普遍认为现行准则存在明显方法缺口，实务挑战突出，尤其难以区分研究与开发阶段以及分摊云成本；所提出的功能控制、复合数字资产与混合计量等方案获得较广泛接受。案例研究进一步表明，采用所提模型相较现行将成本全部费用化的处理，可增加无形资产并提高净利润。作者据此指出当前准则存在概念缺口，建议先以临时本地指引和扩展披露过渡，并认为伊拉克证券交易所尚不具备相应准备。

papers.title: Beyond AI Adoption: Aligning the National Curriculum Framework 2021 and Outcome-Based Education with AI-Enhanced Higher Education in Bangladesh
papers.authors: Najmul Kadir Kaikobad, Kanwaljit Kaur
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping teaching, learning, and assessment in higher education. However, its educational value depends not simply on the availability of AI tools but on how effectively they support intended learning outcomes and responsible academic practices. This paper proposes a context-sensitive conceptual framework for integrating AI into Bangladeshi higher education by drawing on university-level Outcome-Based Education (OBE) and selected competency-oriented principles from the National Curriculum Framework (NCF) 2021. Through a targeted integrative review of academic literature and relevant policy documents, the study brings together institutional conditions, responsible AI governance, curriculum alignment, intended educational outcomes, and feedback for continuous improvement. The analysis draws on established educational perspectives, including constructive alignment, the Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) framework, UNESCO's AI competency frameworks, and recent research on generative AI integration. Rather than presenting an entirely new or empirically validated model, the paper offers a conceptual synthesis tailored to the educational and institutional context of Bangladesh. Although the framework provides a basis for examining responsible and outcome-aligned AI integration, its distinctiveness requires further comparison with existing models, and its proposed relationships need empirical evaluation across universities and academic disciplines in Bangladesh.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对孟加拉国高等教育中人工智能整合的问题，提出一个结合成果导向教育与2021年国家课程框架部分能力原则的情境化概念框架。作者通过有针对性的整合性文献与政策文件综述，将院校条件、负责任的人工智能治理、课程对齐、预期学习成果和持续改进反馈联系起来，并借助建构性对齐、TPACK、联合国教科文组织人工智能能力框架及生成式人工智能整合研究等视角加以支撑。文章明确这是概念综合而非经实证验证的新模型，其独特性仍需与现有模型比较，所提出的关系也需在孟加拉国多所大学和学科中接受实证检验。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Pakistani Higher Education: Evaluating HEC Policy, Educational Practices, Student Skills, and a Strategic Framework for AI Integration
papers.authors: Haleema Parveen, Iram Shahzadi, Abdül Waheed, Sumaira Riaz, Abid Hussain, Dr. Munir Ahmad
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming higher education globally, creating opportunities to enhance teaching, learning, research, and institutional governance. However, its effective integration requires coherent policies, pedagogical readiness, digital competencies, and context-sensitive implementation strategies. This study examines the integration of AI in Pakistani higher education, focusing on Higher Education Commission (HEC) policies, educational practices, students’ AI-related skills, and the development of a strategic framework for sustainable adoption. It investigates the alignment between national policy directions and institutional practices, explores students’ competencies and perceptions regarding AI-enabled learning, and identifies the institutional, technological, ethical, and pedagogical factors influencing implementation. Adopting a systematic research approach, the study seeks to generate evidence-based insights into the opportunities and challenges associated with AI integration across Pakistan’s higher education institutions. Particular attention is given to digital inequality, academic integrity, data privacy, faculty preparedness, and equitable access to AI technologies. The anticipated outcome is a contextually grounded strategic framework that connects policy, institutional capacity, curriculum development, faculty training, and student competency enhancement. By bridging the gap between policy aspirations and educational practice, this research aims to contribute to informed policymaking and responsible AI adoption in Pakistani universities. Ultimately, it seeks to support an inclusive, ethical, and sustainable higher education ecosystem aligned with emerging technological demands and national educational priorities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察巴基斯坦高等教育中人工智能整合的政策与实践问题，聚焦高等教育委员会（HEC）政策、教学实践、学生AI相关技能，并试图构建可持续采用的战略框架。研究采用系统性研究方法，关注国家政策方向与院校实践之间的衔接、学生对AI赋能学习的认知与能力，以及制度、技术、伦理和教学层面的影响因素，并特别提及数字不平等、学术诚信、数据隐私、教师准备和公平获取等问题。摘要显示预期成果是一个连接政策、院校能力、课程开发、教师培训和学生能力提升的情境化战略框架，但未报告具体实证结果，因此其实际发现与框架有效性尚不明确。

papers.title: РАЗРАБОТКА ГЕНЕРАТИВНОГО ПОМОЩНИКА НА ОСНОВЕ GPT-3 ДЛЯ АВТОМАТИЗАЦИИ ВЗАИМОДЕЙСТВИЯ СТУДЕНТОВ С ДЕКАНАТОМ
papers.authors: S. A. Krekina, M. N. Ryzhkova
papers.abstract: The article is devoted to the development and testing of an intelligent generative assistant (chatbot) based on the GPT-3 language model, designed to automate the processing of student requests in the dean's office of the Murom Institute (branch) of Vladimir State University. The relevance of the work is due to the high workload on the administrative staff of universities and the need for digital transformation of the educational environment. In the course of the study, an analysis of the subject area and existing analogues of chatbots in Russian universities was carried out, which revealed their templated and limited nature. To overcome these shortcomings, an approach based on fine-tuning the GPT-3.5-turbo model on a specialized dataset formed through an anonymous survey of students (137 question-answer pairs), the answers to which were prepared by dean's office staff, is proposed. The architecture of the system is described, including a Flask backend, a web interface in the form of a single-page application, and integration with the OpenAI API. To assess the quality of the program, a set of metrics was used: Perplexity (7.9), METEOR (0.71), BERTScore (0.92), precision (0.93), recall (0.991), F1-score (0.92), chrF++ (79.4), TER (0.21), Distinct-1 (0.84), and Self-BLEU (12.4). The obtained values indicate high semantic accuracy, lexical diversity, and minimal need for post-processing of respons-es. The chatbot successfully handles about 90% of typical requests, responds correctly to irrelevant questions, and maintains an official business style of communication. Limitations have been identified: effectiveness depends on the completeness of the dataset, and complex or non-obvious formulations may require clarification. Further development of the system involves expanding the knowledge base, introducing a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mechanism, integration with messengers, and creating an administrator panel. The results confirm the prospects of generative AI assistants for improving information accessibility and reducing the workload of staff in educational institutions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发并测试了一个基于GPT-3.5-turbo微调的生成式聊天机器人，用于自动处理穆罗姆学院教务处的学生咨询，以缓解行政人员的工作负担。系统采用Flask后端、单页网页界面并接入OpenAI API，训练数据来自学生匿名问卷收集的问答对。评估结果显示，该机器人在语义准确性、词汇多样性和减少后处理需求方面表现良好，能处理约九成常见请求，对无关问题也能正确回应并保持正式商务语气；但效果受数据集完整性限制，复杂或表述不清的问题仍需进一步澄清。作者认为生成式AI助手在提升信息可及性和减轻教务人员负担方面具有前景，后续可扩展知识库并引入检索增强生成机制。

papers.title: Parental Health Information Needs, Child-Health Literacy, and Use of Generative AI Among Parents of Children Aged 0 to 4 Years in France: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.authors: Kenza Gavaland, Nicolas Barascud, Anna‐Karin Edstedt Bonamy, Pauline Martinot
papers.abstract: Background: The first thousand days are a sensitive window for child health and social health inequalities. When routine care falls short, parents of young children turn to online sources and, recently, to generative artificial intelligence (AI). Evidence on their concerns, child-health literacy, and AI use is scarce. Objective: To describe health informational needs and concerns, child-health literacy, and use of AI for child-health questions, including differences by parental role and parity, among parents of young children. Methods: In this cross-sectional study, two anonymous self-administered online questionnaires were disseminated through a digital health application between May 12 and June 11, 2026, to French-speaking parents of at least one child aged 0 to 47 months in France. Questionnaire 1 covered unmet information needs, concerns across 16 topics, perceived intra-couple concordance, and confidence in routine care. Questionnaire 2 covered a four-item child-health literacy quiz and AI use (frequency, topics, 12-month trend, barriers, trust conditions, perceived effect on consultations, and disclosure). Results: In total, 12,634 parents responded (Questionnaire 1, n=5,410; Questionnaire 2, n=7,224), mostly mothers (94.6% and 92.9%). Most (61.8%) had searched for information without finding a clear, reliable answer, selecting a median of 4 (Interquartile range [IQR] 3-7) over 16 topics. Leading concerns were sleep (51.3%), nutrition (48.1%), and education (i.e., upbringing and behavior) (47.8%). Mothers were nearly twice as likely as fathers to select accident prevention (26.5% vs 16.3%) and parental mental health (38.7% vs 28.6%); first-time parents selected most topics more often than experienced parents, most markedly dental hygiene (43.8% vs 27.6%). The median child-health literacy score was 3 (IQR 3-4) on a 0-to-4 quiz, with 19.9% of parents scoring 2 or below; tooth-brushing age was the weakest item (68.4% correct). Mothers outscored fathers on every item. More than half of parents (54.2%) had used AI for a child-health question, 11.2% weekly; among those reporting a trend, 68.3% had increased AI use for child-health questions over the year and 6.2% decreased it. The main barriers to AI use were a preference for professionals (55.9%) and reliability concerns (48.7%); trust depended most on medical oversight of the tool (76.6%). AI use appeared additive, with 66.8% reporting no change in healthcare visit frequency. One third (35.5%) had told an AI something shared with neither a professional nor their network, rising to 64.1% among regular users. Conclusions: Parental informational needs were widespread and frequently unmet. AI has become a common and fast-rising source for child-health questions, at times a confidential one, used alongside rather than instead of professionals. Child-health literacy was generally high but uneven, with oral health the clearest gap. Strengths include the sample size and early-generative-AI timing; limitations include the cross-sectional design, self-report, digital-recruitment selection bias, and the small proportion of fathers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注法国0至4岁儿童父母在儿童健康信息方面的需求、儿童健康素养及生成式AI使用情况，通过两份匿名在线问卷对法语父母开展横断面调查。结果显示，父母的信息需求广泛且常未得到满足，睡眠、营养和教育是主要关切；儿童健康素养总体较高但不均衡，口腔健康是明显短板。超过半数父母曾就儿童健康问题使用AI，且使用呈上升趋势，但主要用于补充而非替代专业医疗，信任主要取决于工具是否接受医学监督。研究提示AI已成为年轻父母获取儿童健康信息的常见渠道，但受横断面设计、自我报告和数字招募选择偏倚等限制。

papers.title: Performance of Contemporary Large Language Models on the National Prosthodontic Resident Examination: A Multi-Year Comparative Study
papers.authors: Yo‐Wei Chen, Vathanai Bhunyanaphakul, Pitchaporn Kosago, Matthew Finkelman, Damian J. Lee
papers.abstract: Purpose: To compare the performance of three large language models (LLMs), ChatGPT-o1, Grok 3, and Gemini 2.0 Pro, on the American College of Prosthodontists' National Prosthodontic Resident Examination (NPRE). Materials and Methods: Official NPRE examinations from years 2015-2024 were retrieved from the American College of Prosthodontists website and used to prompt each LLM. Paid access tiers and advanced reasoning were enabled. Responses from LLMs were recorded and compared against the official answer keys for accuracy, variability across years, and consistency of responses. Duplicate questions were retained for the primary analysis and removed in a sensitivity analysis. Accuracy (percent correct) was compared using generalized estimating equations binary logistic regression (primary); Cochran's Q with Bonferroni-adjusted McNemar tests (sensitivity). Year-to-year variability (SD of annual accuracy) was compared using weighted Levene tests. Consistency across duplicate items was quantified as the percentage of perfect matches and compared using Cochran's Q with Bonferroni-adjusted McNemar tests. Results: Across 1,487 questions, overall accuracy differed among models (global P < 0.001). ChatGPT-o1 achieved 78.4% correct, Grok 3 76.4%, and Gemini 2.0 Pro 73.2%; ChatGPT-o1 and Grok 3's accuracy significantly exceeded Gemini 2.0 Pro (both P ≤ 0.016), with no significant difference between ChatGPT-o1 and Grok 3 (P = 0.099). After removing duplicates (n = 1,200), results were similar: ChatGPT-o1, Grok 3, and Gemini 2.0 Pro were 77.1%, 76.6%, and 71.5% correct, respectively; ChatGPT-o1 and Grok 3's accuracy was significantly higher than Gemini 2.0 Pro (both P < 0.001). Variability across years did not differ significantly (P ≥ 0.097). Grok 3 showed significantly higher perfect-match consistency (79.2%) than ChatGPT-o1 (69.4%) and Gemini 2.0 Pro (64.5%) (P ≤ 0.010). Conclusions: Contemporary LLMs showed 70-80% accuracy on postgraduate prosthodontic multiple-choice content. While promising for educational support, residual error and inconsistency warrant human oversight and transparent methods reporting before curricular adoption.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了ChatGPT-o1、Grok 3和Gemini 2.0 Pro三款大语言模型在2015至2024年美国修复齿科住院医师全国考试题目上的答题表现，以官方答案为准评估准确率、年度波动和重复题作答一致性。结果显示，三款模型总体准确率存在差异，ChatGPT-o1与Grok 3均显著高于Gemini 2.0 Pro，而前两者之间无显著差异；剔除重复题后结论基本一致，年度间波动也无显著差别。Grok 3在重复题上给出完全一致答案的比例显著高于另外两款模型。作者据此认为，当代大语言模型对修复齿科研究生选择题内容可达到约七至八成准确率，对教育辅助有潜力，但残留错误和作答不一致意味着在正式纳入课程前仍需人工监督并透明报告使用方法。

papers.title: Sensorimotor cortex activity during cued gait differs in Parkinson's freezers and non-freezers
papers.authors: Lei Ma, Mai Miura, Ipek Talu, Katy A. Cross
papers.abstract: Gait impairments are a major contributor to disability in patients with Parkinson's disease despite dopaminergic and neuromodulation therapies. External cues (e.g., visual targets, rhythmic auditory sounds) are commonly used to improve gait quality and reduce freezing of gait (FOG), yet their effectiveness varies across patients and contexts. Improved understanding of the neural mechanisms of cueing benefits is essential to personalize rehabilitation strategies and improve outcomes. We use mobile electroencephalography (EEG) to test the hypothesis that cues improve gait through engagement of voluntary motor control mechanisms to compensate for impaired gait automaticity. In addition, we investigate whether this mechanism is related to cueing benefits or freezing status. Eighteen PD patients with a history of freezing (PD-F), 21 patients without freezing (PD-NF) and 19 age-matched healthy controls (HC) walked overground under three conditions: normal walking, synchronizing to auditory cues, and stepping over visual cues. Stride-locked beta band (13-30 Hz) power dynamics in sensorimotor cortex were used to measure cortical control of stepping. Spatiotemporal gait parameters improved with cues in all groups. However, PD-F had smaller cue-related gains in speed and stride length when compared with PD-NF for both cue types, and did not improve gait speed with visual cues. EEG revealed greater contralateral sensorimotor cortex swing-phase beta suppression in PD-F than PD-NF patients, with visual cues eliciting the most robust response. In contrast, beta suppression with cues was less pronounced in PD-NF and HC, despite greater behavioral gains. In addition, engagement of sensorimotor cortex during visual cueing was associated with divergent gait effects across PD subgroups: In PD-NF greater beta suppression was associated with less gait improvement, whereas in PD-F the opposite was observed. These findings suggest distinct sensorimotor control mechanisms for cue utilization in PD-F and PD-NF, and indicate that engagement of voluntary motor control circuits may underlie cueing benefits primarily in PD-F.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用移动脑电考察帕金森病患者在有声或视觉提示下行走时感觉运动皮层的β频段活动，比较有冻结史、无冻结史患者与健康对照的差异。行为上各组步态均随提示改善，但有冻结史者的速度与步长增益较小，视觉提示下速度未见提升。脑电显示有冻结史者摆动期对侧感觉运动皮层β抑制更强，视觉提示时最明显；而无冻结史者和健康对照的β抑制较弱却获益更大。视觉提示下的β抑制与步态变化的关系在两个患者亚组中方向相反，提示两类患者利用提示的感觉运动控制机制不同，主动运动控制环路的参与可能主要解释有冻结史者的提示获益。

papers.title: Feature harmonization reveals that apparent cross-cohort differences in tau-positivity prediction reflect variable availability and cohort stage structure
papers.authors: A. Bhat, Mattia Cestari, Chin‐Tu Chen, B. T. Fleming, George Fleming, for the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
papers.abstract: Background: Cross-cohort machine-learning studies of tau positivity are increasingly used to assess generalizability of Alzheimer's disease biomarker models, but apparent differences between cohorts may reflect clinical severity structure and cohort stage composition rather than genuine biological divergence. Methods: We evaluated this problem across subject-level cohorts from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS3), and the National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC) using harmonized tabular predictors and a feature-block ablation framework. For ADNI and OASIS3, we performed matched-feature analyses restricted to shared harmonized variables (age, APOE e4, education, sex, the CDR(R) Dementia Staging Instrument sum-of-boxes score (CDR-SB), and the Functional Activities Questionnaire (FAQ)). Models were trained with five-fold stratified cross-validation using balanced logistic regression as the primary classifier. Random forests and extra-trees classifiers were evaluated as robustness checks and are reported in supplementary analyses. Results: In the primary matched-feature comparison, reference areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) were 0.851 for ADNI tau90, 0.860 for ADNI tau180, and 0.933 for OASIS3 tau180. Severity-only models retained 86-99% of reference performance, whereas demographic/genetic-only models retained 85-87%; bootstrap confidence intervals showed that the reference-minus-demo contrast remained positive across all primary cohorts. Before feature matching, OASIS3 showed substantially weaker demographic-only prediction (AUC approx. 0.54), attributable to missing APOE and age variables. After harmonization with a matched feature set including age, the pre-harmonization demographic gap was no longer attributable to feature availability; the residual difference was most consistent with cohort disease-stage composition asymmetry, with CDR-SB = 0 prevalence of 84.5-88.7% in OASIS3 versus 49.3-51.7% in ADNI. Conclusions: The original large ADNI-OASIS3 performance gap was largely a feature-availability artifact; after strict harmonization including age-field repair, the absolute gap narrowed and the signed ADNI-minus-OASIS3 difference reversed, with the residual difference most consistent with cohort disease-stage composition asymmetry. Clinical severity remains an important predictor across all cohorts, but the unique contributions of severity and demographic/genetic information depend strongly on stage composition. Cross-cohort biomarker modeling should account for both feature-set completeness and disease-stage composition heterogeneity, not only headline performance metrics.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察跨队列的tau阳性预测模型差异究竟反映生物学差异还是队列特征结构差异，利用ADNI、OASIS3和NACC的受试者数据，采用统一化表格预测变量与特征块消融框架进行比较。在匹配特征后，ADNI与OASIS3的参考AUC差距明显缩小，原先OASIS3人口学变量预测偏弱主要源于APOE和年龄字段缺失；匹配后残余差异更符合两队列疾病阶段构成不同，OASIS3中CDR-SB为零者比例远高于ADNI。作者据此指出，跨队列生物标志物建模需同时考虑特征集完整性和疾病阶段构成异质性，而不能只看总体性能指标。

papers.title: Influence of ChatGPT usage on administrative task efficiency in tertiary educational institutions in Kaduna State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Surajo Ahmad Magaji, Abdulhakam Hamza Kwangila, Ahmed Isah
papers.journal: Aminu Kano Academic Scholars Association Multidisciplinary Journal
papers.abstract: This study examined the influence of ChatGPT usage on administrative task efficiency in tertiary educational institutions in Kaduna State, Nigeria. Guided by two objectives, two research questions, and two null hypotheses, the study adopted a descriptive survey research design. The population of the study comprised 11,379 Administrative Officers, Registry Staff, Departmental Secretaries, and Planning and Statistics Officers across tertiary institutions in Kaduna State. A sample of 357 respondents was selected for the study. Data were collected using a researcher-designed instrument titled Influence of ChatGPT Usage on Administrative Task Efficiency Scale (ICUATES), structured on a five-point Likert scale. The instrument was validated by experts in Measurement and Evaluation and Educational Foundations and Curriculum at Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. Descriptive statistics (mean and standard deviation) were used to answer the research questions, while Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) was used to test the hypotheses at a 0.05 level of significance. The findings revealed that ChatGPT usage significantly improves the speed and timeliness of administrative task completion by assisting staff in drafting reports, preparing correspondence, summarizing documents, and organizing institutional information more efficiently. The results also indicated that ChatGPT enhances the quality and accuracy of administrative documentation by producing well-structured reports, reducing grammatical and typographical errors, and improving the clarity and professionalism of official records. The ANOVA results showed no significant differences in the opinions of respondents regarding the influence of ChatGPT on the speed and timeliness of administrative tasks (p = 0.244) and on the quality and accuracy of administrative documentation (p = 0.392). The study concludes that ChatGPT is a valuable technological tool for improving administrative productivity and documentation standards in tertiary institutions. It therefore recommends that tertiary institutions provide training and institutional support to promote the effective integration of ChatGPT into administrative processes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察尼日利亚卡杜纳州高等院校中 ChatGPT 使用对行政任务效率的影响，采用描述性调查研究设计，以行政人员为对象，通过问卷收集数据并用方差分析检验差异。结果显示，ChatGPT 有助于加快行政任务的完成速度与及时性，并提升行政文档的质量与准确性，如生成结构良好的报告、减少语法和拼写错误、增强记录的清晰度与专业性；不同受访群体对这两方面影响的看法无显著差异。研究据此认为 ChatGPT 是提升行政生产力与文档标准的有用工具，并建议院校提供培训与制度支持以促进其有效整合。

papers.title: The Digital Heir: How Next-Generation Successors Experience AI- and FinTech-Enabled Succession in Family Firms
papers.authors: Ibrahim Afaq, Abdullah Naveed
papers.journal: Journal of Business Insight and Innovation
papers.abstract: This study examines how next-generation successors experience AI and FinTech-enabled succession in Pakistani family firms. The study is grounded in Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis, with eight semi-structured interviews conducted with second- and third-generation successors across various sectors. The finding reveals three different developmental patterns: evidence-based legitimisation, governance-based integration, and relationally contested recognition. Transitions became more credible because of small digital pilots, measurable results and trusted digital intermediaries, and more successful when digital initiatives were part of formal governance, decision rights were documented, and there was shared accountability. When succession was unclear, digitalisation further exacerbated the intrusion of the incumbent, family dynamics, and the precarious legitimacy of the ruling elites. The study shows that AI and FinTech are not merely operational tools but mechanisms through which authority, trust, continuity, and leadership identity are negotiated. The study contributes to the family business literature by introducing the concept of authority-gated capability development and by showing how socioeconomic wealth can be limiting and facilitating the process of digital transformation in intergenerational succession. These insights guide management of digitally enabled leadership transitions. Article Classification: M10, M12, M14. References Abaddi, S. (2025).
