In P. Aaltonen & E. Kurvinen (Eds.), Contemporary issues in Industry 5.0: Towards an AI integrated society (pp. 221–262). Springer Nature Switzerland. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-74779-3_9
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察巴基斯坦家族企业下一代继承者如何体验AI与金融科技赋能的代际传承，采用解释性现象学分析，对第二代和第三代继承者进行半结构化访谈。研究发现三种发展模式：基于证据的合法化、基于治理的整合，以及关系上受争议的认可；小型数字试点、可衡量结果与可信数字中介使交接更可信，而数字举措纳入正式治理、记录决策权并共担责任时传承更顺利。当传承安排不清晰时，数字化反而加剧在任者介入、家族动态与继承者合法性的脆弱性。作者据此提出“权威门槛下的能力发展”概念，说明AI与金融科技不只是运营工具，更是协商权威、信任、延续性与领导身份的机制。

papers.title: Innovating Criminal Justice Education: A Behavioral Criminology Master's Program for the Next Generation of Law Enforcement
papers.authors: Robert Ambrosini, Frank Hartle
papers.abstract: This paper proposes an innovative Master of Science degree program in Behavioral Criminology that addresses critical gaps in criminal justice education. The curriculum integrates physiological detection of deception, advanced investigative psychology, and emerging digital threats into a comprehensive educational framework. With growing demands for specialized training in human trafficking, threat assessment, victim advocacy, and cybercrime investigation—including understanding AI-facilitated crimes, online radicalization phenomena, and extremist networks—this program represents a paradigm shift in preparing criminal justice professionals for contemporary challenges. This paper examines the pedagogical rationale, the curriculum design, the results of a student survey, and educational innovation underlying this interdisciplinary program.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一项行为犯罪学理学硕士项目，旨在填补刑事司法教育中的关键空白，回应执法专业人员在人口贩运、威胁评估、受害者权益倡导及网络犯罪调查等方面日益增长的专门训练需求。课程设计将生理测谎、高级调查心理学与新兴数字威胁整合为跨学科框架，并涉及对AI辅助犯罪、网络激进化与极端主义网络的理解。文章还报告了一项学生调查的结果，用以说明该项目的教学设计依据与教育创新之处；整体属于项目方案论述而非对照实验，其成效判断主要基于课程论证与学生反馈。

papers.title: Personal Data Protection in the Artificial Intelligence Era: A Comparative Legal Analysis of Tanzania and China
papers.authors: Hosea Joseph Mwambungu
papers.journal: International Journal of Law Management & Humanities
papers.abstract: The proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI) across banking, education, and public administration has intensified the collection and processing of personal data, raising concerns over algorithmic opacity, automated decision-making, and cross-border data flows. This article examines the adequacy of Tanzania’s legal framework for protecting personal data in the AI environment by comparing it with the more developed regulatory architecture of the People’s Republic of China. Adopting a doctrinal, comparative methodology, the article analyses primary legal instruments, including Tanzania’s Personal Data Protection Act 2022 and China’s Personal Information Protection Law 2021, against a composite theoretical framework combining the human rights-based theory, the risk-based regulatory theory, and Westin’s theory of informational control. The analysis finds that although both jurisdictions share a common statutory ancestry in internationally recognized fair information principles, they diverge sharply in the extent to which domestic law addresses AI-specific risk. China’s centralized, binding framework, anchored by a direct statutory provision on automated decision-making and dedicated generative-AI instruments, contrasts with Tanzania’s fragmented, largely non-binding, sector-confined approach realized through the Bank of Tanzania’s Fintech Regulatory Sandbox and the Ministry of Education’s Guidelines for Artificial Intelligence in Education. The article argues that Tanzania’s reform path lies not in transplanting Chinese regulatory techniques wholesale, given their embeddedness in a security-oriented state paradigm, but in selectively adapting specific mechanisms, including a stronger statutory right to contest automated decisions and binding regulation of generative AI, within its own rights-based constitutional order.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以坦桑尼亚《2022年个人数据保护法》与中国《2021年个人信息保护法》等法律文本为对象，采用法条比较分析，考察两国在人工智能环境下个人数据保护框架的充分性。分析发现，两国法律虽同源于国际公认的公平信息原则，但在应对AI特有风险上差异明显：中国以集中、有约束力的规范直接规定自动化决策并专门规制生成式AI，坦桑尼亚则呈碎片化、多为非约束性且局限于金融沙盒和教育指南等部门性安排。作者据此认为，坦桑尼亚的改革不宜整体移植中国监管技术，而应在本国权利本位宪制秩序内选择性借鉴，如强化对自动化决策提出异议的法定权利和对生成式AI的有约束力监管。

papers.title: Deepfakes and AI-Generated Evidence in Indian Criminal Trials
papers.authors: Mirza Dawood Ullah Baig
papers.journal: International Journal of Law Management & Humanities
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has transformed the creation, manipulation and interpretation of digital information. Deepfakes and other forms of AI-generated content can reproduce human faces, voices, movements and conversations with a degree of realism that makes ordinary visual or auditory inspection unreliable. These developments raise important questions for criminal justice, particularly where video recordings, audio clips, photographs, social-media content and digitally generated material are relied upon to establish criminal liability. In India, the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (BSA), provides the principal statutory framework governing electronic and digital records, but compliance with the rules of admissibility does not necessarily establish the factual truth of the content presented. This paper critically examines the challenges posed by deepfakes and AI-generated evidence in Indian criminal trials. It analyses the distinction between admissibility, authenticity, attribution and evidentiary weight, with particular attention to Sections 39 and 61–63 of the BSA, the Information Technology Act, 2000, and the constitutional guarantees of equality, personal liberty and fair trial. It also considers the continuing relevance of judicial decisions concerning electronic evidence under the former Indian Evidence Act, 1872. The research adopts a doctrinal and analytical methodology based on statutory provisions, judicial precedents and relevant legal scholarship. It argues that electronic-record certification, hash values and conventional chain-of-custody procedures are important safeguards but cannot independently establish that a recording depicts a genuine event or identifies the correct person. The paper recommends risk-sensitive forensic examination, transparent disclosure of relevant technical findings, effective opportunities for cross-examination, and judicial caution against treating digital recordings as inherently reliable. A balanced framework should protect the integrity of criminal proceedings without allowing unsubstantiated allegations of AI manipulation to undermine genuine evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以印度刑事诉讼为背景，采用法条分析与判例梳理的方法，考察深度伪造和AI生成内容对电子证据认定的挑战。作者区分可采性、真实性、归属与证明力，指出依《Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023》完成的电子记录认证、哈希值与保管链虽属重要保障，却不足以单独证明录音录像所呈现的事件真实发生或人物身份无误。文章据此主张对高风险材料进行取证检验、公开披露相关技术结论、保障有效交叉询问，并提醒司法者不宜将数字录音视为天然可靠，同时避免无根据的AI操纵指控削弱真实证据。

papers.title: Students’ strategies for revising AI-assisted writing: towards a conceptual framework
papers.authors: Yog Raj Lamichhane
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) becomes integrated into academic writing, understanding how second language (L2) English students revise AI-assisted writing remains underexplored; therefore, this inductive content analysis explores students’ revision strategies for academic writing to propose a conceptual framework . The study employs an open-ended free listing task with 100 students, who listed their five major strategies for revising AI-assisted writing assignments. Additionally, semi-structured interviews were conducted with 10 students experienced in revising AI-assisted writing. The interview transcripts were open-coded to develop categories. Meanwhile, the free-listing responses were directly categorized because participants listed strategies as explicit codes. The researcher then compared, consolidated, and synthesized the strategy categories into broader themes to form a conceptual framework. The analysis found key revision strategies like incorporating personal ideas and expressions, simplifying the language, consulting additional sources, paraphrasing and rewriting content, integrating personal experience, contextualizing AI content, and cross-checking AI information. It suggested that L2 English students primarily personalize and improve AI-assisted writing rather than passively accepting AI-generated text, while also adapting, evaluating, and responsibly managing AI-generated content. This final synthesis yielded six overarching themes: supportive utilization, ethical engagement, creative reform, critical evaluation, contextual revision, and functional adjustment. The proposed framework with six themes serves as an empirically grounded taxonomy of student revision strategies in AI-assisted writing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注二语英语学生如何修改AI辅助写作，通过开放式自由列举任务与半结构化访谈收集资料，并以归纳内容分析提炼策略类别。分析发现，学生的主要修改策略包括融入个人想法与表达、简化语言、查阅额外资料、改写重写、结合个人经验、为AI内容补充语境以及交叉核对AI信息。作者据此提出包含支持性利用、伦理参与、创造性改造、批判性评估、语境化修改和功能性调整六个主题的概念框架，表明学生更多是在个性化与改进AI生成文本，而非被动接受，同时也在适应、评估和负责任地管理AI内容。该框架为理解AI辅助写作中的学生修改策略提供了基于实证的分类。

papers.title: Explaining the Details Enhances Human Perceptions of the Persuasiveness of GAI Misinformation Corrections
papers.authors: Min Zhang, zhou zuojie, Sihong Li, Xiqing Han, Huanqi Qian
papers.abstract: Public apprehension regarding AI hallucination creates a substantial epistemic barrier, significantly undermining users’ perceived persuasiveness of GAI-based health corrections despite their technical accuracy. To navigate this challenge, this study integrates Fuzzy-Trace Theory and the Persuasion Knowledge Model to explore how the presentation of precise numbers alleviates skepticism to enhance the persuasiveness of GAI health misinformation corrections. Across three experiments (N = 588), we tested the proposed model. Presenting specific numbers along with the gist significantly enhances persuasiveness, while gist without numbers is comparatively less persuasive for an AI advisor. Perceived AI hallucination and cognitive fluency serially mediate the relationship between the presentation of numbers and the persuasiveness of GAI-generated health misinformation correction. Users’ thinking style (Analytic vs. Intuitive) moderates the relationship between perceived hallucination and cognitive fluency. These results provide guidance for designing GAI platforms that build trust by prioritizing transparent, data-rich explanations alongside clear communication of the gist of corrective information.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI健康纠错信息虽技术准确却因用户担忧AI幻觉而削弱说服力的问题，结合模糊痕迹理论与说服知识模型，通过三项实验检验在要点之外呈现具体数字能否缓解怀疑、提升说服力。结果显示，附带具体数字的呈现方式显著增强说服力，而仅有要点、不含数字时对AI顾问而言说服力相对较弱；感知AI幻觉与认知流畅性在数字呈现与说服力之间起序列中介作用，用户的思维风格（分析型与直觉型）则调节感知幻觉与认知流畅性之间的关系。文章据此建议GAI平台以透明、数据丰富的解释配合清晰的要点传达来建立信任，但相关结论限于所考察的健康纠错情境与实验设置。

papers.title: THE USE OF DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES IN STUDENT CAREER GUIDANCE
papers.authors: Ochildi Xatamov
papers.abstract: This thesis analyzes the role and potential of modern digital technologies in student career guidance. It highlights the inadequacy of traditional methods in the context of digital transformation and assesses the impact of online testing, digital portfolios, occupational databases, and mobile applications on the effectiveness of career choice. It also substantiates existing technological limitations and promising directions for their integration with artificial intelligence (AI).
papers.summary_zh: 该论文探讨现代数字技术在学生职业指导中的作用与潜力，指出传统方法在数字化转型背景下已显不足，并评估在线测评、数字档案、职业数据库和移动应用对职业选择效果的影响。研究进一步论证现有技术的局限，以及其与人工智能整合的前景。作为一篇分析性论文，其结论基于对技术应用现状的梳理与评估，而非实证实验；摘要未提供具体数据或效果量，因此对技术实际效能的判断应保持谨慎。

papers.title: Engineering Leadership in the Era of Digital Transformation: A Review of Values, Integrity, and Responsible Innovation
papers.authors: Muhd Akmal Noor Rajikon, Shahrulanuar Mohamed, Ab. Rahman Z.
papers.journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Business and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of digital technologies, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and the Fourth Industrial Revolution (Industry 4.0) has transformed the role of engineers from technical specialists to strategic leaders within organizations. The success of technological development depends not only on technical expertise but also on the values, ethics, and integrity demonstrated by leaders. This article aims to examine the importance of values-based leadership among engineers in addressing the challenges of digital transformation. A qualitative conceptual review approach was employed through an analysis of literature on leadership theory, professional ethics, AI ethics, and responsible innovation. The findings indicate that trustworthiness, integrity, accountability, fairness, and social responsibility are critical elements contributing to effective engineering leadership. Furthermore, challenges such as ethical dilemmas associated with artificial intelligence, organizational pressures, data security and privacy concerns, and technological sustainability require engineering leaders to make decisions grounded in strong moral principles and supported by enabling organizational conditions. This study proposes a Values-Based Engineering Leadership Model as a framework for higher education institutions, industrial organizations, professional bodies, and policymakers. The article contributes to the growing body of knowledge on technical leadership and reinforces the role of engineers as ethical and sustainable agents of technological development.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以定性概念综述的方式，梳理领导力理论、职业伦理、人工智能伦理与负责任创新等文献，考察数字化转型中工程师如何从技术专家转向以价值观为基础的战略领导者。作者提出，可信、正直、问责、公平和社会责任是有效工程领导力的关键要素，而人工智能带来的伦理困境、组织压力、数据安全与隐私问题以及技术可持续性，要求工程领导者在有利的组织条件下依据道德原则决策。文章据此构建了“基于价值观的工程领导力模型”，供高校、产业组织、专业团体和政策制定者参考，并强调工程师作为伦理与可持续发展推动者的角色。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Students’ Perceptions of Emerging Jobs: The Role of AI Knowledge, Perceived Usefulness, Perceived Ease of Use, and Future Work Skills
papers.authors: Mirza Kashif Baig, Erum Ghayas, Rimsha Mohsin, Arwa Motiwala
papers.journal: Open Access Organization and Management Review
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) continues to reshape the workplace landscape. It is imperative to understand how students perceive AI and its implications for future job creation. To examine this phenomenon, we used a cross-sectional design to capture students' perceptions of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its implications for future job creation. A diverse group of students approached to conduct this survey of students studying different specialties in universities in Karachi city. The results revealed a generally positive correlation between students' perceptions of AI and their views on emerging jobs. The research contributes to the ongoing discourse on AI's impact on the workforce by providing empirical insights into students' attitudes towards AI and its role in job creation. It suggests that educational institutions, policymakers, and industry stakeholders should align education and training with the evolving demands of the AI-driven job market. Further research is encouraged to explore how students' perspectives change over time as technology continues to advance. Nevertheless, the study recognizes limitations, including potential sampling biases, a single-city survey, and not including some other relevant factors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注学生如何看待人工智能及其对未来新兴岗位的影响，采用横断面问卷调查了卡拉奇多所高校不同专业的学生。结果显示，学生对人工智能的总体认知与其对新兴职业的看法呈正相关，提示人工智能知识、感知有用性、感知易用性和未来工作技能可能共同塑造这种判断。作者据此建议教育机构、政策制定者和产业方使教育培训与人工智能驱动的就业需求相衔接，同时指出研究受单一城市取样、潜在抽样偏差及未纳入其他相关因素的限制，相关关系不宜解读为因果。

papers.title: AI Disclosure, ESG Performance, and Tobin’s Q in Southeast Asian Banking
papers.authors: Hugo Prasetyo Winotoatmojo, Meiryani Meiryani, Bambang Leo Handoko, Antonius Ary Setyawan
papers.abstract: Background: Banks increasingly disclose AI-related activities, but disclosure does not establish actual implementation or realized outcomes. Evidence remains limited regarding whether AI disclosure is associated with ESG performance and whether ESG performance subsequently has valuation relevance in Southeast Asian banking. Objective: This study examines the associations among AI disclosure, ESG performance, and Tobin’s Q. Methods: A balanced panel of 1,230 bank-year observations covering 205 banking entities in 10 Southeast Asian countries from 2020 to 2025 was analyzed using bank and country-year fixed effects with bank-clustered standard errors. Robustness checks included lagged specifications, alternative variable definitions, ESG-pillar models, country exclusions, and cluster bootstrap analysis of the indirect association. Results: AI disclosure was positively associated with contemporaneous ESG performance (β = 0.0139, p = 0.006; within R² = 0.007), with significant associations for social (β = 0.0181, p = 0.004) and governance (β = 0.0096, p = 0.018) performance. However, the disclosure–ESG association was not significant in lagged or one-year-ahead specifications. AI disclosure was not consistently associated with Tobin’s Q, and the bootstrap confidence interval for the indirect association included zero. Conclusion: AI disclosure is associated with ESG performance only contemporaneously and does not provide consistent evidence of valuation relevance through ESG. The findings support a cautious interpretation of AI disclosure as a potential signal and underscore the need for verifiable, outcome-linked reporting.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察东南亚银行业中AI披露是否与ESG表现相关，以及ESG表现是否进一步与托宾Q估值相关，基于多国银行面板数据并采用固定效应模型进行分析。结果显示，AI披露仅与同期ESG表现呈正相关，且主要体现在社会与治理维度，但在滞后或提前一期的设定中该关联不显著；AI披露与托宾Q无稳定关联，经ESG的间接关联置信区间也包含零。作者据此认为，AI披露至多是一种潜在信号，不宜过度解读其估值含义，并强调需要可验证、与结果挂钩的披露。

papers.title: The Analysis of Students’ Difficulties in Writing Explanation Text in the Eleventh Grade at SMA Negeri 8 Medan
papers.authors: Trysepta Ulina Siregar, Sahlan Tampubolon, Fenty Debora Napitupulu
papers.abstract: Difficulties in writing explanation texts may limit students’ ability to communicate processes and phenomena clearly. This study identified students’ writing difficulties, examined contributing factors, and described strategies used to address them. A descriptive qualitative design involved 30 eleventh-grade students at SMA Negeri 8 Medan. Data were collected through a writing test and an open-ended questionnaire, analyzed descriptively, and triangulated across the two sources. Writing test results identified grammar as the most prominent difficulty (40%), followed by mechanics (36.7%), vocabulary (16.7%), and idea organization (6.6%). Questionnaire responses highlighted difficulty with idea organization (73.3%), revealing a contrast between the test findings and students’ reported experiences. Reported contributing factors included limited grammatical and vocabulary knowledge, insufficient writing practice, and low confidence. Students described using dictionaries, Google Translate, artificial intelligence applications, teacher and peer assistance, and writing practice to address these difficulties. The findings indicate that students require support with both linguistic accuracy and text organization. They suggest that instruction should combine explicit grammar and vocabulary support, structured writing exercises, and constructive feedback to address the difficulties identified through performance assessment and students’ self-reports.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一所高中十一年级学生为对象，采用描述性定性设计，通过写作测试与开放式问卷了解学生在撰写说明文时遇到的困难、成因及应对策略。写作测试显示语法问题最突出，其次为书写规范、词汇和观点组织；而问卷中多数学生自述困难在观点组织，测试结果与学生自身体验存在反差。学生提到的成因包括语法和词汇知识有限、写作练习不足及信心偏低，并会借助词典、翻译工具、人工智能应用、师生帮助和写作练习来应对。研究据此认为教学需同时关注语言准确性与文本组织，结合明确的语法词汇支持、结构化写作练习和建设性反馈。

papers.title: Indonesian Language Education Students Perceptions of the Utilisation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Language Skill Learning
papers.authors: Atikah Anindyarini, Andayani, Sumarwati, Septi Yulisetiani, Ari Suryawati Secio Chaesar
papers.journal: ALINEA Jurnal Bahasa Sastra dan Pengajarannya
papers.abstract: This study aims to examine students’ perceptions of the utilisation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in language-skill learning; identify the benefits and challenges experienced by students in using AI; and identify the AI applications most frequently used by students to support the learning process. A survey method was employed in this study. Data were collected through a questionnaire distributed to 46 students enrolled in the Indonesian Language and Literature Education Study Programme at Universitas Sebelas Maret. Purposive sampling was employed as the sampling technique. The research data consisted of information regarding students’ perceptions of the utilisation of AI in Indonesian language-skill learning; therefore, the selected participants were limited to sixth-semester students of the Indonesian Language Education Study Programme at the Faculty of Teacher Training and Education, Universitas Sebelas Maret. Theoretical and data-source triangulation were employed to establish data validity, while the Miles et al. data analysis model was used to analyse the research data. The findings indicate that: (1) almost all respondents expressed positive perceptions of the presence of AI in language-skill learning, particularly in listening, speaking, reading, and writing; (2) students perceived AI as beneficial to their learning, although dependence on AI was identified as the primary concern; and (3) ChatGPT was the most widely used AI-based application among the students. Consequently, AI should be integrated into language learning alongside lecturer supervision, AI literacy training, rigorous information verification, and clear academic-integrity guidelines. This study contributes to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 4 (Quality Education), through the implementation of innovative learning practices, and SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure), through the utilisation of technology to support educational transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查印度尼西亚语言教育专业学生对人工智能用于语言技能学习的看法，采用问卷调查方式收集数据。结果显示，几乎所有受访者对AI在听说读写学习中的作用持积极态度，认为其有助于学习，但同时也将依赖AI视为主要担忧；ChatGPT是学生最常使用的AI应用。作者据此建议，AI应结合教师监督、AI素养培训、信息核实和明确的学术诚信规范融入语言学习。

papers.title: Generative AI Use and Students' Critical Thinking in Scientific Article Writing: A Quantitative Correlational Study
papers.authors: Yoel Chrisnajaya Pengeu, Ida Nuraeni, Juniati, Gazali, Sukma
papers.journal: ALINEA Jurnal Bahasa Sastra dan Pengajarannya
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative artificial intelligence (generative AI) in higher education has raised concerns about its impact on students' critical thinking in academic writing, yet evidence on the conditions under which the two are related remains inconsistent. This quantitative correlational study examined the relationship between generative AI use and critical thinking among 34 Indonesian Language and Literature Education (PBSI) students participating in the Merdeka Student Exchange Program (PMM) when writing scientific articles. Drawing on Social Cognitive Theory and the cognitive offloading perspective, generative AI use was measured through four indicators (frequency, purpose, dependence, and AI literacy), and critical thinking through five aspects (analysis, evaluation, inference, synthesis–explanation, and reflection), using a four-point Likert questionnaire. Data were analyzed using simple and multiple linear regression, an independent-samples t-test, and moderated hierarchical regression. Composite generative AI use was not linearly related to critical thinking (p = .131) but showed an inverted-U pattern (p = .010), and intensive and selective users did not differ significantly (p = .097). AI literacy moderated the relationship between usage intensity and critical thinking (?R² = .222, p = .004; Holm-adjusted p = .016), with a significant positive relationship only among students with above-average AI literacy. These findings indicate that strengthening AI literacy in academic writing instruction, rather than merely restricting generative AI use, should underpin responsible, literacy-based generative AI policies in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了高校学生在撰写科学文章时使用生成式人工智能与批判性思维之间的关系，以参加交换项目的印尼语言文学教育专业学生为对象，采用问卷调查与回归分析进行定量相关研究。结果显示，生成式AI使用的综合水平与批判性思维并无线性关联，而是呈倒U形关系；高强度使用者与选择性使用者之间也没有显著差异。AI素养调节了使用强度与批判性思维的关系，只有在AI素养高于平均水平的学生中才出现显著正相关。作者据此认为，学术写作教学应着力提升AI素养，而非单纯限制生成式AI的使用。

papers.title: GEN-POEM Model Innovation: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Poetry Writing Instruction
papers.authors: Hidayah Budi Qur’ani, Candra Rahma Wijaya Putra, Maharani Putri Kumalasani
papers.journal: ALINEA Jurnal Bahasa Sastra dan Pengajarannya
papers.abstract: The advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has opened new opportunities in literary learning, particularly in developing creative writing skills at the elementary school level. This study aims to develop and evaluate a poetry writing learning model based on Poem Generator, named GEN-POEM, as an innovative approach to creative literacy. The research design employed a descriptive qualitative approach within an early-stage research and development framework (define–design–develop). Research subjects involved eight fifth-grade teachers at SD Muhammadiyah 9 "Panglima Sudirman" in Malang City. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, focus group discussions (FGD), and document analysis, then analyzed using thematic analysis techniques. The results indicate that GEN-POEM has a systematic learning syntax comprising orientation, idea exploration, initial drafting, AI integration through Poem Generator, revision and reflection, and presentation of works. Teachers assessed the model as practical, creative, and aligned with 21st-century learning needs, particularly in motivating students and integrating digital technology into literary literacy. Challenges include students' readiness to use AI, instructional time allocation, and the teacher's role as facilitator. Based on teacher feedback, GEN-POEM was refined to enhance flexibility and effectiveness. This study contributes to the development of digital creative literacy theory while offering practical implications for elementary school teachers in integrating AI into learning. From a policy perspective, these findings support the implementation of the Merdeka Curriculum and the national digital literacy agenda. A limitation of this study is that its subjects were limited to teachers; further research is therefore recommended to test the direct implementation of GEN-POEM with students in the classroom.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发并评估了基于 Poem Generator 的小学诗歌写作学习模型 GEN-POEM，采用早期研发框架下的描述性质性设计，通过访谈、焦点小组讨论和文档分析，考察八名五年级教师对该模型的看法。结果显示，GEN-POEM 形成了包含定向、构思、初稿、AI 整合、修改反思和作品展示的系统化学习流程；教师认为该模型实用、有创造性，契合 21 世纪学习需求，尤其在激发学生动机和融入数字技术方面具有价值，但也指出学生使用 AI 的准备程度、教学时间分配和教师引导角色等挑战。作者据此对模型作出调整，并说明研究仅以教师为对象，尚需在课堂中直接检验其对学生的影响。

papers.title: Language Meaning in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Mapping the Shift from Symbolic Semantics to Context-Aware Machine Understanding
papers.authors: Rudi Arahman, I Wayan Rasna
papers.journal: ALINEA Jurnal Bahasa Sastra dan Pengajarannya
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has transformed language from a human meaning-making practice into an interaction among computational models, semantic theories, and social values. This systematic literature review examines how scholarship conceptualises language meaning in the AI era and identifies conditions for interpretable, culturally responsive, and ethically accountable machine language understanding. Following PRISMA, the review screened records retrieved from Scopus and sources, synthesising 36 eligible studies through thematic analysis and a Theory–Context–Characteristics–Methodology lens. Evidence shows that scholarship is organised around an interconnected AI–machine learning–natural language processing nexus, with large language models, semantic representation, machine translation, and human–AI interaction as lines of inquiry. Rather than demonstrating that machines simply “understand” language, the studies reveal a shift from formal semantic processing towards contextual, pragmatic, and relational accounts of meaning. Persistent limitations remain: technical performance receives greater attention than linguistic diversity, social consequences, interpretability, algorithmic fairness, privacy, and cultural conditions in which meaning is negotiated. The review also identifies an uneven geography of knowledge production: studies from North America and Europe advance foundational and ethical debates, whereas Asian research foregrounds local applications. Its principal contribution is a multidimensional synthesis connecting computational development with philosophy of language, linguistics, cognition, and ethics, moving beyond narrowly technical reviews of AI language systems. Future research should test culturally adaptive and explainable models across minoritised and multilingual languages, combine computational evaluation with human-centred inquiry, and establish cross-regional collaborations that treat linguistic justice as a core design principle. Meaningful AI requires not textual fluency alone, but accountable participation in context-sensitive human communication.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以PRISMA流程系统梳理36项研究，考察人工智能时代学界如何理解语言意义。研究发现，相关研究围绕AI、机器学习与自然语言处理的关联展开，关注点正从形式语义处理转向语境、语用和关系性的意义观，但技术性能仍比语言多样性、社会后果、可解释性、算法公平与隐私受到更多关注；知识生产在地理上也不均衡，北美和欧洲侧重基础与伦理讨论，亚洲则突出本地应用。文章据此提出应检验文化适应与可解释模型、结合计算评估与以人为中心的研究，并将语言正义作为设计原则。

papers.title: Flashcard creation and use in a histology lecture course: A survey-based case study.
papers.authors: Rachael Allen
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Learning in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Histology, like many basic science subjects requires mastery of terminology, visual structures, and integration of these things to describe functional relationships, making effective study strategies essential for student success. Flashcards are widely used to support retrieval practice and spaced repetition, but students can struggle to develop deeper understanding beyond surface memorization. The relatively recent integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into mainstream higher education exposes new opportunities to enhance active learning strategies. This case study assesses the extent to which flashcards are being used by students in a histology lecture class, and explores the role that AI plays. Data were collected through two voluntary online surveys that included questions asking for multiple-choice responses and short written responses. The subjective and quantitative comparisons together with students’ self-reflection statements prompted classroom discussions about intentional flashcard design and use, and the broader applicability of course-specific study strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该案例研究通过两次自愿在线调查，考察组织学讲座课程中学生使用闪卡的程度以及人工智能在其中扮演的角色。调查包含选择题和简答，结合主观与定量比较及学生自我反思，发现闪卡被用于支持提取练习和间隔重复，但学生可能难以超越表层记忆形成更深理解；AI 的融入被视为增强主动学习策略的新机会。作者据此在课堂上讨论了有意识地设计和使用闪卡，以及课程特定学习策略的更广泛适用性。

papers.title: Educating Humans, Training Machines: From Doing to Becoming in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: James Belcher
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Learning in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping higher education. Generative AI systems can summarize texts, generate written work, provide feedback, assist in problem solving, and support increasingly complex cognitive activities across disciplines. While these technologies create significant opportunities for teaching and learning, they also challenge long-standing assumptions about the relationship between academic task performance and evidence of learning. This paper argues that the central challenge for higher education is not simply integrating artificial intelligence into the classroom but reconsidering the purpose of education through a shift from task-oriented learning focused on “doing” toward developmental learning centered on “becoming.” Drawing upon Bloom’s Taxonomy, experiential learning, transformative learning, situated learning and research on human–AI collaboration, this paper develops a conceptual framework for examining the changing relationship between cognitive task performance and learner development in AI-augmented educational environments. Rather than assigning lower-order cognition to artificial intelligence and higher-order cognition exclusively to humans, the framework recognizes that AI can support activity across cognitive levels while distinguishing successful task performance from the intellectual development of the learner. The paper argues that the educational value of AI ultimately depends on whether its use contributes to the development of judgment, agency, reflection, ethical responsibility, creativity, and intellectual identity. Implications for curriculum design, assessment, faculty development, and institutional policy are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论生成式人工智能进入高等教育后，学术任务表现与学习证据之间原有假设受到的挑战。作者借助布鲁姆分类法、经验学习、转化学习、情境学习及人机协作研究，提出一个概念框架，用以考察AI增强环境中认知任务表现与学习者发展之间关系的变化。文章主张，高等教育的核心问题不只是把AI引入课堂，更在于推动教育目的从侧重“做事”的任务导向学习转向以“成为”为中心的发展性学习；框架不把低阶认知交给AI、高阶认知专属人类，而是承认AI可支持各认知层次的活动，同时区分任务完成与学习者智识发展。作者认为，AI的教育价值最终取决于其使用是否促进判断力、能动性、反思、伦理责任、创造力和智识身份的发展，并据此讨论了课程设计、评价、教师发展和院校政策的启示。

papers.title: Beyond the Algorithm: Integrating AI into Applied Learning Pedagogy—A Critical Inquiry
papers.authors: Ali Kamali
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Learning in Higher Education
papers.abstract: This paper examines how artificial intelligence (AI) can strengthen applied learning in the social sciences by transforming raw information into analyzable material that students actively interpret, evaluate, and convert into disciplinary knowledge. It argues that AI, when guided by theoretical rigor and ethical awareness, enhances critical pedagogy by supporting qualitative interpretation, computational analysis, simulation based inquiry, and independent reasoning. Rather than replacing instruction, AI functions as an analytical scaffold that students interrogate, correct, and contextualize, enabling deeper engagement with social structures, patterned behavior, and institutional dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性批判探讨，关注人工智能如何在社会科学的应用学习中发挥作用。作者提出，AI的作用在于把原始信息转化为可供分析的材料，由学生主动解释、评估并转化为学科知识，而非替代教学；在理论严谨性与伦理意识的引导下，AI可作为分析支架，支持质性解释、计算分析、模拟探究和独立推理，学生则需对其加以质疑、纠正和情境化。文章据此认为，这种协同有助于学生更深入地理解社会结构、行为模式与制度动态，但属于规范性论证，未报告实证检验。

papers.title: Self-perceived digital competence, tool use and knowledge among preservice early childhood and primary teachers
papers.authors: Alastor Enrique, Francisco David Guillén Gámez, Julio RUIZ PALMERO
papers.journal: Research on Preschool and Primary Education
papers.abstract: Everyday familiarity with digital applications is often taken as evidence of pedagogically meaningful teacher digital competence, yet the two are not equivalent. The study's original contribution is a direct, within-sample comparison of how self-reported tool use and knowledge relate to self-perceived digital competence among preservice early childhood and primary education teachers. A cross-sectional, non-experimental survey was completed by 903 students at a public university in southern Spain during 2022–2023, before the widespread incorporation of generative artificial intelligence into teacher education. The instrument combined the validated Digital Competence Questionnaire for Pre-service Teachers (20 items across five dimensions) with an inventory covering use and knowledge of 26 digital tools. Internal consistency of the global self-perceived competence scale was high (α = .93). As expected, self-perceived digital competence was positively associated with global tool knowledge (r = .41, 95% confidence interval (CI) [.35, .46]) and global tool use (r = .33, 95% CI [.27, .39]), both p < .001. The knowledge association was reliably but only modestly stronger, Williams' t(900) = 4.36, p < .001, difference = .076, bootstrap 95% CI [.043, .108]. Among category-specific indices, the association was weakest for social-platform use (r = .24) and strongest for non-social tool knowledge (r = .39). Gender, age, timetable, university entrance grade and socioeconomic status showed no meaningful associations, whereas current academic achievement showed a small positive association (r = .11). The findings indicate that everyday technology use and reported tool knowledge are related but non-interchangeable indicators of self-perceived teacher digital competence and support assessment and training approaches that foreground pedagogical judgement rather than frequency of application use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注日常数字工具使用与知识能否等同于职前教师的数字胜任力，对西班牙南部一所公立大学903名职前幼教与小学教师进行了横断面问卷调查，比较其自报的工具使用、工具知识与自评数字胜任力之间的关系。结果显示，自评数字胜任力与整体工具知识（r=.41）和整体工具使用（r=.33）均呈正相关，其中知识关联仅略强于使用关联；分项来看，社交媒体使用关联最弱，非社交工具知识关联最强。性别、年龄、课表、入学成绩和社会经济地位未见有意义关联，当前学业成绩仅有微弱正相关。作者据此指出，日常技术使用与工具知识虽相关但不可互换，教师数字胜任力的评估与培养应更重视教学判断而非工具使用频率。

papers.title: Silent Interaction Pedagogy: Investigating the Use of Non-Verbal AI Avatars to Enhance English Language Acquisition in Low-Anxiety EFL Classrooms
papers.authors: Muhammad Syarif Hidayatullah, Tiyas Saputri, Nailul Authar
papers.abstract: This study investigates how non-verbal Artificial Intelligence (AI) avatars can help reduce speaking anxiety and support English language acquisition in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) classrooms. It is based on the framework of "Silent Interaction Pedagogy," which prioritizes receptive understanding and visual cues over immediate spoken production. To examine this approach, methodologically, this study utilized a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. After searching Google Scholar, and ERIC, this study selected 14 empirical articles published between 2010 - 2026 for detailed analysis. The thematic synthesis of these papers revealed four core dimensions: (1) the features of low-anxiety EFL learning environments; (2) the role of non-verbal AI avatars as scaffolded learning tools; (3) silent interaction as an inclusive pathway for diverse learners; and (4) the practical and technological challenges of integration. The findings show that non-verbal AI avatars allow students to learn vocabulary and understand context by using visual cues, bypassing the fear of negative evaluation by teachers or peers. This paper also provides recommendations for teachers to develop their technology skills (TPACK) to use these tools effectively.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕“静默互动教学法”框架，考察非言语AI虚拟形象能否在英语作为外语的课堂中降低口语焦虑并支持语言习得。作者按PRISMA 2020指南检索并筛选出14篇实证文章进行主题综合，归纳出低焦虑学习环境特征、非言语AI虚拟形象的支架作用、静默互动对多元学习者的包容路径，以及整合中的实践与技术挑战四个维度。综述指出，这类虚拟形象可借助视觉线索帮助学生学词汇、理解语境，从而绕开对教师或同伴负面评价的恐惧，并建议教师提升TPACK以有效使用相关工具。

papers.title: Mapping Artificial Intelligence Research in Business and Management Higher Education: A Bibliometric Analysis
papers.authors: Kanjana Chumsong, Pattariya Wahamongkhon, Sorachai Sukpun
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping business and management higher education, yet the field remains dispersed across educational, managerial, and technological conversations. This study maps that literature through a reproducible bibliometric review of Dimensions.ai records published from 2017 to 2025. The search and final export were completed on August 22, 2026. PRISMA 2020-guided screening retained 352 English-language open-access articles, chapters, and monographs. Descriptive indicators were combined with VOSviewer 1.6.20 analyses of co-authorship, contributor citations, cited-author co-citation, and title-and-abstract term co-occurrence. Annual output increased from 1 publication in 2017 to 191 in the complete 2025 publication year. Citation impact was concentrated in a small number of recent studies, while the co-authorship network remained fragmented into several small groups. Country results placed the United Kingdom first among records with affiliation metadata, although country information was missing for 182 of 352 records. After removing metadata artifacts, the most frequent title-and-abstract terms included intelligence, ChatGPT, business, opportunity, assessment, and engagement. The study contributes a transparent, multi-layer map of an emerging field and identifies priorities for curriculum design, assessment, responsible AI governance, and stronger cross-institutional collaboration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量方法梳理2017至2025年间商业与管理高等教育中人工智能研究的分布格局，检索Dimensions.ai记录并经PRISMA 2020筛选保留352篇英文开放获取文献，结合描述性指标与VOSviewer的合著、引用和术语共现分析。结果显示，该领域年发文量从2017年的1篇增至2025年完整年度的191篇，引用影响集中于少数近期研究，合著网络仍分散为若干小群体；国家归属信息在大量记录中缺失，英国在具备机构元数据的记录中居首。去除元数据噪声后，标题与摘要中的高频术语包括智能、ChatGPT、商业、机会、评估与参与。作者据此提出课程设计、评估、负责任的人工智能治理及跨机构合作等优先方向，但该图谱反映的是文献分布特征，而非研究干预的效果。

papers.title: The Role of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in Transforming Logistics and Supply Chain Management: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Business Applications
papers.authors: Palapati Srinidhi, B. Giri Murugan
papers.journal: International Journal of Research Publication and Reviews
papers.abstract: This pilot study explores how people perceive the opportunities and challenges of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in logistics and supply chain management. Data were collected from 50 respondents through an online questionnaire using convenience sampling. The responses were analysed using descriptive statistics, Cronbach’s alpha, correlation, regression, ANOVA and chi-square tests. Respondents showed positive perceptions of GenAI, with scores for operational efficiency (M = 3.49), decision-making (M = 3.55), cost reduction (M = 3.48) and transformation potential (M = 3.58), all significantly above the neutral midpoint of 3. Transformation potential explained approximately 61% of the variation in perceived operational efficiency (β = .78, p < .001). Efficiency differed significantly by age, F (2, 47) = 6.10, p = .004, but not by education. Data privacy and security was the most frequently reported barrier (32%). Despite limitations, the findings highlight optimism alongside concerns about security, reliability and employee acceptance.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究通过在线问卷考察了50名受访者对生成式人工智能在物流与供应链管理中机遇与挑战的看法，并用描述统计、相关与回归等方法分析作答。受访者总体持积极态度，运营效率、决策、降本和转型潜力四项感知均显著高于中性中点，其中转型潜力对运营效率感知的解释力较强；效率感知随年龄不同而存在差异，但与教育程度无关。数据隐私与安全是最常被提及的障碍，同时受访者也表达了对可靠性、员工接受度等问题的担忧。研究据此提示，在乐观预期之外，安全与信任问题仍是落地应用需要关注的条件。

papers.title: Using generative AI to build discovery interview capacity: Lessons from a Canadian college
papers.authors: Josh Seeland
papers.abstract: Training staff to conduct discovery interviews for potential academic misconduct can be challenging, particularly for institutions with limited numbers of experienced interviewers, geographically dispersed campuses, or growing demand for academic integrity support. To address this challenge, the author developed and piloted a generative artificial intelligence (genAI)-supported discovery interview simulator designed to provide staff with opportunities to practise interview techniques, receive immediate feedback including alignment with policy and procedure, and build confidence in a safe learning environment. Rather than replacing traditional professional development, the simulator was intended to complement existing training by expanding opportunities for realistic, policy-aligned practice. Drawing on participant feedback and implementation experience, this article describes the development of the simulator, lessons learned during its pilot use, and considerations for institutions interested in exploring similar approaches. Participants reported positive experiences with the simulations, particularly valuing the opportunity to practise realistic conversations, receive formative feedback, and engage in low-risk experiential learning. The pilot also highlighted the importance of aligning genAI-supported training with institutional policies, refining scenarios through ongoing iteration, and integrating genAI-based simulations with facilitated discussion and mentorship. This experience suggests that genAI can serve as a practical tool for expanding institutional capacity for discovery interview training while maintaining human oversight and educational purpose. Recommendations are offered to help Canadian, and other, postsecondary institutions evaluate whether genAI-supported simulations may be appropriate within their own academic integrity training programs.
papers.summary_zh: 该文介绍了一款由作者开发并试点的生成式人工智能支持的调查访谈模拟器，旨在为高校教职工提供练习访谈技巧、获得即时反馈并建立信心的机会，以补充而非替代传统培训。基于参与者反馈和实施经验，文章描述了模拟器的开发过程与试点中的经验教训。参与者对模拟体验反应积极，尤其看重练习真实对话、获得形成性反馈和低风险体验式学习的机会；试点还表明，需将生成式AI培训与院校政策对齐、通过持续迭代完善场景，并将其与引导式讨论和导师指导相结合。作者据此认为，生成式AI可作为扩展机构访谈培训能力的实用工具，但须保持人工监督和教育目的，并为有意评估类似方案的高校提出建议。

papers.title: Digital Education in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Towards anEmirati Model for Protecting Family Identity and EnhancingSocial Cohesion
papers.authors: Wadeema Al-Dhaheri
papers.journal: Emirati Journal of Education and Literature
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), algorithmically curated platforms, and generative media are reshaping how people access information, communicate, and learn. These developments create educational opportunities while raising questions about privacy, misinformation, bias, family interaction, cultural identity, and social cohesion. This conceptual paper examines digital education as a framework for developing the knowledge, judgement, and ethical dispositions needed to participate responsibly in AI-mediated environments. It focuses on the United Arab Emirates (UAE), where national efforts to advance AI literacy provide a relevant policy context for considering how technological capability can be aligned with cultural context and human values. The paper uses a qualitative descriptive-analytical approach to examine selected international frameworks and institutional policy documents alongside conceptual literature on networked communication, media literacy, participatory culture, and digital ethics. It does not claim to measure the prevalence or causal effects of digital risks in Emirati families; rather, it synthesises relevant concepts and derives a proposed educational framework. The analysis identifies five mutually reinforcing pillars: digital national and cultural identity; media and algorithmic literacy; digital ethics and safety; partnership among families, schools, media, and public institutions; and a human-centred balance between technology use and face-to-face relationships. The paper argues that these pillars should be translated into age-appropriate learning outcomes, family guidance, teacher development, and coordinated institutional practice. It concludes that the proposed model is a conceptual contribution requiring subsequent expert review and empirical evaluation before its effectiveness can be established
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，探讨如何以数字教育为框架，培养人们在人工智能介入的信息环境中负责任参与所需的知识、判断力与伦理素养，并以阿联酋的国家AI素养政策为背景。作者采用定性描述分析，梳理国际框架、机构政策文件及相关概念文献，提出由数字国家与文化认同、媒体与算法素养、数字伦理与安全、家庭学校媒体及公共机构协同、以及技术使用与面对面关系的人本平衡这五个相互强化的支柱构成的拟议教育框架。文章强调该模型属概念性贡献，未测量阿联酋家庭中数字风险的普遍性或因果效应，其有效性尚需专家评审与实证检验。

papers.title: An Adaptive Multimodal Meta-Fusion Framework for Alzheimer's Disease and Frontotemporal Dementia Classification using EEG, MRI, and Cognitive Biomarkers
papers.authors: Lalita Moharkar, Monika Bhagwat
papers.journal: International Research Journal of Multidisciplinary Technovation
papers.abstract: A single-modality approach to neurodegenerative disease classification is often limited by heterogeneous clinical manifestations, modality-specific feature distributions, and incomplete data availability. This study proposes an Adaptive Multimodal Meta-Fusion (AMMF) framework integrating cognitive-demographic, structural MRI, and EEG biomarkers for classification of the Alzheimer's disease (AD), Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD), and Cognitively Normal (CN) participants. Three modality-specific cohorts from two public repositories were considered: cognitive-demographic data (n = 679), structural MRI data (n = 595), and EEG data (n = 194; BrainLat n = 106 and OpenNeuro n = 88). Cognitive-demographic features are prioritized using explainable XGBoost with SHAP-based feature analysis, MRI data are processed using ConvNeXt-Small for spatial representation learning, and EEG signals are analyzed using a Transformer-based architecture for temporal and functional representation learning. For the matched BrainLat cohort, the three modality branches generated an 18-dimensional cognitive-demographic representation, a 128-dimensional EEG representation, and a 768-dimensional MRI representation. The proposed framework then applied adaptive late fusion at the modality-probability level: each modality generated an independent three-class probability vector, and a modality-availability mask was used to renormalize the predefined modality weights of 0.20, 0.30, and 0.50 assigned to the cognitive-demographic, EEG, and MRI modalities, respectively. The resulting weighted class-probability vector was supplied to a Random Forest meta-classifier for final three-class classification. The complete multimodal evaluation was performed on 106 subject-level matched participants with all three modalities. The proposed framework achieved an accuracy of 99.06%, demonstrating the utility of combining complementary cognitive, functional, and structural biomarkers through adaptive probability-level meta-fusion for AD, FTD, and CN classification. A continuity-corrected McNemar test yielded χ² = 4.000 (p = 0.0455) for C4 versus C7 and χ² = 4.167 (p = 0.0412) for C5 versus C7, indicating statistically significant paired differences, while C6 versus C7 yielded χ² = 3.200 (p = 0.0736). Integration of cognitive-demographic, MRI, and EEG modalities for multimodal disease classification. The proposed framework integrates cognitive-demographic, MRI, and EEG modalities for multimodal disease classification by combining heterogeneous features in a unified representation space and applying Random Forest-based meta-classification to the fused modality probabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出自适应多模态元融合（AMMF）框架，用于阿尔茨海默病、额颞叶痴呆与认知正常者的三分类，分别用可解释XGBoost处理认知-人口学特征、ConvNeXt-Small提取MRI空间表征、Transformer建模EEG时序与功能表征，并在模态概率层面按预设权重做自适应晚期融合，再由随机森林元分类器给出最终类别。在三种模态齐备的受试者级匹配数据上，该框架报告的分类准确率较高，配对检验显示部分融合配置之间存在显著差异，提示整合互补的认知、功能与结构生物标志物具有潜在价值；但结果基于特定公开队列与匹配子集，尚需外部验证。

papers.title: PENGARUH ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CAPABILITY DAN ORGANIZATIONAL CREATIVITY DALAM MEMAKSIMALKAN ORGANIZATIONAL PERFORMANCE PADA PT RADIANT UTAMA INTERINSCO
papers.authors: Meliana Meliana, Junaidi Junaidi, Marihot Manullang
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF SCIENCE AND SOCIAL RESEARCH
papers.abstract: Abstract: This study examines the effect of artificial intelligence (AI) capability and organizational creativity on organizational performance at PT Radiant Utama Interinsco, an Indonesian oil and gas support services company. A quantitative explanatory design was used. From a population of 150 employees, 108 respondents were selected by simple random sampling based on the Krejcie and Morgan table. Data were collected using a five-point Likert questionnaire and analysed with Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The model explained 73.0% of the variance in organizational creativity and 86.3% in organizational performance. AI capability had a positive and significant effect on organizational performance (β = 0.232; p = 0.041) and on organizational creativity (β = 0.855; p < 0.001). Organizational creativity had a positive and significant effect on organizational performance (β = 0.723; p < 0.001). Organizational creativity partially mediated the effect of AI capability on organizational performance (β = 0.618; p < 0.001), with the indirect effect accounting for 72.7% of the total effect. These findings indicate that AI capability improves performance mainly by strengthening the organization's ability to generate, promote, and implement new ideas. Keyword: artificial intelligence capability; organizational creativity; organizational performance; PLS-SEM; oil and gas services. Abstrak: Penelitian ini menguji pengaruh artificial intelligence (AI) capability dan organizational creativity terhadap organizational performance pada PT Radiant Utama Interinsco, perusahaan jasa pendukung industri minyak dan gas di Indonesia. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif eksplanatori. Dari populasi 150 karyawan, sebanyak 108 responden dipilih dengan simple random sampling berdasarkan tabel Krejcie dan Morgan. Data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner skala Likert lima poin dan dianalisis dengan Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). Model menjelaskan 73,0% variasi organizational creativity dan 86,3% variasi organizational performance. AI capability berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap organizational performance (β = 0,232; p = 0,041) dan organizational creativity (β = 0,855; p < 0,001). Organizational creativity berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap organizational performance (β = 0,723; p < 0,001). Organizational creativity memediasi secara parsial pengaruh AI capability terhadap organizational performance (β = 0,618; p < 0,001), dengan pengaruh tidak langsung sebesar 72,7% dari pengaruh total. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa AI capability meningkatkan kinerja terutama melalui penguatan kemampuan organisasi dalam menghasilkan, mempromosikan, dan mengimplementasikan ide baru. Kata kunci: artificial intelligence capability; organizational creativity; organizational performance; PLS-SEM; jasa migas.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以印尼一家油气支持服务企业的员工为对象，采用问卷调查与结构方程模型，考察人工智能能力与组织创造力对组织绩效的影响。结果显示，人工智能能力对组织绩效有正向作用，但更主要的是通过组织创造力间接发挥作用：组织创造力在两者之间起部分中介作用，间接效应占总效应的大部分。作者据此认为，人工智能能力提升绩效的关键路径在于增强组织产生、推广和落实新想法的能力，而非仅靠技术本身直接改善绩效。

papers.title: Research on AI-empowered teaching in physical geography courses
papers.authors: Zhongqiang Sun, 姝仪 何
papers.journal: Journal of Education and Educational Policy Studies
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology is transforming talent cultivation models and teaching practices in higher education. Physical Geography is a core foundational course in the Geography Science major. Its content system is complex and wide-ranging, spans large spatiotemporal scales, and closely integrates theory with practice; therefore, traditional teaching models face numerous practical challenges. This paper reviews the policy background of AI empowering higher education and the current research status of geography teaching, analyzes the value of integrating AI technology into Physical Geography course teaching, and, by combining literature research and case analysis, examines the current situation of AI-empowered Physical Geography teaching. It summarizes the main problems, analyzes their causes, and proposes teaching strategy recommendations from four aspects: teaching resource development, teaching model innovation, faculty capacity improvement, and evaluation system reconstruction. The study concludes that the key to AI-empowered Physical Geography teaching lies in establishing a "human-AI collaborative" teaching ecology. While fully leveraging technological advantages, it is important to prioritize the cultivation of higher-order abilities such as critical thinking.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕人工智能如何赋能自然地理课程教学展开，采用文献研究与案例分析，梳理了AI赋能高等教育的政策背景和地理教学的现状。文章指出，自然地理内容复杂、时空跨度大且理论与实践结合紧密，传统教学面临诸多挑战；AI赋能的关键在于构建“人机协同”的教学生态，在发挥技术优势的同时，应优先培养学生批判性思维等高阶能力。文章还从教学资源开发、教学模式创新、教师能力提升和评价体系重构四方面提出策略建议，属于综述性讨论，未报告实证干预效果。

papers.title: How Do Organizational Empowerment and Management Control Jointly Promote ESG Value Co-Creation? A Longitudinal Case Study of Haier Smart Home Based on Public Disclosures
papers.authors: Zihan Yuan, Lirui Yu
papers.journal: Highlights in Business Economics and Management
papers.abstract: As sustainability disclosure becomes increasingly institutionalized in China, the managerial challenge is shifting from whether firms disclose ESG information to how ESG objectives are translated into executable, accountable, and measurable operating responsibilities. Prior research has mainly examined the economic consequences of ESG performance, while less attention has been paid to how empowerment and management control work together in decentralized organizations. This study conducts a longitudinal documentary single-case analysis of Haier Smart Home based on public disclosures. The period from 2005 to 2019 is treated as the organizational background, while the analysis focuses on the integration of ESG governance and operating management from 2020 to 2025. The findings suggest that the Rendanheyi-related arrangements of delegated authority, platform-based resource access, and value orientation provide organizational conditions for bringing ESG issues closer to business settings, although public disclosures do not directly establish changes in employees' psychological empowerment. More importantly, Haier Smart Home has increasingly translated selected ESG objectives into operating responsibilities through board oversight, cross-functional ESG structures, target decomposition, and performance incentives. Its 2024 ESG report, for example, discloses that selected ESG indicators are incorporated into monthly performance assessment and that recovery, dismantling, and regeneration targets in the resource-recycling business are linked to executive evaluation and compensation. Supply-chain management and appliance recycling further indicate that ESG tasks extend beyond firm boundaries, but the available evidence does not identify the net causal effect of platform mechanisms on ESG outcomes. Double materiality, metric definitions, and data verification constitute control boundaries for decentralized action, while sustainable finance indicates a possible, rather than established, resource-feedback mechanism. Based on these findings, the study proposes a project-level ESG Win-Win Value-Added Statement integrating responsibility ownership, baselines and boundaries, inputs, physical outputs, financial outcomes, environmental and social impacts, and verification status. The study contributes by integrating organizational empowerment and management control within a single accountability-oriented framework and by explicitly defining the evidentiary limits of a disclosure-based case study.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注去中心化组织中组织赋能与管理控制如何共同推动ESG价值共创，采用基于公开披露的纵向文档单案例方法分析海尔智家。研究发现，链群合约相关安排为ESG议题贴近业务场景提供了组织条件，但公开披露无法直接证实员工心理赋能的变化；公司主要通过董事会监督、跨职能ESG结构、目标分解和绩效激励将部分ESG目标转化为经营责任，供应链管理与家电回收也显示ESG任务延伸至企业边界之外。作者同时强调，现有证据不能识别平台机制对ESG结果的净因果效应，并据此提出项目层面的ESG共赢增值表，将责任归属、基线与边界、投入、实物产出、财务结果、环境社会影响及核验状态纳入同一问责框架。

papers.title: Research on FinTech Reshaping Enterprise Investment and Financing Modes from the Corporate Finance Perspective
papers.authors: Z. Wang
papers.journal: Highlights in Business Economics and Management
papers.abstract: The traditional financial system has long suffered from structural drawbacks. Issues such as an imperfect information disclosure mechanism and a simplistic risk pricing model have persisted for a long time, thereby artificially raising the transaction costs in the investment and financing processes of real enterprises, restricting the flexibility of enterprises' capital operations, and hindering the cultivation and growth of enterprises' long-term value. Based on the theories of corporate finance, information asymmetry, and transaction costs, this paper deeply analyzes the internal logic of how fintech enables the upgrading of enterprises' investment and financing, and also outlines the specific paths for its implementation. Leveraging the technological advantages of digitalization and intelligence, fintech has broken through the time and space limitations and mode barriers of traditional financial services, effectively expanding the financing channels for enterprises, avoiding subjective human biases in investment decisions, and effectively alleviating the financing difficulties commonly faced by small and medium-sized enterprises. It continuously optimizes the allocation efficiency of capital in the market. However, during the process of industrial implementation, the deep integration of fintech and the real economy still faces numerous obstacles. Problems such as uneven digital literacy among market entities, imperfect data governance systems of financial institutions, technical loopholes in algorithm models, and lagging iterations of industry regulatory systems all to some extent weaken the enabling efficacy of digital finance. In response to these practical challenges, this paper builds a collaborative optimization framework involving enterprises, financial institutions, and regulatory authorities, providing effective theoretical support and practical references for digital finance to deeply penetrate the real economy and empower industrial development, and helping real enterprises achieve stable and high-quality long-term development.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从公司金融视角出发，结合公司金融、信息不对称与交易成本理论，分析金融科技重塑企业投融资模式的内在逻辑与实现路径。作者指出，数字化与智能化技术突破了传统金融服务在时空和模式上的限制，拓宽了企业融资渠道，减少了投资决策中的人为主观偏差，有助于缓解中小企业融资难并提升市场资金配置效率。但文章同时强调，金融科技与实体经济深度融合仍受数字素养不均、数据治理不完善、算法模型漏洞和监管迭代滞后等因素制约，并据此构建企业、金融机构与监管部门协同的优化框架。该文属于理论分析，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: Research on the Dilemma of Consumer Empowerment and Brand Control in Brand Co-creation of Platform Enterprises and Its Resolution Paths
papers.authors: Yutian Wang
papers.journal: Highlights in Business Economics and Management
papers.abstract: With the development of the digital economy and platform-based business models, platform enterprises increasingly need consumer participation in co-creating brands to access innovative resources, enhance user engagement, and increase brand asset value. However, this process presents a tension between "consumer empowerment" and "brand control": on one hand, granting consumers greater autonomy can stimulate creativity, foster emotional connections, and strengthen brand loyalty, thereby improving the effectiveness of brand co-creation; on the other hand, excessive empowerment may lead to loss of brand control, inconsistent content quality, misalignment with corporate strategic goals, and even erosion of brand equity and reputational risks, placing companies in a dilemma between "decentralized chaos and centralized stagnation." Drawing on theories of brand co-creation, consumer empowerment, and organizational control, this paper analyzes the operational mechanisms and contradictions involved in brand co-creation within platform enterprises, exploring the root causes of this dilemma—such as the conflict between platform ecosystem openness and corporate strategic stability, the tension between consumer agency and brand consistency management, and challenges in governing user-generated content (UGC) under digital technologies. To address these issues, the paper proposes a "dynamic balance" approach: first, establishing a tiered and differentiated empowerment mechanism that grants varying levels of authority based on consumers' participation depth and expertise; second, implementing flexible brand management through soft controls such as value-driven guidance, community self-governance, and algorithm-assisted content moderation; third, leveraging digital tools to build real-time feedback and collaborative co-creation platforms that strengthen trust and shared benefits between firms and consumers, thus achieving a dynamic equilibrium between empowerment and control. The paper argues that platform enterprises should move beyond binary thinking and instead adopt a synergistic governance model that balances openness with orderliness, effectively integrating institutional design, technological capabilities, and cultural development to maximize co-creation efficiency while safeguarding brand assets. This research not only enriches existing scholarship on brand co-creation and consumer empowerment but also offers practical recommendations for enterprises seeking to enhance their brand management and competitiveness in practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕平台企业品牌共创中“消费者赋权”与“品牌控制”之间的张力展开理论分析，指出赋权虽能激发创意与品牌忠诚，但过度赋权可能导致内容质量不一、偏离企业战略甚至损害品牌资产，使企业陷入“一放就乱、一管就死”的困境。作者从平台生态开放性与企业战略稳定性的冲突、消费者能动性与品牌一致性管理的矛盾，以及数字技术下用户生成内容治理难题等角度剖析成因，并提出分层差异化赋权、价值引导与社区自治等柔性控制、数字工具支撑的实时反馈与协同共创平台相结合的动态平衡路径。文章据此主张平台企业超越二元思维，采用开放与秩序兼顾的协同治理模式。

papers.title: Integrative Education Manners, Artificial Intelligence Literacy, and Learning Motivation for Elementary School Students: Implementation of the Character Proficiency Program at SDN Sumber Wetan 1
papers.authors: Yayak Hardiansyah, Muhammad Adam Rosuli, Firdatus Sholiha, Luluk Zahro Maulidya, Najma Zahira Zukhruf, Miftachul Huda
papers.abstract: Perkembangan teknologi digital dan kebutuhan penguatan karakter menjadi tantangan penting dalam pendidikan sekolah dasar. Program Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (PKM) melalui kegiatan Cakap Berkarakter bertujuan memberikan edukasi kepada siswa mengenai adab, Artificial Intelligence (AI), dan motivasi belajar sebagai upaya mendukung pembentukan karakter serta kesiapan digital siswa. Kegiatan ini dilaksanakan pada Rabu, 9 September 2026 di SDN Sumber Wetan 1 dengan sasaran siswa kelas 4, 5, dan 6 sebanyak 157 peserta. Metode pelaksanaan menggunakan sosialisasi edukatif melalui penyampaian materi dengan media PowerPoint dan proyektor, serta diskusi interaktif dan evaluasi melalui tanya jawab serta kuis. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan bahwa siswa mampu memahami penerapan adab dalam kehidupan sehari-hari, mengenal manfaat dan batasan penggunaan AI secara bijak, serta memperoleh dorongan untuk meningkatkan motivasi belajar. Siswa menunjukkan antusiasme melalui partisipasi aktif dalam diskusi dan sesi evaluasi. Program “Cakap Berkarakter” memberikan kontribusi sebagai edukasi awal dalam mengintegrasikan pendidikan karakter, literasi digital, dan motivasi belajar bagi siswa sekolah dasar.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小学阶段如何将品格教育、人工智能素养与学习动机结合起来，以回应数字技术发展和学生品格培养的双重需求。作者在SDN Sumber Wetan 1面向高年级学生开展“Cakap Berkarakter”社区服务活动，通过PowerPoint讲授、互动讨论和问答测验进行教育性宣传。结果显示，学生能够理解日常生活中的礼仪规范，认识人工智能的益处与使用边界，并获得提升学习动机的鼓励，且在讨论和评估环节表现出积极参与。文章将该项目定位为整合品格教育、数字素养与学习动机的初步教育实践，但属于活动实施报告，未设对照或长期追踪，效果主要基于现场参与和评估反馈。

papers.title: Rekonstruksi Epistemologi Pendidikan Agama Islam di Era Disrupsi:
papers.authors: Ahmad Riza
papers.abstract: The development of artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed the landscape of knowledge production, distribution, and authority, including within Islamic Religious Education (IRE). This transformation raises epistemological concerns because easy access to religious information is not necessarily accompanied by the ability to determine the validity, authority, and value orientation of the knowledge obtained. This study aims to analyze the epistemological problems of Islamic Religious Education in the era of artificial intelligence and to formulate an epistemological reconstruction that integrates knowledge, values, and learning. The study employs a literature review method with a qualitative-descriptive and analytical approach by examining relevant scholarly articles and literature on Islamic educational epistemology, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence. The analysis was conducted through the identification, classification, interpretation, and synthesis of various epistemological perspectives. The findings indicate that conventional Islamic Religious Education epistemology faces significant limitations in responding to shifts in epistemic authority, algorithmic bias, misinformation, and the tendency to reduce knowledge to computationally processed information. Therefore, the epistemology of Islamic Religious Education needs to be reconstructed through an integrative-transformative paradigm that positions revelation as the normative foundation, reason and empirical experience as instruments for developing knowledge, AI as a supporting epistemic tool, and Islamic values and morality as the ultimate orientation of education. In the learning process, teachers should function as murabbi, facilitators, curators, and validators of knowledge, while students should be positioned as critical and reflective subjects. Thus, AI should not replace human scholarly authority but should function as an epistemic instrument whose use requires verification, reflection, and ethical consideration. This model emphasizes that the ultimate goal of Islamic Religious Education in the AI era is not merely to produce students who are technologically capable, but learners who can transform knowledge into awareness, responsible action, and moral character.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献综述方式，考察人工智能时代伊斯兰宗教教育面临的认识论问题，并尝试提出重构方案。作者梳理相关学术文献后指出，传统认识论在应对认识权威转移、算法偏见、错误信息以及将知识简化为可计算信息等方面存在明显局限，因此主张以启示为规范基础、理性与经验为认识工具、人工智能为辅助性认识工具、伊斯兰价值与道德为最终取向的整合—转化范式。文章还强调教师应承担引导者、促进者、知识筛选者与验证者等角色，学生应成为批判反思的主体，人工智能不能取代人的学术权威，其使用需要验证、反思与伦理考量。

papers.title: ChatGPT as a Shopping Assistant: Effects of Perceived Ease of Use, Perceived Usefulness, Anthropomorphism, and Navigation on Satisfaction and Purchase Intention
papers.authors: Acep Rifki Permana, Muhammad Raihan Suprapto, Mukri Hidayatullah, Fatik Rahayu
papers.journal: Golden Ratio of Mapping Idea and Literature Format
papers.abstract: In the context of ChatGPT as a shopping assistant in Indonesia, this research investigates the correlations between satisfaction and factors such as perceived utility, anthropomorphism, ease of use, and navigation, as well as the link between satisfaction and buy intention. Using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), the research takes into account functional perceptions in addition to conversational AI's human-like and interaction-related traits. The data were analysed using structural equation modelling (SEM) with AMOS from a quantitative, cross-sectional survey that was administered to 200 participants. The findings show that elements such as perceived utility, anthropomorphism, and navigation are positively and substantially linked to satisfaction. There is a positive correlation between perceived ease of use and satisfaction, however the link is not statistically significant (β = 0.135, p = 0.063). Having a positive and substantial association with purchase intention (β = 0.537, p < 0.001) constitutes satisfaction. It turns out that four out of five possibilities are correct. According to the results, in this particular sample, features connected to interactions and practical utility are linked to satisfaction, although simplicity of use by itself does not show any statistical significance. Caution is required due to the study's cross-sectional methodology and conflicting model-fit results, but it does expand the applicability of TAM to conversational shopping help in Indonesia.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以技术接受模型为框架，考察在印度尼西亚将ChatGPT用作购物助手时，感知有用性、拟人化、感知易用性和导航与满意度之间的关联，以及满意度与购买意愿的关系；研究采用横断面问卷调查，并用结构方程模型分析数据。结果显示，感知有用性、拟人化和导航与满意度呈显著正相关，而感知易用性与满意度的关联未达统计显著；满意度则与购买意愿呈显著正相关。作者据此认为，在该样本中，互动相关特征和实用效用与满意度相关，但易用性本身未显现统计显著性，并提示横断面设计与模型拟合结果存在矛盾，解读时需谨慎。

papers.title: Introducing the International Learning Commons of the People: Free Learning, Shared Knowledge and Educational Solidarity
papers.authors: Theodor-Nicolae Carp
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract Education is simultaneously a human right, a public institution and one of the principal means through which individuals gain the knowledge required to participate in social, scientific, economic and democratic life. Yet access to educational opportunities remains profoundly unequal. Although public schooling in France is free and compulsory instruction applies from ages three to sixteen, some private and international educational alternatives charge annual tuition fees reaching tens of thousands of euros. At the same time, pupils, teachers and parents in France have mobilised during the autumn of 2026 around concerns including teacher shortages, overcrowded classrooms, deteriorating school buildings and wider pressures on public services. This perspective paper introduces The International Learning Commons of the People, a free-access educational initiative and partner of the School of Consent and Platonic Connection (SCPC). The Commons seeks to make learning materials, introductory courses, scholarly resources and opportunities for self-directed study available without tuition fees or compulsory registration. The paper also situates the Commons within a broader hypothesis concerning democratic participation. Contemporary societies may be entering a period in which representative democracy is increasingly supplemented by more continuous forms of civic participation, deliberation and public scrutiny. Citizens’ assemblies, participatory budgeting, digital consultation, open knowledge infrastructures and emerging public-interest applications of artificial intelligence may increase the practical capacity of people to contribute to collective decision-making between elections. This paper does not claim that such a transition is inevitable, nor that current European unrest constitutes a revolution. It proposes instead that the possibility of a gradual movement from low-frequency representation toward higher-bandwidth participatory democracy deserves serious interdisciplinary investigation, and that free access to knowledge may form part of the educational infrastructure required for such participation. The project does not propose digital learning as a substitute for schools, teachers, universities or accredited education. Rather, it advances a complementary principle: where knowledge can responsibly be shared without charge, unnecessary financial barriers to learning should be reduced. The Commons is situated within the broader traditions of public education, open learning and educational commons. It is presented in solidarity with pupils, educators and families peacefully seeking adequate and equitable educational conditions in France and elsewhere, and as an invitation to academics, researchers and educators to scrutinise, improve and contribute to an emerging public learning resource. The International Learning Commons of the PeopleLe Commun International d’Apprentissage PopulaireA partner of the School of Consent and Platonic Connection (SCPC) The novel Learning Commons of the People platform was carefully developed with the assistance of OpenAI’s ChatGPT-6 Codex models and is available in the Learning Commons section of the following web platform: https://scpc-relational-literacy.useratlantic.chatgpt.site/
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇视角论文，提出名为“人民国际学习公地”的免费开放教育倡议，主张在不收学费、不强制注册的前提下提供学习材料、入门课程与学术资源，作为学校、教师和正规教育的补充而非替代。作者将其置于代议民主可能逐步补充以更持续公民参与（如公民大会、参与式预算、数字协商和公益人工智能应用）的假设之下，认为免费知识获取可构成这类参与所需的教育基础设施，但明确不宣称这一转变必然发生，也不把当前欧洲的社会动荡定性为革命。文章还交代该平台借助OpenAI的ChatGPT-6 Codex模型开发，并邀请学界审视与共建。

papers.title: Relational Echo Calculus (REC): A Transformation-First Mathematical Communication Prototype
papers.authors: Deonte Watts
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: We propose a transformation-first teaching notation for mathematical communication to unfamiliar receivers. The prototype operates on finite motifs drawn from the vertices of a Hamming hypercube. Echo operations act through coordinate permutations and binary translations. We distinguish invariance of a coarse signature from proof of exact orbit equivalence, exhibiting two four-dimensional patterns that have equal pairwise-distance multisets but different induced adjacency. A synthetic toy decoder reconstructs arbitrary token meanings when its complete transformation hypothesis class is supplied. The main testable conjecture is that instruction ordered by invariance might improve cross-agent decoding over instruction ordered by arithmetic under matched information budgets. The conjecture has not been experimentally evaluated; no new extraterrestrial signal or new mathematical theorem is claimed. Status: exploratory design, version 0.1, 21 October 2026; originality not established; user-directed, AI-assisted drafting and implementation. Exact toy checks run; planned H1/H2/H3 cross-agent experiments NOT RUN. Source: the author's iCloud Recents (files dated 2026-10-21), downloaded 2026-10-22; published on Zenodo per the author's standing approval to publish all of his research, including items marked confidential/proprietary. The PDF is byte-identical to the package's main.pdf. Note on blinding: the research package includes experiments/answer_key_private.json and experiments/symbol_key_private.json, which the author's README says must not be shown to evaluators. They are published here as part of the unmodified package; future blinded H1/H2/H3 runs should use freshly generated, unpublished keys. IETF status: converted by the author's assistant into the RFCXML v3 Internet-Draft draft-watts-relational-echo-calculus-00 (intended status Informational), validated with xml2rfc 3.34.1 (no errors or warnings) and idnits 3 (0 errors, 0 warnings; 1 comment for the non-ASCII author name). Submitted to the IETF Datatracker on 2026-10-22 as submission 170761 (status); it is awaiting the author's email confirmation and is not posted until confirmed. Internet-Drafts are works in progress, not IETF standards. The I-D text is a faithful conversion of the paper (math rendered as plain text; the figure described in prose); the confidentiality handling label was left out of the I-D because it cannot carry one under BCP 78, and IANA/Security Considerations sections were added. License: the research package's own LICENSE file is retained unchanged (it carries the author's 'CONFIDENTIAL — PROPRIETARY' handling label and reserves rights; the author has since approved open publication). No Creative Commons license is granted; the Zenodo license field ('other open') refers to these terms. The attached Internet-Draft files (.xml, .txt, .pdf named draft-watts-*) are subject to BCP 78 and the IETF Trust's Legal Provisions Relating to IETF Documents (https://trustee.ietf.org/license-info).
