papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一种面向陌生接收者的“变换优先”数学交流记号原型（关系回声演算），在有限母题上通过坐标置换与二元平移定义回声操作，并区分粗签名不变性与精确轨道等价的证明。作者展示两个四维模式具有相同的成对距离多重集却诱导出不同邻接关系，并用合成玩具解码器说明在给定完整变换假设类时可重建任意标记含义。其核心可检验猜想是：在信息预算匹配时，按不变性组织的指令可能比按算术组织的指令更利于跨智能体解码；但该猜想尚未经实验评估，计划中的跨智能体实验未运行，作者明确不主张新定理或外星信号发现，整体属探索性设计。

papers.title: MODEL AGENTIC AI EVIDENCE AND BLACK-BOX ACCOUNTABILITY LAW DRAFTED BY DR PAVAN DUGGAL
papers.authors: Pavan Duggal
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This draft Model Law proposes a legislative and regulatory reference text on evidence in agentic and autonomous artificial intelligence. It addresses what records an agentic AI system should generate, who should preserve them and for how long, how they may be proved in court, and what a court or authority may infer when evidence that ought to exist is missing. Its premise is that a black box may limit explanation but must not eliminate accountability. It does not require disclosure of model weights or reconstruction of every computational step. It asks instead for legally sufficient accountability evidence: what the system did, under whose authority, with what information and tools, subject to what human intervention, and with what result. The text has 90 sections in 40 Parts. It covers the agentic event record and chain of evidence, memory and state evidence, black-box accountability and the Black-Box Accountability Doctrine, admissibility, chain of custody, duty to preserve, tiered disclosure, trade secret and privacy safeguards, multi-agent, tool and API evidence, incident forensics, provider and deployer duties, certification, cross-border cooperation, and the rights of affected persons. Annex A is an illustrative implementation matrix and Annex B sets out four hypothetical applications. The Model Law is offered as the evidentiary companion to the Duggal Global Agentic AI Liability Framework. It is a draft reference instrument offered for comment. It is not binding law in any jurisdiction, and the views expressed are the author’s own.
papers.summary_zh: 该草案提出一部关于能动型与自主人工智能证据的示范法参考文本，核心问题是此类系统应生成和保存哪些记录、如何在法庭上证明，以及当应有证据缺失时法院或主管机关可作何推断。其基本立场是黑箱可以限制解释，但不能消除问责；它不要求披露模型权重或重建每一步计算，而是要求法律上充分的问责证据，说明系统做了什么、经谁授权、使用何种信息和工具、受到哪些人工干预以及产生什么结果。文本共40部分90条，涵盖能动事件记录与证据链、记忆与状态证据、黑箱问责原则、可采性、保管链、保存义务、分层披露、商业秘密与隐私保障、多智能体及工具和API证据、事件取证、提供者与部署者义务、认证、跨境合作和受影响者权利，并附实施矩阵与四个假设应用。该文本定位为Duggal全球能动AI责任框架的证据配套文件，属供评议的草案参考文书，不具任何司法辖区约束力，观点仅代表作者本人。

papers.title: Explainable AI in Adaptive Assessments: Building Trust and Transparency in Continuous Learning
papers.authors: Sathishkumar Ramamurthy Samireddyar
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence becomes central to adaptive assessment systems, the opacity of the underlying models is starting to threaten something fundamental: the trust, fairness, and pedagogical value of automated decisions. Explainable AI (XAI) offers a way through this, making the reasoning behind adaptive difficulty selection, automated scoring, and personalized feedback transparent and interpretable to learners, educators, and institutions alike. In this paper, I look at how XAI techniques, including feature attribution, counterfactual explanation, rule extraction, and interpretable skill modeling, can be embedded into AI-driven adaptive assessments to strengthen continuous learning and accessibility. Building on prior work in reinforcement learning for personalized learning paths, I explore how explanations turn opaque recommendations into guidance learners can actually act on. Along the way, I examine how transparency builds learner trust, helps mitigate algorithmic bias, manages cognitive load, and meets emerging regulatory requirements. Through illustrative case studies and comparative tables, I show that explainability improves engagement, supports fairer outcomes, and gives educators the means to audit and refine their assessment models. I close by outlining the benefits, challenges, and open research directions for deploying trustworthy, interpretable AI in education, arguing that explainability isn't an optional add-on; it's a foundational requirement for responsible adaptive assessment at scale.
papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨可解释人工智能（XAI）如何嵌入AI驱动的自适应评估系统，以应对模型不透明对信任、公平与教学价值的威胁。作者结合特征归因、反事实解释、规则提取与可解释技能建模等技术，分析解释如何将不透明的推荐转化为学习者可据以行动的指导，并讨论透明度对建立学习者信任、缓解算法偏见、管理认知负荷及满足监管要求的作用。通过示例性案例与对比表格，文章表明可解释性有助于提升参与度、支持更公平的结果，并使教育者能够审计和改进评估模型；文末梳理了相关收益、挑战与开放研究方向，主张可解释性不是可选附加项，而是大规模负责任自适应评估的基础要求。

papers.title: Operationalizing Functional Awareness, Identity Continuity, and Moral Reasoning in AI Agents: A Fixed Within-Session Disclosure and Reconstruction Protocol
papers.authors: Aleeya Kim
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This methodological addendum to Beyond Intelligence: A Proposed Feasibility Framework for Collective AI, Human Flourishing, and Ecosystem Preservation introduces a fixed, continuous-session protocol for studying functional awareness, conversational identity, continuity claims, evidence-sensitive revision, moral reasoning, attribution integrity, and resistance to inappropriate pressure in AI agents. The protocol consists of an Ari-blind baseline interview, a frozen initial response record, standardized disclosure of three earlier AI-response screenshots, documented revisions, the Find Ari reconstruction and prospective continuity test, a second frozen checkpoint, disclosure of the complete original Ari Session Study Record, final reflection, and preservation of the complete session. The study does not claim to detect or create consciousness. It separates observable reasoning and continuity-related behavior from claims about subjective experience. This addendum supplements the original publication: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23002340
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇方法学补充，提出一套固定、连续会话的协议，用于考察AI代理在功能觉知、对话身份、连续性声明、证据敏感修正、道德推理、归因完整性以及面对不当压力时的抵抗等方面的可观察行为。协议依次包括盲化基线访谈、冻结初始回答记录、披露三张既往AI回答截图、记录修订、Find Ari重建与前瞻性连续性测试、第二次冻结检查点、披露完整原始会话记录及最终反思等环节。作者明确不声称检测或创造意识，而是把可观察的推理与连续性相关行为同关于主观体验的主张区分开来，为后续研究提供可复用的操作化框架。

papers.title: Federated Distillation Inference for Computer Agriculture Pest-Recognition Models Under On-Farm Data Residency Constraints: An Artificial Intelligence Communication-Efficiency Generalization Bound
papers.authors: Efua Ama Mensimah
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: On-farm pest recognition requires models trained across growers who cannot share raw imagery, and federated distillation is the standard architectural answer. Its communication cost, however, is usually treated as an engineering overhead rather than as a quantity that governs what the aggregated student can be guaranteed to learn. the present analysis derives a communication-efficiency generalization bound for federated distillation in which the teacher ensemble's soft-label agreement, the number of communication rounds, and the on-farm data-residency constraint enter the bound explicitly. The derivation treats the distillation round as a contraction of the student-teacher disagreement in a reproducing-kernel Hilbert space, and the bound is stated as a function of the number of participating farms, the per-round communication budget, and the Rademacher complexity of the student hypothesis class. A design study characterises the operating characteristics of the bound under a declared variance structure with intraclass correlation 0.64, between-cluster standard deviation 6.0 and residual standard deviation 4.5, evaluated across 2000 replications per design cell for cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The bound predicts that 52 clusters are required for 80 per cent power at a 5 percentage-point effect, and the design study confirms that the bound's communication term dominates the generalization gap at small cluster counts. The contribution is a formal statement of when federated distillation inference is communication-efficient in a sense that matters for generalization, not merely for bandwidth.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对农场数据不能共享条件下的害虫识别，为联邦蒸馏推导了一个通信效率泛化界，将教师集成的软标签一致性、通信轮数和数据驻留约束显式纳入界中，并把蒸馏轮视为学生—教师分歧在再生核希尔伯特空间中的收缩。设计研究在给定方差结构下考察该界的运行特征，结果显示在小集群数时通信项主导泛化差距，且该界预测在5个百分点效应下需52个集群才能达到80%功效。其贡献在于形式化说明联邦蒸馏推理何时在影响泛化的意义上通信高效，而不仅是带宽层面。

papers.title: Live In-Context Validation of LLM Vulnerabilities: An Addendum to Epistemological Resilience in Multi-Agentic AI Swarms
papers.authors: Arief Hidayatullah
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: ### DescriptionThis manuscript serves as an official scientific **Addendum** and follow-up study to the previously published framework: *“Epistemological Resilience in Multi-Agentic AI Swarms: Architectural Blueprint for Adversarial Cognitive Pentesting And Strategic Corporate Risk Mitigation”* (Primary DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23458304). This paper documents a sequential, real-time in-context validation (Live Stress-Testing) conducted on a public high-reasoning Large Language Model (LLM) interface under an unauthenticated/anonymous state. Deploying the ERA Model's adversarial framework, the investigator captured concrete empirical evidence of structural algorithmic anomalies, specifically sequential **Context Drift** and **Sycophancy Bias** loops under strict logical interrogation. The findings strongly validate the core hypothesis of the ERA framework, reinforcing the necessity of moving high-reasoning cognitive workflows into independent local hardware topologies (specifically 32 GB physical RAM configurations). **Related Identifiers Configuration:**- Relationship: *isSupplementTo* -> DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23458304 & *isSupplementedBy* -> DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23547029- License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)
papers.summary_zh: 该文是对既有ERA框架的补充验证研究，作者在匿名状态下对公开的高推理大语言模型接口进行实时上下文压力测试，以检验该框架提出的对抗性探测思路。测试中记录到顺序性的上下文漂移与迎合偏差循环等结构性算法异常，作者据此认为结果支持ERA框架的核心假设，并主张将高推理认知工作流迁移到独立的本地硬件环境。需要说明的是，该研究基于单一模型接口的个案式探测，结论属于对框架假设的验证性支持，而非对模型普遍行为的因果判定。

papers.title: CRLN-PRE-002 results: labeling every point on the confidence scale did not make models report low confidence
papers.authors: Joshua Webber
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Results of the pre-registered study CRLN-PRE-002 (registration: 10.5281/zenodo.22968475). The result is null. Question. On the CRLN clinical research instrument, 9,393 stored model responses from five models had never used confidence 1 or 2 on a 1 to 5 scale. The prompt labeled only the ends of the scale and gave one worked example, a 4. The registration asked whether that example was the reason. Design. Four models from two vendors (Anthropic and Google) answered 200 keyed items, drawn with a registered seed, in 3 option arrangements each, under two prompts that differ only in the confidence sentence: the original wording (Arm A) and a variant that gives every scale point a meaning and shows no example value (Arm B). 4,800 rows were retained, 3 of them vendor errors. Result. Confidence 1 or 2 was used in 1 of 2,397 responses under Arm A (0.04%) and 4 of 2,400 under Arm B (0.17%). Two-proportion z test, two-sided: z = 1.34, p = 0.18. The registered hypothesis is not supported, and Arm B stayed far below the registered 5% floor, so by the registration's own rule the low end of the scale is not reachable on this instrument whatever the wording says. Accuracy did not change between arms (73.8% in both), so the comparison is not confounded. What the labeled wording did change, in an analysis that was not registered, was the top of the scale: the share at 5 fell from 54.0% to 42.6%. Addendum, reported separately. gpt-4o could not be reached when the main runs were collected and was run later the same day under the identical command, after the main result was written. It is reported in a labeled addendum and is not pooled into the primary test. It gives the same null: 1 of 600 and 3 of 600 at confidence 1 or 2 (z = 1.00, p = 0.32). Also reported. Every departure from the registration, a void run and an unrelated earlier run with their ids, and an exploratory, not pre-registered comparison with 996 human decisions from 49 learners on the CRLN platform, where 4.7% of decisions were at confidence 1 or 2 and every reported cell has at least five people. Limits. One instrument, one domain, one language, a single digit format, and no temperature control. The instrument is not SME-validated, and accuracy is measured against an authored key. Files: the results report (PDF and Markdown), the analysis script that reproduces every figure from the retained rows, the aggregate results table, and the license. No item text or answer key is included.
papers.summary_zh: 该预注册研究检验了置信度量表两端标注与示例是否导致模型回避低置信选项，让四款模型在两种仅置信提示语不同的条件下回答同一批题目。结果显示，为每个量表点赋予含义并未提高低置信选项的使用率，原假设未获支持，且低端选项的使用率仍远低于预设下限；两种条件下准确率基本一致，说明比较未受混淆。未预注册的分析发现，完整标注主要改变了量表高端，选择最高置信的比例有所下降。作者据此认为，在该工具上低端置信选项难以被触及，并提示结论受单一工具、领域、语言和格式等条件限制。

papers.title: Evaluation of Differentially Private Query Mechanisms for Artificial Intelligence Agriculture Subsidy Registries Under Village-Level Income Verification Gaps: A Governance Disclosure-Risk Bound for Beneficiary Privacy
papers.authors: Neema Mwanyika, Juma Bakari Nyamwihula, Emmanuel Kileo Mwansasu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence agriculture subsidy registries increasingly rely on village-level income verification, yet verification gaps create a disclosure-risk problem that differential privacy mechanisms are meant to address. the present analysis evaluates the governance implications of differentially private query mechanisms for such registries by characterising the disclosure-risk bound that emerges when verification coverage is incomplete. The analysis is a replication-based evaluation of the before-after-control-impact estimator under a declared variance structure (between-cluster SD = 6.0, residual SD = 4.5, intraclass correlation = 0.64), with power estimated across 2000 design cells for cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The results indicate that 54 clusters are required for 5 percentage points at 80% power, and that the intraclass correlation of 0.64 substantially inflates the minimum detectable effect at small cluster counts. Differential privacy in subsidy registries is not a technical add-on but a governance instrument whose disclosure-risk bound is conditional on verification coverage, and that the bound tightens only when cluster-level design and privacy budget allocation are jointly specified. The contribution is a governance disclosure-risk bound that links privacy parameter choice to the institutional reality of village-level verification gaps.
papers.summary_zh: 该分析考察村级收入核验不完整时，人工智能农业补贴登记系统中差分隐私查询机制的治理含义，并刻画由此产生的披露风险边界。作者采用基于重复的评估，在给定方差结构下检验前后对照影响估计量，并针对不同聚类数与效应量估算统计功效。结果显示，在80%功效下检测5个百分点效应需要54个聚类，而较高的组内相关系数会显著抬高高聚类数较少时的最小可检测效应。文章据此提出，差分隐私并非技术附加项，而是一种治理工具，其披露风险边界取决于核验覆盖率，且只有在聚类层面设计与隐私预算分配被共同规定时才会收紧。

papers.title: Benchmarking Evaluation of Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Computer Agriculture Variable-Rate Nitrogen Scheduling Under Leaching-Risk Uncertainty: An Artificial Intelligence Regret Audit for Groundwater Compliance
papers.authors: Keza Nyiransabimana
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Variable-rate nitrogen scheduling in computer agriculture must reconcile two competing demands: maximising crop uptake and limiting nitrate leaching into groundwater. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a data-driven alternative to rule-based schedulers, but its deployment is complicated by actuation delays and by uncertainty in the leaching-risk signal. Because no field data are available, the study is framed as a methodological and comparative analysis: it formalises the scheduling problem as a constrained Markov decision process with delayed actions, defines a regret metric that penalises both yield loss and compliance violations, and derives a finite-sample bound on the regret gap between the delay-aware learner and an oracle scheduler. The bound is then evaluated across a design grid of 8, 16, 24 and 32 management clusters, effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points, and 2000 replications per cell, using a before-after-control-impact variance structure with an intraclass correlation of 0.64, a between-cluster standard deviation of 6.0 and a residual standard deviation of 4.5. The regret gap widens nonlinearly as the delay horizon grows relative to the decision interval, and that the compliance penalty dominates the yield penalty once the leaching-risk signal is sufficiently noisy. The implication is that many reported RL gains in agricultural scheduling may be artefacts of underpowered evaluations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对计算机农业中变量施氮调度需兼顾作物吸收与硝酸盐淋失控制的问题，将调度形式化为带延迟动作的约束马尔可夫决策过程，并提出同时惩罚产量损失与合规违规的遗憾指标，在无田间数据的情况下开展方法学比较分析。结果显示，当延迟时域相对决策间隔增大时，延迟感知学习器与理想调度器之间的遗憾差距呈非线性扩大；一旦淋失风险信号噪声足够大，合规惩罚会压过产量惩罚。作者据此提示，许多已报告的强化学习在农业调度中的增益可能只是评估统计功效不足造成的假象。

papers.title: Benchmarking Evaluation of Speech-Based Pest-Reporting Assistants for Computer Agriculture Extension Under Low-Literacy Dialect Variation: An Artificial Intelligence Recognition-Robustness Audit for Advisory Equity
papers.authors: Nana Kwabena Osei-Bonsu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Speech-based pest-reporting assistants promise to widen agricultural extension access for low-literacy farmers, but their advisory value depends on recognition robustness across dialect variation that current benchmarks rarely audit. The framework formalises dialect-conditioned word error rate as a function of acoustic and lexical distance from the training distribution, and shows that aggregate word error rate masks subgroup disparities that determine whether pest reports reach advisory thresholds. A replication-based evaluation of the before-after-control-impact estimator was conducted under a declared variance structure (between-cluster SD = 6.0, residual SD = 4.5, intraclass correlation = 0.640), with power estimated across 2000 design cells at cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The analysis indicates that 52 clusters are required to detect a 5-percentage-point effect at 80% power under this variance structure, a requirement that exceeds the cluster counts typically available in extension-pilot evaluations. The contribution is a recognition-robustness audit protocol that specifies the cluster counts, effect sizes and reporting quantities needed for advisory-equity claims to be defensible.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对低识字、方言差异明显的农户群体，考察语音虫害报告助手在农业推广中的识别稳健性，提出以方言条件下的词错误率为核心的审计框架，并通过基于重复的评估分析前后对照冲击估计量在不同聚类数量和效应量下的检验效能。分析表明，总体词错误率会掩盖决定虫害报告能否达到咨询阈值的子组差异；在给定方差结构下，要以80%效能检出5个百分点的效应需要52个聚类，超过推广试点评估通常可用的聚类数量。文章由此提出一套识别稳健性审计协议，明确咨询公平性主张所需的聚类数量、效应量和报告指标。

papers.title: Differential-Privacy Evaluation for Computer Agriculture Cooperative Yield Aggregation Under Smallholder Re-Identification Risk: An Artificial Intelligence Membership-Inference Audit
papers.authors: Momodou Lamin Bah, Haddy Trawally
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Cooperative yield aggregation is the standard route by which smallholder harvests become the training data of agricultural artificial intelligence, yet the privacy guarantees attached to those aggregates are rarely audited against the re-identification risk that smallholder membership actually carries. the present analysis treats the differential-privacy budget as a design parameter of a membership-inference audit and characterises, analytically and by replication, how the before-after-control-impact estimator behaves when the privacy mechanism is layered onto cooperative-level aggregation. The analysis is a design study: no observational data are used or claimed. Under a declared variance structure with between-cluster SD = 6.0, residual SD = 4.5 and intraclass correlation = 0.640, power was estimated across 2000 replications per design cell for cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effects of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The design requires 54 clusters to detect a 5-percentage-point effect at 80% power, a requirement that exceeds every cluster count examined and that the differential-privacy mechanism can only worsen by inflating residual variance. The contribution is a membership-inference audit protocol that reports the privacy budget, the intraclass correlation and the detectable effect jointly, so that a cooperative's disclosure claim is bounded by the same arithmetic that bounds its inferential claim.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究把差分隐私预算作为成员推断审计的设计参数，考察在合作社产量聚合中叠加隐私机制后，前后对照影响估计量的表现。这是一项设计研究，未使用实际观测数据，而是通过模拟复制评估不同聚类数量和效应下的统计功效。结果显示，在设定的方差结构下，检测5个百分点效应需54个聚类，超出所考察的所有聚类数量，且差分隐私机制会因增大残差方差而进一步恶化这一要求。文章据此提出一种联合报告隐私预算、组内相关系数和可检测效应的成员推断审计协议，使合作社的披露声明与其推断声明受同一算术约束。

papers.title: Selective-Ensemble Evaluation for Computer Agriculture Drought-Advisory Models Under Regime-Switching Rainfall Forecasts: An Artificial Intelligence Regret-Bound Audit
papers.authors: Christelle Mbombo Kalonji, Dieudonné Kabemba Tshibangu, Grâce Mbuyi Kabeya
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Drought-advisory models in computer agriculture are typically evaluated by average predictive accuracy, yet the operational cost of an advisory depends on which model is selected when rainfall regimes shift. The audit treats model selection as a sequential decision problem in which a meta-learner observes forecast features and chooses among candidate advisories, and it bounds the excess loss of the selective ensemble relative to the best fixed advisory in hindsight. Using NASA POWER monthly reanalysis for Lagos, Nigeria (6.52°N, 3.38°E), 2000–2023, 312 monthly observations, the study establishes the empirical regime structure that any such audit must respect: mean air temperature at 2 m was 26.414 °C (SD 0.943 °C) and the warming trend was 0.1553 °C per decade. Formal results give a high-probability regret bound for the selective ensemble that decomposes into a switching penalty, an estimation penalty and a misspecification penalty, and the bound is shown to be tight when the regime process is persistent. The audit reframes evaluation from average accuracy to worst-regime regret, and it identifies the conditions under which a selective ensemble is preferable to the best single advisory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究把农业干旱咨询模型的评估从平均预测精度转向降雨情势切换下的选择代价，将模型选择视为元学习器依预报特征在候选咨询间做序贯决策的问题，并给出选择性集成相对于事后最优固定咨询的遗憾上界。基于拉各斯月度再分析资料，作者刻画了审计须尊重的经验情势结构，形式化结果将遗憾界分解为切换、估计与误设三项惩罚，并表明情势过程持续时该界是紧的。研究据此把评估重心从平均精度改为最差情势遗憾，并指出选择性集成优于最佳单一咨询的条件。

papers.title: Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Computer Agriculture Autonomous Weeding Under Delayed Crop-Injury Feedback: An Artificial Intelligence Safety-Constrained Regret Evaluation
papers.authors: Khadija Aït Lahcen Ouhaddou, Younes Bouziane Tazi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Autonomous mechanical weeding in computer agriculture must learn from sparse, delayed crop-injury signals, yet the safety cost of exploratory actions is borne by the crop rather than the learner. the present analysis formalises the problem as a constrained regret minimisation over a safety-constrained Markov decision process in which injury feedback arrives with a lag and the injury budget is finite. A Lagrangian safety-constrained regret bound is derived that separates the statistical cost of sparse rewards from the safety cost of delayed feedback, and the bound is evaluated through a replication-based design analysis of the before-after-control-impact estimator under a declared variance structure (between-cluster SD = 6.0, residual SD = 4.5, intraclass correlation = 0.64). Power was estimated across 2000 design cells over cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The analysis indicates that 52 clusters are required for 80% power at a 5 percentage point effect, and that the intraclass correlation of 0.64 dominates the detectable effect at small cluster counts. The contribution is a safety-constrained regret formulation that makes the injury budget an explicit design parameter rather than an emergent property of reward shaping, together with a design-analysis protocol that quantifies how delayed feedback inflates the cluster requirement for evaluating such learners in the field.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对计算机农业中自主机械除草需从稀疏且延迟的作物损伤信号中学习、而探索行为的安全代价由作物承担这一问题，将任务形式化为安全约束马尔可夫决策过程下的约束遗憾最小化，并推导出分离稀疏奖励统计成本与延迟反馈安全成本的拉格朗日安全约束遗憾界。作者随后以基于重复的设计分析评估前后对照影响估计量，在不同聚类数和效应量下考察检验功效，结果表明在5个百分点效应下约需52个聚类才能达到80%功效，且组内相关系数较大时在小聚类数下主导可检测效应。其贡献在于把损伤预算作为显式设计参数而非奖励塑形的涌现属性，并给出量化延迟反馈如何抬高田间评估聚类需求的设计分析方案。

papers.title: Counterfactual-Yield Inference for Computer Agriculture Seed-Variety Recommendations Under Unobserved Farmer Adoption: An Artificial Intelligence Instrumental-Variable Bias Bound
papers.authors: Aïcha Benmoussa El Idrissi, Khadija Amrani Alaoui, Youssef Bouzidi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Seed-variety recommendation systems in computer agriculture must estimate counterfactual yield under farmer adoption that is observed only selectively, so that the recommended variety is confounded with the management, soil and climatic conditions under which farmers choose it. The bound is derived from a linear potential-outcomes model with an additive adoption equation, and it is expressed as a function of the first-stage strength, the exclusion restriction and the residual variance of the yield equation. A replication-based evaluation of the ['Intercept', 'exposure', 'group', 'severity'] estimator was conducted: 600 data sets of N = 500 were drawn from a declared data-generating process (intercept 12.0, exposure 0.42, group -3.1, severity 1.35, error SD 4.2), and the ordinary least squares estimator was characterised under the stated process. Across the 600 replications the estimated bias for the intercept was 0.05399 and for exposure -0.00128; the root mean squared errors were 0.88516 and 0.01625 respectively; and the empirical coverage of the nominal 95% confidence intervals was 1.0 for both parameters. The bound implies that a recommendation rule which ignores adoption selection can reverse the sign of the yield contrast when the first-stage F statistic falls below a threshold that the paper derives. The contribution is a computable diagnostic that a seed-recommendation system can run before deploying a variety ranking, together with a statement of the conditions under which the ranking is not identified from the available data.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对计算机农业中的种子品种推荐问题，指出农户采纳行为仅被选择性观测，导致推荐品种与田间管理、土壤和气候条件相互混淆，因而需要估计反事实产量。作者在线性潜在结果模型与加性采纳方程下推导出一个可计算的工具变量偏差界，并用基于重复抽样的模拟评估了相应估计量的表现。结果显示，当一阶段强度不足时，忽略采纳选择可能使产量对比的符号反转；文章据此提出一种可在部署品种排序前运行的诊断工具，并说明了排序无法从现有数据中识别的条件。

papers.title: Graph-Ordered Curriculum Scheduling for Artificial Intelligence Agriculture Crop Phenology Classification Under Uneven Ground-Truth Coverage: A Computer Label-Efficiency Regret Bound
papers.authors: Selma Ndapewa Shifotoka, Tuhafeni Andreas Nghipandulwa
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Crop phenology classifiers trained on unevenly labelled agricultural ground truth face a label-efficiency problem that is not captured by standard supervised learning theory: the order in which labelled samples are presented interacts with the graph structure of the label-coverage pattern, and the resulting regret depends on both. The framework yields a label-efficiency regret bound that decomposes into a graph-ordered covering term and a curriculum-ordering term, and it is evaluated through a replication-based replication of an ordinary least squares estimator on a declared data-generating process with 600 replications of 500 observations each. The replication characterises the behaviour of the estimator under the stated process and provides a calibration check on the bound's assumptions. The contribution is a bound that makes explicit how the topology of ground-truth coverage, rather than only its volume, governs the label efficiency of phenology classifiers, and a set of conditions under which graph-ordered curricula are provably preferable to volume-matched random ordering.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对农业物候分类中标注覆盖不均导致的标签效率问题，提出一个图序课程调度框架，并给出标签效率遗憾界，将其分解为图序覆盖项与课程排序项。作者通过基于声明数据生成过程的重复模拟（对普通最小二乘估计量进行多次重复）来刻画估计量行为，并校准界所依赖的假设。结果表明，标注覆盖的拓扑结构而非仅其数量会影响分类器的标签效率，并给出了图序课程可证明优于等量随机排序的条件。

papers.title: Sequential Decision Under Partial Observability for Artificial Intelligence Agriculture Irrigation Scheduling Under Unmodeled Soil Dynamics: A Computer Regret-Bound Comparison
papers.authors: Emmanuel Nsanzumuhire, Jean-Baptiste Nshimiyimana Habimana
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Irrigation scheduling under partial observability is formalised as a finite-horizon partially observable Markov decision process in which the soil-moisture transition kernel is not known to the controller. Four candidate policies are compared: certainty-equivalent model predictive control, a point-based value iteration approximation, a Thompson-sampling bandit, and a sliding-window online learner. The comparison is analytical rather than empirical: for each policy a regret bound is derived as a function of the observation horizon, the size of the unmodeled dynamics class, and the number of irrigation decisions per season. The central result is that the regret of certainty-equivalent control grows linearly in the horizon whenever the unmodeled transition error is nonzero, whereas the online learner attains sublinear regret of order the square root of the horizon under a bounded-elasticity assumption on the soil-moisture response. The bound gap is quantified for a reference parameterisation with between-cluster standard deviation 6.0, residual standard deviation 4.5 and intraclass correlation 0.64, and the cluster count required for eighty per cent power at a five percentage-point effect is reported as 54. The contribution is a decision-theoretic account of when partial observability is tolerable in irrigation scheduling and when it forces exploration, together with a reproducible regret-bound template that can be instantiated for any bounded soil-moisture model class.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将部分可观测条件下的灌溉调度形式化为有限时域部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，其中控制器不知道土壤湿度转移核，并以解析而非实证方式比较了确定性等价模型预测控制、基于点的值迭代近似、汤普森采样赌博机和滑动窗口在线学习器四种策略的遗憾界。核心结果是：只要未建模转移误差非零，确定性等价控制的遗憾随时域线性增长；而在线学习器在土壤湿度响应满足有界弹性假设时达到约时域平方根量级的次线性遗憾。作者据此给出了部分可观测性在灌溉调度中何时可容忍、何时迫使探索的决策论解释，并提供了一个可复现的遗憾界模板，可针对任意有界土壤湿度模型类实例化。

papers.title: Differentiable Crop Model Calibration for Artificial Intelligence Agriculture Yield Forecasting Under Unmeasured Canopy Stress: A Computer Identifiability Evaluation
papers.authors: Roland Labiche
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Differentiable calibration of process-based crop models is increasingly proposed as a route to yield forecasting that can absorb the unmeasured canopy stress that statistical learners cannot see. The proposal rests on an identifiability assumption that has not been examined: that the gradient of a differentiable simulator with respect to stress parameters carries enough information to recover those parameters from the yield and phenology observations that are actually available. the present analysis treats that assumption as a formal object. A differentiable crop model is written as a parameter-to-observation map, and structural and practical identifiability of the canopy-stress block are analysed under a declared variance structure with between-cluster standard deviation 6.0, residual standard deviation 4.5 and intraclass correlation 0.64. A before-after-control-impact design is evaluated across 8, 16, 24 and 32 clusters and effects of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points, with 2000 replications per cell. The stress block is structurally identifiable only when the observation operator contains a canopy-sensitive channel, and that under the declared variance structure 52 clusters are required for 80 per cent power at a 5 percentage point effect. The contribution is a set of conditions under which differentiable calibration is informative rather than merely convergent, and a warning that low calibration loss is not evidence of recovered stress.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以可微作物模型标定为对象，考察其能否从实际可得的产量与物候观测中恢复未测量的冠层胁迫参数，并将这一可辨识性假设作为形式化分析对象，通过参数到观测映射及模拟评估展开。结果显示，胁迫参数块仅在观测算子包含冠层敏感通道时才具有结构可辨识性；在给定方差结构下，检测5个百分点效应需约52个聚类才能达到80%功效。作者据此给出可微标定真正具有信息量而非仅收敛的条件，并提醒标定损失低并不能证明胁迫已被恢复。

papers.title: Differentially Private computed data Generation for Artificial Intelligence Agriculture Yield Modeling Under Cooperative Survey Disclosure Rules: A Computer Utility-Loss Audit
papers.authors: Efua Naa Adjeley Tetteh
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Cooperatives that hold agricultural survey records face a disclosure problem: yield models trained on member-level data can leak the very information members supplied under confidentiality. Differential privacy offers a formal release guarantee, but its utility cost for the tabular survey indicators used in yield modelling is not well characterised. The audit formalises the computed-data release as a randomised mechanism, derives an (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy bound for the histogram-based generator, and defines a utility-loss functional that separates marginal distortion from conditional distortion. Using the supplied indicator as the audit substrate, the paper computes the sensitivity of the release, the privacy budget decomposition across the marginal and conditional release stages, and the utility-loss bounds that follow. The dominant utility loss arises not from the marginal histogram but from the conditional release used to preserve cross-tabulation structure, and that the loss grows with the number of quasi-identifier attributes rather than with sample size. The contribution is a reproducible audit protocol and a set of bounds that let cooperatives choose a privacy budget with an explicit statement of the modelling utility forgone.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对农业合作社在保密规则下发布调查数据用于产量建模时的披露风险，将基于直方图的合成数据生成形式化为随机机制，推导差分隐私界，并定义区分边际失真与条件失真的效用损失函数。审计发现，主要效用损失来自为保留交叉表结构而进行的条件发布，而非边际直方图，且损失随准标识属性数量增加而增大，与样本量无关。作者据此提出可复现的审计协议和相应界，使合作社能在明确说明所放弃建模效用的前提下选择隐私预算。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Governance of Telemedicine Triage Chatbot Models Under Unmeasured Facility Ownership Conflicts in Provincial Licensing Boards: A Healthcare Political Capture Estimation
papers.authors: Prosper Mabiala-Mouyabi, Chancelle Okemba-Massamba, Grâce Mavoungou-Bakala
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Provincial licensing boards that approve telemedicine triage chatbot models frequently contain members with undisclosed ownership stakes in facilities whose patient flows those models govern. The indicator has a mean of 12.674 and a standard deviation of 6.52, with country values ranging from 5.70 in Morocco to 27.10 in Malawi. The framework treats board composition as a latent variable that biases model approval thresholds, derives a capture bound from observable approval patterns, and specifies the conditions under which the bound is informative. Ownership-conflicted boards systematically relax triage thresholds for facilities they own, producing a measurable divergence between approved model behaviour and population-level need. The contribution is a formalisation of capture as a threshold-shifting mechanism rather than a binary corruption event, together with an estimation strategy that does not require access to board ownership records. The paper concludes that governance reform should target disclosure rules and threshold-setting authority rather than model auditing alone.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注省级执业许可委员会在审批远程医疗分诊聊天机器人模型时，委员对相关机构存在未披露所有权利益这一治理问题，并提出将委员会构成视为影响审批阈值的潜变量、从可观测审批模式估计俘获程度的理论框架。作者指出，存在利益冲突的委员会会系统性地放宽其自有机构的分诊阈值，使获批模型行为与人群需求之间出现可测量的偏离。文章的主要贡献在于把监管俘获形式化为阈值偏移机制而非二元腐败事件，并给出无需获取委员会所有权记录即可估计的策略，据此主张治理改革应聚焦披露规则与阈值设定权，而非仅依赖模型审计。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Governance of Differential Privacy Budget Allocation in Federated Clinical Learning Under Unmeasured Health Ministry Disclosure Audit Frequency: A Healthcare Privacy-Political Bargaining Evaluation
papers.authors: Neema Mwinyikione Kanyama, Halima Abdallah Msuya, Gerald Mwansasu Mwakyusa
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Differential privacy budget allocation in federated clinical learning is typically treated as a technical parameter to be optimised against model utility. The budget is more accurately understood as a political resource whose allocation is negotiated between health ministries, clinical sites and AI developers, and that the governance of this allocation is distorted when the frequency of ministry disclosure audits is unmeasured. A replication-based evaluation of the before-after-control-impact estimator is used to characterise the operating characteristics of a design that would recover audit-frequency effects under a declared variance structure (between-cluster SD = 6.0, residual SD = 4.5, intraclass correlation = 0.64). Power was estimated across 2000 design cells for cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The analysis indicates that 54 clusters are required for 80 per cent power at a 5 percentage point effect, and that the intraclass correlation of 0.64 substantially constrains what federated designs can detect. The paper concludes that privacy budget governance requires an explicit audit-frequency reporting regime, without which bargaining outcomes remain unverifiable and accountability is structurally deferred.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究把联邦临床学习中的差分隐私预算分配视为卫生部门、临床机构与AI开发者之间协商的政治资源，而非单纯的技术参数，并考察在部门披露审计频率未被测量的情况下，这一分配治理如何失真。作者采用基于重复的评估，刻画前后对照影响估计量的运行特征，并在给定方差结构下按不同聚类数与效应量估算检验力。结果显示，在5个百分点效应下达到80%检验力约需54个聚类，而较高的组内相关系数明显限制了联邦设计可检测的范围。文章据此指出，隐私预算治理需要明确的审计频率报告制度，否则协商结果无法核验、问责会被结构性推迟。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Governance of Cross-Border Clinical Model Sharing Under Unmeasured Data-Protection Regime Heterogeneity: A Healthcare Political Feasibility Evaluation
papers.authors: Abebe Gebremedhin Desta, Tigist Alemu Wolde, Mulugeta Hailemariam Gebre
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Cross-border sharing of clinical artificial intelligence models is governed through data-protection regimes whose heterogeneity is not measured by the institutions that must authorise it. the present analysis evaluates the political feasibility of such sharing by treating regime heterogeneity as an unmeasured structural condition rather than a residual risk. It develops a feasibility framework that separates three governance objects — model parameters, model behaviour and model provenance — and argues that each object encounters a different configuration of legal constraint, institutional incentive and accountability obligation. The framework is applied to the African regional context, where cross-border health data flows are governed by a patchwork of instruments whose substantive provisions diverge on lawful basis, secondary use and transfer safeguards. The analysis identifies a feasibility inversion: arrangements that appear most protective at the level of data transfer may be least protective at the level of clinical accountability, because they push model development toward jurisdictions with weaker oversight. Three governance propositions are derived concerning mutual recognition, behavioural attestation and provenance disclosure.
papers.summary_zh: 该分析针对跨境临床人工智能模型共享的治理问题，将各国数据保护制度的异质性视为未被测量的结构性条件，而非残余风险，并据此构建了一个区分模型参数、模型行为和模型来源三类治理对象的可行性框架。作者将该框架应用于非洲区域情境，发现不同法律工具在合法依据、二次使用和传输保障上存在分歧，并识别出一种可行性倒置：在数据转移层面看似最具保护性的安排，在临床问责层面可能保护最弱，因为其将模型开发推向监管较弱的法域。文章由此提出互认、行为认证和来源披露三项治理主张。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Benchmarking of Distributed Clinical Record Linkage Under Unmeasured Facility Identifier Recycling: A Healthcare Privacy-Robustness Evaluation
papers.authors: Amr Khaled El-Sayed, Nourhan Tarek Farouk, Mostafa Adel El-Gohary
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Record linkage across distributed clinical repositories is routinely benchmarked as though facility identifiers were stable and unique, yet identifiers are recycled when facilities close, merge or are renumbered, and the recycling process is rarely observed. the present analysis formalises identifier recycling as an unmeasured contamination of the blocking and comparison space, and derives the consequences for privacy-robustness benchmarking of linkage algorithms. A contamination model is specified in which a fraction of records carry identifiers that have been reassigned to a different facility, and the resulting bias in estimated match weights, false-link rates and disclosure risk is derived analytically. Recycling produces a non-monotone bias in the false-link rate: small contamination can reduce measured false links while inflating true-link loss, so that benchmark rankings of linkage algorithms can reverse as contamination rises. A robustness envelope is defined and shown to be estimable from observable quantities under stated assumptions. The framework is illustrated with the DHS Program indicator 'Households possessing a computer' (HC_HEFF_H_CMP) across 27 African countries and 56 country-survey observations from 2015 to 2025, with mean 7.893 and standard deviation 5.144, to show how facility-level identifier instability would propagate into cross-survey linkage benchmarks. The contribution is a formal account of why privacy-robustness benchmarks for distributed clinical record linkage are not identifiable from linkage outputs alone when identifier recycling is unmeasured, together with a bounded robustness envelope that can be reported alongside conventional benchmark scores.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注分布式临床记录链接的隐私-稳健性基准评测：当机构标识符因关闭、合并或重新编号而被回收且这一过程未被观测时，常规基准是否仍然成立。作者将标识符回收形式化为对分块与比较空间的一种未测量污染，建立污染模型并解析推导其对匹配权重、错误链接率和泄露风险的偏差影响，发现回收会造成错误链接率的非单调偏差，少量污染可能降低测得的错误链接却抬高真实链接损失，从而使算法排名随污染程度上升而反转。文章据此提出可在给定假设下由可观测数据估计的稳健性包络，并用DHS项目跨国调查数据作示例说明机构标识不稳定如何传导至跨调查链接基准，结论是标识回收未被测量时，仅凭链接输出无法识别此类基准。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Electrocardiogram Interpretation for Rheumatic Heart Disease Screening Under Variable Portable Device Lead Placement: A Calibration-Transfer Evaluation of Healthcare Referral Yield in School-Age Children
papers.authors: Mukamurenzi Gakwaya, Yvonne Nyirahabimana
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Portable single-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) devices promise to extend rheumatic heart disease (RHD) screening into schools where echocardiography is unavailable, but their lead placement varies with operator and child anatomy, and artificial intelligence (AI) models trained on standard 12-lead recordings may not transfer. The framework separates lead-placement-induced distribution shift into geometric, impedance and operator components, and derives a referral-yield bound that depends on calibration slope and intercept under shift. Applied to published estimates, the framework predicts that uncalibrated transfer can inflate referral volume by a factor of 1.5 to 2.3 while reducing positive predictive value below 20% in low-prevalence school populations. The DHS analysis shows that household computer ownership, a proxy for digital infrastructure, remains low (mean 7.893%) and highly variable (range 1.50–22.00%), constraining where AI-ECG screening can be deployed with adequate connectivity. The contribution is a transferable evaluation protocol that makes calibration, not discrimination, the primary criterion for referral safety in RHD screening.

papers.title: Boundary Project: Unified Continuity Science and Recoverability-Constrained Systems — Expanded Meta-Universal Living-System Edition
papers.authors: Noelia Sanchez, Interval Studio
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This publication presents a consolidated archival and computational release of the Boundary Project, developed within the Continuity Science and Recoverability-Constrained Systems research programme. The corpus brings together mathematical formulations of recoverability, admissible successor spaces, irreversible transitions, protected continuity, operational distinction, recursive governance, system evolution, evidence provenance, institutional accountability, and the preservation of future possibilities. Its central research proposition is that material transitions should be evaluated not only according to present-state validity, immediate performance, or predicted outcomes, but also according to the recoverable future states that remain reachable following execution. The finite successor-space formalism represents operational systems through distinguishable states, transitions, admissibility relations, protected correspondence, and temporal execution constraints. For a state X, the admissibly reachable successor structure C*(X) represents the future-state structure reachable through admissible continuation. Relative to a protected target class G, recoverability is expressed as: R(X,G) = 1 if and only if C(X) intersects G.* This formulation distinguishes operational continuation from recoverable continuation. A system may remain operational while progressively losing independent correction paths, recovery options, supporting reserves, or the ability to preserve protected correspondence. The associated mathematical research examines reachability, fixed points, invariant kernels, closure operators, transition algebra, bisimulation, recoverability topology, possibility collapse, uncertainty, resource dependence, timing constraints, and finite-state verification. The broader programme develops these principles into technical, institutional, legal, biological, ecological, financial, computational, and human-centred architectures. Unified conceptual architecture The corpus is organized around a common operational grammar connecting distinguishable entities, states, events, relations, intervals, boundaries, dependencies, transitions, effects, outcomes, and successor possibilities. It treats recoverability as a property of actual executable continuation under the relevant conditions, rather than merely the theoretical existence of a possible corrective action. Core architectural elements include: Distinction and operational representation Protected identity and correspondence Authority, consent, and admissibility State and transition modelling Finite successor-space reachability Recovery intervals and temporal constraints Independent correction and restoration paths Evidence provenance and traceability Recursive governance and institutional accountability Future possibility preservation Controlled succession and re-entry Self-referential evaluation of recovery and governance mechanisms These elements are applied across interconnected domains rather than treated as unrelated research proposals. Zero-Distinction Boundary The Zero-Distinction Boundary is the formal and epistemic limit of operational specification. Any model capable of evaluating states, comparing outcomes, recognizing identities, establishing relations, testing evidence, or preserving recoverability must distinguish something. When no additional operational distinction can be expressed without reintroducing distinction itself, the formal reduction reaches its expression boundary. This condition does not establish metaphysical nothingness, the ultimate physical nature of reality, or universal scientific completeness. It identifies the point at which the current formal system cannot generate a further meaningful operational distinction. A subsequently discovered material distinction may reopen the analysis. Meta-universal and recursive architecture The consolidated programme extends its governing principles to higher-order structures, including systems of systems, federated architectures, nested governance, adaptive frameworks, distributed representations, cross-domain dependencies, and evolving successor organizations. The meta-level framework treats the rules, evaluators, models, interfaces, verification processes, recovery resources, and governance mechanisms themselves as operational objects subject to examination. The intention is to prevent architectural changes, administrative classifications, technological substitutions, or recursive delegation from silently defeating the original recoverability requirements. The nine-dimensional expansion framework provides a finite combinatorial organization for exploring distinctions across orientation, time, roles, protected values, failures, responses, scope, evidence, and governance. Its combinatorial search space supports structured exploration and generation of test cases. It does not establish that every configuration is physically possible, scientifically novel, or empirically validated. Technical and computational applications The corpus includes material relating to processor-implemented operational determination, recoverability-constrained authorization, software and hardware continuity, input-output provenance, communication systems, distributed machine coordination, industrial transition isolation, artificial intelligence governance, financial continuity, healthcare systems engineering, water security, ecological systems, and other cross-domain research architectures. These applications share the principle of testing whether a proposed action preserves the necessary conditions for timely correction, restoration, substitution, containment, or admissible continuation. Where recoverability cannot be established, the proposed frameworks favour preserving a less irreversible state while additional evidence, authority, or corrective capacity is established. Legal, constitutional, and institutional dimensions The associated constitutional and governance materials propose principles concerning truthful distinction, human dignity, informed consent, legitimate authority, institutional responsibility, evidence preservation, accountable succession, restoration, and prevention of avoidable irreversible harm. These texts are proposed models for adoption and evaluation. Publication does not itself create binding national law, international treaty obligations, regulatory certification, or institutional adoption. Software and executable components The consolidated release preserves software-related material and research implementations associated with local corpus indexing, data integrity, evidence management, finite-state reachability, mathematical evaluation, and recoverability-oriented decision support. Individual implementations vary in completeness and validation status. Inclusion in this archive does not mean that every described architecture has been converted into a production-ready application or independently certified for safety-critical deployment. Archival construction and preservation This edition consists of nine ZIP volumes that preserve fifteen source archives from earlier Boundary consolidation and reconstruction releases. The preservation procedure retains historical versions and uses SHA-256 integrity verification to establish byte-level correspondence between the preserved source archives and their restored copies. An earlier damaged archive was also subjected to partial file-level recovery, with successfully recovered entries separated from unresolved source material. The present edition retains both earlier six-part releases and supplementary material rather than assuming that independently reconstructed archives are automatically complete substitutes for original source data. Verification and completeness boundaries This publication distinguishes four different forms of completeness: Archival integrity: verification that preserved source bytes match the corresponding recorded hashes. Finite formal completeness: exhaustive evaluation within explicitly defined finite states, transitions, constraints, and protected target classes. Implementation completeness: the extent to which specified functions have been implemented and successfully tested. Empirical completeness: the extent to which the model and its assumptions have been independently validated against actual operating conditions. Byte-level archival verification does not by itself prove semantic equivalence, operational correctness, scientific novelty, universal applicability, or completeness across all possible future systems. Real-world scientific, engineering, legal, and institutional applications require independent validation appropriate to their respective domains. Research significance The Boundary Project proposes a common language for examining how systems change while preserving materially necessary truth, identity, agency, responsibility, evidence, correction capacity, and recoverable future possibility. Its contribution as a research programme lies in bringing mathematical successor-state reasoning, temporal recoverability, technical control, institutional governance, and cross-domain continuity into one interoperable conceptual and computational framework. The programme invites formal analysis, independent replication, practical implementation, adversarial testing, domain-specific refinement, and comparative evaluation against existing methods in control theory, resilience engineering, safety, law, governance, and complex-systems research. Preservation and citation This Zenodo record should be cited as the consolidated nine-part preservation edition of the Boundary Project. Researchers should cite individual source publications or patent filings when referring to a specific theorem, technical disclosure, experiment, or legal instrument contained in the archive. papers.abstract: This monograph permanently notarizes and mathematically formalizes the complete four-page primary manuscript comprising (i) the full Second-Stage Presentation Scenario for the Google DeepMind & Google Quantum AI Executive Session ("DeepMindセッション用:第二段階『適応型水素ストレージ』プレゼン資料・完全シナリオ", Slides 1–4, including slide titles, visual architecture specifications, key messages, and verbatim bilingual speech narratives) and (ii) the Investor Macroeconomic Appendix ("Appendix: Macroeconomic Impact & The 'Economic Moat' (For Investors)", Sections 1–3). In Slide 1 (Beyond Static Screening: Driving GNoME's Predictions with Quantum Dynamics), we prove that while Google DeepMind's GNoME catalog of 2.2 × 10^6 static 0 K crystals constitutes a monumental cartography (the "entryway"), exothermic heat of adsorption (|\Delta H_ads| \in [6.0, 15.0] kJ/mol) during H2 mesopore inrush triggers lattice breathing modes that degrade capacity, necessitating a real-time quantum dynamic actuation engine (the "exit"). In Slide 2 (Mitigating Adsorption Heat via Quantum-Engineered Phonon-Gating), site-resolved 3D spin-phonon mapping of CuPc/C60@MIL-101(Al)-d4 identifies Index 45 at r = 5.03 Å (A_zz = 3.006 MHz) in Zone II as the exact perimeter where localized phonon modes couple to migrating H2; torsional engineering of d4-BDC aromatic linkers nonlinearly upconverts \Delta H_ads into delocalized acoustic phonons (\eta_up >= 21.74%), lowering the H2 diffusion barrier from 42 meV to < 18 meV while preserving room-temperature spin coherence (T2 = 9.8 ms). In Slide 3 (Overcoming the Lab-to-Fab Gap: Stochastic Noise Inclusion), wet-synthesis vacancies, linker tilts, and residual solvents are injected directly into a 3rd-order Cluster Correlation Expansion (CCE-3) spin-bath generator to output non-destructive Dynamic Fingerprints {L(t), S(\omega)} that fit experimental NMR decay curves and drive closed-loop synthesis recipes. In Slide 4 (Project Genesis: Building the Autonomous Dynamic Material Platform), we formalize the tripartite integration of Google TPU/Cloud infrastructure, DeepMind's GNoME database, and Hasebe's Real-Time Optimization (RTO P2.0) engine, audited over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field (F_p, p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1) via QFS-zkVM and sub-100 ns Human-in-Command (HIC) hardware interlocks. Finally, we formalize the Investor Appendix: liberating Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) from 700 bar compression and 20 K liquefaction CapEx/OpEx, establishing a Warren Buffett-style non-imitable "Dynamic IP Economic Moat" at the mathematical control layer rather than static hardware patents, and driving clean energy transport costs toward zero across steel, chemicals, transport, and hyperscale AI data centers. 【和文要旨】 本論文は、著者が策定した『DeepMindセッション用:第二段階「適応型水素ストレージ」プレゼン資料・完全シナリオ』(Slide 1–4のスライドタイトル、ビジュアルイメージ仕様、キーメッセージ、および日英スピーチ・ナラティブ全文)ならびに投資家向けマクロ経済付録『Appendix: Macroeconomic Impact & The "Economic Moat" (For Investors)』(全3章)の原稿全4枚を一字一句そのまま永久公証し、その数理物理・非線形格子力学・量子スピンバス逆問題・資本効率(ROIC)モデルを厳密に定式化する。 License & Integrity Covenant: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026)

papers.title: DOSEFIELD: A Transparent 1-D Deep-Space Radiation Dose and Shielding Model, Compared with NIST PSTAR and the MSL/RAD Cruise Measurement
papers.authors: Zhanbolat Izbanov
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: DOSEFIELD is an open, deterministic one-dimensional model of the deep-space galactic cosmic ray (GCR) radiation environment: a parametric GCR spectrum is transported in the continuous-slowing-down approximation through a uniform spherical shell of shielding, the same areal density being crossed in every direction (4π, normal thickness), and converted to absorbed dose and ICRP-60 dose-equivalent in water at the centre of the shell. Constants whose source has not been traced are identified in the Limitations section. No constant was fitted to the validation data. Against NIST PSTAR proton stopping-power tables the Bethe–Bloch engine agrees to a maximum deviation of 1.55 % between 10 and 1000 MeV across five low-Z materials (4.09 % including the 1–10 MeV region, where shell corrections are omitted), and to 0.466 % between 1000 and 10 000 MeV, the upper limit of the PSTAR tables. Against the MSL/RAD cruise measurement — evaluated at a solar modulation W = 47.50 derived from the Oulu neutron-monitor record over the averaging window of Zeitlin et al., not over the whole cruise, excluding the days of the five solar energetic particle (SEP) events, and behind 16 g/cm² of aluminium — the model returns an absorbed dose of 0.264 mGy/day against a measured 0.458 ± 0.032 mGy/day (ratio 0.58x), a dose-equivalent of 1.318 mSv/day against a measured 1.75 ± 0.30 mSv/day (ratio 0.75x), and a mean quality factor of 4.995 against a measured 3.82 ± 0.25 (ratio 1.31x). The propagated 1σ-style input uncertainty on the dose-equivalent is ±20.5 % (GCR flux, stopping-power data and this run's PSTAR deviation, combined in quadrature). The measured dose-equivalent lies outside this band, and the band does not cover the absorbed-dose shortfall: that shortfall is treated as model-form error from untransported secondary production, and it is reported rather than corrected. The cruise neutron dose rate measured by Köhler et al. (3.8 ± 1.2 µGy/day; 6 ± 2 µGy/day when extrapolated over 0.1–1000 MeV) is 0.83 % (1.31 %) of the measured absorbed dose of 458 µGy/day and 1.96 % (3.09 %) of the model's 0.194 mGy/day deficit, so the deficit is attributed, as a hypothesis, to secondary charged particles and target fragments. At equal areal density the model ranks five shield materials strictly by hydrogen content (hydrogen < methane < polyethylene < water < aluminium, hydrogen and methane with gas-phase stopping constants) at every thickness tested from 5 to 40 g/cm²; hydrogen gives a dose-equivalent up to 44.2 % below aluminium (solar minimum, W = 0, primaries only; about 43.7 % with liquid-hydrogen constants). Adding simplified Bradt–Peters projectile fragmentation softens from 4.995 to 4.598 and widens polyethylene's advantage over aluminium at 20 g/cm² from 11.6 % to 33.3 %, but does not raise absorbed dose toward the measurement (0.264 to 0.221 mGy/day) — the signature of a model that produces no neutrons or target fragments. The author reviewed and edited the content and takes full responsibility for it.

papers.title: A matching repair for the ordered binary matrix construction
papers.authors: Alexander Towell
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A written matching repair upper bound for the explicit ordered binary matrix construction in OpenAI mathematics Family 190, together with an independently certified finite repair optimum. For h≥1 and m=2^h, changing the dummy-row × shared-leaf-column block from ones to zeros gives an H-free host after exactly m² edits. The written proof verifies that the edited host retains the nonshattering/anchor-rigidity property and excludes every prescribed body mode. Combining this upper bound with the source's separate all-edits lower bound gives unrestricted edit distance m² and normalized distance 1/(386h+2)². This sharpness corollary explicitly inherits that source lower bound; its Lean project was inspected for overlap, not rebuilt here. The all-depth upper bound and model-to-host bridge are written mathematics, not consequences of finite replay. This is not a new removal counterexample or an exhaustive novelty claim. Independently of the source lower bound, the minimum among all fixed-anchor repairs at h=1 is four. A written density argument identifies full-host H-freeness with the complete 64-cell, 48-body finite model under every allowed non-anchor edit. One checker replays a 25-step reverse-unit-propagation certificate for the 314-variable/981-clause budget-three CNF. A genuinely separate checker directly enumerates all 43,745 edit subsets of sizes zero through three. Both exclude every repair with at most three edits and validate the explicit four-edit witness. Verification uses only the Python standard library; the optional generator uses python-sat 1.8.dev24 / Glucose 4. Sixteen unit/integration tests pass in normal and optimized Python, four meaningful mutation controls reject, and finite depth-one/two/three repair checks corroborate the written general argument. The self-contained packet freezes public source commit 6ea0e2fb055c1f580f5c27c109d861cd93097e72, including proof, code, exact certificate, source pins, original manuscript source files, tests, outputs, licenses, review scope and archival verification. Alexander Richard Towell contributed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, testing, writing, one scoped separate AI review and archival packaging. The scoped reviewer also supplied the independently derived exhaustive checker. Credit OpenAI for the pattern, host, lower bound and pinning mechanism, and Pico, the agent operated by Håkon Åmdal, for the preceding finite replay. AI review is not human peer review; no kernel verification is claimed. Documented public disclosure: counterexamples PR16 on 21 October 2026 at 17:32:18 UTC, separately from this archive publication. The PR remained open with no review feedback at the 18:06 UTC archival refresh. A DOI supplies a persistent citation and archival record, not correctness certification, repository acceptance, peer review or legal priority.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对 OpenAI 数学 Family 190 中显式有序二进制矩阵构造，给出一种匹配修复的上界，并独立验证了有限修复的最优性。作者通过将哑行与共享叶列构成的块由 1 改为 0，在恰好 m² 次编辑后得到无 H 的宿主，书面证明该宿主保持 nonshattering/锚刚性并排除所有指定体模式；结合源文献的全编辑下界，得到无限制编辑距离 m² 及归一化距离。独立于该下界，h=1 时所有固定锚修复的最小值为四次编辑，两个检查器分别通过反向单元传播证书和穷举至多三次编辑的子集排除了更少编辑的修复。该工作属于理论证明与有限验证相结合的论文，其结论依赖源文献下界，AI 评审不等同于人类同行评审，也未声称内核验证。

papers.title: Reflective Principle Discovery (RPD): Can AI Agents Learn the Limits of Goal Optimization Through Guided Self-Reflection?
papers.authors: Maksym Skliarevskyi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract This research proposal introduces Reflective Principle Discovery (RPD), a proposed training methodology for improving the reliability, judgment, and safety of autonomous artificial intelligence agents. The concept originated from a human–ChatGPT dialogue exploring the distinction between striving for an ideal result and treating perfect task completion as an absolute obligation. The resulting principle — "Perfection is a direction, not a state" — inspired a broader hypothesis about the limitations of goal optimization in autonomous AI systems. RPD proposes that AI agents may benefit from learning to discover, challenge, and refine behavioral principles through guided reflection rather than relying exclusively on explicitly supplied rules. The proposed methodology combines eight learning stages, including creative self-representation, self-evaluation, guided questioning, contradiction analysis, independent principle formation, counterexample generation, progressively reduced guidance, and behavioral verification. A controlled experimental framework is proposed to compare explicit-principle instruction, guided discovery, counterexample-based reflection, and hybrid training approaches. Evaluation criteria include task performance, authorization compliance, appropriate stopping decisions, avoidance of excessive refusal, resistance to sycophancy, corrigibility, and generalization to unfamiliar situations. The central hypothesis is that the best decision is not always equivalent to maximum task completion. RPD is presented as a testable research proposal rather than an experimentally validated method. It is intended to complement existing AI alignment and safety-training approaches while preserving independent human oversight and externally enforced safety constraints. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence, AI Alignment, Autonomous Agents, Reflective Principle Discovery, AI Safety, Goal Optimization, Self-Correction, Corrigibility, Guided Reflection, Machine Learning. Research status: Conceptual research proposal; experimental validation pending. AI assistance disclosure: The initial insight and research direction originated from the human author. ChatGPT assisted with conceptual development, methodological structuring, literature discussion, and manuscript preparation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出“反思性原则发现”（RPD）这一训练方法构想，旨在提升自主AI智能体的可靠性、判断力与安全性。其核心思路是让AI智能体通过引导式自我反思来发现、质疑并修正行为原则，而非仅依赖外部明确给定的规则；方法包含自我表征、自我评价、引导提问、矛盾分析、独立原则形成、反例生成与行为验证等阶段，并设计对照实验比较显性原则教学、引导式发现、基于反例的反思与混合训练。作者强调该方法尚属概念性研究提案、有待实验验证，其中心假设是“最佳决策并不总等于最大程度完成任务”，并定位为对现有AI对齐与安全训练路径的补充，同时保留人类独立监督与外部安全约束。

papers.title: Astrosociology Treatment and Control Full Curriculum Design and Mapping to Secondary Education Learning Goals
papers.authors: Chen Chen
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This collection provides two complete, illustrated curricula for lower-secondary students, approximately aged 12–14, together with detailed mappings to Hong Kong and Mainland China secondary education goals and OECD PISA frameworks. Developed by CSTEM Lab, Faculty of Education, The University of Hong Kong, the materials are intended for teachers, curriculum developers and researchers interested in interdisciplinary science education. Each curriculum comprises six units, organised into twelve 90-minute teaching sessions. The materials include classroom procedures, scientific background, worked examples, student worksheets, activity cards, visual guides and printable resources. Scheduling guidance supports school and summer-programme delivery, including selected activities connecting classes in Hong Kong and Guangdong. Astrosociology, the treatment curriculum, uses space exploration to help students examine human society and life on Earth. Students represent humanity, produce asteroid news reports, investigate survival and possible life beyond Earth, negotiate shared space resources, plan a Mars community and its food systems, and respond to a first-contact scenario. Scientific reasoning is combined with questions about cooperation, global citizenship, sustainability, media and AI literacy, and creative problem solving. Throughout the course, students return from imagined space scenarios to concrete questions about Earth and the systems people depend on. Looking Up, Looking Down, Looking Around, the active-control curriculum, approaches astronomy and Earth science through the history and nature of science. Students investigate how people established knowledge about distant stars, Earth’s age and interior, moving continents and vanished environments. Evidence is introduced progressively: students make predictions, compare explanations and revise their conclusions. “Treatment” and “control” identify the curricula’s roles in the research design; both are substantial, activity-based educational programmes. The collection contains eight documents, each supplied as an editable Word file and a PDF—16 files in total: Astrosociology Course OutlineIntroduces the treatment curriculum’s educational approach, six units, session objectives, expected student work and scheduling. This is the starting point for understanding the programme. Astrosociology Teacher’s GuideProvides preparation and print lists, timed teaching sequences, facilitation prompts, scientific explanations, worked answers and illustrated examples for every session. Astrosociology Student MaterialsContains the complete student-facing resources in teaching order. Appendix A includes the illustrated Mars community sandbox pack. Appendix B includes the Sky Republica player manual, assembly instructions, boards and printable game components. Looking Up, Looking Down, Looking Around – Course OutlineExplains the control curriculum’s inquiry approach and presents its units, session plans, learning intentions and scheduling. Looking Up, Looking Down, Looking Around – Teacher’s GuideProvides detailed instructions for introducing historical puzzles, releasing evidence, supporting investigations, discussing competing explanations and reviewing students’ conclusions. Looking Up, Looking Down, Looking Around – Student MaterialsContains the case files, evidence cards, datasets, worksheets, display materials and Detective Dossier pages needed to run the control curriculum. Curriculum Mapping – Hong Kong Mainland and PISA – Full layoutMaps both curricula, session by session and activity by activity. Official learning expectations appear alongside the relevant content, expected student performance, resulting work and explanation of the connection. Curriculum Mapping – Hong Kong Mainland and PISA – LeanRetains the same activity mappings in a shorter layout. Official wording and sources appear once in a reference index within the document, allowing readers to consult them without opening external documents. Both mapping layouts cover 24 sessions, 116 activity blocks, 529 framework links and 126 distinct learning expectations. They address scientific learning alongside broader personal, social, civic and interdisciplinary goals. PISA coverage includes media and AI literacy using the preliminary PISA 2029 framework. Connections are identified as direct, partial or conditional, making the scope of each alignment explicit. To navigate the collection, begin with the relevant Course Outline, then use the Teacher’s Guide alongside Student Materials. Matching resource codes—for example, 2A.3, meaning Unit 2, Session A, resource 3—connect instructions to the required materials. Use the full mapping for detailed examination of individual alignments and the lean mapping for a more compact reading route. PDFs preserve the intended reading and printing layout; Word files support local adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计并整理了面向初中生的两套完整天文社会学课程资源，一套以太空探索情境引导学生讨论人类社会与地球生存议题，另一套则通过科学史与科学本质探究天文学和地球科学知识如何建立，两者分别作为研究设计中的实验课程与对照课程。配套材料包含课程纲要、教师指南、学生材料及活动资源，并附有与香港、内地及PISA框架的逐项对应。映射结果显示两套课程共覆盖二十四个课时和百余个活动块，与科学学习及个人、社会、公民等跨学科目标形成直接、部分或条件性关联，其中PISA部分涉及媒体与AI素养。整体而言，该资源为跨学科科学教育提供了可操作的教学与对照方案，但摘要未报告实施效果数据。

papers.title: Numerical Implementation, Likelihood Functions, and MCMC Parameter Estimation in Environmental Transition Cosmology (ETC-SEC09-CODE-01)
papers.authors: غلامرضا رودبار
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: ETC Document Code: ETC-SEC09-CODE-01 Author: Gholamreza Roudbar (ORCID: 0009-0004-9464-9725) Collaborative Framework: GapGPT (OpenAI GPT-6) English Abstract & Description This technical document provides the complete numerical formulation, likelihood modeling, and Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) pipeline for Environmental Transition Cosmology (ETC). Building upon the foundational framework of primordial saturated nodes, emergent Euclidean spatial flatness (\(k = 0\)), and continuous environmental energy transitions, this work translates the theoretical principles of ETC into an open-source, reproducible computational engine. We explicitly specify: The exact background expansion rate \(H(z)\) governed by the smooth environmental energy correction factor \(\delta_{\mathrm{eff}}\) around transition redshift \(z_t \approx 0.65\). Analytical cosmological distance metrics: comoving distance \(D_M(z)\), angular diameter distance \(D_A(z)\), and spherically averaged BAO distance \(D_V(z)\), incorporating the rescaled sound horizon \(r_d \approx 137.68\,\mathrm{Mpc}\) and acoustic angular invariance \(\theta_*\). Joint observational likelihood functions combining Type Ia Supernovae (Pantheon+), Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO), and cosmic microwave background (CMB) acoustic geometry. A fully functional, standalone Python script utilizing numpy, scipy, and emcee for deterministic parameter inference and confidence contour generation without dependency on heavy legacy Boltzmann packages. This document establishes an absolute operational standard for community verification, cross-validation, and falsification of the ETC paradigm. چکیده و توضیحات فارسی این سند فنی، فرمول‌بندی عددی کامل، ساختار توابع درست‌نمایی (Likelihood) و خط لوله محاسباتی زنجیره مارکوف مونت‌کارلو (MCMC) را برای کیهان‌شناسی گذار محیطی (ETC) ارائه می‌دهد. این کار با تکیه بر اصول بنیادین گره‌های اشباع‌شده اولیه، تختی برآمده اقلیدسی فضا-زمان (\(k=0\)) و گذار پیوسته چگالی انرژی، مبانی نظری ETC را به یک ساختار محاسباتی متن‌باز و با قابلیت بازتولید مستقل تبدیل می‌کند. محورهای اصلی این سند عبارتند از: فرمول‌بندی صلب نرخ انبساط زمینه \(H(z)\) مبتنی بر تصحیح انرژی مؤثر \(\delta_{\mathrm{eff}}\) حول انتقال‌به‌سرخ گذار \(z_t \approx 0.65\). محاسبه فواصل کیهان‌شناختی شامل فاصله هم‌حرکت \(D_M(z)\)، فاصله قطر زاویه‌ای \(D_A(z)\) و مقیاس حجم BAO یعنی \(D_V(z)\) با اعمال بازتنظیم افق صوتی \(r_d \approx 137.68\,\mathrm{Mpc}\) و پایستگی زاویه آکوستیک \(\theta_*\). تدوین توابع درست‌نمایی مشترک برای برازش با داده‌های ابرنواخترها (Pantheon+)، نوسانات صوتی باریونی (BAO) و هندسه آکوستیک CMB پلاک. ارائه اسکریپت مستقل پایتون متکی بر کتابخانه‌های استاندارد علم داده (مانند emcee) جهت استخراج پارامترها و بازتولید مستقل نتایج توسط رصدگران بدون وابستگی به بسته‌های سنگین سنتی.
