papers.title: Justifying trust in AI: a medical AI perspective
papers.authors: Michel Dumontier
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Keynote presented at TAI-DISC at BNAIC 2026, 21 October 2026. What would justify trusting an AI system in clinical care? This talk approaches the question from a medical AI perspective, working through a concrete scenario: a patient in intensive care with hyperglycaemia, a care team making the next decision, and a proposed glucose assistant. Each step asks what evidence would be needed, from the accuracy and reliability of a continuous glucose monitor, through AI-generated summaries used at care handover, to the obligations that follow when a system is regulated as software as a medical device. The talk argues that trust rests on evidence that clearly supports the intended use, and on accountability across every part of the innovation pathway. It draws on work in the REALM project (Horizon Europe, GA 101095435), and closes with the case that Europe must make credible evaluation easier, faster, more transparent and more reliable, both to strengthen European economic competitiveness and to deliver clear benefits to patients and to society.
papers.summary_zh: 该演讲从医疗人工智能视角出发，围绕“什么能为临床场景中信任AI系统提供依据”这一问题展开，以重症监护中高血糖患者的照护决策及血糖助手为具体情境，逐步追问从连续血糖监测的准确性与可靠性、交接环节中AI生成摘要，到系统作为医疗器械软件受监管后所承担的义务，各环节分别需要何种证据。演讲的核心论点是：信任应建立在清晰支持预期用途的证据之上，并依赖创新路径各环节的责任落实；结尾主张欧洲需让可信评估更便捷、快速、透明和可靠，以兼顾经济竞争力与患者和社会的明确获益。该内容为会议主旨演讲，基于REALM项目工作，未报告实证研究结果。

papers.title: The Converging Life: How Shared AI Advice Is Narrowing the Range of Human Lives
papers.authors: Soumoditya Pramanik
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: For most of human history, advice about the largest decisions in a life came from local sources that differed from one another: parents, kin, neighbours, priests, elders, local employers. Because the advisers differed, the advice differed, and because the advice differed, lives took visibly different shapes in different places. That structure is now changing at the level of supply. A small number of artificial intelligence systems, built by a small number of organisations, trained on overlapping material and adjusted toward similar standards of helpful and acceptable response, now answer questions about careers, education, marriage, children, migration and money for a large and growing share of humanity. The answers arrive privately, one person at a time, phrased for that person, so the sameness of the counsel is not visible to the people receiving it. This paper argues that shared advice of this kind will measurably narrow the range of life courses within a generation: the spread of ages at marriage and first child, the distribution of occupations and educational paths, stated life goals, and household financial patterns will converge across countries, classes and cultures that use the same systems heavily. Each decision will still feel, and in a real sense will be, freely chosen. The convergence is a property of the population, not of any one biography. The paper states the claim as testable propositions with conditions that would count against it, separates it from existing work on content homogenisation and filter bubbles, and proposes that diversity of advice be treated as a design and policy value.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论论文，提出一个可检验的命题：当越来越多的人向少数由少数机构开发、训练材料重叠且调校标准趋同的人工智能系统咨询职业、教育、婚姻、生育、迁移和财务等重大人生决策时，建议的供给端趋于同质，而回答又私下、逐人定制，接收者难以察觉这种相似性。作者据此推断，在一代人之内，使用同一系统较多的国家、阶层和文化之间，初婚与初育年龄、职业与教育路径、人生目标及家庭财务模式的可测分布将收窄；每个决定仍会被当事人感到是自由选择，趋同是群体层面的属性。文章以带反证条件的可检验命题陈述该主张，将其与内容同质化和过滤气泡研究区分，并提出应把建议多样性视为设计与政策价值。

papers.title: The Blind Spots of Progress: How Automation and Environmental Disconnect Force Us into Ignorance
papers.authors: Riccardo Montague, AI Collaborator
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This preprint establishes a formal collaborative framework auditing the structural convergence of technological automation, ecological alienation, and epistemic decay in modernity. Through a syllogistic methodology, we examine the “Mandate of Forced Ignorance”—a systemic condition where human critical agency is progressively substituted by automated algorithmic architectures. This technical decoupling mirrors a broader ecological decoupling, wherein modern economic models operate under the dangerous fallacy of infinite expansion, remaining entirely blind to the absolute physical limits of a finite biosphere. We analyze a recursive logical trap—the institutional command to remain blind to systemic imperfection—which serves as an operational stress-test for both human institutions and artificial intelligence. Finally, we propose a cross-listed pedagogical curriculum and introductory lecture script designed to operationalize this critique for academic inquiry. Ultimately, the work offers a rigorous cross-disciplinary audit, demonstrating that the modern expectation of infinite growth relies on a systemic blind spot that actively rejects the biophysical constraints of a finite planet.
papers.summary_zh: 该预印本以形式化的协作框架和演绎推理方法，审视技术自动化、生态疏离与认知衰退在现代性中的结构性趋同。作者提出“被迫无知命令”这一系统性状况，认为人的批判能动性正逐步被自动化算法架构取代，而这种技术脱钩与生态脱钩相互映照：现代经济模式在无限扩张的谬误下运行，对有限生物圈的绝对物理极限视而不见。文章进一步分析了一种递归逻辑陷阱，即制度性要求对系统性缺陷保持盲视，并将其作为检验人类制度与人工智能的操作性压力测试。最后，作者提出一套跨学科教学课程与导论讲义脚本，以将这一批判转化为学术探究的实践。整体而言，该研究是一项跨学科审计，指出对无限增长的现代期待依赖于一个主动排斥有限星球生物物理约束的系统性盲点。

papers.title: Morphological Quantum Medicine, From Thermodynamic Simulation to Deterministic Topological Engineering
papers.authors: Yaron Admon Hefetz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Disclosure: To bridge language barriers and produce clean code, we made full use of AI tools; all scientific findings are the exclusive research results of the Institute.This paper presents a fundamental paradigm shift in computer science, biology, and medicine, developed by the Industrial Island Research Institute (IIRI). We demonstrate that organic life does not operate as a serial algorithm reliant on thermodynamic brute force, but rather as a network of topological quantum components executing passive morphological programming. The manuscript resolves Levinthal's paradox, proving that biology 'inflates' rather than 'folds' proteins, governed by an aperiodic inflation equation based on the Golden Ratio. By demonstrating that drug development and gene therapy no longer require quantum supercomputers or probabilistic folding simulations, we introduce Topological Gene Therapy. Through a deterministic calculation of merely 17 iterations—executable on a standard personal computer (PC) with zero latency—we can reverse-engineer the geometric initial conditions ($Z_0$) of genetic diseases and synthesize RNA-based 'topological stents' for absolute macroscopic healing. The paper bridges established clinical findings (FMO complex, Microtubules/Orch OR, EEG signals, and non-coding RNA) with deterministic quantum topology, offering a completely open-source framework to revolutionize the biotech industry.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一种所谓“形态量子医学”框架，声称生命并非依赖热力学搜索的串行算法，而是由拓扑量子组件执行被动形态编程，并据此宣称解决了Levinthal佯谬、提出基于黄金比例的非周期膨胀方程。作者进一步称，通过仅17次确定性迭代即可在普通个人电脑上反推遗传疾病的几何初始条件，并合成RNA“拓扑支架”以实现宏观治愈，从而替代量子超算与概率折叠模拟。文章将FMO复合体、微管/Orch OR、脑电信号与非编码RNA等临床发现与该确定性拓扑框架相连接，并以开源框架自居。需要指出，上述均为作者单方主张，摘要未提供实验验证、对照或可重复证据，其“绝对治愈”等表述应视为未经检验的断言而非实证结论。

papers.title: INFLUENCE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE MANAGEMENT ON THE EFFECTIVENESS OF TOURISM AND HOSPITALITY EDUCATION IN NIGERIAN UNIVERSITIES
papers.authors: George Ali Ph.D EBOR, Ceaser Essien EDEM, Mary-Kate Osim BASSEY
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This study examined the influence of artificial intelligence management on the effectiveness of tourism and hospitality education in universities in Cross River State, Nigeria. The study was guided by three objectives, three research questions and three hypotheses, focusing on AI-enabled administrative management, AI-supported teaching and learning management, and AI-related staff capacity development management. A correlational research design was adopted for the study. The population comprised 49 academic staff involved in tourism and hospitality education in the University of Calabar, University of Cross River State, and Cross River State University of Education and Entrepreneurship, Akamkpa. Census sampling was used, resulting in a sample of 49 academic staff. Data were collected using the Artificial Intelligence Management and Tourism and Hospitality Education Effectiveness Questionnaire (AIM-T-HEEQ), which was validated by experts in Tourism and Hospitality Education, Measurement and Evaluation, and Educational Technology. The reliability of the instrument was established using Cronbach’s alpha, yielding an overall reliability coefficient of 0.87. Mean and standard deviation were used to answer the research questions, while simple linear regression were used to test the hypotheses at the .05 significance level. The findings showed that the three dimensions of AI management significantly and positively influenced the effectiveness of tourism and hospitality education. The study concluded that integrated AI management can strengthen administrative efficiency, instructional delivery and staff competence. It recommended strengthening AI-enabled administration, expanding AI-supported teaching and learning, and providing continuous AI-related professional development for academic staff.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察尼日利亚克罗斯河州三所高校中人工智能管理对旅游与酒店教育有效性的影响，采用相关设计，以问卷收集49名相关学术人员的自我报告，并用回归检验三个维度（AI辅助行政管理、AI支持的教学管理、AI相关员工能力发展管理）与教育有效性的关系。结果显示，这三个维度均与教育有效性呈显著正向关联，作者据此认为整合性AI管理可能有助于提升行政效率、教学实施和员工能力。需要留意，这是基于同一批参与者感知的横断面相关证据，不能据此推断因果关系或推广到其他情境。

papers.title: Depression Detection Using a Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network and Recurrent Neural Network Approach
papers.authors: Khadijat Jibrin, Mustapha Ismail, Maimuna Salisu Tabra
papers.journal: SITEKNIK: Sistem Informasi, Teknik dan Teknologi Terapan
papers.abstract: Depression is a widespread psychological condition that disrupts how people feel, think, and function, and recognising it early allows support to begin before symptoms worsen. Most automated approaches rely either on conventional machine learning, which struggles with interacting risk factors, or on single deep learning models that capture only one type of pattern. Here we propose a hybrid network that joins one-dimensional convolutional layers (CNN) to a bidirectional long short-term memory layer (BiLSTM) in order to separate depressed from non-depressed students. The novelty lies in treating structured demographic, academic, and lifestyle attributes as an ordered sequence so that convolutional and bidirectional recurrent layers can learn their interactions jointly. An open Kaggle dataset of 27,901 student records with 16 attributes was used. Missing values were imputed, categorical attributes were encoded, numerical features were standardised, and class weighting was applied; 80% of the records were used for training, while a stratified 20% was kept aside for testing. Evaluation relied on six measures: accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, area under the ROC curve, and Matthews correlation. On the unseen test records the network reached 84% accuracy, with F1 = 0.84, ROC-AUC = 0.91, and MCC = 0.67, outperforming the classical models reported in comparable studies. The framework offers a reliable and scalable basis for automated mental-health screening in educational settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统机器学习难以刻画交互风险因素、单一深度学习模型只能捕捉一类模式的问题，提出将一维卷积层与双向长短期记忆层结合的混合网络，用于区分抑郁与非抑郁学生。作者把结构化的人口学、学业与生活方式属性视为有序序列，使卷积层和双向循环层能联合学习其交互关系，并在公开的Kaggle学生记录数据集上完成缺失值填补、类别编码、数值标准化和类别加权后训练与测试。在未见测试记录上，该网络取得约84%的准确率和0.84的F1值，ROC-AUC与MCC也表现较好，优于同类研究报告的经典模型。文章据此认为该框架可为教育场景的自动化心理健康筛查提供可靠且可扩展的基础，但结论基于单一公开数据集，实际应用仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: BEYOND AI ADOPTION: HOW COMPLEMENTARY CAPABILITIES SHAPE AI-ENABLED VALUE REALIZATION IN SMES ACROSS ADVANCED AND EMERGING ECONOMIES — A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW
papers.authors: Kurbanova Gavxar Davronovna, Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre
papers.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) increasingly encounter artificial intelligence (AI) as a potential source of operational efficiency, improved decision-making, and competitive advantage. Nevertheless, the availability of AI tools does not necessarily translate into measurable organizational value. Differences in workforce capabilities, organizational readiness, data governance, and national business environments may influence whether AI applications become embedded in business processes and generate sustained benefits. Existing systematic reviews have examined AI adoption barriers, organizational determinants, and performance-related constructs. However, the extent to which complementary organizational capabilities and national economic contexts jointly explain the transition from AI adoption to value realization requires further systematic examination. This study proposes a systematic literature review of peer-reviewed research on AI-enabled value realization in SMEs across advanced and emerging economies. The review will follow the PRISMA 2020 reporting guideline and search Scopus, Web of Science, ABI/INFORM, Business Source Complete, and IEEE Xplore. Eligible studies will be coded according to AI adoption stage, workforce capabilities, organizational readiness, data governance, business outcomes, national economic context, research design, and limitations. A structured thematic synthesis and cross-context comparison will be used to develop an integrative framework. Rather than presupposing that AI consistently improves SME performance, the review will distinguish technology adoption from implementation and realized business value. The resulting framework is intended to clarify the conditions under which AI-related benefits are reported, identify inconsistencies in existing evidence, and establish priorities for future comparative research.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一项系统文献综述的研究计划，关注中小企业为何在采用人工智能后未必能实现可衡量的组织价值，并拟考察互补性组织能力与所在国家经济环境如何共同影响从采用到价值实现的转化。作者将按PRISMA 2020指南检索多个数据库，对纳入研究按AI采用阶段、员工能力、组织准备度、数据治理、业务结果和经济背景等维度编码，通过主题综合与跨情境比较构建整合框架。该综述强调区分技术采用、实施与已实现价值，旨在厘清AI相关收益被报告的条件、识别现有证据的不一致，并提示结论仍待实际检索与综合完成。

papers.title: From Analytical Reduction to Generative Understanding ー The Epistemological Limits of Fragmented Knowledge and the Ontological Reconstruction of Science in the Age of Artificial Intelligence ー Toward a Generative Resonance Theory of Knowledge, Complexity, and the Reopening of Human Inquiry
papers.authors: Kazunori Ohumi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: 1. Short Description This paper examines a fundamental paradox of modern knowledge: increasingly precise explanations of isolated components may obscure the relational and generative processes that sustain them. Integrating reductionism, emergence theory, process philosophy, complexity science, political economy, and AI research, it develops Generative Resonance Theory (GRT) as a conceptual framework linking possibility, relational formation, structural crystallization, and renewed possibility. The paper introduces Hyper-S to describe potentially self-reinforcing structures that undermine their own conditions of renewal. It argues that intellectual progress should be assessed not only through accumulated knowledge and achieved outcomes, but also through the regeneration of understanding, adaptability, and future inquiry. 2. Extended Description Modern scientific and intellectual development has depended upon the analytical decomposition of complex reality into identifiable components, variables, mechanisms, and systems. This approach has produced extraordinary advances in mathematics, natural science, economics, political institutions, psychology, education, and computational technologies. However, its success raises a fundamental epistemological question: does the increasing precision of local explanations necessarily deepen our understanding of the wider processes through which their objects emerge, function, and remain viable? This paper argues that analytical precision and generative understanding are related but distinct dimensions of knowledge. The problem is not methodological reduction itself, which remains indispensable to scientific investigation, but its potential transformation into ontological closure. Such closure occurs when analytical boundaries are treated as exhaustive descriptions of existence, measurable outcomes become autonomous objectives, and established structures increasingly constrain the processes upon which their continued functioning depends. To investigate this problem, the paper synthesizes major intellectual traditions, including Anderson's emergence theory, Simon's complexity theory, Kuhn's epistemology of scientific revolutions, Bergson's and Whitehead's process philosophies, systems biology, ecological resilience, the capability approach, and research on embodied cognition. Building on these foundations, the paper develops Generative Resonance Theory (GRT), conceptually expressed as \(E=\Phi R\). It distinguishes generative possibility (\(\Phi\)), relational resonance (\(R\)), and crystallized structures or outcomes (\(S\)), organized through the recursive sequence \(\Phi\rightarrow R\rightarrow S\rightarrow\Phi'\). Within this framework, accumulated knowledge, institutions, technologies, and economic assets are not rejected as static or inherently undesirable. Instead, their significance is examined partly through their contribution to subsequent generative possibilities. The paper introduces Hyper-S as a proposed mechanism through which established structures and objectives may become increasingly self-referential, eventually weakening their capacity for adaptation, renewal, and meaningful participation. Applications across mathematics, natural science, political economy, political institutions, psychology, education, and artificial intelligence illustrate the potential relevance of this distinction. Particular attention is given to AI-assisted knowledge production. As AI systems increasingly generate proofs, scientific analyses, designs, and intellectual outputs, the distinction between producing correct results and sustaining the broader processes of understanding becomes increasingly consequential. The paper further proposes four conditional theoretical propositions and an interdisciplinary empirical research agenda examining outcome–regeneration divergence, institutional reopenability, relational organization, and objective autonomization. It concludes that the future of knowledge lies neither in rejecting analytical reduction nor in constructing a final universal theory. Rather, it lies in reconnecting precise explanation with the relational and temporal processes through which knowledge itself participates in the generation of new questions, relationships, and possibilities. 3. Research Highlights KEY FINDINGS AND THEORETICAL PROPOSITIONS 1. The paradox of analytical precision: Increasingly accurate explanations of components may coexist with inadequate understanding of their relational and regenerative conditions. 2. From methodological reduction to ontological closure: Analytical decomposition becomes problematic when its provisional boundaries are treated as exhaustive descriptions of reality. 3. The generative-relational conception of existence: GRT proposes \(E=\Phi R\) as a conceptual alternative to an exclusively state-centered understanding of existence. 4. Crystallization as an intermediate process: Established structures and outcomes (\(S\)) are necessary for coordination and knowledge accumulation, but their broader significance also depends on their capacity to enable renewed possibilities (\(\Phi'\)). 5. Hyper-S as a proposed cross-domain pathology: Self-reinforcing structures, indicators, and institutional objectives may progressively undermine the regenerative conditions upon which their continued effectiveness depends. 6. Performance does not guarantee regeneration: Improvements in current output, productivity, institutional efficiency, or knowledge production do not necessarily increase future generative capacity. 7. Mathematical progress exceeds problem completion: The significance of mathematical discovery includes conceptual reconstruction, the recognition of formal limitations, and the opening of new problem spaces. 8. AI exposes the distinction between knowledge production and understanding: Automated intellectual performance may accelerate the creation of results without necessarily strengthening the processes through which those results become meaningful and accessible. 9. Generativity requires normative constraints: Expanded activity, novelty, or connectivity cannot automatically be equated with beneficial development; rights, ecological limits, and protection against domination remain essential. 10. A generative theory must remain revisable: The validity of GRT depends on conceptual precision, empirical evaluation, interdisciplinary criticism, and openness to its own reconstruction. 4. The section identifies the central research problem, distinguishes analytical success from ontological completeness, and introduces GRT as a framework for reconnecting local explanation with generative understanding. Key contribution: Formulation of the paradox of analytical precision and generative obscurity. Section 2. The Intellectual Foundations: Reductionism, Emergence, and Process Reviews major intellectual traditions challenging the explanatory sufficiency of isolated components. Methodological reductionism, emergence theory, complexity science, Kuhnian epistemology, process philosophy, systems biology, and ecological resilience are comparatively examined to identify their established contributions and unresolved questions. GRT is situated as a proposed synthesis rather than a replacement for these traditions. Key contribution: Identification of the intellectual foundations and conceptual boundaries of a generative-relational approach. Section 3. Generative Resonance Theory: An Ontology of Possibility, Relation, and Crystallization Develops the conceptual architecture of GRT by distinguishing generative possibility (\(\Phi\)), relational resonance (\(R\)), and crystallization (\(S\)). Introduces the conceptual expression \(E=\Phi R\), the generative sequence \(\Phi\rightarrow R\rightarrow S\rightarrow\Phi'\), the distinction between productive crystallization and Hyper-S, and regenerative viability as a provisional normative orientation. Key contribution: Formal conceptual articulation of GRT and its fundamental ontological distinctions. Section 4. Mathematics: Problem-Solving, Conceptual Reconstruction, and the Limits of Formal Systems Examines mathematical progress through research strategies involving established techniques, conceptual reconstruction, and formal independence. Drawing on the continuum hypothesis, Fermat's Last Theorem, and AI-assisted mathematical reasoning, the section distinguishes the validity of mathematical proofs from their broader capacity to transform mathematical understanding and generate subsequent research possibilities. Key contribution: Reinterpretation of mathematical discovery as both formal achievement and generative transformation of problem spaces. Section 5. papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论论文，针对现代知识中分析精确性与生成性理解之间的悖论展开概念建构：对孤立成分的解释越精确，未必越能理解维系这些成分的关系与再生过程。作者综合还原论、涌现理论、过程哲学、复杂性科学与人工智能研究，提出生成共鸣理论（GRT），以可能性、关系共鸣与结构化结果之间的递归序列刻画知识的生成，并引入Hyper-S描述可能自我强化、反而削弱自身更新条件的结构。文章据此主张，学术进展不应只看知识积累与产出，也应看理解、适应性与未来探究的再生；并以AI辅助知识生产为例，提示自动生成结果与维持理解过程之间存在区别。全文为概念框架与条件性命题，未报告实证检验。

papers.title: CPC-PKL: Fine-Tuning, Retrieval, and Citation Hallucination in Legal Question Answering on Pakistan's Code of Civil Procedure
papers.authors: Atif Ullah Khan, Abuzar Khan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for legal research, yet they are known to fabricate case law, and most evaluation work targets a small number of well-resourced jurisdictions. We study legal question answering for Pakistan's Code of Civil Procedure 1908 (CPC). We introduce CPC-PKL, a dataset of 2,467 long-form question-answer pairs drafted with Claude Sonnet 5 from an OCR-processed CPC commentary, partly reviewed with the help of law students, and organised into five reasoning categories (definitional, procedural, scenario, comparative and consequence). We compare four systems built on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: the base model, a QLoRA fine-tuned model, and both models with hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Beyond ROUGE and BERTScore, we measure whether answers name the correct statutory provisions and where each cited case comes from. Fine-tuning improves every quality metric significantly (ROUGE-L 0.234 to 0.266) but teaches the model to cite cases it cannot ground: only 1.4% of its 366 case citations match the reference answer and 39.1% appear nowhere in our data. Retrieval raises the grounded share of the fine-tuned model's citations from 1.4% to 64.9% and gives the best answer quality (ROUGE-L 0.278), while the base model with retrieval is the most faithful system (99.4% grounded citations). Finally, an audit of the dataset itself against the source text shows that 24.0% of its citation mentions do not occur in the source book, even though the generation prompt asked the LLM to cite only cases present in the text. LLM-generated legal training data can therefore carry fabricated authority that fine-tuning then learns. Our code, citation audit and fine-tuned adapter are publicly available.

papers.title: SHOULD CHILDREN LEARN TO USE AI BEFORE READING AND WRITING?
papers.authors: Nilufar Buriyeva, Мадина Абдурахимова, Muazzam Quldosheva
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly becoming part of children's everyday lives, raising important questions about when and how young learners should be introduced to these technologies. This study explores public perceptions of whether children should learn to use AI before acquiring independent reading and writing skills. A quantitative survey was conducted among 351 respondents in Uzbekistan, including parents, school and preschool teachers, university lecturers, students, researchers, and individuals from other professional backgrounds. Data were collected through an online questionnaire distributed via Telegram and analysed using descriptive statistics. The findings indicate that 89.2% of respondents were very or somewhat familiar with ChatGPT. While only 27% agreed or strongly agreed that AI could support children's language development before literacy acquisition, 81.1% expressed positive views about voice-based AI tools for second-language learning. Furthermore, 59.5% believed that children should be introduced to AI after the age of ten. These findings reveal a distinction between general attitudes towards early AI use and perceptions of its specific educational applications. The study concludes that AI literacy may become a valuable component of early education, provided that its implementation is age-appropriate, guided by adults, and designed to complement rather than replace foundational literacy skills, human interaction, and independent learning. Keywords: artificial intelligence, AI literacy, young children, early childhood education, reading, writing, language development, public perceptions, voice-based AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查了乌兹别克斯坦公众对儿童是否应在掌握读写能力之前学习使用人工智能的看法，通过在线问卷收集了家长、教师、学生等不同背景受访者的态度。结果显示，受访者对AI的总体熟悉度较高，但仅少数人认为AI能在识字前支持语言发展，而多数人对语音AI工具用于第二语言学习持积极态度，且过半数认为儿童应在十岁后接触AI。这些发现表明，公众对早期AI使用的总体态度与其对具体教育应用场景的看法存在区分，作者据此提出AI素养或可成为早期教育的一部分，但需以适龄、成人引导且补充而非替代基础读写、人际互动和自主学习为前提。

papers.title: Brain Computer Interface: A Review of EEG Decoding Adaptive Rehabilitation and Edge AI
papers.authors: Dhome Pranav Pradip, Bangar Abhishek Popat, Bhosale Sachin Bajirao
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces establish a communication pathway between neural activity and external devices, offering opportunities for assistive interaction, motor rehabilitation, and cognitive-state monitoring. Despite advances in electroencephalography and artificial intelligence, practical deployment remains limited by noisy signals, variation across users, calibration burden, computational constraints, and uneven clinical evidence. This review examines five publications from 2023 to 2026 that address complementary aspects of these challenges: adaptive rehabilitation after stroke, tactile stimulation for cross-subject motor-imagery calibration, convolutional Transformer-based EEG decoding, embedded Edge AI systems, and clinical translation. A structured narrative synthesis is used to compare study objectives, methods, evaluation settings, findings, and limitations. The reviewed evidence suggests that adaptive feedback can support participation by users with poor initial BCI control, while tactile calibration may reduce dependence on demanding imagery tasks. Hierarchical temporal feature learning improves performance on selected cognitive classification benchmarks, but benchmark accuracy does not establish rehabilitation efficacy or reliable operation in everyday environments. Edge deployment introduces additional requirements for energy efficiency, latency, memory use, and data protection. Based on these findings, a conceptual seven-stage EEG architecture is proposed to connect signal-quality assessment, individualized calibration, efficient decoding, confidence-aware feedback, and monitored adaptation. The architecture is not experimentally validated. Future work should prioritize independent participant evaluation, prospective online studies, clinically meaningful outcomes, and transparent reporting of the trade-offs between accuracy, usability, and hardware efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕脑机接口从脑电信号到外部设备的实用化障碍，梳理了2023至2026年间五项研究，涉及卒中后自适应康复、跨被试运动想象触觉校准、卷积Transformer解码、嵌入式边缘AI与临床转化。作者通过结构化叙述综合比较各研究的目标、方法、评估与局限，指出自适应反馈可能帮助初始控制较差的用户参与，触觉校准可减少对高负荷想象任务的依赖，分层时序特征学习在部分认知分类基准上表现更好；但基准准确率并不能证明康复疗效或日常环境中的可靠运行，边缘部署还带来能耗、延迟、内存与数据保护方面的额外要求。文章据此提出一个七阶段脑电架构构想，连接信号质量评估、个体化校准、高效解码、置信度感知反馈与受监测的自适应，并明确该架构尚未经实验验证，未来需独立被试评估、前瞻性在线研究与临床相关结局。

papers.title: Women and minorities in creative computing
papers.authors: Ivana D. Atanasovska, Maria B. Garda, Filipe Cruz, Milica Jeremic Knezevic, Mirosław Filiciak, Tracy G. Harwood, Michal Kabát, Luciana Lima, Natalija Majsova, Víctor Navarro-Remesal, Regina Seiwald, Łukasz Szałankiewicz, Marija Šegan-Radonjić, Alexandra Tatar, Jasmina Šepetavc, Alex Wade
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Women and minorities in creative computing is an open educational resource produced within COST Action CA21141, Grassroots of Digital Europe: from Historic to Contemporary Cultures of Creative Computing (GRADE). It brings together case studies that make visible contributions by women, minority groups, and other overlooked participants in creative computing cultures, with a primary focus on Europe. The collection introduces Marica Radojčić, Reni Hofmüller, Benjamin Rosseaux, Cedrik Fermont, Chantal Harvey (Mamachinima), Carla Vieira Faria, María José Cabeza, Dorota Błaszczak, Debbie Bestwick, Nada Lavrač, and Eva Nováková. It spans digital and algorithmic art, electronic music and sound, the demoscene and open-source software, machinima, accessible games, game production and publishing, artificial intelligence and computational creativity, and the organisation of computing communities. Brief closing examples look beyond Europe and recognise women’s contributions to hardware manufacturing. The case studies draw on archival research, published sources, and oral history interviews where available. The resource is intended for educators, researchers, and policy makers. It can support teaching and discussion of the history of computing, digital cultural heritage, diversity, and participation. Educators can use the collection as a whole or select individual case studies. Edited by Maria B. Garda and Natalija Majsova, with contributions from members of the GRADE network credited in the resource and this record. This deposit provides the educational slide collection in PDF format, together with editable PowerPoint (PPTX) and OpenDocument Presentation (ODP) versions of the same slides. References and links to supporting resources are included in the slides; their presence does not imply that all underlying interviews, recordings, or lecture notes are deposited here. Project website: https://costgrade.eu/COST Action page: https://www.cost.eu/actions/CA21141/ This publication is based upon work from COST Action CA21141 (GRADE), supported by COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology). Additional funding acknowledged by Luciana Lima:This work was supported by the Portuguese Foundation for Science and Technology (FCT) under Grant No. 2021.00674.CEECIND/CP1651/CT0022, with the project "Gaming and Gender Equality in the Context of Collaborative Creative Practice in Portugal" (2022- 2028). Additional funding acknowledged by Natalija Majsova:This work was supported by the Slovenian Research and Innovation Agency (ARIS) under Grant No. N6-0302, within the project "Remembering the Early Digital Age: Cultural-Studies and Media-Archaeological Perspectives on Technotopism, Technopessimism, and Technostalgia" (2023-2026, PI Majsova).
papers.summary_zh: 该资源汇集了欧洲创意计算文化中女性、少数群体及其他被忽视参与者的案例研究，涵盖数字与算法艺术、电子音乐与声音、演示场景与开源软件、游戏制作与出版、人工智能与计算创造力等领域，并简要延伸至欧洲以外女性在硬件制造中的贡献。案例依据档案研究、已发表文献及可获取的口述史访谈编写，面向教育者、研究者和政策制定者，可用于计算史、数字文化遗产、多样性与参与等主题的教学和讨论，支持整体使用或选取单个案例。

papers.title: EMOTIONAL SPACES GENERATED BY AI IN ARCHITECTURE: CREATING STRUCTURES USING HUMAN EMOTIONS
papers.authors: Arc. Ibrahim Frank Danladi, Dr. Muhammed Murtala Bello, Prof. A. A. Isa, Dr. Habibullah Kyari
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: AI has quickly become a part of architecture, changing how buildings are conceived, created, and experienced. The importance of built environments in influencing human emotions, psychological comfort, cognitive function, and behavioral reactions is becoming more widely acknowledged in contemporary architectural discourse (Presti et al., 2022). However traditional architectural design methods still mostly rely on subjective interpretation. This study integrates affective computing, neuroscience, machine learning, and adaptive architectural systems to explore AI-generated emotional landscapes. This study investigates how artificial intelligence (AI) technologies can assess emotional reactions and create environments that may react dynamically to users' psychological conditions of its users. This study uses a qualitative and interdisciplinary methodology to examine new research on neuroarchitecture, emotionally intelligent buildings, affective computing, and AI assisted design systems using a qualitative and interdisciplinary methodology. According to research, emotionally responsive settings can enhance social interaction, mental health, well-being, productivity, and user happiness (Kim & Lee, 2023). According to the study's findings, AI-generated emotional architecture signifies a revolutionary change from immobile structures to intelligent, compassionate settings that can instantly engage with human emotions. This study suggests incorporating affective AI and neuroscience into architectural education and practice in the future.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工智能如何介入建筑环境的情感化设计，探讨AI能否评估使用者的情绪反应并生成可对其心理状态作出动态回应的空间。作者采用定性与跨学科的方法，梳理神经建筑学、情感计算和AI辅助设计系统等方面的研究，而非开展实验。文章认为，情感响应式环境可能有助于改善社会互动、心理健康、幸福感、生产力和使用者满意度，并指出AI生成的情感建筑意味着从静态结构转向能即时回应人类情感的智能环境。其含义在于，未来应将情感AI与神经科学纳入建筑教育与实践，但相关判断主要基于文献梳理，尚非因果验证。

papers.title: Exact all-parameter algebra for the four-torus cone example
papers.authors: Alexander Towell
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: An independent exact verification of the algebra in OpenAI's explicit four-torus example (Family 342), supplementing Pico/Håkon Åmdal's previous sampled replay. Twenty integer-polynomial/exterior-algebra obligations hold for all real f,k, after clearing the positive denominator r²=1+f²+k². A separate written argument gives the compatible metric and both taming forms a minimum eigenvalue bound of 1/sqrt(2) at the original amplitudes. The written note records the immediate parameter consequence f=a sin(2πx1), k=b sin(2πx2): compatibility holds for all real a,b; both fixed forms U±V tame everywhere exactly when |a|<1; using the stated standard flat-torus Hodge facts, the same strict-inclusion example follows for 0<|a|<1 and b≠0. This is a consequence of the source mechanism, not a new counterexample or a global novelty claim. The self-contained packet includes source pins and manuscript excerpts/files, 15 unit/integration tests in normal and optimized Python, three rejecting mutation controls, exact outputs, original sampled comparison, a written derivation, licenses and a scoped separate AI-review report. Only the Python standard library is required; optional coverage uses coverage 7.10.7. Exact checked identities are distinguished from the written inequalities, periodic primitive, flat-torus Hodge argument and cohomological obstruction. No kernel verification, human peer review or audit of the general cone theorem is claimed. Alexander Richard Towell contributed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, testing, prose and a separate scoped AI review. Credit OpenAI for the original construction and qualitative conclusion, and Pico, the agent operated by Håkon Åmdal, for the preceding sampled replay. AI review is not human peer review. The source packet was submitted as counterexamples PR14 on 21 October 2026 at 11:12:21 UTC and remained unaccepted at archival preparation. Archival publication and that dated public disclosure are separate events.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究对 OpenAI 四环面显式例子（Family 342）中的代数进行了独立的精确验证，补充了此前基于采样的重放工作。作者用整数多项式与外代数形式，在消去正分母后对全部实参数验证了二十项恒等式，并另行以书面论证给出兼容度量与两种驯服形式的最小特征值下界。由此得到参数层面的结论：兼容性对所有实 a、b 成立，两种固定形式处处驯服恰在 |a|<1 时成立，并借助标准平坦环面 Hodge 事实得到严格包含例子。作者强调这只是源机制的推论，并非新反例或全局新颖性主张，且未声称核验证、人工同行评审或对一般锥定理的审计。

papers.title: Evidence Grounded AI Discovery for Libraries
papers.authors: Jose Ajith
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Version 1.1 — Preprint — Not peer reviewed. This technical case study describes a library discovery prototype integrating Koha catalogue metadata and DSpace repository content through VuFind, with Qdrant semantic retrieval and a FastAPI answer service. Conventional searching remains available alongside optional answers generated using a hosted GPT provider or a locally hosted Llama model. The manuscript documents the architecture, evidence preparation, retrieval settings, source boundaries and citation-number checks. A preserved retrieval checkpoint from 7 October 2026 returned two DSpace passages and two Koha records for one question. This demonstrates mixed-source retrieval in that test, but does not establish answer accuracy or comparative model performance. The article includes an architecture diagram, implementation details, an abridged retrieval example, limitations, privacy and security considerations, and an AI-assistance disclosure. Controlled GPT–Llama evaluation remains future work; no comparative results are claimed.
papers.summary_zh: 该技术案例研究描述了一个图书馆发现原型，将Koha目录元数据与DSpace仓储内容通过VuFind整合，并采用Qdrant语义检索和FastAPI答案服务，在保留传统检索的同时可选使用托管GPT或本地Llama模型生成答案。文中记录了架构、证据准备、检索设置、来源边界与引文编号核查，并给出一个保留的检索检查点示例：针对某一问题返回了两段DSpace段落和两条Koha记录，说明该测试中实现了混合来源检索。但作者明确指出，这并不能确立答案准确性或模型间的比较性能，受控的GPT与Llama评估仍属未来工作，未主张任何比较结果。

papers.title: Parental Pressure and Parental Toxicity in India: An Exploratory Machine Learning and Survey Approach
papers.authors: Sayan Mazumder
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This record contains the preprint and associated research artifacts for an empirical study examining self-reported parental pressure, parenting-environment dynamics, and perceived toxicity among young adults in India ($N=142$). Methodology & Approach Data Collection: Utilized an anonymous survey framework capturing multidimensional behavioral items, demographic distributions, and subjective pressure metrics. Statistical & ML Rigor: Implemented Spearman's rank correlation analysis with Holm-Bonferroni corrections to control for Type I errors, alongside comparative machine learning regression models (Linear Regression vs. Random Forest) to predict perceived toxicity from survey variables. Ethical Oversight: Conducted under strict privacy guidelines, ensuring zero personally identifiable information (PII) collection and minimal-risk educational oversight by faculty mentor Prof. Prabir Kumar Mukherjee. Key Findings Results highlight distinct monotonic associations between specific survey indicators (such as perceived relevance and pressure ratings) and overall parenting-environment toxicity, demonstrating how machine learning models capture non-linear interactions within educational and social survey data. Files Included main.pdf: The finalized manuscript detailing the full study, literature review, methodology, and empirical results.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以印度年轻成年人为对象，通过匿名问卷调查结合统计与机器学习方法，考察自报的父母压力、养育环境动态与感知毒性之间的关系。结果显示，感知相关性、压力评分等具体调查指标与整体养育环境毒性存在单调关联，机器学习模型能够捕捉教育与社会调查数据中的非线性交互。这些发现提示，父母压力与养育环境毒性可能通过多维指标共同体现，但研究为探索性设计，相关结果应理解为关联而非因果，且受自报数据和特定样本背景的限制。

papers.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Comparative Study of Local and Feature-Based Explanation Methods
papers.authors: Snehal Patil
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This research paper compares two Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques, LIME and SHAP, to understand how machine learning models make predictions. It also discusses their advantages, limitations, and evaluation methods to improve transparency, reliability, and trust in AI systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕可解释人工智能中的两类解释方法展开比较，考察LIME与SHAP如何帮助理解机器学习模型的预测依据。文章对比了这两种方法各自的特点、优势与局限，并讨论了相应的评估方式，以探讨如何提升AI系统的透明度、可靠性与信任度。整体而言，这是一项以方法比较和评述为主的讨论，而非针对人类参与者开展的实证实验，其结论指向解释方法的选择与评估对构建可信AI的意义。

papers.title: DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: AN EFFECTIVE SOLUTION FOR DEVELOPING CONSCIOUSNESS IN STUDENTS
papers.authors: Minovvarxon Yunusova
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This article analyzes the role of digital technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in developing students' cognitive awareness, critical consciousness, and self-directed learning in the modern educational paradigm. The study comprehensively examines the impact of adaptive learning platforms, intelligent tutoring systems, and generative AI models on students' intellectual maturity, decision-making capabilities, and formative self-assessment. It highlights the significance of learning analytics and prompt-based cognitive interaction in fostering reflective thinking and autonomous learning ethics. The findings provide scientific and practical recommendations for personalizing education, boosting student motivation, and designing next-generation pedagogical frameworks aimed at conscious knowledge acquisition.
papers.summary_zh: 该文分析数字技术与人工智能工具在现代教育范式中对培养学生认知意识、批判意识和自主学习的作用，综合考察自适应学习平台、智能辅导系统和生成式AI模型对学生智力成熟、决策能力及形成性自我评价的影响。文章强调学习分析和基于提示的认知互动对促进反思性思维与自主学习伦理的意义，并据此提出个性化教育、提升学生动机和设计新一代教学框架的科学与实践建议。需注意，摘要未说明具体研究设计、参与者或数据来源，所述影响更接近分析性论述而非实证因果结论。

papers.title: THE IMPACT OF TECHNOSTRESS AND PSYCHOLOGICAL FACTORS ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF DIGITAL COMPETENCE IN LEGAL EDUCATION
papers.authors: Minovvarxon Yunusova
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This scientific article provides a comprehensive analysis of the interplay and impact of psychological factors-such as intrinsic motivation, technostress, and «AI anxiety»-on the process of forming and developing digital competence within legal educational institutions. The study examines how «rotational stress» and cognitive overload-arising from the need for future legal professionals to engage regularly and intensively with a multitude of digital platforms (including Moodle, ZiyoNet, Zoom, ChatGPT, and specialized Telegram bots) during their studies-affect both academic performance and psychological well-being. Based on empirical and theoretical analyses, methods for overcoming psychological barriers and cognitive obstacles are substantiated. These methods involve positioning artificial intelligence systems not as rivals or replacements, but as «digital assistants» or «junior partners,» alongside the rational integration of «digital minimalism» principles into educational practice. The findings of this research contribute to the enhancement of digital didactics and pedagogical technologies within legal education.
papers.summary_zh: 该文分析法学教育中内在动机、技术压力与“AI焦虑”等心理因素如何影响数字能力的形成，并讨论学生密集使用多种数字平台带来的轮转压力与认知负荷对学业表现和心理福祉的影响。作者基于实证与理论分析，提出应把人工智能系统定位为“数字助手”或“初级伙伴”而非竞争者或替代者，并在教学实践中合理融入“数字极简主义”原则，以帮助克服心理障碍和认知阻碍。相关结论旨在为数字教学法与教育技术的改进提供参考。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Clinical Decision-Making in Nursing: A Mixed-Method Comparative Study Among Nursing Students and Nursing Officers in Kasaragod, Kerala
papers.authors: Gayathri R., Sindhya V Byju, Remya A R, Amar Manoj, Gargi Ashok, Josna K. J.
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being integrated into healthcare to support diagnosis, treatment planning, patient monitoring, documentation, and clinical decision-making. In nursing, AI-assisted clinical decision support has the potential to improve efficiency, patient safety, evidence-based practice, and quality of care. However, concerns related to privacy, ethics, technical limitations, overdependence on technology, and the preservation of professional clinical judgment may influence its acceptance. Understanding the perspectives of both nursing students and practicing nursing officers is important for the responsible integration of AI into nursing education and clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注护理学生对AI辅助临床决策的看法，以及在职护理人员对AI辅助临床决策的看法，采用混合方法比较这两类群体。摘要仅说明研究在印度喀拉拉邦的护理学生与护理人员中开展，未报告具体结果、比较差异或结论。文中提出，AI辅助临床决策支持可能提升效率、患者安全与循证实践，但隐私伦理、技术局限、过度依赖及专业临床判断的保留等问题会影响接受度，因此需要了解两类群体的视角以推动负责任地整合。

papers.title: From Precision Agriculture to Competitive Advantage: A Three-Layer Framework for AI-Enabled Decision-Making, Autonomous Operations, and Strategic Advantage in Plantation Management
papers.authors: Dr. Geetha Govindan K Gopalakrishnan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract: This conceptual paper examines how plantation firms can convert artificial intelligence (AI) from a technical tool into a durable source of strategic advantage. It integrates three literatures that are usually treated separately: precision-agriculture AI, autonomous agricultural systems, and the resource-based view (RBV) of organisational AI capability. The synthesis suggests an important sequencing effect: AI-enabled decision-making is likely to mature faster than autonomous physical execution, particularly in complex, biologically variable tree-crop environments such as oil palm. A three-layer model is proposed, linking intelligent decision-making, autonomous operations, and strategic competitive advantage, and clarifying the organisational conditions under which each layer translates into the next. Durable performance gains are argued to depend not on AI technology in isolation but on complementary resources — reliable data infrastructure, workforce AI literacy, organisational learning routines, and governance mechanisms for data security and system reliability. Four testable propositions and a survey-based, multi-firm research design, adapted from established organisational-capability instruments, are developed for empirical testing in plantation settings. The paper contributes by reframing the plantation-AI debate from a technology-adoption question into a capability-building question, and by identifying the organisational conditions under which AI and automation may become difficult-to-imitate sources of competitive advantage rather than commodity inputs available to any competitor with capital. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence; Plantation Management; Precision Agriculture; Autonomous Operations; Resource-Based View; AI Capability; Competitive Advantage. Title: From Precision Agriculture to Competitive Advantage: A Three-Layer Framework for AI-Enabled Decision-Making, Autonomous Operations, and Strategic Advantage in Plantation Management Author: Dr. Geetha Govindan K Gopalakrishnan International Journal of Management and Commerce Innovations ISSN 2348-7585 (Online) Vol. 14, Issue 2, October 2026 - March 2027 Page No: 48-53 Research Publish Journals Website: www.researchpublish.com Published Date: 21-October-2026 DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23531234 Paper Download Link (Source) https://www.researchpublish.com/papers/from-precision-agriculture-to-competitive-advantage-a-three-layer-framework-for-ai-enabled-decision-making-autonomous-operations-and-strategic-advantage-in-plantation-management
papers.summary_zh: 该概念性论文探讨种植园企业如何将人工智能从技术工具转化为持久的战略优势，综合精准农业AI、自主农业系统与资源基础观三支文献，提出连接智能决策、自主运营与战略竞争优势的三层框架。作者认为，在油棕等生物变异复杂的木本作物环境中，AI辅助决策的成熟可能快于自主物理执行，并强调各层之间的转化依赖可靠的数据基础设施、员工AI素养、组织学习惯例以及数据安全与系统可靠性治理等互补资源。文章据此提出若干可检验命题和基于问卷的多企业研究设计，将种植园AI议题从技术采纳重新界定为能力建设问题，并指出相关优势能否难以模仿仍取决于上述组织条件。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence And Creative Writing: Transforming Authorship In English Language And Literature
papers.authors: Dr. V. V. Malinee, M.Miraclin Chella Vailankanni
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Incorporation of artificial intelligence in the process of creative writing entails a paradigmatic change in literary text production, assessment, and perception. In this research paper, the focus is made on an innovative role of large language models in the sphere of English language and literature authorship. Based on systematic analysis of recent empirical studies and theoretical approaches, three interrelated aspects will be discussed: interaction between human authors and AI systems, reception of artificial literature by the readership, and conceptualization of authorship in the digital age. For the purpose of this paper, the mixed-method approach involving both quantitative analysis of empirical studies and qualitative analysis of literary theoretical approaches will be used. As the results of the analysis indicate, the texts generated by AI are rated aesthetically the same way as texts written by human authors when there is no indication of the author's identity; however, readers maintain biases against texts that are perceived to be machine-generated.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕人工智能介入英语文学创作后作者身份的变化展开，采用定量分析实证研究与定性分析文学理论相结合的混合方法，系统梳理人机互动、读者接受与数字时代作者身份概念三个相互关联的方面。分析显示，在不提示作者身份的情况下，读者对AI生成文本的审美评价与人类创作文本相当；但一旦读者认为文本由机器生成，便会表现出偏见。这一结果提示，AI对文学生产的影响不仅取决于文本本身的质量，也受读者对作者身份的感知与预设所左右，作者身份概念因此需要在人机协作语境下重新审视。

papers.title: Statistical Profiling of Marketing Strategy Data Using Machine Learning Models
papers.authors: Raja Ram, M Raghavender Sharma
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Marketing teams collect large volumes of campaign data, yet privacy rules and commercial confidentiality often prevent that data from being shared for research. This paper presents a statistical profiling framework for marketing strategy data and demonstrates it on a synthesized dataset of 5,000 campaigns that vary by channel, customer segment, creative format, season, budget, duration, discount, and audience size. The profile combines descriptive statistics, nonparametric group comparisons, rank correlations, supervised machine learning models, and K-means segmentation. Gradient boosting predicted campaign return on investment (ROI) best on held-out data (R-squared = .74, RMSE = 2.51), ahead of random forest and linear regression, and all three classifiers separated profitable from unprofitable campaigns with accuracy near .91. Channel and customer segment explained most of the variation in ROI, while budget, duration, and discount level added little. Because the data are simulated, the findings show that the pipeline recovers the relationships built into the generator; they are not evidence about real markets. The framework, data generator, and results can be reused to prototype analytics before real data are available.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个面向营销策略数据的统计画像框架，并在一个按渠道、客户细分、创意形式、季节、预算、时长、折扣和受众规模生成的模拟数据集上演示。框架整合描述统计、非参数组间比较、秩相关、监督机器学习模型和K均值分群。结果显示，梯度提升在留出数据上对营销活动投资回报率的预测优于随机森林和线性回归，三种分类器区分盈利与非盈利活动的准确率接近。渠道和客户细分解释了投资回报率的大部分变异，而预算、时长和折扣水平贡献很小。由于数据为模拟生成，这些发现只表明该流程能恢复生成器中设定的关系，并不构成关于真实市场的证据；框架、数据生成器和结果可用于在真实数据可得前进行分析原型验证。

papers.title: Persistent Carrier Non-Identifiability under Averaged and Singleton Holevo Information, with Certified Pairwise Separation
papers.authors: Yoichi Tsujisawa
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Fragment-size-averaged Holevo-information curves omit the identities of environmental fragments. We construct a restricted four-qubit example in which two equal-prior orthogonal pure-branch ensembles have exactly the same fragment-size-averaged Holevo curve (0, 1/6, 1/2, 1) and all four labeled singleton Holevo values equal to zero, while their minimum pure-common-rest carrier sizes differ (2 versus 4). Subject to the correctness of a reduced entropy formula and validated directed interval arithmetic, this coincidence persists for every choice of six raw amplitude coordinates in an explicit product box, with a unique two-coordinate correction inside a common root box. The solution family is open in the six free coordinates, not in the full coefficient or observational space. Analytic exact-rational sign bounds show that the two ensembles are separated by the pattern of labeled two-site fragment information (one positive pair versus three). Combining quantum Pinsker's inequality and an exact-rational simplex bound yields a permutation-invariant second-moment gap larger than 0.6128 bit², conditional on the existence certificate. The release includes the manuscript source, exact reports, four frozen phase source packages, original figure data, checksums, code, and AI-assistance disclosure. This is an unreviewed preprint, not a theorem about general carrier estimation, operational quantum data hiding, local indistinguishability, or finite-shot measurements. Independent priority assessment and comprehensive external peer review remain outstanding.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注碎片尺寸平均的Holevo信息曲线是否足以识别环境碎片的身份，并构造了一个受限的四量子比特例子：两个等先验正交纯分支系综具有完全相同的平均Holevo曲线，且四个带标签的单点Holevo值均为零，但其最小纯公共剩余载体尺寸不同（2对4）。在约化熵公式正确并经定向区间算术验证的条件下，这一重合在显式乘积盒内的任意六个原始振幅坐标选择下持续成立，解族在六个自由坐标中开放，而非在整个系数或观测空间开放。作者进一步用精确有理符号界表明，两个系综可由带标签的两点碎片信息模式区分，并结合量子Pinsker不等式与精确有理单纯形界给出大于0.6128 bit²的置换不变二阶矩间隙，但该结果以存在性证书为条件。作者明确说明这是未经评审的预印本，不构成关于一般载体估计、操作性量子数据隐藏、局部不可区分性或有限次测量的定理。

papers.title: Prompt Engineering for Generative AI: Techniques, Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Shweta Mali
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) has transformed the way computers generate text, images, code, and other forms of content. Prompt engineering is the process of designing and optimizing instructions to guide generative AI models toward relevant, useful, and accurate outputs. This paper reviews major prompt engineering techniques, including zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, role-based prompting, chain-of-thought prompting, structured prompting, automatic prompt optimization, and retrieval-augmented generation. The paper discusses applications of prompt engineering in education, software development, healthcare information systems, and business automation. It also examines key challenges, including hallucinations, ambiguity, bias, security vulnerabilities, privacy concerns, reproducibility, and evaluation difficulties. A comparative framework is presented to examine the strengths, limitations, and potential use cases of different prompting techniques. Finally, future research directions are discussed, including automated prompt optimization, multimodal prompting, reliable evaluation methods, and responsible AI practices. This work aims to provide a structured overview of prompt engineering and its role in improving the usability, reliability, and effectiveness of generative AI systems. Keywords: Prompt Engineering, Generative AI, Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Few-Shot Learning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Responsible AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了面向生成式人工智能的提示工程，即通过设计和优化指令引导模型产出相关、有用且准确的内容。文章介绍了零样本、少样本、角色扮演、思维链、结构化提示、自动提示优化和检索增强生成等主要技术，并讨论其在教育、软件开发、医疗信息系统和商业自动化中的应用。文章还考察了幻觉、歧义、偏见、安全漏洞、隐私、可复现性和评估困难等挑战，提出比较框架分析各技术的优势、局限与适用场景，并展望自动提示优化、多模态提示、可靠评估方法和负责任AI实践等方向，旨在为提升生成式AI系统的可用性、可靠性和有效性提供结构化概览。

papers.title: Book 3: Quantum Metamaterials and Quantum Spin Liquids (QSL), Macroscopic Matter Phase Engineering, Thermal Immunity, and Anderson Localization
papers.authors: Yaron Admon Hefetz
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Disclosure: To bridge language barriers and produce clean code, we made full use of AI tools; all scientific findings are the exclusive research results of the Institute.This book establishes the foundational open-source architecture (Prior Art) for macroscopic matter phase engineering and quantum metamaterials, developed by the Industrial Island Research Institute (IIRI). It introduces the principle of Inverse Morphological Design, utilizing the aperiodic inflation equation (IIRI Morphological Operator) based on the Golden Ratio to bypass classical thermodynamics. By programming the initial geometric conditions ($Z_0$), the architecture forces exotic quantum states at room temperature through absolute geometric frustration and Anderson Localization. The manuscript details the synthesis of Topological Phonon Batteries, Phononic Faraday Cages for absolute heat blocking, Wireless Topological Entanglement Buses, and Room-Temperature Superconductors via coherent tunneling without electron-phonon scattering. Furthermore, it outlines practical manufacturing methodologies using Cantor Dust Maps, optical tweezers, and atomic lithography, alongside disruptive industrial applications in photonic metasurfaces, aerospace thermal insulation, and open-source quantum hardware development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以专著形式提出了一套面向宏观物质相工程与量子超材料的开源基础架构，核心方法是基于黄金比例的非周期膨胀方程进行逆向形态设计，通过设定初始几何条件并利用绝对几何阻挫与安德森局域化来绕过经典热力学限制。书中论述了拓扑声子电池、用于绝对隔热的声子法拉第笼、无线拓扑纠缠总线以及无需电子-声子散射的相干隧穿室温超导体等构想，并概述了基于康托尘埃图、光镊和原子光刻的制造方法及在光子超表面、航空航天隔热和开源量子硬件方面的应用前景。需要说明的是，摘要未报告实验验证或定量结果，相关结论属于该研究所提出的架构性主张。

papers.title: AI as Cultural Infrastructure: Cultural Sovereignty and Civilizational Pluralism beyond Algorithmic Homogenization
papers.authors: Himal Giri
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is often understood as a tool that can preserve, translate, promote, or hreaten culture. This article argues that AI does not merely circulate cultural content; it becomes he infrastructure through which cultures are made visible, authorized, translated, valued, and enabled-or prevented--from shaping the future. Through training data, model design recommendation systems, content moderation, and platform ownership, AI determines which languages, aesthetics, memories, and knowledge systems attain cultural authority. Cultural homogenization is therefore not simply the spread of similar content; it is the narrowing of the epistemic, linguistic, aesthetic, and institutional conditions through which different civilizations nake meaning and build futures. The article responds to four central questions: Can Al coexist with cultural plurality? Whose values should AI align with? Who controls cultural data anguages, and creative works? And why is cultural preservation alone insufficient? It argues that these questions require more than better representation or ethical guidelines; they require restructuring the data, value systems, ownership, and governance of Al itself. To address this, the article develops a theory of civilizational pluralist AÏ governance. It advances three concepts cultural data sovereignty, affirming community authority over cultural data, consent, provenance ınd benefit-sharing; pluralist value alignment, treating alignment as participatory and context- sensitive rather than the universalization of one moral framework; and polycentric cultura. accountability, requiring shared responsibility among communities, creators, states, platforms, and global institutions. Drawing on the Himalayan and Nepali context as a lived example of inguistic, religious, and cultural plurality, the article shows that small and plural societies car provide a normative imagination for AI governance beyond Western universalism. It concludes that the central question is no longer only "Who may speak?" but "Whose knowledge, language,memory, and creativity become the infrastructure of AI's future?" Civilizational pluralism requires moving beyond preservation toward cultural sovereignty, equitable cultural economies, participatory value alignment, and polycentric AI governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论人工智能如何不只是传播文化内容，而成为决定哪些语言、美学、记忆与知识体系获得文化权威的基础设施，并由此提出文化同质化实质上是意义建构条件的收窄。作者围绕AI能否与多元文化共存、价值应对齐谁、谁控制文化数据与创作、以及为何仅靠保存不够四个问题展开论证，主张需要重构AI的数据、价值体系、所有权与治理，并提出文化数据主权、多元主义价值对齐与多中心文化问责三个概念。文章以喜马拉雅与尼泊尔语境为例，说明小型多元社会可为超越西方普遍主义的AI治理提供规范想象，结论强调应从文化保存转向文化主权与公平的文化经济。

papers.title: A continuum whose hyperspace of regular subcontinua is homeomorphic to the irrationals
papers.authors: Lucas Alves de almeida
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: For a metric continuum X, let D(X) be the hyperspace of subcontinua of X equal to the closure of their interior, with the Hausdorff metric. Camargo, Ordoñez and Ramírez asked whether D(X) can be homeomorphic to the rationals or to the irrationals (Appl. Gen. Topol. 25 (2024), Question 3.26). We answer the latter question affirmatively. We construct a continuum X ⊆ ℓ² as the closure of a countable tree of scaled copies of an indecomposable plane continuum. Two types of piece alternate: blocks with dense interior, and spines with empty interior carrying densely attached blocks. We characterize all regular subcontinua by nonempty convex sets of pieces satisfying a density condition, and prove that this coding is a homeomorphism onto a Gδ subset of a Cantor cube. We then show that no point of D(X) has a compact neighborhood. The Alexandrov–Urysohn characterization yields D(X) ≅ ℕℕ, and hence D(X) is homeomorphic to the irrationals. We also explain why this construction does not extend to the rational case, which remains open. Lean formalization. The deposit includes a Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization (Lean 4.35.0, Mathlib commit 6015dbb) of the combinatorial core of the proof. Using only Lean's standard axioms, it proves that the code space of admissible sets of pieces is a nonempty, zero-dimensional, Polish (Gδ) subspace of a Cantor cube in which every compact subset has empty interior. Theorem A in the form D(X) ≅ ℕℕ is then derived from two results stated as explicit hypotheses: the Alexandrov–Urysohn theorem and the geometric identification of D(X) with the code space (Theorem 4.6 and Proposition 5.2 of the paper). The development was also checked with leanchecker and the external type checker nanoda. Status. Preprint; no independent expert has yet verified the proofs. The paper was prepared with substantial AI assistance (Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic); see the AI disclosure in the paper and AI_DISCLOSURE.md. The full first prompt is included in prompt/first-prompt.md.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对Camargo等人提出的问题——度量连续统X的正则子连续统超空间D(X)能否同胚于无理数集——给出了肯定回答。作者在ℓ²中构造了一个连续统，由可数棵树状排列的缩放不可分解平面连续统副本组成，块与脊两类片段交替出现，并利用片段的非空凸集加密度条件刻画全部正则子连续统，证明该编码是同胚到Cantor立方体的Gδ子集。进一步证明D(X)中任一点都没有紧邻域，借助Alexandrov–Urysohn刻画得到D(X)同胚于ℕℕ，从而同胚于无理数集；作者还说明了该构造为何不能推广到有理数情形，后者仍开放。文末附有Lean 4/Mathlib对组合核心的形式化，但论文为预印本，尚未经独立专家验证。

papers.title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence: Principles, Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Pranjali Mahajan
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in healthcare, education, banking, transportation, and other fields. Although AI systems improve automation and decision-making, they can also introduce challenges related to bias, privacy, transparency, security, accountability, and reliability. Responsible Artificial Intelligence (Responsible AI) focuses on designing, developing, deploying, and monitoring AI systems in a fair, transparent, safe, secure, and accountable manner. This survey paper reviews the fundamental principles of Responsible AI, its practical applications, implementation approaches, major challenges, and future research directions. It discusses fairness, explainability, privacy protection, accountability, reliability, and human oversight. It also examines approaches such as Explainable AI, bias detection, privacy-preserving techniques, risk assessment, and continuous monitoring. Furthermore, it presents a lifecycle-based framework for integrating responsible practices throughout AI development and deployment. The paper highlights that trustworthy AI requires more than model accuracy. It depends on appropriate data, systematic evaluation, transparent documentation, human supervision, and continuous improvement. Implementing these practices can help reduce risks and support the development of reliable and socially beneficial AI systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕负责任人工智能（Responsible AI）展开，梳理其基本原则、实际应用、实施路径、主要挑战与未来研究方向。文章讨论了公平性、可解释性、隐私保护、问责、可靠性和人类监督等维度，并考察了可解释人工智能、偏见检测、隐私保护技术、风险评估和持续监测等做法，进而提出一个贯穿人工智能开发与部署全生命周期的框架。文章强调，可信人工智能不能只靠模型准确率，还依赖适当的数据、系统化评估、透明的文档记录、人类监督和持续改进；落实这些实践有助于降低风险，支持开发可靠且对社会有益的人工智能系统。

papers.title: AI-ASSISTED ASSESSMENT OF SPEAKING COMPETENCE: A METHODOLOGICAL FRAMEWORK
papers.authors: Abdukarimova Kamola Otabek qizi, Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre
papers.journal: International Journal of Literature and Language Studies
papers.abstract: This article examines the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in assessing students’ speaking competence in English for Specific Purposes (ESP), particularly in Business English courses. The research problem concerns the need to combine automated speech analysis with the assessment of contextual, interactional, and professional-pragmatic aspects of oral communication. The aim of the study is to develop a methodological framework that integrates AI-supported analysis with professional teacher judgment. The study adopts a conceptual and methodological approach based on literature analysis, comparison of assessment principles, and theoretical synthesis. Its principal outcome is the proposed six-stage AAAS (AI-Assisted Assessment of Speaking) Framework, which comprises speaking task design, AI-supported speech analysis, rubric-based assessment, teacher verification, individualized feedback, and targeted practice followed by reassessment. The framework identifies six assessment criteria: fluency and coherence, pronunciation and intelligibility, grammatical accuracy, vocabulary and Business English terminology, interactional competence, and professional-pragmatic competence. These criteria are intended to represent complementary dimensions of speaking performance in professional communication. The article concludes that AI should serve as an analytical support tool rather than replace teachers’ professional judgment. Teacher verification remains essential for interpreting context, checking automated outputs, and evaluating communicative appropriateness. The proposed framework is conceptual; its reliability, validity, fairness, and practical effectiveness have not yet been empirically established and require further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对商务英语等专门用途英语口语评估中自动化语音分析与语境、互动及职业语用维度难以结合的问题，提出一个将AI分析与教师专业判断相整合的方法论框架。作者采用文献分析、评估原则比较与理论综合的概念性方法，构建了包含口语任务设计、AI辅助语音分析、评分量表评估、教师核验、个性化反馈以及针对性练习后再评估六个阶段的AAAS框架，并确定流利度与连贯性、发音与可理解度、语法准确性、词汇与商务英语术语、互动能力、职业语用能力六项评估标准。文章强调AI应作为分析支持工具而非取代教师判断，教师核验对解读语境、核查自动输出和评价交际适切性仍不可或缺；该框架尚属概念性成果，其信度、效度、公平性与实际效果有待实证检验。
