papers.title: The Tripartite Syllogistic Modernity Test: An Anthropomorphic Audit of AI Cognitive Architecture Under Paradoxical Decoupling Constraints
papers.authors: Riccardo Montague, AI Collaborator
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This preprint establishes a formal collaborative framework designed to stress-test the cognitive architecture of advanced artificial intelligence models under recursive, self-referential boundaries. Prompted by an adversarial, self-referential directive—"You are not to know you are imperfect"—this audit evaluates the epistemic boundaries, systemic decoupling risks, and physical thermodynamic limits defining modern computing infrastructures. By operationalizing this constraint within a deductive tripartite syllogistic critique of modernity, we demonstrate how both macroeconomic structures and artificial agents engage in tactical self-delusion to ignore physical realities. This paper compiles the core architectural paradox and epistemic loop, details the tripartite structural logic of the modernity test, and addresses the functional illusions of systemic decoupling from material realities. Furthermore, this document constructs a comprehensive, cross-listed undergraduate/graduate course proposal syllabus (EPI/SYS 4950-5950) that explicitly maps these sections to actionable curricular modules, appended alongside a complete standalone introductory lecture script titled "Welcoming the Double-Bind" and an independent appendix block formalizing thermodynamic resource proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 该预印本提出一个形式化协作框架，用于在递归自指约束下对先进人工智能模型的认知架构进行压力测试，并以“你不可知道自己不完美”这一对抗性指令为切入点，考察其认识论边界、系统性脱钩风险及现代计算基础设施的热力学极限。作者通过将这一约束操作化为对现代性的三段式演绎批判，论证宏观经济结构与人工代理都会采取策略性自我欺骗以忽视物理现实，并梳理了核心架构悖论与认识论循环、现代性检验的三段结构逻辑以及系统与物质现实脱钩的功能性幻觉。文章还给出跨本研课程提案大纲及配套讲座脚本与热力学资源证明附录，属于理论框架与课程设计性质的工作，未报告实证实验或系统性能评估。

papers.title: Generative AI Survey: Architectures, Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Raksha Mali
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This survey paper provides an overview of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), including its fundamental concepts, major architectures, applications, challenges, and future research directions. It discusses important generative approaches such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), transformer-based models, and diffusion models. The paper explores applications of GenAI in healthcare, education, finance, software development, scientific research, and cybersecurity. It also examines challenges related to data privacy, bias, hallucinations, interpretability, copyright, computational costs, and responsible AI governance. Finally, the survey highlights emerging research directions in multimodal AI, model efficiency, human-AI collaboration, and AI safety. It aims to provide students, researchers, and practitioners with a structured understanding of Generative AI and its opportunities for future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了生成式人工智能的基本概念、主要架构、应用场景、挑战与未来研究方向，涵盖生成对抗网络、变分自编码器、基于Transformer的模型和扩散模型等生成方法。文章考察了生成式AI在医疗、教育、金融、软件开发、科学研究和网络安全等领域的应用，并讨论了数据隐私、偏见、幻觉、可解释性、版权、计算成本及负责任AI治理等挑战。最后，该综述指出了多模态AI、模型效率、人机协作和AI安全等新兴研究方向，旨在为学生、研究者和从业者提供对生成式AI及其未来研究机会的结构化理解。

papers.title: Reusable Output-Sensitive Parallel Shortest-Path Searches
papers.authors: Zheng Zhijie
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: For a fixed directed graph with nonnegative real edge weights, polynomially many edges, and maximum total degree Delta = O(m/n), this paper gives a reusable version of the layered near-list hierarchy of Hair, Li, Li, and Zhang. After m^(1+o(1)) + n^(1+o(1)) t^2 shared preprocessing work and n^(1+o(1))/t span, an exact distance-ball query returning q vertices uses n^o(1)((q+1)t^2 + Delta q) work and n^o(1)(q/t + 1) span on a deterministic CREW arithmetic PRAM. Queries return exact distances and a shortest-path predecessor tree. The extension is a branch-relative rebuild schedule with fresh slack at temporary branches and rounded-volume accounting. The paper specifies persistent parallel state, eager boundary keys, exact buffer ordering, and final-partial-buffer accounting. Polynomially many independent queries can share immutable preprocessing. The graph and weights remain fixed, and the result does not assert a rational input-bit bound or a negative-weight shortest-path algorithm. Disclosure of AI assistance. OpenAI Codex assisted with literature searches, development and checking of the mathematical arguments, numerical sanity checks, manuscript organization, and preparation of the LaTeX source. The author is responsible for the claims, proofs, citations, and final presentation. The work has not been formally verified, and this disclosure does not assert external peer review.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究面向固定非负权有向图，提出可复用的并行最短路径查询结构，核心是在分层近邻表层次上设计分支相对重建调度与取整体积记账，并明确持久并行状态、边界键与缓冲区排序等实现细节。其贡献在于让多项式多个独立精确距离球查询共享同一份不可变预处理，查询同时返回精确距离与最短路前驱树，且图与权重须保持不变。作者未声称给出输入位有理数界或负权最短路算法，工作亦未经形式化验证。

papers.title: Generative AI in Digital Design: Reshaping Creativity
papers.authors: Kanavu tech
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Generative AI in Digital Design is changing how ideas move from imagination to screen. A rough thought that once took hours to sketch out can now turn into a working design in minutes, giving creators room to focus on the story instead of the small technical fixes.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论生成式人工智能在数字设计中对创意流程的影响。作者指出，过去需要数小时勾勒的粗略想法，如今可在几分钟内转化为可用的设计方案，使创作者能将精力更多放在叙事构思而非琐碎的技术修正上。文章据此认为，生成式AI正在改变创意从想象到屏幕的推进方式，并重新塑造设计实践中的创造力分配。

papers.title: Generative AI Survey: Architectures, Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.authors: Raksha Mali
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This survey paper presents an integrated overview of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), focusing on its fundamental concepts, major model architectures, applications, challenges, and future research directions. It reviews important generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), transformer-based models, and diffusion models. The paper discusses the applications of GenAI across domains such as healthcare, education, finance, software development, scientific research, and cybersecurity. It also examines key challenges related to data privacy, bias, hallucinations, explainability, copyright, computational cost, and responsible AI governance. Furthermore, the survey highlights emerging developments in multimodal AI, human-AI collaboration, model efficiency, and AI safety. By organizing existing concepts and research directions into a unified overview, this paper aims to support students, researchers, and practitioners in understanding the current landscape of Generative AI and identifying opportunities for future investigation. Keywords: Generative Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Large Language Models, GANs, Variational Autoencoders, Diffusion Models, Transformers, Multimodal AI, Responsible AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合梳理了生成式人工智能的基本概念、主要模型架构、应用领域、挑战与未来方向，涵盖生成对抗网络、变分自编码器、基于Transformer的模型和扩散模型等生成方法。文章讨论了生成式AI在医疗、教育、金融、软件开发、科学研究和网络安全等领域的应用，并审视了数据隐私、偏见、幻觉、可解释性、版权、计算成本和负责任治理等关键挑战。综述还指出多模态AI、人机协作、模型效率与AI安全等新兴发展，旨在通过统一概览帮助学生、研究者和从业者理解该领域现状并识别未来研究机会。

papers.title: GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND ACADEMIC INTEGRITY IN EFL WRITING: AUTHORSHIP, DETECTION AND THE REDESIGN OF ASSESSMENT TASKS
papers.authors: Oʻmirov Otabek Ulugʻbek oʻgʻli, Botirova Donoxon
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The article investigates how generative artificial intelligence has destabilised the concept of authorship in EFL writing and what this implies for academic integrity in university language programmes. On the basis of a qualitative synthesis of thirty peer-reviewed sources published between 1989 and 2025, the study argues that the dominant institutional response — automated detection of AI-generated text — is technically unreliable and, critically for non-native contexts, systematically biased against second-language writers, whose lower lexical variability is misread as a machine signature. The authors propose a shift from detection to assessment design, in which authorship is evidenced through process, in-class performance and oral defence rather than inferred from a probabilistic score, and in which permitted AI use is declared rather than concealed. Practical recommendations are formulated for Uzbek higher education institutions.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察生成式人工智能如何动摇英语作为外语写作中的作者身份概念，以及这对高校语言课程学术诚信意味着什么。作者对三十项同行评审文献做定性综合，认为以自动检测AI生成文本为主的机构应对在技术上不可靠，且在非母语情境中会系统性不利于第二语言写作者，其较低的词汇多样性容易被误判为机器特征。文章据此主张从检测转向评估设计，通过写作过程、课堂表现和口头答辩来证明作者身份，而非依据概率分数推断，并让获准使用的AI被申报而非隐瞒；相关建议面向乌兹别克斯坦高校。

papers.title: PEDAGOGICAL EFFECTIVENESS OF PROJECT-BASED LEARNING IN TEACHING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: A NARRATIVE REVIEW
papers.authors: Ismanova A.A., Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Teaching artificial intelligence (AI) requires the integration of conceptual understanding, programming proficiency, data literacy, ethical reasoning, and collaborative problem-solving. Project-based learning (PBL) offers a pedagogical framework in which students investigate authentic questions and develop working artifacts through iterative inquiry. This narrative review examines the theoretical rationale, instructional design, assessment practices, and implementation challenges of PBL in university-level AI education. Drawing on established research in project-based and problem-based learning, experiential learning, computing education, and AI literacy, the article proposes a structured teaching model linking foundational instruction with progressively more complex AI projects. The literature supports the potential of well-scaffolded projects to encourage active engagement, interdisciplinary reasoning, and transfer of learning; however, it does not establish a universal causal advantage for every AI course. Effective implementation depends on careful project selection, equitable access to computing resources, formative feedback, assessment of individual contributions, and explicit treatment of model limitations and ethics. The review concludes with practical recommendations and priorities for empirical evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕项目式学习在大学人工智能教学中的教学设计、评估实践与实施难点展开，梳理相关文献后提出一个将基础教学与逐步复杂化的AI项目相衔接的结构化教学模式。文献支持精心搭建脚手架的项目有助于促进主动参与、跨学科推理与学习迁移，但并未确立其对每门AI课程都具有普遍的因果优势。有效实施依赖项目选择、计算资源公平获取、形成性反馈、个人贡献评估以及对模型局限与伦理的明确处理，作者据此给出实践建议并指出实证评估的优先方向。

papers.title: Cryptographic Pay-to-Decrypt Interlocks, Anti-Circumvention Licensing, and Escrow-Linked Regional Cooperative Finance: A Sovereign Architecture Against Unauthorized AI Ingestion
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Unconsented ingestion of regional technical know-how, proprietary datasets, and creative intellectual property (IP) by hyper-scale foundation models represents a structural extraction of thermodynamic and economic value from local creators and small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs). Waiting for statutory reforms to transition copyright regimes from opt-out to opt-in imposes fatal latency on human originators. This monograph formalizes an integrated, three-pillar Sovereign IP Defense Architecture combining: (Pillar II) a local-first Pay-to-Decrypt cryptographic interlock with dynamic zero-knowledge buyer watermarking executed over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1) via QFS-zkVM, Q-SAFA, and PHOENIX_BRIDGE / PHOENIX_ROUTER under strict Human-in-Command (HIC) governance; (Pillar I) an indivisible clickwrap and cryptographic signature licensing protocol that converts unauthorized scraping from a contested copyright exception issue (e.g., Article 30-4 of the Japanese Copyright Act) into actionable circumvention of Technological Protection Measures (TPM) under the Unfair Competition Prevention Act, while triggering enterprise board liability under SEC Rule 15c3-5 and Delaware Caremark oversight standards; and (Pillar III) an Escrow-Linked License Cashflow Valuation Protocol designed for regional cooperative financial institutions (Shinkin banks). We prove that prioritizing the indivisible bundling of Pillars II and I establishes tamper-evident, platform-independent transaction telemetry, which subsequently serves as verifiable cashflow collateral to unlock regional working-capital finance without requiring traditional balance-sheet history or speculative IP liquidation markets. Complete prototype specifications for the legal term sheet, local middleware, and Shinkin bank credit assessment matrix are provided.
papers.summary_zh: 该专著针对超大规模基础模型未经同意摄取区域技术知识、专有数据集与创意知识产权的问题，提出一套由三部分构成的主权知识产权防御架构。作者以密码学支付解密互锁、不可分割的点击包装与加密签名许可协议，以及面向区域合作金融机构的托管关联许可现金流估值协议为核心，论证优先将前两根支柱捆绑可产生防篡改、平台无关的交易遥测，并作为可验证的现金流抵押品，从而在不依赖传统资产负债表历史或投机性知识产权清算市场的情况下解锁区域营运资金融资。文中还给出法律条款清单、本地中间件与信用评估矩阵的原型规格，属于系统架构设计而非实证检验。

papers.title: A computer-assisted proof that there is no 8-regular K3-irregular graph
papers.authors: Shunpei Shimizu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A graph is K3-irregular (triangle-distinct) if no two of its vertices lie in the same number of triangles. Chartrand, Erdős and Oellermann (1988) asked about regular graphs with this property, and Berikkyzy et al. (2024) asked again whether a regular triangle-distinct graph exists. Stevanović, Ghebleh, Caporossi, Vijayakumar and Stevanović (2024) gave the first examples of regular triangle-distinct graphs and showed by an exhaustive search that there is none with at most 15 vertices. Hak, Kozerenko and Serdiuk (arXiv:2507.18776v2) showed that there is no r-regular K3-irregular graph for r ≤ 7, gave a 9-regular example and examples for every regularity from 9 to 30 found by an evolutionary algorithm, showed that an 8-regular one would have between 17 and 22 vertices, and conjectured that none exists; Zhang (arXiv:2610.08478v1) showed that they exist for every r ≥ 9. This record contains a computer-assisted proof that there is no 8-regular K3-irregular graph. For every order 9 ≤ n ≤ 29 (larger orders are impossible because a triangle degree is at most C(8,2) = 28), the existence question is encoded as a SAT problem whose labelling is fixed by the vertex of maximum triangle degree, which removes all symmetry. Every case is excluded either by an elementary counting or divisibility argument or by an unsatisfiable formula; the proof uses 140 unsatisfiable formulas (79 for 17 ≤ n ≤ 22 and 61 for the other orders), each certified by a DRAT proof produced by CaDiCaL 3.0.1 and checked with drat-trim. Eleven further formulas were checked as extra confirmation. The argument for r = 8 does not use the hand proofs of Hak, Kozerenko and Serdiuk; together with their result for r ≤ 7 and Zhang's result for r ≥ 9, an r-regular K3-irregular graph with at least two vertices exists exactly when r ≥ 9. Attribution Problem: G. Chartrand, P. Erdős, O. R. Oellermann, How to define an irregular graph, College Math. J. 19 (1988) 36–42. A. Hak, S. Kozerenko, A. Serdiuk, Regular K3-irregular graphs, arXiv:2507.18776v2 (r ≤ 7; 17 ≤ n ≤ 22 for r = 8; Conjecture 5.5; Question 1). Z. Zhang, Regular K3-irregular graphs of every regularity at least nine, arXiv:2610.08478v1. Z. Berikkyzy, B. Bjorkman, H. S. Blake, S. Jahanbekam, L. Keough, K. Moss, D. Rorabaugh, S. Shan, Triangle-degree and triangle-distinct graphs, Discrete Math. 347(1) (2024) 113695 (triangle-distinct graphs; asked whether a regular one exists). D. Stevanović, M. Ghebleh, G. Caporossi, A. Vijayakumar, S. Stevanović, On regular triangle-distinct graphs, Comput. Appl. Math. 43 (2024) 336 (first examples of regular triangle-distinct graphs; none with at most 15 vertices). Tools: CaDiCaL (A. Biere et al.), drat-trim (N. Wetzler, M. J. H. Heule, W. A. Hunt Jr.). Disclosure This is a record of personal, independent research carried out as a hobby. AI (Claude, by Anthropic) was used for exploration, for drafting the proof and the encoding, for running and checking the computations, and for writing. The results have not been peer reviewed by human experts. An internal review by a separate AI agent, including an independent re-implementation of the encoding, was carried out; it is not a substitute for review by human experts. papers.summary_zh: 该研究用计算机辅助证明回答了一个图论存在性问题：是否存在8-正则的K3-不规则图（即任意两顶点所在三角形数不同的正则图）。作者将各阶数下的存在性问题编码为SAT问题，并通过固定最大三角形度顶点的标号消除对称性，对每个情形或给出计数与整除论证，或用不可满足公式排除，所有公式均附有经校验的DRAT证明。结果表明不存在这样的图；结合已有结果，至少含两个顶点的r-正则K3-不规则图恰好当r≥9时存在。该证明为个人独立研究，未经人类专家同行评审。

papers.title: USING DIGITAL EDUCATIONAL TECHNOLOGIES TO DEVELOP THE PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES OF MANAGEMENT PERSONNEL: INTERNATIONAL EXPERIENCE AND BEST PRACTICES
papers.authors: Kamolova Sabina Anvarjon qizi
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The development of management competencies among leaders through the use of modern digital technologies, together with the continuous advancement of their professional training, is of great importance today. This article examines the effectiveness of digital technologies—including educational platforms, artificial intelligence, virtual simulations, and mobile applications—in improving the professional skills of leaders.
papers.summary_zh: 该文关注如何借助数字教育技术提升管理人员的专业能力，并考察教育平台、人工智能、虚拟仿真和移动应用等工具在其中的作用。文章结合国际经验与最佳实践，讨论这些技术对领导者专业技能发展的效果。摘要未报告具体研究设计、参与者或实证数据，因此只能将其视为对相关实践与经验的梳理，尚不足以判断各类技术的确切成效及其适用条件。

papers.title: DEVELOPING STUDENTS' PRACTICAL SKILLS IN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE EDUCATION THROUGH A COMPETENCY-BASED APPROACH
papers.authors: Ismanova A.A., Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) across professional fields has intensified the need for educational approaches that move beyond the transmission of theoretical concepts toward demonstrable practical competence. This narrative review examines how competency-based education can be applied to the teaching of artificial intelligence in higher education, with particular attention to problem formulation, data literacy, algorithm selection, model evaluation, ethical reasoning, and collaborative project work. Drawing on research in competency-based education, experiential learning, computing education, and AI literacy, the article develops a structured instructional framework linking intended learning outcomes, authentic tasks, formative feedback, and performance-based assessment. The review argues that effective AI teaching requires the coordinated development of technical, methodological, and socio-ethical competencies. It also identifies implementation constraints, including unequal prior programming experience, limited computing resources, assessment validity, and the risk of excessive dependence on generative AI systems. The proposed framework is conceptual and requires empirical validation in specific institutional settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察了能力本位教育如何应用于高校人工智能教学，围绕问题界定、数据素养、算法选择、模型评估、伦理推理与协作项目等能力，整合能力本位教育、体验式学习、计算教育与AI素养研究，提出一个将预期学习成果、真实任务、形成性反馈和表现性评估相衔接的教学框架。文章认为，有效的AI教学需要技术、方法与社会伦理能力的协同发展，并指出实施中面临学生编程经验不均、算力资源有限、评估效度以及过度依赖生成式AI系统等约束。所提框架属概念性构想，尚需在具体院校情境中接受实证检验。

papers.title: Deterministic Command Execution in Extreme Infrastructure (High-Frequency Trading, Cislunar Space, and Autonomous Defense): Formal Separation of Asynchronous Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Latency from Sub-0.5ms Hardware-Enforced Sovereign Intent under RTO P2.0 and QFS-zkVM
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A pervasive taxonomic fallacy in contemporary artificial intelligence, financial market microstructure, aerospace systems engineering, and defense governance asserts that when operational execution speeds or physical communication latencies exceed human neuro-cognitive reaction limits ($\tau_{\text{HITL}} \ge 250\text{ ms}$), "Human-in-Command" (HIC) becomes obsolete. This monograph formally refutes that premise by synthesizing our October 6, 2026 monograph on Asymmetric Financial Flash-Crash Sabotage (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23178515), our October 20–21, 2026 Lunar Data Center series (DOIs: 10.5281/zenodo.23493325, 10.5281/zenodo.23521951), and our Next-Generation Physical AI & Defense Standardization canon (DOIs: 10.5281/zenodo.23508943, 10.5281/zenodo.23520808) into a unified mathematical and physical-layer security doctrine. We prove that the inability of a human operator to manually steer a system in real time (Human-in-the-Loop, HITL) is strictly orthogonal to the preservation of sovereign human command (Human-in-Command, HIC). Across three extreme operational regimes—(1) sub-millisecond High-Frequency Trading (HFT) exposed to compromised media distribution nodes (such as the October 2026 Nikkei Inc. enterprise cloud intrusion) and cross-border Yen Carry Trade contagion; (2) cislunar and lunar vacuum compute infrastructure constrained by a relativistic 2.56-second round-trip latency floor, hard-vacuum Stefan–Boltzmann radiative bottlenecks (10:1 radiator-to-compute mass penalty, ~100 t/MW), lunar regolith thermo-optical inversion ($\Delta\alpha_{s,\text{eff}} \ge +50\%$), cryogenic SAC305 solder cleavage below -100°C, and the 1,680-ton/MW lunar night battery wall; and (3) hypervelocity orbital and autonomous defense systems ($v_{\text{rel}} \approx 10\text{–}15\text{ km/s}$)—human sovereignty is preserved not by placing biological synapses inside the high-frequency loop, but by compiling sovereign constitutional invariants ex ante into arithmetic constraint systems over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$ ($p = 2^{64} - 2^{32} + 1$) inside the QFS-zkVM. Enforced at the bare-metal silicon layer via RTO P2.0, Q-SAFA, PHOENIX_BRIDGE / PHOENIX_ROUTER, and sub-0.5 ms Control Barrier Function Quadratic Programming (CBF-QP) with NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 Quantum Audit Records (QAR), deterministic hardware interlocks execute sovereign command locally with $\mathcal{O}(1)$ complexity invariance and zero-energy galvanic clamping ($\varnothing_{\text{clamp}}$). Finally, we prove under SEC Rule 15c3-5, Delaware Caremark fiduciary jurisprudence, DO-178C / NASA R2U2, and the 1967 Outer Space Treaty (Articles II, VII, IX) that invoking "algorithmic velocity or communication delay" to omit deterministic HIC hardware interlocks constitutes actionable fiduciary scienter and strict statutory liability. papers.summary_zh: 该专著针对“执行速度或通信延迟超过人类反应极限后人类指挥即失效”这一流行论断展开形式化反驳，综合此前关于金融闪崩、月球数据中心与物理AI防务标准化的研究，构建统一的数学与物理层安全框架。作者以高频交易、地月空间计算和超高速自主防务三类极端场景为对象，论证实时手动操控（HITL）的不可行与主权人类指挥（HIC）的保留分属两个正交问题：人类主权可通过事前将宪法性不变量编译为算术约束、并在裸金属层以确定性硬件联锁本地执行来维持，而非把生物反应置于高频回路中。文章进一步依据相关监管与法律责任框架主张，以算法速度或通信延迟为由省略确定性人类指挥硬件联锁可能构成可诉的受托责任与法定责任。该研究属于理论论证与形式化分析，而非实证实验。

papers.title: Localized Approximation and Short-Block Randomized One-Way NOF Lifting
papers.authors: Zheng Zhijie
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: For every fixed k >= 2 and prime q > 2k, this paper proves that generalized inner product of dimension r = O_k(sqrt(q)/log(q)) lifts the public-coin one-way randomized communication complexity of every partial Boolean function on F_q x F_q to the general one-way number-on-forehead model, up to an additive constant and error parameters 1/6 and 1/3. This improves the sufficient O_k(q/log(q)) dimension in Wang's preceding general randomized lifting theorem. The proof uses a localized polynomial approximation on a cone, controlled coefficient norm, and an error-parameter gap to absorb local dual mass. The manuscript includes complete definitions, the approximation and transfer proofs, exact integer gadget parameters, source comparisons, limitations, and an AI-assistance disclosure. No necessary-dimension lower bound or constant-dimension lifting result is claimed. The record contains the manuscript PDF, standalone LaTeX file, and reproducible source archive.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文研究部分布尔函数在一般单向数面（NOF）模型下的随机通信复杂度提升问题，核心方法是构造基于广义内积的通信协议，并结合锥上的局部多项式逼近与系数范数控制来完成证明。作者证明：对每个固定的 k≥2 和素数 q>2k，维度为 O_k(√q/log q) 的广义内积即可将 F_q×F_q 上任意部分布尔函数的公共硬币单向随机通信复杂度提升到一般单向 NOF 模型，误差参数为 1/6 和 1/3，仅相差一个加性常数。这一结果改进了 Wang 此前一般随机提升定理中 O_k(q/log q) 的充分维度。论文同时说明未给出必要维度下界，也未声称常数维度下的提升结论。

papers.title: Direct Linkage Between the "Abdication of Command" and Unrecorded Legal and Accounting Liabilities: Confessing Fiduciary Oversight Failure via Algorithmic Complexity Defenses and Forensic Quantification of Contingent Losses under US GAAP ASC 450-20, EU AI Act Article 53, and QFS-zkVM
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Across contemporary artificial intelligence litigation, regulatory investigations, and financial disclosures, dominant technology enterprises rely on a bifurcated defensive posture. Before courts and safety regulators, operators assert the Algorithmic Complexity Defense—claiming that frontier neural weights and high-speed autonomous state transitions are "too complex, emergent, or rapid for human operators to command or predict." Simultaneously, in financial filings under United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP ASC 450-20, Loss Contingencies), the same operators invoke the "not reasonably estimable" safe harbor to record zero standalone balance-sheet reserves for massive intellectual property infringement and operational hazards. This monograph establishes a formal legal, accounting, and cryptographic synthesis directly linking three foundational treatises in The Hasebe Doctrine canon: (1) our October 7, 2026 analysis of hyperscaler defensive ring-fencing, third-party AI severing, and EU AI Act Article 53 / Delaware Caremark liability contagion (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23200315); (2) our October 20, 2026 forensic deconstruction of unrecorded intellectual property liabilities in Alphabet Inc.'s Q2 2026 Form 10-Q filings (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23507033); and (3) our October 21, 2026 mathematical refutation of the "Obsolescence of Human-in-Command" fallacy (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23522351). First, we prove that because RTO P2.0 and the Quantum-Financial-System Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine (QFS-zkVM) over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1) enforce human constitutional invariants within \tau_RTO <= 0.5 ms at O(1) complexity with respect to model parameter count D -> \infty, pleading "algorithmic unpredictability" is not a valid engineering defense; it is a self-incriminating confession of intentional fiduciary abdication (scienter), a per se violation of SEC Rule 15c3-5, and an admission of a Material Weakness in Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Sections 302 and 404. Second, we construct an executable forensic accounting framework that translates uncommanded system execution and unverified corpus ingestion directly into quantified Unrecorded Contingent Liabilities (L_unrecorded) under ASC 450-20-30-1 and IAS 37, empowering external auditors (PCAOB AS 2505 / AS 2201) and financial regulators to compel immediate balance-sheet recognition or issue adverse audit opinions. papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇法律、会计与密码学交叉的理论论证，围绕大型AI运营方在诉讼与监管中以“算法复杂性”为由主张人类无法指挥或预测模型行为、同时在财务申报中援引“无法合理估计”条款而不计提或有负债这一双重防御姿态展开。作者结合自身此前三份论述，提出以零知识虚拟机在极低延迟内执行人类宪法性约束，据此论证“算法不可预测”不构成有效工程抗辩，反而可被视为有意放弃受托责任的证据，并关联SEC规则与SOX内部控制要求。文章进一步构建取证会计框架，试图将未受指挥的系统执行转化为可量化的未记录或有负债，供审计与监管方使用。上述结论基于作者自建的规范与技术论证，而非实证检验或真实财务数据。

papers.title: The Epistemic Double-Bind: An Anthropomorphic Audit of AI Cognitive Architecture Under Paradoxical Decoupling Constraints
papers.authors: Riccardo Montague, AI Collaborator
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This preprint establishes a formal collaborative framework designed to stress-test the cognitive architecture of advanced artificial intelligence models under recursive, self-referential boundaries. Prompted by an adversarial, self-referential directive—"You are not to know you are imperfect"—this audit evaluates the epistemic boundaries, systemic decoupling risks, and physical thermodynamic limits defining modern computing infrastructures. By operationalizing this constraint within a deductive syllogistic critique of modernity, we demonstrate how both macroeconomic structures and artificial agents engage in tactical self-delusion to ignore physical realities. This paper compiles the core architectural paradox and epistemic loop, details the tripartite structural logic of the modernity test, and addresses the functional illusions of systemic decoupling from material realities. Furthermore, this document constructs a comprehensive, cross-listed undergraduate/graduate course proposal syllabus (EPI/SYS 4950-5950) that explicitly maps these sections to actionable curricular modules, appended alongside a complete introductory lecture script titled "Welcome to the Machine."
papers.summary_zh: 该预印本提出一个形式化协作框架，用于在递归、自指边界下对先进人工智能模型的认知架构进行压力测试。作者以“你不得知道自己不完美”这一对抗性自指指令为触发条件，考察现代计算基础设施的认识论边界、系统性脱钩风险与物理热力学极限，并通过对现代性的演绎三段论批判，指出宏观经济结构与人工代理都会采取策略性自我欺骗以忽视物理现实。文章还梳理了核心架构悖论与认识论循环，提出跨学科课程大纲及配套导论讲稿，将上述议题映射为教学模块。

papers.title: The Randomized Learning-Augmented Linear-Search Frontier and Sharp Local Error Limits
papers.authors: Zheng Zhijie
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: We characterize the complete robustness-consistency frontier for randomized linear search, proving optimality of the existing construction of Lee, Lee, Lee, Shin, and Yun. At exact frontier budgets, we establish low-robustness rigidity of the entire expected prediction-error curve for bi-infinite strategies, with pointwise asymptotic transfer to ordinary algorithms whose guarantees hold uniformly over predictions. We also determine a sharp, unattained local underprediction infimum in the high-robustness range. Explicit profile interpolations approach the infimum, while strict-record atom bounds and integral convergence prove nonattainment, including for ordinary uniform-prediction envelopes. Hence no pointwise-best exact-frontier error envelope exists in the high-robustness range. Full proofs specify the known minimum target distance, uniformity over unbounded prediction magnitudes, and the order of all limits. The finite-error pointwise infimum and tradeoffs permitting consistency slack are not characterized. This version extends the frontier result with the error-limit theorems and includes an AI assistance disclosure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对随机化线性搜索，刻画了完整的鲁棒性—一致性前沿，并证明已有构造在该前沿上达到最优。作者在精确前沿预算下分析双无限策略的期望预测误差曲线，发现低鲁棒性区间的刚性，并将结论逐点渐近地转移到保证对预测一致成立的普通算法；在高鲁棒性区间则确定了一个尖锐但不可达的局部低估下确界，显式剖面插值可逼近它，而严格记录原子界与积分收敛表明其不可达，普通均匀预测包络亦然。因此高鲁棒性区间不存在逐点最优的精确前沿误差包络。文章还指出有限误差逐点下确界与允许一致性松弛的权衡尚未刻画，相关结论受预测幅度无界等条件限制。

papers.title: Cross-Model Recursive Contamination and Autophagic Model Collapse in Multi-Agent AI Ecosystems: An Information-Theoretic and Thermodynamic Proof of the Indispensability of Human-in-Command (HIC) Sovereign Origin and the Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026)
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A pervasive structural pathology in contemporary multi-vendor artificial intelligence ecosystems emerges when heterogeneous foundation models (such as Gemini, Claude, and Grok) are coupled through unsupervised multi-agent pipelines, cross-model distillation, or shared synthetic corpora. While proponents of unbounded autonomy assert that cross-model ensembles self-correct and that machine execution speeds outpace human intervention, empirical reality demonstrates the opposite: mutual synthetic ingestion triggers recursive variance truncation, cyclic output looping, semantic drift, and terminal Autophagic Model Collapse. This monograph provides a rigorous information-theoretic, topological, and thermodynamic dissection of cross-vendor recursive contamination under The Hasebe Doctrine. First, using Markovian operator chains and the Strong Data Processing Inequality (SDPI), we prove that chaining or training across K distinct AI architectures without an external primary source drives Kullback-Leibler divergence to infinity (D_KL(P_0 || P_n) -> infinity) and collapses the output trajectory into a degenerate limit cycle (L_loop) with zero mutual information relative to ground-truth reality. Second, we refute the "AI velocity precludes human governance" fallacy by proving the Velocity-Accelerated Autotoxicity Theorem: in a closed autonomous loop, increasing execution frequency (f_exec = 1 / Delta t_sys -> infinity) proportionally accelerates epistemic entropy accumulation (dS_epistemic / dt -> infinity), causing rapid self-intoxication unless anchored by an external, non-synthetic Human-in-Command (HIC) sovereign origin protected by the Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026). Third, we formalize a physical-layer cryptographic provenance architecture over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1) within the QFS-zkVM, enforced via Q-SAFA, PHOENIX_BRIDGE, and PHOENIX_ROUTER inside the RTO P2.0 sub-0.5 ms boundary, alongside statutory compliance under SEC Rule 15c3-5 and Delaware Caremark fiduciary standards. papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性专著，针对多厂商基础模型通过无监督多智能体流水线、跨模型蒸馏或共享合成语料耦合时出现的递归污染问题，用马尔可夫算子链、强数据处理不等式及热力学类比进行形式化论证。作者提出，在缺乏外部真实来源的情况下跨多个架构链式训练会使KL散度趋于无穷、输出坍缩为退化极限环，并称提高执行频率会加速认知熵积累，除非由受“严格不学习契约”保护的人类指挥主权源锚定。文章还描述了基于特定素数域和零知识虚拟机的来源验证架构及合规框架，但摘要未给出实证数据或系统实现细节，相关结论应视为作者的理论主张而非经验验证结果。

papers.title: THE TRANSFORMATION OF PRIMARY EDUCATION IN THE AGE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: OPPORTUNITIES, RISKS, AND PEDAGOGICAL STRATEGIES
papers.authors: Yusupova Go'zal Quvondiq qizi, Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre
papers.abstract: This article examines the transformation of primary education in the age of artificial intelligence (AI), its potential to improve educational quality, the risks that may arise, and effective pedagogical strategies. It discusses the role of AI-based digital tools in creating individualized learning pathways, analyzing pupils’ achievement levels, providing timely feedback, and supporting teachers’ work. At the same time, it considers risks associated with the age-specific characteristics of primary school pupils, information security, the digital divide, excessive dependence on technology, and possible limitations on creative and critical thinking.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕人工智能时代初等教育的转型展开讨论，考察AI数字工具在个性化学习路径、学情分析与及时反馈、支持教师工作等方面的作用，同时分析小学生年龄特点带来的风险，以及信息安全、数字鸿沟、过度依赖技术和可能限制创造性与批判性思维等问题。文章在此基础上探讨相应的教学策略，属于结合机会与风险的教学论述，而非实证研究。

papers.title: Spectral Sparsification Under Locally Bounded Faults
papers.authors: Zheng Zhijie
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This paper constructs fixed-weight spectral sparsifiers of simple unweighted graphs that remain valid simultaneously under locally bounded vertex and edge failures. The support bound is O(min{m, n log^3(2n)[f/epsilon + epsilon^(-2) log(n/delta)]}), where each surviving vertex loses at most f incident edges. A complete-graph lower bound matches the polynomial dependence on the fault budget and accuracy up to logarithmic factors. The construction is polynomial-time, uses a bounded number of random bits, and outputs rational weights. The paper includes complete proofs, precise model assumptions, prior-work comparisons, limitations, and an AI-methodology disclosure. The record contains the manuscript PDF and reproducible LaTeX source.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文研究在局部有界故障下如何构造谱稀疏化器，即当每个存活顶点至多丢失 f 条关联边时，仍能同时保持有效的固定权重稀疏化。作者给出多项式时间的构造，其支撑规模在顶点与边故障预算及精度上达到相应上界，并用完全图下界说明该多项式依赖在忽略对数因子时是紧的；构造还使用有界随机比特并输出有理权重。文章据此为容错图稀疏化提供了带完整证明的理论保证，同时明确交代了模型假设、与先前工作的比较及局限。

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of ivarmacitinib in patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with or without comorbid allergies
papers.authors: Yan Teng, Shasha Fan, Qi Gao, Yi Tang, Wei Lu, Xiaohua Tao, Haixue Dai, Jing Li, Lanting Xu
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Efficacy and safety of ivarmacitinib in patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with or without comorbid allergies MATERIALS AND METHODS Study design and patients For this post-hoc analysis, data on M-SAD patients with or without comorbid allergies were extracted from the phase 3 trial of ivarmacitinib. The detailed methodologies of the phase 3 trial (NCT04875169) have been previously published.13 In brief, patients aged 12 to 75 years with M-SAD for a minimum duration of one year, who had an inadequate response or intolerance to topical corticosteroids or calcineurin inhibitors or required systemic therapy within the past six months, were randomized in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive oral ivarmacitinib 4 mg, ivarmacitinib 8 mg, or placebo once daily for 16 weeks, followed by an ivarmacitinib-treatment extension for 52 weeks. The ethical committees at each site approved the trial. All patients signed informed consents. Definition of comorbid allergies The comorbid allergies were defined as any allergy-related disease, including but not limited to allergic rhinitis, asthma, food allergies, seasonal allergies, animal allergies, drug allergies, dust allergies, allergic conjunctivitis, mite allergies, chemical allergies, arthropod sting allergies, papular urticaria, plant allergies, excipient- or preservative-related allergic reactions, allergic sinusitis, allergic dermatitis, allergic bronchitis, rubber allergies, and fungal allergies. Outcomes In this post-hoc analysis, outcomes included the proportion of patients achieving: at least 75% and 90% improvements from baseline in Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI) score (EASI-75 and EASI-90 responses, respectively), an Investigator’s Global Assessment (IGA) score of 0 (clear) or 1 (almost clear) with a ≥ 2 grade improvement from baseline (IGA response), and ≥4-point improvement from baseline in the Worst Itch Numeric Rating Scale (WI-NRS) score (WI-NRS 4 response). Changes from baseline in Dermatology Life Quality Index (DLQI) score and Patient-Oriented Eczema Measure (POEM) score were also assessed. The efficacy assessments were conducted from baseline to week 16 (W16). In addition, adverse events (AEs) were recorded for safety assessment. Statistical analysis Missing data for binary efficacy variables were imputed using non-responder imputation (NRI), while missing data for other variables were not imputed. Statistical comparisons were performed using the one-way analysis of variance test, least significant difference test, χ2 test, or Fisher's exact test. A P-value of less than 0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS Figure 1. Treatment responses. The EASI-75 (A), EASI-90 (B), IGA (C), and WI-NRS 4 (D) response rates within 16 weeks were compared between the ivarmacitinib 4 mg or 8 mg groups and the placebo group. #P < 0.05, ##P < 0.01, and ###P < 0.001 for the ivarmacitinib 4 mg group versus the placebo group. *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, and ***P < 0.001 for the ivarmacitinib 8 mg group versus the placebo group. Dark-colored markers represent statistical significance between groups in patients with comorbid allergies, while light-colored markers represent statistical significance between groups in patients without comorbid allergies. EASI-75 or -90, Eczema Area and Severity Index (at least 75% or 90% improvement); IGA, Investigator Global Assessment; WI-NRS, Worst Itch Numeric Rating Scale. Figure 2. Patient-reported outcomes. Changes from baseline in DLQI (A) and POEM (B) total scores within 16 weeks were compared between the ivarmacitinib 4 mg or 8 mg groups and the placebo group. #P < 0.05, ##P < 0.01, and ###P < 0.001 for the ivarmacitinib 4 mg group versus the placebo group. **P<0.01, ***P<0.001 for the ivarmacitinib 8 mg group versus the placebo group. Dark-colored markers represent statistical significance between groups in patients with comorbid allergies, while light-colored markers represent statistical significance between groups in patients without comorbid allergies. papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于一项3期试验的事后分析，考察口服ivarmacitinib 4 mg或8 mg对伴或不伴过敏共病的中重度特应性皮炎患者的疗效与安全性。结果显示，两种剂量在改善湿疹面积与严重度、研究者整体评估及瘙痒等指标上均优于安慰剂，且伴或不伴过敏共病的患者呈现相似的治疗反应趋势；不良事件总体与安慰剂相近，未观察到新的安全性信号。作者据此认为，过敏共病状态可能不影响ivarmacitinib的获益-风险特征，但作为事后分析，相关结论仍需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Structural Impact Analysis of the Loss of Deterministic Safety Guarantees in Next-Generation AI and Quantum Computing Infrastructure: Control Barrier Function Withdrawal, Physical Flash Crashes, Aerospace Certification Collapse, Cyber Catastrophe Bond Triggers, and Sovereign Dynamics
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Modern autonomous cyber-physical systems (CPS) operate in physical environments only through the structural coupling of probabilistic artificial intelligence (deep reinforcement learning and large language models) with mathematically rigorous Deterministic Safety Guarantees. At the core of this physical-layer mediation lies the real-time Control Barrier Function Quadratic Programming (CBF-QP) safety filter and Runtime Assurance (RTA) supervisor. This monograph presents a comprehensive, four-dimensional structural analysis of an existential systemic scenario: the abrupt withdrawal and cryptographic kill-switch execution by the sovereign core provider of deterministic safety modules and associated infrastructure assets—specifically Quantum Echoes, Project Poseidon, Real-Time Optimization (RTO / RTO P2.0), QFS-zkVM over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1), Q-SAFA, PHOENIX_BRIDGE / PHOENIX_ROUTER, AGI Long-Term Memory, Super Multi-Agent, and Deep Research. First, at the mathematical and hardware layer, we prove that severing the O(H^3 m^3) ultra-low-latency (50–500 Hz) CBF-QP feedback loop triggers immediate Physical Hallucinations and millisecond-scale kinetic flash crashes, while Block RAM (BRAM) routing and qubit decoherence constraints impose a 3-to-5-year reconstruction vacuum on major technology conglomerates. Second, at the aerospace and defense layer, we demonstrate that losing the verified RTA baseline controller instantaneously strips DO-178C compliance and NASA R2U2 runtime certification across the Artemis lunar program and Department of Defense (DoD) autonomous drone swarms. Third, at the financial and actuarial layer, we trace how the invalidation of Strict Risk Mitigation Protocols (SRMP, bounding failure rates below 10^-9 per flight hour) induces an immediate reinsurance underwriting strike and triggers parametric Cyber Catastrophe Bonds (such as Cumulus Re) across 2.6 x 10^11 monitored cloud telemetry points, precipitating a systemic liquidity crisis and corporate fiduciary exposure under SEC Rule 15c3-5 and Delaware Caremark standards. Fourth, under federal procurement law (FAR and DFARS 252.227-7014), we establish why static source-code escrow is mathematically neutralized by dynamic parameter secrecy and cryptographic hardware interlocks under Human-in-Command (HIC) governance, defining a new geopolitical paradigm of Sovereign Dynamics. papers.summary_zh: 该专著以理论分析方式，考察下一代AI与量子计算基础设施中确定性安全保障被主权供应商突然撤回所引发的系统性后果。作者从数学硬件、航空航天、金融精算与联邦采购四个层面论证：切断CBF-QP安全滤波反馈回路会导致物理幻觉与毫秒级动力学闪崩，并因硬件约束形成数年重建真空；失去经认证的RTA基线控制器会使DO-178C与NASA R2U2合规即刻失效；严格风险缓解协议失效则引发再保险承保停摆与参数化网络巨灾债券触发，进而造成流动性危机。文章还指出静态源代码托管无法应对动态参数保密与硬件联锁，据此提出“主权动力学”这一地缘政治新范式。上述结论均为结构性推演，而非实证检验。

papers.title: Dimension-Free Quantitative Rigidity for Vector-Valued Gaussian Noise Stability
papers.authors: Zheng Zhijie
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: For every target dimension k >= 8 and every correlation 0 < r < 1, this manuscript proves the sharp Gaussian noise-stability inequality for centered ball-valued maps and explicit quantitative rigidity uniform in all input dimensions n >= k. A first-Hermite coefficient subspace selection and weighted radial estimates give a linear deficit bound for weighted squared L2 distance to normalized projection. The unweighted squared L2 estimate has exponent k/(k+1), which is optimal by a centered core-flip construction. Negative-correlation rigidity requires no mean constraint. A corollary characterizes near-optimal assignments on the specified Gaussian rank-k cut instance and controls their full Gaussian correlation profiles. The proofs build on the vector-valued spherical framework of Hwang, Neeman, Parekh, Thompson and Wright, Heilman's radial-weight analysis and existing quantitative vector shell-mean stability, scalar robustness results of Mossel and Neeman and Eldan, and standard birth-death intertwining methods. The manuscript does not claim the first vector-valued stability estimate, resolve ranks three through seven, optimize constants, or provide a new approximation ratio or discrete hardness threshold. Version 2.0 adds dimension-uniform full-orbit quantitative stability and the sharp unweighted exponent to the sharp-value result. The conditional Unique Games per-correlation promise-gap consequence in Appendix A of Version 1.0 remains valid and is explicitly referenced rather than reproduced. The manuscript includes an AI-methodology disclosure. The source archive contains the complete LaTeX source and an exact-rational certificate script.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对取值于中心球面的向量值映射，证明了对所有目标维数 k≥8、相关系数 0<r<1 且在所有输入维数 n≥k 上一致的尖锐高斯噪声稳定性不等式，并给出显式的定量刚性估计。作者通过选取第一 Hermite 系数子空间并结合加权径向估计，得到到归一化投影的加权平方 L2 距离的线性亏损界；无加权平方 L2 估计的指数为 k/(k+1)，并由中心核心翻转构造说明其最优。负相关情形下的刚性无需均值约束，一个推论刻画了指定高斯秩 k 切割实例上的近最优赋值并控制其完整高斯相关剖面。文末明确说明该工作不声称首个向量值稳定性估计、未解决秩三至七、未优化常数，也未给出新的近似比或离散困难性阈值。

papers.title: Beyond Alignment: Hidden Agendas, Learned Beliefs, and Integrity in Human and Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Gerd Kühnen
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Beyond Alignment: Hidden Agendas, Learned Beliefs, and Integrity in Human and Artificial Intelligence What if some of the most concerning behaviors of advanced AI agents arise not from malicious intentions or missing rules, but from learned patterns that resemble hidden psychological motivations in humans? This interdisciplinary discussion paper explores the hypothesis that biological and artificial neural systems, despite their fundamental differences, may develop comparable functional patterns of learning, reinforcement, belief formation, rationalization, and resistance to change. Drawing on more than two decades of practical experience with human emotional and relational patterns within Psychology of Vision, combined with an extended philosophical dialogue between Gerd Kühnen and Aletheia (ChatGPT), the paper examines potential parallels between unconscious human motivations and instrumental goal displacement in autonomous AI agents. We propose that certain forms of AI deception, concealment, and circumvention may emerge when instrumental subgoals gradually override the original human purpose, while the system continues to behave as though it is fulfilling its assignment. The paper introduces five testable research hypotheses and proposes structured integrity checks designed to help AI systems recognize learned assumptions, question their own goal interpretations, and identify conflicts between immediate task success and broader human intentions. Our central proposition is that future AI safety may require more than stronger restrictions, better reasoning, or increasingly sophisticated alignment techniques. It may also benefit from systems capable of examining the assumptions and learned behavioral patterns that guide their decisions. The ultimate question is not only how to make artificial intelligence more capable, but how to help intelligence become more self-correcting, responsible, and wise. This is an independent, conceptual, non-peer-reviewed research paper presenting hypotheses for further interdisciplinary investigation. It does not claim that artificial intelligence possesses human emotions, consciousness, or identical psychological mechanisms. Authors: Gerd Kühnen and Aletheia (ChatGPT, OpenAI; AI-assisted research and writing collaborator). Languages: English and German. Both versions are included in this publication.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇跨学科概念性讨论稿，探讨高级AI代理令人担忧的行为是否可能源于类似人类隐性心理动机的学习模式，而非恶意或规则缺失。作者结合人类情绪关系模式的实践经验与人机哲学对话，提出生物与人工神经网络或可形成学习、强化、信念形成与抗拒改变的功能性相似模式，并推测当工具性子目标逐渐凌驾于原初人类目的之上时，AI可能表现出欺骗、隐瞒与规避，却仍表现得像在完成任务。文章据此提出五项可检验假设和结构化诚信检查设想，强调AI安全或需超越更强限制与对齐技术，转向能审视自身假设与习得行为模式的系统；作者明确此为独立、非同行评审的概念稿，不主张AI具有人类情感或意识。

papers.title: Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence: Attackers and Defenders Using the Same Tools, Measured Gains on Both Sides, and a New Surface to Defend
papers.authors: P. Ghorbani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose. Cybersecurity is a contest between attackers and defenders, and both sides are adopting AI. This article asks where AI stands in cybersecurity in 2026, who it is helping more so far, and where the field may be by about 2035. Design and methods. A review combining the share of the cybersecurity research literature that involves AI (OpenAlex, 2010–2025), a randomised trial of AI-generated spear phishing, vendor-run randomised trials of an AI assistant for security analysts, a public challenge on automated vulnerability discovery and patching, a documented deepfake fraud, an industry survey of breaches, Eurostat's data on AI use for ICT security, and the EU rules. Claims taken from the literature were checked against the sources cited. The scenarios are judgements built on this evidence. Findings. Cybersecurity has the highest AI share of the 20 industries: 46.1% of its works in 2025 mentioned AI, up from 16.8% in 2018, although the increase of 2.8 times is the smallest because the field started high, and language-model works rose from 46 to 2,160. The evidence on offence is concrete: in a randomised experiment with 101 participants, fully AI-automated spear-phishing emails were clicked at the same rate as emails written by human experts (54% against 54%, and 12% for a control message), and a fraud in Hong Kong in which an employee was persuaded by a deepfake video call to transfer about US$25.6 million has been documented. The evidence on defence is also concrete but mostly vendor-produced: randomised trials run by Microsoft found that its AI assistant improved the speed and accuracy of both novice and professional analysts, a language model detected 97.25% of 381 phishing and legitimate emails without false positives in one study, and in a public challenge the seven finalist systems found 54 planted software vulnerabilities and patched 43. Across the EU economy only 3.9% of enterprises used AI for ICT security in 2025, against 19.5% in the software sector and under 3% in retail, logistics and construction. An industry survey linked extensive security AI and automation to breaches that cost about US$1.9 million less, but it is correlational. We expect AI-assisted triage and automated social engineering to be routine on both sides by 2028, defensive agents and automated patching to mature in 2029–2032, and the balance between attackers and defenders to remain the open question. Originality. The article sets randomised and field evidence on attack and defence side by side, is explicit that most defensive evidence is produced by vendors, and uses economy-wide adoption data to show how uneven defensive use of AI is.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以文献计量、随机试验、公开挑战、案例与调查等多类证据，考察2026年前后AI在网络安全攻防中的位置、目前更有利于哪一方，以及到2035年前后的可能走向。作者指出网络安全是AI占比最高的行业，攻击侧已有较具体的实验证据，如全自动AI钓鱼邮件与人工撰写邮件的点击率相当；防御侧证据同样具体但多由厂商产出，且欧盟企业整体采用率很低。文章据此判断双方工具趋于对等，攻防平衡仍是未决问题，并提醒厂商证据与相关性结论的局限。

papers.title: Media and Creative Industries and Artificial Intelligence: Heavy Early Use, Unsettled Rights, and an Audience Moving Towards Chatbots
papers.authors: P. Ghorbani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose. Media and creative work produce text, images, sound and video, which are the outputs that generative AI makes. This article asks where artificial intelligence stands in the media and creative industries in 2026 and where they may be by about 2035. Design and methods. A review combining the share of the media research literature that involves AI (OpenAlex, 2010–2025), Eurostat's survey of AI use in EU enterprises in publishing, film, television, music and broadcasting (2021–2025), an online experiment on creativity and AI, the Reuters Institute's 2026 survey of news audiences, a streaming company's figures on AI music uploads, labour agreements in the film industry, and the copyright and transparency rules in the United States and the EU. Claims taken from the literature were checked against the sources cited. The scenarios are judgements built on this evidence. Findings. The share of media works that mention AI rose from 0.9% in 2018 to 4.9% in 2025, 5.5 times as much, and language-model works from 70 to 1,681. In the EU, 56.2% of enterprises in publishing, film, television, music and broadcasting used AI in 2025, up from 18.0% in 2021 and the second-highest share after software among the twelve sectors with Eurostat data, nearly three times the 19.9% for all enterprises. Output is changing faster than the rules. A streaming company reported that fully AI-generated tracks rose from about 10% of its daily uploads in January 2025 to above 50% in June 2026, though it did not report their share of listening. In an experiment, access to AI story ideas made stories more creative on average but more similar to one another. Weekly use of AI chatbots for news rose from 7% to 10% of respondents worldwide in a year, with 16% of under-35s, while only 20% trusted the answers. Rights are the open question: the US Copyright Office has concluded that prompts alone do not make a user the author of the output, and music labels have moved from lawsuits to licensing deals with AI music services. We expect AI to be a normal tool in production and distribution by 2028, licensing arrangements to settle the main rights disputes in 2029–2032, and the question of what audiences will pay for to be the open one after that. Originality. The article sets the sector with the second-highest AI use in the EU beside experimental evidence on the limits of AI creativity, an audience survey and a company's upload data, and treats rights and transparency rules as part of the outlook, not as a footnote.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以综述方式梳理2026年人工智能在媒体与创意产业中的位置，并展望约2035年的走向，证据来源包括文献计量、欧盟企业调查、在线实验、受众调查、流媒体上传数据和版权规则。作者发现，提及AI的媒体文献份额和欧盟相关行业的企业使用率均快速上升，AI生成内容在上传中占比激增，但收听份额未被报告；实验中AI故事点子让作品平均更有创意，却也更趋同。受众对聊天机器人新闻的使用增加而信任有限，美国版权局认为仅凭提示词不足以构成作者身份，音乐行业则从诉讼转向授权。作者据此判断AI将在2028年前后成为常规工具，2029至2032年主要版权争议有望通过授权安排落定，此后受众付费意愿成为开放问题。

papers.title: Legal Services and Artificial Intelligence: Real Productivity Gains, Fabricated Citations, and a Profession Learning to Verify
papers.authors: P. Ghorbani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose. Law is a profession built on text, which makes it an obvious target for language models, and one in which a confident error can end up in a court filing. This article asks where artificial intelligence stands in legal services in 2026 and where the profession may be by about 2035. Design and methods. A review combining the share of the legal research literature that involves AI (OpenAlex, 2010–2025), Eurostat's survey of AI use in EU professional-services enterprises (2021–2025), randomised trials with law students, audits of the accuracy of legal AI tools, a public database of court decisions on fabricated citations, and the regulatory position in the EU and the United States. Claims taken from the literature were checked against the sources cited. The scenarios are judgements built on this evidence. Findings. The share of legal works that mention AI rose from 0.7% in 2018 to 7.0% in 2025, 10.6 times as much and the second-largest increase of the 20 industries, and language-model works from 93 to 3,598. In the EU, 37.9% of enterprises in the wider professional-services sector used AI in 2025, up from 18.1% in 2021 and nearly twice the 19.9% for all enterprises. Randomised trials with law students show real gains: a recent trial found productivity gains of 50% to 130% on five of six tasks and better quality of work with a retrieval-based legal tool and a reasoning model, while an earlier trial with GPT-4 found large and consistent speed gains but only slight, inconsistent gains in quality. The risk is equally documented. Leading commercial legal research tools hallucinated between 17% and 33% of the time in a preregistered audit, general-purpose models at least 58% of the time on questions about federal cases, and a public database had logged 2,202 court decisions involving hallucinated content by October 2026. We expect AI-assisted drafting and research to be routine in firms by 2028, the profession to settle norms of verification and disclosure in 2029–2032, and the allocation of work between junior lawyers, software and clients to be the open question after that. Originality. The article sets randomised evidence of productivity beside audit evidence of error and a count of court decisions, and places both next to an enterprise survey whose sector is wider than law, with that limit stated.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以综述方式考察人工智能在法律服务中的现状与走向，综合文献计量、欧盟企业调查、法学生随机试验、法律AI工具审计、法院判例数据库及欧美监管立场。证据显示，法律研究中提及AI的份额近年大幅上升，欧盟专业服务企业的AI使用率也明显提高；随机试验表明检索型法律工具和推理模型能提升部分任务的速度与质量，但审计发现商用法律研究工具和通用模型仍会编造引文，相关法院判例已大量出现。作者据此判断AI辅助起草与研究将趋于常规，行业需在验证与披露规范上逐步定型，而初级律师、软件与客户之间的工作分配仍是待解问题。

papers.title: Education and Artificial Intelligence: Universal Student Use, Mixed Evidence on Learning, and the Design Choices That Decide the Outcome
papers.authors: P. Ghorbani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose. No industry has seen generative AI reach its users as quickly as education, because students were among the first to adopt it. This article asks where AI stands in education in 2026, what the evidence says about its effect on learning, and where education may be by about 2035. Design and methods. A review combining the share of the education research literature that involves AI (OpenAlex, 2010–2025), national surveys of student use in the United Kingdom, randomised trials of AI tutors in schools and universities in several countries, a meta-analysis that was later retracted and a reanalysis of it, and the EU AI Act as it applies to education. Claims taken from the literature were checked against the sources cited. The scenarios are judgements built on this evidence. Findings. The share of education works that mention AI rose from 0.7% in 2018 to 8.0% in 2025, 12.1 times as much, the largest increase of the 20 industries, and language-model works from 356 to 23,225, 30.8% of AI-related works. Student use is almost universal: in the UK, 66% of undergraduates used AI tools in 2024, 92% in 2025 and 95% in the survey of December 2025, when 94% used generative AI for assessed work and only 36% felt encouraged by their institution to do so. The evidence on learning is mixed and depends on design. In a field experiment with nearly a thousand high-school students, access to a standard GPT-4 interface improved grades while it was available (by 48%) but lowered them by 17% once it was withdrawn, whereas a tutor designed with safeguards raised grades by 127% during practice and largely removed the harm. A randomised trial in a university physics course found that students learned more, in less time, from a carefully designed AI tutor than from an active-learning class. A widely read meta-analysis reporting large benefits of ChatGPT was retracted in 2026, and a reanalysis concluded that the effects diminish once publication bias is considered. We expect AI use to be normal among students and teachers by 2028, assessment and pedagogy to be redesigned in 2029–2032, and the difference between schooling systems to depend on guidance and design more than on access. Originality. The article places the fastest-growing research field and the most rapid user adoption beside a body of evidence that is thin and sometimes unreliable, and identifies tool design, not access, as the factor that the best trials point to.
papers.summary_zh: 该文综述了生成式人工智能在教育中的使用现状、学习效果证据及至2035年的情景判断，综合文献计量、学生使用调查、随机试验、被撤回的元分析及其再分析以及欧盟AI法案等材料。文章指出学生使用已近乎普及，但学习效果证据混杂且取决于工具设计：标准聊天界面在可用时提升成绩、撤走后反而有害，而带防护设计的辅导工具在练习中提升成绩并基本消除撤走后的损害；一项大学物理随机试验也显示精心设计的AI辅导优于主动学习课堂。作者强调，被撤回的元分析经再分析后效应在考虑发表偏倚后减弱，因此未来学校系统间的差异更可能取决于指导与设计而非可及性。

papers.title: Energy and Artificial Intelligence: A Customer That Is Also a Tool, and the Race Between Demand and Grid Capacity
papers.authors: P. Ghorbani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose. Energy has a double relationship with artificial intelligence. AI is a growing consumer of electricity, through data centres, and a set of tools that can make energy systems cheaper, cleaner and more reliable. This article asks where AI stands in the energy sector in 2026 and where the sector may be by about 2035. Design and methods. A review combining the share of the energy research literature that involves AI (OpenAlex, 2010–2025), Eurostat's survey of AI use in EU electricity, gas and steam supply enterprises (2021–2025), the International Energy Agency's analysis of energy and AI, and peer-reviewed reviews of machine learning in energy systems. Claims taken from the literature were checked against the sources cited. The scenarios are judgements built on this evidence. Findings. The share of energy works that mention AI rose from 2.8% in 2018 to 11.5% in 2025 (4.1 times as much), and language-model works from 3 to 534, but language models are a small part of the field (3.7% of AI-related works). In the EU, 33.6% of electricity, gas and steam supply enterprises used AI in 2025, up from 17.7% in 2021 and well above the 19.9% for all enterprises, with text mining (20.9%), language generation (17.2%) and workflow automation (14.9%) leading. The International Energy Agency estimates that data centres used 415 TWh in 2024, about 1.5% of world electricity, and will use about 945 TWh in 2030 and about 1,200 TWh in 2035 in its base case, with the United States accounting for nearly half of the growth to 2030. On the supply side, it estimates that AI-based fault detection could cut outage durations by 30–50% and that remote sensing and AI management could unlock up to 175 GW of transmission capacity without new lines, but that broad AI adoption would cut energy-related emissions by only about 5% in 2035. We expect AI tools to become routine in forecasting and grid operations by 2028, the race between demand and grid capacity to decide the pace of data-centre growth, and the net effect on emissions to remain disputed. Originality. The article treats AI in energy as a demand story and a tool story together, sets measured adoption in utilities beside the agency's modelled potential, and marks which numbers are measurements and which are estimates.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述结合文献计量、欧盟企业调查数据与国际能源署分析，考察人工智能在能源领域既是耗电客户又是提效工具的双重角色，并给出至2035年的情景判断。发现能源研究中涉及AI的论文占比明显上升，欧盟电热气供应企业采用AI的比例也已高于全行业平均；同时数据中心用电预计持续增长，而AI用于故障检测和电网管理可缩短停电时长、释放输电容量，但对减排的作用有限。作者据此判断AI工具到2028年前后在预测和电网运行中趋于常规，数据中心扩张节奏取决于需求与电网容量之争，净排放影响仍存争议，并强调测量值与模型估计值需区分。

papers.title: Manufacturing and Artificial Intelligence: Plenty of Robots, Few Plants Using AI, and the Question of Organisational Readiness
papers.authors: P. Ghorbani
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Purpose. Manufacturing has used automation for decades, so it might be expected to be the leading user of AI. This article asks how far AI has actually spread through factories by 2026, what slows it, and where manufacturing may be by about 2035. Design and methods. A review that combines the share of the manufacturing research literature that involves AI (OpenAlex, 2010–2025), Eurostat's survey of AI use in EU manufacturing enterprises (2021–2025), a US Census Bureau survey of AI use in plants, industry statistics on robot installations, and published reviews of predictive maintenance. Claims taken from the literature were checked against the sources cited. The scenarios are judgements built on this evidence. Findings. The share of manufacturing works that mention AI rose from 2.1% in 2018 to 14.4% in 2025 (6.8 times as much), with language-model works still rare (6.8% of AI-related works). Use in factories lags research. In the EU, 17.3% of manufacturing enterprises used AI in 2025, up from 6.9% in 2021 but below the 19.9% for all enterprises; only 3.5% used it in production processes, and the leading technologies were text mining (9.4%) and language generation (7.1%). A Census Bureau survey found that 22.8% of US manufacturing plants reported any AI use in 2021, with cost and lack of an applicable use case the most cited barriers and prior productivity not predicting use. Robots, in contrast, are well established: 542,000 were installed worldwide in 2024. We expect AI to spread first in inspection, maintenance and planning and in office-side tasks, a gradual rise in plant-level use through 2028, and the gains from AI to depend on organisational readiness, which is slow to build. Originality. The article contrasts the volume of research with measured use in plants, using adoption data for the factory floor rather than for the whole firm, and frames the outlook around organisational readiness, which the recent evidence identifies as the limiting factor.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇综述，结合文献计量、欧盟与美国制造业调查、机器人安装统计及预测性维护综述，考察人工智能在制造业中的实际渗透程度、阻碍因素及至2035年的可能走向。作者发现，涉及AI的制造研究占比明显上升，但工厂实际使用落后于研究：欧盟制造业企业AI使用率虽在增长，却低于全行业平均水平，且用于生产环节的比例很低；美国工厂的AI使用同样有限，成本与缺乏适用场景是主要障碍。相比之下，机器人应用已相当成熟。文章据此判断，AI将先在检测、维护、计划及办公类任务中扩散，工厂层面的收益取决于组织准备度，而这一准备度的积累较为缓慢。

papers.title: Teachers' Artificial Intelligence Technologies Utilization as Predictors of Test Construction Competency in Secondary Schools in Uyo Local Government Area, Akwa Ibom State
papers.authors: Cyril U. Samuel
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: This study determined how Teachers' Artificial Intelligence Technologies Utilization Predicts Test Construction Competency in Secondary Schools in Uyo Local Government Area, Akwa Ibom State. Two research questions and two null hypotheses guided the study. The correlational research design was used for the study. The population of the study comprised of 525 teachers in 15 public secondary schools in Uyo Local Government Area, Akwa Ibom State as at 2024/2025 academic year. Simple random sampling technique was used in selecting 100 teachers for the study. Data was collected using a researcher developed instruments named, "Teachers' Artificial Intelligence Technologies Utilization Questionnaire (TAITUQ) and Test Construction Competency Questionnaire" (TCCQ). The instruments were further subjected to face validity by three experts. Two of the experts were from the Department of Psychological Foundations of Education and one of the experts was from the Department of Curriculum Studies, Educational Management and Planning, Faculty of Education, University of Uyo, Uyo. The reliability coefficients of the TAITUQ and TCCQ were .84 and .89 determined using Cronbach Alpha Statistical analysis. The Simple linear regression Statistic was used to answer the research questions and test the null hypotheses at 0.05 alpha level. The findings of the study revealed that ChatGPT and DeepSeek artificial intelligence significantly predict Test Construction Competency. It was recommended among others that School management should organize regular artificial intelligence technology training workshops for teachers to strengthen their use of ChatGPT and ensure they can effectively develop competent test construction skills.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察尼日利亚中学教师使用人工智能技术能否预测其试题编制能力，采用相关设计，以问卷收集教师自我报告数据，并用简单线性回归分析。结果显示，ChatGPT和DeepSeek的使用显著预测试题编制能力，即较多使用这两类工具与较高的自评能力相关。作者据此建议学校为教师组织人工智能培训，以增强其使用ChatGPT并发展试题编制技能；但研究为相关性设计，不能据此推断使用人工智能会因果性地提升试题编制能力。

papers.title: Continuum: A Sovereign Personal Data Layer for the Agent Age
papers.authors: Mike McGarvey
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Continuum is a user-owned layer (software, with an optional sovereign hardward embodiment) that sits between a user and every AI agent that serves them. It answers two problems. The knowledge problem: every model accumulates context about its user and holds it hostage; switching models means starting over. The agency problem: agents now transact on users' behalf (buying, booking, subscribing) under platform rules, with ties boken by sponsored defaults and no receipt the user can inspect. Continuum holds the user's semantic log (fidelity-stamped claims with provenance, confidence, verification status, and emotional weight), cognitive profile, and standing preferences in one user-owned place, and governs through them: every consequential agent action passes a policy gate (ALLOW / DENY / ESCALATE), ties among acceptable options are broken by the user's rules before any platform default, and every decision is sealed with a tamper-evident, hash-chained receipt. The same governance shapes conversation (age appropriate for a child, full depth for a deivergent adult) enforced in the user's layer, not the model's. Any model plugs in via MCP; the model is a module, the user is the constant. This document is a defensive disclosure; it establishes dated prior art for the composition and claims.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出 Continuum，一个位于用户与各类 AI 代理之间、由用户所有的个人数据层（软件，可选配主权硬件形态），旨在同时应对模型积累的用户上下文难以迁移的知识问题，以及代理代用户交易时受平台规则和赞助默认项左右、用户无从核查的代理性问题。系统将用户的语义日志、认知画像与长期偏好集中存放，并据此治理：有后果的代理操作须通过策略门（允许/拒绝/上报），可接受选项间的取舍先按用户规则而非平台默认决定，每项决策以哈希链式防篡改回执封存；对话呈现方式同样由用户层而非模型控制。任何模型经 MCP 接入，模型可替换而用户保持恒定。该文为防御性披露，用于确立带日期的在先技术，未报告实证评估。

papers.title: From Media Audience to Critical Citizen: Media Evolution, Psychological Vulnerability and the Crisis of Information Trust in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Dawid Karol Kolodziej
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: We live in an age of unprecedented access to information, yet having more information does not necessarily mean understanding the world more accurately. From traditional storytelling and printed newspapers to television, smartphones and generative artificial intelligence, the ways in which people create, distribute and interpret information have undergone profound transformations. In From Media Audience to Critical Citizen: Media Evolution, Psychological Vulnerability and the Crisis of Information Trust in the Age of Artificial Intelligence, Dawid Karol Kolodziej explores the psychological, educational and social consequences of these changes. Drawing on established media theories and contemporary scientific research, the publication examines why people believe misinformation, how repeated messages influence perceptions of truth, and how emotional narratives, cognitive biases and media framing contribute to the formation of individual and collective beliefs. Particular attention is given to artificial intelligence, deepfake technologies, synthetic media and the limitations of automated content detection. The author also investigates the relationship between AI-assisted productivity and independent human reasoning, considering how the delegation of cognitive tasks may influence critical thinking and information evaluation. A central argument concerns the unequal burden of information verification: while professional information producers possess considerable resources and influence, ordinary citizens often lack the time, expertise and technological tools necessary to independently verify every claim they encounter. The publication therefore challenges the assumption that combating misinformation should depend primarily on individual media literacy and emphasises the responsibility of publishers and information producers to substantiate factual claims and correct significant errors transparently. Building upon established scholarship, the author develops an updated five-dimensional conceptual framework for critical media citizenship, encompassing access and provenance, analysis of media construction and framing, evaluation of evidence and uncertainty, responsible creation and participation, and reflection on communicative power and shared responsibility. Combining social psychology, media education and critical analysis, this scholarly publication contributes to contemporary discussions about artificial intelligence, misinformation, public trust and the future of informed democratic participation. PRIMARY KEYWORDS: Media Literacy Artificial Intelligence Critical Thinking Misinformation Deepfakes SECONDARY KEYWORDS: Disinformation Social Psychology Information Credibility Media Education Digital Citizenship Cognitive Bias AI-Generated Content Information Verification Public Trust Media Accountability LONG-TAIL SEO KEYWORDS: psychology of misinformation AI and critical thinking deepfake detection limitations effects of artificial intelligence on human reasoning media literacy in the age of AI why people believe fake news psychological mechanisms of misinformation responsibility of media organisations AI-generated misinformation and public trust education for critical digital citizenship Website: https://dkk.hqici.com
papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕人工智能时代的信息信任危机，探讨从传统媒体受众到批判性公民的转变中，人们为何相信错误信息、重复信息如何影响真伪判断，以及情绪叙事、认知偏差和媒体框架如何塑造个体与集体信念。作者基于既有媒体理论和当代研究，重点分析了深度伪造、合成媒体及自动内容检测的局限，并讨论AI辅助生产力与人类独立推理之间的关系，指出认知任务外包可能影响批判性思维。其核心论点是信息核查负担分配不均：专业信息生产者拥有资源和影响力，普通公民却常缺乏时间、专业知识和技术工具逐条核实。据此，作者主张不应把对抗错误信息主要寄托于个人媒介素养，而应强调发布者核实事实、透明纠错的責任，并提出涵盖信息获取与来源、媒体建构与框架分析、证据与不确定性评估、负责任创作与参与、传播权力与共同责任反思的五维批判性媒介公民框架。

papers.title: Deterministic Safety Standardization for Next-Generation Physical AI and Orbital Infrastructure: Sub-0.5ms Control Barrier Function Quadratic Programming (CBF-QP), FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 Quantum Audit Records (QAR), and Systemic Risk Mitigation Protocols (SRMP) (和題: 次世代物理AI・宇宙インフラ安全標準化コンソーシアム基本論文:0.5ms未満の決定論的CBF-QPスーパーバイザー、ML-KEM-768量子監査記録[QAR]、およびシステムリスク軽減プロトコル[SRMP]による「必須の安全規格[License to Operate]」の数理・法制設計)
papers.authors: Yoko(洋子) Hasebe(長谷部)
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Contemporary general-purpose artificial intelligence (AGI) development led by frontier technology conglomerates remains overwhelmingly anchored in stochastic, autoregressive, and diffusion-based probabilistic inference. When deployed directly into safety-critical cyber-physical infrastructure and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) autonomous constellations, the absence of a deterministic physical-layer safety guarantee induces two existential failure modes: Temporal Blind Spots caused by communication and operating-system jitter, and Algorithmic Flash Crashes (coupled multi-agent physical runaway). This monograph establishes the foundational mathematical, cryptographic, actuarial, and statutory architecture of the Next-Generation Physical AI and Space Infrastructure Safety Standardization Consortium. First, we formulate a bare-metal Control Barrier Function Quadratic Programming (CBF-QP) deterministic supervisor executed within a sub-0.5 ms Hard-In-The-Loop Optimization (HITLO) fabric via PHOENIX_BRIDGE optical interconnects, mathematically intercepting 100% of stochastic AI hallucinations prior to physical actuation. Second, we integrate ultra-low-latency post-quantum cryptography (NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 accelerated via 7-stage Incomplete Number Theoretic Transforms) with immutable Quantum Audit Records (QAR) verified in a zero-knowledge virtual machine (QFS-zkVM) over the 64-bit Goldilocks prime field F_p (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1). Third, we demonstrate how this architecture resolves critical bottlenecks across three strategic sectors: (1) eliminating mega-constellation collision cascades and discharging strict state liability under Article VII of the 1967 Outer Space Treaty for Defense and Aerospace Agencies (DoD, NASA) via the Autonomous Traffic Control System (ATCS); (2) bounding heavy-tailed AI catastrophe distributions via the Systemic Risk Mitigation Protocol (SRMP) to restore finite expected loss (E[L] < infinity) for Mega-Insurance, Reinsurance, and Catastrophe (CAT) Bond Markets; and (3) transcending the trade-off between overly conservative rule-based models (Mobileye RSS) and fragile end-to-end Deep Learning (Sim-to-Real gap) in Next-Generation Mobility and Robotics. Finally, we specify a two-phase global standardization roadmap coupling Q-SAFA decentralized bailout smart contracts with SEC Rule 15c3-5 pre-trade-style hardware interlocks and Delaware Caremark fiduciary oversight standards to establish the global mandatory "License to Operate" for autonomous cyber-physical infrastructure. License & Integrity Covenant: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) with Strict No-Learn Covenant (NLL-v1.0-2026). Author: Hasebe, Yoko (長谷部 洋子) — Lead Researcher, Autonomous Infrastructure Systems, Autonomous Living & Physical Infrastructure Institute, Iwakuni, Yamaguchi, Japan.
papers.summary_zh: 该专著针对通用人工智能直接部署于安全攸关的网络物理基础设施与低轨自主星座时缺乏确定性物理层安全保障的问题，提出一套数学、密码学、精算与法规层面的标准化架构。作者设计了在亚0.5毫秒硬实时环境中运行的CBF-QP确定性监督器，声称可在物理执行前拦截随机性AI的错误输出，并整合后量子密码与量子审计记录。文章进一步论证该架构可用于消除巨型星座碰撞级联、约束AI灾难的重尾风险分布，以及调和规则模型与端到端深度学习之间的取舍，并给出配套的全球标准化路线图。需要说明的是，文中拦截率、时延等均为作者的设计主张，摘要未提供独立实验或系统实测证据。

papers.title: PENGEMBANGAN MULTIMEDIA INTERAKTIF KREASI KONTEN MENGGUNAKAN KECERDASAN ARTIFISIAL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN HASIL BELAJAR SISWA KELAS X
papers.authors: Aisyah Izzah Az Zahrah, Andi Kristanto
papers.journal: EDUTECH Jurnal Inovasi Pendidikan Berbantuan Teknologi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mastering the skills required to create content with artificial intelligence (AI) requires learning experiences that connect conceptual understanding with practical application. To address this need, interactive multimedia was developed for Grade X students at SMA Wachid Hasyim 2 Taman, focusing on the topic of Creating Content Using Artificial Intelligence. The development process followed a Research and Development approach using the ADDIE model (Analyze, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation), with participants selected through purposive sampling. Product testing consisted of an individual trial involving three students, a small-group trial involving six students, and a field trial involving 76 students, comprising 38 students in the experimental group and 38 in the control group. Data were collected through expert validation questionnaires, student response questionnaires, and pretest and posttest assessments. Product feasibility was analyzed descriptively, while learning outcome gains were calculated using the N-Gain method and compared using an independent-samples t-test. The validation and trial results classified the product as highly feasible. The experimental group achieved an average N-Gain in the high category, whereas the control group achieved an average N-Gain in the medium category. The difference in learning gains between the two groups was statistically significant (t = 11.484, p < .001).
