The multimedia integrates learning materials, visualizations, animations, tutorial videos, examples of AI applications, exercises, and assessments. This product has the potential to serve as an alternative learning medium for Coding and Artificial Intelligence (KKA), although the findings should be interpreted with due consideration of the use of a nonequivalent group design. ABSTRAK Penguasaan keterampilan membuat konten berbantuan kecerdasan artifisial (AI) membutuhkan pengalaman belajar yang menghubungkan pemahaman konsep dengan praktik penggunaannya. Untuk mendukung kebutuhan tersebut, multimedia interaktif dikembangkan bagi siswa kelas X SMA Wachid Hasyim 2 Taman pada materi Kreasi Konten Menggunakan Kecerdasan Artifisial. Pengembangan mengikuti model Research and Development dengan tahapan ADDIE (Analyze, Design, Development, Implementation, dan Evaluation), sedangkan subjek dipilih melalui purposive sampling. Pengujian produk mencakup uji perseorangan terhadap tiga siswa, uji kelompok kecil terhadap enam siswa, dan uji lapangan yang melibatkan 76 siswa, terdiri atas 38 siswa kelompok eksperimen dan 38 siswa kelompok kontrol. Data diperoleh melalui angket validasi ahli, angket respons siswa, serta tes pretest dan posttest. Kelayakan produk dianalisis secara deskriptif, sementara peningkatan hasil belajar dihitung menggunakan N-Gain dan dibandingkan melalui independent-samples t-test. Hasil validasi dan uji coba menempatkan produk dalam kategori sangat layak. Kelompok eksperimen mencapai rata-rata N-Gain berkategori tinggi, sedangkan kelompok kontrol berada pada kategori sedang. Perbedaan peningkatan kedua kelompok signifikan secara statistik (t = 11,484; p < 0,001). Multimedia mengintegrasikan materi, visualisasi, animasi, video tutorial, contoh penggunaan AI, latihan, dan evaluasi. Produk ini berpotensi menjadi alternatif media pembelajaran Koding dan Kecerdasan Artifisial (KKA), dengan interpretasi hasil tetap memperhatikan penggunaan kelompok nonekuivalen.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对十年级学生开发了一套关于“使用人工智能进行内容创作”的交互式多媒体教学产品，采用ADDIE模型的研发流程，并通过专家验证、学生问卷以及前后测来评估产品可行性与学习效果。验证与试用结果显示产品被评定为高度可行；在前后测比较中，使用该产品的实验组学习提升（N-Gain）平均处于高类别，而对照组处于中类别，两组提升差异具有统计显著性。作者据此认为该多媒体可作为编程与人工智能课程的一种替代教学媒体，同时提示由于采用非等组设计，结果解释需谨慎。

papers.title: PEMETAAN PERKEMBANGAN PENELITIAN SELF-REGULATED LEARNING DAN PROBLEM SOLVING: SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW DAN ANALISIS BIBLIOMETRIK 2020–2026
papers.authors: Briliian Prisillia, Prihantini Prihantini, Asep Herry Hernawan
papers.journal: EDUCATOR Jurnal Inovasi Tenaga Pendidik dan Kependidikan
papers.abstract: Research on self-regulated learning (SRL) and problem solving has expanded because students’ ability to regulate learning processes is important when addressing complex tasks. However, research development remains dispersed across different contexts, requiring systematic mapping to identify the structure and direction of the field. This study aims to map research on SRL and problem solving from 2020 to 2026 using a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) and bibliometric analysis. Data were obtained from Scopus using the search string ("self-regulated learning" OR "self-regulation") AND ("problem solving" OR "problem-solving"). From 730 initial documents, 198 English-language journal articles were retained after screening. VOSviewer and Bibliometrix/Biblioshiny were used to analyze publication development, keyword relationships, collaboration, and thematic evolution. The results show an increase in publications from 21 articles in 2020 to 53 articles as of September 28, 2026. Self-regulated learning, problem solving, and metacognition were the dominant keywords, with strong connections to self-efficacy, motivation, game-based learning, learning analytics, and artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence and generative artificial intelligence emerged as recent research directions. These findings indicate that SRL and problem solving research is increasingly integrating cognitive, motivational, social, and technological dimensions. ABSTRAK Penelitian self-regulated learning (SRL) dan problem solving berkembang karena kemampuan mengatur proses belajar penting dalam penyelesaian tugas kompleks. Namun, perkembangannya masih tersebar pada berbagai konteks sehingga diperlukan pemetaan sistematis untuk mengidentifikasi struktur dan arah penelitian. Penelitian ini bertujuan memetakan perkembangan penelitian SRL dan problem solving periode 2020–2026 melalui Systematic Literature Review (SLR) dan analisis bibliometrik. Data diperoleh dari Scopus menggunakan kata kunci ("self-regulated learning" OR "self-regulation") AND ("problem solving" OR "problem-solving"). Dari 730 dokumen awal, diperoleh 198 artikel jurnal berbahasa Inggris setelah proses penyaringan. Analisis dilakukan menggunakan VOSviewer dan Bibliometrix/Biblioshiny untuk memetakan perkembangan publikasi, hubungan keyword, kolaborasi, dan evolusi tema. Hasil menunjukkan peningkatan publikasi dari 21 artikel pada 2020 menjadi 53 artikel hingga 28 September 2026. Self-regulated learning, problem solving, dan metacognition menjadi keyword dominan, dengan keterkaitan kuat pada self-efficacy, motivation, game-based learning, learning analytics, dan artificial intelligence. Tema AI dan generative artificial intelligence muncul sebagai arah penelitian terbaru. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa kajian SRL dan problem solving berkembang menuju integrasi kognitif, motivasional, sosial, dan teknologi.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述通过系统文献综述与文献计量分析，梳理了2020至2026年间自我调节学习与问题解决研究的发展脉络，基于Scopus筛选出的英文期刊文章分析发文趋势、关键词关系与主题演化。结果显示，自我调节学习、问题解决和元认知是主导关键词，并与自我效能、动机、游戏化学习、学习分析和人工智能紧密关联，人工智能与生成式人工智能成为近期新兴方向。作者据此指出，该领域研究正日益整合认知、动机、社会与技术维度，但相关判断来自文献计量映射而非实证检验。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Adoption and Bank Performance in Nigeria: The Moderating Role of Cybersecurity Risk
papers.authors: Uloma Rose Nwamuo
papers.journal: Central Asian Journal of Innovations on Tourism Management and Finance
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming embedded in Nigerian banking through process automation, predictive analytics, personalised service, credit and risk analytics, and automated customer interfaces. Yet the organisational value associated with these capabilities is realised in an environment of expanding cyber exposure. This study examined the relationship between AI adoption and employee-rated bank performance in Nigeria and tested whether cybersecurity risk conditions affects the relationship. A quantitative cross-sectional explanatory survey was conducted among managerial, supervisory and specialist employees of 12 deposit money banks across major Nigerian banking hubs. From an accessible population of 6,214 eligible employees, 450 questionnaires were distributed through proportionate stratified and systematic sampling; 401 usable responses were analysed. AI adoption was operationalised through AI-driven process automation, predictive analytics and decision intelligence, and AI-enabled customer engagement. Bank performance captured perceived operational efficiency, service quality/customer responsiveness and financial/competitive performance, while cybersecurity risk measured perceived exposure to data compromise, social engineering, system intrusion, third-party/API vulnerabilities and AI-enabled fraud. Descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, HC3-robust ordinary least-squares regression and mean-centred moderation analysis were used. The three AI dimensions jointly explained 37.3% of the variance in bank performance. Predictive analytics showed the strongest positive association (β = .387, p < .001), followed by process automation (β = .210, p < .001) and customer engagement (β = .132, p = .005). Cybersecurity risk was negatively associated with performance (β = -.278, p < .001). Most importantly, the AI adoption × cybersecurity risk interaction was negative and significant (B = -.360, p < .001), adding 3.7 percentage points to explained variance. Simple-slope analysis showed that AI adoption remained positively associated with performance at low, average and high cyber risk, but the association weakened materially as risk increased. The study concludes that deeper AI adoption is associated with stronger employee-rated bank performance, while cybersecurity risk attenuates that relationship. Nigerian banks should therefore govern AI investment and cybersecurity investment as one integrated performance architecture rather than as separate technology programmes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察尼日利亚银行业中人工智能采用与员工评价的银行绩效之间的关系，并检验网络安全风险是否调节这一关系。作者对多家存款银行的员工开展横截面问卷调查，将AI采用操作化为流程自动化、预测分析与决策智能、客户互动三个维度。结果显示，三个AI维度共同解释了绩效的相当部分变异，其中预测分析的关联最强，流程自动化和客户互动次之；网络安全风险本身与绩效负相关，且AI采用与网络安全风险的交互项显著为负，即随着风险升高，AI采用与绩效的正向关联明显减弱。文章据此主张银行应将AI投资与网络安全治理作为一体化绩效架构来统筹，而非分作两套独立的技术项目。

papers.title: Breakfast Habits, Free Nutritious Meal Acceptance, and Nutritional Status Among Students of Sinar Harapan Private Senior High School
papers.authors: Pretty Siagian, Putri Aisyah, Haripin Togap Sinaga
papers.abstract: Background: Breakfast contributes to the fulfillment of daily energy and nutrient requirements among adolescents. The Free Nutritious Meal (Makan Bergizi Gratis/MBG) program is expected to support students’ nutritional intake at school, particularly among those who do not consume breakfast at home. Objective: This study aimed to describe breakfast habits, acceptance of the MBG program, and nutritional status among students of Sinar Harapan Private Senior High School. Methods: A descriptive quantitative study with a cross-sectional design was conducted among 83 students in grades X and XI. Data were collected using structured questionnaires, food-waste weighing, and anthropometric measurements. Breakfast habits were assessed based on frequency, timing, and food type. MBG acceptance was assessed using a five-point hedonic test and food-waste observation for five days. Nutritional status was assessed based on body mass index-for-age (BMI/A) and height-for-age (HAZ). Data were analyzed descriptively using frequency distributions and percentages. Results: A total of 42 students (50.6%) did not consume breakfast, while 28 (33.7%) had good breakfast habits and 13 (15.7%) had less good habits. Most students liked the MBG menu (84.3%). During the five-day observation, an average of 92.6% of students consumed the meals completely. Most students had normal nutritional status based on BMI/A (78.3%) and HAZ (81.9%). Conclusions: Breakfast habits among students were still inadequate, whereas acceptance of the MBG program was good, as indicated by the high level of food liking and low proportion of uneaten food. Most students had normal nutritional.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以Sinar Harapan私立高中十、十一年级学生为对象，采用横断面描述性设计，通过问卷、食物浪费称重和人体测量，考察学生的早餐习惯、对免费营养餐（MBG）的接受度及营养状况。结果显示，半数以上学生不吃早餐，早餐习惯良好者仅约三分之一；但学生对MBG菜单接受度较高，五天内多数人能完整吃完餐食，剩食比例较低。营养状况方面，多数学生按年龄别体质指数和年龄别身高均属正常。作者据此认为学生早餐习惯仍不理想，而MBG项目接受度良好，或有助于补充在校营养摄入，但作为描述性研究，结果只反映现状关联，未检验项目对营养状况的因果作用。

papers.title: An Explainable ESG Sentiment Analysis System Using FinBERT and RoBERTa Transformer Models: Implications for Financial Risk and Business Intelligence
papers.authors: Ispita Jahan, Sonia Nashid, Kaniz Sultana Chy, Md Ashiqul Islam, Maksud Miah, Md Asif Hasan, Quazi Taif Sadat
papers.journal: International Journal of Applied Data Analytics
papers.abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) disclosures have become a vital information source for supporting risk assessment and strategic decision-making in business intelligence systems. However, existing ESG analytics solutions often rely on opaque, accuracy-driven machine learning models that limit interpretability, auditability, and managerial trust. This study develops a transformer-based explainable ESG sentiment analysis model that integrates business intelligence principles with advanced natural language processing to support transparent and reliable financial risk assessment across U.S. industrial sectors. The proposed system combines FinBERT and RoBERTa transformer models with SHAP and XLex-based explainability mechanisms to support interpretable ESG sentiment classification. A corpus of 1,200 ESG-related disclosures from 150 publicly listed U.S. firms (2018–2024), including annual filings, sustainability reports, and corporate communications, is analyzed. ESG sentiment scores are aggregated at firm and sector levels and examined using fixed-effects panel regression and Granger causality analysis to evaluate their relationship with financial risk indicators, including market volatility, credit spreads, and investor confidence. Empirical results show a statistically significant inverse relationship between positive market volatility and ESG sentiment (R² = 0.67, p < 0.01), reflecting that constructive sustainability narratives contribute to financial stability. Granger causality tests further highlight that ESG sentiment provides incremental predictive value for future financial risk beyond historical risk measures. Explainability analyses demonstrate the dominant linguistic tokens and ESG dimensions driving model predictions, enhancing decision traceability and transparency. This study contributes to business intelligence and information systems engineering research by exploring an explainable ESG analytics framework that bridges advanced transformer models with interpretable decision support. The findings provide practical value for investors, managers, and regulators seeking transparent, reliable, and data-driven systems to translate ESG disclosures into actionable financial risk intelligence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有ESG分析模型缺乏可解释性的问题，构建了一个结合FinBERT与RoBERTa及SHAP、XLex解释机制的可解释ESG情感分析系统，并基于美国上市公司ESG披露语料进行情感打分与面板回归、格兰杰因果检验。结果显示，正向ESG情感与市场波动呈显著负相关，且ESG情感对后续财务风险具有超出历史风险指标的增量预测价值；解释性分析还揭示了驱动模型预测的主要语言特征与ESG维度。作者据此讨论了该系统在提升决策可追溯性与透明度方面的意义，为投资者和管理者将ESG披露转化为风险情报提供支持。

papers.title: Reorganizing Graduate Statistical Inference for Modern Biostatistical Practice
papers.authors: Raphael C. Kim, Michele Santacatterina
papers.abstract: First-year graduate courses in statistical inference within PhD programs in biostatistics often follow a classical mathematical statistics progression through probability models, data reduction, point estimation, testing and interval estimation, and asymptotic evaluation. This organization has clear pedagogical strengths, but may provide less guidance when the probability model is not the natural starting point. We propose a complementary target-first organization for a graduate statistical inference course in biostatistics. The course begins with the scientific question and target parameter, then introduces statistical model classes, estimation, first-order sampling behavior, inference, and efficiency within a common framework. Classical methods such as maximum likelihood, method of moments, estimating equations, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, bootstrap and jackknife methods, and the Cramér--Rao bound are organized within a common inferential workflow. A central advantage of this organization is that the same workflow provides a natural bridge from classical inference to modern statistical problems, including flexible estimation using machine learning and artificial intelligence, policy learning, anytime-valid inference, and modern Bayesian methods.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论生物统计博士项目一年级统计推断课程的组织方式，指出传统按概率模型、数据约简、点估计、检验与区间估计、渐近评价展开的数学统计顺序虽有教学优势，但当概率模型不是自然起点时指导性较弱。作者据此提出一种“目标优先”的互补性课程组织：从科学问题和目标参数出发，再引入统计模型类、估计、一阶抽样行为、推断与效率，并把最大似然、矩估计、估计方程、置信区间、假设检验、自助法与刀切法及克拉美—罗界纳入统一推断流程。文章认为，这一流程可自然衔接机器学习与人工智能的灵活估计、策略学习、任意时刻有效推断和现代贝叶斯方法等现代统计问题。

papers.title: When Agentic Retrieval Fails Silently: Framework and Production Evidence from a Creative AI Assistant
papers.authors: Yan, Liang, Anuj Agarwal, Aditya Reddy Cheruku
papers.abstract: CTR, MRR, and behavioral NDCG assume the user sees ranked results and acts on them. In an agentic assistant, a generation layer consumes retrieval output first, and that assumption breaks in three ways. The agent reads the results before the user does (who). The user's action can come several turns or sessions after retrieval (when). Outcomes blend retrieved content with the model's own knowledge (what caused it). We call this the attribution gap. We propose Layered Agentic Retrieval Assessment (LARA), which measures retrieval quality, engagement and outcome, and product success as three independent layers joined by a four-field lineage schema that requires no new modeling. We examine the motivation on Adobe Express, where one retrieval infrastructure serves a gallery search surface and an agentic assistant at roughly one-eighth its session volume for the same user population. Chat users reformulate more than gallery users (44.4% vs. 33.1%) because chat reformulation refines generated output. LARA restores attribution for the retrieval.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究指出，在智能体助手场景中，检索结果先由生成层消费、用户可能隔多轮或跨会话才行动、最终产出又混合了模型自身知识，传统检索指标所依赖的“用户看到并据此行动”假设因此失效，作者将这一问题称为归因缺口。为此，作者提出分层智能体检索评估框架LARA，把检索质量、参与度和产品成效作为三个独立层次，并用四字段血缘模式连接，无需新建模型。基于Adobe Express中同一检索基础设施同时服务图库搜索与智能体助手的生产证据，研究发现聊天用户的改写率高于图库用户，因为聊天中的改写用于细化生成输出；LARA据此恢复了检索的归因。

papers.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
papers.authors: Daniel Ruiz, Luca Luceri, Emilio Ferrara
papers.abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.

papers.title: X-pressing Intimacy: Mental Health Disclosure After Twitter Acquisition
papers.authors: Olivia Pal, Yunhao Yuan, Meghana Mandava, Talayeh Aledavood, Eshwar Chandrasekharan, Koustuv Saha
papers.abstract: Social media platforms provide spaces for individuals to disclose mental health experiences and seek support, yet how these disclosures evolve during major shifts in platform governance remains unclear. We examine mental health self-disclosure surrounding Elon Musk's October 2022 acquisition of Twitter, analyzing approximately 824K tweets across anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder (BD), borderline personality disorder (BPD), and suicidal ideation (SI) or related experiences, alongside 266K comparison tweets. Using Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC) and an LLM-based intimacy classifier, we characterize changes in psycholinguistic expression and disclosure intimacy. Following the acquisition, we observe declines in affective and social language, alongside increases in first-person singular pronouns and future-focused expressions. Intimacy patterns vary by condition: anxiety, depression, and BPD show increases in low-intimacy and decreases in moderate-intimacy disclosures, whereas suicide-related posts show more high-intimacy disclosures. However, compared with broader Twitter discourse, only the relative decline in moderate- versus low-intimacy disclosure for BPD remains statistically significant. Our findings underscore the importance of considering both language and intimacy when studying platform transitions, informing the design of online environments that support sensitive self-disclosure.

papers.title: Gate-Based Feature Importance in Simulation-Based Inference for EEG: A Cautionary Tale
papers.authors: Shrivatsa Deshmukh, Sasha Brenner, Thomas R. Knösche, Nico Scherf
papers.abstract: Simulation-based inference (SBI) provides a powerful way to fit mechanistic models to data, but offers little insight into which information in the data shapes the inferred parameter values. It could therefore benefit from robust and inexpensive interpretability methods. Learned weighting mechanisms such as feature gates provide a potential route to low-cost interpretability, although their interpretation assumes that predictive training reveals which inputs drive performance. We examined this assumption in a computational neuroscience setting, where neural posterior estimation (NPE) is used to infer four physiological parameters of a dynamical model of interacting neuronal populations (Jansen-Rit). We tested whether the learned gate weights captured feature importance by comparing them with a retrain-based ablation benchmark, in which each feature was removed in turn and the NPE retrained. We considered two jointly trained gates: independent sigmoid weights and competing softmax weights. If these reliably reflect feature importance, they should align with the ablation-based estimates. Across nine independent training seeds, however, gate-based and ablation-based importance were negatively correlated (Spearman's rho approximately -0.61 for sigmoid gating and -0.56 for softmax gating). The feature that ablation identified as most important, total signal power, was among the features the gate down-weighted most, despite gating costing negligible predictive accuracy. These results extend a pattern previously documented for attention mechanisms in natural language processing and for explainability methods in electroencephalography (EEG) deep learning to the simulation-based inference setting, and suggest caution when interpreting learned gate weights as measures of causal feature importance in scientific machine-learning pipelines.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了在基于模拟的推断（SBI）中，学习到的特征门控权重能否作为特征重要性的可靠解释，并以计算神经科学中用于推断Jansen-Rit模型四个生理参数的神经后验估计为场景。作者将独立sigmoid门控与竞争softmax门控的权重同逐特征消融并重训的基准进行比较，发现跨多个训练种子两者呈负相关，消融识别为最重要的总信号功率反而被门控大幅降权，而门控几乎不损失预测精度。这表明学习到的门控权重不宜直接解读为因果性特征重要性，提示在科学机器学习流程中使用此类低成本可解释性机制时需保持谨慎。

papers.title: PhishGen: Understanding LLM Capabilities in Automated Phishing Website Generation
papers.authors: Fujiao Ji, Yerim Kim, Yena Cho, Seonhye Park, Hyoungshick Kim, Doowon Kim
papers.abstract: Phishing relies on visual deception, traditionally requiring web-development skills or pre-built kits. LLMs erode this barrier by generating functional websites from natural-language prompts, yet prior work does not answer how far LLM-driven generation actually reaches: functionality is assessed by inspection rather than execution; visual fidelity is scored by automated metrics or a few internal coders rather than the humans such pages aim to deceive; evaluation is confined to commercial models; and no study benchmarks generated pages against phishing kits deployed in the wild. We present PhishGen, a framework that evaluates the appearance fidelity and end-to-end functionality of LLM-generated phishing pages. PhishGen constructs prompts across three input modalities in seven combinations with twelve safeguard-bypassing rewriting strategies, generates pages using 14 LLMs spanning commercial, open-source, and uncensored categories, and assesses each via automated similarity metrics, reference-based detectors, a crowdsourced user study, and execution-based functionality testing, benchmarking all results against 64 real-world phishing kits. Although 96.2% of safeguard-bypassing outputs render, their perceived fidelity is modest (2.02/5), and only 38.7% complete the full credential-harvesting pipeline, with the Unsaved error as the largest failure mode. Contrary to the belief that uncensored models pose the greatest threat, GPT 4.1 reaches 86.3 to 94.1% functional success while uncensored models rarely exceed 45.4%. Phishing kits remain more complete per sample, yet three strong LLMs surpass the kit-level rate (70.9 to 89.7%), showing that LLMs trade average completeness for scalable, low-barrier generation of working phishing pages. We further identify generator-level fingerprints that current similarity-based defenses miss, and distill recommendations for hybrid detectors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出 PhishGen 框架，考察大语言模型能否仅凭自然语言提示生成可用的钓鱼网站，并从外观逼真度与端到端功能两方面进行评估，同时与真实钓鱼工具包对比。结果显示，绕过安全防护后生成的大多数页面虽能渲染，但被感知的逼真度有限，仅少数能完成完整的凭据窃取流程；功能失败主要源于保存错误。与“无审查模型威胁最大”的预期相反，部分商业模型的功能成功率明显更高，而三个强模型在整体成功率上超过工具包层面，说明大模型以牺牲单样本完整度换取低门槛、可规模化的钓鱼页面生成。研究还识别出生成器层面的指纹特征，并为混合检测器提出建议。

papers.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
papers.authors: Zhennan Wan, Jianfei Chen
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出 LongZero 方法，旨在让大语言模型无需任何外部数据即可提升长上下文推理能力。其核心做法是让模型先以紧凑结构化形式自行生成问题、答案及支撑证据，再将证据扩展为长多文档上下文，并结合自生成的多跳推理任务与多轮检索任务，用 GRPO 训练模型。在两个模型和五个长上下文推理基准上的实验显示，LongZero 能泛化到真实任务，并优于基于外部语料合成数据的强化学习基线，提示从零数据出发改进长上下文推理是一条可行且有前景的路径。

papers.title: Every Part Has Its Role: Part-of-Speech Effects in LLM Post-Training
papers.authors: Laya Iyer, Chen Shani
papers.abstract: Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., "The tired coach ran home" $\rightarrow$ {"The tired trainer ran home", "The tired instructor ran home", ...}. Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work $\textit{beyond nouns}$ to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model's internal representations. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of concept augmentation depends on where and how conceptual information is introduced during training.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察概念增强训练中承载概念的词性是否影响大语言模型的表现，将此前以名词为主的实验扩展到动词和形容词，比较不同词性替换对困惑度和下游任务性能的作用。结果显示，概念增强对新闻文本困惑度的改善最稳定且与词性无关，而动词替换带来的下游收益最可靠；表征分析进一步表明，下游增益最大的条件并不一定最改变模型内部表征。作者据此指出，概念增强的效果取决于概念信息在训练中被引入的位置和方式。

papers.title: NeuroCodec: EEG-Guided Latent-Domain Generative Model for High-Fidelity Target Speaker Extraction
papers.authors: Julian Silva, Jaliya Kodithuwakku, Navindu Sirimanna, Shaveen Herath, Wageesha N. Manamperi, Joshua P. Kulasingham
papers.abstract: Driven by recent advancements in hearing assistive devices, target speaker extraction (TSE) in multi-talker environments has drawn significant attention. To address this, hearing technologies identify attention using neural signals recorded via electroencephalography (EEG) to guide TSE, enabling neuro-steered auditory attention decoding. However, most existing techniques rely on time-frequency masking, which suffers from low fidelity in spectro-temporally overlapping regions and is often restricted to narrowband audio. In contrast, we introduce NeuroCodec, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first generative EEG-guided TSE framework operating in the latent space of a neural audio codec. Specifically, NeuroCodec models spatial EEG dependencies via graph convolutions and fuses cross-modal EEG and speech representations through attention mechanisms and Mamba-based temporal modeling. We further introduce a six-phase training curriculum that progressively incorporates latent reconstruction, multi-scale spectral, and adversarial objectives to ensure stable, high-fidelity speech generation. Experiments on the public Cocktail Party and KUL datasets show NeuroCodec outperforms baselines, across several perceptual metrics. A listening experiment with 20 participants validated that NeuroCodec offers greater perceptual accuracy, achieving a mean score of 82.24 compared with 49.63 for M3ANet. Additionally, the proposed method is seen to enable 44.1 kHz reconstruction with spectral content extending up to 20 kHz, further supporting the perceptual results. Finally, we extend NeuroCodec with a causal streaming formulation suited for real-time processing, providing a basis for hearing assistive devices.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对多说话人环境中的目标说话人提取问题，提出 NeuroCodec——一个以脑电信号引导、在神经音频编解码器潜空间中运行的生成式提取框架，并用图卷积、注意力机制和基于 Mamba 的时序建模融合脑电与语音表征。在公开数据集上的实验显示，该方法在多项感知指标上优于基线；20 名参与者参与的听感实验也表明其感知准确度更高，并支持 44.1 kHz 重建、频谱内容延伸至 20 kHz。作者还给出了适用于实时处理的因果流式版本，为助听设备应用提供了初步基础。

papers.title: Will AI kill us all---or just make mathematicians obsolete?
papers.authors: Sergiù Klainerman
papers.abstract: AI's recent advances have fueled predictions of human intellectual obsolescence and fears for the future of mathematics. I argue that, impressive as these achievements are, they do not establish AI's capacity to invent new concepts and theories or sustain autonomous recursive self-improvement. Human intelligence also involves judgment, imagination, and embodied experience that standard measures fail to capture. Mathematics extends beyond proving theorems: its creative core lies in conceptual discovery and understanding. AI can strengthen this enterprise, but realizing its promise requires protecting attribution, open exchange, confidentiality, and mathematical training. I propose an academic AI consortium to provide powerful research tools with enforceable guarantees safeguarding unpublished ideas.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性文章，针对“AI 是否会让人类智力过时、甚至终结数学”的预测提出反驳。作者认为，现有 AI 成就虽令人瞩目，但不足以证明其能发明新概念与新理论，或实现自主的递归自我改进；人类智能还包含判断、想象和具身体验，而这些难以被标准测量捕捉。文章强调数学的创造性核心在于概念发现与理解，而非仅在于证明定理，AI 可以强化这一事业，但其潜力实现需要保护署名、开放交流、保密和数学训练，作者据此提议建立学术 AI 联盟，以可执行的保障提供强大研究工具并保护未发表的想法。

papers.title: TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking
papers.authors: Yan Wang
papers.abstract: Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term. We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates. We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对前沿模型不再返回详细推理过程、而现有破解方式又违反服务条款的问题，提出一种自行生成推理轨迹的替代方案：以上下文和教师答案为输入，按学生模型家族的风格重建推理链，并采用监督加对抗的两阶段训练，由生成器写出轨迹、判别器评估其真实性。独立评审给出的真实性评分显示，生成轨迹与真实轨迹相近，经判别器从多个候选中筛选后更高，但作者明确说明这是真实性而非正确率。在五个基准且其余条件固定的比较中，通用任务上各训练语料表现大致相当，编程任务上生成的推理优于教师自身的思考内容，相同问题与答案下HumanEval+和MBPP+均有提升，作者推测以学生家族风格书写的推理更易被其学习。

papers.title: The Serendiptionnaire: a Questionnaire for Measuring Experienced Serendipity
papers.authors: Brett Binst, Annelien Smets
papers.abstract: Serendipity is important to design for, yet it remains difficult to measure and evaluate. No validated questionnaire exists, so studies either borrow ResQue's novelty scale, which does not measure serendipity, or build their own items, which makes findings hard to compare and synthesize. Building on our earlier conceptualization of experienced serendipity as a fortuitous encounter with content that is both refreshing and enriching, we developed the Serendiptionnaire, a questionnaire that operationalizes our framework. We conducted twenty-seven cognitive interviews over three iterations with respondents who varied in age, education level, country of birth, and English proficiency, while they browsed recommendations on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Spotify. After each iteration, we revised the items until respondents interpreted them as intended. The resulting instrument consists of modular scales that researchers can combine to target the specific flavor of serendipity they want to study or design for. The Serendiptionnaire offers a ground truth for validating system-centered serendipity metrics and LLM-based evaluations, and it provides a nuanced evaluation of users' experienced serendipity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对偶然性体验难以测量、现有问卷或借用不相关量表或自编题项导致结果难以比较的问题，开发了名为Serendiptionnaire的问卷。作者基于将体验到的偶然性界定为遇到既令人耳目一新又有充实感的内容这一框架，通过多轮认知访谈反复修订题项，直至受访者按预期理解，最终形成可由研究者组合使用的模块化量表。该工具为验证以系统为中心的偶然性指标和基于大语言模型的评估提供了参照，并能更细致地评估用户实际体验到的偶然性。

papers.title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
papers.authors: Jiawei Chen, Ruoxi Xu, Boxi Cao, Zhuoqun Li, Ruotong Pan, Yunfei Zhang, Zhirui Yang, Jingyan Chen, Tingting Gao, Han Li, Yaojie Lu, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Xiangyu Wu, Hongyu Lin
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对小语言模型在短视频平台用户模拟中推理流于浅层模式匹配、难以刻画真实决策行为因素的问题，提出训练框架 OmniSimulator。它用五维结构化框架组织行为导向推理，从真实用户历史交互轨迹中筛选数据，并借助教师模型生成高质量推理轨迹，使小模型学习与行为相关的推理模式而非表面行为关联。实验显示，该框架提升了 Qwen3-8B 的模拟表现，达到与 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 相当的水平，并支持更小规模的自托管部署，提示结构化行为推理是提升用户模拟保真度与可扩展性的可行方向。

papers.title: How Far Can Foundation Models Be Distilled for Efficient Jet Tagging?
papers.authors: Jay Agarwal, Siddharth Khare, Dhruv Kumar
papers.abstract: Jet tagging is one of the most important applications of machine learning at the Large Hadron Collider. Recent models build in more physics knowledge or rely on large-scale pretraining, but the experiments place strict limits on their inference cost. Knowledge distillation can transfer their performance to small students that are cheap to run. We ask which properties of a teacher help the student, how small a student can get and how close it can come to the state of the art. On a jet tagging benchmark, we distil six teachers that differ in architecture, symmetry and pretraining, including two foundation models, into five small students. Every teacher improves every student, and the gain depends mainly on the strength of the teacher. We then shrink our two strongest distilled students, Transformer and L-GATr-slim, in width and in depth. With 20 thousand parameters, a distilled L-GATr-slim outperforms every published jet tagger trained from scratch at a fraction of the inference cost of every teacher. Even with two thousand parameters, it matches ParT, a model with a thousand times as many parameters. We also study what the students learn from their teachers. Our benchmark of inference cost shows that students of the same size can differ by almost an order of magnitude in speed. We release the code and the weights of all trained models.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在喷注标记任务中，基础模型能被知识蒸馏压缩到何种程度，以及教师模型的哪些特性有助于学生模型。作者在基准上将六种架构、对称性与预训练各异的教师模型（含两个基础模型）蒸馏到五个小型学生模型，发现所有教师都能提升学生表现，增益主要取决于教师强度；进一步压缩最强的两个蒸馏学生模型后，仅两万参数的L-GATr-slim便超过所有已发表的从头训练喷注标记器，两千参数时也能匹敌参数量高千倍的ParT。研究还分析了学生从教师处学到什么，并指出同尺寸学生推理速度可相差近一个数量级。

papers.title: When Thoughts Become Memory: Unifying In-Context Learning and Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Leon Chlon, Julie Huang
papers.abstract: We are the first to give a certified rule for whether unseen data belong in a pretrained model's context or its weights, built on an exact law for their information value. That value, the code length saved on held-out queries, equals in expectation the bits stored about the query, plus a prior repair, minus a decoding loss, for any model, architecture, dataset and task. The law's ceilings certify the choice from one measurement, and an anytime-valid test makes it from held-out queries, with error controlled whenever it stops. Every certificate the ceilings issue on a trained transformer, TabPFN, an occupancy network and a stereo network is correct. The test picks TabPFN over XGBoost and a trained surrogate over an in-context learner on airfoil pressure, calls the better of GPT-2's cache and fine-tune in 61,948 of 64,000 query streams over 32 comparisons, and errs in at most 3.3% of null streams. The law also diagnoses when learning in context helps and when it does not. Deleting part of a context is held-out validation of that part in any model, and adding parts one at a time traces the learning curve in context: one patch that sees a shape feature cuts an occupancy network's code length there a hundredfold, while eight that miss it nearly double it, and one camera that sees the surface beats four in a stereo network. Ranked by this label-free valuation, a kriging learner's three best support cars beat four drawn at random, and on a yes-or-no claim the valuation recovers a published evidence adjudicator, with AUROC 0.91.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对一个模型设计问题提出判定规则：未见数据应放入预训练模型的上下文还是写入其权重，并基于信息价值给出可验证的判据。作者推导出留出查询上节省的编码长度等于模型存储的查询比特数加先验修正、再减解码损失，并据此构造上限证书与随时有效的检验。在训练好的 Transformer、TabPFN、占据网络和立体网络等系统上，证书判定均正确；检验在多数查询流中选出更优方案，零假设流误判率较低。该法则还能诊断上下文学习何时有效，例如包含形状特征的补丁大幅缩短编码长度，而缺失该特征的补丁则使其增加。

papers.title: Beyond Small Talk: Modeling Disclosure Trajectories in Human-AI Conversation
papers.authors: Keith Kwok, Wanting Ning, Tej Deep Pala, Desmond C. Ong, S. Supraja, Renwen Zhang, Soujanya Poria
papers.abstract: Recently, we see a rise in conversational agents as a form of social and emotional support, where disclosure will unfold over time. Yet, current evaluations of these agents typically examine isolated conversational states. In analyses of naturally occurring conversations, disclosure history and current disclosure are confounded which tends to make their effects difficult to isolate. We thus introduce Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE), an evaluation framework grounded in Social Penetration Theory that utilizes predefined disclosure trajectories and evaluates how preceding disclosure history shapes model behavior under matched current disclosure. Through the use of TraDE, we demonstrate across multiple models and relational behavior benchmarks that responses to disclosures matched on depth can differ depending on the preceding trajectory, particularly in whether models accept or challenge the user's framing. We also observed that these differences track accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than any single moment of vulnerability or the order of disclosures. It also tends to persists for several turns after disclosure returns to shallow levels. For several behaviors, we also demonstrate that models diverge most consistently from human supporters in the Emotional Support Conversation corpus (ESConv) not when users open up but rather when they step back in their disclosure. TraDE thus provides a systematic way to expose history-dependent relational behavior that evaluations of isolated conversational states would otherwise miss.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注对话智能体在长期情感支持中如何受用户自我披露历史影响，指出现有评估多局限于孤立对话状态，难以区分披露历史与当前披露的作用。作者提出基于社会渗透理论的轨迹式披露评估框架TraDE，用预设披露轨迹在匹配当前披露深度的条件下考察模型行为。结果显示，多个模型在关系行为基准上的回应会随先前轨迹不同而变化，尤其体现在接受还是质疑用户框架上；这种差异与累积接触更深披露有关，而非某一脆弱时刻或披露顺序，且在披露回到浅层后仍持续数轮。研究还发现，模型与人类支持者差异最一致之处出现在用户收回披露时，而非敞开心扉时。

papers.title: BrainCodes: A Lightweight EEG Foundation Model over Discrete Neural Codes
papers.authors: Kleanthis Avramidis, Ivan Tashev, Dimitra Emmanouilidou
papers.abstract: Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. Our model matches or surpasses the state of the art across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks, including sleep staging, attention assessment, and cognitive load estimation. BrainCodes transfers effectively to low-resource wearable devices while using up to 97% fewer trainable parameters than comparable architectures. Beyond predictive accuracy, our evaluation framework characterizes the geometry and invariances of learned EEG representations across measurable spatial, temporal, and spectral signal properties.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电基础模型日益依赖大规模参数、难以部署在资源受限设备上的问题，提出轻量级基础模型 BrainCodes，其核心是量化神经分词器与支持任意电极配置的时空编码器，并通过自监督学习在大规模脑电记录上预训练。作者报告该模型在睡眠分期、注意力评估和认知负荷估计等神经生理监测任务上达到或超过现有先进水平，并可迁移至低资源可穿戴设备，同时可训练参数显著少于同类架构。文章还提出评估框架，用于刻画所学脑电表征在空间、时间和频谱属性上的几何结构与不变性，说明紧凑架构同样能获得可迁移的脑电特征。

papers.title: A Stratified Multi-Rater Evaluation of LLM-Based Virtual Standardized Patients with a Deployed Data-Generation Platform
papers.authors: Yongjin Yi, Jinyong Park, Sejoong Kim
papers.abstract: The Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) is widely used to assess clinical communication skills in medical education, requiring trainees to take histories and reason clinically with standardized patients (SPs). Large language model (LLM)-based virtual standardized patients (VSPs), typically built by persona-injected prompting, offer a practical alternative. However, existing evaluations rely on a single backbone LLM, small human rater panels, or LLM-as-a-judge scoring without an utterance-aligned human-expert reference, and so cannot identify the specific shortcomings of individual models. We evaluated four LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama-3.1 70B, and HyperCLOVA X), spanning commercial, open-source and Korean-developed models, against a human-expert reference across three Korean OSCE cases (hematuria, fever in pregnancy, and chronic cough). In a double-blind, fully crossed design, 17 senior medical-student raters scored every model utterance on three sentence-level and six encounter-level Likert metrics, yielding 7,480 data points. We analyzed the scores using a stratified linear mixed-effects model based on an 11-category history-taking and 3-level linguistic-form taxonomy. At the encounter level, three of the four LLMs fell 0.08 to 0.47 Likert points below the human-expert reference on Comprehensibility, Consistency and Hallucination-freeness. The difference was not statistically significant for Hallucination-freeness in Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o, Consistency in GPT-4o, and Engagement in HyperCLOVA X. Llama-3.1 70B fell significantly below the reference on all six metrics. We also introduce a web-based OSCE platform that supports virtual practice across diverse clinical cases and continuously collects student-VSP dialogues under research and privacy consent.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对基于大语言模型的虚拟标准化病人（VSP）缺乏多模型、多评分者系统评估的问题，比较了四种模型与人类专家参考在韩国OSCE病例中的表现。研究采用双盲全交叉设计，由高年级医学生评分者对模型逐句打分，并按病史采集类别和语言形式分层分析。结果显示，多数模型在可理解性、一致性和无幻觉等遭遇层面指标上低于人类专家参考，其中Llama-3.1 70B在所有六项指标上均显著落后，而部分模型在个别指标上的差异不显著。作者据此指出不同模型短板存在差异，并介绍了支持虚拟练习和数据收集的在线平台。

papers.title: Situating Vulnerability: An Ethical Governance Framework for Anthropomorphic AI Interaction
papers.authors: Hanhui Xu, Jiacheng Ji, Yuhan Wang, Haoan Jin, Jaiming Luo, Mengyue Wu
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly address users in the register of care: they remember personal details, adopt a first-person emotional voice, and sustain relationships across many sessions. This anthropomorphic mode of interaction generates risks that output-level metrics capture poorly, because the same empathic utterance may console one user, entrap a second, and consolidate a delusion in a third. Governance has responded in two ways. Uniform restriction refuses sensitive requests or suppresses empathic phrasing across all outputs; group-targeted protection profiles vulnerable populations and applies stricter or prohibitive rules to them. This article argues that both fail. Uniform restriction mislocates harm in the lexical form of responses rather than in the trajectory of a relationship; group-based protection depends on a list that can never be complete, treats a fluid property as a static attribute of persons, and converts protective attention into stigmatizing labels. Drawing on philosophical work that treats vulnerability as universal, relational, and differentiated, we propose that the unit of ethical governance should be the vulnerability situation rather than the vulnerable group, develop a typology of five situations - physical, emotional, cognitive, autonomy, and relational - and specify seven principles into requirements that guide response calibration without diagnosing or persistently classifying users. The framework relocates AI safety from output control to relational safety.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论文章，讨论拟人化AI交互的伦理治理问题。作者指出，大语言模型以关怀口吻记忆细节、使用第一人称情感表达并维持长期关系，其风险难以由输出层面的指标捕捉，因为同一句共情话语对不同用户可能产生安慰、诱陷或强化妄想等不同后果。文章批评统一限制和群体定向保护两种治理路径：前者把伤害定位于措辞而非关系轨迹，后者依赖无法完备的名单、将流动属性固化为人的静态标签并带来污名化。作者援引将脆弱性视为普遍、关系性和差异化的哲学工作，提出以“脆弱情境”而非“脆弱群体”为治理单元，区分身体、情感、认知、自主和关系五类情境，并将七项原则细化为指导回应校准的要求，而不对用户作诊断或持续分类，从而把AI安全从输出控制转向关系性安全。

papers.title: Same Probabilities, Different Advice: Gain-Loss Framing Effects in High-Stakes LLM Decision Support
papers.authors: Yuyao Zhang, Cui Yakun, Han Zhu, Jinhu Lu, Yike Guo, Sirui Han
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support consequential decisions, yet their reliability under equivalent representations of uncertainty remains unclear. Existing work has documented prompt sensitivity, cognitive biases, and confidence miscalibration, but it is still unknown whether high-stakes advice changes when the same probability is expressed through complementary gain and loss frames. We introduce FrameBench-HPS, a controlled benchmark of 2,880 prompts derived from 240 high-stakes scenarios across healthcare, finance, education/career, and legal/consumer-rights domains. Across seven LLMs, gain-loss framing changes the recommendation category in 32.4% of complete groups, with most changes involving uncertainty rather than direct reversals. Human evaluation confirms corresponding shifts in perceived risk and directiveness. Robustness experiments show that framing effects persist under conversational paraphrases and exceed ordinary repeated-generation variability. Probability canonicalization substantially reduces framing sensitivity, identifying probability representation as a practical target for improving consistency in high-stakes LLM decision support.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型在高风险决策支持中，同一概率以收益或损失框架表述时其建议是否改变，并构建了覆盖医疗、金融、教育/职业和法律/消费者权益场景的受控提示基准，对多个模型进行测试。结果显示，增益—损失框架会改变相当一部分完整组别的建议类别，且多数变化表现为不确定性表达而非直接反转，人类评估也观察到风险感知与指令性程度的相应偏移。作者指出，这种框架效应在对话改写和重复生成波动之外依然存在，而概率规范化能明显降低框架敏感性，说明概率表征是提升高风险决策支持一致性的可行着力点。

papers.title: Post-Pruning vs. Early Stopping: Which Works Better for Link Prediction with AnyBurl?
papers.authors: Thomas Eiter, Davide Soldà, Hai Xia
papers.abstract: Rule-based link prediction combines symbolic and statistical artificial intelligence methods by inductively learning a set of rules from a knowledge graph (KG), with the aim of completing the graph when a query cannot be answered from the KG alone. Several systems have been proposed, and while they perform well on classical benchmarks, even compared with embedding-based systems, many of them produce a large number of rules. This compromises scalability in the query-answering phase, especially under strong hardware constraints. In this work, we investigate the behavior of AnyBurl, a state-of-the-art rule learner for link prediction, to determine whether running it for a given time and then pruning the learned rules yields better query-answering performance at test time than a simpler approach that stops rule generation earlier.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基于规则的链接预测在知识图谱补全中的效率问题：AnyBurl 等系统虽性能良好，却常生成大量规则，影响查询阶段的扩展性。作者以 AnyBurl 为对象，比较两种策略——先运行固定时间再对学到的规则做后剪枝，与更早停止规则生成——在测试时查询回答表现上的差异。摘要未给出具体结果，因此无法判断哪种策略更优，仅能确认研究旨在检验后剪枝能否在硬件受限条件下带来更好的查询性能。

papers.title: Failure Modes of Vision-Language Models for Human Activity Understanding in Thermal HRI
papers.authors: Han Hu, He Chen
papers.abstract: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察视觉语言模型在热成像人机交互场景中理解人类活动时的失败模式，以两个以人为中心的热成像数据集为对象，对七种可本地部署的模型进行诊断性评测，并用配对RGB录像作性能参照。结果显示，模型能识别宽泛的活动类别，却难以分辨咳嗽、打喷嚏、打哈欠等细粒度动作，重建的事件时间线不准确，还会虚构涉及物体的动作；简单的热成像输入预处理和额外推理仅带来有限且因模型而异的改善，即使明确要求，各模型的弃答行为也不一致，限制了其实际机器人应用中的可靠性。

papers.title: From AI-Free Gates to AI-First Work: How Engineering Students in India Navigate University Education and Campus Placements Without AI Guidelines
papers.authors: Samhitha Goutham, Ziwei Gu
papers.abstract: Engineering graduates in India enter a technology sector that is being reshaped by generative AI, yet the route into that sector runs through examinations and campus placement screens that largely exclude AI. Institutions in India have an approved intake of nearly 2.9 million seats in engineering and technology for 2026-2027, but HCI research on how students prepare for AI-mediated work has drawn mostly on Western and East Asian settings. We interviewed 23 students and recent graduates of Indian engineering and computing programmes about how they used generative AI across coursework, examinations and placements, and how they judged their own readiness for work. Using reflexive thematic analysis, we report five themes, covering AI-first workplaces and AI-free placement screens, how participants prepared for placement, how they used AI in coursework, the role of faculty authority and enforcement, and participants' concerns about their readiness for work. Drawing on signaling theory, we discuss what grades and screen scores certify once AI can help produce them, and we offer recommendations for employers, institutions and AI tool designers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注印度工程与计算机专业学生在课程学习、考试和校园招聘中如何使用生成式人工智能，以及他们如何判断自己对AI介导工作的准备程度。作者访谈了23名学生和应届毕业生，并通过反思性主题分析归纳出五类主题，涉及AI优先的工作场所与禁用AI的招聘筛选、求职准备方式、课程中的AI使用、教师权威与执行，以及对自身就业准备度的担忧。文章借助信号理论讨论：当AI能协助产出成绩和筛选分数时，这些指标究竟还能证明什么，并据此向雇主、院校和AI工具设计者提出建议。

papers.title: Two for One: Privileged Learning for Resource-Constrained Screening
papers.authors: Lisa Y. W. Tang
papers.abstract: Machine learning systems are often developed under data-rich conditions but deployed when only incomplete information is available. A natural example arises in colour fundus photography (CFP), where both eyes are commonly imaged because they can provide complementary information for ocular disease assessment. Prior approaches that exploit bilateral information either fuse both eyes in a single model or use knowledge distillation to compress a dual-eye teacher into a lightweight student that still requires both images at test time. However, bilateral acquisition may not always be feasible. We thus propose a privileged learning framework in which a teacher model has access to bilateral CFP images during training and learns representations informed by information from both eyes, while the student is trained to transfer this knowledge from the bilateral teacher using only a single-eye image as input. At inference, the student operates exclusively on this single-eye input and does not require the contralateral image. Experimental results show consistent improvements in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve over conventional monocular training, with the largest gains observed for left-eye images for the detection of age-related macular degeneration (0.931 vs. 0.966) and diabetic retinopathy (0.789 vs. 0.836).%, while requiring only a single-eye image at inference. By enabling models to benefit from bilateral information during training while requiring only a single-eye image at inference, our approach may support more reliable deployment in resource-constrained clinical and screening environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对彩色眼底照相筛查中双眼图像并非总能获取的问题，提出一种特权学习框架：训练时教师模型可利用双眼图像学习表征，学生模型仅以单眼图像为输入来迁移这一知识，推理阶段也只需单眼图像。实验显示，与常规单眼训练相比，该方法在受试者工作特征曲线下面积上取得一致提升，其中左眼图像在年龄相关性黄斑变性和糖尿病视网膜病变检测上的增益最大。作者据此认为，让模型在训练中受益于双眼信息、在推理时仅依赖单眼图像，有助于在资源受限的临床与筛查环境中实现更可靠的部署。

papers.title: Architectural Concepts For Integrating Human Preferences And Environmental Susainability Into AI-Driven Architectural Design
papers.authors: Prof. P. B. Chandane Onkar Hanumant Berad, Dr. H. B. Jadhav
papers.journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing architectural design through generative modelling, performance prediction, spatial planning, and workflow automation. However, many current applications address individual tasks or emphasize visual novelty, while practical design decisions must balance human needs, climate responsiveness, affordability, accessibility, regulatory constraints, and environmental performance. This paper proposes a Human-Centered and Sustainability-Aware AI Architectural Design Framework (HCS-AADF) that combines these considerations within an iterative design-support workflow. The framework accepts user requirements, site and climate information, budget limits, and applicable design constraints; analyses the project context; generates alternative layouts or massing concepts; evaluates alternatives against multiple criteria; explains trade-offs; and returns shortlisted options to an architect for review. Human feedback can be used to refine subsequent iterations. A conceptual multi-criteria scoring model and an evaluation protocol are specified to support future implementation and testing. The paper synthesizes three supplied research directions—AI architectures informed by human drives and emotions, the adoption and capabilities of AI software tools in architecture, and systematic reviews of AI applications in architectural design—along with relevant recent literature on generative design and sustainable building optimization. The proposed contribution is an integrated, transparent workflow rather than a claim of experimentally proven performance. Expected benefits include more traceable design comparisons, earlier consideration of sustainability, and improved collaboration between architects and AI systems. The framework also identifies risks involving data quality, bias, explainability, regulatory verification, and over-reliance on generated outputs. Experimental validation with representative building projects and expert review is proposed as the next step.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对当前AI建筑设计多聚焦单一任务或视觉新颖性、难以兼顾人的需求与环境可持续性的问题，提出一个以人为中心且兼顾可持续性的AI建筑设计框架（HCS-AADF）。该框架属于概念性系统设计而非实证研究，将用户需求、场地气候、预算与设计约束纳入迭代流程，生成并多准则评估布局或体量方案、解释权衡，再由建筑师审核并反馈以改进后续迭代，同时给出概念性评分模型与评估协议。作者通过综合三条研究方向与近期文献构建该框架，强调其贡献是透明可追溯的整合工作流，而非已获实验验证的性能；预期收益包括更可追溯的方案比较、更早纳入可持续性考量以及改善建筑师与AI的协作，并指出数据质量、偏见、可解释性、监管核验和过度依赖生成结果等风险，下一步拟以代表性建筑项目开展实验验证与专家评审。

papers.title: Developing an Institutional Readiness Framework for Agentic AI Adoption in Bangladesh Public Universities: Insights from Faculty and Policy Stakeholders
papers.authors: Motia Mannan, Torekol Islam Maruf, Md Asaduzzaman, Nishat Ara Tisha, MD Humayun Kabir, MD Mehedi Hasan Riday, Tamanna
papers.abstract: The evolution of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the landscape of higher education as AI can plan activities, make use of digital tools, and carry out progressively independent acts in teaching, administration, support services, and research processes. The development of such technology brings along new opportunities for the universities, but at the same time, it poses certain challenges to them, which include infrastructure issues, institutional capabilities, governance issues, ethical issues, and human supervision. Such challenges are quite relevant to public universities of Bangladesh. The study constructs a contextualized IRF for adopting agentic AI in Bangladesh public universities. Based on interpretivist approach and adapted TOE framework, this study adopted qualitative research methodology involving semi-structured interviews with 18 university faculty members and policymakers. Four main themes were emerged from thematic analysis: Infrastructure-Policy gap, Socio-cultural inertia, Ethics and Grassroot innovations. The findings indicate that institutional readiness is not solely a technological condition but is shaped by organizational culture, leadership capacity, regulatory preparedness, ethical considerations, trust, and human oversight. Based on these findings, a four-level Institutional Readiness Framework is proposed, comprising foundational readiness, cultural readiness, regulatory readiness, and implementation readiness. The framework emphasizes strengthening digital infrastructure and literacy, developing institutional awareness and role clarity, establishing context-sensitive and human-in-the-loop governance mechanisms, and implementing supervised AI pilots supported by training and review processes. The study contributes to the emerging literature on agentic AI by providing a context-sensitive readiness framework grounded in the realities of public universities in the Global South. It also provides practical implications for policymakers and university administrators seeking to develop responsible, equitable, and contextually appropriate pathways for agentic AI adoption in Bangladesh.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦孟加拉国公立大学采纳能动性人工智能（agentic AI）的制度准备问题，采用解释主义取向和改编的技术-组织-环境框架，通过对18名高校教师与政策相关者的半结构化访谈进行主题分析。研究提炼出基础设施与政策脱节、社会文化惰性、伦理及基层创新四类主题，发现制度准备并非单纯的技术条件，而受组织文化、领导能力、监管准备、伦理考量、信任与人类监督共同塑造。据此，作者提出包含基础准备、文化准备、监管准备和实施准备四个层面的制度准备框架，强调数字基础设施与素养、角色清晰度、情境敏感且人在回路中的治理机制，以及有监督的试点与培训审查流程，为政策制定者和大学管理者提供参考。

papers.title: Assessment Design Needs: A Preliminary Study on Using Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools for Educators
papers.authors: Mohd Azran Mohd Salleh, Siti Nurul Mahfuzah Mohamad, Ibrahim Ahmad
papers.abstract: Assessment is considered as a key feature and central pillar in the teaching and learning process, particularly in making of judgement and measurement of student achievement and mastery of learning outcomes. The traditional methods of designing assessments items face several challenges, such as the need and requirement to design the assessment items manually, the time-consuming nature of the design process and the required cognitive skills through formal training provided by various institutions. As the result, the assessment items may lack on the detailed and context specific to validity and reliability, lack of standardized rubric and inconsistent scoring in performance based. A preliminary study was conducted at the analysis phase to explore fundamental understanding of Outcome-Based Education (OBE), Assessment Literacy, and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) literacy among educators. Forty-six educators were involved in this study. Findings have shown that most of the respondents have lower level of using GAI tools and prompt engineering skills, 43.5% use GAI for teaching and learning, searching information (34.8%), idea collection process (6.5%), reflection/journal (4.3%), writing programming code (4.3%), generate image (4.3%) and other tasks (2.2%). The most difficult tasks are writing assessment test items (28.3%), practical tests (21.7%), presentations (17.4%), projects (10.9%), simulations (6.5%), and fieldwork (5.4%). The study shows that educators lack skills in designing assessment materials using GAI. Promoting a suitable guideline as a new innovative assessment tool will serve as a standardized guideline and as a means of incorporating AI ethically.
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究在分析阶段考察了教育者对成果导向教育、评估素养与生成式人工智能素养的基本理解，以46名教育者为对象，重点了解其使用生成式AI工具设计评估材料的现状与困难。结果显示，多数受访者使用生成式AI工具和提示工程的能力较低，生成式AI主要用于教学与学习，而撰写评估测试题被列为最困难的任务之一。研究据此指出，教育者缺乏借助生成式AI设计评估材料的技能，并提出制定相应指南，将其作为标准化且合乎伦理地融入AI的评估工具。由于这是分析阶段的初步调查，结论主要反映受访者的自评现状，尚不能说明相关培训或指南的实际效果。

papers.title: AI-Enabled ATC Decision Support Systems: A Systematic Review Of Trajectory Prediction, Conflict Detection, And Human-AI Teaming In The Loop
papers.authors: Nur Suraya Sahol Hamid, Nawal Aswan Abdul Jalil, Fairuz Izzuddin Romli, Siti Azfanizam Ahmad, Muhammad Firdaus Ismail
papers.abstract: This systematic literature review (SLR) synthesises recent evidence on artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled Air Traffic Control (ATC) decision-support systems and examines how AI is used to improve operational performance, safety, and resilience in increasingly complex airspace. Research on machine learning, optimisation, and automation has expanded rapidly, but evidence remains fragmented across application areas and validation settings. A Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020-guided protocol was used to search Scopus and IEEE Xplore for English-language journal articles published from 2021 to 2025. Following screening, full-text eligibility assessment, and final reconciliation of study type, scope, and duplicate records, 30 eligible primary studies (n = 30) were included in the qualitative synthesis. The abstract level reporting completeness appraisal yielded a mean score of 80.28% and a median of 83.33%; 16 of 30 studies (53.33%) scored at least 80%, including six studies (20.00%) that scored at least 90%. These percentages describe reporting completeness rather than algorithmic performance. Because the included studies evaluated different operational tasks, datasets, outcome measures, and validation settings, their performance results were not directly commensurable; combining them into a single pooled model-performance percentage would therefore risk conflating non-equivalent metrics. Performance evidence was instead synthesised comparatively by application area, validation setting, and operational trade-off, so that study level performance was interpreted within the metric and dataset used by each primary study rather than averaged across non-equivalent tasks. Three themes were identified: (1) AI-enabled ATC/Air Traffic Management (ATM) operations, including delay and capacity management, conflict resolution, trajectory prediction, and traffic-pattern analytics; (2) aviation safety, surveillance, and resilience, including unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-related risks, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) interference, sensing, monitoring, and safety assurance; and (3) aviation-connected smart mobility and intelligent transportation systems (ITS), including UAV logistics and related surface-transport applications. Comparative synthesis indicated that prediction methods were increasingly connected to operational decision support, whereas conflict-resolution and resilience approaches continued to rely substantially on simulation, experimental datasets, or bounded validation environments. Overall, the evidence showed increasing operational relevance, but important gaps remained in explainability, real-world validation, human-AI interaction, robustness, and system integration before wider safety-critical ATC deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以PRISMA 2020流程检索并筛选出30项原始研究，梳理AI在空管决策支持中的轨迹预测、冲突检测与人机协同应用。作者按应用领域、验证环境和运行权衡进行比较综合，而非合并不同任务的性能指标，归纳出空管运行、航空安全与韧性、智能交通三个主题。结果显示预测方法正日益与运行决策支持衔接，但冲突解决与韧性方法仍多依赖仿真、实验数据集或受限验证环境；证据整体运行相关性增强，在可解释性、真实环境验证、人机交互、鲁棒性和系统集成方面仍存缺口，距安全关键场景的广泛部署尚有距离。

papers.title: The role ofArtificial Intelligence governance in enhancing digital transparency mechanisms within International Joint Ventures: a forward-looking perspective
papers.authors: Heroual Mohamed Amine, Gherbali Abdelhamid, Bais Amira Naziha
papers.abstract: This study aims to explore and analyze the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance as a modern strategic approach to enhancing digital transparency levels within International Joint Ventures (IJVs). Particular emphasis is placed on addressing the critical challenge of "information asymmetry" between international partners through the regulatory, ethical, and operational frameworks of intelligent systems. To achieve this objective, the study adopts a descriptiveanalytical methodology anchored in a deductive theoretical approach. It provides a comprehensive conceptual grounding for algorithmic governance and smart auditing, examining their downstream impact on the quality of financial disclosure and proactive organizational oversight. The findings reveal that transitioning toward digital governance serves as a fundamental pillar for ensuring a real-time, highly reliable information flow that substantially mitigates agency risks. Furthermore, the study emphasizes that the successful implementation of this model in emerging business environments—such as Algeria—remains contingent upon developing robust legislative frameworks and building a advanced digital infrastructure capable of ensuring "algorithmic explainability," thereby constructing bridges of sustainable trust between international partners.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨人工智能治理作为提升国际合资企业数字透明度、缓解合作方信息不对称的战略路径，采用描述性分析与演绎理论相结合的概念性方法，考察算法治理与智能审计对财务披露质量和组织主动监督的影响。文章认为，转向数字治理有助于实现实时、高可靠的信息流动并降低代理风险，但该模式在新兴商业环境中的落地仍取决于健全的立法框架和能够保障算法可解释性的数字基础设施，从而在国际伙伴之间建立可持续信任。

papers.title: Generative AI in Higher Education
papers.authors: Xueyan Zhang, Intesar Almugren, Varun Chotia, Vikram Kumar Sharma, Adrienn Dernóczy-Polyák
papers.abstract: This paper discusses the motivational, cognitive, and institutional aspects with which GenAI is used by business students. Using the Gioia approach, qualitative data was collected in the form of 43 participants who gave elaborate answers to 10 open-ended questions on issues related to the concept comprehension, completion of assignments, collaboration in groups, classroom participation, and assessment expectations. The review generated three broad themes, namely Need-Supportive Affordances, Calibrated Offloading, and Constraints and Misalignments. The study has a contribution to the theory of SDT having expanded it to the interaction between human and AI and fine tuning the concept of calibrated offloading. It also emphasizes practical requirements, such as designing balanced assessment plans, integrating AI literacy into the curriculum, and establishing regular institutional policies to make sure that it is used responsibly and in a constructive way.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注商科学生在高等教育中使用生成式人工智能时的动机、认知与制度层面，采用Gioia方法对参与者就概念理解、作业完成、小组协作、课堂参与和考核预期等问题的开放式回答进行质性分析。分析归纳出需求支持性可供性、校准式卸载以及约束与错配三个主题，并将自我决定理论拓展至人机互动情境，细化了“校准式卸载”概念。文章据此提出设计均衡考核方案、将AI素养纳入课程以及建立常规制度政策等实践要求，以确保生成式人工智能被负责任且建设性地使用。

papers.title: An Evaluation System for University Innovation and Entrepreneurship Capabilities Based on Deep Learning and Multi-Source Data
papers.authors: Huina Mo
papers.abstract: This study proposes a technique, combining Deep Learning-enabled Multi-Source Data (DL-MSD), to evaluate the potential of educational institutions to engage in innovative and entrepreneurial endeavors. The Deep Neural Network–Based Fusion Model (DNN-FM) can combine structured, semi-structured, and behavioral data. It is feasible to discover nonlinear correlations between indicators using Multi-Source Feature Extraction (MSFE). According to the findings of the experiments, the DL-MSD system that was proposed outperforms the statistical and single-modal machine learning standards that are already in place in terms of prediction accuracy (up to 0.94). The most significant aspects that demonstrated the overall quality of the students were the quality of their patents, the quality of their team-based innovation initiatives, and their industry contacts. Hence, the proposed DL-MSD is an excellent instrument for analyzing how well universities perform in I&E, as it is complex, data-driven, and easy to replicate.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一套基于深度学习与多源数据融合的高校创新创业能力评估系统，将结构化、半结构化与行为数据结合，通过多源特征提取刻画指标间的非线性关联。实验结果显示，该系统的预测准确率优于已有统计方法和单模态机器学习基线，其中专利质量、团队创新项目质量和行业联系是反映学生整体素质的最重要特征。作者据此认为该系统可作为分析高校创新创业表现的可复制工具，但摘要未说明具体数据来源与验证范围。

papers.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Tanzania’s Cybercrimes Act in Preventing, Detecting and Prosecuting Mobile Money Fraud Through Unsolicited Messaging
papers.authors: Dickson Mutabazi
papers.journal: East African Journal of Law and Ethics
papers.abstract: This article evaluates how far Tanzania’s Cybercrimes Act prevents, detects, and secures the prosecution of mobile money fraud that begins with an unsolicited message. It combines a doctrinal reading of sections 12 and 20 of the Act and its investigative provisions with empirical data collected in Dodoma through semi-structured interviews and open-ended questionnaires administered to twenty respondents from law enforcement, regulatory bodies, telecommunications companies, Parliament, academia and victims of fraud. The Act gives investigators a usable legal foundation, yet 65 per cent of respondents rated it less than effective. Section 12 is built around the manipulation of computer data or systems and fits awkwardly with schemes in which the victim is persuaded to make the transfer personally, while section 20 predates AI-generated voice calls, deepfakes, QR code scams and spoofed sender names, none of which the Act mentions. Enforcement is further weakened by thin forensic capacity, slow information sharing between agencies and service providers, and low digital literacy among users; no reported decision applying either provision to this kind of fraud could be found. The article argues that the problem is one of design as well as enforcement: an offence built around the manipulation of machines cannot be relied upon to punish the manipulation of people. It offers what appears to be the first focused legal assessment of this fraud vector in Tanzania and proposes legislative, institutional, and awareness-based reforms, including a technology-neutral offence of causing loss by electronic deception, mandatory fraud reporting by operators, a victim compensation mechanism that does not depend on conviction, stronger forensic capacity and sustained public education
papers.summary_zh: 该研究评估坦桑尼亚《网络犯罪法》在预防、侦查和起诉以陌生信息为起点的移动支付诈骗方面的实效，结合对第12条、第20条及调查条款的规范解读，与在多多马对执法、监管、电信、议会、学界及受害者进行的访谈和开放式问卷。结果显示，该法虽为调查者提供了可用的法律基础，但多数受访者认为其效果有限：第12条围绕对计算机数据或系统的操纵构建，难以契合受害者被说服自行转账的情形；第20条则早于AI语音、深度伪造、二维码诈骗和伪造发件人名称，且未提及这些手段。执法还受取证能力薄弱、机构与运营商信息共享缓慢及用户数字素养低制约，也未发现适用上述条款处理此类诈骗的已报告裁决。文章据此认为问题兼有制度设计与执法层面，并提出立法、机构与宣传改革建议。

papers.title: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN SELF-ORGANIZED LEARNING ENVIRONMENT (SOLE) BERBANTUAN CHATBOT AI TERHADAP PEMAHAMAN KONSEP MATEMATIS SISWA SMP
papers.authors: Dina Yulistiana Dina Yulistiana
papers.journal: Didaktik Jurnal Ilmiah PGSD STKIP Subang
papers.abstract: Mathematical conceptual understanding is an essential foundation for students to interpret mathematical ideas, connect representations, and apply concepts to unfamiliar problems. However, learning that emphasizes procedures and final answers may not sufficiently support students in explaining why a mathematical procedure works. This article proposes a quasi-experimental study examining the effect of the Self-Organized Learning Environment (SOLE) model assisted by an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot on junior high school students’ mathematical conceptual understanding. The proposed design uses a non-equivalent pretest–posttest control-group design. The experimental class learns through question-driven inquiry, collaborative exploration, and critical evaluation of chatbot responses, while the control class receives the school’s usual instruction. Conceptual understanding is measured using a validated test based on indicators such as restating concepts, classifying examples and non-examples, representing concepts, selecting procedures, and applying concepts to problem situations. Because no field data were supplied for this draft, empirical findings are not claimed; the results section identifies the analyses and evidence that should be reported after data collection. The article positions AI as a scaffold for inquiry rather than an answer-generating substitute for students’ reasoning, and highlights teacher guidance, source verification, equitable access, and responsible AI use as essential implementation conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一项准实验研究设计，考察自组织学习环境（SOLE）模型结合AI聊天机器人对初中生数学概念理解的影响。实验班通过问题驱动的探究、协作探索和对聊天机器人回答的批判性评估来学习，控制班则接受学校常规教学；概念理解用基于复述概念、区分实例与非实例、表征概念、选择程序及应用于问题情境等指标的测验测量。由于该稿未提供实地数据，作者并未声称已有实证结果，而是说明数据收集后应报告的分析与证据，并将AI定位为探究的支架而非替代学生推理的答案生成器，同时强调教师引导、来源核实、公平获取和负责任使用AI等实施条件。

papers.title: Should Higher Education Adapt to 4IR or Help Shape it?
papers.authors: Tony Mays
papers.abstract: Published in 2022, just before generative AI moved from being an academic discussion to becoming pervasive and disruptive in the higher education (HE) sector, Global Initiatives and Higher Education in the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR), asks a question that has since become more urgent to address: Can HE do more than merely react to technological change? The enduring thesis of this publication is that the answer cannot be found in technology alone; it involves asking difficult questions about human agency and institutional purpose.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文围绕高等教育在第四次工业革命中应被动适应还是主动塑造技术变革这一问题展开讨论，属于理论性论述而非实证研究。作者的核心论点是，答案无法仅从技术层面获得，而需要追问人的能动性与机构使命等根本性问题。文章强调，高等教育若只对技术变化作出反应远远不够，还应反思自身在技术演进中的主体角色与价值定位，这一判断在生成式人工智能日益渗透高等教育领域的背景下显得更为紧迫。

papers.title: ERP and Accounting Information Systems in Higher Education: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Arif Rahman Hasdik, Nurul Emil Safitri, Desi Ratna Dewi
