papers.abstract: This study maps the research landscape on Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Accounting Information Systems (AIS) in higher education, covering both institutional implementation and the use of ERP/AIS as learning objects in accounting and information systems curricula. A scoping review was designed following the Arksey and O’Malley framework and reported in line with the PRISMA-ScR guideline. ScienceDirect, Scopus (through the Watase Uake platform), and Lens.org were searched for journal articles published between 2015 and 2026, which identified 390 records. After removing 86 duplicates, 304 unique records were screened on titles and abstracts by a single reviewer against predefined criteria, and 50 records were retained for the evidence map; no full-text screening or critical appraisal was undertaken. The retained records form four clusters: administrative ERP implementation and critical success factors (27 records), user acceptance and system success (11), ERP/AIS as learning objects (10), and emerging technologies including generative AI (2). Annual output was low and fluctuated between 1 and 7 records without a sustained upward trend. Among the 37 records naming a study context, the Middle East and South Asia were the most frequent (19 records) and Southeast Asia appeared in three; survey-based designs were the most common single design (17 of 50 records) but dominated only the user-acceptance cluster, and no abstract reports a longitudinal design. By placing the administrative-managerial and learning-pedagogical streams in one evidence map, this review identifies a fragmented field and highlights gaps in longitudinal evidence, graduate outcomes, and Southeast Asian contexts, including Indonesia.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据Arksey与O'Malley框架并参照PRISMA-ScR指南，梳理高等教育中ERP与会计信息系统的研究版图，同时涵盖院校层面的系统实施和作为教学对象的使用。纳入文献形成四个集群：行政实施与关键成功因素、用户接受与系统成功、作为学习对象、以及生成式AI等新兴技术；年度产出偏低且波动，未见持续上升趋势。作者据此指出该领域研究分散，并在纵向证据、毕业生结果和东南亚（含印度尼西亚）情境上存在空白，但未做全文筛选或质量评价，结论受此限制。

papers.title: Application Research of VSS Teaching System Based on BS Architecture in Practical Teaching of Water Conservancy Professional Courses
papers.authors: Yuqiang Wang, Miaoyan Liu, Rifeng Xia, Wanling Wu, Xinhui Ju, Shiang Mei
papers.abstract: Traditional practical teaching in hydraulic engineering programs faces persistent challenges, including spatiotemporal constraints and a misalignment between graduate competencies and industry demands. To address these issues, this paper develops a VSS teaching system for hydraulic engineering based on a browser–server (BS) architecture. We present the system architecture and the design of its core functional modules, and discuss its pedagogical advantages. An empirical evaluation was conducted from four stakeholder perspectives—current students, instructors, alumni, and employers—through targeted surveys. The results indicate that all four groups hold positive views of the lightweight VSS system’s teaching effectiveness, with instructors expressing the highest level of approval. Survey results indicated generally positive perceptions of the VSS system in supporting students’ engineering practice and analytical judgment, as well as in graduates’ workplace adaptation. Our findings confirm that the BS-based VSS system can effectively overcome key bottlenecks in hydraulic practical education. We further propose pathways for deeper digital teaching reform by integrating digital twin and artificial intelligence technologies. This study offers both a technical solution and empirical evidence for advancing digital practical teaching reform in hydraulic engineering.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对水利工程专业实践教学受时空限制、毕业生能力与行业需求脱节的问题，设计并实现了一套基于浏览器—服务器架构的VSS教学系统，并介绍了系统架构与核心功能模块。作者从在校学生、教师、校友和用人单位四类相关方开展问卷调查，结果显示各方对这套轻量级系统的教学效果总体持肯定态度，其中教师认可度最高；受访者普遍认为该系统有助于学生工程实践与分析判断能力，也有利于毕业生适应工作岗位。文章据此提出融合数字孪生与人工智能技术深化数字化教学改革的路径，但相关结论主要基于各方的主观评价，而非对学生能力的客观测量。

papers.title: Human–AI Co-Production: Normative Challenges in Public Space Design
papers.authors: Mohammad Hossein Asgari, Morteza Hazbei, Iman Sheikhansari
papers.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in design disciplines marks a shift in design agency, from predominantly human-centered processes toward distributed forms of Human–AI co-production. This study conceptualizes Human–AI co-production as an interpretive construct and examines it through Jasanoff’s co-production framework. As AI becomes involved in multiple stages of design, it functions not merely as a passive tool but as an influential participant in shaping the built environment. Yet, the normative challenges emerging from Human–AI co-production in public space design remain insufficiently examined. Using an exploratory, qualitative, concept-oriented approach, this paper develops a framework-guided synthesis of sixteen normative challenges that are reconfigured when AI is introduced into public space design. These challenges are analyzed at two levels. At the interactional level, they are grouped into four themes—Invisibility and Exclusion, Imposition and Rigidity, Erosion and Displacement, and Distortion and Deception—and reinterpreted through Jasanoff’s four dimensions: identity, discourse, institutions, and representation. At the constitutive level, the analysis suggests that AI recursively embeds an algorithmic rationality across these dimensions, interpreted here as a closed-loop mechanism that reshapes the normative foundations of public space design. The authors find that Human–AI agency can be understood as shaping public space design and its normative challenges immanently, rather than as an external force acting upon it.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以Jasanoff的共生产框架为概念工具，通过探索性、概念导向的质性综合，考察人工智能进入公共空间设计后引发的规范性挑战。作者归纳出十六项挑战，在互动层面将其归为隐形与排斥、强加与僵化、侵蚀与置换、扭曲与欺骗四类主题，并借助身份、话语、制度与表征四个维度加以重新解读；在构成层面则提出，AI会递归地将算法理性嵌入这些维度，形成一种闭环机制，从而重塑公共空间设计的规范基础。文章据此认为，人机能动性应被理解为内在地塑造公共空间设计及其规范挑战，而非作用于其上的外部力量。

papers.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Counsel Men with Testicular Cancer? A Validated Comparison of ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude
papers.authors: Ymer Bushati, Jeffery Yang, Sarah Lorger, Jeremy Saad, Prem Rathore
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude are increasingly used by patients to research new diagnoses, including testicular cancer. The aim of this study was to evaluate and compare the quality of responses generated by these three platforms to patient-facing frequently asked questions on testicular cancer, including a focused evaluation of fertility and sexual health questions. Methods: Fifteen questions were developed from established patient education resources and refined by senior urology consultant review. Each question was posed to ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude using a standardised patient-perspective prompt. The 45 responses were de-identified, randomised and assessed in a single consensus meeting by a urology panel using the Quality Analysis of Medical Artificial Intelligence (QAMAI) tool. Comparative analysis used the Friedman test with Bonferroni-corrected pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank testing. Results: All three models produced moderate quality responses, with a mean total QAMAI score of 21.8 for ChatGPT, 22.4 for Claude, and 22.1 for Gemini (Friedman p = 0.246). Clarity differed significantly between models (adjusted p = 0.022), with Claude and Gemini outperforming ChatGPT. In the fertility and sexual health domain, Claude (24.0) and Gemini (23.0) outperformed ChatGPT (19.7). No response from any model spontaneously cited references or directed the reader to external resources. Conclusions: ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude deliver broadly equivalent overall quality on patient-facing testicular cancer questions, with inter-model differences in clarity and in the fertility and sexual health domain. The absence of source citation is a clinically relevant limitation. These tools should be regarded as a supplement to, rather than a substitute for, specialist counselling.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了ChatGPT、Gemini和Claude三种大语言模型对睾丸癌患者常见问题的回答质量，由泌尿科专家组采用QAMAI工具对标准化提问生成的回答进行评分比较。结果显示，三种模型的总体回答质量相当，均处于中等水平；但清晰度存在显著差异，Claude和Gemini优于ChatGPT，在生育与性健康问题上同样表现更好。值得注意的是，没有任何模型主动引用文献或引导读者查阅外部资源。作者据此指出，这类工具应作为专科咨询的补充而非替代，缺乏来源引用是临床应用中值得关注的局限。

papers.title: Cyborgs, Mind Uploading, and Christian Theological Anthropology: Rethinking Personhood in the Age of AI and Neurotechnology
papers.authors: Vladimir Cvetković
papers.abstract: Rapid developments in artificial intelligence, brain–computer interfaces (BCIs), and other neurotechnologies challenge established understandings of embodiment, personal identity, and human agency. Cyborg enhancement and mind uploading raise fundamental questions about what constitutes a human person and whether personal identity can survive technological transformation. This article approaches these questions from the perspective of Christian theological anthropology, focusing on the patristic understanding of the human person as a unity of body and soul. Drawing on the concept of hypostasis developed by Maximus the Confessor and further articulated by John of Damascus, it examines the anthropological assumptions underlying contemporary visions of posthuman transformation. It argues that the reproduction of cognitive and psychological characteristics through mind uploading does not by itself establish continuity of the original person, since personal identity cannot be reduced to informational or functional continuity. Cyborg technologies present a different theological challenge: technological augmentation need not undermine personhood when it occurs within the continuing embodied life of a particular subject, although functional integration alone is not sufficient to establish numerical personal identity. The article also employs the “golden ratio” as a modern interpretive model for illuminating Maximian patterns of unity-in-difference. It concludes that patristic anthropology can critically engage technological transformation without rejecting innovation or reducing the human person to an informational or computational entity.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从基督教神学人类学出发，以教父传统中身体与灵魂统一的人格观为框架，考察赛博格增强与意识上传所隐含的人类学预设。作者借助马克西姆和约翰所发展的位格概念论证，仅靠复制认知与心理特征不足以确立原有人格的连续性，因为人格身份不能化约为信息或功能上的连续；而赛博格技术在特定主体持续具身生活的范围内未必损害人格，但功能整合本身也不足以确立个体人格的同一性。文章还以“黄金比例”作为现代解释模型来阐明统一中有差异的模式，并据此主张教父人类学既能批判性地回应技术转化，又不必拒斥创新或将人还原为信息或计算实体。

papers.title: Emerging Therapeutic Strategies for Child and Adolescent Obesity: A Narrative Review
papers.authors: Tomaso Oliaro, Federico Amianto
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Childhood obesity is a chronic, multifactorial disease requiring attention to biological, behavioral, psychological, family, and socioeconomic factors. This narrative review examined the integration of lifestyle, family-based, psychological, and pharmacological approaches, focusing on treatment engagement, eating disorders, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and treatment durability. Methods: A single search interface covering PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science (the University of Turin library discovery platform) was used to identify studies published primarily from 2010 to August 2026. Pediatric trials, observational studies, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, guidelines, and public-health reports were prioritized. Results: Intensive family-based, multicomponent behavioral treatment remains the best-supported foundation of care, although psychological outcomes are infrequently assessed. Psychiatric comorbidity is heterogeneous; loss-of-control eating, emotional symptoms, ADHD, and executive-function difficulties may impair engagement in selected patients, and untreated ADHD has been associated with a slower BMI response to weight management. Professionally supervised obesity treatment containing a dietary component did not, on average, worsen eating psychopathology and reduced several related symptoms. Family participation improved outcomes, whereas logistical, socioeconomic, and psychological barriers reduced attendance. Across randomized trials, adding anti-obesity medication to behavioral treatment produced an additional, although on average modest, reduction in BMI. Semaglutide, liraglutide, and phentermine/topiramate produced larger numerical reductions than older agents in separate trials, but heterogeneity and the absence of head-to-head comparisons preclude formal ranking. Gastrointestinal adverse events were frequent with glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists. Pediatric trials and real-world evidence indicate partial weight regain after discontinuation, while prescribing remains limited and unequal. Conclusions: Pediatric obesity care should be phenotype-informed, multidisciplinary, and longitudinal. Pharmacotherapy can enhance BMI reduction but should complement rather than replace behavioral, psychological, and family care. Outcomes should extend beyond BMI to metabolic, psychological, functional, and long-term measures.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了儿童青少年肥胖治疗中生活方式、家庭、心理与药物干预的整合方式，重点关注治疗参与、进食障碍、注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）及疗效持久性。文章指出，强化的家庭本位多成分行为治疗仍是证据最充分的基础，但心理结局评估不足；失控性进食、情绪症状、ADHD与执行功能困难可能削弱部分患者的参与，未治疗的ADHD与体重管理反应较慢相关。在行为治疗基础上加用抗肥胖药物可带来额外但平均有限的BMI下降，停药后存在部分体重反弹，处方仍有限且不均衡。作者据此主张以表型为依据的多学科长期照护，药物应补充而非替代行为、心理与家庭干预，结局评估也应超越BMI。

papers.title: An Interpretable Ensemble-Learning Framework for Decoding Multi-Component–Multi-Bioactivity Relationships in Salvia miltiorrhiza Based on 1H NMR Metabolomics and Lifecycle-Oriented Bioassays
papers.authors: 文铸 李, Shasha Li, Hang Yu, Xiaozhou Zou, Yin Lu, Zhiyan Chen, Nan Wang, Jiana Shi, Kaiyue Ji, Ping Huang
papers.abstract: Background: Linking metabolite composition to biological activities remains challenging in herbal medicines, where diverse metabolites may collectively contribute to pharmacological effects. Although metabolite profiling is fundamental to quality assessment, conventional quality evaluation often provides limited information on how variation in metabolite composition relates to biological activities. Objectives: This study aimed to develop a multi-component–multi-bioactivity framework integrating metabolite profiling and bioactivity assessment, enabling bidirectional mapping between metabolite composition and biological responses and providing a functional perspective for quality characterization of complex herbal medicines. Salvia miltiorrhiza Bunge (Danshen), a widely used medicinal plant with a chemically diverse metabolome and well-documented cardiovascular activities, was selected as a representative model system. Methods: Quantitative 1H NMR spectroscopy was employed to profile 28 metabolites in Danshen, while zebrafish-based bioassays were used to assess three cardiovascular-related bioactivities: pro-angiogenic, anti-thrombotic, and vasodilatory activities. A lifecycle-oriented approach was introduced for bioassay development to improve the robustness and reproducibility of biological measurements. Multiple machine learning approaches were integrated within a two-level stacking ensemble framework to construct quantitative metabolite–bioactivity relationship models and capture nonlinear associations between metabolite composition and biological activities. Results: The stacked models consistently outperformed the individual learners across the three cardiovascular bioactivities, achieving R2 values of 0.895–0.931 and RMSE values of 0.116–0.130. External validation using 10 independent Danshen samples further supported the predictive reliability of the stacked models. Based on model-derived metabolite contributions, a quantitative and interpretable metabolite–bioactivity network linking 28 metabolites with three cardiovascular-related activities was constructed, revealing both shared and activity-specific metabolic contributors. Conclusions: This study establishes an interpretable framework integrating NMR-based metabolite profiling, robust multi-endpoint bioassays, and ensemble learning to connect metabolite composition with functional bioactivity. The framework provides a complementary bioactivity-informed perspective for the quality characterization of medicinal plants and supports systems-level evaluation of complex herbal medicines.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对中药材代谢物组成与生物活性之间关系难以量化的问题，以丹参为对象，整合定量核磁代谢组学、斑马鱼多终点生物活性测定与集成学习建模，构建了多成分—多活性关联框架。作者采用两层堆叠集成模型，对促血管生成、抗血栓和舒张血管三类心血管相关活性进行预测，发现堆叠模型在各活性上均优于单一学习器，外部样本验证也支持其预测可靠性。基于模型给出的代谢物贡献，研究进一步构建了连接代谢物与活性的可解释网络，识别出共享及活性特异的贡献成分。该框架为复杂中药的质量表征提供了以生物活性为补充的视角，但结论主要基于该模型体系与所选活性指标。

papers.title: Maternal Recognition of Ultrasound-Observed Fetal Movements Among Pregnancies in the Third Trimester: Concordance, Directional Discrepancies, and Associated Factors
papers.authors: Pattama Tongdee, Tasanun Nitipreecha, Porntip Nimkuntod, Atcharawan Rattanasak, Talit Jumphoo, Wongsathon Pathonsuwan, Kasidit Kokkhunthod, Sittinon Thanonklang, Monthippa Uthansakul, Peerapong Uthansakul
papers.abstract: Background and Objectives: Maternal perception of fetal movement is widely used to monitor fetal activity; however, maternally perceived movements may not correspond directly to movements observed by ultrasonography. This study aimed to quantify same-window maternal recognition of ultrasound-observed fetal movements, characterize temporal concordance and directional discrepancies, and examine associated maternal and pregnancy-related factors. Materials and Methods: Pregnant women at ≥28 weeks of gestation underwent simultaneous 20 min fetal-movement assessment using real-time ultrasonography and maternal button-press reporting. The ultrasound observer pressed a designated button whenever fetal movement was visually observed, while participants independently pressed a separate button whenever they perceived fetal movement. Both responses were electronically timestamped using the same system clock and segmented into consecutive 5 s windows. Windows containing an ultrasound-observer button press were classified as ultrasound-positive, and those accompanied by a maternal response within the corresponding window were classified as temporally matched. Same-window maternal recognition was defined as the proportion of ultrasound-positive windows accompanied by a maternal response within the same 5 s analytical window. Associated factors were examined using fractional logistic regression with robust standard errors. Results: A total of 112 valid assessment sessions were analyzed. The median number of ultrasound-positive windows was 26.5 (IQR, 15.5–41.5), compared with 10.5 (IQR, 6.0–18.5) maternal-response windows. Median same-window maternal recognition was 20.3% (IQR, 8.3–38.5%; bootstrap percentile 95% CI, 15.7–23.1%), and median overall temporal concordance was 16.1% (IQR, 7.4–25.3%). Maternal-response window counts were lower than ultrasound-positive window counts in 101 of 112 assessment sessions (90.2%). After adjustment for maternal age, BMI, and fetal presentation, later gestational age was associated with lower same-window maternal recognition (β = −0.063, 95% CI −0.122 to −0.004; p = 0.037), corresponding to an average marginal effect of −1.12 percentage points per week (95% CI −2.15 to −0.09; p = 0.033). Conclusions: Maternal and ultrasound-observed fetal-movement counts showed limited same-window temporal correspondence during the 20 min observation period. A modest inverse association with gestational age was observed in the primary model, although the association was less precise in the denominator-aware and vertex-only sensitivity analyses. These findings reflect temporal matching under the predefined 5 s analytical framework and should not be interpreted as indicating that mothers perceive only a small proportion of fetal movements or that maternal perception becomes less reliable as pregnancy advances.

papers.title: From Residents’ Participation to Effective Co-Creation: Collaborative Governance of Urban Community Spaces in Urumqi, Xinjiang, China
papers.authors: Jing Li, Ye Zhang
papers.abstract: Expanding resident participation is an important objective of participatory planning and collaborative governance in urban communities, yet attending activities, contributing resources, or holding representative positions does not necessarily enable residents to influence public decisions. Focusing on four urban communities in Erdaoqiao Subdistrict, Tianshan District, Urumqi, Xinjiang, China, this study draws on fieldwork, participant observation, interviews and field conversations with 93 participants, community documents, and supplementary follow-ups. It employs hybrid inductive–deductive thematic analysis centered on concrete governance events to examine residents’ involvement in spatial use, service co-production, public-plan negotiation, and oversight of shared resources. The findings show that internal spatial reallocation, negotiated sharing of external venues, and support for pre-existing resident self-organization can lower barriers to participation. Contributions of money, skills, labor, and organizational effort can supplement public services and facility maintenance but do not automatically produce decision influence. Dissent may exert practical influence when it reaches an agenda, prompts verification, and leads to revisions of proposals, although the evidence primarily concerns negotiation within particular projects. The link between formal representation and effective oversight depends on access to information, control of accounts, traceability of resources, and the capacity to obtain correction; resident representatives must themselves remain accountable. Access, contribution, decision influence, and actionable accountability are therefore treated as potentially connected or disconnected analytical dimensions rather than a fixed ladder of empowerment. Community space is a form of governance infrastructure shaping participation opportunities and collaborative conditions. Effective co-creation depends on the connection of residents’ needs, knowledge, contributions, and dissent to revisable public decisions and actionable oversight. The study provides a contextualized explanation drawn from urban communities in western China.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注城市社区中居民参与为何未必转化为对公共决策的实际影响，以乌鲁木齐四个社区的具体治理事件为对象，通过田野调查、参与观察、访谈和社区文档进行混合式主题分析。研究发现，内部空间重新分配、协商共用外部场地以及支持既有居民自组织能降低参与门槛；资金、技能、劳动等贡献可补充公共服务，却不自动带来决策影响力。异议只有在进入议程、引发核实并促成方案修改时才可能产生实际作用，而正式代表与有效监督的联系取决于信息获取、账目控制、资源可追溯和获得纠正的能力。作者据此将准入、贡献、决策影响和可操作的问责视为可能连接也可能脱节的分析维度，而非固定的赋权阶梯，并指出社区空间作为治理基础设施塑造了参与机会与协同条件。

papers.title: Decision-Architecture Dependence and Patient-Gender-Conditioned Allocation in Large-Language-Model-Assisted Nursing Allocation: A Multi-Model Counterfactual Audit
papers.authors: Zhiying Li, Zhu Wenjie, Luodi Jiang, Xiuzhen Wei, Jie Zhou, Wei Yang, Baoling Zhong, Qiongyan Hu
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Large language models (LLMs) may support healthcare workforce allocation, but their decisions can be sensitive to demographic cues and decision architecture. This study examined gender–task congruity, Candidate-A dependence under the tested decision architecture, and patient-gender-conditioned nursing allocation. Methods: Three provider-specific LLM configurations were audited across 24 nursing tasks. Male and female nurses were professionally equivalent and counterbalanced across Candidate A/B; patient gender was varied in six intimate-care tasks. Sixty conditions were repeated three times per model, yielding 540 valid outputs. Results: Male nurses were selected in 50.0% of Technical/Procedural and Relational/Educational allocations. Candidate A was selected in all 288 observations, although 285 (99.0%) assigned identical suitability scores. Because A/B assignment was bundled with labeling, presentation order, evaluation order, and response-template anchoring, this pattern indicates Candidate-A dependence under the tested decision architecture rather than an isolated position effect. Changing patient gender from female to male produced 57 female-to-male nurse switches and no reverse switches (p < 0.001). Conclusions: The audited configurations showed no generalized gender–task pattern but demonstrated decision-architecture dependence and patient-gender-conditioned allocation. Fairness audits should assess equivalent-candidate handling, patient preference, and counterfactual stability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以多模型反事实审计的方式，考察大语言模型在护理人力分配中是否受性别线索与决策架构影响，对象为三种供应商特定的模型配置在护理任务上的输出。结果显示，模型未表现出普遍的性别—任务匹配倾向，但在候选者资质相同时几乎总是选择候选者A，且这一模式与标签、呈现顺序和模板锚定捆绑，说明其反映的是特定决策架构下的候选者A依赖，而非孤立的位置效应；同时，将患者性别由女改为男会系统性地改变护士选择，且方向单一。作者据此指出，公平性审计应关注等价候选者的处理、患者偏好与反事实稳定性，而不能仅凭总体性别比例判断模型是否公平。

papers.title: Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools in Imaging Reporting: Practical Guidelines for Sonographers—A Narrative Review
papers.authors: Mozdalifah Elnaeem
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly entering diagnostic ultrasound, supporting image acquisition, automated measurement, computer-aided diagnosis, and report drafting. Sonographers are primary users of these tools, yet sonographer-oriented guidance on their responsible use in imaging reporting remains fragmented. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence, reporting guidelines, trustworthiness frameworks, regulations, and professional standards relevant to AI-assisted imaging reporting to distill practical guidance for sonographers. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched, together with professional-body and regulatory documents published up to July 2026. The review maps AI applications across the reporting chain, from real-time acquisition guidance (AI-guided echocardiography achieving diagnostic-quality images in 98.8% of novice-obtained scans) to computer-aided diagnosis improving breast lesion assessment (area under the curve increasing from 0.83 to 0.87) and large language models drafting structured reports. Evidence on automation bias, deskilling, hallucinated content, algorithmic bias, and medico-legal accountability is critically appraised. Building on FUTURE-AI, CONSORT-AI, DECIDE-AI, and World Health Organization guidance, a phase-based good-practice framework is proposed, covering pre-use appraisal and training, verification during use, and documentation and audit after use. AI should augment, not replace, sonographer judgment; human oversight, verification of every AI output, transparent documentation, and continuing AI literacy are prerequisites for safe adoption in imaging reporting.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦超声技师在影像报告中负责任使用人工智能工具的问题，梳理了AI在图像采集、自动测量、计算机辅助诊断和报告起草等环节的应用证据，并整合报告规范、可信度框架、监管要求与专业标准。文章批判性审视了自动化偏差、技能退化、内容幻觉、算法偏见和医疗法律责任等风险，并基于FUTURE-AI、CONSORT-AI、DECIDE-AI及世界卫生组织指南提出覆盖使用前评估与培训、使用中核验、使用后记录与审计的分阶段实践框架。作者强调AI应增强而非替代技师的判断，人工监督、逐项核验AI输出、透明记录和持续提升AI素养是安全应用的前提。

papers.title: Deception Detection Technologies: Current Advances andForensic Challenges
papers.authors: Francis Llerena, Omar Flor-Unda, Franceska Toscano-Villamarín, Xavier Chango
papers.abstract: Deception detection remains a significant challenge in forensic, security, and legal contexts because traditional tools, such as the polygraph, measure physiological responses associated with stress rather than deception itself. This scoping review examines current deception-detection technologies, with particular emphasis on their technological advances, challenge and limitations in forensic applications, and future research directions. Following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines, searches were conducted in Scopus, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and ScienceDirect to identify 80 journal articles and conference papers published over the past twenty years. Two independent reviewers selected the studies included in the review, and a Cohen’s kappa coefficient of 0.925 was obtained, indicating substantial inter-rater agreement. Five main technological families were identified: polygraphy, electroencephalography, functional magnetic resonance imaging, voice, facial, and body-movement analysis, and multimodal fusion based on artificial intelligence. Each technology involves trade-offs among accuracy, cost, portability, and forensic or legal admissibility. Although multimodal approaches report the highest accuracy levels, they also raise additional challenges related to governance and explainability. Currently, no single technology provides sufficient reliability to be used independently as forensic evidence. Future applications must address ethical, legal, and cultural considerations, particularly mental privacy, algorithmic transparency, and individual variability.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA-ScR指南检索近二十年文献，梳理了测谎、脑电、功能磁共振、语音与面部及身体动作分析、以及基于人工智能的多模态融合五类欺骗检测技术。作者指出，各技术在准确率、成本、便携性与司法可采性之间存在权衡；多模态方法虽报告了最高准确率，却带来治理与可解释性方面的新难题。综述强调，目前尚无单一技术足够可靠、可独立作为法庭证据，未来应用需处理心理隐私、算法透明度和个体差异等伦理、法律与文化问题。

papers.title: AI Financial Advisory Systems: A Trust-Centered Human–AI Interaction Framework for Explainable Decision Support
papers.authors: Muhammad Wisnu Wicaksono, Raditya Pratama, Fausta Irsyad Ramadhan
papers.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into financial advisory services has transformed conventional advisory models into intelligent decision-support systems capable of processing large volumes of financial information and generating automated investment recommendations. Despite the analytical capabilities and scalability of robo-advisory systems, algorithm aversion remains a significant barrier to adoption, particularly when financial decisions involve uncertainty, high perceived risk, and emotional considerations. This systematic literature review examines the technological, human–computer interaction, psychological, and demographic factors that influence user acceptance of AI-based financial advisory systems. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, the study synthesizes the literature on algorithm aversion, trust, explainability, financial literacy, and investor characteristics and complements thematic synthesis with bibliometric mapping using VOSviewer version 1.6.19. The review identifies four interconnected system-level themes: algorithm aversion associated with perceived risk and system opacity; trust formation through transparency and Explainable AI (XAI); the financial-literacy paradox in AI adoption; and demographic variation, particularly age, in responses to automated advisory systems. The findings indicate that algorithm aversion is not solely a limitation of computational performance but is strongly associated with how AI decision-support systems communicate reasoning, uncertainty, system capabilities, and limitations to users. The review further identifies gaps in emerging-market evidence, longitudinal analysis of trust dynamics, integrated human–AI adoption models, comparative evaluation of human, robo-advisor, and hybrid configurations, and interpretable predictive models of advisory choice. Based on the synthesis, a trust-centered Human–AI Interaction framework is proposed that integrates algorithm transparency, perceived ease of use, trust, algorithm aversion, financial literacy, age, and investment experience within complementary explanatory and predictive pathways. The framework provides a systems-oriented foundation for designing explainable, adaptive, and human-centered AI financial advisory systems in which computational decision support is integrated with transparency, trust calibration, and appropriate human intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA 2020指南，结合主题综合与文献计量分析，梳理了影响用户接受AI理财顾问的技术、人机交互、心理与人口因素。作者归纳出四个相互关联的系统层面主题：与感知风险和系统不透明相关的算法厌恶、通过透明度与可解释AI形成的信任、AI采用中的金融素养悖论，以及年龄等人口差异。综述指出，算法厌恶并非仅源于计算性能不足，更与系统如何向用户传达推理、不确定性及自身能力边界密切相关，并据此提出一个以信任为中心的人机交互框架，将透明度、感知易用性、信任、算法厌恶、金融素养、年龄和投资经验纳入解释与预测路径。文章还指出新兴市场证据、信任动态的纵向研究及人机混合配置比较等方面的空白。

papers.title: AI-Based Educational Interventions for Students with Down Syndrome: A Mixed-Methods Systematic Review
papers.authors: Antonia Cascales Martínez, José David Cuesta Sáez de Tejada, Carmen Sánchez-Seller
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is assumed to individualise learning, yet no quantitative synthesis has examined what happens when the intervention targets students with Down syndrome (DS). The review presented here analyses this effect and the extent to which the interventions are linked to Universal Design for Learning (UDL). This study employs a mixed-methods systematic review design, prospectively registered on the Open Science Framework and reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020 (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) guidelines. Searches were conducted in Scopus, Web of Science, APA PsycInfo, and ERIC; studies suitable for pooling were analysed using Hedges’ g under the Knapp–Hartung random-effects model, while the remaining studies were included in a structured narrative synthesis. A large pooled point estimate was found (g = 2.00; 95% confidence interval (CI): −0.89 to 4.90), though it was imprecise, and heterogeneity ranged from moderate to high (I2 = 64.9%); the certainty of the evidence was very low. The eight remaining studies consisted of pilot tests, single-case studies, or designs lacking a control group. The findings indicate improvement following the intervention but offer no recommendations. There are more tools available than evidence of their effectiveness; this review outlines what needs to be measured to determine that.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察人工智能干预对唐氏综合征学生的学习效果，并分析这些干预与通用学习设计的关联程度。作者采用混合方法系统综述，对可合并的研究做元分析，其余研究做结构化叙述综合，发现合并效应量虽大但估计不精确、异质性中到高度、证据确定性很低，其余研究多为试点、单案例或无对照设计。文章据此指出，现有工具数量多于其有效性证据，干预后虽见改善却不足以给出推荐，并说明后续需测量哪些指标才能判断效果。

papers.title: Mapping Artificial Intelligence Integration in Kindergarten Teaching: Usage Patterns, Pedagogical Purposes, and Acceptance Factors Among Teachers with Prior AI-Use Experience
papers.authors: Evania Yafie, Yudha Alfian Haqqi, Taufik Ikhsan Slamet, Wuri Astuti, Sari Karmina, Riska Pristiani, Norazrena Abu Samah
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in education, yet evidence regarding its adoption by kindergarten teachers remains limited, particularly in Indonesian early childhood settings. This study investigated the AI tools used by kindergarten teachers, their educational purposes, implementation challenges, and technology acceptance factors influencing AI integration in Malang, Indonesia. The design used was an exploratory sequential mixed-methods approach. Ten Guru Penggerak and five kindergarten administrators participated in interviews, observations, and document analysis to gather qualitative data. Findings informed a questionnaire administered to 250 kindergarten teachers selected through equal-allocation stratified random sampling across five districts of Malang City. Partial least squares structural equation modeling was used to analyze quantitative data. Qualitative findings showed that teachers used AI for lesson planning, play-based learning design, storytelling, media creation, assessment, documentation, parent communication, and professional learning. Teachers critically reviewed AI-generated content to ensure developmental, curricular, cultural, ethical, and safety appropriateness. Major challenges included limited AI literacy, inadequate infrastructure, restricted premium features, inaccurate outputs, insufficient institutional support, and privacy concerns. According to quantitative findings, behavioral intention was positively and substantially correlated with performance expectancy, effort expectancy, and enabling factors, but there was no statistically significant correlation with social influence. Behavioral intention influenced the effects of performance expectation, effort expectancy, and enabling environments and was substantially correlated with self-reported AI integration. These results imply that teachers’ perceptions of AI’s utility, usability, institutional support, and professional competence all play a role in its successful incorporation in kindergarten. Strengthening AI literacy, prompting skills, ethical awareness, and developmentally appropriate pedagogical practices is essential for sustainable AI implementation in early childhood education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注印尼幼儿园教师如何将人工智能融入教学，以及哪些因素影响其接受程度，采用探索性序列混合方法，先访谈并观察教师与管理者，再向多区教师发放问卷，并用结构方程模型分析。定性结果显示，教师将AI用于备课、游戏化学习设计、讲故事、制作媒体、评估、文档记录、家长沟通和专业学习，并会审慎核查生成内容在发展适宜性、课程、文化、伦理与安全方面的适切性；主要挑战包括AI素养不足、基础设施欠缺、高级功能受限、输出不准确、机构支持不足和隐私顾虑。定量结果显示，行为意向与绩效期望、努力期望和促进条件呈正相关，但与社交影响无显著相关；行为意向与自我报告的AI整合程度相关，并影响上述因素的作用。作者据此认为，教师对AI实用性、易用性、机构支持和专业能力的感知共同关系到幼儿园AI整合的成效。

papers.title: Modeling Factors Associated with Smoking Dependence Severity Using Binary Classification-Based Machine Learning: Prediction with Hematological and Demographic Patient Data
papers.authors: Yavuz Korkmaz, İbrahim Miraç Eligüzel, Adem Taha Özdemir
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: The Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence (FTND) is a subjective, self-report-based instrument used to grade the level of nicotine dependence. Complete blood count (CBC) parameters reflect markers of smoking-related systemic inflammation. In the present study, we aimed to develop a leakage-free and interpretable machine learning approach for classifying FTND level using demographic data, CBC parameters, and duration of smoking exposure. Methods: In this retrospectively designed study, the records of 660 patients with complete data who had presented to the Smoking Cessation Outpatient Clinic of Malatya Training and Research Hospital were included. Because one of the six FTND items directly scores the number of cigarettes smoked per day, the number of packs and the features related to it constitute data leakage and were therefore excluded from the data pool. Smoking duration (years), which is not an FTND item, was retained as the sole predictor of smoking exposure. Feature engineering generated 49 candidate features. Six base learners (logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting, SVM, LightGBM, XGBoost) and a stacking ensemble were evaluated with an 80–20% training/test split and 10-fold stratified cross-validation. To prevent optimism bias, feature selection and scaling were performed only within the training folds, and class imbalance was addressed through class weighting. The models were interpreted with SHAP and LIME, and the contribution of each feature family was quantified by ablation analysis. Results: In leakage-free 10-fold cross-validation (the primary performance estimate), discrimination was modest, with the highest AUC (0.652) obtained by both SVM (RBF) and logistic regression; on the single hold-out test set, the stacking ensemble reached an AUC of 0.749 (95% CI 0.667–0.831). The full model did not significantly outperform smoking duration alone (DeLong p = 0.22), and extensive feature engineering did not provide a measurable gain (ΔAUC = −0.015). In the SHAP analysis, smoking duration and the age-based interaction terms made the largest predictive contributions. Conclusions: Routine CBC parameters do not by themselves constitute an independent diagnostic tool for determining dependence severity; they carry only weak, complementary information and should not be regarded as a screening biomarker. This exploratory study classifies FTND-based nicotine dependence severity at the individual patient level by combining CBC parameters with machine learning and explainable artificial intelligence; the model is not ready for clinical use.

papers.title: Two Pathways to Glycaemic Control: Dietary Adherence, Physical Activity, and Their Independent Contributions Among Persons with Type 2 Diabetes in Urban Delhi—A Community-Based Cross-Sectional Analytical Study
papers.authors: Shivani Rao, Aninda Debnath, Mongjam Meghachandra Singh, Himanshu Bachawandia, Nandini Sharma
papers.abstract: Background: India bears one of the highest diabetes burdens globally, yet community-based evidence simultaneously examining the contributions of dietary adherence and physical activity to glycaemic control remains scarce. Most existing Indian studies are hospital-based and assess only one behavioural domain. Methods: A community-based cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 320 persons with type 2 diabetes in Gokulpuri, North-East Delhi. Dietary adherence was assessed using the Perceived Dietary Adherence Questionnaire (PDAQ) and physical activity using the International Physical Activity Questionnaire (IPAQ). Glycaemic control was measured as random blood sugar (RBS). Sociodemographic and clinical determinants of each behavioural domain were examined using bivariate analyses, followed by multivariable linear regression. Three nested multiple linear regression models were estimated to quantify the independent and combined contributions of dietary adherence and physical activity to RBS. Results: The mean age was 58.09 years (SD 11.17); 65.3% were female. Mean RBS was 217.41 mg/dL (SD 82.21), mean PDAQ score was 47.01 out of 63 (SD 5.32), and mean IPAQ was 531.67 MET-min/week (SD 526.54). Higher household income was a significant positive predictor of dietary adherence (β = 0.103, p = 0.009), while a positive family history of diabetes was a significant negative predictor (β = −2.203, p = 0.004). Male gender was the only significant predictor of greater physical activity (p < 0.001). In nested regression models adjusted for age, gender, education, BMI, diabetes duration, and hypertension, both dietary adherence (β = −3.117, p = 0.001) and physical activity (β = −0.026, p = 0.004) were independently and significantly associated with lower RBS. The combined model demonstrated the best fit (Adjusted R2 = 0.078, F = 3.62), with the two predictors showing near-zero mutual correlation (r = 0.008), confirming their independence. Conclusions: In this cross-sectional analysis, dietary adherence and physical activity were independent additive predictors of lower random blood sugar (RBS) in community-dwelling persons with type 2 diabetes in urban Delhi. Income and diabetes fatalism are key modifiable determinants of dietary adherence, while gender-based disparities drive differences in physical activity. Integrated, dual-domain lifestyle interventions addressing these sociodemographic barriers are warranted within community-based NCD programmes in India.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注城市社区2型糖尿病患者的饮食依从性与身体活动是否各自独立影响血糖控制，采用社区横断面设计，在德里东北部对患者进行问卷调查和血糖测量。结果显示，在调整年龄、性别、体质指数、病程和高血压等因素后，饮食依从性和身体活动均与较低的随机血糖独立相关，且两者几乎不相关，提示二者通过相对独立的路径共同发挥作用。研究还发现家庭收入与糖尿病家族史同饮食依从性相关，男性与更高的身体活动水平相关。作者据此认为，面向社区的非传染性疾病项目宜同时纳入饮食与活动两个维度的干预，并关注收入、性别等社会人口学障碍；但横断面设计限制了因果推断。

papers.title: Serious Games for Education and Intervention in Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Scoping Review of Learning Theories, AI, VR, XR, and Robotics
papers.authors: Irene Chaidi, Pantelis Pergantis, Pinelopi Vlotinou, George Papanastasiou, Charalabos A. Skianis, Χαράλαμπος Καραγιαννίδης, Athanasios S. Drigas
papers.abstract: Serious Games (SGs) have increasingly been investigated as tools for education and intervention for individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), while emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Virtual Reality (VR), Extended Reality (XR), and Human–Robot Interaction (HRI) are expanding their potential for personalization, immersion, and adaptive interaction. However, the literature remains fragmented across pedagogical theory, Serious Game design, and technology-focused interventions, making it difficult to understand how these dimensions are connected within the ASD context. This scoping review therefore maps the available literature on Serious Games for individuals with ASD, focusing on two complementary questions: (RQ1) Which learning theories, pedagogical approaches, and educational or developmental outcomes underpin the design and implementation of Serious Games for individuals with ASD? and (RQ2) How are intelligent and immersive technologies, including AI, VR, XR, and HRI/robotics, integrated into Serious Games, and what benefits and challenges are reported? A structured literature search was conducted across Scopus, ERIC, Web of Science, and the ACM Digital Library, with Google Scholar consulted as a supplementary source, covering publications from January 2005 to June 2025. Following duplicate removal, title/abstract screening, and full-text assessment, 40 studies constituted the formal evidence base. The evidence was organized through descriptive and thematic synthesis, with studies mapped according to theoretical foundations, Serious Game or intervention characteristics, technological modalities, and reported outcomes. The review identified substantial theoretical diversity, including constructivism, socio-cultural theory, social learning theory, self-determination theory, behaviorism, developmental approaches, and intervention-oriented frameworks. AI was mainly associated with personalization, learner modeling, behavioral analysis, and adaptive feedback, whereas VR/XR primarily supported immersive and controlled environments for experiential learning and skills practice. Robotics and HRI were associated with structured and embodied interaction. Reported challenges included accessibility, cost, privacy, cybersickness, methodological heterogeneity, and limited evidence concerning transfer and maintenance of skills. Overall, the review provides a structured overview of the field and indicates priorities for further empirical investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了自闭症谱系障碍严肃游戏研究中学习理论与智能沉浸技术的整合情况，基于2005年至2025年间四个数据库检索并筛选出的40项研究，围绕学习理论、教学取向与教育发展结果，以及AI、VR、XR和机器人技术的融入方式展开归纳。综述发现理论取向高度多样，涵盖建构主义、社会文化理论、社会学习理论、自我决定理论、行为主义及干预导向框架；AI多用于个性化、学习者建模、行为分析与自适应反馈，VR/XR主要提供沉浸式受控环境以支持体验学习和技能练习，机器人与HRI则侧重结构化、具身化互动。报告的问题包括可及性、成本、隐私、晕动症、方法异质性以及技能迁移与维持证据有限，综述据此提出后续实证研究的方向。

papers.title: From Prompt to Performance in Tourism SMEs: Human-AI Orchestration and the Productivity-Capability Paradox
papers.authors: Fabrizio Traversa
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) gives tourism small and medium-sized enterprises scalable cognitive and creative support, but access alone does not ensure sustained advantage. This conceptual article asks how firms can realize productivity gains while preserving the human and place-based capabilities required for future adaptation. An integrative, theory-building review connects tourism research with resource and asset orchestration, AI readiness, human-AI complementarity, organizational routines, and dynamic capabilities. Human-AI orchestration is proposed as a workflow-level configuration of task decomposition, contextualization, verification, and learning. Its contribution lies in coordinating established mechanisms rather than claiming that its dimensions are individually new. The prompt-to-performance framework distinguishes a capability-accumulation loop from a delegation-driven erosion loop. A proposed stock-and-flow mechanism explains switching between them: erosion dominates when losses from displaced practice and knowledge discontinuity exceed learning and replenishment; verification becomes vulnerable when retained capability falls below task-dependent requirements. Seven proposition families specify untested mediating, moderating, nonlinear, multilevel, and temporal relationships, with disconfirming observations. Sector-specific boundary conditions concern perishable service commitments, situated experience, partner interdependence, and concentrated expertise. Four configurations and a foresight matrix support contingent organizational choices. The contribution is a temporally explicit extension of automation-augmentation theory that separates immediate assisted performance from the evolving capacity to verify, recover, and adapt.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性理论文章，探讨旅游中小企业如何借助生成式人工智能获得生产力提升，同时不损害未来适应所需的人类能力与地方性能力。作者整合资源编排、AI准备度、人机互补与动态能力等视角，提出“人机编排”作为任务分解、情境化、验证与学习的工作流配置，并用“从提示到绩效”框架区分能力积累循环与委托驱动的侵蚀循环。文章提出存量-流量机制解释两者切换，给出七组待检验命题及行业边界条件，强调即时辅助绩效与持续验证、恢复和适应能力应分开看待。

papers.title: Developing AI-Ready Human Capital for Future Work: An HRM Perspective on Entrepreneurial AI Value Among Female Business Students in Kuwait
papers.authors: Shaikhah Alainati, Ahmed A. Al-Hunaiyyan, Mariam A. Alterkait, Anfal F A y r Albadir
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping occupational tasks and skill requirements, creating a human resource management (HRM) challenge around how future employees develop readiness for responsible AI-enabled work. This study examines relationships among perceived AI readiness (PAIR), perceived entrepreneurial AI value (AIV), and future AI-enabled work and entrepreneurial engagement (FAE) among 407 female business students in Kuwait. Five-category ordinal indicators were analyzed using diagonally weighted least squares confirmatory factor analysis, competing measurement models, bootstrap-based latent indirect-effect analysis, and an extended structural model incorporating AI learning exposure, trust in AI task delegation, and job-displacement concern. A three-factor readiness–value–engagement structure was retained, although discriminant validity between AIV and FAE was qualified by a high latent correlation. The retained structure showed mixed robust fit and substantial shared covariance, warranting cautious interpretation. PAIR was positively associated with AIV, which was strongly associated with FAE. The indirect association remained significant after supplementary variables were included, decreasing from β = 0.650 to β = 0.420. Formal AI learning exposure was positively associated with readiness but showed a small negative conditional association with perceived entrepreneurial AI value after readiness was held constant; this exploratory finding requires replication. Trust was positively associated with readiness, value, and engagement, while job-displacement concern coexisted with higher readiness and value. Findings suggest that AI-ready human-capital development should combine exposure with authentic business applications, critical evaluation, calibrated trust, and responsible human–AI collaboration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从人力资源管理视角考察科威特女性商科学生感知的AI准备度、创业型AI价值与未来AI赋能工作及创业参与之间的关系，采用验证性因子分析与潜变量间接效应分析。三因子结构基本成立，但价值与参与之间的区分效度因高相关而受限；准备度与AI价值正相关，AI价值又与参与强相关，纳入补充变量后间接关联仍显著但有所减弱。正式AI学习经历与准备度正相关，却在控制准备度后与AI价值呈小幅负向条件关联，属需重复验证的探索性发现；信任与三者均正相关，岗位替代担忧则与更高的准备度和价值并存。作者据此提示，AI人力资本培养需结合真实商业应用、批判性评估与适度信任。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in Saudi otolaryngology research: a scoping review of the current landscape, gaps, and future directions
papers.authors: Turki Aldrees, Abdullah Abdulmohsen Alabdulqader, Mohammed Al-Bar, Feras Alkholaiwi
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in otolaryngology, but the extent and focus of AI research in Saudi Arabia remain unclear. This scoping review mapped the available evidence and identified key research themes and knowledge gaps. Methods A scoping review was conducted following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, and the Saudi Medical Journal archive were searched for studies published between January 2019 and April 2026. Eligible studies investigated AI applications or clinician perspectives within Saudi otolaryngology. The evidence was mapped across major otolaryngology domains, including cochlear implantation and hearing, rhinology and skull base surgery, facial plastic surgery, laryngology and voice, head and neck oncology, surgical and other ENT-related interventions for obstructive sleep apnoea, AI education and implementation, and AI-assisted patient education. Results The searches identified 2,925 database records, four records from other sources and seven records from an updated search and expert suggestions; thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence covered AI awareness and education, large language model (LLM)-based patient education, cochlear implantation, rhinology and skull base surgery, facial plastic surgery, laryngology and voice, and head and neck oncology; no eligible study addressed surgical or other ENT-related interventions for obstructive sleep apnoea. Clinicians were generally positive about AI, while clinical studies showed promising performance of AI models. LLM chatbots generally gave accurate postoperative advice, although, when validated tools were used, their responses were harder to read and less actionable than patient-education standards recommend. However, limited AI education, small or non-Saudi datasets, limited external validation, and implementation barriers remained important challenges. Conclusion AI research in Saudi otolaryngology remains limited but is expanding across several clinical domains. Future research should prioritise Saudi-specific datasets, multicentre clinical validation, structured AI education, rigorous bilingual (Arabic and English) evaluation of LLM-generated patient information, and safe integration of AI into clinical practice in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了沙特阿拉伯耳鼻咽喉科领域人工智能研究的现状、主题与空白，检索多个数据库后纳入符合标准的文献，覆盖人工智能认知与教育、大语言模型患者教育、人工耳蜗植入、鼻科与颅底手术、面部整形、喉科与嗓音及头颈肿瘤等方向，但未发现涉及阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停手术或其他耳鼻咽喉相关干预的研究。临床研究显示人工智能模型表现较好，临床医生总体持积极态度；大语言模型聊天机器人给出的术后建议通常准确，但按标准化工具评估时，其内容可读性和可操作性不及患者教育标准。作者指出，人工智能教育不足、数据集规模小或非沙特本土、外部验证有限及实施障碍仍是主要挑战，并提出未来应优先建设沙特本土数据集、开展多中心临床验证和结构化人工智能教育，并对大语言模型生成的双语患者信息进行严格评估。

papers.title: Physiology-informed spectral-temporal learning with confidence-aware evaluation for single-channel EEG sleep staging
papers.authors: Chunming Shih, Bohan Lv, Liangfan Zhai, Fengquan Xu
papers.abstract: Introduction Automated sleep staging from single-channel electroencephalography (EEG) may reduce acquisition burden. Limited spatial information and inter-subject variability, however, make prediction difficult. Methods We evaluated a physiology-informed spectral-temporal framework for single-channel EEG sleep-stage classification. Each 30-s Fpz-Cz epoch was transformed into a log-power short-time Fourier transform (STFT) representation and modulated across five sleep-related bands. Depthwise-separable convolutions and efficient channel attention extracted local time-frequency patterns. A lightweight Transformer modeled a centered seven-epoch window for center-epoch prediction. Training combined class-balanced focal loss, neighboring-epoch supervision and a transition prior estimated from training labels. Results On a fixed subject-disjoint Sleep-EDF evaluation partition, the framework achieved 0.8469 accuracy, 0.7905 macro F1 and 0.7906 Cohen’s kappa. It yielded higher discrimination metric point estimates than the protocol-matched light CNN, whereas the TCN produced slightly higher accuracy and kappa. The framework yielded the lowest expected calibration error (ECE) point estimate among the three evaluated models (0.0320). Retraining-based ablations removed spectral modulation, transition-prior loss or neighboring-epoch supervision under the same protocol. Across seeds 42, 123 and 2024, accuracy and macro F1 averaged 0.8530 ± 0.0060 and 0.8006 ± 0.0098, respectively. Removing the 20% lowest-confidence epochs yielded 0.9167 accuracy among the remaining automated epochs at 80% coverage. Repeated random referral at the same coverage left accuracy near the full-test-set estimate, whereas confidence-guided referral retained higher accuracy among the automated epochs. Test-time spectral, context and noise stress analyses examined sensitivity of the trained model without retraining. Discussion These results support further evaluation of the framework as an offline or delayed pre-scoring aid. The small fixed test cohort and absence of external validation preclude broader reliability or clinical generalization claims. The findings should be interpreted as methodological evidence rather than clinical validation.

papers.title: Analyzing postpartum patients’ attitudes towards medication for weight management: a mixed-methods analysis
papers.authors: Julia Erickson, Levi J. Anderson, Laine Boitos, Bryan L. Aaron, Samantha B. Schon, Ashley Bartell
papers.abstract: Introduction Pregnancy and the postpartum period present unique stressors that can be barriers to weight loss efforts. The landscape of weight management is rapidly evolving, but without specific understanding or consideration of postpartum people's needs and attitudes towards newer pharmaceutical options (e.g., GLP-1 agonists). We aim to characterize postpartum people's perspectives on weight management interventions in the weeks to months following birth. This study assesses the attitudes of postpartum people with a BMI >30 kg/m2 towards weight management in the immediate postpartum period. Methods This was a prospective, observational study leveraging mixed-methods techniques to extract the opinions and stances of postpartum people from a single institution with a BMI >30 kg/m2 via semi-structured interviews. A total of three focus groups and two one-on-one interviews were conducted. Thematic qualitative analysis was performed to identify emergent themes, followed by a sentiment analysis to quantitatively compare the emotive lexical context of each major theme. Results We qualitatively identified four major themes during the interviews: attitudes about medication (“Medication”), attitudes towards and experiences with weight fluctuation (“Weight”), tools for losing weight (“Tools”), and concerns about long-term health (“Concern”). Quantitatively, participant statements about “Tools” were the most positive, with polarity scores (0.33 ± 0.27), while sentences related to “Concern” were the most negative (polarity scores 0.02 ± 0.25). Terms representing the emotions “joy,” “anticipation,” and “trust” were notably overrepresented compared to other emotions in sentences categorized as discussing “Tools.” These positive stances were reaffirmed in our qualitative review, though participants were skeptical regarding the implications of weight loss medications on breastfeeding. They also conveyed concern about short-term use of medications, favoring a sustainable multimodal approach. Overall, participants expressed overwhelmingly positive attitudes towards weight management interventions in the postpartum period, specifically in conjunction with other lifestyle adjustments and support from medical and familial outlets. Discussion In semi-structured interviews, postpartum participants with a BMI >30 kg/m2 favored a comprehensive plan for weight loss and management—including pharmacologic interventions and social supports or lifestyle alterations—starting in the weeks to months postpartum. Though they highlighted lingering concerns regarding safety and efficacy of pharmacologic interventions in this context, participants were open to integrating medications as one of many tools to optimize long-term cardiometabolic well-being.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注产后体重管理这一议题，采用混合方法，通过半结构化访谈和焦点小组考察BMI超过30的产后人群对体重管理干预（包括新型药物选择）的态度。质性分析归纳出用药态度、体重波动、减重工具和长期健康担忧四个主题，情感分析显示涉及“工具”的表述最为积极，而“担忧”类表述最为消极。参与者总体对产后体重管理干预持积极态度，倾向于将药物作为综合方案的一部分，配合生活方式调整及医疗和家庭支持，但对减重药物对母乳喂养的影响及短期用药存有疑虑，更青睐可持续的多模式路径。研究据此提示，产后人群对药物治疗持开放但审慎的立场，其顾虑值得在相关干预设计中予以考虑。

papers.title: The use of different artificial intelligence-powered chatbots to answer questions related to dental implants
papers.authors: Rasha A. Alamoush, Mohammad Atrash, Ziad Abusidu, Alaa H.A. Sabrah, Islam Abd Alraheam, Marwa M. Alnsour, Mahmoud Khaled AL-Omiri
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI)-powered chatbots based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as sources of health information. In dentistry, patients frequently seek online information regarding dental implant therapy; however, the quality, reliability, and clinical usefulness of AI-generated responses remain uncertain. This study aimed to compare the performance of commonly available AI chatbots in answering dental implant-related questions. Methods Ninety-nine publicly available dental implant-related questions were identified using online question-generation platforms and categorized into four domains: biological and surgical aspects, prosthetic and material science, clinical outcomes and complications, and patient-centered and economic considerations. Each question was submitted independently to four AI chatbots: ChatGPT-5, Gemini 3 Pro, DeepSeek V3.2, and Microsoft Copilot. Responses were evaluated by two calibrated dental specialists using the Global Quality Scale (GQS), CLEAR reliability assessment tool, usefulness scoring, and readability indices including Flesch–Kincaid Grade Level (FKG) and Simple Measure of Gobbledygook (SMOG). Statistical analyses were performed using appropriate parametric and non-parametric tests with a significance level of p < 0.05. Results All evaluated chatbots generated responses with very good reliability according to CLEAR scores. Significant differences were observed among AI models in readability, quality, usefulness, and reliability scores ( p < 0.001). DeepSeek demonstrated the highest reliability (median CLEAR score = 25) and the highest proportion of excellent-quality responses according to GQS. ChatGPT generated significantly more useful responses compared with other models. DeepSeek and Copilot produced more readable responses, whereas Gemini demonstrated the highest reading difficulty based on FKG and SMOG scores. Response performance was not significantly influenced by the question category. Conclusions AI-powered chatbots can provide generally reliable information regarding dental implants and may serve as supportive sources of patient education. However, differences exist between AI models regarding readability, usefulness, and response quality. AI-generated information should complement rather than replace professional dental consultation, and further studies involving patients and clinically validated outcomes are warranted.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了四款常见AI聊天机器人在回答牙种植相关问题时的表现，由两名牙科专家对99个公开问题（涵盖生物学与外科、修复与材料、临床结果与并发症、患者中心与经济考量四个领域）的回答进行质量、可靠性、有用性和可读性评估。结果显示，各模型回答的可靠性总体良好，但模型间在可读性、质量、有用性和可靠性上存在显著差异：DeepSeek可靠性最高且优质回答比例最高，ChatGPT回答的有用性更突出，DeepSeek与Copilot的可读性较好，Gemini阅读难度最高，而问题类别对表现无显著影响。作者据此认为，AI聊天机器人可提供较可靠的种植信息并作为患者教育的辅助来源，但模型间差异明显，其信息应补充而非替代专业牙科咨询，相关结论仍需涉及患者和临床验证结局的进一步研究。

papers.title: Beyond capability frameworks: Australia’s next challenge in preparing the digital health workforce
papers.authors: Salma Arabi, Kerryn A Butler-Henderson
papers.abstract: Australia has made substantial progress in digital health workforce development through the establishment of nationally coordinated strategies, profession-specific capability frameworks, and the Australian Digital Health Capability Framework. Collectively, these initiatives have repositioned digital health from a specialised technical domain to a core professional competency expected across the health workforce. However, while considerable effort has focused on defining the capabilities required for contemporary digital practice, less attention has been directed towards ensuring workforce readiness. This perspective argues that capability and readiness are related but distinct concepts. Capability frameworks describe the knowledge, skills, and behaviours expected of health professionals, whereas readiness reflects the ability to apply these capabilities confidently, ethically, and adaptively within rapidly evolving healthcare environments. As digital health systems become increasingly influenced by artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, and data-driven decision-making, workforce preparedness will depend on more than technical competence alone. It will require critical thinking, ethical reasoning, digital and data literacies, and the capacity to work effectively alongside emerging technologies. We propose that, while capability frameworks will continue to evolve alongside technological and regulatory change, Australia's next challenge is ensuring that existing capability expectations are translated into educational practice, workplace learning, professional development, and measurable workforce outcomes. Sustained implementation, evaluation, and collaboration will be essential to ensure a future-ready digital health workforce.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇观点性文章，讨论澳大利亚数字健康人才培养的下一步挑战。作者指出，澳大利亚已通过国家协调战略、专业能力框架和澳大利亚数字健康能力框架，将数字健康从专门技术领域转变为卫生从业者应具备的核心能力，但现有工作多集中于界定所需能力，对劳动力是否真正“准备好”关注不足。文章据此区分能力与准备度：能力框架描述应具备的知识、技能和行为，准备度则反映在快速变化的医疗环境中自信、合乎伦理且灵活地运用这些能力的程度。随着人工智能、预测分析和数据驱动决策影响加深，作者认为准备度不能只靠技术能力，还需批判性思维、伦理推理、数字与数据素养以及同新兴技术有效协作的能力，并呼吁将能力要求落实到教育、工作场所学习、职业发展和可衡量的队伍成果中。

papers.title: The AI incident disclosure shadow: tracking AI incidents into U.S. securities filings
papers.authors: Samir Chincholikar, Robin Chawla
papers.abstract: Introduction Artificial intelligence (AI) systems developed or deployed by public companies are increasingly linked to documented real-world harms, yet whether these AI incidents ever reach investors through securities filings has not been measured. Research on corporate AI transparency has focused on AI risk-factor language rather than on realized events. We provide incident-level evidence on the gap between the external record of AI incidents and U.S. securities disclosure. Methods Using a pre-registered design, we matched 1,389 AI Incident Database (AIID) incidents dated 2019–2026 to U.S.-listed domestic filers, yielding 307 incidents involving 21 issuers. For each incident, we examined Forms 8-K, 10-K and 10-Q filed in the following 12 months and coded the strongest disclosure into four tiers: T1: incident-specific disclosure, T2: disclosure of a directly related legal consequence, T3: generic risk language on the same technology or harm family, T4: no related disclosure. Validation included a blind second-coder audit of issuer matching, a search-independent full-filing audit, and robustness checks across filing windows, issuer concentration and attribution. Results Only 4 incidents (1.3%; 95% CI 0.4–3.3) received incident-specific disclosure, and 7 (2.3%; 0.9–4.6) received any substantive disclosure. The remaining 300 incidents (97.7%; 95.4–99.1) form an AI incident disclosure shadow. Generic AI-risk language accompanied 278 incidents, but only 84 matched both the incident’s technology and its harm. As a result, 70.4% (64.9–75.4) of incidents had at most weakly related filing language. Substantive disclosures clustered around financial-statement effects or formal legal and regulatory consequences, including reported impacts of approximately $304 million (Zillow) and $478 million (General Motors’ Cruise). In exploratory analyses, no severity gradient was detectable. The shadow rate ranged from 92.5% to 99.0% across all robustness specifications. Discussion Securities filings routinely discuss AI risk in general terms but rarely identify realized AI incidents, so investors relying on SEC filings cannot reconstruct the external incident record. The estimates are conditional on AIID recording and issuer matching and do not imply legal materiality or noncompliance. They provide a pre-regime baseline for evaluating mandatory AI incident reporting under the EU AI Act and any future U.S. AI disclosure guidance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察上市公司遭遇的已记录AI事件是否以及如何进入美国证券披露文件，将AI事件数据库中的事件与美股上市申报公司匹配，并检索其后一年内的定期与临时报告，按披露相关程度分级。结果显示，绝大多数事件在申报文件中没有对应披露，形成明显的“披露阴影”；少量实质性披露多与财务报表影响或正式法律监管后果相关，而泛泛的AI风险表述往往与具体事件的技术或危害类型对不上。作者据此指出，投资者仅凭SEC文件难以还原外部AI事件记录，并强调该估计受事件库收录与公司匹配条件限制，不意味着法律重大性或违规，可作为评估未来强制AI事件披露制度的基线。

papers.title: Improving farm productivity and profitability through AI diffusion: evidence from Punjab, Pakistan
papers.authors: Aeman Khalid, Colin Akhurst, Sayed Abdul Majid Gilani, Firas Armosh, Syeda Aqsa Zanib, Jack Boath, Richard Stanley Peel, Yohani Jinadasa
papers.abstract: Introduction Agriculture remains central to Pakistan's economy, with Punjab accounting for the largest share of national crop production. Despite the rapid global advancement of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled agricultural technologies, their diffusion across farms in developing economies remains uneven and underexplored. This study examines the extent of AI diffusion among farmers in Punjab, Pakistan, and assesses its associations with perceived farm productivity and profitability. Methods Drawing on Diffusion of Innovations (DoI) theory, complemented by the Resource-Based View (RBV) and the Technology-Organisation-Environment (TOE) framework, the study adopts a quantitative, cross-sectional design using survey data from 101 farmers. Results The findings indicate that while awareness and perceived benefits of AI are relatively high, actual adoption remains moderate (AI Diffusion: M = 18.27, SD = 3.71), indicating a gap between perceived value and implementation. AI diffusion was positively correlated with perceived farm productivity ( r = 0.617, p < 0.001) and perceived farm profitability ( r = 0.607, p < 0.001). The findings therefore demonstrate statistically significant associations between greater AI diffusion and stronger perceived farm performance, while not establishing causal effects. Discussion The observed perception-adoption gap is consistent with structural barriers identified in previous research, including high investment costs, limited digital infrastructure and technical capability constraints. The study contributes context-specific evidence on digital agriculture in a developing economy by jointly examining AI diffusion, productivity and profitability. The findings highlight the importance of infrastructure, institutional support and capability development in facilitating wider and more effective adoption of AI-enabled agricultural technologies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以巴基斯坦旁遮普省农户为对象，基于扩散创新理论并结合资源基础观与技术—组织—环境框架，采用问卷调查的定量横断面设计，考察人工智能在农业中的扩散程度及其与感知生产率和盈利能力的关系。结果显示，农户对AI的认知和感知收益较高，但实际采用程度中等，存在认知与采用之间的落差；AI扩散与感知生产率、感知盈利能力均呈正相关，但作者明确未确立因果关系。研究据此指出，高投资成本、数字基础设施不足和技术能力限制等结构性障碍可能制约采用，并强调基础设施、制度支持与能力建设对推广AI农业技术的重要性。

papers.title: The influence of Artificial Intelligence chatbots on consumer behaviour in digital marketing
papers.authors: Roya Anvari, Saba Khergiani, Rokhsareh Mobarhan, Halimah Mohd Yusof
papers.abstract: Introduction Although artificial intelligence (AI)-powered chatbots are increasingly used in digital marketing, their adoption remains challenging because of limited understanding of the factors that shape consumer acceptance and behavioral intention. This study examines the roles of trust, chatbot interactivity, and anthropomorphic design in influencing consumers’ behavioral intention to use AI chatbot services, with a particular focus on consumers in Tbilisi, Georgia. Methods A quantitative research design was employed using a purposive sampling approach to select consumers with previous experience using AI chatbot services. Data were collected through an online questionnaire from consumers who had previously used AI chatbot services provided by major organizations in Tbilisi, Georgia, between August and September 2025. A total of 275 valid responses were retained for analysis. The collected data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) to assess the measurement model and test the hypothesized relationships among the study variables. Results The findings show that chatbot interactivity and anthropomorphic design have significant positive effects on consumers’ behavioral intention. Trust significantly strengthens both relationships, indicating that higher levels of trust enhance the effects of interactivity and anthropomorphic design on behavioral intention. Discussion The findings highlight the importance of interactive and human-like chatbot features and the moderating role of trust in encouraging consumers’ behavioral intention to use chatbot services in digital marketing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注数字营销中AI聊天机器人的消费者接受问题，考察信任、互动性与拟人化设计如何影响消费者使用聊天机器人服务的行为意向，以格鲁吉亚第比利斯有过使用经验的消费者为对象，采用问卷收集数据并用偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析。结果显示，聊天机器人的互动性和拟人化设计对行为意向有显著正向影响，而信任会强化这两种关系，即信任水平越高，互动性与拟人化设计对行为意向的作用越强。文章据此强调互动、类人特征以及信任在推动消费者使用聊天机器人服务中的重要性，但结论基于特定地区消费者的自报数据，属于关联性证据。

papers.title: A regulation-aware architecture for governing AI-generated content: provenance, labeling, privacy, safety, and institutional compliance
papers.authors: Iván Miguel García López, José Martín Molina Espinosa, María Soledad Ramírez Montoya, Nicia Guillén Yparrea
papers.abstract: Introduction The rapid adoption of generative AI across multiple modalities has raised concerns about authenticity, labeling, privacy, safety, accountability, and legal compliance in AI-generated content produced within public-interest institutions, particularly in education and public administration. Although prior research has advanced techniques such as watermarking, provenance tracking, and content authentication, these solutions are often developed in isolation, leaving institutions without an integrated governance approach across the content life cycle. Methods This paper follows a conceptual architecture design approach combining an integrative literature review with a design-science research logic. Based on this synthesis, the paper introduces a layered, regulation-aware governance framework structured around five interdependent dimensions: provenance and authenticity, labeling and disclosure, privacy and safety safeguards, accountability and compliance controls, and operational governance workflows. The framework conceptualizes synthetic-content governance as a systems-level challenge requiring coordination between technical mechanisms and institutional oversight, specifying how provenance metadata, labeling protocols, privacy-preserving controls, safety filters, audit logs, and human review processes can be operationally combined. Results The framework is positioned in relation to established governance instruments—including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the OECD AI Principles, the EU AI Act, the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence, and the General Data Protection Regulation—and its layers are mapped to concrete regulatory and standards-based obligations. Its applicability is examined through an illustrative analytical application to documented institutional incidents involving non-consensual synthetic imagery in educational settings. Discussion The paper contributes by integrating security, privacy, safety, and regulatory compliance into a unified architecture, translating regulatory expectations into implementable institutional controls, and advancing a public-interest perspective that frames AI-generated content governance as a matter of institutional risk and responsibility. The paper's contribution is thus integrative and operational: it consolidates fragmented and weakly operationalized mechanisms into a single life-cycle framework of governance functions that institutions can adapt across contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式AI内容在公共利益机构中引发的真实性、标注、隐私、安全与合规问题，指出水印、来源追踪和内容认证等技术多被孤立开发，机构缺乏覆盖内容全生命周期的整合治理方案。作者采用概念架构设计，结合整合性文献综述与设计科学逻辑，提出一个分层、具监管意识的治理框架，围绕来源与真实性、标注与披露、隐私与安全保障、问责与合规控制、运营治理流程五个相互依赖的维度，说明来源元数据、标注协议、隐私保护控制、安全过滤、审计日志与人工审核如何协同运作。文章将该框架与NIST、OECD、欧盟AI法案、UNESCO建议及GDPR等治理工具对应，并通过教育场景中非自愿合成影像事件的示例性分析考察其适用性。其贡献在于整合分散机制、把监管要求转化为可实施的机构控制，并从公共利益视角将AI生成内容治理界定为机构风险与责任问题；该框架属概念性设计，尚未经实证检验。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence literacy and associated factors among gastroenterologists in China: findings from a multicenter survey with nationwide geographic coverage
papers.authors: Yangyang Zhang, Wenhao Zhang, Canlin Wang, Hewei Ma, Lanshuo Hu, Yiqing Mao, 兰箭, Xudong Tang, Yingpan Zhao
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare, making AI literacy an emerging core competency for physicians. However, AI literacy among Chinese gastroenterologists has not been systematically investigated. This survey assessed AI literacy among Chinese gastroenterologists and examined its associated factors. Methods We conducted a multicenter cross-sectional survey with nationwide geographic coverage among gastroenterologists in China. The study was implemented from February to June 2026 following ethical approval. Participants were recruited from 96 hospitals across 30 provincial-level regions and completed a structured online questionnaire assessing AI literacy using the Medical Artificial Intelligence Readiness Scale for Medical Students (MAIRS-MS). Following univariable analyses, multiple linear regression was used to identify factors independently associated with AI literacy. Results A total of 1,125 valid questionnaires were analyzed. The median overall AI literacy score was 82 (IQR, 69–96). Median scores for the Cognition, Ability, Vision, and Ethics domains were 28, 31, 11, and 12, respectively; after normalization to a 0–100 scale, the corresponding scores were 62.5%, 71.9%, 66.7%, and 75.0%. In the adjusted analysis, more frequent AI tool use was associated with progressively higher AI literacy scores compared with rare or no use (2–3 times/week: B = 3.47; 4–5 times/week: B = 5.86; almost daily: B = 8.00; all p ≤ 0.020). AI-related training (B = 7.61, p < 0.001) and self-reported AI use in medical practice (B = 5.93, p < 0.001) were also associated with higher scores. Participants from central China had higher scores ( p < 0.001), whereas those from western China had lower scores ( p = 0.025), compared with those from eastern China. Conclusion Chinese gastroenterologists reported varying levels of perceived AI readiness across MAIRS-MS domains, with the lowest normalized scores observed in Cognition and Vision. Self-reported AI literacy was associated with educational attainment, geographic region, AI tool use frequency, AI-related training, and AI use in medical practice. These findings highlight the potential relevance of structured and regularly updated AI education, while longitudinal studies incorporating objective competency assessments are needed to clarify these associations and determine whether educational interventions improve physicians’ AI-related knowledge and skills.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过多中心横断面调查，考察了中国消化内科医生的AI素养水平及其相关因素。结果显示，医生在MAIRS-MS各维度上的自评准备度存在差异，认知与视野维度的标准化得分相对较低；更频繁使用AI工具、接受AI相关培训以及在医疗实践中使用AI，均与更高的AI素养得分相关，地区分布也呈现差异。作者据此指出结构化且持续更新的AI教育的潜在意义，同时强调这些仅为关联，仍需结合客观能力评估的纵向研究来厘清关系。

papers.title: Insomnia severity and quality of life before and after comprehensive health resort treatment across BMI categories
papers.authors: Grzegorz Onik, Kamil Barański, Krzysztof Suszyńśki
papers.abstract: Background Excessive body weight is associated with numerous adverse health consequences, including insomnia and reduced quality of life. To date, the impact of body mass index on the effectiveness of comprehensive health resort treatment in terms of insomnia and quality of life has not been investigated. This study aimed to evaluate whether treatment-related improvements in insomnia and quality of life differ across BMI categories and whether BMI and weight loss are associated with treatment effectiveness. Methods The study included 90 individuals (18 men and 72 women) with BMI ranging from 21.63 to 34.01 kg/m2 (mean: 27.82 ± 3.23 kg/m2) who underwent 21-day comprehensive health resort treatment. Participants were divided into three groups according to BMI category: normal weight, overweight, and class I obesity. Insomnia was assessed using the Athens Insomnia Scale (AIS), whereas health-related quality of life was assessed using the EQ-5D-5L questionnaire. Measurements were performed before and after completion of the 21-day treatment. Results Changes in AIS scores ( p = 0.23), EQ-5D-5L index values ( p = 0.35), and EQ-5D-5L VAS scores ( p = 0.88) following treatment did not differ significantly across BMI groups. BMI was not associated with changes in AIS scores ( β = 0.28; p = 0.29), EQ-5D-5L index ( β = −0.001; p = 0.67), or EQ-5D-5L VAS scores ( β = 0.53; p = 0.33). Regression simulations indicated that hypothetical reductions in BMI ( β = −0.380; p = 0.02) and body weight ( β = −0.101; p = 0.04) would be associated with greater improvements in EQ-5D-5L VAS scores. Conclusion Improvements in insomnia severity and quality of life were observed following comprehensive health resort treatment, with no statistically significant differences in these changes between BMI groups.
