A model-based simulation suggested that a hypothetical 3% weight loss might be associated with a small improvement in perceived health status. Further studies are needed to confirm these findings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察综合疗养治疗对失眠严重程度与健康相关生活质量的改善是否因BMI类别而异，并分析BMI及体重变化与疗效的关联。研究对象为接受为期三周综合疗养治疗的成年人，按正常体重、超重和I度肥胖分组，在治疗前后分别用雅典失眠量表和EQ-5D-5L问卷评估。结果显示，各BMI组的失眠与生活质量改善幅度无显著差异，BMI本身也与这些变化无关；仅基于模型的模拟提示，假设性的体重下降可能与自评健康状态的小幅改善相关，作者据此指出该发现尚需进一步研究确认。

papers.title: Shaping early childhood in the age of AI: holistic competencies, pedagogical practices, and ecological support
papers.authors: Li Pei
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the learning and developmental contexts in which young children grow, learn, and interact. Guided by an ecological perspective, this systematic conceptual mapping review examines 86 resources to explore what young children should learn and how they should be taught. Four themes were identified through thematic analysis: (1) holistic competencies for young children, encompassing foundational cognitive and social–emotional skills, physical and mental well-being, executive functions, learning dispositions, and AI literacy; (2) governance for AI integration in early childhood education; (3) professional development and systemic support for educators; and (4) play-based learning and human-centered approaches in AI-enhanced contexts. The findings suggest that thriving in the AI age requires moving beyond isolated digital skills toward holistic development, supported by a cohesive infrastructure that links classroom practice with structural governance. These findings highlight the necessity of cultivating holistic competencies beyond basic AI literacy in curriculum design, preparing children to navigate an ever-changing digital world. Furthermore, they underscore the imperative for robust institutional support, particularly through participatory research to support age-appropriate pedagogy and educators’ digital confidence, while highlighting the value of playful early learning. Concurrently, these insights establish a theoretical framework for future empirical research, offer actionable strategies for ethical child-centred AI implementation, and provide strategic directions for policy and practice to address the critical demand for transformative knowledge in early childhood education.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以生态视角系统梳理了86份文献，围绕人工智能时代幼儿应学什么、如何教展开概念性映射。作者通过主题分析归纳出四方面主题：幼儿的整体素养（含基础认知与社会情感技能、身心健康、执行功能、学习倾向及AI素养）、AI融入幼儿教育的治理、教育者的专业发展与系统支持，以及AI增强情境下以游戏为本和以人为中心的教学取向。文章据此提出，适应AI时代需超越孤立的数字技能训练，转向整体发展，并依靠连接课堂实践与制度治理的协同支持体系；同时强调机构支持与参与式研究对适龄教学法和教育者数字信心的重要性，并为后续实证研究、伦理实施与政策实践提供框架。

papers.title: Gendered affective representations in AI-assisted music videos: a qualitative multimethod study
papers.authors: Yaşar Kızıltan, Ayhan Dolunay, Savas GUNGOR
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has become increasingly visible in music-video production, influencing both production practices and the ways in which emotion, bodies, and gender are portrayed visually. This study examines gendered emotional representation in AI-assisted music videos. Methods A qualitative multimethod design combined interpretive visual analysis of four purposively selected AI-assisted music videos with asynchronous written expert interviews involving six creative-industry professionals and four psychology experts ( N = 10). The videos were analysed through an interpretive coding framework covering emotion, gender, body and face, power relations, AI aesthetics, and traces of bias. Results Across the cases, emotion was conveyed not only through facial expression but also through atmosphere, colour, movement, editing, and spatial transitions. The selected works sometimes reproduced familiar conventions, including heteronormative intimacy, militarised masculinity, and idealised female bodies, but also unsettled them through female anger and solidarity and mutable synthetic bodies. Ambiguity in a body’s appearance did not necessarily unsettle its gendered narrative role. Industry accounts described how prompting, selection, revision, and post-production shape representations, while general psychology-expert perspectives informed their interpretation. Discussion The findings position AI-assisted music videos as co-produced sites of synthetic visual culture in which established gendered conventions may be repeated, negotiated, or challenged. Neither expert group provided direct evidence about the production or reception of the selected videos. The findings underline the practical importance of representational review, consent, diversity, and transparent disclosure in AI-assisted cultural production.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察AI辅助音乐视频中的性别化情感表征，采用定性多方法设计，对四部目的性选取的AI辅助音乐视频进行解释性视觉分析，并对创意产业从业者与心理学专家进行异步书面访谈。分析发现，情感不仅通过面部表情传达，也借助氛围、色彩、运动、剪辑和空间转换呈现；所选作品有时复制异性恋亲密关系、军事化男性气质和理想化女性身体等既有惯例，也通过女性愤怒与团结、可变的合成身体对其加以扰动，而身体外观的模糊性未必动摇其性别化叙事角色。行业受访者描述了提示、筛选、修改和后期制作如何塑造表征，心理学专家则提供解读视角。作者据此将AI辅助音乐视频定位为合成视觉文化的共同生产场域，并强调表征审查、同意、多样性与透明披露的实践意义，同时指出两组专家均未提供关于所选视频生产或接受的直接证据。

papers.title: Parasocial and interpersonal interaction: distinct associations with customer value co-creation in virtual brand communities
papers.authors: Xiaomei Wu, Tianmin Ma, Kaile Wang, Hongyan Lin
papers.abstract: Virtual brand communities expose members to communication from the brand side and interaction with other members, but these sources may not relate to participation through the same psychological processes. Drawing on the stimulus organism response framework, social identity theory, and social cognitive theory, this study tested whether community identification and self-efficacy statistically accounted for indirect associations between parasocial interaction, interpersonal interaction, and customer value co-creation behavior. The hypotheses were examined in an unpublished cross-sectional survey of 240 adult users of virtual brand communities in China. An audit of the questionnaire and data codebook corrected a prior item-block parsing error and established the intended 30-item measurement structure. Internal consistency was acceptable for the five composites (Cronbach's alpha = 0.730–0.837; McDonald's omega = 0.744–0.838). A five-factor confirmatory model fit better than models combining the interaction constructs, combining the mediators, or placing all items on one factor, although its absolute fit and discriminant validity were only partly satisfactory (CFI = 0.870, TLI = 0.857, RMSEA = 0.064, SRMR = 0.056). Regression estimates used HC3 robust standard errors, and indirect associations used 5,000 percentile-bootstrap samples. Parasocial interaction uniquely predicted community identification and self-efficacy, and both variables were associated with customer value co-creation. The indirect associations of parasocial interaction through community identification ( B = 0.163, 95% CI [0.038, 0.303]) and self-efficacy ( B = 0.167, 95% CI [0.053, 0.281]) were statistically detectable. Interpersonal interaction retained a direct association with customer value co-creation but did not uniquely predict either proposed mediator when both interaction variables were included; its two specific indirect associations were not statistically detectable. Results were similar after excluding uniform responders and after adding demographic and community-use controls. The findings distinguish relational and capability-related correlates of parasocial interaction while showing that interpersonal interaction may share substantial variance with brand-side relational experience. Because the data are cross-sectional, same-source, and affected by incomplete discriminant validity, the indirect effects are interpreted as covariance patterns consistent with the proposed pathways rather than evidence of causal psychological mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于刺激—有机体—反应框架、社会认同理论和社会认知理论，考察虚拟品牌社区中准社会互动与人际互动是否通过社区认同和自我效能感与顾客价值共创行为产生间接关联。作者对中国虚拟品牌社区的成年用户开展了一项未发表的横断面问卷调查，并采用结构方程模型和自助法检验间接关联。结果显示，准社会互动能独立预测社区认同和自我效能感，这两条间接关联在统计上可被检出；人际互动则与价值共创保持直接关联，但在同时纳入两类互动后不再独立预测任一中介变量，其特定间接关联也不可检出。作者据此区分了准社会互动的关系性关联与能力性关联，并指出人际互动可能与品牌侧关系体验共享较多方差；由于数据为横断面、同源且区分效度仅部分理想，相关间接效应应理解为与所提路径相符的协变模式，而非因果心理机制的证据。

papers.title: When AI advice agrees or disagrees with human judgment: trust, self-efficacy, psychological resilience, and adaptive responses in physical education
papers.authors: Haoqun Yang
papers.abstract: As AI-based decision-support systems become increasingly embedded in physical education and coaching practice, agreement and disagreement between algorithmic advice and participants’ immediate scenario judgments have become important but theoretically underexamined features of human-AI collaboration. Grounded in a shared Judge-Advisor System paradigm, four scenario-based experiments (total N = 859) manipulated whether an experimentally presented AI recommendation was consistent or conflicting with each participant’s prior judgment and tested machine trust and collaborative decision-making self-efficacy as psychological pathways to self-reported collaborative adaptive responses. Psychological resilience and rationale provision were examined as study-specific boundary conditions. Conflict significantly reduced machine trust (Study 1, d = 1.061) and self-efficacy (Study 2, B = −0.687), and both measured mediators carried significant negative indirect associations with adaptive responses (Study 1, B = −0.428; Study 2, via trust B = −0.201, via self-efficacy B = −0.127). Psychological resilience attenuated the between-condition difference in self-efficacy in Study 3 (index of moderated mediation = 0.115). In Study 4, rationale provision moderated the condition-to-trust association, F (1, 239) = 11.348, p < 0.001, partial η 2 = 0.045: the conflict effect was −0.811 in the black-box condition but −0.182 when a rationale was provided. The manipulation therefore concerns advice-judgment agreement rather than a direct experimental comparison of data-driven judgment with established experiential intuition. Because the scenarios did not establish objective recommendation accuracy, the moderation patterns are interpreted as changes in psychological response rather than as evidence that preserving trust or self-efficacy necessarily improves calibration, decision quality, or welfare.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注体育教育情境中，AI建议与使用者自身判断一致或冲突时，人机协作的心理反应。作者基于共享的“判断者—建议者系统”范式开展四项情境实验，考察机器信任与协作决策自我效能两条心理路径，并将心理韧性和理由说明作为边界条件。结果显示，建议与判断冲突会降低机器信任和自我效能，二者均与较弱的协作适应反应相关；心理韧性可缓冲冲突对自我效能的削弱，而提供理由说明能明显减弱冲突对信任的负面影响。作者强调，实验操纵的是建议与判断是否一致，并非比较数据驱动判断与经验直觉的优劣，且情境未确立建议的客观准确性，因此上述调节模式应理解为心理反应变化，而非信任或自我效能必然改善决策校准、质量或福祉的证据。

papers.title: Prompt specificity and iterative behaviour in text-to-music co-creation: a secondary analysis of interaction logs and a framework for perceived creative control
papers.authors: Xian Zhang, Lu Pan
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative artificial intelligence can lower barriers to musical creation while also shifting consequential decisions away from the user. Methods This study examines that tension through a secondary analysis of the published PAGURI interaction-log prompt corpus and develops a tentative framework for perceived creative control. The analysable corpus contained 304 text-to-music prompts from 24 participants. Musical specificity was operationalised as explicit instrument and technical-parameter markers; iterative continuity was measured with Jaccard similarity between consecutive prompts and checked against TF-IDF cosine similarity. To avoid pseudoreplication, group comparisons were conducted on participant-level summaries rather than treating 304 prompts as independent cases. Results Role-derived experience groups differed substantially in mean prompt specificity, H(2) = 10.25, p = 0.006, ε 2 = 0.39, and specificity density, H(2) = 11.52, p = 0.003, ε 2 = 0.45, but not in refinement rate, H(2) = 0.24, p = 0.888. At a descriptive Jaccard threshold of 0.20, 46.8% of consecutive pairs were refinements and 53.2% were restarts; because this classification was threshold-sensitive, continuous similarity remained the primary continuity measure. Prompt specificity did not increase systematically across the session: the mean within-person Spearman correlation was ρ = −0.06, and the distribution of participant-level correlations did not differ significantly from zero, W = 89.0, p = 0.374. Discussion These findings distinguish the explicit technical-musical information users encode in prompts from the sequential continuity of their prompting behaviour. The paper integrates task structure, system autonomy, model coverage, prior experience, self-efficacy, and psychological ownership into a testable framework for future music-education research. Given the small participant-level sample and role-derived grouping, the empirical findings are exploratory and require confirmation in larger, controlled studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过二次分析已发表的PAGURI交互日志提示语料，考察文本到音乐共创中提示具体性与迭代行为的关系，并据此提出一个关于感知创作控制的初步框架。分析发现，不同角色经验组在提示的具体程度和具体性密度上存在明显差异，但在修改频率上未见差异；提示具体性在会话过程中并未系统性上升，连续提示之间的相似性更多表现为重启而非逐步细化。作者据此区分了用户写入提示的显式技术音乐信息与其提示行为的序列连续性，并将任务结构、系统自主性、模型覆盖、先前经验、自我效能和心理所有权整合为可供后续音乐教育研究检验的框架，同时说明受参与者层面样本较小和按角色分组所限，实证结果具有探索性。

papers.title: Engagement or disengagement: understanding the emotional dynamics of EFL learners in GenAI-assisted writing from the sociocultural perspective
papers.authors: Keqing Wu, Miao Yang, Changmin Lin
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has reshaped EFL writing education, yet the emotional dimensions of student engagement in GenAI-assisted writing remain underexplored. This longitudinal multiple-case study investigates how Chinese EFL learners' emotional engagement evolves during a GenAI-assisted college writing course and what factors drive this evolution. Methods Drawing on the sociocultural framework of L2 student engagement with written feedback, we traced the emotional trajectories of three focal students across three writing tasks (exposition, group feature article, and argumentation) within a 14-week course. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews with stimulated recall, reflective reports, GenAI-student chatlogs, drafts, informal chats, and course syllabus, and analyzed via thematic analysis. Results Our findings reveal three qualitatively distinct trajectories: positive-resilient, characterized by sustained positive affect with temporary fluctuations; pragmatic-transformative, marked by a gradual shift from practical disengagement to critical engagement; and vulnerable-contingent, moving from moderate disengagement, through tentative peer-mediated improvement, to eventual breakdown and intensified disengagement. These trajectories were shaped by the dialectical interplay between individual factors (e.g., English proficiency, GenAI literacy, mindsets, beliefs, and emotion regulation) and environmental factors (GenAI-relevant task design, peer and teacher mediation, and institutional policies). Discussion The study extends the sociocultural framework by identifying English proficiency and GenAI literacy as critical developmental competencies, embedding GenAI-related factors across multiple environmental levels, and foregrounding emotional engagement as a dynamic, fluid state that interacts with behavioral and cognitive engagement over time. The findings challenge universalist claims about GenAI's uniform affective benefits and underscore the need for differentiated pedagogical approaches that attend to learners' diverse emotional needs in GenAI-mediated writing contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从社会文化视角考察中国英语学习者在生成式人工智能辅助写作课程中情感投入的演变及其驱动因素，采用纵向多案例研究，通过访谈、反思报告、聊天记录与作文稿等资料进行主题分析。研究发现三条性质不同的情感轨迹：积极韧性型、务实转化型和脆弱情境型，分别表现为持续积极伴随波动、由实际疏离转向批判性投入，以及由中度疏离经同伴中介的短暂改善走向崩溃与疏离加剧。这些轨迹由英语水平、GenAI素养、心态与情绪调节等个体因素同任务设计、同伴与教师中介及制度政策等环境因素之间的辩证互动所塑造。研究据此将英语水平与GenAI素养视为关键发展能力，并强调情感投入是随时间与行为、认知投入相互作用的动态状态，提示不宜假定GenAI具有普遍一致的情感益处。

papers.title: GenAI literacy and perceived decision quality in e-commerce: the mediating role of perceived information overload and the moderating role of consumer involvement
papers.authors: Yiming Guo
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used to support product search, comparison, and evaluation in e-commerce. However, consumers differ in their ability to use and critically evaluate GenAI-generated information, which may shape their perceived information overload and decision outcomes. Grounded in Information Processing Theory, this study examines the association between GenAI literacy and perceived decision quality, the mediating role of perceived information overload, and the moderating role of consumer involvement. Data were collected through an online survey of 401 Chinese college students and analyzed using confirmatory factor analysis and bootstrapped mediation and moderation procedures. The results show that GenAI literacy is positively associated with perceived decision quality and negatively associated with perceived information overload. Perceived information overload is negatively associated with perceived decision quality and accounts for a significant indirect association between GenAI literacy and perceived decision quality. Consumer involvement further moderates the association between GenAI literacy and perceived information overload: the negative association is stronger at higher levels of involvement. These findings support an information-processing account in which consumers’ GenAI-related capabilities and motivational involvement jointly shape their perceptions of cognitive burden and decision quality. The study highlights the importance of strengthening consumers’ critical GenAI literacy and adapting AI-supported information presentation to different levels of consumer involvement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于信息加工理论，考察电商场景中消费者的生成式AI素养与感知决策质量之间的关系，并检验感知信息过载的中介作用和消费者涉入度的调节作用。作者对401名中国大学生开展在线问卷调查，采用验证性因子分析与自助法中介、调节检验进行分析。结果显示，生成式AI素养与感知决策质量正相关、与感知信息过载负相关，感知信息过载则负向关联感知决策质量，并在两者之间承担显著的间接关联；消费者涉入度进一步调节AI素养与信息过载的关系，涉入度越高，这一负向关联越强。研究据此强调提升消费者批判性AI素养，并针对不同涉入水平调整AI支持的信息呈现方式。

papers.title: How AI disclosure influences consumers' purchase intention toward AI-generated Chinese ethnic-minority fashion: the roles of perceived usefulness, perceived authenticity, and algorithm aversion
papers.authors: Kuilin Wei, Jun Liu, Shuai Wang, Yue Sun
papers.abstract: Background With the growing application of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in fashion design and cultural and creative industries, AI-generated Chinese ethnic-minority fashion has created new opportunities for the contemporary transformation of traditional culture. However, whether consumers are willing to accept such products and how AI disclosure influences their evaluations and purchase intentions remain unclear. Drawing on the Stimulus–Organism–Response (S–O–R) model, this study examines the mechanisms through which AI disclosure, design aesthetics, cultural identity, perceived usefulness, perceived authenticity, and algorithm aversion influence consumers' purchase intentions toward AI-generated Chinese ethnic-minority fashion. Methods A questionnaire survey combined with a scenario-based experiment was employed. Six AI-generated fashion illustrations derived from Tujia costume elements were developed and selected as stimulus materials. Participants were randomly assigned to either an AI disclosure group or a non-disclosure group. Data were collected through Tencent Questionnaire, yielding 410 valid responses. Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) and Importance–Performance Map Analysis (IPMA) were employed to examine the structural relationships, mediating effects, moderating effects, and practical priorities for improvement. Results Design aesthetics and cultural identity influenced purchase intention through perceived usefulness and perceived authenticity, with perceived usefulness emerging as the strongest predictor of purchase intention. AI disclosure significantly reduced design aesthetics, cultural identity, perceived usefulness, and perceived authenticity. Algorithm aversion did not significantly moderate the relationship between perceived usefulness and purchase intention but significantly strengthened the positive effect of perceived authenticity on purchase intention. Conclusions This study reveals the multiple psychological pathways through which AI disclosure shapes consumers' evaluations of AI-generated ethnic cultural fashion. The findings further indicate that algorithm aversion alters the extent to which consumers rely on authenticity judgments when forming purchase intentions. This study extends the application of the Stimulus–Organism–Response (S–O–R) model to the context of AI-generated cultural products and provides practical implications for balancing AI transparency, cultural authenticity, and the practical value of products.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于刺激—有机体—反应模型，结合问卷与情景实验，考察AI披露如何影响消费者对AI生成的中国少数民族服饰的购买意愿。结果显示，设计美感和文化认同通过感知有用性与感知真实性影响购买意愿，其中感知有用性是最强预测因素；AI披露则显著降低上述四项评价。算法厌恶未显著调节感知有用性与购买意愿的关系，但显著增强感知真实性对购买意愿的正向作用。研究据此讨论了AI透明度、文化真实性与产品实用价值之间的平衡。

papers.title: Source-only cross-year prediction of perceived AI capability with a theory-anchored, loss-specific two-stage model
papers.authors: Dan Wang, Yuanzhi Song
papers.abstract: Introduction Understanding how developers judge AI's ability to handle complex tasks can help organizations monitor attitudes toward AI at work. Repeated surveys provide an opportunity to study these judgments, but models used across years must combine useful prediction with clear interpretation of the roles of trust and favorability toward AI. Adding work-related information or changing the prediction objective can alter the coefficients used to describe those relationships. This study examines whether these goals can be separated using Theory-Anchored Residual Surface learning (TARS). Methods We analyzed repeated cross-sectional data from the official 2024 and 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Surveys ( n = 22, 757 and 17, 021 employed professional developers). The outcome was respondents' five-category rating of how well AI tools handle complex development tasks. TARS first models its relationship with trust in output accuracy and favorability toward AI, then uses work and demographic information to correct prediction errors while keeping the first-stage coefficients fixed. Model development used 2024 data alone; 2025 outcomes were reserved for evaluation against models trained under the same protocol. Results In both surveys, higher trust and favorability were associated with higher perceived capability, with trust showing the stronger association. In the cross-year evaluation, TARS achieved R 2 = 0.445 (95% CI [0.434, 0.456]) and mean absolute error = 0.742. Changing the second-stage tuning objective improved absolute-error prediction while retaining the same first-stage coefficients. Discussion These findings show how repeated surveys can support prediction of perceived AI capability while keeping the reported trust-favorability relationship consistent across model adjustments. The approach offers an interpretable way to study professional appraisals of AI as work contexts and prediction priorities change.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察能否在跨年度预测开发者对AI处理复杂任务能力的评价时，既保持对信任与好感作用的可解释描述，又获得有效预测。作者基于2024和2025年Stack Overflow开发者调查的重复横截面数据，提出理论锚定的残差曲面学习（TARS）：先建模信任与好感同感知能力的关系，再用工作与人口信息修正预测误差并固定第一阶段系数，且仅用2024年数据开发模型、以2025年数据评估。结果显示，两项调查中信任与好感均与感知能力正相关，信任关联更强；跨年评估中模型具有一定预测精度，改变第二阶段调优目标可在保持第一阶段系数不变的同时改善绝对误差预测。作者据此认为，重复调查可用于预测感知AI能力，并使信任—好感关系在模型调整间保持一致。

papers.title: From cumulative impacts to informed decisions: an operational ecosystem-based framework for sustainable ocean management
papers.authors: Ángel Borja, Michael Elliott, Heliana Teixeira, Vanessa Stelzenmüller, Stelios Katsanevakis, Marta Coll, Miquel Ortega, Christopher P. Lynam, Nadia K. Papadopoulou, Torsten Berg, Jesper H. Andersen, Jacob Carstensen, Deevesh Ashley Hemraj, Miguel Costa Leal, Juan C. Cubillos-Moreno, Gerjan Piet, María C. Uyarra
papers.abstract: There is an increasing need to carry out cumulative effects assessment (CEA) in marine environments to support ecosystem-based management (EBM) and achieve Good Environmental Status (GES) under European and global policy frameworks. This need has been addressed by the 4 year major European project GES4SEAS, which has developed and operationalized an innovative, science-based toolbox to assess and predict the impacts of multiple human pressures, including climate change, on marine ecosystems, their functioning, and the delivery of ecosystem services and societal benefits. To achieve this objective, during the project, we proposed a framework which overcame major challenges, as shown in this review, through progress in recent years. For that, GES4SEAS implemented a co-creation approach involving a high-level Practitioners Advisory Board, ensuring alignment with policy needs and enhancing the uptake of results. This enabled developing a comprehensive conceptual and analytical framework linking EBM principles with key management elements and appropriate methodological tools, thereby bridging the gap between theory and implementation. Significant progress has been made in understanding cumulative effects by integrating statistical, empirical and mechanistic models, which increased identifying non-linear responses, tipping points and ecological feedbacks. In parallel, the project delivered a suite of interoperable tools, centered on the Tikta software and supported by other tools, enabling holistic assessments of pressures, ecosystem components and services. These tools were rigorously tested across multiple European and international case studies (“Learning Sites”), demonstrating their robustness, transferability and applicability across diverse ecological and data contexts. As such, GES4SEAS represents a major step forward in the state-of-the-art of CEA by transforming fragmented approaches into an integrated, operational workflow to inform marine governance. The project provides practical decision-support systems that enhance transparency, address uncertainties and facilitate adaptive management. By strengthening the science–policy interface and enabling informed decision-making, GES4SEAS has contributed directly to sustainable ocean governance and the achieving environmental and socio-economic objectives under global change.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对海洋管理中累积效应评估（CEA）与生态系统管理（EBM）脱节的问题，通过欧洲GES4SEAS项目提出并实施了一套可操作的框架。项目采用共同创造方式，联合高级实践者咨询委员会，构建了连接EBM原则与管理要素的概念和分析框架，并整合统计、经验和机制模型以识别非线性响应、临界点和生态反馈。项目还交付了以Tikta软件为核心的一套互操作工具，用于对压力、生态系统组分和服务进行整体评估，并在多个欧洲及国际“学习站点”案例中检验了其稳健性、可迁移性和适用性。该框架将分散方法整合为面向海洋治理的操作化工作流，提供增强透明度、处理不确定性并支持适应性管理的决策支持系统，从而强化科学与政策衔接。

papers.title: Body mass index and overall survival in patients with gastric cancer: stage-specific associations and prognostic implications
papers.authors: Sijing Zhou, Dong Yu, Xiaojie Wang, Zhouwei Zhan, ZengQing GUO, Jiami Yu
papers.abstract: Introduction Nutritional impairment is common in gastric cancer and may affect treatment outcomes and overall survival (OS). However, the prognostic significance of body mass index (BMI), particularly across disease stages, remains uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the association between baseline BMI and OS, examine potential stage-specific differences, and assess the additional prognostic value of nutritional and functional indicators. Methods This observational cohort study included 380 adults with histologically confirmed gastric cancer, categorized as underweight (BMI <18.5 kg/m 2 ), normal weight (18.5–23.9 kg/m 2 ), overweight (24.0–27.9 kg/m 2 ), or obese (≥28.0 kg/m 2 ). Associations with OS were evaluated using Kaplan–Meier analysis, multivariable Cox regression, BMI-by-stage interaction testing, parsimonious stage-specific sensitivity analyses, and restricted cubic splines. Prognostic performance was assessed using bootstrap-corrected concordance indices (C-indices) and time-dependent areas under the curve (AUCs). Results Among 374 patients included in the primary multivariable analysis, 202 deaths occurred. After adjustment for clinical, nutritional, and treatment-related factors, overweight was associated with lower mortality than normal weight (hazard ratio [HR], 0.62; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.41–0.93; p = 0.020), whereas underweight and obesity were not significantly associated with OS. The BMI-by-stage interaction was not significant ( p = 0.173). In stage-specific sensitivity analyses, overweight was associated with lower mortality in stage III–IV disease (HR, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.41–0.93), whereas the early-stage estimate for underweight was imprecise (HR, 5.19; 95% CI, 1.42–18.96; 26 deaths). The extended clinical-nutritional model achieved an optimism-corrected C-index of 0.681 after 1,000 bootstrap resamples, compared with 0.646 for the clinical reference model. Its 1-, 3-, and 5-year time-dependent AUCs were 0.744, 0.748, and 0.702, respectively. Discussion Overweight BMI was associated with lower mortality in patients with gastric cancer, while incorporating nutritional and functional indicators modestly improved prognostic discrimination. However, the nonsignificant BMI-by-stage interaction and limited early-stage events preclude definitive conclusions regarding effect modification by disease stage. These findings highlight the potential value of integrating BMI and nutritional assessments into prognostic evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于380例组织学确诊的胃癌成人队列，考察基线体重指数（BMI）与总生存期的关联，并检验这种关联是否随疾病分期而不同。多变量分析显示，超重者死亡风险低于正常体重者，而低体重和肥胖与总生存期无显著关联；BMI与分期的交互作用不显著，分期特异性分析中仅III–IV期超重的关联较为明确，早期低体重的估计因事件数少而不精确。将营养与功能指标纳入临床模型后，预后区分度仅小幅提升。作者据此认为超重与较低死亡率相关，但分期修饰作用尚不能确定，相关结论需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Transforming neurophysiological data into measurable stress metric using machine learning-based stress quantification framework for smart factory workers
papers.authors: Arshia Arif, Zohreh Zakeri, Ahmet Omurtag, Philip Breedon, Azfar Khalid
papers.abstract: Introduction Mental stress is a common issue in demanding occupational setups, such as smart industrial settings, particularly when working with robots, being one of the primary reasons for decreased performance and productivity. Estimating and evaluating stress are critical for worker safety, performance, and overall well-being. A novel integrated framework is proposed in this research for continuous cognitive stress-level estimation that combines neuroimaging (EEG and fNIRS), gaze tracking and machine learning. Methodology A factory workers' stress assessment experiment is designed and implemented, which employs physiological, behavioral and subjective measures to assess mental stress from different perspectives. Physiological features extracted from multimodal neuroimaging data are used for training supervised classification and regression models, while gaze, behavioral, and subjective measures provide complementary evaluation of worker stress. To further optimize the pipeline, multiple feature selection algorithms are tested, followed by ensemble learning approaches, and the best model is chosen for continuous stress-level estimation. Results and discussion After implementing the novel stress quantification framework for the factory workers' stress assessment experiment, the ensemble learning approach produced the best results for both regression (RMSE: 10.86) and classification (accuracy: 84.1%) techniques using the STAI score as the target. The behavioral and subjective measures demonstrate the effect of varying process variables (light, noise, task speed, and complexity) during the experiment. Multimodal data, machine learning, and other computational approaches are integrated in this study to estimate continuous cognitive stress levels, utilizing the proposed framework presented in this research, thereby bridging the gap between research and practical application. The proposed multi-domain framework provides a promising solution for monitoring worker well-being in occupational settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对智能工厂中工人与机器人协作场景下的心理压力问题，提出并实现了一套融合脑电与近红外脑成像、眼动追踪及机器学习的连续认知压力评估框架，并设计了工厂工人压力评估实验加以检验。作者从多模态神经影像数据中提取生理特征训练监督分类与回归模型，再以眼动、行为及主观测量作为补充评估，并比较多种特征选择与集成学习方法。结果显示，以状态焦虑量表得分为目标时，集成学习在回归与分类任务上均表现最佳，行为与主观测量也反映出光照、噪声、任务速度与复杂度等过程变量的影响。文章据此认为该多领域框架为职业环境中的工人健康监测提供了可行途径，但结论基于特定实验设置，其推广仍受条件限制。

papers.title: The perioperative sensory–cognitive interface: multimodal neuroimaging of hierarchical network reconfiguration in perioperative neurocognitive disorders
papers.authors: Nanbo Luo, Zhengjun Liu, Zhiheng Liu
papers.abstract: Perioperative neurocognitive disorders (PNDs) are commonly attributed to neuroinflammation, cerebrovascular stress, anesthetic neurophysiology, and pre-existing brain vulnerability. These mechanisms identify important insults but do not fully explain how they become disturbances of attention, perception, memory, executive control, and fluctuating awareness. We examine whether changes at the sensory–cognitive interface help explain these symptoms, focusing on postoperative delirium (POD) and early recovery within the broader PND classification. The interface comprises distributed, bidirectional operations that transform sensory evidence into context-sensitive representations through thalamocortical routing, integration, attention, and association systems. The framework makes three testable predictions: sensory function should add explanatory value beyond frailty and brain burden; perioperative effects should vary across hierarchical levels and time rather than reflect uniform suppression; and within-person recovery trajectories should explain outcome better than isolated scans. Anesthetic state-transition studies show that primary sensory responses can persist while feedback, thalamic broadcasting, and distributed integration are disrupted, but whether these changes cause PND remains unproven. Direct perioperative MRI and EEG studies identify pre-existing dysconnectivity, altered sensory and association-network organization, abnormal slow-wave and auditory-feedback dynamics, and incomplete postoperative recovery; nevertheless, findings are heterogeneous and sensory-specific tasks remain uncommon. These observations are compatible with established vulnerability–perturbation models and suggest that symptoms may depend on which networks recover and when. Structural–functional connectivity (SC–FC) coupling is one candidate measurement, not an established biomarker or a requirement of the framework. Longitudinal studies integrating sensory phenotyping, domain-specific cognition, delirium surveillance, MRI, EEG, physiology, and molecular markers should test whether this framework adds reproducible value beyond vascular injury, diffuse arousal failure, and latent neurodegeneration.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论性综述，围绕围术期神经认知障碍（PND）提出以“感觉—认知接口”解释术后谵妄与早期恢复的框架，认为感觉信息经丘脑皮层路由、整合与注意系统转化为情境化表征的过程若受扰动，可能比现有神经炎症等机制更直接地对应注意、知觉、记忆与意识波动的症状。作者据此提出三条可检验预测：感觉功能应超越衰弱与脑负荷提供额外解释力；围术期影响应随层级与时间变化而非均匀抑制；个体内恢复轨迹应优于单次扫描。文中引用麻醉状态转换及围术期MRI、EEG研究提示原发感觉反应可保留而反馈与分布式整合受损，但强调这些改变是否导致PND尚未证实，证据异质且感觉特异性任务少见，结构—功能连接耦合仅为候选测量而非既定生物标志物。

papers.title: Generative-augmented multimodal neuroaffective decoding for product evaluation: toward neurofeedback-driven human-in-the-loop co-design
papers.authors: Ming Deng
papers.abstract: Background Kansei engineering traditionally relies on self-reported evaluations of product impressions, which are susceptible to contextual influences, recall bias, and assessment timing. Multimodal psychophysiological measurements offer complementary insights into affective responses, but integrating heterogeneous signals with limited sample sizes remains challenging. This study proposes Generative-Augmented Multimodal Affective Fusion (GAMAF) to predict perceived attractiveness, innovativeness, and friendliness in product evaluation. Methods GAMAF integrates feature-space conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial learning with gradient penalty (cWGAN-GP), cross-modal attention, graph-based interactions, and adaptive modality weighting. Fifty participants evaluated three automobile cockpit designs, yielding 150 participant–stimulus trials after multimodal quality control. Electroencephalography (EEG), eye tracking (ET), and peripheral physiological signals were integrated and evaluated using nested participant-wise cross-validation. Results GAMAF achieved mean outer-fold R² values of 0.810, 0.850, and 0.840 for attractiveness, innovativeness, and friendliness, respectively, each with a standard deviation of 0.016. These values exceeded those of the Multimodal Transformer baseline (0.75, 0.78, and 0.76, respectively). Across the three targets, GAMAF reduced aggregate mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) by approximately 29.6% and 29.7%, respectively. Ablation analyses supported the integrated architecture, while adaptive modality weights revealed target-dependent patterns. Discussion GAMAF demonstrates the potential of generative-augmented multimodal fusion for decoding Kansei-related product impressions. However, performance comparisons remain descriptive because baseline variability and participant-level uncertainty were not quantified. Further validation on unseen product designs and closed-loop design optimization is needed to establish its generalizability and practical utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对感性工学中自评易受情境与回忆偏差影响、多模态生理信号样本有限且难以融合的问题，提出生成增强多模态情感融合方法GAMAF，用脑电、眼动和外周生理信号预测产品评价中的吸引力、创新性与友好度。50名参与者对三款汽车座舱设计进行评价，经质量筛选后得到150次被试—刺激试验，并采用嵌套的被试间交叉验证评估。结果显示，GAMAF对三个目标的平均外层R²分别为0.810、0.850和0.840，高于多模态Transformer基线，并降低了总体平均绝对误差和均方根误差。消融分析支持其整合架构，自适应模态权重呈现随目标而异的模式。作者指出，基线波动与被试层面不确定性未量化，性能比较仍属描述性，且需在未见设计和闭环优化中进一步验证。

papers.title: From a surgeon's stroke to a third hemisphere—The auxilium architecture for brain restoration and extension
papers.authors: Mijail Demian Serruya
papers.abstract: A surgeon was exercising on a stationary bicycle when he had a large ischemic left middle cerebral artery territory stroke, complicated by hemorrhagic transformation requiring hemicraniectomy and cranioplasty. He developed right-sided spastic hemiplegia and a mixed aphasia. This paper takes that case as its anchor to pose the question: beyond improving residual function, what would it mean to restore cognitive function that was lost so that the person fully returns to their pre-stroke baseline? Existing brain-computer interfaces rely on the person having an intact cortical substrate for intended movement and speech. Here we propose the Auxilium, a brain restoration architecture for the situation where that substrate is no longer present: an extracranial auxiliary brain system, agnostic to its substrate, that connects to a person's residual cortex through whatever input-output technology proves most appropriate, and that supplies, in parallel and in real time, new substrate, whether biological or synthetic. We address an assumption of brain-computer interface development, that throughput is the binding constraint. Linking a kHz brain to MHz digital does not impart the higher clock speed, because the limitation lies not in the port but in the architecture of the entire brain and body imparted by evolution. We posit that the substrate of canonical circuits and their integration areas is essential, and the Auxilium can be understood as restoring both connectivity (linkage between disconnected areas) and computation (information generation capability of a volume of neural tissue). We propose a near-term de-risking pipeline using stereoelectroencephalography during surgical epilepsy evaluation, comparing extracranial modules spanning threshold rules, PID controllers, expert systems, artificial neural networks, neuromorphic devices, and biological specimens, each linked in real time to a participant serving as their own control on naturalistic tasks. If ports alone restore the lost function, the requirement is routing connectivity. If performance improves only when the module supplies its own dynamics, the requirement is computational substrate. We expect the answer to depend on how much tissue was lost, how quickly, and on the individual's reserve, and we treat routing and substrate as endpoints of a continuum to be mapped empirically.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以外科医生大面积缺血性卒中后遗留偏瘫与混合性失语为引，提出一个理论架构问题：脑机接口能否不止改善残余功能，而是恢复已丧失的认知功能。作者提出Auxilium架构，设想在颅外接入一个不依赖特定基质的辅助脑系统，通过合适的输入输出技术与残余皮层相连，并行实时提供生物或合成的新基质，并把恢复连通与恢复计算作为两个核心需求。文章还质疑将吞吐量视为脑机接口瓶颈的假设，认为限制来自整个脑与身体的演化架构。作者提出利用手术癫痫评估中的立体脑电，将多种颅外模块与参与者实时连接、以自身为对照开展自然任务，以区分仅需路由连通还是需要计算基质，并预期答案取决于组织损失量、速度与个体储备。

papers.title: Effectiveness of bimanual kinesthetic teaching through different controller settings
papers.authors: Oliver Avsec, Aleš Ude, Matjaž Mihelj, Andrej Gams
papers.abstract: Physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) through kinesthetic teaching enables intuitive robot programming, but extending this approach to bimanual systems introduces challenges in synchronized control. Thus, the best way to control bimanual robot systems for kinesthetic teaching remains unclear. In this paper we evaluate bimanual kinesthetic teaching from the demonstrator's perspective, showing how different modes of control can affect both demonstration performance and user experience. Our study, in which participants kinesthetically taught a bimanual robot to perform a pick-and-place task, showed that the relative stiffness of the two robots significantly affects task timing and operator perception.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注双臂机器人动觉示教中同步控制的难题，比较不同控制方式对示教表现与操作者体验的影响。作者让参与者通过动觉示教引导双臂机器人完成抓取放置任务，发现两台机器人的相对刚度会明显影响任务用时和操作者的主观感受。这一结果提示，在双臂动觉示教中，控制设置带来的刚度差异不仅关乎执行效率，也关系到人机交互体验，相关结论仍需结合具体任务与控制器条件理解。

papers.title: Comparative evaluation of ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Doubao for pediatric IgA vasculitis patient education: content quality, reliability, readability, understandability, and actionability
papers.authors: Ximing Fei, Jiao Zhang, Qiuye Li, Jianhui Yang
papers.abstract: Background Large language model (LLM) chatbot platforms are increasingly used for health information, but their performance for pediatric immunoglobulin A vasculitis (IgAV) patient education is unclear. Objective To compare ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Doubao across content completeness, quality and reliability, readability, understandability, and actionability. Methods Thirty-two standardized English questions were submitted to ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Doubao on August 9, 2026, using a new conversation for each question and retaining the first complete response (96 responses). Two reviewers independently performed the original assessment, with third-reviewer adjudication. GQS, mDISCERN, QAMAI, six readability metrics, PEMAT-P, and ICC(2,1) were used. During revision, a question-specific clinical checklist was established and applied to all archived answers. The research team completed the revision scoring and confirmed the final omission results. Results Clinically relevant information omissions occurred in 16/96 responses (16.67%): 0/32 for ChatGPT, 5/32 for DeepSeek, and 11/32 for Doubao. Retained ratings identified outdated medical advice in 2/96 responses (2.08%) and no real-time information errors or hallucinations. At least one recorded content deficiency occurred in 18/96 responses (18.75%). Original ICC(2,1) values ranged from 0.767 to 0.954. Overall differences were significant for GQS, mDISCERN, QAMAI, PEMAT-U, and PEMAT-A (all P < .01), but not for readability metrics. Bonferroni-adjusted contrasts showed lower ARI, FKGL, CLI, and SMOG scores for DeepSeek than ChatGPT. DeepSeek had the highest PEMAT-U score; ChatGPT had the highest PEMAT-A score. Conclusions Performance varied by evaluation domain, and clinically relevant omissions remained a safety concern. The omission findings reflect criteria established during revision and do not establish a validated platform safety ranking. LLM platforms may supplement patient education but should not replace professional medical review.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了ChatGPT、DeepSeek和Doubao三个大语言模型平台在儿童IgA血管炎患者教育中的表现，围绕内容完整性、质量与可靠性、可读性、可理解性和可操作性，用标准化问题获取回答并开展多工具评估。结果显示，三者在质量、可靠性及可理解性、可操作性上存在显著差异，但可读性指标整体无显著差异；DeepSeek的可理解性得分最高，ChatGPT的可操作性得分最高。临床相关信息遗漏出现在部分回答中，且各平台遗漏数量不同，作者据此指出遗漏仍是安全性关切，但强调该结果基于修订阶段设定的标准，并不构成经过验证的平台安全排名，此类工具可辅助而不能替代专业医学审核。

papers.title: Research advances in brain-computer interfaces in oncology: from cancer pain management to neuroengineering for brain tumors and tumor-neural-immune interactions
papers.authors: Yawen Song, HongXing Guo, Zhen Yu, Aihua Wang, Jiaxin Li, Zhengcun Pei, Jiajing Chen, Xinyun Zhang, Haipeng Guo, Xue Wu, Jingkun Zhang, 吴尘轩, Ximo Wang
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have made significant progress in fields such as neurorehabilitation, motor reconstruction, and alternative communication by capturing, decoding, and providing feedback on brain activity. In contrast, the application of BCI in oncology has a relatively late start, but its development path has gradually become clearer in recent years. On the one hand, brain-signal interfaces based on neural feedback and closed-loop regulation have begun to be used for interventions targeting cancer-related neurological symptoms, particularly cancer pain and chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN), suggesting that supportive cancer care is shifting from empirical symptomatic management toward quantifiable, feedback-based, and adjustable neural state management. On the other hand, in the field of brain tumors, ECoG recording, high-density neural recording, and real-time decoding are providing complementary information on abnormal peritumoral networks and tumor-associated epilepsy within established function-guided surgical workflows. These recording and decision-support approaches are related to BCI engineering but are not automatically BCIs or substitutes for direct electrical stimulation mapping. More importantly, advances in tumor neuroscience suggest that neural activity not only reflects the disruption of host brain tissue by the tumor but may also participate in glioma growth and invasion through circuit remodeling and microenvironmental changes. This article provides a review of the fundamentals of BCI technology, the management of cancer-related symptoms, brain-computer interfaces in brain tumors, tumor neuroscience, tumor-neural-immune interactions, and their translational challenges. Current evidence suggests that the significance of BCI in oncology is no longer limited to assistive devices but is evolving into a novel engineering platform that integrates symptom control, surgical decision-making, and research into disease mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了脑机接口在肿瘤学中的应用进展，涵盖癌症相关症状管理、脑肿瘤相关神经工程以及肿瘤—神经—免疫交互等方向。文章指出，基于神经反馈和闭环调控的脑信号接口已开始用于癌痛和化疗所致周围神经病变的干预，提示支持性照护正从经验性对症处理转向可量化、可反馈调节的神经状态管理；在脑肿瘤领域，皮层脑电记录、高密度神经记录和实时解码可为肿瘤周边异常网络及肿瘤相关癫痫提供补充信息，但作者强调这些手段与脑机接口工程相关，并不等同于脑机接口，也不能替代直接电刺激定位。文章进一步指出，神经活动不仅反映肿瘤对宿主脑组织的破坏，还可能通过环路重塑和微环境改变参与胶质瘤生长与侵袭，并据此讨论了相关转化挑战。

papers.title: Responsible student use of generative AI in academic writing: a scoping review of boundaries, educational approaches, and evidence gaps
papers.authors: Jiayu Tie, MariCarmen Gil Ortega, Dan Zhao
papers.abstract: Generative AI has complicated how higher education distinguishes assistance from replacement in academic writing, and neither blanket prohibition nor permission resolves it, because the same GenAI-assisted practice may scaffold a student's reasoning or perform the work for students. This scoping review maps how empirical and systematically documented practice-based literature categorises responsible student GenAI use in academic writing, how these boundaries are translated into educational approaches, and what evidence exists for their evaluation and implementation. Following PRISMA-ScR, five databases were searched for English- and Spanish-language higher-education studies published between 1 January 2022 and 6 June 2026, supplemented by citation searching. Included studies reported original empirical data or first-hand documentation of an enacted practice, and contributed either to responsible-use boundaries or to a specified pedagogical assessment or guidance approach. In total, 31 studies were included. Charting yielded 192 practice-level records from 29 studies and 122 approach-level records from 29 studies. 27 studies contributed to both datasets. An interpretive synthesis of practice-level conditions, restrictions and explanatory notes identified six recurring principles: targeting learning objectives, preserving human agency, verifying GenAI output, transparency and accountability, authorship and human voice, and privacy, consent and fairness. These judgements are made at the micro level of the writing task but are sustained or eroded at the meso level of course design and the macro level of institutional guidance. Educational approaches were mainly pedagogical, but evaluation typically focused on short-term outcomes an relied on self-reporting. The included evidence suggests that responsible use depends on task purpose, expected intellectual contribution and the conditions surrounding AI assistance. The six principles offer a descriptive basis for developing and testing decision support. Further research could connect explicit boundaries with interventions and assess writing processes, textual outcomes and longer-term transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述关注生成式人工智能进入学术写作后，高校如何区分“辅助”与“替代”，以及相关边界如何转化为教学实践。作者按PRISMA-ScR流程检索并纳入31项研究，梳理出六项反复出现的原则：对准学习目标、保留人的能动性、核验AI输出、透明与问责、署名与个人声音、隐私同意与公平，并指出这些判断在写作任务层面做出，却受课程设计与院校指引的支撑或侵蚀。综述还发现教学路径以教学法为主，但评估多集中于短期结果且依赖自我报告，证据存在缺口；作者据此提出负责任使用取决于任务目的、预期智力贡献与AI辅助所处条件，六项原则可作为开发与检验决策支持的描述性基础。

papers.title: AI self-efficacy and satisfaction with studies among Peruvian university students: the indirect role of language learning strategies
papers.authors: Yurissa Sacsi-Huamani, Royer Chusi-Pacco, Yoni Zoraida Saire-Perez, Yamilet Mendoza-Gutierrez, Carlos Mediver Coaquira Tuco, Willian Huamanttupa Mar
papers.abstract: Introduction The increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into higher education is transforming how students access learning resources, regulate their learning, and engage in academic activities. However, the mechanisms through which perceived competence in using these technologies relates to students' academic experiences remain insufficiently understood, particularly in the context of language learning. This study aimed to examine whether language learning strategies statistically accounted for an indirect association between AI self-efficacy and satisfaction with studies among Peruvian university students. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted with 254 university students. AI self-efficacy, language learning strategies, and satisfaction with studies were assessed, and their relationships were examined using structural equation modeling (SEM). Results The model showed acceptable robust fit (CFI = .954; TLI = .943; RMSEA = .067; SRMR = .055). AI self-efficacy was positively associated with language learning strategies ( β = .431, p < .001), which, in turn, were positively associated with satisfaction with studies ( β = .523, p < .001). The direct association between AI self-efficacy and satisfaction with studies was not statistically significant ( β = .068, p = .421), whereas the indirect association through language learning strategies was statistically significant ( β = .225, p < .001). The model explained 30.9% of the variance in satisfaction with studies. Discussion These findings indicate a statistical indirect association consistent with the hypothesized model, but the cross-sectional design does not establish temporal ordering or causality. The results highlight the potential relevance of integrating AI-related competencies with strategic and self-regulated learning in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察秘鲁大学生的人工智能自我效能感与学习满意度之间的关系，并检验语言学习策略是否在其中起间接作用。作者对大学生开展横断面问卷调查，采用结构方程模型分析三者关系。结果显示，人工智能自我效能感与语言学习策略呈正相关，语言学习策略又与学习满意度呈正相关；自我效能感对满意度的直接关联不显著，而经语言学习策略的间接关联显著。作者据此指出，这一统计上的间接关联与假设模型一致，但横断面设计无法确立时间顺序或因果关系，并提示在高等教育中将人工智能相关能力与策略性、自我调节学习相结合可能具有参考意义。

papers.title: A meta-analysis of the effects of generative artificial intelligence on learning, cognitive, and linguistic outcomes
papers.authors: Begzod K. Khodjaev, Alfiya Rafisovna Masalimova, Alexey Alekseyevich Chistyakov, Yusuf Ay
papers.abstract: This meta-analysis examined the effect of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on students' cognitive, learning, and linguistic outcomes. A total of 68 effect sizes extracted from 58 independent primary studies were analyzed using a three-level random-effects model with cluster-robust variance estimation applied at the study level. Seven moderator variables were evaluated: outcome domain, educational level, GenAI tool type, experimental design, cultural orientation, course/subject domain, and comparison-condition type. The pooled effect was large, g = 0.864, 95% CI [0.720, 1.009], though heterogeneity was substantial (I² ≈ 88%) and the 95% prediction interval, [−0.213, 1.942], was wide enough to include a null or even negative effect in a new setting. Moderator tests, computed against the correct subgroup-weighted reference value and adjusted for multiple comparisons, identified outcome domain (Qb = 9.45, p = .009) and educational level (Qb = 6.50, p = .039) as significant at the conventional threshold, though neither survived Holm correction. Cultural orientation showed the largest raw contrast (vertical-collectivist g = 0.926 vs. horizontal-individualist g = 0.454; Qb = 4.11, p = .043) and remained significant in two of three confound-adjusted models ( p = .032 and p = .041) once subject domain, GenAI tool, experimental design, and small-study bias were held constant. Egger's regression indicated funnel-plot asymmetry ( p = .002), and PET-PEESE estimates suggested that, once corrected for small-study effects, the true effect could be considerably smaller (g ≈ 0.26–0.45) than the observed pooled estimate. Results support a positive average effect of GenAI on learning-related outcomes. However, the wide prediction interval and evidence of small-study inflation counsel caution in generalizing the point estimate, and the moderator pattern beyond outcome domain should be treated as provisional.
papers.summary_zh: 该元分析综合58项独立研究，考察生成式人工智能对学生认知、学习和语言类结果的影响，并检验结果领域、教育阶段、工具类型、实验设计、文化取向、学科领域和对照条件等调节因素。合并效应量较大，但异质性很高，预测区间宽至可包含零效应甚至负效应；结果领域和教育阶段在常规阈值下显著，但未通过多重比较校正。文化取向的原始对比最大，且在部分控制混杂的模型中仍显著。Egger检验提示漏斗图不对称，校正小样本效应后真实效应可能明显小于观测值。作者据此认为，生成式人工智能对学习相关结果平均有正向作用，但点估计的推广需谨慎，结果领域之外的调节模式应视为暂定。

papers.title: Quality assurance 5.0: reframing quality management in higher education through artificial intelligence and continuous institutional learning
papers.authors: Terfa Swem, Velisiwe Gasa
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital technologies is fundamentally reshaping higher education, exposing the limitations of conventional quality assurance systems that are often compliance-driven, periodic, and insufficiently responsive to dynamic institutional demands. This conceptual paper introduces Quality Assurance 5.0 (QA 5.0) as a proposed conceptual framework intended to reframe quality management by integrating artificial intelligence, continuous institutional learning, and evidence-informed governance. Drawing on Organisational Learning Theory, Total Quality Management, and Continuous Improvement Theory, the paper synthesises emerging scholarship to propose an adaptive quality ecosystem that is theorised to shift quality assurance from retrospective evaluation to predictive, real-time, and continuous institutional enhancement. The framework conceptualises AI as an enabler of intelligent quality monitoring, predictive analytics, automated feedback systems, and data-driven decision-making. At the same time, institutional learning serves as the mechanism through which universities continuously generate, share, and apply knowledge to improve academic, administrative, and student outcomes. By integrating technological intelligence with organisational learning capabilities, QA 5.0 is theorised to foster institutional agility, innovation, accountability, and resilience within increasingly complex higher education environments. The paper further presents a conceptual model illustrating the interrelationships among AI-enabled quality systems, learning-oriented organisational culture, strategic leadership, and sustainable institutional performance, specified as a set of testable propositions rather than as established, empirically confirmed relationships. Beyond extending existing quality assurance paradigms, the proposed framework offers a forward-looking perspective for policymakers, university leaders, accreditation agencies, and researchers seeking to modernise quality governance in the era of digital transformation. The study concludes that Quality Assurance 5.0 is proposed as an internally coherent and testable conceptual framework for moving quality management from static compliance toward intelligent, adaptive, and continuously evolving practice; its practical value for diverse higher education contexts remains to be established through the empirical validation identified as a priority for future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，针对传统高等教育质量保障体系偏重合规、周期性强且响应不足的问题，提出“质量保障5.0”框架，试图将人工智能、持续的组织学习与循证治理结合起来。作者依托组织学习理论、全面质量管理和持续改进理论综合已有研究，把AI定位为智能质量监测、预测分析、自动反馈和数据驱动决策的使能因素，把机构学习视为大学持续生成、共享和应用知识以改进教学、管理与学生成果的机制，并给出一个概念模型，说明AI质量系统、学习导向的组织文化、战略领导与可持续机构绩效之间的相互关系。需要强调的是，这些关系仅以可检验命题的形式提出，并非经实证确认的结论；框架对多样高等教育情境的实际价值仍有待未来实证检验。

papers.title: Direct multimodal grading of image-based mathematics and computing responses: rubric-constrained decisions and cross-model selective review
papers.authors: Thapanapong Rukkanchanunt, Supanut Chaidee, Chinawat Isradisaikul, Keerati Buchatip
papers.abstract: Introduction Multimodal language models can inspect submission images directly, potentially bypassing a separate optical-character-recognition pipeline, but end-to-end grading still requires explicit decision rules and a defensible mechanism for human review. Methods This retrospective study evaluates a two-stage workflow in authentic undergraduate mathematics and computing courses. In the first experiment, a model generated 922 analytic rubric criteria for 143 problems; instructors rated their immediate usability and completeness. In the second, GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Pro graded anonymized handwritten or image-based responses using the same instructor-approved binary rubrics and JSON-constrained prompt. The analysis comprised 3,346 rubric decisions from 31 question units and 57 rubric items, stratified by question type, rubric type, course learning outcome (CLO), and course. Results Individual-model agreement with instructor decisions ranged from 76.5% to 87.6%. Full-coverage majority agreement was 83.7%, below Gemini's 87.6%. With all unanswered outputs routed to review, complete unanimity selected 65.6% of decisions at 91.9% agreement (+8.2 percentage points relative to full-coverage majority), while retrospective majority agreement on referred decisions was 68.0% (-15.7 percentage points). All criteria were acceptance-eligible in 60.9% of submission-question responses. For reasoning-justification items, which occurred in a single six-part group assignment in Discrete Mathematics graded by one instructor, coverage was 84.1%, with award discrepancies in 14.1% of accepted decisions. Discussion These findings support a supervised decision aid: referrals combine binary disagreements and incomplete outputs, while unanimity does not guarantee agreement with the instructor. Rubric decomposition makes decisions auditable; because the study lacks an undecomposed-prompt control, its causal effect on reliability remains unestablished.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察多模态语言模型能否直接对图像形式的手写数学与计算作答进行评分，并设计了一套带评分规则约束和人工复核的两阶段流程。作者先在真实本科课程中让模型生成评分细则并由教师评估可用性，再让三个模型依据同一套经教师认可的二元评分细则对匿名作答评分。结果显示，各模型与教师判定的一致率在七成多到近九成之间，而要求所有模型完全一致虽能提高被自动采纳部分的准确率，却会遗漏大量需复核的判定，且完全一致也不保证与教师一致。作者据此认为该流程更适合作为有监督的辅助决策工具，评分细则分解使判定可审计，但由于缺少未分解提示的对照，其对可靠性的因果影响尚未确立。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence and universal design for learning in Kuwait’s higher education institutions: towards an AI-enabled framework for inclusive education
papers.authors: Abdullah Feraih Alenezi
papers.abstract: Inclusive education is a strategic priority for higher education institutions worldwide, driven by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 4, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UNCRPD) and national reform agendas. In Kuwait, universities are adopting AI-enabled learning technologies at pace, yet existing scholarship treats AI adoption, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), responsible AI governance and institutional digital transformation as separate lines of enquiry rather than as interacting institutional capabilities — and largely without engaging the critical literature that questions whether AI adoption strengthens or erodes educational equity in the first place. This paper closes that gap. Through a conceptual, six-stage framework-development process, it synthesises literature on AI in education, learning analytics, inclusive pedagogy, digital transformation and critical education-technology studies to build an explicit theoretical interaction model: AI operationalises UDL, UDL constrains which AI applications are appropriate, Responsible AI governs the technology, Systems and Institutional Theory explain institutional adoption, and a critical counter-current cautions against treating any of this as automatic. Building on this model and a systematic literature-to-pillar derivation, the paper proposes the AI-Enabled Universal Design for Learning (AI-UDL) Framework — five interdependent pillars (institutional leadership, AI-enabled UDL, a responsible AI ecosystem, faculty capacity building, and continuous evaluation) — and validates it against the CAST UDL Guidelines 3.0, UNESCO's AI guidance, the OECD Digital Education Outlook, SDG 4, the UNCRPD and Kuwait Vision 2035, distinguishing conceptual (face) validity from the construct and content validity a future empirical programme would need to establish. The paper offers a context-specific conceptual analysis linking AI, UDL and inclusive higher education within Kuwait and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), together with stakeholder-specific policy recommendations, an implementation maturity model, and a research agenda for empirically testing the framework.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对科威特高校在快速引入人工智能技术时，AI应用、通用学习设计（UDL）、负责任AI治理与机构数字化转型被割裂研究、且较少回应AI是否真正促进教育公平的批判性讨论这一问题，采用概念性六阶段框架开发方法，综合多领域文献构建理论互动模型，并提出由机构领导、AI赋能UDL、负责任AI生态、教师能力建设和持续评估五个相互依存支柱组成的AI-UDL框架。作者将该框架对照CAST UDL指南3.0、联合国教科文组织AI指引、经合组织数字教育展望及可持续发展目标4等文件进行概念效度检验，并明确区分了当前的概念（表面）效度与未来实证研究尚需建立的构念效度和内容效度。文章据此给出面向不同利益相关者的政策建议、实施成熟度模型和实证检验议程，其结论属于特定语境下的概念分析，框架的实际效果仍待实证验证。

papers.title: AI-supported activities for social inclusion: pre-service teachers’ perceptions of opportunities and challenges in special education
papers.authors: Yasmeen Nzam Abu Mukh, Enas Majadley, Jihan Aloshi, Giana Khalifa
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) has been recognized for enhancing accessibility and learning outcomes for students with disabilities. Nevertheless, very little research has examined the impact of AI on the social inclusion of students with intellectual disabilities, particularly from the perspective of pre-service teachers in authentic practicum contexts. Objective Focusing on student communication, participation, peer interaction, sense of belonging, and implementation conditions, this study investigated pre-service teachers’ perspectives on using AI-supported activities to promote the social inclusion of students with mild-to-moderate intellectual disabilities. Methods A qualitative interpretive approach was used, which involved conducting semi-structured interviews with eight pre-service teachers during a 14-week special education practicum at Al-Qasemi Academic College of Education. The data were analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis. Results The participants reported that AI-supported activities enhanced student engagement, communication, participation, and peer interaction when purposefully integrated into instructional practice. However, they emphasized that AI alone was insufficient to promote social inclusion; its effectiveness depended on teacher mediation, inclusive pedagogy, and supportive contexts. Identified challenges included limited technological infrastructure, inadequate teacher preparation, scarcity of Arabic-language AI resources, student distraction, and ethical considerations. Conclusions AI-supported activities have the potential to contribute to the creation of socially inclusive classrooms. However, their effectiveness is contingent upon intentional teacher mediation, using inclusive pedagogical approaches, and providing supportive educational environments, rather than relying on technology alone.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从职前教师视角考察人工智能支持的活动能否促进轻至中度智力障碍学生的社会融合，采用质性解释取向，在特殊教育实习期间对八名职前教师进行半结构化访谈并作反思性主题分析。参与者认为，当AI活动被有目的地融入教学实践时，能提升学生的参与、沟通、课堂参与度和同伴互动；但他们也强调AI本身不足以促进社会融合，其效果取决于教师中介、融合教学法和支持性环境。研究还指出技术基础设施有限、教师准备不足、阿拉伯语AI资源稀缺、学生分心及伦理考量等挑战，结论是AI支持的活动具有营造社会融合课堂的潜力，但成效有赖于有意的教师中介与融合教学取向，而非单纯依赖技术。

papers.title: Can AI make reading more engaging? A motivational framework for AI-assisted reading assessment in EFL/ESL classrooms: a practitioner case study
papers.authors: Maisarah M. Almirabi
papers.abstract: Background Sustaining reading motivation in EFL and ESL settings remains a persistent pedagogical challenge. Textbook-based comprehension tasks—with predictable content, pre-printed answer keys, and limited interactivity—can produce passive compliance rather than engagement. The maturation of large-language-model (LLM) tools now makes it feasible for individual practitioners to generate demographically responsive, proficiency-calibrated reading materials at low time cost. Objectives This paper introduces the AI-Mediated Motivational Reading Assessment (AMMA) framework: a practitioner-developed instructional model grounded in four motivational conditions—interest, achievement, practice, and focused attention—operationalized through a six-stage workflow combining AI text and MCQ generation, session-adaptive item loading, student-autonomous submission, optical-mark-recognition (OMR) grading, and same-session LMS feedback. The paper's primary contribution is the framework itself; the accompanying data are illustrative rather than evaluative. Method The framework was implemented across six MCQ reading quizzes administered to 53 EFL university students (Section 1: n = 33; Section 2: n = 20) over one semester. Quiz 1 used a textbook passage; Quizzes 2–6 used AI-generated passages. Quizzes 1–3 were delivered online and unproctored; Quizzes 4–6 were paper-based and invigilated. The design is a single-cohort descriptive case study with no control group. Passage source is fully confounded with delivery modality, quiz sequence, and cumulative exposure; no inferential tests were conducted. Results Mean scores were 8.4 percentage points higher on AI-generated quizzes than on the textbook quiz (77.8% vs. 69.4%), with narrower dispersion (SD 19.8 vs. 25.1). Because of the confounding noted above, this difference cannot be attributed to passage source. Online quizzes exceeded paper-based quizzes by 5.3 points overall and by approximately 10 points when the textbook quiz is excluded; since online delivery was unproctored, the paper-based scores are the more defensible estimate of independent reading comprehension. Instructor observations recorded peer discussion of quiz content, grade anticipation, and one unsolicited positive evaluation. These observations were not systematically coded and were recorded by the framework's designer. Conclusions The AMMA framework offers a practical, low-cost, replicable workflow for high-frequency formative reading assessment, and its logistical viability was demonstrated across six cycles. The data reported here are consistent with, but do not establish, a motivational or comprehension benefit. Controlled evaluation with validated motivational instruments, counterbalanced modality, and independent observation is required before effectiveness claims can be sustained.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出面向EFL/ESL课堂的AMMA框架，以兴趣、成就、练习和专注四项动机条件为基础，通过AI生成文本与选择题、自适应题量、学生自主提交、光学阅卷和同堂反馈六阶段流程，支持高频形成性阅读测评。作者在一学期内对53名大学生实施六次测验，作为单组描述性案例，主要贡献是框架本身，数据仅作示例。AI生成篇章的测验均分高于教材篇章测验，但篇章来源与施测方式、测验顺序和累积接触完全混淆，且在线测验未监考，因此该差异不能归因于篇章来源，纸笔成绩是更可辩护的独立阅读理解估计。作者据此认为框架在流程上可行，但现有数据不足以确立动机或理解上的收益。

papers.title: The new constructionism. Papert after Peirce: indexicality, navigational thinking, and learning in the age of generative AI
papers.authors: Ilya Levin, Alexei Semenov, Mikael Gorsky
papers.abstract: The arrival of generative AI in every classroom has produced a crisis that is at once technological, epistemological, and pedagogical. We argue that the appropriate response is neither prohibition nor naive adoption, but a principled reconstruction of constructionism for a computational environment that is generative, context-sensitive, and dialogically accessible. Drawing on Peircean semiotics, Papertian constructionism, Polanyi's epistemology, and contemporary neural-network research, we develop a programmatic framework we call the New Constructionism. We make four connected contributions. First, we argue that generative AI introduces an indexical mode of computation: its relation to the empirical world may be direct, mediated, or incomplete, but in a situated human–AI configuration meaning is operationally conditioned by conversational history, artifacts, tools, observations, and action. Second, we introduce a three-dimensional analytical space — semiotic, psycho-epistemological, and pedagogical — in which learning paradigms can be located and compared. Third, we reinterpret the history of programming education as a movement from a predominantly symbolic environment toward a hybrid ecology in which symbolic execution, distributional generation, and situated reference coexist. This hybridity qualifies but does not cancel the indexical turn at the level of interaction and educational practice. Fourth, we articulate three transformations: from “object to think with” to “agent to think with”; from rule-first instruction to abductively initiated inquiry coordinating abduction, induction, and deduction; and from bricolage to artistic navigation. Navigational thinking has logical priority while the relevant problem space remains unstabilized, although it interleaves recursively with computational thinking as inquiry develops. The paper is conceptual rather than empirical: it advances a theoretical account intended to orient subsequent developmental research and pedagogical realization.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性理论文章，针对生成式人工智能进入课堂所引发的技术与认识论危机，提出应重构而非禁止或盲目采纳建构主义。作者借助皮尔士符号学、派珀特建构主义、波兰尼认识论及当代神经网络研究，提出“新建构主义”框架，主张生成式AI带来一种索引式计算模式，并构建符号学、心理认识论与教学法三维分析空间，将编程教育史重释为从符号环境走向符号执行、分布生成与情境指涉共存的混合生态。文章进一步提出从“思考的对象”到“思考的智能体”、从规则先行到溯因引导的探究、从拼凑到艺术性导航的三重转变，并指出导航思维在问题空间尚未稳定时具有逻辑优先性，但与计算思维递归交织。这些结论属于理论构想，尚待后续实证研究检验。

papers.title: Augmentation or erosion? Artificial intelligence and the transformation of clinical reasoning: a critical narrative review
papers.authors: José Daniel Sánchez
papers.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are used to support diagnosis, but a model’s accuracy does not establish that clinicians reason more accurately when they use it. This review appraises how AI decision support and large language models affect physicians’ diagnostic performance and the risks of relying on them. Methods This critical narrative review follows the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles. Scopus, PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO and LILACS were searched in July and August 2026 in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Eligible studies, published from 2015 onward, compared AI-assisted with unassisted clinicians, measured reliance on AI or unassisted performance after exposure to it, or externally validated deployed models. A single author selected sources purposively. Nine primary studies were appraised with an adapted Critical Appraisal Skills Programme framework. Results In randomized trials of perceptual tasks, AI support improved detection. In the MASAI mammography screening trial, cancer detection rose from 5.0 to 6.4 per 1,000 women, reading workload fell by 44%, and the interval-cancer rate was non-inferior. In colonoscopy, computer-aided detection raised the adenoma detection rate from 40.4% to 54.8%. In the only randomized trial of open-ended diagnostic reasoning, access to GPT-4 did not improve physicians’ scores (76% vs. 74%; P = .60 ), although the model alone scored 92%. Evidence of harm came from smaller or non-randomized studies: reader accuracy fell sharply when AI suggestions were incorrect or the AI missed a cancer; physicians trained in AI literacy were still misled by erroneous model advice; unassisted adenoma detection fell from 28.4% to 22.4% after routine AI use in one pre–post study; and a deployed sepsis model discriminated poorly on external validation (area under the curve 0.63). No eligible study from Latin America was identified. Conclusions In the studies reviewed, AI assistance improved clinician performance in bounded detection tasks but not in open-ended diagnostic reasoning, where evidence is limited to one vignette-based trial. The evidence that reliance on AI can impair performance comes from single or design-limited studies and does not establish how large or lasting such effects are. Benefit therefore cannot be inferred from model accuracy alone; assisted and unassisted clinician performance should be measured directly.
papers.summary_zh: 该批判性叙述综述考察AI决策支持与大语言模型如何影响医生的诊断表现及依赖风险，检索并评估了比较AI辅助与无辅助临床医生的研究。综述发现，在有明确边界的感知与检测任务中，AI辅助可提升表现，如乳腺筛查和结肠镜检查；但在开放式诊断推理中，唯一随机试验显示可及GPT-4并未改善医生得分，而模型单独得分更高。关于依赖AI可能损害表现（如错误建议误导判读、停用后无辅助检测下降、外部验证区分度差）的证据来自单项或设计受限研究，尚不能确定影响大小与持续性；作者据此强调不能仅凭模型准确率推断临床获益，应直接测量辅助与无辅助下的医生表现。

papers.title: AI-guided mobile health integrated with physical education improves physical activity and psychophysiological outcomes in university students: a randomized controlled trial protocol
papers.authors: Hongli Yu, Gang Xu, Xia Li, Guangwen Song, Mingmao Li, Guoping Qian, Zbigniew Marcin Ossowski, Anna Szumilewicz
papers.abstract: Background Physical inactivity among university students represents a growing global health concern, contributing to the onset of non-communicable diseases and poor physical fitness. Despite advances in mobile health (mHealth) technologies, few interventions have been effectively integrated into formal physical education curricula. The Dreamer® application was developed to address this gap by combining artificial intelligence (AI)-guided personalization with teacher-supported engagement. Methods This randomized controlled trial aims to assess the effectiveness of Dreamer® in improving physical activity levels, health-related fitness, and psychological well-being among university students. A total of 128 participants will be randomly allocated to either an intervention group using Dreamer® integrated into PE instruction or a control group receiving standard PE. Assessments occur at baseline, 16 weeks, 32 weeks, and 3-month follow-up. Outcomes include physical activity, physical fitness, psychological health, and app usability. Discussion: This study will be among the first to evaluate an AI-supported, teacher-supervised mHealth intervention embedded in a university PE curriculum. The findings will inform the design of scalable digital health strategies that bridge technology and pedagogy in higher education. Clinical Trial Registration https://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.html?proj=284314 , identifier ChiCTR2600133726.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一项随机对照试验方案，旨在评估将人工智能引导的移动健康应用Dreamer®融入大学体育课程后，对学生身体活动、健康相关体适能和心理福祉的影响。研究拟将参与者随机分为使用该应用的干预组和接受标准体育教学的对照组，并在多个时间点进行追踪评估。作为较早将AI支持、教师监督的移动健康干预嵌入高校体育课程的研究之一，其预期结果将为高等教育中连接技术与教学的可扩展数字健康策略设计提供参考；由于目前仅为试验方案，实际效果尚待验证。

papers.title: The challenges that face the Saudi media in the age of artificial intelligence
papers.authors: Umhani Eltayeb, Abdulla Ebrahim Altaher
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) on the international level is reshaping media production, distribution, audience engagement, and organizational practices. The integration of AI into the media sector in Saudi Arabia is developing within a broader national digital transformation associated with Vision 2030. However, the availability of AI technologies does not necessarily translate into uniform or sustainable organizational adoption. In this study the emerging integration of AI within the Saudi media sector is examined by critically synthesizing existing academic literature and publicly available evidence. The analysis focuses on five interconnected dimensions: patterns of AI adoption, major areas of application, organizational and technological barriers, governance and ethical considerations, and anticipated media and organizational outcomes. The findings of the study indicate that AI offers significant opportunities for content creation, automation of routine tasks, audience analysis and improved production efficiency. However, the integration of AI in the Saudi media sector remains uneven as it is influenced by organizational readiness, infrastructure, financial resources and technical expertise, as well as by Arabic-language capabilities, and strategic preparedness. The Saudi context demonstrates that national investment in AI and digital infrastructure can create enabling conditions for media transformation, but such investment does not necessarily result in consistent adoption across media organizations. The study therefore proposes an integrated analytical perspective that connects technological adoption with organizational capacity, media-specific applications, linguistic and cultural localization, and governance and professional responsibility.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以批判性文献综述的方式，考察沙特媒体在人工智能时代面临的整合挑战，围绕应用模式、主要应用领域、组织与技术障碍、治理与伦理以及预期影响五个相互关联的维度展开分析。综述指出，人工智能为内容生产、常规任务自动化、受众分析和生产效率提升带来明显机会，但沙特媒体对人工智能的采用并不均衡，受组织准备度、基础设施、资金、技术专长、阿拉伯语能力与战略准备等因素影响。文章据此提出一个整合视角，将技术采用与组织能力、媒体特定应用、语言文化本地化及治理责任联系起来，并强调国家层面的投资可创造有利条件，却未必带来各媒体机构的一致采用。

papers.title: From daguerreotype to deepfake: a layered model of visual trust in AI-era photojournalism
papers.authors: Francisco Javier Ruíz San Miguel, Ángel Torres-Toukoumidis, Mónica Hinojosa-Becerra, Isidro Marín-Gutiérrez
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence does more than make image fabrication cheaper and more realistic: it destabilizes the conditions under which photographs are accepted or rejected as journalistic evidence. This conceptual article asks how visual trust should be understood when synthetic images can be mistaken for records of real events and authentic photographs can be dismissed as artificial-intelligence outputs. Drawing on photography theory, journalism studies, visual-misinformation research, media-trust research, and digital-provenance scholarship, the article distinguishes veracity, authenticity, provenance, credibility, and trust and proposes the Layered Visual Trust Model (LVTM) as an integrative diagnostic framework rather than an empirically validated theory. The LVTM links five interdependent layers: referential relation, production process, provenance and traceability, institutional warrant, and audience interpretation. A structured maximum-contrast comparison of the 2023 synthetic images depicting Donald Trump being arrested and the 2024 false claim that an authentic Harris-Walz rally photograph was AI-generated illustrates two hypothesized failure pathways: false acceptance and false rejection. The article also evaluates C2PA Content Credentials, camera-based provenance, professional rules, and European Union transparency obligations.
