Because the model and its propositions have not yet been empirically tested, claims are limited to conceptual and diagnostic utility. The analysis suggests that provenance can reduce uncertainty but cannot establish semantic veracity by itself; visual trust is more plausibly supported when technical traceability, editorial verification, institutional accountability, contextual explanation, and audience-facing media literacy operate together.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，追问当合成图像可被误认为真实事件记录、真实照片也可能被斥为AI生成时，视觉信任应如何理解。作者区分真实性、本真性、来源、可信度与信任等概念，提出分层视觉信任模型，将指涉关系、生产过程、来源与可追溯性、制度担保和受众解读五层联系起来，并通过对比两起合成图像与误判真实照片的案例，说明误接受与误拒绝两条假设性失效路径。文章据此评估内容凭证、相机来源、职业规范与透明度义务，强调来源信息能降低不确定性但本身不能确立语义真实性，视觉信任更可能依赖技术追溯、编辑核实、机构问责、语境解释与受众媒介素养的共同作用；由于模型尚未经实证检验，其主张限于概念与诊断用途。

papers.title: Comparing teacher-made and AI-assisted teaching videos for thyroid eye disease: an exploratory study
papers.authors: Shu Liu, Yue Wang, Yuqing Chen, Yunyun Chang, Ying Wang, Yu Gao, Ruili Wei
papers.journal: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology
papers.abstract: Background Thyroid eye disease (TED), together with its acute and vision-threatening complication, dysthyroid optic neuropathy (DON), requires timely diagnosis and intervention. The limited availability of specialists in orbital diseases poses a significant challenge to ophthalmology residency training. In this context, generative artificial intelligence (AI) has created new opportunities for medical education, though its effectiveness in ophthalmology training remains to be explored. Objective This exploratory study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in ophthalmology education, focusing on TED domains. Methods The 46 residents (28 general residents and 18 ophthalmology residents) were randomly assigned to either an AI-assisted or a teacher-made 5-min teaching video on TED. All participants then completed three tests through online questionnaire experiments, each consisting of 20-item clinical questions about TED. Test 1 served as a baseline assessment of disease knowledge, Test 2 was conducted 5 min after learning to evaluate short-term learning outcomes, along with a questionnaire survey about AI tools, and Test 3 was administered 1 week later to assess long-term learning outcome. Results Viewing the AI-assisted video significantly improved test scores from baseline to 5 min (mean difference = 13.04; p = 0.004), but the improvement was not sustained at 1 week (mean difference = 7.61; p = 0.16). Completion time also decreased significantly from baseline to both 5 min (p = 0.009; GMR = 0.57) and 1 week (p < 0.001; GMR = 0.45). No significant differences were observed between the AI-assisted and teacher-made video groups across all assessments (all p > 0.05). Additionally, learning experience was positively correlated with learning outcome (r = 0.60; P < 0.001). Conclusion Our findings suggested that the AI-assisted and teacher-made videos for TED education showed no statistically significant difference. However, substantial expert oversight was required, and the AI-assisted workflow did not reduce total production time in this study. Given the limited long-term retention, such AI-assisted videos may be better positioned as supplementary resources combined with human expertise.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究比较了生成式人工智能辅助制作的视频与教师自制视频在甲状腺眼病教学中的效果，将住院医师随机分配到两种5分钟教学视频条件下，并通过基线、学习后5分钟和1周后的测试评估学习表现。结果显示，AI辅助视频组从基线到学习后5分钟的测试成绩显著提升，但这一提升在1周后未能持续；两组在所有评估中均无显著差异，学习体验与学习结果呈正相关。作者据此指出，AI辅助视频与教师自制视频的教学效果未见统计学差异，但AI制作流程仍需大量专家监督且未缩短总制作时间，加之长期保持有限，此类视频更适合作为结合人类专业知识的补充资源。

papers.title: Operational Readiness for AI Driven Learning: Examining the Inter-play of Self-Assessed Competence, Usage Patterns and Trust
papers.authors: Leonore Negt, Marie Rathmann
papers.abstract: Since the release of generative AI systems in autumn 2022, AI use in academic contexts has gained relevance worldwide. Developing AI-related competencies has emerged as an educational task within the field of learning technologies aimed at enhancing learning outcomes. Against this background, the DigiTaKS*-project investigates how usage patterns, trust in AI, and self-assessed AI compe-tencies are interrelated and how these factors influence students’ operational readiness to integrate AI-driven applications into their learning processes. We frame this presented approach as an idea that can be adapted to different regions and educational systems. This contribution presents findings from a questionnaire study conducted among bachelor’s students in Humanities and Social Sciences at a German university (N = 70). Results indicate that usage, trust, and self-assessed AI competence are closely intertwined and significantly predict opera-tional readiness to integrate AI into academic learning processes. These findings highlight the need for structured educational approaches that systematically foster these interrelated dimensions. In response, the Open Educational Resource (OER) “ComDigiS*” was developed within the project DigiTaKS* to systematically promote reflective, competence-oriented, and equitable AI integration in academic contexts. It conceptualizes AI as a form of machine intelligence and supports in-teracting with AI across different cognitive levels from understanding and apply-ing to critically reflecting thereby fostering a holistic set of AI-use competencies for students. However, the paper presents student AI practices based on ques-tionnaire results and the Open Educational Resource ComDigiS* for promoting (AI) competence development. Grounded in a European setting, the study pro-poses an approach intended for context-sensitive adaptation across diverse edu-cational systems. While the study is grounded in a European higher-education context, it explicitly acknowledges the situatedness of its concepts. This opens a perspective on how the proposed heuristic can be adapted to diverse educational settings across regions, such as educational contexts across the African conti-nent.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大学生将AI驱动应用整合进学习过程的“操作准备度”，考察使用模式、对AI的信任与自评AI能力之间的相互关系。作者对德国一所大学人文与社会科学专业的本科生开展问卷调查，发现这三者紧密交织，并显著预测学生的操作准备度。基于此，研究团队开发了开放教育资源ComDigiS*，将AI理解为一种机器智能，支持学生从理解、应用到批判反思等不同认知层次与AI互动，以系统培养AI使用能力。文章强调需要结构化的教育方案来促进这些相互关联的维度，并说明其结论基于欧洲高等教育情境，所提框架需结合各地教育系统进行情境化调整。

papers.title: PROACTIVE DIGITAL MARKETING OF EDUCATIONAL SERVICES
papers.authors: Margaryta Boiko, Myroslava Bosovska, Liudmyla Romanchuk
papers.abstract: The relevance of this study is driven by the transformation of digital marketing in higher education under the influence of advances in artificial intelligence, data analytics, digital plat­forms, and increasing competition among univer­sities to attract and retain students. The study is based on the hypothesis that the effecti­veness of proactive digital marketing is ensured by the synergy of forecasting, personalization, moni­toring, automation, and managerial decision-sup­port mechanisms, whose interconnected functio­ning is enabled by the integrative role of artificial intelligence. The methodological framework is based on systemic, structural-logical, comparative, and conceptual approaches. The study employs methods of scientific generalization and systematization, comparative analysis, content analysis of the practices adopted by leading universities worldwide, conceptual modelling, and graphical visualization. The findings conceptualize proactive digital marketing of educational services as an integrated stakeholder engagement mana­gement system based on the proactive identifi­cation of stakeholder needs, behavioral prediction, personalized digital engagement, monitoring of studentsʼ learning pathways, communication automation, and information-analytical support for managerial decision-making. The study demon­strates that the effectiveness of proactive digital marketing depends not on the number of imple­mented digital technologies but on the degree of integration, coherence, and synergy among its managerial mechanisms. A managerial mecha­nism synergy function and an artificial intelligence integration function are proposed, whose interaction explains the transition from a reactive to a proactive digital marketing model. Artificial intelligence is identified as a systemic integrator of forecasting, personalization, monitoring, automa­tion, and managerial decision-support mecha­nisms within a unified management cycle. The practical signifi­cance of the research lies in the applicability of the proposed conceptual frame­work to the development of universitiesʼ digital marketing strategies, the assessment of digital maturity and organizational readiness for artificial intelligence implementation, and the further development of an integrated index for assessing proactive digital marketing in higher education institutions.

papers.title: AI TOKENS IN THE CRYPTO ECOSYSTEM
papers.authors: Anatoliі Mazaraki, Світлана Василівна Волосович
papers.abstract: The development of artificial intelligence contributes to its integration into the crypto ecosystem. This creates opportunities for impro­ving automation projects in various fields using artificial intelligence algorithms and models based on their decentralization. The study hypothesized that artificial intelligence tokens are a significant component of the crypto ecosystem, which contri­butes, on the one hand, to expanding the circle of its participants and areas of coverage, and on the other hand, to transforming the spheres of human activity where they are used. To test the hypothesis, the stages of AI token evolution and factors influencing the development of AI tokens were systematized, the elements of the crypto ecosystem were clarified, the possibilities for using AI tokens in various fields were systematized, threats and opportunities for the development of AI tokens were identified, the prospects for the development of AI tokens, and the concept of AI tokens was clarified. To test hypothesis the following methods were used: historical, systemic, graphic, swot-analiz. Statis­tical data from CoinMarketCap, Statista and Kraken were used. Functional, design, and technological approaches to understanding arti­ficial intelligence tokens have been clarified. The following stages of the evolution of artificial intelligence tokens have been identified: emer­gence, improvement, and boom. Technological, economic, legal, and energy factors influencing the development of artificial intelligence tokens have been identified. The possibilities of using artificial intelligence tokens in various areas were identified. The strengths and weaknesses of artificial intelligence tokens, threats and opportunities for their development have been identified. The educational, communication, operational, mana­gement, and stimulating functions of artificial intelligence tokens were first identified in the scientific literature. The scientific novelty is formu­lated definition of artificial intelligence tokens as an element of the crypto ecosystem that ensures the functioning of decentralized artificial intelligence platforms and provides users with the ability to automate their operational activities, facilitate transactions, and stimulate and manage the development of artificial intelligence
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以CoinMarketCap、Statista和Kraken的统计数据为基础，结合历史、系统、图示和SWOT分析等方法，考察人工智能代币在加密生态系统中的地位与作用。作者梳理了AI代币从出现、改进到繁荣的演化阶段，识别出技术、经济、法律和能源等影响因素，并系统整理了其在各领域的应用可能及优势、劣势、威胁与机会。文章首次在学术文献中提出AI代币具有教育、沟通、运营、管理和激励等功能，并将其界定为支撑去中心化人工智能平台运行、帮助用户自动化操作、便利交易并激励和管理AI发展的加密生态要素。上述判断主要基于对现有数据和文献的系统梳理，而非实证检验。

papers.title: Beyond Human-in-the-Loop: Verification-by-Design for Generative AI-Assisted Research Data Analysis
papers.authors: Michael Pin-Chuan Lin
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used to extract, classify, code, summarize, and synthesize textual research data. Existing guidance emphasizes transparency and human oversight but offers limited direction on how verification should vary across analytic tasks. This perspective argues that human-in-the-loop is a principle, not an operational method. We propose verification-by-design, a prespecified and iterative approach in which research teams bound GenAI’s role, calibrate task risk, preserve an audit trail, cross-check outputs, apply escalation or exclusion rules, disclose AI’s influence, and retain responsibility for final judgments. These requirements form TRACE-DA: Task bounding, Risk calibration, Audit trail, Cross-checking, Escalation and exclusion, Disclosure, and Accountability. Its central proposition is that verification intensity should increase with interpretive weight, data sensitivity, consequences of error, and available evidence of tool performance; verification findings may also trigger redesign. TRACE-DA provides a provisional basis for evaluating accuracy, residual error, verification burden, auditability, reproducibility, and stability across tools and contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇观点论文，讨论生成式人工智能用于研究文本数据分析时，验证应如何随任务变化。作者指出，人在回路只是原则而非可操作方法，并提出“设计即验证”框架TRACE-DA，涵盖任务界定、风险校准、审计留痕、交叉核对、升级与排除规则、披露和问责。其核心主张是验证强度应随解释权重、数据敏感性、错误后果和工具性能证据而提高，验证发现也可反过来触发设计调整。该框架为评估准确性、残余误差、验证负担、可审计性、可复现性及跨工具情境的稳定性提供了初步基础。

papers.title: AI-Based Cognitive Scaffolding and Academic Writing Performance among EFL Students
papers.authors: Lam Quoc Huy, Dung Nguyen Tien
papers.journal: Journal of English Language and Education
papers.abstract: Academic writing is a core competence for learners of English as a foreign language (EFL), yet it remains one of the most demanding skills because it requires the simultaneous integration of content development, idea organization, and linguistic accuracy. Many EFL students consequently devote disproportionate cognitive resources to lower-level language concerns, which may hinder higher-order processes such as coherence building and argument development. Drawing on sociocultural perspectives on cognitive scaffolding and the growing capacity of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to deliver immediate, individualized support, this study investigated whether AI-based cognitive scaffolding could enhance EFL students’ academic writing outcomes and whether such effects generalized across different dimensions of writing performance. A quasi-experimental pretest–posttest design was employed over 14 weeks with 53 first-year non-language-major students at a public university in Vietnam. Students’ writing performance was compared between a group that received AI-based scaffolding and a group that received conventional instruction. The findings showed that AI-mediated scaffolding produced a significant improvement in the experimental group’s overall academic writing performance (gain Δ = 0.81) compared with the control group (gain Δ = 0.55). However, the benefits were selective and domain-specific rather than uniform: the intervention markedly enhanced idea generation and language-related performance but had limited impact on organizational structure and content elaboration. These findings highlight both the strengths and the limitations of AI tools in EFL writing instruction and suggest that AI is most effective when embedded in an integrated pedagogy that combines technological scaffolds with explicit teaching and guided support to address higher-order writing demands.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察基于人工智能的认知支架能否提升英语作为外语学生的学术写作表现，以及这种效果是否在不同写作维度上普遍成立。研究采用准实验前后测设计，比较接受AI支架与常规教学的两组学生在学术写作上的变化，发现AI支架组整体写作表现的提升幅度大于对照组，但收益具有选择性：构思生成和语言相关表现改善明显，而组织结构与内容阐发方面影响有限。作者据此指出，AI工具在英语写作教学中有其优势也有局限，将其与显性教学和引导性支持相结合的综合教学法，才更可能兼顾高阶写作需求。

papers.title: Exposure of Disclosure: Mitigating Wrongful Convictions
papers.authors: Andrew Clarke
papers.abstract: The Crown’s duty of disclosure is a cornerstone of Canadian criminal procedure and a central safeguard against wrongful conviction. Since R. v. Stinchcombe, disclosure has been constitutionalized as an incident of the accused’s right to make full answer and defence, requiring the timely production of all relevant material subject only to recognized privileges. Despite the doctrinal clarity of this obligation, disclosure failures remain a recurring feature of Canadian wrongful conviction cases. Public inquiries and comparative experience reveal that these failures rarely arise from doctrinal uncertainty or deliberate misconduct alone, but from structural and epistemic limitations embedded within modern criminal justice systems. This paper argues that contemporary disclosure regimes are increasingly misaligned with the evidentiary environments they are tasked to govern. Exceptions to disclosure—including informer privilege, prosecutorial discretion, third-party record frameworks, and public-interest immunity—are justified in principle, yet they create zones of opacity where relevance must be assessed before information can be meaningfully examined. As criminal cases grow more complex and data-intensive, early and static relevance assessments become fragile, heightening the risk that material evidence remains unseen or untested until corrective mechanisms are no longer effective. Drawing on Canadian doctrine, wrongful conviction inquiries, and comparative analysis of the American Brady regime and the United Kingdom’s CPIA framework, the paper identifies a shared structural vulnerability across jurisdictions. It then examines whether carefully constrained AI-assisted disclosure tools, deployed as auditing and verification mechanisms rather than decision-makers, could reinforce the Crown’s continuing duty to disclose. The paper concludes that, if institutionally designed with transparency, auditability, and constitutional accountability, such tools may reduce epistemic blind spots without displacing prosecutorial judgment or undermining fair-trial rights.
papers.summary_zh: 该文关注加拿大刑事程序中披露义务虽已宪法化、却仍反复导致错误定罪的问题，属于结合判例、错案调查与比较分析的理论论文。作者指出，披露失败往往并非仅源于教义不清或故意不当行为，而是源于现代刑事司法系统内的结构与认知局限：披露例外在原则上合理，却制造了须先判断相关性才能审视信息的模糊地带，而案件日益复杂、数据密集使早期静态的相关性判断变得脆弱。文章据此讨论，经严格约束、仅作审计与核验而非决策者的AI辅助披露工具，在具备透明性、可审计性与宪法问责的制度设计下，或可减少认知盲区，而不取代检察官判断或损害公正审判权。

papers.title: Typology of the Labor Orientation of Student Youth in the Context of Labor Market Transformation
papers.authors: Касаткина Наталья Петровна, Natalya V. Shumkova
papers.journal: Humanities and Social Sciences Bulletin of the Financial University
papers.abstract: Introduction. In the context of uncertainty in the contemporary labour market, driven by shifting trends, automation, the introduction of artificial intelligence, and the growth of platform employment, young people demonstrate various adaptation strategies: from proactive career planning to reactive behaviour and rejection of purposeful actions. Particular attention is paid to the student cohort as a group in a transitional status, when labour attitudes are only being formed and subsequently determine the success of entering the labour market. Purpose. This study aims to construct a typology of students’ labour orientations. Methods. The empirical data come from a survey of university students conducted in October–November 2024 across four Russian regions (n = 933 after data cleaning). Factor analysis (PCA with Varimax rotation) was used to identify latent dimensions of labour attitudes. The typology was constructed using cluster analysis: the number of clusters was determined by hierarchical Ward’s method, and the final clustering was performed with k-means. Results. Three latent dimensions of labour attitudes were identified: instrumental motivation and labour pragmatism, professional orientation and engagement, and self-employment and entrepreneurial orientation. Based on these, four student types were distinguished. “Innovators” (19%) score high on all three factors; this group is predominantly male, enrolled in engineering programmes, and characterised by high income, optimism, and a propensity for migration.“Conformists” (33%) combine high professional motivation with low instrumental concerns; they report the highest fulfilment of educational plans, minimal financial anxiety, and low migration intentions. “Ritualists” (31%) show reduced entrepreneurial and professional orientation; they are predominantly medical students facing financial instability and holding pessimistic expectations. “Retreatists” (17%) exhibit very low professional and entrepreneurial motivation. They demonstrate the lowest level of fulfilment of educational plans, report low subjective well-being, and are frequently engaged in secondary employment outside their field of study. Conclusions. Students’ labour orientations are not limited to the dichotomy of professional employment versus complete withdrawal from the labour market. Instead, they encompass both proactive strategies — such as entrepreneurship — and defensive ones, including wait-and-see behaviour and avoidance of active choice. The typology aligns with existing literature highlighting the growing uncertainty in youth trajectories and the differentiating effect of parental family resources. Future research should explore the stability of these types as graduates transition into the labour market and examine how labour orientations translate into actual career trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于2024年秋对俄罗斯四个地区高校学生的调查数据，采用因子分析与聚类分析，旨在构建学生劳动取向的类型学。分析识别出工具性动机与劳动实用主义、职业取向与投入、自雇与创业取向三个潜在维度，并据此划分出四类学生：创新者、顺从者、仪式主义者和退缩者，各类型在动机结构、教育计划实现程度、经济焦虑与移民意向上呈现差异。作者据此指出，学生的劳动取向并非局限于专业就业与退出劳动力市场之间的二元对立，而是同时包含创业等主动策略与观望、回避选择等防御性策略，且与青年轨迹不确定性及家庭资源的分化作用相关；这些类型的稳定性及其向实际职业轨迹的转化尚待后续研究检验。

papers.title: Assessment of perceived stress levels among professionally active patients with spinal pain undergoing rehabilitation at an occupational medicine centre – a pilot study
papers.authors: Tomasz Wójcik, Marek Grabski, Agnieszka Strzelecka, Roman Starz, Jaroslaw Piotr Chmielewski, Agnieszka Buczaj, Maria Pąchalska
papers.journal: Annals of Agricultural and Environmental Medicine
papers.abstract: Introduction and Objective.Spinal pain is common among professionally active people, and stress may be associated with pain severity and functional limitations.The aim of the study is to assess perceived stress and its associations with pain severity, functional disability, age, BMI, and broad occupational categories in patients undergoing rehabilitation for spinal pain.Materials and Method.This pilot cross-sectional study included 166 patients undergoing rehabilitation at the Provincial Occupational Medicine Centre in Kielce (133 women, 33 men; age 28-65 years).PSS-10, Laitinen scale, ODI, and NDI were used.Analyses included the Mann-Whitney U, χ², Kruskal-Wallis, and Spearman's rho tests.The Benjamini-Hochberg correction was applied to nine correlations.Results.The mean PSS-10 score was 18.81±6.67(95% CI: 17.78-19.83),and the median sten score was 6 (Q1-Q3: 5-8).Work type did not differentiate stress (p=0.913).Before correction, PSS correlated with the Laitinen score (rho=0.156;p=0.045) and NDI (rho=0.266;p=0.001).After correction, only the PSS-NDI association remained significant (q=0.005),including among women (rho=0.282;q=0.005).Conclusions.Perceived stress was average in this single-centre rehabilitation sample.The PSS-NDI relationship was the only association that remained significant after correction.Given the pilot cross-sectional design and unequal subgroup sizes, the findings are exploratory and require confirmation in larger studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注接受脊柱疼痛康复的在职患者，考察其感知压力水平及压力与疼痛严重程度、功能障碍、年龄、BMI和职业类别之间的关联。作者在单一职业医学中心开展横断面预试验，纳入166名康复患者，使用PSS-10、Laitinen量表、ODI和NDI进行测量。结果显示，该样本的感知压力处于中等水平，工作类型未显示与压力存在差异；校正前压力与Laitinen评分和NDI相关，但校正后仅压力与NDI的关联仍显著，且在女性中同样成立。作者据此指出，这一关联是唯一在校正后保持显著的结果，但受横断面预试验设计和亚组样本量不均的限制，结论仍属探索性，需在更大规模研究中验证。

papers.title: РАЗРАБОТКА И ПСИХОМЕТРИЧЕСКАЯ ПРОВЕРКА МЕТОДИКИ ДИАГНОСТИКИ СУБЪЕКТНОСТИ ПРЕПОДАВАТЕЛЯ ВО ВЗАИМОДЕЙСТВИИ С ИСКУССТВЕННЫМ ИНТЕЛЛЕКТОМ
papers.authors: Sergey M. Grigoriev
papers.abstract: Актуальность. Использование генеративного искусственного интеллекта (ИИ) в профессиональной деятельности преподавателя высшей школы ставит вопрос о сохранении авторской позиции, содержательного контроля и ответственности. Существующие инструменты оценивают цифровую компетентность, отношение к технологии или частоту её использования, но не субъектную позицию преподавателя. Цель. Разработка и психометрическая проверка методики диагностики субъектности преподавателя во взаимодействии с ИИ (СП ИИ). Методы. Исследование включало четыре этапа: экспертную оценку содержания (10 экспертов), когнитивные интервью (16 преподавателей), пилотаж (N = 96, из них 86 протоколов пригодны для анализа опросника) и основную психометрическую проверку на выборке 432 преподавателей высшей школы из 6 вузов (N = 389 протоколов пригодны для анализа опросника). Конфирматорный факторный анализ (CFA) проводился методом взвешенных наименьших квадратов с поправкой на среднее и дисперсию (WLSMV), рекомендованным для порядковых данных. Ответы «Н» и «?» рассматривались как структурно отсутствующие данные и исключались попарно на уровне расчёта шкал и анализа. Использовались анализ внутренней согласованности, IRT-анализ (модель градуированных ответов), проверка инвариантности измерения, конвергентной и дивергентной валидности. Результаты. Подтверждена пятифакторная структура методики (ЦА – смысловое целеполагание и авторство; РФ – выбор и распределение функций; ОП – оценка и преобразование результата; РВ – регуляция взаимодействия; ОТ – ответственность): CFI = 0,95; TLI = 0,94; RMSEA = 0,046; SRMR = 0,060. Внутренняя согласованность шкал α = 0,81–0,84; ω = 0,82–0,85. Инвариантность измерения по профилю дисциплин и опыту использования ИИ подтверждена (ΔCFI ≤ 0,02; ΔRMSEA ≤ 0,003). Конвергентная валидность подтверждена связями с общей саморегуляцией (r = 0,46–0,52) и рефлексией (r = 0,48–0,55), дивергентная – слабыми связями с частотой использования ИИ (r = 0,06–0,17) и отношением к нему (r = -0,15–0,13); анализ валидности выполнен на подвыборке N = 68, что ограничивает мощность выводов. Выводы. Методика СП ИИ (версия 1.0) обладает удовлетворительными психометрическими свойствами и может использоваться в исследовательских целях для изучения субъектности преподавателя в условиях цифровой трансформации высшего образования. Авторам не удалось обнаружить валидизированных русскоязычных опросников, прямо направленных на диагностику субъектности преподавателя именно во взаимодействии с генеративным ИИ. Relevance. The use of generative artificial intelligence in the professional activity of higher education teachers raises the question of preserving authorial position, meaningful control over content, and responsibility for outcomes. Existing instruments assess digital competence, attitudes toward technology, or frequency of use, but do not capture the teacher’s agentic position. Objective. To develop and psychometrically validate an instrument for assessing teacher agency in interaction with artificial intelligence (TA AI). Methods. The study comprised four stages: expert content evaluation involving 10 experts, cognitive interviews with 16 teachers, a pilot study with N = 96, of which 86 protocols were suitable for questionnaire analysis, and the main psychometric validation conducted on a sample of 432 higher education teachers from 6 universities, of which N = 389 protocols were suitable for questionnaire analysis. Confirmatory factor analysis was performed using the weighted least squares mean and variance adjusted estimator, which is recommended for ordinal data. Responses coded as “N” and “?” were treated as structurally missing and excluded pairwise at the scale scoring and analysis stages. The study included analyses of internal consistency, item response theory using the graded response model, measurement invariance testing, and assessment of convergent and discriminant validity. Results. The five factor structure of the instrument was confirmed: semantic goal setting and authorship, selection and allocation of functions, evaluation and transformation of the output, regulation of interaction, and responsibility. Model fit indices indicated satisfactory fit: CFI = 0.95, TLI = 0.94, RMSEA = 0.046, SRMR = 0.060. Internal consistency was satisfactory across scales, with Cronbach’s alpha ranging from 0.81 to 0.84 and McDonald’s omega ranging from 0.82 to 0.85. Measurement invariance across disciplinary profile and AI use experience was supported, with ΔCFI ≤ 0.02 and ΔRMSEA ≤ 0.003. Convergent validity was supported by associations with general self regulation (r = 0.46 to 0.52) and reflection (r = 0.48 to 0.55). Discriminant validity was supported by weak associations with frequency of AI use (r = 0.06 to 0.17) and attitudes toward AI (r = -0.15 to 0.13). The validity analysis was conducted on a subsample of N = 68, which limits the statistical power of these conclusions. Conclusions. The TA AI instrument, version 1.0, demonstrates satisfactory psychometric properties and may be used for research purposes to examine teacher agency under conditions of the digital transformation of higher education. The authors were unable to identify any validated Russian language questionnaires specifically designed to assess teacher agency in interaction with generative artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对高校教师在与生成式人工智能互动中如何保持作者立场、内容控制与责任这一问题，开发并检验了“教师与AI互动主体性”（СП ИИ）测评工具，因为现有工具多测数字能力、技术态度或使用频率，未直接测主体性。作者通过专家内容评定、认知访谈、预试和正式心理测量检验，在高校教师样本中确认了五因子结构（意义目标设定与作者性、功能选择与分配、结果评估与转化、互动调节、责任），模型拟合可接受，各量表内部一致性良好，测量不变性在学科背景和AI使用经验上得到支持。效度方面，该工具与一般自我调节、反思呈中等相关，与AI使用频率和态度仅弱相关，但效度分析基于较小样本，结论统计效力有限。总体而言，该工具心理测量性质尚可，可用于研究目的，但作者未发现直接针对生成式AI互动中教师主体性的俄语验证问卷。

papers.title: АДАПТИВНО-ПЕРСОНИФИЦИРОВАННОЕ ЦИФРОВОЕ ОЦЕНИВАНИЕ В ВЫСШЕМ ТЕХНИЧЕСКОМ ОБРАЗОВАНИИ: ПОНЯТИЯ И ПРИЗНАКИ
papers.authors: Tatiana E. Smolentseva
papers.abstract: В данной статье рассматриваются ключевые аспекты оценки образовательных результатов студентов технических вузов в условиях цифровизации и многопоточного обучения. Актуальность исследования обусловлена значительным увеличением количества учебных потоков, расширением цифровых инструментов контроля и внедрением технологий искусственного интеллекта. В таких условиях традиционное одноформатное оценивание не позволяет в полной мере оценить достижения студентов и обеспечить своевременную обратную связь. Целью работы является обоснование и определение понятия адаптивно-персонифицированного цифрового оценивания, а также выделение его признаков и методологических основ. Методологическую базу исследования составляют терминологический анализ, направленный на определение содержания и объема понятия, систематизация и классификация признаков по критериям полноты, независимости и непротиворечивости, а также сравнительный анализ традиционной и адаптивно-персонифицированной моделей оценивания. В исследовании выявлены педагогические особенности технических вузов и особенности оценивания в зависимости от видов учебной деятельности. Четко определены различия между форматами оценивания: одноформатным, многоформатным и многоуровневым. Выделены четыре группы признаков, характеризующих адаптивно-персонифицированное цифровое оценивание: структурные, функциональные, процессуальные и технологические. На основе этих признаков сформулировано авторское определение адаптивно-персонифицированного цифрового оценивания как системно организованного процесса сбора, обработки и интерпретации мультимодальных данных об образовательных результатах. Особенностью данного подхода является непрерывная персонализированная обратная связь и интеллектуальное сопровождение индивидуальных траекторий в цифровой образовательной среде. В качестве методологических основ такого оценивания обоснованы системный, компетентностный, деятельностный и когнитивно-диагностический подходы. Результаты исследования могут быть использованы при разработке фондов оценочных средств, цифровых образовательных сред и программ повышения квалификации преподавателей технических вузов. This article examines key aspects of assessing the educational outcomes of students at technical universities under conditions of digitalization and multi-stream learning. The relevance of the study is driven by a significant increase in the number of student streams, the expansion of digital monitoring tools, and the introduction of artificial intelligence technologies. In such conditions, traditional single-format assessment does not fully allow for evaluating student achievements and ensuring timely feedback. This study aims to substantiate and define the concept of adaptive-personalized digital assessment, as well as to identify its features and methodological foundations. The methodological basis of the study comprises terminological analysis aimed at determining the content and scope of the concept, systematization and classification of features according to the criteria of completeness, independence, and consistency, as well as a comparative analysis of traditional and adaptive-personalized assessment models. The study identifies the pedagogical characteristics of technical universities and the specific features of assessment depending on the types of learning activity. The differences between assessment formats are clearly defined: single-format, multi-format, and multi-level. Four groups of features characterizing adaptive-personalized digital assessment are identified: structural, functional, procedural, and technological. On the basis of these features, the author formulates a definition of adaptive-personalized digital assessment as a systematically organized process of collecting, processing, and interpreting multimodal data on educational outcomes. A distinctive feature of this approach is continuous personalized feedback and intelligent support for individual learning trajectories in the digital educational environment. The systemic, competence-based, activity-based, and cognitive-diagnostic approaches are substantiated as the methodological foundations of such assessment. The results of the study can be used in developing assessment instrument banks, digital educational environments, and professional development programs for teachers at technical universities.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对数字化与多流教学背景下技术高校传统单一形式评价难以充分反映学生学业成果、难以及时反馈的问题，通过术语分析、特征分类和传统与自适应个性化评价模式的比较，界定自适应个性化数字评价的概念并提炼其标志性特征。作者区分单一形式、多形式与多层次评价，归纳出结构、功能、过程和技术四类特征，并将其界定为系统化收集、处理与解释多模态学业数据的过程，核心是持续个性化反馈和对个体学习路径的智能支持。文章还论证了系统、能力、活动与认知诊断等方法论基础，属于概念与理论探讨，未报告实证检验。

papers.title: ВОЗМОЖНЫЕ НЕГАТИВНЫЕ РИСКИ ДЛЯ ЗДОРОВЬЯ ОБУЧАЮЩИХСЯ ПРИ ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИИ ТЕХНОЛОГИЙ ИСКУССТВЕННОГО ИНТЕЛЛЕКТА И МЕРЫ ПО ИХ ПРЕДОТВРАЩЕНИЮ
papers.authors: А.Л. Димова
papers.abstract: В настоящее время для отечественного образования весьма актуальна проблема обеспечения безопасности здоровья обучающихся при активном использовании технологий искусственного интеллекта (ИИ), что связано с: выявлением негативных рисков для здоровья при использовании данных технологий; обоснованием мер по их нивелированию; разработкой научно-методического материала для подготовки педагогов в данной области. Цель статьи состоит в выявлении и систематизации основных групп специфических негативных рисков для здоровья обучающихся, связанных с использованием ИИ, а также в обосновании комплекса мер для их предотвращения в учебном процессе. Применялись следующие методы исследования:анализировались отечественные и зарубежные источники в области возможных негативных рисков для здоровья при использовании ИИ в образовательной деятельности и мер по их предотвращению; обобщались результаты собственных исследований в области предотвращения негативных последствий использования информационных и коммуникационных технологий (ИКТ) для здоровья обучающихся (ПНПЗО). В статье раскрыты основные группы негативных рисков для физического и психического здоровья, когнитивного развития и социальной адаптации обучающихся при использовании технологий ИИ, выявлены их специфические особенности. Особое внимание уделено специфическим негативным рискам для физического здоровья, а также мерам по их предотвращению. Подчеркивается, что систематизированный в рамках данного исследования научно-методический материал в дальнейшем может быть использован для разработки курсов повышения квалификации учителей и преподавателей в области обеспечения безопасности здоровья обучающихся при использовании технологий ИИ. Ensuring the health safety of students with the active use of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies is currently a highly pressing issue for domestic education. This issue involves: identifying negative health risks associated with the use of these technologies; substantiating measures to mitigate them; and developing scientific and methodological materials for training teachers in this area. The purpose of this article is to identify and systematize the main groups of specific negative risks to the health of students associated with the use of AI, as well as to substantiate a set of measures to prevent them in the educational process. The following research methods were used: analyzing domestic and foreign sources on possible negative health risks associated with the use of AI in educational activities and measures to prevent them; summarizing the results of our own research in the field of preventing the negative consequences of the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) for the health of students (PNZHO). The article discloses the main groups of negative risks to the physical and mental health, cognitive development and social adaptation of students when using AI technologies, and identifies their specific features. Particular attention is paid to specific negative risks to physical health. As well as measures to prevent them, it is emphasized that the scientific and methodological material systematized within this study can be used in the future to develop professional development courses for teachers and educators on ensuring student health safety when using AI technologies.
papers.summary_zh: 该文关注学生使用人工智能技术时可能面临的健康风险，并讨论相应的预防措施。作者通过分析国内外相关文献，并结合自身在信息通信技术健康风险预防方面的研究进行归纳，系统梳理了人工智能使用对学生在生理与心理健康、认知发展及社会适应方面的主要风险类别及其特点，其中对身体健康方面的特定风险及防范措施着墨较多。文章属于综述与理论梳理性质，未报告原始实证数据；作者强调所整理的材料可用于开发教师进修课程，以提升其在人工智能使用中保障学生健康安全的能力。

papers.title: Risk factors for prostate cancer incidence and the role of prostate- specific antigen and Gleason score as predictive markers
papers.authors: Fathia Gadri Jaat, Nadia Mohamed Kermani, Asma Faraj Bidos, Fadya Ramadan Shakhim
papers.abstract: Objectives: Prostate cancer (PCa) is the most commonly diagnosed malignancy among men worldwide and the fifth leading cause of cancer-related deaths in men. This study aimed to investigate the association between selected risk factors and prostate cancer and to evaluate prostate-specific antigen (PSA), haematological, and biochemical parameters as potential diagnostic markers. Material and Methods: This observational study was conducted at the National Cancer Institute, Sabratha, Libya, between January and October 2023. A total of 110 patients with histologically confirmed prostate cancer and 50 healthy controls were included. Demographic and clinical data were collected using structured questionnaires. Laboratory investigations included PSA levels and haematological parameters, while Gleason scores were obtained from medical records. Statistical analysis was performed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Results: The highest prevalence of prostate cancer was observed among patients aged 70–79 years (40.1%), followed by those aged 60–69 years (35.5%), while patients aged 50–59 years showed a lower prevalence (21.7%). Increasing age was significantly associated with a higher risk of prostate cancer. Most participants had a normal BMI (66.4%), while 22.7% were obese. Blood groups B + and O + showed the highest frequency (25.5%) among patients. Family history of prostate cancer was more common (50%) among patients with first-degree relatives, particularly among patients with PSA levels ≥14.4 ng/mL. Haematological analysis demonstrated significant reductions in red blood cell counts, haematocrit, and haemoglobin level among patients compared with controls, whereas mean corpuscular haemoglobin and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratios were significantly increased. Conclusion: The findings suggest that PSA and selected haematological and microbiological parameters may have diagnostic value in prostate cancer and could assist in disease evaluation and clinical assessment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在利比亚一家癌症机构开展观察性研究，比较前列腺癌患者与健康对照，考察年龄、家族史、血型、体质指数等风险因素与前列腺癌的关联，并评估前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）、血液学及生化指标作为诊断标志物的潜力。结果显示，前列腺癌在70至79岁人群中最为常见，年龄增长与患病风险升高相关；患者一级亲属中家族史比例较高，且在PSA水平较高者中更明显。与对照相比，患者的红细胞计数、血细胞比容和血红蛋白显著降低，而平均红细胞血红蛋白和血小板与淋巴细胞比值显著升高。作者据此认为PSA及部分血液学指标可能具有诊断参考价值，但作为观察性研究，相关发现属于关联而非因果，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Intelligent Academic Performance Forecasting using Integrated Machine Learning Models
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: In the era of data-driven education, unlocking hidden insights from student learning patterns holds the key to shaping the future of academic success.Accurate prediction of student performance is vital for improving educational standards and enabling proactive support for students at risk.Conventional prediction techniques frequently depend on single algorithms, which can be inadequate when handling the complexity and multidimensionality of educational datasets.This study introduces a novel hybrid machine learning framework that combines Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost to enhance both prediction accuracy and model reliability.By merging the parallel bagging capability of RF with the sequential boosting proficiency of XGBoost, the framework addresses typical shortcomings of opaque models and minimizes variance in individual predictions.The evaluation leverages established benchmark datasets, namely the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) and the Chinese University Dataset (CUD), to assess performance across a broad array of variables, such as demographic data, online learning activities, and previous academic achievements.This methodology directly tackles crucial technical obstacles, including class imbalance and feature significance, which commonly impede effective outcome prediction.The integration of these ensemble methods is intended to equip educators with a dependable early warning system, supporting tailored instructional materials and efficient resource distribution.Additionally, the framework's effectiveness is assessed using various metrics Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F-Measure to provide a thorough evaluation of its predictive capabilities.This research advances the domain of educational data mining by highlighting the enhanced effectiveness of integrated models in early identification of pivotal student outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对单一算法难以处理教育数据复杂性的问题，提出一种融合随机森林与XGBoost的混合机器学习框架，并在OULAD和CUD两个基准数据集上评估其预测学生学业表现的能力。框架结合了随机森林的并行装袋与XGBoost的序列提升，旨在提高预测准确性与可靠性，同时应对类别不平衡和特征重要性等技术难点。结果表明，这种集成方式在准确率、精确率、召回率和F值等指标上提供了较全面的预测评估，作者据此认为集成模型有助于构建学生学业结果的早期预警系统，支持个性化教学与资源分配；但摘要未报告具体性能数值，相关效果仍需结合完整结果判断。

papers.title: Synergizing AI: A Cross-Sectoral Framework for Learning Systems in Health and Academia
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: The rapid emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) is reshaping how educational and clinical institutions approach teaching, learning, decision support, and knowledge dissemination.This paper systematically reviews literature published between 2020 and 2025 on LLMs in higher education, then extends the analysis through a cross-sectoral framework to healthcare, where similar dynamics of personalisation, automation, and ethical risk are unfolding.In higher education, three dominant themes emerge: enhanced personalised learning, automation of academic support functions, and tensions around academic integrity and algorithmic bias.In healthcare, three parallel themes appear, LLMs as tools for medical education and simulated clinical training, their role in clinical decision support and knowledge retrieval, and their use in patient education and health literacy.Findings indicate that while LLMs show strong promise as supplementary tools across both domains, their integration remains uneven, context-dependent, and reliant on robust human oversight.The paper proposes an integrated, layered framework, presented as a flow diagram, tracing LLM capability from foundational model architecture through sector-specific application to human governance and measurable outcomes in classrooms and clinics.It argues that a policy-driven, cross-sectoral approach is essential to realise LLM benefits without compromising educational values or clinical safety, and discusses implications for administrators, faculty, clinicians, and policymakers.
papers.summary_zh: 该文系统梳理2020至2025年间大语言模型在高等教育中的文献，并将分析延伸至医疗领域，构建跨部门框架。综述发现，高等教育中主要呈现个性化学习增强、学术支持自动化以及学术诚信与算法偏见张力三条主线；医疗领域则对应医学教育与模拟训练、临床决策支持与知识检索、患者教育与健康素养三条并行主题。作者指出，大语言模型作为辅助工具在两领域均有前景，但其整合仍不均衡、依赖具体情境，并需强有力的人类监督。文章据此提出从基础模型架构到部门应用再到人类治理与可测结果的分层框架，强调政策驱动的跨部门方法对兼顾教育价值与临床安全的重要性。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Nursing Education: Transforming Learning, Clinical Competency, and Professional Development—A Narrative Review
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming nursing education by introducing innovative approaches to teaching, learning, assessment, and professional development.This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on the applications, benefits, challenges, and future directions of AI in nursing education.A comprehensive literature search was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, ERIC, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar to identify relevant studies published between 2019 and 2026.The reviewed literature demonstrates that AI-powered technologies, including adaptive learning systems, intelligent tutoring platforms, virtual simulation, augmented and virtual reality, learning analytics, natural language processing, and generative AI, have significantly enhanced personalized learning, clinical reasoning, competency development, and learner engagement.AI-assisted assessment methods provide objective evaluation and early identification of students requiring academic support, while AI-driven simulation offers safe, realistic environments for developing clinical skills and decision-making abilities.Furthermore, AI supports lifelong learning and continuing professional development by delivering individualized educational resources and competencybased training.Despite these advantages, challenges related to ethical considerations, algorithmic bias, academic integrity, faculty preparedness, technological infrastructure, data privacy, and equitable access remain significant barriers to implementation.The evidence suggests that AI should be integrated as a complementary educational tool rather than a replacement for nurse educators, preserving the humanistic values of nursing practice.Incorporating AI literacy, digital health competencies, and ethical AI principles into nursing curricula, together with institutional support and evidencebased governance, will prepare future nurses for technology-enabled healthcare systems and contribute to high-quality, safe, and patient-centered nursing practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了人工智能在护理教育中的应用、益处、挑战与未来方向，基于对多个数据库2019至2026年相关文献的检索。综述指出，自适应学习、智能辅导、虚拟仿真、学习分析、自然语言处理与生成式AI等技术可增强个性化学习、临床推理、能力发展与学习者参与，AI辅助评估有助于客观评价并早期识别需支持的学生，AI驱动仿真则提供安全的临床技能训练环境。同时，伦理、算法偏见、学术诚信、师资准备、技术基础设施、数据隐私与公平获取等仍是实施障碍。作者主张AI应作为补充性教育工具而非护理教育者的替代，并建议将AI素养与伦理原则纳入课程。

papers.title: Body Image Perception and Its Association with Overweight and Obesity Among Urban Adolescents in Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu: A SchoolBased Cross-Sectional Study
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Background: Overweight and obesity among urban adolescents represent a growing public health challenge in India, driven by rapid lifestyle transitions, poor dietary habits, and physical inactivity.A critically underexplored dimension of this epidemic is body image perception -an individual's multidimensional psychological experience of their own bodywhich plays a pivotal role in health behaviours, psychological wellbeing, and the risk of eating disorders.The present study aimed to assess the prevalence of overweight and obesity, and to describe the patterns of body image perception among urban adolescents in Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu.Methods: A school-based cross-sectional study was conducted from April 2024 to March 2025 in the urban field practice area of the Urban Health Centre, Thiruporur, Chengalpattu district.A total of 335 adolescents aged 10-17 years were selected by multistage random sampling from two private schools.Anthropometric measurements (height, weight, waist circumference, and waist-hip ratio) were recorded using standard methods and BMI was calculated.Body image perception was assessed using the validated 14-item version of the Body Shape Questionnaire (BSQ-14).Ethical approval was obtained from the Institutional Ethics Committee prior to the study.Results: The mean age of participants was 13.39 ± 1.55 years (range 10-17 years).Females constituted 57.1% of the sample.The mean BMI was 25.77 ± 3.75 kg/m².The prevalence of overweight was 46.87% and obesity 13.73%, with the highest combined prevalence observed at age 11 (87.5%).A family history of obesity, sleeping ≥8 hours per day, and low fruit consumption were the main factors significantly associated with overweight and obesity (p<0.05).Non-vegetarian diet was significantly associated with higher overweight/obesity prevalence compared to vegetarians (58.13% vs controls, p<0.05).Body image dissatisfaction, as measured by the BSQ-14, showed a significant correlation with elevated BMI.Conclusions: There is a high and concerning prevalence of overweight and obesity among urban adolescents in Chengalpattu district, accompanied by significant body image dissatisfaction.School-based interventions targeting Body Image Perception and Its Association with Overweight and Obesity Among Urban Adolescents in Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu: A School-Based Cross-Sectional Study IJDDT Volume 16 Issue 76s 2026 Page: 1457 nutritional education, physical activity promotion, and psychosocial support are urgently needed.Including body image perception as a routine screening component in school health programmes is strongly recommended.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注印度城市青少年的超重与肥胖流行情况及其与身体意象感知的关联，采用学校为基础的横断面设计，对参与者进行人体测量并计算BMI，同时用BSQ-14量表评估身体意象。结果显示超重和肥胖比例较高，身体意象不满与BMI升高存在显著相关，而肥胖家族史、每日睡眠不少于8小时、水果摄入少及非素食饮食也与超重肥胖显著相关。作者据此建议学校健康项目纳入身体意象筛查，并开展营养教育、体育活动促进和心理社会支持；但作为横断面研究，上述关联不能解释为因果关系。

papers.title: Perceptions, Experiences, And Ethical Attitudes Toward Artificial Intelligence Among Undergraduates: A Qualitative Study
papers.authors: Ajibola Ishola, Keyna George, Emmanuel Etim Uye
papers.abstract: The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence (AI) into Nigerian higher education has transformed how students learn, complete assessments, and conceptualize knowledge. Yet while quantitative studies have documented Nigerian students' favorable perceptions and growing use of AI tools, qualitative understanding of how undergraduates in this context perceive, experience, and ethically evaluate these technologies remains less developed. This qualitative study explored the perceptions, usage patterns, educational impacts, ethical attitudes, and future projections regarding AI among 15 undergraduates at the University of Ibadan, Nigeria. Participants aged 19 to 31 years were purposively recruited from six academic departments: Psychology, Computer Science, Sociology, Social Work, Political Science, and Medicine. Semi-structured interviews were analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis. Five overarching themes were developed: AI as instrumental tool versus cognitive agent, strategic adoption of AI tools for academic survival, the efficiency-dependency paradox encompassing enhancement versus perceived cognitive erosion, structural accountability and the call for algorithmic guardrails, and anticipatory anxiety regarding labor displacement and existential reliance. Students demonstrated sophisticated awareness of both affordances and limitations of AI, expressing profound ambivalence about its role in their intellectual development. The findings contribute Nigerian student voices to the global discourse on AI in education and offer an interpretive conceptual model, the efficiency-dependency paradox, derived from participants' accounts. Implications for curriculum design, ethical regulation, and digital policy in Nigerian higher education are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以尼日利亚伊巴丹大学15名本科生为对象，通过半结构化访谈和反思性主题分析，考察他们对生成式人工智能的感知、使用体验与伦理态度。分析归纳出五类主题：学生既把AI视为工具也视为认知主体，策略性地用它应对学业，并在效率提升与认知退化之间形成“效率—依赖悖论”，同时呼吁算法监管、担忧劳动被取代。研究据此提出该悖论的解释性概念模型，并讨论了对课程设计、伦理规范与数字政策的启示，但结论来自特定院校的质性样本。

papers.title: ChatGPT as a Supporting Medium for Islamic Religious Education: Strengthening Students’ Learning Experience and Academic Integrity
papers.authors: Muhamad Basyrul Muvid, Didiet Anindita Arnandy, Achmad Arrosyidi
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AI), particularly ChatGPT, offers opportunities to enhance learning while raising concerns about academic integrity. This study examines the role of ChatGPT in Islamic Religious Education (IRE) and formulates strategies to preserve students’ academic integrity. Using a qualitative library research approach, it analyzes scientific articles, books, policy documents, and other credible sources on generative AI, IRE, learning autonomy, and academic integrity through content analysis and thematic synthesis. The findings indicate that ChatGPT can improve access to learning resources, support independent learning, clarify complex concepts, and provide preliminary feedback. However, excessive reliance may encourage plagiarism, weaken critical thinking, reduce originality, and produce inaccurate information. Six complementary strategies are proposed: institutional policies, academic guidelines, cultivation of academic honesty, higher-order thinking tasks (C4–C6), authentic performance-based assessment, and contextual and problem-based learning. These strategies position ChatGPT as a supporting tool rather than a substitute for students’ intellectual processes, and its outputs must be critically verified against credible scholarly sources. The study concludes that the educational value of ChatGPT in IRE depends on sound pedagogical design and a strong ethical framework. Because the framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature, it has not been empirically validated and should be tested in future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能（尤其是ChatGPT）在伊斯兰宗教教育中如何既支持学生学习又维护学术诚信，采用定性图书馆研究，对相关文献、书籍与政策文件进行内容分析和主题综合。分析指出，ChatGPT能拓宽学习资源获取、支持自主学习、帮助澄清复杂概念并提供初步反馈，但过度依赖可能助长抄袭、削弱批判性思维与原创性，并产生不准确信息。作者据此提出制度政策、学术规范、诚信培养、高阶思维任务、真实性表现评价以及情境化与问题式学习六项互补策略，主张将ChatGPT定位为辅助工具而非学生思维过程的替代品，其输出须对照可靠学术来源加以核验。文章强调其教育价值取决于合理的教学设计与伦理框架，同时说明该框架属于概念性综合，尚未经过实证检验。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Use and Training in Residency: Results of a National Family Medicine Survey
papers.authors: Wendy Brooks Barr, Lars E. Peterson, Sarah Owens, Steven Lin, Andrew Bazemore
papers.abstract: Purpose: We are in a time of rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical care and medical education. We sought to determine the patterns of use and training in AI among family medicine (FM) residents.Methods: The 2025 American Board of Family Medicine (ABFM) National Resident Survey (NRS) was administered in October 2025 to all FM residents who completed the In-Training Exam. Residents were asked about their use of AI in the last month and any education about AI use they received in the last 6 months. Resident demographics were obtained from ABFM administrative databases.Results: A total of 15,259 residents completed the AI questions (response rate: 99.6%) with 10,858 residents (71.1%) reporting they used AI in the last month. The most common uses reported were for medical reference (40.7%), clinical decision support (31.9%), learning outside of patient care (23.6%), and ambient documentation of clinical encounters (21.9%). Only 36% reported any AI education or training in the last 6 months.Conclusions: Most FM residents reported recent use of AI tools, reflecting integration of these technologies into routine educational and clinical activities. However, formal training on AI use appears limited, suggesting a gap between adoption and structured competency development. The widespread use of AI by family medicine trainees has risks and opportunities for our future primary care workforce that will require new critical appraisal skills and new methods for teaching and assessing clinical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于2025年美国美国家庭医学委员会全国住院医师调查，考察家庭医学住院医师近期的AI使用情况与所接受的AI培训。结果显示，多数住院医师在过去一个月内使用过AI工具，用途以医学参考、临床决策支持、患者照护之外的学习和临床记录为主；但仅约三分之一报告近半年接受过任何AI教育或培训。作者据此指出，AI已融入日常教育与临床活动，而正式培训相对有限， adoption与结构化能力培养之间存在差距，这对未来初级保健队伍既带来风险也带来机会，需要新的批判性评估技能以及教授和评估临床推理的方法。

papers.title: Early Alzheimer’s Disease Detection Using EEG Brain Signals
papers.authors: Dhruv Patil, Srushti Raul, Utkarsha Bhoir, Simran Patil
papers.journal: International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease, and early detection is essential for meaningful interventions to improve patient outcomes. While there are diagnostic modalities such as PET scans that can be effective in detecting AD, they tend to be expensive, invasive, or impractical, illustrating the need for more usable alternatives to monitor the progression of AD. Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive and inexpensive way to monitor brain activity, and it has the potential of being a useful way to identify early markers of AD before significant cognitive decline as well. However, a reliable EEG detection model still must overcome the two significant challenges of a lack of large- scale labelled datasets sufficient for training, and considerable variability in EEG signals across individuals, which can ultimately greatly affect the generalizability of EEG models for helpful detection of AD through these differences. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning framework to address these challenges with self-supervised learning. Our framework consists of a pre- training phase from a large, unlabelled corpus of general EEG data to extract the universal features of brain signals without needing to depend on scarce AD-specific labels. We then use a fine-tuning phase to adapt the model to the classification problem using a smaller, labelled AD dataset. The model architecture can acquire both spatial and temporal features from EEG signals, which EADDs to a more comprehensive method of analysis. The experimental results clearly indicate that this approach offers a substantial improvement in AD detecting performance and that there was an increase in F1 scores at both the sample and the subject level over the current state f-the-art methods. This research outlines the ability of self- supervised contrastive learning to mitigate the problems of data scarcity and inter-subject variability and can contribute towards more accurate and scalable AD diagnostic tools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对阿尔茨海默病早期脑电检测中标注数据稀缺和个体间信号差异大的问题，提出一种基于自监督学习的深度学习框架，先在大规模无标签脑电数据上预训练以提取通用特征，再用较小的标注数据集微调完成分类。实验结果显示，该方法在样本和受试者层面的F1分数均优于现有方法，表明自监督对比学习有助于缓解数据不足与个体差异带来的泛化困难，为更准确、可扩展的辅助诊断工具提供了可能。

papers.title: AI Powered Smart Personalized Study Planner with Intelligent Reminder
papers.authors: Prerna N. Deshmukh, Ishwari P. Harne, Om S. Mode, Ayush G. Nimbhorkar, Nikhil S. Band
papers.journal: International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology
papers.abstract: In the contemporary academic paradigm, tertiary and secondary students consistently encounter significant cognitive overhead and temporal fragmentation, largely attributable to suboptimal scheduling methodologies, procrastination, and lack of individualized pedagogical pacing. Conventional digital calendars and static scheduling instruments fail to account for fluid academic priorities, cognitive fatigue thresholds, or behavioral non-compliance. To address these systemic inefficiencies, this paper introduces an AI-Powered Smart Study Planner with Intelligent Reminders, a pervasive Android-based architectural framework engineered to synthesize automated, context-aware study trajectories and foster disciplined academic behaviors. Developed natively utilizing Java and XML with persistent cloud synchronization facilitated by Firebase Realtime Database, the proposed architecture provides dynamic schedule synthesis parameterized by examination schedules, subject difficulty profiles, available temporal bandwidth, and granular academic milestones. A principal contribution of this system lies in its dual integration of predictive behavioural modeling and state-of-the-art conversational artificial intelligence. The framework incorporates a novel Snooze Risk Prediction module that systematically evaluates telemetry data—encompassing chronological snooze frequency, missed learning intervals, and temporal inertia—to compute probabilistic risk factors associated with task avoidance, thereby dynamically recalibrating dispatch heuristics for targeted interventions. Simultaneously, the platform integrates Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipelines and Generative Artificial Intelligence primitives to deliver on-demand cognitive scaffolding. These automated pedagogical tools encompass dynamic notes summarization, programmatic multi-tier quiz synthesis, automated contextual disambiguation of complex academic topics, and real-time conversational agent mediation
papers.summary_zh: 该研究面向学生因排程不当、拖延和缺乏个性化节奏而产生的认知负担与时间碎片化问题，设计并实现了一个基于安卓的智能学习计划系统，通过云端同步，依据考试安排、科目难度、可用时间和学习里程碑动态生成学习计划。系统的主要特点是将行为预测与对话式人工智能结合：一方面根据用户的推迟频率、错过的学习时段等使用数据估计任务回避的风险，并据此调整提醒策略；另一方面提供笔记摘要、分层测验生成、复杂主题解释和实时对话辅助等功能。文章属于系统/原型论文，重点在架构与功能设计，摘要未报告用户实验或效果评估，因此其促进学习纪律与提供认知支持的实际作用尚待验证。

papers.title: The Reconstruction of Artistic Subjectivity and Its Ethical Issues in AI-Based Music Composition
papers.authors: Chen Ni
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has altered the material and conceptual conditions of music-making. Composition is no longer imagined solely as a human practice grounded in intention and lived experience; it increasingly unfolds through interactions among users, datasets, models, and platforms. This study considers how AI-based composition reworks artistic subjectivity and with what ethical consequences. It first outlines the technical foundations of AI music generation and then examines shifts in creative agency, aesthetic judgment, and the relation between human creators and algorithms. The argument is that AI does not simply replace human creativity. It helps produce a distributed human–AI subject of creation. As a result, artistic production moves from experience-based creation toward a hybrid process in which human experience, aesthetic judgment, and algorithmic generation all play a role. The same movement raises ethical questions about authorship, responsibility, creativity, data dependence, and aesthetic homogenization. AI-based music composition is thus better understood as a reconstruction of artistic subjectivity and human–technology relations than as a self-contained technical innovation in music production.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕AI音乐生成如何重塑艺术主体性及其伦理后果展开理论分析，先梳理AI音乐生成的技术基础，再考察创作能动性、审美判断以及人与算法关系的变化。作者认为，AI并非简单取代人类创造力，而是促生一种分布式的人机创作主体，使艺术生产从基于经验的创作转向人类经验、审美判断与算法生成共同参与的混合过程。这一转变同时引出署名、责任、创造力、数据依赖和审美同质化等伦理问题，因此AI音乐创作更适合被理解为艺术主体性与人机关系的重构，而非孤立的技术创新。

papers.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ADOPTION AND EMPLOYEE PRODUCTIVITY IN PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS AND HIGHER EDUCATION ORGANISATIONS IN NIGERIA: THE MEDIATING ROLE OF ORGANISATIONAL READINESS
papers.authors: Mohammed Munirat Nma, Adebayo Helen Oluwatoyin, Obichie Elvis Ugo, Ahmed Hassan Ahmed, Chida Ezekiel
papers.abstract: This study examined the effect of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption on employee productivity in public institutions and higher education organisations in Nigeria, disaggregating AI adoption into AI-assisted decision making, AI-based automation, and generative AI utilisation, and testing organisational readiness—comprising management support, digital infrastructure, employee AI knowledge and skills, and institutional policy—as a mediating mechanism linking adoption to productivity outcomes. A descriptive cross-sectional survey design was employed, targeting lecturers, academic administrators, registry staff, ICT personnel, departmental administrators, and management staff drawn from federal and state universities, polytechnics, colleges of education, and government agencies. Data were collected using a structured, validated five-point Likert-scale questionnaire adapted from established scales, and analysed using hierarchical multiple regression together with bootstrapped mediation analysis (Hayes' PROCESS macro, Model 4) at the 0.05 significance level, preceded by reliability, multicollinearity, and normality diagnostics. Findings revealed that AI-assisted decision making (β = 0.472, p < 0.001), AI-based automation (β = 0.357, p < 0.001), and generative AI utilisation (β = 0.167, p < 0.001) each exerted a positive and significant effect on employee productivity. Furthermore, organisational readiness significantly mediated the relationships between AI-based automation and employee productivity (indirect effect = 0.261, 95% CI: 0.189–0.331) and between generative AI utilisation and employee productivity (indirect effect = 0.221, 95% CI: 0.099–0.362). However, organisational readiness did not significantly mediate the relationship between AI-assisted decision making and employee productivity (indirect effect = -0.038, 95% CI: -0.121–0.041). The study extends the limited Nigeria-centric evidence base on AI adoption within public-sector and higher-education settings and informs institutional policy on infrastructure investment, staff training, and governance frameworks required to convert AI adoption into measurable productivity gains.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察尼日利亚公共机构与高等教育组织中人工智能采用对员工生产力的影响，并将AI采用分为辅助决策、自动化与生成式AI使用三类，检验组织准备度是否在其中起中介作用。研究采用横断面问卷调查高校与政府机构相关人员，通过回归与中介分析发现，三类AI采用均与员工生产力呈正相关；组织准备度在自动化、生成式AI使用与生产力之间起显著中介作用，但在辅助决策与生产力之间未起显著中介作用。研究据此讨论了基础设施投入、员工培训与治理框架对将AI采用转化为生产力收益的意义，并提示结论受横断面设计与特定机构情境的限制。

papers.title: A Multifaceted Intervention to Reduce Obesity Among Preschool Children in Suzhou City: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Pan Yang, Ying Wang, Xiao Jiang, Ziyao Ding, Liye Zhang, Xinyu Bao, 阚迪, Hui Shen, Jia Hu, Jieyun Yin
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The rising prevalence of obesity among preschool children has become a critical public health concern in Suzhou, China. Nevertheless, evidence-based, personalized, and multicomponent intervention strategies tailored to children with overweight or obesity remain inadequately established in current practice. Objective This study aims to investigate the prevalence and pathogenic factors of obesity among preschool children in Suzhou and to develop a comprehensive and multifaceted integrated intervention program. Through systematic assessment of its short-term effectiveness and long-term sustainability in improving obesity-related indicators and preventing overweight, it provides a scientific basis for obesity prevention and control. Methods This cluster randomized controlled trial is being conducted among children aged 3 to 6 years in Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province. Children from 3 kindergartens were randomly assigned to the intervention group and children from 3 other kindergartens were assigned to the control group. The 1-year intervention includes health education, dietary guidance, and increased physical activity, adopting a multilevel approach that engages children, families, schools, communities, and society. Children participate in health education and physical activity courses in the kindergarten, while parents receive educational materials online. Parental education and regular assessment of knowledge, attitudes, and practices are key components of the family-based intervention. Body measurements will be taken at baseline, 6 months, 12 months, and thereafter, alongside questionnaires for both parents and children to evaluate their own health behaviors. The primary outcome will be the difference in BMI, BMI z scores, and body fat percentage between the 2 groups of children at the end of the intervention. Results The study received ethical approval in March 2025. Baseline assessments were conducted from March to June 2025, followed by the initiation of the intervention, which will be completed by June 2026. Participants will then enter a noninterventional long-term follow-up until June 2032, with annual surveys conducted during this period. Conclusions This program will test the effectiveness of comprehensive multifaceted interventions on children. The results of this study will provide scientific evidence for formulating effective intervention strategies for childhood overweight and obesity and are also expected to offer crucial practical references for the formulation and improvement of treatment guidelines for childhood obesity in China.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究方案针对苏州学龄前儿童超重与肥胖问题，设计了一项整群随机对照试验，在幼儿园层面分组比较为期一年的综合干预与常规对照。干预涵盖健康教育、饮食指导、增加身体活动，并联动家庭、学校、社区等多层级，家长通过线上材料接受教育并定期评估知识、态度与行为。主要结局为干预结束时两组儿童BMI、BMI z评分和体脂率的差异，并计划长期随访观察可持续性。由于目前仅报告研究方案与实施安排，干预效果尚待结果公布，文章将其定位为为中国儿童肥胖防控策略与指南完善提供科学依据。

papers.title: Analysis of Student Engagement With AI in Undergraduate Lectures: Protocol for an Implementation Study
papers.authors: Mthobisi L. Ntuli, Nomakhosi Mpofana, Michael Paulse, Godfrey Nkululeko Mazibuko, Shamanie Govender
papers.abstract: Background: AI has quickly become integrated into higher education, transforming how students access information, complete academic tasks, and engage with learning. Universities of technology, with their focus on applied learning, technological skills, and graduate employability, face both challenges and opportunities in incorporating AI in ways that improve learning without sacrificing conceptual understanding, critical thinking, or academic integrity. While current research highlights widespread student use of AI tools, there remains limited empirical evidence on how undergraduate students in applied and health-related fields interact with AI, perceive its educational impact, and manage risks associated with overreliance. Objective: The study aims to examine undergraduate students' AI use patterns, their perceptions of how AI affects conceptual understanding and critical thinking, and their views on risks such as dependency and ethical issues within a university of technology setting. An additional goal is to investigate students' experiences with AI literacy programs and gather evidence to support responsible, educationally grounded AI integration that aligns with institutional strategies and graduate attributes. Methods: The study adopts a convergent mixed methods, cross-sectional, exploratory-descriptive design. Quantitative data will be collected using a structured questionnaire administered to undergraduate students across the mathematics, somatology, and Bachelor of Health Sciences (biomedical and clinical technology) programs within the Faculties of Applied Sciences and Health Sciences at Durban University of Technology. Qualitative data will be generated through semistructured interviews. Quantitative data will be analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistical methods, whereas qualitative data will be analyzed thematically using the method by Tesch. Integration of findings will occur at the interpretation stage to enable triangulation and comprehensive insight. Integration will follow the joint display approach described by Guetterman et al. Quantitative and qualitative results for each objective will be displayed side by side in matrices that compare statistical patterns with thematic insights. Convergence, complementarity, or discordance will be explicitly noted. Meta-inferences will be generated through team deliberation using an integration codebook. A triangulation protocol will document how discrepancies are resolved (eg, prioritizing qualitative depth for mechanism explanation and quantitative breadth for prevalence estimation). Results: A pilot study conducted within the mathematics department identified emerging patterns of AI dependence among students, helping refine research tools and focus interventions. This study was funded by the Department of Higher Education and Training on January 1, 2025, and was conducted between August 2025 and November 2025, with preliminary results available at the end of that period. Data collection is ongoing and is expected to conclude by the end of November 2026, after which the data will be analyzed in 2027 and the findings will be published in a separate results paper. Conclusions: The study is expected to provide evidence on the use of AI in applied and health-related fields. The findings will inform institutional policy, curriculum development, and the development of a short course on the responsible use of AI, thereby supporting broader discussions on the sustainable integration of AI in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一项实施研究方案，计划采用收敛式混合方法横断面设计，通过问卷和半结构化访谈考察技术型大学应用科学与健康科学相关专业本科生使用AI的模式、对AI影响概念理解与批判性思维的感知，以及对依赖和伦理等风险的看法。摘要报告称，数学系试点已初步发现学生存在AI依赖迹象，并据此完善了研究工具；正式数据收集仍在进行，结果尚未产出。文章据此预期为院校政策、课程开发及负责任使用AI的短期课程提供依据，但当前尚无实证结论可报告。

papers.title: Development and Validation of the Large Language Model Privacy Concern Assessment Questionnaire: Psychometric Evaluation Study on a Brief Instrument for Assessing User Privacy Concerns With Large Language Model Applications
papers.authors: Leming Zhou, Hongtao Wang, Yi Xu, I Made Agus Setiawan, Haomin Hu, Andi Saptono, Yong Kyung Choi, Bambang Parmanto
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Privacy concerns represent a primary barrier to the adoption of large language model (LLM) applications, particularly in sensitive domains such as health care. Although a growing body of survey-based research has examined user privacy concerns with LLMs, no standardized instrument exists for measuring this construct. Objective This study aimed to develop and validate a concise, standardized questionnaire for assessing user privacy concerns with LLM-based systems, suitable for use by researchers and practitioners such as AI application developers and health care professionals. Methods A literature review was conducted to identify privacy-related domains relevant to LLM use. A draft questionnaire was developed and subjected to content validity review by 8 experts. The finalized instrument was administered via Qualtrics to adults aged 18 years or older who were aware of LLM-based applications, recruited through the University of Pittsburgh, LinkedIn, and the Pitt+Me research participant registry between April 2025 and July 2026. Internal consistency reliability and factor structure were assessed, with factor structure examined in a split-sample design, in which exploratory factor analysis (EFA) was conducted on a random one-third of the sample and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) on the holdout two-thirds. Results All questionnaire items achieved acceptable content validity (item-level content validity index >0.80; average scale-level content validity index=0.964). A total of 603 responses were collected. After preprocessing, the final sample comprised 361 participants. Most participants were younger than 35 years of age (198/361, 54.8%), female (230/361, 63.7%), and White (285/361, 78.9%); 88.1% (318/361) held at least a bachelor’s degree. The 6-item questionnaire showed high internal consistency (Cronbach α=0.90; McDonald ω=0.90). EFA (n=121) supported a single dominant factor with all standardized loadings ≥0.70. CFA (n=240) showed excellent fit (comparative fit index=0.996; Tucker-Lewis index=0.993; root mean square error of approximation=0.046; standardized root mean square residual=0.057). A 2-factor model separating the transparency- and control-related items fit significantly better than the 1-factor model (Δ χ 2 1 =8.9; P =.003), but the 2 factors were correlated at r =0.83, indicating closely related facets. Because the Fornell-Larcker criterion was met for the transparency and control subscale but not for data use and risk salience, the 6-item total score remains the recommended primary metric. Conclusions The LLM privacy concern assessment is a concise, psychometrically sound 6-item instrument that measures privacy concern with LLM-based systems via 2 correlated subdimensions (transparency and control; data use and risk salience) summarized by a single total score. It enables standardized measurement across studies and practical privacy assessment in real-world LLM applications.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大语言模型应用缺乏标准化隐私担忧测量工具的问题，开发并验证了一份简明的六条目问卷。作者通过文献回顾和专家内容效度评审形成条目，并对知晓大语言模型应用的成年用户开展问卷调查，采用分样本设计分别进行探索性和验证性因子分析。结果显示问卷内部一致性较高，支持单一主导因子结构，透明与控制、数据使用与风险显著性两个相关子维度可由总分概括，总分被推荐为主要指标。该工具为跨研究比较和实际应用中的隐私评估提供了标准化测量手段，但结论基于特定招募渠道和以高学历、年轻用户为主的样本，推广时需谨慎。
