papers.title: Institutional AI Policy Awareness and Responsible AI Use in Legal Education in Bangladesh
papers.authors: Kazi Abdul Mannan, Sifa Sultana
papers.abstract: Institutional guidance on generative artificial intelligence is often evaluated through its existence or students’ general support for regulation. Neither establishes whether awareness of rules corresponds with responsible use. This exploratory study separates perceived knowledge of institutional rule status, anticipated policy benefits and behaviour-specific self-reports in a Bangladesh legal-education database. The complete database contains N = 385 records; its n = 245 current law students form the primary analytical subsample, with all records retained for sensitivity analysis. The principal outcome is endorsement of using AI only as permitted by course or institutional rules. Item-level logistic models, robust intervals, respondent bootstrap standardisation and repeated stratified cross-validation examine association and incremental predictive value. Policy awareness is endorsed by 151 students (61.6%); permitted-use compliance by 150 (61.2%). The student association is positive but uncertain (adjusted odds ratio 1.33; 95% confidence interval 0.95-1.86); the complete-sample estimate is likewise uncertain (1.17; 0.89-1.53). Standardised endorsement probabilities at awareness scores four and three differ by 6.7 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval −0.9-14.7). Associations with independent-work boundaries and avoiding wholly personal attribution are also uncertain. Adding awareness changes the mean held-out Brier score from 0.24308 to 0.24268, while an intercept-only benchmark performs better at 0.23740. Support for training and consistent enforcement is substantially more common than awareness endorsement. Low internal consistency precludes treating these items as one reflective policy construct. The codebook labels identifiers and comments synthetic, leaving numerical provenance unresolved; comments are excluded. The findings identify limits in using perceived awareness as a surrogate for compliance and motivate assessment-specific communication and prospective evaluation. They establish neither institutional policy effectiveness nor misconduct prevalence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以孟加拉国法律教育数据库为对象，考察学生对院校生成式人工智能政策的感知了解是否与其负责任使用相关。作者将政策规则状态的感知知识、预期政策收益与具体行为自评区分开，用条目层面逻辑模型和交叉验证分析关联及增量预测价值。结果显示，政策了解与“仅在课程或院校规则允许时使用AI”的认同呈正向但不确定的关联，对独立完成边界和避免完全归因于个人的关联同样不确定；了解程度对预测表现几乎没有增量贡献，甚至不如仅含截距的基准。支持培训与一致执行的比例明显高于政策了解认同，且条目内部一致性低，不宜视为单一政策构念。研究据此指出，以感知了解替代合规判断存在局限，需针对具体评估开展沟通与前瞻性评价，但既不能确立院校政策有效性，也不能说明不当行为的发生率。

papers.title: Biomaterials as Regulators of Neuron–Glia Crosstalk: From Material Properties to Functional Outcomes
papers.authors: Valeriia S. Shtol, S. P. Konovalova, Kirill A. Arsentiev, Yulia I. Taranukha, Мусиенко Павел Евгеньевич
papers.abstract: Biomaterials for neural tissue engineering, cell delivery, and chronic neural interfaces are conventionally characterized through physicochemical descriptors such as stiffness, topography, surface chemistry, and degradation rate. However, their biological effect is mediated by the material–tissue interface, a dynamic layer formed through protein adsorption, extracellular matrix ligand presentation, and progressive cellular remodeling, that determines how these design parameters are translated into neuronal and glial responses. This review synthesizes current evidence on how neurons, astrocytes, and microglia sense the material–tissue interface, how integrin-dependent adhesion complexes, mechanosensitive Piezo1 channels, and downstream FAK/Src, RhoA/ROCK, and YAP/TAZ pathways transduce interfacial cues into intracellular signaling, and how key design variables (mechanical properties, architecture, surface chemistry, electrical conductivity, and degradation) can be tuned to direct these processes in regenerative scaffolds and chronic neural interfaces. Particular attention is given to studies distinguishing direct neuronal effects from glia-mediated modulation, since concurrent changes in neuronal and glial markers are often reported without establishing causal neuron–glia interaction. We further discuss methodological limitations, including model mismatch across 2D, 3D, and in vivo systems and insufficient duration of chronic observation, that constrain current interpretations of biomaterial-induced neuron–glia crosstalk. We argue that functional biomaterial design for neural applications should move from optimizing isolated cellular readouts toward multicellular experimental frameworks capable of resolving neuron–glia–ECM interactions over physiologically relevant timescales.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦生物材料如何通过材料–组织界面调控神经元与胶质细胞之间的相互作用，梳理了整合素黏附复合物、机械敏感Piezo1通道及FAK/Src、RhoA/ROCK、YAP/TAZ等通路将界面线索转导为胞内信号的过程，并讨论力学性质、结构、表面化学、导电性和降解等设计变量如何用于再生支架与慢性神经界面。作者特别区分了材料的直接神经元效应与胶质细胞介导的间接调节，指出许多研究仅同时报告神经元和胶质标志物变化，未确立因果性的神经元–胶质相互作用。文章还提示二维、三维与在体模型间的失配及慢性观察时长不足限制了现有解释，主张从优化孤立细胞指标转向能解析神经元–胶质–细胞外基质相互作用的多细胞实验框架。

papers.title: Smart at Getting Smarter: Human Differences During the Transition to Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Vance Ashley Woodward
papers.abstract: Part of being smart is being better at getting smarter. Artificial intelligence can amplify that capacity while human judgment shapes how the tool is used. The same technology can also take over problem selection, verification, and learning, reducing the advantage that initially capable users bring to it. This paper develops that transition argument using evidence from writing, customer support, consulting, entrepreneurship, and mathematics education. A simple model shows how persistent differences in improvement rates compound. It then lets those rates change as AI does more of the work. Equal rates can stop the relative gap from widening. Closing it requires the person behind to catch up, or AI to supply so much of the capability that the remaining human differences matter little. With broad access, enough material resources, and help directed toward their own goals, people could live well with less dependence on their starting intelligence or diligence. AI could even help them become more willing to correct their mistakes. A person who keeps refusing help limits what an assistant respecting that choice may do. Meanwhile, early winners may keep their ownership and influence after everyone else gains comparable abilities. The ethical question concerns both people’s ability to live well and their say in the systems supporting them. The central issue is whether broadly available assistance catches up before temporary advantages become durable concentrations of power.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以写作、客服、咨询、创业和数学教育等领域的证据为基础，提出一个关于人类在向人工智能过渡期间差异变化的理论论证，并用一个简单模型说明改进率的持续差异如何累积。作者指出，当 AI 承担更多工作时，这些改进率会发生变化：若各方改进率相等，相对差距可停止扩大；要缩小差距，则需落后者追赶，或由 AI 提供足够能力使剩余的人类差异变得无关紧要。文章进一步讨论，在广泛可及、物质资源充足且帮助指向自身目标的条件下，人们可能减少对初始智力或勤勉的依赖，AI 甚至可能让人更愿意纠正错误；但持续拒绝帮助的人会限制尊重该选择的助手所能做的事，早期受益者也可能在他人获得相当能力后仍保有所有权和影响力。文章据此将伦理问题落在人们过好生活的能力与对支撑系统的发言权上，核心关切是广泛可及的帮助能否在暂时优势变成持久的权力集中之前赶上。

papers.title: ChatGPT Employment Anxiety and Career Confidence: Discipline-Contingent Evidence From Malaysian Undergraduates
papers.authors: Fahd Ali Raza, Abtar Darshan Singh, Rabia Anwar, Jonathan JS Kovilpillai, Analisa Hamdan, Fumiko Konno, Husna HR Azami, Murali Raman
papers.abstract: Background: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has raised concerns about graduate employability, yet evidence on how ChatGPT employment anxiety relates to career confidence remains limited, particularly in non-Western contexts. Objectives: We examined whether ChatGPT employment anxiety is associated with career confidence among Malaysian undergraduates and whether academic discipline or usage intensity moderates that association. Methods: Using the Malaysian subset of the 2024–2025 Global ChatGPT Student Survey (Aristovnik et al., 2025; N = 315 ChatGPT users), we constructed a four-item employment anxiety index (α = .80) and estimated hierarchical ordinary least squares (OLS) regressions predicting a single-item measure of career confidence, controlling for age, gender, institution type, study level, discipline, and usage intensity. Hierarchical regression entered predictors in successive blocks so that the variance explained by employment anxiety, beyond the control variables, could be assessed. We used regression diagnostics and a multiple-imputation sensitivity analysis to check model assumptions and confirm that results did not depend on how missing data were handled. Results: Contrary to H1, employment anxiety showed no overall association with career confidence (β = .029, p = .562). However, an exploratory, discipline-specific pattern emerged (H2 partially supported): The anxiety × information technology (IT) and engineering interaction was significant (β = −.311, p = .005). Within this group, higher anxiety was associated with lower confidence at the conventional threshold (β = −.164, p = .050), whereas no such relationship appeared among business or arts, humanities, and natural sciences students. Usage intensity did not moderate the relationship (H3 not supported). Findings were robust to multiple imputation, meaning the study’s final conclusions did not change. Conclusions: These exploratory findings suggest that the link between AI employment anxiety and career confidence may be discipline contingent rather than uniform—a pattern that does not completely align with Western automation-anxiety models. We framed the buffering role of Malaysia’s collectivist context as an interpretive hypothesis rather than a tested claim because we did not measure cultural orientation. The discipline-specific association among IT and engineering students, who face the most direct occupational exposure, warrants replication. Also, the cross-sectional design and single-item outcome measure limit causal and practical inference.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察马来西亚本科生对ChatGPT的就业焦虑是否与职业信心相关，以及学科和使用强度是否调节这一关系，基于全球ChatGPT学生调查的马来西亚子样本，采用分层回归分析。结果显示，就业焦虑总体上与职业信心无显著关联；但按学科分组后，信息技术与工程学生的焦虑与职业信心呈负相关，而商科及艺术、人文与自然科学学生未见此关系，使用强度不调节该关系。作者据此提出，AI就业焦虑与职业信心的联系可能因学科而异，而非普遍一致，并强调该发现属探索性、需重复验证，横断面设计和单题结果测量限制了因果推断。

papers.title: Trayectorias en riesgo en educación superior en línea: soporte tecnopedagógico con IA generativa
papers.authors: Mariángeles Castro-Sánchez, Romina Silvetti, Sonia Calamante, Daniela Bertuni
papers.abstract: In online higher education, discontinuities in student performance and socialization function as early signs of academic delay or dropout. This article presents an institutional pilot that integrated generative AI (TECgpt/Skill Studio) as technopedagogical support for an academic status assessment tool (VEA), used to detect at-risk trajectories in an online degree program. An ecosystem of five configurable assistants was designed to generate reports at the student, cohort, and program levels. It was evaluated using a qualitatively dominant methodology with the academic management team across four cohorts (N = 198 active students). Results indicate that the tool systematized the process and improved traceability, although output variability was observed and recommendations lacked sufficient differentiation. The tool provides value by standardizing and scaling academic support without replacing human mediation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对在线高等教育中学生表现与社交联结中断所反映的学业滞后或辍学风险，介绍了一项将生成式AI（TECgpt/Skill Studio）作为技术教学支持、与学业状态评估工具（VEA）结合的制度试点，并设计五个可配置助手在个体、群组和项目层面生成报告。研究以质性为主、辅以学术管理团队参与的方式，在四个队列的在线学位项目中评估该工具。结果显示，工具使评估流程更系统化并提升了可追溯性，但输出存在波动，所给建议的区分度也不足。作者据此认为，该工具的价值在于标准化和规模化地支持学业辅导，而非取代人的中介作用。

papers.title: La retroalimentación humana y la automatizada: experiencia de un chatbot detector de errores de redacción
papers.authors: Claudia Maldonado Cáceres, Javier Pizarro Romero, Faviola Puccio - Cárdenas, Giuliano Terrones Terrones
papers.abstract: Since 2022, ChatGPT has contributed to the widespread adoption of AI in education. Custom GPTs can automate part of the written feedback process, a particularly demanding task in large classes. We developed two versions of an error-detection chatbot for first-year students at a private university in Lima and implemented the second version under teacher supervision and through peer discussion. This study examines its potential and limitations. The tool accelerated the identification of spelling and punctuation errors; however, it produced inconsistent assessments. We conclude that its potential is greatest when integrated into a workflow that combines AI with human review. These findings provide guidance for future implementations and contribute to the ongoing debate on the responsible integration of AI into teaching.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对大班写作反馈负担重的问题，开发了两个版本的写作错误检测聊天机器人，并在教师监督和同伴讨论下实施第二版，考察其潜力与局限。结果显示，该工具能加快拼写和标点错误的识别，但评估结果并不一致。作者据此认为，其价值在将人工智能与人工复核相结合的工作流程中才能最大程度发挥，并为后续应用及负责任地将人工智能融入教学提供了参考。

papers.title: Does Generative AI Foster or Erode Critical Thinking, Creativity and Metacognition? A Second-Order Meta-Analysis in Higher Education
papers.authors: David Xavier Echeverría Maggi, René Garzozi-Pincay, Gregory Santamaría, Martha Yesenia Suntaxi-Andrade, María Isabel Posligua, Katty Vera, Roberth Ponce, Monica Loor, Kenia Cevallos, Wilson Alexander Zambrano Vélez

papers.title: Component-based approach to assessing the applicability of large language models in decision support systems
papers.authors: D. E. Chikrin, A. V. Puga
papers.abstract: The article proposes a component-based approach to assessing the applicability of large language models in decision support systems. The necessity of multidimensional evaluation is substantiated, and an original methodology for component-based assessment is presented, taking into account both the content of the text and its suitability for specific applied contexts. Unlike existing review scales, the approach suggests the use of operational applicability profiles of the response and a decision-making procedure at the level of a specific output. The components capture verifiable properties of the response and serve as the basis for reproducible metrics and evaluation criteria. The approach is oriented toward typical decision support system tasks and can be applied in both expert and automated scenarios. The methodology can be used to verify generated results and enhance the substantiation of trust in them.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对大语言模型在决策支持系统中的适用性评估问题，提出一种基于组件的评估方法。作者论证了多维评价的必要性，并给出了一套原创方法：不同于现有评审量表，它引入回答的操作性适用性画像，并在具体输出层面设置决策程序，各组件对应回答中可验证的属性，从而形成可复现的指标与评价标准。该方法面向典型决策支持任务，可用于专家与自动化两类场景，帮助核验生成结果并增强对其信任的依据。文章属于方法学层面的理论构建，未报告实证实验或系统实现。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education: A Bibliometric Analysis of Generative AI, Adaptive Curriculum, and Human–AI Collaboration
papers.authors: Aylin Akınlar
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly generative AI, is reshaping curriculum design, teaching, and learning in higher education. This study maps the recent development of this research landscape through a bibliometric analysis of 265 publications indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection. The archived dataset covers 2006–2026; 2026 is treated as a partial year because the data were retrieved on 26 January 2026. Using the Bibliometrix R package and Biblioshiny interface, the study combines quantitative bibliometric techniques with qualitative thematic interpretation to examine publication trends, citation patterns, geographical distribution, and thematic structures. Findings show a marked increase in research output after 2022, broad dispersion across publication venues, substantial differences in affiliation-based country frequencies, and differentiated citation-based scholarly visibility. Keyword-frequency and co-occurrence patterns were interpreted through author-defined areas concerning curriculum design, personalized and adaptive learning, educational modelling and frameworks, ethical and governance considerations, and human–AI collaboration. The study contributes to curriculum and instruction by providing an integrated map of AI research and emphasizing pedagogically grounded, ethically informed, and context-sensitive approaches to AI integration in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量分析梳理高等教育中人工智能研究的发展脉络，基于 Web of Science 核心合集收录的 265 篇文献，结合定量计量与定性主题解读，考察发表趋势、引用模式、地域分布和主题结构。结果显示，2022 年后研究产出明显增长，发表渠道较为分散，不同国家所属机构的发文频次差异较大，引用层面的学术可见度也呈现分化。作者围绕课程设计、个性化与自适应学习、教育建模与框架、伦理与治理以及人机协作等主题解读关键词共现模式，并据此强调，高等教育中的 AI 整合应注重教学法基础、伦理考量和情境适配。

papers.title: Avaliação da experiência do usuário na utilização de um protótipo de chatbot para o apoio à prevenção do câncer do colo do útero
papers.authors: Luiz Fernando Picolo, Manuella Silva Sampaio, Felipe de Mauro Paulo, Renato Garcia
papers.abstract: Este estudo avaliou a usabilidade, a aceitação e a experiência de fluxo durante a interação com o protótipo do chatbot Liz, desenvolvido para apoiar a prevenção do câncer do colo do útero na saúde pública de Nova Andradina/MS. Foi realizado um estudo de abordagem quanti-qualitativa com 58 participantes, de 18 a 64 anos, utilizando os instrumentos System Usability Scale (SUS), Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) e Flow State Scale (FSS-short), além de uma questão aberta. Os dados foram analisados por meio dos escores dos instrumentos e de análise lexical no IRAMUTEQ. O SUS apresentou escore de 75,5 pontos, indicando boa usabilidade. O TAM revelou percepções favoráveis quanto à utilidade, à facilidade de uso e à intenção de uso, enquanto a FSS-short indicou bom envolvimento durante a interação. Na análise textual, o termo agendamento destacou-se, associado à facilidade, à clareza e à funcionalidade. Contudo, foram relatadas dificuldades pontuais de digitação, nas respostas do chatbot e na ocorrência de erros. Os resultados indicam uma avaliação inicial positiva e demonstram a contribuição da integração de medidas padronizadas e percepções dos usuários para aprimorar interfaces conversacionais em saúde.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究评估了一款面向宫颈癌预防的聊天机器人原型Liz在公共卫生场景中的可用性、接受度与心流体验，采用量化与质性结合的方式，通过标准化量表与开放式问题收集参与者对交互体验的反馈。结果显示，该原型整体可用性良好，参与者对其实用性、易用性和使用意向持积极态度，交互过程中的投入程度也较高，文本分析中“预约”一词与便捷、清晰和功能性的感知相联系。同时，用户也报告了输入、机器人回复及偶发错误等方面的具体困难。作者据此认为初步评价积极，并指出将标准化测量与用户感知结合有助于改进健康领域的对话式界面。

papers.title: Producción científica estudiantil y Agenda 2030: análisis lexicométrico asistido por inteligencia artificial en pregrado
papers.authors: Gerardo Iván Martínez Vizcaíno
papers.abstract: Objective:To characterize the scientific production and thematic trends of health sciences students at Lamar University (2024-2025), evaluating their alignment with the 2030 Agenda to determine the social relevance of undergraduate research. Methodology:A mixed-methods, descriptive, and longitudinal study. A corpus of 393 abstracts presented at the CIARTEC conference (200 in 2024 and 193 in 2025) from the degree programs of Medicine, Psychology, Nutrition, Nursing, and Physical Therapy was analyzed. The analysis was conducted using the Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Qualitative Analysis (ACAIA) model, employing NotebookLM for lexicometric systematization and cross-mapping with the official ECLAC document on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The process integrated three phases: semantic co-occurrence analysis, alignment mapping with the 17 SDGs, and identification of regional epistemological silences. Results:A discursive transition was identified in Medicine: from a personal-narrative approach (autoethnography) in 2024 to a clinical-epidemiological and technological one in 2025, where Artificial Intelligence emerged as a key topic. Although a robust link with SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being, 92.1%) exists, critical "epistemological silences" were detected in priority targets for Latin America: neonatal health (2%), reproductive rights (0.5%), and total omission (0%) regarding neglected tropical diseases (Chagas/Leprosy) and international migration. Psychology showed a massive shift toward netnography, while Nursing and Nutrition maintained stable preventive and educational approaches. Conclusions:Student research reflects technical and scientific maturation, but a "technical blindness" toward structural problems and social determinants of global health persists. The high concentration on individual and urban pathologies, contrasted with silence on issues of social justice and regional vulnerability, suggests the need to reorient undergraduate research lines. The ACAIA model proved to be a disruptive tool for managing large volumes of data in medical education, enabling informed decision-making to enhance the social relevance of the curriculum in the face of 2030 Agenda challenges.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了拉马尔大学健康科学专业本科生科研产出与2030年议程的契合程度，采用混合方法对2024至2025年CIARTEC会议上的393篇摘要进行词汇计量分析，并借助人工智能辅助的ACAIA模型与拉加经委会可持续发展目标文件进行交叉映射。结果显示，学生研究虽与良好健康与福祉目标关联紧密，但在新生儿健康、生殖权利、被忽视热带病和国际移民等拉美优先议题上存在明显的“认识论沉默”，医学领域还出现从个人叙事向临床流行病学与人工智能主题的转向。作者据此指出学生研究存在偏重个体与城市病理、忽视社会决定因素的结构性问题，并认为ACAIA模型有助于在大数据量下支持课程社会相关性的决策。

papers.title: Understanding AI Perception in Higher Education: A TAM-Based Approach from Uzbekistan
papers.authors: Nasibakhon Yusufjonovna Rasulova, Dilnoza Zaripova
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) technologies increasingly penetrate the field of education, understanding how students perceive and use them has become a critical area of research. This study investigates students’ attitudes toward the integration of AI into academic practices at a technical university in Uzbekistan. Drawing on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), the research focuses on three key constructs: perceived usefulness (PU), perceived ease of use (PEOU), and behavioral intention to use AI (BI). A total of 161 undergraduate students from the Faculty of Professional Education in ICT at Tashkent University of Information Technologies (TUIT) participated in an anonymous online survey. The results indicate a generally positive perception of AI among students, with high average scores for PU (5.61) and PEOU (5.65) on a 7-point Likert scale. Although the BI score (5.47) was also high, its wider distribution indicates greater variability in students’ readiness to continue using AI. The findings align with global trends in AI adoption and underscore the importance of ethical guidance and digital literacy in fostering responsible AI integration in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于技术接受模型，调查乌兹别克斯坦一所技术大学的学生对人工智能融入学术实践的态度，聚焦感知有用性、感知易用性和使用意愿三个维度，采用匿名在线问卷调查本科生。结果显示，学生对人工智能的整体感知较为积极，感知有用性和感知易用性的平均得分均较高；使用意愿的得分同样偏高，但分布更分散，表明学生继续使用人工智能的准备程度存在较大差异。作者据此指出，在高等教育中推动负责任的人工智能整合，需要重视伦理引导与数字素养培养。

papers.title: AI in Education: Students’ Feedback on Survey
papers.authors: Uranchimeg Tudevdagva, Altankhaich Baasan, Munkhtsetseg Bayanzul, Batchimeg Chimedosor, Yumchmaa Ayush, Unurnasan Dagva
papers.abstract: This paper aims to analyze on survey results from students about AI in education. The survey’s question was focused on three main dimensions: Basic knowledge about AI and its usage; Ethical issues of the AI; Future of AI in Education. Main aim of the survey is to collect feedback from students on three dimensions surround AI in Education to estimate actual feelings. The result of the study should support educators to prepare the AI policy for university and implement learner centered learning based on the AI. The survey questions prepared online and asked to take part students from different universities. During four weeks in total 85 valid responses were collected. The result of the survey shows that almost half of students used AI only when it is really need (50.6%), which confirms that not yet attracted the students to AI as educators are imaged. Most students answered that AI has supported personalized learning and AI has helped to succeed their studies. Students confirm that AI usage can be engage in cheating and plagiarism and can be risky to reduce creativity. Overall, the three dimensions demonstrate that students’ engagement with AI involves more than technological adoption. The findings indicate a need to simultaneously address AI literacy, ethical awareness, institutional policy, and learner-centered pedagogical practices. Universities should therefore develop comprehensive AI strategies that combine technological innovation with academic integrity, critical thinking, student autonomy, and responsible use of AI. Such an approach can help ensure that AI contributes to improving the quality of education while maintaining the central role of human learning and educational relationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于一项面向多所高校学生的在线问卷调查，从AI基础知识与使用、伦理问题、AI在教育中的未来三个维度收集反馈，以了解学生对AI融入教育的真实感受。结果显示，约半数学生仅在确有需要时使用AI，说明其实际参与程度尚未达到教育者的预期；多数学生认为AI支持了个性化学习并有助于学业成功，同时也确认AI使用可能涉及作弊与抄袭，并存在削弱创造力的风险。作者据此指出，学生对AI的参与不止于技术采纳，大学制定AI政策时需同时兼顾AI素养、伦理意识、学术诚信、批判性思维与学生自主性，并以学习者为中心的教学实践为基础。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Plastic and Hand Surgery – Potential or Provocation?
papers.authors: Mohammed Misbahuddin-Leis, Elias Polykandriotis, Boris Alexis Radeleff, Zeki İlhan, Muzaffer Ankolvi
papers.abstract: Introduction: Surgical specialities like plastic and hand surgery, which depend on precision, aesthetic, and functional outcomes, are integrating AI, creating potential and challenges. AI is rapidly transforming clinical procedures, requiring evaluation of its potential to improve clinical care and the challenges it faces. This narrative review critically evaluates the clinical applications, emerging innovations, and ethical challenges of AI in plastic and hand surgery, synthesising evidence on both its transformative potential and the challenges it presents.Method: We conducted a narrative review of peer-reviewed literature using PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science (2018-2025). Keywords included “artificial intelligence,” “machine learning,” “deep learning,” “plastic surgery,” “hand surgery,” “microsurgery,” and “convolutional neural networks.” We included studies on clinical applications, technological innovations, and ethical considerations. This review differs from existing syntheses by providing a balanced “Potential vs Provocation” framework that systematically addresses both benefits and challenges while proposing concrete implementation strategies for clinical practice.Results: AI technologies such as convolutional neural networks and large language models classify skin lesions, evaluate aesthetics, and automate operative documentation.Conclusion: Innovations such as generative AI, mixed reality, and predictive analytics in microsurgical procedures, patient-specific simulations, and smart rehabilitation have driven tremendous advances in this field. Despite this potential, significant challenges remain, including data bias, limited AI model interpretability, and concerns about liability and privacy. AI in plastic and hand surgery has significant potential to strengthen surgeons; however, integrating it requires acceptance, education, interdisciplinary collaboration, and ethical guidelines to address the challenges of this technological evolution.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以“潜力还是挑衅”为框架，梳理了人工智能在整形与手外科中的临床应用、新兴创新及伦理挑战，检索并综合了2018至2025年间的同行评议文献。文章指出，卷积神经网络和大语言模型等已可用于皮肤病变分类、美学评估和手术记录自动化，生成式AI、混合现实及显微外科预测分析等也推动了该领域进展。但作者同时强调，数据偏倚、模型可解释性有限以及责任与隐私顾虑仍是主要障碍，AI的整合需要外科医生接受、教育培训、跨学科协作和伦理规范，其定位是增强而非取代医生。

papers.title: Dual burden of malnutrition among mother-child dyads in Mozambique: Findings from the Demographic and Health Survey 2022–2023
papers.authors: Nahin Shakurun, Fernanda Andre, Nazeem Muhajarine
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nutritional challenges are a global public health concern, especially among children under five in sub-Saharan African countries. The coexistence of an overweight/obese mother and an underweight child in the same household is recognized as a dual burden of malnutrition (DBM). This study estimated the prevalence, identified associated factors, and assessed socioeconomic inequalities in DBM among mother-child dyads in Mozambique. METHODS: We used nationally representative, cross-sectional data from the Mozambique Demographic and Health Survey 2022-2023 (n = 3,605 mother-child dyads). Child undernutrition and maternal BMI status were calculated using the World Health Organisation (WHO) standard guidelines. The outcome variable, DBM, was defined as the presence of child undernutrition condition (stunting, wasting or underweight) with corresponding maternal overweight/obesity. Multivariable binary logistic regression, Erreygers's concentration index, and concentration curve analyses were performed, accounting for the complex survey design, to determine associated factors and social inequalities. RESULTS: The prevalence of DBM was 5.5% [95% CI: 4.6, 6.6]. Mothers aged ≥ 34 years [aOR (95% CI): 4.01(1.44, 11.14); p < 0.05] and mothers with four or more children [aOR (95% CI): 2.68(1.29, 5.57); p < 0.05] had higher odds of DBM. Rural residence and using unimproved toilet facilities (latter an indicator) were also significantly associated with DBM. Additionally, maternal age modified the association between women's empowerment and mother-child DBM. Women aged 15-19 years at the lowest and highest empowerment levels were more likely to experience DBM than women 20 years or older. A positive and statistically significant concentration index indicates that wealth-related inequalities exist, with DBM more concentrated among wealthier mother-child dyads. CONCLUSION: Our study highlights the occurrence of household-level DBM in Mozambique. These findings emphasize the need for targeted interventions addressing social and economic inequalities, including poor sanitation, a marker of broader household deprivation. Prioritizing integrated maternal-child nutrition interventions within national strategies is essential to improving equity in nutrition and health outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用莫桑比克2022—2023年人口与健康调查的全国代表性横截面数据，考察母子配对中“母亲超重/肥胖与儿童营养不良并存”的双重营养负担问题，估计其患病率、相关因素及社会经济不平等。结果显示，双重负担总体患病率约为5.5%，较高龄母亲和多子女母亲家庭的几率更高，农村居住和未改善的厕所设施也与该负担相关；母亲年龄还改变了女性赋权与该负担之间的关联。财富相关的不平等显著，双重负担更多集中于较富裕的母子配对。作者据此强调需针对社会经济不平等和卫生条件不足开展干预，并将母婴整合营养措施纳入国家策略。

papers.title: Predicting mental health risk in adolescents using interpretable machine learning: Evidence from SHAP analysis
papers.authors: Jinsheng He
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Adolescent mental health is a critical public health concern; however, the combined contribution of emotional, demographic, and behavioral factors to poor mental health remains incompletely understood. This study applied an interpretable machine learning framework to identify key predictors of elevated mental health risk among adolescents and characterize their relative and non-linear contributions. METHODS: Data were drawn from the 2021 Youth Risk Behavior Survey (YRBS), comprising 16,946 U.S. high school students. Elevated mental health risk was defined using the YRBS current mental health item (Q85): reporting that mental health was not good most of the time or always during the past 30 days. The distinct 12-month sadness/hopelessness item (Q25) was retained as a predictor in the primary XGBoost model. The operating threshold was selected by maximizing the Youden index using five-fold out-of-fold predictions in the training set and was then locked before evaluation in the held-out test set. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to assess feature importance and directional and non-linear patterns. RESULTS: Overall, 28.0% of adolescents were classified as having elevated mental health risk, with higher prevalence among females (39.9% vs. 16.9%) and peak prevalence at ages 16-17. The primary XGBoost model achieved an AUC of 0.806 and PR-AUC of 0.603. At the training-derived threshold of 0.285, accuracy was 0.749, sensitivity 0.754, specificity 0.747, and balanced accuracy 0.750. SHAP analysis identified sadness/hopelessness as the dominant predictor, followed by sex, sleep duration, screen time, and breakfast frequency. In a sensitivity analysis excluding sadness/hopelessness, discrimination decreased (AUC 0.736; PR-AUC 0.510). CONCLUSION: The revised primary model achieved balanced sensitivity and specificity above 0.700 using a threshold selected entirely within the training data. Sadness/hopelessness was the strongest predictor, while demographic and behavioral factors provided additional predictive information. Because sadness/hopelessness is conceptually close to the current mental health outcome and the data are cross-sectional, the model should be interpreted as an auxiliary risk-stratification tool rather than a standalone clinical screening or diagnostic instrument.

papers.title: Investigating the role of mental health and lifestyle behaviours in the risk of adolescent suicidal behaviours through machine learning
papers.authors: Yanmei Ding, Yanzhao Lei
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Suicidal behaviors among adolescents are a serious global public health concern and are closely linked to both mental health and everyday lifestyle behaviors. Suicidal ideation, planning, and attempts lie along a spectrum of increasing severity. However, how psychological distress and health-related behaviors interact to influence suicide risk is complex and not yet fully understood. This study aimed to identify key mental health and lifestyle factors associated with different stages of adolescent suicidal behaviors using interpretable machine learning methods. METHODS: Data were obtained from the 2021 Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBS), a nationally representative survey of U.S. high school students. After data cleaning and multiple imputation, 16,946 adolescents aged 14-18 years were included in the analysis. Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) models were developed to predict suicidal ideation, suicide planning, and suicide attempts. Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and related metrics. Feature importance was examined using gain-based measures, while SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and partial dependence plots were used to explore the direction, strength, and nonlinear effects of key predictors. RESULTS: All three XGBoost models showed satisfactory predictive performance. Mental health factors, particularly persistent feelings of sadness and self-rated mental health, were the strongest predictors across all stages of suicidal behaviors. Lifestyle behaviors, including sleep duration, physical activity, diet, screen time, and substance use, also contributed meaningfully to risk prediction, although their relative importance differed by outcome. SHAP analyses indicated that greater sadness and poorer mental health were strongly associated with higher suicide risk, whereas adequate sleep and higher levels of physical activity were associated with lower predicted risk. Substance use, including alcohol, cigarette, and marijuana use, played an important role in predicting suicide attempts than suicidal ideation or planning. Partial dependence analyses showed nonlinear and threshold effects, especially for sadness, mental health status, and sleep duration. CONCLUSION: Mental health factors, especially persistent sadness and overall psychological well-being, were among the most prominent factors associated with suicidal behaviors among adolescents, while lifestyle behaviors showed important and stage-specific associations. Interpretable machine learning approaches help identify complex and nonlinear patterns associated with adolescent suicide risk and offer valuable insights to guide targeted, evidence-based prevention efforts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用可解释机器学习方法，基于2021年美国青少年风险行为监测系统的数据，构建模型预测青少年自杀意念、自杀计划和自杀尝试三个严重程度阶段，并考察心理健康与生活方式因素在各阶段的作用。结果显示，持续悲伤感和自评心理健康是最强的预测因素，睡眠时长、体育活动、饮食、屏幕时间和物质使用也有实质贡献，但相对重要性因结局而异；物质使用对自杀尝试的预测作用强于自杀意念或计划。SHAP与部分依赖分析提示，悲伤和较差心理健康与更高风险相关，充足睡眠和较多体育活动与较低预测风险相关，且部分因素呈非线性与阈值效应。这些发现有助于识别青少年自杀风险的复杂模式，为分阶段预防提供参考。

papers.title: Analyzing Neural Responses to Video Advertisements: From Visual Attention to Cognitive Load
papers.authors: Arbintoro Mas
papers.journal: JAREE (Journal on Advanced Research in Electrical Engineering)
papers.abstract: Understanding consumer engagement is essential for optimizing marketing strategies. This study analyzes neural responses using electroencephalography (EEG) to distinguish interesting and ordinary video advertisements. EEG data from 30 participants (aged 17–40) were recorded across eight channels (F8, F7, T8, T7, P8, P7, O2, O1) and decomposed into five subbands (Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma). Key features, including Power Spectral Density (PSD), Mean Absolute Value (MAV), Hjorth Activity, Zero Crossing Rate (ZCR), and Wavelet Transform, were extracted and analyzed. Results showed that Gamma activity in occipital regions (O1, O2) was higher during interesting advertisements, indicating heightened visual attention, and reduced Beta activity in frontal regions (F7, F8) indicating reduced cognitive load. These findings offer valuable insights for neuromarketing by identifying neural markers of engagement and providing actionable insights for designing effective advertisements.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电图分析消费者观看视频广告时的神经反应，以区分有趣广告与普通广告。结果显示，有趣广告在枕区（O1、O2）的Gamma活动更高，提示视觉注意增强；额区（F7、F8）的Beta活动降低，提示认知负荷减轻。作者据此提出可将这些神经指标用于神经营销，为广告设计提供参考，但结论基于特定电极与频段特征，外推需谨慎。

papers.title: Protocol for Conducting a Scoping Review on The Use of AI in Automated Scoring of Short-Answer Questions in Medical Education
papers.authors: Süleyman Ayhan Çalışkan, Firdaus Bello Abubakar, Mohi Eldin Magzoub
papers.abstract: Assessment is a central component of medical education, requiring methods that can assess learners’ knowledge and reasoning while maintaining acceptable reliability and feasibility. Short-answer questions (SAQs) require learners to construct responses rather than select from predetermined options and can support assessment of applied knowledge and reasoning. However, their use is constrained by the time and resources required for scoring and by potential variability among human graders. These limitations have increased interest in automated approaches to scoring written responses. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based systems using machine learning, deep learning, transformer-based models, large language models, and related natural language processing techniques are increasingly being applied to the automated scoring of SAQs. Such systems may reduce grading workload, improve scoring consistency, and facilitate timely feedback. However, questions remain regarding their scoring performance, reliability, validity, fairness, transparency, and feasibility for use in educational settings. The approaches and evaluation methods reported across the literature are heterogeneous, creating a need to systematically map the available evidence. This scoping review aims to map the literature on AI-based automated scoring of SAQs in medical education. Specifically, it will identify and characterize the AI-based models used; map the measures and metrics used to assess scoring performance, reliability, and validity; describe reported advantages, limitations, and implementation challenges; and examine how studies have compared the scoring performance, reliability, validity, and fairness of AI-based systems with human graders. The review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute methodology for scoping reviews and will use the Population–Concept–Context framework to guide study selection and data extraction. English-language original empirical studies published from 2015 onward involving medical students and AI-based automated scoring of SAQs will be eligible. The findings will provide a structured overview of current approaches and evaluation practices, identify gaps in the evidence, and inform future research and implementation of AI-based automated scoring in medical education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一份范围综述方案，旨在系统梳理医学教育中利用人工智能自动评阅简答题的相关文献。作者计划按Joanna Briggs Institute方法，以人群—概念—情境框架筛选2015年以来的英文实证研究，重点归纳所用AI模型、评分性能与信效度的评估指标，以及与人评阅者比较的做法，并整理已报告的优势、局限和实施挑战。方案本身不提供结果，其意义在于为后续证据整合与教学应用研究提供结构化的梳理框架。

papers.title: Using the implementation research logic model (IRLM) to track implementation strategy changes and adaptations: a case example from a study on APOL1 genetic testing and counseling by nephrologists
papers.authors: Justin Dean Smith, James Lorenz Merle, Jessica Gacki‐Smith, Akansha H. Agrawal, Alexander J. Gilbert, Elisa J. Gordon
papers.abstract: The Implementation Research Logic Model (IRLM) was developed to help implementation researchers specify relationships among determinants, implementation strategies, mechanisms, and outcomes. Although the IRLM is intended to support planning, execution, reporting, and synthesis, it is often treated as a static product used for one purpose—most commonly for planning. Even when used across these purposes, a reporting gap may arise when strategies are adapted, bundled, discontinued, or implemented differently across sites. However, the IRLM can be used to execute and track the study or implementation effort. We describe a structured method for using the IRLM across three versions and outputs: (1) a protocol IRLM that represents the study’s theory-of-intent; (2) a tracked revision of the IRLM that documents changes, rationales, and evidence sources for adaptations and modifications; and (3) a final reconciled IRLM that represents the enacted theory-in-use. We illustrate the use of this methodology with the Apolipoprotein L1 ( APOL1 ) Counseling and Testing Program, a hybrid type 2 effectiveness-implementation study using a two-site non-randomized trial of culturally competent APOL1 genetic testing, a conversational agent (chatbot), and nephrologist-delivered counseling for living kidney donor evaluation. Applying the versioned IRLM method to the APOL1 trial generated a strategy execution matrix and a revised set of context-strategy-mechanism-outcome linkages. The process made visible several forms of protocol-to-practice change including: discontinued electronic health record (EHR) integration strategies, adapted conversational agent and educational brochure delivery, site-specific task shifting, bundled stakeholder engagement strategies, and modifications to nephrologist training supports. Mechanism reassessment led to adding donor empowerment, separating communication from coordination, and removing an EHR-related complex mechanism that was no longer actionable. Treating the IRLM as a dynamic implementation product can improve transparency about what happened during implementation trials, why actions taken differed from the protocol, and how those differences alter hypothesized causal pathways and outcomes. This method complements longitudinal strategy tracking approaches and can support reporting, interpretability, replication, scale-up, and mechanism-focused implementation science.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以实施研究逻辑模型（IRLM）为工具，提出一种跨三个版本追踪实施策略变化与调整的结构化方法，并以APOL1基因检测与咨询项目为案例进行说明。案例中，作者通过协议版、追踪修订版和最终校准版IRLM，生成了策略执行矩阵并修订了情境—策略—机制—结果之间的关联，使电子健康记录整合策略的终止、对话代理与教育材料交付方式的调整、站点特定的任务转移以及肾科医生培训支持的修改等协议到实践的变化得以显现。机制重估还促成了供体赋权的新增、沟通与协调的分离，以及一项不再可行的电子健康记录相关复杂机制的移除。文章认为，将IRLM视为动态的实施产品，有助于提升实施试验的透明度，说明实际做法为何偏离协议以及这种偏离如何改变假设的因果路径与结果，并可支持报告、可解释性、复制、推广和以机制为中心的实施科学。

papers.title: Data-driven subgroups of adolescent depression: integrating EEG-derived brain networks, childhood trauma, and depressive symptoms
papers.authors: Xuan Liu, Yexian Zeng, Xiaofeng Lan, Muqin Zhang, Weicheng Li, Zhanjie Luo, Guanxi Liu, Yiyun Xue, Yuping Ning, Yanling Zhou
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Adolescent major depressive disorder (MDD) is characterized by marked clinical heterogeneity and heightened sensitivity to psychosocial adversity, particularly childhood trauma. Ongoing neurodevelopment and brain plasticity during adolescence may limit the applicability of adult-derived neurobiological models. Previous studies have rarely integrated large-scale network connectivity, trauma exposure, and symptom dimensions within a single multivariate framework and have largely relied on functional magnetic resonance imaging or univariate electroencephalographic (EEG) measures. Methods This cross-sectional case-control study included 67 medication-free adolescents with MDD and 35 matched healthy controls. Resting-state source-space EEG functional connectivity was estimated. Sparse canonical correlation analysis (sCCA) was used to identify multivariate associations between network connectivity and clinical and childhood-trauma measures. Moderation analysis examined whether network connectivity moderated the association between trauma and depression severity. K-means clustering of sCCA-derived canonical variates was used to identify data-driven patient subgroups. Results Adolescents with MDD showed lower default mode network (DMN)-limbic network (LMN) connectivity than healthy controls. The only sCCA mode meeting the prespecified robustness criteria linked physical abuse, emotional neglect, and anxiety/somatization to distributed connectivity features, particularly those involving the frontoparietal, limbic, visual, and salience networks. Within-visual-network connectivity moderated the association between childhood trauma and depression severity. Clustering identified two patient subgroups with distinct symptom and network profiles. Conclusions EEG-derived network measures may help characterize the interplay between childhood trauma and clinical heterogeneity in adolescent MDD. These preliminary findings require replication in larger, independent samples. Clinical trial number not applicable
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年重性抑郁障碍的临床异质性，尝试将静息态脑电源空间功能连接、童年创伤与症状维度纳入同一多变量框架，以识别数据驱动的患者亚组。研究采用横断面病例对照设计，比较青少年患者与健康对照的网络连接，并用稀疏典型相关分析考察连接与创伤、症状的关联。结果显示，患者默认网络与边缘网络连接低于对照；唯一满足稳健性标准的关联模式将躯体虐待、情感忽视和焦虑/躯体化与额顶、边缘、视觉及突显网络等分布式连接特征联系起来，且视觉网络内部连接调节了童年创伤与抑郁严重度的关联。聚类进一步分出两个症状与网络特征不同的患者亚组，作者强调这些初步发现尚需在更大独立样本中验证。

papers.title: Emotional eating as a stress- and emotion-regulation coping mechanism: a systematic review of quantitative evidence across populations
papers.authors: Sohom Saha, Suchishrava Choudhary, Prashant Kumar Choudhary, Sema Arslan Kabasakal, Borko Katanić, Deepak Bangari
papers.abstract: Emotional eating, characterised by eating in response to emotional states rather than physiological hunger, has been associated with stress, emotion-regulation difficulties, and psychological distress. Evidence across populations is methodologically heterogeneous, and it remains unclear whether emotional eating consistently functions as a coping response. This systematic review synthesised quantitative evidence examining emotional eating in relation to stress, negative affect, and emotion-regulation processes across populations and study designs. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and the Web of Science Core Collection were systematically searched. Nineteen peer-reviewed quantitative studies involving adolescents aged 12 years and older, university students, and adults were included. Cross-sectional, longitudinal, experimental, diary-based, and ecological momentary assessment studies were synthesised narratively. Methodological quality was evaluated using the relevant Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. Across the included studies, emotional eating was positively associated with perceived stress, negative affect, depressive and anxiety symptoms, and difficulties in emotion regulation. Laboratory studies indicated that stress or experimentally induced affect altered eating-related responses in some subgroups, whereas diary-based and ecological momentary assessment studies provided more limited evidence concerning temporal ordering. Several studies reported higher emotional-eating scores among women and individuals with higher BMI, although these patterns were not universal. Lower emotional and appetite awareness were associated with greater emotional eating, while one adolescent ecological momentary assessment study found that greater negative emodiversity was associated with higher trait emotional eating. Prospective evidence also linked emotional eating and psychological distress with subsequent increases in high-sugar food and drink consumption. The findings indicate context-dependent associations between emotional eating, psychological stress, negative affect, and emotion-regulation difficulties. However, because most included studies were observational and relied on self-reported measures, the review does not establish causal direction or demonstrate that emotional eating functions as a coping response in every individual. Further prospective, experimental, and intervention studies are required to clarify the underlying mechanisms and clinical relevance of these associations. People sometimes eat when they are stressed, upset, anxious, or experiencing other strong emotions rather than because they are physically hungry. This is known as emotional eating. We reviewed existing research to understand how emotional eating is related to stress, negative emotions, and difficulties in managing emotions. We searched three major research databases and identified 19 quantitative studies involving adolescents, university students, and adults. Overall, emotional eating was associated with higher stress, negative emotions, anxiety and depressive symptoms, and greater difficulty managing emotions. Some studies suggested that stressful or negative emotional experiences can influence eating responses, particularly in certain groups. Emotional eating was also more common in some studies among women and people with higher body mass index, although these patterns were not consistent across all studies. These findings suggest that emotional eating may be related to how people experience and manage stress and emotions, but it does not necessarily function as a coping response in everyone. Because most studies were observational and relied on self-reported information, the findings do not establish that stress or emotional difficulties directly cause emotional eating. Further prospective and experimental research is needed to better understand why emotional eating occurs and how it might be addressed.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了情绪性进食与压力、负性情绪及情绪调节过程相关的定量证据，纳入涉及青少年、大学生和成人的多项观察性与实验性研究，采用叙事综合并评估方法学质量。总体发现情绪性进食与感知压力、负性情绪、抑郁焦虑症状及情绪调节困难呈正相关，实验室研究提示压力或诱发的情绪可改变部分亚组的进食反应，而日记和生态瞬时评估研究对时间顺序提供的证据较为有限。作者指出这些关联具有情境依赖性，且因多数研究为观察性设计并依赖自我报告，无法确立因果方向，也不能证明情绪性进食在每个人身上都起到应对作用，尚需前瞻性与干预研究澄清机制。

papers.title: Machine learning analysis of the association between fertility and under five mortality in Bangladesh using BDHS 2022 data
papers.authors: Shayla Naznin, Md Jamal Uddin, Ishmam Ahmad, Ahmad Kabir
papers.abstract: Under-five mortality is a key indicator of child health, reflecting healthcare quality, nutrition, and socio-economic conditions. In Bangladesh, under-five mortality remains a public health concern despite substantial declines, with fertility-related factors potentially contributing to child survival. Traditional logistic regression may not adequately capture complex and nonlinear relationships, whereas machine learning methods can capture such patterns and provide complementary predictive insights. This study examined the association between fertility-related factors and under-five mortality using traditional logistic regression and machine learning approaches with nationally representative BDHS 2022 data. Data were obtained from the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey (BDHS) 2022. Ten machine learning models Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, Decision Tree, Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, Neural Network, XGBoost, and LightGBM were implemented in Python, while complex-sample logistic regression was conducted using SPSS Version 25. Model interpretability was assessed using SHAP values and partial dependence plots (PDPs). Model performance was evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), Cohen’s Kappa, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Decision Tree demonstrated the best overall performance for identifying under-5 mortality, achieving a mortality precision of 15.25%, recall of 52.94%, F1-score of 0.2368, MCC of 0.2424, Cohen’s Kappa of 0.1973, and AUROC of 0.8045. Gradient Boosting achieved the highest mortality recall (55.88%). Key predictors included household size, total children ever born, currently breastfeeding status, and parental education. SHAP and PDP analyses identified important contributions from fertility-related, household, and socio-economic factors to model predictions. Higher parity, measured by the total number of children ever born, was significantly associated with increased odds of under-five mortality. Current breastfeeding status was inversely associated with mortality; however, this finding should be interpreted cautiously because of potential temporal ambiguity. Machine learning models complemented complex-sample logistic regression by identifying important fertility-related, household, and socioeconomic predictors and capturing potentially nonlinear patterns in the data. These findings provide evidence to inform further research and public health planning aimed at reducing under-five mortality in Bangladesh.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用孟加拉国2022年人口与健康调查数据，比较复杂样本逻辑回归与十种机器学习模型在识别五岁以下儿童死亡相关因素上的表现，并借助SHAP值和偏依赖图解释预测结果。决策树在识别死亡案例上综合表现最好，梯度提升的召回率最高；家庭规模、曾生子女总数、当前母乳喂养状况和父母教育是主要预测因素。分析显示，曾生子女数越多与五岁以下死亡风险升高相关，当前母乳喂养则呈负向关联，但作者提醒后者可能受时间顺序不清的影响。研究认为机器学习可补充传统回归，捕捉 fertility 相关因素与家庭、社会经济因素中的非线性模式，为后续研究和公共卫生规划提供线索。

papers.title: Comparative analysis of five large language models for generating heart failure patient education content: dual perspectives from professionals and patients
papers.authors: Yaqin Chen, Yanchun Peng, Shilin Chen, Bingxin Huang, Jia Xie, Yu Xue, Qingsong Wu, Wenping Gao, Liangwan Chen, Yanjuan Lin
papers.abstract: Self-management in heart failure (HF) is essential for improving outcomes, yet adherence remains suboptimal, particularly among older adults and individuals with limited health literacy. Large language models (LLMs) generating patient education content at scale, yet evidence regarding their accuracy and alignment with HF patient needs is limited. To compare the quality of responses generated by five widely used LLMs (DeepSeek, Doubao, Grok, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to self-management questions of HF patients from two perspectives (professional and patient perception), and to quantify the discrepancies between these perspectives. A cross-sectional study. A structured 45-item question bank on self-management among HF patients, encompassing six domains and varying in type and difficulty, was administered to five LLMs. Responses were independently evaluated by four healthcare professionals using four domains (accuracy, completeness, safety, and actionability; 1–5 Likert scale with safety veto). Fifteen HF patients assessed responses in terms of comprehensibility, usefulness, satisfaction, and trustworthiness. Generalized estimating equations (GEE), intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC), and linear mixed-effects models were used to compare performance and assess variability across raters and models. DeepSeek achieved the highest professional evaluation score (19.49/20), significantly exceeding those of the other models (GEE β = −1.79 to − 1.06, all P < 0.001). In contrast, patients rated Doubao highest (16.93), followed by DeepSeek (16.33), particularly among older and lower-education subgroups. The professional–patient discrepancy varied substantially across models, ranging from 1.50 (Doubao) to 5.02 (ChatGPT). Notably, responses involving dietary sodium restriction showed consistent safety concerns across models, yet patients consistently rated these items favorably. Diet and sodium restriction consistently emerged as the weakest-performing domain across all models. Professional and patient evaluations of LLM-generated self-management education for HF patients diverged significantly. DeepSeek ranked highest clinically, but patients favored Doubao for its readability and trustworthiness, emphasizing the need to balance clinical accuracy with patient-centered design in healthcare AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了五种大语言模型生成的心衰患者自我管理教育内容，由医护人员和患者分别从各自视角评价其质量，并量化两种视角之间的差异。结果显示，专业评价中 DeepSeek 得分最高，而患者更偏好 Doubao，认为其可读性和可信度更好，尤其在年长和低教育程度患者中；不同模型的专业与患者评分差距差异明显。饮食与限钠在所有模型中表现最弱，且患者对相关回答的评价普遍偏正面，提示临床准确性与患者友好设计之间存在张力。

papers.title: Associations of patient safety-related perceptions and lifelong learning-related attitudes with critical trust in AI/digital clinical tools among medical students: a cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Beytullah Nariçi, Mustafa Demir, Numan Güvenç, Hamit Sırrı Keten
papers.abstract: Patient safety, lifelong learning, and the safe use of artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly relevant to undergraduate medical education, but their interrelationships remain poorly understood. This study examined medical students’ patient safety-related perceptions, lifelong learning-related attitudes, and critical trust in AI/digital clinical tools. This single-center cross-sectional survey was conducted at Gaziantep University Faculty of Medicine, Türkiye, between April and May 2026. Of 366 submitted responses, seven from students younger than 18 years were excluded, leaving 359 participants. Study-developed Likert-type item sets assessed patient safety, lifelong learning, and approaches to AI/digital clinical tools. Exploratory factor analysis, informed by parallel analysis, was used to derive exploratory indices. Associations were examined using nonparametric tests and multivariable linear regression, with sensitivity analyses using complete item sets and excluding invariant respondents. Patient safety training during the previous 12 months was reported by 72 students (20.1%), and AI/digital health or clinical decision support system training by 50 (13.9%). Among clinical-phase students, 10 of 79 (12.7%) reported having encountered an adverse-event or near-miss reporting system. The exploratory patient-safety index was positively correlated with the exploratory critical-trust index (Spearman’s ρ = 0.453, p < 0.001). In multivariable analysis, the patient-safety index showed the largest standardized association with critical trust (B = 0.473, 95% CI 0.385 to 0.560; β = 0.507; p < 0.001). Clinical-phase status was positively associated with critical trust (B = 0.167, p = 0.010), whereas reported AI/digital health training was inversely associated (B = − 0.177, p = 0.018). The dichotomous any-use variable for digital clinical or AI-based tools was not independently associated with critical trust. In the complete-item sensitivity model, the patient-safety association persisted but was attenuated (β = 0.292, p < 0.001). Patient safety-related perceptions were associated with critical trust in AI/digital clinical tools, although the lower coefficient in the complete-item analysis indicates that the estimated magnitude was sensitive to how the scores were constructed; differences in item composition, measurement reliability, and wording-related structure may also have contributed. These exploratory cross-sectional findings do not establish causal or curricular effects but provide a rationale for longitudinal, interventional, and simulation-based studies examining how patient safety, lifelong learning, and critical evaluation of AI-supported recommendations may intersect in medical education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以土耳其一所医学院的医学生为对象，通过单中心横断面问卷调查，考察其患者安全相关认知、终身学习态度与对AI/数字临床工具持批判性信任之间的关系。结果显示，患者安全指数与批判性信任呈正相关，且在多变量分析中关联最强；临床阶段学生的批判性信任更高，而自报接受过AI/数字健康培训者反而更低，工具使用与否则无独立关联。作者指出，完整条目敏感性分析中该关联减弱，说明估计幅度受评分构建方式影响，且横断面设计无法确立因果或课程效果。

papers.title: Internet use and health related quality of life in older adults: longitudinal analysis of a population-based cohort
papers.authors: Ana Rita Henriques, Nuno Mendonça, Pedro Manuel Vargues Aguiar, Cátia F. Gonçalves, Helena M Canhão, Diederik De Cock, Ana Maria Rodrigues
papers.abstract: The relationship between Internet use and the health of older adults remains unclear. Therefore, we aimed to assess the association of Internet use on quality of life and physical function among Portuguese older adults (60 + years). This study included 60 + year olds from a nationwide population-based cohort (EpiDoC Cohort), who were followed from 2013 to 2021. Internet usage (status, years, frequency) was self-reported. Health-related quality of life (HRQoL) was assessed using EQ-5D-3L, and physical function via Health Assessment Questionnaire (HAQ). Covariates included sex, age, residence, education, marital status, body mass index (BMI), smoking, alcohol use, exercise, and multimorbidity. Linear mixed models and random intercept Tobit regressions were used. The study followed 1604 participants for an average of 3.2 ± 2.6 years and for a maximum of 3 waves. Among them, 366 (22.8%) used Internet for 9.4 ± 6.5 years, with an average usage of 8.4 ± 9 h/week. Compared with non-users, Internet users had, on average, HRQoL scores 0.05 points higher and HAQ scores 0.13 points lower during follow-up (95%CIs:0.02–0.08 and − 0.23 to − 0.03, respectively), after adjustment for time since baseline and socioeconomic and health covariates. Our results suggest that Internet use among older adults is associated with modestly higher HRQoL and and better physical function during the follow-up. These findings highlight the potential relevance of promoting safe and accessible Internet use among older adults.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于葡萄牙全国性人群队列，考察老年人使用互联网与健康相关生活质量及身体功能之间的关联，使用自报的互联网使用情况，并结合EQ-5D-3L和HAQ量表进行纵向分析。调整社会经济与健康协变量后，互联网使用者的生活质量评分略高、身体功能评分略低，提示使用互联网与随访期间较好的生活质量和身体功能存在关联。作者据此指出，推动老年人安全、可及地使用互联网可能具有潜在意义，但结论属于关联性发现，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Prevalence and factors associated with obesity among healthcare workers in Oman: a cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Salma Rashid Al-Kalbani, Hamed Al-Qanubi
papers.abstract: Obesity is a growing global health concern, increasingly prevalent among healthcare workers (HCWs) who serve as both caregivers and role models for patients. Despite their health knowledge, HCWs are vulnerable to obesity due to occupational stress, sedentary behaviour, and irregular work hours. In Oman, obesity prevalence is high in the general population, yet limited data exist among HCWs. To assess the prevalence of obesity among HCWs in Oman and identify its associated health and occupational risk factors. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 297 HCWs employed in governmental healthcare institutions across Oman from October 2025 to February 2026. Retired HCWs, pregnant women, and private-sector employees were excluded. Data were collected using a structured, self-administered online questionnaire, which included self-reported anthropometric parameters. Data analysis included descriptive statistics and bivariate analyses (chi-square tests or Fisher’s exact tests) to evaluate factors associated with obesity, with the level of significance set at \(\:p<0.05\) . Advanced multivariable modelling was not performed due to sample size constraints. The overall prevalence of obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m²) among participants with complete BMI data was 37.7% (81/215). Obesity prevalence was higher among females (38.0%) and HCWs aged ≥ 40 years (41.0%). Bivariate analysis revealed that having a past medical history was a significant factor associated with obesity (50.0% vs. 33.5%, p = 0.031). In this study, lack of regular exercise had no significant association with obesity (43.7% among non-exercisers vs. 25.0% among those who exercised regularly, p = 0.070). Among work-related factors, availability of healthy food at the workplace was significantly associated with lower obesity prevalence (22.0% vs. 43.2%, p = 0.033). Other factors, such as access to workout facilities, flexible working hours, a supportive culture, and wellness programs, had no significant association with obesity. Obesity is prevalent among HCWs in Oman, with notable associations with both past health history and workplace nutrition availability. Targeted workplace interventions focusing on enhancing healthy food provision, alongside exercise promotion and wellness programs, may help mitigate obesity risk, supporting HCWs’ overall well-being and their capacity to serve as healthy role models for patients. Not applicable.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于阿曼政府医疗机构医护人员横断面调查数据，考察医护人员肥胖患病率及其健康与职业相关因素。结果显示，有完整BMI数据的参与者中肥胖患病率约为37.7%，女性及40岁及以上者患病率略高；双变量分析中，既往病史与肥胖显著相关，工作场所提供健康食品与较低肥胖患病率显著相关，而规律运动、健身设施、弹性工时和健康项目等未显示显著关联。作者据此提出，针对工作场所健康食品供给的干预可能有助于降低医护人员肥胖风险，但研究为横断面设计且未进行多变量建模，相关关联不宜作因果解读。

papers.title: Burden of family history on cardiovascular risk factors and target organ injury in adolescents: the ExAMIN Youth SA study
papers.authors: Chilene Vorster, Wayne T Smith, Ruan Kruger
papers.abstract: The global rise in obesity and hypertension among youth adds to the burden of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in later life. Evidence on how family history (FH) of CVD influences cardiovascular risk factors and target organ injury (TOI) in youth remains limited. We examined the relationship of TOI markers with cardiovascular risk factors in adolescents stratified by the absence (no-FH)/presence of FH of CVD and lifestyle risk. We included 682 school-going adolescents (mean age: 11 years) from the follow-up phase of the Exercise, Arterial Modulation and Nutrition in Youth South Africa study. Data on self-reported FH of CVD and lifestyle risk, demographics, anthropometrics, blood pressure, physical activity, and urinary glucose were collected. Cardiovascular ultrasound was used to determine carotid intima-media thickness (cIMT), left ventricular mass index (LVMI), and relative wall thickness (RWT). Cardiovascular risk factors and TOI markers were similar between the two groups except for higher socioeconomic status (SES) in the FH group ( p < 0.001). Carotid-IMT independently associated with lower SES in the no-FH group while the odds for cIMT>75th percentile was associated with the White population group and lower SES in the FH group. In both groups, RWT inversely associated with age, and additionally with the Black population group in the FH group. LVMI associated positively (β = 0.46 vs. β = 0.25, both p < 0.02) and RWT inversely (β=–0.27 vs. β=–0.49, both p < 0.001) with BMI z-score in both the FH and no-FH groups. Higher BMI z-scores associated with a threefold increase in the odds of both LVH>50 g/m 2.16 and RWT < 0.32 cm/m 2 in both groups. In the no-FH group, elevated urinary glucose was associated with a fourfold increase in LVH and lower RWT. Age associated with higher odds of RWT < 0.32 cm/m 2 in the FH group. TOI in adolescents associated with a combination of social determinates, FH, and modifiable cardiometabolic risk factors. While FH identified a subgroup with greater overall risk burden, BMI z-score emerged as the strongest correlate of cardiac remodelling, independent of FH. These findings underscore the importance of early identification and prevention strategies targeting obesity and other modifiable risk factors across all adolescents. The study was retrospectively registered on ClinicalTrials.gov on 12 August 2019 (NCT04056377).
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于南非青少年追踪数据，考察心血管疾病家族史与生活方式风险如何影响青少年的心血管危险因素及靶器官损伤标志物，并比较有无家族史两组间的差异。结果显示，两组在危险因素和靶器官损伤指标上总体相似，仅家族史组社会经济地位较高；颈动脉内膜中层厚度、左心室质量指数和相对壁厚与年龄、社会经济地位、族群及尿糖等因素的关联在两组间存在差异。值得注意的是，无论有无家族史，BMI z评分都是心脏重构最强的相关因素，较高的BMI z评分与左心室肥厚和相对壁厚异常的风险升高相关。作者据此强调，应在所有青少年中尽早识别并干预肥胖等可改变的危险因素。

papers.title: From crayon to code: visual representation in the age of generative artificial intelligence
papers.authors: Irina Mil-Homens Figueira Dos Santos Silva, Sarah Matthews, Susan J. Danby
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) permeates young children's everyday lives. The Australian Curriculum suggests that AI systems seek to replicate aspects of human problem-solving and task completion, and highlights the need to prepare children to navigate AI responsibly and safely. This article examines how young children aged four to eight engaged with Generative AI (i.e. Adobe Firefly) to visually represent their ideas. Using the children's rights approach, children actively participated in the research, suggesting prompts, reflecting on the outputs generated and iteratively refining them until achieving their desired outcome. We analysed children's conversations during their participation, prompts and outcomes through a sociological lens and UNESCO's AI competency framework for students. Children's experiences highlighted their interest in AI, and awareness of its opportunities, limitations and risks. Providing young children opportunities to safely engage with AI systems supports their AI literacy and critical thinking.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察四至八岁幼儿如何借助生成式人工智能（Adobe Firefly）进行视觉表达，并基于儿童权利取向让儿童参与提出提示词、反思与迭代修改生成结果。对儿童对话、提示词及生成结果的分析显示，儿童对AI表现出兴趣，并对其机会、局限与风险有所意识。作者据此认为，为幼儿提供安全接触AI系统的机会有助于培养其AI素养与批判性思维。

papers.title: What generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) risks make the news? representation of GenAI risk in Australian digital news
papers.authors: Chenchen Wang
papers.abstract: How news media make emerging technological risks visible shapes how those technologies enter public debate. This study examines generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) risk representation in Australian digital news through a mixed-methods content analysis of 379 articles from seven outlets published between 2020 and March 2024. Ethical, legal, and regulatory compliance risks receive the most attention, followed by economic and employment concerns and technical performance risks, while sociocultural and mental health risks remain marginal. Extinction risk also receives substantial coverage. Public outlets give greater attention to governance, education, and sociocultural concerns, whereas private outlets more often emphasize technical and extinction risks. Public outlets also contain more original reporting and Australian contextualization. Across the sample, GPT is frequently named but rarely explained in technical detail, while developing country and Global South contexts receive limited attention. These findings contribute to a contextual understanding of how GenAI risks are represented in Australian digital news.

papers.title: Real-Time Vigilance Monitoring via Biosignals: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Junghoon Chung, Ji-Eun Kim
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: This scoping review aims to identify types of computational models that use physiological signals for real-time vigilance monitoring. Vigilance, or the ability to sustain attention over time, is essential in domains such as driving, aviation, and industrial operations, where lapses can cause serious harm. Following PRISMA guidelines, the review searched IEEE, ProQuest, PubMed, and ScienceDirect and identified 16 studies that examined vigilance and real-time monitoring systems. Most studies applied supervised machine learning, mainly for binary classification of vigilance states such as alert versus drowsy, and were concentrated in automotive contexts. Electroencephalography (EEG) was the most commonly used sensor, while heart rate variability (HRV), electrooculography (EOG), photoplethysmography (PPG), and galvanic skin response (GSR) appeared less frequently. Overall, current systems still prioritize threshold-based detection over continuous tracking of vigilance changes. The review highlights the need for multimodal sensing, real-world validation, and adaptive modeling frameworks to support reliable deployment across diverse operational environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA流程检索多个数据库，梳理了利用生理信号进行实时警觉度监测的16项研究，重点考察所用计算模型的类型。研究发现，多数研究采用监督机器学习，主要对警觉与困倦等状态做二分类，且集中于汽车场景；脑电是最常用的传感器，心率变异性、眼电、光电容积脉搏波和皮肤电反应使用较少。总体而言，现有系统仍偏重基于阈值的检测，而非对警觉度变化的连续追踪，作者据此指出多模态传感、真实环境验证与自适应建模是可靠部署的关键方向。

papers.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces for AAC: Hybrid SSVEP + Eye-Tracking for Faster Selection Rates
papers.authors: Lola Peres
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Augmentative and alternative communication systems are essential for people with severe speech and motor impairments, yet many interfaces remain slow, effortful, and error-prone. This study evaluated a hybrid brain-computer interface that combines steady-state visually evoked potentials (SSVEP) with eye-tracking to improve selection speed, reliability, and usability. Participants completed symbol selection, short phrase construction, and correction tasks under three conditions: SSVEP-only, eye-tracking-only, and hybrid SSVEP plus eye-tracking. In the hybrid condition, gaze rapidly narrowed the likely target region, while SSVEP classification confirmed user intent. Outcomes included selection rate, accuracy, errors, correction time, communication throughput, workload, effort, trust, and preference. The hybrid interface achieved the strongest performance, with faster selection than SSVEP-only and better control than eye-tracking-only. It also reduced accidental selections and correction burden, particularly in dense layouts and longer tasks. Results further emphasized personalized gaze thresholds, SSVEP windows, and visual layouts for sustained, practical AAC use across diverse user needs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对严重言语与运动障碍者使用的辅助沟通系统操作慢、费力且易出错的问题，评估了一种将稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）与眼动追踪结合的混合脑机接口，并让参与者分别在仅SSVEP、仅眼动追踪和混合三种条件下完成符号选择、短语构建与纠错任务。结果显示，混合条件下眼动先快速缩小候选区域、SSVEP再确认意图，选择速度快于仅SSVEP，控制表现优于仅眼动追踪，同时减少了误选和纠错负担，在密集布局和较长任务中尤为明显。作者据此强调，需针对不同用户需求个性化设置注视阈值、SSVEP时间窗和视觉布局，以支持持续、实用的辅助沟通使用。

papers.title: AI Tutors in Technical Training: Trust, Feedback Timing, and Skill Transfer in Maintenance Tasks
papers.authors: Lola Peres
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Technical maintenance training requires learners to develop procedural accuracy, diagnostic reasoning, error recovery, and confidence under realistic conditions. This study examined how AI tutor feedback timing influences trust, over-reliance, and skill transfer in maintenance tasks. Participants completed procedures under three conditions: immediate feedback, delayed feedback, and adaptive feedback triggered by hesitation, repeated errors, or safety-critical risk. Outcomes included training accuracy, recovery quality, completion time, cognitive workload, tutor trust, feedback acceptance, and unaided transfer performance. Immediate feedback improved early accuracy and reduced procedural errors but increased step-by-step dependence and weakened independent troubleshooting. Delayed feedback produced mixed effects, supporting autonomy for some learners while increasing frustration and avoidable mistakes for others. Adaptive feedback produced the strongest results by allowing independent attempts while intervening when support was needed. It improved unaided transfer, error recovery, procedural sequencing, and trust calibration. Overall, AI tutors were most effective when feedback scaffolded learning without replacing trainee judgment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了维护任务技术培训中AI导师的反馈时机如何影响信任、过度依赖与技能迁移，参与者分别在即时反馈、延迟反馈和按需触发的自适应反馈条件下完成操作程序。结果显示，即时反馈虽提升了早期准确率并减少程序性错误，却加剧了逐步依赖、削弱了独立排障能力；延迟反馈效果不一，对部分学习者支持自主性，对另一些人则增加挫败感和可避免的错误。自适应反馈效果最强，它允许学员先独立尝试、在需要时介入，从而改善了无辅助迁移、错误恢复、程序顺序和信任校准。作者据此认为，AI导师在提供学习支架而不替代学员判断时最为有效。

papers.title: Human Oversight for LLM-Assisted Clinical Documentation
papers.authors: Abdus Samad
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Clinical documentation is essential to healthcare delivery but is timeconsuming, cognitively demanding, and prone to error. Large language models (LLMs) can generate draft notes, but may introduce hallucinations, unsupported inferences, or factual distortions that clinicians overlook. This study evaluated whether transparency features improve clinician oversight in LLM-assisted documentation. Using a crossover design, 40 clinicians reviewed AI-generated notes under three conditions: a standard LLM interface, token-level uncertainty highlighting, and uncertainty highlighting combined with direct links to electronic medical record fields. Outcomes included factual errors remaining in finalized notes, editing time, trust, perceived control, and cognitive load. The combined uncertainty-plus-source-link interface performed best, reducing factual errors by 41% and editing time by 18% compared with the standard condition. Uncertainty highlighting alone offered partial benefits but still required manual record verification. These findings indicate that LLM-assisted documentation is safer and more efficient when transparency features support verification, direct attention, and preserve clinician control.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在临床文书场景中，透明度功能能否改善临床医生对LLM生成记录的监督。研究采用交叉设计，让临床医生在标准界面、词元级不确定性高亮、以及不确定性高亮结合电子病历字段直链三种条件下审阅AI生成记录，并比较最终记录中的事实错误、编辑时间、信任、控制感与认知负荷。结果显示，不确定性高亮加来源链接的组合界面表现最佳，相比标准条件减少了事实错误并缩短了编辑时间；仅提供不确定性高亮虽有部分帮助，但仍需人工核对记录。作者据此认为，当透明度功能有助于核验、引导注意并保留临床医生的控制权时，LLM辅助文书会更安全、更高效。

papers.title: Do You Feel Like Using GenAI? Scenario Emotional Valence Impact on Potential Generative Artificial Intelligence Use
papers.authors: Grace S. Oswald, Benjamin A. Clegg
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (genAI) is becoming increasingly ubiquitous, creating questions about what factors are influencing its use. This study explored whether emotions in decision-making scenarios impact the use of genAI writing tools. We presented 35 writing-based scenarios, some associated with the six basic human emotions (sadness, anger, enjoyment, fear, surprise, disgust) and others created as neutral emotional conditions. College student participants were asked whether they would use a genAI tool to complete the task, and then to identify the emotion present. Most participants varied their decision to use AI tools. There were significant effects of emotion on the potential use of genAI assistance, with a higher intended adoption for fear and surprise contexts. Emotion strength also influenced potential AI use, with reported AI trust and task complexity increasing in stronger-rated scenarios. However, the overall rate of AI use was generally low. Implications for automation use and trust theories are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察决策情境中的情绪效价是否影响大学生使用生成式AI写作工具的意愿，向参与者呈现与六种基本情绪相关及中性情绪的写作情境，询问其是否会用AI完成并识别情境情绪。结果显示，多数参与者的使用决定随情境变化，恐惧和惊讶情境下的预期采用率较高；情绪强度也影响使用意愿，情境评分越强，报告的AI信任与任务复杂度越高，但整体AI使用率偏低。文章据此讨论了对自动化使用与信任理论的启示。

papers.title: Research on strategies and algorithms for improving English listening and speaking ability based on artificial intelligence wireless network
papers.authors: Bellam Ravindra Babu, Haftom Gebregziabher, Kassaye Tilahun Abera, Kunam Harika
papers.abstract: The artificial intelligence (AI) wireless network technology is changing the world of education by bringing intelligent learning systems. This can be achieved through breaking the limitations associated with the classroom and providing learners the chance of accessing educational resources whenever and wherever they wish to. Listening and speaking skills still remain a difficult part of English learning for many students, specifically those who are in junior and senior high schools. The present study focuses on the existing situation regarding English listening and speaking teaching for junior high school students and highlights some of the existing problems related to this topic. An attempt will be made to propose a novel approach by making use of the intelligent voice system for improving phonetic learning. Literature review, questionnaire survey, and quasi-experimental designs have been utilized for assessing the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
