Integrating knowledge analysis, experimental evaluation, and AI-based intelligent voice system implementation combines speech processing, language analysis, and feedback mechanisms to enhance personalized English listening and speaking learning outcomes. According to the findings, the application of AI-based intelligent voice systems is very helpful in improving the English language speaking and listening abilities of students. The experimental group achieved a higher mean listening and speaking score of 89.16 compared with 83.32 for the conventional teaching approach, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed AI-based intelligent voice system in improving English language proficiency. Findings have verified the effectiveness of the adopted strategy and indicate how it can revolutionize English language education through digital means.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对初高中学生英语听说学习困难及教学现状问题，提出基于人工智能智能语音系统的学习策略，并采用文献综述、问卷调查和准实验设计评估其效果。结果显示，使用该系统的实验组听说成绩均值高于传统教学组，表明该智能语音方案对提升学生英语听说能力有帮助。作者据此认为该策略有效，并讨论了数字化手段改进英语教育的可能。

papers.title: Social chatbots and character: Mind-modelling, mimetics, and postdigital misperception
papers.authors: Alice Bell
papers.journal: Language and Literature International Journal of Stylistics
papers.abstract: This article examines how users cognitively process social chatbot output as a novel form of participatory, generative “character,” co-produced through human–AI interaction. Reporting on the results of empirical research on user responses to the social chatbot platform character.ai, it shows how cognitive stylistic and narratological approaches to character can be utilised but also must be developed to analyse and theorise users’ experience of and interaction with generative AI agents. It makes specific contributions to cognitive stylistics, rhetorical narratology, character studies, and research on gen AI chatbots by: (1) illustrating how the concept of mind-modelling can used to analyse the ways in which users linguistically anthropomorphise social chatbots; (2) developing two new audience response types – transmimetic and hypermimetic – to respectively capture ways in which users assess chatbots against prior knowledge of characters across media and cases where chatbots appear so convincingly human that users question their ontological status; (3) proposing the concept of ‘postdigital misperception’ to reflect the way that users of AI can misattribute the ontological origin of an LLM’s output. The article demonstrates how social chatbots are reshaping how users understand character, agency, and reality in interactive, participatory and generative digital contexts and argues that social chatbots epitomise postdigital experience in blurring the distinction between the digital and non-digital as well as fictional and real.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察用户如何将社交聊天机器人的输出当作一种由人机互动共同生成的“角色”来认知加工，基于对 character.ai 平台用户反应的实证研究展开分析。作者指出，认知文体学与叙事学中的角色分析路径仍可沿用，但需加以发展；据此提出用“心智建模”分析用户对聊天机器人的语言拟人化，并区分“跨拟仿”与“超拟仿”两种受众反应，后者指机器人逼真到令用户质疑其本体身份。文章进一步提出“后数字误感知”，用以描述用户误判大语言模型输出的本体来源，并据此讨论社交聊天机器人如何模糊数字与非数字、虚构与真实的界限。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in varicose veins: Comparative insights from other vascular diseases, evidence gaps, and future prospects
papers.authors: Che Wang, Yuefeng Zhu
papers.journal: Phlebology The Journal of Venous Disease
papers.abstract: This review provides a comprehensive overview of the performance of artificial intelligence (AI) in varicose veins (VV), covering applications in image recognition, postoperative management, risk factor and biomarker analysis, and the use of large language models (LLMs) to aid clinical decision-making. While significant advancements have been made, valuable lessons can be drawn from AI applications in other vascular diseases. Key considerations for advancing AI in VV include ensuring methodological rigor, high quality data, external validation, strict attention to data security and legal standards, and linking AI tools to clinically important outcomes. It is recommended that machine learning models be developed and validated within standardized frameworks that future VV research can adopt. Accordingly, the development of clear guidelines and benchmarks is imperative. LLMs hold promise in relieving clinicians of repetitive routine tasks, thereby enhancing diagnostic accuracy and assisting in treatment planning. Additionally, LLM-based tools could support the curation of medical content on short video platforms and assist clinicians in creating educational materials, ultimately improving patient engagement and understanding.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了人工智能在静脉曲张中的应用，涵盖图像识别、术后管理、危险因素与生物标志物分析，以及利用大语言模型辅助临床决策。作者借鉴其他血管疾病的经验指出，推进相关研究需重视方法学严谨性、高质量数据、外部验证、数据安全与法律标准，并将AI工具与临床重要结局挂钩，建议在标准化框架内开发和验证模型并建立明确的指南与基准。文章还提出，大语言模型有望减轻临床医生的重复性常规工作，并可用于短视频平台医学内容整理和患者教育材料制作，从而提升患者参与度和理解。

papers.title: Digital dietitians? Assessing ChatGPT's role in transforming nutrition care and dietetic practice: A systematic review
papers.authors: Shivani Phugat, Diksha Agrawat, Anjani Bakshi, Neha Bakshi
papers.abstract: BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) tools are increasingly being integrated into nutrition care and dietary counseling. Evaluating their usefulness, accuracy, and limitations is essential before widespread clinical adoption.AimTo systematically review the evidence on the performance of ChatGPT and related AI tools in nutrition and dietetics, including comparisons with other AI models and human experts.MethodsThis systematic review followed PRISMA guidelines and included studies published until February 2025. Searches were conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar using keywords related to ChatGPT, AI, nutrition, and diet. Of 5504 retrieved records, 31 studies met the inclusion criteria. Data were synthesized under three domains: ChatGPT's performance in nutritional guidance, comparisons with other AI tools, and comparisons with human experts.SummaryMost included studies were cross-sectional and published in 2024, with ChatGPT-3.5 and 4.0 being the most evaluated models. ChatGPT showed high-accuracy in clinical guideline adherence for conditions such as cardiovascular disease and diabetes, moderate performance in dietetics examination simulations, and variable accuracy in disease-specific diet planning. It performed well in nutrition education, dietary recall, and food recognition, but demonstrated limitations in micronutrient estimation, renal nutrition safety, and reproducibility. Compared with other AI tools, ChatGPT showed stronger clinical reasoning but lower performance in specialized food-classification tasks. Compared with human experts, it matched performance in general nutrition knowledge but lacked cultural competence and emotional intelligence. AI tools may complement nutrition care, but human dietitians remain essential for personalized care.

papers.title: The Validity of AI-Generated Multiple-Choice Questions for Students With Disabilities
papers.authors: Bruce B. Frey, Amelia Murray, Maggie A. Mosher
papers.abstract: Classroom assessments must meet the rigorous validity standards required for students with disabilities. This study evaluates whether artificial intelligence (AI) can be a reliable partner in the high-stakes environment of special education data collection by examining the validity of multiple-choice questions generated by three large-language-model chatbots (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini). Each chatbot produced 200 items under default and deeper settings (N = 600) and items were scored against 15 objective item-writing guidelines. Models frequently violated rules about complete stems and randomized key placement, with ChatGPT having the highest overall error rate and Copilot and Gemini the lowest. Chi-square and ANOVA analyses showed significant differences across chatbots, especially for specific guidelines, while deeper prompts improved quality only slightly. Results suggest AI can rapidly draft items with solid, plausible distractors, but educators must review and revise them to ensure their quality.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型聊天机器人生成的多项选择题是否达到残障学生课堂评估所需的效度标准，以三个聊天机器人在默认与更深设置下生成的题目为对象，按客观命题准则评分。结果显示，模型常在题干完整性和选项位置随机化上违规，不同聊天机器人的错误率存在显著差异，而更深提示仅略微改善质量。作者据此指出，AI 能快速起草干扰项合理的题目，但教育工作者仍需审查和修改，才能保证题目质量。

papers.title: The Artificial Levite: AI and the Temptation to “Pass By” the Patient
papers.authors: Luke Petruconis
papers.abstract: Healthcare stands to gain much from the integration of artificial intelligence (AI). We must, as a society, decide how it should be ethically implemented into these human-led sectors. After first examining AI from a Catholic perspective at the general scale using Antiqua et Nova , this essay shifts its focus to the implementation of AI in healthcare. With the gaze of the Good Samaritan as a foundation, this essay establishes relational care as a core principle of a Catholic healthcare system that AI threatens to erode. Using the modern incorporation of electronic health records (EHRs) as a parallel, it describes how advancements in technology have dramatically shifted healthcare away from relationality and finally characterizes how the anticipated implementations of AI will likely lead to similar outcomes. Drawing on Antiqua et Nova's distinction between AI that enhances the patient–provider relationship and AI that replaces it, this paper uses the historical adoption of EHRs as a cautionary precedent and examines ambient AI scribes as a test case for what disciplined, relationship-enhancing AI integration can look like.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从天主教视角讨论人工智能在医疗中的伦理实施问题，以“好撒玛利亚人”的凝视为基础，将关系性照护确立为天主教医疗体系的核心原则，并指出AI可能侵蚀这一原则。作者以电子健康记录（EHR）的现代引入为类比，说明技术进步如何使医疗大幅偏离关系性，并据此推测AI的预期应用可能带来类似后果。文章借助《Antiqua et Nova》对增强医患关系的AI与取代医患关系的AI所作的区分，把EHR的历史采用视为警示性先例，并将环境AI记录员作为检验案例，探讨有纪律、能增强关系的AI整合可能呈现的形态。

papers.title: Technology Meets Theology: Understanding AI-Driven Wellness in Muslim Prayer Apps
papers.authors: Ahmed Alrawi, Mustafa Öz
papers.journal: Journal of Religion Media and Digital Culture
papers.abstract: Abstract This study examines the experiences and perceptions of Muslim users regarding the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in prayer apps and its impact on their religious and online communication activities. Through in-depth online interviews with a diverse group of participants, this study reveals that AI-driven prayer apps foster a sense of virtual community, bridging geographic distances, and enabling meaningful interactions among Muslims. AI tools like chatbots and reminders support emotional well-being by offering comfort, guidance, and companionship. Further, these tools increase religious awareness and empower users to customize their spiritual practices and access educational resources independently. However, perceptions of AI vary, with trust influenced by transparency, privacy concerns, and past experiences. This study emphasizes the importance of transparent and reliable AI tools to build user confidence. Lastly, the findings contribute to theories on digital religion and wellness, offering practical insights for developers, users, and religious organizations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过在线深度访谈，考察穆斯林用户对祈祷应用中人工智能集成的体验与看法。研究发现，AI驱动的祈祷应用能营造虚拟社区感、跨越地理距离促进有意义的互动，聊天机器人和提醒等功能通过提供安慰、引导与陪伴支持情感福祉，并增强宗教意识、帮助用户自主定制灵修实践和获取教育资源。但用户对AI的信任因透明度、隐私顾虑和过往经验而异，研究据此强调透明可靠的AI工具对建立用户信心的重要性，并为数字宗教与福祉理论及开发者、用户和宗教组织提供启示。

papers.title: WSM-Aware HRI: An IoT-Enhanced Framework for Early Detection and Norm-Guided Repair of Failures with LLM Guidance
papers.authors: Hanlin Zhang, Yuquan Wang, Tianwei Zhang, Zhenglong Sun
papers.abstract: Human–robot interaction (HRI) failures remain a major barrier to deploying robots in real-world environments. Prior work often treats failures as isolated technical faults or focuses on post-hoc recovery behaviors. In practice, many breakdowns arise because humans and robots operate under inconsistent assumptions about the current world state. We propose WSM-Aware HRI, an IoT-enhanced modular framework that unifies diverse HRI breakdowns as World-State Mismatches (WSMs) between a human's instruction-implied assumptions and a robot's grounded world model built from multimodal perception and digital augmentation. A Large Language Model (LLM) is used to make implicit assumptions explicit, map them to a small set of mismatch types, and specify the evidence needed for verification against the robot's world state. WSM-Aware HRI shifts failure handling from execution-time recovery to proactive mismatch detection during intention formation, enabling interventions guided by safety, norm compliance, and multi-user coordination with transparent explanations. We evaluate mismatch identification in ten everyday cases spanning both visual and latent-state mismatches. The system can accurately produce the expected output results, and ablations show that reliable identification depends on appropriate grounding representations and verification-oriented refinement. These results indicate that treating interaction breakdowns as explicit world–state mismatches enables earlier detection of impending failures and offers a principled mechanism for integrating external evidence and social constraints into human–robot interaction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出并评估了一个名为 WSM-Aware HRI 的物联网增强模块化框架，将人机交互中的多种故障统一理解为人类指令隐含假设与机器人基于多模态感知和数字增强所建立的世界模型之间的“世界状态不匹配”（WSM），并借助大语言模型把隐含假设显式化、映射到不匹配类型并确定验证所需证据。作者在十个涵盖视觉与潜在状态不匹配的日常案例中评估了不匹配识别，结果显示系统能准确产生预期输出，消融实验表明可靠识别依赖于恰当的接地表示和面向验证的细化。文章据此认为，将交互故障视为显式的世界状态不匹配，有助于更早发现即将发生的失败，并为把外部证据和社会约束纳入人机交互提供了有原则的机制。

papers.title: A Social Robot for Self-Monitoring Support in Psychiatric Daycare: A 24-Month Iterative Development and Practical Evaluation
papers.authors: Takuto Akiyoshi, Hidenobu Sumioka, Hirokazu Kumazaki, Junya Nakanishi, Hirokazu Kato, Masahiro Shiomi
papers.abstract: Self-monitoring, a commonly used technique in cognitive-behavioral interventions, involves the objective observation and organization of one’s internal states. However, providing continuous, individualized support for this process is challenging in resource-limited psychiatric daycare settings. While social robots show promise in facilitating self-disclosure, evidence regarding their long-term practical utility and clinical relevance in real-world clinical environments remains insufficient. To address this gap, we conducted a two-phase field study comprising periodic sessions held over a 24-month period to develop and evaluate a social robot-assisted self-monitoring support system. In the 14-month Development Phase (N = 39), we employed a practice-informed design process to establish robot-specific design principles, prioritizing a non-judgmental listener role over advice-giving and offering user-selected positive and negative topics to accommodate diverse psychosocial needs. This was followed by a 10-month Evaluation Phase (N = 20), consisting of 10 experimental days, to assess the finalized system’s impact. Key findings indicated that: (1) single dialogue sessions were followed by significant improvements in participants’ subjective overall health and alertness; (2) participants demonstrated a strong preference for positive-oriented topics; and (3) qualitative analysis revealed emergent reflective insights and perceived positive changes. These results provide empirical evidence suggesting the system’s practical utility and clinical relevance, highlighting the value of a user-centered approach that empowers patients to choose topics aligned with their recovery goals.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对资源有限的精神科日间照护环境中难以持续提供个体化自我监测支持的问题，通过为期24个月的两阶段现场研究，开发并评估了一套社交机器人辅助的自我监测支持系统。开发阶段采用基于实践的设计流程，确立了以非评判性倾听而非提供建议为核心的机器人设计原则，并让用户自行选择积极或消极话题；随后在评估阶段检验了最终系统。结果显示，单次对话后参与者的主观整体健康状况与警觉性有显著改善，且参与者明显偏好积极导向的话题，定性分析还发现了反思性洞察和感知到的积极变化。作者据此认为，这些发现为该系统的实用性和临床相关性提供了经验证据，并凸显了让患者选择与自身康复目标相符话题的以用户为中心方法的价值。

papers.title: Report on the 3rd International Workshop on Designing Software (Designing 2026)
papers.authors: Michel R. V. Chaudron, Kiev Santos da Gama, Eunsuk Kang, Lu Xiao
papers.abstract: Software design is a set of activities and decisions involved in constructing a software system, ranging from high-level architecture and conceptual design to code design. Decisions made during the design process have a long-lasting impact on various qualities of a system, such as modularity, maintainability, scalability, robustness, security, usability, and performance. Despite its important role in software development, design is still considered something of an art—particularly in terms of design as an activity rather than design as a product or outcome. With the growing societal impact of software and the rapid adoption of AI-assisted development, design has taken on a new and larger role in the engineering of modern software systems. The third edition of the Designing workshop brought together researchers, practitioners, and educators interested in any aspect of software design to discuss novel approaches to design, and to identify open challenges and future directions for the field, with a particular emphasis this year on the impact of AI on the practice and the teaching of software design.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是第三届软件设计国际研讨会（Designing 2026）的报告，汇集研究者、实践者与教育者，围绕软件设计的新方法与开放挑战展开讨论，今年尤其关注 AI 对设计实践与教学的影响。报告指出，设计决策对模块化、可维护性、可扩展性、安全性、可用性和性能等系统质量有长期影响，但设计作为活动仍被视为一种技艺；随着软件社会影响扩大和 AI 辅助开发的快速普及，设计在现代软件工程中承担了更大角色。报告据此梳理了该领域的未来方向，并强调 AI 介入下设计实践与教学的变化值得持续探讨。

papers.title: The ‘Coloniality Problem’ in AI and the Call for ‘Decoloniality’
papers.authors: Damian Eke
papers.abstract: Advocating for a decolonial approach in both AI practice and education to ensure AI technologies do not reinforce old patterns under new guises.
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论人工智能实践与教育中的“殖民性问题”，主张以去殖民化路径防止AI技术以新形式延续旧有支配模式。文章属于立场性论述，而非实证研究或系统实现，核心在于提出这一呼吁并说明其针对的问题。其含义是，AI的设计与教学需审视自身是否复制了不平等关系，但摘要未给出具体方案或效果证据。

papers.title: WiP: An Unobtrusive RF Sensing Solution for Passive Human-Robot Interaction Verification
papers.authors: Vinobalaji Arumugam, Zeyu Deng, Chen Wang
papers.journal: Proceedings of the 28th Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing And Networking
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots operating under remote control commonly authenticate users solely through possession of a remote controller or wireless tag, resulting in a static, single-factor authentication. Such an approach remains vulnerable to increasingly sophisticated cyber-physical attacks, including controller theft, session hijacking, and unauthorized sharing or controller misuse. We extract users' gait information from the UWB signals received by the robot from the tag, leveraging the RF interactions between a moving robot and a user to identify the user, demonstrating for the first time that wireless signals exchanged during human-robot interaction contain distinctive biometric characteristics. We convert these UWB signals into per-step user gait quaternion features that encode the relative motion between the user-worn tag and the robot base, and develop a multi-branch Quaternion Convolutional Neural Network (Q-CNN) for user identification. The system achieves more than 99% accuracy in identifying 10 users within 2 step cycles.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对远程操控四足机器人仅依赖遥控器或无线标签进行静态单因素认证、易受控制器盗用和会话劫持等问题，提出一种无侵入的射频感知方案。作者从机器人接收的UWB信号中提取用户步态信息，将其转换为编码用户与机器人相对运动的逐步四元数特征，并构建多分支四元数卷积神经网络进行身份识别。实验表明，该系统能在两个步态周期内以超过99%的准确率识别10名用户，首次证明人机交互过程中交换的无线信号含有可区分身份的生物特征。

papers.title: Does Generative Artificial Intelligence ( GAI ) Complement, Complicate, and Compromise Family Science Qualitative Analysis?
papers.authors: Md. Mahabub Chowdhury, Elizabeth A. Sharp
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT This article examines the relationship between generative artificial intelligence (GAI) tools and interpretive qualitative research in family science. Drawing on existing literature and an illustrative analytic comparison, we compare human‐led coding, ChatGPT‐assisted coding, and ATLAS.ti‐assisted coding (with GAI built in). In conversation with the literature and our analytic comparison, we consider how GAI tools complement, complicate, and compromise meaning‐making processes central to interpretive qualitative family research. Considering both the literature and our comparison, we conclude that GAI can complement analysis by supporting organization, comparison, and early pattern recognition, but it also complicates and compromises analysis by shifting analytic labor from deep human engagement toward more rote prompt design, output verification, codebook cleanup, and documentation, dampening human insights, creativity, and judgment.
papers.summary_zh: 该文考察生成式人工智能工具与家庭科学解释性定性研究之间的关系，结合文献与一项示例性分析比较，对照了人工主导编码、ChatGPT辅助编码和内置生成式AI的ATLAS.ti辅助编码三种方式。作者认为，生成式AI能在组织材料、比较和早期模式识别上辅助分析，但也会把分析劳动从深度的人工投入转向较为机械的提示设计、输出核验、编码簿清理和记录工作，从而削弱人的洞察、创造力与判断。文章据此提示，这类工具在补充定性分析的同时，也可能使意义建构过程复杂化并受到损害。

papers.title: Being a Teacher in a Digital World: Deepening the Relationships Among Teachers' AI ‐ TPACK , AI Literacy, and AI Acceptance Levels
papers.authors: Fulya Ünsal, Osman Kayhan, Recep Çakır, Özgen Korkmaz
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The purpose of this study is to determine teachers' AI‐TPACK, AI literacy, and AI acceptance levels and to examine the relationships among these variables. The study employed a quantitative correlational design with a sample of 306 teachers working in Türkiye during the 2024–2025 academic year. The findings revealed that teachers' AI literacy and AI acceptance are strongly associated with their AI‐TPACK levels. Additionally, significant differences were observed based on teachers' digital engagement, indicating that higher levels of engagement are linked to higher AI‐related competencies. These results highlight the interconnected nature of AI‐related competencies and suggest that strengthening teachers' AI literacy and acceptance may support the development of their AI‐TPACK. Accordingly, teacher education and professional development programs should adopt a more integrated approach to AI‐related competencies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以土耳其教师为对象，采用量化相关设计考察其AI-TPACK、AI素养与AI接受度之间的关系。结果显示，教师的AI素养和AI接受度与AI-TPACK水平存在较强关联，且数字参与程度较高的教师在各项AI相关能力上表现更好。作者据此指出，这些AI相关能力彼此关联，提升教师的AI素养与接受度可能有助于其AI-TPACK的发展，并建议教师教育与专业发展项目采取更整合的方式来培养相关能力。

papers.title: Moving Minds, Moving Bodies: Rethinking AI Literacy and Health Literacy Through Embodied Education
papers.authors: Yuan Zhong, Feng Xiong, Jingyu Huang
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT AI literacy and health literacy are increasingly important educational agendas, but their relationship cannot be understood simply by adding wellbeing to digital competence. This article develops embodied education as an orientation for examining how learners judge AI‐supported activity within bodily, temporal and institutional conditions. Using a critical integrative conceptual approach, it brings together research on AI and health literacies, embodied learning, digital wellbeing and human–AI interaction. Its central concept is embodied judgement: the context‐sensitive appraisal of technological possibilities, bodily and affective experience, educational purposes and feasible courses of action. The framework distinguishes four interdependent components with different analytical roles: bodily awareness supplies experiential cues; situated judgement interprets those cues alongside evidence and task demands; movement‐based learning provides one pedagogical means of developing and revising understanding; and ethical agency concerns justified action and responsibility towards others. Institutional arrangements and embodied differences condition the entire process. The article identifies tensions between assisted performance and independent learning, rapid feedback and deliberation, and continuous availability and recovery, without assuming that AI necessarily intensifies these tensions. It develops classroom activities, provisional indicators and an illustrative policy comparison of Norway, Finland and Singapore. The contribution is a relational account of the AI–health literacy interface, not a validated scale or intervention. A research agenda specifies how its mechanisms, institutional conditions and accessibility implications can be investigated.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以批判性整合的概念路径，将AI素养、健康素养、具身学习、数字福祉与人机交互研究结合起来，提出以具身教育为取向的分析框架。其核心概念是“具身判断”，即学习者结合身体与情感体验、证据、任务要求和教育目的，对AI支持的活动作出情境化评估；框架区分身体觉察、情境判断、基于动作的学习和伦理能动性四个相互依赖的成分，并强调制度安排与身体差异贯穿整个过程。文章据此识别辅助表现与独立学习、快速反馈与深思、持续可用与恢复之间的张力，但未假定AI必然加剧这些张力，同时给出课堂活动、暂定指标和挪威、芬兰、新加坡的政策比较示例。作者明确这是一项关系性论述而非经验证的量表或干预，并提出后续研究议程。

papers.title: Changes in Gastrointestinal Symptoms Among Children With Cystic Fibrosis During 12 Months of Elexacaftor/Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor Therapy: A Swedish Multicentre Study
papers.authors: Marcus Svedberg, Ellen Karlge Nilsson, Per Ekman, Henrik Imberg
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Elexacaftor/Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor (ETI) has markedly improved clinical outcomes in cystic fibrosis (CF). However, its effects on gastrointestinal (GI) function, nutrition and pancreatic enzyme therapy in children remain insufficiently described. This study aimed to characterise GI‐related changes during the first year of ETI treatment in Swedish children with CF. Methods In this prospective, multicentre study at three paediatric CF centres, children aged 6–17 years who initiated ETI were assessed at baseline, 6 and 12 months. Outcomes included GI symptoms and the use of GI‐related medication, health‐related quality of life (CFQ‐R), nutritional status, PERT use and faecal elastase. Longitudinal changes were analysed using generalised least squares regression. Results Sixty‐two participants (mean age 11.7 years) completed follow‐up. The total mean combined number of reported GI symptoms declined from 1.5 to 0.9 ( p = 0.005), although no individual symptom changed significantly after 12 months of ETI treatment ( p > 0.05). CFQ‐R Digestive scores improved by 7.8 points ( p = 0.002). PERT dose decreased by 1.3 × 10 3 units/kg/day ( p < 0.001), while BMI z‐scores and faecal elastase remained unchanged. Conclusion ETI therapy reduced gastrointestinal symptoms and improved digestive quality of life in children with CF, accompanied by lower PERT use but unchanged pancreatic function and growth.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注囊性纤维化儿童在接受Elexacaftor/Tezacaftor/Ivacaftor（ETI）治疗第一年内胃肠道症状及相关营养、用药情况的变化，在瑞典三家儿科中心对启动ETI治疗的儿童进行了为期12个月的前瞻性随访。结果显示，患儿报告的胃肠道症状合计数量在治疗12个月后有所下降，消化相关生活质量评分改善，胰酶替代治疗剂量减少，而BMI z评分与粪便弹性蛋白酶未见明显变化，且单项胃肠道症状均未出现显著改变。作者据此认为，ETI治疗可减轻胃肠道症状并改善消化相关生活质量，同时伴随胰酶用量下降，但胰腺功能和生长状况未见改变。

papers.title: Green practices as branding tools: an empirical study in the context of higher education
papers.authors: Long Hoang Le, Tram Thi Bao Phan, My Thi Dieu Tran, Ngoc Huynh Hai Hoang Phan, Nhi Ngoc Yen Dinh
papers.abstract: Purpose Green practices can be considered a marketing tool to enhance a university’s image and student outcomes. Based on the theories of customer engagement and value co-creation, this study aims to develop a conceptual model showing the impacts of students’ green engagement, universities’ green management, branding factors and student satisfaction and value co-creation behaviors. Design/methodology/approach Data from a survey of 619 students across universities with different levels of green practices are analyzed using partial structural equation modeling. Findings The findings reveal that both university’s green management (i.e. green campus management and green energy campus management) and students’ green engagement (i.e. cognitive engagement and affective engagement) positively affect branding factors (i.e. self–brand connection and the university’s brand image) and student satisfaction and value co-creation behaviors. In particular, this study highlights the mediating roles of branding factors in the relationships between green factors and student outcomes. Practical implications This study offers implications for connecting green practices and branding campaigns of higher education institutions. Moreover, the findings also suggest a sustainable cycle of green practices: green practice engagement – student satisfaction and value co-creation – more value co-creation – future green engagement. Originality/value This study advances the current literature by highlighting a sustainable process: the linkage of green practices, branding factors and student satisfaction and value co-creation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于顾客参与和价值共创理论，构建模型考察高校绿色实践如何经由品牌因素影响学生满意度与价值共创行为，并对多所绿色实践程度不同高校的学生问卷数据进行分析。结果显示，高校绿色管理（绿色校园管理与绿色能源校园管理）和学生绿色参与（认知与情感参与）均正向影响品牌因素（自我—品牌联结与学校品牌形象）以及学生满意度和价值共创行为，品牌因素在其中起中介作用。文章据此讨论了将绿色实践与高校品牌推广相衔接的启示，并提出“绿色实践参与—满意度与价值共创—更多价值共创—未来绿色参与”的可持续循环，但结论基于问卷数据，属于关联性证据。

papers.title: Online professional development for elementary and middle school teachers: supporting disciplinary literacy instruction through inquiry and AI
papers.authors: Hyoju Ahn, Eric Junco, Razak Kwame Dwomoh, Cansu Tatar
papers.journal: PDS Partners Bridging Research to Practice
papers.abstract: Purpose This study investigates how elementary and middle school teachers developed disciplinary literacy instruction through participation in an online professional development (PD) program integrating inquiry, multimodal literacy, and generative artificial intelligence (AI). Design/methodology/approach This qualitative study examined a university-school partnership aligned with National Association for Professional Development Schools (NAPDS) Essential 3 (Professional Learning and Leading), in which university faculty and Kindergarten to Grade 8 (K–8) teachers engaged in collaborative professional learning focused on disciplinary literacy, inquiry, and AI-supported instruction. Data included teacher interviews, reflections, classroom artifacts, and lesson plans and were analyzed through thematic analysis. Findings This university-school partnership supported teachers' disciplinary literacy knowledge and inquiry-based instructional practices. Three distinct themes emerged from the analysis: (1) inquiry and multiple perspectives as central pillars of disciplinary literacy, (2) multimodal and digital sources supporting disciplinary reading instruction, and (3) AI-supported disciplinary lesson planning and differentiated instruction. Research limitations/implications This study focused on nine K–8 teachers participating in a four-week online PD program. Findings underscore the value of sustained PD and university partnerships that support teachers' integration of disciplinary literacy, inquiry, multimodality, and effective use of AI in literacy and social studies classrooms. Originality/value This study explores how K-8 teachers integrated disciplinary literacy, inquiry, multimodality, and AI through online PD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察一项融合探究、多模态素养与生成式人工智能的在线教师专业发展项目，如何支持中小学教师发展学科素养教学。研究采用质性取向，基于大学与学校合作项目，通过教师访谈、反思、课堂作品和教案进行主题分析。结果显示，该合作支持了教师的学科素养知识与探究式教学实践，并归纳出三个主题：探究与多元视角作为学科素养的核心支柱，多模态与数字资源支持学科阅读教学，以及人工智能辅助学科教案设计与差异化教学。作者指出，研究仅涉及参与为期四周在线项目的九名K–8教师，结论凸显持续专业发展与大学合作在帮助教师整合学科素养、探究、多模态及有效使用人工智能方面的价值。

papers.title: Linguistic anthropomorphism in conversational AI: theoretical foundations and empirical evidence from LMSYS chat 1M
papers.authors: Juan L. Blanco-Guzmán, Pedro R. Palos‐Sánchez, Dan‐Andrei Sitar‐Tăut, Jeisson Alexander Higuera Reina
papers.abstract: Purpose This study investigates linguistic anthropomorphism in large language models (LLMs) by analyzing over one million conversational turns generated by 25 state-of-the-art models, including GPT-4, Claude, Vicuna, Llama-2, and others. The research examines anthropomorphic language markers across eight major languages and explores variation in anthropomorphic language use by model and language. Design/methodology/approach Using the Large Model Systems (LMSYS) Chat 1M dataset from Hugging Face, the study examines anthropomorphic language markers such as first-person pronouns, explicit empathy statements, and emojis across eight major languages. The methodology combines the detection of predefined anthropomorphic and empathetic phrases, the quantification of first-person references, and sentiment analysis to explore variation in anthropomorphic language use by model and language. Findings Results reveal substantial differences in the prevalence of anthropomorphic expressions and affective tone across LLMs, with certain models displaying significantly higher rates of empathetic and self-referential language. The analysis further identifies linguistic and cultural effects, showing that the propensity for anthropomorphic responses is not uniformly distributed across languages or cultural contexts. These findings support the theoretical concept of Situated Linguistic Anthropomorphism, according to which human-like AI language emerges from the interaction between model design and communicative setting. Originality/value The findings provide new insights into the design and evaluation of conversational AI, emphasizing the relevance of anthropomorphic cues for user trust and engagement in multilingual settings. The study contributes to understanding how linguistic anthropomorphism varies across AI models and cultural contexts, with implications for responsible AI design. Peer review The peer review history for this article is available at: Link to the website
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型对话中的语言拟人化现象，基于LMSYS Chat 1M数据集，对25个模型在八种语言中的对话轮次进行拟人化与共情表达标记检测、第一人称指代统计和情感分析。结果显示，不同模型的拟人化表达频率和情感基调差异明显，部分模型更频繁使用共情与自我指代语言；这种倾向在语言和文化语境间分布不均。作者据此提出“情境化语言拟人化”概念，认为类人语言源于模型设计与交流情境的互动，并讨论了其对多语言环境下用户信任与负责任AI设计的含义。

papers.title: The algorithm beneath my wings: examining consumer use intentions and relational dynamics with AI mental health support tools
papers.authors: Elyria Kemp, Nwamaka A. Anaza, Scott Phillips
papers.abstract: Purpose This research aims to examine the psychological, motivational and technological factors that drive consumers’ intentions to use mental health chatbots. Drawing on Service Convenience Theory and the Motivation–Opportunity–Ability (MOA) framework, it examines how negative emotional experiences, risk-adjusted motivation, perceived ability to use artificial intelligence (AI)-mediated mental health technology, opportunity utility and mental health-related stigma influence consumers’ intentions to engage with mental health chatbots. It also examines the role of anthropomorphism in increasing use intentions as well as the moderating role of perceived disclosure adequacy. Special attention is accorded to the policy and the consumer protection implications surrounding the use of these technologies. Design/methodology/approach A model is tested using survey data collected from a national sample (n = 446) of US consumers. Structural equation modeling is employed to test predicted relationships. Findings Results indicate that negative emotional experiences, risk-adjusted motivation, perceived ability, opportunity utility and anthropomorphism are positively related to consumers’ intentions to use mental health chatbots. In addition, mental health chatbot use intentions mediate the relationship between anthropomorphism and isolated attachment, and perceived disclosure adequacy moderates the relationship between ability and use intentions. Practical implications Findings highlight critical policy and consumer protection concerns in AI-mediated mental health services and when such technologies may pose risks related to emotional dependence and isolation. Although such services may expand access to support, they can also heighten vulnerability to problematic relational outcomes. Finally, the results from this research underscore the need for policy approaches that mandate clearer disclosure standards, improved transparency, and comprehensive regulation and governance of digital mental health technologies that do not undermine consumer welfare. Originality/value This research advances understanding of consumer mental health chatbot use and demonstrates how anthropomorphism and disclosure perceptions jointly influence use intentions and relational outcomes. Notably, it contributes to the emerging literature on digital mental health by demonstrating that perceived disclosure adequacy may function less as a protective mechanism and more as a confidence cue that amplifies use among consumers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于服务便利理论与动机—机会—能力框架，考察消费者使用心理健康聊天机器人的心理、动机与技术因素。对美国消费者的调查数据表明，负面情绪体验、风险调整后的动机、感知使用能力、机会效用和拟人化均与使用意向正相关；使用意向在拟人化与孤立依恋之间起中介作用，而感知披露充分性调节能力与使用意向的关系。作者据此讨论了AI心理健康服务中情感依赖与孤立的风险，以及披露标准、透明度和治理方面的政策与消费者保护含义。

papers.title: Language and the measurement of social media engagement: a framework and research agenda
papers.authors: Victor A. Barger
papers.journal: Journal of Research in Interactive Marketing
papers.abstract: Purpose Ten years after Barger et al. (2016) reviewed consumer engagement on social media, this article revisits how engagement is measured. It reviews and integrates language-based measures of engagement, develops a conceptual framework and proposes a research agenda. Design/methodology/approach The article reviews the marketing and adjacent literature on measuring engagement from text, including natural language processing and large language model methods, organized by the cognitive, emotional and behavioral dimensions of engagement and across both the consumer and the firm. Findings Engagement counts capture the act of engagement but not its content. Language-based methods can in principle recover the cognitive and emotional dimensions that the consumer brand engagement construct names but that behavioral counts do not reach. The article maps the linguistic signals and measurement approaches available for each dimension on both sides of the consumer-firm dyad, separates what the literature supports from what remains to be done and identifies the conversation, rather than the isolated post, as the unit at which the co-creative process becomes measurable. Originality/value The article offers a framework that (1) distinguishes the engagement act from engagement content and positions language-based measurement as the means of recovering the latter, (2) extends to both parties of the consumer-firm dyad and locates the conversation as the unit of analysis, (3) states five testable propositions with boundary conditions and (4) sets out a prioritized agenda for research.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以综述与概念框架的形式，重新审视社交媒体互动（engagement）的测量方式，梳理营销及邻近文献中基于文本的测量方法，包括自然语言处理与大语言模型路径，并按认知、情感和行为维度以及消费者与企业双方加以组织。文章指出，互动计数只能捕捉互动行为本身，无法反映其内容；基于语言的方法原则上可以还原消费者品牌互动构念所命名、而行为计数难以触及的认知与情感维度。作者据此区分互动行为与互动内容，把对话而非孤立帖子作为可测量共同创造过程的单元，并提出五个带边界条件的可检验命题及研究议程。

papers.title: Transforming the business model innovation process: how generative artificial intelligence shapes value creation, delivery, and capture
papers.authors: Miklas Cordes, Dominik Kurt Kanbach
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines how Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) may transform the Business Model Innovation (BMI) process and under which conditions it may reshape core Business Model (BM) mechanisms. Design/methodology/approach A systematic literature review of 131 peer-reviewed articles was conducted. Using the Gioia methodology in an abductive analysis, with the 4I-framework of BMI as a sensitizing lens, an integrative framework was developed to synthesize GenAI's role across BMI phases and BM mechanisms. Findings The findings show that GenAI supports all phases of the BMI process by enhancing opportunity recognition, ideation, experimentation, and implementation through the mechanisms of knowledge amplification, cognitive catalysis, and methodological scaffolding. Beyond process support, GenAI can reshape value creation through hyper-personalized and content-centric offerings, alter value delivery through hybrid human-AI service architectures, and extend value capture through efficiency gains and data-driven revenue logics. Whether such effects remain operational augmentation or amount to BM adaptation and transformation depends on their embedding in the BM architecture. At the same time, these effects remain conditioned by data governance, model opacity, ethical and regulatory risk, and workforce capabilities, suggesting GenAI's role in BMI is ambivalent: it may enable innovation while also creating new constraints for its realization. Research limitations/implications The review is conceptual and cross-sectoral. Future research should empirically test the proposed mechanisms and examine industry- and context-specific boundary conditions. Practical implications Firms should treat GenAI as a strategic lever for BMI and complement adoption with robust governance, human oversight, and workforce capability development. Originality/value The study offers a process-oriented synthesis of GenAI-enabled BMI and develops an integrative framework linking BMI phases, GenAI-enabled process mechanisms, and BM mechanisms while identifying key boundary conditions shaping GenAI-enabled BMI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以系统文献综述方式梳理了131篇同行评审文章，并借助Gioia方法与4I框架构建整合性框架，考察生成式人工智能如何影响商业模式创新过程及其核心机制。综述发现，生成式AI可通过知识放大、认知催化与方法性支架支持机会识别、创意生成、实验与实施等各阶段，并可能重塑价值创造、价值传递与价值获取；但这些效应究竟属于运营层面的增强还是商业模式的适应与转型，取决于其嵌入商业模式架构的方式，同时受数据治理、模型不透明、伦理与监管风险及员工能力等条件制约。作者据此提出，生成式AI在商业模式创新中的作用具有两面性，既可能促进创新，也可能带来新的实现约束，后续仍需实证检验相关机制与情境边界。

papers.title: AI-driven forecasting and portfolio optimization under ESG and uncertainty regimes: evidence from global equity indices
papers.authors: Yesser Drira, Hayet Soltani, Dr. Mouna Boujelbene
papers.abstract: Purpose This study investigates how advanced machine learning (ML) and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) models can enhance forecasting accuracy and portfolio decision-making under environmental, social, and governance (ESG)-driven and uncertainty-sensitive market conditions. The objective is to compare the predictive efficiency of state-of-the-art ML architectures with policy-based portfolio strategies to uncover the role of sustainability indicators in shaping market dynamics. Design/methodology/approach We analyze daily data for major ESG and conventional market indices across the USA, Europe, and China, integrating the Standard Statistics Company and Poor's Publishing Company (S&P) Green Bond Index, Geopolitical Risk (GPR), the US Financial Stress Index (FSI), Physical Risk Index (PRI), and Transition Risk Index (TRI). The forecasting stage combines a 20-day long short-term memory (LSTM) temporal representation with Categorical Boosting (CatBoost), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) under a strict 70/15/15 chronological train-validation-test design and train-only scaling. The portfolio stage compares Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3), Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) in a weekly self-financing environment with long-only weights, a 40% position cap, and proportional transaction costs. Random-Walk/Ridge/LSTM forecasting benchmarks and Equal-Weight/Minimum-Variance portfolio benchmarks are included, together with multi-seed and transaction-cost robustness checks. Local interpretable model-agnostic explanations (LIME) is retained for local model interpretation. Findings Forecasting performance is market-dependent rather than governed by a universally dominant learner. Validation selects LSTM-LightGBM for the China and US ESG indices, LSTM-XGBoost for Europe ESG, and LSTM-CatBoost for the three conventional indices. Multi-seed robustness yields positive average root mean square error (RMSE) gains over the Random Walk in five of six markets, with the strongest stability in China and statistically significant main-seed improvement for US ESG. In portfolio allocation, TD3 on the conventional opportunity set provides the strongest ex-post DRL performance (11.10% annualized return; Sharpe ratio 0.776), while SAC is the strongest ESG DRL strategy. Equal Weight remains a demanding benchmark, particularly for ESG portfolios, and the DDPG policies selected ex ante on validation remain profitable across three seeds and under transaction-cost scenarios up to 25 basis points (bps). Originality/value The study extends the emerging literature by integrating explainable hybrid forecasting and continuous-action DRL within a leakage-controlled, benchmark-oriented framework. Its contribution lies in combining ESG-sensitive uncertainty variables, chronological validation, realistic self-financing portfolio constraints, explicit transaction-cost analysis, and reproducibility checks rather than assuming universal AI or ESG superiority.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在ESG与不确定性条件下，机器学习与深度强化学习能否提升股指预测和投资组合决策，并比较不同模型与策略的表现。作者使用美国、欧洲和中国的ESG及常规指数日度数据，将LSTM与CatBoost、LightGBM、XGBoost组合用于预测，再以TD3、SAC、DDPG进行组合配置，并设置随机游走、等权重等基准。结果显示，预测表现因市场而异，没有普遍占优的学习器；组合配置中，TD3在常规机会集上表现最强，SAC在ESG策略中最佳，而等权重仍是难以超越的基准，提示AI与ESG的优势均依赖于具体市场与设定。

papers.title: Exploring undergraduate experiences with AI tools in higher education
papers.authors: Burhan Özfidan, Santiago Luaces, Christa Reyes, Nika Verna
papers.journal: International Journal of Information and Learning Technology
papers.abstract: Purpose It aims to provide thorough insights into how undergraduates utilize, interpret and think about artificial intelligence (AI) tools in academic settings. Design/methodology/approach This mixed-methods study investigates undergraduate students' perceptions of AI tools in the classroom, focusing on both the perceived benefits and the concerns that arise from their use. Quantitative data were collected through an online survey administered to 107 undergraduate students, capturing participant demographics, AI tool familiarity and attitudes toward AI use in academic contexts. Exploratory factor analysis identified four key dimensions: perceived benefits of AI, attitudes toward AI integration in education, perceived challenges and concerns, and perceived impact on educational outcomes. These quantitative findings were complemented by semi-structured interviews with a subsample of participants, which provided rich qualitative insights into how students experience AI in practice. Findings The integrated findings highlight that while students are eager to leverage AI tools for academic advantage, they remain cautious about the broader implications. The study's findings offer actionable insights for educators and policymakers, emphasizing the importance of providing structured guidance, ethical frameworks and institutional support to ensure the responsible and effective integration of AI tools into higher education. Originality/value By investigating the perceived advantages, difficulties and educational effects of AI tools from the viewpoint of students, this study seeks to close that gap.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用混合方法，结合对本科生的在线问卷调查与半结构化访谈，考察他们在学术场景中使用、理解与看待人工智能工具的方式。结果显示，学生一方面积极借助AI工具获取学业优势，另一方面对其更广泛的影响保持谨慎，其态度可归纳为感知收益、对AI融入教育的态度、感知挑战与担忧以及对教育结果的影响等维度。文章据此提示，教育者与政策制定者应提供结构化指导、伦理框架和机构支持，以推动AI工具在高等教育中负责任且有效地整合。

papers.title: Bridging AI perceptions and insurance purchase intentions: the mediating role of perceived ease of use
papers.authors: Dhrub Ranjan, Sunil Kadyan, Manish R. Sharma
papers.abstract: Purpose The insurance industry is being transformed as artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping customer interactions, insurers' underwriting practices and service delivery. However, there is limited research or evidence on how customers' perceptions of AI-driven insurance services influence their purchase intentions. Taking inputs from technology acceptance model (TAM), this study investigates the relationship between customers' perceptions of AI-driven insurance services (CP-AI) and insurance purchase intentions (IPI) through the mediating role of the perceived ease of use (PEU). Design/methodology/approach A cross-sectional design was used in the study to collect the responses from 490 insurance customers from India who were familiar with AI-enabled insurance services. As CP-AI cannot be directly measured, it was conceptualised as a second-order reflective construct consisting of four important dimensions, i.e. attitude towards AI, AI service experience, trust in AI services and technology readiness. The hypothesised relationships were tested using partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). Findings The findings of the study highlights that the CP-AI have a significant positive impact on their purchase intentions. In addition, PEU partially mediates the relationship between CP-AI and their purchase intentions. Research limitations/implications The findings indicate that when customer perceptions are favourable, they are more effectively converted into IPI. In other words, if the AI-enabled insurance services are viewed as simple and effortless to use, the favourable customer perceptions are more likely to be converted into stronger IPI. These findings support the premise of the TAM that PEU is an important element linking technology perceptions to behavioural intentions, even in AI-enabled insurance service contexts. Practical implications The findings of the study provide practical insights for insurers to improve AI adoption among their customers by designing customer-friendly and easy-to-use AI-driven services, which will further improve customer acceptance and strengthen their purchase intentions. Originality/value This study extends research on AI-enabled insurance adoption by examining how customer perceptions influence purchase intentions through PEU. Its originality lies in conceptualising customer perceptions as a second-order reflective construct comprising attitude towards AI, AI service experience, trust in AI and technology readiness. Drawing on the TAM, the study demonstrates that perceived ease of use serves as an important mechanism linking favourable AI perceptions with purchase intentions. Based on responses from 490 Indian insurance customers, the study extends TAM to the AI-driven insurance context and offers practical insights for designing intuitive, customer-centric AI services.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于技术接受模型，考察印度保险客户对AI驱动保险服务的感知如何影响其购买意向，并将客户感知概念化为由AI态度、服务体验、信任和技术准备度构成的二阶反映性构念，采用横截面问卷与偏最小二乘结构方程模型检验假设。结果显示，客户对AI保险服务的感知正向影响购买意向，感知易用性在其中起部分中介作用，即当服务被视为简单省力时，有利感知更易转化为较强的购买意向。作者据此认为感知易用性是把技术感知与行为意向联系起来的重要机制，并建议保险公司设计易用、以客户为中心的AI服务以提升接受度和购买意向；结论基于特定国家客户样本，属相关性证据。

papers.title: Perspectives: artificial intelligence and scientific autonomy: a policy agenda for emerging research systems
papers.authors: Hélio Dias, Hélio Henrique Villela Dias, Hélio Henrique Villela Dias, Hélio Henrique Villela Dias
papers.abstract: Abstract Artificial intelligence is becoming part of the infrastructure through which scientific knowledge is produced, yet access to computing, data, advanced models and expertise remains highly uneven. This Perspective argues that, for emerging research systems, the central science-policy challenge is not simply AI adoption but scientific autonomy: the capacity to choose, understand, adapt, evaluate and govern the technologies on which research increasingly depends. Scientific autonomy is not technological self-sufficiency; it is strategic interdependence supported by domestic capabilities. Drawing on Brazil as an illustrative case, we propose four dimensions of autonomy—epistemic, infrastructural, human-capability and governance autonomy—and a six-part policy agenda based on shared computing, research-data infrastructure, AI literacy, interdisciplinary networks, adaptive governance and capability-building international cooperation. Without deliberate capacity-building, AI may accelerate discovery while deepening structural asymmetries between research systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇观点文章，讨论新兴科研体系在人工智能日益成为知识生产基础设施的背景下如何保持科学自主性。作者以巴西为例，提出认知、基础设施、人力能力和治理四个自主性维度，并给出涵盖共享算力、研究数据基础设施、AI素养、跨学科网络、适应性治理和能力建设型国际合作的政策议程。文章强调科学自主并非技术自给自足，而是有国内能力支撑的战略性相互依赖，并警示若缺乏有意的能力建设，AI可能在加速发现的同时加深科研体系间的结构性不对称。

papers.title: Innovative Learning Tools in Breast Imaging
papers.authors: Benjamin Vega, Yiming Gao
papers.abstract: Radiology and breast imaging curricula have relied almost entirely on passive learning tools such as lectures, books, journal articles, and videos for more than two decades. Despite their wide availability, trainee engagement with these tools to accumulate and synthesize the vast amount of information required to succeed in radiology remains challenging. Knowledge gaps exist among trainees because of natural differences in learning styles, study habits, and case exposure at the reading station. Further, current pressures in academic radiology limit the availability of workstation teaching, which is the most effective teaching and learning strategy in the field. Leading educators aim to bridge these gaps both by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) large language models (LLM) to develop precision learning curricula personalized to the trainee and by creating gamified learning tools to boost the engagement of trainees. Gamification can also be used to simulate learning experiences for trainees. These tools show promise based on user feedback, both by educators and learners. Further, the synergy of AI and gamification strategies may help address knowledge gaps precisely and efficiently. We explore some of these emerging tools, their application, potential benefits, and limitations within radiology with a focus on breast imaging training.
papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨乳腺影像培训中被动学习工具长期占主导、学员知识掌握参差不齐的问题，并梳理了以人工智能大语言模型和游戏化手段开发新型学习工具的探索。作者指出，基于大语言模型的精准学习课程可针对学员个人定制内容，游戏化工具则有助于提升参与度并模拟学习体验；用户反馈显示这些工具有应用前景，二者结合可能更精准高效地弥补知识缺口。文章同时讨论了这些新兴工具在放射学尤其是乳腺影像培训中的应用、潜在益处与局限，属于综述性梳理而非实证检验。

papers.title: Neural evidence for progressive decline of visual face recognition ability in Alzheimer’s disease
papers.authors: Justine David, Lisa Quenon, Adrian Ivanoiu, Laurent Koessler, Lise Colmant, Yasmine Salman, Lara Huyghe, Bernard Jimmy Hanseeuw, Bruno Rossion
papers.abstract: Abstract Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is associated with deficits in recognising familiar faces already at prodromal stages due to significant episodic and semantic memory impairment. However, whether the ability to visually discriminate and match unfamiliar faces for their identity also declines in AD remains unclear. We addressed this issue with a robust implicit electroencephalographic (EEG) measure of face identity recognition (FIR) relying on fast periodic visual stimulation (FPVS). Thirty cognitively unimpaired (CU) individuals and thirty AD patients, including seventeen patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) due to AD and thirteen patients with dementia due to AD viewed stimulation sequences of the same unfamiliar face identity repeated at 6 Hz across size changes, with other identities appearing every 5 faces, eliciting a neural 1.2 Hz response indexing FIR. Stimuli were also presented upside down to control for low-level visual effects. While CU individuals exhibited robust FIR EEG responses at 1.2 Hz (and harmonics) over the occipito-temporal cortex, larger for upright than inverted faces, this response and the inversion effect were significantly reduced in patients with dementia due to AD but preserved in patients with MCI due to AD. These results indicate that unfamiliar FIR is preserved in patients at the prodromal stage, suggesting that familiar FIR difficulties previously observed during the prodromal phase of AD may stem from other cognitive factors, such as long-term memory impairments. In contrast, deficits in discriminating unfamiliar faces seem to emerge as the disease progresses. Overall, this study provides novel evidence for the processes underlying face identity recognition deficits in AD and highlights the diagnosticity of FPVS-EEG for assessing specific cognitive processes in neurodegenerative populations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者对陌生面孔的身份识别能力是否随病程下降，采用快速周期性视觉刺激结合脑电的隐式测量，比较认知未受损者、AD所致轻度认知障碍患者和AD所致痴呆患者对面孔身份识别的神经反应。结果显示，认知未受损者和轻度认知障碍患者仍表现出稳健的面孔身份识别反应及倒置效应，而痴呆患者该反应明显减弱。作者据此认为，陌生面孔的视觉身份识别在AD前驱期尚保留，先前观察到的熟悉面孔识别困难可能源于长期记忆等其他认知因素，而陌生面孔辨别缺陷随疾病进展才出现。

papers.title: Towards semantic brain-computer interfacing: The graded inventory of semantic triggers (GIST) paradigm
papers.authors: Joshua James Podmore, Moein Radman, Riccardo Poli, Silke Paulmann, Ian P. Daly
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Semantic Brain-Computer Interfaces (sBCIs) aim to decode conceptual information directly from neural activity, enabling more efficient and natural communication for individuals with severe motor impairments. However, existing approaches are often confounded by stimulus-driven perceptual processes and lack a reliable means of tagging the moment of concept formation. We introduce the Graded Inventory of Semantic Triggers (GIST), a novel electroencephalography (EEG) paradigm designed to elicit semantic retrieval from graded verbal clues with precise temporal alignment. Approach: EEG data were recorded from 14 participants performing the GIST task across three semantic categories (food, musical instruments, and body parts). Target neural activity was aligned to each participant's self-reported moment of semantic retrieval (spacebar press), enabling response-locked analysis. Here, we propose a staged framework where the first comprises a Conformer-based encoder trained on pooled data using a hybrid contrastive objective that combines instance-level consistency and cross-participant class alignment with domain-adversarial learning to reduce participant-specific information. In the second stage, the frozen encoder is transferred to a held-out participant whose data played no part in Stage 1, and a support vector machine is calibrated on that participant's own labelled items under a nested leave-one-item-out protocol. Results: Above-chance semantic decoding was achieved in all three pairwise tasks. Mean accuracies were 73.4% (Body vs. Food), 70.7% (Body vs. Music), and 68.2% (Food vs. Music). Participant-level permutation tests were significant in 9/11 participants for Body vs. Food and 8/11 for each of the other tasks (p < 0.05). The pre-response interval at [-1.5s, -0.5s] was the most discriminative. Significance: The GIST paradigm enables controlled elicitation and temporal alignment of semantic processing while reducing perceptual confounds. Combined with cross-participant representation pretraining and participant-specific calibration, the results demonstrate above-chance decoding of semantic categories from EEG in individuals excluded from representation learning, supporting the feasibility of sBCIs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出名为GIST的脑电图范式，用分级言语线索诱发语义提取，并将神经活动对齐到参与者自报的语义提取时刻，以考察语义脑机接口能否在新参与者身上解码语义类别。方法上先以Conformer编码器结合对比学习与域对抗训练在汇总数据上预训练，再将冻结编码器迁移到未参与预训练的留出参与者，并用其自身标注数据校准分类器。结果显示三组两两语义分类均高于随机水平，反应前区间最具区分度，且多数参与者的置换检验显著，表明跨参与者表征预训练加个体校准有助于对未参与表征学习者的语义类别解码，支持语义脑机接口的可行性。

papers.title: ACF-Net: Design of an adaptive cross-modal fusion network for cross-subject wearable EEG-EMG gesture recognition
papers.authors: TongLiang Yang
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Cross-subject gesture recognition in wearable brain-computer interfaces is constrained by four structural deficiencies: symmetric cross-modal attention discarding cortical precedence over muscular execution, priors confined to post hoc analysis, invariance anchored on unimodal features, and adaptation requiring labelled target-domain data. This study closes these gaps by embedding corticomuscular coupling directly into the network architecture rather than recovering it from data. Approach: ACF-Net is a four-stage pipeline embedding neurophysiological priors directly into fusion. The corticomuscular coherence prior injection layer (CMC-Prior) encodes time-lagged coherence and phase-locking values for every electroencephalography (EEG)-electromyography (EMG) channel pair as a learnable bias tensor. Granger-causality-inspired directed cross-modal attention (GC-Attn) uses a causal mask allowing only EEG-to-EMG influence within 30-120 ms. The fused embedding is projected onto a symmetric positive definite manifold with log-Euclidean triplet loss. Physiology-consistent test-time adaptation (PC-TTA) updates only batch-normalisation affine parameters, using EEG-precedes-EMG as unlabelled self-supervision, eliminating labelled target data. Leave-one-subject-out validation on WAY-EEG-GAL (12 participants) and WEE-Ges (20 participants, three days) used fold-wise priors and Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests. Main results: ACF-Net reached 87.6% on WAY-EEG-GAL and 89.2% on WEE-Ges, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.4 and 9.1 percentage points with all comparisons significant after correction. Ablation attributed gains of 6.3, 4.9, 3.4 and 1.8 percentage points to directed attention, prior injection, manifold embedding and test-time adaptation. Accuracy remained 77.5% under 20 mm simulated electrode displacement, adaptation reduced the cross-day loss from 6.8 to 2.1 percentage points, and a forward pass on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano took 32.4 ms within a 178 ms end-to-end response at 30.9 Hz. Significance: Learned coupling weights recovered central-to-forearm-extensor projection, and delays matched corticospinal conduction with motor-unit recruitment, suggesting physiological structure, not dataset-specific statistics. Yet healthy young adults, gel-based/semi-dry wired hardware, and simulated displacement make this methodological; clinical and wireless dry-electrode transfer remains unestablished.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对跨被试可穿戴脑机接口手势识别中跨模态融合未体现皮层先于肌肉执行、先验仅事后使用、自适应依赖目标域标注等问题，提出将神经生理先验直接嵌入网络结构的ACF-Net四阶段方法，并在两个数据集上以留一被试验证评估。结果显示其准确率高于最强基线，消融表明定向注意、先验注入、流形嵌入与测试时自适应各有贡献；在模拟电极位移下仍保持一定精度，跨天损失下降，且可在嵌入式设备上实时运行。作者指出学习到的耦合权重与延迟符合生理通路，但健康年轻被试、有线硬件和模拟位移使结论仍属方法学层面，临床与无线干电极迁移尚未确立。

papers.title: Graph representation learning via collaborative online adversarial knowledge transfer for EEG based emotion recognition: Application to hearing impaired subjects
papers.authors: Yushuo Jia, Weijing Han, Qing Wang, Zhonghao Zhou, Nan Geng, Jinnuo Wang, Yu Song
papers.abstract: Abstract Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition enables objective quantification for mental health monitoring and affective brain-computer interface (BCI). However, hearing-impaired people show highly heterogeneous brain functional connectivity due to missing auditory pathways. Coupled with non-stationary EEG, large inter-subject gaps and distribution mismatches from static knowledge distillation, cross-subject recognition performance degrades drastically. Current graph neural networks (GNNs) separately model spatial or temporal features with fixed adjacency matrices and offline distillation, incapable of capturing unique functional patterns of hearingimpaired subjects. To tackle these challenges, this paper proposes a Spearman-Band Attention Graph Network with Online Adversarial Distillation (SBA-GOAD). We construct a multi-view feature enhancement module integrating frequency band attention, convolutional block attention module(CBAM) channel-spatial joint attention and Spearman correlation operators to extract EEG features from three dimensions: frequency bands, electrode space and global functional connectivity. A GATv2 dynamic graph encoder with residual skip connections is utilized to alleviate the over-smoothing issue of deep graph networks and capture multi-scale topological relationships among electrodes. Furthermore, a two-layer collaborative online distillation framework is devised: global distillation based on Kullback-Leibler(KL) divergence aligns prediction distributions of multiple student models, while local cyclic adversarial distillation oriented to node embeddings mines latent graph structural features. A diversity constraint is introduced to prevent model collapse. Validations were conducted on the self-built HIED dataset of individuals with hearing impairment and the public SEED dataset. The subject-dependent accuracies reached 80.54% and 96.65%, respectively, and the leave-one-subject-out cross-subject accuracies reached 70.56% and 86.67%, respectively. Visualizations reveal more dispersed parieto-occipital spatial importance and functional connectivity patterns in individuals with hearing impairment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对听障人群脑功能连接异质性大、脑电非平稳导致跨被试情绪识别性能下降的问题，提出一种结合Spearman相关与注意力机制的图网络及在线对抗蒸馏框架，用于提取频带、电极空间与全局功能连接特征并缓解深度图网络的过平滑。在自建听障数据集与公开数据集上的验证显示，被试内与跨被试识别均取得一定准确率，且可视化表明听障者的顶枕区空间重要性与功能连接模式更为分散。这些结果提示，面向听障人群的脑电情绪识别需考虑其特有的功能连接分布，而在线协同蒸馏有助于缩小跨被试分布差异。

papers.title: Students’ strategies for revising AI-assisted writing: towards a conceptual framework
papers.authors: Yog Raj Lamichhane
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) becomes integrated into academic writing, understanding how second language (L2) English students revise AI-assisted writing remains underexplored; therefore, this inductive content analysis explores students’ revision strategies for academic writing to propose a conceptual framework . The study employs an open-ended free listing task with 100 students, who listed their five major strategies for revising AI-assisted writing assignments. Additionally, semi-structured interviews were conducted with 10 students experienced in revising AI-assisted writing. The interview transcripts were open-coded to develop categories. Meanwhile, the free-listing responses were directly categorized because participants listed strategies as explicit codes. The researcher then compared, consolidated, and synthesized the strategy categories into broader themes to form a conceptual framework. The analysis found key revision strategies like incorporating personal ideas and expressions, simplifying the language, consulting additional sources, paraphrasing and rewriting content, integrating personal experience, contextualizing AI content, and cross-checking AI information. It suggested that L2 English students primarily personalize and improve AI-assisted writing rather than passively accepting AI-generated text, while also adapting, evaluating, and responsibly managing AI-generated content. This final synthesis yielded six overarching themes: supportive utilization, ethical engagement, creative reform, critical evaluation, contextual revision, and functional adjustment. The proposed framework with six themes serves as an empirically grounded taxonomy of student revision strategies in AI-assisted writing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注二语英语学生在AI辅助学术写作中如何修改文本，采用开放式自由列举任务与半结构化访谈，通过归纳性内容分析提炼修改策略并构建概念框架。分析发现，学生的主要策略包括融入个人观点与表达、简化语言、查阅额外资料、改写重写、结合个人经验、为AI内容补充语境以及交叉核对AI信息。研究据此提出支持性利用、伦理参与、创造性改造、批判性评估、语境化修改和功能性调整六个主题，表明学生倾向于对AI生成文本进行个性化与改进，而非被动接受，同时也在适应、评估并负责任地管理AI内容。该框架为理解学生修改AI辅助写作的策略提供了基于实证的分类。

papers.title: Prompting behaviours and feedback uptake in GenAI-supported writing: longitudinal changes in relation to writing self-regulation and associations with later writing performance
papers.authors: Qi Lu, Yuan Yao, Hongbiao Yin, Longhai Xiao, Xinhua Zhu
papers.journal: Innovation in Language Learning and Teaching
papers.abstract: Learner interaction with generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) as part of writing development has drawn increasing attention. However, less is known about how such interaction changes over time and varies with learner characteristics. Adopting a process-oriented perspective, this study examined longitudinal changes in prompting behaviours and feedback uptake, their relations with writing self-regulation, and associations with later writing performance. Data came from 56 undergraduates in a ten-week GenAI-supported academic writing programme with a one-month follow-up. Learners’ draft pairs and GenAI chat logs were coded, transformed into log-ratio contrasts where appropriate, and analysed using linear mixed-effects models and baseline-controlled hierarchical regression. Results showed that prompting frequency increased from T1 to T2 and declined at T3, while meaning-making, regulation-oriented, and evaluative prompting increased relative to direct acquisition prompting from T1 to later time points. The increase in meaning-making relative to direct acquisition was stronger at lower levels of self-regulation, whereas increases in regulation-oriented prompting and in rejected relative to fully implemented uptake were stronger at higher levels. T1-to-T2 increases in meaning-making and regulation-oriented prompting relative to direct acquisition, and in rejected relative to fully implemented uptake, were positively associated with T3 initial-draft performance after baseline performance and self-regulation were controlled. The findings show that GenAI interaction patterns vary with writing self-regulation and that specific prompting and uptake changes are associated with later writing performance. They underscore the value of examining learner differences in human–GenAI interaction from a longitudinal, process-oriented perspective and of providing support responsive to different interaction patterns.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从过程视角考察本科生在生成式人工智能辅助学术写作中提示行为与反馈采纳的纵向变化，并分析其与写作自我调节及后续写作表现的关系。作者对参与十周写作项目的学生草稿与聊天记录进行编码，采用线性混合效应模型和基线控制的层级回归分析。结果显示，提示频率先升后降，意义建构、调节导向和评价性提示相对直接获取提示有所增加；这些变化随自我调节水平不同而异，且特定提示与反馈采纳变化同后续初稿表现相关。研究提示应关注人机交互中的学习者差异并提供针对性支持。

papers.title: Cognitive–affective pathways to AI-assisted informal English-speaking participation in translanguaging EMI contexts: an explanatory sequential mixed-methods study
papers.authors: Siyi Wang, Yongliang Wang
papers.journal: Innovation in Language Learning and Teaching
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has expanded opportunities for spoken English practice beyond the classroom, yet learner participation remains uneven. Using an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design, this study examined the associations of digital competence, cognitive load, and foreign language enjoyment (FLE) with Chinese EMI students’ AI-assisted informal speaking participation. Survey data from 386 students were analysed using structural equation modelling (SEM), followed by thematic analysis of interviews with 10 purposively selected survey participants. SEM indicated that digital competence was positively associated with AI-assisted informal speaking participation, both directly and indirectly through FLE; a sequential indirect association through cognitive load and FLE was also significant. Cognitive load was not directly associated with participation, and the indirect association through cognitive load alone was non-significant. The interview findings suggested that manageable and enjoyable AI interaction did not necessarily coincide with oral practice. Participants most often spoke when they had an immediate disciplinary need, whereas they could use AI to clarify concepts without sustained oral production. Translanguaging was described as supporting disciplinary meaning-making and preparation for English speaking but did not consistently culminate in oral rehearsal. Together, the findings highlight a distinction between speaking participation from broader AI use and identify cognitive, affective, and situated factors associated with such participation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以中国英语授课环境中的学生为对象，采用解释性序列混合方法，考察数字能力、认知负荷与外语愉悦同AI辅助的非正式口语参与之间的关系。问卷的结构方程模型显示，数字能力与口语参与直接正相关，也通过外语愉悦间接相关；经认知负荷再到愉悦的序列间接路径同样显著，但认知负荷本身与参与无直接关联。访谈进一步提示，可管理且愉快的AI互动并不必然转化为口头练习，学生多在即时学科需求下开口，而用AI澄清概念时往往不伴随持续口语产出，跨语言实践也未必落到口头演练。研究据此区分了广泛使用AI与真正口语参与，并指出认知、情感与情境因素共同关联这一参与。

papers.title: Prioritising readiness factors for artificial intelligence-enabled green trade adoption among export-capable Korean small and medium-sized enterprises
papers.authors: Jaewoo Park, 이성우, Young‐Joon Seo
papers.journal: International Journal of Logistics Research and Applications
papers.abstract: This study identifies and prioritises readiness factors for small and medium-sized enterprises’ adoption of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled green trade. Focusing on export-capable Korean SMEs, it develops a literature-derived AHP framework covering trade digital infrastructure and data, transport and logistics AI deployment, green trade finance, regulatory governance, and SME adoption capability. Expert-based pairwise comparisons were used to derive local and global priority weights, while consistency ratios, sensitivity analysis, and a descriptive subgroup comparison were used to assess result reliability. The findings indicate that Trade Digital Infrastructure and Data is the highest-priority main criterion, followed by Transport and Logistics AI Deployment. At the sub-criteria level, Data Interoperability Infrastructure ranked first, followed by AI-Enabled Trade Documentation Automation, Financial Support for AI Adoption, and AI-Driven Load Factor and Demand Forecast Optimisation. The results suggest that AI-enabled green trade readiness is perceived primarily as a practical data and operational capability issue.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注出口型韩国中小企业采用人工智能赋能绿色贸易的准备因素，通过文献构建AHP框架并结合专家两两比较来确定各因素的优先级。结果显示，贸易数字基础设施与数据被视为最重要的主准则，其次是运输与物流中的人工智能部署；在子准则层面，数据互操作基础设施居首，其后是人工智能贸易单据自动化、人工智能采用的财务支持以及人工智能驱动的装载率与需求预测优化。作者据此认为，人工智能赋能的绿色贸易准备度主要被理解为一项实际的数据与运营能力问题，而非单纯的制度或融资议题。

papers.title: When AI Enters the Pencil Box: A Longitudinal Study of Child–LLM Writing Collaboration in a Chinese Primary School
papers.authors: Junrong Song, Zheng Wei, Changyang He, Junxiang Liao, Xian Xu, David Kei Man Yip
papers.abstract: We report a qualitative study spanning more than six months with upper-primary students (ages 9–12) in southern China using a local LLM (Doubao) for writing. Two interview waves with ten students (nine re-interviewed) and six teachers (three re-interviewed) reveal a set of recurring shifts in our focal cohort: from novelty to strategy, from anthropomorphic “companion/virtual teacher” to tool-like framing, and from quick unsticking to guarded use shaped by dependence, fairness, and exam-transfer Footnote1 concerns. Students valued speed and breadth but noted mechanical tone, age/style mismatch, and weak transfer to AI-free tests. We map a Control × Dependency framework and before/after transitions, and surface tensions around classroom norms and equity amid policy ambiguity and uneven AI literacy. We suggest process-visible, agency-preserving integration: sentence- and phrase-level provenance with mandatory micro-edits, task-specific scaffold ceilingsFootnote2, and process-anchored assessment schemes that explicitly factor in AI-use traces.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以中国南方一所小学的高年级学生为对象，开展为期六个多月的定性研究，考察其使用本地大语言模型辅助写作的协作过程。通过两轮学生与教师访谈，作者发现学生对AI的定位从新奇体验和拟人化“伙伴/虚拟教师”逐步转向工具化理解，使用方式也从快速求助转为因依赖、公平和考试迁移等顾虑而有所保留；学生认可速度与广度，但指出语气机械、年龄与风格不匹配、对无AI测试迁移较弱。文章据此提出控制与依赖框架，并建议采用过程可见、保留学生能动性的整合方式，如句词级来源标注与强制微编辑、任务特定的支架上限，以及纳入AI使用痕迹的过程性评价。

papers.title: Does Code-Switching Disrupt Emotion Recognition? A Valence–Arousal Analysis of Affective Misalignment in Multilingual Human–AI Interaction
papers.authors: HeeSoo Kim
papers.abstract: As multilingual communication increasingly involves code-switching, emotion recognition in mixed-language input has become a key challenge for human–AI interaction. This study examines emotion classification under English–Spanish and Spanish–English code-switching conditions using the valence–arousal framework. Five large language models (GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-5, Llama-3, Llama-4, and Claude Opus 4.7) were evaluated on 7,560 inputs across five code-switching ratios. Performance was assessed using accuracy, Macro-F1, and mixed-effects logistic regression, while errors were categorized as valence shifts, arousal shifts, or same-region confusions. Increasing code-switching produced a small but significant accuracy decline in both language directions. Under English-to-Spanish conditions, models generally preserved valence while showing greater arousal instability. Under Spanish-to-English conditions, GPT-5 showed increased valence-shift errors and was the only model with a significant direction–error-type association. Aggregate metrics can obscure distinct forms of affective misalignment. The proposed framework enables dimension-level comparison of error patterns across models, language directions, and code-switching ratios.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察多语言人机交互中语码转换是否干扰大语言模型的情感识别，以效价—唤醒框架评估五种模型在英西、西英双向混合语言输入下的情绪分类表现。结果显示，语码转换比例升高会带来幅度不大但显著的准确率下降；英译西条件下模型多能保持效价而唤醒维度更不稳定，西译英条件下GPT-5的效价偏移错误增多，且是唯一呈现方向与错误类型显著关联的模型。作者据此指出，总体指标可能掩盖不同形式的情感错位，所提框架可在维度层面比较模型、语言方向与转换比例下的错误模式。

papers.title: Developing preservice teachers’ TPACK for ChatGPT integration in CLIL: a longitudinal study in authentic classroom settings
papers.authors: Yi-ju Ariel Wu
papers.abstract: This study investigates how an 18-week cyclical teacher education program supported Taiwanese Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) preservice teachers’ (PSTs’) development of Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) for integrating ChatGPT into authentic elementary classrooms. Grounded in Mishra et al. TPACK framework, this multi-method case study involved 48 PSTs who participated in three iterative teaching cycles. These cycles focused on using ChatGPT for lesson planning (teaching support) and facilitating students’ direct use of ChatGPT for CLIL task completion and inquiry (learning support). Data sources included lesson plans, ChatGPT interaction logs, reflective journals, student work, and classroom observations. Findings revealed a clear developmental trajectory in ChatGPT integration, progressing from lower- to higher-order tasks, from one-way tutor-like use to collaborative partner-like engagement, and from text-based to multimodal learning experiences. TPACK analysis showed a strong emphasis on technological pedagogical knowledge (TPK), with PSTs demonstrating increasing confidence in leveraging ChatGPT’s generative and social affordances. However, limited development was observed in contextual knowledge (XK), particularly in addressing ethical, sociocultural, and institutional considerations. The study contributes to emerging GenAI scholarship by providing longitudinal, classroom-based evidence and demonstrating that structured training supports the meaningful integration of ChatGPT into teaching, with clear implications for future teacher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察一项为期18周的循环式教师教育项目如何支持职前教师发展整合ChatGPT的TPACK，用于真实小学课堂的内容与语言整合学习（CLIL）教学。研究采用多方法个案设计，追踪48名职前教师经历三轮迭代教学，数据包括教案、ChatGPT交互日志、反思日志、学生作品和课堂观察。结果显示，其ChatGPT整合呈现清晰的发展轨迹：从低阶任务走向高阶任务，从单向的辅导式使用转向协作伙伴式参与，从纯文本学习转向多模态学习；TPACK分析中技术教学知识（TPK）较为突出，职前教师对运用ChatGPT的生成性与社交性可供性的信心逐步增强，但情境知识（XK）发展有限，尤其在伦理、社会文化和制度层面的考量上。研究据此认为，结构化培训有助于将ChatGPT有意义地融入教学，并为未来教师教育提供启示。

papers.title: Building and Maintaining Trust in AI Chatbots: Introducing Generative Information Retrieval Accountability Assessment Framework (GIRAAF)
papers.authors: Michael Karlsson, Joanne Kuai, Cornelia Brantner, Haiqing Yu, James Meese
papers.abstract: Social integration of AI requires public trust and appropriate governance. This paper introduces the Generative Information Retrieval Accountability Assessment Framework (GIRAAF), designed to appraise accountability for Large Language Models and their applications, including AI chatbots. Drawing on Dahl’s (1998) notion of enlightened citizens, the framework comprises six interlinked dimensions: Information Readiness, Factual Correctness, Normative Alignment, Sourcing Practice, Transparency and Explainability, and Responsiveness and Adaptivity. Together, these dimensions link observable text outputs to intelligible standards, enabling systematic evaluation and accountable oversight. For scholars, developers and policymakers, GIRAAF provides a diagnostic heuristic and shared vocabulary for critical analysis of AI chatbot performance.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对AI聊天机器人信任的建立与维护问题，提出了生成式信息检索问责评估框架（GIRAAF），用于评估大语言模型及其应用（包括AI聊天机器人）的问责性。该框架为理论性工作，借鉴Dahl的“开明公民”概念，由信息就绪度、事实正确性、规范一致性、来源实践、透明度与可解释性、响应性与适应性六个相互关联的维度构成，将可观察的文本输出与可理解的标准相连接，以支持系统评估和问责监督。对学者、开发者和政策制定者而言，GIRAAF提供了一种诊断性启发工具和共享词汇，用于批判性地分析AI聊天机器人的表现。

papers.title: Learner agency and human-AI collaboration: shaping hybrid intelligence for the future of higher education
papers.authors: Andy Nguyen, Davy Tsz Kit Ng, Xianghan O’Dea, Cecilia Ka Yuk Chan
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly generative AI, has transformed the higher education landscape with remarkable speed, reshaping how students learn, produce academic work, and interact wit...
