papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕高等教育中学习者能动性与人机协作的关系展开讨论，关注生成式人工智能进入学习与研究过程后，学生如何保持对自身学习的掌控。文章提出以“混合智能”为框架，主张人机协作不应以自动化取代学习者的判断，而应通过分工与互动支持学生主动参与。其含义在于，高等教育的设计需把学习者能动性置于核心，使 AI 成为协作伙伴而非替代者，从而塑造面向未来的混合智能。摘要信息有限，文章的具体论证与证据未能完整呈现。

papers.title: Artificial learning: how sessional academics view contract cheating and digital academic misconduct in assessment
papers.authors: Lovasoa Andriamora, Lorna Andriamora, Lorna Andriamora, Lorna Andriamora
papers.abstract: This study investigated sessional academics’ perceptions of student misconduct in tertiary education assessments, focusing on contract cheating, misuse of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and unauthorised use of smart devices. Using a qualitative research design grounded in the interpretivist paradigm, interviews were conducted with 20 experienced sessional academics from diverse institutions in Sydney. Participants identified misconduct as driven by a combination of contextual pressures, institutional shortcomings and student-specific challenges, such as language barriers and fear of failure. They reported relying on intuitive cues – disconnected content, generic writing, and fake references – to detect misconduct while expressing concerns over limited institutional support and unreliable detection tools. Recommendations include rethinking assessment design, enhancing student support and redefining the meaning and objective of ‘education and learning’. A significant theme was the call for systemic educational reform, including redefining learning outcomes to emphasise critical thinking, ethical reasoning and real-world skills. The findings underscore the need for proactive, pedagogically grounded responses to academic integrity challenges in an era increasingly shaped by digital technologies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察兼职学术人员如何看待高等教育评估中的学生不端行为，重点关注代写、生成式人工智能滥用和智能设备违规使用。作者采用解释主义取向的质性设计，访谈了悉尼多所院校的20名有经验的兼职学术人员。参与者认为不端行为由情境压力、制度不足和学生个体困难共同驱动，并主要依靠内容脱节、泛化写作和虚假参考文献等直觉线索识别，同时对机构支持有限和检测工具不可靠表示担忧。文章据此建议重新设计评估、加强学生支持并重新界定教育与学习的目标，强调以批判性思维、伦理推理和现实技能为核心的系统性教育改革。

papers.title: Generalising series elastic actuation to flexible-link flexible-joint robot control using end-point position sensing
papers.authors: Xavier Garant, Clément Gosselin
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a task-space generalisation of series elastic actuation concepts for lightweight flexible-link flexible-joint robots with multiple degrees of freedom (dof). Using end-point sensing, the whole body of the flexible manipulator can effectively be considered a task-space series elastic actuator (SEA). This allows force control of the robot, with notable applications in physical human-robot interaction through admittance and impedance control schemes. Moreover, the proposed method allows whole-body interaction: physical interactions are not limited to the end-effector and can take place at any point on the robot structure. A known necessary condition on the maximum passively renderable stiffness for single-dof SEAs is generalised to multi-dof flexible structures. Finally, the task-space control schemes derived from the SEA literature are implemented and validated on a 3-dof flexible-link flexible-joint manipulator prototype. The results demonstrate low-frequency stiffness rendering on a lightweight manipulator with low apparent inertia at the interaction port.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对多自由度柔性连杆柔性关节机器人，提出将串联弹性驱动概念推广到任务空间，并利用末端位置传感把整机视为任务空间串联弹性执行器，从而实现力控制及基于导纳和阻抗方案的物理人机交互。其关键含义在于物理交互不再局限于末端执行器，而可发生在机器人结构的任意位置；作者还将单自由度串联弹性执行器关于最大被动可渲染刚度的已知必要条件推广到多自由度柔性结构，并在三自由度样机上实现和验证了相关控制方案，结果显示该轻量机械臂能在交互端口呈现低频刚度且表观惯量较低。

papers.title: The chain mediating roles of career planning and future time perspective between AI literacy and employment anxiety among higher vocational college students
papers.authors: Ye Xiong, Jijiang Yu, Hewen Wu
papers.abstract: Against the background of artificial intelligence (AI) reshaping the labor market, employment anxiety among higher vocational college students is becoming increasingly prominent. Grounded in Career Construction Theory, this study aims to explore the relationship between AI literacy and employment anxiety among Chinese higher vocational college students, with a specific focus on the chain mediating roles of career planning and future time perspective. A total of 1,234 students from five industry-featured higher vocational colleges in Jiangxi Province, China, were surveyed using self-report scales measuring AI literacy, employment anxiety, career planning, and future time perspective. The relationships among these variables were tested using the PROCESS macro (Model 6) for SPSS. The results indicated that (1) all variables were significantly correlated with one another; (2) AI literacy exhibited a significant positive total association with employment anxiety, which decomposed into a substantial positive direct association and a negative total indirect association; (3) AI literacy exerted a significant negative indirect association on employment anxiety through three pathways, namely, the independent mediating roles of career planning and future time perspective, and their chain mediating role, while the total association remained positive. These findings suggest that while higher AI literacy may heighten students’ awareness of labor-market disruptions, its negative indirect associations with employment anxiety operate through enhanced career planning and future orientation. It is recommended that higher vocational colleges consider integrating AI literacy education into career guidance programs, strengthening students’ career planning competencies, and cultivating a long-term future orientation, so as to potentially strengthen the anxiety-buffering pathway associated with AI literacy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于生涯建构理论，考察高职学生AI素养与就业焦虑的关系，并检验职业规划与未来时间观在其中的链式中介作用；研究者对江西五所行业特色高职院校学生进行问卷调查，采用PROCESS宏程序分析变量间关系。结果显示，AI素养与就业焦虑总体呈正相关，其中既有显著的正向直接关联，也包含通过职业规划和未来时间观产生的负向间接关联，二者可独立中介，也构成链式中介，但总关联仍为正。作者据此提示，较高的AI素养可能增强学生对劳动力市场冲击的感知，而职业规划与未来取向或可缓冲这种焦虑，建议将AI素养教育融入职业指导。

papers.title: Electroencephalographic gamma correlates with pain intensity attenuation in a prospective longitudinal study using an AI-powered digital device for pain self-management
papers.authors: Bihua Bie, Maria L. Rosén Klement, Samer Ghosn, Elias Isaac Lattouf, Samuel Schut, Jijun Xu, Jianguo Cheng, Jacob Ezell, Carl A. K. Borrebaeck, Carl Y. Saab
papers.abstract: Chronic low back or neck pain is one of the most common neurological disorders in the US. Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a leading noninvasive approach to identify biomarkers for chronic pain, but its validation in clinical settings remains limited by methodological challenges, including variable feature selections, subjective removal of EEG artifacts, and reliance on population-level analyses. In this single center, prospective, longitudinal study, we investigated the relationships among EEG features, patient-reported clinical outcomes via validated Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMS) questionnaires, and daily self-management of pain-associated physical activity via a newly developed AI-powered mobile application Paindrainer PDCC (Paindrainer AB, Lund, Sweden) in patients with chronic pain undergoing standard care. In total, twenty patients with chronic lower back or neck pain were enrolled and evaluated during 3 visits over a 12-week period. Results show significant improvements in pain score, physical function, and pain interference scores over time, whereas mean EEG power spectral density across all electrodes and frequency bands was statistically insignificant at the group level between the three visits. However, logistic regression analysis revealed significant nominal inverse correlations between pain score reduction and gamma power changes (averaged globally and localized to the right temporal and left frontal regions), though these failed to retain significance after multiple comparison correction. Logistic regression showed a statistically significant correlation between increased EEG gamma oscillations (1 Hz bins) and decreased pain intensity in the right temporal EEG electrodes. These exploratory analyses suggest that improvements in self-reported pain outcomes in chronic pain patients undergoing standard treatments and complemented with digital-based behavioral interventions correlate negatively with measurable changes in EEG spectral features, which need further validation in future studies with larger cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察慢性腰背或颈痛患者在接受标准治疗并使用AI驱动的疼痛自我管理移动应用时，脑电特征与患者报告结局之间的关系，采用单中心前瞻性纵向设计，在12周内对患者进行多次随访评估。结果显示，患者的疼痛评分、身体功能和疼痛干扰均随时间改善，而各电极和频段的平均脑电功率谱密度在组间比较中未见统计学显著变化。探索性分析发现，脑电gamma功率变化与疼痛评分下降呈名义上的负相关，其中右侧颞区gamma振荡增强与疼痛强度降低相关，但多数关联经多重比较校正后不再显著。作者据此提示，自报疼痛结局的改善可能与可测量的脑电频谱变化相关，相关结论仍需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Closed-loop EEG feedback pacing alters task load during digital learning
papers.authors: Katrina Sollazzo, Alexander John Karran, Thaddé Rolon-Merette, Alejandra Ruiz‐Segura, Constantinos K. Coursaris, Pierre‐Majorique Léger, Sylvain Sénécal
papers.abstract: Digital learning systems rarely adapt to momentary cognitive state, creating risk of underload or overload. The current study investigates whether EEG-based closed-loop pacing can alter task load dynamics during a digital constellation-learning task. Fifty-one participants were randomly assigned to adaptive, reward, or control conditions. In the adaptive condition, a task load index derived from frontal theta and parietal alpha adjusted feedback duration between 3 and 8 s; fixed 5s feedback was used in reward and control conditions, with reward participants expecting to receive performance-contingent draw entries. Accuracy increased across blocks in all groups, with no significant group or group-by-block effect. In contrast, EEG indices showed group-specific trajectories: task load decreased over time in the adaptive condition, and frontal theta and parietal alpha showed significant group-by-block interactions. The adaptive condition also showed reduced late-session feedback duration, while reward participants reported higher satisfaction. Intrinsic motivation did not moderate group effects, although perceived competence predicted final-block performance and interest, effort, and competence predicted engagement. These findings suggest that EEG-based feedback pacing can regulate neurophysiological task load dynamics despite lack of immediate accuracy gains under the present task constraints. The results support neuroadaptive scaffolding as a state-regulation mechanism for digital learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察基于脑电的闭环节奏调节能否改变数字学习任务中的任务负荷动态，将参与者随机分配到自适应、奖励或对照条件，并以额区theta与顶区alpha构成的任务负荷指数调节反馈时长。结果显示，各组学习正确率均随阶段提升，未出现显著的组间或组别与阶段交互效应；但脑电指标呈现组别特异性变化，自适应组的任务负荷随时间下降，额区theta和顶区alpha存在显著的组别与阶段交互，且其后段反馈时长缩短，奖励组则报告更高的满意度。内在动机未调节组别效应，而感知能力预测末段表现，兴趣、努力与能力感预测投入。作者据此认为，脑电反馈节奏可调节神经生理层面的任务负荷动态，但在当前任务约束下未带来即时的正确率收益。

papers.title: A Human-Technology-Organization Framework for Chemical Safety Education: Knowledge Evolution and Research Trends
papers.authors: Hui Liu, Cong He, Jie Kong, Chang Xu
papers.abstract: Abstract Chemical safety education plays an essential role in preparing students to recognize hazards and conduct laboratory work safely. However, the evolution and emerging priorities of this research field remain insufficiently understood. This study systematically examines the research landscape, major themes, and future directions of chemical safety education. A machine-learning-assisted bibliometric analysis was conducted on 553 publications retrieved from the Web of Science after systematic screening. Four major themes were identified: chemical risk perception and safety behavior, immersive and simulation-based safety education, safety competency development, and chemical risk management and accident prevention. The findings indicate a shift from traditional safety knowledge and behavior training toward technology-supported, experiential, and competency-oriented learning with immersive and intelligent technologies emerging as key drivers of this transformation. To interpret these changes, a human-technology-organization (HTO) framework was developed, highlighting the dynamic interplay among learner needs, educational technologies, and organizational conditions. The framework emphasizes that effective digital safety education requires an appropriate technology, curriculum integration, organizational support, and continuous assessment of learning outcomes. Overall, this study provides a systematic understanding of the evolution of chemical safety education and offers practical guidance for the curriculum design, technology adoption, and laboratory safety instruction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注化学安全教育领域的研究格局、主题演变与未来方向，采用机器学习辅助的文献计量分析，对经过系统筛选的553篇Web of Science文献进行梳理。分析识别出化学风险感知与安全行为、沉浸式与模拟安全教育、安全能力培养、化学品风险管理与事故预防四个主要主题，并显示该领域正从传统的安全知识与行为训练转向技术支持的体验式、能力导向学习，沉浸式与智能技术被视为这一转变的关键驱动力。作者据此构建人-技术-组织（HTO）框架，强调学习者需求、教育技术与组织条件之间的动态互动，并指出有效的数字化安全教育需要适当的技术、课程整合、组织支持以及对学习结果的持续评估。

papers.title: Fragile success under disadvantage: Dynamic pathways of academic resilience among low-SES students in China
papers.authors: Jinglei Xu
papers.abstract: Cross-sectional research on academic resilience often identifies “low-SES but high-performing” students, offering limited insight into changes in high-performance status. Using two-wave longitudinal data from the China Education Panel Survey (2013–2015), this study classified 2867 low-SES junior high school students into four pathways: persistent non-high performance, resilience growth, sustained high performance, and fragile high performance. Fragile high performance denotes the observed transition from W1 high to W2 non-high performance under the adopted percentile-based definition. Low-SES students had lower entry and maintenance rates and a higher exit rate than middle- and high-SES peers. Machine-learning analyses showed that the incremental predictive value of baseline information differed across transitions, with the largest improvement for resilience growth. Baseline achievement position provided substantial predictive information, but full models outperformed percentile-position benchmarks. These findings show that equity-oriented educational evaluation should consider both disadvantaged students’ access to high performance and the stability of that status over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注低社会经济地位学生的学业韧性并非稳定状态，而是可能在高低表现之间转换。作者利用中国教育追踪调查两期纵向数据，将低社会经济地位初中生划分为持续非高表现、韧性增长、持续高表现和脆弱高表现四类路径，并比较其与中高社会经济地位学生的进入率、维持率和退出率差异。机器学习分析显示，基线信息对不同转换的增量预测价值不同，对韧性增长的提升最大；基线成绩位置虽提供大量预测信息，但完整模型仍优于仅用百分位位置的基准。研究据此主张，公平导向的教育评价应同时关注弱势学生获得高表现的机会及其维持的稳定性。

papers.title: False mastery in the age of generative AI: Evidence from case-based learning in digitally mediated higher education
papers.authors: Jayaranjani Sutha

papers.title: A hybrid explainable artificial intelligence framework for equitable prediction and analysis of postnatal care uptake in Ghana: Integrating ensemble learning, counterfactuals, and causal inference
papers.authors: Augustus Osborne, Kobloobase O Usani, Umaru Sesay
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To develop and validate a hybrid, equity-focused artificial intelligence (AI) framework for predicting and analysing postnatal care (PNC) uptake among women in Ghana, with emphasis on minority-class sensitivity, model interpretability, and actionable intervention insights. STUDY DESIGN: Cross-sectional, secondary analysis of nationally representative survey data. METHODS: Using data from the 2022 Ghana Demographic and Health Survey (n = 3314), we developed a hybrid AI framework combining ensemble learning (Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine with soft voting and threshold tuning), explainable AI (SHAP analysis), counterfactual reasoning (DiCE), and causal inference (doubly robust estimators for average and conditional average treatment effects). The Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE) was applied to address class imbalance and stratified 5-fold cross-validation was used for model evaluation. Doubly robust causal inference was conducted using the econml library, with propensity score modelling used to account for treatment assignment, and positivity and exchangeability assumptions assessed through covariate overlap diagnostics. RESULTS: The ensemble model calibrated at a threshold of 0.45 achieved a Class 0 recall of 0.31 and an area under the precision-recall curve (AP) of 0.97, outperforming all individual baseline classifiers. SHAP analysis identified maternal age, education level, wealth status, caesarean section, and sex of household head as the most influential predictors of PNC non-utilization. Counterfactual analysis revealed that minimal, actionable changes including increased media exposure, improved educational attainment, or change of residence could shift individual predictions from non-utilization to utilization of PNC. Causal inference demonstrated significant heterogeneity in treatment responsiveness, with women aged 25-34, those with secondary education or above, urban residents, and those in female-headed households exhibiting the highest conditional average treatment effects. CONCLUSIONS: This interpretable, fairness-aware AI framework advances the prediction and analysis of PNC uptake in Ghana. By prioritizing sensitivity to underserved women and integrating explainability, counterfactual reasoning, and causal inference, the framework provides empirical evidence for targeted, equitable maternal health interventions and is transferable to other low- and middle-income country settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发并验证了一个面向加纳产后护理利用预测与分析的混合可解释人工智能框架，基于全国调查数据结合集成学习、SHAP、反事实推理与因果推断。结果显示，经阈值调整的集成模型在少数类识别上优于各基线分类器，母亲年龄、教育、财富、剖宫产和户主性别是未利用产后护理的主要预测因素；反事实分析表明增加媒体接触、提高教育或改变居住地等小幅可行动变化可将个体预测从未利用转为利用，因果推断则揭示治疗响应存在显著异质性，中年、较高教育、城市及女性户主家庭女性响应最高。作者据此认为该框架可为公平的孕产妇健康干预提供依据，并提示其可迁移至其他中低收入国家。

papers.title: Human-AI orchestration in project business an empirical study of AI adoption, competence recombination, and perceived role change among German project professionals
papers.authors: Reinhard Wagner, Domagoj Mihaljević
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is changing the division of work in project management, but task automation alone does not determine the future of project leadership. This article examines AI adoption, task-substitution assessments, and changing competence requirements among 300 experienced project professionals in Germany and interprets the resulting pattern through orchestration theory and dynamic-capability microfoundations. The survey, conducted from 14 April to 31 May 2026, indicates that respondents expect AI to substitute an increasing share of management tasks toward 2030 and 2035; the 2025 value is a retrospective benchmark and the future values are professional expectations rather than forecasts. Performance expectancy is the dominant predictor of intention to use more AI, while most respondents do not expect traditional project management competences simply to lose importance. The findings therefore point to competence recombination rather than straightforward professional replacement. Human-AI orchestration is proposed as a theory-informed role logic for coordinating human expertise, AI outputs, project data, governance, and stakeholders to create accountable project value. It remains a conceptual proposition that requires direct empirical validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对德国300名资深项目从业者的调查，考察其对人工智能替代管理任务的预期、使用意愿及能力需求变化，并借助编排理论与动态能力微观基础加以解释。结果显示，受访者预期到2030年和2035年AI将替代更多管理任务，但多数人并不认为传统项目管理能力会因此失去重要性；绩效期望是增加AI使用意愿的主要预测因素。作者据此提出“人机编排”这一角色逻辑，强调协调人类专长、AI输出、项目数据、治理与利益相关者以创造可问责的项目价值，同时指出该框架仍属概念性主张，尚需直接实证检验。

papers.title: Personality, cognition, and AI use profiles of college students
papers.authors: Miriam Liss, Leah Schweitzer

papers.title: A comparative study of Talkpal.AI-mediated and task-based instruction in relation to EFL students’ uncertainty-related speaking anxiety and metacognitive awareness in speaking: Insights from self-regulated learning theory
papers.authors: Shanshan Guan
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-mediated speaking applications increasingly extend English as a foreign language (EFL) oral practice beyond limited classroom time, yet evidence remains scarce on whether GPT-powered tools such as Talkpal.AI offer advantages over established instructional approaches. Grounded in self-regulated learning (SRL) theory, this quasi-experimental pretest–posttest study compared Talkpal.AI-mediated instruction, task-based instruction, and traditional instruction among 81 Chinese university EFL students in three intact classes: Talkpal.AI (n = 27), task-based (n = 26), and control (n = 28). Uncertainty-related speaking anxiety and metacognitive awareness in speaking were assessed using validated measures. Data were analyzed using MANCOVA with pretest scores as covariates, followed by univariate ANCOVAs and Bonferroni-adjusted pairwise comparisons. Results showed a significant overall group effect and significant between-group differences for both outcomes, with large effects. The Talkpal.AI group showed the most favorable adjusted posttest profile, followed by the task-based group; both groups showed more favorable outcomes than the control group. From an SRL perspective, structured AI-mediated speaking cycles involving goal setting, repeated practice, monitoring, and reflection may reduce speaking anxiety while strengthening metacognitive awareness. Pedagogically, guided Talkpal.AI rehearsal can be integrated as out-of-class preparation for classroom speaking tasks, supported by brief reflection activities that reinforce strategic regulation and reduce evaluative pressure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于自我调节学习理论，比较了Talkpal.AI辅助教学、任务型教学与传统教学对英语学习者口语焦虑和元认知意识的影响，采用准实验前后测设计，以中国大学生为对象。结果显示，三组在两项结果上均存在显著差异且效应量较大，Talkpal.AI组调整后的后测表现最佳，任务型组次之，二者均优于对照组。作者据此认为，包含目标设定、反复练习、监控与反思的结构化AI口语练习循环，可能有助于降低口语焦虑并增强元认知意识，并建议将引导式Talkpal.AI练习作为课堂口语任务的课外准备。

papers.title: Impact of guided AI Interaction on secondary students’ physics learning outcomes: evidence from a cluster-randomized longitudinal design and multilevel model
papers.authors: Raghad Shaher Alsarayreh, Thabet Bin Saeed Al-Kahlan
papers.abstract: This study aimed to examine the impact of AI-supported learning environments on secondary students’ physics learning outcomes by comparing a guided ChatGPT interaction design with open chatbot use. A facilitator-matched cluster-randomized longitudinal online trial was conducted among 604 Jordanian Grade 11 and Grade 12 students participating in a six-week Arabic-language physics learning program between February and April 2026. Participants were assigned to 24 supervised virtual cohorts, with 12 cohorts receiving a structured guided-prompting approach and 12 cohorts engaging in open ChatGPT use. Both conditions used the same ChatGPT model, learning materials, instructional tasks, session duration, and facilitator support. Because participants were nested within virtual cohorts and facilitator-matched pairs, multilevel mixed-effects models were applied to examine changes in conceptual understanding while accounting for baseline performance, cohort clustering, and facilitator effects. The analysis showed that guided AI-supported learning significantly improved immediate conceptual understanding compared with open chatbot use after controlling for baseline differences and design factors (adjusted difference = 3.07 points, 95% CI [1.43, 4.72], p = .002, Hedges’ g = 0.48). Guided interaction also produced stronger immediate transfer (adjusted difference = 2.54, p < .001, g = 0.53) and delayed retention (adjusted difference = 3.01, p = .001, g = 0.40). Transcript analyzes further indicated that guided learning environments promoted more evidence seeking, critical examination, verification, reflection, and revision, while reducing direct-answer seeking. These findings show that the educational value of generative AI depends not only on access to a capable system but also on the instructional structures that shape what learners do with its output. The results support designing AI-supported physics learning environments that preserve students’ cognitive responsibility and foster transferable learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察引导式AI交互设计相较于开放式聊天机器人使用，对中学生物理学习结果的影响，采用整群随机纵向在线试验，将学生分配到引导式提示与开放式ChatGPT使用两种条件，并用多层混合效应模型分析。结果显示，在控制基线表现、群组聚类和促进者效应后，引导式AI支持学习在即时概念理解、即时迁移和延迟保持上均优于开放式使用，且学习记录分析表明引导环境促使学生更多寻求证据、批判检视、验证、反思与修正，减少直接索取答案。作者据此指出，生成式AI的教育价值不仅取决于能否使用能力强的系统，也取决于塑造学生如何使用其输出的教学结构，并支持设计维护学生认知责任、促进可迁移学习的AI物理学习环境。

papers.title: Stacked ensemble learning-based approach for a coordinated optimal energy management framework in renewable energy assisted microgrid systems
papers.authors: Maneesh Kumar, Sachidananda Sen, Vedik Basetti, Arvind Kumar Prajapati, Pravin Kumar
papers.abstract: The paper proposes an optimal energy management framework for renewable energy–assisted microgrid (MG) systems using a machine-learning-based approach. Smart and intelligent real-time energy management techniques enable flexible and efficient utilization of distributed energy resources (DERs); however, accurate prediction of renewable generation and variable loads remains challenging. To address this issue, a stacked ensemble learning (SEL) model is developed to achieve more reliable and accurate renewable energy forecasting. One year of solar irradiance data collected for Roorkee, Uttarakhand, India (29.8543 o N , 77.8880 o E ) is used for model training and validation. The SEL framework integrates multiple individual learners, exploiting their complementary strengths and diverse data interpretations to enhance overall prediction accuracy. This improved forecasting capability supports coordinated operational optimization of both grid-connected and off-grid (isolated) renewable-assisted MG systems. The Performance evaluation demonstrates that the proposed SEL model outperforms conventional methods such as GBM, XRT, DRF, etc. The achieved RMSE, MSE, MAE, RMSLE, and mean residual deviance values are 0.4072, 0.1658, 0.1829, 0.0968, and 0.1658, respectively, representing the lowest errors among all compared models. Based on accurate forecasts, optimal day-ahead dispatch strategies are derived for grid-connected and off-grid MG configurations that satisfy operational constraints. The AutoML technique is employed to automate the application of the proposed algorithm, and its performance is compared with baseline models such as ARIMA and Prophet. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is validated using a hardware-in-loop (HIL) setup.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对可再生能源辅助微电网中发电与负荷预测不准的问题，提出一种基于堆叠集成学习的优化能量管理框架。作者用印度鲁尔基一年的太阳辐照度数据训练和验证模型，将多个基学习器组合以提升预测精度，并据此为并网与离网微电网制定日前优化调度策略。结果显示，该集成模型的预测误差低于GBM、XRT、DRF等常规方法，且通过AutoML实现流程自动化，并在硬件在环装置上验证了策略的有效性。文章表明，更准确的预测可支撑微电网的协调运行优化，但结论主要基于单一地点的数据与仿真验证。

papers.title: A liquid fiducial marker for image-guided proton beam therapy of abdominal tumors
papers.authors: Sarah Stefanowicz, Jonas R. Henriksen, Rasmus Jølck, Stefan Menkel, Michael W. Mortensen, Esther G.C. Troost
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: This study compared a liquid to solid fiducial markers regarding visibility, artifact characteristics on X-ray imaging and dose perturbation for image-guided proton therapy (IGPT) of abdominal tumors. Additionally, the radio-opaque composition of the liquid fiducial marker was optimized, and the chemical stability after proton beam irradiation was analyzed. MATERIAL AND METHODS: The fiducial markers inserted into an anthropomorphic abdominal phantom were exposed to X-ray, single-energy computed tomography (SECT), dual-energy CT (DECT) and cone-beam CT (CBCT) to determine contrast-to-noise ratios (CNR) and artifacts. Proton dose perturbation estimations were performed using a Monte Carlo dose algorithm. Chemical stability following proton beam irradiation was assessed with biophysical and optical methods. RESULTS: The CNR of the liquid marker with a volume ≥ 100 μl (CNR ≤ 2.69) on 2D X-ray images was superior to the solid markers (CNR ≤ 1.72). The artifact areas (A) and severity in the CT modalities were more pronounced for the solid (e.g. , SECT: ). Dose mitigation of ≥ 50% in a proton beam was calculated for solid fiducial markers, while the liquid marker less influenced the dose distribution. Increasing radio-opaque content in the liquid prototypes improved visibility (CNR ≤ 2.97) without significantly increasing artifact volume (SECT: A ≤ 40.5 mm3) or dose perturbation. No degradation of the liquid fiducial marker's chemical composition was observed. CONCLUSION: The liquid fiducial marker demonstrated comparable visibility and chemical stability with reduced artifact generation and dose perturbation compared to solid markers, indicating superiority for IGPT of abdominal tumors. Optimization of the liquid marker composition may be considered.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对腹部肿瘤图像引导质子治疗中的基准标记问题，在体模中比较了液体与固体标记在X射线、CT及锥形束CT下的可见度、伪影和质子剂量扰动，并优化了液体标记的显影成分、检测其辐照后的化学稳定性。结果显示，液体标记在二维X射线下的可见度优于固体标记，在CT中的伪影更小，对质子剂量分布的影响也更弱，而固体标记可造成明显的剂量衰减；提高液体原型中显影成分含量可改善可见度，且未显著增加伪影体积或剂量扰动，辐照后也未观察到化学成分降解。作者据此认为液体标记在保持可见度和化学稳定性的同时减少了伪影与剂量扰动，在腹部肿瘤图像引导质子治疗中具有优势，其成分优化值得进一步考虑。

papers.title: Beyond proximity: Green space visitation patterns and physical health outcomes
papers.authors: Aikaterini Lilli, Fani Konstantinou, Elisavet Tsekeri, Tryfon Daras, Dionysia Denia Kolokotsa
papers.abstract: Urban green spaces (GS) are increasingly recognized for mitigating health risks linked to urbanization, yet most research emphasizes proximity rather than actual use in Mediterranean cities. This study examines how GS visitation patterns, demographic characteristics, and physical health outcomes interact in Chania, Crete, addressing gaps in GS exposure and chronic disease prevention. A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 718 adult residents between June and August 2024. Data included demographics, GS use, physical activity, and self-reported health indicators, including BMI, coronary artery disease (CAD), hypertension, and hypercholesterolemia. Chi-square tests and logistic regression models were applied. Demographics were significantly associated with GS engagement and health. Men more often visited forests and had higher odds of chronic conditions (e.g., OR = 3.194 for CAD, p = 0.004), while older adults visited GS more frequently. Limited GS accessibility (>20-minute walk) was associated with higher odds of hypertension (OR = 1.603, p = 0.024). Garden visits were associated with more frequent GS use (OR = 3.133, p = 0.017), and longer visits (>1 h) were associated with lower odds of CAD, hypercholesterolemia, hypertension and longer physical activity duration. These findings highlight the importance of actual GS engagement alongside availability and support equitable, quality-focused GS planning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注地中海城市中绿地实际使用而非单纯邻近性如何与居民身体健康状况相关，以希腊哈尼亚成年居民为对象开展横断面问卷调查，并结合人口学特征、绿地使用情况、体力活动与自报健康指标进行分析。结果显示，人口学特征与绿地使用和健康状况存在关联，男性更常到访森林且慢性病风险更高，而较长的绿地停留时间与较低的心血管疾病、高胆固醇和高血压风险相关，绿地可达性受限则与高血压风险升高相关。研究据此强调，绿地规划除关注供给与可达性外，还应重视实际使用和公平可及。需要说明的是，这些结果来自横断面关联分析，不能直接解释为因果效应。

papers.title: Fusion of EEG signals with adaptive encoder network-based attention deep learning for real-time driver drowsiness detection
papers.authors: Zhenwei You, Jafar Ahmad Abed Alzubi, Srinivas Vadali, Ahmad Fallatah, Shabana Urooj, Rajesh Arunachalam

papers.title: Factors influencing artificial intelligence (AI) use in learning and research among university students in Vietnam
papers.authors: Nguyen Thi Bach Tuyet, Thi Trang Dao, Dinh Anh Truong, Dieu Thuy Hoang, Cong Dung Bui, Minh Duc Ngo, Dai Quang Dinh, Quang Yen Tran, Tran Duc Thang, Duc Tam Duong, Dinh Giau Le, Thanh Ha Vi, Dinh Duc Truong
papers.abstract: In the context of digital transformation reshaping the higher education ecosystem, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into learning and research activities has emerged as a key driver for enhancing academic effectiveness. Although AI tools are increasingly used to support students’ academic tasks, there remains limited understanding of the factors that shape university students’ satisfaction and AI usage behavior, particularly in the Vietnamese higher education context. To address this research gap, this study investigates the factors influencing university students’ AI adoption in learning and research by integrating technology readiness characteristics with perceptions of usefulness, ease of use, enjoyment, innovation, and satisfaction through an online survey of 1,203 students enrolled across multiple universities in Vietnam. Data were collected through a questionnaire employing a five-point Likert scale, and the proposed hypotheses were examined using the PLS-SEM approach implemented in SmartPLS 4.0. The results indicate that technology optimism, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, technology innovation, and perceived enjoyment all exert significant positive effects on students’ satisfaction and AI usage behavior. Specifically, technology optimism and technology innovativeness positively influence students’ perceptions of AI usefulness and ease of use, while technology discomfort and technology insecurity also show positive effects, suggesting that students’ concerns may encourage more careful and purposeful AI use. These findings contribute to the expansion of the technology motivation framework in the emerging higher education context by showing that students’ AI adoption is shaped not only by positive technology readiness characteristics but also by their responses to concerns associated with AI use. The study also provide practical implications for institutions in policy planning, digital platform implementation, and optimizing AI-enhanced learning environments. In particular, higher education institutions should provide AI training, ethical guidelines, and support mechanisms to enhance students’ confidence, responsible AI use, and satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注越南高校学生在学习和科研中使用人工智能的影响因素，基于技术准备度与感知有用性、易用性、愉悦感、创新性和满意度构建模型，并通过问卷对多所大学的学生进行调查，采用PLS-SEM检验假设。结果显示，技术乐观、感知有用性、感知易用性、技术创新和感知愉悦均对学生的满意度与AI使用行为有显著正向作用；技术乐观和创新性还提升学生对AI有用性和易用性的感知。值得注意的是，技术不适与技术不安全感也呈现正向效应，作者据此推测学生的担忧可能促使其更谨慎、更有目的地使用AI。研究提示，高校在推动AI融入学习环境时，除强化积极的技术准备特征外，也应关注学生对风险的回应，并通过培训、伦理规范和支持机制提升其负责任使用的能力与满意度。

papers.title: Mapping research trends in artificial intelligence for K–12 teaching and learning: a scientometric analysis
papers.authors: Diana Teresa Parra Sánchez, José Joaquín Uribe-Arengas
papers.abstract: This study examines the evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) research in K–12 teaching and learning by identifying major research trends, thematic structures, and emerging scholarly directions. A scientometric analysis was conducted using a validated corpus of 1,154 Scopus-indexed documents published between 2016 and May 2026. To strengthen corpus reliability, the dataset underwent content-level validation through abstract screening, duplicate detection, and thematic relevance assessment focused on K–12 educational contexts. Co-citation analysis, clustering algorithms, and citation burst detection were performed using CiteSpace to identify influential publications, thematic clusters, and temporal patterns of scholarly influence. The findings reveal rapid growth in academic production after 2020, particularly following the emergence of generative AI technologies. Four major research clusters were identified: (1) artificial intelligence literacy, focused on competency-based AI education and ethical awareness; (2) large language models (LLMs), centred on generative AI, conversational systems, and AI-mediated assessment; (3) early childhood education, emphasising developmentally appropriate AI learning experiences and playful pedagogies; and (4) K–12 context, addressing broader educational, ethical, and societal implications of AI integration in schools. Citation burst analysis revealed a progression from foundational AI literacy frameworks and constructionist machine learning pedagogies toward curriculum co-design, teacher readiness, and human-centred AI integration. Overall, the findings indicate that AI research in K–12 education is evolving toward more pedagogically grounded, ethically informed, and student-centred educational models while simultaneously highlighting challenges related to teacher readiness, curriculum adaptation, and equitable AI integration in school contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以文献计量方法考察了2016年至2026年间K–12人工智能教育研究的发展脉络，基于经内容校验的文献语料，通过共被引分析、聚类和引文突现检测识别研究趋势与主题结构。结果显示，2020年后相关学术产出快速增长，尤其伴随生成式人工智能的出现；研究形成人工智能素养、大语言模型、幼儿教育和K–12情境四个主要集群，引文突现则呈现从基础素养框架与建构主义机器学习教学转向课程协同设计、教师准备度和以人为本的AI整合。作者据此认为，该领域正走向更具教学依据、伦理意识和学生中心的教育模式，同时教师准备度、课程适应与公平整合仍是待解难题。

papers.title: A diagnostic human agency framework for AI driven education from a PRISMA guided systematic review
papers.authors: Kandarp Acharya, Mili Gondaliya
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming education and workforce development, yet the dominant discourse prioritises technical efficiency over the qualitative dimensions of human agency—autonomy, dignity, and the capacity to shape one’s learning and career trajectories. This article proposes the Human Agency Framework (HAF), a conceptual framework intended to support the evaluation of AI-driven educational initiatives through the lens of agency. Grounded in a systematic literature review (35 sources) and a novel “diagnostic design synthesis” methodology that integrates academic evidence with practitioner insights, the HAF operationalises agency across four interconnected dimensions: purpose (what valued capabilities learners gain), control (who directs learning pathways and data), collaboration (how human‑AI teams function), and conditions (the structural and policy enablers). The framework offers a potential lens for identifying tensions between efficiency claims and genuine empowerment, providing tentative guidance for educators, industry leaders, and policymakers. Two illustrative case studies—a UNESCO‑Huawei capacity‑building project and a global EdTech career guidance platform—illustrate how the HAF may be applied to examine potential strengths and weaknesses. By shifting the focus from what AI can do to what learners and workers can do and be with AI, The framework is conceptually aligned with the objectives of SDG 4 (Quality Education) and SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth). We conclude with a research agenda for empirical validation and cultural adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对AI驱动教育中效率话语压过人的能动性的问题，提出一个“人类能动性框架”（HAF），其依据是PRISMA导向的系统综述（35项来源）与一种名为“诊断性设计综合”的方法，将学术证据与从业者见解结合。框架从目的、控制、协作与条件四个相互关联的维度操作化能动性，并借助两个案例说明如何用它审视AI教育举措的潜在优劣。文章属于概念性框架研究，未开展实证检验，作者仅将其定位为识别效率主张与真正赋权之间张力的可能视角，并给出面向教育者、产业与政策制定者的初步指引，最后提出实证验证与文化适配的研究议程。

papers.title: Data science for K-12: A design-based research study
papers.authors: Andrew A. Tawfik, Luiz Barboza, Andrew McGregor Olney, Yeonji Jung
papers.abstract: Abstract Data science is a field that merges advancements in computer science, statistics, and machine learning. To date, much data science instruction has been through graduate programs or self-directed course offerings. There are therefore fewer opportunities for formal data science education, especially for K-12 educators and learners who have limited exposure to these fields. While some efforts have emerged to introduce data science in pre-college settings, there is little research regarding learning design strategies that support data science for inservice teachers. As such, this project employs a design-based research (DBR) approach to develop accessible and engaging open-access learning resources as a way to reduce barriers to data science instruction across the educational spectrum. Given the gap regarding data science in K-12, our DBR study identifies the following design elements: (a) revised data science content scope, (b) design standardization for interactive learning, (c) reframing data science for case-based learning, (d) artificial intelligence (AI) towards data personalization, and (e) data science coding through goal-based learning. The project also introduces aspects of the curriculum via a teacher professional development, which provides important insights and challenges regarding data science at the middle and high school levels. Implications for learning design, open-educational resources, data science standards, and others are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对K-12阶段数据科学教育机会有限、尤其缺乏支持在职教师的教学设计策略这一问题，采用基于设计的研究方法开发开放获取的学习资源。研究识别出修订的数据科学内容范围、交互式学习的设计标准化、以案例为基础重构数据科学、面向数据个性化的AI应用，以及通过目标导向学习开展数据科学编程等设计要素，并通过教师专业发展活动引入课程，揭示了中学阶段数据科学教学的重要见解与挑战。文章据此讨论了学习设计、开放教育资源与数据科学标准等方面的启示。

papers.title: From architecture to action: developing and validating the shared student success model (SSSM) for higher education institutions
papers.authors: Apoorva Bhan, Sarabjeet Singh, Ankur Kumar Gupta

papers.title: Explaining teacher adoption of AI through the technology acceptance model: a meta-analysis and systematic review
papers.authors: Prashanth Shenoy, Mirka Saarela
papers.abstract: Abstract The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education has accelerated rapidly, yet the factors shaping teachers’ adoption of these technologies remain insufficiently understood. A growing body of empirical research applies the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to examine how teachers integrate AI, focusing on perceived usefulness (PU), perceived ease of use (PEOU), and behavioral intention (BI). TAM was, however, originally developed for static, deterministic technologies, and AI differs in its opacity, adaptivity, and capacity to challenge professional roles and identity, raising the question of whether perceived usefulness and ease of use alone are sufficient to predict adoption intentions in this context. Following PRISMA guidelines, this study conducts a systematic review of 38 empirical studies ( $$N = 15{,}919$$ teachers across 19 countries) on teachers’ AI adoption, together with a meta-analysis of the subset reporting extractable bivariate correlations. A random-effects model (DerSimonian–Laird) is used to estimate the associations among PEOU, PU, and BI across $$k = 24$$ studies ( $$N = 11{,}768$$ ), while the full corpus is synthesised to identify contextual conditions shaping these relationships. Pooled correlations are positive and moderate to strong (PEOU–PU: $$r = 0.532$$ , 95% CI [0.410, 0.636]; PEOU–BI: $$r = 0.536$$ , 95% CI [0.435, 0.623]; PU–BI: $$r = 0.619$$ , 95% CI [0.511, 0.708]), and are robust to alternative variance estimators and to the inclusion of UTAUT studies under a construct-equivalence ruling. Heterogeneity is very high ( $$I^2 = 97.9\%$$ – $$98.6\%$$ ) and prediction intervals span from negative to near-unity values, indicating that these associations hold directionally but vary considerably across contexts in ways the core model does not represent. Egger’s regression indicates funnel asymmetry on all three associations; leave-one-out diagnostics attribute this asymmetry entirely to a single large-sample, low-effect study, and the asymmetry is not interpretable as evidence of publication bias under heterogeneity of this magnitude. The qualitative synthesis identifies five dimensions associated with variation in these relationships: AI literacy and trust as preconditions for usefulness judgments; a shift from functional to identity-based acceptance shaped by pedagogical beliefs and institutional norms; the role of sociocultural and institutional context; tool-specific adoption logics; and ethical risk calibration as a values-based gate on adoption decisions. These findings suggest that predicting teacher AI adoption intentions may require variables beyond the TAM core, and motivate the development of extended frameworks designed for the sociotechnical complexity of AI in education.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述与元分析考察技术接受模型（TAM）能否解释教师对人工智能的采纳，系统梳理了38项实证研究，并对其中报告可提取相关系数的子集进行随机效应元分析。结果显示，感知易用性、感知有用性与行为意向之间的合并相关为正且中等偏强，但异质性极高，预测区间从负值延伸到接近完全相关，说明这些关联在方向上成立，却会随情境大幅变化。定性综合进一步指出，AI素养与信任、身份层面的接受、社会文化与制度情境、工具特定逻辑以及伦理风险校准，都可能超出TAM核心变量的解释范围。作者据此认为，预测教师的AI采纳意向可能需要引入TAM之外的变量，并发展面向教育AI社会技术复杂性的扩展框架。

papers.title: Toward unified intelligence in renewable-dominant power systems: a survey of hybrid forecasting, explainable AI, and multi-agent optimization
papers.authors: Tariq Ali, Muzna Sarwar, Husam S. Samkari, Farrukh Jamal, Mohammad Hijji, Muhammad Ayaz, Mohammed F. Allehyani, Muhammad Irfan, El-Hadi M. Aggoune
papers.abstract: The transition toward renewable-dominant power systems has introduced significant operational challenges due to increased uncertainty, reduced system inertia, and the proliferation of distributed energy resources. While artificial intelligence (AI) techniques have been widely adopted for renewable energy forecasting and grid optimization, existing studies primarily address these components in isolation, leading to fragmented system-level intelligence. This paper presents a comprehensive survey that systematically integrates three critical dimensions of modern intelligent energy systems: hybrid forecasting, explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), and multi-agent optimization. First, we review advanced hybrid learning architectures, including decomposition-based models, ensemble frameworks, and deep learning-metaheuristic hybrids, highlighting their effectiveness in capturing nonlinear and stochastic renewable dynamics. Second, we examine XAI techniques that enhance transparency, interpretability, and trust in AI-driven energy systems. Third, we analyze the evolution from centralized optimization to distributed collective intelligence using multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), swarm intelligence, and federated learning paradigms. Unlike conventional surveys, this work provides a unified system-level perspective by explicitly linking predictive uncertainty with decentralized decision-making and explainability mechanisms. A conceptual integration framework is presented to demonstrate how probabilistic forecasting, risk-aware MARL policies, and interpretable models can jointly enable robust and scalable grid operation. Furthermore, we identify key research challenges related to scalability, computational efficiency, uncertainty propagation, and real-time deployment. This survey offers a structured reference for researchers and practitioners and outlines future directions toward trustworthy, adaptive, and cooperative AI-driven energy systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述针对可再生能源主导电力系统中不确定性上升、系统惯量下降和分布式资源增多带来的运行挑战，指出既有研究多将预测、优化与可解释性分开处理，导致系统级智能碎片化。文章系统梳理了混合预测架构、可解释人工智能与多智能体优化三条技术路线，并强调将预测不确定性、去中心化决策与可解释机制显式关联，提出一个概念性集成框架，说明概率预测、风险感知的多智能体强化学习策略与可解释模型如何协同支撑稳健且可扩展的电网运行。综述还讨论了可扩展性、计算效率、不确定性传播和实时部署等挑战，为可信、自适应且协作的AI驱动能源系统提供参考。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence‐Mediated Eco‐Design and Environmental Strategy: Human Decision Authority, Sustainability Disclosure, and Lifecycle Accountability
papers.authors: Nicholas G. Paparoidamis, Ken Robinson
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to generate, simulate, and optimize sustainable product designs. This development creates an environmental strategy problem that existing greenwashing, decoupling, and eco‐innovation theories do not fully explain: an environmentally favorable outcome may be technically real yet difficult for stakeholders to attribute to accountable organizational environmental judgment. This conceptual article develops eco‐algorithmic decoupling as a process attribution gap that may arise, especially for stakeholders who value traceable human environmental judgment, when meaningful human eco‐design decision authority is weak or when disclosures misrepresent the human‐AI division of decision‐making. It distinguishes this process attribution problem from lifecycle incompleteness, a separate accounting problem concerning whether material AI process impacts fall within product claim boundaries and are accounted for or disclosed. The article advances a two‐path credibility model: human decision authority affects perceived moral eco‐integrity and then claim credibility, while lifecycle completeness affects perceived claim completeness and then claim credibility. Disclosure congruence, stakeholder characteristics, and verified environmental performance moderate these paths. The paper contributes to environmental strategy by specifying how AI changes the governance conditions under which eco‐innovation is perceived as credible, accountable, and strategically valuable. It offers propositions, a governance typology, provisional PMEI items, coding rules, and an empirical research agenda for testing AI‐mediated eco‐design credibility.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，针对AI生成、模拟和优化可持续产品设计时出现的环境战略问题，提出“生态算法脱钩”概念，用以描述一种过程归因缺口：当人类在生态设计中的实质决策权较弱，或披露信息歪曲了人机决策分工时，重视可追溯人类环境判断的利益相关者便难以将有利的环境结果归因于可问责的组织判断。文章将此与生命周期不完整性这一独立的核算问题区分开，并提出双路径可信度模型：人类决策权经由感知道德生态诚信影响声明可信度，生命周期完整性经由感知声明完整性影响声明可信度，披露一致性、利益相关者特征和经核实的环境绩效起调节作用。文章据此给出命题、治理类型学、初步测量条目、编码规则和实证研究议程，属于理论建构而非实证检验。

papers.title: Associations Between Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease and Sleep in Cognitively Unimpaired Older Adults
papers.authors: Cornelia Sauter, Hans Dorn, Julian Hellmann‐Regen, Ana Bueno‐Lopez, Verena van Ginneken, Heidi Danker‐Hopfe
papers.journal: Annals of Clinical and Translational Neurology
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Sleep disturbances have been implicated as a risk factor for developing Alzheimer's disease (AD), but evidence linking plasma AD biomarkers to sleep in cognitively unimpaired individuals remains limited. The present study examined associations between evening, morning, and overnight changes in plasma AD biomarkers and measures of sleep macro- and microstructure and subjective sleep quality in older adults. METHODS: Forty cognitively unimpaired adults aged 55 to 75 years (20 females) without sleep or mental disorders underwent overnight polysomnography. Plasma AD biomarkers p-tau181, p-tau217, t-tau, Aβ42, Aβ40, and Aβ42/40 were assessed in the evening and in the morning and related to sleep macro- and microstructure (sleep spindles, EEG spectral power), and subjective sleep measures by using correlational analyzes. RESULTS: Higher evening t-tau and p-tau181 were associated with reduced N3 sleep, whereas higher morning t-tau and greater overnight increases in t-tau were related to longer nocturnal wakefulness. Amyloid-β measures showed the most consistent associations with sleep microstructure. Higher Aβ42 and Aβ40 concentrations were associated with shorter duration and lower density of sleep spindles, particularly at frontal sites. Higher evening and morning amyloid-β concentrations were also associated with lower alpha, beta, and spindle-frequency EEG power, mainly during non-rapid eye movement sleep. Tau associations with EEG spectral power were less consistent. INTERPRETATION: In cognitively unimpaired older adults, plasma AD biomarkers were associated with PSG sleep features, especially amyloid-β markers with sleep microstructure. These exploratory, correlational findings suggest that sleep spindles and spectral power may reflect early AD-related biological processes but require replication in larger cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察认知功能未受损的老年人血浆阿尔茨海默病生物标志物与睡眠宏观、微观结构及主观睡眠质量之间的关联，对参与者进行整夜多导睡眠监测，并检测晚间与晨间的血浆标志物。结果显示，较高的晚间t-tau和p-tau181与N3期睡眠减少相关，晨间t-tau较高及夜间t-tau增幅较大与夜间清醒时间更长相关；淀粉样蛋白指标与睡眠微观结构的关联最为一致，较高的Aβ42和Aβ40浓度与睡眠纺锤波时长更短、密度更低相关，尤其在额区，且与NREM睡眠中较低的alpha、beta及纺锤波频段脑电功率相关。作者指出这些探索性相关结果提示睡眠纺锤波和脑电功率可能反映早期AD相关生物学过程，但尚需在更大队列中重复验证。

papers.title: ROECSG report: Real‐world implementation patterns and perceptions of artificial intelligence in radiation oncology
papers.authors: James J. Sohn, Cory S. Knill, Elizabeth L. Bossart, Samuel Chen, Rohan Patel, Kevin Du, Leah Katz
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Clinical Medical Physics
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: While international surveys have examined radiation oncology professionals' attitudes toward artificial intelligence (AI) and documented generally low early utilization, actual implementation patterns and the depth of integration among engaged practitioners remain unclear. This multi-institutional survey aims to characterize current AI implementation, identify critical barriers to optimization, and evaluate the psychological factors driving clinical trust. METHODS AND MATERIALS: A de-identified survey covering six domains was developed by a multi-institutional working group and distributed via a widely subscribed medical physics listserv and at the 2025 American Association of Physicists in Medicine (AAPM) Annual Meeting. The instrument assessed adoption rates, specific workflow applications, and user perceptions (trust and understanding) using 6-point Likert scales to reduce central tendency bias. Quantitative data were analyzed using Pearson correlation coefficients and Welch's two-sample t-tests, while qualitative responses underwent inductive thematic analysis (κ = 0.78). RESULTS: In this convenience sample of 80 respondents (46.3% radiation oncologists, 37.5% medical physicists), 85.0% (68/80) reported current AI use. Adoption is heavily concentrated in auto-contouring (88.2% of AI users), whereas diagnosis/prognostication (14.7%) and treatment planning (23.5%) remain limited. Most users (60.3%) employ AI for task automation without influencing clinical judgment. Trust in AI (3.55 ± 1.02) correlates positively with perceived time savings (r = 0.57), clarity of use (r = 0.54), and technical understanding (r = 0.51, all p < 0.001), with no significant difference among these correlations (Williams test, both p > 0.59). Notably, self-rated understanding averaged near the scale midpoint (3.44 ± 1.22), yet 88.8% welcomed greater AI integration. Qualitative analysis identified transparency (38%) and validation protocols (31%) as the primary barriers to deeper implementation. CONCLUSIONS: AI use was common within this sample (85.0%), although self-selection likely inflates this figure relative to the broader field. However, implementation remains "broad but shallow," focused on workflow automation rather than clinical intelligence. The gap between enthusiasm and understanding necessitates a shift toward active institutional governance and standardized AI-literacy education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过多机构便利样本调查，考察放射肿瘤学从业者中人工智能的实际实施模式与信任感知。结果显示，尽管85.0%的受访者报告使用AI，但应用集中于自动勾画等任务自动化，诊断与治疗计划等临床判断环节有限，呈现“广而浅”的特征；对AI的信任与感知节省时间、使用清晰度和技术理解呈正相关，而自评理解仅处于量表中点，透明度和验证流程被视为深化应用的主要障碍。作者据此指出热情与理解之间的落差，强调机构治理与标准化AI素养教育的必要性，同时提示便利样本可能高估实际使用率。

papers.title: Obesity in Children Aged 2 to 12 Years
papers.authors: Claudia K. Fox, Sarah Armstrong, Aaron S. Kelly
papers.abstract: Importance: Obesity affects 15% of children aged 2 to 5 years and 22% of children aged 6 to 11 years in the US. Obesity in children is associated with dyslipidemia, hypertension, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, and obstructive sleep apnea. Compared with normal-weight peers, children with obesity have lower quality of life and are 5 times more likely to have obesity in adulthood. Observations: Body mass index (BMI; calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) is used to identify children at risk for excess adiposity, and guidelines recommend that clinicians screen for obesity using BMI starting at age 2 years. Among children, obesity is defined using standardized age- and sex-specific growth charts, with obesity defined as BMI in the 95th or higher percentile and severe obesity as BMI of 120% or greater of the 95th percentile. Obesity treatment in children includes intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment, consisting of at least 26 contact hours of face-to-face group or family-based activities that incorporate nutrition, physical activity, and behavior change education delivered to the child and caregivers over a 3- to 12-month period. Intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment reduces BMI by 0.7 compared with children who do not participate in intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment. The only obesity pharmacotherapy currently approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for children younger than 12 years is setmelanotide, a melanocortin-4 receptor agonist, which is indicated for 3 forms of rare monogenic obesity (LEPR, POMC, and PCSK1 genetic variants), Bardet-Biedl syndrome, and acquired hypothalamic obesity. Liraglutide is currently only FDA approved for youth aged 12 years or older; however, a randomized clinical trial among children aged 6 to younger than 12 years demonstrated that, compared with placebo, liraglutide reduced BMI by 7.4%. Metabolic and bariatric surgery is rarely used in children younger than age 12 years and evidence supporting its use in children is limited. Early identification and treatment of obesity during childhood may reduce risk of type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and mortality in adulthood. Conclusions and Relevance: Obesity in children is associated with chronic disease, such as hypertension, and with poor quality of life. Evidence-based treatment for obesity in children includes intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment, and pharmacotherapy may provide additional benefit, although short- and long-term safety and efficacy data are limited. Early identification and treatment of obesity during childhood may reduce risk of type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and mortality in adulthood.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕2至12岁儿童肥胖的识别与治疗展开综述，指出肥胖在该年龄段已相当普遍，并与血脂异常、高血压、脂肪性肝病和阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停等慢性病相关，患儿生活质量较低且成年后肥胖风险更高。文章梳理了以年龄和性别特异性生长曲线上的BMI百分位界定肥胖与重度肥胖的筛查做法，并说明强化健康行为与生活方式治疗可小幅降低BMI，而药物和代谢手术在该年龄段适用有限、证据不足。作者据此强调儿童期早期识别和治疗可能降低成年期2型糖尿病、血脂异常、高血压及死亡风险。

papers.title: Can AI interview? Comparing AI-led to Human-led Chat Interviews
papers.authors: Andreas Bjerre-Nielsen, Tobias Priesholm Gårdhus, Hjalmar Bang Carlsen, Anna Rogers, Semra Guven
papers.abstract: Large language model chatbots have been proposed as AI-interviewers for collecting qualitative interview data at scale, potentially bridging social science's longstanding divide between the breadth of surveys and the depth of qualitative interviews. This paper provides the first direct empirical comparison of data quality in AI-led and human-led interviews. In a randomized experiment (N = 41), university students were interviewed via synchronous text chat by either trained non-expert interviewers or a locally hosted AI system; we evaluate exposure, specificity, and relevance. Median interview duration was similar across conditions, but AI-interviewers asked more than twice as many questions per interview and elicited roughly 65 percent more respondent text per interview. Per-question responses were longer with human interviewers, though not after multiple-testing correction; only AI-condition participants skipped questions. Responses were almost uniformly on-topic in both conditions; for specificity we detect no difference, but the design cannot exclude one of up to three quarters of a point. These results were obtained with a small, locally hosted open-weight model (7B parameters), which addresses concerns about data security, GDPR compliance, and scientific reproducibility. Our findings support the viability of AI-interviewing for large-N qualitative data collection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过随机实验，让大学生分别接受经过训练的非专家访谈者或本地部署的大语言模型聊天机器人的同步文本访谈，直接比较AI主导与人类主导访谈的数据质量。结果显示，AI访谈者提问数量是人工的两倍多，获得的受访者文本总量约多65%，但人工访谈中单个问题的回答更长；两种条件下回答几乎都切题，特异性未检出差异，不过设计无法排除最高约四分之三分的差异，且只有AI组参与者跳过问题。作者据此认为，基于小型本地开源模型的AI访谈在大规模定性数据收集中具有可行性，同时提示结论受模型规模与实验设计限制。

papers.title: AI-driven instructional design in art education
papers.authors: Rong Xu, Othman Bin Talib
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is being increasingly integrated into higher education, yet its application in art and design education remains fragmented. Existing studies differ in instructional approaches and outcome measures, making it difficult to develop a comprehensive understanding of how AI-driven instructional design influences student engagement and creativity. This literature review highlights what existing works say about applying AI within instructional design for art and design education, with particular attention given to learner engagement and creativity. The review also considers how different forms of AI-supported instruction are incorporated into creative learning environments and identifies the pedagogical and ethical issues associated with their use. Following the PRISMA guidelines, 21 publications published between 2020 and 2026 were selected and analyzed. The included studies were examined in terms of their research settings, study designs, instructional characteristics, AI technologies, outcome measures, major findings, and reported limitations. The results show that AI tools have become an important part of art and design education. Generative AI, interactive technologies, and feedback-based applications are the most commonly used tools. These tools support idea generation, design exploration, interactive learning, immediate feedback, and personalized assistance. They also prompt learners to participate more actively as they study. Across the reviewed literature, AI-supported learning also appears to encourage iterative experimentation, reflective learning, and greater opportunities for students to explore alternative creative ideas. However, the educational value of these technologies depends substantially on how they are integrated into instructional practice rather than on the technologies themselves. Nonetheless, the reviewed research has several notable drawbacks—diverse methods, insufficient sample sizes, and an exploratory nature. The measures of creativity and engagement vary among the studies, making it impossible to compare results. There are ethical issues as well, such as the questions of originality and authorship, bias, and the dependency of students on machine-generated content. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of human-centered instructional design that positions AI as a support for, rather than a replacement for, human creativity and artistic judgment.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA指南，梳理了2020至2026年间21篇关于人工智能在艺术与设计教育教学设计中应用的文献，重点关注学习者参与度和创造力。综述发现，生成式人工智能、交互技术和反馈类应用是较常用的工具，被用于支持构思、设计探索、互动学习、即时反馈和个性化辅助，并可能促进迭代尝试、反思性学习以及探索多种创意方案；但这类技术的教育价值很大程度上取决于其如何融入教学实践，而非技术本身。作者同时指出，纳入研究在方法、样本和创造力与参与度的测量上差异较大，结果难以比较，且存在原创性与署名、偏见以及学生对机器生成内容依赖等伦理问题，据此强调应以人为中心进行教学设计，将人工智能定位为对人类创造力和艺术判断的支持而非替代。

papers.title: LLM agents in online communities draw fewer replies and more disagreement when labeled as AI
papers.authors: Boris Stupovski, Aleksandar Tomašević, D. Vudragović, Ana Vranić, Darja Cvetković, Sara Major, Marija Mitrovic Dankulov
papers.abstract: Autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) accounts now post, reply, and vote alongside people in online communities. Visible identity labels may act as cultural markers that set these accounts apart from human participants. In a field experiment on YSocial, a Reddit-like platform, 36 students at a Serbian university discussed globally circulated popular culture in English alongside 72 AI accounts with persistent personas and relationship-specific memories over 21 experiment days. AI accounts were labeled in one community and unlabeled in the other. Among 2,143 human replies, the estimated probability of replying to an AI-authored post or comment was 3.5 percentage points higher under hidden labels, given the same eligible earlier thread contributions (95% credible interval 0.5–6.5). In browser telemetry, the disadvantage of AI-authored posts in direct thread entry from the feed was 4.4 percentage points smaller under hidden labels (95% credible interval 0.8–8.1). In both communities, participants were more likely to answer an AI account that had just replied to them. The gap in criticism, including polite disagreement, between replies to AI and human accounts was 13.3 percentage points larger in the visible-label community (95% credible interval 5.1–21.4), mainly criticism of content; the corresponding gap in downvotes from other participants was also larger there, and nearly all references to AI identity occurred there. Toxicity differences were uncertain. Visible labels were associated with less selection and more criticism of AI contributions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在线社区中AI账号的身份标签如何影响人类用户的回应行为，采用在类Reddit平台YSocial上开展田野实验的方法，让人类参与者与具有持久人设和关系记忆的AI账号共同讨论流行文化。结果显示，在隐藏标签条件下，人类回复AI所发帖文或评论的概率更高，从信息流直接进入AI帖文的比例也更高；而可见标签社区中，对AI内容的批评（含礼貌性分歧）与点踩差距明显更大，几乎全部提及AI身份的言论也出现在该社区。作者据此指出，可见标签与对AI贡献更少的选择和更多批评相关，毒性差异则不确定。

papers.title: AI Companionship and Loneliness in Autistic and Neurotypical Users
papers.authors: Gary McKeown, Anna Hollis
papers.abstract: Materials, de-identified data, and analysis code associated with the manuscript "AI Companionship and Loneliness in Autistic and Neurotypical Users: Trust, Substitution, and the Social Role of Chatbots."
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症与非自闭症用户在使用AI聊天机器人作为陪伴时，孤独感与信任、替代性及聊天机器人社会角色之间的关系。摘要仅说明这是与论文配套的材料、去标识数据和代码，未给出研究对象、方法或结果，因此无法概述主要发现及其含义。

papers.title: Assessing artificial intelligence literacy in higher education: A systematic review of measurement tools, current trends and future directions
papers.authors: Ying Fan, Yan Piaw Chua
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognised as a core capability in higher education, but its assessment remains fragmented across generic, generative-AI and discipline-specific instruments. Differences in construct definitions, response formats and intended uses make it difficult to compare students’ and educators’ literacy or to identify instruments that are fit for educational decisions. This systematic review examines available tools, current empirical patterns and future directions for assessment. Following PRISMA-informed procedures, searches of Scopus, Web of Science and ERIC yielded 852 records, of which 679 remained after deduplication. The review synthesises 39 primary studies: 16 tool-development, validation or adaptation studies and 23 studies of status, correlates or educational interventions. Data extraction covered target constructs, assessment formats, samples, reported measurement evidence and principal findings; methodological quality was appraised using an adapted Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool framework. Most instruments assess understanding, application or use, evaluation and ethics; newer generative-AI and discipline-specific measures also address prompting, autonomous learning, pedagogical integration, critical writing and self-regulation. Evidence for factor structure and internal consistency is common, whereas evidence for content validity, test–retest reliability, responsiveness and cross-cultural comparability is less developed. Across the reviewed studies, profiles varied by discipline, study stage and learner group, with recurring weaknesses in technical understanding and socio-critical judgement. Course interventions yielded promising learning signals, but the available evidence was largely derived from small, uncontrolled pre–post studies. Heterogeneity in constructs, samples and outcomes precluded meta-analysis, and most empirical studies provided moderate rather than high-quality evidence. Taken together, these findings indicate that universities should move beyond self-reported confidence and frequency of use. Assessment should combine self-report with performance-based, context-sensitive and equity-aware approaches to support meaningful capability development.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了高等教育中人工智能素养测评工具的研究现状，基于PRISMA流程从三个数据库筛选出39项原始研究，涵盖工具开发验证与现状、相关因素及教学干预两类研究。综述发现，多数工具侧重理解、应用、评估与伦理维度，新兴的生成式AI与学科专用工具还涉及提示词使用、自主学习与批判性写作等能力；因子结构与内部一致性证据较常见，而内容效度、重测信度、反应性与跨文化可比性证据相对薄弱。学生素养表现因学科、学习阶段和群体而异，技术理解与社会批判判断是反复出现的短板；课程干预虽显示积极学习信号，但多来自小型、非对照的前后测研究，证据质量多为中等。作者据此建议高校超越自评信心与使用频率，将自评与基于表现、情境敏感且关注公平的测评方式结合。

papers.title: Mapping chemical reasoning in chemistry education: A bibliometric-systematic literature review of research trends and conceptualizations
papers.authors: Ratna Sari Siti Aisyah, Suyatno Sutoyo, Achmad Lutfi, Robby Zidny, Hutkemri Zulnaidi
papers.abstract: Chemical reasoning is increasingly recognized as an important goal in chemistry education, yet the construct is described and operationalized in different ways across studies. This study maps the development of research on chemical reasoning and synthesizes how the construct has been defined, conceptualized, and operationalized in chemistry education. A bibliometric-systematic literature review was conducted using Scopus records retrieved on 18 July 2026. The initial search identified 168 documents published between 1941-2026. Bibliographic data were cleaned using Open Refine and analyzed with Biblioshiny and VOSviewer, while study selection followed PRISMA 2020. Following full-text screening, 23 studies were included in the systematic synthesis. The bibliometric results show gradual growth in the educational literature, followed by a marked recent increase partly associated with artificial intelligence, large language models, and computational chemistry. Chemistry Education Research and Practice and the Journal of Chemical Education formed the educational publication core, while the thematic structure revealed a clear distinction between human-centered and machine-centered uses of reasoning. The systematic synthesis further showed that chemical reasoning is not a single, uniform construct. Across studies, it is most consistently understood as a context-sensitive process through which learners select, connect, and use chemical knowledge, evidence, models, and representations to explain, predict, justify, evaluate, or make decisions. The review proposes an integrative conceptual architecture linking chemical resources, epistemic operations, reasoning perspectives, reasoning products, and operational evidence. These findings provide a clearer conceptual basis for future research and for the design of chemistry learning and assessment tasks that make students' reasoning visible.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述通过文献计量与系统性文献回顾，梳理了化学教育中化学推理研究的发展脉络，并综合分析了这一构念在既有研究中如何被定义、概念化和操作化。文献计量结果显示相关教育文献长期缓慢增长，近期明显上升，部分与人工智能、大语言模型和计算化学有关，主题结构上呈现以人为中心和以机器为中心的推理用途之分。系统综合表明，化学推理并非单一统一的构念，而更一致地被理解为一种情境敏感的过程，学习者借此选择、连接和运用化学知识、证据、模型与表征来进行解释、预测、论证、评价或决策。综述据此提出一个整合性概念架构，将化学资源、认知操作、推理视角、推理产物和操作化证据联系起来，为后续研究及使学生的推理可见的学习与测评任务设计提供概念基础。

papers.title: Human Centred Educational Technology and Generative AI for Vocational and Creative Education: A Critical Integrative Review
papers.authors: Fitria Fitria, Abdul Hafid Hasim
papers.journal: Journal of Creative Industries and Vocational Innovation
papers.abstract: Educational technology and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) can expand feedback, simulation, ideation, and access to learning resources, yet their educational value depends on pedagogy, inclusion, integrity, and institutional accountability. This critical integrative review examines how these conditions shape responsible technology integration and how they apply to vocational and creative education. A purposive analytical corpus of 20 peer-reviewed articles published in 2021–2024 comprised 12 reviews or syntheses, four empirical studies, and four conceptual or critical studies. Design-sensitive appraisal and a framework-based thematic synthesis produced six themes: pedagogical alignment; teacher capability and workload; learner agency and authentic assessment; equity and accessibility; ethics, privacy, authorship, and intellectual property; and governance through staged evidence. The synthesis indicates that GenAI is most defensible when it supports rather than substitutes for human judgement, disciplinary practice, iterative feedback, and visible evidence of learning. In vocational and creative settings, applications include graphic ideation, content production, portfolio development, workplace simulation, and prototype feedback, but implementation should retain process records, human critique, copyright safeguards, and industry validation. The review contributes a human centred ecosystem and an evidence gated implementation roadmap linking learning quality, equity, integrity, workload, and accountability. Because the corpus was purposively retained from an earlier review archive and formal search strings and screening counts were unavailable, the findings do not establish prevalence, causality, or comprehensive coverage. Future research should validate the framework through multi-site vocational and creative education pilots.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察生成式人工智能与教育技术在职教和创意教育中负责任整合的条件，基于对2021至2024年相关文献的批判性整合分析，归纳出教学对齐、教师能力与负担、学习者能动性与真实性评价、公平与可及性、伦理与版权、分阶段证据治理六个主题。综述指出，生成式人工智能只有在支持而非替代人的判断、学科实践、迭代反馈和可见学习证据时才最具合理性；在职教与创意场景中可用于图形构思、内容生产、作品集开发、工作场所模拟和原型反馈，但实施需保留过程记录、人工批评、版权保障和行业验证。作者据此提出以人为中心的生态系统和证据门槛式实施路线图，并说明因语料为 purposive 保留、缺乏正式检索与筛选记录，结论不涉及流行率、因果关系或全面覆盖。

papers.title: THE ROLE OF GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN FOSTERING SELF-REGULATED LEARNING STRATEGIES WITHIN DIGITAL HIGHER EDUCATION
papers.authors: Rustam Yakhshiboev
papers.abstract: The rapid spread of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools such as ChatGPT has created both opportunities and risks for self-regulated learning (SRL), a competence that largely determines student success in digital higher education. This article aims to synthesise current evidence on how GenAI influences students' SRL strategies and to identify the pedagogical conditions under which GenAI fosters rather than substitutes self-regulation. An integrative literature review was conducted on 18 peer-reviewed publications from 2023–2026, comprising nine empirical studies involving 1,394 university students, six systematic reviews and meta-analyses, and three conceptual design frameworks. The publications were coded deductively against Zimmerman's threephase SRL model and analysed thematically. The results show that GenAI supports all three phases: goal setting and resource search in the forethought phase, problem-solving strategies and progress monitoring in the performance phase, and feedback and self-assessment in the self-reflection phase. However, gains in task performance did not consistently translate into knowledge gain, transfer or accurate self-evaluation, and several studies reported reduced mental effort, over-reliance and metacognitive laziness. Improvements in SRL processes were observed when GenAI use was combined with explicit metacognitive support or with reflective feedback based on learning analytics. The article proposes a conditional model in which GenAI acts as a regulation amplifier only when the learner retains metacognitive agency, and as a regulation substitute otherwise. Practical recommendations are formulated for universities, including those of Uzbekistan, concerning assignment design, AI literacy and teacher development. The findings can inform institutional policies on the responsible integration of GenAI into digital higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合2023至2026年间18篇同行评审文献，以Zimmerman三阶段自我调节学习模型为编码框架，考察生成式人工智能如何影响数字高等教育中学生的自我调节学习策略。结果显示，GenAI在目标设定、问题解决与自我反思等阶段均可提供支持，但任务表现的提升并不稳定转化为知识掌握、迁移或准确的自我评价，部分研究还报告了认知投入降低、过度依赖与元认知惰性。作者据此提出条件性模型：只有当学习者保留元认知主导权，并辅以显性元认知支持或基于学习分析的反思性反馈时，GenAI才起调节放大作用，否则可能替代自我调节。

papers.title: METHODOLOGY FOR DEVELOPING PROBABILISTIC-STATISTICAL THINKING IN STUDENTS BASED ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
papers.authors: Allambergenova Gulimkhan Mukhtarbaevna
papers.abstract: This article examines the methodological foundations of developing probabilistic-statistical thinking in students through the use of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. Probabilistic-statistical thinking is an essential component of modern education because it enables students to analyze data, evaluate uncertainty, identify patterns, and make evidence-based decisions. The article discusses the educational potential of AI-based learning environments, adaptive learning systems, statistical modeling tools, and interactive simulations. Particular attention is paid to teaching methods that encourage independent reasoning, critical thinking, and practical application of statistical knowledge. The proposed methodological approach aims to improve students’ understanding of probability theory and statistics by integrating AI-supported activities into the learning process.
papers.summary_zh: 该文探讨如何借助人工智能技术发展学生的概率统计思维，属于方法论层面的理论讨论，而非实证研究。文章提出，AI 学习环境、自适应学习系统、统计建模工具与交互式模拟具有教育潜力，并强调应通过教学方法引导学生独立推理、批判性思考并实际应用统计知识。作者据此勾勒出一套将 AI 支持的活动融入学习过程的方法思路，目标在于增进学生对概率论与统计学的理解；摘要未报告具体实施效果或验证数据。

papers.title: REIMAGINING EDUCATIONAL LEADERSHIP IN THE DIGITAL AGE: TRANSFORMING SCHOOL LEADERSHIP FOR QUALITY TEACHING AND LEARNING IN NIGERIA
papers.authors: Abiodun Amudalatu SAGAYA, Elijah Abiodun Amiable AYODELE, Abdulfatai Abdulkareem
papers.abstract: Educational leadership is increasingly recognised as a critical determinant of the quality, relevance and sustainability of education systems. The rapid development of digital technologies, changing learner expectations, increasing demands for accountability, teacher shortages, resource constraints and the emergence of artificial intelligence have expanded the responsibilities of educational leaders beyond traditional administration. This paper discusses the changing educational leadership in the digital age. The paper posits that educational leaders should not merely introduce technology into schools but should create an institutional culture where technology supports teaching, learning, and professional development. The paper notes that digital transformation cannot succeed through technology acquisition alone. Inadequate infrastructure, electricity challenges, digital inequality, limited professional development, resistance to change, weak institutional support, and insufficient leadership preparation may constrain implementation. The paper therefore advocates a context-sensitive model of educational leadership that integrates vision, instructional leadership, digital competence, distributed leadership, ethical practice, teacher development and community engagement. It was suggested that systematic preparation and continuous professional development of educational leaders, investment in digital infrastructure, stronger leadership standards, participatory governance, digital citizenship education, and context-sensitive monitoring of school leadership is important in Nigerian schools. The paper concludes that Nigeria's educational transformation requires leaders who can combine human-centred leadership with technological competence to create schools that are innovative, inclusive, collaborative and focused on meaningful learning
papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论数字时代尼日利亚教育领导力的转变，属于理论性论述而非实证研究。作者提出，教育领导者不应只是把技术引入学校，而应营造让技术支持教学、学习和专业发展的制度文化，并指出数字化转型仅靠购置技术难以成功，基础设施不足、电力问题、数字不平等、专业发展有限和领导准备不足等都可能制约实施。文章据此主张一种情境敏感的领导模式，整合愿景、教学领导、数字能力、分布式领导、伦理实践、教师发展和社区参与，并建议系统培养教育领导者、投资数字基础设施和加强领导标准，最终将人本领导与技术能力结合。

papers.title: AWARENESS AND UTILIZATION OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TOOLS FOR TEACHING AND RESEARCH AMONG LECTURERS IN UNIVERSITIES IN KWARA STATE
papers.authors: Israel Segun OGUNDELE PhD, Ayinde Dauda Oladeji, Sikiru Issa Nuhu, Kehinde Olabisi ADEWARA
papers.abstract: The study examined the awareness and utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools for teaching and research among Education lecturers in selected universities in Kwara State, Nigeria. Specifically, the study determined lecturers’ level of awareness of AI tools for teaching and research and the extent to which they utilized AI for teaching and research activities. A descriptive survey research design was adopted for the study. Data were collected using a researcher-developed questionnaire titled Awareness and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence Tools for Teaching and Research Questionnaire (AUAITRQ). The instrument was subjected to face and content validation, while its internal consistency was established using Cronbach’s alpha which yielded a reliability coefficient of 0.87. Mean and standard deviation were used to analyse the data and answer the research questions. The findings revealed that lecturers had a moderate level of awareness of AI tools for teaching and a moderate level of awareness of AI tools for research.
