The study further found that lecturers utilized AI tools for teaching to a high extent and also utilized AI tools for research to a high extent. The findings imply that lecturers are already making considerable use of AI in their academic activities despite having only moderate awareness of the range and functions of available AI tools. The study concluded that there is a need to strengthen lecturers’ AI literacy to ensure that their high level of utilization is supported by adequate knowledge, critical judgement and responsible academic practice. It was recommended, among others, that university management should organise regular training, seminars and workshops to improve lecturers’ awareness, practical competence and responsible use of AI tools for teaching and research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了尼日利亚夸拉州部分大学教育学科讲师对人工智能工具用于教学与科研的认知程度和实际使用情况，采用描述性调查研究设计，通过自编问卷收集数据。结果显示，讲师对教学和科研中AI工具的认知均处于中等水平，但在教学和科研活动中使用AI工具的程度却较高。这意味着讲师已在学术工作中大量使用AI，而其对该类工具范围与功能的了解相对有限，因此研究强调需加强讲师的AI素养，使高使用率建立在充分知识、批判判断和负责任的学术实践之上，并建议高校管理层通过定期培训、研讨会和工作坊提升讲师的认知、实操能力与规范使用。

papers.title: Strategic foresight in the age of AI: Cultivating Futures Literacy among EAP/ESP practitioners
papers.authors: Lorena Leigh, Eric Tindall
papers.journal: The Asian Journal of Applied Linguistics
papers.abstract: Language education, particularly English for Academic/Specific Purposes (EAP/ESP), is navigating a period of systemic disruption. The rapid proliferation of Generative Artificial Intelligence, arriving just after the significant upheaval of the COVID-19 pandemic, has once again altered institutional policies and reshaped student needs. This continuous flux leaves many practitioners in a state of constant reactivity. In line with the conference theme, Innovations in Language Education: Advancing Pedagogy, Practice and Research, we argue for a shift away from responding to educational change toward anticipating and influencing it. This paper presents the conceptual framework and insights gleaned from participants in a Futures Workshop conducted at the conference. Drawing on the multidisciplinary field of Futures Studies (FS), the workshop introduced language educators to three foundational foresight methodologies: Metaphors, the Futures Triangle, and Scenario Planning. Contextualised within the English as a Medium of Instruction environment of Hong Kong, the paper outlines the theoretical rationale for applying FS to strategic thinking within language education, details the workshop's design, and presents initial participant perspectives on the field's trajectory. We conclude that equipping educators with Futures Literacy is critical for cultivating teacher agency, enabling us to design and advocate for preferable pedagogical futures.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式人工智能与疫情后制度变动叠加下EAP/ESP教学者长期处于被动应对的状态，提出应从回应变化转向预判和影响变化，并介绍了一个基于未来学研究的概念框架及会议未来工作坊的初步经验。工作坊以香港英语授课环境为背景，向语言教育者引入隐喻、未来三角和情景规划三种前瞻方法，并呈现参与者对领域走向的初步看法。作者据此认为，培养未来素养有助于增强教师能动性，使其参与设计和倡导更可取的教学未来；但文中报告的是概念框架与参与者初步观点，而非效果检验。

papers.title: INTERNALISASI NILAI-NILAI AKHLAK DALAM PEMBELAJARAN PAI DI ERA ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE UNTUK MEMBENTUK ETIKA PESERTA DIDIK
papers.authors: Aris Eko Cahyono, Azwar Aripin, Reza Fahlepi, Muttaqin
papers.journal: Ilmuna Jurnal Studi Pendidikan Agama Islam
papers.abstract: The development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education presents both opportunities and challenges for shaping students’ ethical behavior. This study aims to analyze the internalization of moral values in Islamic Religious Education (PAI) as a foundation for developing students’ ethical behavior in the use of AI. Theoretically, this study contributes to the development of Islamic Religious Education and moral education scholarship in responding to technological advancement, while practically providing a foundation for developing AI-oriented ethical learning in PAI. This study employed a qualitative approach with a case study design. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, observations, and documentation and analyzed thematically through coding, categorization, theme identification, and interpretation. The findings indicate that the internalization of moral values occurs through several interconnected stages: value recognition, critical understanding, appreciation, habituation, and actualization. The values of ṣidq (honesty), amanah (trustworthiness), responsibility, tabayyun (verification), respect for others’ work, and self-control constitute important foundations for shaping students’ ethical behavior when using AI. The novelty of this study lies in proposing an akhlaq-based AI literacy perspective, integrating technological literacy with the internalization of Islamic moral values in PAI learning. This perspective positions AI not merely as a learning technology but also as a new context for character formation and ethical development among students.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨在人工智能时代，伊斯兰宗教教育（PAI）学习如何内化道德价值观以塑造学生的伦理行为，采用定性案例研究，通过深度访谈、观察和文档分析进行主题分析。研究发现，内化过程包含价值认知、批判理解、欣赏、习惯化和实践等相互关联的阶段，诚实、可信、责任、核实、尊重他人成果和自我控制等价值观构成学生使用AI时伦理行为的重要基础。文章据此提出以道德为基础的AI素养视角，将技术素养与伊斯兰道德价值观内化相结合，把AI视为品格塑造与伦理发展的新情境，而不仅是学习技术。

papers.title: Judging Reliability and Technology-Assisted Performance Evaluation in DanceSport and Other Judged Sports: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Cristoforo Filetti, Francesca Strassoldo di Villanova, Elvira Padua, Laura Lunetta, Bruno Ruscello, Gianluca Briotti, Cristina Tonelli, Luca Francesco Ticini, Laura Pantanella, Gabriele Morganti, Marco Porta
papers.abstract: FAIR-DANCE is a scoping review of judging reliability, scoring validity, contextual effects, judge performance, and technology-assisted performance evaluation in DanceSport and other judged sports. This OSF project hosts the review protocol, search documentation, screening and retrieval records, final data-charting dataset, supplementary materials, reporting checklists, methodological amendments, and reproducibility materials. The review maps evidence on reliability and agreement, scoring accuracy and validity, contextual bias, anomalous scoring behaviour, judge education and calibration, competition monitoring and evaluation procedures, digital systems, statistical analytics, and artificial intelligence-supported assessment, with particular emphasis on the potential transferability of these approaches to DanceSport. The review was conducted according to Joanna Briggs Institute methodological guidance for scoping reviews and is reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR. Original searches were conducted in Scopus, SPORTDiscus, and PubMed/MEDLINE. A targeted supplementary Scopus sensitivity search conducted on 6 October 2026 identified 10 additional eligible studies, yielding a final analytic corpus of 123 studies. The final synthesis is organised around five complementary dimensions: Measurement Quality, Contextual Fairness, Scoring Monitoring and Anomaly Detection, Technology-Assisted Evaluation, and Evaluation Procedures and Feedback. Continuous judge education and calibration and human-in-the-loop technology are treated as cross-cutting mechanisms supporting technical performance evaluation. Post-registration methodological amendments, supplementary-search decisions, and the complete reproducibility audit trail are documented transparently in this project.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以范围综述方法梳理了DanceSport及其他打分项目中裁判可靠性、评分效度、情境偏差与技术支持评估的研究证据，检索覆盖多个数据库并纳入补充检索所得文献。综述将证据归纳为测量质量、情境公平、评分监测与异常检测、技术辅助评估以及评估程序与反馈五个互补维度，并将持续的裁判教育与校准、人在回路的技术视为贯穿各维度的支撑机制。文章重点讨论了这些方法向DanceSport迁移的可能性，同时以公开的协议、检索记录和可复现材料说明其方法学调整与结论边界。

papers.title: From Policy to Pedagogy: A Scoping Review of Artificial Intelligence Implementation Frameworks in Africa Universities
papers.authors: Elias Kainkwa, Edda Tandi Lwoga
papers.abstract: The rapid integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into higher education globally has prompted urgent calls for coherent policy frameworks to guide implementation. In Tanzania, recent national initiatives—including the National Guidelines for AI in Education (2025) and the National Digital Education Strategy 2024/25–2029/30—signal growing policy attention to AI's educational potential. However, a significant gap persists between these policy aspirations and their translation into pedagogical practice within Tanzanian universities.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦非洲大学人工智能实施框架，梳理相关政策与教学实践之间的衔接问题。文章以坦桑尼亚近期国家层面的人工智能教育指南和数字教育战略为背景，指出政策层面对人工智能教育应用的关注正在增强，但这些政策目标向大学教学实践的转化仍存在明显缺口。综述据此提示，相关实施框架需要更关注政策如何落地为具体教学安排，而非停留在顶层设计层面。

papers.title: Human–AI Co-Creation Across Scientific, Narrative, and Creative Work: A Reflective Multi-Case Study of Archival Professional Identity
papers.authors: Dwi Ridho Aulianto
papers.abstract: The growing integration of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models and generative systems, has reshaped professional and creative workflows by enabling users to generate, organize, refine, and transform knowledge and expression.However, existing studies often examine AI use within isolated domains, limiting the understanding of how the roles of AI shift across analytical, interpretive, and creative practices.This study addresses this gap through a single-subject reflective multi-case analysis of AI-assisted workflows across three domains: scientific writing, narrative composition, and creative song production.All cases are situated within the shared thematic context of archival professional identity, particularly the expression of "Bangga menjadi arsiparis." The analysis focuses on reconstructed interaction cycles involving human input, prompting, AI-generated output, human evaluation, and either revision, acceptance, rejection, or selection.The findings show that AI assumed three domain-specific roles: an analytical and structural assistant in scientific writing, a narrative structuring agent in personal storytelling, and a creative generator in song production.The study further identifies an interpretive inverse pattern between AI generative autonomy and the intensity of direct human correction or validation.In scientific writing, human control appeared as verification and methodological judgment; in narrative writing, as meaning preservation and authentic voice maintenance; and in song production, as selection, curation, and final approval.Across the three reconstructed cases, these findings suggest that human control did not disappear as AI assumed more generative roles; rather, its form appeared to shift according to task demands, output expectations, and error sensitivity.The study provides a reflective, cross-domain, practice-based framework for understanding adaptive human-AI co-creation and highlights the importance of tasksensitive strategies, human oversight, and contextual judgment in responsible AI use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有AI使用研究多局限于单一领域、难以说明AI角色如何随任务变化的问题，采用单主体反思性多案例分析，考察科学写作、叙事创作和歌曲创作三类人机协作流程。作者围绕档案职业身份这一共同主题，重建了由人类输入、提示、AI生成、人工评估及后续修订或取舍构成的互动循环，发现AI在三个领域分别承担分析性结构助手、叙事结构代理和创意生成器角色，且AI生成自主性与人工直接修正或验证强度之间呈现反向模式。研究据此指出，人类控制并未随AI生成角色增强而消失，而是依任务需求、产出预期和错误敏感度改变形态，并强调任务敏感策略、人类监督与情境判断在人机协同中的重要性。

papers.title: From AI-Assisted Performance to Independent Thinking: A Framework for Developing Higher-Order Thinking with Generative AI in Higher Education
papers.authors: Chen Wang
papers.journal: International Theory and Practice in Humanities and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: In an AI-supported task, a student may explain a weak comparison once it has been identified, yet fail to notice a similar problem without a reminder. A decision about further help therefore needs evidence about what the student did without being prompted. We examine such decisions in English-medium university argumentation and evidence evaluation. The framework brings together English-language work on scaffolding, learner-generated reasoning, metacognitive calibration, and cognitive offloading. We distinguish help that supplies a reason from help that initiates a check. Readiness to work without the first does not establish readiness to work without the second. Coding examples and boundary cases make evidence about these functions interpretable, while six conditional propositions connect reconstruction and regulation to adaptation and transfer. A proposed experiment gives every group comparable diagnostic practice but varies whether teachers use its results to adjust assistance. This comparison isolates the value of using the evidence from learning through the diagnostic task itself. We relate the account to four GenAI approaches and illustrate it with a hypothetical sociology lesson. Help may be retained or restored when a new task requires it. The framework and coding rules need validation, particularly beyond the language and disciplinary settings considered here.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一个用于高等教育中借助生成式AI培养高阶思维的分析框架，关注如何依据学生在无提示条件下独立完成推理与证据评估的表现来决定是否提供帮助。作者区分了“提供理由”与“启动检查”两类帮助，指出能独立完成前者并不等于能独立完成后者，并通过编码示例、边界案例和六条条件性命题，将学生的重构与调节过程同适应和迁移联系起来。文章还设计了一项拟议实验，让各组接受相同的诊断练习，仅改变教师是否依据诊断结果调整辅助，以分离诊断任务本身所提供学习证据的价值，并结合四种生成式AI路径和一个假设的社会学课堂示例加以说明。作者强调，当新任务需要时帮助可以保留或恢复，但该框架与编码规则仍需在更多语言和学科情境中验证。

papers.title: AI-ASSISTED FINANCIAL JOURNALISM AND THE CREDIBILITY OF CORPORATE FINANCIAL INFORMATION IN NIGERIA
papers.authors: ATUKUM MARYAM AWUNGHAY, OLADOKUN PAUL OLAYIWOLA
papers.journal: International Journal of Anthropology and Ethnology Research Development
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI, natural language processing, machine learning and automated data-analysis systems, is transforming the production and dissemination of financial news. In Nigeria, where journalists increasingly rely on digital tools to interpret corporate disclosures, analyse financial statements and communicate market information to investors and the wider public, AI-assisted financial journalism presents both opportunities and credibility risks. This article examines the relationship between AI-assisted financial journalism and the credibility of corporate financial information in Nigeria. The study adopts an integrative literature-review approach, drawing on recent scholarly literature published between 2024 and 2026. The review is anchored on Source Credibility Theory, Technology Acceptance Model, Diffusion of Innovations Theory, Information Asymmetry Theory and Gatekeeping Theory. Seven recent empirical studies were critically reviewed, including studies of Nigerian journalists' AI adoption, newsroom practices, AI-attributed news credibility, AI disclosure and automated data-driven journalism. The review indicates that AI can improve the speed, analytical capacity, consistency and accessibility of financial journalism, particularly where journalists use AI to process large corporate datasets, identify anomalies, summarise reports and generate preliminary financial stories. However, the credibility benefits are not automatic. Risks arise from hallucinated information, inaccurate numerical interpretation, algorithmic bias, inadequate disclosure, overdependence on automated outputs, weak verification and the cultural and linguistic limitations of AI systems operating in Nigerian contexts. Recent Nigerian evidence also indicates that journalists are increasingly using AI for transcription, editing and preliminary drafting, while human journalists continue to retain important editorial responsibilities. The article argues that the credibility of AI-assisted financial journalism depends less on automation itself than on the quality of human verification, source transparency, professional competence, data provenance and institutional governance surrounding AI use. The article proposes a Human–AI Financial Journalism Credibility Framework in which AI performs computational and assistive functions while journalists retain responsibility for verification, interpretation, contextualisation and ethical publication. The study contributes to emerging literature by connecting AI-assisted journalism with the credibility of corporate financial information in an African emerging-market context.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以整合性文献综述的方式，考察尼日利亚AI辅助财经新闻与公司财务信息可信度之间的关系，梳理了2024至2026年间的相关研究，并以来源可信度理论、技术接受模型等为框架。综述指出，AI能提升财经新闻的速度、分析能力、一致性和可及性，尤其在大规模公司数据处理、异常识别和初步稿件生成方面；但可信度收益并非自动实现，幻觉信息、数值解读失准、算法偏见、披露不足、过度依赖自动输出、核查薄弱以及本地文化与语言局限都会带来风险。文章据此提出“人—AI财经新闻可信度框架”，主张AI承担计算与辅助功能，记者保留核查、解读、情境化与伦理发布的责任，并强调可信度更多取决于人工核查质量、来源透明度、专业能力、数据来源和制度治理，而非自动化本身。

papers.title: Evaluating Generative AI Assisted Lesson Planning for Secondary Chemistry: A Critical Review of Planning Quality and Teacher Judgment
papers.authors: Ruiyang Gong, Xinyue Luo, Yuling Zhao
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) can produce chemistry lesson plans containing objectives, activities, resources, and assessments, but evaluating their educational contribution requires different kinds of evidence. This critical narrative review examines GenAI-assisted planning for secondary chemistry through three objects of evaluation: the written plan, teachers' professional reasoning and revisions, and students' learning. Seven recent chemistry and science education studies provide the principal contemporary evidence, interpreted alongside research on pedagogical content knowledge, chemical representations, and constructive alignment. The synthesis identifies useful planning support while showing why completed templates, teacher perceptions, and classroom outcomes require separate interpretation. Chemistry-specific review should examine the conditions attached to scientific claims, the connections among representations, the reasoning elicited by tasks, and the responses that trigger instructional adjustment. A worked illustration using electrolysis of aqueous copper sulfate demonstrates how these criteria translate into changes to objectives, diagnostic questions, and follow-up teaching decisions. The article proposes a planning-review procedure and a teacher-education assignment that make justified revisions visible through planning records and discussion. Future studies can connect these records with classroom enactment and student explanations while separating AI assistance from additional opportunities to revise. The review positions teachers' transformation of generated materials as the link between the availability of planning support and the quality of the learning opportunities eventually offered to students.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察生成式人工智能辅助中学化学备课的评估问题，指出书面教案、教师的专业推理与修改、学生学习这三类对象需要分别解读，不能相互替代。作者基于近期化学与科学教育研究，结合学科教学知识、化学表征与建构对齐等视角，提出化学备课审查应关注科学主张的限定条件、表征间的联系、任务引发的推理以及触发教学调整的学生反应，并以硫酸铜电解为例说明如何据此修改目标、诊断性问题与后续教学决策。文章进而提出备课审查程序和教师教育任务，使有依据的修改通过备课记录与讨论显现，并将教师对生成材料的转化视为连接备课支持与学生实际学习机会的关键环节。

papers.title: Pengaruh Penggunaan Artificial Intelligence Perpajakan dan Literasi Digital terhadap Kepatuhan Wajib Pajak Gen Z: Kajian Literatur Sistematis
papers.authors: Agnes Sisca Erlina Sari, Henny Henny, Ayu Miranti
papers.abstract: The rise of digital technology has helped the modernization of the tax system through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital-based tax services. Generation Z, as a cohort that has grown up in the digital era, is expected to adapt to these advances which would improve tax compliance. The present study intends to assess the influence of the application of Artificial Intelligence in taxes and digital literacy on the compliance of Generation Z taxpayers through a systematic literature review approach. The research strategy employed is the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) by assessing five relevant scientific articles published in the year 2022-2026. The results of the study reveal that there has not been a consistent direct effect of AI and tax digitization on taxpayer compliance. Conversely, digital literacy has been identified as a critical factor to improve taxpayers’ awareness, access and utilization of digital tax services. Tax literacy and tax socialization are other supporting elements that increase the relationship between tax technology and taxpayer compliance. These results demonstrate that the effective adoption of AI in taxation is not only based on the technological sophistication but also on the level of digital literacy and tax understanding of users. Thus, there is a need for a strategy that include technology advancement, greater digital literacy, and tax education to promote sustainable compliance among Generation Z taxpayers.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以系统文献综述方式，梳理2022至2026年间五篇相关文献，考察税务人工智能应用与数字素养对Z世代纳税人税收遵从的影响。结果显示，人工智能和税务数字化对遵从并无一致的直接作用，而数字素养被视为提升纳税人认知、获取和使用数字税务服务的关键因素，税收素养与税务宣传也起辅助作用。作者据此指出，税务人工智能的有效采用不仅取决于技术先进程度，也取决于用户的数字素养与税收理解水平，并建议将技术进步、数字素养提升与税收教育结合。

papers.title: The Effectiveness of AI Chatbots in Foreign Language Learning: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.authors: Aliya Nabila, Dian Citra Faridsyah, Melky Riano Siahaan, riyan dinata, Shinta Krisdayanti Sihombing, Elsa Sabrina
papers.journal: Indonesian Journal of Innovation Multidisipliner Research
papers.abstract: The use of artificial intelligence in foreign language learning has increased, particularly through AI chatbots that provide interactive communication and personalized learning support. This study aimed to examine the effectiveness of AI chatbots in foreign language learning through a Systematic Literature Review. A total of 30 articles published between 2021 and 2026 were reviewed to identify their effects on language skills, learner motivation, engagement, and learning experiences. The findings indicate that AI chatbots support foreign language learning, particularly in writing, grammar, and vocabulary development. Immediate feedback and opportunities for independent practice also contribute to learner motivation and engagement. However, the effectiveness of AI chatbots varies across language skills, with mixed findings in speaking and listening activities. Several challenges were identified, including inaccurate responses, technical limitations, plagiarism, overdependence on technology, and ethical concerns. These challenges highlight the importance of using AI chatbots appropriately in educational settings. The findings suggest that AI chatbots are most beneficial when integrated into learning activities as complementary tools rather than replacements for teachers or conventional language instruction. Their effective implementation requires appropriate pedagogical strategies, teacher guidance, and attention to ethical considerations. In conclusion, AI chatbots have the potential to improve foreign language learning experiences when used purposefully and supported by suitable instructional approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2021至2026年间30篇文献，考察AI聊天机器人在外语学习中的效果。总体来看，聊天机器人对写作、语法和词汇学习有支持作用，即时反馈和自主练习机会也有助于提升学习动机与参与度；但效果因语言技能而异，在口语和听力活动中的发现并不一致。综述还指出回答不准确、技术限制、抄袭、过度依赖技术和伦理问题等挑战，认为聊天机器人更适合作为补充工具而非教师或常规教学的替代，其有效实施需要教学策略、教师引导和对伦理问题的关注。

papers.title: The Adaptive Opportunity Floor: Distributionally Robust Safeguards for Inclusive AI Tutoring
papers.authors: Kwan Hong TAN
papers.abstract: Purpose: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) tutors can personalize learning, but improved average performance cannot establish equitable benefit for learners facing accessibility, language, connectivity, or time constraints. Methodology: This theoretical design-science study develops the Adaptive Opportunity Floor (AOF), combining causal potential-outcome comparisons, subgroup distributional robustness, accessible instructional alternatives, and educator-controlled fallback. We derive a conditional lower bound on subgroup benefit and distinguish direct empirical Wasserstein uncertainty from a separately calibrated population-shift model. Results: A formal bound and a hypothetical worked example demonstrate how average-gain optimization can reject a subgroup-safe policy. A finite-sample extension makes sampling uncertainty, candidate-policy selection, and probabilistic assumptions explicit. A comparative synthesis distinguishes AOF from predictive parity, Universal Design for Learning, conventional causal policy learning, and generic robust optimization. Implications: Institutions can predeclare accessible comparators, absolute attainment minima, subgroup margins, and evidence thresholds before deploying AI tutoring. The proposed safeguards are sufficient only under identified causal effects, defensible error and shift bounds, and valid outcome measurement. No learner data were collected and empirical effectiveness has not been demonstrated.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究是一项理论设计科学研究，针对生成式AI辅导可能只提升平均表现、却无法保证弱势学习者平等受益的问题，提出“自适应机会下限”（AOF）框架，将因果潜在结果比较、子群分布稳健性、可访问教学替代方案与教育者控制的回退机制结合起来。作者推导了子群受益的条件下界，区分直接经验Wasserstein不确定性与单独校准的总体漂移模型，并通过形式化边界和假设性示例说明：以平均增益为目标的优化可能拒绝子群安全的策略。比较分析进一步将AOF与预测均等、通用学习设计、常规因果策略学习及一般稳健优化区分开。文章建议机构在部署AI辅导前预先声明可访问对照、绝对达标下限、子群边际和证据阈值，同时明确这些保障仅在因果效应可识别、误差与漂移界限合理且结果测量有效时才充分；研究未收集学习者数据，尚未证明实际效果。

papers.title: The Learning Assurance Frontier: A Capacity-Constrained Theory of Generative AI, Knowledge Verification, and Independent Learning Transfer
papers.authors: Kwan Hong TAN
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) can improve the speed and polish of assessed work without necessarily strengthening knowledge that learners can independently reproduce. Existing accounts of cognitive offloading and responsible AI identify this risk, but provide limited formal guidance for allocating verification effort when AI output volume rises faster than learner and educator capacity. This article develops the Learning Assurance Frontier (LAF), a capacity-constrained theory of AI-assisted learning that distinguishes production, verification, and delayed independent transfer. Using analytic modelling, constrained optimisation, and transparent numerical scenarios, it derives conditional propositions: (i) the fraction of AI-supported work that can be fully checked declines once verification demand exceeds finite review capacity; (ii) an explicitly specified assurance-adjusted educational objective has a unique, capacity-dependent optimal AI-assistance intensity; and (iii) unequal review resources can create assurance disparities even when students have equal access to AI tools. Additional results establish consequence-weighted allocation of limited review time and a distributionally robust safety margin for uncertain verification demand, both under explicit assumptions. In illustrative, non-empirical scenarios, increasing weekly verification capacity from 1.8 to 3.0 hours shifts the model-optimal assistance intensity from approximately 0.35 to 0.71. The article translates these conditional results into an assessment architecture incorporating evidence checks, self-explanation, delayed unaided transfer, and equity safeguards. It specifies an experimentally testable research programme, while explicitly avoiding any claim that the illustrative parameters are measured educational effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出“学习保障前沿”（LAF）这一容量约束理论，用解析建模与约束优化区分AI辅助学习中的产出、核验与延迟独立迁移三个环节，考察当AI产出增速超过学习者与教育者的核验能力时，核验投入应如何分配。理论推导给出若干条件性命题：核验需求超出有限复核能力后，能被完整检查的AI辅助工作比例会下降；在明确设定的保障调整目标下，存在随容量变化的最优AI辅助强度；复核资源不均会在AI工具可及性相同时造成保障差距。作者据此提出含证据核查、自我解释、延迟无辅助迁移与公平保障的评估架构，并强调示例参数并非实测教育效应，结论仅为条件性推论。

papers.title: Decolonising Generative Artificial Intelligence in African Higher Education: Toward Ubuntu-ẸkỌ, Augmented Collective Wisdom and Digital Sovereignty
papers.authors: E. Mashungu, D Chipfunde, R Rusinga
papers.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) into higher education presents both significant opportunities and critical challenges for institutions in Africa and the wider Global South. While GenAI can expand access to information, support teaching and learning, and strengthen research productivity, its deployment also raises questions concerning whose knowledge is represented, which languages are privileged, how credibility is constructed, and who exercises control over the infrastructures and data on which artificial intelligence depends. This article critically examined the implications of these challenges through the lenses of decolonial theory, epistemic justice, African philosophical thought, and critical AI studies. Rather than treating artificial intelligence as a culturally neutral technological artefact, the article conceptualises AI as a sociotechnical system whose knowledge practices are shaped by historical, economic, linguistic and epistemological relations of power. Drawing on a critical interpretive synthesis of scholarly literature, policy documents and African philosophical perspectives, the article developed the Ubuntu-Ẹ̀kọ́ Framework as an original conceptual contribution. The framework brings together relationality, ethical character, contextual responsiveness, critical consciousness and communal capability. Building on this framework, the article proposes Augmented Collective Wisdom (ACW) as a reorientation of AI from a technology primarily designed to automate or individualise knowledge work toward a sociotechnical resource that supports collective learning, human judgement, cultural integrity and community wellbeing. The article further advanced Digital Sovereignty as a strategic alternative to a narrow discourse of AI readiness. It concluded that decolonising AI in higher education does not require rejection of technological innovation; rather, it requires institutions to develop the epistemic, cultural, linguistic, infrastructural and governance capacities necessary to determine how AI is designed, interpreted, deployed and evaluated within their own contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以去殖民理论、认识正义与非洲哲学为视角，批判性审视生成式人工智能进入非洲及全球南方高等教育后所涉及的知识代表性、语言特权、可信度建构与基础设施控制问题。作者通过批判性解释性综合梳理学术文献、政策文件与非洲哲学观点，提出Ubuntu-Ẹ̀kọ́框架，并据此倡导“增强集体智慧”，主张将AI从自动化、个体化的知识工具转向支持集体学习、人类判断与文化完整性的社会技术资源，同时以“数字主权”替代狭隘的AI就绪话语。文章的核心结论是：去殖民化并不要求拒绝技术创新，而是要求高校在自身语境中具备认识、文化、语言、基础设施与治理能力，以决定AI如何设计、解释、部署与评估。

papers.title: The Integration Artificial Intelligence Into Higher Education: Strengthening the Learning Process of Independent Work
papers.authors: Jhonatan André Orozco Ochoa, Ana Elvira Manuel Ferrer, Cindy Vanessa Hoyos Angulo, Damar Paola Barraza Ospino, JHON FREDDY CASTAÑO
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has become a relevant tool for strengthening the learning process both inside and outside the classroom. Objective: To determine how the integration of AI impacts the enhancement of learning during independent study in a higher education institution in Barranquilla. The research was conducted between June and November 2025 at a higher education institution in Barranquilla. Method: It was developed using a mixed-methods approach, through the administration of surveys and semi-structured interviews to a sample of 72 students. The instruments were previously validated and administered with informed consent. From the quantitative perspective, correlation and multiple regression analyses were used to determine the relationship between the use of artificial intelligence and learning. The qualitative component allowed for a deeper exploration of the participants' perceptions and experiences. Results: The findings demonstrate that integrating artificial intelligence strengthens learning during independent study by promoting autonomy, enhancing content comprehension, and fostering student academic performance. Likewise, the continuous feedback provided by these tools contributes significantly to the learning process, as it offers access to real-time information, greater flexibility, and better time management. A favorable attitude toward its use was also identified, although it is emphasized that AI must be used responsibly and consciously. Conclusion: It is concluded that artificial intelligence, when used correctly, can strengthen learning in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了在巴兰基亚一所高等教育机构中，人工智能的整合如何影响学生自主学习阶段的学习效果，采用混合方法，通过问卷调查和半结构化访谈收集学生对AI使用与学习的看法。研究发现，AI的整合有助于增强自主学习，表现为促进自主性、加深内容理解并改善学业表现；工具提供的持续反馈也被认为对学习过程有重要贡献，带来实时信息获取、更大灵活性和更好的时间管理。参与者对使用AI总体持积极态度，但研究同时强调AI需被负责任且有意识地使用。文章据此认为，使用得当的人工智能能够强化高等教育中的学习。

papers.title: Generative AI in Higher Education: Evidence Synthesis of Applied Learning Outcomes
papers.authors: Muhammad Nazirul Mubin Bin Abdul Moen, Alfa Rohmatin, Mia Siti Nurazizah, Mehwish Kaleem
papers.journal: International Journal of Applied Research and Innovation
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has spread through higher education faster than institutions have produced stable evidence on learning effects. This study synthesized recent empirical reviews, meta-analyses, and applied higher-education research to identify where generative artificial intelligence improved learning and where outcomes remained contingent on instructional design. A structured evidence-synthesis method compared five quantitative or systematic anchor reviews with complementary studies on assessment, feedback, academic integrity, and learner regulation. The anchor literature ranged from 34 to 103 included studies, while a 2026 three-level meta-analysis reported an overall learning effect of g = 0.499 across 36 studies, 132 effect sizes, and 7,229 participants. Larger effects were reported for collaborative learning and cognitive or creative outcomes, while other reviews showed positive achievement and motivation effects but inconsistent self-efficacy findings. The synthesis concluded that generative artificial intelligence produced stronger outcomes when embedded in guided, task-specific pedagogy rather than used as an unrestricted answer generator. Assessment redesign, verification routines, and learner metacognition remained necessary implementation conditions
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以结构化证据综合方法，比较了多篇实证综述、元分析与应用研究，考察生成式人工智能在高等教育中改善学习的效果及其条件。综合结果显示，其整体学习效应为正，在协作学习以及认知或创造性成果上报告的效应更大，对成绩与动机也有积极影响，但自我效能感方面的发现并不一致。作者据此指出，生成式人工智能嵌入有引导、面向具体任务的教学设计时效果更强，而非作为不受限制的答案生成器使用；评估方式重新设计、核验流程与学习者元认知仍是必要的实施条件。

papers.title: Event-related potential signatures of auditory predictive processing in first-episode psychosis: a passive pattern-based study
papers.authors: Manuel Muñoz‐Caracuel, Vanesa Muñoz, Brenda Angulo, Francisco J. Ruiz‐Martínez, Salvador Perona Garcelán, Marta Isabel Garrido, Rafael Romero-Garcia, Antonio J. Vázquez Morejón, Benedicto Crespo‐Facorro, Carlos M. Gómez
papers.abstract: Background: Predictive-processing accounts propose altered prediction-error signaling in psychosis. However, event-related potential (ERP) findings in first-episode psychosis (FEP) are inconsistent and focused predominantly on mismatch negativity (MMN). Examining anticipatory and later post-stimulus ERP responses alongside MMN within a single passive paradigm may broaden the assessment of predictive processing in FEP. Methods: 34 participants with non-affective FEP and 34 healthy controls (HC) underwent EEG during a passive auditory pattern-based paradigm. Mean amplitudes of contingent negative variation (CNV), MMN, and post-imperative negative variation (PINV) were quantified at five frontocentral electrodes. Exploratory analyses examined N1 and P2 mean amplitudes. Mixed models tested group, electrode, and group-by- electrode effects adjusting for age, sex and years of education. Regressions examined ERP associations with psychotic-like experiences, neurocognition, and social cognition across groups, and with symptoms, functioning, and antipsychotic dose within FEP. Results: FEP participants reported more psychotic-like experiences and showed poorer global and social cognition than HC (all p-FDR ≤ .042). Standardized adjusted FEP-HC differences at FCz were nonsignificant for CNV (β = −0.46), MMN (β = −0.30), and PINV (β = −0.10; all p-FDR ≥ .265). Exploratory analyses identified lower P2 amplitude in FEP at FCz (β = −0.73; p-FDR = .019) and in the averaged frontocentral ROI (β = −0.64; p-FDR = .027). No ERP-phenotype associations survived FDR correction. Conclusions: Despite phenotypic differences between FEP and HC, no significant differences emerged in the primary ERP indices of predictive processing examined. The exploratory P2 finding and its possible relationship to predictive processing and frontal dysfunction in FEP warrant further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察首发精神病患者与健康对照在被动听觉模式范式下的预测加工相关事件相关电位特征，比较两组在CNV、MMN和PINV等成分上的差异，并探索其与精神病样体验、神经认知和社会认知的关联。结果显示，尽管患者组报告更多精神病样体验且整体与社会认知表现较差，但上述三个主要ERP指标在组间均无显著差异；探索性分析发现患者组P2波幅较低，但未发现经校正后仍成立的ERP与表型关联。作者据此认为，主要预测加工ERP指标未见组间差异，P2结果及其与额叶功能的关系尚需进一步研究。

papers.title: Beyond the Percentile: CDC-referenced BMI-for-Age and Brain Structure Across Childhood and Adolescence
papers.authors: Dani Beck, Lars Tjelta Westlye, Christian Krog Tamnes
papers.abstract: Abstract Importance Pediatric obesity affects 1 in 5 US children and has been linked to brain structural differences. Most evidence is cross-sectional and models body mass index (BMI) linearly, with metrics that compress severe obesity. Objective To examine associations between brain structure and BMI-for-age across the weight spectrum and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) weight status categories, distinguishing between- and within-person associations, and their age and sex moderation. Design, Setting, and Participants Longitudinal cohort study of youth aged 8–10 years at baseline in the US community-based Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (4 waves, 2016–2025; ages 8–18 years). Exposures Extended CDC BMI-for-age z-score, grouped by wave-mean z-score: underweight (<5th percentile, n=297), healthy weight (5th–<85th, n=7,452), overweight (85th–<95th, n=1,919), and obesity (≥95th, n=1,842). Main Outcomes and Measures Cortical thickness (12 regions) and subcortical volume (7 regions) from T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), defined a priori. Results Among 11,510 participants contributing 32,212 observations (mean [SD] age, 12.6 [2.5] years; 52.2% male), higher between-person BMI-for-age z was associated with lower frontal and temporal thickness (6 regions) and larger subcortical volume (5 regions; all q < .001), but associations were nonlinear (17 of 19 regions). Youth with obesity had lower thickness than healthy weight youth in 8 frontal and temporal regions (largest, −0.21 SD; q < .001), with dorsal frontal differences decreasing across adolescence; underweight youth had smaller subcortical volumes. Higher BMI-for-age z was associated with larger subcortical volume (all 7 regions) within the healthy weight category and lower cortical thickness (11 of 12 regions; fusiform: β = −0.27; q < .001) within the obesity category, steeper than in healthy weight youth in 10 regions, but not in overweight or underweight youth. Within-person associations did not reproduce the obesity associations, reversed from negative at age 10 to positive at age 16, and were more negative in female than male participants. Conclusions and Relevance Youth with obesity had lower cortical thickness than healthy weight peers, but associations between brain structure and BMI-for-age differed between CDC weight status groups, suggesting a complex relationship between adiposity and brain structure. Key Points Question How is BMI-for-age associated with brain structure across the weight spectrum, within CDC weight status categories, and within individuals over time in youth? Findings In this cohort study of 11,510 youth aged 8–18 years, those with obesity had lower frontal and temporal cortical thickness than healthy weight youth. Within categories, higher BMI-for-age was associated with lower thickness in obesity but larger subcortical volumes in healthy weight youth; within individuals over time, the obesity association was not reproduced. Meaning BMI–brain associations differ between CDC weight status categories and may be obscured by assuming a single linear association.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于美国青少年脑认知发展研究的纵向队列，考察儿童青少年BMI-for-age与脑结构（皮层厚度和皮层下体积）的关联，并区分个体间与个体内效应。结果发现，肥胖青少年在多个额叶和颞叶区域的皮层厚度低于健康体重同龄人，且多数脑区呈非线性关联；在肥胖类别内，BMI-for-age越高皮层厚度越低，而在健康体重类别内则表现为皮层下体积更大。个体内随时间变化的关联未能重现上述肥胖相关模式，提示BMI与脑结构的关系因CDC体重类别而异，单一线性假设可能掩盖这种复杂性。

papers.title: Detecting movement preparation with HYDRE: a hybrid model of temporal and spectral brain signals
papers.authors: Romaric Thiboud, Fayed Rassoulou, Denis Schwartz, Pauline Mouchès, Pierre-Elliott Thiboud, Eshaan Eshaan, Alessandro Farnè, Marine Vernet
papers.abstract: Abstract Previous research on brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) has demonstrated the feasibility of decoding different movements. However, less attention has been given to detecting motor preparation (i.e., decoding from brain signals whether or not a participant is about to perform a given movement). In this study, we wanted to assess the performance of a new model, rooted in motor preparation physiology, in detecting an upcoming movement across the period preceding a voluntary action. Participants (n=18, including 7 females) performed a simple self-paced motor task where they either pressed a button to change an image shown on screen, or let the computer change the image. Participants’ brain activity was recorded using magnetoencephalography and submitted to a newly developed linear ensemble classifier that relies on features extracted using PCA from the temporal, spectral and Riemannian domain. We then compared its performance against other classifiers used in BCIs. Our HYbrid Domain Riemannian Ensemble (HYDRE) classifier emerged as the best-performing method, achieving average above-chance decoding up to 1400ms before the action, with a maximum ROC score of 76% at the time of the button press. Moreover, decoding performance in the temporal and Riemannian domains was respectively predictive of Readiness Field and Event-Related Desynchronization magnitudes, two well-known motor preparation markers. Combining features from the temporal, spectral, and Riemannian domains significantly improved motor preparation decoding compared to single-domain approaches. By leveraging the most discriminative features from each domain, HYDRE yielded consistent performance gains across participants with varying baseline decoding performance, effectively addressing inter-individual variability in motor preparation markers. Significance Statement Our results show that combining features from temporal, spectral, and Riemannian domains significantly improves motor preparation decoding compared to single-domain approaches. The HYbrid Domain Riemannian Ensemble (HYDRE) classifier we developed following this principle yields consistent performance gains across participants with varying levels of baseline decoding performances (improving prediction in both high- and low-decoding individuals). Lastly, we characterize how motor preparation decoding evolves in the time window leading up to the movement, linking decoding trajectories directly to observable physiological markers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑机接口中较少被探讨的运动准备检测问题，即能否在参与者即将执行动作之前从脑信号中判断其意图。作者让参与者完成自定节奏的按键或由电脑改变图像的任务，并用脑磁图记录其脑活动，据此提出融合时间、频谱与黎曼域特征的HYDRE线性集成分类器，并与常用脑机接口分类器比较。结果显示，HYDRE在动作前较长时间窗口内即可高于随机水平解码，且多域特征结合比单一域方法更稳定地提升表现，在不同基线解码水平的参与者中均有改善；时间域与黎曼域的解码表现还分别与准备场和事件相关去同步这两个运动准备标记相关。作者据此说明多域特征融合有助于应对个体差异，并将解码轨迹与可观测的生理标记联系起来。

papers.title: Prompt Literacy as a Core Workplace Competency: Development of the Prompt Literacy Index (PLI-20) for Non-Technical Professionals
papers.authors: Shivanand R Koppalkar, Ajit Ashok Shenvi
papers.abstract: Organizations are adopting generative artificial intelligence faster than their employees can use it well. Training investment targets tools rather than the human skill that determines output quality. This article defines prompt literacy as a distinct, measurable workplace competency: the ability of a worker to instruct, contextualize, verify, refine, and ethically govern the output of a generative AI system during ordinary job tasks. Drawing on digital literacy theory, AI literacy research, and recent evidence on prompting behavior, the article develops a five-dimension conceptual framework covering task framing, context supply, output verification, iterative refinement, and ethical use. Following established scale development procedures, a 40-item pool was generated from peer-reviewed literature published between 2004 and 2025 and reduced through a structured content-validity design to the 20-item Prompt Literacy Index (PLI-20). The full instrument is presented, together with a registered validation protocol specifying the sample, exploratory factor analysis, and reliability criteria for the planned pilot study with non-technical professionals. The article contributes the first profession-agnostic framework and instrument for measuring applied prompting skill outside technical roles, shifting the unit of analysis in workplace AI research from the tool to the worker. Implications for workforce development, training design, and future confirmatory validation are discussed. Keywords: Generative Artificial Intelligence; AI literacy; prompt literacy; workplace competency; scale development; digital skills
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对员工使用生成式人工智能的能力落后于组织采用速度的问题，提出“提示素养”这一可测量的职场能力概念，涵盖指令、情境补充、输出核验、迭代改进与伦理使用等方面。作者依据数字素养理论、AI 素养研究及提示行为证据构建五维框架，经文献生成条目池并通过结构化内容效度设计，形成20个条目的提示素养量表（PLI-20），同时给出完整工具及一项面向非技术从业者的注册验证方案。文章将职场 AI 研究的分析单位从工具转向工作者，为培训设计与后续验证提供基础，但量表效度尚待实证检验。

papers.title: Social Media Storytelling and Fan Co-Creation in Museum Cultural and Creative Products: From Audiences to Value Co-Creators
papers.authors: XiYan Zhu
papers.abstract: This research investigates the transformative role of social media storytelling in fostering fan co-creation of museum cultural and creative products and its subsequent impact on audience-driven value generation. Recognizing the increasing reliance of museums on digital platforms for audience engagement, this study addresses a critical gap in understanding how narrative-driven social media content can shift audiences from passive consumers to active participants in product development. Employing a mixed-methods approach, the research analyzes specific social media storytelling strategies utilized by museums, examining their efficacy in eliciting fan co-creation. It further explores the motivations and processes underlying fan engagement in creating museum-related content and products, ranging from user-generated narratives to collaborative design initiatives. The findings are expected to reveal that interactive and emotionally resonant storytelling techniques significantly enhance fan co-creation. Crucially, the study demonstrates that this co-creation process generates multifaceted value, including increased product authenticity, expanded audience reach, strengthened brand loyalty, and the development of innovative cultural products. This work contributes to theories of participatory culture and service-dominant logic by illustrating a novel pathway for value co-creation within the cultural heritage sector, ultimately redefining the museum-audience relationship in the digital age.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察社交媒体叙事如何推动博物馆文创产品的粉丝共创，以及由此带来的受众驱动价值生成，采用混合方法分析博物馆的叙事策略及粉丝参与的动机与过程。摘要指出，互动性强、情感共鸣的叙事技巧有望显著促进粉丝共创，而共创过程可提升产品真实性、扩大受众覆盖、增强品牌忠诚并催生创新文化产品。文章据此从参与式文化与服务主导逻辑角度，提出文化遗产领域价值共创的新路径，并讨论数字时代博物馆与受众关系的重新界定；上述发现多为预期性表述，尚需实证结果支撑。

papers.title: РАСЧЕТ РЫНОЧНЫХ СТАВОК РОЯЛТИ НА БАЗЕ АНАЛИЗА БОЛЬШИХ ДАННЫХ СУДЕБНЫХ РЕШЕНИЙ В РОССИЙСКОЙ ФЕДЕРАЦИИ
papers.authors: Н.Р. КИРШИНА, К.А. МУРАШЕВ
papers.abstract: В статье предложены решение задачи корректного извлечения из опубликованных судебных актов сведений о фактических значениях ставок роялти, зафиксированных в лицензионных договорах и договорах коммерческой концессии, реализованное с использованием мультиагентной системы искусственного интеллекта, разработанной одним из соавторов, а также алгоритм отбора наблюдений по объекту интеллектуальной собственности, договору, отрасли, международной классификации товаров и услуг, происхождению ставки, базе роялти и независимости данных. Отмечено, что неполное раскрытие сведений в источнике ограничивает применение наблюдаемых данных, однако полученные сведения могут служить индикатором рыночных тенденций. This article proposes a solution for correctly extracting information on the actual values of royalty rates fixed in license agreements and commercial concession agreements from published courtdecisions. This solution utilizes a multi-agent artificial intelligence system developed by one of the co-authors. It also proposes an algorithm for selecting observations based on intellectual property, agreement, industry, international classification of goods and services, rate origin, royalty base, and data independence. It is noted that incomplete disclosure of information in the source limits the applicability of the observed data; however, the obtained information can serve as an indicator of market trends.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对如何从已公开的俄罗斯法院判决中正确提取许可协议与商业特许经营协议所载实际许可费率信息这一问题，提出了一套基于多智能体人工智能系统的抽取方案，并配套设计了按知识产权对象、合同类型、行业、国际商品与服务分类、费率来源、许可费基数及数据独立性筛选观测值的算法。作者指出，来源中信息披露不完整会限制所观测数据的适用范围，但提取所得信息仍可作为市场趋势的参考指标。

papers.title: Generative AI and Social Inequality in Education: A Human-Centered Social Science Review of Global and Indonesian Evidence
papers.authors: Siti Nur Aisyah, Muhammad Alif Pratama, Dewi Anggraini
papers.abstract: This review examined how generative artificial intelligence (AI) can widen educational opportunity while also reproducing social inequality. An integrative review synthesized 24 sources: 17 Indonesian publications (2022–2026), identified through national journal portals and Google Scholar, and seven international policy documents and scholarly works (2016–2023) selected as conceptual anchors. Thematic analysis produced four themes: unequal access, unequal digital and AI literacy, unequal capacity to benefit from AI-supported learning, and governance risks involving privacy, bias, academic integrity, and human agency. The reported benefits of generative AI, such as tutoring, writing support, and translation, appear to depend on connectivity, devices, language resources, teacher competence, and students' ability to evaluate machine output. The Indonesian evidence is mostly cross-sectional, self-reported, or based on small single-institution samples, with little evidence on learning outcomes. One national household analysis of school participation (not AI use) found no significant difference between 3T (disadvantaged, frontier, and outermost) and matched non-3T households, suggesting that regional labels may be an imperfect proxy for household conditions. The review proposes a cumulative model of AI inequality that extends van Dijk's sequence of digital inequality with a governance stage and a feedback loop. The model is a conceptual proposition, not a tested result, and recommendations are ordered by the strength of supporting evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察生成式人工智能如何既可能扩大教育机会、又可能复制社会不平等，综合了印尼相关文献与国际政策及学术研究，并通过主题分析归纳出获取机会、数字与AI素养、受益能力以及隐私、偏见、学术诚信和人的能动性等治理风险四类议题。文章指出，生成式AI的辅导、写作支持和翻译等收益依赖网络、设备、语言资源、教师能力和学生评判机器输出的能力；印尼证据多为横断面、自我报告或小型单校样本，学习结果证据不足，且一项关于入学而非AI使用的家庭分析未发现3T与非3T家庭存在显著差异，提示区域标签可能不是家庭条件的理想代理。作者据此提出一个在van Dijk数字不平等序列上增加治理阶段与反馈回路的累积模型，但明确其为概念性主张而非检验结果，建议也按证据强度排序。

papers.title: STUDENT CREATIVITY IN THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) FOR THESIS WRITING: A LITERATURE REVIEW
papers.authors: Deswita, Vera Wulandari, Nur Suhaela
papers.abstract: The development of artificial intelligence (AI) has brought significant changes to the world of higher education, particularly in the process of writing a thesis as a final-level scientific work. Students are increasingly utilizing various AI applications to assist with literature searches, idea development, writing structure, and improving academic language. This study aims to analyze the forms and patterns of AI use by students in writing their theses and examine its impact on student creativity based on the findings of a literature study. The method used is a descriptive qualitative approach through a literature study of relevant scientific articles published between 2020 and 2025. The results of the study indicate that AI plays a strategic role in stimulating idea exploration, increasing flexibility of thinking, and supporting students' creative process in writing their theses. However, the use of AI also presents challenges in the form of potential dependency, decreased originality, and the risk of plagiarism if not accompanied by adequate control and academic ethics. Therefore, the use of AI needs to be positioned as a catalyst for academic creativity, not as a substitute for students' critical thinking.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以2020至2025年间发表的相关文献为对象，梳理了学生在学位论文写作中使用人工智能的形式与模式，并考察其对创造力的影响。文章指出，AI在激发思路探索、增强思维灵活性和支持写作创造过程方面具有积极作用，但若缺乏适当控制与学术伦理约束，也可能带来依赖、原创性下降和抄袭风险。作者据此主张将AI定位为学术创造力的催化剂，而非学生批判性思维的替代品。

papers.title: Teacher’s Strategies in Addressing Students’ Difficulties in Learning English at SMP Negeri 1 Tanjung Bunga
papers.authors: Ummi Qalsum Arif, Yulius Pertama B Kelen, Levin Hermina Sitania, Chiciesther Morita Beto Piran
papers.abstract: This study aims to identify the English learning difficulties encountered by seventh-grade students at SMP Negeri 1 Tanjung Bunga. Utilizing a descriptive qualitative research design, this study gathered data through systematic non-participant classroom observations, semi-structured interviews with teachers and students, and field notes during the learning process. The findings reveal that seventh-grade students experience complex learning difficulties, including vocabulary limitations, phonological interference from their mother tongue that hinders pronunciation, speaking anxiety, low learning motivation due to a lack of language exposure outside the classroom, and limited learning resources. To overcome these challenges, the teacher implemented integrated strategies encompassing Contextual Teaching and Learning (CTL) by linking materials to East Flores local wisdom, Communicative Language Teaching (CLT), language games, the use of physical gestures and vocal variations as substitutes for digital audio media, and the co-creation of a "Classroom Agreement" to foster a safe classroom culture free from peer ridicule.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察印度尼西亚一所初中七年级学生在英语学习中遇到的具体困难，以及教师为应对这些困难所采取的策略。作者采用描述性定性设计，通过课堂观察、半结构式访谈和田野笔记收集资料，发现学生的困难涉及词汇量有限、母语语音干扰发音、口语焦虑、课外缺乏语言接触导致学习动机偏低以及学习资源不足。教师据此综合运用了将教材与当地智慧相联系的情境教学、交际语言教学、语言游戏、以肢体动作和语调变化替代数字音频媒体，以及共同制定“课堂公约”以营造免于同伴嘲笑的课堂文化等策略。这些发现提示，在资源有限的环境中，教师需结合本地语境和多模态手段回应学生的多重困难。

papers.title: FAIRITHM: Unlearning Bias and Rewriting for Fairness
papers.authors: 남윤진, Donghui Lim, Sungkyun Im, Zuobin Xiong, Jeongeun Park
papers.abstract: Bias-mitigation research largely emphasizes English-language benchmarks over interactive tools. FAIRITHM is an interactive Korean bias-rewriting system combining a KcBERT bias-assessment module updated using partitioned contrastive gradient unlearning (PCGU) with GPT-4o rewriting. Based on 12,720 sentences across six bias domains, it provides sentence- and token-level pseudo-log-likelihood difference signals, reduced-bias revision candidates, and visual feedback. Evaluation showed largely preserved language-modeling performance and a statistically reliable directional signal supporting advisory screening rather than autonomous classification. In a source-blinded study with 34 participants, AI revisions received higher perceived fairness and sentence completeness ratings but lower meaning preservation ratings than revisions by one expert; perceived bias improvement did not differ significantly. AI revisions were preferred for fairness and appropriateness for use, but not clearly for overall trustworthiness. Perceived usability was acceptable (System Usability Scale: 72.72), whereas future trust and use intention were neutral. These findings support calibrated, human-supervised bias rewriting rather than full automation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了面向韩语的交互式偏见改写系统 FAIRITHM，将基于 PCGU 更新的 KcBERT 偏见评估模块与 GPT-4o 改写结合，在六个偏见领域的句子数据上提供句子级和词元级信号、降偏改写候选与可视化反馈。评估显示语言建模性能大体保持，方向性信号支持辅助筛查而非自主分类；在参与者研究中，AI 改写被评公平性和句子完整性更高，但意义保留低于专家改写，感知偏见改善无显著差异，AI 改写更受偏好用于公平性和适用性，整体可信度偏好不明确，可用性可接受而未来信任与使用意愿中性。结果支持有人监督的校准式偏见改写，而非完全自动化。

papers.title: Generative AI and Differentiated Instruction in Private Undergraduate English Education: Implementation Pathways and a Conceptual Framework
papers.authors: Shu Shen, Lijuan Shen
papers.journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Progressive Education and Development
papers.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has reopened an old question in language pedagogy: how to teach heterogeneous classrooms without leaving slower or more advanced learners behind. In the Chinese private undergraduate sector, non-English majors often enter with uneven proficiency while large class sizes constrain individual attention, so the traditional ideal of teaching according to aptitude has remained more aspiration than routine practice. This paper argues that GenAI, used deliberately, can operationalize differentiated instruction at scale. Drawing on Tomlinson's differentiation framework, Vygotsky's zone of proximal development, and technology-acceptance theory, the paper develops a conceptual model and proposes six implementation pathways: diagnostic profiling, AI-generated tiered materials, personalized feedback, learner choice in products, teacher role reconfiguration, and integrity safeguards. The analysis situates each pathway within the constraints of private undergraduate institutions and connects it to the conditions under which differentiated judgment is preserved rather than displaced. The paper concludes by discussing the theoretical implications of framing GenAI as an engine for teacher-led differentiation and by outlining the propositions that future empirical work should test.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对中国民办本科非英语专业学生水平参差、大班教学难以因材施教的问题，探讨生成式人工智能如何支持规模化差异化教学。作者基于Tomlinson差异化框架、最近发展区理论和技术接受理论构建概念模型，提出诊断画像、AI生成分层材料、个性化反馈、学习者产品选择、教师角色重构与诚信保障六条实施路径，并将各路径置于民办院校的现实约束中分析。文章强调GenAI应作为教师主导差异化判断的辅助工具而非替代，最后提出供后续实证检验的命题，属于理论性概念研究，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: From AI Knowledge to Pedagogical Practice: A Conceptual Framework for AI-Integrated STEM Education among Rural Primary Science Teachers
papers.authors: Caroline Anak Edmund Kenawang, Nurfaradilla Mohamad Nasri
papers.journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Progressive Education and Development
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing education, particularly in teaching, learning, assessment and educational decision-making. However, its educational value largely depends on teachers’ ability to apply their AI knowledge in pedagogically meaningful ways in the classroom. This conceptual paper proposes a framework for the understanding of transitioning of rural primary science teachers into learning and teaching Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) with AI. Drawing on the latest literature on AI literacy, teacher readiness for AI, AI-integrated STEM pedagogical practice, professional development and technology integration in rural areas. The paper identifies three interrelated constructs comprising AI knowledge, AI readiness and AI-integrated STEM pedagogical practice. Will-Skill-Tool is the most important theoretical lens used to understand the importance of enabling resources and institutional conditions, teacher knowledge and willingness. The proposed framework situates AI readiness between the knowledge and the pedagogical practice, recognizes a pathway from knowledge to practice and provides room for the development of AI competence in the form of literacy. The concept of ‘rural contextual conditions’ focuses on factors that can support or hinder implementation such as digital infrastructure, access to AI tools, professional development and school support. The framework includes propositions and implications for teachers, professional development providers, school leaders, policymakers and additional empirical research.
papers.summary_zh: 该概念性论文针对农村小学科学教师如何将人工智能知识转化为STEM教学实践这一问题，提出了一个整合性框架。作者基于AI素养、教师AI准备度、AI融入STEM教学实践、专业发展及农村技术整合等文献，识别出AI知识、AI准备度与AI融入的STEM教学实践三个相互关联的构念，并以“意愿—技能—工具”视角理解使能资源、制度条件、教师知识与意愿的作用。框架将AI准备度置于知识与教学实践之间，勾勒出从知识到实践的转化路径，并纳入数字基础设施、AI工具可及性、专业发展和学校支持等农村情境条件。文末给出相关命题及对教师、专业发展提供者、学校领导者、政策制定者和后续实证研究的启示。

papers.title: The Role of Digital Innovation in Enhancing Hifz Al-Quran Achievement in Tahfiz Education: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.authors: Nor Haliena Rasli, Isa Hamzah
papers.journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Progressive Education and Development
papers.abstract: The rapid development of digital technology has created opportunities to support Hifz al-Quran education through digital memorisation applications, interactive multimedia, online learning platforms and emerging artificial intelligence (AI) tools. However, the extent to which these technologies improve measurable Hifz outcomes remains unclear. This systematic literature review examined the roles, forms and reported effects of digital innovation in Tahfiz education. Searches were conducted in Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar and MyJurnal for studies published between 2020 and July 2026 in English or Malay. The manuscript records 280 identified records, of which 75 duplicates were removed; 205 records were screened, 50 full texts were assessed, and 24 studies were included in the synthesis. Thematic synthesis organised the literature into four dimensions: digital memorisation applications, interactive multimedia, digital learning platforms and AI. Across the included literature, digital tools were reported to support access to resources, repetition and murajaah, motivation, learner autonomy, monitoring and continuity of learning. Nevertheless, the evidence presented is more consistent for learning support and learner perceptions than for demonstrable improvements in memorisation accuracy, tasmi’ fluency, memorisation quantity or retention. Digital tools should therefore complement, rather than replace, teacher-guided talaqqi, musyafahah, tasmi’ and murajaah. The review identifies a need for transparent quality appraisal and further empirical studies using clearly defined Hifz outcome measures.

papers.title: The Impact of Dynamic Cloud Computing and Employee Value Co-Creation on Employee Productivity
papers.authors: Tayyiba KHALIL, Harcharanjit Singh, Afra Al-Zadjali
papers.journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Business and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: Despite significant investments in advanced digital infrastructures, organizations continue to face the “digital productivity paradox,” where technological capacity fails to translate into sustained performance gains. This paper advances a conceptual framework positioning Employee Value Co-Creation (EVCC) as the critical mediator between dynamic cloud computing environments and employee productivity. Drawing on Service-Dominant Logic and Job Demands-Resources Theory, EVCC is operationalized as a unidimensional construct that captures employees’ role as resource integrators who actively reshape workflows and solve operational challenges in collaboration with technology. Rather than treating employees as passive adopters, the framework highlights their agency in co-producing task efficiency, output quality, and organizational agility. By reframing digital workplaces as bottom-up ecosystems of co-creation, this study contributes to Information Systems, Service-Dominant Logic, and Strategic Human Resource Management literatures, offering both theoretical insight and practical guidance for managers seeking to transform IT investments into measurable productivity outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对企业数字基础设施投入难以转化为持续绩效的“数字生产力悖论”，提出一个概念框架，将员工价值共创置于动态云计算环境与员工生产力之间，作为关键中介。作者依据服务主导逻辑与工作需求—资源理论，把员工价值共创操作化为单维构念，强调员工并非被动采用技术，而是作为资源整合者主动重塑工作流程、协同解决运营问题，从而共同产出任务效率、产出质量与组织敏捷性。文章属理论建构，未报告实证检验，其贡献在于把数字工作场所重新理解为自下而上的共创生态，并为管理者将IT投资转化为可测生产力结果提供思路。

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence and Teaching According to Aptitude in Private Undergraduate College English: A Production-Oriented Approach Framework
papers.authors: Huifan Chen, Lijuan Shen
papers.journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Business and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping how language is taught and learned, yet its potential to support teaching according to each learner's aptitude—a long-stated ideal in Chinese higher education—remains under-theorized, especially in resource-constrained private undergraduate institutions. This conceptual paper proposes a framework that embeds GenAI within the Production-Oriented Approach (POA) to enable differentiated, aptitude-responsive college English instruction at scale. Drawing on POA's three-stage cycle (driving, enabling, assessing) and on established accounts of differentiated instruction and individual differences in second language acquisition, the paper unpacks six implementation pathways: AI-assisted diagnostic profiling, adaptive enabling materials, culturally situated micro-content, differentiated production tasks, automated personalized feedback, and teacher mediation with integrity safeguards. Rather than treating GenAI as a substitute for pedagogical judgment, the framework positions it as an engine that extends the teacher's capacity to respond to learner readiness, interest, and learning profile. The paper clarifies the conditions under which such a model is likely to succeed, flags risks of over-reliance and inequity, and offers propositions for future empirical testing. It is offered as a theoretical contribution, not a report of an empirical study.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇概念性论文，针对资源有限的民办本科院校中生成式人工智能如何支持大学英语因材施教这一问题，提出将生成式人工智能嵌入产出导向法（POA）的理论框架。作者基于POA的驱动、促成、评价三阶段，结合差异化教学与二语个体差异研究，梳理出AI辅助诊断画像、自适应促成材料、差异化产出任务、个性化反馈及教师中介等六条实施路径，并将AI定位为扩展教师回应学习者准备度、兴趣与学习画像能力的工具，而非教学判断的替代品。文章进一步说明该模式可能奏效的条件，提示过度依赖与公平性风险，并提出供后续实证检验的命题；其本身为理论贡献，而非实证研究报告。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in biology education: Perspectives of pre-service biology teachers
papers.authors: Asya Asenova
papers.journal: Annual of Sofia University "St Kliment Ohridski" Faculty of Biology Book 2 – Botany
papers.abstract: This study explores the attitudes, perceptions, and expectations of pre-service biology teachers regarding the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in the educational process. Using a combination of case studies and student-created visualizations, the research examines how AI can support teaching and learning in biology. The findings indicate that students view AI as a pedagogical assistant that enhances the visualization of complex biological processes, facilitates personalized learning, and promotes student engagement. At the same time, participants demonstrated a critical understanding of potential risks, including over-reliance on technology and the need for critical evaluation of AI-generated content. The results highlight the importance of an active teacher role and the development of both digital and pedagogical competencies in future educators. Overall, the study suggests that AI has significant potential to enrich biology education when implemented as a complementary tool within a balanced, pedagogically guided approach.
