papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察职前生物教师对人工智能融入教学的态度、认知与期待，采用案例研究与学习者自制可视化相结合的方式。结果显示，参与者把AI视为教学助手，认为它有助于呈现复杂生物过程、支持个性化学习并提升学生参与度；同时他们也意识到过度依赖技术和不加批判地使用AI生成内容的风险。作者据此强调教师主动角色的重要性，以及未来教育者数字素养与教学能力的共同发展，认为AI作为教学引导下的补充工具才能丰富生物教育。

papers.title: Transformasi Digital UMKM Penyedia Pangan Sekolah Melalui Implementasi Sistem Pendukung Keputusan Berbasis Machine Learning
papers.authors: Ulya Ilhami Arsyah, Fanni Sukma, Rahmi Putri Kurnia, Mutiana Pratiwi
papers.abstract: Warung Pak Mul merupakan salah satu Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM) di Kota Padang yang mengelola layanan katering dan program makan bergizi bagi beberapa sekolah swasta dan instansi, namun pengelolaan usahanya masih dilakukan secara manual melalui papan tulis dan lembar kerja sederhana sehingga rawan kesalahan pencatatan, sulit direkap, dan tidak mendukung perencanaan menu maupun pengendalian biaya secara akurat. Kegiatan penerapan iptek ini bertujuan mentransformasi pengelolaan mitra melalui pengembangan dan implementasi Sistem Pendukung Keputusan (SPK) berbasis machine learning yang mengintegrasikan data historis pesanan, ketersediaan bahan baku, kebutuhan gizi, dan biaya produksi untuk menghasilkan rekomendasi menu yang optimal. Metode pelaksanaan meliputi koordinasi dan analisis kebutuhan mitra, perancangan arsitektur sistem, pengembangan model machine learning untuk prediksi permintaan dan rekomendasi menu, digitalisasi dan migrasi data awal, pelatihan serta pendampingan operator, dan evaluasi kinerja sistem. Sistem yang dikembangkan terdiri atas lima modul utama, yaitu manajemen pesanan, manajemen bahan baku, perencanaan produksi, pencatatan dan analisis biaya, serta rekomendasi menu berbasis machine learning. Hasil implementasi menunjukkan bahwa digitalisasi pencatatan mampu menggantikan proses manual pada papan tulis dan Excel sederhana, sementara pelatihan dan pendampingan meningkatkan literasi digital mitra dalam menginterpretasikan rekomendasi sistem untuk pengambilan keputusan operasional sehari-hari. Kegiatan ini diharapkan menjadi model replikatif transformasi digital bagi UMKM penyedia pangan sekolah lain dalam mendukung pengelolaan usaha yang lebih efisien, akurat, dan berbasis data. Warung Pak Mul is a micro, small, and medium enterprise (MSME) in Padang City that manages catering and nutritious meal services for several private schools and institutions, yet its operations still rely on manual whiteboard notes and simple spreadsheets that are prone to recording errors, difficult to recapitulate, and unable to support accurate menu planning or cost control. This community service activity aims to transform the partner's business management through the development and implementation of a machine learning-based Decision Support System (DSS) that integrates historical order data, raw material availability, nutritional requirements, and production costs to generate optimal menu recommendations. The implementation method consists of partner needs analysis, system architecture design, machine learning model development for demand prediction and menu recommendation, digitalization and initial data migration, operator training and mentoring, and system performance evaluation. The developed system comprises five main modules: order management, raw material management, production planning, cost recording and analysis, and machine learning-based menu recommendation. The implementation results show that digitized recording has replaced the manual whiteboard and spreadsheet process, while training and mentoring improved the partner's digital literacy in interpreting system recommendations for daily operational decisions. This activity is expected to serve as a replicable model of digital transformation for other school-food MSMEs seeking more efficient, accurate, and data-driven management.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对巴东市一家为学校提供餐饮与营养餐服务的中小企业仍依赖白板和简单表格手工管理、易出错且难以支持菜单规划与成本控制的问题，开发并实施了基于机器学习的决策支持系统，整合历史订单、原料供应、营养需求和生产成本等数据以生成菜单推荐。系统包含订单、原料、生产计划、成本记录分析和菜单推荐五个模块，实施中完成了数据数字化迁移以及操作人员培训和陪伴。结果显示，数字化记录取代了原有手工流程，培训与陪伴也提升了合作方解读系统推荐并用于日常运营决策的数字素养。作者将这一实践视为可供其他学校供餐中小企业借鉴的数字化转型模式，但摘要未报告系统预测性能或经营效益的量化评估。

papers.title: Enhancing the validity of probability prompts using four generative artificial intelligence tools
papers.authors: Ayşe Fethiye Gemci, Amanda Gantt Sawyer, Haley M. Smiley, Richard Busi, Juliana Galano
papers.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (genAI) has become a large influence on students and teachers in the mathematics classroom. Specifically, researchers found that genAI tools could solve probability questions such as “What is the probability of drawing the Queen of Hearts from a standard deck of playing cards on the first try?” These researchers also stated that the genAI tools could not be trusted when solving, “Three cards are lying face down in front of me. Two are face cards, and there are no spades. No card is next to a card of the same color. What are the odds that the card on the left is the Queen of Hearts?” However, it is unclear whether that statement is true. Thus, we verified these findings by investigating four genAI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Co-Pilot, and Claude AI) on their ability to complete the identified probability task to determine when genAI can be trusted to perform probability calculation. Using the results of this investigation, we examined these genAI models using their responses and the predictions made by the genAI trainer. The investigation implies that developing mathematical validity requires intentional instruction, including teaching students how to compare genAI’s explanations, conducting GenAI Triangulation Process, cross-checking results using independent methods or alternative tools, and justifying whether an answer is mathematically sound.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对生成式人工智能在数学课堂中处理概率问题的可信度问题，检验了ChatGPT、Gemini、Co-Pilot和Claude AI四款工具完成特定概率任务的能力，以判断其何时可被信任用于概率计算。作者通过比较这些模型的回答与训练方预测，发现模型表现存在差异，说明其数学有效性并不可靠。文章据此提出，培养学生的数学有效性需要有意设计的教学，包括教学生比较不同生成式AI的解释、开展“生成式AI三角验证”、用独立方法或替代工具交叉核对结果，并判断答案在数学上是否成立。

papers.title: When Algorithms Enter the Prosecutor’s Office: The Limits of Artificial Intelligence in Supporting Prosecutorial Decision-Making in the Vietnamese Context
papers.authors: Bien Thi Ngoc Dao, Nguyen Van Tinh
papers.journal: HAL (Le Centre pour la Communication Scientifique Directe)
papers.abstract: This article examines the potential, risks, and legal requirements of using artificial intelligence (AI) to support prosecutorial decision-making in Vietnam’s People’s Procuracy. Through an analysis of relevant studies and legal provisions, this article clarifies how AI could assist prosecutors in organizing statements, cross-checking evidence, identifying issues requiring further clarification, and preparing draft documents. However, AI may distort evidence, favor the prosecution, or produce conclusions that are difficult to verify. Reliance on AI recommendations and the risk of disclosing case-file information may affect the quality of prosecutorial work and the rights of accused persons. The findings show that greater efficiency in AI-assisted information processing is not sufficient to ensure that a recommendation to prosecute is well-founded. The current legal framework provides a basis for oversight, but it needs to be further developed to address the specific requirements of prosecutorial practice. The article recommends a phased approach to AI deployment, with measures to ensure that its outputs are traceable, to test for bias, to protect data, and to provide meaningful human oversight, while preserving the independent assessment of evidence and the decision-making responsibility of authorized officials.
papers.summary_zh: 该文通过分析相关研究与法律条文，考察越南人民检察院运用人工智能辅助检察决策的潜力、风险与法律要求。文章指出，AI可协助整理陈述、核对证据、识别待澄清问题并起草文书，但也可能扭曲证据、偏向控方或产生难以核实的结论；对AI建议的依赖和案卷信息泄露风险会影响检察工作质量与被告权利。作者强调，信息处理效率的提升不足以确保起诉建议有充分依据，现行法律框架虽为监督提供基础，仍需针对检察实践的具体要求加以完善，并建议分阶段部署AI，配套输出可追溯、偏见测试、数据保护和有意义的人类监督等措施，同时保留对证据的独立评估与授权官员的决策责任。

papers.title: From Repositories to Ecosystems: The Strategic Evolution, Institutional Practices, and Policy Frameworks of Open Educational Resource Initiatives in Higher Education
papers.authors: Pham Van Thinh
papers.journal: European Journal of Contemporary Education and E-Learning
papers.abstract: Open Educational Resources (OER) in higher education are shifting from models centred on the creation and storage of learning materials towards structures characterised by greater connectivity and institutionalisation. This study analyses this development across four dimensions: the emergence of repositories; infrastructure connectivity and interoperability; the institutionalisation of OER in association with Open Educational Practices (OEP); and the formation of adaptive OER ecosystems. Drawing on a review and mapping of the literature, policy analysis, and a comparison of selected prominent OER initiatives, the study conceptualises the development of OER as a five-level progression: repository, organised production, institutionalisation, ecosystem, and adaptive/AI-enabled ecosystem. The findings indicate that repositories constitute a necessary infrastructural condition, but are insufficient in themselves to ensure the effective use, reuse, and sustainability of OER. Interoperability, stakeholder capacities, pedagogical practices, policies, and governance mechanisms become increasingly important as OER expands. Accordingly, the study argues that an OER ecosystem should be understood as a structure comprising interconnected components that can adapt to technological change, particularly the development of generative AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察高等教育中开放教育资源（OER）如何从以资源创建和存储为中心的模式，转向连通性更强、制度化程度更高的结构。作者通过文献综述与映射、政策分析以及若干代表性OER项目的比较，将OER发展概括为从仓储、有组织生产、制度化、生态系统到自适应/人工智能赋能生态系统的五级递进。研究发现，仓储是必要的基础设施条件，但本身不足以保障OER的有效使用、复用与可持续性；随着OER扩展，互操作性、利益相关者能力、教学实践、政策与治理机制日益重要。文章据此主张将OER生态系统理解为由相互关联组件构成、能够适应技术变化（尤其是生成式人工智能发展）的结构。

papers.title: Boden, Margaret, 1936-2025
papers.authors: Andy Clark
papers.journal: Biographical Memoirs of Fellows of the British Academy
papers.abstract: Margaret (‘Maggie’) Boden was a philosopher and psychologist whose unique interdisciplinary vision helped shape the discipline of Cognitive Science. Her work was among the first to explore the promise of Artificial Intelligence as a source of insights into the human mind. She paid special attention to the role of AI as a tool for unraveling the nature of human insight and creativity. That work continues to inform debate today, and is perhaps more important than ever in the dawning age of ‘artificial general intelligence’. Maggie was also an influential mentor, a public intellectual, and a notable contributor to the British Academy
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇纪念性文章，梳理哲学家与心理学家Margaret Boden的学术贡献。她以跨学科视野参与塑造认知科学，较早探讨人工智能作为理解人类心智的启发来源，并特别关注AI如何帮助揭示人类洞察与创造力的本质。文章指出，她的相关工作至今仍影响相关争论，在所谓通用人工智能兴起的背景下可能比以往更重要；文中还提及她作为导师、公共知识分子及英国学术院贡献者的角色。摘要未报告实证研究或具体方法。

papers.title: Understanding Teachers’ Ethical AI Use: A Backward Mapping Study in Indonesian Vocational Education
papers.authors: Nisrina Nur Aini, Febrina Aliefia Zahra, Yaya Nur Fajar Tri Rahmadani, Muhammad Saiful Anwar, Muh. Zacky Fadhil Rachmat
papers.journal: Edu Society Jurnal Pendidikan Ilmu Sosial Dan Pengabdian Kepada Masyarakat
papers.abstract: Previous studies have examined artificial intelligence (AI) adoption in education, focusing primarily on pedagogical benefits, digital competence, and ethical challenges. However, limited attention has been paid to how AI ethics are implemented at the school level through the interplay between educators’ practices, institutional arrangements, and policy awareness. This study analyzes the implementation of AI ethics among teachers at SMK Negeri 3 Yogyakarta, Indonesia, through Richard Elmore’s backward mapping perspective. Using a qualitative case study design, data were collected through participant observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation involving the vice principal, teachers, and students. The findings reveal that teachers use AI to support lesson planning, instructional material development, and assessment. Although teachers recognize ethical risks, particularly data security and students’ dependence on technology, most have limited understanding of Minister of Communication and Informatics Circular Letter No. 9 of 2023 on AI ethics. Consequently, ethical practices remain informal and largely dependent on individual teachers’ discretion. Key barriers include inadequate infrastructure, limited policy dissemination, and the absence of school-specific AI regulations. These findings highlight the need to align national ethical guidance with institutional policies, teacher capacity development, and practical school-level implementation. The study’s original contribution is its identification of a gap between teachers’ emerging ethical awareness and the institutional mechanisms required to translate AI ethics into consistent educational practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以印度尼西亚一所职业高中为案例，采用回溯映射视角的质性个案设计，考察教师如何在日常教学中落实人工智能伦理。研究发现，教师已把人工智能用于备课、教学材料开发和评估，也能意识到数据安全与学生技术依赖等风险，但多数人对国家相关伦理通函了解有限，伦理实践因而停留在非正式层面，主要依靠教师个人判断。基础设施不足、政策传达不畅和学校层面专门规定的缺失构成主要障碍。文章据此指出，教师的伦理意识与将其转化为一致实践所需的制度机制之间存在落差，需要把国家层面的伦理指引与学校政策、教师能力建设和实际执行衔接起来。

papers.title: The Impact of Integrating Human Expertise and Artificial Intelligence on Improving Logistics Decision-Making: A Field Study in the Saudi Environment
papers.authors: Faisal Mohammed Al-Rashidi, Said Mahfoudh Toumi
papers.journal: International Journal of Accounting and Management Sciences
papers.abstract: The study aimed to identify the effect of combining human experience and artificial intelligence to improve logistical decision-making. A field study on the Saudi environment was conducted, where the descriptive analytical method was used as the study method to analyze the effect of human experience and artificial intelligence as independent variables on rationalizing logistical decisions as the dependent variable. A field study was conducted on a sample of Saudi joint-stock companies, where the sample size was 111 individuals, and the SPSS statistical program was used to conduct the statistical analysis. The study concluded with several findings: A statistically significant relationship (p < 0.05) exists between artificial intelligence and improved logistical decision-making. However, no statistically significant relationship (p > 0.05) exists between human experience and improved logistical decision- making, as the study relies solely on human experience without the use of artificial intelligence. Furthermore, the statistical results indicate a statistically significant relationship (p < 0.05) between the integration of both artificial intelligence and human experience and improved logistical decision- making. The study made several recommendations, including paying attention to artificial intelligence education at all educational levels, providing training courses to raise the level of performance of workers in the field of artificial intelligence, and focusing on conducting research and studies in the field of artificial intelligence in the Saudi environment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以沙特联合股份公司为对象开展实地调查，用描述性分析方法考察人工智能与人类经验对改善物流决策的作用。结果显示，人工智能与物流决策改善之间存在显著关系，而单独依靠人类经验与决策改善之间未发现显著关系；但两者整合后与物流决策改善呈显著关系。作者据此建议重视各教育阶段的人工智能教育、开展相关培训，并加强沙特环境下的人工智能研究。

papers.title: Responsible AI In Credit Portfolio Growth: A Risk-Controlled Framework For Artificial Intelligence–Driven Lending In U.S. Banks
papers.authors: Юлія Лук'яненко
papers.journal: International Journal of Business & Management Studies
papers.abstract: This study develops and validates GUARD (Governance, Underwriting integrity, Accountability, Resilience, Disclosure), a risk-controlled framework for the deployment of artificial intelligence in credit origination and portfolio management by U.S. banking organizations. It examines how lenders can convert AI-driven underwriting into sustained credit portfolio growth while retaining defensible control over fair lending exposure, model risk, and consumer explanation obligations, in a supervisory environment that between April 2025 and June 2026 moved decisively from prescriptive to principles-based expectations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对美国银行在AI信贷审批与组合管理中如何兼顾业务增长与风险可控的问题，提出并验证了GUARD框架，涵盖治理、承保诚信、问责、韧性与披露五个方面。研究关注在监管从规则导向转向原则导向的背景下，贷款机构如何对公平信贷风险、模型风险和消费者解释义务保持可辩护的控制。摘要未报告具体验证方法与实证结果，因此无法判断框架的实际效果。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Tools and the Enhancement of Inclusive Learning for Business Education Students with Special Needs in Rivers State Universities
papers.authors: Yiraodi Joel Godpower
papers.journal: IIARD INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF ECONOMICS AND BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
papers.abstract: The study examined the relationship between Artificial Intelligence Tools and the enhancement of inclusive learning for Business Education students with special needs in Rivers State Universities. The study adopted a correlational research design. Two research questions were posed, and two corresponding null hypotheses were formulated to guide the conduct of the study. The population of the study comprised 2,088 level 100, 200, 300, and 400 undergraduate Business Education students for the 2025/2026 academic session in Rivers State University (RSU), Ignatius Ajuru University of Education, and the University of Port Harcourt. Krejcie and Morgan’s (1970) table for determining sample size was used, and 322 students were selected for data analysis after applying the formula. The justification for selecting level 100–400 undergraduate Business Education students was based on the assumption that they may have faced various challenges in their pursuit of higher education and are therefore more experienced to provide the researcher with the required information for the study. Two instruments, “Questionnaire on Artificial Intelligence Tools” (QAIT) and “Questionnaire on Enhancing Inclusive Learning for Business Education Students with Special Needs” (QEILBES), were used to elicit responses from the respondents. The instruments were validated through expert judgment of two experts from Business Education and one from Measurement and Evaluation. All inputs and corrections fromthe experts were incorporated to modify and refine the instruments. The reliability of the instruments was established using the test–retest method. Pearson’s Product Moment Correlation Coefficient was used to analyze the two sets of data, yielding reliability coefficients of 0.74 for QAIT and 0.73 for QEILBES. Pearson’s Product Moment Correlation Coefficient, with the aid of SPSS version 2023, was used to answer the research questions and test the hypotheses using a p value of 0.05 level of significance. The findings of the study revealed that there is a significant relationship between ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Otter.ai tools and the enhancement of inclusive learning for Business Education students with special needs in Rivers State Universities. Based on the findings, the researcher recommended, among others, that university management and Business Education departments should integrate ChatGPT as a formal support tool in teaching and learning by providing students with guided access and training. Furthermore, Microsoft Copilot should be incorporated into classroom and assignment activities, especially for students with special needs, by leveraging its accessibility features such as real-time transcription, translation, document-reading support, and adaptive content creation for a better learning experience since all students cannot learn at the same space due to individual differences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以尼日利亚河流州三所大学的商科教育本科生为对象，采用相关研究设计，通过问卷考察ChatGPT、Microsoft Copilot和Otter.ai等人工智能工具与特殊需要学生包容性学习增强之间的关系。结果显示，这三种工具的使用与包容性学习的增强均存在显著相关。作者据此建议高校将ChatGPT作为正式教学支持工具并配套指导与培训，同时把Microsoft Copilot融入课堂和作业活动，利用其实时转写、翻译、文档阅读支持和自适应内容生成等功能，以适应学生的个体差异。需要说明的是，相关设计只能表明工具使用与包容性学习增强之间存在关联，尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: Empowerment of Islamic Religious Education Teachers through Generative AI Training for the Development of Islamic Value-Based Learning Media at SMP Negeri 35 Medan
papers.authors: Marhan Hasibuan, Muhammad Arif Hidayat
papers.abstract: The development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, particularly Generative AI, has created new opportunities for developing innovative, interactive, and contextual learning media. However, many Islamic Religious Education (IRE) teachers still have limited competencies in utilizing this technology as a learning medium while maintaining Islamic values. This Community Service Program (PKM) aimed to improve the competence of IRE teachers at SMP Negeri 35 Medan in utilizing Generative AI to develop creative, effective, and Islamic value-based learning media. The program employed a Participatory Action Learning approach consisting of needs identification, educational sessions, practical training, mentoring, and evaluation. The training involved demonstrations and hands-on practice using various Generative AI platforms, including ChatGPT, Canva AI, Gamma AI, and Microsoft Copilot, to develop teaching materials, presentations, assessment questions, and visual learning media based on Islamic values. The results indicated an improvement in participants' understanding of Generative AI, enhanced skills in developing digital learning media, and increased awareness of the ethical use of AI from an Islamic perspective. The teachers were able to produce learning media that were more engaging, interactive, contextual, and supportive of the implementation of the Merdeka Curriculum. This program contributed positively to improving teachers' digital literacy while strengthening the integration of technology and Islamic values in the IRE learning process.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对伊斯兰宗教教育教师在利用生成式人工智能开发学习媒体方面能力有限的问题，在 SMP Negeri 35 Medan 开展了一项社区服务项目，采用参与式行动学习方式，通过需求识别、讲座、实操训练、辅导和评估等环节，让教师练习使用 ChatGPT、Canva AI、Gamma AI 和 Microsoft Copilot 等平台制作教学材料、演示文稿、评估题目和视觉学习媒体。结果显示，参与者对生成式人工智能的理解有所提升，开发数字学习媒体的技能得到增强，并从伊斯兰视角提高了对人工智能伦理使用的意识，能够产出更具吸引力、互动性和情境性的学习媒体，以支持 Merdeka 课程的实施。该项目在提升教师数字素养的同时，也促进了技术与伊斯兰价值观在宗教教育过程中的整合。

papers.title: Improving Teachers' Competence In Designing AI-Assisted Learning Media At Yayasan Rahmat Islamiyah Medan
papers.authors: Hasrian Rudi Setiawan, Mavianti Mavianti, Isman Efendi Limbong, Dhety Tri Royani, Ayumna Ayumna
papers.abstract: This community service program was conducted to improve teachers' competence in designing Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted learning media at Yayasan Rahmat Islamiyah, Medan. The program was motivated by the gap between the rapid development of AI-based educational technology and the limited digital pedagogical capacity of teachers in many Islamic educational foundations, which still rely on conventional, text-based teaching media. Teachers at the foundation faced difficulties in producing communicative visual, audio-visual, presentation, and video-based learning media, as well as in building effective communication with young learners. The program was carried out through four stages adapted from the management cycle of planning, organizing, actuating, and controlling, followed by an evaluation stage using Kirkpatrick's four-level model. Activities included lectures, hands-on workshops, mentoring, and simulation of AI tool usage such as Canva AI, CapCut AI, and presentation-generation platforms, grounded in the Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge framework. Results show a significant increase in teachers' knowledge and skills, reflected in pre-test and post-test scores, active participation, and the production of AI-assisted teaching media by all participants. Teachers also reported improved confidence in communicating with children through more engaging, visualized instructional content. This PKM concludes that structured, AI-based media-design training effectively strengthens teacher competence and can serve as a sustainable model for continuous professional development in Islamic educational foundations facing similar digital transformation challenges.
papers.summary_zh: 该社区服务项目针对伊斯兰教育基金会教师数字教学能力不足、仍依赖传统文本教学媒体的问题，基于TPACK框架，通过讲座、实操工作坊、辅导和AI工具模拟等方式，开展AI辅助学习媒体设计的培训。结果显示，教师的知识与技能在前后测中明显提升，参与积极，且全部参与者都产出了AI辅助教学媒体；教师还表示，借助更具吸引力的可视化内容，与儿童沟通的信心有所增强。文章据此认为，结构化的AI媒体设计培训能有效提升教师能力，可作为类似机构持续专业发展的参考模式。

papers.title: NEUROLEARN - A Learning Platform for Neurodiverse Students
papers.authors: Prof. Mallamma C G, Akshaya Shreem N L, Monisha Gladys F, Aditi Kumari, Anushree R
papers.journal: International Scientific Journal of Engineering and Management
papers.abstract: Kids with autism, ADHD, or dyslexia hit roadblocks in regular schools their brains just work differently when it comes to focusing, thinking, or picking up new stuff at their own pace. That's why we built NeuroLearn AI: a web tool powered by smart tech that customizes lessons just for you, making school feel welcoming and doable. It keeps an eye on how you click, learn, and perform, then switches things up right away like easing the challenge level, changing how info shows up, or matching your best way to absorb it. You'll get helpers to stay on track, clean layouts that won't stress you out, game-like challenges to make it fun, and choices for seeing, hearing, or doing activities. All this ramps up what sticks in your head without overwhelming you, helps you learn on your own, and ditches that nagging school worry. Parents and teachers see updates as you go. Bottom line, NeuroLearn smooths out the bumps, making education fair for everyone—no matter how your mind ticks. Keywords: Neurodiversity, Adaptive Learning, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Personalized Education, Web Platform.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自闭症、ADHD或阅读障碍等神经多样性学生在常规学校中面临的学习障碍，设计并实现了一个名为NeuroLearn AI的网页学习平台。平台通过智能技术追踪学生的点击、学习与表现行为，并据此实时调整难度、信息呈现方式或匹配其偏好的吸收方式，同时提供进度辅助、简洁界面、游戏化挑战及视、听、做等多种活动选择。摘要称这些设计有助于提升知识留存、促进自主学习并减轻学习焦虑，家长和教师也可同步查看进展。不过摘要未报告任何实证评估或量化结果，其效果主张尚属设计层面的预期，而非已验证的因果结论。

papers.title: Investigating AI-Mediated Informal Digital Learning of English Practices among Indonesian Undergraduates
papers.authors: Muhsiyana Nurul Aisyiah, Listiana Ikawati
papers.abstract: AI’s unprecedented advancement has impacted various fields, including foreign language learning. This research aimed to investigate EFL students’ engagement with AI for their informal English Learning and their perceptions regarding AI’s practicality and challenges. Using an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design, this study carried out an online survey involving 82 students in the quantitative phase. It was followed by semi-structured interviews in the qualitative phase. Descriptive statistics and thematic analysis were employed to discover the patterns of AI’s acceptance, students’ voices on AI’s usability, AI practicality, reasons for using AI, and analytical considerations. The quantitative phase indicates that the percentage of AI use is high (97.6%), but its usage frequency remains moderate. Students approved AI’s usefulness for developing their vocabulary, assisting their writing, and regulating their own learning. Students also voiced concerns about accuracy and critical thinking loss (M=4.11) and overreliance. Semi-structured interviews with four students provided more profound insights that AI use was formed by accessibility and platform familiarity. Supporting the quantitative phase findings, students claimed AI was an easy, emotionally supportive, and helpful learning aid, but faced challenges in creating effective prompts and avoiding dependency. This study implies that students’ AI literacy advancement is mandatory to encourage more efficient, analytical, and independent AI-mediated informal language learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察印尼本科生如何将人工智能用于非正式的英语学习，以及他们如何看待AI的实用性与局限。作者采用解释性序列混合方法，先对82名学生进行在线问卷调查，再对其中4人进行半结构化访谈，以描述性统计和主题分析梳理使用模式与看法。结果显示，AI使用比例很高但使用频率中等；学生认可AI在词汇、写作和自我调节学习方面的帮助，同时也担忧准确性、批判性思维削弱和过度依赖，访谈进一步指出可及性与平台熟悉度塑造了使用方式，并提到提示词撰写和避免依赖的困难。文章据此强调提升学生AI素养的必要性。

papers.title: An Evidence-Grounded Framework for Evaluating AI-Generated Educational Feedback
papers.authors: Xinqi Yang
papers.abstract: Educational feedback generated by artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in teaching, but there are still differences in how to evaluate its quality in existing research. This study examined 68 empirical studies and compared the criteria, methods, evaluators, and evidence used in these evaluations. The results show that the relevant evaluation can be roughly summarised into three dimensions: Evidence Validity, Rubric and Task Alignment, and Pedagogical Usefulness. Evidence Validity focuses on whether the feedback is accurate and reliable, and is based on the learner's actual work. Rubric and Task Alignment focuses on whether the feedback meets the task requirements, evaluation criteria, and learner responses. Pedagogical Usefulness focuses on whether the feedback is clear, specific, actionable, and can support revision and further learning. The reviewed studies also used a variety of evidence to judge the quality of feedback, including human judgement, learner perceptions, revision behaviour, learning outcomes, and automated metrics. Based on these findings, this study proposes an evaluation framework that links different dimensions of feedback quality with corresponding evidence to provide clearer evaluation ideas for subsequent research and educational practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何评价人工智能生成的教育反馈质量，梳理了68项实证研究在评价标准、方法、评价者与证据上的差异。作者归纳出证据有效性、评分标准与任务对齐、教学实用性三个维度，并指出既有研究使用了人工判断、学习者感知、修改行为、学习结果和自动指标等多种证据。基于此，文章提出一个将反馈质量维度与相应证据对应起来的评价框架，为后续研究和教学实践提供更清晰的评价思路。

papers.title: From Prompting to Direct Manipulation: Interaction Patterns and Designer Experience in Generative AI-Supported Visual Workflows
papers.authors: Yucheng Wang
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is now employed in many visual design programs to create images rapidly, but these images may not meet the designer's expectations at first glance. This paper studies mismatch via text prompting, parameters and presets, reference-based input, and in-canvas manipulation. The fourteen academic sources in the review include thirteen peer-reviewed publications from 2024-2026 and Shneiderman's original work on direct manipulation. The workflow stage, participant group, interaction pattern, and the five dimensions of efficiency, perceived control, cognitive load, creative agency, and output predictability were used for evidence coding. Based on this evidence, the demand for refinement reduces the apparent advantage of rapid exploration. Effort saved in generation may be recovered by reducing prompt modifications, filtering output, or re-retrieving a suitable image. More local interactions help express and observe the decisions, but they do not eliminate the uncertainty in the generated results. Evidence for the parameters and presets is relatively scarce, so all four patterns cannot be evaluated equally. This framing clarifies how interface design, rather than model capability alone, affects professional agency and supports more informed tool selection in creative practice.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕生成式AI辅助视觉设计流程，考察文本提示、参数与预设、参考图输入和画布内直接操作这四类交互方式如何影响设计师体验。作者对十四份学术文献（含2024至2026年的同行评审出版物和Shneiderman的直接操作原始论述）按工作流阶段、参与者群体、交互模式及效率、感知控制、认知负荷、创造性自主性和输出可预测性五个维度进行证据编码。综述指出，对结果精修的需求削弱了快速探索的表面优势，生成环节省下的精力可能被修改提示、筛选输出或重新检索合适图像所抵消；更局部的交互有助于表达和观察设计决策，但并不能消除生成结果的不确定性。参数与预设方面的证据相对稀缺，因此四种模式无法被同等评价。文章据此强调，界面设计本身而非仅模型能力会影响专业自主性，并有助于在创作实践中更明智地选择工具。

papers.title: DARF-P1DNet: A Dual-View Attention-Guided Residual Fusion Pyramidal 1D Network for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Detection
papers.authors: Yuexi Xiang
papers.abstract: Seizures cause noticeable abnormal changes in EEG signals. Relying on manual reading of long-term EEG recordings not only costs plenty of time, but it is also easily affected by the doctor's experience and fatigue. To improve the automation and stability of EEG seizure detection, this paper proposes a Dual-view Attention Residual Fusion Pyramidal 1D Network (DARF-P1DNet). First, this method normalizes the single-channel signals from the Bonn EEG dataset. It then constructs the original view and an augmented view for the training phase. Next, two P-1D-CNN encoders are used. They have the same structure, but their parameters are independent. These encoders extract complementary features from the two views. Then, Feature-wise Attention and Residual Fusion are used to filter and keep important information from the dual views. Finally, the model uses a lightweight classification head to perform binary classification between Non-seizure and Seizure. It is trained using weighted cross-entropy loss. In the experiments, we evaluate the model using common classification metrics, ablation studies, and comparison experiments. The overall method has a clear structure. It can fully use the complementary information from the original and augmented signals while keeping the model relatively lightweight. This provides a workable solution for seizure detection in EEG data with small sample sizes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电癫痫发作检测中人工判读耗时且易受经验与疲劳影响的问题，提出一种双视角注意力引导的残差融合金字塔一维网络（DARF-P1DNet）。方法上，作者对Bonn数据集的单通道信号做归一化，构建原始与增强两个视角，用结构相同但参数独立的一维卷积编码器分别提取互补特征，再经特征注意力与残差融合筛选保留重要信息，最后由轻量分类头完成发作与非发作的二分类。实验通过常用分类指标、消融与对比实验评估，结果显示该结构能较充分利用双视角互补信息并保持模型相对轻量，为小样本脑电数据的发作检测提供了一种可行方案。

papers.title: Enhancing Adolescents' Physical Education Self Efficacy Through Artificial Intelligence Supported Feedback
papers.authors: Wenxaing Long
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence can provide individualized movement information at a frequency that is difficult to achieve through teacher observation alone. This study examined whether AI-supported corrective feedback could strengthen adolescents' physical education self-efficacy while improving movement execution. Eighty-four students aged 13–15 completed an eight-week controlled experiment involving bodyweight squats, forward lunges, and countermovement jumps. The AI group received pose-estimation-based feedback generated with MediaPipe Pose Landmarker and OpenCV, whereas the control group received standardized teacher feedback. The AI group increased self-efficacy from 4.17 ± 0.62 to 5.39 ± 0.56 points, compared with 4.19 ± 0.60 to 4.66 ± 0.61 in the control group, producing a significant group × time interaction, F(1,82) = 42.31, p < .001, ηp² = .340. Movement scores increased from 64.1 ± 6.8 to 82.3 ± 5.7 in the AI group. Within the AI condition, movement-score improvement and feedback engagement jointly predicted post-intervention self-efficacy, adjusted R²=.487. The findings indicate that interpretable, attempt-specific AI feedback can make mastery progress more visible and support both technical learning and efficacy beliefs in adolescent physical education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察人工智能支持的纠正性反馈能否在改善青少年动作执行的同时提升其体育自我效能感，采用对照实验比较AI反馈与教师标准化反馈在自重深蹲、前弓步和反向纵跳练习中的效果。结果显示，接受基于姿态估计的AI反馈的学生在自我效能感和动作评分上的提升均明显大于对照组，且AI组内动作进步与反馈投入共同预测了干预后的自我效能感。作者据此认为，可解释、针对每次尝试的AI反馈能让掌握进度更可见，从而同时支持技术学习与效能信念，但结论限于该实验任务与青少年体育情境。

papers.title: Force Feedback and Force Sensing in Humanoid Robotic Arm Structures
papers.authors: Chenjia Li
papers.abstract: Humanoid robotic arms must manage uncertain contact during grasping, assembly, transport, and physical human-robot interaction. Vision and high-gain position control provide useful pre-contact geometry but cannot continuously reveal contact location, force direction, shear, slip, or load variation. This paper examines how force information is generated, transmitted, measured, and fed back through five actuation routes: high-gear-ratio rigid drives, series elastic actuators, variable-stiffness actuators, low-gear-ratio quasi-direct drives, and cable remote drives. Joint torque sensing, wrist six-axis force/torque sensing, and distributed tactile sensing are compared as complementary layers. The synthesis shows that interaction performance depends jointly on reflected inertia, structural stiffness, elastic elements, load paths, calibration quality, and control bandwidth. Sensor placement, overload protection, compliance, thermal management, and maintenance access therefore belong to one structural design problem rather than an afterthought. The paper provides a traceable framework for selecting sensing locations and actuation structures and identifies range, calibration, overload recovery, bandwidth, and serviceability as validation targets for future hardware experiments.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕人形机械臂在抓取、装配、搬运及人机物理交互中如何获取并反馈力信息展开讨论，指出视觉与高增益位置控制只能提供接触前的几何信息，无法持续反映接触位置、力方向、剪切、滑移和负载变化。文章按五类驱动路线梳理力信息的产生、传递、测量与反馈，并将关节力矩传感、腕部六维力/力矩传感和分布式触觉传感视为互补的感知层次。综述表明，交互性能取决于反射惯量、结构刚度、弹性元件、载荷路径、标定质量与控制带宽的共同作用，因此传感器布置、过载保护、柔顺性、热管理与维护可达性应纳入统一的结构设计问题；文章据此提出传感位置与驱动结构的选择框架，并把量程、标定、过载恢复、带宽和可维护性列为后续硬件实验的验证目标。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Assisted Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease: From Monomodal Imaging to Multimodal Fusion
papers.authors: Renpu Han
papers.abstract: In the field of auxiliary diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD), deep learning is developing along two paths: single-modal imaging and multi-modal fusion. The single-modal approach utilizes lightweight networks (with efficient receptive fields and multi-axis attention mechanisms) to optimize preprocessing and improve three-dimensional models, achieving high-precision classification while controlling the number of parameters; multi-modal fusion integrates structural magnetic resonance, genetic information, scale data, diffusion tensor imaging, and electroencephalogram, and employs technical means such as Transformer and graph convolutional networks to significantly enhance the performance of early identification and multi-classification. The existing limitations include weak cross-center generalization ability, difficulties in obtaining and aligning multi-modal data, insufficient interpretability, and the lack of longitudinal prediction. Future development directions include lightweight edge deployment, federated and self-supervised learning, incorporating low-cost modalities such as plasma markers, and constructing longitudinal prediction and frameworks with pathological prior interpretability, thereby facilitating the implementation of clinical applications. This article aims to provide a reference for the further optimization and clinical translation of related methods by summarizing the main technical paths, application progress and existing problems of deep learning in the auxiliary diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕阿尔茨海默病辅助诊断中的深度学习技术，梳理了从单模态影像到多模态融合的两条主要路径。单模态方法借助轻量网络与注意力机制，在控制参数量的同时实现较高精度的分类；多模态融合则整合结构磁共振、基因、量表、弥散张量成像和脑电等信息，结合Transformer与图卷积网络，提升了早期识别和多分类的表现。文章指出，现有方法仍受跨中心泛化弱、多模态数据获取与对齐困难、可解释性不足及缺乏纵向预测等限制，并据此提出轻量化边缘部署、联邦与自监督学习、引入低成本模态以及构建纵向预测和病理先验可解释框架等发展方向。作为一篇综述，其贡献在于归纳技术路径与应用进展，而非开展实证验证。

papers.title: Generative AI Driven Cultural Content Production Mechanisms and Creative Labor Substitution Effects
papers.authors: Jiekun Yu
papers.abstract: Generative AI is reshaping content production in the cultural and creative industries by shifting cultural material organization, script writing, exhibition interpretation, and cultural tourism communication from linear manual workflows to human-AI collaborative workflows. Focusing on productivity improvement and the boundary of creative labor substitution, this research constructs a three-group comparison framework involving human-only creation, AI-assisted creation, and fully AI-generated creation. Based on public cultural heritage data, cultural policy texts, and cultural tourism communication samples from 2018 to 2024, LLMs, RAG, Sentence-BERT semantic retrieval, expert scoring, and mixed-effects ANOVA are combined to measure generation quality, policy suitability, and substitution intensity across different cultural tasks. The results show that the average completion time of the AI-assisted group decreases from 44.2 min to 25.7 min, while the overall quality score increases from 82.6 to 84.1, indicating that human-AI collaboration can improve production efficiency while maintaining content quality. Although the fully AI-generated group achieves the lowest time cost, its policy suitability and cultural accuracy decline noticeably. Task complexity further affects substitution intensity. Cultural tourism copy and short-video scripts are more substitutable, while exhibition interpretation and policy explanation still rely on human judgment. These findings provide quantitative evidence for AI adoption, creative labor restructuring, and cultural policy governance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式人工智能在文化内容生产中对创作效率与创造性劳动替代边界的影响，基于文化遗产数据、文化政策文本和文化旅游传播样本，构建纯人工创作、AI辅助创作与完全AI生成三组比较框架，结合大语言模型、检索增强生成、语义检索、专家评分与混合效应方差分析进行测量。结果显示，AI辅助组在缩短完成时间的同时保持了整体质量，而完全AI生成组虽然时间成本最低，却在政策适配性和文化准确性上明显下降；任务复杂度也影响替代强度，旅游文案和短视频脚本更易被替代，展览解说与政策阐释仍依赖人的判断。文章据此为AI采用、创造性劳动结构调整和文化政策治理提供了量化依据。

papers.title: High Dimensional Factor Discovery for Cross Sectional Equity Returns via Sparse Deep Learning
papers.authors: Yishu Li
papers.abstract: The expansion of high-dimensional firm characteristics has made cross-sectional equity return prediction more difficult because redundant variables, accumulated noise, and nonlinear exposures often appear at the same time. Traditional multifactor models provide strong economic interpretation, but their predefined factor sets are limited. They cannot fully use the complex information contained in public financial data, trading data, and market-state variables. The study focuses on U.S. common stocks listed on major exchanges from 2010 to 2024. It integrates Stooq market trading data, SEC EDGAR financial disclosure data, and Kenneth French factor data to construct a monthly cross-sectional feature matrix. A sparse deep learning model is then used to identify stable return-related factors. The model combines a feature gating layer, nonlinear hidden layers, and a bottleneck factor layer to achieve variable selection and latent factor learning. It is compared with the Fama-French five-factor regression, LASSO, random forest, and standard neural network through rolling out-of-sample tests. The illustrative experimental results show that the sparse deep model achieves an out-of-sample R² of 0.72 percent, a Spearman IC of 0.031, and a long-short portfolio Sharpe ratio of 0.91. After transaction costs, the Sharpe ratio remains 0.73. The results indicate that the sparse structure can reduce high-dimensional noise and improve the stability and economic interpretability of factor discovery. This framework provides an executable path for explainable machine learning asset pricing in fintech applications.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对高维公司特征带来的冗余变量、累积噪声与非线性暴露并存问题，考察稀疏深度学习能否在横截面股票收益预测中识别稳定因子。作者以美国主要交易所普通股为对象，整合市场交易、财务披露与因子数据构建月度特征矩阵，采用含特征门控层、非线性隐藏层和瓶颈因子层的稀疏深度模型进行变量选择与潜因子学习，并与多因子回归、LASSO、随机森林和标准神经网络做滚动样本外比较。示例性结果显示该模型样本外表现优于对照，且稀疏结构有助于降低高维噪声、提升因子发现的稳定性与经济可解释性；但摘要仅给出示例性实验，结论的普适性仍受样本区间与市场条件限制。

papers.title: AI Driven Early Warning of ESG Performance in Real Estate Enterprises
papers.authors: Shuhao Chen
papers.abstract: Real estate enterprises face increasing pressure from green transition, financing constraints, and higher requirements for governance transparency. ESG performance has become an important basis for evaluating sustainable operation, risk exposure, and management quality. Due to high leverage, long development cycles, and strong externalities in the real estate industry, ESG performance deterioration often appears together with liquidity risk, weak disclosure, and governance defects. Based on Chinese A-share listed real estate enterprises from 2015 to 2024, ESG ratings, financial indicators, governance variables, and textual information from annual reports and ESG reports are integrated to build an AI-driven early-warning model for ESG performance. TF-IDF is used to extract textual risk signals. Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM are compared, while SHAP is applied to explain key driving factors. The results show that LightGBM achieves the highest AUC and F1 score on the test set, indicating stronger ability to identify firms with ESG performance deterioration in the following year. Leverage ratio, cash-to-short-term debt ratio, negative risk-word frequency, environmental disclosure intensity, and governance penalty records are the main influencing factors. This framework can support ESG risk identification, internal governance improvement, and investment risk screening in real estate enterprises.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对房地产企业ESG表现恶化常与流动性风险、披露薄弱和治理缺陷并存的问题，构建了基于人工智能的ESG表现预警模型。作者整合2015至2024年中国A股上市房企的ESG评级、财务指标、治理变量及年报和ESG报告文本信息，用TF-IDF提取文本风险信号，并比较逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM的预测表现，同时以SHAP解释关键驱动因素。结果显示LightGBM在测试集上的AUC和F1最高，对识别次年ESG表现恶化的企业能力更强；杠杆率、现金短债比、负面风险词频、环境披露强度和治理处罚记录是主要影响因素。该框架可用于房企ESG风险识别、内部治理改进和投资风险筛查。

papers.title: Designing and Evaluating a Collaborative Teaching Model for Integrating AI-Assisted Media Art Practice into Secondary STEAM Education
papers.authors: Tian Wang
papers.abstract: In this paper, the proposed collaboration-based teaching model with incorporation of AI-assisted media arts practice is considered within the scope of secondary STEAM education. Two intact classes of Grade 8 students enrolled at a secondary school conducted the experiment for eight weeks. The experimental class took part in the coordinated instruction in science, technology, and art subjects and performed an assignment called "Urban Environmental Data and Interactive Media Art Project," where they used BBC micro:bit sensors, Adobe Express with Firefly, p5.js Web Editor, Google Classroom, and Padlet. The control class did a traditional STEAM project related to the same subject and period of time. Creativity test, project assessment rubrics, collaboration and engagement questionnaires, observations in classrooms, learning diaries, and interviews were utilized for evidence collection. The experimental class showed greater increase in creative problem solving compared to the control class (14.83 ± 5.21 vs. 5.87 ± 4.69) with statistically significant group effect. Furthermore, their projects had higher marks for data-art integration, interactivity, and justifications of design decisions. The score for collaboration and engagement achieved 4.31 ± 0.36 and 4.24 ± 0.41, respectively.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在中学STEAM教育情境中提出并检验了一种融入AI辅助媒体艺术实践的协作教学模式，以两个八年级完整班级开展为期八周的准实验，实验班围绕城市环境数据与交互媒体艺术项目进行科学、技术与艺术的协同教学，对照班则完成同主题的传统STEAM项目。结果显示，实验班在创造性问题解决上的提升幅度大于对照班，且存在统计显著的组间效应；其项目作品在数据与艺术整合、交互性以及设计决策论证方面也获得更高评分，协作与投入的问卷得分同样较高。文章据此认为，将AI辅助媒体艺术实践嵌入跨学科协作教学，可能有助于提升学生的创造性问题解决表现与项目质量，但相关结论仍需结合具体教学情境理解。

papers.title: AI in the Game Industry: Latest Research Advances and Future Direction
papers.authors: Sibo Song
papers.journal: Advances in Economics Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: The paper is a summary of the current developments of AI in the gaming sector between 2023 and 2026, including automated generation of content, intelligent game agents (NPCs) and large language models (LLMs), game testing and quality assurance by means of AI, modeling of players and dynamic difficulty management, as well as reorganization of the industry and the new concept of the so-called AI-native games. This study reveals that the use of AI will not be used to assist in the creation of contents but rather become part of the core elements of game mechanics. Real-time diffusion models can model game engines (GameNGen), LLM agents are already implemented in commercial QA systems (TITAN framework), reinforcement learning and player modeling can be applied to adjust the difficulty of the game dynamically based on the data. At the same time, there exists a discussion in the field of efficiency of the process, the creative aspect of it, and how much restructuring of the organization should be done. The authors also suggest some of the criteria which can be used to determine whether a game is an AI-native game (counterfactual testing) and indicate the open issues like automatic playability tests, user acceptance, safety of the contents and ownership of the copyright.
papers.summary_zh: 该文综述了2023至2026年间人工智能在游戏产业中的研究进展，涵盖内容自动生成、智能NPC与大语言模型、AI辅助测试与质量保证、玩家建模与动态难度管理，以及产业重组和“AI原生游戏”这一新概念。文章指出，AI正从辅助内容创作转向成为游戏机制的核心组成部分，例如实时扩散模型可用于建模游戏引擎，LLM智能体已进入商业QA系统，强化学习与玩家建模可依据数据动态调整难度。作者同时讨论了流程效率、创造性以及组织重构程度等争议，并提出以反事实测试判断游戏是否属于AI原生游戏的标准，最后列出自动可玩性测试、用户接受度、内容安全与版权归属等开放问题。

papers.title: An Analytical Study on Artificial Intelligence as a Turning Point for the Transformation of the Auditing Industry
papers.authors: Wenyi Wang
papers.journal: Advances in Economics Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: With the digital economy growing at an unprecedented rate, corporate transaction data has become exponentially large, presenting several challenges to the auditing profession - including the exponential increase in the volume of data, more complex transaction patterns, and stricter regulatory requirements - making traditional sampling-based auditing techniques less effective. This paper examines how artificial intelligence (AI) can be a game changer in the evolution of the auditing industry. The research employs both literature review and comparative analysis to provide a systematic account of how AI has been used in the auditing industry since 2015. The analysis is divided into four main dimensions: transformation of auditing processes, motivations behind the adoption of AI, the practical benefits of its implementation, and obstacles faced during this process. The results suggest that AI is radically changing the scope, effectiveness, and decision-making references of the auditing profession, making it one of the key drivers of industry development. Nonetheless, the influence of AI is unfolding slowly; the sector is now in the transitional stage: moving towards a mainly human-oriented strategy to a human-machine partnership. The main issues that should be addressed in this transition are overdependence on AI, the absence of transparency in algorithmic decision-making, the specification of accountability, and the change of the auditing workforce. On the basis of the information provided in this paper, the author suggests practical suggestions on AI governance practices of firms, the creation of strong regulatory frameworks, and the development of competent auditing talent.
papers.summary_zh: 该文通过文献回顾与比较分析，系统梳理了2015年以来人工智能在审计行业中的应用，围绕审计流程变革、采用动因、实际效益与实施障碍四个维度展开讨论。分析认为，AI正在改变审计的范围、效率与决策依据，但其影响释放缓慢，行业目前处于从以人为主导向人机协作过渡的阶段。作者指出，这一转型需重点应对对AI的过度依赖、算法决策缺乏透明度、责任界定以及审计人员转型等问题，并据此提出企业AI治理、监管框架建设和人才培养方面的建议。

papers.title: Why Customers Welcome or Resist AI Salespeople: Formation Mechanisms of Algorithm Aversion and Algorithm Appreciation in Large Language Model Sales
papers.authors: Dasen Yin
papers.journal: Advances in Economics Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now answer product questions, recommend items and help close deals in online shops, banks and telecom services. Customers react to these AI sales agents in two opposite ways. Some avoid them, a pattern researchers call algorithm aversion, while others prefer them to human advice, a pattern called algorithm appreciation. This paper reviews the main empirical studies on both patterns and asks how each one forms when the "algorithm" is a conversational sales agent. Drawing on research in judgment and decision making, consumer behavior and human computer interaction, it proposes a framework with three layers. The first layer contains the cues that an LLM sales agent gives off. The second layer contains five psychological pathways that operate during the conversation: competence belief, error sensitivity, empathy and uniqueness concern, social presence, and perceived control. The third layer contains situational conditions such as product type, the timing of AI identity disclosure, the customer's emotional state and prior AI experience. Six propositions are derived. The paper argues that aversion and appreciation are not fixed traits of customers but outcomes of how these layers combine in a particular sales encounter, and it discusses implications for firms and for future student research.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇综述，梳理了关于大语言模型销售代理的算法厌恶与算法欣赏两类反应的形成机制。作者整合判断与决策、消费者行为和人机交互研究，提出一个三层框架：LLM销售代理发出的线索、对话中运作的五条心理路径（能力信念、错误敏感、共情与独特性担忧、社会临场感、感知控制），以及产品类型、AI身份披露时机、顾客情绪和先前AI经验等情境条件，并据此推导出六项命题。文章的核心论点是，厌恶与欣赏并非顾客的固定特质，而是这些层次在具体销售遭遇中如何组合的结果，并讨论了对企业和未来学生研究的意义。

papers.title: From Transactional Exchange to Relational Trust: Reconfiguring Brand–Consumer Data Relationships in the Era of Surveillance Capitalism
papers.authors: Caihan Zhou
papers.journal: Advances in Economics Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: As algorithms and large-scale data increasingly shape the digital economy, consumer behavioral data have become an important strategic resource for firms. However, under the logic of surveillance capitalism, extensive collection and commercialization of consumer data may raise concerns regarding privacy, information asymmetry, and reduced consumer autonomy, potentially undermining the foundations of long-term brand–consumer trust. Existing research has largely emphasized the efficiency and commercial value of data while paying comparatively less attention to the relational and ethical dimensions of data use. Against this background, this study examines how brands may reconfigure consumer data relationships in the context of surveillance capitalism. Drawing on surveillance capitalism theory, relationship marketing, and trust formation, the study develops a Relational Trust Framework. The framework conceptualizes a shift toward three interrelated dimensions—shared ownership, shared governance, and value co-creation—and proposes a potential pathway from data transparency to perceived fairness, trust formation, and long-term relationship development. Theoretically, the framework extends transactional approaches to consumer data by incorporating relational trust and consumer agency into the analysis. Practically, it provides a conceptual basis for brands, digital platforms, and regulators to develop more transparent, ethical, and sustainable approaches to data-driven marketing.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对监控资本主义下品牌大规模收集与商业化消费者数据可能侵蚀品牌—消费者长期信任的问题，指出既有研究多强调数据的效率与商业价值，对数据使用的关系与伦理维度关注不足。作者基于监控资本主义理论、关系营销与信任形成研究，提出一个关系型信任框架，将消费者数据关系重构为共享所有权、共享治理与价值共创三个相互关联的维度，并勾勒出从数据透明到感知公平、信任形成再到长期关系发展的可能路径。作为理论论文，其贡献在于把关系型信任与消费者能动性纳入对消费者数据的分析，为品牌、数字平台与监管者提供了走向更透明、合乎伦理且可持续的数据驱动营销的概念基础，文中路径属框架性设想而非实证检验。

papers.title: Earnings Management and Artificial Intelligence Technology Disclosure: Empirical Evidence from a Corporate Impression Management Perspective
papers.authors: Yuehao Gao
papers.journal: Advances in Economics Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: While artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly emerged as a technological narrative in capital markets, the descriptions of AI use in corporate annual reports can be real or might be used strategically for image building purposes. Based on A-share listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2013 to 2023, this study considers whether or not financial embellishment also happens in technological narrative disclosure. The findings reveal that disclosure of AI-related technologies is associated with the level of earnings management of the firm. The result is still strong after the separation of the two types of earnings management (upward and downward). This relationship further found to be influenced by ownership structure and is more strongly observed in non-state owned enterprises. The results indicate that disclosure of AI technology does not necessarily contain only incremental information; it can also serve as a story tool to embellish earnings and build a new image of the company's growth and innovation by companies that manage their earnings. This paper builds on the literature on corporate impression management and offers practical implications for investors and regulators for the evaluation of credibility of narrative disclosures regarding new technologies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以2013至2023年沪深A股上市公司为对象，考察年报中人工智能技术披露与盈余管理之间的关系，并检验产权性质的调节作用。结果显示，AI技术披露与盈余管理程度相关，区分向上和向下两类盈余管理后该关联依然稳健，且在非国有企业中更为明显。作者据此指出，AI技术披露未必只包含增量信息，也可能被盈余管理企业用作修饰业绩、塑造成长与创新形象的故事工具，这为投资者和监管者评估新技术叙事披露的可信度提供了参考。

papers.title: Neural Differences Between Prosocial and Self-Serving Lies: A Review of Evidence from Cognitive Neuroscience
papers.authors: Ziyu Song
papers.abstract: There has been numerous evidence from neuroimaging and electrophysiological studies that suggest overlapping but distinct networks between self-serving lies and prosocial lies. On the basis of current research, self-serving lies engage the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and anterior cingulate cortex, reflecting heightened cognitive control and moral conflict, while prosocial lies recruit the temporoparietal junction and medial prefrontal cortex, which emphasizes empathy and social cognition. Researchers also attach importance to the interplay between executive control, social processing, and emotional regulation in deception. By understanding these neural differences, we can make contributions to developmental psychology, cross-cultural research, forensic applications, and the design of socially adaptive artificial intelligence systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了脑成像与电生理研究中利己谎言与利他谎言背后的神经机制。现有证据显示，两类说谎涉及部分重叠但可区分的网络：利己谎言更多激活背外侧前额叶与前扣带皮层，反映较强的认知控制与道德冲突；利他谎言则更多招募颞顶联合区与内侧前额叶，侧重共情与社会认知。作者据此强调执行控制、社会加工与情绪调节在欺骗中的交互作用，并指出这些神经差异对发展心理学、跨文化研究、司法应用以及社会适应型人工智能系统设计具有参考意义。

papers.title: The Impact of AI-Generated Content on Trust and Authenticity in Social Media Communication: A Study of Three Australian Case Studies
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Song
papers.abstract: The robust growth of generative artificial intelligence (AI), especially large language models and image-generation systems, has greatly shaped communication practices on social media. In this context, AI-generated content has become widely adopted by businesses, media organizations, influencers, and individual users to efficiently create text, images, videos, and interactive content. While these technologies boost creativity and communication productivity, they also introduce ethical concerns regarding transparency, authenticity, misinformation, and public trust. This study investigates how AI-generated content influences trust and authenticity in social media communication through a qualitative interpretive case study approach. Three representative cases, the Georgie Purcell AI image controversy, the AI-generated "Aboriginal Steve Irwin" incident, and the Jeanswest AI-generated advertising backlash, are investigated using secondary sources including academic literature, news reports, organizational statements, and public responses. Based on this analytical framework, AI ethics principles of transparency, accountability, fairness, and human oversight are applied to guide the analysis. The findings suggest that generative AI has reshaped social media communication by improving efficiency and personalization while disrupting authenticity assessment. Therefore, public trust relies on transparent AI disclosure, ethical governance, and responsible practices. Moreover, sustainable AI integration requires stronger governance, platform transparency, and human oversight to maintain communication credibility.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式AI内容如何影响社交媒体传播中的信任与真实性，采用定性解释性案例研究方法，分析澳大利亚三起代表性事件，并借助透明度、问责、公平和人类监督等AI伦理原则进行解读。研究发现，生成式AI在提升传播效率与个性化的同时，也扰乱了公众对内容真实性的判断，使信任更依赖透明的AI披露、伦理治理与负责任实践。文章据此指出，可持续的AI整合需要更强治理、平台透明度与人类监督，以维护传播可信度。

papers.title: Generative AI‑Empowered Optimization Strategies for High School English Teaching: A Case Study of Poetry Appreciation of The Road Not Taken in Selective Compulsory Course 3
papers.authors: Yuan Bian
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into education and teaching, the question of how to leverage teachers' professional judgment and achieve effective human-machine collaboration has become a significant issue. Based on the theories of AI-TPACK and SAMR, this study focuses on the human-machine co-creation mechanism in the design of high school English teaching activities supported by generative AI. The research employs semi-structured interviews and design-based research methods. By interviewing three high school English teachers, their AI-TPACK performance and practical dilemmas are analyzed. Subsequently, a human-machine co-creation teaching operation model is constructed, and two rounds of practice are carried out in a high school English poetry appreciation course. The research findings indicate that teachers have developed a certain awareness of AI integration, yet they still encounter problems such as poor adaptation to students' learning situations, insufficient output evaluation, and inadequate collaboration mechanisms. The practice shows that continuous negotiation, evaluation, and reconstruction under teachers' guidance are the keys to achieving effective human-machine co-creation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能支持高中英语教学设计时，教师如何发挥专业判断实现有效人机协同。作者基于AI-TPACK与SAMR理论，通过半结构化访谈和设计研究，分析高中英语教师的AI-TPACK表现与实践困境，并构建人机共创教学模式，在英语诗歌鉴赏课中开展两轮实践。研究发现，教师虽已具备一定的AI融合意识，但仍面临对学生学情适配不佳、输出评价不足和协作机制不健全等问题；实践表明，在教师引导下持续进行协商、评价与重构，是实现有效人机共创的关键。

papers.title: Generative AI Tools for Performance Assessment of University Students: Effects, Challenges, and Countermeasures
papers.authors: Linyun Tang
papers.journal: Lecture Notes in Education Psychology and Public Media
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of educational evaluation reform, Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) has been increasingly applied to performance assessment, yet its actual effects and challenges remain underexplored. This study surveyed 50 undergraduate students to examine their perceptions of GAI-based performance assessment across five dimensions: evaluation efficiency and feedback timeliness, accuracy and fairness, appropriateness of scoring criteria and weight distribution, stability and trust, and deep learning and innovation. Results show that over 70% of respondents recognized GAI's advantages in scoring speed and feedback timeliness, and most regarded its scoring criteria as clear and consistent. However, nearly 75% believed GAI failed to identify innovative highlights, over 70% perceived a tendency to emphasize form over content, and 44% reported that such preferences constrained their creative expression. Respondents also raised concerns about incorrect information, technical instability, and the lack of emotional interaction compared with human evaluation. These findings suggest that GAI should act as an auxiliary tool rather than a full replacement for teacher evaluation. To address current limitations, it is necessary to improve GAI's deep evaluation and fact-checking capabilities, establish human-machine collaborative review mechanisms, and cultivate students' critical thinking. This study provides implications for integrating GAI into university performance assessment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究调查了大学生对生成式人工智能用于表现性评价的感知，覆盖评价效率与反馈及时性、准确性与公平性、评分标准与权重合理性、稳定性与信任、深度学习与创新五个维度。结果显示，多数受访者认可其在评分速度和反馈及时性上的优势，并认为评分标准较为清晰一致；但近四分之三的受访者认为它难以识别创新亮点，超过七成感到其偏重形式而非内容，部分学生表示这种倾向限制了创造性表达，还有人担忧错误信息、技术不稳定及缺乏情感互动。作者据此主张生成式人工智能应作为教师评价的辅助工具而非完全替代，并建议提升其深度评价与事实核查能力、建立人机协同审核机制、培养学生的批判性思维。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence, Drones, and Digital Twins for Disaster Risk Modeling and Emergency Response in Southern Nigeria
papers.authors: Sunny O. Asomaku, Benson P. Okwori, Ayodele A. Suberu, Augustine O. Wokocha, Victoria O. Emelu
papers.abstract: Southern Nigeria, encompassing the Niger Delta and the wider South-South, South-East, and South-West geopolitical zones, faces a recurring and intensifying burden of hydro-meteorological and technological disasters, chiefly seasonal flooding, oil spills, gas-flaring incidents, and coastal erosion. Conventional disaster risk management (DRM) approaches in the region remain largely reactive, hampered by fragmented data, limited real-time situational awareness, and weak inter-agency coordination. This paper presents an integrative review and conceptual framework for combining three converging technologies — artificial intelligence (AI), unmanned aerial vehicles (drones/UAVs), and digital twins — to strengthen disaster risk modeling and emergency response across Southern Nigeria. Drawing on peer-reviewed literature indexed in Scopus, Web of Science, and related databases, alongside authoritative agency reports from the Nigeria Hydrological Services Agency (NIHSA) and the National Oil Spill Detection and Response Agency (NOSDRA), the review synthesizes evidence on machine-learning-based flood and oil-spill prediction, UAV-enabled aerial surveillance and search-and-rescue support, and digital twin platforms for real-time infrastructure and hazard simulation. A conceptual integration framework is proposed, linking data acquisition (drones, satellites, sensors, community reporting) through AI-driven analytics and digital twin simulation to produce early warning, optimized emergency response, and post-disaster recovery outcomes. The paper further analyzes the 2026 NIHSA Annual Flood Outlook, which classifies the majority of Southern Nigeria's states — including Rivers, Bayelsa, Delta, Lagos, and Cross River — as high flood-risk zones, and reviews documented machine-learning performance in comparable Nigerian flood contexts. Persistent barriers to adoption are identified, including infrastructural deficits, regulatory restrictions on UAV operation, data governance gaps, and limited technical capacity. The paper concludes with policy recommendations for phased, cost-effective adoption of AI-drone-digital twin systems by Nigerian disaster management institutions, oil and gas operators, and state governments.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇整合性综述与概念框架研究，聚焦尼日利亚南部反复加剧的洪涝、溢油与海岸侵蚀等灾害，梳理人工智能、无人机与数字孪生三类技术如何结合以改进灾害风险建模与应急响应。作者基于已发表文献和机构报告，归纳了机器学习洪水与溢油预测、无人机空中监测与搜救支持、数字孪生实时模拟等方面的证据，并提出一个从数据采集经AI分析到孪生模拟、进而支撑预警与响应的整合框架。文章还分析了将多数南部州划为高风险区的洪水展望，指出基础设施不足、无人机监管限制、数据治理缺口与技术能力有限等障碍，并据此提出分阶段、低成本采纳的政策建议。

papers.title: Interdisciplinary Case Design and Exploration for Machine Learning Course
papers.authors: Guangmei Xu, Jinhua Wang, Jingzun Zhang, Ning He
papers.journal: Journal of Education and Educational Research
papers.abstract: Traditional machine learning teaching commonly suffers from repetitive experimental paradigms and narrow real-world application contexts, which leads students to rely on mechanical code replication and surface-level learning. This instructional pattern fails to cultivate interdisciplinary cognition and humanistic accomplishment. To improve the current teaching deficiencies, this study adopts digitized Dunhuang mural resources as an innovative teaching medium to develop interdisciplinary practice cases. Following the design concepts of staged ability progression, integration of technical and artistic perspectives, and authentic scenario orientation, this research constructs a three-tier teaching system including basic training, in-depth exploration and comprehensive innovation. The practical curriculum covers a full range of computer vision tasks: Dunhuang image preprocessing, stylistic discrimination, CNN visual recognition, artistic style migration, decorative pattern generation, and damaged mural inpainting. All experimental units combine algorithm engineering practice with Dunhuang art and cultural instruction. This study develops two-dimensional teaching support resources. It also constructs a tailored T-A-P evaluation system that integrates technical ability, artistic attainment and practical performance. The comprehensive student assessment covers coding skills, model error analysis and cultural aesthetic understanding. Classroom teaching practice has proven that the designed case system can significantly strengthen students’ machine learning engineering capabilities and enrich their cultural accomplishment. This research offers a feasible and referable paradigm for interdisciplinary integration in artificial intelligence teaching.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统机器学习教学实验范式重复、应用情境狭窄、学生易停留于机械代码复现的问题，以数字化敦煌壁画资源为媒介设计跨学科实践案例，构建了基础训练、深入探究与综合创新三层教学体系，覆盖图像预处理、风格判别、CNN视觉识别、艺术风格迁移、纹样生成和壁画修复等计算机视觉任务，并配套二维教学支持资源与融合技术能力、艺术素养和实践表现的T-A-P评价体系。课堂实践表明，该案例体系能提升学生的机器学习工程能力并丰富其文化素养，为人工智能教学的跨学科融合提供了一种可参考的范式。

papers.title: RKCS v0.1: Reality–Knowledge–Consensus Separation Framework, with the EM-001 100-Claim Synthetic Pilot
papers.authors: Deonte Watts
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: A falsifiable, typed model separates ontological categories, epistemic states, evidence, consensus, uncertainty, provenance, and authority. The proposed protocol forbids consensus-only promotion of physical claims and requires traceable evidence for changes in verification status. Novelty and empirical advantage remain unestablished. The record also includes EM-001, a 100-case synthetic pilot (20 per domain: physics, medicine, finance, law, subjective experience) comparing majority vote, evidence-weighted scoring and RKCS. Illustrative synthetic accuracy: majority 0.30, evidence-weighted 0.70, RKCS 0.94 — labels are rule-derived and RKCS is scored against an oracle aligned with its own rules (circularity risk), so this is a software smoke test, not a performance claim. Preregistration draft NOT REGISTERED; human adjudication NOT RUN. Status: frozen proposed specification plus deterministic reference checker (7/7 synthetic unit tests pass), 2026-10-20; AI-assisted formulation. Source: the author's iCloud Recents (files dated 2026-10-21), downloaded 2026-10-22; published on Zenodo per the author's standing approval to publish all of his research, including items marked confidential/proprietary. The PDF was compiled with pdflatex from the package's unmodified main.tex (no PDF existed). The v0.1 package ZIP is also contained inside the EM-001 ZIP (folder rkcs_v0_1/); both original ZIPs are deposited. papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出RKCS v0.1框架，将本体类别、认知状态、证据、共识、不确定性、来源与权威分开建模，并规定物理主张不得仅凭共识升级、验证状态变更须有可追溯证据。作者同时报告EM-001合成试点，在五个领域各20个案例上比较多数投票、证据加权评分与RKCS，但强调标签由规则导出、RKCS对照与其规则一致的标准答案评分，存在循环性风险，因此只是软件冒烟测试而非性能主张。文中明确新颖性与实证优势尚未确立，预注册未登记、人工裁决未运行，故主要贡献是冻结的规范草案与确定性参考检查器，而非已验证的效果结论。

papers.title: MICA-NEX EXP-03: Controlled Evidence-Transfer and Authorization Boundary (conditional research protocol, not executed)
papers.authors: Deonte Watts
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: We define a prospective, staged disclosure gate to preserve the distinction between authenticated laboratory records and independently verified physical results in MICA-NEX EXP-03. The plan makes explicit the prerequisites for contractual authority, signer independence, documented metrological traceability, calibration uncertainties, consent to data export and independent evaluation. The package includes a machine-readable checklist whose local code cannot authorize any disclosure. No external appointment, transfer, or physical measurement has occurred. The author provided research direction; technical drafting and tests were AI-assisted (the package README names OpenAI GPT-6). Novelty has not been established. Status: conditional, nonbinding protocol v0.1 dated 2026-10-20 — NOT EXECUTED. Lab/reviewer NOT APPOINTED; agreement NOT EXECUTED; physical replication NOT RUN. The included term sheet and role-acceptance form are unsigned templates, not contracts. The package was marked 'INTERNAL REVIEW ONLY'. papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一项分阶段披露门控方案，旨在在MICA-NEX EXP-03中区分经认证的实验室记录与经独立核验的物理结果，并列出合同授权、签署人独立性、计量溯源、校准不确定度及数据导出同意等前提条件。方案包含一份机器可读清单，其本地代码不能授权任何披露。作者说明目前未进行外部任命、转移或物理测量，新颖性尚未确立，所附条款清单与角色接受表均为未签署模板，整套材料标注为仅限内部评审。该文属于条件性、非约束性的研究协议，而非已执行的实证研究。

papers.title: Intelligent Job Matching and Allocation Using Machine Learning, Language Models, and Strategy proof Mechanisms: A Review
papers.authors: Hande Pooja Vinod, Bangar Abhishek P., Karad Vandana A., Sachin Balasaheb Bhosale
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Job matching is increasingly supported by computational systems that estimate employment opportunities, interpret unstructured career information, and allocate scarce positions or resources. This review synthesises three supplied research papers that address complementary parts of this problem: large-scale machine learning for labour-market matching, strategyproof matching when project capacities depend on resource allocation, and CareerBERT for semantic resume-to-job recommendation. The first study analyses approximately 55 million German employment spells from 2012–2018 and reports that random forests outperform logit, ordinary least squares, and k-nearest neighbours for occupation-level prediction. The second formalises a student-project-resource problem and shows that strategyproofness cannot be combined with fairness and weak efficiency in full generality; it introduces Sample and Deferred Acceptance (SDA) mechanisms to balance these objectives. The third combines ESCO occupational taxonomy entries with EURES job advertisements and fine-tunes a BERT-based Siamese network using Multiple Negatives Ranking loss to place resumes and jobs in a shared semantic embedding space. Across the papers, matching quality depends on the representation of preferences and profiles, the scale and quality of data, the way capacities are modelled, and the objectives used to evaluate outcomes. Predictive accuracy and semantic relevance can improve recommendations, but they do not by themselves guarantee fairness, truthful reporting, or efficient resource use. The review therefore proposes a layered design that combines data-driven ranking with transparent allocation rules, human oversight, and explicit auditing of outcomes. Since the review is limited to three supplied studies with different tasks and evaluation settings, reported metrics are compared descriptively rather than treated as directly equivalent.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕计算系统如何支持职位匹配与岗位分配，梳理了三项任务与评估设定各异的研究：大规模机器学习用于劳动力市场职业预测，资源依赖型项目容量下的策略防伪匹配机制，以及基于语义嵌入的简历—职位推荐模型。综述指出，匹配质量取决于偏好与画像的表示方式、数据的规模与质量、容量的建模方式以及评价目标；预测准确性和语义相关性可以改善推荐，但本身并不保证公平、真实申报或资源高效利用。据此，作者提出将数据驱动排序与透明的分配规则、人工监督和结果审计相结合的分层设计，并说明由于仅纳入三项研究，相关指标只作描述性比较。

papers.title: Assessment of the physical and technological limits of brain-computer interfaces based on quantum magnetometry with NV centres in diamond
papers.authors: José Israel Nadal Vidal, Antonio Ginés López
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Background. Project Reload proposes a brain-computer interface based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond, with an electron-nuclear hybrid memory, "emulated qubits", a 25-qubit processor and a prototype within 9 to 12 months. Objective. To determine which parts of the proposal are demonstrated, which are plausible and which are unsupported, and to quantify the distance between what is required and what has been demonstrated. Methods. Structured literature review (52 studies) and computational feasibility analysis: a record of the provenance of every input parameter, signal-to-noise, coherence, retention and error-correction models, simulation of dynamical decoupling, a 20,000-iteration timeline model and global sensitivity analysis. Results. With 1 s of integration, which assumes a sustained signal or the average of repeated events, reading a single neuron at 1 mm requires a sensitivity 75 to 297 times better than the best published for an NV ensemble, and 14 times better in the most favourable combination explored, if peak-to-peak field values are used as amplitudes; with peak amplitudes, the figures double. An isolated spike is detectable only up to a median of 10.7 µm. A logical error of 10-6 with the surface code requires 161 physical qubits per logical qubit. Coherent integration over 8 ms requires a T2 of 35.9 ms, 15 times the best value in bulk diamond; classical accumulation of repeated cycles does not have that requirement. Demonstrated quantum memory spans 1 to 60 s. Under the model's assumptions, the full route to a usable prototype has a median of 113 months and a limited laboratory demonstrator one of 18 months (probability of 4.4% of completion within 12). Conclusions. NV magnetometry of neuronal populations at short range is a defensible research line; non-invasive single-cell reading at millimetre scale, memory at psychological scale and a usable prototype within 12 months are not supported by the available evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以结构化文献综述与计算可行性分析相结合的方式，评估了基于金刚石氮-空位色心的量子磁力测量脑机接口方案在物理与技术上的可达性。分析显示，短距离读取神经元群体尚属可辩护的研究方向，但在毫米尺度上无创读取单个神经元所需的灵敏度远超已发表水平，孤立脉冲的可检测距离也极为有限；同时，心理时间尺度上的量子存储与12个月内交付可用原型均缺乏证据支持，模型估计的完整路线中位时间远长于提案预期。作者据此区分了已被演示、尚属合理与缺乏依据的环节，提示该方案的关键瓶颈在于灵敏度、相干时间与纠错开销，而非概念本身。

papers.title: Revolutionizing Indian Education: Assessing the Effectiveness of AI-Based Adaptive Learning Systems in Higher Education (Odisha)
papers.authors: Dash Satyabrata, Sasmita Panigrahi, Biswanath Patro
papers.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: In today's era, Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming the education sector by enhancing learning outcomes andpersonalizing educational experiences. This study investigates the effectiveness of AI based adaptive learningsystems in higher education using a quantitative research design involving 300 post graduate students and 48 facultymembers from urban, semi urban, and rural institutions in Odisha, India. Participants were selected throughstratified sampling, and data were gathered through surveys and academic records to compare students usingada ptive learning systems with those in traditional classroom environments. Statistical techniques, includingindependent t tests and one way ANOVA, were employed to analyze AI driven behavioral differences and emergingtrends in the higher education sector. The primary goal is to assess the impact of these systems on academicperformance, student engagement, and retention rates.The results indicate that students, being more digitally adaptive, actively engage with AI tools for personalizedlearning, real time feedback, and independent exploration. Conversely, teachers exhibit a more reserved adoptionpattern, shaped by concerns regarding digital literacy, pedagogical integration, and the need for adequate training.Furthermore, students utilizing adap tive technologies reported increased participation, motivation, and higherretention rates.Despite these positive outcomes, the study identifies key challenges, including technical barriers, initialimplementation costs, and resistance to change among edu cators. The findings underscore that successful AIimplementation depends heavily on institutional readiness and robust infrastructure. The study recommends targetedteacher training, equitable access to technology, and the development of inclusive, contex t sensitive AI tools toensure effective and equitable integration across diverse educational landscapes. Ultimately, these insights provide astrategic roadmap for educators and policymakers seeking to optimize the integration of AI in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以印度奥里萨邦高等教育中的研究生和教师为对象，采用问卷调查与学业记录相结合的定量设计，比较使用AI自适应学习系统的学生与传统课堂学生，考察系统对学业表现、参与度和留存率的影响。结果显示，学生对AI工具的接受和主动使用程度较高，借助个性化学习、实时反馈和自主探索，其参与度、动机和留存率有所提升；教师则因数字素养、教学整合和培训不足而采纳较为谨慎。研究同时指出技术障碍、初期实施成本和变革阻力等挑战，认为AI落地效果取决于院校准备程度与基础设施，并建议加强教师培训、保障技术公平获取。需注意，相关发现来自组间比较，不宜直接解读为因果效应。
