Although individual studies on AI adoption, digital ethics, and device dependence exist, a significant empirical gap remains regarding how psychological reliance on mobile devices (nomophobia) and virtual-specific ethics jointly drive GenAI adoption among healthcare students, where ethical lapses directly impact clinical competence. To address this gap, this study examined the predictive roles of academic integrity, online learning integrity, and nomophobia in the use of AI tools among allied healthcare students at a higher education institution. Employing a quantitative cross-sectional design, the researchers collected data via convenience sampling among 300 full-time allied health students in Central Luzon, Philippines. The study used four research tools to gather pertinent data for the investigation, including an online survey administered during the second semester of the 2025-2026 academic year. Both descriptive and inferential statistics were employed using SPSS 23. Descriptive results showed high academic integrity, moderate AI usage and nomophobia, but low online learning integrity. Correlation analyses showed that AI tool use was positively associated with online learning integrity, nomophobia, and academic integrity. Multiple linear regression demonstrated that the model significantly predicted AI usage. Online learning integrity was the strongest predictor, followed by academic integrity and nomophobia. These results show that ethical digital engagement and mobile connectedness actively propel AI integration; ultimately, achieving SDG 4 objectives within healthcare education requires moving beyond prohibitive policies toward anticipatory digital governance, robust AI literacy, and ethical models that prepare future professionals for a digitally driven medical environment.

papers.title: The nature of science in the age of generative artificial intelligence: Epistemic authority, materiality, and a synergetic response
papers.authors: Muminova Zarifa Odilovna, Dilmurod Mamadaliyevich Mamatkulov, Тўроқулова Раьно Иброгимовна, Nigina Tolibovna Rakhmonova, Oybek Shavqiyev, Zoirova Sojida Umbarovna
papers.journal: Eurasia Journal of Mathematics Science and Technology Education
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has entered science classrooms faster than the epistemological questions it raises have been addressed. This study is an attempt to reveal how the knowledge-producing character of text-based conversational systems diverges from institutional science, and what that divergence implies for teaching the nature of science in secondary and undergraduate science. The two are compared through the family resemblance approach across aims and values, methods, practices, knowledge, and social-institutional systems, and the procedure linking literature to judgement is reported. The comparison is then reframed through synergetic: science is an open system in continuous evidential exchange with material reality, whereas the model reorganizes a corpus closed to new evidence at inference. A coupled-system model follows: the classroom verification norm is the order parameter, the teacher-set verification requirement the control parameter, and materiality the boundary condition. Five propositions are derived, the last a path-dependent threshold prediction that can falsify the model.

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of doppler ultrasonography to detect carotid artery disease in hypertensive patients, while taking CT Angiography as the gold standard.
papers.authors: Tooba Binte Shahid, Nasra Iqbal, Azhar Mahmood Javed, Abdullah Wali
papers.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of Doppler ultrasonography in detecting carotid artery disease in hypertensive patients, using CT angiography as the reference standard. Study Deisng: Cross-sectional study. Setting: Radiology, Ghurki Trust Teaching Hospital, Lahore. Period: November 2025 to March 2026. Methods: Which consisted of 148 hypertensive patients. Each patient was exposed to Colour Doppler ultrasonography and then to CTA within 24 hours. The results obtained were classified into true positive, true negative, false positive, and false negative. Calculation of sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and overall accuracy was made based on CTA as the gold standard. Results: The presence of carotid stenosis was confirmed by CTA in 60.8% of patients. The sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and accuracy of diagnosis by DUS were 93.3%, 75.9%, 85.7%, 88.0%, and 86.5%, respectively. DUS accurately detected 93.3% of patients with stenosis and excluded 75.9% of patients without stenosis. Similar results were obtained in the subgroups stratified by age, gender, BMI, and concomitant diseases. The prevalence of detection increased with the progression of stenosis severity. Conclusion: Doppler ultrasonography demonstrates high sensitivity and commendable diagnostic accuracy in identifying carotid artery disease among hypertensive patients. But its moderate specificity shows that CT angiography is still important for confirmation and planning before an intervention. For the best care of patients, a combined diagnostic approach is recommended.

papers.title: Structured prompt engineering as scaffolding in generative ai-supported project-based network programming learning: a systematic literature review and conceptual framework
papers.authors: Muhammad Rizki Ananda, Titi Sri Wahyuni, Fahmi Rizal, Resmi Darni
papers.abstract: This systematized literature review examines how prompt engineering in generative AI (GenAI) has been used to support Project-Based Learning (PjBL) and develops a conceptual framework for Network Programming courses. Following the PRISMA 2020 statement, records published from 2020 to 2026 were retrieved from IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Google Scholar, and Garuda/Sinta. Of 310 records identified, 242 remained after duplicate removal, 56 were assessed in full text, and 24 studies met the eligibility criteria. Screening decisions were cross-checked by a second reviewer (Cohen's κ = [....]), and study quality was appraised with the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT). Data were analyzed through a hybrid deductive–inductive thematic analysis following Braun and Clarke's six phases: the four research questions served as a priori categories, sub-themes were coded inductively until no new codes emerged, and coding disagreements were resolved by consensus. The results revealed that structured and scaffolded prompting is consistently associated with deeper engagement than unstructured prompting in programming classes, and that GenAI-supported PjBL preserves student autonomy and creativity when AI interaction is embedded in project stages and students must justify their technical decisions. Only one included study addressed computer networking directly. Reported challenges were excessive dependence on AI-produced solutions, shallow learning, and unclear assessment practices. Unlike existing PjBL–GenAI models, which treat AI as a generally available tool, the proposed three-layer framework (competency, scaffolding, and assessment) specifies when and how prompting is taught, constrained, and evaluated across network programming project milestones, and it yields testable propositions for future empirical research.

papers.title: Inteligência Artificial Generativa no Design de Jogos Digitais
papers.authors: Igor Carvalho Barreto Pereira, Cássia Regina D'Antonio Rocha da Silva
papers.journal: Revista de Design, Tecnologia e Sociedade
papers.abstract: This article examines the impacts of generative artificial intelligence on digital game design creation, investigating how this technology transforms creative processes in the industry. The research, using a qualitative approach, employed bibliographic review, comparative case study between Palworld and Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, and semi-structured interviews with three professionals in the field. The analysis identified five thematic categories: technological democratization, transformation of creative processes, preservation of human authenticity, ethical issues, and professional adaptation. The results show that generative AI democratizes game development, allowing independent studios to achieve quality comparable to major producers, but raises questions about authenticity and ethical sustainability. As a practical contribution, the study proposes seven guidelines for maintaining human-centered design, balancing technological innovation with ethical values and human creativity.

papers.title: Development of a universal methodology for estimating the cost of educational services of Russian universities based on machine learning and mathematical modeling methods
papers.authors: Aleksandr Blagov, Andrey Korolev
papers.journal: Journal of Monetary Economics and Management
papers.abstract: This study is devoted to the development of a universal methodology for estimating the cost of educational services for higher education programs in Russian universities for 2026. The relevance of the study is due to fundamental changes in the regulatory framework for paid admission: the introduction of state quotas for places, the prohibition of setting prices below cost, and limiting price increases to the inflation rate. In conditions of peak demographic demand and the need to compensate for the loss of university income, there is a need for an objective tool for calculating the fair cost of tuition. The purpose of the work is to create a methodology suitable for practical use by universities. Using machine learning methods (gradient boosting, random forest), a systematic analysis of 30 pricing factors was carried out, and their normalized weighting coefficients were obtained. On this basis, mathematical models have been built that make it possible to calculate the reference cost of an educational program, assess its price adequacy, and predict price dynamics taking into account competitive pressures and macroeconomic factors. The developed methodology was tested using the example of a number of specialties at Samara University.

papers.title: Digital health innovation in HIV prevention and sexual health promotion: current applications and future prospects of mobile health and telehealth
papers.authors: Xiaohe Sun
papers.abstract: Digital health is now a delivery strategy for HIV prevention and sexual health promotion, not simply a channel for health education. Mobile messaging, web-based testing, HIV self-testing (HIVST) support, mobile applications, social media recruitment, telehealth, tele-pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), and chatbot-assisted workflows can reduce barriers related to stigma, distance, clinic capacity, and confidentiality. These tools also create an opportunity for primary HIV and sexually transmitted infection (STI) prevention before high-risk patterns are established, using positive, age-appropriate messages that support consent, healthy relationships, condom and vaccine uptake, timely testing, and informed prevention choices. This narrative review synthesizes evidence from trials, systematic reviews, implementation studies, and program evaluations, emphasizing quantitative outcomes and implementation limits. The most consistent benefits are seen for service actions with clear endpoints: HIVST, online STI testing, PrEP initiation through telehealth, and interactive text-message support for adherence. Effects are less consistent for sustained PrEP persistence, complex behavior change, linkage after reactive self-tests, and equity. Digital tools can improve access among men who have sex with men, adolescents and young adults, women, sex workers, and rural populations. Still, they can also reproduce inequities when privacy, cost, literacy, device access, legal vulnerability, and laboratory infrastructure are not addressed. Future systems should integrate prevention education and digital entry points with laboratories, pharmacies, clinicians, community navigators, human escalation, privacy governance, and equity monitoring. The field should now move from platform-centered pilots toward accountable hybrid sexual health systems.
keywords: men who have sex with men

papers.title: Percepciones sobre IA en la educación superior salteña
papers.authors: Cristian Leonel Julián Flores
papers.abstract: In this article, I aim to analyze the perceptions and uses of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) among students at Higher Education Institutes (HEIs) in Salta. Through a mixed-methods approach based on surveys, it investigates the tension between the massive student adoption for autonomous learning and the infrastructural shortcomings that deepen the digital divide in a local context. The obtained sample evidences a predominant enthusiasm for the emancipatory potential of GenAI, although ethical concerns persist regarding data reliability and the fear of replacing the teaching role. It is observed that the appropriation of AI occurs mostly in a delocalized manner and without pedagogical support, highlighting the urgency to update teacher training while also promoting public policies that guarantee a critical and inclusive integration.

papers.title: Motivation of employees of older age groups for professional retraining in the context of technological changes
papers.authors: Polina Igorevna Ananchenkova, S. A. Shapiro
papers.journal: Scientific notes of the Russian academy of entrepreneurship
papers.abstract: The article examines the features of motivation of employees of older age groups for professional retraining in the context of digitalization, automation and the introduction of artificial intelligence. The relevance of the study is due to the simultaneous impact of two processes: the aging of the workforce and the acceleration of technological changes, as a result of which the content of professional activity is updated faster than traditional training mechanisms are being formed. The purpose of the article is to substantiate the factors and organizational and pedagogical conditions that determine the willingness of employees of older age groups to master new types of professional activities. The author’s motivation model is proposed, which includes the contours of professional meaning, recognition of experience, educational safety, practical development, organizational support and professional transfer. It is concluded that there is a need to move from a unified learning model to an age–inclusive system of professional retraining.

papers.title: Empowering ICT Teachers through AI Utilization Training to Enhance Learning Effectiveness in the Society 5.0 Era
papers.authors: Hansi Effendi, Winda Agustiarmi, Fenti Amelia Sari, Wifri Azizah
papers.journal: Suluah Bendang Jurnal Ilmiah Pengabdian Kepada Masyarakat
papers.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in education is a transformative force in the Society 5.0 era, yet AI literacy among vocational ICT teachers in Indonesia remains low, particularly in areas with limited technology access such as Lima Puluh Kota Regency. This activity aimed to improve the AI literacy and pedagogical readiness of 51 ICT teachers in the local Teachers' Working Group (MGMP) through a three-week mentoring program comprising orientation, a workshop, practice, and evaluation. Using a pre-experimental one-group pretest-posttest design, results showed a significant increase in mean scores from 83.51 to 92.10 (Z = 4.287; p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 0.68). Participant perceptions were highly positive (mean 4.68/5), with benefits including greater AI awareness, easier material preparation, and improved learning efficiency, despite constraints such as unstable internet. Findings confirm that practice-based AI mentoring strengthens vocational teachers' digital literacy and supports adaptive learning in the Society 5.0 era.

papers.title: Improving ICT Teachers' Competence through Canva AI Training in Lima Puluh Kota Regency
papers.authors: Hansi Effendi, Ayu Hendra, Annisa Yumna Yudistia, Wifri Azizah
papers.journal: Suluah Bendang Jurnal Ilmiah Pengabdian Kepada Masyarakat
papers.abstract: Teachers' ability to use Information and Communication Technology (ICT) is essential in the digital era, yet only about 60% of Indonesian teachers feel comfortable using technology for instruction. This community service activity aimed to improve the competence of junior secondary ICT teachers in the Lima Puluh Kota Regency ICT Teachers' Working Group (MGMP) in using Canva AI to create creative, interactive learning materials. Conducted over two days (6-7 September 2024) at UPTD SMPN 3 Harau, the program involved 30 teachers through socialization, two-stage intensive training, technology implementation, mentoring and evaluation, and formation of a sustainable learning community. Results showed 80% of participants mastered Canva AI's basic features and 70% produced creative, innovative learning materials, with increased confidence in integrating digital technology. The activity also produced a teacher learning community and received local media coverage, confirming that Canva AI training effectively improves ICT teachers' digital competence in areas with limited infrastructure.

papers.title: IMPLIKASI PEMANFAATAN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TERHADAP PROFESIONALISME GURU DALAM PEMBELAJARAN DITINJAU DARI ASPEK PEDAGOGIS DAN ETIKA
papers.authors: Laela Cahyu Andini, Krisdianto Hadiprasetyo
papers.abstract: Implications of the Use of Artificial Intelligence on Teacher Professionalism in Learning from Pedagogical and Ethical Perspectives. The purpose of this study is to analyze the implications of the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on teacher professionalism in learning from pedagogical and ethical perspectives. This study is a qualitative case study, which allows the researcher to analyze the phenomenon of AI utilization comprehensively, intensively, in detail, and in depth within the context of teaching and learning. Data collection was conducted through interviews, observations, and documentation. Data validity was analyzed through data triangulation by comparing and cross-checking information from multiple sources. The results indicate that the use of AI has implications for teachers’ professionalism through pedagogical reinforcement and consideration, as well as the affirmation of ethical responsibility in technology use. From a pedagogical perspective, AI supports teachers in developing learning experiences but does not replace the professional, humanistic role of teachers. Every AI output requires verification, adjustment, and pedagogical consideration before being used in instruction. From an ethical perspective, the use of AI requires teachers to ensure the accuracy, relevance, and appropriateness of information while maintaining professional responsibility for instructional decisions. These findings indicate that the use of AI requires not only technological proficiency but also a strengthening of pedagogical judgment and ethical responsibility as part of teachers’ professionalism, while pedagogical decisions, the verification process, the contextualization of learning, and the humanistic role remain with the teacher.

papers.title: PEMANFAATAN GENERATIVE AL SEBAGAI MEDIA INTERAKTIF DALAM PEMBELAJARAN MENULIS AKADEMIK
papers.authors: Rusda Nitanelly Manurung, Siti Fatimah Zahara
papers.abstract: Advances in Generative AI offer new opportunities to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of teaching and learning processes in higher education. One of its primary functions is assisting students in completing academic writing tasks. This study aims to explore the use of Generative AI in improving students' academic writing skills and to identify the advantages and challenges encountered in the educational landscape. A literature review method was employed, analyzing various domestic and international scholarly works regarding Generative AI, academic writing, and higher education published between 2023 and 2026. The findings indicate that Generative AI can assist students in formulating ideas, structuring outlines, refining grammar, and boosting writing productivity. Furthermore, the technology contributes to increased student confidence and efficiency in the academic writing process. However, despite its significant potential, the use of Generative AI in learning can also give rise to various ethical issues, including disparities in access, data bias, the risk of plagiarism, and ambiguity regarding authorship. Therefore, the utilization of Generative AI must be accompanied by digital literacy and an ethical understanding to ensure responsible use within educational environments. The study suggests that Generative AI holds great potential for enhancing academic writing skills when employed appropriately and responsibly.

papers.title: Perceived Usefulness of ChatGPT for Learning Physics Components of Basic Science among Junior Secondary Students
papers.authors: Ifeoluwa Sarah  Adunola, Adeniyi Michael Adeduyigbe
papers.journal: Journal of Advances in Physics Education
papers.abstract: Background. The increasing use of generative AI in education has created new opportunities for students to obtain academic support beyond conventional classroom interaction. ChatGPT, in particular, can provide explanations, examples and assistance with academic tasks. However, limited evidence exists on how junior secondary school students perceive its usefulness for learning the Physics components of Basic Science, particularly within the Nigerian context. Objective. This study therefore examined students’ perceptions of ChatGPT as a learning support tool, with specific attention to its perceived usefulness for assignment and examination preparation and for learning Physics. Method. The study adopted a quantitative approach using a descriptive survey research design. The participants comprised 171 students from a purposively selected secondary school in Ibadan, Nigeria. Data were collected using a self-developed Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT as a Learning Support Tool Questionnaire (SPC-LSTQ). A pilot study was conducted and analysed using Cronbach’s alpha, yielding reliability coefficients of 0.82 for Part One and 0.84 for Part Two. The data were analysed using frequency counts, percentages, means and standard deviations in SPSS. A criterion mean of 2.50 was used to interpret the four-point Likert-scale responses. Results. The findings revealed an overall positive perception of ChatGPT for assignment and examination preparation (weighted mean = 2.95). Students also reported a positive perception of ChatGPT for learning Physics (weighted mean = 3.01). Conclusion. The findings indicate that the participating junior secondary school students perceived ChatGPT as a useful learning support tool for both academic tasks and learning Physics components of Basic Science. However, these positive perceptions represent students’ reported views and should not be interpreted as evidence of improved learning achievement or the accuracy of ChatGPT-generated responses.

papers.title: OS IMPACTOS DO USO DE TELAS E DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL NO PROCESSO DE APRENDIZAGEM À LUZ DAS TEORIAS PSICOPEDAGÓGICAS
papers.authors: Cirla Suchy Chaves, Lisandra Barbireski Barcia da Silva
papers.abstract: A presença das tecnologias digitais na vida cotidiana das crianças tem provocado debates cada vez mais relevantes sobre seus efeitos no desenvolvimento e na aprendizagem. Nesse contexto, o uso crescente de telas e a ampliação do acesso a ferramentas de inteligência artificial suscitam reflexões acerca das possibilidades e dos desafios que essas tecnologias apresentam para o processo educativo, especialmente durante a alfabetização. Este estudo tem como objetivo analisar os impactos do uso de telas e da Inteligência Artificial no processo de aprendizagem infantil, tomando como referência contribuições da psicopedagogia, da psicologia do desenvolvimento e das neurociências. Trata-se de uma pesquisa bibliográfica, de abordagem qualitativa, fundamentada na análise de obras e estudos científicos que discutem o desenvolvimento cognitivo, as teorias da aprendizagem e as transformações decorrentes da cultura digital. Os resultados indicam que a exposição excessiva e não mediada às tecnologias digitais pode repercutir em aspectos relacionados à atenção, à memória, à linguagem, à autorregulação emocional e às interações sociais, fatores diretamente vinculados à aprendizagem. Em contrapartida, evidencia-se que recursos digitais e sistemas baseados em inteligência artificial podem favorecer experiências educativas mais personalizadas e interativas quando utilizados de forma intencional e acompanhados pela mediação de adultos. Conclui-se que os benefícios ou prejuízos dessas tecnologias dependem menos de sua presença e mais das condições em que são inseridas na rotina das crianças, destacando-se a importância da atuação conjunta da família, da escola e da psicopedagogia na construção de práticas que promovam uma aprendizagem crítica, significativa e compatível com as necessidades do desenvolvimento infantil. Palavras-chave: psicopedagogia; inteligência artificial; tecnologias digitais; aprendizagem infantil; alfabetização. Abstract The presence of digital technologies in children's daily lives has generated increasingly significant discussions regarding their effects on development and learning. In this context, the growing use of screens and the expanding access to Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools raise important reflections on the opportunities and challenges these technologies present to the educational process, particularly during literacy development. This study aims to analyze the impacts of screen use and Artificial Intelligence on children's learning processes, drawing on contributions from Psychopedagogy, Developmental Psychology, and Neuroscience. The research is a bibliographic study with a qualitative approach, based on the analysis of academic works and scientific studies addressing cognitive development, learning theories, and the transformations associated with digital culture. The findings indicate that excessive and unmediated exposure to digital technologies may affect attention, memory, language development, emotional self-regulation, and social interactions, all of which are directly related to learning. Conversely, digital resources and AI-based systems can support more personalized and interactive educational experiences when used intentionally and under adult guidance. It is concluded that the benefits or drawbacks of these technologies depend less on their presence and more on the conditions under which they are incorporated into children's daily routines. Therefore, the collaborative involvement of families, schools, and psychopedagogical professionals is essential for developing practices that foster critical, meaningful learning aligned with children's developmental needs. Keywords: psychopedagogy; artificial intelligence; digital technologies; children's learning; literacy. Resumen La presencia de las tecnologías digitales en la vida cotidiana de los niños ha generado debates cada vez más relevantes acerca de sus efectos en el desarrollo y el aprendizaje. En este contexto, el creciente uso de pantallas y la ampliación del acceso a herramientas de inteligencia artificial suscitan reflexiones sobre las posibilidades y los desafíos que estas tecnologías presentan para el proceso educativo, especialmente durante la alfabetización. Este estudio tiene como objetivo analizar los impactos del uso de pantallas y de la inteligencia artificial en el proceso de aprendizaje infantil, tomando como referencia las contribuciones de la psicopedagogía, la psicología del desarrollo y las neurociencias. Se trata de una investigación bibliográfica de enfoque cualitativo, fundamentada en el análisis de obras y estudios científicos que abordan el desarrollo cognitivo, las teorías del aprendizaje y las transformaciones derivadas de la cultura digital. Los resultados indican que la exposición excesiva y no mediada a las tecnologías digitales puede repercutir en aspectos relacionados con la atención, la memoria, el lenguaje, la autorregulación emocional y las interacciones sociales, factores directamente vinculados al aprendizaje. Por otro lado, se evidencia que los recursos digitales y los sistemas basados en inteligencia artificial pueden favorecer experiencias educativas más personalizadas e interactivas cuando se utilizan de manera intencional y con la mediación de adultos. Se concluye que los beneficios o perjuicios de estas tecnologías dependen menos de su presencia y más de las condiciones en que se incorporan a la rutina de los niños, destacándose la importancia de la actuación conjunta de la familia, la escuela y la psicopedagogía en la construcción de prácticas que promuevan un aprendizaje crítico, significativo y compatible con las necesidades del desarrollo infantil. Palabras clave: psicopedagogía; inteligencia artificial; tecnologías digitales; aprendizaje infantil; alfabetización.

papers.title: DEFICIÊNCIA INTELECTUAL: INTERVENÇÃO PSICOPEDAGÓGICA CLÍNICA PARA O SUCESSO DA APRENDIZAGEM
papers.authors: Alessandra Conceição Oliveira Lucena, Gisele do Rocio Cordeiro, CAMILA CASTELIANO PEREIRA DOS SANTOS
papers.abstract: A deficiência intelectual caracteriza-se por limitações significativas no funcionamento intelectual e no comportamento adaptativo, influenciando as habilidades conceituais, sociais e práticas do indivíduo. Nesse contexto, a intervenção psicopedagógica clínica desempenha papel fundamental na promoção da aprendizagem, da autonomia e da inclusão social, por meio de estratégias individualizadas que consideram as potencialidades e as necessidades específicas do sujeito. O presente estudo tem como objetivo compreender as contribuições da intervenção psicopedagógica clínica para o sucesso da aprendizagem de jovens com deficiência intelectual, analisando os aspectos cognitivos, emocionais e sociais que interferem nesse processo. Trata-se de uma pesquisa qualitativa, de caráter exploratório, desenvolvida por meio de revisão bibliográfica, com base em obras de autores como Piaget, Vygotsky, Fernández, Paín, Bossa e Visca, além de documentos relacionados à Educação Especial na perspectiva da Educação Inclusiva. A análise dos referenciais evidenciou que a aprendizagem da pessoa com deficiência intelectual não deve ser compreendida apenas sob uma perspectiva orgânica, mas como um fenômeno complexo que envolve múltiplos fatores e requer mediações adequadas. Os resultados apontam que a atuação psicopedagógica clínica favorece o desenvolvimento de habilidades cognitivas, sociais e funcionais, contribuindo para a construção da autonomia e da participação ativa do sujeito em diferentes contextos. Destaca-se ainda o potencial das tecnologias digitais e da inteligência artificial como recursos complementares capazes de ampliar a acessibilidade, personalizar estratégias de ensino e favorecer processos inclusivos, desde que utilizados de forma ética e articulados à mediação humana. Conclui-se que a intervenção psicopedagógica clínica, associada a práticas inclusivas e ao uso consciente das tecnologias educacionais, constitui importante instrumento para o desenvolvimento integral da pessoa com deficiência intelectual e para a efetivação do direito à aprendizagem. Palavras-chave: deficiência intelectual; psicopedagogia clínica; aprendizagem; educação inclusiva; inteligência artificial. Abstract Intellectual disability is characterized by significant limitations in intellectual functioning and adaptive behavior, affecting an individual's conceptual, social, and practical skills. In this context, clinical psychopedagogical intervention plays a fundamental role in promoting learning, autonomy, and social inclusion through individualized strategies that consider the person's strengths and specific needs. This study aims to understand the contributions of clinical psychopedagogical intervention to the learning success of young people with intellectual disabilities by analyzing the cognitive, emotional, and social aspects that influence this process. This is a qualitative, exploratory study developed through a bibliographic review based on the works of authors such as Piaget, Vygotsky, Fernández, Paín, Bossa, and Visca, as well as on documents related to Special Education from the perspective of Inclusive Education. The analysis of the literature revealed that the learning process of individuals with intellectual disabilities should not be understood solely from an organic perspective, but rather as a complex phenomenon involving multiple factors that require appropriate mediation. The findings indicate that clinical psychopedagogical practice fosters the development of cognitive, social, and functional skills, contributing to the construction of autonomy and the active participation of individuals in different contexts. The study also highlights the potential of digital technologies and artificial intelligence as complementary resources capable of enhancing accessibility, personalizing teaching strategies, and promoting inclusive processes, provided that they are used ethically and in conjunction with human mediation. It is concluded that clinical psychopedagogical intervention, associated with inclusive practices and the conscious use of educational technologies, constitutes an important instrument for the holistic development of individuals with intellectual disabilities and for ensuring their right to learn. - Keywords: intellectual disability; clinical psychopedagogy; learning; inclusive education; artificial intelligence. Resumen La discapacidad intelectual se caracteriza por limitaciones significativas en el funcionamiento intelectual y en el comportamiento adaptativo, influyendo en las habilidades conceptuales, sociales y prácticas del individuo. En este contexto, la intervención psicopedagógica clínica desempeña un papel fundamental en la promoción del aprendizaje, de la autonomía y de la inclusión social, mediante estrategias individualizadas que consideran las potencialidades y las necesidades específicas de la persona. El presente estudio tiene como objetivo comprender las contribuciones de la intervención psicopedagógica clínica al éxito del aprendizaje de jóvenes con discapacidad intelectual, analizando los aspectos cognitivos, emocionales y sociales que interfieren en este proceso. Se trata de una investigación cualitativa, de carácter exploratorio, desarrollada mediante una revisión bibliográfica, basada en las obras de autores como Piaget, Vygotsky, Fernández, Paín, Bossa y Visca, además de documentos relacionados con la Educación Especial desde la Perspectiva de la Educación Inclusiva. El análisis de los referentes teóricos evidenció que el aprendizaje de las personas con discapacidad intelectual no debe comprenderse únicamente desde una perspectiva orgánica, sino como un fenómeno complejo que involucra múltiples factores y requiere mediaciones adecuadas. Los resultados indican que la actuación psicopedagógica clínica favorece el desarrollo de habilidades cognitivas, sociales y funcionales, contribuyendo a la construcción de la autonomía y a la participación activa del sujeto en diferentes contextos. Asimismo, se destaca el potencial de las tecnologías digitales y de la inteligencia artificial como recursos complementarios capaces de ampliar la accesibilidad, personalizar las estrategias de enseñanza y favorecer procesos inclusivos, siempre que sean utilizados de manera ética y articulados con la mediación humana. Se concluye que la intervención psicopedagógica clínica, asociada a prácticas inclusivas y al uso consciente de las tecnologías educativas, constituye un importante instrumento para el desarrollo integral de las personas con discapacidad intelectual y para la garantía efectiva del derecho al aprendizaje. Palabras clave: discapacidad intelectual; psicopedagogía clínica; aprendizaje; educación inclusiva; inteligencia artificial.

papers.title: AVALIAÇÃO PSICOPEDAGÓGICA CLÍNICA NO TRANSTORNO DO ESPECTRO AUTISTA: CONTRIBUIÇÕES, MEDIAÇÃO AUMENTADA E INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL
papers.authors: Andréia Nogueira, Sandra Regina Bernardes de Oliveira Rosa
papers.abstract: Este artigo tem como objeto de estudo a avaliação psicopedagógica clínica no Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA). O objetivo é analisar suas contribuições para a compreensão dos processos de aprendizagem, articulando a Inteligência Artificial (IA) como eixo teórico e tema transversal. Trata-se de uma pesquisa qualitativa, bibliográfica e teórico-reflexiva, fundamentada em autores da Psicopedagogia, documentos legais sobre inclusão e proteção de dados e estudos sobre IA generativa aplicada à educação. Os resultados indicam que a avaliação deve ultrapassar a identificação de dificuldades, considerando aspectos cognitivos, comunicacionais, sensoriais, afetivos e contextuais. Conclui-se que a IA pode qualificar a prática psicopedagógica por meio de recursos de apoio à mediação e à adaptação pedagógica, desde que utilizada sob supervisão humana, com observância de critérios éticos e dos princípios da educação inclusiva. Palavras-chave: avaliação psicopedagógica clínica; Transtorno do Espectro Autista; inteligência artificial; mediação; inclusão. Abstract This article focuses on clinical psychopedagogical assessment in Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Its objective is to analyze the contributions of such assessment to the understanding of learning processes, while articulating Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a theoretical framework and cross-cutting themes. This is a qualitative, bibliographic, and theoretical-reflective study grounded in contributions from Psychopedagogy, legal documents concerning inclusion and data protection, and studies on the application of generative AI in education. The findings indicate that assessment should go beyond the identification of learning difficulties, considering cognitive, communicative, sensory, affective, and contextual aspects. It is concluded that AI can enhance psychopedagogical practice through resources that support mediation and pedagogical adaptation, provided that it is used under human supervision and in accordance with ethical standards and the principles of inclusive education. Keywords: clinical psychopedagogical assessment; Autism Spectrum Disorder; artificial intelligence; mediation; inclusion. Resumen Este artículo tiene como objeto de estudio la evaluación psicopedagógica clínica en el Trastorno del Espectro Autista (TEA). Su objetivo es analizar sus contribuciones para la comprensión de los procesos de aprendizaje, articulando la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) como eje teórico y tema transversal. Se trata de una investigación cualitativa, bibliográfica y teórico-reflexiva, fundamentada en autores de la Psicopedagogía, documentos legales sobre inclusión y protección de datos, y estudios sobre IA generativa aplicada a la educación. Los resultados indican que la evaluación debe ir más allá de la identificación de dificultades, considerando aspectos cognitivos, comunicativos, sensoriales, afectivos y contextuales. Se concluye que la IA puede mejorar la práctica psicopedagógica mediante recursos de apoyo a la mediación y la adaptación pedagógica, siempre que se utilice bajo supervisión humana, con observancia de criterios éticos y de los principios de la educación inclusiva. Palabras clave: evaluación psicopedagógica clínica; Trastorno del Espectro Autista; Inteligencia Artificial; mediación; inclusón.

papers.title: A INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL COMO FERRAMENTA DE APOIO À APRENDIZAGEM SIGNIFICATIVA: REFLEXÕES PSICOPEDAGÓGICAS
papers.authors: Lisandra Babireski Barcia da Silva, Sandra Regina Carvalho Okumura Okumura
papers.abstract: O desenvolvimento das tecnologias digitais e, mais recentemente, dos sistemas de Inteligência Artificial tem provocado transformações significativas nos processos de ensino e aprendizagem. Ferramentas capazes de produzir conteúdos, fornecer feedback, adaptar explicações, organizar informações e interagir em linguagem natural ampliam as possibilidades educacionais, mas também apresentam desafios relacionados à autonomia, autoria, ética, privacidade, confiabilidade das informações e dependência tecnológica. Este estudo tem como objetivo analisar as contribuições e os desafios da Inteligência Artificial para a promoção da aprendizagem significativa sob a perspectiva da Psicopedagogia. Trata-se de uma pesquisa qualitativa, de natureza bibliográfica e exploratória, fundamentada em autores clássicos da aprendizagem, do desenvolvimento cognitivo e da educação, como Ausubel, Vygotsky, Damasio, Gardner e Moran, articulados a estudos contemporâneos sobre Inteligência Artificial na educação, especialmente Holmes, Miao, Cukurova, Williamson, Lo, Hew e Jong. A discussão considera a Inteligência Artificial como ferramenta de apoio à personalização da aprendizagem, à elaboração de diferentes formas de representação do conhecimento, ao feedback, à motivação e à inclusão educacional. Simultaneamente, problematiza-se a utilização acrítica dessas ferramentas e a possibilidade de comprometimento do pensamento crítico e da autonomia do estudante. Defende-se que a Inteligência Artificial não substitui a mediação humana, mas pode ampliar as possibilidades de intervenção quando integrada a objetivos pedagógicos claros. Conclui-se que a Psicopedagogia possui papel relevante na articulação entre tecnologia, cognição, emoção e singularidade do aprendiz, contribuindo para uma utilização ética, crítica, inclusiva e humanizada da Inteligência Artificial. Palavras-chave: inteligência artificial; psicopedagogia; aprendizagem significativa; tecnologias digitais; mediação da aprendizagem. Abstract The development of digital technologies and, more recently, Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems has led to significant transformations in teaching and learning processes. Tools capable of generating content, providing feedback, adapting explanations, organizing information, and interacting through natural language have expanded educational possibilities. However, they also present challenges related to autonomy, authorship, ethics, privacy, information reliability, and technological dependency. This study aims to analyze the contributions and challenges of Artificial Intelligence in promoting meaningful learning from a psychopedagogical perspective. It is a qualitative, bibliographic, and exploratory study grounded in classical authors of learning, cognitive development, and education, including Ausubel, Vygotsky, Damasio, Gardner, and Moran, articulated with contemporary research on Artificial Intelligence in education, particularly the works of Holmes, Miao, Cukurova, Williamson, Lo, Hew, and Jong. The discussion considers Artificial Intelligence as a tool that supports personalized learning, enables multiple forms of knowledge representation, enhances feedback processes, promotes learner motivation, and contributes to educational inclusion. Simultaneously, the study problematizes the uncritical use of such technologies and the potential risks they pose to the development of students’ critical thinking and autonomy. It is argued that Artificial Intelligence does not replace human mediation; rather, it can expand possibilities for educational intervention when integrated into clearly defined pedagogical objectives. The study concludes that Psychopedagogy plays a relevant role in connecting technology, cognition, emotion, and the learner’s individuality, contributing to an ethical, critical, inclusive, and human-centered use of Artificial Intelligence. Keywords: artificial intelligence; psychopedagogy; meaningful learning; digital technologies; learning mediation. Resumen El desarrollo de las tecnologías digitales y, más recientemente, de los sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial ha provocado transformaciones significativas en los procesos de enseñanza y aprendizaje. Las herramientas capaces de generar contenidos, proporcionar retroalimentación, adaptar explicaciones, organizar información e interactuar mediante lenguaje natural amplían las posibilidades educativas, pero también presentan desafíos relacionados con la autonomía, la autoría, la ética, la privacidad, la confiabilidad de la información y la dependencia tecnológica. Este estudio tiene como objetivo analizar las contribuciones y los desafíos de la Inteligencia Artificial para la promoción del aprendizaje significativo desde la perspectiva de la psicopedagogía. Se trata de una investigación cualitativa, de naturaleza bibliográfica y exploratoria, fundamentada en autores clásicos del aprendizaje, del desarrollo cognitivo y de la educación, como Ausubel, Vygotsky, Damasio, Gardner y Moran, articulados con estudios contemporáneos sobre Inteligencia Artificial en la educación, especialmente Holmes, Miao, Cukurova, Williamson, Lo, Hew y Jong. La discusión considera la Inteligencia Artificial como una herramienta de apoyo para la personalización del aprendizaje, la elaboración de diferentes formas de representación del conocimiento, la retroalimentación, la motivación y la inclusión educativa. Simultáneamente, se problematiza el uso acrítico de estas herramientas y la posibilidad de que comprometan el pensamiento crítico y la autonomía del estudiante. Se defiende que la Inteligencia Artificial no sustituye la mediación humana, sino que puede ampliar las posibilidades de intervención cuando se integra en objetivos pedagógicos claramente definidos. Se concluye que la psicopedagogía desempeña un papel relevante en la articulación entre tecnología, cognición, emoción y singularidad del aprendiz, contribuyendo a un uso ético, crítico, inclusivo y humanizado de la Inteligencia Artificial. Palabras clave: inteligencia artificial; psicopedagogía; aprendizaje significativo; tecnologías digitales; mediación del aprendizaje.
keywords: digital technologies in teaching and learning

papers.title: JOGOS E BRINCADEIRAS COMO FERRAMENTAS PSICOPEDAGÓGICAS: INOVAÇÕES COM O USO DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL
papers.authors: Brenda Victoria Manzoni Cunha, Lisandra Barbireski Barcia da Silva
papers.abstract: Este estudo tem como objetivo analisar a utilização de jogos e brincadeiras como ferramentas psicopedagógicas no processo de aprendizagem infantil, considerando as possibilidades de inovação proporcionadas pelo uso da Inteligência Artificial (IA), para o desenvolvimento cognitivo, social e motor de crianças, particularmente no contexto escolar. A pesquisa busca compreender de que maneira os jogos e brincadeiras podem ser utilizados como instrumentos de intervenção psicopedagógica e como os recursos tecnológicos baseados em Inteligência Artificial podem contribuir para a criação, a adaptação e a personalização dessas atividades de acordo com as necessidades de cada criança. Trata-se de uma pesquisa de abordagem qualitativa, de caráter exploratório e bibliográfico, fundamentada em estudos relacionados à ludicidade, à aprendizagem, à psicopedagogia e às tecnologias educacionais. As contribuições teóricas de Jean Piaget, Lev Vygotsky e Loris Malaguzzi são consideradas para compreender a importância do brincar no desenvolvimento infantil. Palavras-chave: psicopedagogia; jogos; brincadeiras; ludicidade; inteligência artificial; aprendizagem. Abstract This study aims to analyze the use of games and play-based activities as psychopedagogical tools in children's learning, considering the innovative possibilities offered by artificial intelligence (AI) to promote cognitive, social, and motor development, particularly within the school environment. The study further seeks to examine how games and playful activities can be employed as psychopedagogical intervention strategies and how AI-based technological resources can contribute to the creation, adaptation, and personalization of these activities according to the individual needs of each child. This study employs a qualitative, exploratory, and bibliographic approach, drawing upon research on playfulness, learning, Psychopedagogy, and educational technologies. The theoretical contributions of Jean Piaget, Lev Vygotsky, and Loris Malaguzzi provide the foundation for understanding the role of play in child development. The findings underscore the potential of integrating playful methodologies with artificial intelligence to create more engaging, inclusive, and personalized learning experiences, thereby fostering children's holistic development. Keywords: Psychopedagogy; games; play-based activities; playfulness; artificial intelligence; learning. Resumen Este estudio tiene como objetivo analizar el uso de juegos y actividades lúdicas como herramientas psicopedagógicas en el proceso de aprendizaje infantil, considerando las posibilidades de innovación que ofrece la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) para el desarrollo cognitivo, social y motor de los niños, especialmente en el contexto escolar. La investigación busca comprender de qué manera los juegos y las actividades lúdicas pueden emplearse como instrumentos de intervención psicopedagógica y cómo los recursos tecnológicos basados en Inteligencia Artificial pueden contribuir a la creación, adaptación y personalización de dichas actividades, de acuerdo con las necesidades específicas de cada niño. Se trata de una investigación de enfoque cualitativo, de carácter exploratorio y bibliográfico, sustentada en estudios relacionados con las actividades lúdicas, el aprendizaje, la psicopedagogía y las tecnologías educativas. Asimismo, se consideran las contribuciones teóricas de Jean Piaget, Lev Vygotsky y Loris Malaguzzi para comprender la importancia del juego en el desarrollo infantil. En este contexto, se destaca el potencial de la integración entre las metodologías lúdicas y la Inteligencia Artificial para favorecer experiencias de aprendizaje más significativas, inclusivas y personalizadas, contribuyendo al desarrollo integral de los niños. Palabras clave: psicopedagogía; juegos; actividades lúdicas; ludicidad; inteligencia artificial; aprendizaje.

papers.title: CARTAS, DESAFIOS E RECOMPENSAS: A GAMIFICAÇÃO NO ENSINO DE LÍNGUA INGLESA E A PERSONALIZAÇÃO DA APRENDIZAGEM POR MEIO DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL GENERATIVA
papers.authors: Marisa Cleff
papers.abstract: Este artigo analisa de que maneira a gamificação, articulada à personalização possibilitada pela inteligência artificial generativa, pode contribuir para o engajamento e a aprendizagem em aulas de língua inglesa. Diante de um cenário educacional marcado pela cultura digital e pelo desafio de superar metodologias centradas na transmissão de conteúdos, desenvolveu-se uma pesquisa de abordagem qualitativa, de natureza exploratória e de caráter bibliográfico, com a análise da literatura organizada em dois eixos: a gamificação no ensino de língua inglesa e a inteligência artificial generativa como recurso de personalização da aprendizagem. Como resultado, apresenta-se uma proposta pedagógica baseada no recurso Question Answer, composto por cartas físicas e digitais de perguntas e respostas voltadas aos níveis iniciais de proficiência em língua inglesa (A1.1 e A1.2), cuja aplicação gamificada com desafios, feedback imediato, progressão e recompensas, pode ser ampliada pela inteligência artificial generativa por meio da criação de novos desafios, da adaptação dos níveis de dificuldade e da geração de percursos personalizados de aprendizagem. Conclui-se que a articulação entre gamificação e inteligência artificial generativa representa uma possibilidade promissora para o ensino de língua inglesa, desde que orientada por intencionalidade pedagógica, pelo uso ético das tecnologias e pela centralidade da mediação docente. Palavras-chave: gamificação; inteligência artificial generativa; ensino de língua inglesa; personalização da aprendizagem. Abstract This article analyzes how gamification, combined with the personalization afforded by generative artificial intelligence, can contribute to engagement and learning in English language classes. In an educational context shaped by digital culture and by the challenge of moving beyond transmission-based methodologies, a qualitative, exploratory, bibliographic study was conducted. The literature review was organized around two thematic axes: gamification in English language teaching and generative artificial intelligence as a resource for personalizing learning. As a result, the article presents a pedagogical proposal based on the Question Answer resource, consisting of physical and digital question-and-answer cards designed for beginner proficiency levels (A1.1 and A1.2). Its gamified implementation, incorporating challenges, immediate feedback, progression, and rewards, can be further enhanced through generative AI by creating new challenges, adapting difficulty levels, and generating personalized learning paths. The study concludes that the integration of gamification and generative artificial intelligence represents a promising approach to English language teaching, provided that it is guided by pedagogical intentionality, the ethical use of technology, and the central role of teacher mediation. Keywords: gamification; generative artificial intelligence; English language teaching; personalized learning. Resumen Este artículo analiza de qué manera la gamificación, articulada con la personalizacó posibilitada por la Inteligencia Aritifical Generativa, puede contribuir al compromise y al aprendizaje en las clases de lengua inglesa. Ante un scenario educativo marcado por la cultura digital y pore la desafío de supercar metodologías centradas en la transmission de contenidos, se desarrolló una investigación de enfoque cualitativo, de naturaleza exploratoria y de carácter bibliográfico, con un análisis de la literature organizado en dos ejes: la gamificación en la enseñaza de la lengua inglesa y la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa como recurso para la personalización del aprendizaje. Como resultado, se presenta una propuesta pedagógica basada en el recurso Question Answer, compuesto por tarjetas físicas y digitales de preguntas y respuestas dirigidas a los niveles iniciales de domínio de la lengua inglesa (A1.1 y A1.2), cuyaaplicación gamificada, con desafios, feedback inmediato, progression y recompensas, puede ampliarse mediante la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa a través de la creación de nuevos desafíos, la adaptación de los niveles de dificuldad y la generación de itineraries personalizados de apredizaje. Se concluye que la articulación entre la gamificación y la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa representa una posibilidad prometedora para la enseñaza de la lengua inglesa, siempre que esté orientada por una intencionalidad pedagógica, por el uso ético de las tecnologías y por la centralidad de la mediación docente. Palabras clave: gamificación; inteligencia artificial generativa; enseñanza de la lengua inglesa; personalizaión del aprendizaje.

papers.title: PERSONAS, PERSONAGENS FICCIONAIS E INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL: A PERSONA COMO PEDRA ANGULAR DO DESENVOLVIMENTO ÉTICO DE CHATBOTS E SISTEMAS DE IA
papers.authors: Pietra de Oliveira Frizzera, Danielle Fracaro da Cruz, Rogério Pereira da Cunha
papers.abstract: Este artigo propõe uma aproximação entre os estudos literários e o design conversacional para discutir a construção ética de personas em chatbots baseados em regras e em grandes modelos de linguagem. Parte-se da hipótese de que conceitos usados na criação de personagens ficcionais — sobretudo verossimilhança, motivação e relação entre objetivos internos e externos — ajudam a compreender por que certos agentes parecem coerentes, confiáveis e capazes de estabelecer vínculos com os usuários. A pesquisa é qualitativa, exploratória e bibliográfica, reunindo trabalhos de teoria da personagem, interação humano-computador, antropomorfização, relações parassociais e ética da inteligência artificial. A análise mostra que a persona não funciona apenas como recurso de humanização ou estratégia de marketing: é nela que escolhas sobre identidade, linguagem, limites e formas de resposta se tornam perceptíveis durante a interação. Essa mesma coerência, contudo, pode ampliar a persuasão e o apego afetivo. Por isso, o desenvolvimento de personas exige transparência, proteção dos públicos vulneráveis e mecanismos que impeçam a exploração comercial da confiança. Conclui-se que os estudos literários oferecem instrumentos importantes ao design conversacional, embora não substituam medidas técnicas, institucionais e regulatórias de segurança. Palavras-chave: chatbot; inteligência artificial; persona; personagem ficcional; antropomorfização; relações parassociais. Abstract This article proposes a dialogue between literary studies and conversational design to discuss the ethical construction of personas in rule-based chatbots and large language model systems. It starts from the hypothesis that concepts used to create fictional characters — especially verisimilitude, motivation, and the relationship between internal and external goals — help explain why some agents appear coherent, trustworthy, and capable of forming bonds with users. The study adopts a qualitative, exploratory, and bibliographic approach, drawing on character theory, human-computer interaction, anthropomorphism, parasocial relationships, and artificial intelligence ethics. The analysis shows that persona is not merely a humanization device or a marketing strategy: it is the layer in which choices concerning identity, language, limits, and response patterns become perceptible during interaction. Such coherence, however, may also increase persuasion and affective attachment. Persona development therefore requires transparency, protection for vulnerable users, and safeguards against the commercial exploitation of trust. Literary studies provide valuable tools for conversational design, although they do not replace technical, institutional, and regulatory measures for safety. Keywords: chatbot; artificial intelligence; persona; fictional character; anthropomorphism; AI ethics; parasocial relationships. Resumen Este artículo propone un diálogo entre los estudios literarios y el diseño conversacional para discutir la construcción ética de personas en chatbots basados en reglas y en grandes modelos de lenguaje. Se parte de la hipótesis de que los conceptos utilizados en la creación de personajes ficcionales —especialmente la verosimilitud, la motivación y la relación entre objetivos internos y externos— ayudan a comprender por qué ciertos agentes parecen coherentes, confiables y capaces de establecer vínculos con los usuarios. La investigación es cualitativa, exploratoria y bibliográfica, y reúne estudios sobre teoría del personaje, interacción humano-computadora, antropomorfización, relaciones parasociales y ética de la inteligencia artificial. El análisis muestra que la persona no funciona únicamente como recurso de humanización o estrategia de marketing: en ella se hacen perceptibles las decisiones sobre identidad, lenguaje, límites y formas de respuesta. Sin embargo, esa misma coherencia puede aumentar la persuasión y el apego afectivo. Por ello, el desarrollo de personas exige transparencia, protección de los públicos vulnerables y salvaguardias contra la explotación comercial de la confianza. Se concluye que los estudios literarios aportan instrumentos importantes al diseño conversacional, aunque no sustituyen las medidas técnicas, institucionales y regulatorias de seguridad. Palabras clave: chatbot; inteligencia artificial; persona; personaje ficcional; antropomorfización; relaciones parasociales.

papers.title: O SIMULACRO DO LOGOS: ANÁLISE TEOLÓGICA DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL EM CONTRASTE COM A DOUTRINA DA ENCARNAÇÃO
papers.authors: Tiago Teixeira Vieira
papers.abstract: Este artigo, originado de trabalho de conclusão do curso de Bacharelado em Teologia, examina teologicamente a Inteligência Artificial (IA) à luz da Doutrina da Encarnação e da antropologia teológica fundada na imago Dei. A pesquisa, de natureza bibliográfica e abordagem hermenêutico-dedutiva, mobiliza a Sagrada Escritura, a tradição patrístico-tomista (Agostinho, Tomás de Aquino), a Teologia Sistemática contemporânea em chave interconfessional (Tillich, Barth, Bonhoeffer, Pannenberg, Ratzinger), as elaborações teológico-literárias de Tolkien e Lewis e os documentos magisteriais recentes: a Nota Antiqua et Nova (2025) e a Carta Encíclica Magnifica Humanitas (2026). A análise sustenta que a IA configura uma subcriação técnica desprovida de imago Dei, incapaz de receber o sopro vital e impossibilitada de encarnar o Logos, e localiza o risco teológico contemporâneo na sacralização do artefato: a transferência indevida ao algoritmo de prerrogativas que pertencem à pessoa humana e, em última instância, a Deus. O artigo conclui discutindo as implicações formativas e pastorais da delegação do juízo humano a sistemas automatizados em ambientes educacionais e eclesiais. Palavras-chave: inteligência artificial; doutrina da encarnação; imago Dei; Magnifica Humanitas; teologia sistemática. Abstract This article, originating from an undergraduate thesis in theology, theologically examines artificial intelligence (AI) in light of the doctrine of the Incarnation and the theological anthropology grounded in the imago Dei. The research, bibliographic in nature and hermeneutic-deductive in approach, draws on Sacred Scripture, the patristic-thomistic tradition (Augustine and Thomas Aquinas), contemporary systematic theology in an interconfessional key (Tillich, Barth, Bonhoeffer, Pannenberg and Ratzinger), the theological-literary elaborations of Tolkien and Lewis, and recent magisterial documents: the Note Antiqua et Nova (2025) and the Encyclical Letter Magnifica Humanitas (2026). The analysis argues that AI constitutes a technical sub-creation devoid of the imago Dei, incapable of receiving the breath of life and unable to incarnate the logos, and locates the contemporary theological risk in the sacralization of the artifact: the undue transfer to the algorithm of prerogatives that belong to the human person and, ultimately, to God. The article concludes by discussing the formative and pastoral implications of delegating human judgment to automated systems in educational and ecclesial settings. Keywords: artificial intelligence; doctrine of the incarnation; imago Dei; Magnifica Humanitas; systematic theology. Resumen Este artículo, derivado de un trabajo de fin de grado en Teología, examina teológicamente la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) a la luz de la Doctrina de la Encarnación y de la antropología teológica fundamentada en la imago Dei. La investigación, de carácter bibliográfico y con un enfoque hermenéutico-deductivo, recurre a la Sagrada Escritura, a la tradición patrístico-tomista (Agustín y Tomás de Aquino), a la Teología Sistemática contemporánea en clave interconfesional (Tillich, Barth, Bonhoeffer, Pannenberg y Ratzinger), a las elaboraciones teológico-literarias de Tolkien y Lewis, y a documentos magisteriales recientes: la Nota Antiqua et Nova (2025) y la Carta Encíclica Magnifica Humanitas (2026). El análisis sostiene que la IA constituye una subcreación técnica desprovista de imago Dei, incapaz de recibir el aliento vital e imposibilitada para encarnar el Logos. Asimismo, identifica el riesgo teológico contemporáneo en la sacralización del artefacto: la transferencia indebida al algoritmo de prerrogativas que pertenecen a la persona humana y, en última instancia, a Dios. El artículo concluye examinando las implicaciones formativas y pastorales de la delegación del juicio humano a sistemas automatizados en contextos educativos y eclesiales. Palabras clave: Inteligencia Artificial; Doctrina de la Encarnación; imago Dei; Magnifica Humanitas; Teología Sistemática.

papers.title: USOS DE INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL POR PROFESSORES DE MATEMÁTICA: UMA REVISÃO SISTEMÁTICA
papers.authors: Adrianny de Sousa Lopes, Vanessa De Paula Correa, Yasmin de Souza Martins, Gisele Sousa Brasileiro, Ana Paula de Andrade Janz Elias
papers.abstract: A Inteligência Artificial (IA) tem ocupado espaço crescente na educação matemática, oferecendo novas possibilidades para o planejamento docente. Diante desse cenário, este estudo teve como objetivo identificar de que maneira a IA tem sido utilizada por professores de matemática que atuam nos Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e no Ensino Médio. Para isso, foi realizada uma revisão sistemática da literatura na base de dados ERIC, abrangendo o período de fevereiro a maio de 2026. A busca inicial resultou em 246 artigos, dos quais 12 atenderam aos critérios de inclusão e compuseram o corpo final da análise. A análise temática permitiu identificar duas categorias principais: percepções docentes sobre a IA no ensino de matemática e uso da IA para O planejamento de aulas. Os resultados indicam que a IA tem sido utilizada principalmente para auxiliar na elaboração de materiais didáticos, atividades, exercícios e planos de aula, contribuindo para a otimização do tempo de planejamento. Os estudos também evidenciam que os professores reconhecem o potencial da IA para personalizar o ensino e apoiar a aprendizagem, embora manifestem preocupações relacionadas à confiabilidade das respostas, à dependência tecnológica, à privacidade dos dados e à necessidade de formação específica. Conclui-se que a IA apresenta potencial significativo para apoiar o ensino de matemática, desde que utilizada de forma crítica, ética e mediada pelo professor. Palavras-chave: inteligência artificial; educação matemática; planejamento docente; revisão sistemática. Abstract Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been playing an increasingly significant role in mathematics education, offering new possibilities for instructional planning. Against this backdrop, this study aimed to identify how AI has been used by mathematics teachers working in the final years of elementary school and in high school. To this end, a systematic literature review was conducted in the ERIC database, covering the period from February to May 2026. The initial search yielded 246 articles, of which 12 met the inclusion criteria and comprised the final body of the analysis. The thematic analysis identified two main categories: teachers’ perceptions of AI in mathematics education and the use of AI for lesson planning. The results indicate that AI has been used primarily to assist in the development of teaching materials, activities, exercises, and lesson plans, contributing to the optimization of planning time. The studies also show that teachers recognize AI’s potential to personalize instruction and support learning, although they express concerns regarding the reliability of responses, technological dependence, data privacy, and the need for specific training. It is concluded that AI has significant potential to support mathematics education, provided it is used critically, ethically, and under teacher supervision. Keywords: artificial intelligence; mathematics education; lesson planning; systematic review. Resumen La inteligencia artificial (IA) ha adquirido una presencia creciente en la educación matemática, ofreciendo nuevas posibilidades para la planificación docente. Ante este escenario, este estudio tuvo como objetivo identificar de qué manera la IA ha sido utilizada por profesores de matemáticas que trabajan en los últimos años de la educación primaria y en la educación secundaria. Para ello, se realizó una revisión sistemática de la literatura en la base de datos ERIC, abarcando el período de febrero a mayo de 2026. La búsqueda inicial arrojó 246 artículos, de los cuales 12 cumplieron con los criterios de inclusión y conformaron el corpus final del análisis. El análisis temático permitió identificar dos categorías principales: percepciones docentes sobre la IA en la enseñanza de las matemáticas y uso de la IA para la planificación de clases. Los resultados indican que la IA se ha utilizado principalmente para ayudar en la elaboración de materiales didácticos, actividades, ejercicios y planes de clase, contribuyendo a la optimización del tiempo de planificación. Los estudios también evidencian que los profesores reconocen el potencial de la IA para personalizar la enseñanza y apoyar el aprendizaje, aunque manifiestan preocupaciones relacionadas con la fiabilidad de las respuestas, la dependencia tecnológica, la privacidad de los datos y la necesidad de formación específica. Se concluye que la IA presenta un potencial significativo para apoyar la enseñanza de las matemáticas, siempre que se utilice de manera crítica, ética y mediada por el profesor. Palabras clave: inteligencia artificial; educación matemática; planificación docente; revisión sistemática.

papers.title: Youth Co-Design of an Artificial Intelligence–Powered Chatbot for Comprehensive Sexuality Education in Canada: Protocol for a Community-Based Participatory Study (Preprint)
papers.authors: Neelam Saleem Punjani, Amber Hussain, Lise Milne, Oluwabukola Oladunni Salami, Abdul‐Fatawu Abdulai, Saima Shams Hirani, Kristopher Wells, Carmen H. Logie, Shannon D. Scott
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Young people increasingly seek sexual health information through digital technologies, particularly when sensitive questions are difficult to discuss with parents, educators, or health care professionals. Conversational artificial intelligence may offer a private, immediate, and accessible way to obtain information through natural-language interactions. However, generative artificial intelligence systems can produce inaccurate, unsupported, biased, or developmentally inappropriate responses, creating important safety concerns for adolescents and young adults. Although conversational agents have been investigated for sexual and reproductive health, qualitative and participatory studies remain among the least represented in this literature and less is known about how diverse youth can be meaningfully engaged throughout the design of generative artificial intelligence systems intended to provide sensitive health information. OBJECTIVE This study aims to engage youth in the co-design and evaluation of an artificial intelligence–powered chatbot intended to provide safe, reliable, inclusive, and evidence-based comprehensive sexuality education to youth aged 15-24 years in Canada. Specifically, the study will identify youths’ sexual health information and support needs, engage youth in chatbot development, and evaluate the prototype’s usability, acceptability, perceived safety, and utility. METHODS This multiphase study is guided by community-based participatory research and informed by intersectionality and user-centered design. In phase 1, a National Youth Advisory Group (N-YAG) of approximately 10-12 youth aged 15-24 years will be established and will remain engaged across all subsequent phases, contributing to study implementation, co-development of the focus group guide, interpretation of findings, chatbot development, usability assessment, and knowledge mobilization. Phase 2 will involve 8-10 virtual focus groups with approximately 80-100 youth aged 15-24 years residing in Canada to explore sexual health information-seeking experiences, unmet needs, barriers to accessing information and support, and expectations of conversational artificial intelligence. In phase 3, qualitative findings and vetted sexual health resources will inform development of a curated knowledge base, which will be validated by a panel of 3-5 content experts using content validity indices and reviewed by the N-YAG, and then integrated into a chatbot prototype using retrieval-augmented generation. In phase 4, approximately 30-60 youth will use the prototype for approximately 2 days and participate in usability testing combining virtual focus groups with standardized rating scales, including the System Usability Scale and the user version of the Mobile Application Rating Scale, alongside study-developed items addressing inclusivity, perceived safety, and trust. Qualitative data will be analyzed using the DEPICT participatory analysis model and managed using NVivo. Rating-scale data will be summarized descriptively, and open-ended responses will be analyzed thematically. The study received ethics approval from the University of Alberta Research Ethics Board (Pro00164574). RESULTS Recruitment is expected to begin in November 2026. Data collection across all 4 phases is anticipated to conclude in March 2027. Initial study findings are expected to be disseminated and submitted for publication in fall 2027. CONCLUSIONS This study places young people within the design and interpretation processes of an artificial intelligence–supported sexual health intervention. Integrating participatory research with a validated sexual health knowledge base and retrieval-augmented generation may provide practical insights into the development of safer and more inclusive conversational artificial intelligence for developmentally sensitive health information. CLINICALTRIAL NA

papers.title: Artificial intelligence co-creation of e-learning tools, a pilot trial of a targeted fidelity training simulator for relative afferent pupillary defects (Preprint)
papers.authors: Wesley KX McLoughlin, Muhammad Asyraaf Bin Ismail, James Welch
papers.abstract: UNSTRUCTURED Artificial intelligence co-creation of simulators has received little attention, in this study, we evaluate the ability of this methodology to create a unique simulator to aid learning about an important, uncommon clinical sign.

papers.title: Perfiles y usos de la Inteligencia Artificial por Profesionales de Biblioteca y Académicos en los Servicios de Apoyo a la Investigación de una Universidad Estatal
papers.authors: Yerko Cubillos Figueroa
papers.journal: Revista de Estudios y Experiencias en Educación
papers.abstract: This research aims to determine the characteristics and perceptions of library professionals and academics at a state university regarding the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in research support services. This study is framed within a context of digital transformation that significantly impacts higher education institutions, where AI emerges as a key tool for optimizing academic and information management processes. This descriptive study is framed within a positivist/post-positivist paradigm. The research method is quantitative with a non-experimental, cross-sectional methodological design. The sample consists of library professionals from the Arica campus (n=8) and academics from the state university (n=75). The data collection instrument was a survey. The results indicate that both library professionals and academics recognize the potential of AI to improve tasks such as data management, information retrieval, and assistance in academic writing. However, they also express concerns related to the need for specialized training, ethical considerations, and the potential automation of functions that could affect the nature of their professional roles. In conclusion, the appropriate implementation of AI-based tools in Research Support services requires not only embracing emerging technologies but also institutional strategies that address staff training, ethical use of technology, and the redefinition of professional roles. This study contributes to the understanding of the challenges and opportunities that AI presents in academia and library science, providing a foundation for future research and institutional policies in this area.

papers.title: UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLES AND THE INTERNET OF THINGS IN AGRICULTURE: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW OF TECHNOLOGICAL DIRECTIONS AND DEVELOPMENT PROSPECTS
papers.authors: Volodymyr Panchenko, Георгій Кучук
papers.abstract: Relevance. Modern agriculture is undergoing a profound cyber-physical transformation driven by the need to shift from extensive to precision, high-accuracy, and environmentally balanced production methods. The technological foundation of this transition is the integration of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and wireless Internet of Things (IoT) sensor networks, which together form the concept of Agriculture 5.0. Despite the rapid growth of publications on this topic, the accumulated body of research remains fragmented across directions (computer vision, network technologies, robotics, adoption economics), which complicates the formation of a holistic picture of the field and of priority directions for further research. The subject of this study are methods and technologies of applying UAVs and IoT networks to precision-agriculture tasks. The purpose of the article to systematize and classify current scientific research on the use of UAVs and IoT in agriculture, and to determine the leading technological directions, their quantitative proportions, and promising development vectors. The following results were obtained. A total of 198 scientific publications from 2024-2026 were processed and classified into seven thematic classes: crop health and biological threat monitoring, hardware engineering, edge computing and spraying, navigation, swarm intelligence and data collection, phenotyping, biomass and yield forecasting, soil science, water balance and precision irrigation, economics, ecology and socio-cultural perception, and specialized agrotechnical operations. For each class, consolidated tables of applied methods and results, as well as diagrams revealing the internal structure of the direction, were constructed. The dominance of navigation/swarm-control tasks and biological-threat monitoring was identified, along with key technical barriers (limited battery energy density, beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight regulations, and fragmentation of data-exchange standards). Conclusion. The obtained results provide a holistic assessment of the state and structure of the research field on UAV and IoT applications in agriculture and can serve as a basis for shaping further research programs and educational courses in precision agriculture. Future research directions concern improving the energy autonomy of platforms, standardizing data-exchange protocols, and developing edge artificial-intelligence models resilient to complex field conditions.

papers.title: METHODS OF TEACHING HUMANITIES UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: TEACHERS' PERCEPTION THROUGH THE LENS OF NEW OPPORTUNITIES
papers.authors: Ludmila Ivanovna Zharkova
papers.journal: Veredas do Direito Direito Ambiental e Desenvolvimento Sustentável
papers.abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the practices and beliefs of humanities teachers at Russian universities in connection with the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the educational process. With humanities being a heterogeneous block of disciplines, the question of whether disciplinary specificity determines teachers' perception of AI has only recently become a point of scrutiny. For the purposes of analysis, the disciplines were divided into two clusters: text-centric (philology and linguistics, history, and philosophy; n=58) and practice-oriented (pedagogy and psychology; n=36). The results indicate that the clusters are similar in the perception of institutional deficits but differ significantly in the use of AI and in its assessment as a didactic tool. Teachers of text-centric disciplines were much more inclined to use AI to generate assignments and work with texts, expressed more acute concern about threats to academic integrity, and yet more often saw AI as a potential heuristic tool.

papers.title: Digital Revolution: How Chatbots Increase Revenue for MSMEs in Banten Province
